mv-qi-zhi-ge.title: 漆之歌
mv-qi-zhi-ge.remark: 从甲骨之「七」到大漆非遗，再到李子柒的漆柜：一条字链串起古今。

ddj-boshu.title: 道德经帛书本
ddj-boshu.remark: 1973年马王堆出土，含甲、乙两本，约公元前194年抄写，是现存较早的较完整抄本。实物帛书为《德经》在前、《道经》在后；此处章次暂依传世本以便对照。异文如：非常道→非恒道、大器晚成→大器免成、与善仁→予善天等。

mv-qi-qiyushi.title: 七与十
mv-qi-qiyushi.remark: 甲骨文中七、十的字形来源、演变、为什么容易混淆，以及为什么用现代/小篆形区分二者。

mv-qi-qiyuqi.title: 七与柒
mv-qi-qiyuqi.remark: 从七进入柒：重点讲七古形与割的动作之间的联系，从数字进入动作。

mv-qi-qiyuxi.remark: 柒＝割木取漆的动作 → 桼＝割木所得的漆；以桼为树根展开厀、㓼、漆、膝等字族。

mv-qi-daqi.title: 大漆
mv-qi-daqi.remark: 从漆进入大漆非遗：采漆、制漆、髹漆、打磨、推光、描金、螺钿等传统工艺。

mv-qi-qiguiyin.remark: 回到李子柒和奶奶的旧衣柜：大漆修复让古艺重回生活；「柒」正好是这条字链的回环。

ddj-bs-ch-01.pinyin: dao4 ke3 dao4 ye3， fei1 heng2 dao4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 道可道也，非恒道也。
interpretations.explanation: 可以说出来的「道」，就不是那永恒不变的道。帛书用「恒」字，传世本多作「常」（避汉文帝刘恒讳）。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

terms.explanation: 本源、规律；此处指终极之「道」。
可以说、可以用言语称说。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way.

ddj-bs-ch-01.pinyin: ming2 ke3 ming2 ye3， fei1 heng2 ming2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 名可名也，非恒名也。
interpretations.explanation: 可以命名、固定下来的「名」，就不是那永恒的名。与上句「道／名」对举。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The name that can be named is not the constant name.

ddj-bs-ch-01.pinyin: wu2 ming2， wan4 wu4 zhi1 shi3 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 无名，万物之始也。
interpretations.explanation: 「无名」即万物（天地）之始。帛书此句作「万物之始」，传世本常见「天地之始」。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The nameless is the beginning of the myriad things.

ddj-bs-ch-01.pinyin: you3 ming2， wan4 wu4 zhi1 mu3 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有名，万物之母也。
interpretations.explanation: 「有名」即万物之母——有规定性的一面，是万物生成之所依。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The named is the mother of the myriad things.

ddj-bs-ch-01.content: 故恒无欲也，以观其妙，恒有欲也，以观其所徼。
ddj-bs-ch-01.pinyin: gu4 heng2 wu2 yu4 ye3， yi3 guan1 qi2 miao4， heng2 you3 yu4 ye3， yi3 guan1 qi2 suo3 jiao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 故恒无欲也，以观其妙，恒有欲也，以观其所徼。
interpretations.explanation: 常从「无欲」观其精微，从「有欲」观其边界／显现。帛书「恒无欲／恒有欲」连写于一句。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

terms.explanation: 恒常地有所指向、有欲求。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore, constantly without desire, observe its subtlety; constantly with desire, observe its manifestations.

ddj-bs-ch-01.content: 两者同出，异名同谓，玄之又玄，众妙之门。
ddj-bs-ch-01.pinyin: liang3 zhe3 tong2 chu1， yi4 ming2 tong2 wei4， xuan2 zhi1 you4 xuan2， zhong4 miao4 zhi1 men2。

interpretations.segmentation: 两者同出，异名同谓，玄之又玄，众妙之门。
interpretations.explanation: 无欲／有欲，妙／徼，同出而异名，同谓之玄；玄之又玄，是众妙所出之门。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

terms.explanation: 妙与徼、无与有同出一源。

terms.note: 帛书作「同谓」；传世本或作「同谓之玄」。

interpretations.segmentation: These two emerge together—different names for the same calling; mystery upon mystery, the gateway of all subtleties.

ddj-bs-ch-02.pinyin: tian1 xia4 jie1 zhi1 mei3、 wei4 mei3， e4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下皆知美、为美，恶已。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When all under Heaven know beauty as beauty, then ugliness is already there;

ddj-bs-ch-02.pinyin: jie1 zhi1 shan4， si1 bu4 shan4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 皆知善，斯不善矣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When all know good as good, then what is not good is already there.

ddj-bs-ch-02.pinyin: you3， wu2 zhi1 xiang1 sheng1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有，无之相生也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Being and non-being give birth to each other;

ddj-bs-ch-02.pinyin: nan2， yi4 zhi1 xiang1 cheng2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 难，易之相成也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Difficult and easy complete each other;

ddj-bs-ch-02.pinyin: zhang3， duan3 zhi1 xiang1 xing2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 长，短之相形也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Long and short shape each other;

ddj-bs-ch-02.pinyin: gao1， xia4 zhi1 xiang1 ying2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 高，下之相盈也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: High and low fill each other;

ddj-bs-ch-02.pinyin: yin1， sheng1 zhi1 xiang1 he2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 音，声之相和也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Tone and voice harmonize with each other;

ddj-bs-ch-02.pinyin: xian1， hou4 zhi1 xiang1 sui2， heng2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 先，后之相随，恒也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Before and after follow each other—this is constant.

ddj-bs-ch-02.content: 是以圣人居无为之事，行不言之教。
ddj-bs-ch-02.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 ju1 wu2 wei4 zhi1 shi4， xing2 bu4 yan2 zhi1 jiao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人居无为之事，行不言之教。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage abides in affairs of non-action and practices the teaching without words.

ddj-bs-ch-02.content: 万物作而弗始也，为而弗恃也，成功而弗居也。
ddj-bs-ch-02.pinyin: wan4 wu4 zuo4 er2 fu2 shi3 ye3， wei4 er2 fu2 shi4 ye3， cheng2 gong1 er2 fu2 ju1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 万物作而弗始也，为而弗恃也，成功而弗居也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things arise and he does not turn them away; he gives life but does not possess; he acts but does not rely; when the work is done he does not dwell on it.

ddj-bs-ch-02.pinyin: fu1 wei2 fu2 ju1， shi4 yi3 fu2 qu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯弗居，是以弗去。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because he does not dwell on it, it does not leave him.

ddj-bs-ch-03.pinyin: bu4 shang4 xian2， shi3 min2 bu4 zheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不上贤，使民不争。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not exalt the worthy, and the people will not contend;

ddj-bs-ch-03.content: 不贵难得之货，使民不为盗。
ddj-bs-ch-03.pinyin: bu4 gui4 nan2 de2 zhi1 huo4， shi3 min2 bu4 wei4 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不贵难得之货，使民不为盗。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not prize rare goods, and the people will not become thieves;

ddj-bs-ch-03.pinyin: bu4 jian4 ke3 yu4， shi3 min2 bu4 luan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不见可欲，使民不乱。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not display what can be desired, and the people's hearts will not be disturbed.

ddj-bs-ch-03.content: 是以圣人之治也，虚其心，实其腹，弱其志，强其骨。
ddj-bs-ch-03.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 zhi1 zhi4 ye3， xu1 qi2 xin1， shi2 qi2 fu4， ruo4 qi2 zhi4， qiang2 qi2 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人之治也，虚其心，实其腹，弱其志，强其骨。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage's way of governing empties their minds and fills their bellies;

ddj-bs-ch-03.content: 恒使民无知无欲也，使夫智不敢。
ddj-bs-ch-03.pinyin: heng2 shi3 min2 wu2 zhi1 wu2 yu4 ye3， shi3 fu1 zhi4 bu4 gan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 恒使民无知无欲也，使夫智不敢。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He constantly keeps the people without knowledge and without desire, so that the clever dare not act.

ddj-bs-ch-03.pinyin: fu2 wei4 er2 yi3， ze2 wu2 bu4 zhi4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 弗为而已，则无不治矣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Act by non-action, and nothing will be left ungoverned.

ddj-bs-ch-04.pinyin: dao4 zhong1， er2 yong4 zhi1 you4 fu2 ying2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 道盅，而用之又弗盈也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way is empty, yet use it and it is never filled; how deep it is, as if the ancestor of the myriad things.

ddj-bs-ch-04.pinyin: yuan1 he1， shi4 wan4 wu4 zhi1 zong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 渊呵，似万物之宗。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way is empty, yet use it and it is never filled; how deep it is, as if the ancestor of the myriad things.

ddj-bs-ch-04.content: 挫其锐，解其纷，和其光，同其尘。
ddj-bs-ch-04.pinyin: cuo4 qi2 rui4， jie3 qi2 fen1， he2 qi2 guang1， tong2 qi2 chen2。

interpretations.segmentation: 挫其锐，解其纷，和其光，同其尘。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Blunt the sharpness, untie the tangles, soften the glare, and merge with the dust.
湛呵，似或存。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Deep—it seems as if it were there.

ddj-bs-ch-04.content: 吾不知其谁之子也，象帝之先。
ddj-bs-ch-04.pinyin: wu2 bu4 zhi1 qi2 shui2 zhi1 zi ye3， xiang4 di4 zhi1 xian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 吾不知其谁之子也，象帝之先。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How deep and clear it seems to endure; I do not know whose child it is—it appears to precede the Lord.

ddj-bs-ch-05.content: 天地不仁，以万物为刍狗。
ddj-bs-ch-05.pinyin: tian1 di4 bu4 ren2， yi3 wan4 wu4 wei4 chu2 gou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 天地不仁，以万物为刍狗。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven and Earth are not humane; they treat the myriad things as straw dogs;

ddj-bs-ch-05.content: 圣人不仁，以百姓为刍狗。
ddj-bs-ch-05.pinyin: sheng4 ren2 bu4 ren2， yi3 bai3 xing4 wei4 chu2 gou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 圣人不仁，以百姓为刍狗。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The sage is not humane; he treats the hundred clans as straw dogs.

ddj-bs-ch-05.pinyin: tian1 di4 zhi1 jian1， qi2 you2 tuo2 yue4 yu3！

interpretations.segmentation: 天地之间，其犹橐籥与！
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Is the space between Heaven and Earth not like a bellows?

ddj-bs-ch-05.pinyin: xu1 er2 bu4 qu1， dong4 er2 yu4 chu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 虚而不屈，动而愈出。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Empty yet inexhaustible; the more it moves, the more it yields.

ddj-bs-ch-05.pinyin: duo1 wen2 shu4 qiong2， bu4 ruo4 shou3 yu2 zhong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 多闻数穷，不若守于中。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Much talking leads to exhaustion; better to hold to the center.

ddj-bs-ch-06.pinyin: gu3 shen2 bu4 si3， shi4 wei4 xuan2 pin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 谷神不死，是谓玄牝。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The spirit of the valley never dies; this is called the mysterious female.

ddj-bs-ch-06.content: 玄牝之门，是谓天地之根。
ddj-bs-ch-06.pinyin: xuan2 pin4 zhi1 men2， shi4 wei4 tian1 di4 zhi1 gen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 玄牝之门，是谓天地之根。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The gateway of the mysterious female is called the root of Heaven and Earth.

ddj-bs-ch-06.pinyin: mian2 mian2 he1 ruo4 cun2， yong4 zhi1 bu4 jin3

interpretations.segmentation: 绵绵呵若存，用之不堇
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Continuous and as if enduring, use it and it is never worn out.
天长地久。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven is lasting and Earth endures.

ddj-bs-ch-07.content: 天地所以能长且久者，以其不自生，故能长生。
ddj-bs-ch-07.pinyin: tian1 di4 suo3 yi3 neng2 zhang3 qie3 jiu3 zhe3， yi3 qi2 bu4 zi4 sheng1， gu4 neng2 zhang3 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天地所以能长且久者，以其不自生，故能长生。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The reason Heaven and Earth can last and endure is that they do not live for themselves; thus they can live long.

ddj-bs-ch-07.content: 是以圣人后其身而身先，外其身而身存。
ddj-bs-ch-07.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 hou4 qi2 shen1 er2 shen1 xian1， wai4 qi2 shen1 er2 shen1 cun2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人后其身而身先，外其身而身存。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage puts his person behind and yet it comes first; sets his person aside and yet it is preserved.

ddj-bs-ch-07.pinyin: fei1 yi3 qi2 wu2 si1 xie2？

interpretations.segmentation: 非以其无私邪？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Is it not because he is without self-interest?
故能成其私。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus he is able to accomplish his own ends.
上善似水。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Highest good is like water. Water benefits the myriad things and stays quiet, dwelling where others dislike, and so comes close to the Way. In dwelling, good is the place; in heart, good is depth; in giving, good is Heaven; in speech, good is trust; in government, good is order; in affairs, good is ability; in action, good is timing. Only by not contending is there no blame.

ddj-bs-ch-08.content: 水善利万物而有静，居众人之所恶，故几于道矣。
ddj-bs-ch-08.pinyin: shui3 shan4 li4 wan4 wu4 er2 you3 jing4， ju1 zhong4 ren2 zhi1 suo3 e4， gu4 ji3 yu2 dao4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 水善利万物而有静，居众人之所恶，故几于道矣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Water benefits the myriad things and does not contend; it dwells in places the multitude dislike—thus it is close to the Way.

ddj-bs-ch-08.content: 居善地，心善渊，予善天，言善信，政善治，事善能，动善时。
ddj-bs-ch-08.pinyin: ju1 shan4 di4， xin1 shan4 yuan1， yu3 shan4 tian1， yan2 shan4 xin4， zheng4 shan4 zhi4， shi4 shan4 neng2， dong4 shan4 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 居善地，心善渊，予善天，言善信，政善治，事善能，动善时。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In dwelling, good is the low place; in mind, good is depth; in giving, good is kindness; in speech, good is trustworthiness; in government, good is order; in affairs, good is ability; in action, good is timing.

ddj-bs-ch-08.pinyin: fu1 wei2 bu4 zheng1， gu4 wu2 you2。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯不争，故无尤。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because it does not contend, it is without blame.

ddj-bs-ch-09.pinyin: chi2 er2 ying2 zhi1， bu4 ru2 qi2 yi3；

interpretations.segmentation: 持而盈之，不如其已；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To hold and fill it to the brim is not as good as stopping;

ddj-bs-ch-09.pinyin: chuai1 er2 rui4 zhi1， bu4 ke3 zhang3 bao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 揣而锐之，不可长保。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To hammer and sharpen it cannot keep it long.

ddj-bs-ch-09.pinyin: jin1 yu4 man3 tang2， mo4 zhi1 neng2 shou3；

interpretations.segmentation: 金玉满堂，莫之能守；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A hall filled with gold and jade cannot be guarded;

ddj-bs-ch-09.pinyin: fu4 gui4 er2 jiao1， zi4 yi2 qi2 jiu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 富贵而骄，自遗其咎。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Wealth and rank with arrogance bring their own calamity.

ddj-bs-ch-09.pinyin: gong1 cheng2 shen1 tui4， tian1 zhi1 dao4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 功成身退，天之道也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the work is done, withdraw—this is the Way of Heaven.

ddj-bs-ch-10.pinyin: zai4 ying2 po4 bao4 yi1， neng2 wu2 li2 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 载营魄抱一，能无离乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In carrying the soul and embracing the One, can you keep from parting?

ddj-bs-ch-10.pinyin: zhuan1 qi4 zhi4 rou2， neng2 ru2 ying1 er2 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 专气致柔，能如婴儿乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In concentrating the breath and making it soft, can you become as an infant?

ddj-bs-ch-10.pinyin: di2 chu2 xuan2 jian4， neng2 wu2 ci1 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 涤除玄鉴，能无疵乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In cleansing and purifying the mysterious mirror, can you be without blemish?

ddj-bs-ch-10.pinyin: ai4 min2 zhi4 guo2， neng2 wu2 wei4 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 爱民治国，能无为乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In loving the people and governing the state, can you practice non-action?

ddj-bs-ch-10.pinyin: tian1 men2 kai1 he2， neng2 wei4 ci2 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 天门开阖，能为雌乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In the opening and closing of Heaven's gate, can you take the female part?

ddj-bs-ch-10.pinyin: ming2 bai2 si4 da2， neng2 wu2 zhi1 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 明白四达，能无知乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In understanding that reaches in all directions, can you be without knowledge?

ddj-bs-ch-10.content: 生之畜之，生而不有，为而不恃，长而不宰，是谓玄德。
ddj-bs-ch-10.pinyin: sheng1 zhi1 chu4 zhi1， sheng1 er2 bu4 you3， wei4 er2 bu4 shi4， zhang3 er2 bu4 zai3， shi4 wei4 xuan2 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 生之畜之，生而不有，为而不恃，长而不宰，是谓玄德。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Give them life and nurture them—give life without possessing, act without relying, lead without dominating: this is called mysterious virtue.

ddj-bs-ch-11.content: 三十辐共一毂，当其无，有车之用。
ddj-bs-ch-11.pinyin: san1 shi2 fu2 gong4 yi1 gu3， dang1 qi2 wu2， you3 che1 zhi1 yong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 三十辐共一毂，当其无，有车之用。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thirty spokes share one hub; it is in the empty space that the use of the cart lies.

ddj-bs-ch-11.content: 埏埴以为器，当其无，有器之用。
ddj-bs-ch-11.pinyin: shan1 zhi2 yi3 wei4 qi4， dang1 qi2 wu2， you3 qi4 zhi1 yong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 埏埴以为器，当其无，有器之用。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Knead clay to make a vessel; it is in the empty space that the use of the vessel lies.

ddj-bs-ch-11.content: 凿户牖以为室，当其无，有室之用。
ddj-bs-ch-11.pinyin: zao2 hu4 you3 yi3 wei4 shi4， dang1 qi2 wu2， you3 shi4 zhi1 yong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 凿户牖以为室，当其无，有室之用。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cut doors and windows to make a room; it is in the empty space that the use of the room lies.

ddj-bs-ch-11.content: 故有之以为利，无之以为用。
ddj-bs-ch-11.pinyin: gu4 you3 zhi1 yi3 wei4 li4， wu2 zhi1 yi3 wei4 yong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 故有之以为利，无之以为用。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore what is has benefit; what is not has use.

ddj-bs-ch-12.pinyin: wu3 se4 ling4 ren2 mu4 mang2；

interpretations.segmentation: 五色令人目盲；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The five colors make people's eyes blind;

ddj-bs-ch-12.pinyin: wu3 yin1 ling4 ren2 er3 long2；

interpretations.segmentation: 五音令人耳聋；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The five tones make people's ears deaf;

ddj-bs-ch-12.pinyin: wu3 wei4 ling4 ren2 kou3 shuang3；

interpretations.segmentation: 五味令人口爽；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The five flavors make people's mouths dull;

ddj-bs-ch-12.pinyin: chi2 cheng3 tian2 lie4， ling4 ren2 xin1 fa1 kuang2；

interpretations.segmentation: 驰骋畋猎，令人心发狂；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Racing and hunting make people's hearts go mad;

ddj-bs-ch-12.pinyin: nan2 de2 zhi1 huo4， ling4 ren2 xing2 fang2；

interpretations.segmentation: 难得之货，令人行妨；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Goods hard to obtain make people's conduct go astray.

ddj-bs-ch-12.content: 是以圣人为腹不为目，故去彼取此。
ddj-bs-ch-12.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 wei4 fu4 bu4 wei4 mu4， gu4 qu4 bi3 qu3 ci3。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人为腹不为目，故去彼取此。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage provides for the belly, not for the eyes; thus he discards that and takes this.

ddj-bs-ch-13.pinyin: chong3 ru3 ruo4 jing1， gui4 da4 huan4 ruo4 shen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 宠辱若惊，贵大患若身。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Favor and disgrace are alike startling; value great trouble as you value your body.

ddj-bs-ch-13.pinyin: he2 wei4 chong3 ru3 ruo4 jing1？

interpretations.segmentation: 何谓宠辱若惊？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is meant by "favor and disgrace are alike startling"?

ddj-bs-ch-13.content: 宠为下，得之若惊，失之若惊，是谓宠辱若惊。
ddj-bs-ch-13.pinyin: chong3 wei4 xia4， de2 zhi1 ruo4 jing1， shi1 zhi1 ruo4 jing1， shi4 wei4 chong3 ru3 ruo4 jing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 宠为下，得之若惊，失之若惊，是谓宠辱若惊。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Favor is lowly: gaining it startles, losing it startles—this is what is meant by favor and disgrace being alike startling.

ddj-bs-ch-13.pinyin: he2 wei4 gui4 da4 huan4 ruo4 shen1？

interpretations.segmentation: 何谓贵大患若身？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is meant by "value great trouble as you value your body"?

ddj-bs-ch-13.content: 吾所以有大患者，为吾有身，及吾无身，吾有何患？
ddj-bs-ch-13.pinyin: wu2 suo3 yi3 you3 da4 huan4 zhe3， wei4 wu2 you3 shen1， ji2 wu2 wu2 shen1， wu2 you3 he2 huan4？

interpretations.segmentation: 吾所以有大患者，为吾有身，及吾无身，吾有何患？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The reason I have great trouble is that I have a body; if I had no body, what trouble would I have?

ddj-bs-ch-13.content: 故贵以身为天下，若可寄天下；
ddj-bs-ch-13.pinyin: gu4 gui4 yi3 shen1 wei4 tian1 xia4， ruo4 ke3 ji4 tian1 xia4；

interpretations.segmentation: 故贵以身为天下，若可寄天下；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore, one who values the world as he values his body may be entrusted with the world;

ddj-bs-ch-13.content: 爱以身为天下，若可托天下。
ddj-bs-ch-13.pinyin: ai4 yi3 shen1 wei4 tian1 xia4， ruo4 ke3 tuo1 tian1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 爱以身为天下，若可托天下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who loves the world as he loves his body may be given charge of the world.

ddj-bs-ch-14.pinyin: shi4 er2 bu4 jian4， ming2 yue1 yi2；

interpretations.segmentation: 视而不见，名曰夷；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Look at it and you do not see it—it is called the Invisible;

ddj-bs-ch-14.pinyin: ting1 zhi1 bu4 wen2， ming2 yue1 xi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 听之不闻，名曰希；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Listen to it and you do not hear it—it is called the Inaudible;

ddj-bs-ch-14.pinyin: bo2 zhi1 bu4 de2， ming2 yue1 wei1。

interpretations.segmentation: 搏之不得，名曰微。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Grasp at it and you do not get it—it is called the Intangible.

ddj-bs-ch-14.content: 此三者不可致诘，故混而为一。
ddj-bs-ch-14.pinyin: ci3 san1 zhe3 bu4 ke3 zhi4 ji2， gu4 hun4 er2 wei4 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 此三者不可致诘，故混而为一。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: These three cannot be further inquired into; therefore they merge and become one.

ddj-bs-ch-14.content: 其上不徼，其下不昧，绳绳兮不可名，复归于无物。
ddj-bs-ch-14.pinyin: qi2 shang4 bu4 jiao3， qi2 xia4 bu4 mei4， sheng2 sheng2 xi1 bu4 ke3 ming2， fu4 gui1 yu2 wu2 wu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 其上不徼，其下不昧，绳绳兮不可名，复归于无物。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Above it is not bright; below it is not dark; continuous and unnameable, it returns again to no-thing.

ddj-bs-ch-14.content: 是谓无状之状，无物之象，是谓惚恍。
ddj-bs-ch-14.pinyin: shi4 wei4 wu2 zhuang4 zhi1 zhuang4， wu2 wu4 zhi1 xiang4， shi4 wei4 hu1 huang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 是谓无状之状，无物之象，是谓惚恍。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: This is called the form of the formless, the image of no-thing—this is called the Vague and Elusive.

ddj-bs-ch-14.content: 迎之不见其首，随之不见其后。
ddj-bs-ch-14.pinyin: ying2 zhi1 bu4 jian4 qi2 shou3， sui2 zhi1 bu4 jian4 qi2 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 迎之不见其首，随之不见其后。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Meet it and you see no front; follow it and you see no rear.

ddj-bs-ch-14.pinyin: zhi2 gu3 zhi1 dao4， yi3 yu4 jin1 zhi1 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 执古之道，以御今之有。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Hold to the Way of old to master the things of today.

ddj-bs-ch-14.pinyin: neng2 zhi1 gu3 shi3， shi4 wei4 dao4 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 能知古始，是谓道纪。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To be able to know the ancient beginning—this is called the thread of the Way.

ddj-bs-ch-15.content: 古之善为道者，微妙玄通，深不可识。
ddj-bs-ch-15.pinyin: gu3 zhi1 shan4 wei4 dao4 zhe3， wei1 miao4 xuan2 tong1， shen1 bu4 ke3 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 古之善为道者，微妙玄通，深不可识。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those of old who were good at practicing the Way were subtle, mysterious, penetrating, and too deep to be known.

ddj-bs-ch-15.content: 夫不唯不可识，故强为之容；
ddj-bs-ch-15.pinyin: fu1 bu4 wei2 bu4 ke3 shi2， gu4 qiang2 wei4 zhi1 rong2；

interpretations.segmentation: 夫不唯不可识，故强为之容；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because they cannot be known, one can only force a description: Cautious, as if crossing a winter stream;

ddj-bs-ch-15.pinyin: yu4 xi1 ruo4 dong1 she4 chuan1；

interpretations.segmentation: 豫兮若冬涉川；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because they cannot be known, one can only force a description: Cautious, as if crossing a winter stream;

ddj-bs-ch-15.pinyin: you2 xi1 ruo4 wei4 si4 lin2；

interpretations.segmentation: 犹兮若畏四邻；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Hesitant, as if fearing the neighbors on all sides;
俨兮其若客；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Reserved, like a guest;

ddj-bs-ch-15.pinyin: huan4 xi1 qi2 ruo4 ling2 shi4；

interpretations.segmentation: 涣兮其若凌释；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Yielding, like ice about to melt;
敦兮其若朴；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Simple and genuine, like uncarved wood;
旷兮其若谷；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Open and broad, like a valley;
混兮其若浊；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Murky, like muddy water.

ddj-bs-ch-15.pinyin: shu2 neng2 zhuo2 yi3 jing4 zhi1 xu2 qing1？

interpretations.segmentation: 孰能浊以静之徐清？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Who can take the muddy and, by stillness, gradually make it clear?

ddj-bs-ch-15.pinyin: shu2 neng2 an1 yi3 jing4 zhi1 xu2 sheng1？

interpretations.segmentation: 孰能安以静之徐生？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Who can take the settled and, by long movement, gradually bring it to life?

ddj-bs-ch-15.pinyin: bao3 ci3 dao4 zhe3， bu4 yu4 ying2。

interpretations.segmentation: 保此道者，不欲盈。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who preserve this Way do not desire to be full.

ddj-bs-ch-15.content: 夫唯不盈，故能蔽而新成。
ddj-bs-ch-15.pinyin: fu1 wei2 bu4 ying2， gu4 neng2 bi4 er2 xin1 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯不盈，故能蔽而新成。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because they are not full, they can be worn and yet newly made.

ddj-bs-ch-16.pinyin: zhi4 xu1 ji2， shou3 jing4 du3；

interpretations.segmentation: 致虚极，守静笃；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Attain utmost emptiness; hold firmly to stillness.

ddj-bs-ch-16.pinyin: wan4 wu4 bing4 zuo4， wu2 yi3 guan1 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 万物并作，吾以观复。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things arise together; I watch their return.

ddj-bs-ch-16.pinyin: fu1 wu4 yun2 yun2， ge4 fu4 gui1 qi2 gen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫物芸芸，各复归其根。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Things flourish in abundance, yet each returns to its root.

ddj-bs-ch-16.pinyin: gui1 gen1 yue1 jing4， jing4 yue1 fu4 ming4。

interpretations.segmentation: 归根曰静，静曰复命。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Returning to the root is called stillness; stillness is called returning to destiny.

ddj-bs-ch-16.pinyin: fu4 ming4 yue1 chang2， zhi1 chang2 yue1 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 复命曰常，知常曰明。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Returning to destiny is called the Constant; knowing the Constant is called insight.

ddj-bs-ch-16.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 chang2， wang4 zuo4 xiong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不知常，妄作凶。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Not knowing the Constant, one acts recklessly and meets with misfortune.

ddj-bs-ch-16.content: 知常容，容乃公，公乃全，全乃天，天乃道，道乃久，没身不殆。
ddj-bs-ch-16.pinyin: zhi1 chang2 rong2， rong2 nai3 gong1， gong1 nai3 quan2， quan2 nai3 tian1， tian1 nai3 dao4， dao4 nai3 jiu3， mei2 shen1 bu4 dai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 知常容，容乃公，公乃全，全乃天，天乃道，道乃久，没身不殆。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Knowing the Constant, one is tolerant; tolerance leads to impartiality; impartiality leads to kingliness; kingliness leads to Heaven; Heaven leads to the Way; the Way leads to permanence—to the end of life one is without danger.

ddj-bs-ch-17.pinyin: tai4 shang4， bu4 zhi1 you3 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 太上，不知有之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Of the highest, those below merely know that he exists;

ddj-bs-ch-17.pinyin: qi2 ci4， qin1 er2 yu4 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 其次，亲而誉之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Of the next, they draw near and praise him;
其次，畏之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Of the next, they fear him;
其次，侮之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Of the next, they insult him.

ddj-bs-ch-17.pinyin: xin4 bu4 zu2 yan1， you3 bu4 xin4 yan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 信不足焉，有不信焉。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When trust is insufficient, there is distrust.
悠兮，其贵言。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How leisurely he is, sparing of his words.

ddj-bs-ch-17.content: 功成事遂，百姓皆谓我自然。
ddj-bs-ch-17.pinyin: gong1 cheng2 shi4 sui4， bai3 xing4 jie1 wei4 wo3 zi4 ran2。

interpretations.segmentation: 功成事遂，百姓皆谓我自然。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the work is done and affairs succeed, the hundred clans all say, "We did this ourselves."

ddj-bs-ch-18.pinyin: da4 dao4 fei4， you3 ren2 yi4；

interpretations.segmentation: 大道废，有仁义；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the Great Way is abandoned, there are benevolence and righteousness;

ddj-bs-ch-18.pinyin: zhi4 hui4 chu1， you3 da4 wei3；

interpretations.segmentation: 智慧出，有大伪；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When wisdom and cleverness appear, there is great hypocrisy;

ddj-bs-ch-18.pinyin: liu4 qin1 bu4 he2， you3 xiao4 ci2；

interpretations.segmentation: 六亲不和，有孝慈；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the six relations are not in harmony, there are filial piety and parental kindness;

ddj-bs-ch-18.pinyin: guo2 jia1 hun1 luan4， you3 zhong1 chen2。

interpretations.segmentation: 国家昏乱，有忠臣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the state is in disorder, there are loyal ministers.

ddj-bs-ch-19.pinyin: jue2 sheng4 qi4 zhi4， min2 li4 bai3 bei4；

interpretations.segmentation: 绝圣弃智，民利百倍；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Abolish sagehood and discard wisdom, and the people will benefit a hundredfold;

ddj-bs-ch-19.pinyin: jue2 ren2 qi4 yi4， min2 fu4 xiao4 ci2；

interpretations.segmentation: 绝仁弃义，民复孝慈；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Abolish benevolence and discard righteousness, and the people will return to filial piety and kindness;

ddj-bs-ch-19.pinyin: jue2 qiao3 qi4 li4， dao4 zei2 wu2 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 绝巧弃利，盗贼无有。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Abolish cleverness and discard profit, and there will be no thieves.

ddj-bs-ch-19.content: 此三者以为文不足，故令有所属；
ddj-bs-ch-19.pinyin: ci3 san1 zhe3 yi3 wei4 wen2 bu4 zu2， gu4 ling4 you3 suo3 shu3；

interpretations.segmentation: 此三者以为文不足，故令有所属；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: These three, taken as outward culture, are not enough; therefore let people have something to hold to: look to the plain and embrace the uncarved; lessen self-interest and reduce desire.

ddj-bs-ch-19.pinyin: jian4 su4 bao4 pu3， shao3 si1 gua3 yu4；

interpretations.segmentation: 见素抱朴，少私寡欲；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: These three, taken as outward culture, are not enough; therefore let people have something to hold to: look to the plain and embrace the uncarved; lessen self-interest and reduce desire.
绝学无忧。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Abandon learning, and sorrow ends.

ddj-bs-ch-20.pinyin: wei2 zhi1 yu3 a1， xiang1 qu4 ji3 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 唯之与阿，相去几何？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How far is "yes" from "yeah"?

ddj-bs-ch-20.pinyin: mei3 zhi1 yu3 e4， xiang1 qu4 ruo4 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 美之与恶，相去若何？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How far is good from evil?

ddj-bs-ch-20.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 suo3 wei4， bu4 ke3 bu4 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之所畏，不可不畏。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What people fear cannot but be feared.

ddj-bs-ch-20.pinyin: huang1 xi1， qi2 wei4 yang1 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 荒兮，其未央哉！
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How desolate—it has not yet reached its end!

ddj-bs-ch-20.content: 众人熙熙，如享太牢，如春登台。
ddj-bs-ch-20.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 xi1 xi1， ru2 xiang3 tai4 lao2， ru2 chun1 deng1 tai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 众人熙熙，如享太牢，如春登台。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The multitude are merry, as if enjoying a great feast, as if climbing a terrace in spring.

ddj-bs-ch-20.pinyin: wo3 du2 po1 xi1， qi2 wei4 zhao4；

interpretations.segmentation: 我独泊兮，其未兆；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I alone am still, without sign—like an infant that has not yet smiled.

ddj-bs-ch-20.pinyin: dun4 dun4 xi1， ru2 ying1 er2 zhi1 wei4 hai2；

interpretations.segmentation: 沌沌兮，如婴儿之未孩；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I alone am still, without sign—like an infant that has not yet smiled.

ddj-bs-ch-20.pinyin: lei3 lei3 xi1， ruo4 wu2 suo3 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 傫傫兮，若无所归。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Weary and forlorn, as if I had nowhere to return.

ddj-bs-ch-20.content: 众人皆有余，而我独若遗。
ddj-bs-ch-20.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 jie1 you3 yu2， er2 wo3 du2 ruo4 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 众人皆有余，而我独若遗。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The multitude all have more than enough, while I alone seem to have lost.

ddj-bs-ch-20.pinyin: wo3 yu2 ren2 zhi1 xin1 ye3 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 我愚人之心也哉！
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I have the mind of a fool indeed!

ddj-bs-ch-20.pinyin: su2 ren2 zhao1 zhao1， wo3 du2 hun1 hun1。

interpretations.segmentation: 俗人昭昭，我独昏昏。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Ordinary people are bright and clear; I alone am dull and confused;

ddj-bs-ch-20.pinyin: su2 ren2 cha2 cha2， wo3 du2 men4 men4。

interpretations.segmentation: 俗人察察，我独闷闷。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Ordinary people are sharp and discerning; I alone am closed and muffled.
澹兮，其若海；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Calm as the sea, drifting as if without end.
飂兮，若无止。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Calm as the sea, drifting as if without end.

ddj-bs-ch-20.content: 众人皆有以，而我独顽且鄙。
ddj-bs-ch-20.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 jie1 you3 yi3， er2 wo3 du2 wan2 qie3 bi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 众人皆有以，而我独顽且鄙。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The multitude all have purpose, while I alone am stubborn and rustic.

ddj-bs-ch-20.pinyin: wo3 du2 yi4 yu2 ren2， er2 gui4 shi2 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我独异于人，而贵食母。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I alone differ from others, and value drawing nourishment from the Mother.

ddj-bs-ch-21.pinyin: kong3 de2 zhi1 rong2， wei2 dao4 shi4 cong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 孔德之容，惟道是从。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The bearing of great virtue follows only the Way.

ddj-bs-ch-21.pinyin: dao4 zhi1 wei4 wu4， wei2 huang3 wei2 hu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 道之为物，惟恍惟惚。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: As a thing, the Way is only elusive and vague.

ddj-bs-ch-21.pinyin: hu1 xi1 huang3 xi1， qi2 zhong1 you3 xiang4；

interpretations.segmentation: 惚兮恍兮，其中有象；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Vague and elusive—within it there is image;

ddj-bs-ch-21.pinyin: huang3 xi1 hu1 xi1， qi2 zhong1 you3 wu4；

interpretations.segmentation: 恍兮惚兮，其中有物；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Elusive and vague—within it there is substance.

ddj-bs-ch-21.content: 窈兮冥兮，其中有精，其精甚真，其中有信，自今及古，其名不去，以阅众甫。
ddj-bs-ch-21.pinyin: yao3 xi1 ming2 xi1， qi2 zhong1 you3 jing1， qi2 jing1 shen4 zhen1， qi2 zhong1 you3 xin4， zi4 jin1 ji2 gu3， qi2 ming2 bu4 qu4， yi3 yue4 zhong4 fu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 窈兮冥兮，其中有精，其精甚真，其中有信，自今及古，其名不去，以阅众甫。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: From the present back to antiquity, its name has not departed; by it one surveys the beginnings of the multitude.

ddj-bs-ch-21.pinyin: wu2 he2 yi3 zhi1 zhong4 fu3 zhi1 zhuang4 zai1？

interpretations.segmentation: 吾何以知众甫之状哉？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How do I know the form of the beginnings of the multitude?
以此。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: By this.

ddj-bs-ch-22.content: 曲则全，枉则直，洼则盈，敝则新，少则得，多则惑。
ddj-bs-ch-22.pinyin: qu1 ze2 quan2， wang3 ze2 zhi2， wa1 ze2 ying2， bi4 ze2 xin1， shao3 ze2 de2， duo1 ze2 huo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 曲则全，枉则直，洼则盈，敝则新，少则得，多则惑。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Bent, then whole; crooked, then straight; hollow, then full; worn, then new; little, then gain; much, then confusion.

ddj-bs-ch-22.content: 是以圣人抱一为天下式。
ddj-bs-ch-22.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 bao4 yi1 wei4 tian1 xia4 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人抱一为天下式。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage embraces the One and becomes the model for all under Heaven.
不自见，故明；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He does not display himself, and so is illustrious;

ddj-bs-ch-22.content: 不自是，故彰，不自伐，故有功；
ddj-bs-ch-22.pinyin: bu4 zi4 shi4， gu4 zhang1， bu4 zi4 fa2， gu4 you3 gong1；

interpretations.segmentation: 不自是，故彰，不自伐，故有功；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He does not boast, and so has merit;
不自矜，故长。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He does not vaunt himself, and so endures.

ddj-bs-ch-22.content: 夫唯不争，故天下莫能与之争。
ddj-bs-ch-22.pinyin: fu1 wei2 bu4 zheng1， gu4 tian1 xia4 mo4 neng2 yu3 zhi1 zheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯不争，故天下莫能与之争。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because he does not contend, no one under Heaven can contend with him.

ddj-bs-ch-22.content: 古之所谓曲则全者，岂虚言哉？
ddj-bs-ch-22.pinyin: gu3 zhi1 suo3 wei4 qu1 ze2 quan2 zhe3， qi3 xu1 yan2 zai1？

interpretations.segmentation: 古之所谓曲则全者，岂虚言哉？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The ancient saying "bent, then whole"—how could it be empty words?
诚全而归之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Truly, wholeness returns to him.
希言自然。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Sparse words are natural.

ddj-bs-ch-23.content: 故飘风不终朝，骤雨不终日，孰为此者？
ddj-bs-ch-23.pinyin: gu4 piao1 feng1 bu4 zhong1 chao2， zhou4 yu3 bu4 zhong1 ri4， shu2 wei4 ci3 zhe3？

interpretations.segmentation: 故飘风不终朝，骤雨不终日，孰为此者？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore a whirlwind does not last a morning; a sudden rain does not last a day.
天地。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven and Earth.

ddj-bs-ch-23.content: 天地尚不能久，而况于人乎？
ddj-bs-ch-23.pinyin: tian1 di4 shang4 bu4 neng2 jiu3， er2 kuang4 yu2 ren2 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 天地尚不能久，而况于人乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Even Heaven and Earth cannot make them last—how much less can man?

ddj-bs-ch-23.pinyin: gu4 cong2 shi4 yu2 dao4 zhe3 tong2 yu2 dao4；

interpretations.segmentation: 故从事于道者同于道；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore one who engages in the Way becomes one with the Way;
德者同于德；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who engages in virtue becomes one with virtue;
失者同于失。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who engages in loss becomes one with loss.

ddj-bs-ch-23.pinyin: tong2 yu2 dao4 zhe3， dao4 yi4 le4 de2 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 同于道者，道亦乐得之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who is one with the Way—the Way also gladly receives him;

ddj-bs-ch-23.pinyin: tong2 yu2 de2 zhe3， de2 yi4 le4 de2 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 同于德者，德亦乐得之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who is one with virtue—virtue also gladly receives him;

ddj-bs-ch-23.pinyin: tong2 yu2 shi1 zhe3， shi1 yi4 le4 de2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 同于失者，失亦乐得之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who is one with loss—loss also gladly receives him.

ddj-bs-ch-23.pinyin: xin4 bu4 zu2 yan1， you3 bu4 xin4 yan1！

interpretations.segmentation: 信不足焉，有不信焉！
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When trust is insufficient, there is distrust.

ddj-bs-ch-24.pinyin: qi3 zhe3 bu4 li4， kua4 zhe3 bu4 xing2；

interpretations.segmentation: 企者不立，跨者不行；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who stands on tiptoe cannot stand firm;
自见者不明；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who displays himself is not illustrious;
自是者不彰；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who asserts himself is not distinguished;
自伐者无功；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who boasts has no merit;
自矜者不长。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who vaunts himself does not endure.

ddj-bs-ch-24.pinyin: qi2 zai4 dao4 ye3， yue1 yu2 shi2 zhui4 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 其在道也，曰余食赘形。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In the Way, such things are called leftover food and superfluous growths.

ddj-bs-ch-24.content: 物或恶之，故有道者不处。
ddj-bs-ch-24.pinyin: wu4 huo4 e4 zhi1， gu4 you3 dao4 zhe3 bu4 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 物或恶之，故有道者不处。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Things may detest them; therefore one who has the Way does not abide in them.

ddj-bs-ch-25.pinyin: you3 wu4 hun4 cheng2， xian1 tian1 di4 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有物混成，先天地生。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: There was something formed in chaos, born before Heaven and Earth.

ddj-bs-ch-25.content: 寂兮寥兮，独立而不改，周行而不殆，可以为天地母。
ddj-bs-ch-25.pinyin: ji4 xi1 liao2 xi1， du2 li4 er2 bu4 gai3， zhou1 xing2 er2 bu4 dai4， ke3 yi3 wei4 tian1 di4 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 寂兮寥兮，独立而不改，周行而不殆，可以为天地母。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Silent and void, it stands alone and does not change; it cycles and does not weary—it may be the mother of Heaven and Earth.

ddj-bs-ch-25.content: 吾不知其名，强字之曰：道，强为之名曰：大。
ddj-bs-ch-25.pinyin: wu2 bu4 zhi1 qi2 ming2， qiang2 zi4 zhi1 yue1： dao4， qiang2 wei4 zhi1 ming2 yue1： da4。

interpretations.segmentation: 吾不知其名，强字之曰：道，强为之名曰：大。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I do not know its name; I style it "the Way," and force a name upon it, calling it "Great."

ddj-bs-ch-25.pinyin: da4 yue1 shi4， shi4 yue1 yuan3， yuan3 yue1 fan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 大曰逝，逝曰远，远曰反。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Great means passing on; passing on means going far; going far means returning.

ddj-bs-ch-25.content: 故道大，天大，地大，人亦大。
ddj-bs-ch-25.pinyin: gu4 dao4 da4， tian1 da4， di4 da4， ren2 yi4 da4。

interpretations.segmentation: 故道大，天大，地大，人亦大。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the Way is great, Heaven is great, Earth is great, and man also is great.

ddj-bs-ch-25.content: 域中有四大，而人居其一焉。
ddj-bs-ch-25.pinyin: yu4 zhong1 you3 si4 da4， er2 ren2 ju1 qi2 yi1 yan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 域中有四大，而人居其一焉。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In the realm there are four greats, and man is one of them.

ddj-bs-ch-25.content: 人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然。
ddj-bs-ch-25.pinyin: ren2 fa3 di4， di4 fa3 tian1， tian1 fa3 dao4， dao4 fa3 zi4 ran2。

interpretations.segmentation: 人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Man models himself on Earth; Earth models itself on Heaven; Heaven models itself on the Way; the Way models itself on what is naturally so.

ddj-bs-ch-26.pinyin: zhong4 wei4 qing1 gen1， jing4 wei4 zao4 jun1。

interpretations.segmentation: 重为轻根，静为躁君。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaviness is the root of lightness; stillness is the master of restlessness.

ddj-bs-ch-26.content: 是以君子终日行不离辎重，虽有荣观，燕处超然。
ddj-bs-ch-26.pinyin: shi4 yi3 jun1 zi zhong1 ri4 xing2 bu4 li2 zi1 zhong4， sui1 you3 rong2 guan1， yan4 chu4 chao1 ran2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以君子终日行不离辎重，虽有荣观，燕处超然。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage travels all day without leaving his baggage wagons.

ddj-bs-ch-26.content: 奈何万乘之主，而以身轻天下？
ddj-bs-ch-26.pinyin: nai4 he2 wan4 cheng2 zhi1 zhu3， er2 yi3 shen1 qing1 tian1 xia4？

interpretations.segmentation: 奈何万乘之主，而以身轻天下？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How then can the lord of ten thousand chariots take his own person lightly in ruling the world?

ddj-bs-ch-26.pinyin: qing1 ze2 shi1 gen1， zao4 ze2 shi1 jun1。

interpretations.segmentation: 轻则失根，躁则失君。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Lightness loses the root; restlessness loses the master.
善行，无辙迹；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A good traveler leaves no track;
善言，无瑕谪；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A good speaker leaves no flaw for blame;

ddj-bs-ch-27.pinyin: shan4 shu4， bu4 yong4 chou2 ce4；

interpretations.segmentation: 善数，不用筹策；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A good reckoner needs no counting rods;

ddj-bs-ch-27.pinyin: shan4 bi4， wu2 guan1 jian4 er2 bu4 ke3 kai1；

interpretations.segmentation: 善闭，无关楗而不可开；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A good closer needs no bolts, yet none can open;

ddj-bs-ch-27.pinyin: shan4 jie2， wu2 sheng2 yue1 er2 bu4 ke3 jie3。

interpretations.segmentation: 善结，无绳约而不可解。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A good binder needs no ropes, yet none can untie.

ddj-bs-ch-27.content: 是以圣人常善救人，故无弃人；
ddj-bs-ch-27.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 chang2 shan4 jiu4 ren2， gu4 wu2 qi4 ren2；

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人常善救人，故无弃人；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage is always good at saving people, and so abandons no one;

ddj-bs-ch-27.pinyin: chang2 shan4 jiu4 wu4， gu4 wu2 qi4 wu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 常善救物，故无弃物。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Always good at saving things, and so abandons nothing.
是谓袭明。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: This is called clothing oneself in light.

ddj-bs-ch-27.pinyin: gu4 shan4 ren2 zhe3， bu4 shan4 ren2 zhi1 shi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 故善人者，不善人之师；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the good man is the teacher of the not-good;

ddj-bs-ch-27.pinyin: bu4 shan4 ren2 zhe3， shan4 ren2 zhi1 zi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不善人者，善人之资。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The not-good man is the material of the good.

ddj-bs-ch-27.content: 不贵其师，不爱其资，虽智大迷，是谓要妙。
ddj-bs-ch-27.pinyin: bu4 gui4 qi2 shi1， bu4 ai4 qi2 zi1， sui1 zhi4 da4 mi2， shi4 wei4 yao4 miao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不贵其师，不爱其资，虽智大迷，是谓要妙。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Not to value the teacher, not to love the material—though wise, one is greatly confused: this is called the essential mystery.

ddj-bs-ch-28.content: 知其雄，守其雌，为天下溪。
ddj-bs-ch-28.pinyin: zhi1 qi2 xiong2， shou3 qi2 ci2， wei4 tian1 xia4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 知其雄，守其雌，为天下溪。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Know the male, yet keep to the female, and be the stream of the world.

ddj-bs-ch-28.content: 为天下溪，常德不离，复归于婴儿。
ddj-bs-ch-28.pinyin: wei4 tian1 xia4 xi1， chang2 de2 bu4 li2， fu4 gui1 yu2 ying1 er2。

interpretations.segmentation: 为天下溪，常德不离，复归于婴儿。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Being the stream of the world, constant virtue does not depart, and one returns again to the infant.

ddj-bs-ch-28.content: 知其白，守其黑，为天下式，为天下式，常德不忒，复归于无极。
ddj-bs-ch-28.pinyin: zhi1 qi2 bai2， shou3 qi2 hei1， wei4 tian1 xia4 shi4， wei4 tian1 xia4 shi4， chang2 de2 bu4 te4， fu4 gui1 yu2 wu2 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 知其白，守其黑，为天下式，为天下式，常德不忒，复归于无极。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Being the model of the world, constant virtue does not err, and one returns again to the limitless.

ddj-bs-ch-28.content: 知其荣，守其辱，为天下谷。
ddj-bs-ch-28.pinyin: zhi1 qi2 rong2， shou3 qi2 ru3， wei4 tian1 xia4 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 知其荣，守其辱，为天下谷。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Know honor, yet keep to disgrace, and be the valley of the world.

ddj-bs-ch-28.content: 为天下谷，常德乃足，复归于朴。
ddj-bs-ch-28.pinyin: wei4 tian1 xia4 gu3， chang2 de2 nai3 zu2， fu4 gui1 yu2 pu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 为天下谷，常德乃足，复归于朴。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Being the valley of the world, constant virtue is then sufficient, and one returns again to the uncarved block.

ddj-bs-ch-28.content: 朴散则为器，圣人用之，则为官长，故大制不割。
ddj-bs-ch-28.pinyin: pu3 san4 ze2 wei4 qi4， sheng4 ren2 yong4 zhi1， ze2 wei4 guan1 zhang3， gu4 da4 zhi4 bu4 ge1。

interpretations.segmentation: 朴散则为器，圣人用之，则为官长，故大制不割。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the uncarved block is scattered, it becomes vessels; the sage uses it and becomes the chief of officers.

ddj-bs-ch-29.content: 将欲取天下而为之，吾见其不得已。
ddj-bs-ch-29.pinyin: jiang1 yu4 qu3 tian1 xia4 er2 wei4 zhi1， wu2 jian4 qi2 bu4 de2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 将欲取天下而为之，吾见其不得已。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If one would take the world and act upon it, I see that he will not succeed.

ddj-bs-ch-29.content: 天下神器，不可为也，不可执也。
ddj-bs-ch-29.pinyin: tian1 xia4 shen2 qi4， bu4 ke3 wei4 ye3， bu4 ke3 zhi2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下神器，不可为也，不可执也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The world is a sacred vessel; it cannot be acted upon.

ddj-bs-ch-29.pinyin: wei4 zhe3 bai4 zhi1， zhi2 zhe3 shi1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 为者败之，执者失之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who acts upon it ruins it; he who grasps it loses it.

ddj-bs-ch-29.content: 是以圣人无为，故无败，故无失。
ddj-bs-ch-29.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 wu2 wei4， gu4 wu2 bai4， gu4 wu2 shi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人无为，故无败，故无失。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage does nothing, and so does not fail, and so does not lose.

ddj-bs-ch-29.pinyin: fu1 wu4 huo4 xing2 huo4 sui2；

interpretations.segmentation: 夫物或行或随；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore among things, some go forward, some follow;
或觑或吹；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Some blow warm, some blow cold;
或强或羸；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Some are strong, some are weak;
或载或隳。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Some are loaded, some are broken.

ddj-bs-ch-29.content: 是以圣人去甚、去奢、去泰。
ddj-bs-ch-29.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 qu4 shen4、 qu4 she1、 qu4 tai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人去甚、去奢、去泰。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage discards extremes, discards extravagance, discards excess.

ddj-bs-ch-30.content: 以道佐人主者，不以兵强天下，其事好还。
ddj-bs-ch-30.pinyin: yi3 dao4 zuo3 ren2 zhu3 zhe3， bu4 yi3 bing1 qiang2 tian1 xia4， qi2 shi4 hao3 hai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 以道佐人主者，不以兵强天下，其事好还。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who assists a ruler with the Way does not use arms to force the world.

ddj-bs-ch-30.pinyin: shi1 zhi1 suo3 chu4， jing1 ji2 sheng1 yan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 师之所处，荆棘生焉。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Such affairs tend to rebound: where armies encamp, thorns and brambles grow;

ddj-bs-ch-30.pinyin: da4 jun1 zhi1 hou4， bi4 you3 xiong1 nian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 大军之后，必有凶年。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: After a great war, there are sure to be years of famine.

ddj-bs-ch-30.content: 善有果而已，不敢以取强。
ddj-bs-ch-30.pinyin: shan4 you3 guo3 er2 yi3， bu4 gan3 yi3 qu3 qiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 善有果而已，不敢以取强。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A good commander achieves his end and stops; he dares not take by force.

ddj-bs-ch-30.content: 果而勿矜，果而勿伐，果而勿骄，果而不得已，果而勿强。
ddj-bs-ch-30.pinyin: guo3 er2 wu4 jin1， guo3 er2 wu4 fa2， guo3 er2 wu4 jiao1， guo3 er2 bu4 de2 yi3， guo3 er2 wu4 qiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 果而勿矜，果而勿伐，果而勿骄，果而不得已，果而勿强。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Achieve the end and do not boast; achieve and do not brag; achieve and do not be proud; achieve only as a last resort; achieve and do not force.

ddj-bs-ch-30.content: 物壮则老，是谓不道，不道早已。
ddj-bs-ch-30.pinyin: wu4 zhuang4 ze2 lao3， shi4 wei4 bu4 dao4， bu4 dao4 zao3 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 物壮则老，是谓不道，不道早已。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When things are strong they grow old—this is called contrary to the Way; what is contrary to the Way comes to an early end.

ddj-bs-ch-31.content: 夫兵者，不祥之器，物或恶之，故有道者不处。
ddj-bs-ch-31.pinyin: fu1 bing1 zhe3， bu4 xiang2 zhi1 qi4， wu4 huo4 e4 zhi1， gu4 you3 dao4 zhe3 bu4 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫兵者，不祥之器，物或恶之，故有道者不处。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Arms are instruments of ill omen; things may detest them; therefore one who has the Way does not abide by them.

ddj-bs-ch-31.content: 君子居则贵左，用兵则贵右。
ddj-bs-ch-31.pinyin: jun1 zi ju1 ze2 gui4 zuo3， yong4 bing1 ze2 gui4 you4。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子居则贵左，用兵则贵右。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The gentleman values the left in ordinary dwelling; when using arms he values the right.

ddj-bs-ch-31.content: 兵者不祥之器，非君子之器，不得已而用之，恬淡为上，胜而不美，而美之者，是乐杀人。
ddj-bs-ch-31.pinyin: bing1 zhe3 bu4 xiang2 zhi1 qi4， fei1 jun1 zi zhi1 qi4， bu4 de2 yi3 er2 yong4 zhi1， tian2 dan4 wei4 shang4， sheng4 er2 bu4 mei3， er2 mei3 zhi1 zhe3， shi4 le4 sha1 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 兵者不祥之器，非君子之器，不得已而用之，恬淡为上，胜而不美，而美之者，是乐杀人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Arms are instruments of ill omen, not the instruments of a gentleman; he uses them only when he must, and calm detachment is best.

ddj-bs-ch-31.content: 夫乐杀人者，则不可得志于天下矣。
ddj-bs-ch-31.pinyin: fu1 le4 sha1 ren2 zhe3， ze2 bu4 ke3 de2 zhi4 yu2 tian1 xia4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫乐杀人者，则不可得志于天下矣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who delights in killing men cannot fulfill his will under Heaven.

ddj-bs-ch-31.pinyin: ji2 shi4 shang4 zuo3， xiong1 shi4 shang4 you4。

interpretations.segmentation: 吉事尚左，凶事尚右。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Auspicious affairs honor the left; inauspicious affairs honor the right.

ddj-bs-ch-31.content: 偏将军居左，上将军居右。
ddj-bs-ch-31.pinyin: pian1 jiang1 jun1 ju1 zuo3， shang4 jiang1 jun1 ju1 you4。

interpretations.segmentation: 偏将军居左，上将军居右。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The lieutenant general stands on the left, the senior general on the right—this means they are treated with funeral rites.

ddj-bs-ch-31.pinyin: yan2 yi3 sang4 li3 chu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 言以丧礼处之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The lieutenant general stands on the left, the senior general on the right—this means they are treated with funeral rites.

ddj-bs-ch-31.content: 杀人之众，以悲哀莅之，战胜以丧礼处之。
ddj-bs-ch-31.pinyin: sha1 ren2 zhi1 zhong4， yi3 bei1 ai1 li4 zhi1， zhan4 sheng4 yi3 sang4 li3 chu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 杀人之众，以悲哀莅之，战胜以丧礼处之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When many are slain, weep for them with grief; when victorious, treat it with funeral rites.
道常无名，朴。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way is constantly nameless; though the uncarved block is small, none under Heaven can make it a subject.

ddj-bs-ch-32.pinyin: sui1 xiao3， tian1 xia4 mo4 neng2 chen2。

interpretations.segmentation: 虽小，天下莫能臣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way is constantly nameless; though the uncarved block is small, none under Heaven can make it a subject.

ddj-bs-ch-32.content: 候王若能守之，万物将自宾。
ddj-bs-ch-32.pinyin: hou4 wang2 ruo4 neng2 shou3 zhi1， wan4 wu4 jiang1 zi4 bin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 候王若能守之，万物将自宾。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If lords and kings can keep to it, the myriad things will of themselves submit as guests.

ddj-bs-ch-32.content: 天地相合，以降甘露，民莫之令而自均。
ddj-bs-ch-32.pinyin: tian1 di4 xiang1 he2， yi3 jiang4 gan1 lu4， min2 mo4 zhi1 ling4 er2 zi4 jun1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天地相合，以降甘露，民莫之令而自均。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven and Earth join and send down sweet dew; the people, without being commanded, share it evenly of themselves.

ddj-bs-ch-32.content: 始制有名，名亦既有，夫亦将知止，知止可以不殆。
ddj-bs-ch-32.pinyin: shi3 zhi4 you3 ming2， ming2 yi4 ji4 you3， fu1 yi4 jiang1 zhi1 zhi3， zhi1 zhi3 ke3 yi3 bu4 dai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 始制有名，名亦既有，夫亦将知止，知止可以不殆。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When institutions begin, names appear; once there are names, one should also know when to stop.

ddj-bs-ch-32.content: 譬道之在天下，犹川谷之于江海。
ddj-bs-ch-32.pinyin: pi4 dao4 zhi1 zai4 tian1 xia4， you2 chuan1 gu3 zhi1 yu2 jiang1 hai3。

interpretations.segmentation: 譬道之在天下，犹川谷之于江海。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way's presence in the world is like streams and valleys flowing to the rivers and the sea.

ddj-bs-ch-33.pinyin: zhi1 ren2 zhe3 zhi4， zi4 zhi1 zhe3 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 知人者智，自知者明。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To know others is wisdom; to know oneself is insight.

ddj-bs-ch-33.pinyin: sheng4 ren2 zhe3 you3 li4， zi4 sheng4 zhe3 qiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 胜人者有力，自胜者强。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To conquer others is strength; to conquer oneself is true power.

ddj-bs-ch-33.content: 知足者富，强行者有志，不失其所者久，死而不亡者寿。
ddj-bs-ch-33.pinyin: zhi1 zu2 zhe3 fu4， qiang2 xing2 zhe3 you3 zhi4， bu4 shi1 qi2 suo3 zhe3 jiu3， si3 er2 bu4 wang2 zhe3 shou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 知足者富，强行者有志，不失其所者久，死而不亡者寿。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Not to lose one's place is to endure; to die and yet not perish is to live long.

ddj-bs-ch-34.pinyin: da4 dao4 si4 xi1， qi2 ke3 zuo3 you4。

interpretations.segmentation: 大道汜兮，其可左右。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Great Way floods everywhere; it may go left or right.

ddj-bs-ch-34.content: 万物恃之以生而不辞，功成而不有。
ddj-bs-ch-34.pinyin: wan4 wu4 shi4 zhi1 yi3 sheng1 er2 bu4 ci2， gong1 cheng2 er2 bu4 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 万物恃之以生而不辞，功成而不有。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things rely on it to live, and it does not refuse them; when the work is done, it claims no name of possession.

ddj-bs-ch-34.content: 衣养万物而不为主，常无欲，可名于小；
ddj-bs-ch-34.pinyin: yi1 yang3 wan4 wu4 er2 bu4 wei4 zhu3， chang2 wu2 yu4， ke3 ming2 yu2 xiao3；

interpretations.segmentation: 衣养万物而不为主，常无欲，可名于小；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: It clothes and nourishes the myriad things yet does not act as their master; always without desire, it may be named small;

ddj-bs-ch-34.content: 万物归焉而不为主，可名为大。
ddj-bs-ch-34.pinyin: wan4 wu4 gui1 yan1 er2 bu4 wei4 zhu3， ke3 ming2 wei4 da4。

interpretations.segmentation: 万物归焉而不为主，可名为大。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things return to it yet it does not act as their master—it may be named great.

ddj-bs-ch-34.content: 以其终不自为大，故能成其大。
ddj-bs-ch-34.pinyin: yi3 qi2 zhong1 bu4 zi4 wei4 da4， gu4 neng2 cheng2 qi2 da4。

interpretations.segmentation: 以其终不自为大，故能成其大。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Because to the end it does not make itself great, it is able to achieve its greatness.

ddj-bs-ch-35.pinyin: zhi2 da4 xiang4， tian1 xia4 wang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 执大象，天下往。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Hold the great image, and the world will come.

ddj-bs-ch-35.pinyin: wang3 er2 bu4 hai4， an1 ping2 tai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 往而不害，安平太。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Coming, they suffer no harm, but find peace, evenness, and ease.

ddj-bs-ch-35.content: 乐与饵，过客止，道之出口，淡乎其无味，视之不足见，听之不足闻，用之不足既。
ddj-bs-ch-35.pinyin: le4 yu3 er3， guo4 ke4 zhi3， dao4 zhi1 chu1 kou3， dan4 hu1 qi2 wu2 wei4， shi4 zhi1 bu4 zu2 jian4， ting1 zhi1 bu4 zu2 wen2， yong4 zhi1 bu4 zu2 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐与饵，过客止，道之出口，淡乎其无味，视之不足见，听之不足闻，用之不足既。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the Way comes forth from the mouth, how bland—it has no flavor; look, and it is not enough to see; listen, and it is not enough to hear; use it, and it is not enough to exhaust.

ddj-bs-ch-36.pinyin: jiang1 yu4 she4 zhi1， bi4 gu4 zhang1 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 将欲歙之，必固张之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is to be contracted must first be expanded;

ddj-bs-ch-36.pinyin: jiang1 yu4 ruo4 zhi1， bi4 gu4 qiang2 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 将欲弱之，必固强之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is to be weakened must first be strengthened;

ddj-bs-ch-36.pinyin: jiang1 yu4 fei4 zhi1， bi4 gu4 xing1 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 将欲废之，必固兴之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is to be abolished must first be raised;

ddj-bs-ch-36.pinyin: jiang1 yu4 qu3 zhi1， bi4 gu4 yu3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 将欲取之，必固与之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is to be taken must first be given.

ddj-bs-ch-36.pinyin: shi4 wei4 wei1 ming2， rou2 ruo4 sheng4 gang1 qiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是谓微明，柔弱胜刚强。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The soft and weak overcome the hard and strong.

ddj-bs-ch-36.content: 鱼不可脱于渊，国之利器不可以示人。
ddj-bs-ch-36.pinyin: yu2 bu4 ke3 tuo1 yu2 yuan1， guo2 zhi1 li4 qi4 bu4 ke3 yi3 shi4 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鱼不可脱于渊，国之利器不可以示人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Fish cannot leave the depths; the sharp instruments of the state must not be shown to others.

ddj-bs-ch-37.pinyin: dao4 chang2 wu2 wei4 er2 wu2 bu4 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 道常无为而无不为。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way constantly does nothing, yet nothing is left undone.

ddj-bs-ch-37.content: 候王若能守之，万物将自化。
ddj-bs-ch-37.pinyin: hou4 wang2 ruo4 neng2 shou3 zhi1， wan4 wu4 jiang1 zi4 hua4。

interpretations.segmentation: 候王若能守之，万物将自化。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If lords and kings can keep to it, the myriad things will transform of themselves.

ddj-bs-ch-37.content: 化而欲作，吾将镇之以无名之朴，镇之以无名之朴，夫将不欲。
ddj-bs-ch-37.pinyin: hua4 er2 yu4 zuo4， wu2 jiang1 zhen4 zhi1 yi3 wu2 ming2 zhi1 pu3， zhen4 zhi1 yi3 wu2 ming2 zhi1 pu3， fu1 jiang1 bu4 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 化而欲作，吾将镇之以无名之朴，镇之以无名之朴，夫将不欲。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If, transforming, desire should arise, I will quiet it with the nameless uncarved block.

ddj-bs-ch-37.pinyin: bu4 yu4 yi3 jing4， tian1 xia4 jiang1 zi4 ding4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不欲以静，天下将自定。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Without desire and thus still, the world will settle of itself.

ddj-bs-ch-38.pinyin: shang4 de2 bu4 de2， shi4 yi3 you3 de2；

interpretations.segmentation: 上德不德，是以有德；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Highest virtue is not virtue, and therefore it has virtue;

ddj-bs-ch-38.pinyin: xia4 de2 bu4 shi1 de2， shi4 yi3 wu2 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 下德不失德，是以无德。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Lower virtue never loses virtue, and therefore it has no virtue.

ddj-bs-ch-38.pinyin: shang4 de2 wu2 wei4 er2 wu2 yi3 wei4；

interpretations.segmentation: 上德无为而无以为；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Highest virtue does nothing and has no motive for doing;

ddj-bs-ch-38.pinyin: xia4 de2 wu2 wei4 er2 you3 yi3 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 下德无为而有以为。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Lower virtue acts and has a motive for acting.

ddj-bs-ch-38.pinyin: shang4 ren2 wei4 zhi1 er2 wu2 yi3 wei4；

interpretations.segmentation: 上仁为之而无以为；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Highest benevolence acts but has no motive for acting;

ddj-bs-ch-38.pinyin: shang4 yi4 wei4 zhi1 er2 you3 yi3 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 上义为之而有以为。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Highest righteousness acts and has a motive for acting.

ddj-bs-ch-38.content: 上礼为之而莫之应，则攘臂而扔之。
ddj-bs-ch-38.pinyin: shang4 li3 wei4 zhi1 er2 mo4 zhi1 ying1， ze2 rang3 bi4 er2 reng1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 上礼为之而莫之应，则攘臂而扔之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Highest propriety acts, and when none respond, it rolls up its sleeves and forces them.

ddj-bs-ch-38.content: 故失道而后德，失德而后仁，失仁而后义，失义而后礼。
ddj-bs-ch-38.pinyin: gu4 shi1 dao4 er2 hou4 de2， shi1 de2 er2 hou4 ren2， shi1 ren2 er2 hou4 yi4， shi1 yi4 er2 hou4 li3。

interpretations.segmentation: 故失道而后德，失德而后仁，失仁而后义，失义而后礼。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore when the Way is lost, then comes virtue; when virtue is lost, then comes benevolence; when benevolence is lost, then comes righteousness; when righteousness is lost, then comes propriety.

ddj-bs-ch-38.content: 夫礼者，忠信之薄，而乱之首。
ddj-bs-ch-38.pinyin: fu1 li3 zhe3， zhong1 xin4 zhi1 bao2， er2 luan4 zhi1 shou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫礼者，忠信之薄，而乱之首。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Propriety is the thinning of loyalty and trust, and the beginning of disorder.

ddj-bs-ch-38.content: 前识者，道之华，而愚之始。
ddj-bs-ch-38.pinyin: qian2 shi2 zhe3， dao4 zhi1 hua2， er2 yu2 zhi1 shi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 前识者，道之华，而愚之始。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Foresight is the flower of the Way, and the beginning of folly.

ddj-bs-ch-38.content: 是以大丈夫处其厚，不居其薄；
ddj-bs-ch-38.pinyin: shi4 yi3 da4 zhang4 fu1 chu4 qi2 hou4， bu4 ju1 qi2 bao2；

interpretations.segmentation: 是以大丈夫处其厚，不居其薄；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the great man abides in the thick, and does not dwell in the thin;

ddj-bs-ch-38.pinyin: chu4 qi2 shi2， bu4 ju1 qi2 hua2。

interpretations.segmentation: 处其实，不居其华。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Abides in the substance, and does not dwell in the flower.
故去彼取此。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus he discards that and takes this.

ddj-bs-ch-39.content: 昔之得一者，天得一以清；
ddj-bs-ch-39.pinyin: xi1 zhi1 de2 yi1 zhe3， tian1 de2 yi1 yi3 qing1；

interpretations.segmentation: 昔之得一者，天得一以清；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Of those who of old attained the One: Heaven attained the One and became clear;
地得一以宁；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Earth attained the One and became settled;
神得一以灵；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Spirits attained the One and became efficacious;

ddj-bs-ch-39.content: 谷得一以盈，万物得一以生；
ddj-bs-ch-39.pinyin: gu3 de2 yi1 yi3 ying2， wan4 wu4 de2 yi1 yi3 sheng1；

interpretations.segmentation: 谷得一以盈，万物得一以生；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things attained the One and came to life;

ddj-bs-ch-39.pinyin: hou2 wang2 de2 yi1 yi3 wei4 tian1 xia4 zheng4。

interpretations.segmentation: 侯王得一以为天下正。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Lords and kings attained the One and became the standard for the world.

ddj-bs-ch-39.content: 其致之也，谓天无以清，将恐裂；
ddj-bs-ch-39.pinyin: qi2 zhi4 zhi1 ye3， wei4 tian1 wu2 yi3 qing1， jiang1 kong3 lie4；

interpretations.segmentation: 其致之也，谓天无以清，将恐裂；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What brings this about: if Heaven had nothing by which to be clear, it would, I fear, split;

ddj-bs-ch-39.pinyin: di4 wu2 yi3 ning2， jiang1 kong3 fei4；

interpretations.segmentation: 地无以宁，将恐废；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If Earth had nothing by which to be settled, it would, I fear, collapse;

ddj-bs-ch-39.pinyin: shen2 wu2 yi3 ling2， jiang1 kong3 xie1；

interpretations.segmentation: 神无以灵，将恐歇；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If spirits had nothing by which to be efficacious, they would, I fear, cease;

ddj-bs-ch-39.pinyin: gu3 wu2 yi3 ying2， jiang1 kong3 jie2；

interpretations.segmentation: 谷无以盈，将恐竭；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If valleys had nothing by which to be full, they would, I fear, dry up;

ddj-bs-ch-39.pinyin: wan4 wu4 wu2 yi3 sheng1， jiang1 kong3 mie4；

interpretations.segmentation: 万物无以生，将恐灭；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If the myriad things had nothing by which to live, they would, I fear, perish;

ddj-bs-ch-39.pinyin: hou4 wang2 wu2 yi3 zheng4， jiang1 kong3 jue2。

interpretations.segmentation: 候王无以正，将恐蹶。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If lords and kings had nothing by which to be noble and high, they would, I fear, fall.

ddj-bs-ch-39.content: 故贵以贱为本，高以下为基。
ddj-bs-ch-39.pinyin: gu4 gui4 yi3 jian4 wei4 ben3， gao1 yi3 xia4 wei4 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 故贵以贱为本，高以下为基。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the noble takes the lowly as its root; the high takes the low as its foundation.

ddj-bs-ch-39.content: 是以侯王自称孤、寡、不谷。
ddj-bs-ch-39.pinyin: shi4 yi3 hou2 wang2 zi4 cheng1 gu1、 gua3、 bu4 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以侯王自称孤、寡、不谷。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus lords and kings call themselves "orphan," "lonely," and "unworthy."

ddj-bs-ch-39.pinyin: ci3 fei1 yi3 jian4 wei4 ben3 xie2？

interpretations.segmentation: 此非以贱为本邪？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Is this not taking the lowly as the root?
非乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Is it not so?
故至誉无誉。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Hence the highest praise is without praise.

ddj-bs-ch-39.content: 是故不欲琭琭如玉，珞珞如石。
ddj-bs-ch-39.pinyin: shi4 gu4 bu4 yu4 lu4 lu4 ru2 yu4， luo4 luo4 ru2 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是故不欲琭琭如玉，珞珞如石。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not desire to shine like jade, or to be hard like stone.

ddj-bs-ch-40.content: 反者道之动，弱者道之用。
ddj-bs-ch-40.pinyin: fan3 zhe3 dao4 zhi1 dong4， ruo4 zhe3 dao4 zhi1 yong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 反者道之动，弱者道之用。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Return is the movement of the Way; weakness is the use of the Way.

ddj-bs-ch-40.content: 天下万物生于有，有生于无。
ddj-bs-ch-40.pinyin: tian1 xia4 wan4 wu4 sheng1 yu2 you3， you3 sheng1 yu2 wu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下万物生于有，有生于无。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things under Heaven are born of being; being is born of non-being.

ddj-bs-ch-41.pinyin: shang4 shi4 wen2 dao4， qin2 er2 xing2 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 上士闻道，勤而行之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the highest type of man hears the Way, he diligently puts it into practice;

ddj-bs-ch-41.pinyin: zhong1 shi4 wen2 dao4， ruo4 cun2 ruo4 wang2；

interpretations.segmentation: 中士闻道，若存若亡；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the middling type hears the Way, he seems to keep it and seems to lose it;

ddj-bs-ch-41.pinyin: xia4 shi4 wen2 dao4， da4 xiao4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 下士闻道，大笑之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the lowest type hears the Way, he laughs aloud at it.

ddj-bs-ch-41.pinyin: bu4 xiao4 bu4 zu2 yi3 wei4 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不笑不足以为道。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If it were not laughed at, it would not be fit to be the Way.

ddj-bs-ch-41.content: 故建言有之：明道若昧，进道若退，夷道若纇。
ddj-bs-ch-41.pinyin: gu4 jian4 yan2 you3 zhi1： ming2 dao4 ruo4 mei4， jin4 dao4 ruo4 tui4， yi2 dao4 ruo4 lei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 故建言有之：明道若昧，进道若退，夷道若纇。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the established sayings have it: The bright Way seems dark;
上德若谷；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Highest virtue seems like a valley;
大白若辱；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Great whiteness seems stained;
广德若不足；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Abundant virtue seems insufficient;
建德若偷；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Established virtue seems stealthy;
质真若渝。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Genuine substance seems changeable;
大方无隅；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The great square has no corners;
大器晚成；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The great vessel is late in being completed;
大音希声；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The great note has a rarefied sound;
大象无形；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The great image has no form.
道隐无名。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way is hidden and nameless.

ddj-bs-ch-41.pinyin: fu1 wei2 dao4， shan4 dai4 qie3 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯道，善贷且成。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Only the Way is good at lending and bringing things to completion.

ddj-bs-ch-42.content: 道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物。
ddj-bs-ch-42.pinyin: dao4 sheng1 yi1， yi1 sheng1 er4， er4 sheng1 san1， san1 sheng1 wan4 wu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way gives birth to One; One gives birth to Two; Two gives birth to Three; Three gives birth to the myriad things.

ddj-bs-ch-42.content: 万物负阴而抱阳，冲气以为和。
ddj-bs-ch-42.pinyin: wan4 wu4 fu4 yin1 er2 bao4 yang2， chong1 qi4 yi3 wei4 he2。

interpretations.segmentation: 万物负阴而抱阳，冲气以为和。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things carry yin on their backs and embrace yang; the blending of the vital breaths makes harmony.

ddj-bs-ch-42.content: 人之所恶，唯孤、寡、不谷，而王公以为称。
ddj-bs-ch-42.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 suo3 e4， wei2 gu1、 gua3、 bu4 gu3， er2 wang2 gong1 yi3 wei4 cheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之所恶，唯孤、寡、不谷，而王公以为称。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What people detest—"orphan," "lonely," and "unworthy"—kings and dukes take as titles.

ddj-bs-ch-42.content: 故物或损之而益，或益之而损。
ddj-bs-ch-42.pinyin: gu4 wu4 huo4 sun3 zhi1 er2 yi4， huo4 yi4 zhi1 er2 sun3。

interpretations.segmentation: 故物或损之而益，或益之而损。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore some things are diminished and thereby gain; some are increased and thereby diminish.

ddj-bs-ch-42.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 suo3 jiao4， wo3 yi4 jiao4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之所教，我亦教之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What others teach, I also teach: the violent and overbearing do not meet a natural death—I take this as the father of my teaching.

ddj-bs-ch-42.content: 强梁者不得其死，吾将以为教父。
ddj-bs-ch-42.pinyin: qiang2 liang2 zhe3 bu4 de2 qi2 si3， wu2 jiang1 yi3 wei4 jiao4 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 强梁者不得其死，吾将以为教父。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What others teach, I also teach: the violent and overbearing do not meet a natural death—I take this as the father of my teaching.

ddj-bs-ch-43.content: 天下之至柔，驰骋天下之至坚。
ddj-bs-ch-43.pinyin: tian1 xia4 zhi1 zhi4 rou2， chi2 cheng3 tian1 xia4 zhi1 zhi4 jian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下之至柔，驰骋天下之至坚。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The softest thing under Heaven races through the hardest under Heaven.

ddj-bs-ch-43.content: 无有入无间，吾是以知无为之有益。
ddj-bs-ch-43.pinyin: wu2 you3 ru4 wu2 jian1， wu2 shi4 yi3 zhi1 wu2 wei4 zhi1 you3 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 无有入无间，吾是以知无为之有益。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: That which has no being enters where there is no space; thereby I know the benefit of non-action.

ddj-bs-ch-43.content: 不言之教，无为之益，天下希及之。
ddj-bs-ch-43.pinyin: bu4 yan2 zhi1 jiao4， wu2 wei4 zhi1 yi4， tian1 xia4 xi1 ji2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不言之教，无为之益，天下希及之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The teaching without words, the benefit of non-action—few under Heaven attain to these.
名与身孰亲？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Fame or the body—which is dearer?
身与货孰多？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The body or goods—which is worth more?
得与亡孰病？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Gain or loss—which is the greater affliction?

ddj-bs-ch-44.content: 甚爱必大费，多藏必厚亡。
