ddj-bs-ch-44.pinyin: shen4 ai4 bi4 da4 fei4， duo1 cang2 bi4 hou4 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 甚爱必大费，多藏必厚亡。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Excessive love must bring great expense;

ddj-bs-ch-44.content: 故知足不辱，知止不殆，可以长久。
ddj-bs-ch-44.pinyin: gu4 zhi1 zu2 bu4 ru3， zhi1 zhi3 bu4 dai4， ke3 yi3 zhang3 jiu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 故知足不辱，知止不殆，可以长久。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore know contentment and you will not be disgraced; know when to stop and you will not be in danger—you can last long.

ddj-bs-ch-45.pinyin: da4 cheng2 ruo4 que1， qi2 yong4 bu4 bi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 大成若缺，其用不弊。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Great completion seems incomplete, yet its use is never worn out.

ddj-bs-ch-45.pinyin: da4 ying2 ruo4 chong1， qi2 yong4 bu4 qiong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 大盈若冲，其用不穷。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Great fullness seems empty, yet its use is never exhausted.

ddj-bs-ch-45.content: 大直若屈，大巧若拙，大辩若讷。
ddj-bs-ch-45.pinyin: da4 zhi2 ruo4 qu1， da4 qiao3 ruo4 zhuo1， da4 bian4 ruo4 ne4。

interpretations.segmentation: 大直若屈，大巧若拙，大辩若讷。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Great straightness seems bent; great skill seems clumsy; great eloquence seems stammering.

ddj-bs-ch-45.pinyin: jing4 sheng4 zao4， han2 sheng4 re4。

interpretations.segmentation: 静胜躁，寒胜热。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Restlessness overcomes cold; stillness overcomes heat.

ddj-bs-ch-45.pinyin: qing1 jing4 wei4 tian1 xia4 zheng4。

interpretations.segmentation: 清静为天下正。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Clarity and stillness set the world in order.

ddj-bs-ch-46.content: 天下有道，却走马以粪，天下无道，戎马生于郊。
ddj-bs-ch-46.pinyin: tian1 xia4 you3 dao4， que4 zou3 ma3 yi3 fen4， tian1 xia4 wu2 dao4， rong2 ma3 sheng1 yu2 jiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下有道，却走马以粪，天下无道，戎马生于郊。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the world has the Way, spare horses are used for manure;

ddj-bs-ch-46.pinyin: huo4 mo4 da4 yu2 bu4 zhi1 zu2；

interpretations.segmentation: 祸莫大于不知足；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: No disaster is greater than not knowing contentment;

ddj-bs-ch-46.pinyin: jiu4 mo4 da4 yu2 yu4 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 咎莫大于欲得。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: No fault is greater than the desire to get.

ddj-bs-ch-46.pinyin: gu4 zhi1 zu2 zhi1 zu2， chang2 zu2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 故知足之足，常足矣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the contentment of knowing contentment is lasting contentment.

ddj-bs-ch-47.pinyin: bu4 chu1 hu4， zhi1 tian1 xia4；

interpretations.segmentation: 不出户，知天下；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Without going out the door, know the world;

ddj-bs-ch-47.pinyin: bu4 kui1 you3， jian4 tian1 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不窥牖，见天道。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Without looking through the window, see the Way of Heaven.

ddj-bs-ch-47.pinyin: qi2 chu1 mi2 yuan3， qi2 zhi1 mi2 shao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 其出弥远，其知弥少。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The farther one goes out, the less one knows.

ddj-bs-ch-47.content: 是以圣人不行而知，不见而明，不为而成。
ddj-bs-ch-47.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 bu4 xing2 er2 zhi1， bu4 jian4 er2 ming2， bu4 wei4 er2 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人不行而知，不见而明，不为而成。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage knows without traveling, understands without seeing, and accomplishes without acting.

ddj-bs-ch-48.content: 为学日益，为道日损，损之又损，以至于无为。
ddj-bs-ch-48.pinyin: wei4 xue2 ri4 yi4， wei4 dao4 ri4 sun3， sun3 zhi1 you4 sun3， yi3 zhi4 yu2 wu2 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 为学日益，为道日损，损之又损，以至于无为。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Decrease and again decrease, until one reaches non-action.

ddj-bs-ch-48.content: 无为而无不为，取天下常以无事；
ddj-bs-ch-48.pinyin: wu2 wei4 er2 wu2 bu4 wei4， qu3 tian1 xia4 chang2 yi3 wu2 shi4；

interpretations.segmentation: 无为而无不为，取天下常以无事；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Through non-action, nothing is left undone.

ddj-bs-ch-48.content: 及其有事，不足以取天下。
ddj-bs-ch-48.pinyin: ji2 qi2 you3 shi4， bu4 zu2 yi3 qu3 tian1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 及其有事，不足以取天下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To take the world, one must always be without meddling; when there is meddling, one is not fit to take the world.

ddj-bs-ch-49.content: 圣人常无心，以百姓之心为心。
ddj-bs-ch-49.pinyin: sheng4 ren2 chang2 wu2 xin1， yi3 bai3 xing4 zhi1 xin1 wei4 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 圣人常无心，以百姓之心为心。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The sage has no fixed mind; he takes the mind of the hundred clans as his mind.
善者，吾善之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who are good I treat as good; those who are not good I also treat as good—this is the virtue of goodness.

ddj-bs-ch-49.pinyin: bu4 shan4 zhe3， wu2 yi4 shan4 zhi1， de2 shan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不善者，吾亦善之，德善。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who are good I treat as good; those who are not good I also treat as good—this is the virtue of goodness.
信者，吾信之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who are trustworthy I trust; those who are not trustworthy I also trust—this is the virtue of trust.

ddj-bs-ch-49.pinyin: bu4 xin4 zhe3， wu2 yi4 xin4 zhi1， de2 xin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不信者，吾亦信之，德信。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who are trustworthy I trust; those who are not trustworthy I also trust—this is the virtue of trust.

ddj-bs-ch-49.content: 圣人在天下，歙歙焉为天下浑其心，百姓皆注其耳目，圣人皆孩之。
ddj-bs-ch-49.pinyin: sheng4 ren2 zai4 tian1 xia4， she4 she4 yan1 wei4 tian1 xia4 hun2 qi2 xin1， bai3 xing4 jie1 zhu4 qi2 er3 mu4， sheng4 ren2 jie1 hai2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 圣人在天下，歙歙焉为天下浑其心，百姓皆注其耳目，圣人皆孩之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The sage in the world gathers it in and makes the world's mind one and muddled.

ddj-bs-ch-50.content: 出生入死，生之徒，十有三；
ddj-bs-ch-50.pinyin: chu1 sheng1 ru4 si3， sheng1 zhi1 tu2， shi2 you3 san1；

interpretations.segmentation: 出生入死，生之徒，十有三；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Companions of life are three in ten;

ddj-bs-ch-50.pinyin: si3 zhi1 tu2， shi2 you3 san1；

interpretations.segmentation: 死之徒，十有三；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Companions of death are three in ten;

ddj-bs-ch-50.content: 人之生，动之于死地，亦十有三。
ddj-bs-ch-50.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 sheng1， dong4 zhi1 yu2 si3 di4， yi4 shi2 you3 san1。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之生，动之于死地，亦十有三。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: People whose living moves them onto the ground of death are also three in ten.
夫何故？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Why is this?

ddj-bs-ch-50.pinyin: yi3 qi2 sheng1 sheng1 zhi1 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 以其生生之厚。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Because they live life too richly.

ddj-bs-ch-50.content: 盖闻善摄生者，陆行不遇兕虎，入军不被甲兵。
ddj-bs-ch-50.pinyin: gai4 wen2 shan4 she4 sheng1 zhe3， lu4 xing2 bu4 yu4 si4 hu3， ru4 jun1 bu4 bei4 jia3 bing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 盖闻善摄生者，陆行不遇兕虎，入军不被甲兵。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I have heard that one skilled at preserving life walks on land without meeting rhinoceros or tiger, and enters the army without being touched by armor or weapons.

ddj-bs-ch-50.content: 兕无所投其角，虎无所措其爪，兵无所容其刃。
ddj-bs-ch-50.pinyin: si4 wu2 suo3 tou2 qi2 jiao3， hu3 wu2 suo3 cuo4 qi2 zhao3， bing1 wu2 suo3 rong2 qi2 ren4。

interpretations.segmentation: 兕无所投其角，虎无所措其爪，兵无所容其刃。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The rhinoceros finds no place to thrust its horn, the tiger no place to set its claws, weapons no place to lodge their blades.
夫何故？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Why is this?
以其无死地。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Because he has no ground of death.

ddj-bs-ch-51.content: 道生之，德畜之，物形之，势成之。
ddj-bs-ch-51.pinyin: dao4 sheng1 zhi1， de2 chu4 zhi1， wu4 xing2 zhi1， shi4 cheng2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 道生之，德畜之，物形之，势成之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way gives them birth; virtue rears them; things give them form; circumstances bring them to completion.

ddj-bs-ch-51.content: 是以万物莫不尊道而贵德。
ddj-bs-ch-51.pinyin: shi4 yi3 wan4 wu4 mo4 bu4 zun1 dao4 er2 gui4 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以万物莫不尊道而贵德。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore among the myriad things none fails to honor the Way and prize virtue.

ddj-bs-ch-51.content: 道之尊，德之贵，夫莫之命而常自然。
ddj-bs-ch-51.pinyin: dao4 zhi1 zun1， de2 zhi1 gui4， fu1 mo4 zhi1 ming4 er2 chang2 zi4 ran2。

interpretations.segmentation: 道之尊，德之贵，夫莫之命而常自然。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The honor of the Way and the prizing of virtue—none commands it, yet it is always naturally so.

ddj-bs-ch-51.content: 故道生之，德畜之，长之育之，亭之毒之；
ddj-bs-ch-51.pinyin: gu4 dao4 sheng1 zhi1， de2 chu4 zhi1， zhang3 zhi1 yu4 zhi1， ting2 zhi1 du2 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 故道生之，德畜之，长之育之，亭之毒之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the Way gives them birth, and virtue rears them;
养之覆之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Shelters them and protects them.

ddj-bs-ch-51.content: 生而不有，为而不恃，长而不宰，是谓玄德。
ddj-bs-ch-51.pinyin: sheng1 er2 bu4 you3， wei4 er2 bu4 shi4， zhang3 er2 bu4 zai3， shi4 wei4 xuan2 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 生而不有，为而不恃，长而不宰，是谓玄德。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: It gives birth but does not possess; acts but does not rely; raises but does not rule—this is called mysterious virtue.

ddj-bs-ch-52.pinyin: tian1 xia4 you3 shi3， yi3 wei4 tian1 xia4 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下有始，以为天下母。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The world has a beginning; take it as the mother of the world.

ddj-bs-ch-52.pinyin: ji4 de2 qi2 mu3， yi3 zhi1 qi2 zi；

interpretations.segmentation: 既得其母，以知其子；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Having found the mother, one knows her children;

ddj-bs-ch-52.content: 既知其子，复守其母，没身不殆。
ddj-bs-ch-52.pinyin: ji4 zhi1 qi2 zi， fu4 shou3 qi2 mu3， mei2 shen1 bu4 dai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 既知其子，复守其母，没身不殆。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Having known the children, return and keep to the mother, and to the end of life one is without danger.

ddj-bs-ch-52.content: 塞其兑，闭其门，终身不勤。
ddj-bs-ch-52.pinyin: sai1 qi2 dui4， bi4 qi2 men2， zhong1 shen1 bu4 qin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 塞其兑，闭其门，终身不勤。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Block the openings, shut the doors, and all one's life one will not toil.

ddj-bs-ch-52.content: 开其兑，济其事，终身不救。
ddj-bs-ch-52.pinyin: kai1 qi2 dui4， ji4 qi2 shi4， zhong1 shen1 bu4 jiu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 开其兑，济其事，终身不救。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Open the openings, multiply affairs, and all one's life one will not be saved.

ddj-bs-ch-52.pinyin: jian4 xiao3 yue1 ming2， shou3 rou2 yue1 qiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 见小曰明，守柔曰强。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To see the small is called insight; to keep to the soft is called strength.

ddj-bs-ch-52.content: 用其光，复归其明，无遗身殃；
ddj-bs-ch-52.pinyin: yong4 qi2 guang1， fu4 gui1 qi2 ming2， wu2 yi2 shen1 yang1；

interpretations.segmentation: 用其光，复归其明，无遗身殃；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Use the light, return again to insight, leave the body no calamity—this is called practicing the Constant.
是为袭常。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: This is called wearing the constant.

ddj-bs-ch-53.content: 使我介然有知，行于大道，唯施是畏。
ddj-bs-ch-53.pinyin: shi3 wo3 jie4 ran2 you3 zhi1， xing2 yu2 da4 dao4， wei2 shi1 shi4 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 使我介然有知，行于大道，唯施是畏。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If I had even a shred of knowledge, walking on the great Way, I would fear only going astray.

ddj-bs-ch-53.pinyin: da4 dao4 shen4 yi2， er2 ren2 hao3 jing4。

interpretations.segmentation: 大道甚夷，而人好径。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The great Way is very level, yet people love bypaths.

ddj-bs-ch-53.content: 朝甚除，田甚芜，仓甚虚，服文采，带利剑，厌饮食，财货有余，是谓盗竽。
ddj-bs-ch-53.pinyin: chao2 shen4 chu2， tian2 shen4 wu2， cang1 shen4 xu1， fu2 wen2 cai3， dai4 li4 jian4， yan4 yin3 shi2， cai2 huo4 you3 yu2， shi4 wei4 dao4 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 朝甚除，田甚芜，仓甚虚，服文采，带利剑，厌饮食，财货有余，是谓盗竽。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Wearing patterned clothes, carrying sharp swords, sated with food and drink, with goods in surplus—this is called the swagger of robbers.
非道也哉！
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not the Way!

ddj-bs-ch-54.content: 善建者不拔，善抱者不脱，子孙以祭祀不辍。
ddj-bs-ch-54.pinyin: shan4 jian4 zhe3 bu4 ba2， shan4 bao4 zhe3 bu4 tuo1， zi sun1 yi3 ji4 si4 bu4 chuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 善建者不拔，善抱者不脱，子孙以祭祀不辍。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is well planted is not uprooted; what is well embraced is not pulled away—sons and grandsons will offer sacrifice without cease.

ddj-bs-ch-54.pinyin: xiu1 zhi1 yu2 shen1， qi2 de2 nai3 zhen1；

interpretations.segmentation: 修之于身，其德乃真；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cultivate it in the person, and its virtue is genuine;

ddj-bs-ch-54.pinyin: xiu1 zhi1 yu2 jia1， qi2 de2 nai3 yu2；

interpretations.segmentation: 修之于家，其德乃余；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cultivate it in the family, and its virtue has surplus;

ddj-bs-ch-54.pinyin: xiu1 zhi1 yu2 xiang1， qi2 de2 nai3 zhang3；

interpretations.segmentation: 修之于乡，其德乃长；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cultivate it in the village, and its virtue endures;

ddj-bs-ch-54.pinyin: xiu1 zhi1 yu2 bang1， qi2 de2 nai3 feng1；

interpretations.segmentation: 修之于邦，其德乃丰；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cultivate it in the state, and its virtue is abundant;

ddj-bs-ch-54.pinyin: xiu1 zhi1 yu2 tian1 xia4， qi2 de2 nai3 pu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 修之于天下，其德乃普。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cultivate it in the world, and its virtue is universal.

ddj-bs-ch-54.content: 故以身观身，以家观家，以乡观乡，以邦观邦，以天下观天下。
ddj-bs-ch-54.pinyin: gu4 yi3 shen1 guan1 shen1， yi3 jia1 guan1 jia1， yi3 xiang1 guan1 xiang1， yi3 bang1 guan1 bang1， yi3 tian1 xia4 guan1 tian1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 故以身观身，以家观家，以乡观乡，以邦观邦，以天下观天下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore observe persons by the person, families by the family, villages by the village, states by the state, the world by the world.

ddj-bs-ch-54.pinyin: wu2 he2 yi3 zhi1 tian1 xia4 ran2 zai1？

interpretations.segmentation: 吾何以知天下然哉？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How do I know that the world is so?
以此。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: By this.

ddj-bs-ch-55.pinyin: han2 de2 zhi1 hou4， bi3 yu2 chi4 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 含德之厚，比于赤子。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who holds virtue in abundance may be compared to a newborn child.

ddj-bs-ch-55.content: 毒虫不螫，猛兽不据,攫鸟不搏。
ddj-bs-ch-55.pinyin: du2 chong2 bu4 shi4， meng3 shou4 bu4 ju4, jue2 niao3 bu4 bo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 毒虫不螫，猛兽不据,攫鸟不搏。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Poisonous insects do not sting it, fierce beasts do not seize it, birds of prey do not strike it.

ddj-bs-ch-55.pinyin: gu3 ruo4 jin1 rou2 er2 wo4 gu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 骨弱筋柔而握固。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Its bones are weak and its sinews soft, yet its grip is firm; it does not yet know the union of male and female, yet its organ stirs—this is the perfection of essence.

ddj-bs-ch-55.content: 未知牝牡之合而朘作，精之至也。
ddj-bs-ch-55.pinyin: wei4 zhi1 pin4 mu3 zhi1 he2 er2 zui1 zuo4， jing1 zhi1 zhi4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 未知牝牡之合而朘作，精之至也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Its bones are weak and its sinews soft, yet its grip is firm; it does not yet know the union of male and female, yet its organ stirs—this is the perfection of essence.

ddj-bs-ch-55.content: 终日号而不嗄，和之至也。
ddj-bs-ch-55.pinyin: zhong1 ri4 hao4 er2 bu4 a2， he2 zhi1 zhi4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 终日号而不嗄，和之至也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: It cries all day and does not grow hoarse—this is the perfection of harmony.

ddj-bs-ch-55.content: 知和曰常，知常曰明，益生曰祥，心使气曰强。
ddj-bs-ch-55.pinyin: zhi1 he2 yue1 chang2， zhi1 chang2 yue1 ming2， yi4 sheng1 yue1 xiang2， xin1 shi3 qi4 yue1 qiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 知和曰常，知常曰明，益生曰祥，心使气曰强。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To know harmony is called the Constant; to know the Constant is called insight; to force life is called ominous; for the mind to drive the vital breath is called forcing.

ddj-bs-ch-55.content: 物壮则老，谓之不道，不道早已。
ddj-bs-ch-55.pinyin: wu4 zhuang4 ze2 lao3， wei4 zhi1 bu4 dao4， bu4 dao4 zao3 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 物壮则老，谓之不道，不道早已。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When things are strong they grow old—this is called contrary to the Way; what is contrary to the Way comes to an early end.

ddj-bs-ch-56.pinyin: zhi1 zhe3 bu4 yan2， yan2 zhe3 bu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 知者不言，言者不知。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who know do not speak; those who speak do not know.

ddj-bs-ch-56.pinyin: sai1 qi2 dui4， bi4 qi2 men2；

interpretations.segmentation: 塞其兑，闭其门；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Block the openings, shut the doors;

ddj-bs-ch-56.pinyin: cuo4 qi2 rui4， jie3 qi2 fen1；

interpretations.segmentation: 挫其锐，解其纷；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Blunt the sharpness, untie the tangles;

ddj-bs-ch-56.content: 和其光，同其尘，是谓玄同。
ddj-bs-ch-56.pinyin: he2 qi2 guang1， tong2 qi2 chen2， shi4 wei4 xuan2 tong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 和其光，同其尘，是谓玄同。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Soften the glare, merge with the dust;

ddj-bs-ch-56.content: 故不可得而亲，不可得而疏；
ddj-bs-ch-56.pinyin: gu4 bu4 ke3 de2 er2 qin1， bu4 ke3 de2 er2 shu1；

interpretations.segmentation: 故不可得而亲，不可得而疏；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore one cannot get close to it, nor get distant from it;

ddj-bs-ch-56.content: 不可得而利，不可得而害；
ddj-bs-ch-56.pinyin: bu4 ke3 de2 er2 li4， bu4 ke3 de2 er2 hai4；

interpretations.segmentation: 不可得而利，不可得而害；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cannot get benefit from it, nor get harm from it;

ddj-bs-ch-56.content: 不可得而贵，不可得而贱；
ddj-bs-ch-56.pinyin: bu4 ke3 de2 er2 gui4， bu4 ke3 de2 er2 jian4；

interpretations.segmentation: 不可得而贵，不可得而贱；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cannot get honor from it, nor get lowliness from it.
故为天下贵。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore it is prized by all under Heaven.

ddj-bs-ch-57.content: 以正治国，以奇用兵，以无事取天下。
ddj-bs-ch-57.pinyin: yi3 zheng4 zhi4 guo2， yi3 qi2 yong4 bing1， yi3 wu2 shi4 qu3 tian1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 以正治国，以奇用兵，以无事取天下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Govern the state with uprightness, use arms with surprise, take the world by being without affairs.

ddj-bs-ch-57.pinyin: wu2 he2 yi3 zhi1 qi2 ran2 zai1？

interpretations.segmentation: 吾何以知其然哉？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How do I know that this is so?

ddj-bs-ch-57.content: 以此：天下多忌讳，而民弥贫；
ddj-bs-ch-57.pinyin: yi3 ci3： tian1 xia4 duo1 ji4 hui4， er2 min2 mi2 pin2；

interpretations.segmentation: 以此：天下多忌讳，而民弥贫；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: By this: the more taboos under Heaven, the poorer the people;

ddj-bs-ch-57.pinyin: ren2 duo1 li4 qi4， guo2 jia1 zi1 hun1；

interpretations.segmentation: 人多利器，国家滋昏；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The more sharp instruments among the people, the more the state grows disordered;

ddj-bs-ch-57.pinyin: ren2 duo1 ji4 qiao3， qi2 wu4 zi1 qi3；

interpretations.segmentation: 人多伎巧，奇物滋起；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The more skills people have, the more strange things arise;

ddj-bs-ch-57.pinyin: fa3 ling4 zi1 zhang1， dao4 zei2 duo1 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 法令滋彰，盗贼多有。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The more laws and ordinances are proclaimed, the more thieves and robbers there are.

ddj-bs-ch-57.content: 故圣人云：我无为，而民自化；
ddj-bs-ch-57.pinyin: gu4 sheng4 ren2 yun2： wo3 wu2 wei4， er2 min2 zi4 hua4；

interpretations.segmentation: 故圣人云：我无为，而民自化；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage says: I do nothing, and the people transform of themselves;

ddj-bs-ch-57.pinyin: wo3 hao3 jing4， er2 min2 zi4 zheng4；

interpretations.segmentation: 我好静，而民自正；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I love stillness, and the people correct themselves;

ddj-bs-ch-57.pinyin: wo3 wu2 shi4， er2 min2 zi4 fu4；

interpretations.segmentation: 我无事，而民自富；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I am without affairs, and the people enrich themselves;

ddj-bs-ch-57.pinyin: wo3 wu2 yu4， er2 min2 zi4 pu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我无欲，而民自朴。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I am without desire, and the people become simple of themselves.

ddj-bs-ch-58.pinyin: qi2 zheng4 men4 men4， qi2 min2 chun2 chun2；

interpretations.segmentation: 其政闷闷，其民淳淳；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When government is muffled and dull, the people are pure and simple;

ddj-bs-ch-58.pinyin: qi2 zheng4 cha2 cha2， qi2 min2 que1 que1。

interpretations.segmentation: 其政察察，其民缺缺。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When government is sharp and prying, the people are wanting and deficient.

ddj-bs-ch-58.pinyin: huo4 xi1， fu2 zhi1 suo3 yi3；

interpretations.segmentation: 祸兮，福之所倚；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Disaster is that on which good fortune leans; good fortune is that in which disaster lurks.

ddj-bs-ch-58.pinyin: fu2 xi1， huo4 zhi1 suo3 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 福兮，祸之所伏。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Disaster is that on which good fortune leans; good fortune is that in which disaster lurks.

ddj-bs-ch-58.pinyin: shu2 zhi1 qi2 ji2： qi2 wu2 zheng4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 孰知其极：其无正也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Who knows their limit?

ddj-bs-ch-58.pinyin: zheng4 fu4 wei4 qi2， shan4 fu4 wei4 yao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 正复为奇，善复为妖。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The correct reverts to the strange; the good reverts to the ominous.

ddj-bs-ch-58.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 mi2， qi2 ri4 gu4 jiu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之迷，其日固久。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: People's confusion has long been so.

ddj-bs-ch-58.content: 是以圣人方而不割，廉而不刿，直而不肆，光而不耀。
ddj-bs-ch-58.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 fang1 er2 bu4 ge1， lian2 er2 bu4 gui4， zhi2 er2 bu4 si4， guang1 er2 bu4 yao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人方而不割，廉而不刿，直而不肆，光而不耀。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage is square but does not cut; sharp but does not wound; straight but not unrestrained; bright but not dazzling.

ddj-bs-ch-59.pinyin: zhi4 ren2 shi4 tian1， mo4 ruo4 se4。

interpretations.segmentation: 治人事天，莫若啬。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In governing people and serving Heaven, nothing is better than frugality.

ddj-bs-ch-59.pinyin: fu1 wei2 se4， shi4 wei4 zao3 fu2；

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯啬，是谓早服；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Only frugality is called early submission;

ddj-bs-ch-59.pinyin: zao3 fu2 wei4 zhi1 zhong4 ji1 de2；

interpretations.segmentation: 早服谓之重积德；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Early submission is called heavily accumulating virtue;

ddj-bs-ch-59.pinyin: zhong4 ji1 de2 ze2 wu2 bu4 ke4；

interpretations.segmentation: 重积德则无不克；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heavily accumulating virtue, there is nothing one cannot overcome;

ddj-bs-ch-59.content: 无不克则莫知其极，莫知其极，可以有国；
ddj-bs-ch-59.pinyin: wu2 bu4 ke4 ze2 mo4 zhi1 qi2 ji2， mo4 zhi1 qi2 ji2， ke3 yi3 you3 guo2；

interpretations.segmentation: 无不克则莫知其极，莫知其极，可以有国；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When there is nothing one cannot overcome, none knows one's limit;

ddj-bs-ch-59.pinyin: you3 guo2 zhi1 mu3， ke3 yi3 zhang3 jiu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有国之母，可以长久。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Possessing the mother of the state, one can last long.

ddj-bs-ch-59.content: 是谓根深固柢，长生久视之道。
ddj-bs-ch-59.pinyin: shi4 wei4 gen1 shen1 gu4 di3， zhang3 sheng1 jiu3 shi4 zhi1 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是谓根深固柢，长生久视之道。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: This is called deep roots and a firm base—the Way of long life and lasting vision.

ddj-bs-ch-60.content: 治大国，若烹小鲜，以道莅天下，其鬼不神。
ddj-bs-ch-60.pinyin: zhi4 da4 guo2， ruo4 peng1 xiao3 xian1， yi3 dao4 li4 tian1 xia4， qi2 gui3 bu4 shen2。

interpretations.segmentation: 治大国，若烹小鲜，以道莅天下，其鬼不神。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When one approaches the world with the Way, its ghosts have no spirit;

ddj-bs-ch-60.content: 非其鬼不神，其神不伤人。
ddj-bs-ch-60.pinyin: fei1 qi2 gui3 bu4 shen2， qi2 shen2 bu4 shang1 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 非其鬼不神，其神不伤人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not that the ghosts have no spirit, but that their spirit does not harm people;

ddj-bs-ch-60.content: 非其神不伤人，圣人亦不伤人。
ddj-bs-ch-60.pinyin: fei1 qi2 shen2 bu4 shang1 ren2， sheng4 ren2 yi4 bu4 shang1 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 非其神不伤人，圣人亦不伤人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not only that their spirit does not harm people—the sage also does not harm people.

ddj-bs-ch-60.content: 夫两不相伤，故德交归焉。
ddj-bs-ch-60.pinyin: fu1 liang3 bu4 xiang1 shang1， gu4 de2 jiao1 gui1 yan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫两不相伤，故德交归焉。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When these two do not harm each other, virtue converges and returns to them.

ddj-bs-ch-61.content: 大邦者下流，天下之牝，天下之交也。
ddj-bs-ch-61.pinyin: da4 bang1 zhe3 xia4 liu2， tian1 xia4 zhi1 pin4， tian1 xia4 zhi1 jiao1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 大邦者下流，天下之牝，天下之交也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A great state is like the lower reaches of a river—the female of the world, the meeting place of the world.

ddj-bs-ch-61.content: 牝常以静胜牡，以静为下。
ddj-bs-ch-61.pinyin: pin4 chang2 yi3 jing4 sheng4 mu3， yi3 jing4 wei4 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 牝常以静胜牡，以静为下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The female constantly overcomes the male by stillness, and by stillness takes the lower place.

ddj-bs-ch-61.content: 故大邦以下小邦，则取小邦；
ddj-bs-ch-61.pinyin: gu4 da4 bang1 yi3 xia4 xiao3 bang1， ze2 qu3 xiao3 bang1；

interpretations.segmentation: 故大邦以下小邦，则取小邦；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore when a great state places itself below a small state, it takes the small state;

ddj-bs-ch-61.content: 小邦以下大邦，则取大邦。
ddj-bs-ch-61.pinyin: xiao3 bang1 yi3 xia4 da4 bang1， ze2 qu3 da4 bang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 小邦以下大邦，则取大邦。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When a small state places itself below a great state, it is taken by the great state.

ddj-bs-ch-61.pinyin: gu4 huo4 xia4 yi3 qu3， huo4 xia4 er2 qu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 故或下以取，或下而取。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus some take by placing themselves below; some are taken by placing themselves below.

ddj-bs-ch-61.content: 大邦不过欲兼畜人，小邦不过欲入事人。
ddj-bs-ch-61.pinyin: da4 bang1 bu4 guo4 yu4 jian1 chu4 ren2， xiao3 bang1 bu4 guo4 yu4 ru4 shi4 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 大邦不过欲兼畜人，小邦不过欲入事人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A great state wants no more than to unite and nurture others; a small state wants no more than to enter and serve others.

ddj-bs-ch-61.content: 夫两者各得所欲，大者宜为下。
ddj-bs-ch-61.pinyin: fu1 liang3 zhe3 ge4 de2 suo3 yu4， da4 zhe3 yi2 wei4 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫两者各得所欲，大者宜为下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When both get what they desire, the great one should take the lower place.

ddj-bs-ch-62.content: 道者，万物之奥，善人之宝，不善人之所保。
ddj-bs-ch-62.pinyin: dao4 zhe3， wan4 wu4 zhi1 ao4， shan4 ren2 zhi1 bao3， bu4 shan4 ren2 zhi1 suo3 bao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 道者，万物之奥，善人之宝，不善人之所保。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way is the sanctuary of the myriad things, the treasure of the good man, and that by which the not-good are kept.

ddj-bs-ch-62.content: 美言可以市尊，美行可以加人。
ddj-bs-ch-62.pinyin: mei3 yan2 ke3 yi3 shi4 zun1， mei3 xing2 ke3 yi3 jia1 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 美言可以市尊，美行可以加人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Fine words can purchase honor; fine conduct can raise a person above others.

ddj-bs-ch-62.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 bu4 shan4， he2 qi4 zhi1 you3？

interpretations.segmentation: 人之不善，何弃之有？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Even if people are not good, how can they be abandoned?

ddj-bs-ch-62.content: 故立天子，置三公，虽有拱璧以先驷马，不如坐进此道。
ddj-bs-ch-62.pinyin: gu4 li4 tian1 zi， zhi4 san1 gong1， sui1 you3 gong3 bi4 yi3 xian1 si4 ma3， bu4 ru2 zuo4 jin4 ci3 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 故立天子，置三公，虽有拱璧以先驷马，不如坐进此道。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore when the Son of Heaven is established and the Three Dukes appointed, though one present a jade disk ahead of a team of four horses, it is not as good as sitting and offering this Way.

ddj-bs-ch-62.pinyin: gu3 zhi1 suo3 yi3 gui4 ci3 dao4 zhe3 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 古之所以贵此道者何？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Why did the ancients prize this Way?

ddj-bs-ch-62.content: 不曰：求以得，有罪以免邪？
ddj-bs-ch-62.pinyin: bu4 yue1： qiu2 yi3 de2， you3 zui4 yi3 mian3 xie2？

interpretations.segmentation: 不曰：求以得，有罪以免邪？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Was it not said: by seeking, one obtains; having guilt, one is spared?
故为天下贵。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore it is prized by all under Heaven.

ddj-bs-ch-63.pinyin: wei4 wu2 wei4， shi4 wu2 shi4， wei4 wu2 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 为无为，事无事，味无味。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Act by non-action; handle affairs by being without affairs; taste the tasteless.
大小多少。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Regard the great as small, the many as few; repay injury with virtue.
报怨以德。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Regard the great as small, the many as few; repay injury with virtue.

ddj-bs-ch-63.content: 图难于其易，为大于其细；
ddj-bs-ch-63.pinyin: tu2 nan2 yu2 qi2 yi4， wei4 da4 yu2 qi2 xi4；

interpretations.segmentation: 图难于其易，为大于其细；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Plan the difficult while it is easy; do the great while it is fine.

ddj-bs-ch-63.pinyin: tian1 xia4 nan2 shi4， bi4 zuo4 yu2 yi4；

interpretations.segmentation: 天下难事，必作于易；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The difficult affairs of the world must arise from the easy; the great affairs of the world must arise from the fine.

ddj-bs-ch-63.pinyin: tian1 xia4 da4 shi4， bi4 zuo4 yu2 xi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下大事，必作于细。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The difficult affairs of the world must arise from the easy; the great affairs of the world must arise from the fine.

ddj-bs-ch-63.content: 是以圣人终不为大，故能成其大。
ddj-bs-ch-63.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 zhong1 bu4 wei4 da4， gu4 neng2 cheng2 qi2 da4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人终不为大，故能成其大。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage to the end does not attempt the great, and so is able to achieve greatness.

ddj-bs-ch-63.content: 夫轻诺必寡信，多易必多难。
ddj-bs-ch-63.pinyin: fu1 qing1 nuo4 bi4 gua3 xin4， duo1 yi4 bi4 duo1 nan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫轻诺必寡信，多易必多难。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Light promises must bring little trust; taking many things as easy must bring many difficulties.

ddj-bs-ch-63.content: 是以圣人犹难之，故终无难矣。
ddj-bs-ch-63.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 you2 nan2 zhi1， gu4 zhong1 wu2 nan2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人犹难之，故终无难矣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage still treats them as difficult, and so in the end has no difficulty.

ddj-bs-ch-64.pinyin: qi2 an1 yi4 chi2， qi2 wei4 zhao4 yi4 mou2；

interpretations.segmentation: 其安易持，其未兆易谋；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is at peace is easy to hold; what has not yet shown signs is easy to plan for.

ddj-bs-ch-64.pinyin: qi2 cui4 yi4 pan4， qi2 wei1 yi4 san4。

interpretations.segmentation: 其脆易泮，其微易散。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is brittle is easy to break; what is minute is easy to scatter.

ddj-bs-ch-64.content: 为之于未有，治之于未乱。
ddj-bs-ch-64.pinyin: wei4 zhi1 yu2 wei4 you3， zhi4 zhi1 yu2 wei4 luan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 为之于未有，治之于未乱。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Act on it before it exists; order it before disorder arises.

ddj-bs-ch-64.pinyin: he2 bao4 zhi1 mu4， sheng1 yu2 hao2 mo4；

interpretations.segmentation: 合抱之木，生于毫末；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A tree that fills the arms' embrace grows from a tiny shoot;

ddj-bs-ch-64.pinyin: jiu3 ceng2 zhi1 tai2， qi3 yu2 lei4 tu3；

interpretations.segmentation: 九层之台，起于累土；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A terrace of nine stories rises from a heap of earth;

ddj-bs-ch-64.pinyin: qian1 li3 zhi1 xing2， shi3 yu2 zu2 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 千里之行，始于足下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A journey of a thousand li begins under one's feet.

ddj-bs-ch-64.pinyin: wei4 zhe3 bai4 zhi1， zhi2 zhe3 shi1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 为者败之，执者失之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who acts upon it ruins it; he who grasps it loses it.

ddj-bs-ch-64.content: 是以圣人无为故无败，无执故无失。
ddj-bs-ch-64.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 wu2 wei4 gu4 wu2 bai4， wu2 zhi2 gu4 wu2 shi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人无为故无败，无执故无失。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage does not act, and so does not ruin; does not grasp, and so does not lose.

ddj-bs-ch-64.content: 民之从事，常于几成而败之。
ddj-bs-ch-64.pinyin: min2 zhi1 cong2 shi4， chang2 yu2 ji3 cheng2 er2 bai4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之从事，常于几成而败之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: People in their undertakings often fail when nearly complete.

ddj-bs-ch-64.pinyin: shen4 zhong1 ru2 shi3， ze2 wu2 bai4 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 慎终如始，则无败事。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Be as careful at the end as at the beginning, and there will be no failed affairs.

ddj-bs-ch-64.content: 是以圣人欲不欲，不贵难得之货，学不学，复众人之所过，以辅万物之自然而不敢为。
ddj-bs-ch-64.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 yu4 bu4 yu4， bu4 gui4 nan2 de2 zhi1 huo4， xue2 bu4 xue2， fu4 zhong4 ren2 zhi1 suo3 guo4， yi3 fu3 wan4 wu4 zhi1 zi4 ran2 er2 bu4 gan3 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人欲不欲，不贵难得之货，学不学，复众人之所过，以辅万物之自然而不敢为。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage desires not to desire, and does not prize goods hard to obtain;

ddj-bs-ch-65.content: 古之善为道者，非以明民，将以愚之。
ddj-bs-ch-65.pinyin: gu3 zhi1 shan4 wei4 dao4 zhe3， fei1 yi3 ming2 min2， jiang1 yi3 yu2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 古之善为道者，非以明民，将以愚之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those of old who were good at practicing the Way did not use it to enlighten the people, but to keep them simple.

ddj-bs-ch-65.pinyin: min2 zhi1 nan2 zhi4， yi3 qi2 zhi4 duo1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之难治，以其智多。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The people are hard to govern because they have too much cleverness.

ddj-bs-ch-65.pinyin: gu4 yi3 zhi4 zhi4 guo2， guo2 zhi1 zei2；

interpretations.segmentation: 故以智治国，国之贼；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore to govern a state by cleverness is to be a thief of the state;

ddj-bs-ch-65.pinyin: bu4 yi3 zhi4 zhi4 guo2， guo2 zhi1 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 不以智治国，国之福。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Not to govern a state by cleverness is to be a blessing to the state.

ddj-bs-ch-65.pinyin: zhi1 ci3 liang3 zhe3， yi4 ji1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 知此两者，亦稽式。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To know these two is also a standard.

ddj-bs-ch-65.pinyin: chang2 zhi1 ji1 shi4， shi4 wei4 xuan2 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 常知稽式，是谓玄德。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Always to know the standard is called mysterious virtue.

ddj-bs-ch-65.content: 玄德深矣，远矣，与物反矣，然后乃至大顺。
ddj-bs-ch-65.pinyin: xuan2 de2 shen1 yi3， yuan3 yi3， yu3 wu4 fan3 yi3， ran2 hou4 nai3 zhi4 da4 shun4。

interpretations.segmentation: 玄德深矣，远矣，与物反矣，然后乃至大顺。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Mysterious virtue is deep, is far; it returns with things, and only then reaches great accordance.

ddj-bs-ch-66.content: 江海之所以能为百谷王者，以其善下之，故能为百谷王。
ddj-bs-ch-66.pinyin: jiang1 hai3 zhi1 suo3 yi3 neng2 wei4 bai3 gu3 wang2 zhe3， yi3 qi2 shan4 xia4 zhi1， gu4 neng2 wei4 bai3 gu3 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 江海之所以能为百谷王者，以其善下之，故能为百谷王。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The reason the rivers and the sea can be kings of the hundred valleys is that they are good at taking the lower place—thus they can be kings of the hundred valleys.

ddj-bs-ch-66.content: 是以圣人欲上民，必以言下之；
ddj-bs-ch-66.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 yu4 shang4 min2， bi4 yi3 yan2 xia4 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人欲上民，必以言下之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore if the sage would be above the people, he must in speech put himself below them;

ddj-bs-ch-66.pinyin: yu4 xian1 min2， bi4 yi3 shen1 hou4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 欲先民，必以身后之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If he would be ahead of the people, he must in person put himself behind them.

ddj-bs-ch-66.content: 是以圣人处上而民不重，处前而民不害。
ddj-bs-ch-66.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 chu4 shang4 er2 min2 bu4 zhong4， chu4 qian2 er2 min2 bu4 hai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人处上而民不重，处前而民不害。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage dwells above and the people do not feel burdened; dwells ahead and the people do not feel harmed.

ddj-bs-ch-66.pinyin: shi4 yi3 tian1 xia4 le4 tui1 er2 bu4 yan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以天下乐推而不厌。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore all under Heaven gladly push him forward and do not tire of him.

ddj-bs-ch-66.content: 以其不争，故天下莫能与之争。
ddj-bs-ch-66.pinyin: yi3 qi2 bu4 zheng1， gu4 tian1 xia4 mo4 neng2 yu3 zhi1 zheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 以其不争，故天下莫能与之争。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Because he does not contend, no one under Heaven can contend with him.

ddj-bs-ch-67.content: 天下皆谓我道大，似不肖。
ddj-bs-ch-67.pinyin: tian1 xia4 jie1 wei4 wo3 dao4 da4， shi4 bu4 xiao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下皆谓我道大，似不肖。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: All under Heaven say my Way is great, and seems unlike anything else.

ddj-bs-ch-67.pinyin: fu1 wei2 da4， gu4 shi4 bu4 xiao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯大，故似不肖。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because it is great, it seems unlike anything else.

ddj-bs-ch-67.pinyin: ruo4 xiao4， jiu3 yi3 qi2 xi4 ye3 fu1！

interpretations.segmentation: 若肖，久矣其细也夫！
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If it were like anything else, it would long ago have been small!

ddj-bs-ch-67.content: 我有三宝，持而保之：一曰慈，二曰俭，三曰不敢为天下先。
ddj-bs-ch-67.pinyin: wo3 you3 san1 bao3， chi2 er2 bao3 zhi1： yi1 yue1 ci2， er4 yue1 jian3， san1 yue1 bu4 gan3 wei4 tian1 xia4 xian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我有三宝，持而保之：一曰慈，二曰俭，三曰不敢为天下先。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I have three treasures that I hold and keep: the first is compassion; the second is frugality; the third is not daring to be first under Heaven.
慈故能勇；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: With compassion one can be brave;
俭故能广；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: With frugality one can be generous;

ddj-bs-ch-67.content: 不敢为天下先，故能成器长。
ddj-bs-ch-67.pinyin: bu4 gan3 wei4 tian1 xia4 xian1， gu4 neng2 cheng2 qi4 zhang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 不敢为天下先，故能成器长。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Not daring to be first under Heaven, one can become the chief of vessels.
今舍慈且勇；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Now to discard compassion and yet be brave, to discard frugality and yet be generous, to discard being behind and yet be first—is to die!
舍俭且广；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: With frugality one can be generous;
舍后且先；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To cast aside the rear and put oneself first—
死矣！
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: is death!

ddj-bs-ch-67.content: 夫慈，以战则胜，以守则固。
ddj-bs-ch-67.pinyin: fu1 ci2， yi3 zhan4 ze2 sheng4， yi3 shou3 ze2 gu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫慈，以战则胜，以守则固。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: With compassion, one who fights wins; one who defends holds firm.

ddj-bs-ch-67.pinyin: tian1 jiang1 jiu4 zhi1， yi3 ci2 wei4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天将救之，以慈卫之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven will save him, and guard him with compassion.

ddj-bs-ch-68.pinyin: shan4 wei4 shi4 zhe3， bu4 wu3；

interpretations.segmentation: 善为士者，不武；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One good at being an officer is not martial;
善战者，不怒；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: one good at battle is not angry;

ddj-bs-ch-68.pinyin: shan4 sheng4 di2 zhe3， bu4 yu3；

interpretations.segmentation: 善胜敌者，不与；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: one good at defeating enemies does not engage them;

ddj-bs-ch-68.pinyin: shan4 yong4 ren2 zhe3， wei4 zhi1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 善用人者，为之下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A good officer is not warlike; a good fighter is not angry; a good conqueror of enemies does not engage them; one good at using people places himself below them.

ddj-bs-ch-68.content: 是谓不争之德，是谓用人之力，是谓配天古之极。
ddj-bs-ch-68.pinyin: shi4 wei4 bu4 zheng1 zhi1 de2， shi4 wei4 yong4 ren2 zhi1 li4， shi4 wei4 pei4 tian1 gu3 zhi1 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是谓不争之德，是谓用人之力，是谓配天古之极。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: This is called the virtue of not contending; this is called the power of using people; this is called matching Heaven—the ultimate of old.

ddj-bs-ch-69.content: 用兵有言：吾不敢为主，而为客；
ddj-bs-ch-69.pinyin: yong4 bing1 you3 yan2： wu2 bu4 gan3 wei4 zhu3， er2 wei4 ke4；

interpretations.segmentation: 用兵有言：吾不敢为主，而为客；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Military strategists have a saying: I dare not be the host but prefer to be the guest; I dare not advance an inch but prefer to withdraw a foot.

ddj-bs-ch-69.pinyin: bu4 gan3 jin4 cun4， er2 tui4 chi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 不敢进寸，而退尺。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Military strategists have a saying: I dare not be the host but prefer to be the guest; I dare not advance an inch but prefer to withdraw a foot.
是谓行无行；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: This is called marching without ranks, rolling up the sleeves without an arm, facing without an enemy, grasping without a weapon.
攘无臂；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: to bare an arm where there is none;
扔无敌；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: to throw where there is no enemy;
执无兵。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: to grasp a weapon where there is none.

ddj-bs-ch-69.content: 祸莫大于轻敌，轻敌几丧吾宝。
ddj-bs-ch-69.pinyin: huo4 mo4 da4 yu2 qing1 di2， qing1 di2 ji3 sang4 wu2 bao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 祸莫大于轻敌，轻敌几丧吾宝。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: No disaster is greater than underestimating the enemy; to underestimate the enemy is nearly to lose my treasure.

ddj-bs-ch-69.pinyin: gu4 kang4 bing1 xiang1 ruo4， ai1 zhe3 sheng4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 故抗兵相若，哀者胜矣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore when opposing armies are evenly matched, the one that grieves wins.

ddj-bs-ch-70.pinyin: wu2 yan2 shen4 yi4 zhi1， shen4 yi4 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 吾言甚易知，甚易行。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: My words are very easy to understand, very easy to practice.

ddj-bs-ch-70.pinyin: tian1 xia4 mo4 neng2 zhi1， mo4 neng2 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下莫能知，莫能行。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Yet none under Heaven can understand them, none can practice them.

ddj-bs-ch-70.content: 言有宗，事有君，夫唯无知，是以不我知。
ddj-bs-ch-70.pinyin: yan2 you3 zong1， shi4 you3 jun1， fu1 wei2 wu2 zhi1， shi4 yi3 bu4 wo3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 言有宗，事有君，夫唯无知，是以不我知。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because people are without knowledge, they do not understand me.

ddj-bs-ch-70.pinyin: zhi1 wo3 zhe3 xi1， ze2 wo3 zhe3 gui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 知我者希，则我者贵。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who understand me are rare; thus I am prized.

ddj-bs-ch-70.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 bei4 he4 er2 huai2 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人被褐而怀玉。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage wears coarse cloth and holds jade in his bosom.
知不知，尚矣；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To know that one does not know is best;
不知知，病也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Not to know and yet think one knows is a disease.

ddj-bs-ch-71.pinyin: sheng4 ren2 bu4 bing4， yi3 qi2 bing4 bing4。

interpretations.segmentation: 圣人不病，以其病病。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The sage is not diseased, because he treats disease as disease.

ddj-bs-ch-71.pinyin: fu1 wei2 bing4 bing4， shi4 yi3 bu4 bing4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯病病，是以不病。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because he treats disease as disease, he is therefore not diseased.

ddj-bs-ch-72.pinyin: min2 bu4 wei4 wei1， ze2 da4 wei1 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 民不畏威，则大威至。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the people do not fear power, then a greater power arrives.

ddj-bs-ch-72.content: 无狎其所居，无厌其所生。
ddj-bs-ch-72.pinyin: wu2 xia2 qi2 suo3 ju1， wu2 yan4 qi2 suo3 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无狎其所居，无厌其所生。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not constrict their dwellings; do not oppress their livelihood.

ddj-bs-ch-72.pinyin: fu1 wei2 bu4 yan4， shi4 yi3 bu4 yan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯不厌，是以不厌。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because one does not oppress, they are not oppressed.

ddj-bs-ch-72.content: 是以圣人自知不自见，自爱不自贵。
ddj-bs-ch-72.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 zi4 zhi1 bu4 zi4 jian4， zi4 ai4 bu4 zi4 gui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人自知不自见，自爱不自贵。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage knows himself but does not display himself; loves himself but does not exalt himself.
故去彼取此。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus he discards that and takes this.

ddj-bs-ch-73.content: 勇于敢则杀，勇于不敢则活。
ddj-bs-ch-73.pinyin: yong3 yu2 gan3 ze2 sha1， yong3 yu2 bu4 gan3 ze2 huo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 勇于敢则杀，勇于不敢则活。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Courage in daring leads to death; courage in not daring leads to life.

ddj-bs-ch-73.pinyin: ci3 liang3 zhe3， huo4 li4 huo4 hai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 此两者，或利或害。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Of these two, one benefits and one harms.

ddj-bs-ch-73.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 suo3 e4， shu2 zhi1 qi2 gu4？

interpretations.segmentation: 天之所恶，孰知其故？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What Heaven detests—who knows its reason?

ddj-bs-ch-73.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 you2 nan2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人犹难之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore even the sage finds this hard.

ddj-bs-ch-73.content: 天之道，不争而善胜，不应而善应，不召而自来，繟然而善谋。
ddj-bs-ch-73.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 dao4， bu4 zheng1 er2 shan4 sheng4， bu4 ying1 er2 shan4 ying1， bu4 zhao4 er2 zi4 lai2， chan3 ran2 er2 shan4 mou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天之道，不争而善胜，不应而善应，不召而自来，繟然而善谋。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way of Heaven does not contend and yet is good at winning; does not speak and yet is good at responding; is not summoned and yet comes of itself; is relaxed and yet good at planning.

ddj-bs-ch-73.pinyin: tian1 wang3 hui1 hui1， shu1 er2 bu4 shi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天网恢恢，疏而不失。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven's net is vast; though its mesh is coarse, nothing slips through.

ddj-bs-ch-74.content: 民不畏死，奈何以死惧之。
ddj-bs-ch-74.pinyin: min2 bu4 wei4 si3， nai4 he2 yi3 si3 ju4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民不畏死，奈何以死惧之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If the people do not fear death, how can one frighten them with death?

ddj-bs-ch-74.content: 若使民常畏死，而为奇者，吾得执而杀之，孰敢？
ddj-bs-ch-74.pinyin: ruo4 shi3 min2 chang2 wei4 si3， er2 wei4 qi2 zhe3， wu2 de2 zhi2 er2 sha1 zhi1， shu2 gan3？

interpretations.segmentation: 若使民常畏死，而为奇者，吾得执而杀之，孰敢？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If one could make the people constantly fear death, and there were those who acted strangely, I could seize and kill them—who would dare?

ddj-bs-ch-74.pinyin: chang2 you3 si1 sha1 zhe3 sha1。

interpretations.segmentation: 常有司杀者杀。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: There is always One who is in charge of killing.

ddj-bs-ch-74.content: 夫代司杀者杀，是谓代大匠斫，希有不伤其手者矣。
ddj-bs-ch-74.pinyin: fu1 dai4 si1 sha1 zhe3 sha1， shi4 wei4 dai4 da4 jiang4 zhuo2， xi1 you3 bu4 shang1 qi2 shou3 zhe3 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫代司杀者杀，是谓代大匠斫，希有不伤其手者矣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To take the place of the One in charge of killing is called hewing wood in place of the master carpenter.

ddj-bs-ch-75.content: 民之饥，以其上食税之多，是以饥。
ddj-bs-ch-75.pinyin: min2 zhi1 ji1， yi3 qi2 shang4 shi2 shui4 zhi1 duo1， shi4 yi3 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之饥，以其上食税之多，是以饥。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The people starve because those above eat too much in taxes—thus they starve.

ddj-bs-ch-75.content: 民之难治，以其上之有为，是以难治。
ddj-bs-ch-75.pinyin: min2 zhi1 nan2 zhi4， yi3 qi2 shang4 zhi1 you3 wei4， shi4 yi3 nan2 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之难治，以其上之有为，是以难治。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The people are hard to govern because those above are given to action—thus they are hard to govern.

ddj-bs-ch-75.content: 民之轻死，以其上求生之厚，是以轻死。
ddj-bs-ch-75.pinyin: min2 zhi1 qing1 si3， yi3 qi2 shang4 qiu2 sheng1 zhi1 hou4， shi4 yi3 qing1 si3。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之轻死，以其上求生之厚，是以轻死。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The people take death lightly because those above seek life too richly—thus they take death lightly.

ddj-bs-ch-75.content: 夫唯无以生为者，是贤于贵生。
ddj-bs-ch-75.pinyin: fu1 wei2 wu2 yi3 sheng1 wei4 zhe3， shi4 xian2 yu2 gui4 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯无以生为者，是贤于贵生。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Only one who does not make living his concern is wiser than one who values life.

ddj-bs-ch-76.content: 人之生也柔弱，其死也坚强。
ddj-bs-ch-76.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 sheng1 ye3 rou2 ruo4， qi2 si3 ye3 jian1 qiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之生也柔弱，其死也坚强。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When people are alive they are soft and weak; when dead they are hard and stiff.

ddj-bs-ch-76.content: 草木之生也柔脆，其死也枯槁。
ddj-bs-ch-76.pinyin: cao3 mu4 zhi1 sheng1 ye3 rou2 cui4， qi2 si3 ye3 ku1 gao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 草木之生也柔脆，其死也枯槁。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things, the grasses and trees, when alive are soft and fragile; when dead they are dry and withered.

ddj-bs-ch-76.content: 故坚强者死之徒，柔弱者生之徒。
ddj-bs-ch-76.pinyin: gu4 jian1 qiang2 zhe3 si3 zhi1 tu2， rou2 ruo4 zhe3 sheng1 zhi1 tu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 故坚强者死之徒，柔弱者生之徒。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the hard and strong are companions of death; the soft and weak are companions of life.

ddj-bs-ch-76.content: 是以兵强则灭，木强则折。
ddj-bs-ch-76.pinyin: shi4 yi3 bing1 qiang2 ze2 mie4， mu4 qiang2 ze2 zhe2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以兵强则灭，木强则折。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus when arms are strong they are destroyed; when a tree is strong it is broken.

ddj-bs-ch-76.pinyin: qiang2 da4 chu4 xia4， rou2 ruo4 chu4 shang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 强大处下，柔弱处上。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The strong and great take the lower place; the soft and weak take the higher place.

ddj-bs-ch-77.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 dao4， qi2 you2 zhang1 gong1 yu3？

interpretations.segmentation: 天之道，其犹张弓与？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way of Heaven—is it not like stretching a bow?

ddj-bs-ch-77.content: 高者抑下，下者举之，有余者损之，不足者补之。
ddj-bs-ch-77.pinyin: gao1 zhe3 yi4 xia4， xia4 zhe3 ju3 zhi1， you3 yu2 zhe3 sun3 zhi1， bu4 zu2 zhe3 bu3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 高者抑下，下者举之，有余者损之，不足者补之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What has surplus is diminished; what is insufficient is supplemented.

ddj-bs-ch-77.content: 天之道，损有余而补不足。
ddj-bs-ch-77.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 dao4， sun3 you3 yu2 er2 bu3 bu4 zu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天之道，损有余而补不足。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way of Heaven diminishes what has surplus and supplements what is insufficient.

ddj-bs-ch-77.content: 人之道，则不然，损不足以奉有余。
ddj-bs-ch-77.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 dao4， ze2 bu4 ran2， sun3 bu4 zu2 yi3 feng4 you3 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之道，则不然，损不足以奉有余。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The way of man is not so: it diminishes what is insufficient to offer to what has surplus.

ddj-bs-ch-77.content: 孰能有余以奉天下，唯有道者。
ddj-bs-ch-77.pinyin: shu2 neng2 you3 yu2 yi3 feng4 tian1 xia4， wei2 you3 dao4 zhe3。

interpretations.segmentation: 孰能有余以奉天下，唯有道者。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Who can take his surplus and offer it to the world?

ddj-bs-ch-77.content: 是以圣人为而不恃，功成而不处，其不欲见贤。
ddj-bs-ch-77.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 wei4 er2 bu4 shi4， gong1 cheng2 er2 bu4 chu4， qi2 bu4 yu4 jian4 xian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人为而不恃，功成而不处，其不欲见贤。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage acts but does not rely; when the work is done he does not dwell on it; he does not wish to display his worth.

ddj-bs-ch-78.content: 天下莫柔弱于水，而攻坚强者莫之能胜，以其无以易之。
ddj-bs-ch-78.pinyin: tian1 xia4 mo4 rou2 ruo4 yu2 shui3， er2 gong1 jian1 qiang2 zhe3 mo4 zhi1 neng2 sheng4， yi3 qi2 wu2 yi3 yi4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下莫柔弱于水，而攻坚强者莫之能胜，以其无以易之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Nothing under Heaven is softer and weaker than water, yet for attacking the hard and strong nothing can surpass it, because nothing can take its place.

ddj-bs-ch-78.content: 弱之胜强，柔之胜刚，天下莫不知，莫能行。
ddj-bs-ch-78.pinyin: ruo4 zhi1 sheng4 qiang2， rou2 zhi1 sheng4 gang1， tian1 xia4 mo4 bu4 zhi1， mo4 neng2 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 弱之胜强，柔之胜刚，天下莫不知，莫能行。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: That the weak overcomes the strong, the soft overcomes the hard—none under Heaven does not know it, yet none can put it into practice.

ddj-bs-ch-78.content: 是以圣人云：受国之垢，是谓社稷主；
ddj-bs-ch-78.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 yun2： shou4 guo2 zhi1 gou4， shi4 wei4 she4 ji4 zhu3；

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人云：受国之垢，是谓社稷主；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage says: He who takes upon himself the dirt of the state is called the lord of the altars of soil and grain;

ddj-bs-ch-78.pinyin: shou4 guo2 bu4 xiang2， shi4 wei4 tian1 xia4 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 受国不祥，是为天下王。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who takes upon himself the misfortunes of the state is called the king of the world.
正言若反。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: True words seem paradoxical.

ddj-bs-ch-79.pinyin: he2 da4 yuan4， bi4 you3 yu2 yuan4；

interpretations.segmentation: 和大怨，必有余怨；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When a great resentment is reconciled, there is sure to be leftover resentment—how can this be considered good?

ddj-bs-ch-79.pinyin: bao4 yuan4 yi3 de2， an1 ke3 yi3 wei4 shan4？

interpretations.segmentation: 报怨以德，安可以为善？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When a great resentment is reconciled, there is sure to be leftover resentment—how can this be considered good?

ddj-bs-ch-79.content: 是以圣人执左契，而不责于人。
ddj-bs-ch-79.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 zhi2 zuo3 qi4， er2 bu4 ze2 yu2 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人执左契，而不责于人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage holds the left-hand tally and does not press people for payment.

ddj-bs-ch-79.pinyin: you3 de2 si1 qi4， wu2 de2 si1 che4。

interpretations.segmentation: 有德司契，无德司彻。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One with virtue takes charge of the tally; one without virtue takes charge of the tax.

ddj-bs-ch-79.pinyin: tian1 dao4 wu2 qin1， chang2 yu3 shan4 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天道无亲，常与善人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way of Heaven shows no favoritism; it is always with the good person.
小国寡民。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Let the state be small and the people few.

ddj-bs-ch-80.pinyin: shi3 you3 shen2 bo2 zhi1 qi4 er2 bu4 yong4；

interpretations.segmentation: 使有什伯之器而不用；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Let there be tools for tens and hundreds, yet none be used;

ddj-bs-ch-80.pinyin: shi3 min2 zhong4 si3 er2 bu4 yuan3 xi3；

interpretations.segmentation: 使民重死而不远徙；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Let the people take death seriously and not migrate far.

ddj-bs-ch-80.pinyin: sui1 you3 zhou1 yu2， wu2 suo3 cheng2 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 虽有舟舆，无所乘之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Though there be boats and carriages, none will ride them;

ddj-bs-ch-80.pinyin: sui1 you3 jia3 bing1， wu2 suo3 chen2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 虽有甲兵，无所陈之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Though there be armor and weapons, none will display them.

ddj-bs-ch-80.pinyin: shi3 ren2 fu4 jie2 sheng2 er2 yong4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 使人复结绳而用之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Let the people return to knotting cords and using them.
至治之极。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: This is the utmost of ordered rule.

ddj-bs-ch-80.content: 甘美食，美其服，安其居，乐其俗，邻国相望，鸡犬之声相闻，民至老死不相往来。
ddj-bs-ch-80.pinyin: gan1 mei3 shi2， mei3 qi2 fu2， an1 qi2 ju1， le4 qi2 su2， lin2 guo2 xiang1 wang4， ji1 quan3 zhi1 sheng1 xiang1 wen2， min2 zhi4 lao3 si3 bu4 xiang1 wang3 lai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 甘美食，美其服，安其居，乐其俗，邻国相望，鸡犬之声相闻，民至老死不相往来。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Neighboring states may overlook one another, and the sounds of chickens and dogs be heard from each, yet the people grow old and die without coming and going among them.

ddj-bs-ch-81.pinyin: xin4 yan2 bu4 mei3， mei3 yan2 bu4 xin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 信言不美，美言不信。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: True words are not beautiful; beautiful words are not true.

ddj-bs-ch-81.pinyin: shan4 zhe3 bu4 bian4， bian4 zhe3 bu4 shan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 善者不辩，辩者不善。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The good do not argue; those who argue are not good.

ddj-bs-ch-81.pinyin: zhi1 zhe3 bu4 bo2， bo2 zhe3 bu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 知者不博，博者不知。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who know are not broadly learned; the broadly learned do not know.

ddj-bs-ch-81.content: 圣人不积，既以为人己愈有，既以与人己愈多。
ddj-bs-ch-81.pinyin: sheng4 ren2 bu4 ji1， ji4 yi3 wei4 ren2 ji3 yu4 you3， ji4 yi3 yu3 ren2 ji3 yu4 duo1。

interpretations.segmentation: 圣人不积，既以为人己愈有，既以与人己愈多。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The sage does not accumulate: having done for others, he has himself all the more; having given to others, he himself has all the more.

ddj-bs-ch-81.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 dao4， li4 er2 bu4 hai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天之道，利而不害。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way of Heaven benefits and does not harm;

ddj-bs-ch-81.pinyin: sheng4 ren2 zhi1 dao4， wei4 er2 bu4 zheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 圣人之道，为而不争。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way of the sage acts but does not contend.

ddj-ch-01.pinyin: dao4 ke3 dao4， fei1 chang2 dao4；

interpretations.segmentation: 道可道，非常道；
interpretations.explanation: 可以用言辞表述的「道」，就不是那永恒不变的道。强调道超言绝象，不可被概念完全固定。
interpretations.note: 通行读法：以「可道／非常道」相对。

terms.explanation: 本源、规律、道路；此处指终极之「道」。
可以说、可以用言语称说。

terms.note: 「非」否定；「常」永恒。帛书本作「非恒道」。

interpretations.segmentation: 道，可道非常道。
interpretations.explanation: 另作一读：先标举「道」，再言「可道」者皆非恒道。
interpretations.note: 较少见的断法，用来对照理解「道」与「可道」的层次。

terms.explanation: 凡可称说者，皆不是永恒之道。
terms.note: 将「可道非常道」作一整段判断。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way;
यः मार्गः वक्तुं शक्यते स नित्यमार्गः न भवति;

ddj-ch-01.pinyin: ming2 ke3 ming2， fei1 chang2 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 名可名，非常名。
interpretations.explanation: 可以用名号固定下来的「名」，就不是那永恒的名。与上句「道／名」对举。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

terms.explanation: 名称、名相，用以指称事物。

interpretations.segmentation: 名，可名非常名。
interpretations.note: 异读：与上句「道，可道…」同构。

interpretations.segmentation: The name that can be named is not the constant name.
यं नाम वक्तुं शक्यते तन्नित्यनाम न भवति।

ddj-ch-01.pinyin: wu2， ming2 tian1 di4 zhi1 shi3；

interpretations.segmentation: 无，名天地之始；
interpretations.explanation: 就「无」这一面说，可以称之为天地的开始。
interpretations.note: 王弼读法：在「无／有」处断读。

terms.explanation: 无形无名的面向；与「有」相对。

interpretations.segmentation: 无名，天地之始；
interpretations.explanation: 「无名」即天地之始。把「无名」视为一词。
interpretations.note: 今教材常见读法：以「无名／有名」为对。

interpretations.segmentation: The nameless is the beginning of Heaven and Earth;
अनाम्ना स्वर्गपृथिव्योः आरम्भः उच्यते;

ddj-ch-01.pinyin: you3， ming2 wan4 wu4 zhi1 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有，名万物之母。
interpretations.explanation: 就「有」这一面说，可以称之为万物的母亲。

interpretations.segmentation: 有名，万物之母。
interpretations.explanation: 「有名」即万物之母。

interpretations.segmentation: The named is the mother of the myriad things.
सत्ता सर्वभूतानां माता इति उच्यते।

ddj-ch-01.pinyin: gu4 chang2 wu2， yu4 yi3 guan1 qi2 miao4；

interpretations.segmentation: 故常无，欲以观其妙；
interpretations.explanation: 所以常从「无」的欲望状态去观照道的精微。

interpretations.segmentation: 故常无欲，以观其妙；
interpretations.explanation: 所以要常保持无欲，才能观照道的奥妙。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore, constantly without desire, one observes its subtlety;
तस्माद् नित्यम् अकरणेन तस्य गुह्यत्वं द्रष्टुं शक्यते;

ddj-ch-01.pinyin: chang2 you3， yu4 yi3 guan1 qi2 jiao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 常有，欲以观其徼。
interpretations.explanation: 常从「有」的一面去观照道的边际、显象。

terms.explanation: 用以观照道之端倪、边际。

interpretations.segmentation: 常有欲，以观其徼。
interpretations.explanation: 常就「有欲」的状态，观照道的端倪。

interpretations.segmentation: Constantly with desire, one observes its manifestations.
नित्यम् इच्छया तस्य प्रकाशं द्रष्टुं शक्यते।

ddj-ch-01.content: 此两者同出而异名，同谓之玄。
ddj-ch-01.pinyin: ci3 liang3 zhe3 tong2 chu1 er2 yi4 ming2， tong2 wei4 zhi1 xuan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 此两者同出而异名，同谓之玄。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: These two emerge together but differ in name; together they are called the Mystery.
इदमुभयं एकस्माद् उत्थितम् अन्यनाम, उभयं गुह्यम् इति उच्यते।

ddj-ch-01.pinyin: xuan2 zhi1 you4 xuan2， zhong4 miao4 zhi1 men2。

interpretations.segmentation: 玄之又玄，众妙之门。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Mystery upon mystery—the gateway of all wonders.
गुह्यस्य गुह्यं सर्वोत्कृष्टभेदानां द्वारम्।

ddj-ch-02.content: 天下皆知美之为美，斯恶已；
ddj-ch-02.pinyin: tian1 xia4 jie1 zhi1 mei3 zhi1 wei4 mei3， si1 e4 yi3；

interpretations.segmentation: 天下皆知美之为美，斯恶已；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When all under Heaven know beauty as beauty, then ugliness is already there;
जगति सर्वे सौन्दर्यं सौन्दर्यम् इति जानन्ति, तदा कुरूपता अस्त्येव;

ddj-ch-02.content: 皆知善之为善，斯不善已。
ddj-ch-02.pinyin: jie1 zhi1 shan4 zhi1 wei4 shan4， si1 bu4 shan4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 皆知善之为善，斯不善已。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When all know good as good, then what is not good is already there.
सर्वे शुभं शुभम् इति जानन्ति, तदा अशुभम् अस्त्येव।

ddj-ch-02.content: 故有无相生，难易相成，长短相形，高下相倾，音声相和，前后相随。
ddj-ch-02.pinyin: gu4 you3 wu2 xiang1 sheng1， nan2 yi4 xiang1 cheng2， zhang3 duan3 xiang1 xing2， gao1 xia4 xiang1 qing1， yin1 sheng1 xiang1 he2， qian2 hou4 xiang1 sui2。

interpretations.segmentation: 故有无相生，难易相成，长短相形，高下相倾，音声相和，前后相随。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus being and non-being give birth to each other; difficult and easy complete each other; long and short shape each other; high and low lean on each other; tone and voice harmonize with each other; front and back follow each other.
तस्मात् सदसत् परस्परं जनयति, कठिनं सुलभं च परस्परं पूरयति, दीर्घं ह्रस्वं च आकारयति, उन्नतं नीचं च आश्रित्यते, ध्वनिरन्तरं सङ्गच्छति, पूर्वम् अपरं च अनुगच्छति।

ddj-ch-02.content: 是以圣人处无为之事，行不言之教。
ddj-ch-02.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 chu4 wu2 wei4 zhi1 shi4， xing2 bu4 yan2 zhi1 jiao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人处无为之事，行不言之教。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage abides in affairs of non-action and practices the teaching without words.
तस्मात् मुनिः निष्क्रियतायां स्थित्वा अनुदितोपदेशं चरति।

ddj-ch-02.content: 万物作焉而不辞，生而不有，为而不恃，功成而弗居。
ddj-ch-02.pinyin: wan4 wu4 zuo4 yan1 er2 bu4 ci2， sheng1 er2 bu4 you3， wei4 er2 bu4 shi4， gong1 cheng2 er2 fu2 ju1。

interpretations.segmentation: 万物作焉而不辞，生而不有，为而不恃，功成而弗居。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things arise and he does not turn them away; he gives life but does not possess; he acts but does not rely; when the work is done he does not dwell on it.
सर्वाणि भूतानि उत्पद्यन्ते न च निवारयति, जीवयति न च स्वीकरोति, करोति न च आश्रयति, कर्म समाप्तं न च तिष्ठति।

ddj-ch-02.pinyin: fu1 wei2 fu2 ju1， shi4 yi3 bu4 qu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯弗居，是以不去。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because he does not dwell on it, it does not leave him.
यस्माद् न तिष्ठति तस्मात् न त्यजति।

ddj-ch-03.pinyin: bu4 shang4 xian2， shi3 min2 bu4 zheng1；

interpretations.segmentation: 不尚贤，使民不争；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not exalt the worthy, and the people will not contend;
आर्यान् न स्तूयेत, लोकः न स्पर्धते;

ddj-ch-03.content: 不贵难得之货，使民不为盗；
ddj-ch-03.pinyin: bu4 gui4 nan2 de2 zhi1 huo4， shi3 min2 bu4 wei4 dao4；

interpretations.segmentation: 不贵难得之货，使民不为盗；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not prize rare goods, and the people will not become thieves;
दुर्लभवस्तून् न मह्येत, लोकः न चौर्यं करोति;

ddj-ch-03.pinyin: bu4 jian4 ke3 yu4， shi3 min2 xin1 bu4 luan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不见可欲，使民心不乱。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not display what can be desired, and the people's hearts will not be disturbed.
इच्छनीयं न दर्शयेत, लोकचित्तं न व्याकुलीभवति।

ddj-ch-03.content: 是以圣人之治，虚其心，实其腹；
ddj-ch-03.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 zhi1 zhi4， xu1 qi2 xin1， shi2 qi2 fu4；

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人之治，虚其心，实其腹；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage's way of governing empties their minds and fills their bellies;
तस्मात् मुनेः शासनं चित्तं शून्यं करोति, उदरं पूर्णं;

ddj-ch-03.pinyin: ruo4 qi2 zhi4， qiang2 qi2 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 弱其志，强其骨。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Weakens their ambitions and strengthens their bones.
प्रतिभानं नमयति, अस्थीनि दृढानि करोति।

ddj-ch-03.content: 常使民无知无欲，使夫智者不敢为也。
ddj-ch-03.pinyin: chang2 shi3 min2 wu2 zhi1 wu2 yu4， shi3 fu1 zhi4 zhe3 bu4 gan3 wei4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 常使民无知无欲，使夫智者不敢为也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He constantly keeps the people without knowledge and without desire, so that the clever dare not act.
नित्यं लोकं अज्ञानमकामं करोति, प्राज्ञाः न प्रवर्तन्ते।

ddj-ch-03.pinyin: wei4 wu2 wei4， ze2 wu2 bu4 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 为无为，则无不治。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Act by non-action, and nothing will be left ungoverned.
अकरणेन कुर्वन् सर्वं शासितं भवति।

ddj-ch-04.content: 道冲而用之或不盈，渊兮似万物之宗。
ddj-ch-04.pinyin: dao4 chong1 er2 yong4 zhi1 huo4 bu4 ying2， yuan1 xi1 shi4 wan4 wu4 zhi1 zong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 道冲而用之或不盈，渊兮似万物之宗。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way is empty, yet use it and it is never filled; how deep it is, as if the ancestor of the myriad things.
मार्गः शून्यः, उपयोगेन न पूर्णः, गम्भीरः सर्वभूतप्रपितृवत्।

ddj-ch-04.content: 挫其锐，解其纷，和其光，同其尘。
ddj-ch-04.pinyin: cuo4 qi2 rui4， jie3 qi2 fen1， he2 qi2 guang1， tong2 qi2 chen2。

interpretations.segmentation: 挫其锐，解其纷，和其光，同其尘。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Blunt the sharpness, untie the tangles, soften the glare, and merge with the dust.
तीक्ष्णतां नमयति, बन्धं विसृजति, प्रभां मृदुयति, धूलिसहितः समवायी भवति।

ddj-ch-04.content: 湛兮似或存，吾不知谁之子，象帝之先。
ddj-ch-04.pinyin: zhan4 xi1 shi4 huo4 cun2， wu2 bu4 zhi1 shui2 zhi1 zi， xiang4 di4 zhi1 xian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 湛兮似或存，吾不知谁之子，象帝之先。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How deep and clear it seems to endure; I do not know whose child it is—it appears to precede the Lord.
गम्भीरः स्थायीव मन्यते, न जानामि कस्य सन्तानः, स्वर्गात् पूर्वम् प्रतिभाति।

ddj-ch-05.content: 天地不仁，以万物为刍狗；
ddj-ch-05.pinyin: tian1 di4 bu4 ren2， yi3 wan4 wu4 wei4 chu2 gou3；

interpretations.segmentation: 天地不仁，以万物为刍狗；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven and Earth are not humane; they treat the myriad things as straw dogs;
द्यौः पृथिवी च न दयालु, सर्वभूतानि तृणमृगवत्;

ddj-ch-05.content: 圣人不仁，以百姓为刍狗。
ddj-ch-05.pinyin: sheng4 ren2 bu4 ren2， yi3 bai3 xing4 wei4 chu2 gou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 圣人不仁，以百姓为刍狗。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The sage is not humane; he treats the hundred clans as straw dogs.
मुनिः न दयालु, जनान् तृणमृगवत्।

ddj-ch-05.pinyin: tian1 di4 zhi1 jian1， qi2 you2 tuo2 yue4 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 天地之间，其犹橐籥乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Is the space between Heaven and Earth not like a bellows?
द्यावापृथिव्योर्मध्ये भस्त्रिकेव?

ddj-ch-05.pinyin: xu1 er2 bu4 qu1， dong4 er2 yu4 chu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 虚而不屈，动而愈出。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Empty yet inexhaustible; the more it moves, the more it yields.
शून्या च न शीर्यते, चलनेन अधिकं निर्यति।

ddj-ch-05.pinyin: duo1 yan2 shu4 qiong2， bu4 ru2 shou3 zhong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 多言数穷，不如守中。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Much talking leads to exhaustion; better to hold to the center.
बहु भाषणं क्षयाय, मध्यस्थानं रक्षितुं श्रेयः।

ddj-ch-06.pinyin: gu3 shen2 bu4 si3， shi4 wei4 xuan2 pin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 谷神不死，是谓玄牝。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The spirit of the valley never dies; this is called the mysterious female.
उपत्यकायाः देवता न म्रियते, गुह्यप्रकृतिरित्युच्यते।

ddj-ch-06.pinyin: xuan2 pin4 zhi1 men2， shi4 wei4 tian1 di4 gen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 玄牝之门，是谓天地根。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The gateway of the mysterious female is called the root of Heaven and Earth.
गुह्यप्रकृतेः द्वारं द्यावापृथिव्योर्मूलम्।

ddj-ch-06.pinyin: mian2 mian2 ruo4 cun2， yong4 zhi1 bu4 qin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 绵绵若存，用之不勤。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Continuous and as if enduring, use it and it is never worn out.
सततं स्थितीव, उपयोगेन न शीर्यते।
天长地久。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven is lasting and Earth endures.
द्यौः चिरस्थायी, पृथिवी दीर्घकालिका।

ddj-ch-07.content: 天地所以能长且久者，以其不自生，故能长生。
ddj-ch-07.pinyin: tian1 di4 suo3 yi3 neng2 zhang3 qie3 jiu3 zhe3， yi3 qi2 bu4 zi4 sheng1， gu4 neng2 zhang3 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天地所以能长且久者，以其不自生，故能长生。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The reason Heaven and Earth can last and endure is that they do not live for themselves; thus they can live long.
द्यावापृथिव्योः दीर्घायुषः कारणं स्वार्थं न जीवनम्, तस्मात् दीर्घजीविनौ।

ddj-ch-07.content: 是以圣人后其身而身先，外其身而身存。
ddj-ch-07.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 hou4 qi2 shen1 er2 shen1 xian1， wai4 qi2 shen1 er2 shen1 cun2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人后其身而身先，外其身而身存。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage puts his person behind and yet it comes first; sets his person aside and yet it is preserved.
तस्मात् मुनिः आत्मानं पश्चात् कृत्वा अग्रे भवति, बहिः कृत्वा तिष्ठति।

ddj-ch-07.pinyin: fei1 yi3 qi2 wu2 si1 xie2？

interpretations.segmentation: 非以其无私邪？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Is it not because he is without self-interest?
न स्वार्थरहितत्वादेव?
故能成其私。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus he is able to accomplish his own ends.
तस्मात् स्वार्थं साधयति।
上善若水。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The highest good is like water.
उत्तमं शुभं जलवत्।

ddj-ch-08.content: 水善利万物而不争，处众人之所恶，故几于道。
ddj-ch-08.pinyin: shui3 shan4 li4 wan4 wu4 er2 bu4 zheng1， chu4 zhong4 ren2 zhi1 suo3 e4， gu4 ji3 yu2 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 水善利万物而不争，处众人之所恶，故几于道。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Water benefits the myriad things and does not contend; it dwells in places the multitude dislike—thus it is close to the Way.
जलं सर्वभूतानि हित्वा न स्पर्धते, जनानाम् अप्रिये स्थाने, मार्गनिकटम्।

ddj-ch-08.content: 居善地，心善渊，与善仁，言善信，政善治，事善能，动善时。
ddj-ch-08.pinyin: ju1 shan4 di4， xin1 shan4 yuan1， yu3 shan4 ren2， yan2 shan4 xin4， zheng4 shan4 zhi4， shi4 shan4 neng2， dong4 shan4 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 居善地，心善渊，与善仁，言善信，政善治，事善能，动善时。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In dwelling, good is the low place; in mind, good is depth; in giving, good is kindness; in speech, good is trustworthiness; in government, good is order; in affairs, good is ability; in action, good is timing.
निवासे नीचं शुभम्, चित्ते गम्भीरता, दाने दया, वचसि सत्यम्, राज्ये व्यवस्था, कार्ये कौशलम्, चेष्टायां समयः।

ddj-ch-08.pinyin: fu1 wei2 bu4 zheng1， gu4 wu2 you2。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯不争，故无尤。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because it does not contend, it is without blame.
यस्माद् न स्पर्धते तस्माद् न दोषः।

ddj-ch-09.pinyin: chi2 er2 ying2 zhi1， bu4 ru2 qi2 yi3；

interpretations.segmentation: 持而盈之，不如其已；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To hold and fill it to the brim is not as good as stopping;
धृत्वा पूर्णं कर्तुं निरोधः श्रेयः;

ddj-ch-09.pinyin: chuai1 er2 rui4 zhi1， bu4 ke3 zhang3 bao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 揣而锐之，不可长保。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To hammer and sharpen it cannot keep it long.
