घट्टयित्वा तीक्ष्णं कर्तुं दीर्घकालं न स्थातुं शक्यते।

ddj-ch-09.pinyin: jin1 yu4 man3 tang2， mo4 zhi1 neng2 shou3；

interpretations.segmentation: 金玉满堂，莫之能守；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A hall filled with gold and jade cannot be guarded;
सुवर्णमणिप्रपूर्णं गृहं न कोऽपि रक्षति;

ddj-ch-09.pinyin: fu4 gui4 er2 jiao1， zi4 yi2 qi2 jiu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 富贵而骄，自遗其咎。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Wealth and rank with arrogance bring their own calamity.
धनवैभवेन गर्वी स्वदोषं आहर्ति।

ddj-ch-09.pinyin: gong1 cheng2 shen1 tui4， tian1 zhi1 dao4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 功成身退，天之道也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the work is done, withdraw—this is the Way of Heaven.
कर्म समाप्तम्, शरीरं निवर्त, द्योः मार्गः।

ddj-ch-10.pinyin: zai4 ying2 po4 bao4 yi1， neng2 wu2 li2 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 载营魄抱一，能无离乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In carrying the soul and embracing the One, can you keep from parting?
आत्मानं धारयन् एकं गृहाण, विभक्तिं वर्जयितुं शक्यते?

ddj-ch-10.pinyin: zhuan1 qi4 zhi4 rou2， neng2 ru2 ying1 er2 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 专气致柔，能如婴儿乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In concentrating the breath and making it soft, can you become as an infant?
प्राणं केन्द्रित्वा मृदुं कुर्वन् बालवत् भवितुं शक्यते?

ddj-ch-10.pinyin: di2 chu2 xuan2 lan3， neng2 wu2 ci1 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 涤除玄览，能无疵乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In cleansing and purifying the mysterious mirror, can you be without blemish?
गुह्यदर्पणं शोधयित्वा दोषरहितः भवितुं शक्यते?

ddj-ch-10.pinyin: ai4 min2 zhi4 guo2， neng2 wu2 wei4 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 爱民治国，能无为乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In loving the people and governing the state, can you practice non-action?
जनान् प्रेम्णा राज्यं शासन् अकरणेन कर्तुं शक्यते?

ddj-ch-10.pinyin: tian1 men2 kai1 he2， neng2 wei4 ci2 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 天门开阖，能为雌乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In the opening and closing of Heaven's gate, can you take the female part?
द्योद्वारस्य उद्घाटने संवरणे, प्रकृतिवत् भवितुं शक्यते?

ddj-ch-10.pinyin: ming2 bai2 si4 da2， neng2 wu2 zhi1 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 明白四达，能无知乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In understanding that reaches in all directions, can you be without knowledge?
चतुर्दिक् प्रज्ञायां, अज्ञानवत् भवितुं शक्यते?

ddj-ch-11.content: 三十辐共一毂，当其无，有车之用。
ddj-ch-11.pinyin: san1 shi2 fu2 gong4 yi1 gu3， dang1 qi2 wu2， you3 che1 zhi1 yong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 三十辐共一毂，当其无，有车之用。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thirty spokes share one hub; it is in the empty space that the use of the cart lies.
त्रिंशत् अराः एकनाभौ, शून्ये रथस्य उपयोगः।

ddj-ch-11.content: 埏埴以为器，当其无，有器之用。
ddj-ch-11.pinyin: shan1 zhi2 yi3 wei4 qi4， dang1 qi2 wu2， you3 qi4 zhi1 yong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 埏埴以为器，当其无，有器之用。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Knead clay to make a vessel; it is in the empty space that the use of the vessel lies.
मृत्तिकां लम्बयित्वा पात्रं, शून्ये पात्रस्य उपयोगः।

ddj-ch-11.content: 凿户牖以为室，当其无，有室之用。
ddj-ch-11.pinyin: zao2 hu4 you3 yi3 wei4 shi4， dang1 qi2 wu2， you3 shi4 zhi1 yong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 凿户牖以为室，当其无，有室之用。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cut doors and windows to make a room; it is in the empty space that the use of the room lies.
द्वारजालानि कृत्वा गेहे, शून्ये गेहस्य उपयोगः।

ddj-ch-11.content: 故有之以为利，无之以为用。
ddj-ch-11.pinyin: gu4 you3 zhi1 yi3 wei4 li4， wu2 zhi1 yi3 wei4 yong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 故有之以为利，无之以为用。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore what is has benefit; what is not has use.
तस्मात् सत्ता लाभाय, शून्यता उपयोगाय।

ddj-ch-12.pinyin: wu3 se4 ling4 ren2 mu4 mang2；

interpretations.segmentation: 五色令人目盲；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The five colors make people's eyes blind;
पञ्चवर्णाः नयनं जनानां अन्धानि कुर्वन्ति;

ddj-ch-12.pinyin: wu3 yin1 ling4 ren2 er3 long2；

interpretations.segmentation: 五音令人耳聋；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The five tones make people's ears deaf;
पञ्चस्वराः श्रोत्रं जनानां बधिरानि कुर्वन्ति;

ddj-ch-12.pinyin: wu3 wei4 ling4 ren2 kou3 shuang3；

interpretations.segmentation: 五味令人口爽；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The five flavors make people's mouths dull;
पञ्चरसाः मुखं जनानां अव्यञ्जकं कुर्वन्ति;

ddj-ch-12.pinyin: chi2 cheng3 tian2 lie4， ling4 ren2 xin1 fa1 kuang2；

interpretations.segmentation: 驰骋畋猎，令人心发狂；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Racing and hunting make people's hearts go mad;
धावनमृगवेधनं हृदयं जनानां उन्मत्तं कुर्वन्ति;

ddj-ch-12.pinyin: nan2 de2 zhi1 huo4， ling4 ren2 xing2 fang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 难得之货，令人行妨。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Goods hard to obtain make people's conduct go astray.
दुर्लभवस्तूनि चरितं जनानां दूषयन्ति।

ddj-ch-12.content: 是以圣人为腹不为目，故去彼取此。
ddj-ch-12.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 wei4 fu4 bu4 wei4 mu4， gu4 qu4 bi3 qu3 ci3。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人为腹不为目，故去彼取此。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage provides for the belly, not for the eyes; thus he discards that and takes this.
तस्मात् मुनिः उदराय कार्यं करोति नेत्राय न, तत् त्यजति इदं गृह्णाति।

ddj-ch-13.pinyin: chong3 ru3 ruo4 jing1， gui4 da4 huan4 ruo4 shen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 宠辱若惊，贵大患若身。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Favor and disgrace are alike startling; value great trouble as you value your body.
प्रसादअपमानौ सममेव भयङ्करौ, महापदं शरीरवत् मह्यताम्;

ddj-ch-13.pinyin: he2 wei4 chong3 ru3 ruo4 jing1？

interpretations.segmentation: 何谓宠辱若惊？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is meant by "favor and disgrace are alike startling"?
प्रसादअपमानयोः समभयं किम्?

ddj-ch-13.content: 宠为下，得之若惊，失之若惊，是谓宠辱若惊。
ddj-ch-13.pinyin: chong3 wei4 xia4， de2 zhi1 ruo4 jing1， shi1 zhi1 ruo4 jing1， shi4 wei4 chong3 ru3 ruo4 jing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 宠为下，得之若惊，失之若惊，是谓宠辱若惊。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Favor is lowly: gaining it startles, losing it startles—this is what is meant by favor and disgrace being alike startling.
प्रसादः नीचः, प्राप्तौ भयं, हानौ भयं, एष प्रसादअपमानयोः समभयः।

ddj-ch-13.pinyin: he2 wei4 gui4 da4 huan4 ruo4 shen1？

interpretations.segmentation: 何谓贵大患若身？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is meant by "value great trouble as you value your body"?
महापदं शरीरवत् मह्यतां किम्?

ddj-ch-13.content: 吾所以有大患者，为吾有身，及吾无身，吾有何患？
ddj-ch-13.pinyin: wu2 suo3 yi3 you3 da4 huan4 zhe3， wei4 wu2 you3 shen1， ji2 wu2 wu2 shen1， wu2 you3 he2 huan4？

interpretations.segmentation: 吾所以有大患者，为吾有身，及吾无身，吾有何患？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The reason I have great trouble is that I have a body; if I had no body, what trouble would I have?
मम महापदस्य कारणं शरीरम्, शरीररहितः किं पीडां प्राप्नुयाम्?

ddj-ch-13.content: 故贵以身为天下，若可寄天下；
ddj-ch-13.pinyin: gu4 gui4 yi3 shen1 wei4 tian1 xia4， ruo4 ke3 ji4 tian1 xia4；

interpretations.segmentation: 故贵以身为天下，若可寄天下；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore, one who values the world as he values his body may be entrusted with the world;
तस्मात् यः शरीरवत् जगन्तं मह्यते, तस्मै जगद् समर्प्यते;

ddj-ch-13.content: 爱以身为天下，若可托天下。
ddj-ch-13.pinyin: ai4 yi3 shen1 wei4 tian1 xia4， ruo4 ke3 tuo1 tian1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 爱以身为天下，若可托天下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who loves the world as he loves his body may be given charge of the world.
यः शरीरवत् जगन्तं प्रेमति, तस्य जगद् न्यस्तम्।

ddj-ch-14.pinyin: shi4 zhi1 bu4 jian4 ming2 yue1 yi2；

interpretations.segmentation: 视之不见名曰夷；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Look at it and you do not see it—it is called the Invisible;
पश्यन् न दृश्यते, तददृश्यमित्युच्यते;

ddj-ch-14.pinyin: ting1 zhi1 bu4 wen2 ming2 yue1 xi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 听之不闻名曰希；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Listen to it and you do not hear it—it is called the Inaudible;
शृण्वन् न श्रूयते, तदश्राव्यमित्युच्यते;

ddj-ch-14.pinyin: bo2 zhi1 bu4 de2 ming2 yue1 wei1。

interpretations.segmentation: 搏之不得名曰微。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Grasp at it and you do not get it—it is called the Intangible.
गृह्णन् न लभ्यते, तत् सूक्ष्ममित्युच्यते।

ddj-ch-14.content: 此三者不可致诘，故混而为一。
ddj-ch-14.pinyin: ci3 san1 zhe3 bu4 ke3 zhi4 ji2， gu4 hun4 er2 wei4 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 此三者不可致诘，故混而为一。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: These three cannot be further inquired into; therefore they merge and become one.
इमे त्रयः न पृष्टुं शक्याः, तस्मात् मिलित्वा एकं भवन्ति।

ddj-ch-14.content: 其上不皦，其下不昧，绳绳兮不可名，复归于无物。
ddj-ch-14.pinyin: qi2 shang4 bu4 jiao3， qi2 xia4 bu4 mei4， sheng2 sheng2 xi1 bu4 ke3 ming2， fu4 gui1 yu2 wu2 wu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 其上不皦，其下不昧，绳绳兮不可名，复归于无物。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: 其上不皦，其下不昧。绳绳兮不可名，复归于无物。
interpretations.note: 异读：在「不昧」后作更大停顿。

interpretations.segmentation: Above it is not bright; below it is not dark; continuous and unnameable, it returns again to no-thing.
ऊर्ध्वं न तेजस्वि, अधः न तमः, सततम् अनाम, पुनः अवस्तुषु प्रत्येति।

ddj-ch-14.content: 是谓无状之状，无物之象，是谓惚恍。
ddj-ch-14.pinyin: shi4 wei4 wu2 zhuang4 zhi1 zhuang4， wu2 wu4 zhi1 xiang4， shi4 wei4 hu1 huang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 是谓无状之状，无物之象，是谓惚恍。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: This is called the form of the formless, the image of no-thing—this is called the Vague and Elusive.
रूपस्य रूपं, अवस्तुनो रूपम्, मोहप्रभमित्युच्यते।

ddj-ch-14.content: 迎之不见其首，随之不见其后。
ddj-ch-14.pinyin: ying2 zhi1 bu4 jian4 qi2 shou3， sui2 zhi1 bu4 jian4 qi2 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 迎之不见其首，随之不见其后。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Meet it and you see no front; follow it and you see no rear.
सम्मुखं गच्छन् अग्रं न दृश्यते, पृष्ठतः गच्छन् पश्चात् न दृश्यते।

ddj-ch-14.pinyin: zhi2 gu3 zhi1 dao4， yi3 yu4 jin1 zhi1 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 执古之道，以御今之有。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Hold to the Way of old to master the things of today.
पुरातनं मार्गं धृत्वा वर्तमानसत्तां वशीकरोति।

ddj-ch-14.pinyin: neng2 zhi1 gu3 shi3， shi4 wei4 dao4 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 能知古始，是谓道纪。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To be able to know the ancient beginning—this is called the thread of the Way.
प्राचीनस्य आरम्भं ज्ञातुं शक्नुवन्, मार्गस्य सूत्रमित्युच्यते।

ddj-ch-15.content: 古之善为道者，微妙玄通，深不可识。
ddj-ch-15.pinyin: gu3 zhi1 shan4 wei4 dao4 zhe3， wei1 miao4 xuan2 tong1， shen1 bu4 ke3 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 古之善为道者，微妙玄通，深不可识。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those of old who were good at practicing the Way were subtle, mysterious, penetrating, and too deep to be known.
पुरातनाः मार्गे दक्षाः सूक्ष्मगुह्यसमग्राः, गम्भीरा अज्ञेयाः।

ddj-ch-15.content: 夫唯不可识，故强为之容：豫兮若冬涉川；
ddj-ch-15.pinyin: fu1 wei2 bu4 ke3 shi2， gu4 qiang2 wei4 zhi1 rong2： yu4 xi1 ruo4 dong1 she4 chuan1；

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯不可识，故强为之容：豫兮若冬涉川；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because they cannot be known, one can only force a description: Cautious, as if crossing a winter stream;
यस्माद् अज्ञेयाः, बलात् वर्णनम्, सावधानः शीतनदीतरणवत्;

ddj-ch-15.pinyin: you2 xi1 ruo4 wei4 si4 lin2；

interpretations.segmentation: 犹兮若畏四邻；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Hesitant, as if fearing the neighbors on all sides;
ससंशयः चतुर्दिक् प्रतिवेशिभ्यो भीतवत्;
俨兮其若客；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Reserved, like a guest;
गम्भीरः आगन्तुकवत्;

ddj-ch-15.pinyin: huan4 xi1 ruo4 bing1 zhi1 jiang1 shi4；

interpretations.segmentation: 涣兮若冰之将释；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Yielding, like ice about to melt;
शिथिलः हिमस्य विलापवत्;
敦兮其若朴；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Simple and genuine, like uncarved wood;
सारलः अनकृतककाष्ठवत्;
旷兮其若谷；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Open and broad, like a valley;
विस्तीर्णः उपत्यकावत्;
混兮其若浊。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Murky, like muddy water.
कलुषः मलिनजलवत्।

ddj-ch-15.pinyin: shu2 neng2 zhuo2 yi3 jing4 zhi1 xu2 qing1？

interpretations.segmentation: 孰能浊以静之徐清？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Who can take the muddy and, by stillness, gradually make it clear?
कः कलुषं शान्त्या क्रमेण शुद्धं करोति?

ddj-ch-15.pinyin: shu2 neng2 an1 yi3 jiu3 dong4 zhi1 xu2 sheng1？

interpretations.segmentation: 孰能安以久动之徐生？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Who can take the settled and, by long movement, gradually bring it to life?
कः स्थितं दीर्घचालनेन क्रमेण जीवयति?

ddj-ch-15.pinyin: bao3 ci3 dao4 zhe3， bu4 yu4 ying2。

interpretations.segmentation: 保此道者，不欲盈。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who preserve this Way do not desire to be full.
एतं मार्गं रक्षन्तः न पूर्णं इच्छन्ति।

ddj-ch-15.content: 夫唯不盈，故能蔽不新成。
ddj-ch-15.pinyin: fu1 wei2 bu4 ying2， gu4 neng2 bi4 bu4 xin1 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯不盈，故能蔽不新成。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because they are not full, they can be worn and yet newly made.
यस्माद् न पूर्णाः, जीर्णाः च नूतनाः च भवन्ति।

ddj-ch-16.pinyin: zhi4 xu1 ji2， shou3 jing4 du3。

interpretations.segmentation: 致虚极，守静笃。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Attain utmost emptiness; hold firmly to stillness.
परमं शून्यं प्राप्नु, शान्तिं दृढं रक्ष।

ddj-ch-16.pinyin: wan4 wu4 bing4 zuo4， wu2 yi3 guan1 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 万物并作，吾以观复。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things arise together; I watch their return.
सर्वाणि भूतानि उत्तिष्ठन्ति, अहं प्रत्यागमनं पश्यामि।

ddj-ch-16.pinyin: fu1 wu4 yun2 yun2， ge4 fu4 gui1 qi2 gen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫物芸芸，各复归其根。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Things flourish in abundance, yet each returns to its root.
भूतानि समृद्धानि, प्रत्येकं स्वमूलं प्रत्येति।

ddj-ch-16.pinyin: gui1 gen1 yue1 jing4， jing4 yue1 fu4 ming4。

interpretations.segmentation: 归根曰静，静曰复命。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Returning to the root is called stillness; stillness is called returning to destiny.
मूलप्रत्यागमनं शान्तिरित्युच्यते, शान्तिः विधिप्रत्यागमनम्।

ddj-ch-16.pinyin: fu4 ming4 yue1 chang2， zhi1 chang2 yue1 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 复命曰常，知常曰明。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Returning to destiny is called the Constant; knowing the Constant is called insight.
विधिप्रत्यागमनं नित्यमित्युच्यते, नित्यं ज्ञातुं प्रज्ञा।

ddj-ch-16.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 chang2， wang4 zuo4 xiong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不知常，妄作凶。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Not knowing the Constant, one acts recklessly and meets with misfortune.
नित्यं न ज्ञात्वा मिथ्या कुर्वन् दुःखं प्राप्नुयात्।

ddj-ch-16.content: 知常容，容乃公，公乃王，王乃天，天乃道，道乃久，没身不殆。
ddj-ch-16.pinyin: zhi1 chang2 rong2， rong2 nai3 gong1， gong1 nai3 wang2， wang2 nai3 tian1， tian1 nai3 dao4， dao4 nai3 jiu3， mei2 shen1 bu4 dai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 知常容，容乃公，公乃王，王乃天，天乃道，道乃久，没身不殆。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Knowing the Constant, one is tolerant; tolerance leads to impartiality; impartiality leads to kingliness; kingliness leads to Heaven; Heaven leads to the Way; the Way leads to permanence—to the end of life one is without danger.
नित्यं ज्ञात्वा सहिष्णु, सहिष्णुता समत्वं, समत्वात् राजत्वं, राजत्वात् स्वर्गः, स्वर्गात् मार्गः, मार्गात् चिरस्थितिः, जीवनान्तं न भयम्।

ddj-ch-17.pinyin: tai4 shang4， xia4 zhi1 you3 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 太上，下知有之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Of the highest, those below merely know that he exists;
उत्तमाधिपतौ, अधः जनाः केवलं अस्तीतिं जानन्ति;

ddj-ch-17.pinyin: qi2 ci4， qin1 er2 yu4 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 其次，亲而誉之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Of the next, they draw near and praise him;
अग्रिमे, आगत्य स्तुवन्ति;
其次，畏之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Of the next, they fear him;
अग्रिमे, तस्य भयम्;
其次，侮之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Of the next, they insult him.
अग्रिमे, निन्दन्ति।

ddj-ch-17.pinyin: xin4 bu4 zu2 yan1， you3 bu4 xin4 yan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 信不足焉，有不信焉。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When trust is insufficient, there is distrust.
विश्वासे अपर्याप्ते, अविश्वासः।
悠兮其贵言。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How leisurely he is, sparing of his words.
विलम्बितः, वचनं दुर्लभम्।

ddj-ch-17.content: 功成事遂，百姓皆谓我自然。
ddj-ch-17.pinyin: gong1 cheng2 shi4 sui4， bai3 xing4 jie1 wei4 wo3 zi4 ran2。

interpretations.segmentation: 功成事遂，百姓皆谓我自然。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the work is done and affairs succeed, the hundred clans all say, "We did this ourselves."
कर्म समाप्तं, कार्यं सिद्धम्, जनाः स्वकृतमित्येव भाषन्ते।

ddj-ch-18.pinyin: da4 dao4 fei4， you3 ren2 yi4；

interpretations.segmentation: 大道废，有仁义；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the Great Way is abandoned, there are benevolence and righteousness;
महामार्गे त्यक्ते, धर्मार्धता भवति;

ddj-ch-18.pinyin: zhi4 hui4 chu1， you3 da4 wei3；

interpretations.segmentation: 智慧出，有大伪；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When wisdom and cleverness appear, there is great hypocrisy;
प्रज्ञोदये महामाया;

ddj-ch-18.pinyin: liu4 qin1 bu4 he2， you3 xiao4 ci2；

interpretations.segmentation: 六亲不和，有孝慈；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the six relations are not in harmony, there are filial piety and parental kindness;
षड्बन्धवोऽसमूहाः, पितृपुत्रस्नेहः;

ddj-ch-18.pinyin: guo2 jia1 hun1 luan4， you3 zhong1 chen2。

interpretations.segmentation: 国家昏乱，有忠臣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the state is in disorder, there are loyal ministers.
राष्ट्रे भ्रमे, भक्तामात्याः।

ddj-ch-19.pinyin: jue2 sheng4 qi4 zhi4， min2 li4 bai3 bei4；

interpretations.segmentation: 绝圣弃智，民利百倍；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Abolish sagehood and discard wisdom, and the people will benefit a hundredfold;
मुनित्वं त्यज प्रज्ञां च, लोकः शतगुणं लभते;

ddj-ch-19.pinyin: jue2 ren2 qi4 yi4， min2 fu4 xiao4 ci2；

interpretations.segmentation: 绝仁弃义，民复孝慈；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Abolish benevolence and discard righteousness, and the people will return to filial piety and kindness;
दयां धर्मार्धतां च त्यज, लोकः पितृपुत्रस्नेहम पुनराव्रजति;

ddj-ch-19.pinyin: jue2 qiao3 qi4 li4， dao4 zei2 wu2 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 绝巧弃利，盗贼无有。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Abolish cleverness and discard profit, and there will be no thieves.
चातुर्यं त्यज लाभं च, चोराः न सन्ति।

ddj-ch-19.content: 此三者以为文不足，故令有所属：见素抱朴，少私寡欲。
ddj-ch-19.pinyin: ci3 san1 zhe3 yi3 wei4 wen2 bu4 zu2， gu4 ling4 you3 suo3 shu3： jian4 su4 bao4 pu3， shao3 si1 gua3 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 此三者以为文不足，故令有所属：见素抱朴，少私寡欲。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: These three, taken as outward culture, are not enough; therefore let people have something to hold to: look to the plain and embrace the uncarved; lessen self-interest and reduce desire.
एतत् त्रयं बाह्योपासनया अल्पम्, अतो लोकस्य आश्रयो भवेत्; शुक्लम् अवलम्य अनकृतं गृह्णाति, स्वार्थं न्यूनम्, इच्छां च न्यूनाम्।
绝学无忧。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Abolish learning, and there will be no sorrow.
विद्यां त्यज, शोकः न भवति।

ddj-ch-20.pinyin: wei2 zhi1 yu3 a1， xiang1 qu4 ji3 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 唯之与阿，相去几何？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How far is "yes" from "yeah"?
सत्यम् अनुनीतिं च, कियदन्तरम्?

ddj-ch-20.pinyin: mei3 zhi1 yu3 e4， xiang1 qu4 ruo4 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 美之与恶，相去若何？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How far is good from evil?
शुभं पापं च, कियदन्तरम्?

ddj-ch-20.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 suo3 wei4， bu4 ke3 bu4 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之所畏，不可不畏。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What people fear cannot but be feared.
यल्लोकः बिभेति, तद् बिभेतुमेव।

ddj-ch-20.pinyin: huang1 xi1 qi2 wei4 yang1 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 荒兮其未央哉！
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How desolate—it has not yet reached its end!
शून्यम्, अन्तं न प्राप्तम्!

ddj-ch-20.content: 众人熙熙，如享太牢，如春登台。
ddj-ch-20.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 xi1 xi1， ru2 xiang3 tai4 lao2， ru2 chun1 deng1 tai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 众人熙熙，如享太牢，如春登台。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The multitude are merry, as if enjoying a great feast, as if climbing a terrace in spring.
बहवः प्रहर्षन्ति, महायज्तभोजनवत्, वसन्तसोपाने आरोहणवत् इव।

ddj-ch-20.content: 我独泊兮其未兆，如婴儿之未孩。
ddj-ch-20.pinyin: wo3 du2 po1 xi1 qi2 wei4 zhao4， ru2 ying1 er2 zhi1 wei4 hai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我独泊兮其未兆，如婴儿之未孩。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I alone am still, without sign—like an infant that has not yet smiled.
अहमेकः शान्तः, अङ्कितं न, बालस्य हासरहितवत्।

ddj-ch-20.pinyin: lei3 lei3 xi1 ruo4 wu2 suo3 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 傫傫兮若无所归。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Weary and forlorn, as if I had nowhere to return.
श्रान्तः निराशः, निवासस्थानं न।

ddj-ch-20.content: 众人皆有余，而我独若遗。
ddj-ch-20.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 jie1 you3 yu2， er2 wo3 du2 ruo4 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 众人皆有余，而我独若遗。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The multitude all have more than enough, while I alone seem to have lost.
बहवः अतिरिक्तं धारयन्ति, अहमेकः हीनवत्।

ddj-ch-20.pinyin: wo3 yu2 ren2 zhi1 xin1 ye3 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 我愚人之心也哉！
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I have the mind of a fool indeed!
मूढचित्तोऽहम्!
沌沌兮。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How muddled!
कलुषम्!

ddj-ch-20.pinyin: su2 ren2 zhao1 zhao1， wo3 du2 hun1 hun1；

interpretations.segmentation: 俗人昭昭，我独昏昏；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Ordinary people are bright and clear; I alone am dull and confused;
लौकिकाः प्रकाशन्ति, अहमेकः तिमिरः;

ddj-ch-20.pinyin: su2 ren2 cha2 cha2， wo3 du2 men4 men4。

interpretations.segmentation: 俗人察察，我独闷闷。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Ordinary people are sharp and discerning; I alone am closed and muffled.
लौकिकाः तीक्ष्णाः, अहमेकः मन्दः।

ddj-ch-20.content: 澹兮其若海，飂兮若无止。
ddj-ch-20.pinyin: dan4 xi1 qi2 ruo4 hai3， liu4 xi1 ruo4 wu2 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 澹兮其若海，飂兮若无止。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Calm as the sea, drifting as if without end.
शान्तः समुद्रवत्, विसर्गः अन्तरहितः।

ddj-ch-20.content: 众人皆有以，而我独顽似鄙。
ddj-ch-20.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 jie1 you3 yi3， er2 wo3 du2 wan2 shi4 bi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 众人皆有以，而我独顽似鄙。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The multitude all have purpose, while I alone am stubborn and rustic.
बहवः प्रयोजनवन्तः, अहमेकः जडः ग्राम्यवत्।

ddj-ch-20.pinyin: wo3 du2 yi4 yu2 ren2， er2 gui4 shi2 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我独异于人，而贵食母。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I alone differ from others, and value drawing nourishment from the Mother.
अहमेकः अन्येभ्यो भिन्नः, मातुः पोषणं मह्यते।

ddj-ch-21.pinyin: kong3 de2 zhi1 rong2， wei2 dao4 shi4 cong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 孔德之容，惟道是从。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The bearing of great virtue follows only the Way.
महागुणस्य रूपं केवलं मार्गस्य अनुगच्छति।

ddj-ch-21.pinyin: dao4 zhi1 wei4 wu4， wei2 huang3 wei2 hu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 道之为物，惟恍惟惚。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: As a thing, the Way is only elusive and vague.
मार्गः वस्तु भूत्वा, केवलं सन्दिग्धः एव सन्दिग्धः।

ddj-ch-21.pinyin: hu1 xi1 huang3 xi1， qi2 zhong1 you3 xiang4；

interpretations.segmentation: 惚兮恍兮，其中有象；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Vague and elusive—within it there is image;
सन्दिग्धः, सन्दिग्धः — तस्य अन्तः आकृतिः अस्ति;

ddj-ch-21.pinyin: huang3 xi1 hu1 xi1， qi2 zhong1 you3 wu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 恍兮惚兮，其中有物。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Elusive and vague—within it there is substance.
सन्दिग्धः, सन्दिग्धः — तस्य अन्तः वस्तु अस्ति।

ddj-ch-21.pinyin: yao3 xi1 ming2 xi1， qi2 zhong1 you3 jing1；

interpretations.segmentation: 窈兮冥兮，其中有精；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Deep and dark—within it there is essence;
गम्भीरः, तमः — तस्य अन्तः सारः अस्ति;

ddj-ch-21.pinyin: qi2 jing1 shen4 zhen1， qi2 zhong1 you3 xin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 其精甚真，其中有信。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Its essence is most true; within it there is trust.
तस्य सारः अत्यन्तं सत्यः; तस्य अन्तः विश्वासः अस्ति।

ddj-ch-21.content: 自今及古，其名不去，以阅众甫。
ddj-ch-21.pinyin: zi4 jin1 ji2 gu3， qi2 ming2 bu4 qu4， yi3 yue4 zhong4 fu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 自今及古，其名不去，以阅众甫。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: From the present back to antiquity, its name has not departed; by it one surveys the beginnings of the multitude.
अद्यात् प्राचीनकालं यावत्, तस्य नाम न विच्युतम्; तेन बहूनां आदीन् अवलोकयति।

ddj-ch-21.pinyin: wu2 he2 yi3 zhi1 zhong4 fu3 zhi1 zhuang4 zai1？

interpretations.segmentation: 吾何以知众甫之状哉？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How do I know the form of the beginnings of the multitude?
बहूनां आदीन् रूपं कथं जानामि?
以此。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: By this.
अनेन।

ddj-ch-22.content: 曲则全，枉则直，洼则盈，敝则新，少则得，多则惑。
ddj-ch-22.pinyin: qu1 ze2 quan2， wang3 ze2 zhi2， wa1 ze2 ying2， bi4 ze2 xin1， shao3 ze2 de2， duo1 ze2 huo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 曲则全，枉则直，洼则盈，敝则新，少则得，多则惑。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Bent, then whole; crooked, then straight; hollow, then full; worn, then new; little, then gain; much, then confusion.
वक्रः, तर्हि पूर्णः; विकृतः, तर्हि ऋजुः; निम्नः, तर्हि पूर्णः; जीर्णः, तर्हि नवः; अल्पं, तर्हि लभ्यते; बहु, तर्हि मोहः।

ddj-ch-22.content: 是以圣人抱一为天下式。
ddj-ch-22.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 bao4 yi1 wei4 tian1 xia4 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人抱一为天下式。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage embraces the One and becomes the model for all under Heaven.
तस्मात् मुनिः एकं आश्रित्य सर्वस्य मार्गः भवति।
不自见，故明；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He does not display himself, and so is illustrious;
न स्वं दर्शयति, तस्मात् प्रकाशः;
不自是，故彰；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He does not assert himself, and so is distinguished;
न स्वं स्थापयति, तस्मात् विशिष्टः;

ddj-ch-22.pinyin: bu4 zi4 fa2， gu4 you3 gong1；

interpretations.segmentation: 不自伐，故有功；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He does not boast, and so has merit;
न स्वं स्तौति, तस्मात् पुण्यम्;
不自矜，故长。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He does not vaunt himself, and so endures.
न स्वं गर्वयति, तस्मात् दीर्घकालम्।

ddj-ch-22.content: 夫唯不争，故天下莫能与之争。
ddj-ch-22.pinyin: fu1 wei2 bu4 zheng1， gu4 tian1 xia4 mo4 neng2 yu3 zhi1 zheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯不争，故天下莫能与之争。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because he does not contend, no one under Heaven can contend with him.
यतः न स्पर्धते, तस्मात् अन्तरिक्षे न कोऽपि तेन स्पर्धते।

ddj-ch-22.content: 古之所谓曲则全者，岂虚言哉？
ddj-ch-22.pinyin: gu3 zhi1 suo3 wei4 qu1 ze2 quan2 zhe3， qi3 xu1 yan2 zai1？

interpretations.segmentation: 古之所谓曲则全者，岂虚言哉？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The ancient saying "bent, then whole"—how could it be empty words?
प्राचीनाः "वक्रः, तर्हि पूर्णः" इति — कथं रिक्तं वचः?
诚全而归之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Truly, wholeness returns to him.
सत्यं, पूर्णता तस्य प्रत्यागच्छति।
希言自然。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Sparse words are natural.
अल्पवाक् स्वभावः।

ddj-ch-23.content: 故飘风不终朝，骤雨不终日。
ddj-ch-23.pinyin: gu4 piao1 feng1 bu4 zhong1 chao2， zhou4 yu3 bu4 zhong1 ri4。

interpretations.segmentation: 故飘风不终朝，骤雨不终日。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore a whirlwind does not last a morning; a sudden rain does not last a day.
तस्मात् वायुः प्रातः न तिष्ठति, वर्षा दिवसं न तिष्ठति।
孰为此者？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Who makes these?
एतत् कः करोति?
天地。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven and Earth.
द्यावापृथिवी।

ddj-ch-23.content: 天地尚不能久，而况于人乎？
ddj-ch-23.pinyin: tian1 di4 shang4 bu4 neng2 jiu3， er2 kuang4 yu2 ren2 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 天地尚不能久，而况于人乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Even Heaven and Earth cannot make them last—how much less can man?
द्यावापृथिव्योः अपि दीर्घकालं न, किं पुनः मनुष्यस्य?

ddj-ch-23.pinyin: gu4 cong2 shi4 yu2 dao4 zhe3， tong2 yu2 dao4；

interpretations.segmentation: 故从事于道者，同于道；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore one who engages in the Way becomes one with the Way;
तस्मात् मार्गे यः कार्यं करोति, मार्गेण सह एकः भवति;
德者，同于德；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who engages in virtue becomes one with virtue;
गुणे यः, गुणेन सह एकः;
失者，同于失。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who engages in loss becomes one with loss.
हानौ यः, हानिना सह एकः।

ddj-ch-23.pinyin: tong2 yu2 dao4 zhe3， dao4 yi4 le4 de2 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 同于道者，道亦乐得之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who is one with the Way—the Way also gladly receives him;
मार्गेण यः एकः, मार्गः अपि तं प्रीत्या गृह्णाति;

ddj-ch-23.pinyin: tong2 yu2 de2 zhe3， de2 yi4 le4 de2 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 同于德者，德亦乐得之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who is one with virtue—virtue also gladly receives him;
गुणेन यः एकः, गुणः अपि तं प्रीत्या गृह्णाति;

ddj-ch-23.pinyin: tong2 yu2 shi1 zhe3， shi1 yi4 le4 de2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 同于失者，失亦乐得之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who is one with loss—loss also gladly receives him.
हानिना यः एकः, हानिः अपि तं प्रीत्या गृह्णाति।

ddj-ch-23.pinyin: xin4 bu4 zu2 yan1， you3 bu4 xin4 yan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 信不足焉，有不信焉。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When trust is insufficient, there is distrust.
विश्वासे अपर्याप्ते, अविश्वासः भवति।
企者不立；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who stands on tiptoe cannot stand firm;
उत्थितः न तिष्ठति;
跨者不行；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who strides cannot walk far;
दीर्घपदः न चलति;
自见者不明；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who displays himself is not illustrious;
आत्मानं दर्शयन् न प्रकाशः;
自是者不彰；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who asserts himself is not distinguished;
आत्मानं स्थापयन् न विशिष्टः;
自伐者无功；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who boasts has no merit;
आत्मानं स्तुवन् न पुण्यम्;
自矜者不长。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who vaunts himself does not endure.
आत्मानं गर्वयन् न दीर्घकालम्।

ddj-ch-24.pinyin: qi2 zai4 dao4 ye3， yue1 yu2 shi2 zhui4 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 其在道也，曰余食赘形。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In the Way, such things are called leftover food and superfluous growths.
मार्गे एतत् "अवशिष्टान्नं, अतिरिक्तं शरीरम्" इति उच्यते।

ddj-ch-24.content: 物或恶之，故有道者不处。
ddj-ch-24.pinyin: wu4 huo4 e4 zhi1， gu4 you3 dao4 zhe3 bu4 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 物或恶之，故有道者不处。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Things may detest them; therefore one who has the Way does not abide in them.
वस्तूनि एतत् द्वेष्टि; तस्मात् मार्गवान् न वसति।

ddj-ch-25.pinyin: you3 wu4 hun4 cheng2， xian1 tian1 di4 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有物混成，先天地生。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: There was something formed in chaos, born before Heaven and Earth.
किञ्चिद् अव्यक्तं, द्यावापृथिव्योः पूर्वं जातम्।

ddj-ch-25.content: 寂兮寥兮，独立而不改，周行而不殆，可以为天地母。
ddj-ch-25.pinyin: ji4 xi1 liao2 xi1， du2 li4 er2 bu4 gai3， zhou1 xing2 er2 bu4 dai4， ke3 yi3 wei4 tian1 di4 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 寂兮寥兮，独立而不改，周行而不殆，可以为天地母。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Silent and void, it stands alone and does not change; it cycles and does not weary—it may be the mother of Heaven and Earth.
निःशब्दं, शून्यं, एकाकी स्थित्वा न परिवर्तते; परिभ्रमन् न श्रान्तः — द्यावापृथिव्योः माता भवितुम् अर्हति।

ddj-ch-25.content: 吾不知其名，强字之曰道，强为之名曰大。
ddj-ch-25.pinyin: wu2 bu4 zhi1 qi2 ming2， qiang2 zi4 zhi1 yue1 dao4， qiang2 wei4 zhi1 ming2 yue1 da4。

interpretations.segmentation: 吾不知其名，强字之曰道，强为之名曰大。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I do not know its name; I style it "the Way," and force a name upon it, calling it "Great."
तस्य नाम न जानामि; बलात् "मार्गः" इति नामकरणम्, बलात् "महत्" इति नाम।

ddj-ch-25.pinyin: da4 yue1 shi4， shi4 yue1 yuan3， yuan3 yue1 fan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 大曰逝，逝曰远，远曰反。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Great means passing on; passing on means going far; going far means returning.
महत् — गमनम्; गमनम् — दूरम्; दूरम् — प्रत्यागमनम्।

ddj-ch-25.content: 故道大，天大，地大，人亦大。
ddj-ch-25.pinyin: gu4 dao4 da4， tian1 da4， di4 da4， ren2 yi4 da4。

interpretations.segmentation: 故道大，天大，地大，人亦大。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the Way is great, Heaven is great, Earth is great, and man also is great.
तस्मात् मार्गः महान्, द्यौः महती, पृथिवी महती, मनुष्यः अपि महान्।

ddj-ch-25.content: 域中有四大，而人居其一焉。
ddj-ch-25.pinyin: yu4 zhong1 you3 si4 da4， er2 ren2 ju1 qi2 yi1 yan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 域中有四大，而人居其一焉。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In the realm there are four greats, and man is one of them.
क्षेत्रे चत्वारः महान्तः, मनुष्यः एकः।

ddj-ch-25.content: 人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然。
ddj-ch-25.pinyin: ren2 fa3 di4， di4 fa3 tian1， tian1 fa3 dao4， dao4 fa3 zi4 ran2。

interpretations.segmentation: 人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Man models himself on Earth; Earth models itself on Heaven; Heaven models itself on the Way; the Way models itself on what is naturally so.
मनुष्यः पृथिवीम् अनुकरोति, पृथिवी द्यौम्, द्यौः मार्गम्, मार्गः स्वभावम्।

ddj-ch-26.pinyin: zhong4 wei4 qing1 gen1， jing4 wei4 zao4 jun1。

interpretations.segmentation: 重为轻根，静为躁君。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaviness is the root of lightness; stillness is the master of restlessness.
गुरुत्वं लघुत्वस्य मूलम्, शान्तिः उद्वेगस्य स्वामी।

ddj-ch-26.content: 是以圣人终日行不离辎重。
ddj-ch-26.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 zhong1 ri4 xing2 bu4 li2 zi1 zhong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人终日行不离辎重。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage travels all day without leaving his baggage wagons.
तस्मात् मुनिः दिवसं चलन् भारवाहनं न त्यजति।

ddj-ch-26.pinyin: sui1 you3 rong2 guan1， yan4 chu4 chao1 ran2。

interpretations.segmentation: 虽有荣观，燕处超然。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Though there be glorious sights, he dwells at ease, detached.
शोभा दृष्ट्वा अपि, सुखेन निर्लिप्तः वसति।

ddj-ch-26.content: 奈何万乘之主，而以身轻天下？
ddj-ch-26.pinyin: nai4 he2 wan4 cheng2 zhi1 zhu3， er2 yi3 shen1 qing1 tian1 xia4？

interpretations.segmentation: 奈何万乘之主，而以身轻天下？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How then can the lord of ten thousand chariots take his own person lightly in ruling the world?
सहस्ररथाधिपतिः स्वम् अङ्गं लघु कृत्वा जगतं कथम्?

ddj-ch-26.pinyin: qing1 ze2 shi1 gen1， zao4 ze2 shi1 jun1。

interpretations.segmentation: 轻则失根，躁则失君。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Lightness loses the root; restlessness loses the master.
लघुत्वात् मूलं ह्रियते, उद्वेगात् स्वामी ह्रियते।
善行无辙迹；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A good traveler leaves no track;
कुशलगतिः चिह्नं न त्यजति;
善言无瑕谪；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A good speaker leaves no flaw for blame;
कुशलवाक् दोषं न ददाति;

ddj-ch-27.pinyin: shan4 shu4 bu4 yong4 chou2 ce4；

interpretations.segmentation: 善数不用筹策；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A good reckoner needs no counting rods;
कुशलगणना काष्ठैः न;

ddj-ch-27.pinyin: shan4 bi4 wu2 guan1 jian4 er2 bu4 ke3 kai1；

interpretations.segmentation: 善闭无关楗而不可开；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A good closer needs no bolts, yet none can open;
कुशलनिरोधः बन्धनं विना, न अपि उद्घाट्यते;

ddj-ch-27.pinyin: shan4 jie2 wu2 sheng2 yue1 er2 bu4 ke3 jie3。

interpretations.segmentation: 善结无绳约而不可解。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A good binder needs no ropes, yet none can untie.
कुशलबन्धनं रज्जु विना, न अपि विमुच्यते।

ddj-ch-27.content: 是以圣人常善救人，故无弃人；
ddj-ch-27.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 chang2 shan4 jiu4 ren2， gu4 wu2 qi4 ren2；

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人常善救人，故无弃人；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage is always good at saving people, and so abandons no one;
तस्मात् मुनिः सदा जनान् रक्षति, तस्मात् न त्यजति;

ddj-ch-27.pinyin: chang2 shan4 jiu4 wu4， gu4 wu2 qi4 wu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 常善救物，故无弃物。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Always good at saving things, and so abandons nothing.
सदा वस्तूनि रक्षति, तस्मात् न त्यजति।
是谓袭明。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: This is called clothing oneself in light.
इदम् "प्रकाशम् आच्छाद्य" इति उच्यते।

ddj-ch-27.pinyin: gu4 shan4 ren2 zhe3， bu4 shan4 ren2 zhi1 shi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 故善人者，不善人之师；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the good man is the teacher of the not-good;
तस्मात् साधुः असाधोः गुरुः;

ddj-ch-27.pinyin: bu4 shan4 ren2 zhe3， shan4 ren2 zhi1 zi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不善人者，善人之资。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The not-good man is the material of the good.
असाधुः साधोः साधनम्।

ddj-ch-27.content: 不贵其师，不爱其资，虽智大迷，是谓要妙。
ddj-ch-27.pinyin: bu4 gui4 qi2 shi1， bu4 ai4 qi2 zi1， sui1 zhi4 da4 mi2， shi4 wei4 yao4 miao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不贵其师，不爱其资，虽智大迷，是谓要妙。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Not to value the teacher, not to love the material—though wise, one is greatly confused: this is called the essential mystery.
गुरुं न पूजयन्, साधनं न प्रेमन् — बुद्धिमान् अपि महामोहः; एतत् "मर्मगुह्यम्" इति उच्यते।

ddj-ch-28.content: 知其雄，守其雌，为天下溪。
ddj-ch-28.pinyin: zhi1 qi2 xiong2， shou3 qi2 ci2， wei4 tian1 xia4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 知其雄，守其雌，为天下溪。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Know the male, yet keep to the female, and be the stream of the world.
पुंभावं ज्ञात्वा स्त्रीभावं रक्षन्, जगतः स्रोतः भव।

ddj-ch-28.content: 为天下溪，常德不离，复归于婴儿。
ddj-ch-28.pinyin: wei4 tian1 xia4 xi1， chang2 de2 bu4 li2， fu4 gui1 yu2 ying1 er2。

interpretations.segmentation: 为天下溪，常德不离，复归于婴儿。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Being the stream of the world, constant virtue does not depart, and one returns again to the infant.
जगतः स्रोतः भूत्वा, नित्यगुणः न विच्युतः, शिशुं प्रत्यागच्छति।

ddj-ch-28.content: 知其白，守其黑，为天下式。
ddj-ch-28.pinyin: zhi1 qi2 bai2， shou3 qi2 hei1， wei4 tian1 xia4 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 知其白，守其黑，为天下式。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Know the white, yet keep to the black, and be the model of the world.
शुक्लं ज्ञात्वा कृष्णं रक्षन्, जगतः मार्गः भव।

ddj-ch-28.content: 为天下式，常德不忒，复归于无极。
ddj-ch-28.pinyin: wei4 tian1 xia4 shi4， chang2 de2 bu4 te4， fu4 gui1 yu2 wu2 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 为天下式，常德不忒，复归于无极。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Being the model of the world, constant virtue does not err, and one returns again to the limitless.
जगतः मार्गः भूत्वा, नित्यगुणः न भ्रमति, अनन्तं प्रत्यागच्छति।

ddj-ch-28.content: 知其荣，守其辱，为天下谷。
ddj-ch-28.pinyin: zhi1 qi2 rong2， shou3 qi2 ru3， wei4 tian1 xia4 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 知其荣，守其辱，为天下谷。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Know honor, yet keep to disgrace, and be the valley of the world.
यशः ज्ञात्वा अपयशः रक्षन्, जगतः कन्दरः भव।

ddj-ch-28.content: 为天下谷，常德乃足，复归于朴。
ddj-ch-28.pinyin: wei4 tian1 xia4 gu3， chang2 de2 nai3 zu2， fu4 gui1 yu2 pu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 为天下谷，常德乃足，复归于朴。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Being the valley of the world, constant virtue is then sufficient, and one returns again to the uncarved block.
जगतः कन्दरः भूत्वा, नित्यगुणः पूर्णः, अखण्डं प्रत्यागच्छति।

ddj-ch-28.content: 朴散则为器，圣人用之则为官长。
ddj-ch-28.pinyin: pu3 san4 ze2 wei4 qi4， sheng4 ren2 yong4 zhi1 ze2 wei4 guan1 zhang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 朴散则为器，圣人用之则为官长。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the uncarved block is scattered, it becomes vessels; the sage uses it and becomes the chief of officers.
अखण्डं विभज्यमानं पात्राणि भवन्ति; मुनिः तत् उपयुज्य अधिकारिणां प्रधानः भवति।
故大制不割。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the great cutting does not sever.
तस्मात् महानियमः न छिनन्ति।

ddj-ch-29.content: 将欲取天下而为之，吾见其不得已。
ddj-ch-29.pinyin: jiang1 yu4 qu3 tian1 xia4 er2 wei4 zhi1， wu2 jian4 qi2 bu4 de2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 将欲取天下而为之，吾见其不得已。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If one would take the world and act upon it, I see that he will not succeed.
जगत् ग्रहीतुं कर्तुं च इच्छन्, न सफलः इति पश्यामि।

ddj-ch-29.pinyin: tian1 xia4 shen2 qi4， bu4 ke3 wei4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下神器，不可为也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The world is a sacred vessel; it cannot be acted upon.
जगत् पवित्रं पात्रम्; कर्तुं न शक्यते।

ddj-ch-29.pinyin: wei4 zhe3 bai4 zhi1， zhi2 zhe3 shi1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 为者败之，执者失之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who acts upon it ruins it; he who grasps it loses it.
करन् विनाशयति, गृहन् ह्रियते।

ddj-ch-29.pinyin: gu4 wu4 huo4 xing2 huo4 sui2；

interpretations.segmentation: 故物或行或随；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore among things, some go forward, some follow;
तस्मात् वस्तूनि — केचित् अग्रे गच्छन्ति, केचित् अनुवर्तन्ति;
或歔或吹；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Some blow warm, some blow cold;
केचित् उष्णं वमन्ति, केचित् शीतं वायन्ति;
或强或羸；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Some are strong, some are weak;
केचित् बलवन्तः, केचित् दुर्बलाः;
或载或隳。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Some are loaded, some are broken.
केचित् धृताः, केचित् भग्नाः।

ddj-ch-29.content: 是以圣人去甚，去奢，去泰。
ddj-ch-29.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 qu4 shen4， qu4 she1， qu4 tai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人去甚，去奢，去泰。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage discards extremes, discards extravagance, discards excess.
तस्मात् मुनिः अतिशयं, विलासं, अतिरेकं त्यजति।

ddj-ch-30.content: 以道佐人主者，不以兵强天下。
ddj-ch-30.pinyin: yi3 dao4 zuo3 ren2 zhu3 zhe3， bu4 yi3 bing1 qiang2 tian1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 以道佐人主者，不以兵强天下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who assists a ruler with the Way does not use arms to force the world.
मार्गेण स्वामिनं साहाय्यं कुन्वन्, शस्त्रेण जगत् न प्रभावयति।

ddj-ch-30.content: 其事好还：师之所处，荆棘生焉；
ddj-ch-30.pinyin: qi2 shi4 hao3 hai2： shi1 zhi1 suo3 chu4， jing1 ji2 sheng1 yan1；

interpretations.segmentation: 其事好还：师之所处，荆棘生焉；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Such affairs tend to rebound: where armies encamp, thorns and brambles grow;
अस्य कार्यस्य प्रत्यावृत्तिः: यत्र सेना, तत्र कण्टकाणि;

ddj-ch-30.pinyin: da4 jun1 zhi1 hou4， bi4 you3 xiong1 nian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 大军之后，必有凶年。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: After a great war, there are sure to be years of famine.
महत्याः सेनायाः पश्चात्, दुर्भिक्षवर्षाणि सन्ति।

ddj-ch-30.content: 善有果而已，不敢以取强。
ddj-ch-30.pinyin: shan4 you3 guo3 er2 yi3， bu4 gan3 yi3 qu3 qiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 善有果而已，不敢以取强。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A good commander achieves his end and stops; he dares not take by force.
कुशलः फलमेव प्राप्य, बलेन न गृहन्न्ति।

ddj-ch-30.content: 果而勿矜，果而勿伐，果而勿骄，果而不得已，果而勿强。
ddj-ch-30.pinyin: guo3 er2 wu4 jin1， guo3 er2 wu4 fa2， guo3 er2 wu4 jiao1， guo3 er2 bu4 de2 yi3， guo3 er2 wu4 qiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 果而勿矜，果而勿伐，果而勿骄，果而不得已，果而勿强。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Achieve the end and do not boast; achieve and do not brag; achieve and do not be proud; achieve only as a last resort; achieve and do not force.
फलं प्राप्य न गर्वयति, न स्तौति, न दर्पयति; अवश्यं फलम्, बलेन न।

ddj-ch-30.content: 物壮则老，是谓不道，不道早已。
ddj-ch-30.pinyin: wu4 zhuang4 ze2 lao3， shi4 wei4 bu4 dao4， bu4 dao4 zao3 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 物壮则老，是谓不道，不道早已。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When things are strong they grow old—this is called contrary to the Way; what is contrary to the Way comes to an early end.
वस्तूनि बलवन्ति जीर्णानि — "अमार्गः" इति उच्यते; अमार्गः शीघ्रं नाशः।

ddj-ch-31.content: 夫兵者，不祥之器，物或恶之，故有道者不处。
ddj-ch-31.pinyin: fu1 bing1 zhe3， bu4 xiang2 zhi1 qi4， wu4 huo4 e4 zhi1， gu4 you3 dao4 zhe3 bu4 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫兵者，不祥之器，物或恶之，故有道者不处。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Arms are instruments of ill omen; things may detest them; therefore one who has the Way does not abide by them.
शस्त्राणि अशुभोपकरणानि; वस्तूनि द्वेषन्ति; मार्गवान् न वसन्ति।

ddj-ch-31.content: 君子居则贵左，用兵则贵右。
ddj-ch-31.pinyin: jun1 zi ju1 ze2 gui4 zuo3， yong4 bing1 ze2 gui4 you4。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子居则贵左，用兵则贵右。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The gentleman values the left in ordinary dwelling; when using arms he values the right.
आर्यः वासे वामं पूजयति, शस्त्रे दक्षिणाम्।

ddj-ch-31.content: 兵者不祥之器，非君子之器，不得已而用之，恬淡为上。
ddj-ch-31.pinyin: bing1 zhe3 bu4 xiang2 zhi1 qi4， fei1 jun1 zi zhi1 qi4， bu4 de2 yi3 er2 yong4 zhi1， tian2 dan4 wei4 shang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 兵者不祥之器，非君子之器，不得已而用之，恬淡为上。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Arms are instruments of ill omen, not the instruments of a gentleman; he uses them only when he must, and calm detachment is best.
शस्त्राणि अशुभानि, नार्यस्य उपकरणानि; अवश्यं यदा, शान्त्या उत्तमम्।

ddj-ch-31.content: 胜而不美，而美之者，是乐杀人。
ddj-ch-31.pinyin: sheng4 er2 bu4 mei3， er2 mei3 zhi1 zhe3， shi4 le4 sha1 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 胜而不美，而美之者，是乐杀人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To win and yet find no beauty in it—to find beauty in it is to delight in killing men.
जयं न शोभयते; जयं शोभयते — वधरतिम्।

ddj-ch-31.content: 夫乐杀人者，则不可得志于天下矣。
ddj-ch-31.pinyin: fu1 le4 sha1 ren2 zhe3， ze2 bu4 ke3 de2 zhi4 yu2 tian1 xia4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫乐杀人者，则不可得志于天下矣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who delights in killing men cannot fulfill his will under Heaven.
वधरतिः अन्तरिक्षे इच्छां न साधयति।

ddj-ch-31.pinyin: ji2 shi4 shang4 zuo3， xiong1 shi4 shang4 you4。

interpretations.segmentation: 吉事尚左，凶事尚右。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Auspicious affairs honor the left; inauspicious affairs honor the right.
मङ्गले वामम्, अमङ्गले दक्षिणाम्।

ddj-ch-31.content: 偏将军居左，上将军居右，言以丧礼处之。
ddj-ch-31.pinyin: pian1 jiang1 jun1 ju1 zuo3， shang4 jiang1 jun1 ju1 you4， yan2 yi3 sang4 li3 chu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 偏将军居左，上将军居右，言以丧礼处之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The lieutenant general stands on the left, the senior general on the right—this means they are treated with funeral rites.
उपसेनापतिः वामे, महासेनापतिः दक्षिणे — अन्त्यक्रियया इति।

ddj-ch-31.content: 杀人之众，以悲哀泣之，战胜以丧礼处之。
ddj-ch-31.pinyin: sha1 ren2 zhi1 zhong4， yi3 bei1 ai1 qi4 zhi1， zhan4 sheng4 yi3 sang4 li3 chu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 杀人之众，以悲哀泣之，战胜以丧礼处之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When many are slain, weep for them with grief; when victorious, treat it with funeral rites.
बहून् हत्वा शोकेन रोदति, जिते अन्त्यक्रियया इति।

ddj-ch-32.content: 道常无名，朴虽小，天下莫能臣。
ddj-ch-32.pinyin: dao4 chang2 wu2 ming2， pu3 sui1 xiao3， tian1 xia4 mo4 neng2 chen2。

interpretations.segmentation: 道常无名，朴虽小，天下莫能臣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: 道常无名。朴虽小，天下莫能臣。
interpretations.note: 异读：「道常无名」独立成读。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way is constantly nameless; though the uncarved block is small, none under Heaven can make it a subject.
मार्गः सदा अनाम; अखण्डं लघु, अन्तरिक्षे न दासं करोति।

ddj-ch-32.content: 侯王若能守之，万物将自宾。
ddj-ch-32.pinyin: hou2 wang2 ruo4 neng2 shou3 zhi1， wan4 wu4 jiang1 zi4 bin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 侯王若能守之，万物将自宾。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If lords and kings can keep to it, the myriad things will of themselves submit as guests.
राजानः रक्षेयुः, सर्वाणि स्वयम् अतिथि भवन्ति।

ddj-ch-32.content: 天地相合，以降甘露，民莫之令而自均。
ddj-ch-32.pinyin: tian1 di4 xiang1 he2， yi3 jiang4 gan1 lu4， min2 mo4 zhi1 ling4 er2 zi4 jun1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天地相合，以降甘露，民莫之令而自均。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven and Earth join and send down sweet dew; the people, without being commanded, share it evenly of themselves.
द्यावापृथिवी संयुज्यते, मधु वर्षन्ति; जनाः आज्ञां विना समाः भवन्ति।

ddj-ch-32.content: 始制有名，名亦既有，夫亦将知止。
ddj-ch-32.pinyin: shi3 zhi4 you3 ming2， ming2 yi4 ji4 you3， fu1 yi4 jiang1 zhi1 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 始制有名，名亦既有，夫亦将知止。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When institutions begin, names appear; once there are names, one should also know when to stop.
विधानं नाम; नाम्नि सति, स्थानं ज्ञात्वा।

ddj-ch-32.pinyin: zhi1 zhi3 ke3 yi3 bu4 dai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 知止可以不殆。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Knowing when to stop, one can be without danger.
स्थानं ज्ञात्वा, न भयम्।

ddj-ch-32.content: 譬道之在天下，犹川谷之于江海。
ddj-ch-32.pinyin: pi4 dao4 zhi1 zai4 tian1 xia4， you2 chuan1 gu3 zhi1 yu2 jiang1 hai3。

interpretations.segmentation: 譬道之在天下，犹川谷之于江海。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way's presence in the world is like streams and valleys flowing to the rivers and the sea.
मार्गः लोके — नदीकन्दरसमुद्र इव।

ddj-ch-33.pinyin: zhi1 ren2 zhe3 zhi4， zi4 zhi1 zhe3 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 知人者智，自知者明。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To know others is wisdom; to know oneself is insight.
परान् ज्ञात्वा प्रज्ञा; आत्मानं ज्ञात्वा प्रकाशः।

ddj-ch-33.pinyin: sheng4 ren2 zhe3 you3 li4， zi4 sheng4 zhe3 qiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 胜人者有力，自胜者强。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To conquer others is strength; to conquer oneself is true power.
परान् जेतुं बलम्; आत्मानं जेतुं शक्तिः।

ddj-ch-33.pinyin: zhi1 zu2 zhe3 fu4， qiang2 xing2 zhe3 you3 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 知足者富，强行者有志。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To know contentment is wealth; to press on with vigor is to have will.
तृप्तिं ज्ञात्वा धनम्; उत्साहेन गच्छन् इच्छा।

ddj-ch-33.content: 不失其所者久，死而不亡者寿。
ddj-ch-33.pinyin: bu4 shi1 qi2 suo3 zhe3 jiu3， si3 er2 bu4 wang2 zhe3 shou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不失其所者久，死而不亡者寿。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Not to lose one's place is to endure; to die and yet not perish is to live long.
स्थानं न त्यजन् दीर्घम्; मृत्युं लब्ध्वा न नशन् आयुः।

ddj-ch-34.pinyin: da4 dao4 fan4 xi1， qi2 ke3 zuo3 you4。

interpretations.segmentation: 大道泛兮，其可左右。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Great Way floods everywhere; it may go left or right.
महामार्गः सर्वत्र; वामं दक्षिणं वा।

ddj-ch-34.content: 万物恃之以生而不辞，功成不名有。
ddj-ch-34.pinyin: wan4 wu4 shi4 zhi1 yi3 sheng1 er2 bu4 ci2， gong1 cheng2 bu4 ming2 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 万物恃之以生而不辞，功成不名有。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things rely on it to live, and it does not refuse them; when the work is done, it claims no name of possession.
सर्वाणि तेन जीवन्ति, न प्रत्याहति; कृत्ये न स्वं नाम।

ddj-ch-34.content: 衣养万物而不为主，常无欲，可名于小；
ddj-ch-34.pinyin: yi1 yang3 wan4 wu4 er2 bu4 wei4 zhu3， chang2 wu2 yu4， ke3 ming2 yu2 xiao3；

interpretations.segmentation: 衣养万物而不为主，常无欲，可名于小；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: 衣养万物而不为主。常无欲，可名于小；
It clothes and nourishes the myriad things yet does not act as their master; always without desire, it may be named small;
पोषयति न स्वामी; सदा निरीहा, लघु इति नाम;

ddj-ch-34.content: 万物归焉而不为主，可名为大。
ddj-ch-34.pinyin: wan4 wu4 gui1 yan1 er2 bu4 wei4 zhu3， ke3 ming2 wei4 da4。

interpretations.segmentation: 万物归焉而不为主，可名为大。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things return to it yet it does not act as their master—it may be named great.
सर्वाणि प्रत्यागच्छन्ति न स्वामी; महत् इति नाम।

ddj-ch-34.content: 以其终不自为大，故能成其大。
ddj-ch-34.pinyin: yi3 qi2 zhong1 bu4 zi4 wei4 da4， gu4 neng2 cheng2 qi2 da4。

interpretations.segmentation: 以其终不自为大，故能成其大。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Because to the end it does not make itself great, it is able to achieve its greatness.
अन्ततः न महत्, तस्मात् महत् साधयति।

ddj-ch-35.pinyin: zhi2 da4 xiang4， tian1 xia4 wang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 执大象，天下往。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Hold the great image, and the world will come.
महारूपं गृहीत्वा, लोकः आगच्छति।

ddj-ch-35.pinyin: wang3 er2 bu4 hai4， an1 ping2 tai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 往而不害，安平泰。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Coming, they suffer no harm, but find peace, evenness, and ease.
आगताः न हीयन्ते, शान्त्या समतया सुखेन।

ddj-ch-35.pinyin: le4 yu3 er3， guo4 ke4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐与饵，过客止。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Music and fine food make the passing guest pause.
गीतं मधुरं — अतिथिः तिष्ठति।

ddj-ch-35.content: 道之出口，淡乎其无味，视之不足见，听之不足闻，用之不足既。
ddj-ch-35.pinyin: dao4 zhi1 chu1 kou3， dan4 hu1 qi2 wu2 wei4， shi4 zhi1 bu4 zu2 jian4， ting1 zhi1 bu4 zu2 wen2， yong4 zhi1 bu4 zu2 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 道之出口，淡乎其无味，视之不足见，听之不足闻，用之不足既。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the Way comes forth from the mouth, how bland—it has no flavor; look, and it is not enough to see; listen, and it is not enough to hear; use it, and it is not enough to exhaust.
मार्गः वक्तुं — निर्रसः; दृष्ट्वा न पर्याप्तम्, श्रुत्वा न पर्याप्तम्, उपयुज्य न क्षीयते।

ddj-ch-36.pinyin: jiang1 yu4 she4 zhi1， bi4 gu4 zhang1 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 将欲歙之，必固张之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is to be contracted must first be expanded;
संकोचयितुम् इच्छन्, प्रथमं विस्तारयेत;

ddj-ch-36.pinyin: jiang1 yu4 ruo4 zhi1， bi4 gu4 qiang2 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 将欲弱之，必固强之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is to be weakened must first be strengthened;
दुर्बलीकर्तुम् इच्छन्, प्रथमं बलयेत;

ddj-ch-36.pinyin: jiang1 yu4 fei4 zhi1， bi4 gu4 xing1 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 将欲废之，必固兴之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is to be abolished must first be raised;
नाशयितुम् इच्छन्, प्रथमं उत्थापयेत;

ddj-ch-36.pinyin: jiang1 yu4 duo2 zhi1， bi4 gu4 yu3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 将欲夺之，必固与之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is to be taken must first be given.
हन्तुम् इच्छन्, प्रथमं दद्यात्।
是谓微明。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: This is called subtle insight.
एतत् "सूक्ष्मप्रकाशः" इति उच्यते।
柔弱胜刚强。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The soft and weak overcome the hard and strong.
मृदुं दुर्बलं जयति दृढं बलवत्।

ddj-ch-36.content: 鱼不可脱于渊，国之利器不可以示人。
ddj-ch-36.pinyin: yu2 bu4 ke3 tuo1 yu2 yuan1， guo2 zhi1 li4 qi4 bu4 ke3 yi3 shi4 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鱼不可脱于渊，国之利器不可以示人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Fish cannot leave the depths; the sharp instruments of the state must not be shown to others.
मत्स्यः गर्तात् न निर्याति; राज्यस्य तीक्ष्णानि न दृश्यन्ते।

ddj-ch-37.pinyin: dao4 chang2 wu2 wei4 er2 wu2 bu4 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 道常无为而无不为。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: 道常无为，而无不为。
interpretations.note: 异读：强调「无为／无不为」对举停顿。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way constantly does nothing, yet nothing is left undone.
मार्गः सदा अकरणम्, न किंचिद् अकृतम्।

ddj-ch-37.content: 侯王若能守之，万物将自化。
ddj-ch-37.pinyin: hou2 wang2 ruo4 neng2 shou3 zhi1， wan4 wu4 jiang1 zi4 hua4。

interpretations.segmentation: 侯王若能守之，万物将自化。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If lords and kings can keep to it, the myriad things will transform of themselves.
राजानः रक्षेयुः, सर्वाणि स्वयम् परिणमन्ति।

ddj-ch-37.content: 化而欲作，吾将镇之以无名之朴。
ddj-ch-37.pinyin: hua4 er2 yu4 zuo4， wu2 jiang1 zhen4 zhi1 yi3 wu2 ming2 zhi1 pu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 化而欲作，吾将镇之以无名之朴。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If, transforming, desire should arise, I will quiet it with the nameless uncarved block.
परिणम्य इच्छा उत्पद्येत, अनामाखण्डेन शान्तयामि।

ddj-ch-37.pinyin: wu2 ming2 zhi1 pu3， fu1 yi4 jiang1 wu2 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 无名之朴，夫亦将无欲。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: With the nameless uncarved block, there will also be no desire.
अनामाखण्डेन, निरीहा अपि भवति।

ddj-ch-37.pinyin: bu4 yu4 yi3 jing4， tian1 xia4 jiang1 zi4 ding4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不欲以静，天下将自定。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Without desire and thus still, the world will settle of itself.
निरीहायाः शान्तिः; लोकः स्वयम् अवस्थापयति।

ddj-ch-38.pinyin: shang4 de2 bu4 de2， shi4 yi3 you3 de2；

interpretations.segmentation: 上德不德，是以有德；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Highest virtue is not virtue, and therefore it has virtue;
उत्तमगुणः न गुणः, तस्मात् गुणः;

ddj-ch-38.pinyin: xia4 de2 bu4 shi1 de2， shi4 yi3 wu2 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 下德不失德，是以无德。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Lower virtue never loses virtue, and therefore it has no virtue.
अधमगुणः गुणं न त्यजति, तस्मात् न गुणः।

ddj-ch-38.pinyin: shang4 de2 wu2 wei4 er2 wu2 yi3 wei4；

interpretations.segmentation: 上德无为而无以为；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Highest virtue does nothing and has no motive for doing;
उत्तमगुणः अकरणम्, न हेतुः;

ddj-ch-38.pinyin: xia4 de2 wei4 zhi1 er2 you3 yi3 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 下德为之而有以为。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Lower virtue acts and has a motive for acting.
अधमगुणः करोति, हेतुः अस्ति।

ddj-ch-38.pinyin: shang4 ren2 wei4 zhi1 er2 wu2 yi3 wei4；

interpretations.segmentation: 上仁为之而无以为；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Highest benevolence acts but has no motive for acting;
उत्तमकरुणा करोति, न हेतुः;

ddj-ch-38.pinyin: shang4 yi4 wei4 zhi1 er2 you3 yi3 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 上义为之而有以为。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Highest righteousness acts and has a motive for acting.
उत्तमधर्मः करोति, हेतुः अस्ति।

ddj-ch-38.content: 上礼为之而莫之应，则攘臂而扔之。
ddj-ch-38.pinyin: shang4 li3 wei4 zhi1 er2 mo4 zhi1 ying1， ze2 rang3 bi4 er2 reng1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 上礼为之而莫之应，则攘臂而扔之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Highest propriety acts, and when none respond, it rolls up its sleeves and forces them.
उत्तमव्यवहारः करोति, न प्रत्युत्तरति, बाहुमुद्यम्य क्षिपति।

ddj-ch-38.content: 故失道而后德，失德而后仁，失仁而后义，失义而后礼。
ddj-ch-38.pinyin: gu4 shi1 dao4 er2 hou4 de2， shi1 de2 er2 hou4 ren2， shi1 ren2 er2 hou4 yi4， shi1 yi4 er2 hou4 li3。

interpretations.segmentation: 故失道而后德，失德而后仁，失仁而后义，失义而后礼。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore when the Way is lost, then comes virtue; when virtue is lost, then comes benevolence; when benevolence is lost, then comes righteousness; when righteousness is lost, then comes propriety.
मार्गः नष्टे गुणः; गुणः नष्टे करुणा; करुणा नष्टे धर्मः; धर्मः नष्टे व्यवहारः।

ddj-ch-38.content: 夫礼者，忠信之薄，而乱之首。
ddj-ch-38.pinyin: fu1 li3 zhe3， zhong1 xin4 zhi1 bao2， er2 luan4 zhi1 shou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫礼者，忠信之薄，而乱之首。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Propriety is the thinning of loyalty and trust, and the beginning of disorder.
व्यवहारः — भक्तिविश्वासस्य क्षयः, विभ्रमादिः।

ddj-ch-38.content: 前识者，道之华，而愚之始。
ddj-ch-38.pinyin: qian2 shi2 zhe3， dao4 zhi1 hua2， er2 yu2 zhi1 shi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 前识者，道之华，而愚之始。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Foresight is the flower of the Way, and the beginning of folly.
पूर्वज्ञानं मार्गकुसुमं, मोहादिः।

ddj-ch-38.content: 是以大丈夫处其厚，不居其薄；
ddj-ch-38.pinyin: shi4 yi3 da4 zhang4 fu1 chu4 qi2 hou4， bu4 ju1 qi2 bao2；

interpretations.segmentation: 是以大丈夫处其厚，不居其薄；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the great man abides in the thick, and does not dwell in the thin;
महापुरुषः घनं वसति, न तनु;

ddj-ch-38.pinyin: chu4 qi2 shi2， bu4 ju1 qi2 hua2。

interpretations.segmentation: 处其实，不居其华。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Abides in the substance, and does not dwell in the flower.
वस्तुनि वसति, न कुसुमे।
故去彼取此。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus he discards that and takes this.
तस्मात् तत् त्यजति, इदम् गृह्णाति।

ddj-ch-39.content: 昔之得一者：天得一以清；
ddj-ch-39.pinyin: xi1 zhi1 de2 yi1 zhe3： tian1 de2 yi1 yi3 qing1；

interpretations.segmentation: 昔之得一者：天得一以清；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Of those who of old attained the One: Heaven attained the One and became clear;
प्राचीना एकं लभ्द्वा: द्यौः एकं लभ्द्वा शुद्धा;
地得一以宁；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Earth attained the One and became settled;
पृथिवी एकं लभ्द्वा स्थिरा;
神得一以灵；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Spirits attained the One and became efficacious;
देवाः एकं लभ्द्वा प्रभावाः;
谷得一以盈；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Valleys attained the One and became full;
कन्दराः एकं लभ्द्वा पूर्णाः;

ddj-ch-39.pinyin: wan4 wu4 de2 yi1 yi3 sheng1；

interpretations.segmentation: 万物得一以生；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things attained the One and came to life;
सर्वाणि एकं लभ्द्वा जीवन्ति;

ddj-ch-39.pinyin: hou2 wang2 de2 yi1 yi3 wei4 tian1 xia4 zhen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 侯王得一以为天下贞。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Lords and kings attained the One and became the standard for the world.
राजानः एकं लभ्द्वा जगतः प्रमाणम्।

ddj-ch-39.content: 其致之：天无以清将恐裂；
ddj-ch-39.pinyin: qi2 zhi4 zhi1： tian1 wu2 yi3 qing1 jiang1 kong3 lie4；

interpretations.segmentation: 其致之：天无以清将恐裂；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What brings this about: if Heaven had nothing by which to be clear, it would, I fear, split;
एतद् यदि न स्यात्: द्यौः शुद्धा न स्यात्, भयम् भिद्येत्;

ddj-ch-39.pinyin: di4 wu2 yi3 ning2 jiang1 kong3 fei4；

interpretations.segmentation: 地无以宁将恐废；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If Earth had nothing by which to be settled, it would, I fear, collapse;
पृथिवी स्थिरा न स्यात्, भयम् भग्नेत्;

ddj-ch-39.pinyin: shen2 wu2 yi3 ling2 jiang1 kong3 xie1；

interpretations.segmentation: 神无以灵将恐歇；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If spirits had nothing by which to be efficacious, they would, I fear, cease;
देवाः प्रभावा न स्युः, भयम् शाम्येत्;

ddj-ch-39.pinyin: gu3 wu2 yi3 ying2 jiang1 kong3 jie2；

interpretations.segmentation: 谷无以盈将恐竭；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If valleys had nothing by which to be full, they would, I fear, dry up;
कन्दराः पूर्णा न स्युः, भयम् शुष्येत्;

ddj-ch-39.pinyin: wan4 wu4 wu2 yi3 sheng1 jiang1 kong3 mie4；

interpretations.segmentation: 万物无以生将恐灭；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If the myriad things had nothing by which to live, they would, I fear, perish;
सर्वाणि जीवन्ति न स्युः, भयम् नशेत्;

ddj-ch-39.pinyin: hou2 wang2 wu2 yi3 gui4 gao1 jiang1 kong3 jue2。

interpretations.segmentation: 侯王无以贵高将恐蹶。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If lords and kings had nothing by which to be noble and high, they would, I fear, fall.
राजानः उच्चा न स्युः, भयम् पतन्ति।

ddj-ch-39.content: 故贵以贱为本，高以下为基。
ddj-ch-39.pinyin: gu4 gui4 yi3 jian4 wei4 ben3， gao1 yi3 xia4 wei4 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 故贵以贱为本，高以下为基。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the noble takes the lowly as its root; the high takes the low as its foundation.
तस्मात् उच्चाः नीचां मूलम्, उच्चं अधः आधारम्।

ddj-ch-39.content: 是以侯王自谓孤、寡、不谷。
ddj-ch-39.pinyin: shi4 yi3 hou2 wang2 zi4 wei4 gu1、 gua3、 bu4 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以侯王自谓孤、寡、不谷。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus lords and kings call themselves "orphan," "lonely," and "unworthy."
तस्मात् राजानः "अनाथ", "एकाकी", "अपात्र" इति आह्वयन्ते।

ddj-ch-39.pinyin: ci3 fei1 yi3 jian4 wei4 ben3 xie2？

interpretations.segmentation: 此非以贱为本邪？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Is this not taking the lowly as the root?
एतद् नीचां मूलम् — न?
非乎？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Is it not so?
न?

ddj-ch-39.pinyin: gu4 zhi4 shu4 yu2 wu2 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 故致数舆无舆。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the highest renown is to have no renown.
तस्मात् बहुयानं यानं विना।

ddj-ch-39.content: 不欲琭琭如玉，珞珞如石。
ddj-ch-39.pinyin: bu4 yu4 lu4 lu4 ru2 yu4， luo4 luo4 ru2 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 不欲琭琭如玉，珞珞如石。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not desire to shine like jade, or to be hard like stone.
मणिव दीप्तिम्, अश्मिव कठोरताम् इच्छां मा कुरु।

ddj-ch-40.content: 反者道之动，弱者道之用。
ddj-ch-40.pinyin: fan3 zhe3 dao4 zhi1 dong4， ruo4 zhe3 dao4 zhi1 yong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 反者道之动，弱者道之用。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Return is the movement of the Way; weakness is the use of the Way.
प्रत्यागमः मार्गगतिः; दौर्बल्यं मार्गप्रयोगः।

ddj-ch-40.content: 天下万物生于有，有生于无。
ddj-ch-40.pinyin: tian1 xia4 wan4 wu4 sheng1 yu2 you3， you3 sheng1 yu2 wu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下万物生于有，有生于无。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things under Heaven are born of being; being is born of non-being.
सर्वाणि भावात् जायन्ते; भावः अभावात्।

ddj-ch-41.pinyin: shang4 shi4 wen2 dao4， qin2 er2 xing2 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 上士闻道，勤而行之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the highest type of man hears the Way, he diligently puts it into practice;
उत्तमः श्रुत्वा मार्गं तं प्रयत्नेन आचरति;

ddj-ch-41.pinyin: zhong1 shi4 wen2 dao4， ruo4 cun2 ruo4 wang2；

interpretations.segmentation: 中士闻道，若存若亡；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the middling type hears the Way, he seems to keep it and seems to lose it;
मध्यमः श्रुत्वा मार्गं धारयति इव, नश्यति इव;

ddj-ch-41.pinyin: xia4 shi4 wen2 dao4， da4 xiao4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 下士闻道，大笑之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the lowest type hears the Way, he laughs aloud at it.
अधमः श्रुत्वा मार्गं महता हसति।

ddj-ch-41.pinyin: bu4 xiao4 bu4 zu2 yi3 wei4 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不笑不足以为道。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If it were not laughed at, it would not be fit to be the Way.
न हसितः स्यात्, मार्गः न स्यात्।

ddj-ch-41.pinyin: gu4 jian4 yan2 you3 zhi1： ming2 dao4 ruo4 mei4；

interpretations.segmentation: 故建言有之：明道若昧；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the established sayings have it: The bright Way seems dark;
तस्माद् उक्तम्—प्रकाशमानो मार्गः तमः इव;
进道若退；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The advancing Way seems to retreat;
अग्रगामी मार्गः पश्चाद् गच्छति इव;
夷道若颣；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The level Way seems rough;
समो मार्गः खुरन्द इव;
上德若谷；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Highest virtue seems like a valley;
उत्तमो गुणः कन्दरा इव;
大白若辱；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Great whiteness seems stained;
महान् श्वेतः अपमानः इव;
广德若不足；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Abundant virtue seems insufficient;
प्रभूतो गुणः अपर्याप्तः इव;
建德若偷；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Established virtue seems stealthy;
स्थापितो गुणः चौर्यं इव;
质真若渝；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Genuine substance seems changeable;
सत्यं सारं परिवर्तते इव;
大方无隅；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The great square has no corners;
महान् चतुष्कोणः कोणः न;
大器晚成；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The great vessel is late in being completed;
महत् पात्रं विलम्बेन पूर्णम्;
大音希声；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The great note has a rarefied sound;
महान् नादः दुर्लभः शब्दः;
大象无形。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The great image has no form.
महत् प्रतिमा रूपं न।
道隐无名。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way is hidden and nameless.
मार्गः गुप्तः अनामा।

ddj-ch-41.pinyin: fu1 wei2 dao4， shan4 dai4 qie3 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯道，善贷且成。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Only the Way is good at lending and bringing things to completion.
केवलं मार्गः उद्धारयति च सम्पादयति च।

ddj-ch-42.content: 道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物。
ddj-ch-42.pinyin: dao4 sheng1 yi1， yi1 sheng1 er4， er4 sheng1 san1， san1 sheng1 wan4 wu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way gives birth to One; One gives birth to Two; Two gives birth to Three; Three gives birth to the myriad things.
मार्गः एकं जनयति, एकं द्वौ, द्वौ त्रीणि, त्रीणि सर्वाणि भूतानि।

ddj-ch-42.content: 万物负阴而抱阳，冲气以为和。
ddj-ch-42.pinyin: wan4 wu4 fu4 yin1 er2 bao4 yang2， chong1 qi4 yi3 wei4 he2。

interpretations.segmentation: 万物负阴而抱阳，冲气以为和。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things carry yin on their backs and embrace yang; the blending of the vital breaths makes harmony.
सर्वाणि भूतानि अन्धं धारयन्ति, उष्णं आलिङ्गन्ति; प्राणसंयोगः साम्यं करोति।

ddj-ch-42.content: 人之所恶，唯孤、寡、不谷，而王公以为称。
ddj-ch-42.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 suo3 e4， wei2 gu1、 gua3、 bu4 gu3， er2 wang2 gong1 yi3 wei4 cheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之所恶，唯孤、寡、不谷，而王公以为称。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What people detest—"orphan," "lonely," and "unworthy"—kings and dukes take as titles.
यत् जनाः द्वेष्टुं, अनाथः एकाकी अयोग्यः—राजानः तत् नामधेयं गृह्णन्ति।

ddj-ch-42.content: 故物或损之而益，或益之而损。
ddj-ch-42.pinyin: gu4 wu4 huo4 sun3 zhi1 er2 yi4， huo4 yi4 zhi1 er2 sun3。

interpretations.segmentation: 故物或损之而益，或益之而损。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore some things are diminished and thereby gain; some are increased and thereby diminish.
तस्मात् केचित् ह्रसयन्ति, लभन्ते; केचित् वर्धयन्ति, ह्रसन्ति।

ddj-ch-42.content: 人之所教，我亦教之：强梁者不得其死，吾将以为教父。
ddj-ch-42.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 suo3 jiao4， wo3 yi4 jiao4 zhi1： qiang2 liang2 zhe3 bu4 de2 qi2 si3， wu2 jiang1 yi3 wei4 jiao4 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之所教，我亦教之：强梁者不得其死，吾将以为教父。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What others teach, I also teach: the violent and overbearing do not meet a natural death—I take this as the father of my teaching.
यत् अन्ये उपदिशन्ति, अहं अपि—बलवान् अत्याचारी स्वाभाविकं मरणं न लभते; एतत् उपदेशस्य पिता।

ddj-ch-43.content: 天下之至柔，驰骋天下之至坚。
ddj-ch-43.pinyin: tian1 xia4 zhi1 zhi4 rou2， chi2 cheng3 tian1 xia4 zhi1 zhi4 jian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下之至柔，驰骋天下之至坚。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The softest thing under Heaven races through the hardest under Heaven.
अधः स्वभावतः मृदुतमं, स्वभावतः कठिनतमं अतिक्रमति।

ddj-ch-43.content: 无有入无间，吾是以知无为之有益。
ddj-ch-43.pinyin: wu2 you3 ru4 wu2 jian1， wu2 shi4 yi3 zhi1 wu2 wei4 zhi1 you3 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 无有入无间，吾是以知无为之有益。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: That which has no being enters where there is no space; thereby I know the benefit of non-action.
असत् अन्तरं प्रविशति; ततः अकरणस्य फलं जानामि।

ddj-ch-43.content: 不言之教，无为之益，天下希及之。
ddj-ch-43.pinyin: bu4 yan2 zhi1 jiao4， wu2 wei4 zhi1 yi4， tian1 xia4 xi1 ji2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不言之教，无为之益，天下希及之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The teaching without words, the benefit of non-action—few under Heaven attain to these.
अवाक् उपदेशः, अकरणस्य फलं—क्वचित् लोकेऽपि प्राप्नोति।
名与身孰亲？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Fame or the body—which is dearer?
कीर्तिः शरीरं वा—कः प्रियतरः?
身与货孰多？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The body or goods—which is worth more?
शरीरं वस्तु वा—कः अधिकं?
得与亡孰病？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Gain or loss—which is the greater affliction?
लाभः नाशः वा—कः अधिकं व्याधिः?
甚爱必大费；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Excessive love must bring great expense;
अतिप्रेम महत् व्ययं आनयति;
多藏必厚亡。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Much hoarding must bring heavy loss.
अधिकं संग्रहणं भारं नाशं आनयति।

ddj-ch-44.content: 故知足不辱，知止不殆，可以长久。
ddj-ch-44.pinyin: gu4 zhi1 zu2 bu4 ru3， zhi1 zhi3 bu4 dai4， ke3 yi3 zhang3 jiu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 故知足不辱，知止不殆，可以长久。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore know contentment and you will not be disgraced; know when to stop and you will not be in danger—you can last long.
तस्मात् तृप्तिं जानाति, अपमानं न; स्थानं जानाति, भयं न—दीर्घकालं स्थातुं शक्नोति।

ddj-ch-45.pinyin: da4 cheng2 ruo4 que1， qi2 yong4 bu4 bi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 大成若缺，其用不弊。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Great completion seems incomplete, yet its use is never worn out.
महत् पूर्णं अपूर्णम् इव, तस्य उपयोगः न शीर्यते।

ddj-ch-45.pinyin: da4 ying2 ruo4 chong1， qi2 yong4 bu4 qiong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 大盈若冲，其用不穷。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Great fullness seems empty, yet its use is never exhausted.
महत् पूर्णं रिक्तम् इव, तस्य उपयोगः न क्षीयते।

ddj-ch-45.content: 大直若屈，大巧若拙，大辩若讷。
ddj-ch-45.pinyin: da4 zhi2 ruo4 qu1， da4 qiao3 ruo4 zhuo1， da4 bian4 ruo4 ne4。

interpretations.segmentation: 大直若屈，大巧若拙，大辩若讷。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Great straightness seems bent; great skill seems clumsy; great eloquence seems stammering.
महान् ऋजुः वक्रः इव, महत् कौशलं अकुशलम् इव, महान् वाक् मूकः इव।

ddj-ch-45.pinyin: zao4 sheng4 han2， jing4 sheng4 re4。

interpretations.segmentation: 躁胜寒，静胜热。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Restlessness overcomes cold; stillness overcomes heat.
चञ्चलता शीतं जयति, स्थैर्यं उष्णं जयति।

ddj-ch-45.pinyin: qing1 jing4 wei4 tian1 xia4 zheng4。

interpretations.segmentation: 清静为天下正。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Clarity and stillness set the world in order.
शान्तिः स्थैर्यं च लोकस्य धर्मं स्थापयति।

ddj-ch-46.pinyin: tian1 xia4 you3 dao4， que4 zou3 ma3 yi3 fen4；

interpretations.segmentation: 天下有道，却走马以粪；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the world has the Way, spare horses are used for manure;
लोके मार्गः सन्, अश्वाः क्षेत्रं सिञ्चन्ति;

ddj-ch-46.pinyin: tian1 xia4 wu2 dao4， rong2 ma3 sheng1 yu2 jiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下无道，戎马生于郊。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the world lacks the Way, war horses are bred on the borders.
लोके मार्गः न सन्, युद्धाश्वाः सीमायां जायन्ते।

ddj-ch-46.pinyin: huo4 mo4 da4 yu2 bu4 zhi1 zu2；

interpretations.segmentation: 祸莫大于不知足；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: No disaster is greater than not knowing contentment;
न अतर्पणात् महत्तरं दुःखम्;
