ddj-ch-46.pinyin: jiu4 mo4 da4 yu2 yu4 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 咎莫大于欲得。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: No fault is greater than the desire to get.
न लोभात् महत्तरं दोषः।

ddj-ch-46.pinyin: gu4 zhi1 zu2 zhi1 zu2， chang2 zu2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 故知足之足，常足矣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the contentment of knowing contentment is lasting contentment.
तस्मात् तृप्तेः तृप्तिः सदा तृप्तिः।

ddj-ch-47.pinyin: bu4 chu1 hu4， zhi1 tian1 xia4；

interpretations.segmentation: 不出户，知天下；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Without going out the door, know the world;
गृहाद् बहिर् न गच्छन्, लोकं जानाति;

ddj-ch-47.pinyin: bu4 kui1 you3， jian4 tian1 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不窥牖，见天道。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Without looking through the window, see the Way of Heaven.
जालकं न पश्यन्, दिव्यं मार्गं पश्यति।

ddj-ch-47.pinyin: qi2 chu1 mi2 yuan3， qi2 zhi1 mi2 shao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 其出弥远，其知弥少。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The farther one goes out, the less one knows.
यावत् दूरं गच्छति, तावत् अल्पं जानाति।

ddj-ch-47.content: 是以圣人不行而知，不见而明，不为而成。
ddj-ch-47.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 bu4 xing2 er2 zhi1， bu4 jian4 er2 ming2， bu4 wei4 er2 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人不行而知，不见而明，不为而成。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage knows without traveling, understands without seeing, and accomplishes without acting.
तस्मात् मुनिः न गच्छन् जानाति, न पश्यन् अवगच्छति, न कुर्वन् सम्पादयति।

ddj-ch-48.pinyin: wei4 xue2 ri4 yi4， wei4 dao4 ri4 sun3。

interpretations.segmentation: 为学日益，为道日损。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In pursuit of learning, one increases day by day; in pursuit of the Way, one decreases day by day.
अध्ययने दिने दिने वर्धते, मार्गे दिने दिने ह्रस्यति।

ddj-ch-48.pinyin: sun3 zhi1 you4 sun3， yi3 zhi4 yu2 wu2 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 损之又损，以至于无为。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Decrease and again decrease, until one reaches non-action.
ह्रसयन् पुनः ह्रसयन्, यावत् अकरणम्।

ddj-ch-48.pinyin: wu2 wei4 er2 wu2 bu4 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 无为而无不为。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Through non-action, nothing is left undone.
अकरणेन सर्वं कृतम्।

ddj-ch-48.content: 取天下常以无事，及其有事，不足以取天下。
ddj-ch-48.pinyin: qu3 tian1 xia4 chang2 yi3 wu2 shi4， ji2 qi2 you3 shi4， bu4 zu2 yi3 qu3 tian1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 取天下常以无事，及其有事，不足以取天下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To take the world, one must always be without meddling; when there is meddling, one is not fit to take the world.
लोकं ग्रहीतुं सदा निर्व्यापारः; व्यापारे सति, लोकं ग्रहीतुं न अर्हति।

ddj-ch-49.content: 圣人无常心，以百姓心为心。
ddj-ch-49.pinyin: sheng4 ren2 wu2 chang2 xin1， yi3 bai3 xing4 xin1 wei4 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 圣人无常心，以百姓心为心。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The sage has no fixed mind; he takes the mind of the hundred clans as his mind.
मुनेः न स्थिरं चित्तम्; जनानां चित्तं स्वचित्तम्।

ddj-ch-49.content: 善者吾善之，不善者吾亦善之，德善。
ddj-ch-49.pinyin: shan4 zhe3 wu2 shan4 zhi1， bu4 shan4 zhe3 wu2 yi4 shan4 zhi1， de2 shan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 善者吾善之，不善者吾亦善之，德善。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who are good I treat as good; those who are not good I also treat as good—this is the virtue of goodness.
शुभान् शुभं, अशुभान् अपि शुभं—गुणः शुभत्वम्।

ddj-ch-49.content: 信者吾信之，不信者吾亦信之，德信。
ddj-ch-49.pinyin: xin4 zhe3 wu2 xin4 zhi1， bu4 xin4 zhe3 wu2 yi4 xin4 zhi1， de2 xin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 信者吾信之，不信者吾亦信之，德信。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who are trustworthy I trust; those who are not trustworthy I also trust—this is the virtue of trust.
विश्वास्यान् विश्वसति, अविश्वास्यान् अपि—गुणः विश्वासः।

ddj-ch-49.content: 圣人在天下，歙歙焉为天下浑其心。
ddj-ch-49.pinyin: sheng4 ren2 zai4 tian1 xia4， she4 she4 yan1 wei4 tian1 xia4 hun2 qi2 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 圣人在天下，歙歙焉为天下浑其心。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The sage in the world gathers it in and makes the world's mind one and muddled.
मुनिः लोके संगृह्य लोकचित्तं एकं मिश्रं करोति।

ddj-ch-49.content: 百姓皆注其耳目，圣人皆孩之。
ddj-ch-49.pinyin: bai3 xing4 jie1 zhu4 qi2 er3 mu4， sheng4 ren2 jie1 hai2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 百姓皆注其耳目，圣人皆孩之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The hundred clans all fix their ears and eyes upon him; the sage treats them all as children.
जनाः श्रोत्रचक्षूणि नियोजयन्ति; मुनिः सर्वान् बालान् इव पालयति।
出生入死。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: We come forth into life and enter into death.
जन्म प्रविश्य मरणम्।

ddj-ch-50.pinyin: sheng1 zhi1 tu2 shi2 you3 san1；

interpretations.segmentation: 生之徒十有三；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Companions of life are three in ten;
जीवनस्य सहचाराः दशसु त्रयः;

ddj-ch-50.pinyin: si3 zhi1 tu2 shi2 you3 san1；

interpretations.segmentation: 死之徒十有三；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Companions of death are three in ten;
मरणस्य सहचाराः दशसु त्रयः;

ddj-ch-50.content: 人之生动之死地，亦十有三。
ddj-ch-50.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 sheng1 dong4 zhi1 si3 di4， yi4 shi2 you3 san1。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之生动之死地，亦十有三。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: People whose living moves them onto the ground of death are also three in ten.
जीवन्तः मरणभूमौ गच्छन्ति, अपि दशसु त्रयः।
夫何故？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Why is this?
किम् कारणम्?

ddj-ch-50.pinyin: yi3 qi2 sheng1 sheng1 zhi1 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 以其生生之厚。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Because they live life too richly.
जीवनं अतिप्रचुरं जीवन्ति।

ddj-ch-50.content: 盖闻善摄生者，陆行不遇兕虎，入军不被甲兵。
ddj-ch-50.pinyin: gai4 wen2 shan4 she4 sheng1 zhe3， lu4 xing2 bu4 yu4 si4 hu3， ru4 jun1 bu4 bei4 jia3 bing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 盖闻善摄生者，陆行不遇兕虎，入军不被甲兵。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I have heard that one skilled at preserving life walks on land without meeting rhinoceros or tiger, and enters the army without being touched by armor or weapons.
श्रुतम्—जीवनरक्षणे कुशलः भौमे गच्छन् गण्डकं व्याघ्रं न लभते, सेनायां न शस्त्रैः स्पृश्यते।

ddj-ch-50.content: 兕无所投其角，虎无所措其爪，兵无所容其刃。
ddj-ch-50.pinyin: si4 wu2 suo3 tou2 qi2 jiao3， hu3 wu2 suo3 cuo4 qi2 zhao3， bing1 wu2 suo3 rong2 qi2 ren4。

interpretations.segmentation: 兕无所投其角，虎无所措其爪，兵无所容其刃。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The rhinoceros finds no place to thrust its horn, the tiger no place to set its claws, weapons no place to lodge their blades.
गण्डकः शृङ्गं न प्रक्षिपति, व्याघ्रः नखान् न स्थापयति, शस्त्राणि न प्रविशन्ति।
夫何故？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Why is this?
किम् कारणम्?
以其无死地。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Because he has no ground of death.
मरणभूमिः न अस्ति।

ddj-ch-51.content: 道生之，德畜之，物形之，势成之。
ddj-ch-51.pinyin: dao4 sheng1 zhi1， de2 chu4 zhi1， wu4 xing2 zhi1， shi4 cheng2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 道生之，德畜之，物形之，势成之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way gives them birth; virtue rears them; things give them form; circumstances bring them to completion.
मार्गः जनयति, गुणः पालयति, वस्तु रूपं, परिस्थितिः सम्पादयति।

ddj-ch-51.content: 是以万物莫不尊道而贵德。
ddj-ch-51.pinyin: shi4 yi3 wan4 wu4 mo4 bu4 zun1 dao4 er2 gui4 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以万物莫不尊道而贵德。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore among the myriad things none fails to honor the Way and prize virtue.
तस्मात् सर्वाणि भूतानि मार्गं पूजयन्ति, गुणं प्रशंसन्ति।

ddj-ch-51.content: 道之尊，德之贵，夫莫之命而常自然。
ddj-ch-51.pinyin: dao4 zhi1 zun1， de2 zhi1 gui4， fu1 mo4 zhi1 ming4 er2 chang2 zi4 ran2。

interpretations.segmentation: 道之尊，德之贵，夫莫之命而常自然。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The honor of the Way and the prizing of virtue—none commands it, yet it is always naturally so.
मार्गस्य पूजा, गुणस्य महत्त्वम्—न कोत्पि आज्ञापयति, सदा स्वाभाविकम्।

ddj-ch-51.pinyin: gu4 dao4 sheng1 zhi1， de2 chu4 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 故道生之，德畜之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the Way gives them birth, and virtue rears them;
तस्मात् मार्गः जनयति, गुणः पालयति;
长之育之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Raises them and nurtures them;
वर्धयति पोषयति;
亭之毒之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Settles them and completes them;
स्थापयति पूर्णयति;
养之覆之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Shelters them and protects them.
पालयति आच्छादयति।

ddj-ch-51.content: 生而不有，为而不恃，长而不宰，是谓玄德。
ddj-ch-51.pinyin: sheng1 er2 bu4 you3， wei4 er2 bu4 shi4， zhang3 er2 bu4 zai3， shi4 wei4 xuan2 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 生而不有，为而不恃，长而不宰，是谓玄德。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: It gives birth but does not possess; acts but does not rely; raises but does not rule—this is called mysterious virtue.
जनयति न धारयति, करोति न आश्रयति, वर्धयति न अधिशिष्यति—एष गुप्तः गुणः।

ddj-ch-52.pinyin: tian1 xia4 you3 shi3， yi3 wei4 tian1 xia4 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下有始，以为天下母。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The world has a beginning; take it as the mother of the world.
लोकस्य आदिः अस्ति; तं लोकस्य मातरम् गृह्णीहि।

ddj-ch-52.pinyin: ji4 de2 qi2 mu3， yi3 zhi1 qi2 zi；

interpretations.segmentation: 既得其母，以知其子；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Having found the mother, one knows her children;
मातरम् प्राप्य, तस्याः पुत्रान् जानाति;

ddj-ch-52.content: 既知其子，复守其母，没身不殆。
ddj-ch-52.pinyin: ji4 zhi1 qi2 zi， fu4 shou3 qi2 mu3， mei2 shen1 bu4 dai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 既知其子，复守其母，没身不殆。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Having known the children, return and keep to the mother, and to the end of life one is without danger.
पुत्रान् ज्ञात्वा, मातरम् पुनः रक्षति, जीवनं न भयम्।

ddj-ch-52.content: 塞其兑，闭其门，终身不勤。
ddj-ch-52.pinyin: sai1 qi2 dui4， bi4 qi2 men2， zhong1 shen1 bu4 qin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 塞其兑，闭其门，终身不勤。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Block the openings, shut the doors, and all one's life one will not toil.
द्वाराणि पिधाय, द्वाराणि पिधाय, जीवनं न श्रमति।

ddj-ch-52.content: 开其兑，济其事，终身不救。
ddj-ch-52.pinyin: kai1 qi2 dui4， ji4 qi2 shi4， zhong1 shen1 bu4 jiu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 开其兑，济其事，终身不救。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Open the openings, multiply affairs, and all one's life one will not be saved.
द्वाराणि विवरयति, कर्माणि बहूनि करोति, जीवनं न त्रायते।

ddj-ch-52.pinyin: jian4 xiao3 yue1 ming2， shou3 rou2 yue1 qiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 见小曰明，守柔曰强。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To see the small is called insight; to keep to the soft is called strength.
अल्पम् पश्यन् प्रज्ञा उच्यते, मृदुम् रक्षन् बलम् उच्यते।

ddj-ch-52.content: 用其光，复归其明，无遗身殃，是为袭常。
ddj-ch-52.pinyin: yong4 qi2 guang1， fu4 gui1 qi2 ming2， wu2 yi2 shen1 yang1， shi4 wei4 xi2 chang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 用其光，复归其明，无遗身殃，是为袭常。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Use the light, return again to insight, leave the body no calamity—this is called practicing the Constant.
ज्योतिः उपयुज्य, प्रज्ञाम् पुनः गच्छति, शरीरम् न दुःखम्—एष नित्यं सेवते।

ddj-ch-53.content: 使我介然有知，行于大道，唯施是畏。
ddj-ch-53.pinyin: shi3 wo3 jie4 ran2 you3 zhi1， xing2 yu2 da4 dao4， wei2 shi1 shi4 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 使我介然有知，行于大道，唯施是畏。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If I had even a shred of knowledge, walking on the great Way, I would fear only going astray.
अल्पम् अपि ज्ञानम् स्यात्, महति मार्गे गच्छन्, विकृतिम् एव बिभेमि।

ddj-ch-53.pinyin: da4 dao4 shen4 yi2， er2 ren2 hao3 jing4。

interpretations.segmentation: 大道甚夷，而人好径。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The great Way is very level, yet people love bypaths.
महान् मार्गः अति समः, जनाः तु क्षुद्रं पन्थानम् इच्छन्ति।

ddj-ch-53.pinyin: chao2 shen4 chu2， tian2 shen4 wu2， cang1 shen4 xu1；

interpretations.segmentation: 朝甚除，田甚芜，仓甚虚；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The court is very well kept, the fields are very weedy, the granaries very empty;
सभा अति शुद्धा, क्षेत्रम् अति उषरम्, कोशः अति रिक्तम्;

ddj-ch-53.content: 服文采，带利剑，厌饮食，财货有余，是谓盗夸。
ddj-ch-53.pinyin: fu2 wen2 cai3， dai4 li4 jian4， yan4 yin3 shi2， cai2 huo4 you3 yu2， shi4 wei4 dao4 kua1。

interpretations.segmentation: 服文采，带利剑，厌饮食，财货有余，是谓盗夸。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Wearing patterned clothes, carrying sharp swords, sated with food and drink, with goods in surplus—this is called the swagger of robbers.
वर्णवन्तं वाससी, तीक्ष्णं खड्गम्, अन्नपाने तृप्ताः, वसु अतिशिष्टम्—एष चोरस्य दर्पः।
非道也哉！
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not the Way!
मार्गः न!

ddj-ch-54.content: 善建者不拔，善抱者不脱，子孙以祭祀不辍。
ddj-ch-54.pinyin: shan4 jian4 zhe3 bu4 ba2， shan4 bao4 zhe3 bu4 tuo1， zi sun1 yi3 ji4 si4 bu4 chuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 善建者不拔，善抱者不脱，子孙以祭祀不辍。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is well planted is not uprooted; what is well embraced is not pulled away—sons and grandsons will offer sacrifice without cease.
सुष्टु रोपितम् न उन्मूल्यते, सुष्टु आलिङ्गितम् न मुञ्चते—पुत्रपौत्राः यज्यम् न मुञ्चन्ति।

ddj-ch-54.pinyin: xiu1 zhi1 yu2 shen1， qi2 de2 nai3 zhen1；

interpretations.segmentation: 修之于身，其德乃真；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cultivate it in the person, and its virtue is genuine;
आत्मनि सेवते, तस्य गुणः सत्यम्;

ddj-ch-54.pinyin: xiu1 zhi1 yu2 jia1， qi2 de2 nai3 yu2；

interpretations.segmentation: 修之于家，其德乃余；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cultivate it in the family, and its virtue has surplus;
कुले सेवते, तस्य गुणः अधिकः;

ddj-ch-54.pinyin: xiu1 zhi1 yu2 xiang1， qi2 de2 nai3 zhang3；

interpretations.segmentation: 修之于乡，其德乃长；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cultivate it in the village, and its virtue endures;
ग्रामे सेवते, तस्य गुणः दीर्घः;

ddj-ch-54.pinyin: xiu1 zhi1 yu2 guo2， qi2 de2 nai3 feng1；

interpretations.segmentation: 修之于国，其德乃丰；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cultivate it in the state, and its virtue is abundant;
राष्ट्रे सेवते, तस्य गुणः प्रभूतः;

ddj-ch-54.pinyin: xiu1 zhi1 yu2 tian1 xia4， qi2 de2 nai3 pu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 修之于天下，其德乃普。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cultivate it in the world, and its virtue is universal.
लोके सेवते, तस्य गुणः सर्वत्र।

ddj-ch-54.content: 故以身观身，以家观家，以乡观乡，以国观国，以天下观天下。
ddj-ch-54.pinyin: gu4 yi3 shen1 guan1 shen1， yi3 jia1 guan1 jia1， yi3 xiang1 guan1 xiang1， yi3 guo2 guan1 guo2， yi3 tian1 xia4 guan1 tian1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 故以身观身，以家观家，以乡观乡，以国观国，以天下观天下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore observe persons by the person, families by the family, villages by the village, states by the state, the world by the world.
तस्मात् आत्मना आत्मानम्, कुलेन कुलम्, ग्रामेण ग्रामम्, राष्ट्रेण राष्ट्रम्, लोकेन लोकम् पश्यति।

ddj-ch-54.pinyin: wu2 he2 yi3 zhi1 tian1 xia4 ran2 zai1？

interpretations.segmentation: 吾何以知天下然哉？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How do I know that the world is so?
कथम् जानामि लोकम् इवम्?
以此。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: By this.
एतेन।

ddj-ch-55.pinyin: han2 de2 zhi1 hou4， bi3 yu2 chi4 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 含德之厚，比于赤子。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One who holds virtue in abundance may be compared to a newborn child.
गुणस्य भारं धारयन् नवजातस्य बालस्य उपमा।

ddj-ch-55.content: 毒虫不螫，猛兽不据，攫鸟不搏。
ddj-ch-55.pinyin: du2 chong2 bu4 shi4， meng3 shou4 bu4 ju4， jue2 niao3 bu4 bo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 毒虫不螫，猛兽不据，攫鸟不搏。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Poisonous insects do not sting it, fierce beasts do not seize it, birds of prey do not strike it.
विषवन्तः न दंशन्ति, व्याघ्रा न गृह्णन्ति, पक्षिणो न हन्ति।

ddj-ch-55.content: 骨弱筋柔而握固，未知牝牡之合而朘作，精之至也。
ddj-ch-55.pinyin: gu3 ruo4 jin1 rou2 er2 wo4 gu4， wei4 zhi1 pin4 mu3 zhi1 he2 er2 zui1 zuo4， jing1 zhi1 zhi4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 骨弱筋柔而握固，未知牝牡之合而朘作，精之至也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Its bones are weak and its sinews soft, yet its grip is firm; it does not yet know the union of male and female, yet its organ stirs—this is the perfection of essence.
अस्थनि दुर्बलम्, स्नायु मृदु, ग्रहणं तु दृढम्; स्त्रीपुंसः संयोगम् अजानन् अपि उद्भवति—ओजसां परमम्।

ddj-ch-55.content: 终日号而不嗄，和之至也。
ddj-ch-55.pinyin: zhong1 ri4 hao4 er2 bu4 a2， he2 zhi1 zhi4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 终日号而不嗄，和之至也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: It cries all day and does not grow hoarse—this is the perfection of harmony.
अहर्निषम् रोदिति, न स्वरः भ्रश्यते—साम्यस्य परमम्।

ddj-ch-55.content: 知和曰常，知常曰明，益生曰祥，心使气曰强。
ddj-ch-55.pinyin: zhi1 he2 yue1 chang2， zhi1 chang2 yue1 ming2， yi4 sheng1 yue1 xiang2， xin1 shi3 qi4 yue1 qiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 知和曰常，知常曰明，益生曰祥，心使气曰强。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To know harmony is called the Constant; to know the Constant is called insight; to force life is called ominous; for the mind to drive the vital breath is called forcing.
साम्यम् ज्ञात्वा नित्यम् उच्यते, नित्यम् ज्ञात्वा प्रज्ञा; जीवनं वर्धयति अशुभम्, चित्तम् प्राणम् बलम् करोति।

ddj-ch-55.content: 物壮则老，谓之不道，不道早已。
ddj-ch-55.pinyin: wu4 zhuang4 ze2 lao3， wei4 zhi1 bu4 dao4， bu4 dao4 zao3 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 物壮则老，谓之不道，不道早已。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When things are strong they grow old—this is called contrary to the Way; what is contrary to the Way comes to an early end.
वस्तूनि बलवन्ति जरां गच्छन्ति—मार्गे विरुद्धम्; मार्गे विरुद्धम् शीघ्रम् अन्तम्।

ddj-ch-56.pinyin: zhi1 zhe3 bu4 yan2， yan2 zhe3 bu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 知者不言，言者不知。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who know do not speak; those who speak do not know.
जानन्तः न वदन्ति, वदन्तः न जानन्ति।

ddj-ch-56.pinyin: sai1 qi2 dui4， bi4 qi2 men2；

interpretations.segmentation: 塞其兑，闭其门；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Block the openings, shut the doors;
द्वाराणि पिधाय, द्वाराणि पिधाय;

ddj-ch-56.pinyin: cuo4 qi2 rui4， jie3 qi2 fen1；

interpretations.segmentation: 挫其锐，解其纷；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Blunt the sharpness, untie the tangles;
तीक्ष्णताम् मृद्णाति, ग्रन्थिम् विमुचयति;

ddj-ch-56.pinyin: he2 qi2 guang1， tong2 qi2 chen2；

interpretations.segmentation: 和其光，同其尘；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Soften the glare, merge with the dust;
प्रभाम् साम्यम् करोति, रजसा सह युज्यते;
是谓玄同。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: This is called the mysterious identity.
एष गूढः समता उच्यते।

ddj-ch-56.content: 故不可得而亲，不可得而疏；
ddj-ch-56.pinyin: gu4 bu4 ke3 de2 er2 qin1， bu4 ke3 de2 er2 shu1；

interpretations.segmentation: 故不可得而亲，不可得而疏；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore one cannot get close to it, nor get distant from it;
तस्मात् न उपगन्तुम् शक्यते, न दूरीकर्तुम्;

ddj-ch-56.content: 不可得而利，不可得而害；
ddj-ch-56.pinyin: bu4 ke3 de2 er2 li4， bu4 ke3 de2 er2 hai4；

interpretations.segmentation: 不可得而利，不可得而害；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cannot get benefit from it, nor get harm from it;
न लभ्दुम्, न हन्तुम्;

ddj-ch-56.content: 不可得而贵，不可得而贱。
ddj-ch-56.pinyin: bu4 ke3 de2 er2 gui4， bu4 ke3 de2 er2 jian4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不可得而贵，不可得而贱。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Cannot get honor from it, nor get lowliness from it.
न पूज्यम्, न अवज्ञेयम्।
故为天下贵。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore it is prized by all under Heaven.
तस्मात् लोके सर्वत्र पूज्यते।

ddj-ch-57.content: 以正治国，以奇用兵，以无事取天下。
ddj-ch-57.pinyin: yi3 zheng4 zhi4 guo2， yi3 qi2 yong4 bing1， yi3 wu2 shi4 qu3 tian1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 以正治国，以奇用兵，以无事取天下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Govern the state with uprightness, use arms with surprise, take the world by being without affairs.
राष्ट्रम् धर्मेण शासति, सेनाम् आश्चर्येण, लोकम् निर्व्यापारेण गृह्णाति।

ddj-ch-57.pinyin: wu2 he2 yi3 zhi1 qi2 ran2 zai1？

interpretations.segmentation: 吾何以知其然哉？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: How do I know that this is so?
कथम् जानामि इवम्?

ddj-ch-57.content: 以此：天下多忌讳，而民弥贫；
ddj-ch-57.pinyin: yi3 ci3： tian1 xia4 duo1 ji4 hui4， er2 min2 mi2 pin2；

interpretations.segmentation: 以此：天下多忌讳，而民弥贫；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: By this: the more taboos under Heaven, the poorer the people;
एतेन—लोके निषेदा बहवः, जनाः अति दीनाः;

ddj-ch-57.pinyin: min2 duo1 li4 qi4， guo2 jia1 zi1 hun1；

interpretations.segmentation: 民多利器，国家滋昏；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The more sharp instruments among the people, the more the state grows disordered;
जनाः तीक्ष्णानि शस्त्राणि बहूनि, राष्ट्रम् अति मूढम्;

ddj-ch-57.pinyin: ren2 duo1 ji4 qiao3， qi2 wu4 zi1 qi3；

interpretations.segmentation: 人多伎巧，奇物滋起；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The more skills people have, the more strange things arise;
जनाः कौशलम् बहु, आश्चर्यवस्तूनि उत्पद्यन्ते;

ddj-ch-57.pinyin: fa3 ling4 zi1 zhang1， dao4 zei2 duo1 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 法令滋彰，盗贼多有。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The more laws and ordinances are proclaimed, the more thieves and robbers there are.
विधयः प्रकाशिताः बहवः, चोराः बहवः।

ddj-ch-57.content: 故圣人云：我无为而民自化；
ddj-ch-57.pinyin: gu4 sheng4 ren2 yun2： wo3 wu2 wei4 er2 min2 zi4 hua4；

interpretations.segmentation: 故圣人云：我无为而民自化；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage says: I do nothing, and the people transform of themselves;
तस्मात् मुनिर् आह—अहम् अकुर्वन् जनाः स्वयम् परिवर्तन्ते;

ddj-ch-57.pinyin: wo3 hao3 jing4 er2 min2 zi4 zheng4；

interpretations.segmentation: 我好静而民自正；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I love stillness, and the people correct themselves;
अहम् शान्तिम् इच्छामि, जनाः स्वयम् सम्यक्;

ddj-ch-57.pinyin: wo3 wu2 shi4 er2 min2 zi4 fu4；

interpretations.segmentation: 我无事而民自富；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I am without affairs, and the people enrich themselves;
अहम् निर्व्यापारः, जनाः स्वयम् धनवन्ताः;

ddj-ch-57.pinyin: wo3 wu2 yu4 er2 min2 zi4 pu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我无欲而民自朴。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I am without desire, and the people become simple of themselves.
अहम् निरिच्छकः, जनाः स्वयम् सरलाः।

ddj-ch-58.pinyin: qi2 zheng4 men4 men4， qi2 min2 chun2 chun2；

interpretations.segmentation: 其政闷闷，其民淳淳；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When government is muffled and dull, the people are pure and simple;
राजन् मन्दः, जनाः शुद्धाः;

ddj-ch-58.pinyin: qi2 zheng4 cha2 cha2， qi2 min2 que1 que1。

interpretations.segmentation: 其政察察，其民缺缺。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When government is sharp and prying, the people are wanting and deficient.
राजन् तीक्ष्णः, जनाः हीनाः।

ddj-ch-58.content: 祸兮福之所倚，福兮祸之所伏。
ddj-ch-58.pinyin: huo4 xi1 fu2 zhi1 suo3 yi3， fu2 xi1 huo4 zhi1 suo3 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 祸兮福之所倚，福兮祸之所伏。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Disaster is that on which good fortune leans; good fortune is that in which disaster lurks.
दुःखम् यत्र सुखम् आश्रयति, सुखम् यत्र दुःखम् गूढम्।
孰知其极？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Who knows their limit?
कः अन्तम् जानाति?
其无正也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: There is no fixed correctness.
न स्थिरं धर्मम्।

ddj-ch-58.pinyin: zheng4 fu4 wei4 qi2， shan4 fu4 wei4 yao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 正复为奇，善复为妖。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The correct reverts to the strange; the good reverts to the ominous.
सम्यक् पुनः आश्चर्यम्, शुभम् पुनः अशुभम्।

ddj-ch-58.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 mi2， qi2 ri4 gu4 jiu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之迷，其日固久。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: People's confusion has long been so.
जनानाम् मोहः चिरात् एव।

ddj-ch-58.content: 是以圣人方而不割，廉而不刿，直而不肆，光而不耀。
ddj-ch-58.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 fang1 er2 bu4 ge1， lian2 er2 bu4 gui4， zhi2 er2 bu4 si4， guang1 er2 bu4 yao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人方而不割，廉而不刿，直而不肆，光而不耀。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage is square but does not cut; sharp but does not wound; straight but not unrestrained; bright but not dazzling.
तस्मात् मुनिर् चतुरस्रः न छिन्दति, तीक्ष्णः न व्रणयति, ऋजुः न अत्याचरति, ज्योतिर्मान् न दीप्यति।

ddj-ch-59.pinyin: zhi4 ren2 shi4 tian1， mo4 ruo4 se4。

interpretations.segmentation: 治人事天，莫若啬。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: In governing people and serving Heaven, nothing is better than frugality.
जनान् परिपालयन् दिवम् सेवन्, न किंचित् परिश्रुतात् श्रेष्ठम्।

ddj-ch-59.pinyin: fu1 wei2 se4， shi4 wei4 zao3 fu2；

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯啬，是谓早服；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Only frugality is called early submission;
परिश्रुतम् एव पूर्वं सेवा उच्यते;

ddj-ch-59.pinyin: zao3 fu2 wei4 zhi1 zhong4 ji1 de2；

interpretations.segmentation: 早服谓之重积德；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Early submission is called heavily accumulating virtue;
पूर्वं सेवा बहु गुणम् संचिनोति उच्यते;

ddj-ch-59.pinyin: zhong4 ji1 de2 ze2 wu2 bu4 ke4；

interpretations.segmentation: 重积德则无不克；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heavily accumulating virtue, there is nothing one cannot overcome;
बहु गुणम् संचिन्वन् न किंचित् न जयति;

ddj-ch-59.pinyin: wu2 bu4 ke4 ze2 mo4 zhi1 qi2 ji2；

interpretations.segmentation: 无不克则莫知其极；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When there is nothing one cannot overcome, none knows one's limit;
न किंचित् न जयन्न्, न कश्चित् अन्तम् जानाति;

ddj-ch-59.pinyin: mo4 zhi1 qi2 ji2， ke3 yi3 you3 guo2；

interpretations.segmentation: 莫知其极，可以有国；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When none knows one's limit, one can possess the state;
अन्तम् अजानन्न्, राष्ट्रम् धारयितुम् शक्नोति;

ddj-ch-59.pinyin: you3 guo2 zhi1 mu3， ke3 yi3 zhang3 jiu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有国之母，可以长久。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Possessing the mother of the state, one can last long.
राष्ट्रस्य मातरम् धारयन् दीर्घम् तिष्ठति।

ddj-ch-59.content: 是谓深根固柢，长生久视之道。
ddj-ch-59.pinyin: shi4 wei4 shen1 gen1 gu4 di3， zhang3 sheng1 jiu3 shi4 zhi1 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是谓深根固柢，长生久视之道。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: This is called deep roots and a firm base—the Way of long life and lasting vision.
एष गम्भीरमूलं दृढस्तम्भम्—दीर्घायुर् दीर्घदर्शनस्य मार्गः।

ddj-ch-60.pinyin: zhi4 da4 guo2， ruo4 peng1 xiao3 xian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 治大国，若烹小鲜。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Governing a large state is like cooking a small fish.
महत् राष्ट्रम् शालयः पक्वमत्स्यम् इव शास्ति।

ddj-ch-60.pinyin: yi3 dao4 li4 tian1 xia4， qi2 gui3 bu4 shen2；

interpretations.segmentation: 以道莅天下，其鬼不神；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When one approaches the world with the Way, its ghosts have no spirit;
मार्गेण लोकम् अभ्युपगच्छन्, प्रेताः न प्रभवन्ति;

ddj-ch-60.content: 非其鬼不神，其神不伤人；
ddj-ch-60.pinyin: fei1 qi2 gui3 bu4 shen2， qi2 shen2 bu4 shang1 ren2；

interpretations.segmentation: 非其鬼不神，其神不伤人；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not that the ghosts have no spirit, but that their spirit does not harm people;
प्रेताः न प्रभवन्ति न, तेषाम् प्रभावः जनान् न हन्ति;

ddj-ch-60.content: 非其神不伤人，圣人亦不伤人。
ddj-ch-60.pinyin: fei1 qi2 shen2 bu4 shang1 ren2， sheng4 ren2 yi4 bu4 shang1 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 非其神不伤人，圣人亦不伤人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not only that their spirit does not harm people—the sage also does not harm people.
प्रभावः न हन्ति एव, मुनिर् अपि न हन्ति।

ddj-ch-60.content: 夫两不相伤，故德交归焉。
ddj-ch-60.pinyin: fu1 liang3 bu4 xiang1 shang1， gu4 de2 jiao1 gui1 yan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫两不相伤，故德交归焉。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When these two do not harm each other, virtue converges and returns to them.
उभौ न हन्ति, तस्मात् गुणः उभयोः समागच्छति।

ddj-ch-61.content: 大邦者下流，天下之牝，天下之交也。
ddj-ch-61.pinyin: da4 bang1 zhe3 xia4 liu2， tian1 xia4 zhi1 pin4， tian1 xia4 zhi1 jiao1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 大邦者下流，天下之牝，天下之交也。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A great state is like the lower reaches of a river—the female of the world, the meeting place of the world.
महत् राज्यम् अधोगामि, जगतः स्त्री, जगतः संगमः।

ddj-ch-61.content: 牝常以静胜牡，以静为下。
ddj-ch-61.pinyin: pin4 chang2 yi3 jing4 sheng4 mu3， yi3 jing4 wei4 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 牝常以静胜牡，以静为下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The female constantly overcomes the male by stillness, and by stillness takes the lower place.
स्त्री नित्यं शान्त्या पुमानं जयति, शान्त्या अधः स्थानं गृह्णाति।

ddj-ch-61.content: 故大邦以下小邦，则取小邦；
ddj-ch-61.pinyin: gu4 da4 bang1 yi3 xia4 xiao3 bang1， ze2 qu3 xiao3 bang1；

interpretations.segmentation: 故大邦以下小邦，则取小邦；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore when a great state places itself below a small state, it takes the small state;
तस्माद् महत् राज्यं क्षुद्रात् अधस्तात् स्थितं क्षुद्रं गृह्णाति;

ddj-ch-61.content: 小邦以下大邦，则取大邦。
ddj-ch-61.pinyin: xiao3 bang1 yi3 xia4 da4 bang1， ze2 qu3 da4 bang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 小邦以下大邦，则取大邦。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When a small state places itself below a great state, it is taken by the great state.
क्षुद्रं महतः अधस्तात् स्थितं महता गृह्यते।

ddj-ch-61.pinyin: gu4 huo4 xia4 yi3 qu3， huo4 xia4 er2 qu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 故或下以取，或下而取。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus some take by placing themselves below; some are taken by placing themselves below.
तस्मात् केचित् अधः स्थित्वा गृह्णन्ति, केचित् अधः स्थिताः गृह्यन्ते।

ddj-ch-61.content: 大邦不过欲兼畜人，小邦不过欲入事人。
ddj-ch-61.pinyin: da4 bang1 bu4 guo4 yu4 jian1 chu4 ren2， xiao3 bang1 bu4 guo4 yu4 ru4 shi4 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 大邦不过欲兼畜人，小邦不过欲入事人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A great state wants no more than to unite and nurture others; a small state wants no more than to enter and serve others.
महत् राज्यं न केवलं जनान् संगृहीतुम् इच्छति, क्षुद्रं प्रविश्य सेवां इच्छति।

ddj-ch-61.content: 夫两者各得所欲，大者宜为下。
ddj-ch-61.pinyin: fu1 liang3 zhe3 ge4 de2 suo3 yu4， da4 zhe3 yi2 wei4 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫两者各得所欲，大者宜为下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When both get what they desire, the great one should take the lower place.
उभयोः स्वम् इच्छितं लभ्यते, महान् अधः स्थातुम् युज्यते।

ddj-ch-62.content: 道者万物之奥，善人之宝，不善人之所保。
ddj-ch-62.pinyin: dao4 zhe3 wan4 wu4 zhi1 ao4， shan4 ren2 zhi1 bao3， bu4 shan4 ren2 zhi1 suo3 bao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 道者万物之奥，善人之宝，不善人之所保。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way is the sanctuary of the myriad things, the treasure of the good man, and that by which the not-good are kept.
मार्गः भूतानां गुहा, शुभानां रत्नम्, अशुभानां रक्षा।

ddj-ch-62.content: 美言可以市尊，美行可以加人。
ddj-ch-62.pinyin: mei3 yan2 ke3 yi3 shi4 zun1， mei3 xing2 ke3 yi3 jia1 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 美言可以市尊，美行可以加人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Fine words can purchase honor; fine conduct can raise a person above others.
शोभनं वचनं मानम् अर्जयति, शोभना कृतिः उपरि उठापयति।

ddj-ch-62.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 bu4 shan4， he2 qi4 zhi1 you3？

interpretations.segmentation: 人之不善，何弃之有？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Even if people are not good, how can they be abandoned?
जनानां अशुभता, कथं त्यज्यते?

ddj-ch-62.content: 故立天子，置三公，虽有拱璧以先驷马，不如坐进此道。
ddj-ch-62.pinyin: gu4 li4 tian1 zi， zhi4 san1 gong1， sui1 you3 gong3 bi4 yi3 xian1 si4 ma3， bu4 ru2 zuo4 jin4 ci3 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 故立天子，置三公，虽有拱璧以先驷马，不如坐进此道。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore when the Son of Heaven is established and the Three Dukes appointed, though one present a jade disk ahead of a team of four horses, it is not as good as sitting and offering this Way.
तस्माद् देवपुत्रं स्थापयित्वा, त्रयः मन्त्रिणः नियुज्यन्ते, यद्यपि श्याममणिः चतुरश्वैः पूर्वं दीयते, तत् न तावत् यत् आसीनः एतत् मार्गं समर्पयति।

ddj-ch-62.pinyin: gu3 zhi1 suo3 yi3 gui4 ci3 dao4 zhe3 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 古之所以贵此道者何？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Why did the ancients prize this Way?
पुरातनाः एतत् मार्गं किमर्थं पूजयन्ति?

ddj-ch-62.content: 不曰：求以得，有罪以免邪？
ddj-ch-62.pinyin: bu4 yue1： qiu2 yi3 de2， you3 zui4 yi3 mian3 xie2？

interpretations.segmentation: 不曰：求以得，有罪以免邪？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Was it not said: by seeking, one obtains; having guilt, one is spared?
नोच्यते: अन्वेषणेन लभ्यते, पापं च मुच्यते?
故为天下贵。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore it is prized by all under Heaven.
तस्माद् जगतः पूज्यः।

ddj-ch-63.pinyin: wei4 wu2 wei4， shi4 wu2 shi4， wei4 wu2 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 为无为，事无事，味无味。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Act by non-action; handle affairs by being without affairs; taste the tasteless.
अकरणेन कुर्यात्, निष्क्रियतया कार्याणि, अरसम् अनुभवेत्।

ddj-ch-63.pinyin: da4 xiao3 duo1 shao3， bao4 yuan4 yi3 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 大小多少，报怨以德。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Regard the great as small, the many as few; repay injury with virtue.
महत् क्षुद्रम्, बहु अल्पम्; वैरम् गुणेन प्रतिकुर्यात्।

ddj-ch-63.content: 图难于其易，为大于其细。
ddj-ch-63.pinyin: tu2 nan2 yu2 qi2 yi4， wei4 da4 yu2 qi2 xi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 图难于其易，为大于其细。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Plan the difficult while it is easy; do the great while it is fine.
कठिनं सुकरे योजयेत्, महत् सूक्ष्मे करोतु।

ddj-ch-63.content: 天下难事必作于易，天下大事必作于细。
ddj-ch-63.pinyin: tian1 xia4 nan2 shi4 bi4 zuo4 yu2 yi4， tian1 xia4 da4 shi4 bi4 zuo4 yu2 xi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下难事必作于易，天下大事必作于细。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The difficult affairs of the world must arise from the easy; the great affairs of the world must arise from the fine.
जगतः कठिनानि कार्याणि सुकरात् उद्भवन्ति, महान्ति कार्याणि सूक्ष्मात्।

ddj-ch-63.content: 是以圣人终不为大，故能成其大。
ddj-ch-63.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 zhong1 bu4 wei4 da4， gu4 neng2 cheng2 qi2 da4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人终不为大，故能成其大。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage to the end does not attempt the great, and so is able to achieve greatness.
तस्माद् मुनिः अन्तं महत् न करोति, ततः स्वम् महत्त्वं साधयति।

ddj-ch-63.content: 夫轻诺必寡信，多易必多难。
ddj-ch-63.pinyin: fu1 qing1 nuo4 bi4 gua3 xin4， duo1 yi4 bi4 duo1 nan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫轻诺必寡信，多易必多难。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Light promises must bring little trust; taking many things as easy must bring many difficulties.
लघु प्रतिज्ञा अल्पविश्वासं जनयति, बहु सुकरं बहु कठिनम्।

ddj-ch-63.content: 是以圣人犹难之，故终无难矣。
ddj-ch-63.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 you2 nan2 zhi1， gu4 zhong1 wu2 nan2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人犹难之，故终无难矣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage still treats them as difficult, and so in the end has no difficulty.
तस्माद् मुनिः तानि अपि कठिनानि मन्यते, ततः अन्ते कठिनता नास्ति।

ddj-ch-64.pinyin: qi2 an1 yi4 chi2， qi2 wei4 zhao4 yi4 mou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 其安易持，其未兆易谋。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is at peace is easy to hold; what has not yet shown signs is easy to plan for.
यत् शान्तं तत् धारयितुं सुलभम्, यत् अ-लक्षितं तत् योजयितुं सुलभम्।

ddj-ch-64.pinyin: qi2 cui4 yi4 pan4， qi2 wei1 yi4 san4。

interpretations.segmentation: 其脆易泮，其微易散。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is brittle is easy to break; what is minute is easy to scatter.
यत् भग्नं तत् विघटयितुं सुलभम्, यत् सूक्ष्मं तत् विसर्पयितुं सुलभम्।

ddj-ch-64.content: 为之于未有，治之于未乱。
ddj-ch-64.pinyin: wei4 zhi1 yu2 wei4 you3， zhi4 zhi1 yu2 wei4 luan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 为之于未有，治之于未乱。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Act on it before it exists; order it before disorder arises.
अ-भूते करोतु, अ-व्याकुले व्यवस्थापयेत्।

ddj-ch-64.pinyin: he2 bao4 zhi1 mu4， sheng1 yu2 hao2 mo4；

interpretations.segmentation: 合抱之木，生于毫末；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A tree that fills the arms' embrace grows from a tiny shoot;
बाहु-परिधानं वृक्षः कणिकायाः उद्भवति;

ddj-ch-64.pinyin: jiu3 ceng2 zhi1 tai2， qi3 yu2 lei4 tu3；

interpretations.segmentation: 九层之台，起于累土；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A terrace of nine stories rises from a heap of earth;
नव-स्तम्भः प्रासादः पिण्ड-मृत्तिकायाः उद्भवति;

ddj-ch-64.pinyin: qian1 li3 zhi1 xing2， shi3 yu2 zu2 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 千里之行，始于足下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A journey of a thousand li begins under one's feet.
सहस्र-योजन-यात्रा पाद-अधः आरभ्यते।

ddj-ch-64.pinyin: wei4 zhe3 bai4 zhi1， zhi2 zhe3 shi1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 为者败之，执者失之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who acts upon it ruins it; he who grasps it loses it.
यः करोति स भ्रंशयति, यः गृह्णाति स हरति।

ddj-ch-64.content: 是以圣人无为故无败，无执故无失。
ddj-ch-64.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 wu2 wei4 gu4 wu2 bai4， wu2 zhi2 gu4 wu2 shi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人无为故无败，无执故无失。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage does not act, and so does not ruin; does not grasp, and so does not lose.
तस्माद् मुनिः अकरणात् न भ्रंशति, अ-ग्रहणात् न हरति।

ddj-ch-64.content: 民之从事，常于几成而败之。
ddj-ch-64.pinyin: min2 zhi1 cong2 shi4， chang2 yu2 ji3 cheng2 er2 bai4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之从事，常于几成而败之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: People in their undertakings often fail when nearly complete.
जनाः कार्येषु प्रायः निकट-सिद्धौ विफलन्ते।

ddj-ch-64.pinyin: shen4 zhong1 ru2 shi3， ze2 wu2 bai4 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 慎终如始，则无败事。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Be as careful at the end as at the beginning, and there will be no failed affairs.
अन्तं आदौ इव सावधानं, ततः विफलं कार्यं न भवति।

ddj-ch-64.content: 是以圣人欲不欲，不贵难得之货；
ddj-ch-64.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 yu4 bu4 yu4， bu4 gui4 nan2 de2 zhi1 huo4；

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人欲不欲，不贵难得之货；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage desires not to desire, and does not prize goods hard to obtain;
तस्माद् मुनिः अ-कामं कामयते, दुर्लभ-वस्तूनि न पूजयति;

ddj-ch-64.pinyin: xue2 bu4 xue2， fu4 zhong4 ren2 zhi1 suo3 guo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 学不学，复众人之所过。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Learns not to learn, and returns to what the multitude pass by.
अ-शिक्षां शिक्षते, जन-समूहस्य अतिक्रमं पुनः गच्छति।

ddj-ch-64.content: 以辅万物之自然而不敢为。
ddj-ch-64.pinyin: yi3 fu3 wan4 wu4 zhi1 zi4 ran2 er2 bu4 gan3 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 以辅万物之自然而不敢为。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He assists the natural course of the myriad things and dares not act.
भूतानां स्व-स्वभावं अनुगृह्णाति, कर्तुं न धृष्टं भवति।

ddj-ch-65.content: 古之善为道者，非以明民，将以愚之。
ddj-ch-65.pinyin: gu3 zhi1 shan4 wei4 dao4 zhe3， fei1 yi3 ming2 min2， jiang1 yi3 yu2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 古之善为道者，非以明民，将以愚之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those of old who were good at practicing the Way did not use it to enlighten the people, but to keep them simple.
पुरातनाः मार्गे कुशलाः, जनान् प्रकाशयितुं न, तान् सरलान् कर्तुम्।

ddj-ch-65.pinyin: min2 zhi1 nan2 zhi4， yi3 qi2 zhi4 duo1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之难治，以其智多。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The people are hard to govern because they have too much cleverness.
जनाः दुःशास्याः, तेषां बुद्धिः बहुला।

ddj-ch-65.pinyin: gu4 yi3 zhi4 zhi4 guo2， guo2 zhi1 zei2；

interpretations.segmentation: 故以智治国，国之贼；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore to govern a state by cleverness is to be a thief of the state;
तस्माद् बुद्ध्या राज्यं शासितुं राज्यस्य चोरः;

ddj-ch-65.pinyin: bu4 yi3 zhi4 zhi4 guo2， guo2 zhi1 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 不以智治国，国之福。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Not to govern a state by cleverness is to be a blessing to the state.
बुद्ध्या विना शासितुं राज्यस्य शुभम्।

ddj-ch-65.pinyin: zhi1 ci3 liang3 zhe3 yi4 ji1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 知此两者亦稽式。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To know these two is also a standard.
एतौ द्वौ ज्ञात्वा माप-दण्डः अपि।

ddj-ch-65.pinyin: chang2 zhi1 ji1 shi4， shi4 wei4 xuan2 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 常知稽式，是谓玄德。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Always to know the standard is called mysterious virtue.
नित्यं माप-दण्डं ज्ञातुं गुह्य-गुणः उच्यते।

ddj-ch-65.content: 玄德深矣，远矣，与物反矣，然后乃至大顺。
ddj-ch-65.pinyin: xuan2 de2 shen1 yi3， yuan3 yi3， yu3 wu4 fan3 yi3， ran2 hou4 nai3 zhi4 da4 shun4。

interpretations.segmentation: 玄德深矣，远矣，与物反矣，然后乃至大顺。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Mysterious virtue is deep, is far; it returns with things, and only then reaches great accordance.
गुह्य-गुणः गम्भीरः, दूरः, भूतैः सह प्रतिनिवर्तते, ततः महत् अनुकूलं प्राप्नोति।

ddj-ch-66.content: 江海所以能为百谷王者，以其善下之，故能为百谷王。
ddj-ch-66.pinyin: jiang1 hai3 suo3 yi3 neng2 wei4 bai3 gu3 wang2 zhe3， yi3 qi2 shan4 xia4 zhi1， gu4 neng2 wei4 bai3 gu3 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 江海所以能为百谷王者，以其善下之，故能为百谷王。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The reason the rivers and the sea can be kings of the hundred valleys is that they are good at taking the lower place—thus they can be kings of the hundred valleys.
नद्यः समुद्रः शत-दरीणां राजा, अधः स्थानं कुशलत्वात्, तस्माद् शत-दरीणां राजा।

ddj-ch-66.content: 是以圣人欲上民，必以言下之；
ddj-ch-66.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 yu4 shang4 min2， bi4 yi3 yan2 xia4 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人欲上民，必以言下之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore if the sage would be above the people, he must in speech put himself below them;
तस्माद् मुनिः जनान् उपरि इच्छन्, वचनैः अधः स्थातव्यम्;

ddj-ch-66.pinyin: yu4 xian1 min2， bi4 yi3 shen1 hou4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 欲先民，必以身后之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If he would be ahead of the people, he must in person put himself behind them.
जनान् अग्रे इच्छन्, शरीरेण पश्चात् स्थातव्यम्।

ddj-ch-66.content: 是以圣人处上而民不重，处前而民不害。
ddj-ch-66.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 chu4 shang4 er2 min2 bu4 zhong4， chu4 qian2 er2 min2 bu4 hai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人处上而民不重，处前而民不害。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage dwells above and the people do not feel burdened; dwells ahead and the people do not feel harmed.
तस्माद् मुनिः उपरि स्थितः जनाः न बाधन्ते, अग्रे स्थितः न हिंसन्ते।

ddj-ch-66.pinyin: shi4 yi3 tian1 xia4 le4 tui1 er2 bu4 yan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以天下乐推而不厌。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore all under Heaven gladly push him forward and do not tire of him.
तस्माद् जगत् सुखेन प्रेरयति, न क्लान्ति।

ddj-ch-66.content: 以其不争，故天下莫能与之争。
ddj-ch-66.pinyin: yi3 qi2 bu4 zheng1， gu4 tian1 xia4 mo4 neng2 yu3 zhi1 zheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 以其不争，故天下莫能与之争。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Because he does not contend, no one under Heaven can contend with him.
अ-स्पर्धया, जगति कोऽपि स्पर्धितुं न शक्नोति।

ddj-ch-67.content: 天下皆谓我道大，似不肖。
ddj-ch-67.pinyin: tian1 xia4 jie1 wei4 wo3 dao4 da4， shi4 bu4 xiao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下皆谓我道大，似不肖。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: All under Heaven say my Way is great, and seems unlike anything else.
जगत् सर्वे मम मार्गं महान्तम्, असदृशम् इति वदन्ति।

ddj-ch-67.pinyin: fu1 wei2 da4， gu4 shi4 bu4 xiao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯大，故似不肖。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because it is great, it seems unlike anything else.
यतो महान्, तस्माद् असदृशः।

ddj-ch-67.pinyin: ruo4 xiao4， jiu3 yi3 qi2 xi4 ye3 fu1！

interpretations.segmentation: 若肖，久矣其细也夫！
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If it were like anything else, it would long ago have been small!
यदि सदृशः स्यात्, पुरा एव क्षुद्रः अभविष्यत्!

ddj-ch-67.content: 我有三宝，持而保之：一曰慈，二曰俭，三曰不敢为天下先。
ddj-ch-67.pinyin: wo3 you3 san1 bao3， chi2 er2 bao3 zhi1： yi1 yue1 ci2， er4 yue1 jian3， san1 yue1 bu4 gan3 wei4 tian1 xia4 xian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我有三宝，持而保之：一曰慈，二曰俭，三曰不敢为天下先。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: I have three treasures that I hold and keep: the first is compassion; the second is frugality; the third is not daring to be first under Heaven.
मम त्रीणि रत्नानि, धृत्वा रक्षामि: प्रथमं दया, द्वितीयं परिमितिः, तृतीयं जगति अग्रे न धृष्टः।
慈故能勇；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: With compassion one can be brave;
दया तस्माद् वीरः;
俭故能广；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: With frugality one can be generous;
परिमितिः तस्माद् व्यापकः;

ddj-ch-67.content: 不敢为天下先，故能成器长。
ddj-ch-67.pinyin: bu4 gan3 wei4 tian1 xia4 xian1， gu4 neng2 cheng2 qi4 zhang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 不敢为天下先，故能成器长。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Not daring to be first under Heaven, one can become the chief of vessels.
जगति अग्रे न धृष्टः, तस्माद् पात्राणां नायकः।

ddj-ch-67.content: 今舍慈且勇，舍俭且广，舍后且先，死矣！
ddj-ch-67.pinyin: jin1 she3 ci2 qie3 yong3， she3 jian3 qie3 guang3， she3 hou4 qie3 xian1， si3 yi3！

interpretations.segmentation: 今舍慈且勇，舍俭且广，舍后且先，死矣！
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Now to discard compassion and yet be brave, to discard frugality and yet be generous, to discard being behind and yet be first—is to die!
अद्य दयां त्यक्त्वा वीरः, परिमितिं त्यक्त्वा व्यापकः, पश्चात् त्यक्त्वा अग्रे — मृत्युः!

ddj-ch-67.content: 夫慈，以战则胜，以守则固。
ddj-ch-67.pinyin: fu1 ci2， yi3 zhan4 ze2 sheng4， yi3 shou3 ze2 gu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫慈，以战则胜，以守则固。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: With compassion, one who fights wins; one who defends holds firm.
दया, युद्धे जयति, रक्षणे दृढः।

ddj-ch-67.pinyin: tian1 jiang1 jiu4 zhi1， yi3 ci2 wei4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天将救之，以慈卫之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven will save him, and guard him with compassion.
द्यौः तं रक्षति, दया तं पालयति।

ddj-ch-68.content: 善为士者不武，善战者不怒，善胜敌者不与，善用人者为之下。
ddj-ch-68.pinyin: shan4 wei4 shi4 zhe3 bu4 wu3， shan4 zhan4 zhe3 bu4 nu4， shan4 sheng4 di2 zhe3 bu4 yu3， shan4 yong4 ren2 zhe3 wei4 zhi1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 善为士者不武，善战者不怒，善胜敌者不与，善用人者为之下。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: A good officer is not warlike; a good fighter is not angry; a good conqueror of enemies does not engage them; one good at using people places himself below them.
कुशलः शूरः न योद्धा, कुशलः योद्धा न क्रुद्धः, कुशलः शत्रु-जेता न युध्यते, कुशलः जन-उपयोक्ता अधः स्थाति।

ddj-ch-68.content: 是谓不争之德，是谓用人之力，是谓配天古之极。
ddj-ch-68.pinyin: shi4 wei4 bu4 zheng1 zhi1 de2， shi4 wei4 yong4 ren2 zhi1 li4， shi4 wei4 pei4 tian1 gu3 zhi1 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是谓不争之德，是谓用人之力，是谓配天古之极。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: This is called the virtue of not contending; this is called the power of using people; this is called matching Heaven—the ultimate of old.
इदं अ-स्पर्धा-गुणः, जन-शक्ति-उपयोगः, द्योः अनुकूलता — पुरातन-परमम्।

ddj-ch-69.content: 用兵有言：吾不敢为主而为客，不敢进寸而退尺。
ddj-ch-69.pinyin: yong4 bing1 you3 yan2： wu2 bu4 gan3 wei4 zhu3 er2 wei4 ke4， bu4 gan3 jin4 cun4 er2 tui4 chi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 用兵有言：吾不敢为主而为客，不敢进寸而退尺。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Military strategists have a saying: I dare not be the host but prefer to be the guest; I dare not advance an inch but prefer to withdraw a foot.
सैन्य-शास्त्रेषु उक्तम्: स्वामित्वं न धृष्टः, अतिथित्वं गृह्णामि; अङ्गुलिं न अग्रे, पादं पश्चात्।

ddj-ch-69.content: 是谓行无行，攘无臂，扔无敌，执无兵。
ddj-ch-69.pinyin: shi4 wei4 xing2 wu2 xing2， rang3 wu2 bi4， reng1 wu2 di2， zhi2 wu2 bing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 是谓行无行，攘无臂，扔无敌，执无兵。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: This is called marching without ranks, rolling up the sleeves without an arm, facing without an enemy, grasping without a weapon.
इदं उच्यते: पङ्क्ति-विना गमनम्, बाहु-विना विक्षेपणम्, शत्रु-विना मुखम्, शस्त्र-विना ग्रहणम्।

ddj-ch-69.content: 祸莫大于轻敌，轻敌几丧吾宝。
ddj-ch-69.pinyin: huo4 mo4 da4 yu2 qing1 di2， qing1 di2 ji3 sang4 wu2 bao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 祸莫大于轻敌，轻敌几丧吾宝。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: No disaster is greater than underestimating the enemy; to underestimate the enemy is nearly to lose my treasure.
शत्रु-अवमानात् न कोऽपि दुःखं महत्तरम्; शत्रु-अवमानः मम रत्नं प्रायः हरति।

ddj-ch-69.pinyin: gu4 kang4 bing1 xiang1 ruo4， ai1 zhe3 sheng4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 故抗兵相若，哀者胜矣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore when opposing armies are evenly matched, the one that grieves wins.
तस्माद् समान-सैन्ययोः, शोक-युक्तः जयति।

ddj-ch-70.pinyin: wu2 yan2 shen4 yi4 zhi1， shen4 yi4 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 吾言甚易知，甚易行。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: My words are very easy to understand, very easy to practice.
मम वचांसि अत्यन्तं सुज्ञेयानि, सुकराणि च।

ddj-ch-70.pinyin: tian1 xia4 mo4 neng2 zhi1， mo4 neng2 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下莫能知，莫能行。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Yet none under Heaven can understand them, none can practice them.
जगति कोऽपि ज्ञातुं न शक्नोति, कर्तुं न शक्नोति।

ddj-ch-70.pinyin: yan2 you3 zong1， shi4 you3 jun1。

interpretations.segmentation: 言有宗，事有君。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Words have an ancestor; affairs have a sovereign.
वचः मूलं, कार्यं स्वामी।

ddj-ch-70.pinyin: fu1 wei2 wu2 zhi1， shi4 yi3 bu4 wo3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯无知，是以不我知。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because people are without knowledge, they do not understand me.
यतो अ-ज्ञानम्, तस्माद् मां न जानन्ति।

ddj-ch-70.pinyin: zhi1 wo3 zhe3 xi1， ze2 wo3 zhe3 gui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 知我者希，则我者贵。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who understand me are rare; thus I am prized.
मां जानन्तः दुर्लभाः, तस्माद् मूल्यवान्।

ddj-ch-70.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 bei4 he4 huai2 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人被褐怀玉。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage wears coarse cloth and holds jade in his bosom.
तस्माद् मुनिः जीर्ण-वस्त्रं धारयति, हृदये मणिम्।
知不知，上；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To know that one does not know is best;
ज्ञातुं अ-ज्ञानं, श्रेष्ठम्;
不知知，病。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Not to know and yet think one knows is a disease.
अ-ज्ञात्वा ज्ञानं, रोगः।

ddj-ch-71.pinyin: sheng4 ren2 bu4 bing4， yi3 qi2 bing4 bing4。

interpretations.segmentation: 圣人不病，以其病病。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The sage is not diseased, because he treats disease as disease.
मुनिः न रोगी, यतः रोगं रोग इति मन्यते।

ddj-ch-71.pinyin: fu1 wei2 bing4 bing4， shi4 yi3 bu4 bing4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯病病，是以不病。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because he treats disease as disease, he is therefore not diseased.
यतो रोगं रोग इति मन्यते, तस्माद् न रोगी।

ddj-ch-72.pinyin: min2 bu4 wei4 wei1， ze2 da4 wei1 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 民不畏威，则大威至。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When the people do not fear power, then a greater power arrives.
जनाः शक्तिं न बिभ्यति, ततः महती शक्तिः आगच्छति।

ddj-ch-72.content: 无狎其所居，无厌其所生。
ddj-ch-72.pinyin: wu2 xia2 qi2 suo3 ju1， wu2 yan4 qi2 suo3 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无狎其所居，无厌其所生。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not constrict their dwellings; do not oppress their livelihood.
तेषां वास-स्थानं न संकुचय, जीविकां न पीडय।

ddj-ch-72.pinyin: fu1 wei2 bu4 yan4， shi4 yi3 bu4 yan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯不厌，是以不厌。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Precisely because one does not oppress, they are not oppressed.
यतो न पीडयति, तस्माद् न पीड्यन्ते।

ddj-ch-72.content: 是以圣人自知不自见，自爱不自贵。
ddj-ch-72.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 zi4 zhi1 bu4 zi4 jian4， zi4 ai4 bu4 zi4 gui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人自知不自见，自爱不自贵。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage knows himself but does not display himself; loves himself but does not exalt himself.
तस्माद् मुनिः स्वं जानाति, न दर्शयति, स्वं प्रेमति, न उन्नतयति।
故去彼取此。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus he discards that and takes this.
तस्माद् तत् त्यजति, इदं गृह्णाति।

ddj-ch-73.content: 勇于敢则杀，勇于不敢则活。
ddj-ch-73.pinyin: yong3 yu2 gan3 ze2 sha1， yong3 yu2 bu4 gan3 ze2 huo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 勇于敢则杀，勇于不敢则活。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Courage in daring leads to death; courage in not daring leads to life.
धृष्ट-साहसे मरणम्, अ-धृष्ट-साहसे जीवनम्।

ddj-ch-73.pinyin: ci3 liang3 zhe3， huo4 li4 huo4 hai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 此两者，或利或害。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Of these two, one benefits and one harms.
एतयोः, एकं हितम्, एकं हानि।

ddj-ch-73.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 suo3 e4， shu2 zhi1 qi2 gu4？

interpretations.segmentation: 天之所恶，孰知其故？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What Heaven detests—who knows its reason?
यत् द्यौः द्वेष्टि, तस्य कारणं कः जानति?

ddj-ch-73.content: 天之道，不争而善胜，不言而善应，不召而自来，繟然而善谋。
ddj-ch-73.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 dao4， bu4 zheng1 er2 shan4 sheng4， bu4 yan2 er2 shan4 ying1， bu4 zhao4 er2 zi4 lai2， chan3 ran2 er2 shan4 mou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天之道，不争而善胜，不言而善应，不召而自来，繟然而善谋。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way of Heaven does not contend and yet is good at winning; does not speak and yet is good at responding; is not summoned and yet comes of itself; is relaxed and yet good at planning.
द्योः मार्गः, न स्पर्धते, जयति; न वदति, प्रत्युत्तरति; न आहूयते, स्वयम् आगच्छति; शिथिलः, कुशल-योजकः।

ddj-ch-73.pinyin: tian1 wang3 hui1 hui1， shu1 er2 bu4 shi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天网恢恢，疏而不失。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven's net is vast; though its mesh is coarse, nothing slips through.
द्योः जालं विशालम्, विरलं, न किञ्चित् त्यजति।

ddj-ch-74.content: 民不畏死，奈何以死惧之？
ddj-ch-74.pinyin: min2 bu4 wei4 si3， nai4 he2 yi3 si3 ju4 zhi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 民不畏死，奈何以死惧之？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If the people do not fear death, how can one frighten them with death?
जनाः मरणात् न बिभ्यति, मरणेन कथं भयं दास्यसि?

ddj-ch-74.content: 若使民常畏死，而为奇者，吾得执而杀之，孰敢？
ddj-ch-74.pinyin: ruo4 shi3 min2 chang2 wei4 si3， er2 wei4 qi2 zhe3， wu2 de2 zhi2 er2 sha1 zhi1， shu2 gan3？

interpretations.segmentation: 若使民常畏死，而为奇者，吾得执而杀之，孰敢？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: If one could make the people constantly fear death, and there were those who acted strangely, I could seize and kill them—who would dare?
यदि जनाः नित्यं मरणात् बिभ्युः, विचित्र-कर्तारः, हत्वा कः धृष्टः?

ddj-ch-74.pinyin: chang2 you3 si1 sha1 zhe3 sha1。

interpretations.segmentation: 常有司杀者杀。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: There is always One who is in charge of killing.
नित्यं हन्ता अ-न्यः अस्ति।

ddj-ch-74.content: 夫代司杀者杀，是谓代大匠斫。
ddj-ch-74.pinyin: fu1 dai4 si1 sha1 zhe3 sha1， shi4 wei4 dai4 da4 jiang4 zhuo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫代司杀者杀，是谓代大匠斫。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: To take the place of the One in charge of killing is called hewing wood in place of the master carpenter.
हन्तुः स्थाने हन्तुं, महत्-स्थापत्य-स्थाने छेदनम्।

ddj-ch-74.content: 夫代大匠斫者，希有不伤其手矣。
ddj-ch-74.pinyin: fu1 dai4 da4 jiang4 zhuo2 zhe3， xi1 you3 bu4 shang1 qi2 shou3 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫代大匠斫者，希有不伤其手矣。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Of those who hew wood in place of the master carpenter, few do not injure their own hands.
महत्-स्थापत्य-स्थाने छिन्वन्तः, दुर्लभाः हस्तं न क्षुण्णन्ति।

ddj-ch-75.content: 民之饥，以其上食税之多，是以饥。
ddj-ch-75.pinyin: min2 zhi1 ji1， yi3 qi2 shang4 shi2 shui4 zhi1 duo1， shi4 yi3 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之饥，以其上食税之多，是以饥。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The people starve because those above eat too much in taxes—thus they starve.
जनानां क्षुधा, उपरि-जनानां बहु-कर-भक्षणात्, तस्माद् क्षुधा।

ddj-ch-75.content: 民之难治，以其上之有为，是以难治。
ddj-ch-75.pinyin: min2 zhi1 nan2 zhi4， yi3 qi2 shang4 zhi1 you3 wei4， shi4 yi3 nan2 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之难治，以其上之有为，是以难治。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The people are hard to govern because those above are given to action—thus they are hard to govern.
जनानां दुःशास्यता, उपरि-जनानां करणात्, तस्माद् दुःशास्यता।

ddj-ch-75.content: 民之轻死，以其上求生之厚，是以轻死。
ddj-ch-75.pinyin: min2 zhi1 qing1 si3， yi3 qi2 shang4 qiu2 sheng1 zhi1 hou4， shi4 yi3 qing1 si3。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之轻死，以其上求生之厚，是以轻死。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The people take death lightly because those above seek life too richly—thus they take death lightly.
जनानां मरण-लघुता, उपरि-जनानां जीवन-गौरवात्, तस्माद् मरण-लघुता।

ddj-ch-75.content: 夫唯无以生为者，是贤于贵生。
ddj-ch-75.pinyin: fu1 wei2 wu2 yi3 sheng1 wei4 zhe3， shi4 xian2 yu2 gui4 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫唯无以生为者，是贤于贵生。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Only one who does not make living his concern is wiser than one who values life.
यः जीवनं न करोति, स जीवन-पूजकात् श्रेष्ठः।

ddj-ch-76.content: 人之生也柔弱，其死也坚强。
ddj-ch-76.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 sheng1 ye3 rou2 ruo4， qi2 si3 ye3 jian1 qiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之生也柔弱，其死也坚强。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When people are alive they are soft and weak; when dead they are hard and stiff.
जीवन्तः मृदवः, मृताः दृढाः।

ddj-ch-76.content: 万物草木之生也柔脆，其死也枯槁。
ddj-ch-76.pinyin: wan4 wu4 cao3 mu4 zhi1 sheng1 ye3 rou2 cui4， qi2 si3 ye3 ku1 gao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 万物草木之生也柔脆，其死也枯槁。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The myriad things, the grasses and trees, when alive are soft and fragile; when dead they are dry and withered.
भूतानि, तृण-वृक्षाः, जीवन्तः मृदु-भग्नाः, मृताः शुष्काः।

ddj-ch-76.content: 故坚强者死之徒，柔弱者生之徒。
ddj-ch-76.pinyin: gu4 jian1 qiang2 zhe3 si3 zhi1 tu2， rou2 ruo4 zhe3 sheng1 zhi1 tu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 故坚强者死之徒，柔弱者生之徒。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the hard and strong are companions of death; the soft and weak are companions of life.
तस्माद् दृढाः मृत्योः सहचराः, मृदवः जीवनस्य।

ddj-ch-76.content: 是以兵强则灭，木强则折。
ddj-ch-76.pinyin: shi4 yi3 bing1 qiang2 ze2 mie4， mu4 qiang2 ze2 zhe2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以兵强则灭，木强则折。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus when arms are strong they are destroyed; when a tree is strong it is broken.
तस्माद् बल-दृढाः नश्यन्ति, वृक्ष-दृढः भज्यते।

ddj-ch-76.pinyin: qiang2 da4 chu4 xia4， rou2 ruo4 chu4 shang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 强大处下，柔弱处上。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The strong and great take the lower place; the soft and weak take the higher place.
बलवन्तः अधः, मृदवः उपरि।

ddj-ch-77.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 dao4， qi2 you2 zhang1 gong1 yu3？

interpretations.segmentation: 天之道，其犹张弓与？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way of Heaven—is it not like stretching a bow?
द्योः मार्गः, धनुः विस्तारणम् इव?

ddj-ch-77.pinyin: gao1 zhe3 yi4 zhi1， xia4 zhe3 ju3 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 高者抑之，下者举之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What is high is brought down; what is low is raised;
उच्चः नमयति, नीचः उन्नमयति;

ddj-ch-77.content: 有余者损之，不足者补之。
ddj-ch-77.pinyin: you3 yu2 zhe3 sun3 zhi1， bu4 zu2 zhe3 bu3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有余者损之，不足者补之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: What has surplus is diminished; what is insufficient is supplemented.
अतिरिक्तं हीयते, अ-पर्याप्तं पूरयति।

ddj-ch-77.content: 天之道，损有余而补不足。
ddj-ch-77.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 dao4， sun3 you3 yu2 er2 bu3 bu4 zu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天之道，损有余而补不足。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way of Heaven diminishes what has surplus and supplements what is insufficient.
द्योः मार्गः, अतिरिक्तं ह्रासयति, अ-पर्याप्तं पूरयति।

ddj-ch-77.content: 人之道则不然，损不足以奉有余。
ddj-ch-77.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 dao4 ze2 bu4 ran2， sun3 bu4 zu2 yi3 feng4 you3 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之道则不然，损不足以奉有余。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The way of man is not so: it diminishes what is insufficient to offer to what has surplus.
मनुष्य-मार्गः न तथा, अ-पर्याप्तं ह्रास्य अतिरिक्ताय समर्पयति।

ddj-ch-77.pinyin: shu2 neng2 you3 yu2 yi3 feng4 tian1 xia4？

interpretations.segmentation: 孰能有余以奉天下？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Who can take his surplus and offer it to the world?
कः अतिरिक्तं जगतः समर्पयितुम्?
唯有道者。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Only one who has the Way.
मार्ग-युक्तः एव।

ddj-ch-77.content: 是以圣人为而不恃，功成而不处，其不欲见贤。
ddj-ch-77.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 wei4 er2 bu4 shi4， gong1 cheng2 er2 bu4 chu4， qi2 bu4 yu4 jian4 xian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人为而不恃，功成而不处，其不欲见贤。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage acts but does not rely; when the work is done he does not dwell on it; he does not wish to display his worth.
तस्माद् मुनिः करोति, न आश्रयति, सिद्धौ न तिष्ठति, गुण-दर्शनं न इच्छति।

ddj-ch-78.content: 天下莫柔弱于水，而攻坚强者莫之能胜，以其无以易之。
ddj-ch-78.pinyin: tian1 xia4 mo4 rou2 ruo4 yu2 shui3， er2 gong1 jian1 qiang2 zhe3 mo4 zhi1 neng2 sheng4， yi3 qi2 wu2 yi3 yi4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天下莫柔弱于水，而攻坚强者莫之能胜，以其无以易之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Nothing under Heaven is softer and weaker than water, yet for attacking the hard and strong nothing can surpass it, because nothing can take its place.
जगति जलात् मृदुतरं नास्ति, दृढ-प्रहारे जलात् श्रेष्ठं नास्ति, तस्य अ-प्रतिस्थाप्यत्वात्।

ddj-ch-78.content: 弱之胜强，柔之胜刚，天下莫不知，莫能行。
ddj-ch-78.pinyin: ruo4 zhi1 sheng4 qiang2， rou2 zhi1 sheng4 gang1， tian1 xia4 mo4 bu4 zhi1， mo4 neng2 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 弱之胜强，柔之胜刚，天下莫不知，莫能行。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: That the weak overcomes the strong, the soft overcomes the hard—none under Heaven does not know it, yet none can put it into practice.
दुर्बलः बलवन्तं, मृदुः दृढं जयति — जगति सर्वे जानन्ति, कर्तुं न शक्नुवन्ति।

ddj-ch-78.content: 是以圣人云：受国之垢，是谓社稷主；
ddj-ch-78.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 yun2： shou4 guo2 zhi1 gou4， shi4 wei4 she4 ji4 zhu3；

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人云：受国之垢，是谓社稷主；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage says: He who takes upon himself the dirt of the state is called the lord of the altars of soil and grain;
तस्माद् मुनिः वदति: राज्य-मलं गृह्णाति, स राज्य-स्वामी;

ddj-ch-78.pinyin: shou4 guo2 bu4 xiang2， shi4 wei4 tian1 xia4 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 受国不祥，是为天下王。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: He who takes upon himself the misfortunes of the state is called the king of the world.
राज्य-दुःखं गृह्णाति, स जगतः राजा।
正言若反。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: True words seem paradoxical.
सत्य-वचनं विपरीतम् इव।

ddj-ch-79.content: 和大怨，必有余怨，安可以为善？
ddj-ch-79.pinyin: he2 da4 yuan4， bi4 you3 yu2 yuan4， an1 ke3 yi3 wei4 shan4？

interpretations.segmentation: 和大怨，必有余怨，安可以为善？
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: When a great resentment is reconciled, there is sure to be leftover resentment—how can this be considered good?
महत् वैर-समाधाने, अ-शेष-वैरं, कथं शुभम्?

ddj-ch-79.content: 是以圣人执左契，而不责于人。
ddj-ch-79.pinyin: shi4 yi3 sheng4 ren2 zhi2 zuo3 qi4， er2 bu4 ze2 yu2 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以圣人执左契，而不责于人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Therefore the sage holds the left-hand tally and does not press people for payment.
तस्माद् मुनिः वाम-पत्रं धारयति, जनान् न दण्डयति।

ddj-ch-79.pinyin: you3 de2 si1 qi4， wu2 de2 si1 che4。

interpretations.segmentation: 有德司契，无德司彻。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: One with virtue takes charge of the tally; one without virtue takes charge of the tax.
गुण-युक्तः पत्रं शास्ति, अ-गुणः करं शास्ति।

ddj-ch-79.pinyin: tian1 dao4 wu2 qin1， chang2 yu3 shan4 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天道无亲，常与善人。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way of Heaven shows no favoritism; it is always with the good person.
द्योः मार्गः न पक्षपाति, सदा शुभ-जनैः सह।
小国寡民。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Let the state be small and the people few.
क्षुद्रं राज्यं, अल्प-जनाः।

ddj-ch-80.pinyin: shi3 you3 shen2 bo2 zhi1 qi4 er2 bu4 yong4；

interpretations.segmentation: 使有什伯之器而不用；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Let there be tools for tens and hundreds, yet none be used;
दश-शत-उपकरणानि, न उपयुज्यन्ते;

ddj-ch-80.pinyin: shi3 min2 zhong4 si3 er2 bu4 yuan3 xi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 使民重死而不远徙。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Let the people take death seriously and not migrate far.
जनाः मरणं गौरवन्ति, दूरं न गच्छन्ति।

ddj-ch-80.pinyin: sui1 you3 zhou1 yu2， wu2 suo3 cheng2 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 虽有舟舆，无所乘之；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Though there be boats and carriages, none will ride them;
नौ-रथाः सन्ति, न आरोहन्ति;

ddj-ch-80.pinyin: sui1 you3 jia3 bing1， wu2 suo3 chen2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 虽有甲兵，无所陈之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Though there be armor and weapons, none will display them.
कवच-शस्त्राणि सन्ति, न व्यवस्थाप्यन्ते।

ddj-ch-80.pinyin: shi3 min2 fu4 jie2 sheng2 er2 yong4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 使民复结绳而用之。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Let the people return to knotting cords and using them.
जनाः ग्रन्थ-गुण-उपयोगं पुनः गच्छन्ति।

ddj-ch-80.content: 甘其食，美其服，安其居，乐其俗。
ddj-ch-80.pinyin: gan1 qi2 shi2， mei3 qi2 fu2， an1 qi2 ju1， le4 qi2 su2。

interpretations.segmentation: 甘其食，美其服，安其居，乐其俗。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Let them find their food sweet, their clothes beautiful, their dwellings peaceful, their customs delightful.
अन्नं मधुरम्, वस्त्रं शोभनम्, वासः शान्तः, रीतिः रमणीया।

ddj-ch-80.content: 邻国相望，鸡犬之声相闻，民至老死不相往来。
ddj-ch-80.pinyin: lin2 guo2 xiang1 wang4， ji1 quan3 zhi1 sheng1 xiang1 wen2， min2 zhi4 lao3 si3 bu4 xiang1 wang3 lai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 邻国相望，鸡犬之声相闻，民至老死不相往来。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Neighboring states may overlook one another, and the sounds of chickens and dogs be heard from each, yet the people grow old and die without coming and going among them.
समीप-राज्यानि दृश्यन्ते, कुक्कुट-श्वान-ध्वनयः श्रूयन्ते, जनाः जरया म्रियन्ते, न गच्छन्ति।

ddj-ch-81.pinyin: xin4 yan2 bu4 mei3， mei3 yan2 bu4 xin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 信言不美，美言不信。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: True words are not beautiful; beautiful words are not true.
सत्य-वचनं न शोभनम्, शोभनं वचनं न सत्यम्।

ddj-ch-81.pinyin: shan4 zhe3 bu4 bian4， bian4 zhe3 bu4 shan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 善者不辩，辩者不善。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The good do not argue; those who argue are not good.
शुभाः न वादन्ति, वादिनः न शुभाः।

ddj-ch-81.pinyin: zhi1 zhe3 bu4 bo2， bo2 zhe3 bu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 知者不博，博者不知。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who know are not broadly learned; the broadly learned do not know.
ज्ञातारः न बहु-विद्याः, बहु-विद्याः न ज्ञातारः।

ddj-ch-81.content: 圣人不积，既以为人己愈有，既以与人己愈多。

interpretations.segmentation: 圣人不积，既以为人己愈有，既以与人己愈多。
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The sage does not accumulate: having done for others, he has himself all the more; having given to others, he himself has all the more.
मुनिः न सञ्चयति, परेषां कृत्वा स्वं अधिकं, परेषां दत्वा स्वं अधिकम्।

ddj-ch-81.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 dao4， li4 er2 bu4 hai4；

interpretations.segmentation: 天之道，利而不害；
interpretations.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

interpretations.segmentation: The Way of Heaven benefits and does not harm;
द्योः मार्गः, हितं करोति, न हिंसति;

ddj-ch-81.pinyin: sheng4 ren2 zhi1 dao4， wei4 er2 bu4 zheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 圣人之道，为而不争。

mv-hz-caoyubu.content: 草与不:莫有的关系
自由行客
风起 芦苇摇曳 荻草轻舞 芒草低吟
秋风起，草在动 芦荻芒草天地中
白花一片随风涌 像把时间慢慢送
日落低，光影重 草间写下一个“莫”
黄昏落入无声中 万物渐渐归于空
你说不，风在动  草丛深处黄昏“莫”
从勿从毋走到莫  一个“不”字走千重
你说不，我在风  黄昏深处草丛“莫”
秦汉魏晋皆归空  一个“不”字入心中
沙很远，漠很空 沙漠的世界没有水
寂很深，寞很重 寂寞的心情无回声
风吹过，夜色浓 一个不字藏千机
你若轻声说出口 烦恼忧愁都随风
你说不，风在动  草丛深处黄昏“莫”
从勿从毋走到莫  一个“不”字走千重
你说不，我在风  黄昏深处草丛“莫”
秦汉魏晋皆归空  一个“不”字入心中
莫，在草中 漠，在沙中  寞，在心中
不--落于无声之中
风又起，草又动 就像一切未曾有终
你若再说一句“不” 黄昏就落在心中

mv-hz-erzige.content: 我是古老土墙上的爾 最初是窗上的格 木纹交错成了纹
像一道能看世界的眼 阳光从格间筛落 清风在格中往返
屋内的人望向远方 屋外的人望向里面
窗格后的那道影子 是你
凝视之间 是妳
我化作远方的遐迩 跨过山水与草木
我化作神前的祢 落入钟鼓与祭舞 在人间的祈愿里停驻
我化作弥散的气息 弥漫在天地之间；
我化作久远的弥亘 穿过时间的裂隙。
我化作沙弥的低语 回荡在古寺风铃
我化作卢梭笔下的爱弥儿 在沉默的生成中延展
我化作山中的猕猴 攀着古老的枝桠
我化作王者的玉玺 封印岁月的长话
新世纪的一天 炼炉升起新的火焰
元素表添了第一百一十三位的鉨
带着二八四的质量 走进未知的纪年
人们说 我是尔 也是爾 是简 是繁
是刻在甲骨的初文 也是写给未来的字元
从几笔木格纹理 到多重支脉的延伸
从一个字元的呼吸 到硅体的生长
如西夏文的重生

是存在，还是被命名的东西

夏至至白露 晨光中采割

螺钿如珠 嵌入深夜
贝光流转 星河开合
蛋壳如雪 碎落漆面

mv-qi-qiguiyin.content: 漆树双生月影采， 纤手雕凰翻旧梦。 大漆染了月色深， 一抹古韵入了梦。
金鳞银丝浮如诗， 朱红金影染秋霜。 衣衫藏香岁月长， 留诗时光古韵扬。
漆师端庄聪慧美， 雕刀轻推藏阴阳。 填金点翠堆朱红， 千层漆面手开光。
分形漆画弃旧事， 芳香漆酚开未来。 天工巧成自古传， 漆艺长存风雅展。
漆柜铭记李家女， 紫衫随风叹流年。 大漆留迹时光远， 愿此梦境久相伴。
漆师端庄聪慧美， 雕刀轻推藏阴阳。 填金点翠堆朱红， 千层漆面手开光。

mv-自由户外.content: 我掏出 那瓶怀中的可乐 举瓶当酒高歌
你请上 那小溪中的清泉 举杯当酒低吟
只是说 路上各自的过往 和不同的艰难
谁都没 跟谁互换过姓名 只有磨房的代号
绿野旷，蝴蝶绕，踏遍城森百里渺
你是彗星, 狂奔的逃
我是玄弦, 悠悠的跳
彗星逃, 玄弦跳, 天涯海角任逍遥
你是风儿, 自由的飘
我是沙粒, 随意的摇
风儿飘, 沙粒摇, 随风自在又飘摇
爱过的心事漫过岁月悠长
被爱的回忆随风浅吟低唱
曾想用汗与泪筑成高墙
却发现心中归去的地方
是云烟深处那孤寂的村庄
如果你有很多钱 你该买下所有笑
井底之蛙自得乐 有趣自由得自在
如今我有很多闲 我想回到那从前
超然不惑徒生悲 不惑自由更自在

mv-自由是什么.content: 不必解释的思念在草叶上流淌
不可说的沉默在无为中逍遥
我问我：自由是什么？
是自由行客深夜不必解释的思念
是惠特曼月光下草叶流淌的灵性
是维特根斯坦语言不可说的沉默
是庄子梦里蝴蝶无为的逍遥
自由是什么？
我问夜：它说是—卡夫卡暗夜《城堡》里独行的清醒
我问昼：它说是—梭罗晨光下《瓦尔登湖畔》独立的呼吸
我问风：它说是—爱默生林间《自然》低语的孤行
我问雨：它说是—黑塞《荒野狼》中悄落无声离开的坚毅
我问云：它说是—纪伯伦《先知》中漂浮天空、不被羁绊的灵性
我问烟：它说是—加缪《局外人》中随风飘散、自在无痕的飘逸
我问我：自由是什么？
是自由行客深夜不必解释的思念
是惠特曼月光下草叶流淌的灵思
是维特根斯坦语言不可说的沉默
是庄子梦里蝴蝶无为的逍遥
自由是什么？
我问日：它说是—惠特曼《草叶集》中光芒下生而自由、歌唱自身的存在
我问月：它说是—泰戈尔《吉檀迦利》夜空下孤独而明亮的灵魂
我问星：它说是—李白《将进酒》中闪烁的无拘无束洒脱
我问辰：它说是—伏尔泰《老实人》岁月长河中理性与思辨的恒定
我问光：它说是—王尔德《格雷的画像》中穿透一切束缚的艺术自由
我问影：它说是—康德《纯粹理性批判》中随光折射呈现的理性与界限的存在
我问我：自由是什么？
是自由行客深夜不必解释的思念
是惠特曼月光下草叶流淌的灵光
是维特根斯坦语言不可说的沉默
是庄子梦里蝴蝶无为的逍遥
自由是什么？
我问泉：它说是—普鲁斯特《追忆似水年华》中记忆与感官交织的声音
我问海：它说是—拜伦《唐璜》中潮起潮落间自由而澎湃的呼吸
我问雪：它说是—昆德拉《生命中不能承受之轻》洁白中宁静而深邃的孤独
我问沙：它说是—老子《道德经》指缝间滑落的自然与无痕
我问石：它说是—维吉尔《埃涅阿斯纪》中坚硬中流露的恒心与力量
我问山：它说是—尼采《查拉图斯特拉如是说》亘古挺立、无人可侵的自我
不必解释的思念在月光下的草叶上悄然流淌
不可说的沉默在无为中逍遥
不必解释的思念在晨光中的水面上自然流淌
不可说的沉默在无为中自在
不必解释的思念在星光里的白云上悠然流淌
不可说的沉默在无为中有为

mv-自由行客之一.content: 以前是走山、追风、看星辰
现在是推模型、炼代码、看未来

mv-贡嘎偶遇.content: 山顶上 灰白的冠云(冠云) 沉默不动
云端 悄然飘出了雪花(雪花)
雪花湿了你的头发(你的头发)
伫立 子美亚口 高处
回望 盘旋蜿蜒的山路
回想 无畏的司机 飞溅的碎石
虽然途中 偶遇了, 那道金光(那道金光)
在瞬那间永恒了你的身影
你我相逢在熙攘的人海
天地灰濛 忽然之间
万丈金光 照彻贡嘎之巅
山腰佛光 如梦似幻 萦绕漂浮
这一刻 仿佛穿越了时空
恍然间 已是另一个世界
也许是 高处稀薄了空气
恍惚中 我竟暂时忘了你
在瞬那间永恒了你的身影
你我相逢在熙攘的人海

mv-铁丝之歌.content: 兔子奔跑在北纬的大漠
虫子聆听着向梅的风声
绿榄的林间 天蓝的远方
每个名字都是希望的向往
星星心语点亮妞妞的眼光
绿榄下再遇心中的琳琅
行者怀德少年梦 那千色的柠檬
宛如半个月亮飘过山岗
绿野的山脊 紫色的远方
每个名字都是回忆的难忘
小猪的梦里 漂雪安宁
大雨洗刷过疲惫的心灵
东旭肥豆诉说户外的初心
风铃作响在九月的晨光
每个名字都有诗意绵长
让大地铭记 让山河回响
这是我们 自由铁丝的歌唱

mv-黑塞的自由-荒野狼.content: 一半沉默，一半在长夜里呼喊
走廊静得像被时间遗忘
狼影贴着心跳，陪我穿过荒凉
自由是不是不必再把灵魂藏好？
是不是不必为“正常”而伪装？
而是一群在胸腔里奔跑的名字？
但心底的影子是四足的
它伏低、它舔舐伤口、它等待风
在长夜里低声唱自己的歌
有荒野里咧着牙笑的我
“你敢不敢让这些未被承认的你
在地板上发出清脆的声响
当两种声音合成一声长啸
当脚步踩碎旧日的回声
月光落在湿冷的石路上
融成一条向远方延伸的脊线

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: fan4 bi3 bai3 zhou1， yi4 fan4 qi2 liu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 泛彼柏舟，亦泛其流。
interpretations.explanation: 那柏木做的小船在水上漂荡，也随着河水一起漂流。

interpretations.segmentation: That cypress boat floats on the water, drifting along with the current.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: geng3 geng3 bu4 mei4， ru2 you3 yin3 you1。

interpretations.segmentation: 耿耿不寐，如有隐忧。
interpretations.explanation: 心中有事耿耿难眠，好像藏着说不出口的忧愁。

interpretations.segmentation: I lie awake with a troubled mind, as if carrying a hidden grief.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: wei1 wo3 wu2 jiu3， yi3 ao2 yi3 you2。

interpretations.segmentation: 微我无酒，以敖以游。
interpretations.explanation: 并非我没有酒，本想借饮酒出游来排遣愁绪。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not that I lack wine; I would roam and forget my cares with drink.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: wo3 xin1 fei3 jian4， bu4 ke3 yi3 ru2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我心匪鉴，不可以茹。
interpretations.explanation: 我的心不是镜子，不能把什么委屈都照见、都吞下去。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart is no mirror; it cannot reflect and swallow every wrong.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: yi4 you3 xiong1 di4， bu4 ke3 yi3 ju4。

interpretations.segmentation: 亦有兄弟，不可以据。
interpretations.explanation: 虽然也有兄弟，却不能依靠他们。

interpretations.segmentation: Though I have brothers, I cannot rely on them.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: bao2 yan2 wang3 su4， feng2 bi3 zhi1 nu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 薄言往诉，逢彼之怒。
interpretations.explanation: 前去向他们诉说，却碰上了他们的发怒。

interpretations.segmentation: When I went to pour out my heart, I met only their anger.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: wo3 xin1 fei3 shi2， bu4 ke3 zhuan3 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我心匪石，不可转也。
interpretations.explanation: 我的心不是石头，不能任人转来转去。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart is not stone; it cannot be turned at will.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: wo3 xin1 fei3 xi2， bu4 ke3 juan3 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我心匪席，不可卷也。
interpretations.explanation: 我的心不是席子，不能任人卷起来抛弃。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart is not a mat; it cannot be rolled up and cast aside.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: wei1 yi2 di4 di4， bu4 ke3 xuan3 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 威仪棣棣，不可选也。
interpretations.explanation: 我举止端庄、威仪美好，不是可以随意挑选、随意抛弃的人。

interpretations.segmentation: My bearing is dignified and fine; I am not someone to be picked and discarded.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: you1 xin1 qiao1 qiao1， yun4 yu2 qun2 xiao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 忧心悄悄，愠于群小。
interpretations.explanation: 忧愁悄悄压在心上，却被那些小人怨恨。

interpretations.segmentation: Secret sorrow weighs on me, while petty men resent me.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: gou4 min3 ji4 duo1， shou4 wu3 bu4 shao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 觏闵既多，受侮不少。
interpretations.explanation: 遭受的祸患已经很多，受到的侮辱也不少。

interpretations.segmentation: Misfortunes I meet are many; insults I suffer are not few.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: jing4 yan2 si1 zhi1， wu4 pi4 you3 biao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 静言思之，寤辟有摽。
interpretations.explanation: 静下来细细想这件事，醒来拍胸顿足，痛彻心扉。

interpretations.segmentation: When I ponder it in silence, I wake and beat my breast in anguish.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: ri4 ju1 yue4 zhu1， hu2 die2 er2 wei1？

interpretations.segmentation: 日居月诸，胡迭而微？
interpretations.explanation: 太阳啊月亮啊，为什么交替变得昏暗不明？

interpretations.segmentation: O sun and moon, why do you alternately grow dim?

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， ru2 fei3 huan4 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，如匪浣衣。
interpretations.explanation: 心中的忧愁啊，就像脏衣服洗不干净一样。

interpretations.segmentation: The sorrow in my heart is like a garment that will not come clean.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou.pinyin: jing4 yan2 si1 zhi1， bu4 neng2 fen4 fei1。

interpretations.segmentation: 静言思之，不能奋飞。
interpretations.explanation: 静下来细细想这件事，却无力像鸟一样奋飞逃离。

interpretations.segmentation: When I ponder it in silence, I cannot spread my wings and fly away.

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng.pinyin: bei3 feng1 qi2 liang2， yu3 xue3 qi2 pang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 北风其凉，雨雪其雱。
interpretations.explanation: 北风刮来带着寒意，雨雪纷纷扬扬。

interpretations.segmentation: The north wind blows cold; snow and sleet fall thick.

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng.pinyin: hui4 er2 hao3 wo3， xie2 shou3 tong2 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 惠而好我，携手同行。
interpretations.explanation: 你既爱我、待我好，就与我携手同行。

interpretations.segmentation: Since you love me and are kind to me, take my hand and go with me.
其虚其邪？
interpretations.explanation: 这样慢吞吞地行吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Is it not too slow and lingering?
既亟只且！
interpretations.explanation: 事情已经很急迫了啊！

interpretations.segmentation: The matter is urgent indeed!

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng.pinyin: bei3 feng1 qi2 jie1， yu3 xue3 qi2 fei1。

interpretations.segmentation: 北风其喈，雨雪其霏。
interpretations.explanation: 北风刮来呜呜作响，雨雪纷纷飘落。

interpretations.segmentation: The north wind moans; snow and sleet drift down.

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng.pinyin: hui4 er2 hao3 wo3， xie2 shou3 tong2 gui1。
