interpretations.segmentation: 惠而好我，携手同归。
interpretations.explanation: 你既爱我、待我好，就与我携手同归。

interpretations.segmentation: Since you love me and are kind to me, take my hand and return with me.
其虚其邪？
interpretations.explanation: 这样慢吞吞地行吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Is it not too slow and lingering?
既亟只且！
interpretations.explanation: 事情已经很急迫了啊！

interpretations.segmentation: The matter is urgent indeed!

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng.pinyin: mo4 chi4 fei3 hu2， mo4 hei1 fei3 wu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 莫赤匪狐，莫黑匪乌。
interpretations.explanation: 没有不红的不是狐狸，没有不黑的不是乌鸦；比喻世事混浊。

interpretations.segmentation: Nothing red is not a fox, nothing black is not a crow—the world is murky and alike in evil.

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng.pinyin: hui4 er2 hao3 wo3， xie2 shou3 tong2 che1。

interpretations.segmentation: 惠而好我，携手同车。
interpretations.explanation: 你既爱我、待我好，就与我同乘一车。

interpretations.segmentation: Since you love me and are kind to me, ride in the same carriage with me.
其虚其邪？
interpretations.explanation: 这样慢吞吞地行吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Is it not too slow and lingering?
既亟只且！
interpretations.explanation: 事情已经很急迫了啊！

interpretations.segmentation: The matter is urgent indeed!

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen.pinyin: chu1 zi4 bei3 men2， you1 xin1 yin1 yin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 出自北门，忧心殷殷。
interpretations.explanation: 从北门出来，心中忧愁深重。

interpretations.segmentation: I go out by the north gate, my heart heavy with care.

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen.pinyin: zhong1 ju4 qie3 pin2， mo4 zhi1 wo3 jian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 终窭且贫，莫知我艰。
interpretations.explanation: 终究又穷又苦，没人知道我的艰难。

interpretations.segmentation: Poor and wretched at last, and none know how hard it is for me.
已焉哉！
interpretations.explanation: 算了吧！

interpretations.segmentation: Let it be!

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen.pinyin: tian1 shi2 wei4 zhi1， wei4 zhi1 he2 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 天实为之，谓之何哉！
interpretations.explanation: 这都是上天安排的，还能说什么呢！

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven has willed it so—what can I say?

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen.content: 王事适我，政事一埤益我。
sj-feng-beifeng-beimen.pinyin: wang2 shi4 shi4 wo3， zheng4 shi4 yi1 pi2 yi4 wo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 王事适我，政事一埤益我。
interpretations.explanation: 王室的事推给我，公务又一层层加到我身上。

interpretations.segmentation: The king's business falls on me, and official duties are piled ever higher on me.

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen.content: 我入自外，室人交遍谪我。
sj-feng-beifeng-beimen.pinyin: wo3 ru4 zi4 wai4， shi4 ren2 jiao1 bian4 zhe2 wo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我入自外，室人交遍谪我。
interpretations.explanation: 我从外头回家，家里人反而一齐责备我。

interpretations.segmentation: When I come in from outside, those at home all reproach me together.
已焉哉！
interpretations.explanation: 算了吧！

interpretations.segmentation: Let it be!

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen.pinyin: tian1 shi2 wei4 zhi1， wei4 zhi1 he2 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 天实为之，谓之何哉！
interpretations.explanation: 这都是上天安排的，还能说什么呢！

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven has willed it so—what can I say?

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen.content: 王事敦我，政事一埤遗我。
sj-feng-beifeng-beimen.pinyin: wang2 shi4 dun1 wo3， zheng4 shi4 yi1 pi2 yi2 wo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 王事敦我，政事一埤遗我。
interpretations.explanation: 王室的事催逼我，公务又一件件丢给我。

interpretations.segmentation: The king's business presses me, and official tasks are dumped on me one after another.

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen.content: 我入自外，室人交遍摧我。
sj-feng-beifeng-beimen.pinyin: wo3 ru4 zi4 wai4， shi4 ren2 jiao1 bian4 cui1 wo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我入自外，室人交遍摧我。
interpretations.explanation: 我从外头回家，家里人反而一齐摧折我。

interpretations.segmentation: When I come in from outside, those at home all wear me down together.
已焉哉！
interpretations.explanation: 算了吧！

interpretations.segmentation: Let it be!

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen.pinyin: tian1 shi2 wei4 zhi1， wei4 zhi1 he2 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 天实为之，谓之何哉！
interpretations.explanation: 这都是上天安排的，还能说什么呢！

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven has willed it so—what can I say?

sj-feng-beifeng-erzichengzhou.pinyin: er4 zi cheng2 zhou1， fan4 fan4 qi2 jing3。

interpretations.segmentation: 二子乘舟，泛泛其景。
interpretations.explanation: 两个少年乘着小船，船影在水上漂荡。

interpretations.segmentation: Two youths ride a boat; its shadow drifts on the water.

sj-feng-beifeng-erzichengzhou.pinyin: yuan4 yan2 si1 zi， zhong1 xin1 yang3 yang3！

interpretations.segmentation: 愿言思子，中心养养！
interpretations.explanation: 多么想念他们啊，心中忧思绵绵！

interpretations.segmentation: How I long for them—my heart is full of anxious love!

sj-feng-beifeng-erzichengzhou.pinyin: er4 zi cheng2 zhou1， fan4 fan4 qi2 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 二子乘舟，泛泛其逝。
interpretations.explanation: 两个少年乘着小船，船儿向远方驶去。

interpretations.segmentation: Two youths ride a boat; it sails away into the distance.

sj-feng-beifeng-erzichengzhou.pinyin: yuan4 yan2 si1 zi， bu4 xia2 you3 hai4？

interpretations.segmentation: 愿言思子，不瑕有害？
interpretations.explanation: 多么想念他们啊，他们该不会有什么灾祸吧？

interpretations.segmentation: How I long for them—surely no harm will befall them?

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: xi2 xi2 gu3 feng1， yi3 yin1 yi3 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 习习谷风，以阴以雨。
interpretations.explanation: 山谷里风习习吹来，带来阴云和雨意。

interpretations.segmentation: The valley wind blows steadily, bringing cloud and rain.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: min3 mian3 tong2 xin1， bu4 yi2 you3 nu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 黾勉同心，不宜有怒。
interpretations.explanation: 应当同心协力，不该彼此发怒。

interpretations.segmentation: We should strive together in one heart, not turn to anger.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: cai3 feng1 cai3 fei1， wu2 yi3 xia4 ti3？

interpretations.segmentation: 采葑采菲，无以下体？
interpretations.explanation: 采萝卜采菲菜，难道能因根部不好就不要吗？

interpretations.segmentation: When we gather turnips and melons, do we reject them for the lower part?

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: de2 yin1 mo4 wei2， ji2 er3 tong2 si3。

interpretations.segmentation: 德音莫违，及尔同死。
interpretations.explanation: 美好的誓言不要违背，愿与你同生共死。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not break your good words; I would share life and death with you.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: xing2 dao4 chi2 chi2， zhong1 xin1 you3 wei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 行道迟迟，中心有违。
interpretations.explanation: 走在路上步履迟缓，心中却充满离恨。

interpretations.segmentation: I walk the road with slow steps, but rebellion fills my heart.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: bu4 yuan3 yi1 er3， bao2 song4 wo3 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不远伊迩，薄送我畿。
interpretations.explanation: 路并不远，你却只把我送到近郊。

interpretations.segmentation: The way is not far, yet you send me off only to the outskirts.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: shui2 wei4 tu2 ku3， qi2 gan1 ru2 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 谁谓荼苦，其甘如荠。
interpretations.explanation: 谁说荼菜是苦的？对我来说却像荠菜一样甜。

interpretations.segmentation: Who says bitter sow-thistle is bitter? To me it is sweet as shepherd's purse.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: yan4 er3 xin1 hun1， ru2 xiong1 ru2 di4。

interpretations.segmentation: 宴尔新婚，如兄如弟。
interpretations.explanation: 你和新妇欢宴作乐，亲如兄弟。

interpretations.segmentation: You feast with your new bride, close as brothers.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: jing1 yi3 wei4 zhuo2， shi2 shi2 qi2 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 泾以渭浊，湜湜其沚。
interpretations.explanation: 泾水因渭水而显得浊，但泾水清处仍澄澈见底。

interpretations.segmentation: The Jing seems turbid beside the Wei, yet where it is clear its bed shines bright.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: yan4 er3 xin1 hun1， bu4 wo3 xie4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 宴尔新婚，不我屑以。
interpretations.explanation: 你和新妇欢宴作乐，却不肯把我放在眼里。

interpretations.segmentation: You feast with your new bride and will not deign to notice me.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: wu2 shi4 wo3 liang2， wu2 fa1 wo3 gou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 毋逝我梁，毋发我笱。
interpretations.explanation: 不要离开我的鱼梁，不要打开我的鱼笼。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not leave my fish dam; do not open my bamboo trap.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: wo3 gong1 bu4 yue4， huang2 xu4 wo3 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我躬不阅，遑恤我后。
interpretations.explanation: 我自己都过不下去，哪还顾得上以后的事。

interpretations.segmentation: I cannot even save myself—how could I care for what comes after?

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: jiu4 qi2 shen1 yi3， fang1 zhi1 zhou1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 就其深矣，方之舟之。
interpretations.explanation: 水深了就撑船过去，想办法渡过去。

interpretations.segmentation: Where the water is deep, I raft and boat across.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: jiu4 qi2 qian3 yi3， yong3 zhi1 you2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 就其浅矣，泳之游之。
interpretations.explanation: 水浅了就涉水游过去，自己想办法过去。

interpretations.segmentation: Where it is shallow, I wade and swim across.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: he2 you3 he2 wang2， min3 mian3 qiu2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 何有何亡，黾勉求之。
interpretations.explanation: 无论有无，都勉力去寻求、操持家务。

interpretations.segmentation: Whether we have or lack, I strive hard to seek and provide.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: fan2 min2 you3 sang4， pu2 fu2 jiu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 凡民有丧，匍匐救之。
interpretations.explanation: 别人家有丧事，我爬着也要去帮忙。

interpretations.segmentation: When neighbors suffer bereavement, I crawl on hands and knees to help.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: bu4 wo3 neng2 chu4， fan3 yi3 wo3 wei4 chou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 不我能畜，反以我为仇。
interpretations.explanation: 你不但不能好好待我，反而把我当作仇敌。

interpretations.segmentation: You cannot cherish me; instead you treat me as an enemy.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: ji4 zu3 wo3 de2， jia3 yong4 bu4 shou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 既阻我德，贾用不售。
interpretations.explanation: 你既嫌弃我的德行，我的好意也如同货物卖不出去。

interpretations.segmentation: You reject my virtue; my goodwill is like goods that will not sell.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: xi1 yu4 kong3 yu4 ju1， ji2 er3 dian1 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 昔育恐育鞫，及尔颠覆。
interpretations.explanation: 从前怕养不活孩子、受委屈，也曾陪你度过艰难。

interpretations.segmentation: Once, fearing want and hardship in raising children, I stayed with you through ruin.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: ji4 sheng1 ji4 yu4， bi3 yu3 yu2 du2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既生既育，比予于毒。
interpretations.explanation: 如今孩子已经长大，你却把我比作毒物。

interpretations.segmentation: Now the children are raised, yet you compare me to poison.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: wo3 you3 zhi3 xu4， yi4 yi3 yu4 dong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我有旨蓄，亦以御冬。
interpretations.explanation: 我存了美味的菜干，本用来抵御寒冬。

interpretations.segmentation: I stored tasty preserved greens to see us through the winter.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: yan4 er3 xin1 hun1， yi3 wo3 yu4 qiong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 宴尔新婚，以我御穷。
interpretations.explanation: 你和新妇欢宴作乐，却拿我去抵挡贫穷。

interpretations.segmentation: You feast with your new bride and use me to fend off poverty.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: you3 guang1 you3 kui4， ji4 yi2 wo3 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 有洸有溃，既诒我肄。
interpretations.explanation: 你水流满面的样子，还对我嬉笑戏弄。

interpretations.segmentation: With tears streaming you still mock and toy with me.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng.pinyin: bu4 nian4 xi1 zhe3， yi1 yu2 lai2 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不念昔者，伊余来塈。
interpretations.explanation: 不念往日的情分，如今才把我扫地出门。

interpretations.segmentation: Forgetting the past, you now cast me out and sweep the house clean of me.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi.pinyin: jian3 xi1 jian3 xi1， fang1 jiang1 wan4 wu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 简兮简兮，方将万舞。
interpretations.explanation: 多么勇武啊，正要跳起万舞。

interpretations.segmentation: How bold and grand—he is about to lead the great dance.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi.pinyin: ri4 zhi1 fang1 zhong1， zai4 qian2 shang4 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 日之方中，在前上处。
interpretations.explanation: 太阳正当中天，他在前面高位上。

interpretations.segmentation: The sun stands at noon; he is in the place of honor ahead.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi.pinyin: shuo4 ren2 yu3 yu3， gong1 ting2 wan4 wu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 硕人俣俣，公庭万舞。
interpretations.explanation: 身材高大的人仪态美好，在公堂上跳万舞。

interpretations.segmentation: The tall man moves with grace, performing the great dance in the court.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi.pinyin: you3 li4 ru2 hu3， zhi2 pei4 ru2 zu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有力如虎，执辔如组。
interpretations.explanation: 有力气像猛虎，执缰绳像编织一样稳。

interpretations.segmentation: Strong as a tiger, he holds the reins firm as woven silk.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi.pinyin: zuo3 shou3 zhi2 yue4， you4 shou3 bing3 di2。

interpretations.segmentation: 左手执龠，右手秉翟。
interpretations.explanation: 左手拿着龠管，右手举着雉尾。

interpretations.segmentation: In his left hand the flute; in his right, pheasant plumes.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi.pinyin: he4 ru2 wo4 zhe3， gong1 yan2 xi1 jue2。

interpretations.segmentation: 赫如渥赭，公言锡爵。
interpretations.explanation: 面色红润如涂赭，国君发言赐他酒爵。

interpretations.segmentation: His face glows red as ochre; the lord speaks and grants him a cup.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi.pinyin: shan1 you3 zhen1， xi2 you3 ling2。

interpretations.segmentation: 山有榛，隰有苓。
interpretations.explanation: 山上有榛树，低湿处有苓草。

interpretations.segmentation: On the hill are hazels; in the wet low ground, licorice grows.
云谁之思？
interpretations.explanation: 我思念的是谁呢？

interpretations.segmentation: Whom do I long for?
西方美人。
interpretations.explanation: 是西方的那位美人。

interpretations.segmentation: The fair one from the west.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi.pinyin: bi3 mei3 ren2 xi1， xi1 fang1 zhi1 ren2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼美人兮，西方之人兮。
interpretations.explanation: 那美人啊，就是西方来的那个人啊。

interpretations.segmentation: That fair one—he is the man from the west.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu.pinyin: ji1 gu3 qi2 tang1， yong3 yue4 yong4 bing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 击鼓其镗，踊跃用兵。
interpretations.explanation: 战鼓咚咚响，士兵踊跃要出征。

interpretations.segmentation: War drums thunder; soldiers leap eager for battle.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu.pinyin: tu3 guo2 cheng2 cao2， wo3 du2 nan2 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 土国城漕，我独南行。
interpretations.explanation: 本国筑城漕邑，唯独我向南行。

interpretations.segmentation: At home they fortify Cao; I alone march south.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu.pinyin: cong2 sun1 zi zhong4， ping2 chen2 yu3 song4。

interpretations.segmentation: 从孙子仲，平陈与宋。
interpretations.explanation: 跟随孙子仲，去平定陈国与宋国。

interpretations.segmentation: Following Sun Zizhong, I help pacify Chen and Song.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu.pinyin: bu4 wo3 yi3 gui1， you1 xin1 you3 chong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不我以归，忧心有忡。
interpretations.explanation: 他不带我回去，心中忧愁不安。

interpretations.segmentation: He will not take me home—my heart is restless with care.
爰居爰处？
interpretations.explanation: 我在哪里安身？

interpretations.segmentation: Where shall I dwell?
爰丧其马？
interpretations.explanation: 我的马在哪里丢失？

interpretations.segmentation: Where did I lose my horse?
于以求之？
interpretations.explanation: 到哪里去找它？

interpretations.segmentation: Where shall I seek it?
于林之下。
interpretations.explanation: 在树林下面。

interpretations.segmentation: Beneath the grove.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu.pinyin: si3 sheng1 qi4 kuo4， yu3 zi cheng2 shuo1。

interpretations.segmentation: 死生契阔，与子成说。
interpretations.explanation: 生死离合，我曾与你立下誓言。

interpretations.segmentation: Through life and death, parting and meeting—we once made our vow.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu.pinyin: zhi2 zi zhi1 shou3， yu3 zi xie2 lao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 执子之手，与子偕老。
interpretations.explanation: 握着你的手，与你白头偕老。

interpretations.segmentation: I hold your hand and grow old with you.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu.pinyin: yu2 jie1 kuo4 xi1， bu4 wo3 huo2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 于嗟阔兮，不我活兮。
interpretations.explanation: 唉，分离啊，你不能与我团聚了。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas for separation—you cannot live on with me.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu.pinyin: yu2 jie1 xun2 xi1， bu4 wo3 xin4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 于嗟洵兮，不我信兮。
interpretations.explanation: 唉，确实啊，你不能守信用了。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, it is true—you cannot keep faith with me.

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv.pinyin: jing4 nv3 qi2 shu1， qi2 wo3 yu2 cheng2 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 静女其姝，俟我于城隅。
interpretations.explanation: 娴静姑娘真美丽，在城角等我。

interpretations.segmentation: The quiet maiden is fair; she waits for me at the corner of the wall.

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv.pinyin: ai4 er2 bu4 jian4， sao1 shou3 chi2 chu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 爱而不见，搔首踟蹰。
interpretations.explanation: 她有意躲着不见，我挠头徘徊不知所措。

interpretations.segmentation: She hides and will not show herself; I scratch my head and linger, at a loss.

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv.pinyin: jing4 nv3 qi2 luan2， yi2 wo3 tong2 guan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 静女其娈，贻我彤管。
interpretations.explanation: 娴静姑娘真姣好，送给我一支彤管。

interpretations.segmentation: The quiet maiden is lovely; she gives me a red flute.

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv.pinyin: tong2 guan3 you3 wei3， shuo1 yi4 nv3 mei3。

interpretations.segmentation: 彤管有炜，说怿女美。
interpretations.explanation: 彤管色彩鲜明，我为你的美而喜悦。

interpretations.segmentation: The red flute shines bright; I delight in your beauty.

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv.pinyin: zi4 mu4 gui1 ti2， xun2 mei3 qie3 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 自牧归荑，洵美且异。
interpretations.explanation: 从郊野采来的嫩荑，确实又美又特别。

interpretations.segmentation: The tender grass she brought from the meadow is truly fine and rare.

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv.pinyin: fei3 nv3 zhi1 wei4 mei3， mei3 ren2 zhi1 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪女之为美，美人之贻。
interpretations.explanation: 不是荑草本身美，是美人所赠才珍贵。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not the grass itself that is beautiful—it is precious because the fair one gave it.

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng.pinyin: kai3 feng1 zi4 nan2， chui1 bi3 ji2 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 凯风自南，吹彼棘心。
interpretations.explanation: 和暖的南风吹来，吹在棘树嫩心上。

interpretations.segmentation: The warm south wind blows upon the tender heart of the thorn tree.

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng.pinyin: ji2 xin1 yao1 yao1， mu3 shi4 qu2 lao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 棘心夭夭，母氏劬劳。
interpretations.explanation: 棘心茁壮生长，母亲养育多么辛劳。

interpretations.segmentation: The thorn heart grows lush—how toilsome was my mother's care.

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng.pinyin: kai3 feng1 zi4 nan2， chui1 bi3 ji2 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 凯风自南，吹彼棘薪。
interpretations.explanation: 和暖的南风吹来，吹在已成薪柴的棘树。

interpretations.segmentation: The warm south wind blows upon the thorn now gathered as fuel.

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng.pinyin: mu3 shi4 sheng4 shan4， wo3 wu2 ling4 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 母氏圣善，我无令人。
interpretations.explanation: 母亲圣明善良，我却不是好儿子。

interpretations.segmentation: My mother is wise and good, yet I am no worthy child.
爰有寒痊？
interpretations.explanation: 哪里有清冷的寒泉？

interpretations.segmentation: Where is the cold spring?
在浚之下。
interpretations.explanation: 在浚城下面。

interpretations.segmentation: Below the city of Jun.

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng.pinyin: you3 zi qi1 ren2， mu3 shi4 lao2 ku3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有子七人，母氏劳苦。
interpretations.explanation: 有七个儿子，母亲仍然劳苦。

interpretations.segmentation: Though she has seven sons, our mother still toils in hardship.

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng.pinyin: xian4 huan4 huang2 niao3， zai4 hao3 qi2 yin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 睍睆黄鸟，载好其音。
interpretations.explanation: 黄鸟婉转鸣叫，声音多么好听。

interpretations.segmentation: The oriole sings softly, its voice so sweet.

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng.pinyin: you3 zi qi1 ren2， mo4 wei4 mu3 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有子七人，莫慰母心。
interpretations.explanation: 有七个儿子，却不能安慰母亲的心。

interpretations.segmentation: Seven sons we have, yet none can comfort our mother's heart.

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi.pinyin: lv4 xi1 yi1 xi1， lv4 yi1 huang2 guo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 绿兮衣兮，绿衣黄裹。
interpretations.explanation: 绿啊衣啊，绿衣里配黄里子。

interpretations.segmentation: Green, the robe—green outside with yellow lining.

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， he2 wei2 qi2 yi3！

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，曷维其已！
interpretations.explanation: 心中的忧伤啊，什么时候才能停止！

interpretations.segmentation: Sorrow in my heart—when will it ever end?

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi.pinyin: lv4 xi1 yi1 xi1， lv4 yi1 huang2 shang。

interpretations.segmentation: 绿兮衣兮，绿衣黄裳。
interpretations.explanation: 绿啊衣啊，绿衣下配黄下裳。

interpretations.segmentation: Green, the robe—green upper garment with yellow skirt.

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， he2 wei2 qi2 wang2！

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，曷维其亡！
interpretations.explanation: 心中的忧伤啊，什么时候才能消散！

interpretations.segmentation: Sorrow in my heart—when will it pass away?

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi.pinyin: lv4 xi1 si1 xi1， nv3 suo3 zhi4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 绿兮丝兮，女所治兮。
interpretations.explanation: 绿啊丝啊，是你亲手所织啊。

interpretations.segmentation: Green thread—it was you who wove it.

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi.pinyin: wo3 si1 gu3 ren2， bi3 wu2 you2 xi1！

interpretations.segmentation: 我思古人，俾无訧兮！
interpretations.explanation: 我思念古人，愿不再有过失啊！

interpretations.segmentation: I think of the ancients, that I may commit no fault!

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi.pinyin: chi1 xi1 xi4 xi1， qi1 qi2 yi3 feng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 絺兮绤兮，凄其以风。
interpretations.explanation: 粗葛细葛啊，风吹上去感到凄凉。

interpretations.segmentation: Coarse and fine hemp cloth—wind through them feels chill.

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi.pinyin: wo3 si1 gu3 ren2， shi2 huo4 wo3 xin1！

interpretations.segmentation: 我思古人，实获我心！
interpretations.explanation: 我思念古人，他们实在深得我心！

interpretations.segmentation: I think of the ancients—they truly reached my heart!

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu.content: 旄丘之葛兮，何诞之节兮。
sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu.pinyin: mao2 qiu1 zhi1 ge2 xi1， he2 dan4 zhi1 jie2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 旄丘之葛兮，何诞之节兮。
interpretations.explanation: 旄丘上的葛藤啊，为什么枝节这样长？

interpretations.segmentation: The vine on Mao Hill—why are its joints so long?

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu.pinyin: shu1 xi1 bo2 xi1， he2 duo1 ri4 ye3？

interpretations.segmentation: 叔兮伯兮，何多日也？
interpretations.explanation: 叔伯们啊，为什么拖了这么多日子？

interpretations.segmentation: O uncles and elders, why so many days' delay?
何其处也？
interpretations.explanation: 为什么安然不动？

interpretations.segmentation: Why do you sit at ease?
必有与也！
interpretations.explanation: 一定是有同伴相从！

interpretations.segmentation: Surely you have company with you!
何其久也？
interpretations.explanation: 为什么这样久？

interpretations.segmentation: Why so long?
必有以也！
interpretations.explanation: 一定是有缘故！

interpretations.segmentation: Surely there is some reason!

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu.pinyin: hu2 qiu2 meng2 rong2， fei3 che1 bu4 dong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 狐裘蒙戎，匪车不东。
interpretations.explanation: 穿着狐裘却蒙着戎装，不是车不往东去。

interpretations.segmentation: Fox fur wrapped in martial garb—not that the chariot will not go east.

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu.pinyin: shu1 xi1 bo2 xi1， mi2 suo3 yu3 tong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔兮伯兮，靡所与同。
interpretations.explanation: 叔伯们啊，没有谁与我同行。

interpretations.segmentation: O uncles and elders, none share the road with me.

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu.pinyin: suo3 xi1 wei3 xi1， liu2 li2 zhi1 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 琐兮尾兮，流离之子。
interpretations.explanation: 细小又尾随啊，像流离失所的孩子。

interpretations.segmentation: Small and trailing—like a child cast adrift.

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu.pinyin: shu1 xi1 bo2 xi1， xiu4 ru2 chong1 er3。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔兮伯兮，褎如充耳。
interpretations.explanation: 叔伯们啊，袖手旁观像塞满了耳朵。

interpretations.segmentation: O uncles and elders, you stand aloof as if your ears were stuffed.

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye.pinyin: pao2 you3 ku3 ye4， ji4 you3 shen1 she4。

interpretations.segmentation: 匏有苦叶，济有深涉。
interpretations.explanation: 葫芦带着苦叶，渡口有深水要渡。

interpretations.segmentation: The gourd has bitter leaves; at the ford lies a deep crossing.

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye.pinyin: shen1 ze2 li4， qian3 ze2 jie1。

interpretations.segmentation: 深则厉，浅则揭。
interpretations.explanation: 水深就连衣涉水，水浅就撩起衣摆。

interpretations.segmentation: If deep, wade with skirts tied up; if shallow, raise the hem.

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye.pinyin: you3 mi2 ji4 ying2， you3 yao3 zhi4 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有瀰济盈，有鷕雉鸣。
interpretations.explanation: 济水满溢，雄雉声声鸣叫。

interpretations.segmentation: The Ji overflows; the cock pheasant calls.

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye.content: 济盈不濡轨，雉鸣求其牡。
sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye.pinyin: ji4 ying2 bu4 ru2 gui3， zhi4 ming2 qiu2 qi2 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 济盈不濡轨，雉鸣求其牡。
interpretations.explanation: 水虽满却不湿车轴，雉鸣是在求其配偶。

interpretations.segmentation: Though full, it wets not the axle—the pheasant calls seeking its mate.

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye.pinyin: yong1 yong1 ming2 yan4， xu4 ri4 shi3 dan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 雍雍鸣雁，旭日始旦。
interpretations.explanation: 雁声雍雍，旭日刚刚升起。

interpretations.segmentation: Wild geese call harmoniously; the morning sun just rises.

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye.pinyin: shi4 ru2 gui1 qi1， dai4 bing1 wei4 pan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 士如归妻，迨冰未泮。
interpretations.explanation: 士人若要求妻，应趁冰未融化之时。

interpretations.segmentation: If a gentleman would take a wife, let him do it before the ice melts.

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye.pinyin: zhao1 zhao1 zhou1 zi， ren2 she4 ang2 fou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 招招舟子，人涉卬否。
interpretations.explanation: 船家招手唤人，别人渡河我是否渡？

interpretations.segmentation: The boatman beckons—others cross; shall I cross?

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye.pinyin: bu4 she4 ang2 fou3， ang2 xu1 wo3 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 不涉卬否，卬须我友。
interpretations.explanation: 别人不渡我也不渡，我要等我的朋友。

interpretations.segmentation: If others do not cross, I will not; I must wait for my friend.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui.pinyin: bi4 bi3 quan2 shui3， yi4 liu2 yu2 qi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 毖彼泉水，亦流于淇。
interpretations.explanation: 清澈的泉水汩汩流出，也流入淇水。

interpretations.segmentation: Clear spring water bubbles forth and flows into the Qi.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui.pinyin: you3 huai2 yu2 wei4， mi2 ri4 bu4 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有怀于卫，靡日不思。
interpretations.explanation: 心中怀念卫国，没有一天不想念。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart yearns for Wei—not a day passes without longing.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui.pinyin: luan2 bi3 zhu1 ji1， liao2 yu3 zhi1 mou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 娈彼诸姬，聊与之谋。
interpretations.explanation: 那些卫国的姬姓女子，姑且与她们商量。

interpretations.segmentation: Those Ji clanswomen of Wei—I will talk my plans over with them.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui.pinyin: chu1 su4 yu2 ji3， yin3 jian4 yu2 mi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 出宿于泲，饮饯于祢。
interpretations.explanation: 出宿在泲地，在祢地饮酒饯行。

interpretations.segmentation: I lodge at Ji on the way out; they give me a parting cup at Ni.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui.content: 女子有行，远父母兄弟，问我诸姑，遂及伯姊。
sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui.pinyin: nv3 zi you3 xing2， yuan3 fu4 mu3 xiong1 di4， wen4 wo3 zhu1 gu1， sui4 ji2 bo2 zi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 女子有行，远父母兄弟，问我诸姑，遂及伯姊。
interpretations.explanation: 女子出嫁远行，远离父母兄弟；我问候各位姑姑，也问到伯姊。

interpretations.segmentation: A woman travels far from parents and kin; I greet my aunts and elder sister too.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui.pinyin: chu1 su4 yu2 gan4， yin3 jian4 yu2 yan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 出宿于干，饮饯于言。
interpretations.explanation: 出宿在干地，在言地饮酒饯行。

interpretations.segmentation: I lodge at Gan on the way out; they give me a parting cup at Yan.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui.pinyin: zai4 zhi1 zai4 xia2， hai2 che1 yan2 mai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 载脂载辖，还车言迈。
interpretations.explanation: 涂好脂膏、装好车辖，转车就要上路。

interpretations.segmentation: I grease the axle and fit the linchpin; the returning cart sets out.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui.pinyin: chuan2 zhen1 yu2 wei4， bu4 xia2 you3 hai4？

interpretations.segmentation: 遄臻于卫，不瑕有害？
interpretations.explanation: 很快就能到卫国，该不会有灾祸吧？

interpretations.segmentation: Soon I reach Wei—surely no harm will come?

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui.pinyin: wo3 si1 fei2 quan2， zi1 zhi1 yong3 tan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我思肥泉，兹之永叹。
interpretations.explanation: 我思念肥泉，为此长久叹息。

interpretations.segmentation: I think of Fei Spring and sigh long for it.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui.pinyin: si1 xu1 yu3 cao2， wo3 xin1 you1 you1。

interpretations.segmentation: 思须与漕，我心悠悠。
interpretations.explanation: 思念须地与漕地，我的心悠悠不已。

interpretations.segmentation: I think of Xu and Cao—my heart is endlessly sad.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui.pinyin: jia4 yan2 chu1 you2， yi3 xie3 wo3 you1。

interpretations.segmentation: 驾言出游，以写我忧。
interpretations.explanation: 驾上车出游，以排遣心中的忧愁。

interpretations.segmentation: I drive out to wander and ease the sorrow in my heart.

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue.pinyin: ri4 ju1 yue4 zhu1， zhao4 lin2 xia4 tu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 日居月诸，照临下土。
interpretations.explanation: 太阳啊月亮啊，照临下方大地。

interpretations.segmentation: O sun and moon, you shine upon the earth below.

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue.pinyin: nai3 ru2 zhi1 ren2 xi1， shi4 bu4 gu3 chu4？

interpretations.segmentation: 乃如之人兮，逝不古处？
interpretations.explanation: 像这样的人啊，为何不像古人那样相处？

interpretations.segmentation: A man like this—why does he not dwell with me as men of old?
胡能有定？
interpretations.explanation: 什么时候才能定下来？

interpretations.segmentation: When will things be settled?
宁不我顾。
interpretations.explanation: 难道就不回头看我。

interpretations.segmentation: Will he not turn and look to me?

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue.pinyin: ri4 ju1 yue4 zhu1， xia4 tu3 shi4 mao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 日居月诸，下土是冒。
interpretations.explanation: 太阳啊月亮啊，照临下方土地。

interpretations.segmentation: O sun and moon, you cover the land below.

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue.pinyin: nai3 ru2 zhi1 ren2 xi1， shi4 bu4 xiang1 hao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃如之人兮，逝不相好。
interpretations.explanation: 像这样的人啊，为何不再与我相好。

interpretations.segmentation: A man like this—why will he no longer love me?
胡能有定？
interpretations.explanation: 什么时候才能定下来？

interpretations.segmentation: When will things be settled?
宁不我报。
interpretations.explanation: 难道就不回报我。

interpretations.segmentation: Will he not answer me in turn?

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue.pinyin: ri4 ju1 yue4 zhu1， chu1 zi4 dong1 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 日居月诸，出自东方。
interpretations.explanation: 太阳啊月亮啊，从东方升起。

interpretations.segmentation: O sun and moon, you rise from the east.

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue.pinyin: nai3 ru2 zhi1 ren2 xi1， de2 yin1 wu2 liang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃如之人兮，德音无良。
interpretations.explanation: 像这样的人啊，好话里却没有善良。

interpretations.segmentation: A man like this—fair words, yet no goodness in them.
胡能有定？
interpretations.explanation: 什么时候才能定下来？

interpretations.segmentation: When will things be settled?
俾也可忘。
interpretations.explanation: 使我也能把他忘掉。

interpretations.segmentation: So that I too may forget him.

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue.pinyin: ri4 ju1 yue4 zhu1， dong1 fang1 zi4 chu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 日居月诸，东方自出。
interpretations.explanation: 太阳啊月亮啊，从东方出来。

interpretations.segmentation: O sun and moon, you come forth from the east.

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue.pinyin: fu4 xi1 mu3 xi1， chu4 wo3 bu4 zu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 父兮母兮，畜我不卒。
interpretations.explanation: 父亲啊母亲啊，养我不终。

interpretations.segmentation: Father and mother, you reared me but not to the end.
胡能有定？
interpretations.explanation: 什么时候才能定下来？

interpretations.segmentation: When will things be settled?
报我不述。
interpretations.explanation: 回报我却不照实说。

interpretations.segmentation: You answer me, yet do not speak the truth.

sj-feng-beifeng-shiwei.pinyin: shi4 wei1， shi4 wei1， hu2 bu4 gui1？

interpretations.segmentation: 式微，式微，胡不归？
interpretations.explanation: 天黑了，天黑了，为什么还不回家？

interpretations.segmentation: Dark, dark—why do we not return home?

sj-feng-beifeng-shiwei.pinyin: wei1 jun1 zhi1 gu4， hu2 wei4 hu1 zhong1 lu4！

interpretations.segmentation: 微君之故，胡为乎中露！
interpretations.explanation: 若不是为君主的事，为什么在露水中劳作！

interpretations.segmentation: If not for our lord's sake, why toil in the open dew?

sj-feng-beifeng-shiwei.pinyin: shi4 wei1， shi4 wei1， hu2 bu4 gui1？

interpretations.segmentation: 式微，式微，胡不归？
interpretations.explanation: 天黑了，天黑了，为什么还不回家？

interpretations.segmentation: Dark, dark—why do we not return home?

sj-feng-beifeng-shiwei.pinyin: wei1 jun1 zhi1 gong1， hu2 wei4 hu1 ni2 zhong1！

interpretations.segmentation: 微君之躬，胡为乎泥中！
interpretations.explanation: 若不是为君主自身，为什么在泥里劳作！

interpretations.segmentation: If not for our lord himself, why work in the mud?

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai.pinyin: xin1 tai2 you3 ci3， he2 shui3 mi2 mi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 新台有泚，河水瀰瀰。
interpretations.explanation: 新台高大鲜明，河水满溢流淌。

interpretations.segmentation: The new tower gleams bright; the river brims and flows.

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai.pinyin: yan4 wan3 zhi1 qiu2， qu2 chu2 bu4 xian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 燕婉之求，蘧篨不鲜。
interpretations.explanation: 本想求得温柔和顺的佳人，得到的却是蓬头垢面的丑妇。

interpretations.segmentation: Seeking a gentle, graceful bride, he gets a unkempt, coarse woman instead.

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai.pinyin: xin1 tai2 you3 sa3， he2 shui3 mei3 mei3。

interpretations.segmentation: 新台有洒，河水浼浼。
interpretations.explanation: 新台高大开阔，河水奔流不息。

interpretations.segmentation: The new tower stands broad; the river rushes on.

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai.pinyin: yan4 wan3 zhi1 qiu2， qu2 chu2 bu4 tian3。

interpretations.segmentation: 燕婉之求，蘧篨不殄。
interpretations.explanation: 本想求得温柔和顺的佳人，得到的丑妇却未绝灭（仍占其位）。

interpretations.segmentation: Seeking a gentle bride, he gets one so ugly she should have perished—yet she remains.

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai.pinyin: yu2 wang3 zhi1 she4， hong2 ze2 li2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鱼网之设，鸿则离之。
interpretations.explanation: 鱼网已经张开，鸿雁却被网住。

interpretations.segmentation: The fish net is set, yet the wild swan is caught in it.

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai.pinyin: yan4 wan3 zhi1 qiu2， de2 ci3 qi1 shi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 燕婉之求，得此戚施。
interpretations.explanation: 本想求得温柔和顺的佳人，得到的却是驼背的丑人。

interpretations.segmentation: Seeking a gentle bride, he ends with this hunchback.

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi.pinyin: xiong2 zhi4 yu2 fei1， xie4 xie4 qi2 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 雄雉于飞，泄泄其羽。
interpretations.explanation: 雄雉在空中飞，缓缓扇动翅膀。

interpretations.segmentation: The cock pheasant flies, slowly spreading its wings.

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 huai2 yi3， zi4 yi2 yi1 zu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我之怀矣，自诒伊阻。
interpretations.explanation: 我心中有思念，这是自己招来的阻隔。

interpretations.segmentation: Longing fills my heart—I brought this barrier on myself.

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi.pinyin: xiong2 zhi4 yu2 fei1， xia4 shang4 qi2 yin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 雄雉于飞，下上其音。
interpretations.explanation: 雄雉在空中飞，上下鸣叫。

interpretations.segmentation: The cock pheasant flies, calling above and below.

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi.pinyin: zhan3 yi3 jun1 zi， shi2 lao2 wo3 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 展矣君子，实劳我心。
interpretations.explanation: 那君子啊，实在使我的心劳神。

interpretations.segmentation: That gentleman truly wears my heart with care.

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi.pinyin: zhan1 bi3 ri4 yue4， you1 you1 wo3 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻彼日月，悠悠我思。
interpretations.explanation: 望着那日月，我的思念悠长。

interpretations.segmentation: I gaze at sun and moon—my longing stretches far.

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi.pinyin: dao4 zhi1 yun2 yuan3， he2 yun2 neng2 lai2？

interpretations.segmentation: 道之云远，曷云能来？
interpretations.explanation: 道路如此遥远，什么时候才能再来？

interpretations.segmentation: The way is so distant—when can he come again?

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi.pinyin: bai3 er3 jun1 zi， bu4 zhi1 de2 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 百尔君子，不知德行。
interpretations.explanation: 你们这些君子，不懂得德行。

interpretations.segmentation: You gentlemen do not understand virtue.

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi.pinyin: bu4 zhi4 bu4 qiu2， he2 yong4 bu4 zang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不忮不求，何用不臧。
interpretations.explanation: 不嫉妒、不贪求，有什么不好呢。

interpretations.segmentation: Without envy or greed—what could be wrong?

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan.pinyin: yan4 yan4 yu2 fei1， cha4 chi2 qi2 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 燕燕于飞，差池其羽。
interpretations.explanation: 燕子飞来飞去，翅膀错落不齐。

interpretations.segmentation: Swallows fly to and fro, their wings uneven in flight.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan.pinyin: zhi1 zi yu2 gui1， yuan3 song4 yu2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 之子于归，远送于野。
interpretations.explanation: 这位姑娘要出嫁，远送到郊野。

interpretations.segmentation: This maiden goes to her new home; we send her far to the wilds.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan.pinyin: zhan1 wang4 fu2 ji2， qi4 ti4 ru2 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻望弗及，泣涕如雨。
interpretations.explanation: 望着已看不见她，眼泪像雨一样落下。

interpretations.segmentation: We watch until she is gone; tears fall like rain.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan.pinyin: yan4 yan4 yu2 fei1， jie2 zhi1 hang2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 燕燕于飞，颉之颃之。
interpretations.explanation: 燕子飞来飞去，一上一下。

interpretations.segmentation: Swallows fly to and fro, now up, now down.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan.pinyin: zhi1 zi yu2 gui1， yuan3 yu2 jiang1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 之子于归，远于将之。
interpretations.explanation: 这位姑娘要出嫁，远远送她离去。

interpretations.segmentation: This maiden goes to her new home; we escort her far away.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan.pinyin: zhan1 wang4 fu2 ji2， zhu4 li4 yi3 qi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻望弗及，伫立以泣。
interpretations.explanation: 望着已看不见她，伫立在那里哭泣。

interpretations.segmentation: We watch until she is gone; we stand and weep.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan.pinyin: yan4 yan4 yu2 fei1， xia4 shang4 qi2 yin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 燕燕于飞，下上其音。
interpretations.explanation: 燕子飞来飞去，上下鸣叫。

interpretations.segmentation: Swallows fly to and fro, calling above and below.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan.pinyin: zhi1 zi yu2 gui1， yuan3 song4 yu2 nan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 之子于归，远送于南。
interpretations.explanation: 这位姑娘要出嫁，远送到南方。

interpretations.segmentation: This maiden goes to her new home; we send her far to the south.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan.pinyin: zhan1 wang4 fu2 ji2， shi2 lao2 wo3 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻望弗及，实劳我心。
interpretations.explanation: 望着已看不见她，实在使我的心劳神。

interpretations.segmentation: We watch until she is gone—it truly wears my heart.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan.pinyin: zhong4 shi4 ren4 zhi3， qi2 xin1 sai1 yuan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 仲氏任只，其心塞渊。
interpretations.explanation: 仲氏诚实可信，心胸深广。

interpretations.segmentation: Zhong is steadfast; her heart is deep as a pool.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan.pinyin: zhong1 wen1 qie3 hui4， shu1 shen4 qi2 shen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 终温且惠，淑慎其身。
interpretations.explanation: 既温和又柔顺，谨慎守身。

interpretations.segmentation: Warm and gentle, she is pure and careful in conduct.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan.pinyin: xian1 jun1 zhi1 si1， yi3 xu4 gua3 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 先君之思，以勖寡人。
interpretations.explanation: 不忘先君之思，以此勉励我。

interpretations.segmentation: She remembers our late lord's wish and thus encourages me.

sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng.content: 终风且暴，顾我则笑，谑浪笑敖，中心是悼。
sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng.pinyin: zhong1 feng1 qie3 bao4， gu4 wo3 ze2 xiao4， xue4 lang4 xiao4 ao2， zhong1 xin1 shi4 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 终风且暴，顾我则笑，谑浪笑敖，中心是悼。
interpretations.explanation: 风整天狂暴，看见我反而笑，戏谑调笑，心中却满是悲伤。

interpretations.segmentation: All day the wind rages; seeing me he laughs—mocking and jeering—while my heart grieves.

sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng.content: 终风且霾，惠然肯来，莫往莫来，悠悠我思。
sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng.pinyin: zhong1 feng1 qie3 mai2， hui4 ran2 ken3 lai2， mo4 wang3 mo4 lai2， you1 you1 wo3 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 终风且霾，惠然肯来，莫往莫来，悠悠我思。
interpretations.explanation: 风整天灰蒙蒙，若肯温柔前来多好；不来也不去，我的思念悠长。

interpretations.segmentation: All day haze and wind; would he kindly come? Neither going nor coming—my thoughts stretch on.

sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng.content: 终风且曀，不日有曀，寤言不寐，愿言则嚏。
sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng.pinyin: zhong1 feng1 qie3 yi4， bu4 ri4 you3 yi4， wu4 yan2 bu4 mei4， yuan4 yan2 ze2 ti4。

interpretations.segmentation: 终风且曀，不日有曀，寤言不寐，愿言则嚏。
interpretations.explanation: 风整天阴云密布，不日更阴；醒来睡不着，想念他就打喷嚏。

interpretations.segmentation: All day cloudy wind; soon darker still. I wake and cannot sleep—missing him, I sneeze.

sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng.content: 曀曀其阴，虺虺其雷，寤言不寐，愿言则怀。
sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng.pinyin: yi4 yi4 qi2 yin1， hui1 hui1 qi2 lei2， wu4 yan2 bu4 mei4， yuan4 yan2 ze2 huai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 曀曀其阴，虺虺其雷，寤言不寐，愿言则怀。
interpretations.explanation: 阴云密布，雷声隐隐；醒来睡不着，想念他就心有所怀。

interpretations.segmentation: Dark clouds gather; thunder mutters. I wake and cannot sleep—missing him, my heart holds him close.

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao.content: 鸱鸮鸱鸮，既取我子，无毁我室。
sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao.pinyin: chi1 xiao1 chi1 xiao1， ji4 qu3 wo3 zi， wu2 hui3 wo3 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 鸱鸮鸱鸮，既取我子，无毁我室。
interpretations.explanation: 猫头鹰啊猫头鹰，你已经叼走我的孩子，不要再毁我的巢。

interpretations.segmentation: O owl, owl—you took my young; do not destroy my nest.

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao.pinyin: en1 si1 qin2 si1， yu4 zi zhi1 min3 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 恩斯勤斯，鬻子之闵斯。
interpretations.explanation: 恩爱勤劳啊，养子的可怜啊。

interpretations.segmentation: With love and toil—the pity of raising young!

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao.content: 迨天之未阴雨，彻彼桑土，绸缪牖户。
sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao.pinyin: dai4 tian1 zhi1 wei4 yin1 yu3， che4 bi3 sang1 tu3， chou2 mou2 you3 hu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 迨天之未阴雨，彻彼桑土，绸缪牖户。
interpretations.explanation: 趁还没下雨，剥取桑根皮，把窗户门扇牢牢扎好。

interpretations.segmentation: Before rain falls, strip mulberry bark and bind window and door tight.

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao.pinyin: jin1 nv3 xia4 min2， huo4 gan3 wu3 yu3？

interpretations.segmentation: 今女下民，或敢侮予？
interpretations.explanation: 如今你们这些下民，还敢欺侮我吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Now you folk below—dare you still insult me?

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao.pinyin: yu3 shou3 jie2 ju4， yu3 suo3 lv3 tu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 予手拮据，予所捋荼。
interpretations.explanation: 我手劳累，我所采的荼菜。

interpretations.segmentation: My hands are worn with work—the bitter herbs I pluck.

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao.content: 予所蓄租，予口卒瘏，曰予未有室家。
sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao.pinyin: yu3 suo3 xu4 zu1， yu3 kou3 zu2 tu2， yue1 yu3 wei4 you3 shi4 jia1。

interpretations.segmentation: 予所蓄租，予口卒瘏，曰予未有室家。
interpretations.explanation: 我所积蓄的柴草，我口劳瘁，说我还未成家有室。

interpretations.segmentation: The fuel I stored; my mouth is sore—they say I have no home yet.

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao.content: 予羽谯谯，予尾翛翛，予室翘翘。
sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao.pinyin: yu3 yu3 qiao2 qiao2， yu3 wei3 xiao1 xiao1， yu3 shi4 qiao4 qiao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 予羽谯谯，予尾翛翛，予室翘翘。
interpretations.explanation: 我的羽毛枯焦，我的尾巴残破，我的巢室高翘。

interpretations.segmentation: My feathers are tattered, my tail frayed, my nest stands high.

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao.content: 风雨所漂摇，予维音哓哓！
sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao.pinyin: feng1 yu3 suo3 piao1 yao2， yu3 wei2 yin1 xiao1 xiao1！

interpretations.segmentation: 风雨所漂摇，予维音哓哓！
interpretations.explanation: 在风雨中飘摇，我只能声声号叫！

interpretations.segmentation: Tossed in wind and rain—I can only cry out loud!

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: wo3 cu2 dong1 shan1， tao1 tao1 bu4 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我徂东山，慆慆不归。
interpretations.explanation: 我出征东山，久久不能回家。

interpretations.segmentation: I marched to the eastern hills and long did not return.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: wo3 lai2 zi4 dong1， ling2 yu3 qi2 meng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我来自东，零雨其濛。
interpretations.explanation: 我从东方回来，细雨蒙蒙。

interpretations.segmentation: I come from the east; fine rain drizzles down.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: wo3 dong1 yue1 gui1， wo3 xin1 xi1 bei1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我东曰归，我心西悲。
interpretations.explanation: 我向东边说归期，心却向西悲。

interpretations.segmentation: I say eastward I will return, but my heart grieves westward.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: zhi4 bi3 shang yi1， wu4 shi4 xing2 mei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 制彼裳衣，勿士行枚。
interpretations.explanation: 缝制那套衣裳，不再当兵衔枚。

interpretations.segmentation: I sew those garments—no more marching with gag in mouth.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: yuan1 yuan1 zhe3 zhu2， zheng1 zai4 sang1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 蜎蜎者蠋，烝在桑野。
interpretations.explanation: 蠕动的野蚕，成群在桑野。

interpretations.segmentation: Crawling caterpillars teem in the mulberry fields.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: dun1 bi3 du2 su4， yi4 zai4 che1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 敦彼独宿，亦在车下。
interpretations.explanation: 孤独地独宿，也在车下。

interpretations.segmentation: Alone I sleep—even beneath the cart.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: wo3 cu2 dong1 shan1， tao1 tao1 bu4 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我徂东山，慆慆不归。
interpretations.explanation: 我出征东山，久久不能回家。

interpretations.segmentation: I marched to the eastern hills and long did not return.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: wo3 lai2 zi4 dong1， ling2 yu3 qi2 meng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我来自东，零雨其濛。
interpretations.explanation: 我从东方回来，细雨蒙蒙。

interpretations.segmentation: I come from the east; fine rain drizzles down.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: guo3 luo3 zhi1 shi2， yi4 shi1 yu2 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 果臝之实，亦施于宇。
interpretations.explanation: 栝楼果实，也挂到屋檐下。

interpretations.segmentation: Gourd fruit hangs even under the eaves.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: yi1 wei1 zai4 shi4， xiao1 shao1 zai4 hu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 伊威在室，蠨蛸在户。
interpretations.explanation: 喜蛛在室内，蜘蛛在门边。

interpretations.segmentation: Longlegs in the room; spiders at the door.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: ting1 tun3 lu4 chang3， yi4 yao4 xiao1 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 町畽鹿场，熠耀宵行。
interpretations.explanation: 田鹿场里，萤火虫夜间闪亮。

interpretations.segmentation: On the field paths, fireflies gleam at night.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: bu4 ke3 wei4 ye3， yi1 ke3 huai2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 不可畏也，伊可怀也。
interpretations.explanation: 并不可怕啊，实在值得怀念。

interpretations.segmentation: Not to be feared—they are truly worth remembering.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: wo3 cu2 dong1 shan1， tao1 tao1 bu4 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我徂东山，慆慆不归。
interpretations.explanation: 我出征东山，久久不能回家。

interpretations.segmentation: I marched to the eastern hills and long did not return.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: wo3 lai2 zi4 dong1， ling2 yu3 qi2 meng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我来自东，零雨其濛。
interpretations.explanation: 我从东方回来，细雨蒙蒙。

interpretations.segmentation: I come from the east; fine rain drizzles down.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: guan4 ming2 yu2 die2， fu4 tan4 yu2 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 鹳鸣于垤，妇叹于室。
interpretations.explanation: 鹳鸟在土丘上鸣叫，妇人在室内叹息。

interpretations.segmentation: The stork calls on the mound; the wife sighs indoors.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: sa3 sao3 qiong2 zhi4， wo3 zheng1 yu4 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 洒扫穹窒，我征聿至。
interpretations.explanation: 洒扫洞室，我的征人就要到了。

interpretations.segmentation: She sweeps the hollow room—my soldier will soon arrive.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: you3 dun1 gua1 ku3， zheng1 zai4 li4 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有敦瓜苦，烝在栗薪。
interpretations.explanation: 苦瓠累累，堆在柴薪上。

interpretations.segmentation: Bitter gourds hang thick on the stacked firewood.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: zi4 wo3 bu4 jian4， yu2 jin1 san1 nian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 自我不见，于今三年。
interpretations.explanation: 自从见不到你，至今已经三年。

interpretations.segmentation: Since I last saw you, three years have passed.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: wo3 cu2 dong1 shan1， tao1 tao1 bu4 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我徂东山，慆慆不归。
interpretations.explanation: 我出征东山，久久不能回家。

interpretations.segmentation: I marched to the eastern hills and long did not return.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: wo3 lai2 zi4 dong1， ling2 yu3 qi2 meng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我来自东，零雨其濛。
interpretations.explanation: 我从东方回来，细雨蒙蒙。

interpretations.segmentation: I come from the east; fine rain drizzles down.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: cang1 geng1 yu2 fei1， yi4 yao4 qi2 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 仓庚于飞，熠耀其羽。
interpretations.explanation: 仓庚鸟在飞，羽毛闪闪发亮。

interpretations.segmentation: Orioles fly; their feathers shine bright.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: zhi1 zi yu2 gui1， huang2 bo2 qi2 ma3。

interpretations.segmentation: 之子于归，皇驳其马。
interpretations.explanation: 姑娘要出嫁，马儿斑驳多彩。

interpretations.segmentation: A maiden weds; the horses are dappled and fine.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: qin1 jie2 qi2 li2， jiu3 shi2 qi2 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 亲结其缡，九十其仪。
interpretations.explanation: 母亲为她结好婚带，礼仪齐全。

interpretations.segmentation: Her mother ties her wedding sash; rites are complete in every way.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan.pinyin: qi2 xin1 kong3 jia1， qi2 jiu4 ru2 zhi1 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 其新孔嘉，其旧如之何？
interpretations.explanation: 新嫁很好，旧妻又该怎么办呢？

interpretations.segmentation: The new bride is splendid—what of the old wife?
伐柯如何？
interpretations.explanation: 怎样砍斧柄？

interpretations.segmentation: How do we hew an axe handle?
匪斧不克。
interpretations.explanation: 没有斧子就砍不成。

interpretations.segmentation: Without an axe it cannot be done.
取妻如何？
interpretations.explanation: 怎样娶妻子？

interpretations.segmentation: How do we take a wife?
匪媒不得。
interpretations.explanation: 没有媒人就不成。

interpretations.segmentation: Without a go-between it cannot be done.

sj-feng-binfeng-fake.pinyin: fa2 ke1 fa2 ke1， qi2 ze2 bu4 yuan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 伐柯伐柯，其则不远。
interpretations.explanation: 砍斧柄啊砍斧柄，它的法则就在近处。

interpretations.segmentation: Hew the handle, hew the handle—the pattern is close at hand.

sj-feng-binfeng-fake.pinyin: wo3 gou4 zhi1 zi， bian1 dou4 you3 jian4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我觏之子，笾豆有践。
interpretations.explanation: 我见到那位姑娘，礼器摆列整齐。

interpretations.segmentation: I meet that maiden; platters and cups are set in order.

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu.pinyin: jiu3 yu4 zhi1 yu2， zun1 fang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 九罭之鱼，鳟鲂。
interpretations.explanation: 九罭之网捕到的，是鳟鱼和鲂鱼。

interpretations.segmentation: In the nine-meshed net are trout and bream.

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu.pinyin: wo3 gou4 zhi1 zi， gun3 yi1 xiu4 shang。

interpretations.segmentation: 我觏之子，衮衣绣裳。
interpretations.explanation: 我见到那位君子，穿着衮衣绣裳。

interpretations.segmentation: I meet that lord in robe and embroidered skirt.

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu.content: 鸿飞遵渚，公归无所，于女信处。
sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu.pinyin: hong2 fei1 zun1 zhu3， gong1 gui1 wu2 suo3， yu2 nv3 xin4 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 鸿飞遵渚，公归无所，于女信处。
interpretations.explanation: 鸿雁沿沙洲飞，公要归去无所栖，在此信处可安居。

interpretations.segmentation: Wild swans fly along the islet; the lord returns with nowhere to stay—here he may dwell in trust.

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu.content: 鸿飞遵六，公归不复，于女信宿。
sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu.pinyin: hong2 fei1 zun1 liu4， gong1 gui1 bu4 fu4， yu2 nv3 xin4 su4。

interpretations.segmentation: 鸿飞遵六，公归不复，于女信宿。
interpretations.explanation: 鸿雁沿渚岸飞，公要归去不再回，在此信宿可留连。

interpretations.segmentation: Wild swans fly along the bank; the lord returns no more—here he may lodge in trust.

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu.content: 是以有衮衣兮，无以我公归兮，无使我心悲兮。
sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu.pinyin: shi4 yi3 you3 gun3 yi1 xi1， wu2 yi3 wo3 gong1 gui1 xi1， wu2 shi3 wo3 xin1 bei1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 是以有衮衣兮，无以我公归兮，无使我心悲兮。
interpretations.explanation: 因此有这衮衣啊，不要让我公归去啊，不要使我的心悲啊。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus we have this grand robe—do not let our lord go home; do not break my heart with grief.

sj-feng-binfeng-langba.pinyin: lang2 ba2 qi2 hu2， zai4 zhi4 qi2 wei3。

interpretations.segmentation: 狼跋其胡，载疐其尾。
interpretations.explanation: 狼前进时踩着胡须，又绊住尾巴。

interpretations.segmentation: The wolf steps on its beard, then trips on its tail.

sj-feng-binfeng-langba.pinyin: gong1 sun1 shuo4 fu1， chi4 xi4 ji3 ji3。

interpretations.segmentation: 公孙硕肤，赤舄几几。
interpretations.explanation: 公孙皮肤丰腴，赤舄几几然。

interpretations.segmentation: Our lord's skin is full and smooth; his red shoes stand firm.

sj-feng-binfeng-langba.pinyin: lang2 zhi4 qi2 wei3， zai4 ba2 qi2 hu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 狼疐其尾，载跋其胡。
interpretations.explanation: 狼绊住尾巴，又踩着胡须。

interpretations.segmentation: The wolf trips on its tail, then steps on its beard.

sj-feng-binfeng-langba.pinyin: gong1 sun1 shuo4 fu1， de2 yin1 bu4 xia2？

interpretations.segmentation: 公孙硕肤，德音不瑕？
interpretations.explanation: 公孙皮肤丰腴，德行难道有瑕疵？

interpretations.segmentation: Our lord's skin is full and smooth—is there any flaw in his virtue?

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu.pinyin: ji4 po4 wo3 fu3， you4 que1 wo3 qiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 既破我斧，又缺我斨。
interpretations.explanation: 既打坏我的斧，又损缺我的凿。

interpretations.segmentation: They broke my axe and chipped my adze.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu.pinyin: zhou1 gong1 dong1 zheng1， si4 guo2 shi4 huang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 周公东征，四国是皇。
interpretations.explanation: 周公东征，安定四方之国。

interpretations.segmentation: The Duke of Zhou marched east and settled the four realms.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu.pinyin: ai1 wo3 ren2 si1， yi4 kong3 zhi1 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 哀我人斯，亦孔之将。
interpretations.explanation: 可怜我们这些人，也实在很刚强。

interpretations.segmentation: Pity us common folk—we too are very tough.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu.pinyin: ji4 po4 wo3 fu3， you4 que1 wo3 qi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既破我斧，又缺我锜。
interpretations.explanation: 既打坏我的斧，又损缺我的凿（锜）。

interpretations.segmentation: They broke my axe and chipped my chisel.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu.pinyin: zhou1 gong1 dong1 zheng1， si4 guo2 shi4 qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 周公东征，四国是遒。
interpretations.explanation: 周公东征，四方之国来归顺。

interpretations.segmentation: The Duke of Zhou marched east; the four realms submitted.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu.pinyin: ai1 wo3 ren2 si1， yi4 kong3 zhi1 jia1。

interpretations.segmentation: 哀我人斯，亦孔之嘉。
interpretations.explanation: 可怜我们这些人，也实在很好。

interpretations.segmentation: Pity us common folk—we too are very fine.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu.pinyin: ji4 po4 wo3 fu3， you4 que1 wo3 qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既破我斧，又缺我銶。
interpretations.explanation: 既打坏我的斧，又损缺我的矛头。

interpretations.segmentation: They broke my axe and chipped my spear-blade.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu.pinyin: zhou1 gong1 dong1 zheng1， si4 guo2 shi4 qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 周公东征，四国是遒。
interpretations.explanation: 周公东征，四方之国来归顺。

interpretations.segmentation: The Duke of Zhou marched east; the four realms submitted.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu.pinyin: ai1 wo3 ren2 si1， yi4 kong3 zhi1 xiu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 哀我人斯，亦孔之休。
interpretations.explanation: 可怜我们这些人，也实在美善。

interpretations.segmentation: Pity us common folk—we too are very good.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: qi1 yue4 liu2 huo3， jiu3 yue4 shou4 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 七月流火，九月授衣。
interpretations.explanation: 七月里大火星向西落，九月就该把寒衣发给人们了。

interpretations.segmentation: In the seventh month the Fire Star sets westward; in the ninth month winter clothes are handed out.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 一之日觱发，二之日栗烈。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: yi1 zhi1 ri4 bi4 fa1， er4 zhi1 ri4 li4 lie4。

interpretations.segmentation: 一之日觱发，二之日栗烈。
interpretations.explanation: 周历正月北风刺骨，二月寒气更加凛冽。

interpretations.segmentation: In the first month of Zhou the north wind bites; in the second month the cold is keener still.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: wu2 yi1 wu2 he4， he2 yi3 zu2 sui4？

interpretations.segmentation: 无衣无褐，何以卒岁？
interpretations.explanation: 没有衣服也没有粗布短衣，怎么熬过这一年？

interpretations.segmentation: With no coat and no coarse garment, how can we get through the year?

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 三之日于耜，四之日举趾。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: san1 zhi1 ri4 yu2 si4， si4 zhi1 ri4 ju3 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 三之日于耜，四之日举趾。
interpretations.explanation: 三月里修理农具，四月里就动身下地。

interpretations.segmentation: In the third month we mend the plough; in the fourth we set out to the fields.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: tong2 wo3 fu4 zi， ye4 bi3 nan2 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 同我妇子，馌彼南亩。
interpretations.explanation: 带着我的妻子儿女，到南边田里去送饭。

interpretations.segmentation: With my wife and children I carry food to the southern fields.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: tian2 jun4 zhi4 xi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 田畯至喜。
interpretations.explanation: 田官来了，十分欢喜。

interpretations.segmentation: The field overseer comes and is greatly pleased.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: qi1 yue4 liu2 huo3， jiu3 yue4 shou4 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 七月流火，九月授衣。
interpretations.explanation: 七月里大火星向西落，九月就该把寒衣发给人们了。

interpretations.segmentation: In the seventh month the Fire Star sets westward; in the ninth month winter clothes are handed out.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: chun1 ri4 zai4 yang2， you3 ming2 cang1 geng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 春日载阳，有鸣仓庚。
interpretations.explanation: 春天里阳光和煦，黄鹂鸟在鸣叫。

interpretations.segmentation: In spring the sun shines warm, and the oriole sings.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 女执懿筐，遵彼微行，爰求柔桑。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: nv3 zhi2 yi4 kuang1， zun1 bi3 wei1 xing2， yuan2 qiu2 rou2 sang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 女执懿筐，遵彼微行，爰求柔桑。
interpretations.explanation: 姑娘提着深筐，沿着小路去采嫩桑叶。

interpretations.segmentation: The girl takes a deep basket and, along the narrow path, goes to gather tender mulberry leaves.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: chun1 ri4 chi2 chi2， cai3 fan2 qi2 qi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 春日迟迟，采蘩祁祁。
interpretations.explanation: 春日漫长，姑娘们采白蒿，成群结队。

interpretations.segmentation: The spring day is long; girls gather felwort in great numbers.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 女心伤悲，殆及公子同归。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: nv3 xin1 shang1 bei1， dai4 ji2 gong1 zi tong2 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 女心伤悲，殆及公子同归。
interpretations.explanation: 姑娘心里悲伤，恐怕要随公子嫁去。

interpretations.segmentation: The girl's heart is sad, fearing she must go home with the lord's son.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: qi1 yue4 liu2 huo3， ba1 yue4 huan2 wei3。

interpretations.segmentation: 七月流火，八月萑苇。
interpretations.explanation: 七月里大火星向西落，八月里芦苇已长得茂密。

interpretations.segmentation: In the seventh month the Fire Star sets; in the eighth month reeds and rushes grow thick.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: can2 yue4 tiao2 sang1， qu3 bi3 fu3 qiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 蚕月条桑，取彼斧斨。
interpretations.explanation: 养蚕的月份要修剪桑枝，取来斧头与方刃斧。

interpretations.segmentation: In silkworm month we trim the mulberry; we take axe and adze.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: yi3 fa2 yuan3 yang2， yi1 bi3 nv3 sang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 以伐远扬，猗彼女桑。
interpretations.explanation: 砍去高处的枝条，嫩桑树多么茂盛。

interpretations.segmentation: We cut the far-reaching branches; how lush the young mulberry trees!

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: qi1 yue4 ming2 ju2， ba1 yue4 zai4 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 七月鸣鵙，八月载绩。
interpretations.explanation: 七月里伯劳鸟叫，八月里开始绩麻。

interpretations.segmentation: In the seventh month the shrike calls; in the eighth we begin spinning hemp.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 载玄载黄，我朱孔阳，为公子裳。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: zai4 xuan2 zai4 huang2， wo3 zhu1 kong3 yang2， wei4 gong1 zi shang。

interpretations.segmentation: 载玄载黄，我朱孔阳，为公子裳。
interpretations.explanation: 染出黑线黄线，我们的朱红格外鲜明，为公子做下裳。

interpretations.segmentation: We dye black and yellow threads; our crimson is bright indeed, to make the lord's lower robe.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: si4 yue4 xiu4 yao1， wu3 yue4 ming2 tiao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 四月秀葽，五月鸣蜩。
interpretations.explanation: 四月里远志开花，五月里蝉在鸣叫。

interpretations.segmentation: In the fourth month the plantain blooms; in the fifth the cicada sings.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: ba1 yue4 qi2 huo4， shi2 yue4 yun3 tuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 八月其获，十月陨萚。
interpretations.explanation: 八月里收获庄稼，十月里落叶纷纷。

interpretations.segmentation: In the eighth month we harvest; in the tenth the leaves fall.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 一之日于貉，取彼狐狸，为公子裘。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: yi1 zhi1 ri4 yu2 hao2， qu3 bi3 hu2 li2， wei4 gong1 zi qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 一之日于貉，取彼狐狸，为公子裘。
interpretations.explanation: 正月里去打貉，猎取狐狸，为公子做皮裘。

interpretations.segmentation: In the first month we hunt raccoon-dogs and foxes for the lord's fur coat.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: er4 zhi1 ri4 qi2 tong2， zai4 zuan3 wu3 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 二之日其同，载缵武功。
interpretations.explanation: 二月里众人会同狩猎，继续练武事。

interpretations.segmentation: In the second month all hunt together, carrying on martial practice.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: yan2 si1 qi2 zong1， xian4 jian1 yu2 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 言私其豵，献豜于公。
interpretations.explanation: 自己留下小猪，把大猪献给公家。

interpretations.segmentation: We keep the piglets for ourselves and present the boars to the lord.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 五月斯螽动股，六月莎鸡振羽。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: wu3 yue4 si1 zhong1 dong4 gu3， liu4 yue4 sha1 ji1 zhen4 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 五月斯螽动股，六月莎鸡振羽。
interpretations.explanation: 五月里螽斯弹动后股，六月里纺织娘振翅。

interpretations.segmentation: In the fifth month the katydid stirs its legs; in the sixth the grasshopper beats its wings.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 七月在野，八月在宇，九月在户，十月蟋蟀，入我床下。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: qi1 yue4 zai4 ye3， ba1 yue4 zai4 yu3， jiu3 yue4 zai4 hu4， shi2 yue4 xi1 shuai4， ru4 wo3 chuang2 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 七月在野，八月在宇，九月在户，十月蟋蟀，入我床下。
interpretations.explanation: 七月蟋蟀在野外，八月在檐下，九月在门内，十月钻进床下。

interpretations.segmentation: In the seventh month crickets are in the wild; in the eighth under the eaves; in the ninth at the door; in the tenth under the bed.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: qiong2 zhi4 xun1 shu3， sai1 xiang4 jin4 hu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 穹窒熏鼠，塞向墐户。
interpretations.explanation: 熏鼠洞堵向开，用泥把门缝抹严。

interpretations.segmentation: We fumigate mouse holes, block the north window, and seal the door.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 嗟我妇子，曰为改岁，入此室处。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: jie1 wo3 fu4 zi， yue1 wei4 gai3 sui4， ru4 ci3 shi4 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 嗟我妇子，曰为改岁，入此室处。
interpretations.explanation: 唉，我的妻子儿女，说到了改年，就搬进这屋里住。

interpretations.segmentation: Ah, my wife and children—when the year turns, we enter this room to dwell.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 六月食郁及薁，七月亨葵及菽。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: liu4 yue4 shi2 yu4 ji2 yu4， qi1 yue4 heng1 kui2 ji2 shu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 六月食郁及薁，七月亨葵及菽。
interpretations.explanation: 六月里吃李子和葡萄，七月里煮葵菜和豆类。

interpretations.segmentation: In the sixth month we eat plums and grapes; in the seventh we boil mallow and beans.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: ba1 yue4 bo1 zao3， shi2 yue4 huo4 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 八月剥枣，十月获稻。
interpretations.explanation: 八月里打枣，十月里收稻。

interpretations.segmentation: In the eighth month we pick dates; in the tenth we gather rice.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: wei4 ci3 chun1 jiu3， yi3 jie4 mei2 shou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 为此春酒，以介眉寿。
interpretations.explanation: 酿这春酒，用来祝老人长寿。

interpretations.segmentation: We brew this spring wine to wish the elders long life.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 七月食瓜，八月断壶，九月叔苴，采荼薪樗。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: qi1 yue4 shi2 gua1， ba1 yue4 duan4 hu2， jiu3 yue4 shu1 ju1， cai3 tu2 xin1 chu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 七月食瓜，八月断壶，九月叔苴，采荼薪樗。
interpretations.explanation: 七月里吃瓜，八月里断壶，九月里收麻子，采苦菜、砍臭椿当柴。

interpretations.segmentation: In the seventh we eat melons; in the eighth gather gourds; in the ninth pick hemp seed, gather sowthistle, and cut ailanthus for fuel.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: shi2 wo3 nong2 fu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 食我农夫。
interpretations.explanation: 养活我们这些农夫。

interpretations.segmentation: It sustains us farmers.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 九月筑场圃，十月纳禾稼。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: jiu3 yue4 zhu4 chang3 pu3， shi2 yue4 na4 he2 jia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 九月筑场圃，十月纳禾稼。
interpretations.explanation: 九月里筑场圃，十月里把禾稼收进场。

interpretations.segmentation: In the ninth month we build threshing floors; in the tenth we bring in the grain.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: shu3 ji4 zhong4 lu4， he2 ma2 shu1 mai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 黍稷重穋，禾麻菽麦。
interpretations.explanation: 黍稷重穋，还有禾、麻、豆、麦。

interpretations.segmentation: Millet, late millet, and also hemp, beans, and wheat.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 嗟我农夫，我稼既同，上入执宫功。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: jie1 wo3 nong2 fu1， wo3 jia4 ji4 tong2， shang4 ru4 zhi2 gong1 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 嗟我农夫，我稼既同，上入执宫功。
interpretations.explanation: 唉，我们农夫，庄稼都收齐了，还要上去服宫中的劳役。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, we farmers—when the crops are all in, we must go up to labor at the palace.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 昼尔于茅，宵尔索綯，亟其乘屋，其始播百谷。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: zhou4 er3 yu2 mao2， xiao1 er3 suo3 tao2， ji2 qi2 cheng2 wu1， qi2 shi3 bo1 bai3 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 昼尔于茅，宵尔索綯，亟其乘屋，其始播百谷。
interpretations.explanation: 白天割茅草，夜里搓绳，赶紧盖屋，好再播种百谷。

interpretations.segmentation: By day we cut thatch, by night we twist rope, hurry to roof the house, and sow the grains again.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 二之日凿冰冲冲，三之日纳于凌阴。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: er4 zhi1 ri4 zao2 bing1 chong1 chong1， san1 zhi1 ri4 na4 yu2 ling2 yin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 二之日凿冰冲冲，三之日纳于凌阴。
interpretations.explanation: 二月里凿冰咚咚响，三月里把冰送进冰窖。

interpretations.segmentation: In the second month we chop ice with a clang; in the third we store it in the ice house.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: si4 zhi1 ri4 qi2 zao3， xian4 gao1 ji4 jiu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 四之日其蚤，献羔祭韭。
interpretations.explanation: 四月里早起来，献羔羊、祭韭菜。

interpretations.segmentation: In the fourth month, rising early, we offer a lamb and leeks in sacrifice.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: jiu3 yue4 su4 shuang1， shi2 yue4 di2 chang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 九月肃霜，十月涤场。
interpretations.explanation: 九月里秋霜肃杀，十月里清扫场圃。

interpretations.segmentation: In the ninth month frost falls sharp; in the tenth we clean the threshing ground.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.content: 朋酒斯飨，曰杀羔羊，跻彼公堂。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: peng2 jiu3 si1 xiang3， yue1 sha1 gao1 yang2， ji1 bi3 gong1 tang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 朋酒斯飨，曰杀羔羊，跻彼公堂。
interpretations.explanation: 聚酒宴饮，杀羔羊，登上公堂。

interpretations.segmentation: We gather for a feast with wine, kill a lamb, and climb the lord's hall.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue.pinyin: cheng1 bi3 si4 gong1： wan4 shou4 wu2 jiang1！

interpretations.segmentation: 称彼兕觥：万寿无疆！
interpretations.explanation: 举起犀角杯：万寿无疆！

interpretations.segmentation: Raise the rhinoceros horn cup: may you live ten thousand years without end!

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou.pinyin: fu2 you2 zhi1 yu3， yi1 shang chu3 chu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 蜉蝣之羽，衣裳楚楚。
interpretations.explanation: 蜉蝣的翅膀，使衣裳显得鲜明整齐。

interpretations.segmentation: The mayfly's wings make its garments bright and neat.

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， yu2 wo3 gui1 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，于我归处。
interpretations.explanation: 内心忧愁啊，该到何处安身？

interpretations.segmentation: My heart is full of sorrow—where shall I find a resting place?

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou.pinyin: fu2 you2 zhi1 yi4， cai3 cai3 yi1 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 蜉蝣之翼，采采衣服。
interpretations.explanation: 蜉蝣的翅膀，色彩鲜明，衣服华美。

interpretations.segmentation: The mayfly's wings are bright; its clothes are fine.

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， yu2 wo3 gui1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，于我归息。
interpretations.explanation: 内心忧愁啊，该到哪里休息？

interpretations.segmentation: My heart is full of sorrow—where shall I find repose?

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou.pinyin: fu2 you2 jue2 yue4， ma2 yi1 ru2 xue3。

interpretations.segmentation: 蜉蝣掘阅，麻衣如雪。
interpretations.explanation: 蜉蝣刚刚钻出，麻衣洁白如雪。

interpretations.segmentation: The mayfly just emerges, its hemp robe white as snow.

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， yu2 wo3 gui1 shuo1。

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，于我归说。
interpretations.explanation: 内心忧愁啊，该向谁倾诉？

interpretations.segmentation: My heart is full of sorrow—to whom shall I unburden myself?

sj-feng-caofeng-houren.pinyin: bi3 hou4 ren2 xi1， he2 ge1 yu3 dui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼候人兮，何戈与祋。
interpretations.explanation: 那候望的人啊，为何拿着戈和祋？

interpretations.segmentation: That lookout—why does he carry spear and trident?

sj-feng-caofeng-houren.pinyin: bi3 qi2 zhi1 zi， san1 bai3 chi4 fei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼其之子，三百赤芾。
interpretations.explanation: 那些贵族子弟，有三百人身穿赤色蔽膝。

interpretations.segmentation: Those lordlings—three hundred in crimson knee-guards.

sj-feng-caofeng-houren.pinyin: wei2 ti2 zai4 liang2， bu4 ru2 qi2 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 维鹈在梁，不濡其翼。
interpretations.explanation: 鹈鹕站在鱼梁上，却不沾湿翅膀。

interpretations.segmentation: The pelican stands on the fish dam yet does not wet its wings.

sj-feng-caofeng-houren.pinyin: bi3 qi2 zhi1 zi， bu4 cheng1 qi2 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼其之子，不称其服。
interpretations.explanation: 那些贵族子弟，与其身份不相称。

interpretations.segmentation: Those lordlings—their rank does not match their dress.

sj-feng-caofeng-houren.pinyin: wei2 ti2 zai4 liang2， bu4 ru2 qi2 zhou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 维鹈在梁，不濡其咮。
interpretations.explanation: 鹈鹕站在鱼梁上，却不沾湿嘴。

interpretations.segmentation: The pelican stands on the fish dam yet does not wet its beak.

sj-feng-caofeng-houren.pinyin: bi3 qi2 zhi1 zi， bu4 sui4 qi2 gou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼其之子，不遂其媾。
interpretations.explanation: 那些贵族子弟，不配享受他们的恩宠。

interpretations.segmentation: Those lordlings—they do not deserve the favor they receive.

sj-feng-caofeng-houren.pinyin: hui4 xi1 wei4 xi1， nan2 shan1 chao2 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 荟兮蔚兮，南山朝隮。
interpretations.explanation: 草木茂盛，南山朝云升起。

interpretations.segmentation: Lush and thick the growth; on the southern hill morning clouds rise.

sj-feng-caofeng-houren.pinyin: wan3 xi1 luan2 xi1， ji4 nv3 si1 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 婉兮娈兮，季女斯饥。
interpretations.explanation: 温柔美丽啊，年轻姑娘正挨饿。

interpretations.segmentation: Gentle and fair—the young girl goes hungry.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu.pinyin: shi1 jiu1 zai4 sang1， qi2 zi qi1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鳲鸠在桑，其子七兮。
interpretations.explanation: 斑鸠在桑树上，它的孩子有七个。

interpretations.segmentation: The turtledove is in the mulberry; its brood numbers seven.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu.pinyin: shu1 ren2 jun1 zi， qi2 yi2 yi1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 淑人君子，其仪一兮。
interpretations.explanation: 贤德的君子，他的仪态始终如一。

interpretations.segmentation: The good and noble man keeps one uniform bearing.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu.pinyin: qi2 yi2 yi1 xi1， xin1 ru2 jie2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 其仪一兮，心如结兮。
interpretations.explanation: 仪态始终如一，内心专一坚定。

interpretations.segmentation: His bearing is one; his heart is firm as a knot.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu.pinyin: shi1 jiu1 zai4 sang1， qi2 zi zai4 mei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鳲鸠在桑，其子在梅。
interpretations.explanation: 斑鸠在桑树上，它的孩子在梅树间。

interpretations.segmentation: The turtledove is in the mulberry; its young are among the plum trees.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu.pinyin: shu1 ren2 jun1 zi， qi2 dai4 yi1 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 淑人君子，其带伊丝。
interpretations.explanation: 贤德的君子，他的腰带是丝织的。

interpretations.segmentation: The good and noble man wears a silk girdle.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu.pinyin: qi2 dai4 yi1 si1， qi2 bian4 yi1 qi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 其带伊丝，其弁伊骐。
interpretations.explanation: 丝织的腰带，皮弁上饰有青黑纹。

interpretations.segmentation: A silk girdle; on his cap, dark patterned trim.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu.pinyin: shi1 jiu1 zai4 sang1， qi2 zi zai4 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鳲鸠在桑，其子在棘。
interpretations.explanation: 斑鸠在桑树上，它的孩子在荆棘间。

interpretations.segmentation: The turtledove is in the mulberry; its young are among the thorns.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu.pinyin: shu1 ren2 jun1 zi， qi2 yi2 bu4 te4。

interpretations.segmentation: 淑人君子，其仪不忒。
interpretations.explanation: 贤德的君子，他的仪态没有差错。

interpretations.segmentation: The good and noble man—his conduct never errs.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu.pinyin: qi2 yi2 bu4 te4， zheng4 shi4 si4 guo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 其仪不忒，正是四国。
interpretations.explanation: 仪态没有差错，正是四国的榜样。

interpretations.segmentation: Without error in bearing, he is the model for the four states.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu.pinyin: shi1 jiu1 zai4 sang1， qi2 zi zai4 zhen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鳲鸠在桑，其子在榛。
interpretations.explanation: 斑鸠在桑树上，它的孩子在榛树下。

interpretations.segmentation: The turtledove is in the mulberry; its young are under the hazel.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu.content: 淑人君子，正是国人，正是国人。
sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu.pinyin: shu1 ren2 jun1 zi， zheng4 shi4 guo2 ren2， zheng4 shi4 guo2 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 淑人君子，正是国人，正是国人。
interpretations.explanation: 贤德的君子，正是国人的表率，正是国人的表率。

interpretations.segmentation: The good and noble man is the people's standard—yes, the people's standard.
胡不万年？
interpretations.explanation: 为何不祝他万年长寿？

interpretations.segmentation: Why not wish him ten thousand years of life?

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan.pinyin: lie4 bi3 xia4 quan2， jin4 bi3 bao1 lang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 冽彼下泉，浸彼苞稂。
interpretations.explanation: 清冷的泉水，浸泡着丛生的狼尾草。

interpretations.segmentation: Cold is the spring below; it soaks the tufted barnyard grass.

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan.pinyin: kai4 wo3 wu4 tan4， nian4 bi3 zhou1 jing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 忾我寤叹，念彼周京。
interpretations.explanation: 醒来长叹，怀念那周朝京都。

interpretations.segmentation: Awake I sigh deeply, thinking of the capital of Zhou.

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan.pinyin: lie4 bi3 xia4 quan2， jin4 bi3 bao1 xiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 冽彼下泉，浸彼苞萧。
interpretations.explanation: 清冷的泉水，浸泡着丛生的艾蒿。

interpretations.segmentation: Cold is the spring below; it soaks the tufted wormwood.

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan.pinyin: kai4 wo3 wu4 tan4， nian4 bi3 jing1 zhou1。

interpretations.segmentation: 忾我寤叹，念彼京周。
interpretations.explanation: 醒来长叹，怀念那周京。

interpretations.segmentation: Awake I sigh deeply, thinking of the Zhou capital.

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan.pinyin: lie4 bi3 xia4 quan2， jin4 bi3 bao1 shi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 冽彼下泉，浸彼苞蓍。
interpretations.explanation: 清冷的泉水，浸泡着丛生的蓍草。

interpretations.segmentation: Cold is the spring below; it soaks the tufted yarrow.

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan.pinyin: kai4 wo3 wu4 tan4， nian4 bi3 jing1 shi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 忾我寤叹，念彼京师。
interpretations.explanation: 醒来长叹，怀念那京师。

interpretations.segmentation: Awake I sigh deeply, thinking of the royal capital.

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan.pinyin: peng2 peng2 shu3 miao2， yin1 yu3 gao1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 芃芃黍苗，阴雨膏之。
interpretations.explanation: 黍苗长得茂盛，阴雨滋润它。

interpretations.segmentation: Luxuriant grow the millet shoots, nourished by rainy dew.

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan.pinyin: si4 guo2 you3 wang2， huan2 bo2 lao2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 四国有王，郇伯劳之。
interpretations.explanation: 四方有王，郇伯来慰劳他们。

interpretations.segmentation: The four regions have a king; Lord Xun labors to comfort them.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi.pinyin: dong1 men2 zhi1 chi2， ke3 yi3 ou1 ma2。

interpretations.segmentation: 东门之池，可以沤麻。
interpretations.explanation: 东门外有池塘，可以在里面沤麻。

interpretations.segmentation: By the east gate is a pool where hemp may be steeped.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi.pinyin: bi3 mei3 shu1 ji1， ke3 yu3 wu4 ge1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼美淑姬，可与晤歌。
interpretations.explanation: 那美丽贤淑的姑娘，可以和她对歌。

interpretations.segmentation: That fair and good maiden—we may sing with her.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi.pinyin: dong1 men2 zhi1 chi2， ke3 yi3 ou1 zhu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 东门之池，可以沤纻。
interpretations.explanation: 东门外有池塘，可以在里面沤苎。

interpretations.segmentation: By the east gate is a pool where ramie may be steeped.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi.pinyin: bi3 mei3 shu1 ji1， ke3 yu3 wu4 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼美淑姬，可与晤语。
interpretations.explanation: 那美丽贤淑的姑娘，可以和她交谈。

interpretations.segmentation: That fair and good maiden—we may talk with her.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi.pinyin: dong1 men2 zhi1 chi2， ke3 yi3 ou1 jian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 东门之池，可以沤菅。
interpretations.explanation: 东门外有池塘，可以在里面沤菅草。

interpretations.segmentation: By the east gate is a pool where sedge may be steeped.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi.pinyin: bi3 mei3 shu1 ji1， ke3 yu3 wu4 yan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼美淑姬，可与晤言。
interpretations.explanation: 那美丽贤淑的姑娘，可以和她畅言。

interpretations.segmentation: That fair and good maiden—we may speak freely with her.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen.pinyin: dong1 men2 zhi1 fen2， wan3 qiu1 zhi1 xu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 东门之枌，宛丘之栩。
interpretations.explanation: 东门的白榆，宛丘的柞树。

interpretations.segmentation: The elm at the east gate, the oak on Wan Hill.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen.pinyin: zi zhong4 zhi1 zi， po2 suo1 qi2 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 子仲之子，婆娑其下。
interpretations.explanation: 子仲家的姑娘，在树下翩翩起舞。

interpretations.segmentation: The girl of Zizhong's house dances gracefully beneath them.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen.pinyin: gu3 dan4 yu2 cha4， nan2 fang1 zhi1 yuan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 穀旦于差，南方之原。
interpretations.explanation: 选个吉日，到南边的原野去。

interpretations.segmentation: On a chosen good day we go to the southern plain.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen.pinyin: bu4 ji4 qi2 ma2， shi4 ye3 po2 suo1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不绩其麻，市也婆娑。
interpretations.explanation: 不绩麻了，在集市上跳舞。

interpretations.segmentation: She does not spin hemp; at the market she dances.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen.pinyin: gu3 dan4 yu2 shi4， yue4 yi3 zong1 mai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 穀旦于逝，越以鬷迈。
interpretations.explanation: 吉日已逝，越地人带着礼物来。

interpretations.segmentation: The good day has passed; men from Yue come with gifts.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen.pinyin: shi4 er3 ru2 qiao2， yi2 wo3 wo4 jiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 视尔如荍，贻我握椒。
interpretations.explanation: 看你像锦葵一样美，赠我一把花椒。

interpretations.segmentation: I see you lovely as mallow; you give me a handful of pepper.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhiyang.pinyin: dong1 men2 zhi1 yang2， qi2 ye4 zang1 zang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 东门之杨，其叶牂牂。
interpretations.explanation: 东门的白杨，叶子多么茂盛。

interpretations.segmentation: The poplar at the east gate—how lush its leaves!

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhiyang.pinyin: hun1 yi3 wei4 qi1， ming2 xing1 huang2 huang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 昏以为期，明星煌煌。
interpretations.explanation: 黄昏为约会之时，明星明亮闪耀。

interpretations.segmentation: Twilight was our tryst; the stars blaze bright.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhiyang.pinyin: dong1 men2 zhi1 yang2， qi2 ye4 fei4 fei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 东门之杨，其叶肺肺。
interpretations.explanation: 东门的白杨，叶子多么繁密。

interpretations.segmentation: The poplar at the east gate—how thick its foliage!

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhiyang.pinyin: hun1 yi3 wei4 qi1， ming2 xing1 zhe2 zhe2。

interpretations.segmentation: 昏以为期，明星晢晢。
interpretations.explanation: 黄昏为约会之时，明星清朗可见。

interpretations.segmentation: Twilight was our tryst; the stars shine clear.

sj-feng-chenfeng-fangyouquechao.pinyin: fang2 you3 que4 chao2， qiong2 you3 zhi3 shao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 防有鹊巢，邛有旨苕。
interpretations.explanation: 堤上有鹊巢，土丘上有美苕。

interpretations.segmentation: On the dyke—a magpie's nest; on the mound—fine reed grass.
谁侜予美？
interpretations.explanation: 谁在诽谤我的爱人？

interpretations.segmentation: Who slanders my beloved?
心焉忉忉。
interpretations.explanation: 心中多么忧伤。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart is torn with grief.

sj-feng-chenfeng-fangyouquechao.pinyin: zhong1 tang2 you3 pi4， qiong2 you3 zhi3 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 中唐有甓，邛有旨鷊。
interpretations.explanation: 院中铺有砖，土丘上有美鹳。

interpretations.segmentation: In the courtyard are tiles; on the mound—a fine heron.
谁侜予美？
interpretations.explanation: 谁在诽谤我的爱人？

interpretations.segmentation: Who slanders my beloved?
心焉惕惕。
interpretations.explanation: 心中多么惊惧。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart is full of fear.

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen.pinyin: heng2 men2 zhi1 xia4， ke3 yi3 qi1 chi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 衡门之下，可以栖迟。
interpretations.explanation: 横木为门之下，可以栖身安居。

interpretations.segmentation: Beneath a simple crossbeam gate one may dwell at ease.

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen.pinyin: mi4 zhi1 yang2 yang2， ke3 yi3 le4 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 泌之洋洋，可以乐饥。
interpretations.explanation: 泌水洋洋流淌，可以解饥为乐。

interpretations.segmentation: The Bi waters flow wide—enough to ease hunger with joy.

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen.pinyin: qi3 qi2 shi2 yu2， bi4 he2 zhi1 fang2？

interpretations.segmentation: 岂其食鱼，必河之鲂？
interpretations.explanation: 难道吃鱼，一定要黄河的鲂鱼？

interpretations.segmentation: Must one eat only bream from the Yellow River?

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen.pinyin: qi3 qi2 qu3 qi1， bi4 qi2 zhi1 jiang1？

interpretations.segmentation: 岂其取妻，必齐之姜？
interpretations.explanation: 难道娶妻，一定要齐国的姜女？

interpretations.segmentation: Must one wed only a Jiang girl from Qi?

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen.pinyin: qi3 qi2 shi2 yu2， bi4 he2 zhi1 li3？

interpretations.segmentation: 岂其食鱼，必河之鲤？
interpretations.explanation: 难道吃鱼，一定要黄河的鲤鱼？

interpretations.segmentation: Must one eat only carp from the Yellow River?

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen.pinyin: qi3 qi2 qu3 qi1， bi4 song4 zhi1 zi？

interpretations.segmentation: 岂其取妻，必宋之子？
interpretations.explanation: 难道娶妻，一定要宋国的姑娘？

interpretations.segmentation: Must one wed only a girl from Song?

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen.pinyin: mu4 men2 you3 ji2， fu3 yi3 si1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 墓门有棘，斧以斯之。
