interpretations.explanation: 墓门有荆棘，用斧子来砍伐。

interpretations.segmentation: At the grave gate are thorns—cut them with the axe.

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen.pinyin: fu1 ye3 bu4 liang2， guo2 ren2 zhi1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫也不良，国人知之。
interpretations.explanation: 这个人不好，国中人都知道。

interpretations.segmentation: This man is wicked; all in the state know it.

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen.pinyin: zhi1 er2 bu4 yi3， shui2 xi1 ran2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 知而不已，谁昔然矣。
interpretations.explanation: 知道却不制止，是谁从前纵容的？

interpretations.segmentation: Knowing yet not stopping—who indulged him long ago?

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen.pinyin: mu4 men2 you3 mei2， you3 xiao1 cui4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 墓门有梅，有鸮萃止。
interpretations.explanation: 墓门有梅树，有猫头鹰聚集栖息。

interpretations.segmentation: At the grave gate is a plum tree; owls gather there.

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen.pinyin: fu1 ye3 bu4 liang2， ge1 yi3 xun4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夫也不良，歌以讯之。
interpretations.explanation: 这个人不好，用歌来告诫他。

interpretations.segmentation: This man is wicked—I warn him in song.

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen.pinyin: xun4 yu3 bu4 gu4， dian1 dao4 si1 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 讯予不顾，颠倒思予。
interpretations.explanation: 告诫他却不听，颠倒过来还怨我。

interpretations.segmentation: He heeds no warning; turned upside down, he blames me.

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu.pinyin: zi zhi1 tang1 xi1， wan3 qiu1 zhi1 shang4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 子之汤兮，宛丘之上兮。
interpretations.explanation: 你游荡啊，在宛丘之上。

interpretations.segmentation: You wander there on the top of Wan Hill.

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu.pinyin: xun2 you3 qing2 xi1， er2 wu2 wang4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 洵有情兮，而无望兮。
interpretations.explanation: 确实有情意，却没有希望。

interpretations.segmentation: Truly you have feeling, yet there is no hope.

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu.pinyin: kan3 qi2 ji1 gu3， wan3 qiu1 zhi1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 坎其击鼓，宛丘之下。
interpretations.explanation: 击鼓声坎坎，在宛丘之下。

interpretations.segmentation: Drums beat steadily below Wan Hill.

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu.pinyin: wu2 dong1 wu2 xia4， zhi2 qi2 lu4 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 无冬无夏，值其鹭羽。
interpretations.explanation: 不论冬夏，都举着鹭羽舞蹈。

interpretations.segmentation: Winter or summer, they dance holding egret plumes.

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu.pinyin: kan3 qi2 ji1 fou3， wan3 qiu1 zhi1 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 坎其击缶，宛丘之道。
interpretations.explanation: 击缶声坎坎，在宛丘的大道上。

interpretations.segmentation: Pot-drums beat on the road of Wan Hill.

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu.pinyin: wu2 dong1 wu2 xia4， zhi2 qi2 lu4 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 无冬无夏，值其鹭翿。
interpretations.explanation: 不论冬夏，都举着鹭翿舞蹈。

interpretations.segmentation: Winter or summer, they dance holding egret fans.
月出皎兮。
interpretations.explanation: 月亮出来多么明亮。

interpretations.segmentation: The moon comes out, bright and clear.
佼人僚兮。
interpretations.explanation: 美人仪容美好。

interpretations.segmentation: The fair one's beauty is splendid.
舒窈纠兮。
interpretations.explanation: 体态轻盈窈窕。

interpretations.segmentation: Her figure is graceful and slender.
劳心悄兮。
interpretations.explanation: 劳心思念，悄悄忧伤。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart labors; I am quietly sad.
月出皓兮。
interpretations.explanation: 月亮出来多么皓洁。

interpretations.segmentation: The moon comes out, pure and white.
佼人懰兮。
interpretations.explanation: 美人仪容美好。

interpretations.segmentation: The fair one's beauty is lovely.
舒忧受兮。
interpretations.explanation: 体态舒缓优美。

interpretations.segmentation: Her bearing is relaxed and fine.
劳心慅兮。
interpretations.explanation: 劳心思念，忧愁不安。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart labors; I am restless with care.
月出照兮。
interpretations.explanation: 月亮出来照耀大地。

interpretations.segmentation: The moon comes out and shines on all.
佼人燎兮。
interpretations.explanation: 美人仪容鲜明。

interpretations.segmentation: The fair one's beauty is radiant.
舒夭绍兮。
interpretations.explanation: 体态轻盈柔美。

interpretations.segmentation: Her figure is light and gracefully long.
劳心惨兮。
interpretations.explanation: 劳心思念，忧伤惨切。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart labors; my grief is bitter.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei.pinyin: bi3 ze2 zhi1 bei1， you3 pu2 yu3 he2。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼泽之陂，有蒲与荷。
interpretations.explanation: 那池塘的堤岸，有蒲草和荷花。

interpretations.segmentation: On the bank of that marsh are cattail and lotus.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei.pinyin: you3 mei3 yi1 ren2， shang1 ru2 zhi1 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 有美一人，伤如之何？
interpretations.explanation: 有一个美人，我思念她该怎么办？

interpretations.segmentation: There is a fair one—how can I bear longing for her?

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei.pinyin: wu4 mei4 wu2 wei4， ti4 si4 pang1 tuo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 寤寐无为，涕泗滂沱。
interpretations.explanation: 醒也睡也无所作为，眼泪滂沱而下。

interpretations.segmentation: Waking or sleeping I can do nothing; tears pour in streams.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei.pinyin: bi3 ze2 zhi1 bei1， you3 pu2 yu3 jian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼泽之陂，有蒲与蕳。
interpretations.explanation: 那池塘的堤岸，有蒲草和兰草。

interpretations.segmentation: On the bank of that marsh are cattail and orchid grass.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei.pinyin: you3 mei3 yi1 ren2， shuo4 da4 qie3 juan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有美一人，硕大且卷。
interpretations.explanation: 有一个美人，身材高大而卷发。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a fair one, tall and with curling hair.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei.pinyin: wu4 mei4 wu2 wei4， zhong1 xin1 yuan1 yuan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 寤寐无为，中心悁悁。
interpretations.explanation: 醒也睡也无所作为，心中郁闷忧愁。

interpretations.segmentation: Waking or sleeping I can do nothing; my heart is troubled and sad.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei.pinyin: bi3 ze2 zhi1 bei1， you3 pu2 han4 dan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼泽之陂，有蒲菡萏。
interpretations.explanation: 那池塘的堤岸，有蒲和荷花。

interpretations.segmentation: On the bank of that marsh are cattail and lotus bloom.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei.pinyin: you3 mei3 yi1 ren2， shuo4 da4 qie3 yan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有美一人，硕大且俨。
interpretations.explanation: 有一个美人，身材高大而庄重。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a fair one, tall and dignified.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei.pinyin: wu4 mei4 wu2 wei4， nian3 zhuan3 fu2 zhen3。

interpretations.segmentation: 寤寐无为，辗转伏枕。
interpretations.explanation: 醒也睡也无所作为，辗转伏在枕上。

interpretations.segmentation: Waking or sleeping I can do nothing; I toss and lie on my pillow.
胡为乎株林？
interpretations.explanation: 为什么到株林去？

interpretations.segmentation: Why go to the Zhi grove?
从夏南！
interpretations.explanation: 是为了追随夏南！

interpretations.segmentation: To follow Xia Nan!

sj-feng-chenfeng-zhulin.pinyin: fei3 shi4 zhu1 lin2， cong2 xia4 nan2！

interpretations.segmentation: 匪适株林，从夏南！
interpretations.explanation: 不是要到株林，是为了追随夏南！

interpretations.segmentation: Not to reach Zhi grove—to follow Xia Nan!

sj-feng-chenfeng-zhulin.pinyin: jia4 wo3 cheng2 ma3， shuo1 yu2 zhu1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 驾我乘马，说于株野。
interpretations.explanation: 驾我的四马，在株野停息。

interpretations.segmentation: Drive my team of four; rest at Zhi wilds.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zhulin.pinyin: cheng2 wo3 cheng2 ju1， chao2 shi2 yu2 zhu1！

interpretations.segmentation: 乘我乘驹，朝食于株！
interpretations.explanation: 骑我的马驹，在株地吃早饭！

interpretations.segmentation: Ride my colts; take morning meal at Zhi!

sj-feng-guifeng-feifeng.pinyin: fei3 feng1 fa1 xi1， fei3 che1 ji4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪风发兮，匪车偈兮。
interpretations.explanation: 不是风在刮，不是车在急驰。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not the wind rising; it is not the cart rushing.

sj-feng-guifeng-feifeng.pinyin: gu4 zhan1 zhou1 dao4， zhong1 xin1 da2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 顾瞻周道，中心怛兮。
interpretations.explanation: 回头望周道，心中悲苦。

interpretations.segmentation: I look back at the Zhou road; my heart is sore.

sj-feng-guifeng-feifeng.pinyin: fei3 feng1 piao1 xi1， fei3 che1 piao4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪风飘兮，匪车嘌兮。
interpretations.explanation: 不是风在飘，不是车在轻驰。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not the wind drifting; it is not the cart gliding.

sj-feng-guifeng-feifeng.pinyin: gu4 zhan1 zhou1 dao4， zhong1 xin1 diao4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 顾瞻周道，中心吊兮。
interpretations.explanation: 回头望周道，心中哀悼。

interpretations.segmentation: I look back at the Zhou road; my heart mourns.
谁能亨鱼？
interpretations.explanation: 谁能烹鱼？

interpretations.segmentation: Who can cook the fish?
溉之釜鬵。
interpretations.explanation: 要洗净锅和鬵。

interpretations.segmentation: One must wash the pot and cauldron.
谁将西归？
interpretations.explanation: 谁将要西归？

interpretations.segmentation: Who will go westward home?
怀之好音。
interpretations.explanation: 怀念那好音讯。

interpretations.segmentation: I cherish the good word from afar.

sj-feng-guifeng-gaoqiu.pinyin: gao1 qiu2 xiao1 yao2， hu2 qiu2 yi3 chao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 羔裘逍遥，狐裘以朝。
interpretations.explanation: 穿着羔裘逍遥，穿着狐裘上朝。

interpretations.segmentation: In lamb fur he roams at ease; in fox fur he attends court.
岂不尔思？
interpretations.explanation: 难道不想念你吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Do I not think of you?
劳心忉忉。
interpretations.explanation: 劳心忧伤啊。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart labors; I am deeply grieved.

sj-feng-guifeng-gaoqiu.pinyin: gao1 qiu2 ao2 xiang2， hu2 qiu2 zai4 tang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 羔裘翱翔，狐裘在堂。
interpretations.explanation: 穿着羔裘翱翔，狐裘放在堂上。

interpretations.segmentation: In lamb fur he ranges free; fox fur hangs in the hall.
岂不尔思？
interpretations.explanation: 难道不想念你吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Do I not think of you?
我心忧伤。
interpretations.explanation: 我的心中忧伤。

interpretations.segmentation: Sorrow fills my heart.

sj-feng-guifeng-gaoqiu.pinyin: gao1 qiu2 ru2 gao1， ri4 chu1 you3 yao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 羔裘如膏，日出有曜。
interpretations.explanation: 羔裘像油脂一样润泽，太阳出来闪闪发光。

interpretations.segmentation: Lamb fur glossy as grease; when the sun rises it gleams.
岂不尔思？
interpretations.explanation: 难道不想念你吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Do I not think of you?
中心是悼。
interpretations.explanation: 心中只有哀悼。

interpretations.segmentation: In my heart is nothing but mourning.

sj-feng-guifeng-suguan.content: 庶见素冠兮，棘人栾栾兮。
sj-feng-guifeng-suguan.pinyin: shu4 jian4 su4 guan1 xi1， ji2 ren2 luan2 luan2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 庶见素冠兮，棘人栾栾兮。
interpretations.explanation: 希望能见到戴素冠的人，棘丛中人瘦骨嶙峋。

interpretations.segmentation: Would I might see him in the white mourning cap—among thorns, wasted and thin.
劳心慱慱兮。
interpretations.explanation: 劳心忧思啊。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart labors with anxious care.

sj-feng-guifeng-suguan.content: 庶见素衣兮，我心伤悲兮。
sj-feng-guifeng-suguan.pinyin: shu4 jian4 su4 yi1 xi1， wo3 xin1 shang1 bei1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 庶见素衣兮，我心伤悲兮。
interpretations.explanation: 希望能见到穿素衣的人，我的心中悲伤。

interpretations.segmentation: Would I might see him in white robes—grief fills my heart.

sj-feng-guifeng-suguan.pinyin: liao2 yu3 zi tong2 gui1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 聊与子同归兮。
interpretations.explanation: 姑且与你同归吧。

interpretations.segmentation: Let me go home with you for a while.

sj-feng-guifeng-suguan.content: 庶见素韠兮，我心蕴结兮。
sj-feng-guifeng-suguan.pinyin: shu4 jian4 su4 bi4 xi1， wo3 xin1 yun4 jie2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 庶见素韠兮，我心蕴结兮。
interpretations.explanation: 希望能见到穿素蔽膝的人，我的心中郁结。

interpretations.segmentation: Would I might see him in white knee-guards—knots bind my heart.

sj-feng-guifeng-suguan.pinyin: liao2 yu3 zi ru2 yi1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 聊与子如一兮。
interpretations.explanation: 姑且与你如一吧。

interpretations.segmentation: Let me be as one with you.

sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu.content: 隰有苌楚，猗傩其枝，夭之沃沃，乐子之无知。
sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu.pinyin: xi2 you3 chang2 chu3， yi1 nuo2 qi2 zhi1， yao1 zhi1 wo4 wo4， le4 zi zhi1 wu2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 隰有苌楚，猗傩其枝，夭之沃沃，乐子之无知。
interpretations.explanation: 低湿处有猕猴桃，枝条柔嫩，果实饱满，羡慕你没有知觉。

interpretations.segmentation: In the marsh are kiwi vines—tender branches, plump fruit; happy you who have no cares.

sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu.content: 隰有苌楚，猗傩其华，夭之沃沃。
sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu.pinyin: xi2 you3 chang2 chu3， yi1 nuo2 qi2 hua2， yao1 zhi1 wo4 wo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 隰有苌楚，猗傩其华，夭之沃沃。
interpretations.explanation: 低湿处有猕猴桃，枝条柔嫩，花朵繁茂，果实饱满。

interpretations.segmentation: In the marsh are kiwi vines—tender branches, lush flowers, plump fruit.
乐子之无家。
interpretations.explanation: 羡慕你没有家室之累。

interpretations.segmentation: Happy you who have no family burden.

sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu.content: 隰有苌楚，猗傩其实，夭之沃沃。
sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu.pinyin: xi2 you3 chang2 chu3， yi1 nuo2 qi2 shi2， yao1 zhi1 wo4 wo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 隰有苌楚，猗傩其实，夭之沃沃。
interpretations.explanation: 低湿处有猕猴桃，枝条柔嫩，果实累累，果实饱满。

interpretations.segmentation: In the marsh are kiwi vines—tender branches, heavy fruit, plump and full.
乐子之无室。
interpretations.explanation: 羡慕你没有妻室之累。

interpretations.segmentation: Happy you who have no wife and home to worry over.

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou.pinyin: bi4 gou3 zai4 liang2， qi2 yu2 fang2 guan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 敝笱在梁，其鱼鲂鳏。
interpretations.explanation: 破鱼篓在鱼梁上，鱼是鲂和鳏。

interpretations.segmentation: A broken fish basket on the dam—bream and bighead carp.

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou.pinyin: qi2 zi gui1 zhi3， qi2 cong2 ru2 yun2。

interpretations.segmentation: 齐子归止，其从如云。
interpretations.explanation: 齐国的女子回来了，随从像云一样多。

interpretations.segmentation: The Qi lady returns; her followers cloud the road.

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou.pinyin: bi4 gou3 zai4 liang2， qi2 yu2 fang2 xu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 敝笱在梁，其鱼鲂鱮。
interpretations.explanation: 破鱼篓在鱼梁上，鱼是鲂和鱮。

interpretations.segmentation: A broken fish basket on the dam—bream and silver carp.

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou.pinyin: qi2 zi gui1 zhi3， qi2 cong2 ru2 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 齐子归止，其从如雨。
interpretations.explanation: 齐国的女子回来了，随从像雨一样密。

interpretations.segmentation: The Qi lady returns; her followers fall like rain.

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou.pinyin: bi4 gou3 zai4 liang2， qi2 yu2 wei2 wei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 敝笱在梁，其鱼唯唯。
interpretations.explanation: 破鱼篓在鱼梁上，鱼缓缓游去。

interpretations.segmentation: A broken fish basket on the dam—the fish slip through at ease.

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou.pinyin: qi2 zi gui1 zhi3， qi2 cong2 ru2 shui3。

interpretations.segmentation: 齐子归止，其从如水。
interpretations.explanation: 齐国的女子回来了，随从像水一样涌。

interpretations.segmentation: The Qi lady returns; her followers flow like water.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming.pinyin: dong1 fang1 wei4 ming2， dian1 dao4 yi1 shang。

interpretations.segmentation: 东方未明，颠倒衣裳。
interpretations.explanation: 东方还未亮，穿衣穿颠倒了。

interpretations.segmentation: The east is not yet light; I put my clothes on upside down.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming.pinyin: dian1 zhi1 dao4 zhi1， zi4 gong1 zhao4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 颠之倒之，自公召之。
interpretations.explanation: 颠颠倒倒地穿，是公家来召唤。

interpretations.segmentation: Dressing all awry— the lord has summoned me.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming.pinyin: dong1 fang1 wei4 xi1， dian1 dao4 shang yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 东方未晞，颠倒裳衣。
interpretations.explanation: 东方还未晒干，下裳上衣穿颠倒了。

interpretations.segmentation: The east is not yet dry; skirt and coat are reversed.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming.pinyin: dao4 zhi1 dian1 zhi1， zi4 gong1 ling4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 倒之颠之，自公令之。
interpretations.explanation: 倒倒颠颠地穿，是公家来下令。

interpretations.segmentation: All reversed again—the lord has ordered me out.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming.pinyin: zhe2 liu3 fan2 pu3， kuang2 fu1 qu2 qu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 折柳樊圃，狂夫瞿瞿。
interpretations.explanation: 折柳编篱笆，狂夫瞪眼怒视。

interpretations.segmentation: Break willow to fence the garden—the wild man stares fiercely.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming.pinyin: bu4 neng2 chen2 ye4， bu4 su4 ze2 mo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不能辰夜，不夙则莫。
interpretations.explanation: 不能分清早晚，不是早就是晚。

interpretations.segmentation: He cannot tell night from dawn—if not too early, then too late.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri.content: 东方之日兮，彼姝者子，在我室兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri.pinyin: dong1 fang1 zhi1 ri4 xi1， bi3 shu1 zhe3 zi， zai4 wo3 shi4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 东方之日兮，彼姝者子，在我室兮。
interpretations.explanation: 东方太阳升起，那美丽的姑娘在我室内。

interpretations.segmentation: The sun rises in the east; that fair girl is in my room.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri.pinyin: zai4 wo3 shi4 xi1， lv3 wo3 ji2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 在我室兮，履我即兮。
interpretations.explanation: 在我室内，踩着我的足迹。

interpretations.segmentation: In my room she treads upon my footprints.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri.content: 东方之月兮，彼姝者子，在我闼兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri.pinyin: dong1 fang1 zhi1 yue4 xi1， bi3 shu1 zhe3 zi， zai4 wo3 ta4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 东方之月兮，彼姝者子，在我闼兮。
interpretations.explanation: 东方月亮升起，那美丽的姑娘在我门内。

interpretations.segmentation: The moon rises in the east; that fair girl is at my door.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri.pinyin: zai4 wo3 ta4 xi1， lv3 wo3 fa1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 在我闼兮，履我发兮。
interpretations.explanation: 在我门内，踩着我走过的足迹。

interpretations.segmentation: At my door she treads where I have walked.

sj-feng-qifeng-futian.pinyin: wu2 tian2 fu3 tian2， wei2 you3 jiao1 jiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无田甫田，维莠骄骄。
interpretations.explanation: 不要种大田，莠草长得骄骄。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not plant the great field—cockle grows rank and tall.

sj-feng-qifeng-futian.pinyin: wu2 si1 yuan3 ren2， lao2 xin1 dao1 dao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无思远人，劳心忉忉。
interpretations.explanation: 不要思念远方的人，劳心忧伤。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not long for one far away; the heart grieves in vain.

sj-feng-qifeng-futian.pinyin: wu2 tian2 fu3 tian2， wei2 you3 jie2 jie2。

interpretations.segmentation: 无田甫田，维莠桀桀。
interpretations.explanation: 不要种大田，莠草长得桀桀。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not plant the great field—cockle shoots up wild.

sj-feng-qifeng-futian.pinyin: wu2 si1 yuan3 ren2， lao2 xin1 da2 da2。

interpretations.segmentation: 无思远人，劳心怛怛。
interpretations.explanation: 不要思念远方的人，劳心悲苦。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not long for one far away; the heart is sore with care.
婉兮娈兮。
interpretations.explanation: 温柔美丽啊。

interpretations.segmentation: Gentle and lovely!
总角丱兮。
interpretations.explanation: 总角结发啊。

interpretations.segmentation: Hair in childhood knots!

sj-feng-qifeng-futian.pinyin: wei4 ji3 jian4 xi1， tu1 er2 bian4 xi1！

interpretations.segmentation: 未几见兮，突而弁兮！
interpretations.explanation: 不久再见面，突然戴上冠了！

interpretations.segmentation: Soon we meet again—suddenly he wears a man's cap!

sj-feng-qifeng-hai.content: 子之还兮，遭我乎狃之间兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-hai.pinyin: zi zhi1 hai2 xi1， zao1 wo3 hu1 niu3 zhi1 jian1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 子之还兮，遭我乎狃之间兮。
interpretations.explanation: 你打猎回来，在狃地的小路上遇见我。

interpretations.segmentation: Returning from the hunt, you met me on the path at Niu.

sj-feng-qifeng-hai.content: 并驱从两肩兮，揖我谓我儇兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-hai.pinyin: bing4 qu1 cong2 liang3 jian1 xi1， yi1 wo3 wei4 wo3 xuan1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 并驱从两肩兮，揖我谓我儇兮。
interpretations.explanation: 并马驱从两匹公马，作揖说我敏捷。

interpretations.segmentation: Riding side by side with two stallions, you bow and call me quick.

sj-feng-qifeng-hai.content: 子之茂兮，遭我乎狃之道兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-hai.pinyin: zi zhi1 mao4 xi1， zao1 wo3 hu1 niu3 zhi1 dao4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 子之茂兮，遭我乎狃之道兮。
interpretations.explanation: 你仪表美好，在狃地的大路上遇见我。

interpretations.segmentation: Handsome you are—you met me on the road at Niu.

sj-feng-qifeng-hai.content: 并驱从两牡兮，揖我谓我好兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-hai.pinyin: bing4 qu1 cong2 liang3 mu3 xi1， yi1 wo3 wei4 wo3 hao3 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 并驱从两牡兮，揖我谓我好兮。
interpretations.explanation: 并马驱从两匹公马，作揖说我好。

interpretations.segmentation: Riding side by side with two stallions, you bow and call me fine.

sj-feng-qifeng-hai.content: 子之昌兮，遭我乎狃之阳兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-hai.pinyin: zi zhi1 chang1 xi1， zao1 wo3 hu1 niu3 zhi1 yang2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 子之昌兮，遭我乎狃之阳兮。
interpretations.explanation: 你仪表昌盛，在狃地的山南遇见我。

interpretations.segmentation: Splendid you are—you met me on the sunny slope at Niu.

sj-feng-qifeng-hai.content: 并驱从两狼兮，揖我谓我臧兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-hai.pinyin: bing4 qu1 cong2 liang3 lang2 xi1， yi1 wo3 wei4 wo3 zang1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 并驱从两狼兮，揖我谓我臧兮。
interpretations.explanation: 并马驱从两匹公马，作揖说我善。

interpretations.segmentation: Riding side by side with two stallions, you bow and call me good.

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming.pinyin: ji1 ji4 ming2 yi3， chao2 ji4 ying2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鸡既鸣矣，朝既盈矣。
interpretations.explanation: 鸡已经叫了，朝堂上已坐满人。

interpretations.segmentation: The cock has crowed; the court is full.

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming.pinyin: fei3 ji1 ze2 ming2， cang1 ying2 zhi1 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪鸡则鸣，苍蝇之声。
interpretations.explanation: 不是鸡在叫，是苍蝇的声音。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not the cock—it is the buzz of flies.

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming.pinyin: dong1 fang1 ming2 yi3， chao2 ji4 chang1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 东方明矣，朝既昌矣。
interpretations.explanation: 东方已明亮，朝堂上已兴旺。

interpretations.segmentation: The east is bright; the court is thriving.

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming.pinyin: fei3 dong1 fang1 ze2 ming2， yue4 chu1 zhi1 guang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪东方则明，月出之光。
interpretations.explanation: 不是东方亮，是月亮出来的光。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not the dawn—it is the moon's light.

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming.pinyin: chong2 fei1 hong1 hong1， gan1 yu3 zi tong2 meng4。

interpretations.segmentation: 虫飞薨薨，甘与子同梦。
interpretations.explanation: 虫飞嗡嗡，甘愿与你同梦。

interpretations.segmentation: Insects hum in flight; gladly I share your dream.

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming.pinyin: hui4 qie3 gui1 yi3， wu2 shu4 yu3 zi zeng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 会且归矣，无庶予子憎。
interpretations.explanation: 会集且要回去了，不要让人憎恶我们。

interpretations.segmentation: The meeting ends and we must go—let no one hate us for it.

sj-feng-qifeng-luling.pinyin: lu2 ling4 ling4， qi2 ren2 mei3 qie3 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 卢令令，其人美且仁。
interpretations.explanation: 猎犬铃铃响，那人美好又仁德。

interpretations.segmentation: The hound's bell rings clear; the man is fair and kind.

sj-feng-qifeng-luling.pinyin: lu2 zhong4 huan2， qi2 ren2 mei3 qie3 quan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 卢重环，其人美且鬈。
interpretations.explanation: 猎犬项圈成双，那人美好卷发。

interpretations.segmentation: Double rings on the hound; the man is fair with curling hair.

sj-feng-qifeng-luling.pinyin: lu2 zhong4 mei2， qi2 ren2 mei3 qie3 cai1。

interpretations.segmentation: 卢重鋂，其人美且偲。
interpretations.explanation: 猎犬项圈相连，那人美好又有才。

interpretations.segmentation: Linked rings on the hound; the man is fair and able.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan.pinyin: nan2 shan1 cui1 cui1， xiong2 hu2 sui2 sui2。

interpretations.segmentation: 南山崔崔，雄狐绥绥。
interpretations.explanation: 南山高大，雄狐缓缓行走。

interpretations.segmentation: The southern hill rises steep; the male fox moves slowly.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan.pinyin: lu3 dao4 you3 dang4， qi2 zi you2 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鲁道有荡，齐子由归。
interpretations.explanation: 通往鲁国的路宽平，齐国的女子从那里出嫁。

interpretations.segmentation: The road to Lu is broad; the Qi bride goes home by it.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan.pinyin: ji4 yue1 gui1 zhi3， he2 you4 huai2 zhi3？

interpretations.segmentation: 既曰归止，曷又怀止？
interpretations.explanation: 已经说嫁人了，为何又怀念？

interpretations.segmentation: She was said to be wed—why does she still yearn?

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan.pinyin: ge2 ju4 wu3 liang3， guan1 rui2 shuang1 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 葛屦五两，冠緌双止。
interpretations.explanation: 葛鞋配五两，冠缨成双。

interpretations.segmentation: Hemp shoes in pairs of five; cap tassels come double.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan.pinyin: lu3 dao4 you3 dang4， qi2 zi yong1 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鲁道有荡，齐子庸止。
interpretations.explanation: 通往鲁国的路宽平，齐国的女子嫁过去了。

interpretations.segmentation: The road to Lu is broad; the Qi bride has gone.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan.pinyin: ji4 yue1 yong1 zhi3， he2 you4 cong2 zhi3？

interpretations.segmentation: 既曰庸止，曷又从止？
interpretations.explanation: 已经说嫁过去了，为何又跟从？

interpretations.segmentation: She was said to be gone—why does she follow again?
蓺麻如之何？
interpretations.explanation: 种麻该怎样？

interpretations.segmentation: How does one plant hemp?
衡从其亩。
interpretations.explanation: 要横成垄沟从亩起。

interpretations.segmentation: Lay furrows crosswise from the field strip.
取妻如之何？
interpretations.explanation: 娶妻该怎样？

interpretations.segmentation: How does one take a wife?
必告父母。
interpretations.explanation: 一定要告知父母。

interpretations.segmentation: One must inform one's parents.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan.pinyin: ji4 yue1 gao4 zhi3， he2 you4 ju1 zhi3？

interpretations.segmentation: 既曰告止，曷又鞠止？
interpretations.explanation: 已经说告知了，为何又放纵？

interpretations.segmentation: They were told—why indulge her still?
析薪如之何？
interpretations.explanation: 劈柴该怎样？

interpretations.segmentation: How does one split firewood?
匪斧不克。
interpretations.explanation: 没有斧子劈不开。

interpretations.segmentation: Without an axe it cannot be done.
取妻如之何？
interpretations.explanation: 娶妻该怎样？

interpretations.segmentation: How does one take a wife?
匪媒不得。
interpretations.explanation: 没有媒人得不到。

interpretations.segmentation: Without a go-between it cannot be done.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan.pinyin: ji4 yue1 de2 zhi3， he2 you4 ji2 zhi3？

interpretations.segmentation: 既曰得止，曷又极止？
interpretations.explanation: 已经说得到了，为何又过头？

interpretations.segmentation: It was done—why push it to the extreme?

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie.pinyin: yi1 jie1 chang1 xi1， qi2 er2 zhang3 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 猗嗟昌兮，颀而长兮。
interpretations.explanation: 唉，他真昌盛，身材颀长。

interpretations.segmentation: Ah, how splendid he is—tall and long of limb!

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie.pinyin: yi4 ruo4 yang2 xi1， mei3 mu4 yang2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 抑若扬兮，美目扬兮。
interpretations.explanation: 额角开阔，美目明亮。

interpretations.segmentation: His brow is broad; his eyes shine bright.

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie.pinyin: qiao3 qu1 qiang1 xi1， she4 ze2 zang1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 巧趋跄兮，射则臧兮。
interpretations.explanation: 步伐矫健，射箭技艺好。

interpretations.segmentation: His step is nimble; his archery is true.

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie.pinyin: yi1 jie1 ming2 xi1， mei3 mu4 qing1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 猗嗟名兮，美目清兮。
interpretations.explanation: 唉，他真有名望，美目清亮。

interpretations.segmentation: Ah, how famed he is—his eyes are clear.

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie.content: 仪既成兮，终日射侯，不出正兮，展我甥兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-yijie.pinyin: yi2 ji4 cheng2 xi1， zhong1 ri4 she4 hou2， bu4 chu1 zheng4 xi1， zhan3 wo3 sheng1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 仪既成兮，终日射侯，不出正兮，展我甥兮。
interpretations.explanation: 仪态已成，整天射侯，箭不出靶心，展现我外甥的才能。

interpretations.segmentation: His bearing is set; all day he shoots at the mark, never missing the center—my sister's son shows his skill.

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie.pinyin: yi1 jie1 luan2 xi1， qing1 yang2 wan3 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 猗嗟娈兮，清扬婉兮。
interpretations.explanation: 唉，他真美好，眉目清扬婉丽。

interpretations.segmentation: Ah, how lovely he is—clear brows and graceful looks.

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie.content: 舞则选兮，射则贯兮，四矢反兮，以御乱兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-yijie.pinyin: wu3 ze2 xuan3 xi1， she4 ze2 guan4 xi1， si4 shi3 fan3 xi1， yi3 yu4 luan4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 舞则选兮，射则贯兮，四矢反兮，以御乱兮。
interpretations.explanation: 舞姿出众，射箭穿透靶子，四箭全中，用以抵御祸乱。

interpretations.segmentation: He chooses the dance; his arrows pierce the target—four shafts reversed—to ward off disorder.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu.pinyin: zai4 qu1 bao2 bao2， dian4 fu2 zhu1 kuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 载驱薄薄，簟茀朱鞹。
interpretations.explanation: 车马轻快地奔驰，竹席车蔽朱色皮革。

interpretations.segmentation: The carriage drives lightly; bamboo mat screen, red leather.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu.pinyin: lu3 dao4 you3 dang4， qi2 zi fa1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鲁道有荡，齐子发夕。
interpretations.explanation: 通往鲁国的路宽平，齐国的女子黄昏出发。

interpretations.segmentation: The road to Lu is broad; the Qi lady sets out at dusk.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu.pinyin: si4 li2 ji4 ji4， chui2 pei4 mi3 mi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 四骊济济，垂辔沵沵。
interpretations.explanation: 四匹黑马整齐，垂着缰绳缓缓行。

interpretations.segmentation: Four black horses in order; reins hang loose and easy.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu.pinyin: lu3 dao4 you3 dang4， qi2 zi qi3 di4。

interpretations.segmentation: 鲁道有荡，齐子岂弟。
interpretations.explanation: 通往鲁国的路宽平，齐国的女子和乐平易。

interpretations.segmentation: The road to Lu is broad; the Qi lady is gentle and kind.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu.pinyin: wen4 shui3 tang1 tang1， xing2 ren2 peng2 peng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 汶水汤汤，行人彭彭。
interpretations.explanation: 汶水汤汤流淌，行人众多。

interpretations.segmentation: The Wen waters surge; travelers are many.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu.pinyin: lu3 dao4 you3 dang4， qi2 zi ao2 xiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鲁道有荡，齐子翱翔。
interpretations.explanation: 通往鲁国的路宽平，齐国的女子自在翱翔。

interpretations.segmentation: The road to Lu is broad; the Qi lady roams at ease.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu.pinyin: wen4 shui3 tao1 tao1， xing2 ren2 biao1 biao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 汶水滔滔，行人儦儦。
interpretations.explanation: 汶水滔滔流淌，行人往来纷纷。

interpretations.segmentation: The Wen waters roll on; travelers throng the way.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu.pinyin: lu3 dao4 you3 dang4， qi2 le you2 ao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鲁道有荡，齐了游敖。
interpretations.explanation: 通往鲁国的路宽平，齐国的女子游遨其中。

interpretations.segmentation: The road to Lu is broad; the Qi lady wanders and plays.

sj-feng-qifeng-zhe.content: 俟我于着乎而，充耳以素乎而，尚之以琼华乎而。
sj-feng-qifeng-zhe.pinyin: qi2 wo3 yu2 zhe hu1 er2， chong1 er3 yi3 su4 hu1 er2， shang4 zhi1 yi3 qiong2 hua2 hu1 er2。

interpretations.segmentation: 俟我于着乎而，充耳以素乎而，尚之以琼华乎而。
interpretations.explanation: 在着地等我，充耳用白丝线，再饰以琼华。

interpretations.segmentation: Wait for me at Zhu—earplugs of white silk, topped with fine jade.

sj-feng-qifeng-zhe.content: 俟我于庭乎而，充耳以青乎而，尚之以琼莹乎而。
sj-feng-qifeng-zhe.pinyin: qi2 wo3 yu2 ting2 hu1 er2， chong1 er3 yi3 qing1 hu1 er2， shang4 zhi1 yi3 qiong2 ying2 hu1 er2。

interpretations.segmentation: 俟我于庭乎而，充耳以青乎而，尚之以琼莹乎而。
interpretations.explanation: 在庭院等我，充耳用青丝线，再饰以琼莹。

interpretations.segmentation: Wait for me in the courtyard—earplugs of green silk, topped with gleaming jade.

sj-feng-qifeng-zhe.content: 俟我于堂乎而，充耳以黄乎而，尚之以琼英乎而。
sj-feng-qifeng-zhe.pinyin: qi2 wo3 yu2 tang2 hu1 er2， chong1 er3 yi3 huang2 hu1 er2， shang4 zhi1 yi3 qiong2 ying1 hu1 er2。

interpretations.segmentation: 俟我于堂乎而，充耳以黄乎而，尚之以琼英乎而。
interpretations.explanation: 在堂上等我，充耳用黄丝线，再饰以琼英。

interpretations.segmentation: Wait for me in the hall—earplugs of yellow silk, topped with precious jade.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin.pinyin: you3 che1 lin2 lin2， you3 ma3 bai2 dian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有车邻邻，有马白颠。
interpretations.explanation: 有车声邻邻，有马额白颠。

interpretations.segmentation: Carriages rumble near; horses have white foreheads.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin.pinyin: wei4 jian4 jun1 zi， si4 ren2 zhi1 ling4。

interpretations.segmentation: 未见君子，寺人之令。
interpretations.explanation: 还没见到君子，先听到寺人的命令。

interpretations.segmentation: Before I see the lord, I hear the eunuch's order.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin.pinyin: ban3 you3 qi1， xi2 you3 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 阪有漆，隰有栗。
interpretations.explanation: 坡上有漆树，低湿处有栗树。

interpretations.segmentation: On the slope are lacquer trees; in the marsh, chestnuts.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin.pinyin: ji4 jian4 jun1 zi， bing4 zuo4 gu3 se4。

interpretations.segmentation: 既见君子，并坐鼓瑟。
interpretations.explanation: 已经见到君子，并坐一起鼓瑟。

interpretations.segmentation: Now I have seen the lord; we sit together playing zither.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin.pinyin: jin1 zhe3 bu4 le4， shi4 zhe3 qi2 die2。

interpretations.segmentation: 今者不乐，逝者其耋。
interpretations.explanation: 今天不乐，时光逝去人将老。

interpretations.segmentation: If we do not rejoice today, time will pass and we grow old.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin.pinyin: ban3 you3 sang1， xi2 you3 yang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 阪有桑，隰有杨。
interpretations.explanation: 坡上有桑树，低湿处有杨树。

interpretations.segmentation: On the slope are mulberries; in the marsh, poplars.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin.pinyin: ji4 jian4 jun1 zi， bing4 zuo4 gu3 huang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既见君子，并坐鼓簧。
interpretations.explanation: 已经见到君子，并坐一起吹簧。

interpretations.segmentation: Now I have seen the lord; we sit together playing reed pipe.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin.pinyin: jin1 zhe3 bu4 le4， shi4 zhe3 qi2 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 今者不乐，逝者其亡。
interpretations.explanation: 今天不乐，时光逝去人将亡。

interpretations.segmentation: If we do not rejoice today, time will pass and we are gone.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng.pinyin: yu4 bi3 chen2 feng1， yu4 bi3 bei3 lin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鴥彼晨风，郁彼北林。
interpretations.explanation: 晨风鸟疾飞，北林树茂密。

interpretations.segmentation: The morning breeze bird flies swiftly; the northern woods are dense and dark.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng.pinyin: wei4 jian4 jun1 zi， you1 xin1 qin1 qin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 未见君子，忧心钦钦。
interpretations.explanation: 见不到丈夫，心中忧愁不已。

interpretations.segmentation: I have not seen my lord; my heart is full of anxious care.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng.pinyin: ru2 he2 ru2 he2， wang4 wo3 shi2 duo1！

interpretations.segmentation: 如何如何，忘我实多！
interpretations.explanation: 为何这样啊，他把我忘得这样多！

interpretations.segmentation: How is it so? He has forgotten me so much!

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng.pinyin: shan1 you3 bao1 li4， xi2 you3 liu4 bo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 山有苞栎，隰有六駮。
interpretations.explanation: 山上有丛生的栎树，低湿处有斑纹的马。

interpretations.segmentation: On the hills are clustered oaks; in the low wet ground are dappled horses.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng.pinyin: wei4 jian4 jun1 zi， you1 xin1 mi2 le4。

interpretations.segmentation: 未见君子，忧心靡乐。
interpretations.explanation: 见不到丈夫，心中没有欢乐。

interpretations.segmentation: I have not seen my lord; my heart knows no joy.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng.pinyin: ru2 he2 ru2 he2， wang4 wo3 shi2 duo1！

interpretations.segmentation: 如何如何，忘我实多！
interpretations.explanation: 为何这样啊，他把我忘得这样多！

interpretations.segmentation: How is it so? He has forgotten me so much!

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng.pinyin: shan1 you3 bao1 di4， xi2 you3 shu4 sui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 山有苞棣，隰有树檖。
interpretations.explanation: 山上有丛生的棣树，低湿处有树檖。

interpretations.segmentation: On the hills are clustered pear trees; in the wet ground grow mulberry-leaf trees.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng.pinyin: wei4 jian4 jun1 zi， you1 xin1 ru2 zui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 未见君子，忧心如醉。
interpretations.explanation: 见不到丈夫，忧愁像醉了一样。

interpretations.segmentation: I have not seen my lord; my sorrow is like drunkenness.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng.pinyin: ru2 he2 ru2 he2， wang4 wo3 shi2 duo1！

interpretations.segmentation: 如何如何，忘我实多！
interpretations.explanation: 为何这样啊，他把我忘得这样多！

interpretations.segmentation: How is it so? He has forgotten me so much!

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao.pinyin: jiao1 jiao1 huang2 niao3， zhi3 yu2 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 交交黄鸟，止于棘。
interpretations.explanation: 黄鸟叫声交交，停落在荆棘上。

interpretations.segmentation: The yellow birds cry crisply; they perch on the thorn bushes.

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao.pinyin: shui2 cong2 mu4 gong1？

interpretations.segmentation: 谁从穆公？
interpretations.explanation: 谁跟从了穆公？

interpretations.segmentation: Who followed Duke Mu to the grave?

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao.pinyin: zi che1 yan3 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 子车奄息。
interpretations.explanation: 是子车奄息。

interpretations.segmentation: It was Ziche Yansi.

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao.pinyin: wei2 ci3 yan3 xi1， bai3 fu1 zhi1 te4。

interpretations.segmentation: 维此奄息，百夫之特。
interpretations.explanation: 这位奄息，能抵百夫之勇。

interpretations.segmentation: This Yansi was a match for a hundred men.

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao.pinyin: lin2 qi2 xue2， zhui4 zhui4 qi2 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 临其穴，惴惴其栗。
interpretations.explanation: 来到墓穴前，心中恐惧战栗。

interpretations.segmentation: Approaching his tomb, we tremble with dread.

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao.pinyin: bi3 cang1 zhe3 tian1， jian1 wo3 liang2 ren2！

interpretations.segmentation: 彼苍者天，歼我良人！
interpretations.explanation: 苍天啊，你害死了我们的好人！

interpretations.segmentation: O blue Heaven, you have destroyed our good man!

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao.pinyin: ru2 ke3 shu2 xi1， ren2 bai3 qi2 shen1！

interpretations.segmentation: 如可赎兮，人百其身！
interpretations.explanation: 若可赎回，愿以百身代替他！

interpretations.segmentation: If he could be ransomed, we would give a hundred lives for his!

interpretations.segmentation: 维此仲行，百夫之防。
interpretations.explanation: 这位仲行，能抵百夫之防。

interpretations.segmentation: This Zhonghang was the defense of a hundred men.

interpretations.segmentation: 子车针虎。
interpretations.explanation: 是子车针虎。

interpretations.segmentation: It was Ziche Zhenhu.

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao.pinyin: wei2 ci3 zhen1 hu3， bai3 fu1 zhi1 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 维此针虎，百夫之御。
interpretations.explanation: 这位针虎，能抵百夫之御。

interpretations.segmentation: This Zhenhu could withstand a hundred men in battle.

interpretations.segmentation: 蒹葭苍苍，白露为霜。
interpretations.explanation: 芦苇青苍，白露凝结成霜。

interpretations.segmentation: The reeds are lush and green; white dew has turned to frost.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia.pinyin: suo3 wei4 yi1 ren2， zai4 shui3 yi1 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 所谓伊人，在水一方。
interpretations.explanation: 所说的那个人，在水的那一边。

interpretations.segmentation: The one I speak of is on the other side of the water.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia.pinyin: su4 hui2 cong2 zhi1， dao4 zu3 qie3 zhang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 溯洄从之，道阻且长。
interpretations.explanation: 逆流而上追寻他，道路险阻又漫长。

interpretations.segmentation: Going upstream to follow him, the way is blocked and long.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia.pinyin: su4 you2 cong2 zhi1， wan3 zai4 shui3 zhong1 yang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 溯游从之，宛在水中央。
interpretations.explanation: 顺流而下追寻他，仿佛就在水中央。

interpretations.segmentation: Going downstream to follow him, he seems to be in the middle of the water.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia.pinyin: jian1 jia1 qi1 qi1， bai2 lu4 wei4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 蒹葭萋萋，白露未晞。
interpretations.explanation: 芦苇茂盛，白露尚未晒干。

interpretations.segmentation: The reeds are thick; the white dew has not yet dried.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia.pinyin: suo3 wei4 yi1 ren2， zai4 shui3 zhi1 mei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 所谓伊人，在水之湄。
interpretations.explanation: 所说的那个人，在水边岸上。

interpretations.segmentation: The one I speak of is on the water's bank.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia.pinyin: su4 hui2 cong2 zhi1， dao4 zu3 qie3 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 溯洄从之，道阻且跻。
interpretations.explanation: 逆流而上追寻他，道路险阻又陡峻。

interpretations.segmentation: Going upstream to follow him, the way is blocked and steep.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia.pinyin: su4 you2 cong2 zhi1， wan3 zai4 shui3 zhong1 chi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 溯游从之，宛在水中坻。
interpretations.explanation: 顺流而下追寻他，仿佛在水中小洲上。

interpretations.segmentation: Going downstream to follow him, he seems on an islet in the water.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia.pinyin: jian1 jia1 cai3 cai3， bai2 lu4 wei4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 蒹葭采采，白露未已。
interpretations.explanation: 芦苇采采，白露尚未止歇。

interpretations.segmentation: The reeds are plentiful; the white dew has not yet ceased.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia.pinyin: suo3 wei4 yi1 ren2， zai4 shui3 zhi1 si4。

interpretations.segmentation: 所谓伊人，在水之涘。
interpretations.explanation: 所说的那个人，在水边涯上。

interpretations.segmentation: The one I speak of is at the water's edge.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia.pinyin: su4 hui2 cong2 zhi1， dao4 zu3 qie3 you4。

interpretations.segmentation: 溯洄从之，道阻且右。
interpretations.explanation: 逆流而上追寻他，道路险阻又迂回。

interpretations.segmentation: Going upstream to follow him, the way is blocked and winding.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia.pinyin: su4 you2 cong2 zhi1， wan3 zai4 shui3 zhong1 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 溯游从之，宛在水中沚。
interpretations.explanation: 顺流而下追寻他，仿佛在水中小块陆地。

interpretations.segmentation: Going downstream to follow him, he seems on a small shoal in the water.

sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu.content: 于我乎，夏屋渠渠，今也每食无余。
sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu.pinyin: yu2 wo3 hu1， xia4 wu1 qu2 qu2， jin1 ye3 mei3 shi2 wu2 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 于我乎，夏屋渠渠，今也每食无余。
interpretations.explanation: 当初对我啊，大屋高大宽敞，如今每顿饭都吃不饱。

interpretations.segmentation: Once for me there were grand spacious halls; now at every meal I have nothing left.

sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu.pinyin: yu2 jie1 hu1， bu4 cheng2 quan2 yu2！

interpretations.segmentation: 于嗟乎，不承权舆！
interpretations.explanation: 唉，不能继承当初的起始之福啊！

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, we cannot inherit the blessings we began with!

sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu.content: 于我乎，每食四簋，今也每食不饱。
sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu.pinyin: yu2 wo3 hu1， mei3 shi2 si4 gui3， jin1 ye3 mei3 shi2 bu4 bao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 于我乎，每食四簋，今也每食不饱。
interpretations.explanation: 当初对我啊，每顿四簋盛食，如今每顿饭都吃不饱。

interpretations.segmentation: Once for me each meal filled four bowls; now at every meal I am not full.

sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu.pinyin: yu2 jie1 hu1， bu4 cheng2 quan2 yu2！

interpretations.segmentation: 于嗟乎，不承权舆！
interpretations.explanation: 唉，不能继承当初的起始之福啊！

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, we cannot inherit the blessings we began with!

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie.pinyin: si4 tie3 kong3 fu4， liu4 pei4 zai4 shou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 驷驖孔阜，六辔在手。
interpretations.explanation: 四匹黑鬃马高大，六根缰绳握在手中。

interpretations.segmentation: Four black-maned horses are stout and tall; six reins are held in hand.

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie.pinyin: gong1 zhi1 mei4 zi， cong2 gong1 yu2 shou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 公之媚子，从公于狩。
interpretations.explanation: 国君所宠爱的人，跟随国君去打猎。

interpretations.segmentation: The duke's favored men follow the duke on the hunt.

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie.pinyin: feng4 shi2 chen2 mu3， chen2 mu3 kong3 shuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 奉时辰牡，辰牡孔硕。
interpretations.explanation: 按时进献应季的公兽，公兽非常肥大。

interpretations.segmentation: They present the season's royal quarry; the beasts are very large.

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie.pinyin: gong1 yue1 zuo3 zhi1， she3 ba2 ze2 huo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 公曰左之，舍拔则获。
interpretations.explanation: 国君说向左，放下箭就能射中猎物。

interpretations.segmentation: The duke says 'to the left'; they release the arrows and make the kill.

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie.pinyin: you2 yu2 bei3 yuan2， si4 ma3 ji4 xian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 游于北园，四马既闲。
interpretations.explanation: 在北园游乐，四匹马已经熟练。

interpretations.segmentation: They roam the northern park; the four horses are now well trained.

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie.pinyin: you2 che1 luan2 biao1， zai4 xian3 xie1 jiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 輶车鸾镳，载猃歇骄。
interpretations.explanation: 轻便车配鸾铃，载着猎犬歇骄。

interpretations.segmentation: Light carts with tinkling bells carry the hounds Xi and Jiao.

sj-feng-qinfeng-weiyang.pinyin: wo3 song4 jiu4 shi4， yue1 zhi4 wei4 yang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我送舅氏，曰至渭阳。
interpretations.explanation: 我送别舅氏，来到渭水之阳。

interpretations.segmentation: I escort my mother's brother; we reach the south bank of the Wei River.
何以赠之？
interpretations.explanation: 拿什么赠送他呢？

interpretations.segmentation: With what shall I gift him?
路车乘黄。
interpretations.explanation: 路车与乘黄马。

interpretations.segmentation: A carriage for the road and a team of yellow horses.

sj-feng-qinfeng-weiyang.pinyin: wo3 song4 jiu4 shi4， you1 you1 wo3 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我送舅氏，悠悠我思。
interpretations.explanation: 我送别舅氏，思念之情悠长。

interpretations.segmentation: I escort my mother's brother; my longing stretches far.
何以赠之？
interpretations.explanation: 拿什么赠送他呢？

interpretations.segmentation: With what shall I gift him?
琼瑰玉佩。
interpretations.explanation: 琼瑰玉佩。

interpretations.segmentation: Pendants of fine jade and gems.
岂曰无衣？
interpretations.explanation: 难道说没有战衣？

interpretations.segmentation: Who says we have no coats?
与子同袍。
interpretations.explanation: 与你同穿一件袍子。

interpretations.segmentation: We share the same robe with you.

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi.pinyin: wang2 yu2 xing1 shi1， xiu1 wo3 ge1 mao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 王于兴师，修我戈矛。
interpretations.explanation: 君王要兴兵，我们修好戈矛。

interpretations.segmentation: The king is raising troops; we ready our spears and halberds.
与子同仇！

interpretations.explanation: 有个女子被抛弃，放声长啸。

interpretations.segmentation: A woman cast off in divorce gives a long, wailing cry.

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui.content: 条其歗矣，遇人之不淑矣。
sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui.pinyin: tiao2 qi2 xiao4 yi3， yu4 ren2 zhi1 bu4 shu1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 条其歗矣，遇人之不淑矣。
interpretations.explanation: 她放声长啸，是因为所遇之人不好啊。

interpretations.segmentation: She wails so—because the man she met was not good.

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui.pinyin: zhong1 gu3 you3 tui1， han4 qi2 shi1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 中谷有蓷，暵其湿矣。
interpretations.explanation: 山谷里有益母草，被晒得湿漉漉又枯了。

interpretations.segmentation: In the valley grows motherwort, wilted and damp from the heat.

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui.pinyin: you3 nv3 pi3 li2， chuai4 qi2 qi4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有女仳离，啜其泣矣。
interpretations.explanation: 有个女子被抛弃，抽泣不止。

interpretations.segmentation: A woman cast off in divorce weeps in broken sobs.

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui.pinyin: chuai4 qi2 qi4 yi3， he2 jie1 ji2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 啜其泣矣，何嗟及矣。
interpretations.explanation: 她抽泣不止，后悔也来不及了。

interpretations.segmentation: She weeps so—yet it is too late for regret.

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi.pinyin: bo2 xi1 qie4 xi1， bang1 zhi1 jie2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 伯兮朅兮，邦之桀兮。
interpretations.explanation: 丈夫啊多么英武，是国家的豪杰。

interpretations.segmentation: My lord is bold and gallant—the hero of the state.

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi.pinyin: bo2 ye3 zhi2 shu1， wei4 wang2 qian2 qu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 伯也执殳，为王前驱。
interpretations.explanation: 他手持兵器，做王的先锋。

interpretations.segmentation: He holds a halberd and marches as the king's vanguard.

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi.pinyin: zi4 bo2 zhi1 dong1， shou3 ru2 fei1 peng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 自伯之东，首如飞蓬。
interpretations.explanation: 自从他向东出征，我的头发乱如蓬草。

interpretations.segmentation: Since he went east on campaign, my hair has flown wild like tumbleweed.
岂无膏沐？
interpretations.explanation: 难道没有脂膏可以润发？

interpretations.segmentation: Is it that I lack ointment to dress my hair?
谁适为容！
interpretations.explanation: 为谁梳妆打扮呢！

interpretations.segmentation: For whom should I make myself fair!

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi.pinyin: qi2 yu3 qi2 yu3， gao3 gao3 chu1 ri4。

interpretations.segmentation: 其雨其雨，杲杲出日。
interpretations.explanation: 希望下雨啊下雨，（盼他归）却见灿烂日出。

interpretations.segmentation: I pray for rain, yet the bright sun climbs high.

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi.pinyin: yuan4 yan2 si1 bo2， gan1 xin1 shou3 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 愿言思伯，甘心首疾。
interpretations.explanation: 一心思念丈夫，情愿为此头疾也不悔。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart longs only for my lord; I gladly bear this ache in my head.
焉得谖草？
interpretations.explanation: 哪里能采到忘忧草？

interpretations.segmentation: Where can I find the forget-sorrow plant?
言树之背。
interpretations.explanation: 说要种在屋脊背后。

interpretations.segmentation: They say to plant it behind the roof ridge.
愿言思伯。
interpretations.explanation: 一心思念丈夫，

interpretations.segmentation: My heart longs only for my lord;
使我心痗。
interpretations.explanation: 使我内心痛苦难当。

interpretations.segmentation: it makes my heart sick with grief.

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.content: 坎坎伐檀兮，置之河之干兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: kan3 kan3 fa2 tan2 xi1， zhi4 zhi1 he2 zhi1 gan4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 坎坎伐檀兮，置之河之干兮。
interpretations.explanation: 坎坎声里伐檀树，把木头放在河岸上。

interpretations.segmentation: With axe-strokes ringing, we hew sandalwood and lay it on the river bank.

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: he2 shui3 qing1 qie3 lian2 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 河水清且涟猗。
interpretations.explanation: 河水清又清，波纹荡漾。

interpretations.segmentation: The river water is clear and ripples gently.

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.content: 不稼不穑，胡取禾三百廛兮？
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: bu4 jia4 bu4 se4， hu2 qu3 he2 san1 bai3 chan2 xi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 不稼不穑，胡取禾三百廛兮？
interpretations.explanation: 不种不收，凭什么占我三百户人家的禾稼？

interpretations.segmentation: You neither sow nor reap—why do you take grain from three hundred households?

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.content: 不狩不猎，胡瞻尔庭有县貆兮？
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: bu4 shou4 bu4 lie4， hu2 zhan1 er3 ting2 you3 xian4 huan2 xi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 不狩不猎，胡瞻尔庭有县貆兮？
interpretations.explanation: 不打不猎，凭什么看见你庭院里挂着野猪肉？

interpretations.segmentation: You neither hunt nor chase—why hang wild boar in your courtyard?

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: bi3 jun1 zi xi1， bu4 su4 can1 xi1！

interpretations.segmentation: 彼君子兮，不素餐兮！
interpretations.explanation: 那些君子啊，不能白吃饭！

interpretations.segmentation: Those 'gentlemen' must not live on idle meals!

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.content: 坎坎伐辐兮，置之河之侧兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: kan3 kan3 fa2 fu2 xi1， zhi4 zhi1 he2 zhi1 ce4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 坎坎伐辐兮，置之河之侧兮。
interpretations.explanation: 坎坎声里伐车辐，把木头放在河旁边。

interpretations.segmentation: With axe-strokes ringing, we hew wheel spokes and lay them by the river.

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: he2 shui3 qing1 qie3 zhi2 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 河水清且直猗。
interpretations.explanation: 河水清又清，流势笔直。

interpretations.segmentation: The river water is clear and runs straight.

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.content: 不稼不穑，胡取禾三百亿兮？
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: bu4 jia4 bu4 se4， hu2 qu3 he2 san1 bai3 yi4 xi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 不稼不穑，胡取禾三百亿兮？
interpretations.explanation: 不种不收，凭什么占我亿万粒禾稼？

interpretations.segmentation: You neither sow nor reap—why do you take grain by the hundred million?

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.content: 不狩不猎，胡瞻尔庭有县特兮？
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: bu4 shou4 bu4 lie4， hu2 zhan1 er3 ting2 you3 xian4 te4 xi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 不狩不猎，胡瞻尔庭有县特兮？
interpretations.explanation: 不打不猎，凭什么看见你庭院里挂着三岁大兽？

interpretations.segmentation: You neither hunt nor chase—why hang a three-year-old beast in your courtyard?

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: bi3 jun1 zi xi1， bu4 su4 shi2 xi1！

interpretations.segmentation: 彼君子兮，不素食兮！
interpretations.explanation: 那些君子啊，不能白吃肉！

interpretations.segmentation: Those 'gentlemen' must not live on idle meat!

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.content: 坎坎伐轮兮，置之河之漘兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: kan3 kan3 fa2 lun2 xi1， zhi4 zhi1 he2 zhi1 chun2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 坎坎伐轮兮，置之河之漘兮。
interpretations.explanation: 坎坎声里伐车轮，把木头放在河湾处。

interpretations.segmentation: With axe-strokes ringing, we hew wheel rims and lay them at the river bend.

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: he2 shui3 qing1 qie3 lun2 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 河水清且沦猗。
interpretations.explanation: 河水清又清，漩涡流转。

interpretations.segmentation: The river water is clear and swirls in eddies.

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.content: 不稼不穑，胡取禾三百囷兮？
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: bu4 jia4 bu4 se4， hu2 qu3 he2 san1 bai3 qun1 xi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 不稼不穑，胡取禾三百囷兮？
interpretations.explanation: 不种不收，凭什么占我三百囷仓的禾稼？

interpretations.segmentation: You neither sow nor reap—why fill three hundred granaries with our grain?

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.content: 不狩不猎，胡瞻尔庭有县鹑兮？
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: bu4 shou4 bu4 lie4， hu2 zhan1 er3 ting2 you3 xian4 chun2 xi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 不狩不猎，胡瞻尔庭有县鹑兮？
interpretations.explanation: 不打不猎，凭什么看见你庭院里挂着鹌鹑？

interpretations.segmentation: You neither hunt nor chase—why hang quail in your courtyard?

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan.pinyin: bi3 jun1 zi xi1， bu4 su4 sun1 xi1！

interpretations.segmentation: 彼君子兮，不素飧兮！
interpretations.explanation: 那些君子啊，不能白吃晚餐！

interpretations.segmentation: Those 'gentlemen' must not live on idle suppers!

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru.pinyin: bi3 fen2 ju3 ru4， yan2 cai3 qi2 mo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼汾沮洳，言采其莫。
interpretations.explanation: 在那汾水低湿处，人们采泽泻。

interpretations.segmentation: On the marshy banks of the Fen, they gather the water plantain.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru.pinyin: bi3 qi2 zhi1 zi， mei3 wu2 du4。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼其之子，美无度。
interpretations.explanation: 那个公子，美好得无法度量。

interpretations.segmentation: That young lord is so fair that beauty cannot measure him.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru.pinyin: mei3 wu2 du4， shu1 yi4 hu1 gong1 lu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 美无度，殊异乎公路。
interpretations.explanation: 美好无法度量，和公路大夫大不相同。

interpretations.segmentation: Beyond measure in beauty—utterly unlike the Grand Road officer.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru.pinyin: bi3 fen2 yi1 fang1， yan2 cai3 qi2 sang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼汾一方，言采其桑。
interpretations.explanation: 在那汾水一方，人们采桑叶。

interpretations.segmentation: On one stretch of the Fen, they gather mulberry leaves.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru.pinyin: bi3 qi2 zhi1 zi， mei3 ru2 ying1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼其之子，美如英。
interpretations.explanation: 那个公子，美如鲜花。

interpretations.segmentation: That young lord is lovely as blossoming flowers.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru.pinyin: mei3 ru2 ying1， shu1 yi4 hu1 gong1 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 美如英，殊异乎公行。
interpretations.explanation: 美如鲜花，和公行大夫大不相同。

interpretations.segmentation: Lovely as flowers—utterly unlike the Grand Procession officer.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru.pinyin: bi3 fen2 yi1 qu1， yan2 cai3 qi2 xu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼汾一曲，言采其藚。
interpretations.explanation: 在那汾水弯曲处，人们采藚草。

interpretations.segmentation: Where the Fen bends, they gather the artemisia.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru.pinyin: bi3 qi2 zhi1 zi， mei3 ru2 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼其之子，美如玉。
interpretations.explanation: 那个公子，美如美玉。

interpretations.segmentation: That young lord is fair as polished jade.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru.pinyin: mei3 ru2 yu4， shu1 yi4 hu1 gong1 zu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 美如玉，殊异乎公族。
interpretations.explanation: 美如美玉，和公族大夫大不相同。

interpretations.segmentation: Fair as jade—utterly unlike the lord of the clan.

sj-feng-weifeng-geju.pinyin: jiu1 jiu1 ge2 ju4， ke3 yi3 lv3 shuang1？

interpretations.segmentation: 纠纠葛屦，可以履霜？
interpretations.explanation: 麻葛编成的鞋，能踩霜过冬吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Can shoes woven of hemp and vine truly tread upon the frost?

sj-feng-weifeng-geju.pinyin: can4 can4 nv3 shou3， ke3 yi3 feng4 shang？

interpretations.segmentation: 掺掺女手，可以缝裳？
interpretations.explanation: 那女子细瘦的手，能缝好衣裳吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Can that girl's thin, weary hands truly sew a proper robe?

sj-feng-weifeng-geju.pinyin: yao4 zhi1 ji2 zhi1， hao3 ren2 fu2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 要之襋之，好人服之。
interpretations.explanation: 她缝好领子袖口，让“好人”穿上。

interpretations.segmentation: She finishes collar and cuff for the 'fine lady' to wear.

sj-feng-weifeng-geju.content: 好人提提，宛然左辟，佩其象揥。
sj-feng-weifeng-geju.pinyin: hao3 ren2 ti2 ti2， wan3 ran2 zuo3 pi4， pei4 qi2 xiang4 ti4。

interpretations.segmentation: 好人提提，宛然左辟，佩其象揥。
interpretations.explanation: 那“好人”仪态闲雅，侧身让路，佩戴象牙簪。

interpretations.segmentation: The 'fine lady' moves with ease, steps aside to the left, and wears an ivory hairpin.

sj-feng-weifeng-geju.pinyin: wei2 shi4 bian3 xin1， shi4 yi3 wei4 ci4。

interpretations.segmentation: 维是褊心，是以为刺。
interpretations.explanation: 正因为她心地偏狭，才写下这首诗讽刺。

interpretations.segmentation: Because her heart is narrow and cruel, this poem is written as a rebuke.
谁谓河广？
interpretations.explanation: 谁说黄河宽？

interpretations.segmentation: Who says the Yellow River is wide?
一苇杭之。
interpretations.explanation: 一根芦苇就能渡过去。

interpretations.segmentation: A single reed could ferry you across.
谁谓宋远？
interpretations.explanation: 谁说宋国远？

interpretations.segmentation: Who says the state of Song is far?
跂予望之。
interpretations.explanation: 踮起脚就能望见。

interpretations.segmentation: Stand on tiptoe and you can see it.
谁谓河广？
interpretations.explanation: 谁说黄河宽？

interpretations.segmentation: Who says the Yellow River is wide?
曾不容刀。
interpretations.explanation: 竟容不下一叶小舟。

interpretations.segmentation: It cannot even hold a little boat.
谁谓宋远？
interpretations.explanation: 谁说宋国远？

interpretations.segmentation: Who says the state of Song is far?
曾不崇朝。
interpretations.explanation: 一个早晨就能走到。

interpretations.segmentation: One morning is enough to reach it.

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan.pinyin: kao3 pan2 zai4 jian4， shuo4 ren2 zhi1 kuan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 考槃在涧，硕人之宽。
interpretations.explanation: 他盘桓在山涧，隐士心胸宽畅。

interpretations.segmentation: He dwells and wanders in the mountain stream— the lofty man's heart is spacious.

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan.pinyin: du2 mei4 wu4 yan2， yong3 shi3 fu2 xuan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 独寐寤言，永矢弗谖。
interpretations.explanation: 独自睡醒来言说，永志不忘这份快乐。

interpretations.segmentation: Alone he sleeps and wakes to speak; forever he will not forget this joy.

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan.pinyin: kao3 pan2 zai4 a1， shuo4 ren2 zhi1 ke1。

interpretations.segmentation: 考槃在阿，硕人之薖。
interpretations.explanation: 他盘桓在山坡，隐士形貌魁伟。

interpretations.segmentation: He dwells on the hillside— the lofty man's form is grand.

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan.pinyin: du2 mei4 wu4 ge1， yong3 shi3 fu2 guo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 独寐寤歌，永矢弗过。
interpretations.explanation: 独自睡醒来歌唱，永志不违背此志。

interpretations.segmentation: Alone he sleeps and wakes to sing; forever he will not stray from this path.

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan.pinyin: kao3 pan2 zai4 liu4， shuo4 ren2 zhi1 zhou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 考槃在六，硕人之轴。
interpretations.explanation: 他盘桓在土丘，隐士风度温厚。

interpretations.segmentation: He dwells on the earthen mound— the lofty man's bearing is warm and steady.

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan.pinyin: du2 mei4 wu4 su4， yong3 shi3 fu2 gao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 独寐寤宿，永矢弗告。
interpretations.explanation: 独自睡醒来栖止，永志不把此志告人。

interpretations.segmentation: Alone he sleeps and wakes to rest; forever he will not proclaim this resolve to others.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: mang2 zhi1 chi1 chi1， bao4 bu4 mao4 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 氓之蚩蚩，抱布贸丝。
interpretations.explanation: 那男子装得老实，抱着布来换丝。

interpretations.segmentation: That man looked simple and honest, carrying cloth to trade for silk.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: fei3 lai2 mao4 si1， lai2 ji2 wo3 mou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪来贸丝，来即我谋。
interpretations.explanation: 并不是真来换丝，是来谈婚嫁之事。

interpretations.segmentation: He did not come to trade silk—he came to talk of marriage.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: song4 zi she4 qi2， zhi4 yu2 dun4 qiu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 送子涉淇，至于顿丘。
interpretations.explanation: 我送你渡过淇水，到达顿丘。

interpretations.segmentation: I saw you across the Qi and on to Dunqiu.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: fei3 wo3 qian1 qi1， zi wu2 liang2 mei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪我愆期，子无良媒。
interpretations.explanation: 不是我拖延婚期，是你没有好媒人。

interpretations.segmentation: It was not I who delayed our wedding—you had no good go-between.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: jiang1 zi wu2 nu4， qiu1 yi3 wei4 qi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 将子无怒，秋以为期。
interpretations.explanation: 请你别生气，把秋天定为婚期吧。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not be angry; let autumn be our wedding day.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: cheng2 bi3 gui3 yuan2， yi3 wang4 fu4 guan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乘彼垝垣，以望复关。
interpretations.explanation: 我登上那破墙，眺望复关。

interpretations.segmentation: I climbed the broken wall to gaze toward Fuguan.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: bu4 jian4 fu4 guan1， qi4 ti4 lian2 lian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 不见复关，泣涕涟涟。
interpretations.explanation: 看不见你从复关来，眼泪涟涟。

interpretations.segmentation: When I did not see you coming from Fuguan, tears streamed down.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: ji4 jian4 fu4 guan1， zai4 xiao4 zai4 yan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既见复关，载笑载言。
interpretations.explanation: 一旦看见你从复关来，又笑又说。

interpretations.segmentation: When I saw you coming from Fuguan, I laughed and talked with joy.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: er3 bo er3 shi4， ti3 wu2 jiu4 yan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔卜尔筮，体无咎言。
interpretations.explanation: 你占卦又占筮，结果没有凶兆。

interpretations.segmentation: You divined by tortoise and milfoil, and the omens held no blame.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: yi3 er3 che1 lai2， yi3 wo3 hui4 qian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 以尔车来，以我贿迁。
interpretations.explanation: 你用车来接我，把我的嫁妆运走。

interpretations.segmentation: You came with your cart to fetch me and carry away my dowry.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: sang1 zhi1 wei4 luo4， qi2 ye4 wo4 ruo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 桑之未落，其叶沃若。
interpretations.explanation: 桑树还未落叶，叶子润泽茂盛。

interpretations.segmentation: The mulberry had not yet shed its leaves; they were lush and moist.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: yu2 jie1 jiu1 xi1！

interpretations.segmentation: 于嗟鸠兮！
interpretations.explanation: 唉呀斑鸠啊！

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, the turtledove!

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: wu2 shi2 sang1 ren4。

interpretations.segmentation: 无食桑葚。
interpretations.explanation: 不要贪吃桑葚，（吃多了会醉人）。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not gorge on mulberries—they will intoxicate you.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: yu2 jie1 nv3 xi1！

interpretations.segmentation: 于嗟女兮！
interpretations.explanation: 唉呀女子啊！

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, young woman!

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: wu2 yu3 shi4 dan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无与士耽。
interpretations.explanation: 不要与男子沉溺于情爱。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not lose yourself in love with a man.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: shi4 zhi1 dan1 xi1， you2 ke3 shuo1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 士之耽兮，犹可说也。
interpretations.explanation: 男子沉溺于情，还可以解脱。

interpretations.segmentation: When a man is lost in love, he may still be talked out of it.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: nv3 zhi1 dan1 xi1， bu4 ke3 shuo1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 女之耽兮，不可说也。
interpretations.explanation: 女子沉溺于情，就无法解脱了。

interpretations.segmentation: When a woman is lost in love, there is no talking her free.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: sang1 zhi1 luo4 yi3， qi2 huang2 er2 yun3。

interpretations.segmentation: 桑之落矣，其黄而陨。
interpretations.explanation: 桑树已经落叶，叶子变黄飘落。

interpretations.segmentation: The mulberry has shed its leaves; they turn yellow and fall.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: zi4 wo3 cu2 er3， san1 sui4 shi2 pin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 自我徂尔，三岁食贫。
interpretations.explanation: 自从我嫁到你家，三年过着贫苦日子。

interpretations.segmentation: Since I came to you, three years we have lived in want.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: qi2 shui3 tang1 tang1， jian4 che1 wei2 shang。

interpretations.segmentation: 淇水汤汤，渐车帷裳。
interpretations.explanation: 淇水滚滚，漫湿了我的车帷。

interpretations.segmentation: The Qi runs broad and deep and soaked my carriage curtain.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: nv3 ye3 bu4 shuang3， shi4 er4 qi2 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 女也不爽，士二其行。
interpretations.explanation: 我没有差错，你却变心两意。

interpretations.segmentation: I have not been at fault, yet you go two ways at once.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: shi4 ye3 wang3 ji2， er4 san1 qi2 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 士也罔极，二三其德。
interpretations.explanation: 男子无底线，反复改变德行。

interpretations.segmentation: The man knows no limit and shifts his virtue again and again.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: san1 sui4 wei4 fu4， mi2 shi4 lao2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 三岁为妇，靡室劳矣。
interpretations.explanation: 三年做你的妻子，家务劳动没有稍息。

interpretations.segmentation: Three years as your wife—I never rested from household toil.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: su4 xing1 ye4 mei4， mi2 you3 chao2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 夙兴夜寐，靡有朝矣。
interpretations.explanation: 早起晚睡，没有一天有过早晨的闲暇。

interpretations.segmentation: Up early and late to bed—not one morning had I to myself.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: yan2 ji4 sui4 yi3， zhi4 yu2 bao4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 言既遂矣，至于暴矣。
interpretations.explanation: 你目的达到了，竟至于对我施暴。

interpretations.segmentation: Once you had your way, you even turned cruel to me.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: xiong1 di4 bu4 zhi1， xi4 qi2 xiao4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 兄弟不知，咥其笑矣。
interpretations.explanation: 兄弟不了解我，对我嗤笑。

interpretations.segmentation: My brothers did not understand and laughed at me.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: jing4 yan2 si1 zhi1， gong1 zi4 dao4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 静言思之，躬自悼矣。
interpretations.explanation: 静思此事，只能独自悲伤。

interpretations.segmentation: Thinking on it in silence, I can only mourn alone.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: ji2 er3 xie2 lao3， lao3 shi3 wo3 yuan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 及尔偕老，老使我怨。
interpretations.explanation: 当初说要白头偕老，到老只余怨恨。

interpretations.segmentation: You said we would grow old together—now old age would only mean resentment.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: qi2 ze2 you3 an4， xi2 ze2 you3 pan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 淇则有岸，隰则有泮。
interpretations.explanation: 淇水有岸，湿地有边，情变却无界。

interpretations.segmentation: The Qi has its bank and the marsh its shore—yet betrayal knows no bound.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.content: 总角之宴，言笑晏晏，信誓旦旦，不思其反。
sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: zong3 jiao3 zhi1 yan4， yan2 xiao4 yan4 yan4， xin4 shi4 dan4 dan4， bu4 si1 qi2 fan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 总角之宴，言笑晏晏，信誓旦旦，不思其反。
interpretations.explanation: 少年时欢宴言笑，誓言旦旦，却不想日后反悔。

interpretations.segmentation: In youth we feasted and laughed, swore oaths bright and clear, never thinking you would turn back.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang.pinyin: fan3 shi4 bu4 si1， yi4 yi3 yan1 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 反是不思，亦已焉哉！
interpretations.explanation: 既然你全然不想旧情，也就到此为止吧！

interpretations.segmentation: Since you will not think of the past at all, let it end here!

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua.content: 投我以木瓜，报之以琼琚。
sj-feng-weifeng-mugua.pinyin: tou2 wo3 yi3 mu4 gua1， bao4 zhi1 yi3 qiong2 ju1。

interpretations.segmentation: 投我以木瓜，报之以琼琚。
interpretations.explanation: 你赠我木瓜，我还你美玉佩。

interpretations.segmentation: You toss me a papaya; I return a fine jade pendant.

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua.pinyin: fei3 bao4 ye3， yong3 yi3 wei4 hao3 ye3！

interpretations.segmentation: 匪报也，永以为好也！
interpretations.explanation: 不是为了回报，是为永结友好！

interpretations.segmentation: Not as repayment—to bind our friendship forever!

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua.content: 投我以木桃，报之以琼瑶。
sj-feng-weifeng-mugua.pinyin: tou2 wo3 yi3 mu4 tao2， bao4 zhi1 yi3 qiong2 yao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 投我以木桃，报之以琼瑶。
interpretations.explanation: 你赠我木桃，我还你美玉瑶。

interpretations.segmentation: You toss me a peach-wood gift; I return fine jade and carnelian.

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua.pinyin: fei3 bao4 ye3， yong3 yi3 wei4 hao3 ye3！

interpretations.segmentation: 匪报也，永以为好也！
interpretations.explanation: 不是为了回报，是为永结友好！

interpretations.segmentation: Not as repayment—to bind our friendship forever!

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua.content: 投我以木李，报之以琼九。
sj-feng-weifeng-mugua.pinyin: tou2 wo3 yi3 mu4 li3， bao4 zhi1 yi3 qiong2 jiu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 投我以木李，报之以琼九。
interpretations.explanation: 你赠我木李，我还你美玉玖。

interpretations.segmentation: You toss me a plum-wood gift; I return dark fine jade.

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua.pinyin: fei3 bao4 ye3， yong3 yi3 wei4 hao3 ye3！

interpretations.segmentation: 匪报也，永以为好也！
interpretations.explanation: 不是为了回报，是为永结友好！

interpretations.segmentation: Not as repayment—to bind our friendship forever!

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao.pinyin: zhan1 bi3 qi2 ao4， lv4 zhu2 yi1 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻彼淇奥，绿竹猗猗。
interpretations.explanation: 远望淇水弯曲处，绿竹长得茂盛。

interpretations.segmentation: Gazing at the bends of the Qi, the green bamboo grows lush.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao.content: 有匪君子，如切如磋，如琢如磨，瑟兮僴兮，赫兮咺兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-qiao.pinyin: you3 fei3 jun1 zi， ru2 qie4 ru2 cuo1， ru2 zuo2 ru2 mo2， se4 xi1 xian4 xi1， he4 xi1 xuan3 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有匪君子，如切如磋，如琢如磨，瑟兮僴兮，赫兮咺兮。
interpretations.explanation: 有位俊美君子，如切磋骨角、如雕琢玉石；庄重而威严，光明又显赫。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a splendid gentleman—polished as bone on stone, refined as gem on jade; dignified and stern, bright and commanding.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao.pinyin: you3 fei3 jun1 zi， zhong1 bu4 ke3 xuan1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有匪君子，终不可谖兮。
interpretations.explanation: 有位俊美君子，永远不能忘怀啊。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a splendid gentleman—one can never forget him.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao.pinyin: zhan1 bi3 qi2 ao4， lv4 zhu2 qing1 qing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻彼淇奥，绿竹青青。
interpretations.explanation: 远望淇水弯曲处，绿竹青青。

interpretations.segmentation: Gazing at the bends of the Qi, the green bamboo is deep green.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao.content: 有匪君子，充耳秀莹，会弁如星。
sj-feng-weifeng-qiao.pinyin: you3 fei3 jun1 zi， chong1 er3 xiu4 ying2， hui4 bian4 ru2 xing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有匪君子，充耳秀莹，会弁如星。
interpretations.explanation: 有位俊美君子，充耳玉光莹润，帽上美玉如星。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a splendid gentleman—ear-plugs gleam, cap gems shine like stars.
瑟兮僴兮。
interpretations.explanation: 庄重而威严。

interpretations.segmentation: Dignified and stern.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao.content: 赫兮咺兮，有匪君子，终不可谖兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-qiao.pinyin: he4 xi1 xuan3 xi1， you3 fei3 jun1 zi， zhong1 bu4 ke3 xuan1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 赫兮咺兮，有匪君子，终不可谖兮。
interpretations.explanation: 光明又显赫；有位俊美君子，永远不能忘怀啊。

interpretations.segmentation: Bright and commanding—there is a splendid gentleman one can never forget.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao.pinyin: zhan1 bi3 qi2 ao4， lv4 zhu2 ru2 ze2。

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻彼淇奥，绿竹如箦。
interpretations.explanation: 远望淇水弯曲处，绿竹密如积。

interpretations.segmentation: Gazing at the bends of the Qi, the green bamboo stands thick as a stack.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao.content: 有匪君子，如金如锡，如圭如璧。
sj-feng-weifeng-qiao.pinyin: you3 fei3 jun1 zi， ru2 jin1 ru2 xi1， ru2 gui1 ru2 bi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 有匪君子，如金如锡，如圭如璧。
interpretations.explanation: 有位俊美君子，如金如锡，如圭如璧。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a splendid gentleman—like gold and tin, like scepter-stone and disk-jade.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao.pinyin: kuan1 xi1 chuo4 xi1， yi1 zhong4 jiao4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 宽兮绰兮，猗重较兮。
interpretations.explanation: 宽宏又从容，倚在车轼上。

interpretations.segmentation: Spacious and at ease, he leans on the chariot rail.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao.pinyin: shan4 xi4 xue4 xi1， bu4 wei4 nve4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 善戏谑兮，不为虐兮。
interpretations.explanation: 善于说笑取乐，却不伤人。

interpretations.segmentation: He jokes and teases well, yet never hurts.

sj-feng-weifeng-shimuzhijian.content: 十亩之间兮，桑者闲闲兮，行与子还兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-shimuzhijian.pinyin: shi2 mu3 zhi1 jian1 xi1， sang1 zhe3 xian2 xian2 xi1， xing2 yu3 zi hai2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 十亩之间兮，桑者闲闲兮，行与子还兮。
interpretations.explanation: 十亩桑园之间，采桑的人从容悠闲，我和你一起回家。

interpretations.segmentation: Among ten acres of mulberry, the pickers move at ease—I walk home with you.

sj-feng-weifeng-shimuzhijian.content: 十亩之外兮，桑者泄泄兮，行与子逝兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-shimuzhijian.pinyin: shi2 mu3 zhi1 wai4 xi1， sang1 zhe3 xie4 xie4 xi1， xing2 yu3 zi shi4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 十亩之外兮，桑者泄泄兮，行与子逝兮。
interpretations.explanation: 十亩桑园之外，采桑的人散放而行，我和你一同离去。

interpretations.segmentation: Beyond the ten acres, the pickers stroll freely—I go away with you.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren.pinyin: shuo4 ren2 qi2 qi2， yi1 jin3 jiong3 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 硕人其颀，衣锦褧衣。
interpretations.explanation: 新娘身材颀长，穿着锦缎罩衣。

interpretations.segmentation: The bride is tall and stately, wearing brocade over her robe.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren.pinyin: qi2 hou2 zhi1 zi， wei4 hou2 zhi1 qi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 齐侯之子，卫侯之妻。
interpretations.explanation: 她是齐侯的女儿，卫侯的妻子。

interpretations.segmentation: She is the daughter of the Lord of Qi, wife of the Lord of Wei.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren.content: 东宫之妹，邢侯之姨，谭公维私。
sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren.pinyin: dong1 gong1 zhi1 mei4， xing2 hou2 zhi1 yi2， tan2 gong1 wei2 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 东宫之妹，邢侯之姨，谭公维私。
interpretations.explanation: 东宫之妹，邢侯之姨，谭公之妻。

interpretations.segmentation: Sister of the heir, aunt of the Lord of Xing, wife of the Lord of Tan.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren.content: 手如柔荑，肤如凝脂，领如蝤蛴，齿如瓠犀，螓首蛾眉，巧笑倩兮，美目盼兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren.pinyin: shou3 ru2 rou2 ti2， fu1 ru2 ning2 zhi1， ling3 ru2 qiu2 qi2， chi3 ru2 hu4 xi1， qin2 shou3 e2 mei2， qiao3 xiao4 qian4 xi1， mei3 mu4 pan4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 手如柔荑，肤如凝脂，领如蝤蛴，齿如瓠犀，螓首蛾眉，巧笑倩兮，美目盼兮。
interpretations.explanation: 手像柔荑，肤像凝脂，颈像蝤蛴，齿像瓠犀，额广眉秀；巧笑倩兮，美目盼兮。

interpretations.segmentation: Hands like tender shoots, skin like congealed cream, neck like larvae-white, teeth like melon seeds, broad brow and fine brows—her clever smile charms, her lovely eyes glance.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren.pinyin: shuo4 ren2 ao2 ao2， shuo1 yu2 nong2 jiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 硕人敖敖，说于农郊。
interpretations.explanation: 新娘体态闲雅，在郊外农人面前致意。

interpretations.segmentation: The stately bride greets the farmers in the outskirts.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren.pinyin: si4 mu3 you3 jiao1， zhu1 fen2 biao1 biao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 四牡有骄，朱幩镳镳。
interpretations.explanation: 四匹雄马骄健，朱饰马络鲜明。

interpretations.segmentation: Four stallions are proud; red trappings gleam.
翟茀以朝。
interpretations.explanation: 以雉羽为饰的车驾上朝。

interpretations.segmentation: She rides in state to court in a carriage hung with pheasant feathers.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren.pinyin: da4 fu1 su4 tui4， wu2 shi3 jun1 lao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 大夫夙退，无使君劳。
interpretations.explanation: 大夫们早退，莫使国君劳倦。

interpretations.segmentation: Let the ministers withdraw early—do not weary our lord.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren.pinyin: he2 shui3 yang2 yang2， bei3 liu2 huo2 huo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 河水洋洋，北流活活。
interpretations.explanation: 黄河水势浩荡，向北奔流活活。

interpretations.segmentation: The Yellow River rolls vast, flowing north with a rushing sound.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren.pinyin: shi1 gu1 hui4 hui4， zhan1 wei3 fa1 fa1。

interpretations.segmentation: 施罛濊濊，鳣鲔发发。
interpretations.explanation: 撒网入水濊濊，鳣鲔游动发发。

interpretations.segmentation: Cast nets splash wide; sturgeon and trout dart and flash.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren.content: 葭菼揭揭，庶姜孽孽，庶士有朅。
sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren.pinyin: jia1 tan3 jie1 jie1， shu4 jiang1 nie4 nie4， shu4 shi4 you3 qie4。

interpretations.segmentation: 葭菼揭揭，庶姜孽孽，庶士有朅。
interpretations.explanation: 芦苇荻花揭揭，陪嫁众女盛美，士人前来迎亲。

interpretations.segmentation: Reeds and rushes rise tall; the attendant ladies are glorious; gentlemen come to meet the bride.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu.pinyin: shuo4 shu3 shuo4 shu3， wu2 shi2 wo3 shu3！

interpretations.segmentation: 硕鼠硕鼠，无食我黍！
interpretations.explanation: 大鼠啊大鼠，不要吃我的黍！

interpretations.segmentation: Big rat, big rat—do not eat my millet!

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu.pinyin: san1 sui4 guan4 nv3， mo4 wo3 ken3 gu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 三岁贯女，莫我肯顾。
interpretations.explanation: 多年供养你，你却不肯顾念我。

interpretations.segmentation: Years we have fed you, yet you never care for us.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu.pinyin: shi4 jiang1 qu4 nv3， shi4 bi3 le4 tu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 逝将去女，适彼乐土。
interpretations.explanation: 我要离开你，到那安乐的土地去。

interpretations.segmentation: I will leave you and go to that happy land.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu.pinyin: le4 tu3 le4 tu3， yuan2 de2 wo3 suo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐土乐土，爰得我所。
interpretations.explanation: 安乐的土地啊，那里才有我的归宿。

interpretations.segmentation: Happy land, happy land—there I shall find my place.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu.pinyin: shuo4 shu3 shuo4 shu3， wu2 shi2 wo3 mai4！

interpretations.segmentation: 硕鼠硕鼠，无食我麦！
interpretations.explanation: 大鼠啊大鼠，不要吃我的麦！

interpretations.segmentation: Big rat, big rat—do not eat my wheat!

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu.pinyin: san1 sui4 guan4 nv3， mo4 wo3 ken3 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 三岁贯女，莫我肯德。
interpretations.explanation: 多年供养你，你却不肯感激我。

interpretations.segmentation: Years we have fed you, yet you never repay us.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu.pinyin: shi4 jiang1 qu4 nv3， shi4 bi3 le4 guo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 逝将去女，适彼乐国。
interpretations.explanation: 我要离开你，到那安乐的国家去。

interpretations.segmentation: I will leave you and go to that happy state.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu.pinyin: le4 guo2 le4 guo2， yuan2 de2 wo3 zhi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐国乐国，爰得我直。
interpretations.explanation: 安乐的国家啊，那里才有我的所值。

interpretations.segmentation: Happy state, happy state—there I shall find my worth.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu.pinyin: shuo4 shu3 shuo4 shu3， wu2 shi2 wo3 miao2！

interpretations.segmentation: 硕鼠硕鼠，无食我苗！
interpretations.explanation: 大鼠啊大鼠，不要吃我的苗！

interpretations.segmentation: Big rat, big rat—do not eat my young crops!

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu.pinyin: san1 sui4 guan4 nv3， mo4 wo3 ken3 lao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 三岁贯女，莫我肯劳。
interpretations.explanation: 多年供养你，你却不肯慰劳我。

interpretations.segmentation: Years we have fed you, yet you never comfort our toil.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu.pinyin: shi4 jiang1 qu4 nv3， shi4 bi3 le4 jiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 逝将去女，适彼乐郊。
interpretations.explanation: 我要离开你，到那安乐的郊野去。

interpretations.segmentation: I will leave you and go to that happy borderland.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu.pinyin: le4 jiao1 le4 jiao1， shui2 zhi1 yong3 hao4？
