interpretations.segmentation: We descend to view the mulberry fields; divination says auspicious—and so it proves good.

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong.content: 灵雨既零，命彼倌人，星言夙驾，说于桑田。
sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong.pinyin: ling2 yu3 ji4 ling2， ming4 bi3 guan1 ren2， xing1 yan2 su4 jia4， shuo1 yu2 sang1 tian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 灵雨既零，命彼倌人，星言夙驾，说于桑田。
interpretations.explanation: 好雨已下，命那管园人，星夜早驾，到桑田慰劳。

interpretations.segmentation: The blessed rain has fallen; we bid the keeper drive out at starlight and greet the mulberry fields.

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong.content: 匪直也人，秉心塞渊，騋牝三千。
sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong.pinyin: fei3 zhi2 ye3 ren2， bing3 xin1 sai1 yuan1， lai2 pin4 san1 qian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪直也人，秉心塞渊，騋牝三千。
interpretations.explanation: 不只是因为人好，更因秉性深沉，马匹三千。

interpretations.segmentation: Not men alone are upright—their hearts are deep and true, and three thousand mares stand in the stalls.

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao.pinyin: jie2 jie2 gan4 mao2， zai4 jun4 zhi1 jiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 孑孑干旄，在浚之郊。
interpretations.explanation: 孤零零的牛尾旗高举，出现在浚城郊外。

interpretations.segmentation: Alone flies the ox-tail banner, out on the outskirts of Jun.

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao.pinyin: su4 si1 pi1 zhi1， liang2 ma3 si4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 素丝纰之，良马四之。
interpretations.explanation: 用白丝绳编饰旗杆，以四匹良马驾车。

interpretations.segmentation: White silk cords trim the staff; four fine horses draw the chariot.

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao.pinyin: bi3 shu1 zhe3 zi， he2 yi3 bi4 zhi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 彼姝者子，何以畀之？
interpretations.explanation: 那位贤德之士，该用什么赠给他呢？

interpretations.segmentation: That worthy man—what shall we bestow upon him?

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao.pinyin: jie2 jie2 gan4 yu2， zai4 jun4 zhi1 dou1。

interpretations.segmentation: 孑孑干旟，在浚之都。
interpretations.explanation: 孤零零的鸟隼旗飘扬，在浚城都邑。

interpretations.segmentation: Alone flies the falcon banner, at the capital of Jun.

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao.pinyin: su4 si1 zu3 zhi1， liang2 ma3 wu3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 素丝组之，良马五之。
interpretations.explanation: 用白丝绳编织旗饰，以五匹良马驾车。

interpretations.segmentation: White silk is woven into the pennant; five fine horses draw the chariot.

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao.pinyin: bi3 shu1 zhe3 zi， he2 yi3 yu3 zhi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 彼姝者子，何以予之？
interpretations.explanation: 那位贤德之士，该用什么给予他呢？

interpretations.segmentation: That worthy man—what shall we grant him?

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao.pinyin: jie2 jie2 gan4 jing1， zai4 jun4 zhi1 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 孑孑干旌，在浚之城。
interpretations.explanation: 孤零零的羽旌招展，在浚城城下。

interpretations.segmentation: Alone flies the feathered standard, below the walls of Jun.

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao.pinyin: su4 si1 zhu4 zhi1， liang2 ma3 liu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 素丝祝之，良马六之。
interpretations.explanation: 用白丝绳扎束旗杆，以六匹良马驾车。

interpretations.segmentation: White silk binds the staff; six fine horses draw the chariot.

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao.pinyin: bi3 shu1 zhe3 zi， he2 yi3 gao4 zhi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 彼姝者子，何以告之？
interpretations.explanation: 那位贤德之士，该用什么告知他呢？

interpretations.segmentation: That worthy man—what shall we declare to him?

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao.pinyin: jun1 zi xie2 lao3， fu4 ji1 liu4 jia1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子偕老，副笄六珈。
interpretations.explanation: 君子与她白头偕老，她头戴副笄，缀有六珈。

interpretations.segmentation: The lord grows old with her; she wears the ceremonial hairpin with six jade pendants.

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao.content: 委委佗佗，如山如河，象服是宜。
sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao.pinyin: wei3 wei3 tuo2 tuo2， ru2 shan1 ru2 he2， xiang4 fu2 shi4 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 委委佗佗，如山如河，象服是宜。
interpretations.explanation: 她举止雍容，如山如河，穿绘有象牙的礼服十分相宜。

interpretations.segmentation: Graceful and stately as mountains and rivers, she suits her robe embroidered with ivory figures.

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao.pinyin: zi zhi1 bu4 shu1， yun2 ru2 zhi1 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 子之不淑，云如之何？
interpretations.explanation: 你的品行却不善，这该怎么办呢？

interpretations.segmentation: Your conduct is not good—what can be done about it?

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao.pinyin: ci3 xi1 ci3 xi1， qi2 zhi1 di2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 玼兮玼兮，其之翟也。
interpretations.explanation: 多么鲜明啊，她穿的翟衣。

interpretations.segmentation: How bright and clear—her robe of pheasant feathers!

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao.pinyin: zhen3 fa1 ru2 yun2， bu4 xie4 di2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鬒发如云，不屑髢也。
interpretations.explanation: 黑发如云，不必用假发修饰。

interpretations.segmentation: Her black hair is like clouds; she need not wear a wig.

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao.content: 玉之瑱也，象之揥也，扬且之晳也。
sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao.pinyin: yu4 zhi1 zhen4 ye3， xiang4 zhi1 ti4 ye3， yang2 qie3 zhi1 xi1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 玉之瑱也，象之揥也，扬且之晳也。
interpretations.explanation: 耳上玉瑱，头上象簪，额角洁白明亮。

interpretations.segmentation: Jade ear-plugs, an ivory hairpin, and a fair, bright brow.
胡然而天也！
interpretations.explanation: 怎么竟像天神一般！

interpretations.segmentation: How can she seem like a being of heaven!
胡然而帝也。
interpretations.explanation: 怎么竟像上帝一般。

interpretations.segmentation: How can she seem like a divine sovereign!

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao.pinyin: cuo1 xi1 cuo1 xi1， qi2 zhi1 zhan3 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 瑳兮瑳兮，其之展也。
interpretations.explanation: 多么洁白啊，她穿的展衣。

interpretations.segmentation: How pure and white—her ceremonial robe!

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao.pinyin: meng2 bi3 zhou4 chi1， shi4 xie4 pan4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 蒙彼绉絺，是绁袢也。
interpretations.explanation: 外罩绉纱单衣，里面是绁袢。

interpretations.segmentation: Over fine crepe she wears an outer robe; beneath is her inner garment.

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao.pinyin: zi zhi1 qing1 yang2， yang2 qie3 zhi1 yan2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 子之清扬，扬且之颜也。
interpretations.explanation: 你眉目清朗，额角和颜悦色。

interpretations.segmentation: Your brows and eyes are clear; your brow is fair and serene.

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao.pinyin: zhan3 ru2 zhi1 ren2 xi1， bang1 zhi1 yuan4 ye3！

interpretations.segmentation: 展如之人兮，邦之媛也！
interpretations.explanation: 像这样真美的人，是国家的佳丽！

interpretations.segmentation: A woman truly fair as this is the beauty of the state!

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci.pinyin: qiang2 you3 ci2， bu4 ke3 sao3 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 墙有茨，不可扫也。
interpretations.explanation: 墙上长着蒺藜，没法扫掉。

interpretations.segmentation: Thistles grow on the wall—they cannot be swept away.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci.pinyin: zhong1 gou4 zhi1 yan2， bu4 ke3 dao4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 中冓之言，不可道也。
interpretations.explanation: 宫廷内部的丑话，没法说出口。

interpretations.segmentation: The shameful talk within the court cannot be spoken aloud.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci.pinyin: suo3 ke3 dao4 ye3， yan2 zhi1 chou3 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 所可道也，言之丑也。
interpretations.explanation: 若要说出来，那话太丑恶了。

interpretations.segmentation: If one could tell it, the words would be too ugly.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci.pinyin: qiang2 you3 ci2， bu4 ke3 xiang1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 墙有茨，不可襄也。
interpretations.explanation: 墙上长着蒺藜，没法除掉。

interpretations.segmentation: Thistles grow on the wall—they cannot be cleared away.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci.pinyin: zhong1 gou4 zhi1 yan2， bu4 ke3 xiang2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 中冓之言，不可详也。
interpretations.explanation: 宫廷内部的丑话，没法细说。

interpretations.segmentation: The shameful talk within the court cannot be told in detail.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci.pinyin: suo3 ke3 xiang2 ye3， yan2 zhi1 zhang3 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 所可详也，言之长也。
interpretations.explanation: 若要说细，那话太长了。

interpretations.segmentation: If one could recount it, the tale would be too long.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci.pinyin: qiang2 you3 ci2， bu4 ke3 shu4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 墙有茨，不可束也。
interpretations.explanation: 墙上长着蒺藜，没法捆束。

interpretations.segmentation: Thistles grow on the wall—they cannot be bound up.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci.pinyin: zhong1 gou4 zhi1 yan2， bu4 ke3 du2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 中冓之言，不可读也。
interpretations.explanation: 宫廷内部的丑话，没法传读。

interpretations.segmentation: The shameful talk within the court cannot be read aloud.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci.pinyin: suo3 ke3 du2 ye3， yan2 zhi1 ru3 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 所可读也，言之辱也。
interpretations.explanation: 若要说出来，那太辱没人了。

interpretations.segmentation: If one could speak it, it would be too humiliating.
爰采唐矣？
interpretations.explanation: 到哪里采女萝呢？

interpretations.segmentation: Where shall we gather the tang plant?
沬之乡矣。
interpretations.explanation: 在沬邑的乡中。

interpretations.segmentation: In the hamlets of Mei.
云谁之思？
interpretations.explanation: 我思念的是谁呢？

interpretations.segmentation: Whom do I long for?
美孟姜矣。
interpretations.explanation: 是美丽的孟姜。

interpretations.segmentation: The lovely Meng Jiang.

sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong.content: 期我乎桑中，要我乎上宫，送我乎淇之上矣。
sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong.pinyin: qi1 wo3 hu1 sang1 zhong1， yao4 wo3 hu1 shang4 gong1， song4 wo3 hu1 qi2 zhi1 shang4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 期我乎桑中，要我乎上宫，送我乎淇之上矣。
interpretations.explanation: 在桑中与我相约，在上宫等我，在淇水之上送我。

interpretations.segmentation: She fixed a tryst with me at Sangzhong, waited for me at Shanggong, and saw me off on the Qi riverbank.
爰采麦矣？
interpretations.explanation: 到哪里采麦呢？

interpretations.segmentation: Where shall we gather wheat?
沬之北矣。
interpretations.explanation: 在沬邑的北边。

interpretations.segmentation: North of Mei.
云谁之思？
interpretations.explanation: 我思念的是谁呢？

interpretations.segmentation: Whom do I long for?
美孟弋矣。
interpretations.explanation: 是美丽的孟弋。

interpretations.segmentation: The lovely Meng Yi.

sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong.content: 期我乎桑中，要我乎上宫，送我乎淇之上矣。
sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong.pinyin: qi1 wo3 hu1 sang1 zhong1， yao4 wo3 hu1 shang4 gong1， song4 wo3 hu1 qi2 zhi1 shang4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 期我乎桑中，要我乎上宫，送我乎淇之上矣。
interpretations.explanation: 在桑中与我相约，在上宫等我，在淇水之上送我。

interpretations.segmentation: She fixed a tryst with me at Sangzhong, waited for me at Shanggong, and saw me off on the Qi riverbank.
爰采葑矣？
interpretations.explanation: 到哪里采葑菜呢？

interpretations.segmentation: Where shall we gather turnip greens?
沬之东矣。
interpretations.explanation: 在沬邑的东边。

interpretations.segmentation: East of Mei.
云谁之思？
interpretations.explanation: 我思念的是谁呢？

interpretations.segmentation: Whom do I long for?
美孟庸矣。
interpretations.explanation: 是美丽的孟庸。

interpretations.segmentation: The lovely Meng Yong.

sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong.content: 期我乎桑中，要我乎上宫，送我乎淇之上矣。
sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong.pinyin: qi1 wo3 hu1 sang1 zhong1， yao4 wo3 hu1 shang4 gong1， song4 wo3 hu1 qi2 zhi1 shang4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 期我乎桑中，要我乎上宫，送我乎淇之上矣。
interpretations.explanation: 在桑中与我相约，在上宫等我，在淇水之上送我。

interpretations.segmentation: She fixed a tryst with me at Sangzhong, waited for me at Shanggong, and saw me off on the Qi riverbank.

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu.pinyin: xiang1 shu3 you3 pi2， ren2 er2 wu2 yi2！

interpretations.segmentation: 相鼠有皮，人而无仪！
interpretations.explanation: 看那老鼠还有皮，人却没有威仪！

interpretations.segmentation: Look—the rat has its hide, yet this man has no dignity!

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu.pinyin: ren2 er2 wu2 yi2， bu4 si3 he2 wei4？

interpretations.segmentation: 人而无仪，不死何为？
interpretations.explanation: 人若无威仪，不死还等什么？

interpretations.segmentation: If a man lacks dignity, why does he not die?

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu.pinyin: xiang1 shu3 you3 chi3， ren2 er2 wu2 zhi3！

interpretations.segmentation: 相鼠有齿，人而无止！
interpretations.explanation: 看那老鼠还有牙齿，人却没有节制！

interpretations.segmentation: Look—the rat has teeth, yet this man has no restraint!

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu.pinyin: ren2 er2 wu2 zhi3， bu4 si3 he2 qi2？

interpretations.segmentation: 人而无止，不死何俟？
interpretations.explanation: 人若无节制，不死还等何时？

interpretations.segmentation: If a man lacks restraint, what is he waiting for but death?

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu.content: 相鼠有体，人而无礼，人而无礼！
sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu.pinyin: xiang1 shu3 you3 ti3， ren2 er2 wu2 li3， ren2 er2 wu2 li3！

interpretations.segmentation: 相鼠有体，人而无礼，人而无礼！
interpretations.explanation: 看那老鼠还有身体，人却没有礼节，人却没有礼节！

interpretations.segmentation: Look—the rat has a body, yet this man has no propriety—no propriety at all!
胡不遄死？
interpretations.explanation: 为什么不快点去死？

interpretations.segmentation: Why does he not hurry up and die?

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi.pinyin: zai4 chi2 zai4 qu1， gui1 yan4 wei4 hou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 载驰载驱，归唁卫侯。
interpretations.explanation: 车马疾驰，我要回去慰问卫侯。

interpretations.segmentation: I drive on, I hurry on, to return and comfort the lord of Wei.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi.pinyin: qu1 ma3 you1 you1， yan2 zhi4 yu2 cao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 驱马悠悠，言至于漕。
interpretations.explanation: 策马悠悠，说到漕地。

interpretations.segmentation: The horses travel far; I say I have reached Cao.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi.pinyin: da4 fu1 ba2 she4， wo3 xin1 ze2 you1。

interpretations.segmentation: 大夫跋涉，我心则忧。
interpretations.explanation: 大夫们跋山涉水赶来，我的心却满怀忧愁。

interpretations.segmentation: The ministers come struggling over hills and streams, yet my heart is full of grief.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi.pinyin: ji4 bu4 wo3 jia1， bu4 neng2 xuan2 fan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 既不我嘉，不能旋反。
interpretations.explanation: 既然不赞许我，我也不能马上回去。

interpretations.segmentation: Since you do not approve of me, I cannot turn back at once.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi.pinyin: shi4 er3 bu4 zang1， wo3 si1 bu4 yuan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 视尔不臧，我思不远。
interpretations.explanation: 看你们并不善，我的思念并不远。

interpretations.segmentation: You are not kind, yet my longing is not far from home.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi.pinyin: ji4 bu4 wo3 jia1， bu4 neng2 xuan2 ji4？

interpretations.segmentation: 既不我嘉，不能旋济？
interpretations.explanation: 既然不赞许我，难道不能渡河返回？

interpretations.segmentation: Since you do not approve of me, can I not cross the river and return?

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi.pinyin: shi4 er3 bu4 zang1， wo3 si1 bu4 bi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 视尔不臧，我思不閟。
interpretations.explanation: 看你们并不善，我的心思藏不住。

interpretations.segmentation: You are not kind, yet I cannot hide my thoughts.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi.pinyin: zhi4 bi3 a1 qiu1， yan2 cai3 qi2 meng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 陟彼阿丘，言采其蝱。
interpretations.explanation: 登上那阿丘，说要采那里的益母草。

interpretations.segmentation: I climb that hillock, saying I will gather its medicinal plants.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi.pinyin: nv3 zi shan4 huai2， yi4 ge4 you3 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 女子善怀，亦各有行。
interpretations.explanation: 女子多怀忧思，也各有其道理。

interpretations.segmentation: Women are prone to sorrow, yet each has her own way.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi.pinyin: xu3 ren2 you2 zhi1， zhong4 zhi4 qie3 kuang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 许人尤之，众稚且狂。
interpretations.explanation: 许国人责备我，说我幼稚又狂妄。

interpretations.segmentation: The people of Xu blame me, calling me childish and reckless.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi.pinyin: wo3 xing2 qi2 ye3， peng2 peng2 qi2 mai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我行其野，芃芃其麦。
interpretations.explanation: 我行走在原野上，麦子长得茂盛。

interpretations.segmentation: I walk the open country; the wheat grows lush and tall.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi.pinyin: kong4 yu2 da4 bang1， shui2 yin1 shui2 ji2？

interpretations.segmentation: 控于大邦，谁因谁极？
interpretations.explanation: 向大国求助，谁能依靠、谁能到头？

interpretations.segmentation: I appeal to a great state—on whom can I rely, and who will see it through?

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi.pinyin: da4 fu1 jun1 zi， wu2 wo3 you3 you2。

interpretations.segmentation: 大夫君子，无我有尤。
interpretations.explanation: 各位大夫君子，不要责怪我。

interpretations.segmentation: You ministers and gentlemen, do not blame me.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi.pinyin: bai3 er3 suo3 si1， bu4 ru2 wo3 suo3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 百尔所思，不如我所之。
interpretations.explanation: 你们百般谋划，不如我所行的道路。

interpretations.segmentation: All your schemes are not equal to the course I have taken.

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei.pinyin: biao1 you3 mei2， qi2 shi2 qi1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 摽有梅，其实七兮。
interpretations.explanation: 梅子纷纷落地，还剩七成。

interpretations.segmentation: Plums fall and scatter; seven tenths of the fruit remain.

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei.pinyin: qiu2 wo3 shu4 shi4， dai4 qi2 ji2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 求我庶士，迨其吉兮。
interpretations.explanation: 各位士子来求我吧，趁这吉利时候。

interpretations.segmentation: Come woo me, you gentlemen—while the time is auspicious.

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei.pinyin: biao1 you3 mei2， qi2 shi2 san1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 摽有梅，其实三兮。
interpretations.explanation: 梅子纷纷落地，只剩三成。

interpretations.segmentation: Plums fall and scatter; only three tenths remain.

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei.pinyin: qiu2 wo3 shu4 shi4， dai4 qi2 jin1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 求我庶士，迨其今兮。

interpretations.segmentation: How does it gnaw through my wall?

interpretations.explanation: 林中有小木，野地有死鹿。

interpretations.segmentation: In the grove are saplings; in the field lies a dead deer.

sj-feng-zhaonan-yeyousijun.pinyin: bai2 mao2 chun2 shu4， you3 nv3 ru2 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 白茅纯束，有女如玉。
interpretations.explanation: 白茅成捆扎好，有女子美如玉。

interpretations.segmentation: White rushes bind it in a bundle; a maiden fair as jade.

sj-feng-zhaonan-yeyousijun.content: 舒而脱脱兮，无感我帨兮，无使尨也吠。
sj-feng-zhaonan-yeyousijun.pinyin: shu1 er2 tuo1 tuo1 xi1， wu2 gan3 wo3 shui4 xi1， wu2 shi3 mang2 ye3 fei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 舒而脱脱兮，无感我帨兮，无使尨也吠。
interpretations.explanation: 慢慢脱衣啊，别碰我的佩巾，别让狗叫起来。

interpretations.segmentation: Slowly, gently remove your clothes; do not touch my scarf; do not let the dog bark.

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei.pinyin: yin1 qi2 lei2， zai4 nan2 shan1 zhi1 yang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 殷其雷，在南山之阳。
interpretations.explanation: 雷声隆隆，在南山之阳。

interpretations.segmentation: Thunder rolls, on the sunny side of the southern hill.

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei.pinyin: he2 si1 wei2 si1， mo4 gan3 huo4 huang2？

interpretations.segmentation: 何斯违斯，莫敢或遑？
interpretations.explanation: 为何离开这里，不敢有片刻闲暇？

interpretations.segmentation: Why leave this place—daring not a moment's rest?

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei.pinyin: zhen4 zhen4 jun1 zi， gui1 zai1 gui1 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 振振君子，归哉归哉！
interpretations.explanation: 忠厚君子啊，归来吧归来吧！

interpretations.segmentation: Steadfast lord, come home—come home!

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei.pinyin: yin1 qi2 lei2， zai4 nan2 shan1 zhi1 ce4。

interpretations.segmentation: 殷其雷，在南山之侧。
interpretations.explanation: 雷声隆隆，在南山之侧。

interpretations.segmentation: Thunder rolls, on the flank of the southern hill.

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei.pinyin: he2 si1 wei2 si1， mo4 gan3 huang2 xi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 何斯违斯，莫敢遑息？
interpretations.explanation: 为何离开这里，不敢休息片刻？

interpretations.segmentation: Why leave this place—daring not to pause and rest?

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei.pinyin: zhen4 zhen4 jun1 zi， gui1 zai1 gui1 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 振振君子，归哉归哉！
interpretations.explanation: 忠厚君子啊，归来吧归来吧！

interpretations.segmentation: Steadfast lord, come home—come home!

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei.pinyin: yin1 qi2 lei2， zai4 nan2 shan1 zhi1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 殷其雷，在南山之下。
interpretations.explanation: 雷声隆隆，在南山之下。

interpretations.segmentation: Thunder rolls, below the southern hill.

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei.pinyin: he2 si1 wei2 si1， mo4 huo4 huang2 chu4？

interpretations.segmentation: 何斯违斯，莫或遑处？
interpretations.explanation: 为何离开这里，不敢安居停留？

interpretations.segmentation: Why leave this place—daring not to stay and dwell?

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei.pinyin: zhen4 zhen4 jun1 zi， gui1 zai1 gui1 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 振振君子，归哉归哉！
interpretations.explanation: 忠厚君子啊，归来吧归来吧！

interpretations.segmentation: Steadfast lord, come home—come home!

sj-feng-zhaonan-zouyu.content: 彼茁者葭，壹发五豝，于嗟乎驺虞！
sj-feng-zhaonan-zouyu.pinyin: bi3 zhuo2 zhe3 jia1， yi1 fa1 wu3 ba1， yu2 jie1 hu1 zou1 yu2！

interpretations.segmentation: 彼茁者葭，壹发五豝，于嗟乎驺虞！
interpretations.explanation: 那茁壮的芦苇，一箭射中五头小猪，啊驺虞！

interpretations.segmentation: Lush reeds grow tall; one shot brings down five piglets—ah, Zou Yu!

sj-feng-zhaonan-zouyu.content: 彼茁者蓬，壹发五豵，于嗟乎驺虞！
sj-feng-zhaonan-zouyu.pinyin: bi3 zhuo2 zhe3 peng2， yi1 fa1 wu3 zong1， yu2 jie1 hu1 zou1 yu2！

interpretations.segmentation: 彼茁者蓬，壹发五豵，于嗟乎驺虞！
interpretations.explanation: 那茁壮的蓬草，一箭射中五头小豕，啊驺虞！

interpretations.segmentation: Lush wormwood grows tall; one shot brings down five shoats—ah, Zou Yu!

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen.pinyin: chu1 qi2 dong1 men2， you3 nv3 ru2 yun2。

interpretations.segmentation: 出其东门，有女如云。
interpretations.explanation: 走出东门，女子多如云。

interpretations.segmentation: Out of the east gate—girls thick as clouds.
虽则如云。
interpretations.explanation: 虽然多如云。

interpretations.segmentation: Though they are thick as clouds,
匪我思存。
interpretations.explanation: 却不是我所思念的。

interpretations.segmentation: They are not the one I hold in my heart.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen.pinyin: gao3 yi1 qi2 jin1， liao2 le4 wo3 yuan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 缟衣綦巾，聊乐我员。
interpretations.explanation: 穿素衣戴綦巾的她，足以使我快乐。

interpretations.segmentation: She in white robe and green scarf is enough to make me glad.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen.pinyin: chu1 qi2 yin1 du1， you3 nv3 ru2 tu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 出其闉阇，有女如荼。
interpretations.explanation: 走出城门外，女子多如茶白。

interpretations.segmentation: Out through the city gate—girls white as tea blossoms.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen.pinyin: sui1 ze2 ru2 tu2， fei3 wo3 si1 qie3。

interpretations.segmentation: 虽则如荼，匪我思且。
interpretations.explanation: 虽然多如茶白，却不是我所思的。

interpretations.segmentation: Though white as tea blossoms, she is not the one I long for.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen.pinyin: gao3 yi1 ru2 lv2， liao2 ke3 yu3 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 缟衣茹藘，聊可与娱。
interpretations.explanation: 穿素衣戴茹藘（红巾）的她，可以与她相娱。

interpretations.segmentation: She in white robe and red scarf— with her I may find joy.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.pinyin: shu1 yu2 tian2， cheng2 cheng2 ma3。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔于田，乘乘马。
interpretations.explanation: 叔去田猎，驾四马。

interpretations.segmentation: Uncle goes hunting, driving a team of four.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.pinyin: zhi2 pei4 ru2 zu3， liang3 can1 ru2 wu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 执辔如组，两骖如舞。
interpretations.explanation: 握缰如组，两骖马如舞。

interpretations.segmentation: He holds the reins like woven cords; the outer pair prance like dancers.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.pinyin: shu1 zai4 sou3， huo3 lie4 ju4 ju3。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔在薮，火烈具举。
interpretations.explanation: 叔在泽薮，烈火齐举。

interpretations.segmentation: Uncle is in the marsh; fires blaze all around.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.pinyin: tan3 ti4 bao4 hu3， xian4 yu2 gong1 suo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 襢裼暴虎，献于公所。
interpretations.explanation: 袒衣搏虎，献于公所。

interpretations.segmentation: Bare-chested he wrestles a tiger and presents it at the lord's place.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.pinyin: jiang1 shu1 wu4 niu3， jie4 qi2 shang1 nv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 将叔勿狃，戒其伤女。
interpretations.explanation: 请叔别习以为常，当心伤着你。

interpretations.segmentation: Uncle, do not grow reckless—take care lest you be hurt.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.pinyin: shu1 yu2 tian2， cheng2 cheng2 huang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔于田，乘乘黄。
interpretations.explanation: 叔去田猎，驾黄马。

interpretations.segmentation: Uncle goes hunting, driving bay horses.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.pinyin: liang3 fu2 shang4 xiang1， liang3 can1 yan4 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 两服上襄，两骖雁行。
interpretations.explanation: 两服马齐上，两骖如雁行。

interpretations.segmentation: The inner pair pull evenly; the outer pair fly like geese in line.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.pinyin: shu1 zai4 sou3， huo3 lie4 ju4 yang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔在薮，火烈具扬。
interpretations.explanation: 叔在泽薮，烈火齐扬。

interpretations.segmentation: Uncle is in the marsh; flames leap high together.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.pinyin: shu1 shan4 she4 ji4， you4 liang2 yu4 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔善射忌，又良御忌。
interpretations.explanation: 叔善于射箭，又善于驾车。

interpretations.segmentation: Uncle shoots well and drives well too.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.pinyin: yi4 qing4 kong4 ji4， yi4 zong4 song4 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 抑罄控忌，抑纵送忌。
interpretations.explanation: 时而勒马，时而纵放，技艺精熟。

interpretations.segmentation: Now he reins in, now he lets go—skilled in every move.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.pinyin: shu1 yu2 tian2， cheng2 cheng2 bao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔于田，乘乘鸨。
interpretations.explanation: 叔去田猎，驾杂色马。

interpretations.segmentation: Uncle goes hunting, driving piebald horses.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.pinyin: liang3 fu2 qi2 shou3， liang3 can1 ru2 shou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 两服齐首，两骖如手。
interpretations.explanation: 两服马齐头，两骖如手。

interpretations.segmentation: The inner pair match heads; the outer pair move like hands in unison.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.pinyin: shu1 zai4 sou3， huo3 lie4 ju4 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔在薮，火烈具阜。
interpretations.explanation: 叔在泽薮，烈火齐盛。

interpretations.segmentation: Uncle is in the marsh; the fires burn fierce together.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.content: 叔马慢忌，叔发罕忌，抑释掤忌，抑鬯弓忌。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian.pinyin: shu1 ma3 man4 ji4， shu1 fa1 han3 ji4， yi4 shi4 bing1 ji4， yi4 chang4 gong1 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔马慢忌，叔发罕忌，抑释掤忌，抑鬯弓忌。
interpretations.explanation: 叔马舒缓，叔发稀少，放下盾牌，放松弓弦。

interpretations.segmentation: Uncle's horses slow; his shots are few; he sets aside shield and loosens bow.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dongmenzhishan.pinyin: dong1 men2 zhi1 shan4， ru2 lv2 zai4 ban3。

interpretations.segmentation: 东门之墠，茹藘在阪。
interpretations.explanation: 东门外的广场，茹藘长在山坡。

interpretations.segmentation: On the open ground east of the gate, madder grows on the slope.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dongmenzhishan.pinyin: qi2 shi4 ze2 er3， qi2 ren2 shen4 yuan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 其室则迩，其人甚远。
interpretations.explanation: 他家离得近，人却很远。

interpretations.segmentation: His house is near, yet the man is far away.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dongmenzhishan.pinyin: dong1 men2 zhi1 li4， you3 jian4 jia1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 东门之栗，有践家室。
interpretations.explanation: 东门的栗树，有整齐的人家。

interpretations.segmentation: East-gate chestnut trees—orderly homes stand there.
岂不尔思？
interpretations.explanation: 难道不想你吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Do I not long for you?
子不我即！
interpretations.explanation: 你不来亲近我！

interpretations.segmentation: You do not come to me!

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng.content: 子之丰兮，俟我乎巷兮，悔予不送兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng.pinyin: zi zhi1 feng1 xi1， qi2 wo3 hu1 xiang4 xi1， hui3 yu3 bu4 song4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 子之丰兮，俟我乎巷兮，悔予不送兮。
interpretations.explanation: 你丰仪美好，在巷口等我，后悔没送你。

interpretations.segmentation: Handsome as you are, you waited for me in the lane—I regret I did not escort you.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng.content: 子之昌兮，俟我乎堂兮，悔予不将兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng.pinyin: zi zhi1 chang1 xi1， qi2 wo3 hu1 tang2 xi1， hui3 yu3 bu4 jiang1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 子之昌兮，俟我乎堂兮，悔予不将兮。
interpretations.explanation: 你仪表堂堂，在堂上等我，后悔没跟你走。

interpretations.segmentation: Bright as you are, you waited in the hall—I regret I did not go with you.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng.pinyin: yi1 jin3 jiong3 yi1， shang jin3 jiong3 shang。

interpretations.segmentation: 衣锦褧衣，裳锦褧裳。
interpretations.explanation: 里穿锦衣外罩麻衣，下裳也如此。

interpretations.segmentation: Silk within, hemp robe without—the skirt the same.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng.pinyin: shu1 xi1 bo2 xi1， jia4 yu3 yu3 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔兮伯兮，驾予与行。
interpretations.explanation: 叔啊伯啊，驾车接我同行。

interpretations.segmentation: Uncle, elder brother—drive your chariot and take me along.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng.pinyin: shang jin3 jiong3 shang， yi1 jin3 jiong3 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 裳锦褧裳，衣锦褧衣。
interpretations.explanation: 下裳外罩麻衣，里穿锦衣。

interpretations.segmentation: Hemp skirt without, silk within.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng.pinyin: shu1 xi1 bo2 xi1， jia4 yu3 yu3 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔兮伯兮，驾予与归。
interpretations.explanation: 叔啊伯啊，驾车接我同归。

interpretations.segmentation: Uncle, elder brother—drive your chariot and take me home.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu.content: 风雨凄凄，鸡鸣喈喈，既见君子。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu.pinyin: feng1 yu3 qi1 qi1， ji1 ming2 jie1 jie1， ji4 jian4 jun1 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 风雨凄凄，鸡鸣喈喈，既见君子。
interpretations.explanation: 风雨凄凄，鸡鸣喈喈，已经见到君子。

interpretations.segmentation: Wind and rain are chill; cocks crow clearly—I have seen my lord.
云胡不夷？
interpretations.explanation: 为何不安心呢？

interpretations.segmentation: Why should my heart not be at ease?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu.pinyin: feng1 yu3 xiao1 xiao1， ji1 ming2 jiao1 jiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 风雨潇潇，鸡鸣胶胶。
interpretations.explanation: 风雨潇潇，鸡鸣胶胶。

interpretations.segmentation: Wind and rain rush; cocks crow steadily.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu.pinyin: ji4 jian4 jun1 zi， yun2 hu2 bu4 chou1？

interpretations.segmentation: 既见君子，云胡不瘳？
interpretations.explanation: 已经见到君子，为何不快慰呢？

interpretations.segmentation: I have seen my lord—why should I not be comforted?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu.pinyin: feng1 yu3 ru2 hui4， ji1 ming2 bu4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 风雨如晦，鸡鸣不已。
interpretations.explanation: 风雨如晦，鸡鸣不已。

interpretations.segmentation: Wind and rain darken the day; cocks crow without cease.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu.pinyin: ji4 jian4 jun1 zi， yun2 hu2 bu4 xi3？

interpretations.segmentation: 既见君子，云胡不喜？
interpretations.explanation: 已经见到君子，为何不欢喜呢？

interpretations.segmentation: I have seen my lord—why should I not rejoice?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu.pinyin: gao1 qiu2 ru2 ru2， xun2 zhi2 qie3 hou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 羔裘如濡，洵直且侯。
interpretations.explanation: 羔裘润泽，确实正直而美好。

interpretations.segmentation: The lamb-skin coat is glossy—truly upright and noble.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu.pinyin: bi3 qi2 zhi1 zi， she3 ming4 bu4 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼其之子，舍命不渝。
interpretations.explanation: 那位君子，舍命也不改其志。

interpretations.segmentation: That man would give his life and never change his pledge.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu.pinyin: gao1 qiu2 bao4 shi4， kong3 wu3 you3 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 羔裘豹饰，孔武有力。
interpretations.explanation: 羔裘豹饰，非常勇武有力。

interpretations.segmentation: Lamb-skin with leopard trim—most bold and strong.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu.pinyin: bi3 qi2 zhi1 zi， bang1 zhi1 si1 zhi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼其之子，邦之司直。
interpretations.explanation: 那位君子，是国家的正直之士。

interpretations.segmentation: That man is the upright judge of the state.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu.pinyin: gao1 qiu2 yan4 xi1， san1 ying1 can4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 羔裘晏兮，三英粲兮。
interpretations.explanation: 羔裘鲜明，三英光彩照人。

interpretations.segmentation: The lamb-skin coat is bright; three ornaments gleam.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu.pinyin: bi3 qi2 zhi1 zi， bang1 zhi1 yan4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼其之子，邦之彦兮。
interpretations.explanation: 那位君子，是国家的俊彦。

interpretations.segmentation: That man is the outstanding talent of the state.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi.content: 将仲子兮，无逾我里，无折我树杞。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi.pinyin: jiang1 zhong4 zi xi1， wu2 yu2 wo3 li3， wu2 zhe2 wo3 shu4 qi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 将仲子兮，无逾我里，无折我树杞。
interpretations.explanation: 仲子啊，别越过我的里墙，别折断我的杞树。

interpretations.segmentation: Zhongzi, do not climb over my lane wall; do not break my jujube tree.
岂敢爱之？
interpretations.explanation: 哪里是舍不得树？

interpretations.segmentation: It is not that I cherish the tree—
畏我父母。
interpretations.explanation: 是怕父母知道。

interpretations.segmentation: I fear my parents.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi.content: 仲可怀也，父母之言亦可畏也。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi.pinyin: zhong4 ke3 huai2 ye3， fu4 mu3 zhi1 yan2 yi4 ke3 wei4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 仲可怀也，父母之言亦可畏也。
interpretations.explanation: 仲子值得思念，父母的话也令人畏惧。

interpretations.segmentation: Zhongzi is dear to me, yet my parents' words are to be feared.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi.content: 将仲子兮，无逾我墙，无折我树桑。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi.pinyin: jiang1 zhong4 zi xi1， wu2 yu2 wo3 qiang2， wu2 zhe2 wo3 shu4 sang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 将仲子兮，无逾我墙，无折我树桑。
interpretations.explanation: 仲子啊，别越过我的墙，别折断我的桑树。

interpretations.segmentation: Zhongzi, do not climb over my wall; do not break my mulberry tree.
岂敢爱之？
interpretations.explanation: 哪里是舍不得树？

interpretations.segmentation: It is not that I cherish the tree—
畏我诸兄。
interpretations.explanation: 是怕各位兄长。

interpretations.segmentation: I fear my elder brothers.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi.content: 仲可怀也，诸兄之言亦可畏也。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi.pinyin: zhong4 ke3 huai2 ye3， zhu1 xiong1 zhi1 yan2 yi4 ke3 wei4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 仲可怀也，诸兄之言亦可畏也。
interpretations.explanation: 仲子值得思念，兄长的话也令人畏惧。

interpretations.segmentation: Zhongzi is dear to me, yet my brothers' words are to be feared.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi.content: 将仲子兮，无逾我园，无折我树檀。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi.pinyin: jiang1 zhong4 zi xi1， wu2 yu2 wo3 yuan2， wu2 zhe2 wo3 shu4 tan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 将仲子兮，无逾我园，无折我树檀。
interpretations.explanation: 仲子啊，别越过我的园，别折断我的檀树。

interpretations.segmentation: Zhongzi, do not enter my garden; do not break my sandalwood tree.
岂敢爱之？
interpretations.explanation: 哪里是舍不得树？

interpretations.segmentation: It is not that I cherish the tree—
畏人之多言。
interpretations.explanation: 是怕旁人多嘴。

interpretations.segmentation: I fear people's gossip.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi.content: 仲可怀也，人之多言亦可畏也。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi.pinyin: zhong4 ke3 huai2 ye3， ren2 zhi1 duo1 yan2 yi4 ke3 wei4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 仲可怀也，人之多言亦可畏也。
interpretations.explanation: 仲子值得思念，闲言碎语也令人畏惧。

interpretations.segmentation: Zhongzi is dear to me, yet loose talk is to be feared.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong.pinyin: bi3 jiao3 tong2 xi1， bu4 yu3 wo3 yan2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼狡童兮，不与我言兮。
interpretations.explanation: 那个狡童啊，不跟我说话。

interpretations.segmentation: That fickle youth will not speak with me.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong.content: 维子之故，使我不能餐兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong.pinyin: wei2 zi zhi1 gu4， shi3 wo3 bu4 neng2 can1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维子之故，使我不能餐兮。
interpretations.explanation: 都因为你的缘故，使我吃不下饭。

interpretations.segmentation: Because of you alone, I cannot eat my meal.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong.pinyin: bi3 jiao3 tong2 xi1， bu4 yu3 wo3 shi2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼狡童兮，不与我食兮。
interpretations.explanation: 那个狡童啊，不跟我一起吃饭。

interpretations.segmentation: That fickle youth will not dine with me.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong.content: 维子之故，使我不能息兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong.pinyin: wei2 zi zhi1 gu4， shi3 wo3 bu4 neng2 xi1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维子之故，使我不能息兮。
interpretations.explanation: 都因为你的缘故，使我不能安睡。

interpretations.segmentation: Because of you alone, I cannot rest in sleep.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming.pinyin: nv3 yue1 ji1 ming2， shi4 yue1 mei4 dan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 女曰鸡鸣，士曰昧旦。
interpretations.explanation: 女子说鸡叫了，男子说天还没亮。

interpretations.segmentation: The wife says the cock has crowed; the husband says it is still dark.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming.pinyin: zi xing1 shi4 ye4， ming2 xing1 you3 lan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 子兴视夜，明星有烂。
interpretations.explanation: 你起来看看夜色，启明星已经明亮。

interpretations.segmentation: Rise and look at the night—the morning star burns bright.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming.pinyin: jiang1 ao2 jiang1 xiang2， yi4 fu2 yu3 yan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 将翱将翔，弋凫与雁。
interpretations.explanation: 将要飞射将要翱翔，去射野鸭和大雁。

interpretations.segmentation: Soon to fly and roam—to shoot duck and wild geese.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming.pinyin: yi4 yan2 jia1 zhi1， yu3 zi yi2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 弋言加之，与子宜之。
interpretations.explanation: 射到了就给你，与你同享。

interpretations.segmentation: What I shoot I give you; we share it together.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming.pinyin: yi2 yan2 yin3 jiu3， yu3 zi xie2 lao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 宜言饮酒，与子偕老。
interpretations.explanation: 该当饮酒，与你白头偕老。

interpretations.segmentation: We should drink wine and grow old together.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming.pinyin: qin2 se4 zai4 yu4， mo4 bu4 jing4 hao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 琴瑟在御，莫不静好。
interpretations.explanation: 琴瑟在旁，无不安静美好。

interpretations.segmentation: Zither and lute at hand—all is calm and good.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming.content: 知子之来之，杂佩以赠之。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming.pinyin: zhi1 zi zhi1 lai2 zhi1， za2 pei4 yi3 zeng4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 知子之来之，杂佩以赠之。
interpretations.explanation: 知道你来看望我，杂佩赠给你。

interpretations.segmentation: Knowing you come to me, I give you my mixed pendants.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming.content: 知子之顺之，杂佩以问之。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming.pinyin: zhi1 zi zhi1 shun4 zhi1， za2 pei4 yi3 wen4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 知子之顺之，杂佩以问之。
interpretations.explanation: 知道你顺从我，杂佩向你问安。

interpretations.segmentation: Knowing you follow my wish, I greet you with mixed pendants.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming.content: 知子之好之，杂佩以报之。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming.pinyin: zhi1 zi zhi1 hao3 zhi1， za2 pei4 yi3 bao4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 知子之好之，杂佩以报之。
interpretations.explanation: 知道你爱我，杂佩回报你。

interpretations.segmentation: Knowing you love me, I repay you with mixed pendants.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qianshang.pinyin: zi hui4 si1 wo3， qian1 shang she4 qin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 子惠思我，褰裳涉溱。
interpretations.explanation: 你若爱我，就提起衣裳渡过溱水。

interpretations.segmentation: If you love me, lift your skirt and wade the Zhen.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qianshang.pinyin: zi bu4 wo3 si1， qi3 wu2 ta1 ren2？

interpretations.segmentation: 子不我思，岂无他人？
interpretations.explanation: 你若不想我，难道没有别人？

interpretations.segmentation: If you do not think of me, are there not other men?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qianshang.pinyin: kuang2 tong2 zhi1 kuang2 ye3 qie3！

interpretations.segmentation: 狂童之狂也且！
interpretations.explanation: 傻小子真傻啊！

interpretations.segmentation: You foolish boy—how foolish!

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qianshang.pinyin: zi hui4 si1 wo3， qian1 shang she4 wei3。

interpretations.segmentation: 子惠思我，褰裳涉洧。
interpretations.explanation: 你若爱我，就提起衣裳渡过洧水。

interpretations.segmentation: If you love me, lift your skirt and wade the Wei.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qianshang.pinyin: zi bu4 wo3 si1， qi3 wu2 ta1 shi4？

interpretations.segmentation: 子不我思，岂无他士？
interpretations.explanation: 你若不想我，难道没有其他士子？

interpretations.segmentation: If you do not think of me, are there not other gentlemen?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qianshang.pinyin: kuang2 tong2 zhi1 kuang2 ye3 qie3！

interpretations.segmentation: 狂童之狂也且！
interpretations.explanation: 傻小子真傻啊！

interpretations.segmentation: You foolish boy—how foolish!

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren.pinyin: qing1 ren2 zai4 peng2， si4 jie4 pang2 pang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 清人在彭，驷介旁旁。
interpretations.explanation: 郑国的军队在彭地，四马披甲整齐。

interpretations.segmentation: Zheng's troops are at Peng; four armored horses stand in rank.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren.pinyin: er4 mao2 zhong4 ying1， he2 shang4 hu1 ao2 xiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 二矛重英，河上乎翱翔。
interpretations.explanation: 两支矛饰重英，在黄河上翱翔。

interpretations.segmentation: Two spears with heavy tassels—they soar above the river.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren.pinyin: qing1 ren2 zai4 xiao1， si4 jie4 pao2 pao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 清人在消，驷介麃麃。
interpretations.explanation: 郑国的军队在消地，四马披甲威武。

interpretations.segmentation: Zheng's troops are at Xiao; four armored horses look fierce.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren.pinyin: er4 mao2 zhong4 qiao2， he2 shang4 hu1 xiao1 yao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 二矛重乔，河上乎逍遥。
interpretations.explanation: 两支矛饰重乔，在黄河上逍遥。

interpretations.segmentation: Two spears with tall plumes—they roam freely on the river.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren.pinyin: qing1 ren2 zai4 zhou2， si4 jie4 tao2 tao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 清人在轴，驷介陶陶。
interpretations.explanation: 郑国的军队在轴地，四马披甲和乐。

interpretations.segmentation: Zheng's troops are at Zhou; four armored horses seem at ease.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren.pinyin: zuo3 xuan2 you4 chou1， zhong1 jun1 zuo4 hao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 左旋右抽，中军作好。
interpretations.explanation: 左旋右抽，在中军显示好身手。

interpretations.segmentation: Wheel left, draw right—showing their skill in the center army.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei.pinyin: qin2 yu3 wei3， fang1 huan4 huan4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 溱与洧，方涣涣兮。
interpretations.explanation: 溱水与洧水，春水正哗哗奔流。

interpretations.segmentation: The Zhen and Wei rivers are swelling and rushing in the spring flood.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei.pinyin: shi4 yu3 nv3， fang1 bing3 jian1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 士与女，方秉蕳兮。
interpretations.explanation: 青年男女，正手持香草（蕳）出游。

interpretations.segmentation: Young men and women are out together, each holding sprigs of fragrant herb.
女曰观乎？
interpretations.explanation: 姑娘说：去看看吧？

interpretations.segmentation: The girl says, “Shall we go and look?”
士曰既且。
interpretations.explanation: 小伙说：已经去过了。

interpretations.segmentation: The lad replies, “We’ve already been.”
且往观乎？
interpretations.explanation: （姑娘又说）再去看看好吗？

interpretations.segmentation: “Then shall we go again and see?” she asks.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei.pinyin: wei3 zhi1 wai4， xun2 xu1 qie3 le4。

interpretations.segmentation: 洧之外，洵訏且乐。
interpretations.explanation: 洧水岸边，地方又宽又热闹，真快乐。

interpretations.segmentation: Beyond the Wei, the ground is wide and open—truly spacious and joyful.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei.content: 维士与女，伊其相谑，赠之以勺药。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei.pinyin: wei2 shi4 yu3 nv3， yi1 qi2 xiang1 xue4， zeng4 zhi1 yi3 shao2 yao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 维士与女，伊其相谑，赠之以勺药。
interpretations.explanation: 那些男女彼此说笑调情，还互赠芍药花。

interpretations.segmentation: The couples banter and flirt, exchanging peonies as tokens.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei.pinyin: qin2 yu3 wei3， liu2 qi2 qing1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 溱与洧，浏其清矣。
interpretations.explanation: 溱水与洧水，清澈见底。

interpretations.segmentation: The Zhen and Wei now run clear and bright.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei.pinyin: shi4 yu3 nv3， yin1 qi2 ying2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 士与女，殷其盈矣。
interpretations.explanation: 男女游人，越来越多，挤得满满当当。

interpretations.segmentation: Men and women throng the banks, packed in great numbers.
女曰观乎？
interpretations.explanation: 姑娘又说：去看看吧？

interpretations.segmentation: Again the girl says, “Shall we go and look?”
士曰既且。
interpretations.explanation: 小伙又说：已经去过了。

interpretations.segmentation: Again the lad says, “We’ve already been.”
且往观乎？
interpretations.explanation: （姑娘）再去看看好吗？

interpretations.segmentation: “Then shall we go again?” she presses.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei.pinyin: wei3 zhi1 wai4， xun2 xu1 qie3 le4。

interpretations.segmentation: 洧之外，洵訏且乐。
interpretations.explanation: 洧水岸边，又宽又乐，和前面一样。

interpretations.segmentation: Beyond the Wei it is still wide and merry as before.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei.content: 维士与女，伊其将谑，赠之以勺药。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei.pinyin: wei2 shi4 yu3 nv3， yi1 qi2 jiang1 xue4， zeng4 zhi1 yi3 shao2 yao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 维士与女，伊其将谑，赠之以勺药。
interpretations.explanation: 男女将要互相戏谑，仍以芍药相赠。

interpretations.segmentation: The couples are about to jest and tease, again giving peonies in gift.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shanyoufusu.pinyin: shan1 you3 fu2 su1， xi2 you3 he2 hua2。

interpretations.segmentation: 山有扶苏，隰有荷华。
interpretations.explanation: 山上有扶苏树，低湿处开着荷花。

interpretations.segmentation: On the hill grows fusu; in the marsh bloom lotus flowers.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shanyoufusu.pinyin: bu4 jian4 zi dou1， nai3 jian4 kuang2 qie3。

interpretations.segmentation: 不见子都，乃见狂且。
interpretations.explanation: 没见到子都那样的美男子，却碰上了狂且。

interpretations.segmentation: I did not meet the handsome Zidu, but met this reckless fellow instead.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shanyoufusu.content: 山有乔松，隰有游龙，不见子充，乃见狡童。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-shanyoufusu.pinyin: shan1 you3 qiao2 song1， xi2 you3 you2 long2， bu4 jian4 zi chong1， nai3 jian4 jiao3 tong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 山有乔松，隰有游龙，不见子充，乃见狡童。
interpretations.explanation: 山上有高大松树，低处有游龙草；不见子充，却见狡童。

interpretations.segmentation: Tall pines on the hill, dragon-tail grass below; no Zichong—only a sly youth appears.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian.pinyin: shu1 yu2 tian2， xiang4 wu2 ju1 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔于田，巷无居人。
interpretations.explanation: 叔出去打猎，巷里像没人似的。

interpretations.segmentation: When Uncle goes hunting, the lanes seem deserted.
岂无居人？
interpretations.explanation: 难道真的没人吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Is there really no one left?
不如叔也。
interpretations.explanation: （有人）比不上叔啊。

interpretations.segmentation: None compare with Uncle.
洵美且仁。
interpretations.explanation: 他确实又俊又仁厚。

interpretations.segmentation: He is truly handsome and kind-hearted.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian.pinyin: shu1 yu2 shou4， xiang4 wu2 yin3 jiu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔于狩，巷无饮酒。
interpretations.explanation: 叔出去冬猎，巷里没人饮酒作乐。

interpretations.segmentation: When Uncle goes on the winter hunt, no one drinks in the lanes.
岂无饮酒？
interpretations.explanation: 难道没有酒宴吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Is there no feasting with wine?
不如叔也。
interpretations.explanation: （别的聚会）比不上叔啊。

interpretations.segmentation: Nothing matches Uncle’s company.
洵美且好。
interpretations.explanation: 他确实又美又好。

interpretations.segmentation: He is truly fine and good.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian.pinyin: shu1 shi4 ye3， xiang4 wu2 fu2 ma3。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔适野，巷无服马。
interpretations.explanation: 叔到郊野去，巷里没人备马出行。

interpretations.segmentation: When Uncle rides to the wilds, no one saddles horses in the lanes.
岂无服马？
interpretations.explanation: 难道没有备好的马吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Are there no horses harnessed?
不如叔也。
interpretations.explanation: （别人）还是比不上叔啊。

interpretations.segmentation: Still, none measure up to Uncle.
洵美且武。
interpretations.explanation: 他确实又美又勇武。

interpretations.segmentation: He is truly handsome and brave.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-tuoxi.pinyin: tuo4 xi1 tuo4 xi1， feng1 qi2 chui1 nv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 萚兮萚兮，风其吹女。
interpretations.explanation: 落叶纷纷啊，风把它吹向你。

interpretations.segmentation: Leaves fall, fall—the wind blows them toward you.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-tuoxi.pinyin: shu1 xi1 bo2 xi1， chang4 yu3 he2 nv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔兮伯兮，倡予和女。
interpretations.explanation: 叔啊伯啊，你起头唱，我来和着你。

interpretations.segmentation: Brothers dear, you lead the song and I will harmonize with you.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-tuoxi.pinyin: tuo4 xi1 tuo4 xi1， feng1 qi2 piao1 nv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 萚兮萚兮，风其漂女。
interpretations.explanation: 落叶纷纷啊，风把它飘向你。

interpretations.segmentation: Leaves drift, drift—the wind wafts them toward you.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-tuoxi.pinyin: shu1 xi1 bo2 xi1， chang4 yu3 yao4 nv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 叔兮伯兮，倡予要女。
interpretations.explanation: 叔啊伯啊，你起头唱，我来邀你同歌。

interpretations.segmentation: Brothers dear, you start the tune and I will draw you in to sing.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui.pinyin: yang2 zhi1 shui3， bu4 liu2 shu4 chu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 扬之水，不流束楚。
interpretations.explanation: 缓缓的流水，冲不散捆好的荆条。

interpretations.segmentation: The slow current cannot break apart a bundle of thornwood.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui.pinyin: zhong1 xian1 xiong1 di4， wei2 yu3 yu3 nv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 终鲜兄弟，维予与女。
interpretations.explanation: 终究没有兄弟，只有我和你相依。

interpretations.segmentation: I have no brothers at last—only you and me.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui.pinyin: wu2 xin4 ren2 zhi1 yan2， ren2 shi2 kuang2 nv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 无信人之言，人实诳女。
interpretations.explanation: 别信别人的话，他们其实在骗你。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not trust others’ words; they are truly deceiving you.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui.pinyin: yang2 zhi1 shui3， bu4 liu2 shu4 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 扬之水，不流束薪。
interpretations.explanation: 缓缓的流水，冲不散捆好的柴薪。

interpretations.segmentation: The slow current cannot break apart a bundle of firewood.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui.pinyin: zhong1 xian1 xiong1 di4， wei2 yu3 er4 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 终鲜兄弟，维予二人。
interpretations.explanation: 终究没有兄弟，只剩我们两人。

interpretations.segmentation: I have no brothers—just the two of us.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui.pinyin: wu2 xin4 ren2 zhi1 yan2， ren2 shi2 bu4 xin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 无信人之言，人实不信。
interpretations.explanation: 别信别人的话，他们实在不可信。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not trust others’ words; they are truly not to be believed.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao.pinyin: ye3 you3 man4 cao3， ling2 lu4 tuan2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 野有蔓草，零露漙兮。
interpretations.explanation: 郊野长着蔓草，晶莹的露水成团。

interpretations.segmentation: Creeping grass in the wilds; dew gathers in shining beads.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao.pinyin: you3 mei3 yi1 ren2， qing1 yang2 wan3 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有美一人，清扬婉兮。
interpretations.explanation: 有一位美人，眉目清秀又温柔。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a fair person, with clear brows and gentle grace.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao.pinyin: xie4 hou4 xiang1 yu4， shi4 wo3 yuan4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 邂逅相遇，适我愿兮。
interpretations.explanation: 偶然相遇，正合我的心愿。

interpretations.segmentation: We meet by chance—just as my heart wished.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao.pinyin: ye3 you3 man4 cao3， ling2 lu4 rang2 rang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 野有蔓草，零露瀼瀼。
interpretations.explanation: 郊野蔓草青青，露水浓得发亮。

interpretations.segmentation: Creeping grass in the wilds; dew lies heavy and bright.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao.pinyin: you3 mei3 yi1 ren2， wan3 ru2 qing1 yang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有美一人，婉如清扬。
interpretations.explanation: 有一位美人，温柔得像清扬的眉目。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a fair one, gentle as clear, lifted brows.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao.pinyin: xie4 hou4 xiang1 yu4， yu3 zi xie2 zang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 邂逅相遇，与子偕臧。
interpretations.explanation: 偶然相遇，愿与你同好共处。

interpretations.segmentation: We meet by chance; with you I would share what is good.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche.pinyin: you3 nv3 tong2 che1， yan2 ru2 shun4 hua2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有女同车，颜如舜华。
interpretations.explanation: 有位姑娘同车而行，容颜像木槿花一样鲜。

interpretations.segmentation: A girl rides in the same carriage; her face is fresh as hibiscus bloom.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche.pinyin: jiang1 ao2 jiang1 xiang2， pei4 yu4 qiong2 ju1。

interpretations.segmentation: 将翱将翔，佩玉琼琚。
interpretations.explanation: 步履轻扬如鸟飞，佩玉琼琚叮当作响。

interpretations.segmentation: She moves as if about to soar; jade pendants chime on her belt.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche.pinyin: bi3 mei3 meng4 jiang1， xun2 mei3 qie3 dou1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼美孟姜，洵美且都。
interpretations.explanation: 那美丽的孟姜，确实又美又娴雅。

interpretations.segmentation: That lovely Meng Jiang is truly beautiful and refined.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche.pinyin: you3 nv3 tong2 xing2， yan2 ru2 shun4 ying1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有女同行，颜如舜英。
interpretations.explanation: 有位姑娘同路而行，容颜像木槿花一样盛。

interpretations.segmentation: A girl walks the same road; her face glows like hibiscus in full flower.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche.pinyin: jiang1 ao2 jiang1 xiang2， pei4 yu4 jiang1 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 将翱将翔，佩玉将将。
interpretations.explanation: 步履轻扬，佩玉锵锵有声。

interpretations.segmentation: She moves lightly; her jade ornaments ring clearly.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche.pinyin: bi3 mei3 meng4 jiang1， de2 yin1 bu4 wang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼美孟姜，德音不忘。
interpretations.explanation: 那美丽的孟姜，好德行令人难忘。

interpretations.segmentation: That lovely Meng Jiang—her virtue is not forgotten.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin.pinyin: qing1 qing1 zi jin1， you1 you1 wo3 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 青青子衿，悠悠我心。
interpretations.explanation: 青青的是你的衣领，悠悠的是我的心。

interpretations.segmentation: Your collar is blue-green; my heart is long with longing.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin.pinyin: zong4 wo3 bu4 wang3， zi ning2 bu4 si4 yin1？

interpretations.segmentation: 纵我不往，子宁不嗣音？
interpretations.explanation: 即使我不去找你，你难道就不给我音讯吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Even if I do not go to you, will you not send word?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin.pinyin: qing1 qing1 zi pei4， you1 you1 wo3 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 青青子佩，悠悠我思。
interpretations.explanation: 青青的是你的佩玉，悠悠的是我的思念。

interpretations.segmentation: Your girdle-gems are blue-green; my thoughts stretch on and on.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin.pinyin: zong4 wo3 bu4 wang3， zi ning2 bu4 lai2？

interpretations.segmentation: 纵我不往，子宁不来？
interpretations.explanation: 即使我不去找你，你难道就不来吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Even if I do not go, will you not come?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin.pinyin: tiao1 xi1 da2 xi1， zai4 cheng2 que1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 挑兮达兮，在城阙兮。
interpretations.explanation: 我独自往来张望，站在高高的城楼上。

interpretations.segmentation: I pace back and forth, waiting on the high city tower.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin.pinyin: yi1 ri4 bu4 jian4， ru2 san1 yue4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 一日不见，如三月兮。
interpretations.explanation: 一天不见，就像过了三个月那样久。

interpretations.segmentation: One day apart feels like three months long.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi.content: 缁衣之宜兮，敝予又改为兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi.pinyin: zi1 yi1 zhi1 yi2 xi1， bi4 yu3 you4 gai3 wei4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 缁衣之宜兮，敝予又改为兮。
interpretations.explanation: 黑色官服很合宜，穿旧了我又给你改做新的。

interpretations.segmentation: The black robe suits you well; worn out, I make you another.
适子之馆兮。
interpretations.explanation: 到你住的馆舍去。

interpretations.segmentation: I go to your lodging.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi.pinyin: hai2 yu3 shou4 zi zhi1 can4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 还予授子之粲兮。
interpretations.explanation: 回来把做好的新衣交给你。

interpretations.segmentation: Returning, I hand you the fine new garment I made.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi.content: 缁衣之好兮，敝予又改造兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi.pinyin: zi1 yi1 zhi1 hao3 xi1， bi4 yu3 you4 gai3 zao4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 缁衣之好兮，敝予又改造兮。
interpretations.explanation: 黑色官服真好看，旧了我又给你改做。

interpretations.segmentation: The black robe is lovely; when it frays, I refashion it for you.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi.content: 适子之馆兮，还予授子之粲兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi.pinyin: shi4 zi zhi1 guan3 xi1， hai2 yu3 shou4 zi zhi1 can4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 适子之馆兮，还予授子之粲兮。
interpretations.explanation: 到你馆舍去，回来把新衣交给你。

interpretations.segmentation: To your lodging I go, and come back to give you the new robe.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi.content: 缁衣之席兮，敝予又改作兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi.pinyin: zi1 yi1 zhi1 xi2 xi1， bi4 yu3 you4 gai3 zuo4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 缁衣之席兮，敝予又改作兮。
interpretations.explanation: 黑色官服坐着正合适，旧了我又重新制作。

interpretations.segmentation: The black robe fits you at ease; worn, I sew a fresh one.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi.content: 适子之馆兮，还予授子之粲兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi.pinyin: shi4 zi zhi1 guan3 xi1， hai2 yu3 shou4 zi zhi1 can4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 适子之馆兮，还予授子之粲兮。
interpretations.explanation: 到你馆舍去，回来把新衣交给你。

interpretations.segmentation: To your lodging I go, and return to present the new garment.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu.content: 遵大路兮，掺执子之袪兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu.pinyin: zun1 da4 lu4 xi1， can4 zhi2 zi zhi1 qu1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 遵大路兮，掺执子之袪兮。
interpretations.explanation: 沿着大路走啊，我拉着你的衣襟。

interpretations.segmentation: Along the broad road I go, clutching the hem of your robe.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu.pinyin: wu2 wo3 e4 xi1， bu4 jie2 gu4 ye3！

interpretations.segmentation: 无我恶兮，不蓵故也！
interpretations.explanation: 别嫌恶我啊，不要因旧情而疏远！

interpretations.segmentation: Do not loathe me—do not turn away because of old ties!

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu.content: 遵大路兮，掺执子之手兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu.pinyin: zun1 da4 lu4 xi1， can4 zhi2 zi zhi1 shou3 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 遵大路兮，掺执子之手兮。
interpretations.explanation: 沿着大路走啊，我握着你的手。

interpretations.segmentation: Along the broad road I go, holding your hand.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu.pinyin: wu2 wo3 chou3 xi1， bu4 jie2 hao3 ye3！

interpretations.segmentation: 无我魗兮，不蓵好也！
interpretations.explanation: 别讨厌我啊，不要因相好而背弃！

interpretations.segmentation: Do not detest me—do not forsake our affection!

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi.pinyin: cai3 cai3 fu2 yi3， bao2 yan2 cai3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 采采芣苡，薄言采之。
interpretations.explanation: 采啊采芣苡，我们去采它。

interpretations.segmentation: Gather, gather plantain—we set out to pick it.

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi.pinyin: cai3 cai3 fu2 yi3， bao2 yan2 you3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 采采芣苡，薄言有之。
interpretations.explanation: 采啊采芣苡，采到了。

interpretations.segmentation: Gather, gather plantain—we have some in hand.

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi.pinyin: cai3 cai3 fu2 yi3， bao2 yan2 duo1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 采采芣苡，薄言掇之。
interpretations.explanation: 采啊采芣苡，伸手摘取。

interpretations.segmentation: Gather, gather plantain—we pluck it up.

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi.pinyin: cai3 cai3 fu2 yi3， bao2 yan2 lv3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 采采芣苡，薄言捋之。
interpretations.explanation: 采啊采芣苡，顺着茎捋下来。

interpretations.segmentation: Gather, gather plantain—we strip it along the stalk.

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi.pinyin: cai3 cai3 fu2 yi3， bao2 yan2 jie2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 采采芣苡，薄言袺之。
interpretations.explanation: 采啊采芣苡，用衣襟兜住。

interpretations.segmentation: Gather, gather plantain—we tuck it in our aprons.

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi.pinyin: cai3 cai3 fu2 yi3， bao2 yan2 xie2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 采采芣苡，薄言襭之。
interpretations.explanation: 采啊采芣苡，提起衣襟装满怀。

interpretations.segmentation: Gather, gather plantain—we lift our skirts to fill them full.

sj-feng-zhounan-getan.content: 葛之覃兮，施于中谷，维叶萋萋。
sj-feng-zhounan-getan.pinyin: ge2 zhi1 tan2 xi1， shi1 yu2 zhong1 gu3， wei2 ye4 qi1 qi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 葛之覃兮，施于中谷，维叶萋萋。
interpretations.explanation: 葛藤蔓延长，延到山谷中，叶子茂盛青青。

interpretations.segmentation: The kudzu spreads far into the mid-valley; its leaves grow lush and green.

sj-feng-zhounan-getan.content: 黄鸟于飞，集于灌木，其鸣喈喈。
sj-feng-zhounan-getan.pinyin: huang2 niao3 yu2 fei1， ji2 yu2 guan4 mu4， qi2 ming2 jie1 jie1。

interpretations.segmentation: 黄鸟于飞，集于灌木，其鸣喈喈。
interpretations.explanation: 黄鸟飞来飞去，落在灌木上，叫声和悦喈喈。

interpretations.segmentation: Yellow birds fly and alight on bushes, singing clear and sweet.

sj-feng-zhounan-getan.content: 葛之覃兮，施于中谷，维叶莫莫。
sj-feng-zhounan-getan.pinyin: ge2 zhi1 tan2 xi1， shi1 yu2 zhong1 gu3， wei2 ye4 mo4 mo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 葛之覃兮，施于中谷，维叶莫莫。
interpretations.explanation: 葛藤又蔓延，延到山谷中，叶子密密层层。

interpretations.segmentation: Again the kudzu spreads through the valley; its leaves hang thick and deep.

sj-feng-zhounan-getan.content: 是刈是濩，为絺为绤，服之无斁。
sj-feng-zhounan-getan.pinyin: shi4 yi4 shi4 huo4， wei4 chi1 wei4 xi4， fu2 zhi1 wu2 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是刈是濩，为絺为绤，服之无斁。
interpretations.explanation: 割下煮软，织成细葛布和粗葛布，穿了不厌。

interpretations.segmentation: Cut and boil it, weave fine and coarse cloth—we never tire of wearing it.

sj-feng-zhounan-getan.pinyin: yan2 gao4 shi1 shi4， yan2 gao4 yan2 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 言告师氏，言告言归。
interpretations.explanation: 告诉师氏，告诉已可回娘家。

interpretations.segmentation: I tell the mistress; I tell her I may go home.

sj-feng-zhounan-getan.pinyin: bao2 wu1 wo3 si1， bao2 huan4 wo3 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 薄污我私，薄浣我衣。
interpretations.explanation: 快洗我的私衣，快浣我的礼服。

interpretations.segmentation: Quick, wash my private clothes; rinse my formal robes.

sj-feng-zhounan-getan.pinyin: hai4 huan4 hai4 fou3， gui1 ning2 fu4 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 害浣害否，归宁父母。
interpretations.explanation: 哪些该洗哪些不洗，我要回去看望父母。

interpretations.segmentation: Which to wash, which not—I go home to comfort my parents.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju.pinyin: guan1 guan1 ju1 jiu1， zai4 he2 zhi1 zhou1。

interpretations.segmentation: 关关雎鸠，在河之洲。
interpretations.explanation: 雎鸠鸟关关和鸣，在河中的沙洲上。

interpretations.segmentation: Fish hawks call guan-guan on the islet in the river.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju.pinyin: yao3 tiao3 shu1 nv3， jun1 zi hao3 qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 窈窕淑女，君子好逑。
interpretations.explanation: 文静美好的姑娘，是君子理想的配偶。

interpretations.segmentation: The gentle, graceful maiden is a good match for the gentleman.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju.pinyin: can1 cha4 xing4 cai4， zuo3 you4 liu2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 参差荇菜，左右流之。
interpretations.explanation: 长短不齐的荇菜，左右捞取它。

interpretations.segmentation: Uneven water shield—left and right we gather it.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju.pinyin: yao3 tiao3 shu1 nv3， wu4 mei4 qiu2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 窈窕淑女，寤寐求之。
interpretations.explanation: 文静美好的姑娘，醒着睡着都在追求她。

interpretations.segmentation: The gentle maiden—waking and sleeping I seek her.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju.pinyin: qiu2 zhi1 bu4 de2， wu4 mei4 si1 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 求之不得，寤寐思服。
interpretations.explanation: 追求不到，醒着睡着都在思念。

interpretations.segmentation: Seeking in vain, I think of her waking and in sleep.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju.pinyin: you1 zai1 you1 zai1， nian3 zhuan3 fan3 ce4。

interpretations.segmentation: 悠哉悠哉，辗转反侧。
interpretations.explanation: 思念绵长啊，辗转反侧睡不着。

interpretations.segmentation: Long, long longing—I toss and turn and cannot rest.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju.pinyin: can1 cha4 xing4 cai4， zuo3 you4 cai3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 参差荇菜，左右采之。
interpretations.explanation: 长短不齐的荇菜，左右采摘它。

interpretations.segmentation: Uneven water shield—left and right we pick it.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju.pinyin: yao3 tiao3 shu1 nv3， qin2 se4 you3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 窈窕淑女，琴瑟友之。
interpretations.explanation: 文静美好的姑娘，用琴瑟亲近她。

interpretations.segmentation: The gentle maiden—I befriend her with zither and lute.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju.pinyin: can1 cha4 xing4 cai4， zuo3 you4 mao4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 参差荇菜，左右芼之。
interpretations.explanation: 长短不齐的荇菜，左右择取它。

interpretations.segmentation: Uneven water shield—left and right we select it.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju.pinyin: yao3 tiao3 shu1 nv3， zhong1 gu3 le4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 窈窕淑女，钟鼓乐之。
interpretations.explanation: 文静美好的姑娘，敲钟击鼓使她欢乐。

interpretations.segmentation: The gentle maiden—I delight her with bells and drums.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang.pinyin: nan2 you3 qiao2 mu4， bu4 ke3 xiu1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 南有乔木，不可休息。
interpretations.explanation: 南方有高大乔木，不能在其下休息。

interpretations.segmentation: Southward stands a tall tree—you cannot rest beneath it.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang.pinyin: han4 you3 you2 nv3， bu4 ke3 qiu2 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 汉有游女，不可求思。
interpretations.explanation: 汉水上有游女，不能去求娶她。

interpretations.segmentation: On the Han floats a roaming maiden—you cannot woo her.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang.pinyin: han4 zhi1 guang3 yi3， bu4 ke3 yong3 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 汉之广矣，不可泳思。
interpretations.explanation: 汉水多么宽广，不能游渡过去。

interpretations.segmentation: How wide the Han—one cannot swim across.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang.pinyin: jiang1 zhi1 yong3 yi3， bu4 ke3 fang1 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 江之永矣，不可方思。
interpretations.explanation: 长江多么漫长，不能筏渡过去。

interpretations.segmentation: How long the Yangtze—one cannot ferry across.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang.pinyin: qiao4 qiao4 cuo4 xin1， yan2 yi4 qi2 chu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 翘翘错薪，言刈其楚。
interpretations.explanation: 柴薪堆得高翘，说的是去割荆条。

interpretations.segmentation: Firewood piled high—I speak of cutting thornwood.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang.pinyin: zhi1 zi yu2 gui1， yan2 mo4 qi2 ma3。

interpretations.segmentation: 之子于归，言秣其马。
interpretations.explanation: 那姑娘要出嫁，说的是喂饱她的马。

interpretations.segmentation: That girl will wed—I speak of feeding her horses.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang.pinyin: han4 zhi1 guang3 yi3， bu4 ke3 yong3 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 汉之广矣，不可泳思。
interpretations.explanation: 汉水多么宽广，不能游渡过去。

interpretations.segmentation: How wide the Han—one cannot swim across.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang.pinyin: jiang1 zhi1 yong3 yi3， bu4 ke3 fang1 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 江之永矣，不可方思。
interpretations.explanation: 长江多么漫长，不能筏渡过去。

interpretations.segmentation: How long the Yangtze—one cannot ferry across.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang.pinyin: qiao4 qiao4 cuo4 xin1， yan2 yi4 qi2 lou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 翘翘错薪，言刈其蒌。
interpretations.explanation: 柴薪堆得高翘，说的是去割蒌蒿。

interpretations.segmentation: Firewood piled high—I speak of cutting artemisia.
之子于归。
interpretations.explanation: 那姑娘要出嫁。

interpretations.segmentation: That girl is going to marry.
言秣其驹。
interpretations.explanation: 说的是喂饱她的小马。

interpretations.segmentation: I speak of feeding her colt.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang.pinyin: han4 zhi1 guang3 yi3， bu4 ke3 yong3 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 汉之广矣，不可泳思。
interpretations.explanation: 汉水多么宽广，不能游渡过去。

interpretations.segmentation: How wide the Han—one cannot swim across.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang.pinyin: jiang1 zhi1 yong3 yi3， bu4 ke3 fang1 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 江之永矣，不可方思。
interpretations.explanation: 长江多么漫长，不能筏渡过去。

interpretations.segmentation: How long the Yangtze—one cannot ferry across.

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu.pinyin: nan2 you3 jiu1 mu4， ge2 lei3 lei4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 南有樛木，葛藟累之。
interpretations.explanation: 南方有弯曲的树枝，葛藤层层缠绕它。

interpretations.segmentation: Southward a bending tree—kudzu vines climb and bind it.

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu.pinyin: le4 zhi3 jun1 zi， fu2 lv3 sui2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐只君子，福履绥之。
interpretations.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，愿福禄安稳降临。

interpretations.segmentation: Happy is the lord—may fortune and blessing settle on him.

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu.pinyin: nan2 you3 jiu1 mu4， ge2 lei3 huang1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 南有樛木，葛藟荒之。
interpretations.explanation: 南方有弯曲的树枝，葛藤密密覆盖它。

interpretations.segmentation: Southward a bending tree—kudzu covers it thickly.

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu.pinyin: le4 zhi3 jun1 zi， fu2 lv3 jiang1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐只君子，福履将之。
interpretations.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，愿福禄扶助他。

interpretations.segmentation: Happy is the lord—may fortune assist him.

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu.pinyin: nan2 you3 jiu1 mu4， ge2 lei3 ying2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 南有樛木，葛藟萦之。
interpretations.explanation: 南方有弯曲的树枝，葛藤环绕缠抱它。

interpretations.segmentation: Southward a bending tree—kudzu coils and embraces it.

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu.pinyin: le4 zhi3 jun1 zi， fu2 lv3 cheng2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐只君子，福履成之。
interpretations.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，愿福禄成就他。

interpretations.segmentation: Happy is the lord—may fortune be fulfilled for him.

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner.pinyin: cai3 cai3 juan3 er3， bu4 ying2 qing3 kuang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 采采卷耳，不盈顷筐。
interpretations.explanation: 采啊采卷耳，却采不满浅筐。

interpretations.segmentation: Gather, gather mouse-ear—but the shallow basket is not filled.

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner.pinyin: jie1 wo3 huai2 ren2， zhi4 bi3 zhou1 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 嗟我怀人，置彼周行。
interpretations.explanation: 唉，我思念那人，把筐放在大道旁。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, I think of my love and set the basket by the highway.

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner.pinyin: zhi4 bi3 cui1 wei2， wo3 ma3 hui1 tui2。

interpretations.segmentation: 陟彼崔嵬，我马虺隤。
interpretations.explanation: 登上高峻的山，我的马已疲惫。

interpretations.segmentation: I climb steep heights; my horses are worn and faltering.

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner.content: 我姑酌彼金罍，维以不永怀。
sj-feng-zhounan-juaner.pinyin: wo3 gu1 zhuo2 bi3 jin1 lei2， wei2 yi3 bu4 yong3 huai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我姑酌彼金罍，维以不永怀。
interpretations.explanation: 我且斟那金杯，借此排遣长久思念。

interpretations.segmentation: I pour the golden goblet—to ease this endless longing.

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner.pinyin: zhi4 bi3 gao1 gang1， wo3 ma3 xuan2 huang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 陟彼高冈，我马玄黄。
interpretations.explanation: 登上高高的冈，我的马已色衰力竭。

interpretations.segmentation: I climb the high ridge; my horses are spent and sallow.

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner.content: 我姑酌彼兕觥，维以不永伤。
sj-feng-zhounan-juaner.pinyin: wo3 gu1 zhuo2 bi3 si4 gong1， wei2 yi3 bu4 yong3 shang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我姑酌彼兕觥，维以不永伤。
interpretations.explanation: 我且斟那兕角杯，借此减轻心中忧伤。

interpretations.segmentation: I pour the rhinoceros horn cup—to lighten enduring grief.

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner.content: 陟彼砠矣，我马瘏矣，我仆痡矣，云何吁矣。
sj-feng-zhounan-juaner.pinyin: zhi4 bi3 ju1 yi3， wo3 ma3 tu2 yi3， wo3 pu1 fu1 yi3， yun2 he2 xu1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 陟彼砠矣，我马瘏矣，我仆痡矣，云何吁矣。
interpretations.explanation: 登上多石的山，马病仆倒，我为何如此叹息！

interpretations.segmentation: I climb rocky slopes—horses sick, servants collapsed; why such sighs!

sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi.content: 麟之趾，振振公子，于嗟麟兮。
sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi.pinyin: lin2 zhi1 zhi3， zhen4 zhen4 gong1 zi， yu2 jie1 lin2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 麟之趾，振振公子，于嗟麟兮。
interpretations.explanation: 麒麟的蹄足，公子的后代德行美好，唉，麒麟啊！

interpretations.segmentation: The unicorn’s hooves—the lord’s sons are dignified; alas, the unicorn!

sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi.content: 麟之定，振振公姓，于嗟麟兮。
sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi.pinyin: lin2 zhi1 ding4， zhen4 zhen4 gong1 xing4， yu2 jie1 lin2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 麟之定，振振公姓，于嗟麟兮。
interpretations.explanation: 麒麟的额顶，公姓的子孙德行美好，唉，麒麟啊！

interpretations.segmentation: The unicorn’s brow—the lord’s clan is dignified; alas, the unicorn!

sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi.content: 麟之角，振振公族，于嗟麟兮。
sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi.pinyin: lin2 zhi1 jiao3， zhen4 zhen4 gong1 zu2， yu2 jie1 lin2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 麟之角，振振公族，于嗟麟兮。
interpretations.explanation: 麒麟的角，公族的子弟德行美好，唉，麒麟啊！

interpretations.segmentation: The unicorn’s horn—the lord’s kindred are dignified; alas, the unicorn!

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen.pinyin: zun1 bi3 ru3 fen2， fa2 qi2 tiao2 mei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 遵彼汝坟，伐其条枚。
interpretations.explanation: 沿着汝水堤岸走，砍伐那树枝条。

interpretations.segmentation: Along the Ru’s bank I go, cutting branches and twigs.

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen.pinyin: wei4 jian4 jun1 zi， ni4 ru2 diao4 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 未见君子，惄如调饥。
interpretations.explanation: 还没见到君子，心中饥渴像调羹未熟。

interpretations.segmentation: Not yet seeing my lord, I hunger like broth not yet ready.

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen.pinyin: zun1 bi3 ru3 fen2， fa2 qi2 tiao2 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 遵彼汝坟，伐其条肄。
interpretations.explanation: 沿着汝水堤岸走，砍伐那树新条。

interpretations.segmentation: Along the Ru’s bank I go, cutting fresh young shoots.

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen.pinyin: ji4 jian4 jun1 zi， bu4 wo3 xia2 qi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 既见君子，不我遐弃。
interpretations.explanation: 已经见到君子，他没有把我远远抛弃。

interpretations.segmentation: Having seen my lord, he has not cast me far away.

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen.pinyin: fang2 yu2 cheng1 wei3， wang2 shi4 ru2 hui3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鲂鱼赪尾，王室如毁。
interpretations.explanation: 鲂鱼尾巴发红，王室像遭火焚。

interpretations.segmentation: Bream tails turn red—the royal house seems burned.

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen.pinyin: sui1 ze2 ru2 hui3， fu4 mu3 kong3 er3。

interpretations.segmentation: 虽则如毁，父母孔迩。
interpretations.explanation: 虽然像遭焚毁，父母还在身边很近。

interpretations.segmentation: Though it seems ruined, my parents are still very near.

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao.pinyin: tao2 zhi1 yao1 yao1， zhuo2 zhuo2 qi2 hua2。

interpretations.segmentation: 桃之夭夭，灼灼其华。
interpretations.explanation: 桃花开得茂盛，颜色灼灼鲜明。

interpretations.segmentation: Peach trees flourish; their blossoms blaze bright.

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao.pinyin: zhi1 zi yu2 gui1， yi2 qi2 shi4 jia1。

interpretations.segmentation: 之子于归，宜其室家。
interpretations.explanation: 这位姑娘要出嫁，宜于安室宜家。

interpretations.segmentation: This girl goes to wed—fit to settle house and home.

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao.pinyin: tao2 zhi1 yao1 yao1， you3 fen2 qi2 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 桃之夭夭，有蕡其实。
interpretations.explanation: 桃花开得茂盛，果实累累饱满。

interpretations.segmentation: Peach trees flourish; fruit hangs heavy and full.

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao.pinyin: zhi1 zi yu2 gui1， yi2 qi2 jia1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 之子于归，宜其家室。
interpretations.explanation: 这位姑娘要出嫁，宜于治理家室。

interpretations.segmentation: This girl goes to wed—fit to keep the household in order.

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao.pinyin: tao2 zhi1 yao1 yao1， qi2 ye4 zhen1 zhen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 桃之夭夭，其叶蓁蓁。
interpretations.explanation: 桃花开得茂盛，叶子密密层层。

interpretations.segmentation: Peach trees flourish; leaves grow thick and green.

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao.pinyin: zhi1 zi yu2 gui1， yi2 qi2 jia1 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 之子于归，宜其家人。
interpretations.explanation: 这位姑娘要出嫁，宜于和睦家人。

interpretations.segmentation: This girl goes to wed—fit to harmonize with her family.

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju.pinyin: su4 su4 tu4 ju1， zhuo2 zhi1 ding1 ding1。

interpretations.segmentation: 肃肃兔罝，椓之丁丁。
interpretations.explanation: 密密布置兔网，桩子敲得丁丁响。

interpretations.segmentation: Rabbit snares set tight—the stakes ring ding-ding as they are driven.

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju.pinyin: jiu1 jiu1 wu3 fu1， gong1 hou2 gan4 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 赳赳武夫，公侯干城。
interpretations.explanation: 威武的武士，是公侯的屏障。

interpretations.segmentation: Bold, sturdy warriors—they are ramparts for lords and marquises.

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju.pinyin: su4 su4 tu4 ju1， shi1 yu2 zhong1 kui2。

interpretations.segmentation: 肃肃兔罝，施于中逵。
interpretations.explanation: 密密布置兔网，设在四通八达的路口。

interpretations.segmentation: Rabbit snares set tight—placed at crossroads in the open.

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju.pinyin: jiu1 jiu1 wu3 fu1， gong1 hou2 hao3 chou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 赳赳武夫，公侯好仇。
interpretations.explanation: 威武的武士，是公侯的好帮手。

interpretations.segmentation: Bold warriors—they are good companions to lords and marquises.

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju.pinyin: su4 su4 mian3 ju1， shi1 yu2 zhong1 lin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 肃肃免罝，施于中林。
interpretations.explanation: 密密布置兔网，设在树林深处。

interpretations.segmentation: Rabbit snares set tight—spread through the heart of the woods.

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju.pinyin: jiu1 jiu1 wu3 fu1， gong1 hou2 fu4 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 赳赳武夫，公侯腹心。
interpretations.explanation: 威武的武士，是公侯的心腹。

interpretations.segmentation: Bold warriors—they are trusted hearts of lords and marquises.

sj-feng-zhounan-zhongsi.pinyin: zhong1 si1 yu3， shen1 shen1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 螽斯羽，诜诜兮。
interpretations.explanation: 螽斯振翅，子孙众多啊。

interpretations.segmentation: Katydids spread their wings—your offspring teem.

sj-feng-zhounan-zhongsi.pinyin: yi2 er3 zi sun1， zhen4 zhen4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 宜尔子孙，振振兮。
interpretations.explanation: 愿你的子孙，兴旺发达啊。

interpretations.segmentation: May your descendants flourish and thrive.

sj-feng-zhounan-zhongsi.pinyin: zhong1 si1 yu3， hong1 hong1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 螽斯羽，薨薨兮。
interpretations.explanation: 螽斯振翅，子孙成群啊。

interpretations.segmentation: Katydids hum in flight—your offspring swarm.
宜尔子孙。
interpretations.explanation: 愿你的子孙，

interpretations.segmentation: May your descendants
绳绳兮。
interpretations.explanation: 绵延不绝啊。

interpretations.segmentation: continue on and on.

sj-feng-zhounan-zhongsi.pinyin: zhong1 si1 yu3， yi1 yi1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 螽斯羽，揖揖兮。
interpretations.explanation: 螽斯聚集，子孙齐集啊。

interpretations.segmentation: Katydids gather close—your offspring assemble.

sj-feng-zhounan-zhongsi.pinyin: yi2 er3 zi sun1， zhe2 zhe2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 宜尔子孙，蛰蛰兮。
interpretations.explanation: 愿你的子孙，和睦众多啊。

interpretations.segmentation: May your descendants be harmonious and numerous.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: bi4 gong1 you3 xu4， shi2 shi2 mei2 mei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 閟宫有侐，实实枚枚。
interpretations.explanation: 閟宫广大，建筑坚实而众多。

interpretations.segmentation: The Bi palace is spacious; its halls stand solid and many.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: he4 he4 jiang1 yuan2， qi2 de2 bu4 hui2。

interpretations.segmentation: 赫赫姜嫄，其德不回。
interpretations.explanation: 伟大的姜嫄，德行纯正无邪。

interpretations.segmentation: Glorious Jiang Yuan—her virtue never swerves.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: shang4 di4 shi4 yi1， wu2 zai1 wu2 hai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 上帝是依，无灾无害。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝护佑她，无灾无害。

interpretations.segmentation: God favored her—no harm, no woe.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: mi2 yue4 bu4 chi2， shi4 sheng1 hou4 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 弥月不迟，是生后稷。
interpretations.explanation: 满月按时而生，于是生下后稷。

interpretations.segmentation: At full term, not late, she bore Lord Millet.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: jiang4 zhi1 bai3 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 降之百福。
interpretations.explanation: 降下百种福泽。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven sent down blessings in abundance.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: shu3 ji4 zhong4 lu4， zhi1 zhi4 shu1 mai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 黍稷重穋，稙稚菽麦。
interpretations.explanation: 黍稷重穋，早种晚收的豆麦齐备。

interpretations.segmentation: Millet, double-crop grain, early and late beans and wheat.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: yan3 you3 xia4 guo2， bi3 min2 jia4 se4。

interpretations.segmentation: 奄有下国，俾民稼穑。
interpretations.explanation: 拥有天下，使百姓从事稼穑。

interpretations.segmentation: He held the realm below and taught the people to farm.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: you3 ji4 you3 shu3， you3 dao4 you3 ju4。

interpretations.segmentation: 有稷有黍，有稻有秬。
interpretations.explanation: 有稷有黍，有稻有黑黍。

interpretations.segmentation: There were millet and panic grass, rice and black millet.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: yan3 you3 xia4 tu3， zuan3 yu3 zhi1 xu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 奄有下土，缵禹之绪。
interpretations.explanation: 拥有天下土地，继承大禹的事业。

interpretations.segmentation: He held the land below and continued Yu’s work.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: hou4 ji4 zhi1 sun1， shi2 wei2 da4 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 后稷之孙，实维大王。
interpretations.explanation: 后稷的子孙，就是大王（古公亶父）。

interpretations.segmentation: Lord Millet’s descendant was the Great Lord.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: ju1 qi2 zhi1 yang2， shi2 shi3 jian3 shang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 居岐之阳，实始剪商。
interpretations.explanation: 住在岐山南面，开始剪除商纣。

interpretations.segmentation: He dwelt on the sunny slope of Qi and began to cut down Shang.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.content: 至于文武，缵大王之绪，致天之届，于牧之野。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: zhi4 yu2 wen2 wu3， zuan3 da4 wang2 zhi1 xu4， zhi4 tian1 zhi1 jie4， yu2 mu4 zhi1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 至于文武，缵大王之绪，致天之届，于牧之野。
interpretations.explanation: 到了文王武王，继承大王基业，致天命于牧野。

interpretations.segmentation: Through Wen and Wu, continuing the Great Lord’s line, Heaven’s mandate reached Muye.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: wu2 er4 wu2 yu2， shang4 di4 lin2 nv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 无二无虞，上帝临女。
interpretations.explanation: 没有二心没有疑虑，上帝照临你们。

interpretations.segmentation: No duplicity, no doubt—God looks down upon you.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: dun1 shang1 zhi1 lv3， ke4 xian2 jue2 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 敦商之旅，克咸厥功。
interpretations.explanation: 整治商之旅，皆能成就其功。

interpretations.segmentation: The hosts of Shang were subdued—all their deeds fulfilled.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.content: 王曰叔父，建尔元子，俾侯于鲁。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: wang2 yue1 shu1 fu4， jian4 er3 yuan2 zi， bi3 hou2 yu2 lu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 王曰叔父，建尔元子，俾侯于鲁。
interpretations.explanation: 王说：叔父，立你的长子，封他为鲁侯。

interpretations.segmentation: The king said, “Uncle, establish your eldest son and make him marquis of Lu.”

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: da4 qi3 er3 yu3， wei4 zhou1 shi4 fu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 大启尔宇，为周室辅。
interpretations.explanation: 大大开辟你的封土，做周王室的辅佐。

interpretations.segmentation: Greatly open your domain to be a pillar of the Zhou house.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: nai3 ming4 lu3 gong1， bi3 hou2 yu2 dong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃命鲁公，俾侯于东。
interpretations.explanation: 于是命鲁公，封侯于东方。

interpretations.segmentation: Then he charged the Lord of Lu to rule the east.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: xi1 zhi1 shan1 chuan1， tu3 tian2 fu4 yong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 锡之山川，土田附庸。
interpretations.explanation: 赐给他山川土地和附庸。

interpretations.segmentation: He granted mountains, rivers, fields, and vassal lands.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: zhou1 gong1 zhi1 sun1， zhuang1 gong1 zhi1 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 周公之孙，庄公之子。
interpretations.explanation: 周公的孙子，庄公的儿子。

interpretations.segmentation: The Duke of Zhou’s grandson, Duke Zhuang’s son.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: long2 qi2 cheng2 si4。

interpretations.segmentation: 龙旂承祀。
interpretations.explanation: 龙旗承继祭祀。

interpretations.segmentation: With dragon banner he carries on the rites.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: liu4 pei4 er3 er3。

interpretations.segmentation: 六辔耳耳。
