interpretations.explanation: 六辔整齐，马铃悦耳。

interpretations.segmentation: Six reins hang even; horse bells ring clear.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: chun1 qiu1 fei3 jie3， xiang3 si4 bu4 te4。

interpretations.segmentation: 春秋匪解，享祀不忒。
interpretations.explanation: 春秋祭祀不懈，享祭没有差错。

interpretations.segmentation: Spring and autumn rites never slack; offerings are without fault.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: huang2 huang2 hou4 di4！

interpretations.segmentation: 皇皇后帝！
interpretations.explanation: 伟大的上帝啊！

interpretations.segmentation: Great God on high!

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: huang2 zu3 hou4 ji4！

interpretations.segmentation: 皇祖后稷！
interpretations.explanation: 伟大的先祖后稷啊！

interpretations.segmentation: Great ancestor Lord Millet!

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: xiang3 yi3 xing1 xi1， shi4 xiang3 shi4 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 享以骍牺，是飨是宜。
interpretations.explanation: 用赤色牺牲献祭，既享又合宜。

interpretations.segmentation: With red victims we sacrifice—fitting to offer and to feast.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.content: 降福既多，周公皇祖，亦其福女。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: jiang4 fu2 ji4 duo1， zhou1 gong1 huang2 zu3， yi4 qi2 fu2 nv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 降福既多，周公皇祖，亦其福女。
interpretations.explanation: 降福已经很多，周公皇祖也赐福于你。

interpretations.segmentation: Blessings descend in plenty; the Duke of Zhou’s royal ancestor blesses you too.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.content: 秋而载尝，夏而楅衡，白牡骍刚。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: qiu1 er2 zai4 chang2， xia4 er2 bi1 heng2， bai2 mu3 xing1 gang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 秋而载尝，夏而楅衡，白牡骍刚。
interpretations.explanation: 秋天尝祭，夏天设衡，用白牡赤犧。

interpretations.segmentation: Autumn tasting rites, summer yokes in place—white bull and red victim.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: xi1 zun1 jiang1 jiang1， mao2 pao2 zi4 geng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 牺尊将将，毛炰胾羹。
interpretations.explanation: 牺尊排列，毛炮肉羹齐备。

interpretations.segmentation: Sacrificial bronzes stand in rows; roasted flesh and sliced soup are ready.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: bian1 dou4 da4 fang2， wan4 wu3 yang2 yang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 笾豆大房，万舞洋洋。
interpretations.explanation: 笾豆大房，万舞洋洋。

interpretations.segmentation: Baskets, dishes, and great trays; myriad dancers move in grandeur.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: xiao4 sun1 you3 qing4。

interpretations.segmentation: 孝孙有庆。
interpretations.explanation: 孝孙因此有喜庆。

interpretations.segmentation: The reverent grandson has cause to rejoice.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.content: 俾尔炽而昌，俾尔寿而臧。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: bi3 er3 chi4 er2 chang1， bi3 er3 shou4 er2 zang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 俾尔炽而昌，俾尔寿而臧。
interpretations.explanation: 使你炽盛而昌盛，使你长寿而吉祥。

interpretations.segmentation: May you blaze and flourish; may you live long and be good.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: bao3 bi3 dong1 fang1， lu3 bang1 shi4 chang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 保彼东方，鲁邦是尝。
interpretations.explanation: 保祐东方，鲁邦因此受福。

interpretations.segmentation: Guard the east—Lu receives the blessing.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: bu4 kui1 bu4 beng1， bu4 zhen4 bu4 teng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 不亏不崩，不震不腾。
interpretations.explanation: 不亏不崩，不震不腾。

interpretations.segmentation: No loss, no collapse; no shock, no upheaval.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: san1 shou4 zuo4 peng2， ru2 gang1 ru2 ling2。

interpretations.segmentation: 三寿作朋，如冈如陵。
interpretations.explanation: 三寿为友，如山如陵。

interpretations.segmentation: Three long lives as companions—firm as hills and mounds.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: gong1 che1 qian1 cheng2， zhu1 ying1 lv4 teng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 公车千乘，朱英绿縢。
interpretations.explanation: 公车千乘，朱缨绿縢。

interpretations.segmentation: A thousand chariots of the lord—red tassels, green lashings.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: er4 mao2 zhong4 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 二矛重弓。
interpretations.explanation: 二矛重弓。

interpretations.segmentation: Two spears, double bows.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: gong1 tu2 san1 wan4， bei4 zhou4 zhu1 qin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 公徒三万，贝胄朱綅。
interpretations.explanation: 公徒三万，贝胄朱綅。

interpretations.segmentation: Thirty thousand footmen—shell helmets, red kneecaps.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.content: 烝徒增增，戎狄是膺，荆舒是惩，则莫我敢承！
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: zheng1 tu2 zeng1 zeng1， rong2 di2 shi4 ying1， jing1 shu1 shi4 cheng2， ze2 mo4 wo3 gan3 cheng2！

interpretations.segmentation: 烝徒增增，戎狄是膺，荆舒是惩，则莫我敢承！
interpretations.explanation: 众徒增增，抵御戎狄，惩罚荆舒，无人敢承当（其锋）！

interpretations.segmentation: Hosts swell and swell—they beat the Rong and Di, chastise Jing and Shu; none dare meet them!

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.content: 俾尔昌而炽，俾尔寿而富。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: bi3 er3 chang1 er2 chi4， bi3 er3 shou4 er2 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 俾尔昌而炽，俾尔寿而富。
interpretations.explanation: 使你昌而炽，使你寿而富。

interpretations.segmentation: May you thrive and blaze; may you live long and grow rich.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: huang2 fa1 tai2 bei4， shou4 xu1 yu3 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 黄发台背，寿胥与试。
interpretations.explanation: 黄发台背，长寿相与试验（享验）。

interpretations.segmentation: Gray hair and bent backs—long life granted and proved.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.content: 俾尔昌而大，俾尔耆而艾。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: bi3 er3 chang1 er2 da4， bi3 er3 qi2 er2 ai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 俾尔昌而大，俾尔耆而艾。
interpretations.explanation: 使你昌而大，使你老而治。

interpretations.segmentation: May you flourish and grow great; may you age in wisdom and rule.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: wan4 you3 qian1 sui4， mei2 shou4 wu2 you3 hai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 万有千岁，眉寿无有害。
interpretations.explanation: 万寿千岁，眉寿无有害。

interpretations.segmentation: Myriad years, a thousand ages—long life without harm.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: tai4 shan1 yan2 yan2， lu3 bang1 suo3 zhan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 泰山岩岩，鲁邦所詹。
interpretations.explanation: 泰山岩岩，是鲁邦所瞻仰。

interpretations.segmentation: Mount Tai stands stern—the pillar Lu looks to.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: yan3 you3 gui1 meng2， sui4 huang1 da4 dong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 奄有龟蒙，遂荒大东。
interpretations.explanation: 拥有龟蒙，于是开拓大东。

interpretations.segmentation: Holding Gui and Meng, they opened the great east.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: zhi4 yu2 hai3 bang1， huai2 yi2 lai2 tong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 至于海邦，淮夷来同。
interpretations.explanation: 至于海滨，淮夷来同朝。

interpretations.segmentation: To the sea’s edge the Huai tribes came in unity.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: mo4 bu4 lv4 cong2， lu3 hou2 zhi1 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 莫不率从，鲁侯之功。
interpretations.explanation: 无不顺从，这是鲁侯的功劳。

interpretations.segmentation: None failed to follow—this is the Lu lord’s merit.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: bao3 you3 fu2 yi4， sui4 huang1 xu2 zhai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 保有凫绎，遂荒徐宅。
interpretations.explanation: 保有凫绎，于是开拓徐地。

interpretations.segmentation: Keeping Fu and Yi, they extended over Xu’s lands.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: zhi4 yu2 hai3 bang1， huai2 yi2 man2 mo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 至于海邦，淮夷蛮貊。
interpretations.explanation: 至于海滨，淮夷与蛮貊。

interpretations.segmentation: To the sea came Huai tribes and southern barbarians.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: ji2 bi3 nan2 yi2， mo4 bu4 lv4 cong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 及彼南夷，莫不率从。
interpretations.explanation: 及于南夷，无不顺从。

interpretations.segmentation: Down to the southern tribes—all obeyed.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: mo4 gan3 bu4 nuo4， lu3 hou2 shi4 ruo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 莫敢不诺，鲁侯是若。
interpretations.explanation: 不敢不诺，鲁侯是这样（的君主）。

interpretations.segmentation: None dared refuse assent—such is the Lord of Lu.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: tian1 xi1 gong1 chun2 gu3， mei2 shou4 bao3 lu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 天锡公纯嘏，眉寿保鲁。
interpretations.explanation: 上天赐鲁公大福，眉寿保鲁。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven grants the Lord of Lu pure blessing—long life guarding Lu.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: ju1 chang2 yu3 xu3， fu4 zhou1 gong1 zhi1 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 居常与许，复周公之宇。
interpretations.explanation: 居常与许，恢复周公的封宇。

interpretations.segmentation: Dwelling at Chang and Xu, restoring the Duke of Zhou’s domain.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: lu3 hou2 yan4 xi3， ling4 qi1 shou4 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鲁侯燕喜，令妻寿母。
interpretations.explanation: 鲁侯燕喜，令妻寿母。

interpretations.segmentation: The Lu lord feasts in peace—fine wife, long-lived mother.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: yi2 da4 fu1 shu4 shi4， bang1 guo2 shi4 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 宜大夫庶士，邦国是有。
interpretations.explanation: 大夫庶士适宜，邦国因此有秩序。

interpretations.segmentation: Great officers and common knights in place—the state stands firm.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: ji4 duo1 shou4 zhi3， huang2 fa1 er2 chi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 既多受祉，黄发儿齿。
interpretations.explanation: 既多受福，黄发儿齿（高寿）。

interpretations.segmentation: Blessings received in plenty—gray hair like a child’s teeth (great age).

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: cu2 lai2 zhi1 song1， xin1 fu3 zhi1 bai3。

interpretations.segmentation: 徂徠之松，新甫之柏。
interpretations.explanation: 徂徕的松树，新甫的柏树。

interpretations.segmentation: Pines of Culai, cypress of Xinfu.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: shi4 duan4 shi4 du4， shi4 xun2 shi4 chi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 是断是度，是寻是尺。
interpretations.explanation: 砍伐丈量，寻尺计算。

interpretations.segmentation: Felled and measured—marked by cubits and feet.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.content: 松桷有舄，路寝孔硕，新庙奕奕。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: song1 jue2 you3 xi4， lu4 qin3 kong3 shuo4， xin1 miao4 yi4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 松桷有舄，路寝孔硕，新庙奕奕。
interpretations.explanation: 松椽有舄，路寝宏大，新庙奕奕。

interpretations.segmentation: Pine rafters with shoe-blocks; the main hall vast; the new temple gleams.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.content: 奚斯所作，孔曼且硕，万民是若。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong.pinyin: xi1 si1 suo3 zuo4， kong3 man4 qie3 shuo4， wan4 min2 shi4 ruo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 奚斯所作，孔曼且硕，万民是若。
interpretations.explanation: 奚斯所作，非常广大，万民效法。

interpretations.segmentation: Built by Xi Si—grand and vast; all people take it as model.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.pinyin: jiong1 jiong1 mu3 ma3， zai4 jiong1 zhi1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 駉駉牡马，在坰之野。
interpretations.explanation: 壮马肥健，在郊外的野地。

interpretations.segmentation: Sturdy stallions graze on the open plain beyond the city.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.content: 薄言駉者，有驈有皇，有骊有黄，以车彭彭。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.pinyin: bao2 yan2 jiong1 zhe3， you3 yu4 you3 huang2， you3 li2 you3 huang2， yi3 che1 peng2 peng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 薄言駉者，有驈有皇，有骊有黄，以车彭彭。
interpretations.explanation: 那些骏马，有青白有黄骊，拉车彭彭有声。

interpretations.segmentation: Those fine horses—piebald, bay, black, and yellow—draw chariots rumbling on.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.pinyin: si1 wu2 jiang1 si1， ma3 si1 zang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 思无疆思，马斯臧。
interpretations.explanation: 思无疆界，马皆良善。

interpretations.segmentation: Thought without limit—the horses are all good.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.pinyin: jiong1 jiong1 mu3 ma3， zai4 jiong1 zhi1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 駉駉牡马，在坰之野。
interpretations.explanation: 壮马肥健，在郊外的野地。

interpretations.segmentation: Sturdy stallions on the open plain beyond the city.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.content: 薄言駉者，有骓有駓，有骍有骐，以车伾伾。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.pinyin: bao2 yan2 jiong1 zhe3， you3 zhui1 you3 pi1， you3 xing1 you3 qi2， yi3 che1 pi1 pi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 薄言駉者，有骓有駓，有骍有骐，以车伾伾。
interpretations.explanation: 那些骏马，有骓有駓有骍有骐，拉车伾伾有力。

interpretations.segmentation: Those fine horses—dappled, chestnut, red, and dark—pull chariots strong and steady.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.pinyin: si1 wu2 qi1 si1， ma3 si1 cai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 思无期思，马斯才。
interpretations.explanation: 思无期限，马皆才具。

interpretations.segmentation: Thought without end—the horses all have talent.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.pinyin: jiong1 jiong1 mu3 ma3， zai4 jiong1 zhi1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 駉駉牡马，在坰之野。
interpretations.explanation: 壮马肥健，在郊外的野地。

interpretations.segmentation: Sturdy stallions on the open plain beyond the city.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.content: 溥言駉者，有驒有骆，有骝有雒，以车绎绎。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.pinyin: pu3 yan2 jiong1 zhe3， you3 tuo2 you3 luo4， you3 liu2 you3 luo4， yi3 che1 yi4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 溥言駉者，有驒有骆，有骝有雒，以车绎绎。
interpretations.explanation: 那些骏马，有驒有骆有骝有雒，拉车绎绎不绝。

interpretations.segmentation: Those fine horses—gray, white, bay, and piebald—draw chariots in endless train.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.pinyin: si1 wu2 yi4 si1， ma3 si1 zuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 思无斁思，马斯作。
interpretations.explanation: 思无厌足，马皆振作。

interpretations.segmentation: Thought without weariness—the horses all excel.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.pinyin: jiong1 jiong1 mu3 ma3， zai4 jiong1 zhi1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 駉駉牡马，在坰之野。
interpretations.explanation: 壮马肥健，在郊外的野地。

interpretations.segmentation: Sturdy stallions on the open plain beyond the city.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.content: 薄言駉者，有骃有騢，有驔有鱼，以车祛祛。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.pinyin: bao2 yan2 jiong1 zhe3， you3 yin1 you3 xia2， you3 dian4 you3 yu2， yi3 che1 qu1 qu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 薄言駉者，有骃有騢，有驔有鱼，以车祛祛。
interpretations.explanation: 那些骏马，有骃有騢有驔有鱼，拉车祛祛徐行。

interpretations.segmentation: Those fine horses—light bay, gray, dappled, and marked—draw chariots moving at ease.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong.pinyin: si1 wu2 xie2 si1， ma3 si1 cu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 思无邪思，马斯徂。
interpretations.explanation: 思无邪曲，马皆前往。

interpretations.segmentation: Thought without crookedness—the horses all go forward.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: si1 le4 pan4 shui3， bao2 cai3 qi2 qin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 思乐泮水，薄采其芹。
interpretations.explanation: 快乐地在泮水边，采那里的芹菜。

interpretations.segmentation: Joy at Pan water—we lightly gather celery there.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: lu3 hou2 li4 zhi3， yan2 guan1 qi2 qi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鲁侯戾止，言观其旂。
interpretations.explanation: 鲁侯来到，要看他的旗帜。

interpretations.segmentation: The Lord of Lu arrives; we gaze upon his banner.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: qi2 qi2 fa2 fa2， luan2 sheng1 hui4 hui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 其旂茷茷，鸾声哕哕。
interpretations.explanation: 旗帜飘动，鸾铃哕哕作响。

interpretations.segmentation: His banner flutters; bell-charms on the team ring clear.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: wu2 xiao3 wu2 da4， cong2 gong1 yu2 mai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 无小无大，从公于迈。
interpretations.explanation: 无论幼小或长大，都跟随公侯前行。

interpretations.segmentation: None too small, none too great—all follow the lord on the march.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: si1 le4 pan4 shui3， bao2 cai3 qi2 zao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 思乐泮水，薄采其藻。
interpretations.explanation: 快乐地在泮水边，采那里的藻。

interpretations.segmentation: Joy at Pan water—we gather water plants there.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: lu3 hou2 li4 zhi3， qi2 ma3 jue1 jue1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鲁侯戾止，其马蹻蹻。
interpretations.explanation: 鲁侯来到，他的马蹻蹻健壮。

interpretations.segmentation: The Lord of Lu arrives; his horses step strong and tall.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: qi2 ma3 jue1 jue1， qi2 yin1 zhao1 zhao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 其马蹻蹻，其音昭昭。
interpretations.explanation: 马儿蹻蹻，声音昭昭明畅。

interpretations.segmentation: The horses stride high; their bells sound bright and far.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: zai4 se4 zai4 xiao4， fei3 nu4 yi1 jiao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 载色载笑，匪怒伊教。
interpretations.explanation: 和颜悦色带笑，不是发怒而是施教。

interpretations.segmentation: With color and laughter—not anger but instruction.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: si1 le4 pan4 shui3， bao2 cai3 qi2 mao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 思乐泮水，薄采其茆。
interpretations.explanation: 快乐地在泮水边，采那里的茆（茅）。

interpretations.segmentation: Joy at Pan water—we pick rushes on the bank.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: lu3 hou2 li4 zhi3， zai4 pan4 yin3 jiu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鲁侯戾止，在泮饮酒。
interpretations.explanation: 鲁侯来到，在泮水饮酒。

interpretations.segmentation: The Lord of Lu arrives to drink at Pan water.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: ji4 yin3 zhi3 jiu3， yong3 xi1 nan2 lao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 既饮旨酒，永锡难老。
interpretations.explanation: 既饮美酒，永赐难老之福。

interpretations.segmentation: Having tasted fine wine, may he receive endless age.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: shun4 bi3 zhang3 dao4， qu1 ci3 qun2 chou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 顺彼长道，屈此群丑。
interpretations.explanation: 顺沿长道，使群丑屈服。

interpretations.segmentation: Along the long road he goes, bending rebellious foes.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: mu4 mu4 lu3 hou2， jing4 ming2 qi2 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 穆穆鲁侯，敬明其德。
interpretations.explanation: 穆穆鲁侯，彰明其德。

interpretations.segmentation: Solemn is the Lord of Lu—he makes his virtue clear.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: jing4 shen4 wei1 yi2， wei2 min2 zhi1 ze2。

interpretations.segmentation: 敬慎威仪，维民之则。
interpretations.explanation: 敬慎威仪，是民众的法则。

interpretations.segmentation: Reverent in bearing and rites—he is the people’s model.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: yun3 wen2 yun3 wu3， zhao1 jia3 lie4 zu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 允文允武，昭假烈祖。
interpretations.explanation: 既文既武，昭告烈祖。

interpretations.segmentation: Cultured and martial—he announces it to blazing ancestors.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: mi2 you3 bu4 xiao4， zi4 qiu2 yi1 hu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 靡有不孝，自求伊祜。
interpretations.explanation: 无不孝顺，自求吉祥。

interpretations.segmentation: None fail in filial duty—he seeks blessing for himself.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: ming2 ming2 lu3 hou2， ke4 ming2 qi2 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 明明鲁侯，克明其德。
interpretations.explanation: 英明的鲁侯，能明其德。

interpretations.segmentation: Bright is the Lord of Lu—he can illumine his virtue.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: ji4 zuo4 pan4 gong1， huai2 yi2 you1 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既作泮宫，淮夷攸服。
interpretations.explanation: 既建泮宫，淮夷于是臣服。

interpretations.segmentation: The Pan palace built—the Huai tribes submit.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: jiao3 jiao3 hu3 chen2， zai4 pan4 xian4 guo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 矫矫虎臣，在泮献馘。
interpretations.explanation: 勇武如虎的臣，在泮宫献所斩敌首。

interpretations.segmentation: Tiger-bold warriors present severed heads at Pan.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: shu1 wen4 ru2 gao1 tao2， zai4 pan4 xian4 qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 淑问如皋陶，在泮献囚。
interpretations.explanation: 审问如皋陶，在泮宫献俘虏。

interpretations.segmentation: Judging like Gao Yao, they present captives at Pan.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: ji4 ji4 duo1 shi4， ke4 guang3 de2 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 济济多士，克广德心。
interpretations.explanation: 济济多士，能广德心。

interpretations.segmentation: Many officers in array—they broaden the heart of virtue.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: huan2 huan2 yu2 zheng1， di2 bi3 dong1 nan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 桓桓于征，狄彼东南。
interpretations.explanation: 威武出征，平定那东南。

interpretations.segmentation: Bold on campaign—they pacify the southeast.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: zheng1 zheng1 huang2 huang2， bu4 wu2 bu4 yang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 烝烝皇皇，不吴不扬。
interpretations.explanation: 众多而皇皇，不喧哗不张扬。

interpretations.segmentation: Hosts vast and stately—neither noisy nor boastful.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: bu4 gao4 yu2 xiong1， zai4 pan4 xian4 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不告于訩，在泮献功。
interpretations.explanation: 不必诉于喧哗，在泮宫献战功。

interpretations.segmentation: No need to clamor in dispute—they report merit at Pan.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: jiao3 gong1 qi2 qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 角弓其觩。
interpretations.explanation: 角弓弯曲。

interpretations.segmentation: Horn bows are curved.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: shu4 shi3 qi2 sou1。

interpretations.segmentation: 束矢其搜。
interpretations.explanation: 束矢齐整。

interpretations.segmentation: Bundled arrows lie in order.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: rong2 che1 kong3 bo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 戎车孔博。
interpretations.explanation: 戎车非常宽大。

interpretations.segmentation: War chariots are broad and grand.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: tu2 yu4 wu2 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 徒御无斁。
interpretations.explanation: 徒众御者无厌倦。

interpretations.segmentation: Footmen and drivers never weary.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: ji4 ke4 huai2 yi2， kong3 shu1 bu4 ni4。

interpretations.segmentation: 既克淮夷，孔淑不逆。
interpretations.explanation: 既克淮夷，非常和顺不叛逆。

interpretations.segmentation: Having conquered the Huai, they are most gentle and not rebellious.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: shi4 gu4 er3 you2， huai2 yi2 zu2 huo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 式固尔犹，淮夷卒获。
interpretations.explanation: 巩固你的谋划，淮夷终被俘获。

interpretations.segmentation: Make firm your plans—the Huai are taken at last.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: pian1 bi3 fei1 xiao1， ji2 yu2 pan4 lin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 翩彼飞鸮，集于泮林。
interpretations.explanation: 翩翩飞鸮，集于泮林。

interpretations.segmentation: Flying owls wheel and settle in Pan grove.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: shi2 wo3 sang1 dan3， huai2 wo3 hao3 yin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 食我桑黮，怀我好音。
interpretations.explanation: 吃我桑椹，怀我好音。

interpretations.segmentation: They eat our mulberries and cherish our good words.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: jing3 bi3 huai2 yi2， lai2 xian4 qi2 chen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 憬彼淮夷，来献其琛。
interpretations.explanation: 远方淮夷，来献珍宝。

interpretations.segmentation: From afar the Huai come, offering tribute gems.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui.pinyin: yuan2 gui1 xiang4 chi3， da4 lu4 nan2 jin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 元龟象齿，大赂南金。
interpretations.explanation: 大龟象牙，大赂南金。

interpretations.segmentation: Great tortoises, ivory tusks—rich gifts of southern gold.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi.pinyin: you3 bi4 you3 bi4， bi4 bi3 cheng2 huang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有駜有駜，駜彼乘黄。
interpretations.explanation: 骏马强壮又肥硕，拉着黄色的车乘。

interpretations.segmentation: Strong and stout are the steeds, drawing the yellow chariot.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi.pinyin: su4 ye4 zai4 gong1， zai4 gong1 ming2 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 夙夜在公，在公明明。
interpretations.explanation: 从早到晚在公门办事，在朝廷上光明公正。

interpretations.segmentation: From early morn till night they serve the lord, upright and clear in the hall.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi.pinyin: zhen4 zhen4 lu4， lu4 yu2 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 振振鹭，鹭于下。
interpretations.explanation: 白鹭振翅翩翩，向下飞落。

interpretations.segmentation: White egrets flutter their wings, settling down below.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi.pinyin: gu3 yan4 yan4， zui4 yan2 wu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鼓咽咽，醉言舞。
interpretations.explanation: 鼓声咽咽响起，醉后说着话、跳起舞。

interpretations.segmentation: Drums beat softly; tipsy, they speak and dance.
于胥乐兮！
interpretations.explanation: 大家多么快乐啊！

interpretations.segmentation: How joyful we all are!

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi.pinyin: you3 bi4 you3 bi4， bi4 bi3 cheng2 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有駜有駜，駜彼乘牡。
interpretations.explanation: 骏马强壮又肥硕，拉着公马的车乘。

interpretations.segmentation: Strong and stout are the steeds, drawing the stallion team.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi.pinyin: su4 ye4 zai4 gong1， zai4 gong1 yin3 jiu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 夙夜在公，在公饮酒。
interpretations.explanation: 从早到晚在公门办事，在朝廷上饮酒宴乐。

interpretations.segmentation: From early morn till night they serve the lord, drinking at court.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi.pinyin: zhen4 zhen4 lu4， lu4 yu2 fei1。

interpretations.segmentation: 振振鹭，鹭于飞。
interpretations.explanation: 白鹭振翅翩翩，向空中飞去。

interpretations.segmentation: White egrets flutter their wings, soaring in flight.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi.pinyin: gu3 yan4 yan4， zui4 yan2 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鼓咽咽，醉言归。
interpretations.explanation: 鼓声咽咽响起，醉后说着要回去。

interpretations.segmentation: Drums beat softly; drunk, they speak of going home.
于胥乐兮！
interpretations.explanation: 大家多么快乐啊！

interpretations.segmentation: How joyful we all are!

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi.pinyin: you3 bi4 you3 bi4， bi4 bi3 cheng2 xuan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有駜有駜，駜彼乘駽。
interpretations.explanation: 骏马强壮又肥硕，拉着青骢马的车乘。

interpretations.segmentation: Strong and stout are the steeds, drawing the piebald team.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi.pinyin: su4 ye4 zai4 gong1， zai4 gong1 zai4 yan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夙夜在公，在公载燕。
interpretations.explanation: 从早到晚在公门办事，在朝廷上设宴欢聚。

interpretations.segmentation: From early morn till night they serve the lord, feasting at court.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi.pinyin: zi4 jin1 yi3 shi3， sui4 qi2 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 自今以始，岁其有。
interpretations.explanation: 从今以后，愿年年都有好收成。

interpretations.segmentation: From this day on, may each year bring abundance.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi.pinyin: jun1 zi you3 gu3， yi2 sun1 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子有穀，诒孙子。
interpretations.explanation: 君子有五谷，留给子孙享用。

interpretations.segmentation: The noble lord has grain to leave for sons and grandsons.
于胥乐兮！
interpretations.explanation: 大家多么快乐啊！

interpretations.segmentation: How joyful we all are!

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: jun4 zhe2 wei2 shang1， zhang3 fa1 qi2 xiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 浚哲维商，长发其祥。
interpretations.explanation: 商族深谋远虑，祥瑞长久绵延。

interpretations.segmentation: Deep in wisdom is Shang; its good omens long endure.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: hong2 shui3 mang2 mang2， yu3 fu1 xia4 tu3 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 洪水芒芒，禹敷下土方。
interpretations.explanation: 洪水茫茫无际，禹遍治天下四方。

interpretations.segmentation: Vast was the flood; Yu spread order over the land.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: wai4 da4 guo2 shi4 jiang1， fu2 yun3 ji4 zhang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 外大国是疆，幅陨既长。
interpretations.explanation: 划分大国疆界，幅员因而扩大。

interpretations.segmentation: He marked the great states' bounds; the realm grew wide.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: you3 song1 fang1 jiang1， di4 li4 zi sheng1 shang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有娀方将，帝立子生商。
interpretations.explanation: 有娀氏正强盛，上帝立其子，商族由此而生。

interpretations.segmentation: When You-song rose, God set her son—thus Shang was born.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.content: 玄王桓拨，受小国是达，受大国是达。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: xuan2 wang2 huan2 bo1， shou4 xiao3 guo2 shi4 da2， shou4 da4 guo2 shi4 da2。

interpretations.segmentation: 玄王桓拨，受小国是达，受大国是达。
interpretations.explanation: 玄王勇武开拓，使小国大国都通达归附。

interpretations.segmentation: Lord Xuan boldly opened the way; small and great states all reached him.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: lv4 lv3 bu4 yue4， sui4 shi4 ji4 fa1。

interpretations.segmentation: 率履不越，遂视既发。
interpretations.explanation: 遵循法度不越轨，于是视民而政令畅达。

interpretations.segmentation: He kept the path without straying; his rule went forth to the people.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: xiang1 shi4 lie4 lie4。

interpretations.segmentation: 相士烈烈。
interpretations.explanation: 相士威武刚烈。

interpretations.segmentation: Xiang-shi was fierce and bold.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: hai3 wai4 you3 jie2。

interpretations.segmentation: 海外有截。
interpretations.explanation: 海外诸邦也顺服。

interpretations.segmentation: Even beyond the seas, all were brought in line.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: di4 ming4 bu4 wei2， zhi4 yu2 tang1 qi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 帝命不违，至于汤齐。
interpretations.explanation: 天命不可违背，传至汤时齐同受命。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven's command was not defied, till Tang received it in full.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: tang1 jiang4 bu4 chi2， sheng4 jing4 ri4 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 汤降不迟，圣敬日跻。
interpretations.explanation: 汤王降世不迟，圣敬之心日日上升。

interpretations.segmentation: Tang came not late; sacred reverence rose day by day.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.content: 昭假迟迟，上帝是祗，帝命式于九围。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: zhao1 jia3 chi2 chi2， shang4 di4 shi4 zhi1， di4 ming4 shi4 yu2 jiu3 wei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 昭假迟迟，上帝是祗，帝命式于九围。
interpretations.explanation: 光明久照，敬奉上帝，受命治理九州。

interpretations.segmentation: Long he shone in prayer, revering God; Heaven charged him with the nine regions.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.content: 受小球大球，为下国缀旒，何天之休。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: shou4 xiao3 qiu2 da4 qiu2， wei4 xia4 guo2 zhui4 liu2， he2 tian1 zhi1 xiu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 受小球大球，为下国缀旒，何天之休。
interpretations.explanation: 接受大小玉球，为下国作缀旒，这是上天所赐的美福。

interpretations.segmentation: He received large and small jade spheres, pendant gems for vassal kings—Heaven's grace.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: bu4 jing4 bu4 qiu2， bu4 gang1 bu4 rou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 不竞不絿，不刚不柔。
interpretations.explanation: 不争强好胜，也不软弱退缩；不刚愎，不优柔。

interpretations.segmentation: He did not strive nor slack; neither hard nor soft alone.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: fu1 zheng4 you1 you1。

interpretations.segmentation: 敷政优优。
interpretations.explanation: 施政宽和优裕。

interpretations.segmentation: His governance was gentle and ample.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: bai3 lu4 shi4 qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 百禄是遒。
interpretations.explanation: 百种福禄都汇聚而来。

interpretations.segmentation: All hundred blessings gathered to him.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.content: 受小共大共，为下国骏厖。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: shou4 xiao3 gong4 da4 gong4， wei4 xia4 guo2 jun4 pang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 受小共大共，为下国骏厖。
interpretations.explanation: 接受大小贡物，为下国作厚辅。

interpretations.segmentation: He took small and great tribute, a mighty support for vassal states.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: he2 tian1 zhi1 long2， fu1 zou4 qi2 yong3。

interpretations.segmentation: 何天之龙，敷奏其勇。
interpretations.explanation: 上天多么隆宠，陈奏其勇武。

interpretations.segmentation: How Heaven favored him—he showed forth his valor.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.content: 不震不动，不戁不竦，百禄是总。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: bu4 zhen4 bu4 dong4， bu4 nan3 bu4 song3， bai3 lu4 shi4 zong3。

interpretations.segmentation: 不震不动，不戁不竦，百禄是总。
interpretations.explanation: 不震不动，不恐不悚，百种福禄总集其身。

interpretations.segmentation: Unshaken, unafraid, all hundred blessings were his.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: wu3 wang2 zai4 pei4， you3 qian2 bing3 yue4。

interpretations.segmentation: 武王载旆，有虔秉钺。
interpretations.explanation: 武王挥旗出征，虔诚手执斧钺。

interpretations.segmentation: King Wu raised his banner; devoutly he grasped axe and halberd.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: ru2 huo3 lie4 lie4， ze2 mo4 wo3 gan3 he2。

interpretations.segmentation: 如火烈烈，则莫我敢曷。
interpretations.explanation: 如火烈烈，没有谁敢与我为敌。

interpretations.segmentation: Blazing like fire—none dared stand against us.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: bao1 you3 san1 nie4， mo4 sui4 mo4 da2。

interpretations.segmentation: 苞有三蘖，莫遂莫达。
interpretations.explanation: 根株有三蘖，却不得遂长、不得通达。

interpretations.segmentation: The root had three shoots, yet none could thrive or reach far.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.content: 九有有截，韦顾既伐，昆吾夏桀。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: jiu3 you3 you3 jie2， wei2 gu4 ji4 fa2， kun1 wu2 xia4 jie2。

interpretations.segmentation: 九有有截，韦顾既伐，昆吾夏桀。
interpretations.explanation: 九州都顺服，韦、顾已伐灭，昆吾与夏桀同亡。

interpretations.segmentation: The nine realms were subdued; Wei and Gu fell, Kun-wu and Jie of Xia perished.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: xi1 zai4 zhong1 ye4， you3 zhen4 qie3 ye4。

interpretations.segmentation: 昔在中叶，有震且业。
interpretations.explanation: 昔在中叶之时，有震威且有功业。

interpretations.segmentation: In mid-dynasty days there was awe and great achievement.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: yun3 ye3 tian1 zi， jiang4 yu3 qing1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 允也天子，降予卿士。
interpretations.explanation: 确实是天子，降任卿士辅佐。

interpretations.segmentation: Truly a Son of Heaven—he sent down ministers to aid.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa.pinyin: shi2 wei2 a1 heng2， shi2 zuo3 you4 shang1 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 实维阿衡，实左右商王。
interpretations.explanation: 实有阿衡，实在左右商王。

interpretations.segmentation: There was A-heng indeed, truly at the king of Shang's side.
嗟嗟烈祖！
interpretations.explanation: 啊，伟大的烈祖！

interpretations.segmentation: Ah, great Ancestor of fiery merit!
有秩斯祜。
interpretations.explanation: 有常秩的福祜降下。

interpretations.segmentation: Ranked blessings descend upon us.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu.pinyin: shen1 xi1 wu2 jiang1， ji2 er3 si1 suo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 申锡无疆，及尔斯所。
interpretations.explanation: 再次赐予无穷福泽，及于此时此地。

interpretations.segmentation: Again bestowing boundless grace, reaching us here and now.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu.pinyin: ji4 zai4 qing1 gu1， lai4 wo3 si1 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既载清酤，赉我思成。
interpretations.explanation: 既已备好清酒，赐我祭祀成功。

interpretations.segmentation: Clear wine is ready; grant us a successful rite.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu.pinyin: yi4 you3 he2 geng1， ji4 jie4 ji4 ping2。

interpretations.segmentation: 亦有和羹，既戒既平。
interpretations.explanation: 也有调和的羹汤，既已戒备又已齐备。

interpretations.segmentation: There is harmonized broth; all is prepared and settled.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu.pinyin: zong1 jia3 wu2 yan2， shi2 mi2 you3 zheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鬷假无言，时靡有争。
interpretations.explanation: 肃敬无声，此时没有争讼。

interpretations.segmentation: Reverent and silent—now none contend.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu.pinyin: sui2 wo3 mei2 shou4， huang2 gou3 wu2 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 绥我眉寿，黄耇无疆。
interpretations.explanation: 赐我长寿，黄发老人福泽无疆。

interpretations.segmentation: Grant us long life; the aged enjoy endless blessing.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu.pinyin: yue1 di3 cuo4 heng2， ba1 luan2 cang1 cang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 约軧错衡，八鸾鸧鸧。
interpretations.explanation: 车軧皮革交错，八鸾铃响当当。

interpretations.segmentation: Leather traces cross; eight bells ring clear.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu.pinyin: yi3 jia3 yi3 xiang3， wo3 shou4 ming4 pu3 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 以假以享，我受命溥将。
interpretations.explanation: 以此致祭享献，我受命广大将行。

interpretations.segmentation: With these we pray and feast; I bear a broad mandate.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu.pinyin: zi4 tian1 jiang4 kang1， feng1 nian2 rang2 rang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 自天降康，丰年穰穰。
interpretations.explanation: 自天降康，丰年谷粮满仓。

interpretations.segmentation: From Heaven comes peace; harvest years overflow.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu.pinyin: lai2 jia3 lai2 xiang3， jiang4 fu2 wu2 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 来假来飨，降福无疆。
interpretations.explanation: 来祭来享，降福无穷。

interpretations.segmentation: Come to worship, come to feast—blessings without end.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu.pinyin: gu4 yu3 zheng1 chang2， tang1 sun1 zhi1 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 顾予烝尝，汤孙之将。
interpretations.explanation: 顾念我秋冬之祭，汤孙将主其事。

interpretations.segmentation: Look on our seasonal offerings; Tang's descendant will lead them.
猗与那与！
interpretations.explanation: 多么美好啊！

interpretations.segmentation: How fine, how noble!
置我鞉鼓。
interpretations.explanation: 安置我的鞉鼓。

interpretations.segmentation: Set out my hand-drums.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na.pinyin: zou4 gu3 jian3 jian3， kan4 wo3 lie4 zu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 奏鼓简简，衎我烈祖。
interpretations.explanation: 击鼓声简简，使我烈祖欣悦。

interpretations.segmentation: Drums beat steadily, delighting our fiery ancestor.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na.pinyin: tang1 sun1 zou4 jia3， sui2 wo3 si1 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 汤孙奏假，绥我思成。
interpretations.explanation: 汤孙奏乐致祭，安我祭祀成功。

interpretations.segmentation: Tang's descendant plays in prayer; settle our rite in success.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na.pinyin: tao2 gu3 yuan1 yuan1， hui4 hui4 guan3 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鞉鼓渊渊，嘒嘒管声。
interpretations.explanation: 鞉鼓声渊渊，管乐嘒嘒清亮。

interpretations.segmentation: Hand-drums rumble deep; pipes shrill and bright.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na.pinyin: ji4 he2 qie3 ping2， yi1 wo3 qing4 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 既和且平，依我磬声。
interpretations.explanation: 既和谐又平和，依循磬声齐奏。

interpretations.segmentation: Harmonious and calm, following the chime-stones' lead.
于赫汤孙！
interpretations.explanation: 显赫啊汤孙！

interpretations.segmentation: Splendid is Tang's descendant!
穆穆厥声。
interpretations.explanation: 穆穆其声威。

interpretations.segmentation: Solemn and dignified is his fame.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na.pinyin: yong1 gu3 you3 yi4， wan4 wu3 you3 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 庸鼓有斁，万舞有奕。
interpretations.explanation: 用鼓不止，万舞盛大。

interpretations.segmentation: Drums never cease; the myriad dance is grand.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na.pinyin: wo3 you3 jia1 ke4， yi4 bu4 yi2 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我有嘉客，亦不夷怿。
interpretations.explanation: 我有嘉客，也都非常喜悦。

interpretations.segmentation: We have honored guests, and none are displeased.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na.pinyin: zi4 gu3 zai4 xi1， xian1 min2 you3 zuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 自古在昔，先民有作。
interpretations.explanation: 自古在昔，先民有所创制。

interpretations.segmentation: From ancient times our forebears made these rites.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na.content: 温恭朝夕，执事有恪，顾予烝尝，汤孙之将。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na.pinyin: wen1 gong1 chao2 xi1， zhi2 shi4 you3 ke4， gu4 yu3 zheng1 chang2， tang1 sun1 zhi1 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 温恭朝夕，执事有恪，顾予烝尝，汤孙之将。
interpretations.explanation: 温恭朝夕，执事有恪，顾念我烝尝之祭，汤孙将主其事。

interpretations.segmentation: Gentle and reverent day and night, dutiful in service—mind our offerings; Tang's descendant will lead.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao.content: 天命玄鸟，降而生商，宅殷土芒芒。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao.pinyin: tian1 ming4 xuan2 niao3， jiang4 er2 sheng1 shang1， zhai2 yin1 tu3 mang2 mang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天命玄鸟，降而生商，宅殷土芒芒。
interpretations.explanation: 天命玄鸟，降而生商，定居殷土广大。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven sent the dark bird; it descended and Shang was born, dwelling on vast Yin soil.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao.content: 古帝命武汤，正域彼四方。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao.pinyin: gu3 di4 ming4 wu3 tang1， zheng4 yu4 bi3 si4 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 古帝命武汤，正域彼四方。
interpretations.explanation: 古帝命武汤，正其域于四方。

interpretations.segmentation: The ancient Lord charged valiant Tang to set the realm in order on every side.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao.pinyin: fang1 ming4 jue2 hou4， yan3 you3 jiu3 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 方命厥后，奄有九有。
interpretations.explanation: 分命其后代，奄有九州。

interpretations.segmentation: He assigned their heirs— they held the nine realms.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao.content: 商之先后，受命不殆，在武丁孙子。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao.pinyin: shang1 zhi1 xian1 hou4， shou4 ming4 bu4 dai4， zai4 wu3 ding1 sun1 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 商之先后，受命不殆，在武丁孙子。
interpretations.explanation: 商之先后，受命不殆，在武丁孙子身上。

interpretations.segmentation: Shang's forebears and successors, charged without fail, live on in Wu-ding's line.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao.pinyin: wu3 ding1 sun1 zi， wu3 wang2 mi2 bu4 sheng4。

interpretations.segmentation: 武丁孙子，武王靡不胜。
interpretations.explanation: 武丁孙子，武王无不胜。

interpretations.segmentation: Wu-ding's descendant—the martial king wins every battle.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao.pinyin: long2 qi2 shi2 cheng2， da4 xi1 shi4 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 龙旂十乘，大糦是承。
interpretations.explanation: 龙旗十乘，大糦是承。

interpretations.segmentation: Ten dragon banners; he receives the great grain tribute.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao.content: 邦畿千里，维民所止，肇域彼四海。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao.pinyin: bang1 ji1 qian1 li3， wei2 min2 suo3 zhi3， zhao4 yu4 bi3 si4 hai3。

interpretations.segmentation: 邦畿千里，维民所止，肇域彼四海。
interpretations.explanation: 邦畿千里，维民所止，始开域于四海。

interpretations.segmentation: The capital domain spans a thousand li where people dwell; thus the four seas were opened.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao.pinyin: si4 hai3 lai2 jia3， lai2 jia3 qi2 qi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 四海来假，来假祁祁。
interpretations.explanation: 四海来朝，来朝者众多。

interpretations.segmentation: From the four seas they come; hosts arrive in throngs.
景员维河。
interpretations.explanation: 景山环绕黄河。

interpretations.segmentation: Jing Mountain lies by the great River.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao.pinyin: yin1 shou4 ming4 xian2 yi2， bai3 lu4 shi4 he2。

interpretations.segmentation: 殷受命咸宜，百禄是何。
interpretations.explanation: 殷受天命皆合宜，百种福禄归之。

interpretations.segmentation: Yin received Heaven's charge fitly— all hundred blessings are theirs.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: ta4 bi3 yin1 wu3， fen4 fa2 jing1 chu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 挞彼殷武，奋伐荆楚。
interpretations.explanation: 殷武威武，奋伐荆楚。

interpretations.segmentation: Mighty is Yin-Wu, striking hard against Jing and Chu.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: shen1 ru4 qi2 zu3， pou2 jing1 zhi1 lv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 深入其阻，裒荆之旅。
interpretations.explanation: 深入其险阻，聚荆楚之众。

interpretations.segmentation: Deep into their rugged land; he gathered the hosts of Jing.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: you3 jie2 qi2 suo3， tang1 sun1 zhi1 xu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 有截其所，汤孙之绪。
interpretations.explanation: 所至皆服，汤孙之绪业。

interpretations.segmentation: Where he went, all submitted— the legacy of Tang's line.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: wei2 nv3 jing1 chu3， ju1 guo2 nan2 xiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维女荆楚，居国南乡。
interpretations.explanation: 你们荆楚，居国在南方。

interpretations.segmentation: You of Jing and Chu, your state lies in the south.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.content: 昔有成汤，自彼氐羌，莫敢不来享，莫敢不来王。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: xi1 you3 cheng2 tang1， zi4 bi3 di1 qiang1， mo4 gan3 bu4 lai2 xiang3， mo4 gan3 bu4 lai2 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 昔有成汤，自彼氐羌，莫敢不来享，莫敢不来王。
interpretations.explanation: 昔有成汤，自氐羌以来，莫敢不来享，莫敢不来朝。

interpretations.segmentation: Once Cheng Tang ruled—from Di and Qiang on, none dared not come to feast or pay homage.
曰商是常。
interpretations.explanation: 说商是常服之邦。

interpretations.segmentation: They said Shang was the constant lord.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.content: 天命多辟，设都于禹之绩。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: tian1 ming4 duo1 pi4， she4 dou1 yu2 yu3 zhi1 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天命多辟，设都于禹之绩。
interpretations.explanation: 天命多诸侯，设都于禹治水之功绩之地。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven charged many lords to set capitals where Yu's work endured.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.content: 岁事来辟，勿予祸适，稼穑匪解。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: sui4 shi4 lai2 pi4， wu4 yu3 huo4 shi4， jia4 se4 fei3 jie3。

interpretations.segmentation: 岁事来辟，勿予祸适，稼穑匪解。
interpretations.explanation: 岁事来朝，勿予祸患，稼穑不懈。

interpretations.segmentation: Each year they come to court— bring no disaster; keep farming without slack.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: tian1 ming4 jiang4 jian1， xia4 min2 you3 yan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天命降监，下民有严。
interpretations.explanation: 天命降监察，下民有严敬。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven sends down oversight; the people below are reverent.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: bu4 jian4 bu4 lan4， bu4 gan3 dai4 huang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 不僭不滥，不敢怠遑。
interpretations.explanation: 不越分不滥刑，不敢懈怠偷安。

interpretations.segmentation: Neither overstepping nor excess in punishment— never idle or negligent.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: ming4 yu2 xia4 guo2， feng1 jian4 jue2 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 命于下国，封建厥福。
interpretations.explanation: 命于下国，分封其福。

interpretations.segmentation: Charge the states below; allot them blessing.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: shang1 yi4 yi4 yi4， si4 fang1 zhi1 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 商邑翼翼，四方之极。
interpretations.explanation: 商都翼翼整齐，为四方之极。

interpretations.segmentation: Shang's capital stands in order—the pole for all directions.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: he4 he4 jue2 sheng1， zhuo2 zhuo2 jue2 ling2。

interpretations.segmentation: 赫赫厥声，濯濯厥灵。
interpretations.explanation: 赫赫其声名，濯濯其威灵。

interpretations.segmentation: Renown resounds; spirit shines bright.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: shou4 kao3 qie3 ning2， yi3 bao3 wo3 hou4 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 寿考且宁，以保我后生。
interpretations.explanation: 寿考且安宁，以保我后世子孙。

interpretations.segmentation: Long life and peace—to guard our later generations.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: zhi4 bi3 jing3 shan1， song1 bo2 wan2 wan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 陟彼景山，松伯丸丸。
interpretations.explanation: 登上景山，松树柏树丸丸齐整。

interpretations.segmentation: We climb Jing Mountain; pines and cypresses stand round and tall.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: shi4 duan4 shi4 qian1， fang1 zhuo2 shi4 qian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是断是迁，方斫是虔。
interpretations.explanation: 斫断迁运，方斫虔敬。

interpretations.segmentation: Felling and moving them— square-hewing with devotion.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.content: 松桷有梴，旅楹有闲，寝成孔安。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu.pinyin: song1 jue2 you3 chan1， lv3 ying2 you3 xian2， qin3 cheng2 kong3 an1。

interpretations.segmentation: 松桷有梴，旅楹有闲，寝成孔安。
interpretations.explanation: 松作椽条长，旅楹有闲，寝庙成而甚安。

interpretations.segmentation: Pine rafters long, pillars in rows with space— the temple hall stands secure.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.pinyin: jie1 jie1 chen2 gong1， jing4 er3 zai4 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 嗟嗟臣工，敬尔在公。
interpretations.explanation: 啊，各位臣工，敬慎地在公门办事。

interpretations.segmentation: O ministers all, be reverent in public service.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.pinyin: wang2 li2 er3 cheng2， lai2 zi1 lai2 ru2。

interpretations.segmentation: 王厘尔成，来咨来茹。
interpretations.explanation: 王赞美你们的成就，来咨询、来采纳意见。

interpretations.segmentation: The king praises your work— come counsel and advise.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.content: 嗟嗟保介，维莫之春，亦又何求？
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.pinyin: jie1 jie1 bao3 jie4， wei2 mo4 zhi1 chun1， yi4 you4 he2 qiu2？

interpretations.segmentation: 嗟嗟保介，维莫之春，亦又何求？
interpretations.explanation: 啊，各位田官，正是暮春时节，还求什么？

interpretations.segmentation: O field officers, it is late spring— what more do you seek?
如何新畲？
interpretations.explanation: 新垦的田地怎样？

interpretations.segmentation: How fare the newly broken fields?

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.pinyin: yu2 huang2 lai2 mou2， jiang1 shou4 jue2 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 于皇来牟，将受厥明。
interpretations.explanation: 美哉来牟，将受明赐。

interpretations.segmentation: Fine is the wheat and barley— it will receive bright bounty.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.pinyin: ming2 zhao1 shang4 di4， qi4 yong4 kang1 nian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 明昭上帝，迄用康年。
interpretations.explanation: 光明昭告上帝，终得康年。

interpretations.segmentation: Brightly tell God above— at last a year of plenty.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.content: 命我众人：庤乃钱镈，奄观铚艾。
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.pinyin: ming4 wo3 zhong4 ren2： zhi4 nai3 qian2 bo2， yan3 guan1 zhi4 ai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 命我众人：庤乃钱镈，奄观铚艾。
interpretations.explanation: 命我众人：修治钱镈，尽观铚艾之获。

interpretations.segmentation: He charges us all: ready the sickles and reaping hooks, and watch the harvest.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-fengnia.content: 丰年多黍多稌，亦有高廪，万亿及秭。
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-fengnia.pinyin: feng1 nian2 duo1 shu3 duo1 tu2， yi4 you3 gao1 lin3， wan4 yi4 ji2 zi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 丰年多黍多稌，亦有高廪，万亿及秭。
interpretations.explanation: 丰年多黍多稌，也有高仓，积至万亿秭。

interpretations.segmentation: In a rich year, millet and glutinous grain abound; granaries rise high— stores to trillions.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-fengnia.pinyin: wei4 jiu3 wei4 li3， zheng1 bi4 zu3 bi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 为酒为醴，烝畀祖妣。
interpretations.explanation: 酿酒制醴，进献祖先。

interpretations.segmentation: Brew wine and sweet liquor to offer forebears.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-fengnia.pinyin: yi3 qia4 bai3 li3， jiang4 fu2 kong3 jie1。

interpretations.segmentation: 以洽百礼，降福孔皆。
interpretations.explanation: 以洽百礼，降福非常普遍。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus all rites are fulfilled; blessings descend abundantly.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-qian.pinyin: yi1 yu3 qi1 ju3， qian2 you3 duo1 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 猗与漆沮，潜有多鱼。
interpretations.explanation: 美好啊漆沮之水，潜藏许多鱼。

interpretations.segmentation: How fine are Qi and Ju— many fish hide in their depths.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-qian.pinyin: you3 zhan1 you3 wei3， tiao2 chang2 yan3 li3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有鳣有鲔，鲦鲿鰋鲤。
interpretations.explanation: 有鳣有鲔，还有鲦、鲿、鰋、鲤。

interpretations.segmentation: Sturgeon and great carp, plus minnow, catfish, loach, and carp.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-qian.pinyin: yi3 xiang3 yi3 si4， yi3 jie4 jing3 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 以享以祀，以介景福。
interpretations.explanation: 用以享祭，以介大福。

interpretations.segmentation: For feast and sacrifice—to gain great blessing.
于皇武王！
interpretations.explanation: 伟大啊武王！

interpretations.segmentation: Great is King Wu!
无竞维烈。
interpretations.explanation: 无人可与之争烈。

interpretations.segmentation: None can rival his blazing merit.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-wu.pinyin: yun3 wen2 wen2 wang2， ke4 kai1 jue2 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 允文文王，克开厥后。
interpretations.explanation: 确实文德之王文王，能开其后嗣。

interpretations.segmentation: Truly cultured King Wen opened the way for those after.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-wu.content: 嗣武受之，胜殷遏刘，耆定尔功。
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-wu.pinyin: si4 wu3 shou4 zhi1， sheng4 yin1 e4 liu2， qi2 ding4 er3 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 嗣武受之，胜殷遏刘，耆定尔功。
interpretations.explanation: 嗣武王承受之，胜殷遏杀，耆定其功。

interpretations.segmentation: Successor Wu received it— conquered Yin, checked slaughter, settled his achievement in old age.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yixi.pinyin: yi1 xi1 cheng2 wang2， ji4 zhao1 jia3 er3。

interpretations.segmentation: 噫嘻成王，既昭假尔。
interpretations.explanation: 啊成王，既已明告上天。

interpretations.segmentation: O King Cheng, you have clearly prayed to Heaven.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yixi.pinyin: lv4 shi2 nong2 fu1， bo1 jue2 bai3 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 率时农夫，播厥百谷。
interpretations.explanation: 率领此时农夫，播种种类百谷。

interpretations.segmentation: Lead the farmers now to sow every kind of grain.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yixi.pinyin: jun4 fa1 er3 si1， zhong1 san1 shi2 li3。

interpretations.segmentation: 骏发尔私，终三十里。
interpretations.explanation: 迅速发私田，终行三十里。

interpretations.segmentation: Quickly open private plots— thirty li they go.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yixi.pinyin: yi4 fu2 er3 geng1， shi2 qian1 wei2 ou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 亦服尔耕，十千维耦。
interpretations.explanation: 也服事公田，十千耦耕。

interpretations.segmentation: They also work the lord's field— ten thousand pairs plow together.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yong.pinyin: you3 lai2 yong1 yong1， zhi4 zhi3 su4 su4。

interpretations.segmentation: 有来雝雝，至止肃肃。
interpretations.explanation: 来者雍雍，到达时肃肃。

interpretations.segmentation: Guests come in harmony; on arrival all is solemn.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yong.pinyin: xiang1 wei2 pi4 gong1， tian1 zi mu4 mu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 相维辟公，天子穆穆。
interpretations.explanation: 助祭的是诸侯，天子穆穆庄重。

interpretations.segmentation: The feudal lords assist; the Son of Heaven is grave and dignified.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yong.pinyin: yu2 jian4 guang3 mu3， xiang1 yu3 si4 si4。

interpretations.segmentation: 于荐广牡，相予四祀。
interpretations.explanation: 进献大公牛，助我四时之祭。

interpretations.segmentation: They offer great bulls to aid my four-season rites.
假哉皇考！
interpretations.explanation: 美哉皇考！

interpretations.segmentation: How glorious is my late father!
绥予孝子。
interpretations.explanation: 安我孝子之心。

interpretations.segmentation: Give peace to me, his filial son.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yong.pinyin: xuan1 zhe2 wei2 ren2， wen2 wu3 wei2 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 宣哲维人，文武维后。
interpretations.explanation: 宣明哲之人，文武之后。

interpretations.segmentation: Clear and wise are the men— heirs of Wen and Wu.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yong.pinyin: yan4 ji2 huang2 tian1， ke4 chang1 jue2 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 燕及皇天，克昌厥后。
interpretations.explanation: 燕及皇天，克昌其后。

interpretations.segmentation: Reaching to great Heaven— may their line flourish.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yong.content: 绥我眉寿，介以繁祉，既右烈考，亦右文母。
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yong.pinyin: sui2 wo3 mei2 shou4， jie4 yi3 fan2 zhi3， ji4 you4 lie4 kao3， yi4 you4 wen2 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 绥我眉寿，介以繁祉，既右烈考，亦右文母。
interpretations.explanation: 安我长寿，介以多福，既右烈考，亦右文母。

interpretations.segmentation: Grant long life, bestow rich blessing— honor fierce father and cultured mother.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yougu.pinyin: you3 gu3 you3 gu3， zai4 zhou1 zhi1 ting2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有瞽有瞽，在周之庭。
interpretations.explanation: 有瞽者有瞽，在周之庭。

interpretations.segmentation: Blind musicians, blind musicians—in Zhou's courtyard.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yougu.pinyin: she4 ye4 she4 ju4， chong2 ya2 shu4 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 设业设虡，崇牙树羽。
interpretations.explanation: 设钟架设虡，崇牙树羽。

interpretations.segmentation: Set the bell frames and stands, lofty teeth and feather plumes.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yougu.pinyin: ying1 tian2 xian4 gu3， tao2 qing4 chu4 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 应田县鼓，鞉磬柷圉。
interpretations.explanation: 应田悬鼓，鞉磬柷圉。

interpretations.segmentation: Responding drums and suspended drums, hand-drums, chimes, grain-scraper, and tiger-chime.
既备
interpretations.explanation: 既已齐备。

interpretations.segmentation: All is now complete.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yougu.pinyin: nai3 zou4， xiao1 guan3 bei4 ju3。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃奏，箫管备举。
interpretations.explanation: 于是奏乐，箫管一齐响起。

interpretations.segmentation: Then they play— flutes and pipes all rise together.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yougu.content: 喤喤厥声，肃雍和鸣，先祖是听。
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yougu.pinyin: huang2 huang2 jue2 sheng1， su4 yong1 he2 ming2， xian1 zu3 shi4 ting1。

interpretations.segmentation: 喤喤厥声，肃雍和鸣，先祖是听。
interpretations.explanation: 喤喤其声，肃雍和鸣，先祖来听。

interpretations.segmentation: Sound resounds; solemn harmony rings— ancestors listen.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yougu.pinyin: wo3 ke4 li4 zhi3， yong3 guan1 jue2 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我客戾止，永观厥成。
interpretations.explanation: 我客至此，永观此成礼。

interpretations.segmentation: Our guests have come—to forever behold this completed rite.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-youke.pinyin: you3 ke4 you3 ke4， yi4 bai2 qi2 ma3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有客有客，亦白其马。
interpretations.explanation: 有客有客，马也洁白。

interpretations.segmentation: Guests arrive— their horses are white.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-youke.pinyin: you3 qi1 you3 qie3， dun1 zuo2 qi2 lv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有萋有且，敦琢其旅。
interpretations.explanation: 随从茂盛且多，雕琢其行列。

interpretations.segmentation: Attendants lush and many— their ranks refined.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-youke.pinyin: you3 ke4 su4 su4， you3 ke4 xin4 xin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 有客宿宿，有客信信。
interpretations.explanation: 有客久留，有客长住。

interpretations.segmentation: Some guests stay long; some lodge many nights.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-youke.pinyin: yan2 shou4 zhi1 zhi2， yi3 zhi2 qi2 ma3。

interpretations.segmentation: 言授之絷，以絷其马。
interpretations.explanation: 于是授之绊索，以拴其马。

interpretations.segmentation: We give them tether ropes to tie their horses.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-youke.pinyin: bao2 yan2 zhui1 zhi1， zuo3 you4 sui2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 薄言追之，左右绥之。
interpretations.explanation: 薄言追之，左右绥之。

interpretations.segmentation: We go to see them off; attendants ease them on either side.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-youke.pinyin: ji4 you3 yin2 wei1， jiang4 fu2 kong3 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既有淫威，降福孔夷。
interpretations.explanation: 既有大威，降福非常平易。

interpretations.segmentation: Great is their majesty— blessings descend in ample ease.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zaijian.pinyin: zai4 jian4 pi4 wang2， yue1 qiu2 jue2 zhang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 载见辟王，曰求厥章。
interpretations.explanation: 初次见诸侯王，说求其章服。

interpretations.segmentation: First meeting the feudal king— seeking his regalia.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zaijian.pinyin: long2 qi2 yang2 yang2， he2 ling2 yang1 yang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 龙旂阳阳，和铃央央。
interpretations.explanation: 龙旗阳阳，和铃央央。

interpretations.segmentation: Dragon banners gleam; harmony bells ring clear.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zaijian.pinyin: tiao2 ge2 you3 cang1， xiu1 you3 lie4 guang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鞗革有鸧，休有烈光。
interpretations.explanation: 鞗革有鸧色，美有烈光。

interpretations.segmentation: Leather traces bear azure; beauty shines with fiery light.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zaijian.pinyin: lv4 jian4 zhao1 kao3， yi3 xiao4 yi3 xiang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 率见昭考，以孝以享。
interpretations.explanation: 率见昭考，以孝以享。

interpretations.segmentation: Lead to bright father— with filial piety we sacrifice.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zaijian.content: 以介眉寿，永言保之，思皇多祜。
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zaijian.pinyin: yi3 jie4 mei2 shou4， yong3 yan2 bao3 zhi1， si1 huang2 duo1 hu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 以介眉寿，永言保之，思皇多祜。
interpretations.explanation: 以介眉寿，永言保之，思皇多祜。

interpretations.segmentation: Grant long life, ever keep it— think of Heaven's many blessings.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zaijian.content: 烈文辟公，绥以多福，俾缉熙于纯嘏。
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zaijian.pinyin: lie4 wen2 pi4 gong1， sui2 yi3 duo1 fu2， bi3 ji1 xi1 yu2 chun2 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 烈文辟公，绥以多福，俾缉熙于纯嘏。
interpretations.explanation: 烈文诸侯，绥以多福，俾缉熙于纯嘏。

interpretations.segmentation: Illustrious lords— peace with much fortune, that they may gather pure blessing.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zhenlu.pinyin: zhen4 lu4 yu2 fei1， yu2 bi3 xi1 yong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 振鹭于飞，于彼西雍。
interpretations.explanation: 白鹭振翅而飞，于彼西雍。

interpretations.segmentation: White egrets flutter in flight— there at Western Yong.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zhenlu.pinyin: wo3 ke4 li4 zhi3， yi4 you3 si1 rong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我客戾止，亦有斯容。
interpretations.explanation: 我客至此，也有此仪容。

interpretations.segmentation: Our guests have come—with the same dignified bearing.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zhenlu.pinyin: zai4 bi3 wu2 e4， zai4 ci3 wu2 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 在彼无恶，在此无斁。
interpretations.explanation: 在彼无恶，在此无斁。

interpretations.segmentation: None hate them there; none tire of them here.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zhenlu.pinyin: shu4 ji3 su4 ye4， yi3 yong3 zhong1 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 庶几夙夜，以永终誉。
interpretations.explanation: 庶几夙夜，以永终誉。

interpretations.segmentation: May they rise early and sleep late—to keep honor to the end.
于皇时周！
interpretations.explanation: 伟大啊此时周！

interpretations.segmentation: Great is Zhou in this age!

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-ban.content: 陟其高山，嶞山乔岳，允犹翕河。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-ban.pinyin: zhi4 qi2 gao1 shan1， duo4 shan1 qiao2 yue4， yun3 you2 xi1 he2。

interpretations.segmentation: 陟其高山，嶞山乔岳，允犹翕河。
interpretations.explanation: 登其高山，嶞山乔岳，确实犹似黄河。

interpretations.segmentation: We climb high mountains— steep peaks and lofty ranges, truly like the great River.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-ban.pinyin: fu1 tian1 zhi1 xia4， pou2 shi2 zhi1 dui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 敷天之下，裒时之对。
interpretations.explanation: 遍天之下，聚此时之对答。

interpretations.segmentation: Under all Heaven— gather this time's responses.
时周之命。
interpretations.explanation: 此时周之天命。

interpretations.segmentation: This is Zhou's mandate now.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-fang.pinyin: fang3 yu3 luo4 zhi3， lv4 shi2 zhao1 kao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 访予落止，率时昭考。
interpretations.explanation: 访我落止，率时昭考。

interpretations.segmentation: I consult at my accession— following bright father of old.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-fang.pinyin: yu2 hu1 you1 zai1， zhen4 wei4 you3 ai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 于乎悠哉，朕未有艾。
interpretations.explanation: 呜呼悠远啊，我尚未有定见。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, how far it stretches—I have not yet found my way.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-fang.pinyin: jiang1 yu3 jiu4 zhi1， ji4 you2 pan4 huan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 将予就之，继犹判涣。
interpretations.explanation: 将我就之，继犹判涣。

interpretations.segmentation: I would approach it— the legacy still seems scattered.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-fang.pinyin: wei2 yu3 xiao3 zi， wei4 kan1 jia1 duo1 nan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 维予小子，未堪家多难。
interpretations.explanation: 维我小子，未堪家多难。

interpretations.segmentation: I, a young king, am not yet equal to the house's many troubles.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-fang.pinyin: shao4 ting2 shang4 xia4， zhi4 jiang4 jue2 jia1。

interpretations.segmentation: 绍庭上下，陟降厥家。
interpretations.explanation: 绍庭上下，陟降厥家。

interpretations.segmentation: Continue the court above and below— ascend and descend in the house.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-fang.pinyin: xiu1 yi3 huang2 kao3， yi3 bao3 ming2 qi2 shen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 休矣皇考，以保明其身。
interpretations.explanation: 美哉皇考，以保明其身。

interpretations.segmentation: Blessed was bright father— he kept himself clear and safe.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-huan.pinyin: sui2 wan4 bang1， lv3 feng1 nian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 绥万邦，屡丰年。
interpretations.explanation: 安抚万邦，屡得丰年。

interpretations.segmentation: Pacify ten thousand states— again and again, rich harvest years.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-huan.pinyin: tian1 ming4 fei3 jie3， huan2 huan2 wu3 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天命匪解，桓桓武王。
interpretations.explanation: 天命不解，桓桓武王。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven's charge unbroken— bold, bold King Wu.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-huan.content: 保有厥士，于以四方，克定厥家。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-huan.pinyin: bao3 you3 jue2 shi4， yu2 yi3 si4 fang1， ke4 ding4 jue2 jia1。

interpretations.segmentation: 保有厥士，于以四方，克定厥家。
interpretations.explanation: 保有其士众，于以四方，克定厥家。

interpretations.segmentation: He kept his warriors— to the four quarters, and settled his house.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-huan.pinyin: yu2 zhao1 yu2 tian1， huang2 yi3 jian1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 于昭于天，皇以间之。
interpretations.explanation: 昭明于天，皇以间之。

interpretations.segmentation: Bright before Heaven— the sovereign mediates between.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.content: 敬之敬之，天维显思，命不易哉。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.pinyin: jing4 zhi1 jing4 zhi1， tian1 wei2 xian3 si1， ming4 bu4 yi4 zai1。

interpretations.segmentation: 敬之敬之，天维显思，命不易哉。
interpretations.explanation: 敬之又敬，天维显思，命不易哉。

interpretations.segmentation: Be reverent, ever reverent— Heaven sees clearly; the charge is not easy.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.content: 无曰高高在上，陟降厥士，日监在兹。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.pinyin: wu2 yue1 gao1 gao1 zai4 shang4， zhi4 jiang4 jue2 shi4， ri4 jian1 zai4 zi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无曰高高在上，陟降厥士，日监在兹。
interpretations.explanation: 勿说高高在上，陟降厥士，日监在兹。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not say 'I sit on high'— Heaven rises and descends among the people, watching daily here.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.pinyin: wei2 yu3 xiao3 zi， bu4 cong1 jing4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 维予小子，不聪敬止。
interpretations.explanation: 维我小子，不聪敬止。

interpretations.segmentation: I, the young king, am not yet wise enough in reverence.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.content: 日就月将，学有缉熙于光明。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.pinyin: ri4 jiu4 yue4 jiang1， xue2 you3 ji1 xi1 yu2 guang1 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 日就月将，学有缉熙于光明。
interpretations.explanation: 日就月将，学有缉熙于光明。

interpretations.segmentation: Day by day, month by month— learning gathers toward the light.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.pinyin: fu2 shi2 zai3 jian1， shi4 wo3 xian3 de2 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 佛时仔肩，示我显德行。
interpretations.explanation: 佛时仔肩，示我显德行。

interpretations.segmentation: Help me bear the burden— show me bright virtue to follow.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lai.pinyin: wen2 wang2 ji4 qin2 zhi3， wo3 ying1 shou4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王既勤止，我应受之。
interpretations.explanation: 文王既勤止，我应受之。

interpretations.segmentation: King Wen toiled to the end—I should receive his legacy.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lai.pinyin: fu1 shi2 yi4 si1， wo3 cu2 wei2 qiu2 ding4。

interpretations.segmentation: 敷时绎思，我徂维求定。
interpretations.explanation: 敷时绎思，我徂维求定。

interpretations.segmentation: Spread thought through the times—I go only to seek stability.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lai.pinyin: shi2 zhou1 zhi1 ming4， yu2 yi4 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 时周之命，于绎思。
interpretations.explanation: 时周之命，于绎思。

interpretations.segmentation: This is Zhou's charge— ever to be pondered.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.pinyin: ce4 ce4 liang2 si4， chu4 zai4 nan2 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 畟畟良耜，俶载南亩。
interpretations.explanation: 畟畟良耜，始载南亩。

interpretations.segmentation: Sharp is the good plough— first turned in the southern field.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.pinyin: bo1 jue2 bai3 gu3， shi2 han2 si1 huo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 播厥百谷，实函斯活。
interpretations.explanation: 播种种类百谷，实涵斯活。

interpretations.segmentation: Sow every grain— seeds swell and live.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.content: 或来瞻女，载筐及莒，其饟伊黍。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.pinyin: huo4 lai2 zhan1 nv3， zai4 kuang1 ji2 ju3， qi2 xiang3 yi1 shu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 或来瞻女，载筐及莒，其饟伊黍。
interpretations.explanation: 或来瞻女，载筐及筥，其饷伊黍。

interpretations.segmentation: Some come to watch you— baskets and tubs bring millet for refreshment.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.content: 其笠伊纠，其镈斯赵，以薅荼蓼。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.pinyin: qi2 li4 yi1 jiu1， qi2 bo2 si1 zhao4， yi3 hao1 tu2 liao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 其笠伊纠，其镈斯赵，以薅荼蓼。
interpretations.explanation: 其笠伊纠，其镈斯赵，以薅荼蓼。

interpretations.segmentation: Bamboo hats tight, hoes flash— to weed out thorn and smartweed.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.pinyin: tu2 liao3 xiu3 zhi3， shu3 ji4 mao4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 荼蓼朽止，黍稷茂止。
interpretations.explanation: 荼蓼朽烂，黍稷茂盛。

interpretations.segmentation: Weeds rot away; millet and panic grass thrive.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.pinyin: huo4 zhi1 zhi4 zhi4， ji1 zhi1 li4 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 获之挃挃，积之栗栗。
interpretations.explanation: 收获挃挃，积之栗栗。

interpretations.segmentation: Harvest cut clean; stacks piled tight.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.pinyin: qi2 chong2 ru2 yong1， qi2 bi3 ru2 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 其崇如墉，其比如栉。
interpretations.explanation: 其高如墙，其密如栉。

interpretations.segmentation: As high as a wall, as close as comb teeth.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.content: 以开百室，百室盈止，妇子宁止。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.pinyin: yi3 kai1 bai3 shi4， bai3 shi4 ying2 zhi3， fu4 zi ning2 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 以开百室，百室盈止，妇子宁止。
interpretations.explanation: 以开百室，百室盈止，妇子宁止。

interpretations.segmentation: Open a hundred rooms—all full; wives and children rest in peace.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.pinyin: sha1 shi2 chun2 mu3， you3 jiu4 qi2 jiao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 杀时犉牡，有捄其角。
interpretations.explanation: 杀此时犉牡，有救其角。

interpretations.segmentation: Slaughter this season's bull— its horns curved for ritual.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.pinyin: yi3 shi4 yi3 xu4， xu4 gu3 zhi1 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 以似以续，续古之人。
interpretations.explanation: 以似以续，续古之人。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus we continue the rites— following the ancients.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-miny.content: 闵予小子，遭家不造，嬛嬛在疚。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-miny.pinyin: min3 yu3 xiao3 zi， zao1 jia1 bu4 zao4， huan2 huan2 zai4 jiu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 闵予小子，遭家不造，嬛嬛在疚。
interpretations.explanation: 悯我小子，遭家不造，孤独在忧病。

interpretations.segmentation: Pity me, young king— the house meets ill fortune; alone in grief and care.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-miny.pinyin: yu2 hu1 huang2 kao3， yong3 shi4 ke4 xiao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 于乎皇考，永世克孝。
interpretations.explanation: 呜呼皇考，永世克孝。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, bright father— forever able in filial piety.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-miny.pinyin: nian4 zi1 huang2 zu3， zhi4 jiang4 ting2 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 念兹皇祖，陟降庭止。
interpretations.explanation: 念此皇祖，陟降庭止。

interpretations.segmentation: Think on this grand ancestor— ascending and descending in the hall.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-miny.pinyin: wei2 yu3 xiao3 zi， su4 ye4 jing4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 维予小子，夙夜敬止。
interpretations.explanation: 维我小子，夙夜敬止。

interpretations.segmentation: I, the young king— early and late I am reverent.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-miny.pinyin: yu2 hu1 huang2 wang2， ji4 xu4 si1 bu4 wang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 于乎皇王，继序思不忘。
interpretations.explanation: 呜呼皇王，继序思不忘。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, royal king— continue the order; never forget.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-siyi.pinyin: si1 yi1 qi2 fou2， zai4 bian4 qiu2 qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 丝衣其紑，载弁俅俅。
interpretations.explanation: 丝衣其紑，载弁俅俅。

interpretations.segmentation: Silken robes dark red; caps worn with grace.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-siyi.content: 自堂徂基，自羊徂牛，鼐鼎及鼒，兕觥其觩。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-siyi.pinyin: zi4 tang2 cu2 ji1， zi4 yang2 cu2 niu2， nai4 ding3 ji2 zi1， si4 gong1 qi2 qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 自堂徂基，自羊徂牛，鼐鼎及鼒，兕觥其觩。
interpretations.explanation: 自堂徂基，自羊徂牛，鼐鼎及鼒，兕觥其觩。

interpretations.segmentation: From hall to altar, sheep to ox— great and small cauldrons, rhinoceros horns curved.
旨酒思柔。
interpretations.explanation: 旨酒思柔。

interpretations.segmentation: Fine wine, mild and smooth.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-siyi.pinyin: bu4 wu2 bu4 ao2， hu2 kao3 zhi1 xiu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不吴不敖，胡考之休。
interpretations.explanation: 不喧哗不傲慢，长寿之福。

interpretations.segmentation: Neither noisy nor proud—the blessing of long life.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-xiao.pinyin: yu3 qi2 cheng2， er2 bi4 hou4 huan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 予其惩，而毖后患。
interpretations.explanation: 我要警戒，而防后患。

interpretations.segmentation: I will take warning and guard against later harm.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-xiao.pinyin: mo4 yu3 ping2 feng1， zi4 qiu2 xin1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 莫予荓蜂，自求辛螫。
interpretations.explanation: 莫予荓蜂，自求辛螫。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not make me a bristling bee— you seek bitter stings yourselves.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-xiao.pinyin: zhao4 yun3 bi3 tao2 chong2， pan4 fei1 wei2 niao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 肇允彼桃虫，拚飞维鸟。
interpretations.explanation: 始信彼桃虫，拚飞维鸟。

interpretations.segmentation: At first trust that peach worm—it flaps wings and becomes a bird.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-xiao.content: 未堪家多难，予又集于蓼。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-xiao.pinyin: wei4 kan1 jia1 duo1 nan2， yu3 you4 ji2 yu2 liao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 未堪家多难，予又集于蓼。
interpretations.explanation: 未堪家多难，予又集于蓼。

interpretations.segmentation: Not yet equal to the house's troubles—I am plunged again into hardship.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.pinyin: zai4 shan1 zai4 zha4， qi2 geng1 ze2 ze2。

interpretations.segmentation: 载芟载柞，其耕泽泽。
interpretations.explanation: 除草伐木，其耕泽泽。

interpretations.segmentation: Weed and fell trees—the plowing moist and fine.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.pinyin: qian1 ou3 qi2 yun2， cu2 xi2 cu2 zhen3。

interpretations.segmentation: 千耦其耘，徂隰徂畛。
interpretations.explanation: 千耦其耘，往湿田往畛。

interpretations.segmentation: A thousand pairs plow— to low fields and to borders.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.content: 侯主侯伯，侯亚侯旅，侯彊侯以。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.pinyin: hou2 zhu3 hou2 bo2， hou2 ya4 hou2 lv3， hou2 jiang4 hou2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 侯主侯伯，侯亚侯旅，侯彊侯以。
interpretations.explanation: 有主有伯，有亚有旅，有强有以。

interpretations.segmentation: Masters and chiefs, deputies and companies, the strong and helpers.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.content: 有嗿其馌，思媚其妇，有依其士。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.pinyin: you3 tan3 qi2 ye4， si1 mei4 qi2 fu4， you3 yi1 qi2 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 有嗿其馌，思媚其妇，有依其士。
interpretations.explanation: 有送其饭，思媚其妇，有依其士。

interpretations.segmentation: Food is brought; wives are gracious; men have their support.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.content: 有略其耜，俶载南亩，播厥百谷。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.pinyin: you3 lve4 qi2 si4， chu4 zai4 nan2 mu3， bo1 jue2 bai3 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有略其耜，俶载南亩，播厥百谷。
interpretations.explanation: 有略其耜，始载南亩，播种种类百谷。

interpretations.segmentation: Sharp ploughshares— first in the south field, sow every grain.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.pinyin: shi2 han2 si1 huo2， yi4 yi4 qi2 da2。

interpretations.segmentation: 实函斯活，驿驿其达。
interpretations.explanation: 实涵斯活，驿驿其达。

interpretations.segmentation: Seeds swell and live; swiftly they sprout.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.content: 有厌其杰，厌厌其苗，绵绵其麃。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.pinyin: you3 yan4 qi2 jie2， yan4 yan4 qi2 miao2， mian2 mian2 qi2 pao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有厌其杰，厌厌其苗，绵绵其麃。
interpretations.explanation: 有厌其杰，厌厌其苗，绵绵其麃。

interpretations.segmentation: Fine are the tallest; lush the shoots; thick the rows.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.content: 载获济济，有实其积，万亿及秭。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.pinyin: zai4 huo4 ji4 ji4， you3 shi2 qi2 ji1， wan4 yi4 ji2 zi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 载获济济，有实其积，万亿及秭。
interpretations.explanation: 收获济济，有实其积，万亿及秭。

interpretations.segmentation: Harvest abundant; stores solid— trillions piled.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.content: 为酒为醴，烝畀祖妣，不洽百礼。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.pinyin: wei4 jiu3 wei4 li3， zheng1 bi4 zu3 bi3， bu4 qia4 bai3 li3。

interpretations.segmentation: 为酒为醴，烝畀祖妣，不洽百礼。
interpretations.explanation: 为酒为醴，进献祖先，以洽百礼。

interpretations.segmentation: Brew wine and liquor— offer ancestors, fulfill every rite.
有飶其香。
interpretations.explanation: 有飶其香。

interpretations.segmentation: Fragrance rises rich.
邦家之光。
interpretations.explanation: 邦家之光。

interpretations.segmentation: Glory to state and clan.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.pinyin: you3 jiao1 qi2 xin1， hu2 kao3 zhi1 ning2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有椒其馨，胡考之宁。
interpretations.explanation: 有椒其馨，长寿安宁。

interpretations.segmentation: Spicy fragrance— long life and peace.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.content: 匪且有且，匪今斯今，振古如兹。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.pinyin: fei3 qie3 you3 qie3， fei3 jin1 si1 jin1， zhen4 gu3 ru2 zi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪且有且，匪今斯今，振古如兹。
interpretations.explanation: 匪且有且，匪今斯今，振古如兹。

interpretations.segmentation: Not only now but always—not only today but forever—as from ancient times.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zhuo.pinyin: yu2 shuo4 wang2 shi1， zun1 yang3 shi2 hui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 于铄王师，遵养时晦。
interpretations.explanation: 威武啊王师，遵养时晦。

interpretations.segmentation: Glorious the royal host— nurturing strength till the hour is dark.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zhuo.pinyin: shi2 chun2 xi1 yi3， shi4 yong4 da4 jie4。

interpretations.segmentation: 时纯熙矣，是用大介。
interpretations.explanation: 时纯熙矣，是用大介。

interpretations.segmentation: Now pure brightness comes— thus great aid is given.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zhuo.pinyin: wo3 long2 shou4 zhi1， jue1 jue1 wang2 zhi1 zao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我龙受之，蹻蹻王之造。
interpretations.explanation: 我龙受之，蹻蹻王之造。

interpretations.segmentation: I, the sovereign, receive it— valiant is the king's achievement.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zhuo.content: 载用有嗣，实维尔公允师。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zhuo.pinyin: zai4 yong4 you3 si4， shi2 wei2 er3 gong1 yun3 shi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 载用有嗣，实维尔公允师。
interpretations.explanation: 载用有嗣，实维尔公允师。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus heirs continue— truly you, lord, are the fair model.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-haotian.pinyin: hao4 tian1 you3 cheng2 ming4， er4 hou4 shou4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 昊天有成命，二后受之。
interpretations.explanation: 昊天有成命，文武二后受之。

interpretations.segmentation: Great Heaven fixed the mandate— the two kings Wen and Wu received it.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-haotian.content: 成王不敢康，夙夜基命宥密。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-haotian.pinyin: cheng2 wang2 bu4 gan3 kang1， su4 ye4 ji1 ming4 you4 mi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 成王不敢康，夙夜基命宥密。
interpretations.explanation: 成王不敢康，夙夜基命宥密。

interpretations.segmentation: King Cheng dares not be at ease— day and night he grounds the charge in reverent care.
于缉熙！
interpretations.explanation: 啊，缉熙！

interpretations.segmentation: Ah— gather toward the light!

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-haotian.pinyin: dan1 jue2 xin1， si4 qi2 jing4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 单厥心，四其靖之。
interpretations.explanation: 尽其心，四方皆安定。

interpretations.segmentation: With all his heart— the four quarters are settled.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-liewen.pinyin: lie4 wen2 pi4 gong1， xi1 zi1 zhi3 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 烈文辟公，锡兹祉福。
interpretations.explanation: 烈文诸侯，赐此祉福。

interpretations.segmentation: Illustrious feudal lords— Heaven grants this blessing.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-liewen.pinyin: hui4 wo3 wu2 jiang1， zi sun1 bao3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 惠我无疆，子孙保之。
interpretations.explanation: 惠我无疆，子孙保之。

interpretations.segmentation: Favor us without end— sons and grandsons keep it.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-liewen.content: 无封靡于尔邦，维王其崇之。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-liewen.pinyin: wu2 feng1 mi2 yu2 er3 bang1， wei2 wang2 qi2 chong2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无封靡于尔邦，维王其崇之。
interpretations.explanation: 无封靡于尔邦，维王其崇之。

interpretations.segmentation: Let no one overreach in your states— the king will honor you.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-liewen.pinyin: nian4 zi1 rong2 gong1， ji4 xu4 qi2 huang2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 念兹戎功，继序其皇之。
interpretations.explanation: 念此戎功，继序其皇之。

interpretations.segmentation: Remember this martial merit— continue the sovereign's line.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-liewen.pinyin: wu2 jing4 wei2 ren2， si4 fang1 qi2 xun4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无竞维人，四方其训之。
interpretations.explanation: 无竞维人，四方其训之。

interpretations.segmentation: Strive not against the people— the four quarters will learn from you.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-liewen.pinyin: bu4 xian3 wei2 de2， bai3 pi4 qi2 xing2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不显维德，百辟其刑之。
interpretations.explanation: 不显维德，百辟其刑之。

interpretations.segmentation: Make not bright your virtue alone— all lords will take it as model.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-liewen.pinyin: yu2 hu1， qian2 wang2 bu4 wang4！

interpretations.segmentation: 于乎，前王不忘！
interpretations.explanation: 呜呼，前王不忘！

interpretations.segmentation: Alas— do not forget the former kings!

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-qingmia.pinyin: yu2 mu4 qing1 miao4， su4 yong1 xian3 xiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 于穆清庙，肃雍显相。
interpretations.explanation: 于穆清庙，肃雍显相。
