interpretations.segmentation: Solemn is the clear temple— reverent harmony, illustrious assistants.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-qingmia.pinyin: ji4 ji4 duo1 shi4， bing3 wen2 zhi1 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 济济多士，秉文之德。
interpretations.explanation: 济济多士，秉文之德。

interpretations.segmentation: Hosts of officers— bearing culture's virtue.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-qingmia.pinyin: dui4 yue4 zai4 tian1， jun4 ben1 zou3 zai4 miao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 对越在天，骏奔走在庙。
interpretations.explanation: 对越在天，骏奔走在庙。

interpretations.segmentation: Facing Heaven above— they swiftly serve in the shrine.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-qingmia.pinyin: bu4 xian3 bu4 cheng2， wu2 she4 yu2 ren2 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不显不承，无射于人斯。
interpretations.explanation: 不显不承，无射于人斯。

interpretations.segmentation: Neither failing to show nor to receive— endless praise for these men.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai.content: 时迈其邦，昊天其子之，实右序有周。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai.pinyin: shi2 mai4 qi2 bang1， hao4 tian1 qi2 zi zhi1， shi2 you4 xu4 you3 zhou1。

interpretations.segmentation: 时迈其邦，昊天其子之，实右序有周。
interpretations.explanation: 时巡其邦，昊天其子之，实右序有周。

interpretations.segmentation: He tours the states in season— Heaven treats him as its child, truly aiding ordered Zhou.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai.pinyin: bao2 yan2 zhen4 zhi1， mo4 bu4 zhen4 die2。

interpretations.segmentation: 薄言震之，莫不震叠。
interpretations.explanation: 薄言震之，莫不震叠。

interpretations.segmentation: When he stirs them, none fail to tremble and submit.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai.content: 怀柔百神，及河乔岳，允王维后。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai.pinyin: huai2 rou2 bai3 shen2， ji2 he2 qiao2 yue4， yun3 wang2 wei2 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 怀柔百神，及河乔岳，允王维后。
interpretations.explanation: 怀柔百神，及河乔岳，允王维后。

interpretations.segmentation: Gentle to all spirits— to the River and lofty peaks— truly the king is Heaven's heir.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai.pinyin: ming2 zhao1 you3 zhou1， shi4 xu4 zai4 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 明昭有周，式序在位。
interpretations.explanation: 明昭有周，式序在位。

interpretations.segmentation: Bright is Zhou— thus order ranks in office.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai.pinyin: zai4 ji2 gan4 ge1， zai4 tuo2 gong1 shi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 载戢干戈，载橐弓矢。
interpretations.explanation: 载戢干戈，载橐弓矢。

interpretations.segmentation: Put away spears and shields; case bows and arrows.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai.content: 我求懿德，四于时夏，允王保之。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai.pinyin: wo3 qiu2 yi4 de2， si4 yu2 shi2 xia4， yun3 wang2 bao3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我求懿德，四于时夏，允王保之。
interpretations.explanation: 我求懿德，四于时夏，允王保之。

interpretations.segmentation: We seek fine virtue— spread through this great realm; the king truly keeps it.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-siwen.pinyin: si1 wen2 hou4 ji4， ke4 pei4 bi3 tian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 思文后稷，克配彼天。
interpretations.explanation: 思文后稷，克配彼天。

interpretations.segmentation: Think on cultured Hou Ji— he could match Heaven.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-siwen.pinyin: li4 wo3 zheng1 min2， mo4 fei1 er3 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 立我烝民，莫菲尔极。
interpretations.explanation: 立我烝民，莫匪尔极。

interpretations.segmentation: He established our people— none beyond your utmost care.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-siwen.content: 贻我来牟，帝命率育，无此疆尔界。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-siwen.pinyin: yi2 wo3 lai2 mou2， di4 ming4 lv4 yu4， wu2 ci3 jiang1 er3 jie4。

interpretations.segmentation: 贻我来牟，帝命率育，无此疆尔界。
interpretations.explanation: 贻我来牟，帝命率育，无此疆尔界。

interpretations.segmentation: He left us wheat and barley— God's charge to nurture all, without this border or that.
陈常于时夏。
interpretations.explanation: 陈常于时夏。

interpretations.segmentation: Set the constant way in this great realm.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-tianzuo.pinyin: tian1 zuo4 gao1 shan1， da4 wang2 huang1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天作高山，大王荒之。
interpretations.explanation: 天作高山，大王荒之。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven made the high mountains— Great King tamed them.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-tianzuo.pinyin: bi3 zuo4 yi3， wen2 wang2 kang1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼作矣，文王康之。
interpretations.explanation: 彼作矣，文王康之。

interpretations.segmentation: He built there— King Wen made it secure.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-tianzuo.pinyin: bi3 cu2 yi3， qi2 you3 yi2 zhi1 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼徂矣，岐有夷之行。
interpretations.explanation: 彼往矣，岐有夷之行。

interpretations.segmentation: He passed on— at Qi, roads lay smooth and level.
子孙保之。
interpretations.explanation: 子孙保之。

interpretations.segmentation: Sons and grandsons guard it.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-weiqing.pinyin: wei2 qing1 ji1 xi1， wen2 wang2 zhi1 dian3。

interpretations.segmentation: 维清缉熙，文王之典。
interpretations.explanation: 维清缉熙，文王之典。

interpretations.segmentation: Pure gathering toward light— King Wen's rite.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-weiqing.content: 肇禋，迄用有成，维周之祯。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-weiqing.pinyin: zhao4 yin1， qi4 yong4 you3 cheng2， wei2 zhou1 zhi1 zhen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 肇禋，迄用有成，维周之祯。
interpretations.explanation: 肇禋，迄用有成，维周之祯。

interpretations.segmentation: He began the sacrifice— at last success came; Zhou's good omen.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-weitian.pinyin: wei2 tian1 zhi1 ming4， yu2 mu4 bu4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 维天之命，于穆不已。
interpretations.explanation: 维天之命，于穆不已。

interpretations.segmentation: Such is Heaven's charge— solemn, never ceasing.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-weitian.content: 于乎不显，文王之德之纯。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-weitian.pinyin: yu2 hu1 bu4 xian3， wen2 wang2 zhi1 de2 zhi1 chun2。

interpretations.segmentation: 于乎不显，文王之德之纯。
interpretations.explanation: 呜呼不显，文王之德之纯。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas how glorious— King Wen's virtue wholly pure.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-weitian.pinyin: jia3 yi3 yi4 wo3， wo3 qi2 shou1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 假以溢我，我其收之。
interpretations.explanation: 假以溢我，我其收之。

interpretations.segmentation: Grant overflow to us—we shall receive it.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-weitian.pinyin: jun4 hui4 wo3 wen2 wang2， ceng2 sun1 du3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 骏惠我文王，曾孙笃之。
interpretations.explanation: 骏惠我文王，曾孙笃之。

interpretations.segmentation: Greatly favor our King Wen— his great-grandson holds it firm.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-wojiang.content: 我将我享，维羊维牛，维天其右之。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-wojiang.pinyin: wo3 jiang1 wo3 xiang3， wei2 yang2 wei2 niu2， wei2 tian1 qi2 you4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我将我享，维羊维牛，维天其右之。
interpretations.explanation: 我将我享，维羊维牛，维天其右之。

interpretations.segmentation: I bring, I sacrifice— sheep and oxen— may Heaven assist.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-wojiang.content: 仪式刑文王之典，日靖四方。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-wojiang.pinyin: yi2 shi4 xing2 wen2 wang2 zhi1 dian3， ri4 jing4 si4 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 仪式刑文王之典，日靖四方。
interpretations.explanation: 仪式刑文王之典，日靖四方。

interpretations.segmentation: In form and rule, King Wen's rite— daily pacify the four quarters.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-wojiang.pinyin: yi1 gu3 wen2 wang2， ji4 you4 xiang3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 伊嘏文王，既右飨之。
interpretations.explanation: 伊嘏文王，既右飨之。

interpretations.segmentation: Ah, blessed Wen— already honored at the feast.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-wojiang.content: 我其夙夜，畏天之威，于时保之。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-wojiang.pinyin: wo3 qi2 su4 ye4， wei4 tian1 zhi1 wei1， yu2 shi2 bao3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我其夙夜，畏天之威，于时保之。
interpretations.explanation: 我其夙夜，畏天之威，于时保之。

interpretations.segmentation: Early and late I fear Heaven's majesty— thus I keep the charge.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-zhijing.pinyin: zhi2 jing4 wu3 wang2， wu2 jing4 wei2 lie4。

interpretations.segmentation: 执竞武王，无竞维烈。
interpretations.explanation: 执竞武王，无竞维烈。

interpretations.segmentation: Strive on, King Wu— none rival your blazing merit.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-zhijing.pinyin: bu4 xian3 cheng2 kang1， shang4 di4 shi4 huang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 不显成康，上帝是皇。
interpretations.explanation: 不显成康，上帝是皇。

interpretations.segmentation: Glorious Cheng and Kang— they revered God on high.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-zhijing.content: 自彼成康，奄有四方，斤斤其明。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-zhijing.pinyin: zi4 bi3 cheng2 kang1， yan3 you3 si4 fang1， jin1 jin1 qi2 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 自彼成康，奄有四方，斤斤其明。
interpretations.explanation: 自彼成康，奄有四方，斤斤其明。

interpretations.segmentation: From Cheng and Kang on— they held the four quarters, keen and bright.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-zhijing.content: 钟鼓喤喤，磬莞将将，降福穰穰。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-zhijing.pinyin: zhong1 gu3 huang2 huang2， qing4 guan3 jiang1 jiang1， jiang4 fu2 rang2 rang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 钟鼓喤喤，磬莞将将，降福穰穰。
interpretations.explanation: 钟鼓喤喤，磬莞将将，降福穰穰。

interpretations.segmentation: Bells and drums resound; chimes ring clear— blessings pour down rich.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-zhijing.pinyin: jiang4 fu2 jian3 jian3， wei1 yi2 fan3 fan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 降福简简，威仪反反。
interpretations.explanation: 降福简简，威仪反反。

interpretations.segmentation: Blessings come simple and ample; dignity returns again and again.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-zhijing.pinyin: ji4 zui4 ji4 bao3， fu2 lu4 lai2 fan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 既醉既饱，福禄来反。
interpretations.explanation: 既醉既饱，福禄来反。

interpretations.segmentation: Drunk and full— fortune and blessing come back to us.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: he4 he4 ming2 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 赫赫明明。
interpretations.explanation: 周宣王英武威严，声名显赫。

interpretations.segmentation: The king is majestic and resplendent in fame and authority.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.content: 王命卿士，南仲大祖，大师皇父。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: wang2 ming4 qing1 shi4， nan2 zhong4 da4 zu3， da4 shi1 huang2 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 王命卿士，南仲大祖，大师皇父。
interpretations.explanation: 宣王任命卿士南仲、太祖、皇父等重臣。

interpretations.segmentation: The king appoints his ministers Nan Zhong, Da Zu, and Grand Master Huang Fu.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: zheng3 wo3 liu4 shi1， yi3 xiu1 wo3 rong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 整我六师，以修我戎。
interpretations.explanation: 整顿六军，修治兵器，准备出征。

interpretations.segmentation: He musters the six armies and readies the weapons of war.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: ji4 jing4 ji4 jie4， hui4 ci3 nan2 guo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既敬既戒，惠此南国。
interpretations.explanation: 既敬慎又戒备，施恩德于南方诸国。

interpretations.segmentation: With reverence and vigilance, he brings kindness to the southern states.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.content: 王谓尹氏，命程伯休父，左右陈行。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: wang2 wei4 yin3 shi4， ming4 cheng2 bo2 xiu1 fu4， zuo3 you4 chen2 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 王谓尹氏，命程伯休父，左右陈行。
interpretations.explanation: 宣王对尹氏下令，命程伯休父左右排列军队行列。

interpretations.segmentation: The king tells Yin Shi to command Cheng Bo Xiufu to array the ranks on left and right.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.content: 戒我师旅，率彼淮浦，省此徐土。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: jie4 wo3 shi1 lv3， lv4 bi3 huai2 pu3， sheng3 ci3 xu2 tu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 戒我师旅，率彼淮浦，省此徐土。
interpretations.explanation: 告诫军队，沿淮水岸前进，巡视徐国土地。

interpretations.segmentation: He warns the troops to march along the Huai shore and inspect the land of Xu.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: bu4 liu2 bu4 chu4， san1 shi4 jiu4 xu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不留不处，三事就绪。
interpretations.explanation: 不停留、不安居，三公之职各就各位。

interpretations.segmentation: They tarry not nor linger; the three high offices are all in readiness.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: he4 he4 ye4 ye4， you3 yan2 tian1 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 赫赫业业，有严天子。
interpretations.explanation: 威武严肃，天子威仪凛然。

interpretations.segmentation: Grand and awe-inspiring is the stern majesty of the Son of Heaven.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: wang2 shu1 bao3 zuo4， fei3 shao4 fei3 you2。

interpretations.segmentation: 王舒保作，匪绍匪游。
interpretations.explanation: 宣王从容安行，不是迟缓也不是游逸。

interpretations.segmentation: The king moves at ease yet with purpose—not slack nor idle.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: xu2 fang1 yi4 sao1， zhen4 jing1 xu2 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 徐方绎骚，震惊徐方。
interpretations.explanation: 徐方骚动不安，大为震惊。

interpretations.segmentation: The region of Xu is stirred and thrown into great alarm.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: ru2 lei2 ru2 ting2， xu2 fang1 zhen4 jing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 如雷如霆，徐方震惊。
interpretations.explanation: 王师声势如雷如霆，徐方再次震惊。

interpretations.segmentation: Like thunder and lightning the royal host resounds, and Xu is shaken again.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: wang2 fen4 jue2 wu3， ru2 zhen4 ru2 nu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 王奋厥武，如震如怒。
interpretations.explanation: 宣王奋发武勇，如雷霆震怒。

interpretations.segmentation: The king rouses his martial prowess, fierce as thunder in wrath.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: jin4 jue2 hu3 chen2， han3 ru2 xiao1 hu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 进厥虎臣，阚如虓虎。
interpretations.explanation: 派出虎臣猛将，勇猛如咆哮的猛虎。

interpretations.segmentation: He sends forth his tiger-like warriors, bold as roaring tigers.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: pu4 dun1 huai2 fen2， reng2 zhi2 chou3 lu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 铺敦淮濆，仍执丑虏。
interpretations.explanation: 在淮水边大举进击，仍俘获敌酋。

interpretations.segmentation: They press hard upon the Huai banks and still seize the enemy chiefs.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: jie2 bi3 huai2 pu3， wang2 shi1 zhi1 suo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 截彼淮浦，王师之所。
interpretations.explanation: 截断淮水沿岸，正是王师驻扎之处。

interpretations.segmentation: They cut off the Huai shore—there the king's army makes its stand.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: wang2 lv3 chan3 chan3， ru2 fei1 ru2 han4。

interpretations.segmentation: 王旅啴啴，如飞如翰。
interpretations.explanation: 王师行进和缓，却快如飞羽。

interpretations.segmentation: The royal columns move at ease, yet swift as flight or soaring pinions.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: ru2 jiang1 ru2 han4， ru2 shan1 zhi1 bao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 如江如汉，如山之苞。
interpretations.explanation: 浩大如江汉，稳固如山岳。

interpretations.segmentation: Vast as the Yangtze and Han, firm as mountains wrapped in strength.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: ru2 chuan1 zhi1 liu2， mian2 mian2 yi4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 如川之流，绵绵翼翼。
interpretations.explanation: 奔流如江河，绵延而齐整。

interpretations.segmentation: Flowing like rivers in flood, continuous and orderly in array.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: bu4 ce4 bu4 ke4， zhuo2 zheng1 xu2 guo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 不测不克，濯征徐国。
interpretations.explanation: 深不可测、不可抵挡，大举征伐徐国。

interpretations.segmentation: Deep beyond measure and irresistible, they sweep forth to chastise the state of Xu.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: wang2 you2 yun3 sai1， xu2 fang1 ji4 lai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 王犹允塞，徐方既来。
interpretations.explanation: 宣王谋划确实可行，徐方已经前来归附。

interpretations.segmentation: The king's plans are truly fulfilled, and Xu has already come to submit.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: xu2 fang1 ji4 tong2， tian1 zi zhi1 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 徐方既同，天子之功。
interpretations.explanation: 徐方已与周室同心，这是天子的功业。

interpretations.segmentation: Xu is now of one mind with Zhou; this is the Son of Heaven's achievement.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: si4 fang1 ji4 ping2， xu2 fang1 lai2 ting2。

interpretations.segmentation: 四方既平，徐方来庭。
interpretations.explanation: 四方既已平定，徐方来朝见天子。

interpretations.segmentation: When the four quarters are pacified, Xu comes to the royal court.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu.pinyin: xu2 fang1 bu4 hui2， wang2 yue1 hai2 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 徐方不回，王曰还归。
interpretations.explanation: 徐方不敢违逆，宣王下令班师还朝。

interpretations.segmentation: Xu dares not turn away; the king commands the army to return home.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: dang4 dang4 shang4 di4， xia4 min2 zhi1 pi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 荡荡上帝，下民之辟。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝广大无边，是下民的君主。

interpretations.segmentation: Vast is God on high, the ruler and refuge of the people below.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: ji2 wei1 shang4 di4， qi2 ming4 duo1 pi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 疾威上帝，其命多辟。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝疾恶暴虐，其降下的命令多给不法之君。

interpretations.segmentation: God abhors cruel might; his decrees often fall on lawless rulers.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: tian1 sheng1 zheng1 min2， qi2 ming4 fei3 chen2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天生烝民，其命匪谌。
interpretations.explanation: 上天生养众民，给人的命数却未必恒久可信。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven breeds the multitude, yet the fate it assigns is not always steadfast.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: mi2 bu4 you3 chu1， xian1 ke4 you3 zhong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 靡不有初，鲜克有终。
interpretations.explanation: 凡事多能善始，却少有能善终的。

interpretations.segmentation: Nothing lacks a good beginning, but few can bring things to a good end.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: wen2 wang2 yue1 zi1， zi1 ru3 yin1 shang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王曰咨，咨汝殷商。
interpretations.explanation: 文王叹息说：唉，你们殷商啊。

interpretations.segmentation: King Wen sighs and says: Alas, you people of Yin-Shang!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: ceng2 shi4 jiang4 yu4？

interpretations.segmentation: 曾是彊御？
interpretations.explanation: 难道曾不是强暴的抵御者吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Were you not once fierce defenders of your realm?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: ceng2 shi4 pou2 ke4？

interpretations.segmentation: 曾是掊克？
interpretations.explanation: 难道曾不是聚敛搜刮吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Were you not once gatherers who scraped the people dry?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: ceng2 shi4 zai4 wei4？

interpretations.segmentation: 曾是在位？
interpretations.explanation: 难道曾不在高位吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Were you not once seated in high office?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: ceng2 shi4 zai4 fu2？

interpretations.segmentation: 曾是在服？
interpretations.explanation: 难道曾不在服事之列吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Were you not once among those who served the throne?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: tian1 jiang4 tao1 de2， nv3 xing1 shi4 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天降滔德，女兴是力。
interpretations.explanation: 上天降下滔天恶德，你却凭此自恃强力。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven sent down overflowing wickedness, and you rose up by that very force.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: wen2 wang2 yue1 zi1， zi1 nv3 yin1 shang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王曰咨，咨女殷商。
interpretations.explanation: 文王叹息说：唉，你们殷商啊。

interpretations.segmentation: King Wen sighs and says: Alas, you people of Yin-Shang!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: er2 bing3 yi4 lei4， jiang4 yu4 duo1 dui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 而秉义类，彊御多怼。
interpretations.explanation: 你本当秉持道义，强暴之徒却多生怨怼。

interpretations.segmentation: You should have held to righteousness, yet the violent breed much resentment.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: liu2 yan2 yi3 dui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 流言以对。
interpretations.explanation: 用流言蜚语来应对政事。

interpretations.segmentation: You answer affairs with slander and idle rumor.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: kou4 rang3 shi4 nei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 寇攘式内。
interpretations.explanation: 寇盗攘夺之风竟入于朝廷之内。

interpretations.segmentation: Robbery and plunder even enter the inner court.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: hou2 zuo4 hou2 zhu4， mi2 jie4 mi2 jiu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 侯作侯祝，靡届靡究。
interpretations.explanation: 诸侯作威作福、祝祷求福，却无边无际、没有尽头。

interpretations.segmentation: Lords play lord and pray for blessing, yet there is no limit and no end.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: wen2 wang2 yue1 zi1， zi1 nv3 yin1 shang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王曰咨，咨女殷商。
interpretations.explanation: 文王叹息说：唉，你们殷商啊。

interpretations.segmentation: King Wen sighs and says: Alas, you people of Yin-Shang!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: nv3 pao2 xiu1 yu2 zhong1 guo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 女炰烋于中国。
interpretations.explanation: 你在中原大肆烹杀暴虐。

interpretations.segmentation: You boil and burn with cruelty throughout the central lands.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: lian3 yuan4 yi3 wei4 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 敛怨以为德。
interpretations.explanation: 把招来的怨恨当作自己的德政。

interpretations.segmentation: You take gathered hatred and call it your virtue.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: bu4 ming2 er3 de2， shi2 wu2 bei4 wu2 ce4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不明尔德，时无背无侧。
interpretations.explanation: 不明你的德行，朝中没有辅佐与侧近。

interpretations.segmentation: Your virtue is not clear; in court there are no aides at back or side.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: er3 de2 bu4 ming2， yi3 wu2 pei2 wu2 qing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔德不明，以无陪无卿。
interpretations.explanation: 你的德行昏昧，因此没有陪臣、没有卿士。

interpretations.segmentation: Your virtue is dim, so you have no attendants and no ministers of rank.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: wen2 wang2 yue1 zi1， zi1 nv3 yin1 shang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王曰咨，咨女殷商。
interpretations.explanation: 文王叹息说：唉，你们殷商啊。

interpretations.segmentation: King Wen sighs and says: Alas, you people of Yin-Shang!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.content: 天不湎尔以酒，不义从式。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: tian1 bu4 mian3 er3 yi3 jiu3， bu4 yi4 cong2 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天不湎尔以酒，不义从式。
interpretations.explanation: 上天并非让你沉溺于酒，你却从不义之道放纵。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven did not drown you in wine, yet you follow the way of injustice.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: ji4 yan3 er3 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 既衍尔止。
interpretations.explanation: 已经越过了应有的限度。

interpretations.segmentation: You have already overstepped every proper bound.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: mi2 ming2 mi2 hui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 靡明靡晦。
interpretations.explanation: 不分白天黑夜地胡为。

interpretations.segmentation: There is no distinction of bright day or dark night in your deeds.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: shi4 hao4 shi4 hu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 式号式呼。
interpretations.explanation: 大声号呼、狂呼乱叫。

interpretations.segmentation: You shout and cry out without restraint.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: bi3 zhou4 zuo4 ye4。

interpretations.segmentation: 俾昼作夜。
interpretations.explanation: 竟把白天当作黑夜来荒淫作乐。

interpretations.segmentation: You make the day into night for riot and pleasure.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: wen2 wang2 yue1 zi1， zi1 nv3 yin1 shang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王曰咨，咨女殷商。
interpretations.explanation: 文王叹息说：唉，你们殷商啊。

interpretations.segmentation: King Wen sighs and says: Alas, you people of Yin-Shang!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: ru2 tiao2 ru2 tang2， ru2 fei4 ru2 geng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 如蜩如螗，如沸如羹。
interpretations.explanation: 像蝉鸣螗叫般聒噪，像沸水羹汤般翻滚。

interpretations.segmentation: Noisy as cicadas and katydids, seething like boiling broth.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: xiao3 da4 jin4 sang4， ren2 shang4 hu1 you2 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 小大近丧，人尚乎由行。
interpretations.explanation: 大小官职近于丧亡，人们还沿着旧路不改。

interpretations.segmentation: Great and small offices near ruin, yet men still walk the old crooked way.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: nei4 bi4 yu2 zhong1 guo2， tan2 ji2 gui3 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 内奰于中国，覃及鬼方。
interpretations.explanation: 在国内兴妖作乱，祸延及远方鬼方。

interpretations.segmentation: You stir chaos within the realm, and the harm reaches even to distant Gui Fang.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: wen2 wang2 yue1 zi1， zi1 nv3 yin1 shang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王曰咨，咨女殷商。
interpretations.explanation: 文王叹息说：唉，你们殷商啊。

interpretations.segmentation: King Wen sighs and says: Alas, you people of Yin-Shang!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: fei3 shang4 di4 bu4 shi2， yin1 bu4 yong4 jiu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪上帝不时，殷不用旧。
interpretations.explanation: 不是上帝不适时，而是殷商不遵旧法。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not that God is untimely, but that Yin will not use the old ways.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: sui1 wu2 lao3 cheng2 ren2， shang4 you3 dian3 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 虽无老成人，尚有典刑。
interpretations.explanation: 虽然没有老成之人，尚有先王留下的典章法度。

interpretations.segmentation: Though there are no elders of long experience, the statutes and models still remain.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: ceng2 shi4 mo4 ting1， da4 ming4 yi3 qing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 曾是莫听，大命以倾。
interpretations.explanation: 你们竟不肯听从，天命因此倾覆。

interpretations.segmentation: Yet you would not listen, and the great mandate toppled.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: wen2 wang2 yue1 zi1， zi1 nv3 yin1 shang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王曰咨，咨女殷商。
interpretations.explanation: 文王叹息说：唉，你们殷商啊。

interpretations.segmentation: King Wen sighs and says: Alas, you people of Yin-Shang!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: ren2 yi4 you3 yan2： dian1 pei4 zhi1 jie1，

interpretations.segmentation: 人亦有言：颠沛之揭，
interpretations.explanation: 古人也有话说：颠仆时刚被揭起，

interpretations.segmentation: Men also have a saying: when a tree is uprooted and raised,

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: zhi1 ye4 wei4 you3 hai4， ben3 shi2 xian1 bo1。

interpretations.segmentation: 枝叶未有害，本实先拨。
interpretations.explanation: 枝叶尚未受损，根实却已先被拔断。

interpretations.segmentation: the branches and leaves are not yet harmed, but the root and fruit are torn out first.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang.pinyin: yin1 jian4 bu4 yuan3， zai4 xia4 hou4 zhi1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 殷鉴不远，在夏后之世。
interpretations.explanation: 殷商的鉴戒并不遥远，就在夏朝末年的情形。

interpretations.segmentation: Yin's mirror is not far off—it lies in the age after the Xia.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.content: 奕奕梁山，维禹甸之，有倬其道。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: yi4 yi4 liang2 shan1， wei2 yu3 dian1 zhi1， you3 zhuo1 qi2 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 奕奕梁山，维禹甸之，有倬其道。
interpretations.explanation: 高大雄壮的梁山，是大禹所划分的疆域，道路宽阔通达。

interpretations.segmentation: Lofty and grand is Mount Liang, marked out by Yu; its roads are broad and clear.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.content: 韩侯受命，王亲命之：缵戎祖考，无废朕命。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: han2 hou2 shou4 ming4， wang2 qin1 ming4 zhi1： zuan3 rong2 zu3 kao3， wu2 fei4 zhen4 ming4。

interpretations.segmentation: 韩侯受命，王亲命之：缵戎祖考，无废朕命。
interpretations.explanation: 韩侯受天子之命，周王亲自嘱咐：继承你祖上的事业，不要废弃我的命令。

interpretations.segmentation: The Marquis of Han receives the mandate; the king personally charges him: continue your forefathers' work and do not fail my command.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.content: 夙夜匪解，虔共尔位，朕命不易。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: su4 ye4 fei3 jie3， qian2 gong4 er3 wei4， zhen4 ming4 bu4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夙夜匪解，虔共尔位，朕命不易。
interpretations.explanation: 早晚不懈怠，恭敬守其位，王命不可更改。

interpretations.segmentation: From dawn to dusk without slackening, serve your post with reverence—the royal charge must not change.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: can4 bu4 ting2 fang1， yi3 zuo3 rong2 pi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 粲不庭方，以佐戎辟。
interpretations.explanation: 光明磊落地治理四方，以辅佐周王。

interpretations.segmentation: He governs the regions with bright integrity to assist the king.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: si4 mu3 yi4 yi4， kong3 xiu1 qie3 zhang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 四牡奕奕，孔修且张。
interpretations.explanation: 四匹雄马威武，车马装饰华美而张扬。

interpretations.segmentation: The four stallions are stately; the chariot is finely adorned and splendid.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.content: 韩侯入觐，以其介圭，入觐于王。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: han2 hou2 ru4 jin4， yi3 qi2 jie4 gui1， ru4 jin4 yu2 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 韩侯入觐，以其介圭，入觐于王。
interpretations.explanation: 韩侯入朝觐见，手持大圭，向周王行觐见之礼。

interpretations.segmentation: The Marquis of Han enters audience, bearing his great jade tablet to pay homage to the king.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.content: 王锡韩侯，淑旂绥章，簟茀错衡。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: wang2 xi1 han2 hou2， shu1 qi2 sui2 zhang1， dian4 fu2 cuo4 heng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 王锡韩侯，淑旂绥章，簟茀错衡。
interpretations.explanation: 周王赏赐韩侯：绘有图案的旗帜、绥带章饰，以及竹席车蔽和错金的衡木。

interpretations.segmentation: The king bestows on Han: fine banners and insignia, bamboo awning and inlaid chariot yoke.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.content: 玄衮赤舄，钩膺镂锡，鞹鞃浅幭，鞗革金厄。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: xuan2 gun3 chi4 xi4， gou1 ying1 lou4 xi1， kuo4 hong2 qian3 mie4， tiao2 ge2 jin1 e4。

interpretations.segmentation: 玄衮赤舄，钩膺镂锡，鞹鞃浅幭，鞗革金厄。
interpretations.explanation: 玄色礼服、赤色鞋履，马胸饰与镂刻锡饰，皮革护具与浅幭，鞗革金环等全套仪仗。

interpretations.segmentation: Black robe and red shoes, hooked breast-plates and chased tin, leather fittings and shallow covers, thongs and golden rings—all full regalia.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: han2 hou2 chu1 zu3， chu1 su4 yu2 tu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 韩侯出祖，出宿于屠。
interpretations.explanation: 韩侯出京上路，首夜宿于屠地。

interpretations.segmentation: The Marquis of Han sets out on the road and lodges the first night at Tu.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: xian3 fu4 jian4 zhi1， qing1 jiu3 bai3 hu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 显父饯之，清酒百壶。
interpretations.explanation: 显父设宴为他饯行，备清酒百壶。

interpretations.segmentation: Xian Fu holds a farewell feast for him with a hundred jars of clear wine.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: qi2 xiao2 wei2 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 其殽维何？
interpretations.explanation: 所备的肉食是什么？

interpretations.segmentation: What meats are served?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: pao2 bie1 xian1 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 炰鳖鲜鱼。
interpretations.explanation: 是烹煮的大鳖和鲜鱼。

interpretations.segmentation: Stewed turtle and fresh fish.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: qi2 su4 wei2 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 其蔌维何？
interpretations.explanation: 所备的蔬菜是什么？

interpretations.segmentation: What vegetables are there?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: wei2 sun3 ji2 pu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 维笋及蒲。
interpretations.explanation: 是笋和蒲菜。

interpretations.segmentation: Bamboo shoots and cattail shoots.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: qi2 zeng4 wei2 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 其赠维何？
interpretations.explanation: 所赠的礼物是什么？

interpretations.segmentation: What gifts are given?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: cheng2 ma3 lu4 che1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乘马路车。
interpretations.explanation: 是乘马和路车。

interpretations.segmentation: A team of horses and a road chariot.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: bian1 dou4 you3 qie3。

interpretations.segmentation: 笾豆有且。
interpretations.explanation: 笾豆等食器摆列整齐。

interpretations.segmentation: Bowls and dishes are set out in good order.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: hou2 shi4 yan4 xu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 侯氏燕胥。
interpretations.explanation: 诸侯们一同宴饮相乐。

interpretations.segmentation: The lords feast together in mutual joy.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.content: 韩侯取妻，汾王之甥，蹶父之子。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: han2 hou2 qu3 qi1， fen2 wang2 zhi1 sheng1， jue2 fu4 zhi1 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 韩侯取妻，汾王之甥，蹶父之子。
interpretations.explanation: 韩侯迎娶妻子，她是汾王的外甥女、蹶父的女儿。

interpretations.segmentation: The Marquis of Han takes a wife—the niece of the king of Fen and daughter of Jue Fu.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: han2 hou2 ying2 zhi3， yu2 jue2 zhi1 li3。

interpretations.segmentation: 韩侯迎止，于蹶之里。
interpretations.explanation: 韩侯前往迎亲，来到蹶父的乡里。

interpretations.segmentation: The Marquis goes to meet the bride at the hamlet of Jue.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.content: 百两彭彭，八鸾锵锵，不显其光。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: bai3 liang3 peng2 peng2， ba1 luan2 qiang1 qiang1， bu4 xian3 qi2 guang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 百两彭彭，八鸾锵锵，不显其光。
interpretations.explanation: 百辆婚车声势彭彭，八鸾铃声锵锵，光彩显赫。

interpretations.segmentation: A hundred wedding chariots roll mightily; eight bells ring clear—splendor shines forth.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: zhu1 di4 cong2 zhi1， qi2 qi2 ru2 yun2。

interpretations.segmentation: 诸娣从之，祁祁如云。
interpretations.explanation: 众娣女随从而行，仪态美好如云。

interpretations.segmentation: The attendant maidens follow, graceful and numerous as clouds.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: han2 hou2 gu4 zhi1， lan4 qi2 ying2 men2。

interpretations.segmentation: 韩侯顾之，烂其盈门。
interpretations.explanation: 韩侯回头顾看，门庭光彩满溢。

interpretations.segmentation: The Marquis looks back—the courtyard glows with brilliance.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: jue2 fu4 kong3 wu3， mi2 guo2 bu4 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 蹶父孔武，靡国不到。
interpretations.explanation: 蹶父非常勇武，没有到不了的地方。

interpretations.segmentation: Jue Fu is very bold; there is no land he has not reached.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: wei4 han2 ji2 xiang1 you1， mo4 ru2 han2 le4。

interpretations.segmentation: 为韩姞相攸，莫如韩乐。
interpretations.explanation: 为韩姞选择居处，没有比韩国更安乐的。

interpretations.segmentation: Choosing a home for Lady Han Ji, none is happier than the land of Han.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.content: 孔乐韩土，川泽訏訏，鲂鱮甫甫，麀鹿噳噳。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: kong3 le4 han2 tu3， chuan1 ze2 xu1 xu1， fang2 xu4 fu3 fu3， you1 lu4 yu3 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 孔乐韩土，川泽訏訏，鲂鱮甫甫，麀鹿噳噳。
interpretations.explanation: 韩国土地十分安乐，川泽广阔，鲂鱮成群，母鹿呦呦。

interpretations.segmentation: Great joy is the soil of Han—broad marshes and streams, shoals of bream, does calling softly.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: you3 xiong2 you3 pi2， you3 mao1 you3 hu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有熊有罴，有猫有虎。
interpretations.explanation: 有熊有罴，有猫有虎，物产丰饶。

interpretations.segmentation: There are bears and brown bears, lynxes and tigers—rich in game and goods.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: qing4 ji4 ling4 ju1， han2 ji2 yan4 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 庆既令居，韩姞燕誉。
interpretations.explanation: 庆氏既有好居处，韩姞也备受称誉。

interpretations.segmentation: The Qing clan has a fine dwelling; Lady Han Ji wins praise and honor.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: pu3 bi3 han2 cheng2， yan4 shi1 suo3 wan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 溥彼韩城，燕师所完。
interpretations.explanation: 韩城广大，由燕国军队协助修筑完成。

interpretations.segmentation: Wide is the city of Han, completed with aid from Yan's troops.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: yi3 xian1 zu3 shou4 ming4， yin1 shi2 bai3 man2。

interpretations.segmentation: 以先祖受命，因时百蛮。
interpretations.explanation: 因先祖受天命，适时镇抚百蛮。

interpretations.segmentation: Because their ancestors received the mandate, they rule the many barbarian peoples in season.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: wang2 xi1 han2 hou2， qi2 zhui1 qi2 mo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 王锡韩侯，其追其貊。
interpretations.explanation: 周王赐韩侯统辖之追、貊等部。

interpretations.segmentation: The king grants the Marquis of Han authority over the Zhui and Mo peoples.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: yan3 shou4 bei3 guo2， yin1 yi3 qi2 bo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 奄受北国，因以其伯。
interpretations.explanation: 奄有北方国土，因而封为伯。

interpretations.segmentation: He holds the northern realm and is made a regional lord.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: shi2 yong1 shi2 he4， shi2 mu3 shi2 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 实墉实壑，实亩实藉。
interpretations.explanation: 修筑城墙沟壑，整理田亩与税籍。

interpretations.segmentation: He builds walls and moats, and sets fields and tax registers in order.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi.pinyin: xian4 qi2 pi2 pi2， chi4 bao4 huang2 pi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 献其貔皮，赤豹黄罴。
interpretations.explanation: 进献貔皮，以及赤豹、黄罴等珍兽之皮。

interpretations.segmentation: He presents pelts of the pi beast, red leopards, and yellow bears.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: jiang1 han4 fu2 fu2， wu3 fu1 tao1 tao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 江汉浮浮，武夫滔滔。
interpretations.explanation: 江汉水势浩荡，武士众多威武。

interpretations.segmentation: The Jiang and Han roll on; warriors abound in martial splendor.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: fei3 an1 fei3 you2， huai2 yi2 lai2 qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪安匪游，淮夷来求。
interpretations.explanation: 并非安逸游逸，而是淮夷前来请求治理。

interpretations.segmentation: Not for ease or idle roaming—the Huai tribes come seeking rule and order.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: ji4 chu1 wo3 che1， ji4 she4 wo3 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既出我车，既设我旟。
interpretations.explanation: 已经出动战车，已经竖起军旗。

interpretations.segmentation: Our chariots are out; our banners are raised.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: fei3 an1 fei3 shu1， huai2 yi2 lai2 pu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪安匪舒，淮夷来铺。
interpretations.explanation: 并非安逸舒缓，而是淮夷前来归附。

interpretations.segmentation: Not for rest and slackness—the Huai tribes come to submit.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: jiang1 han4 tang1 tang1， wu3 fu1 guang1 guang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 江汉汤汤，武夫洸洸。
interpretations.explanation: 江汉汤汤奔流，武士光明勇武。

interpretations.segmentation: The Jiang and Han surge onward; the warriors shine with courage.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: jing1 ying2 si4 fang1， gao4 cheng2 yu2 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 经营四方，告成于王。
interpretations.explanation: 经营四方事务，向周王报告功业已成。

interpretations.segmentation: They manage the four quarters and report completion to the king.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: si4 fang1 ji4 ping2， wang2 guo2 shu4 ding4。

interpretations.segmentation: 四方既平，王国庶定。
interpretations.explanation: 四方既已平定，王国大致安定。

interpretations.segmentation: When the four sides are pacified, the royal domain is largely settled.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: shi2 mi2 you3 zheng1， wang2 xin1 zai4 ning2。

interpretations.segmentation: 时靡有争，王心载宁。
interpretations.explanation: 当时没有争乱，周王心中因而安宁。

interpretations.segmentation: In that time there was no strife, and the king's heart was at peace.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.content: 江汉之浒，王命召虎：式辟四方，彻我疆土。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: jiang1 han4 zhi1 hu3， wang2 ming4 zhao4 hu3： shi4 pi4 si4 fang1， che4 wo3 jiang1 tu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 江汉之浒，王命召虎：式辟四方，彻我疆土。
interpretations.explanation: 在江汉之滨，周王命令召虎：开辟四方，治理我疆土。

interpretations.segmentation: On the Jiang-Han shore the king commands Hu of Zhao: open the four quarters and govern our borders.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: fei3 jiu4 fei3 ji2， wang2 guo2 lai2 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪疚匪棘，王国来极。
interpretations.explanation: 不是忧患也不是急难，王国来归附至极。

interpretations.segmentation: Neither affliction nor distress—the realm comes to its utmost order.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: yu2 jiang1 yu2 li3， zhi4 yu2 nan2 hai3。

interpretations.segmentation: 于疆于理，至于南海。
interpretations.explanation: 划分疆界、整理田亩，直到南海。

interpretations.segmentation: Demarcating fields and boundaries, even to the Southern Sea.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: wang2 ming4 zhao4 hu3： lai2 xun2 lai2 xuan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 王命召虎：来旬来宣。
interpretations.explanation: 周王命令召虎：按时巡行、宣布王命。

interpretations.segmentation: The king commands Hu of Zhao: come round in season and proclaim the royal will.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: wen2 wu3 shou4 ming4， zhao4 gong1 wei2 han4。

interpretations.segmentation: 文武受命，召公维翰。
interpretations.explanation: 文武受天命，召公是国家的栋梁。

interpretations.segmentation: Wen and Wu received the mandate; Duke of Zhao is the state's mainstay.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: wu2 yue1 yu3 xiao3 zi， zhao4 gong1 shi4 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 无曰予小子，召公是似。
interpretations.explanation: 不要说我年幼，要效法召公那样。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not say I am young—be like Duke of Zhao.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: zhao4 min3 rong2 gong1， yong4 xi1 er3 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 肇敏戎公，用锡尔祉。
interpretations.explanation: 开始敏于公事，因此赐你福禄。

interpretations.segmentation: Be diligent in public duty from the start, and so receive blessing from me.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: li2 er3 gui1 zan4， ju4 chang4 yi1 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 厘尔圭瓒，秬鬯一卣。
interpretations.explanation: 赐你圭瓒，以及一卣黑黍鬯酒。

interpretations.segmentation: I grant you the jade libation vessel and one jar of black-millet fragrant wine.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: gao4 yu2 wen2 ren2， xi1 shan1 tu3 tian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 告于文人，锡山土田。
interpretations.explanation: 祭告文德祖先，并赐山土田。

interpretations.segmentation: Report to the civil ancestors and bestow hills, land, and fields.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.content: 于周受命，自召祖命，虎拜稽首：天子万年！
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: yu2 zhou1 shou4 ming4， zi4 zhao4 zu3 ming4， hu3 bai4 ji1 shou3： tian1 zi wan4 nian2！

interpretations.segmentation: 于周受命，自召祖命，虎拜稽首：天子万年！
interpretations.explanation: 在周室受封，承召祖之命，召虎叩头拜谢：愿天子万年！

interpretations.segmentation: Receiving charge in Zhou, from Zhao's ancestral command—Hu kowtows: May the Son of Heaven live ten thousand years!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: hu3 bai4 ji1 shou3， dui4 yang2 wang2 xiu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 虎拜稽首，对扬王休。
interpretations.explanation: 召虎叩头拜谢，称颂宣扬王的美善。

interpretations.segmentation: Hu kowtows and responds, praising and spreading the king's grace.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: zuo4 zhao4 gong1 kao3： tian1 zi wan4 shou4！

interpretations.segmentation: 作召公考：天子万寿！
interpretations.explanation: 作召公之颂：愿天子万寿无疆！

interpretations.segmentation: He composes a hymn to Duke of Zhao: May the Son of Heaven enjoy long life!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.content: 明明天子，令闻不已，矢其文德，洽此四国。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan.pinyin: ming2 ming2 tian1 zi， ling4 wen2 bu4 yi3， shi3 qi2 wen2 de2， qia4 ci3 si4 guo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 明明天子，令闻不已，矢其文德，洽此四国。
interpretations.explanation: 光明睿智的天子，美名不绝，发扬文德，和洽四方之国。

interpretations.segmentation: Bright and wise is the Son of Heaven; his fair fame unceasing—he displays civil virtue and harmonizes the four realms.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.content: 菀彼桑柔，其下侯旬，捋采其刘，瘼此下民。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: wan3 bi3 sang1 rou2， qi2 xia4 hou2 xun2， lv3 cai3 qi2 liu2， mo4 ci3 xia4 min2。

interpretations.segmentation: 菀彼桑柔，其下侯旬，捋采其刘，瘼此下民。
interpretations.explanation: 茂盛柔嫩的桑树，其下遍生旬类植物；采捋已凋的桑叶，百姓因此受病。

interpretations.segmentation: Lush and tender mulberries; beneath them rank weeds grow—stripping the faded leaves, the common people are afflicted.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: bu4 tian3 xin1 you1， cang1 xiong1 tian2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不殄心忧，仓兄填兮。
interpretations.explanation: 忧思不绝，仓皇悲戚填满心间。

interpretations.segmentation: My grief does not cease; panic and sorrow fill my breast.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: zhuo1 bi3 hao4 tian1， ning2 bu4 wo3 jin1？

interpretations.segmentation: 倬彼昊天，宁不我矜？
interpretations.explanation: 那广大的苍天，难道不怜悯我吗？

interpretations.segmentation: O vast bright Heaven, will you not pity me?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: si4 mu3 kui2 kui2， yu2 zhao4 you3 pian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 四牡骙骙，旟旐有翩。
interpretations.explanation: 四马雄健，旗帜随风翩飞。

interpretations.segmentation: The four steeds are strong; banners and pennants flutter in the wind.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: luan4 sheng1 bu4 yi2， mi2 guo2 bu4 min3。

interpretations.segmentation: 乱生不夷，靡国不泯。
interpretations.explanation: 祸乱生起不能平定，没有哪一个国家不危亡。

interpretations.segmentation: When disorder rises it is not pacified; no state escapes ruin.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: min2 mi2 you3 li2， ju4 huo4 yi3 jin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 民靡有黎，具祸以烬。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓没有安宁，一齐遭受灾祸如同焚烬。

interpretations.segmentation: The people have no peace; together they meet disaster as if burned to ash.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: yu2 hu1 you3 ai1， guo2 bu4 si1 pin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 于乎有哀，国步斯频。
interpretations.explanation: 唉，真可悲啊，国运如此频危。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, how sad—the nation's course is so often perilous.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: guo2 bu4 mie4 zi1， tian1 bu4 wo3 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 国步灭资，天不我将。
interpretations.explanation: 国运将尽资财，上天不再扶助我们。

interpretations.segmentation: The nation's step consumes its resources; Heaven no longer upholds us.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: mi2 suo3 zhi3 yi2， yun2 cu2 he2 wang3？

interpretations.segmentation: 靡所止疑，云徂何往？
interpretations.explanation: 没有可止之处、可定之方，将要往哪里去？

interpretations.segmentation: There is nowhere to stop or settle—where shall we go?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: jun1 zi shi2 wei2， bing3 xin1 wu2 jing4。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子实维，秉心无竞。
interpretations.explanation: 君子实在在此，秉持心志而不争竞。

interpretations.segmentation: The noble man is truly here, holding his heart without strife.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: shui2 sheng1 li4 jie1， zhi4 jin1 wei4 geng3？

interpretations.segmentation: 谁生厉阶，至今为梗？
interpretations.explanation: 是谁生出祸乱的阶梯，至今成为阻碍？

interpretations.segmentation: Who raised the steps of calamity that still block us today?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: you1 xin1 yin1 yin1， nian4 wo3 tu3 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 忧心殷殷，念我土宇。
interpretations.explanation: 忧心深切，惦念我们的国土。

interpretations.segmentation: Deep is my worry; I think of our land and realm.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: wo3 sheng1 bu4 chen2， feng2 tian1 dan4 nu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我生不辰，逢天僤怒。
interpretations.explanation: 我生不逢时，正遇上天降怒。

interpretations.segmentation: I was born at an ill hour, meeting Heaven's raging wrath.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: zi4 xi1 cu2 dong1， mi2 suo3 ding4 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 自西徂东，靡所定处。
interpretations.explanation: 从西到东，没有可安定的地方。

interpretations.segmentation: From west to east there is no place to rest secure.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: duo1 wo3 gou4 min2， kong3 ji2 wo3 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 多我觏痻，孔棘我圉。
interpretations.explanation: 多遇我病痛之事，边境也极为危急。

interpretations.segmentation: I meet much sickness; our borders are sorely threatened.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: wei4 mou2 wei4 bi4， luan4 kuang4 si1 xue1。

interpretations.segmentation: 为谋为毖，乱况斯削。
interpretations.explanation: 谋划谨慎，乱局才得削减。

interpretations.segmentation: With careful counsel and prudence, disorder may be reduced.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: gao4 er3 you1 xu4， hui4 er3 xu4 jue2。

interpretations.segmentation: 告尔忧恤，诲尔序爵。
interpretations.explanation: 告知你们忧虑体恤之道，教你们按序授爵。

interpretations.segmentation: I tell you how to care and show concern; I teach you to grant ranks in order.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: shui2 neng2 zhi2 re4， shi4 bu4 yi3 zhuo2？

interpretations.segmentation: 谁能执热，逝不以濯？
interpretations.explanation: 谁能手执灼热之物，而不先用水洗濯？

interpretations.segmentation: Who can hold what is hot and not first wash his hands in water?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: qi2 he2 neng2 shu1， zai4 xu1 ji2 ni4。

interpretations.segmentation: 其何能淑，载胥及溺。
interpretations.explanation: 这样怎能行善，只会相与陷溺。

interpretations.segmentation: How then can they do good? They will drag one another into drowning.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: ru2 bi3 su4 feng1， yi4 kong3 zhi1 ai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 如彼溯风，亦孔之僾。
interpretations.explanation: 像逆风而行，也实在很艰难。

interpretations.segmentation: Like walking against the wind—it is painfully hard.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: min2 you3 su4 xin1， ping2 yun2 bu4 dai3。

interpretations.segmentation: 民有肃心，荓云不逮。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓本有肃敬之心，却被小人说不逮。

interpretations.segmentation: The people have reverent hearts, yet petty men say they fall short.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: hao3 shi4 jia4 se4， li4 min2 dai4 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 好是稼穑，力民代食。
interpretations.explanation: 他们好的是不事稼穑，役使百姓而代食其禄。

interpretations.segmentation: They love not farming but force the people to toil while they eat others' food.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: jia4 se4 wei2 bao3， dai4 shi2 wei2 hao3？

interpretations.segmentation: 稼穑维宝，代食维好？
interpretations.explanation: 稼穑才是宝贝，代食才是好吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Is not farming the treasure—how can living on others be good?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: tian1 jiang4 sang4 luan4， mie4 wo3 li4 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天降丧乱，灭我立王。
interpretations.explanation: 上天降下丧乱，欲灭我们所立的王。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven sends ruin and chaos, destroying the king we set up.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: jiang4 ci3 mao2 zei2， jia4 se4 zu2 yang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 降此蟊贼，稼穑卒痒。
interpretations.explanation: 又降下蟊贼，使稼穑尽受损害。

interpretations.segmentation: It sends blight and pests until the crops are all harmed.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: ai1 dong4 zhong1 guo2， ju4 zhui4 zu2 huang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 哀恫中国，具赘卒荒。
interpretations.explanation: 可悲地痛惜中原，人民如赘疣般困穷荒芜。

interpretations.segmentation: Pity the central land—the people are like excrescences, destitute and waste.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: mi2 you3 lv3 li4， yi3 nian4 qiong2 cang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 靡有旅力，以念穹苍。
interpretations.explanation: 没有一点力量，只能仰望苍天。

interpretations.segmentation: With no strength at all, we can only look up to Heaven.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: wei2 ci3 hui4 jun1， min2 ren2 suo3 zhan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维此惠君，民人所瞻。
interpretations.explanation: 只有这位惠爱的君主，是百姓所仰望的。

interpretations.segmentation: Only this gracious lord is whom the people look to.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: bing3 xin1 xuan1 you2， kao3 shen4 qi2 xiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 秉心宣犹，考慎其相。
interpretations.explanation: 他秉持心意、宣示善谋，考察慎选辅相。

interpretations.segmentation: He holds his heart, declares good counsel, and carefully chooses his ministers.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: wei2 bi3 bu4 shun4， zi4 du2 bi3 zang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维彼不顺，自独俾臧。
interpretations.explanation: 那些不顺之人，却独自自以为善。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who are perverse think themselves alone in the right.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: zi4 you3 fei4 chang2， bi3 min2 zu2 kuang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 自有肺肠，俾民卒狂。
interpretations.explanation: 自有私心，使百姓终至狂乱。

interpretations.segmentation: With private schemes they drive the people to madness.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: zhan1 bi3 zhong1 lin2， shen1 shen1 qi2 lu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻彼中林，甡甡其鹿。
interpretations.explanation: 望见林中的鹿群，众多而往来。

interpretations.segmentation: Looking at the deer in the wood—they throng and move about.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: peng2 you3 yi3 zen4， bu4 xu1 yi3 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 朋友已谮，不胥以穀。
interpretations.explanation: 朋友已经进谗，不能彼此以善相待。

interpretations.segmentation: Friends have already slandered; they cannot treat one another with goodness.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: ren2 yi4 you3 yan2： jin4 tui4 wei2 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 人亦有言：进退维谷。
interpretations.explanation: 古人也说：进退都处于困境。

interpretations.segmentation: Men also say: in advance or retreat one is trapped in a ravine.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: wei2 ci3 sheng4 ren2， zhan1 yan2 bai3 li3。

interpretations.segmentation: 维此圣人，瞻言百里。
interpretations.explanation: 这位圣人，远望能及百里。

interpretations.segmentation: This sage sees a hundred li ahead.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: wei2 bi3 yu2 ren2， fu4 kuang2 yi3 xi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 维彼愚人，覆狂以喜。
interpretations.explanation: 那个愚人，颠倒狂妄却自欢喜。

interpretations.segmentation: That fool turns things upside down in folly yet rejoices.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: fei3 yan2 bu4 neng2， hu2 si1 wei4 ji4？

interpretations.segmentation: 匪言不能，胡斯畏忌？
interpretations.explanation: 不是不能说话，为何如此畏忌？

interpretations.segmentation: It is not that he cannot speak—why then such fear and restraint?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: wei2 ci3 liang2 ren2， fu2 qiu2 fu2 di2。

interpretations.segmentation: 维此良人，弗求弗迪。
interpretations.explanation: 这位良人，不求进用也不求显达。

interpretations.segmentation: This good man neither seeks promotion nor presses forward.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: wei2 bi3 ren3 xin1， shi4 gu4 shi4 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 维彼忍心，是顾是复。
interpretations.explanation: 那个忍心之人，却反复顾念坏人。

interpretations.segmentation: That hard-hearted one looks back again and again to the wicked.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: min2 zhi1 tan1 luan4， ning2 wei4 tu2 du2。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之贪乱，宁为荼毒。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓贪于乱政，宁愿忍受荼毒。

interpretations.segmentation: The people, greedy for disorder, would rather endure poison and pain.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: da4 feng1 you3 sui4， you3 kong1 da4 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 大风有隧，有空大谷。
interpretations.explanation: 大风有通路，有空阔的大谷。

interpretations.segmentation: The great wind has its tunnel; there is a hollow, wide valley.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: wei2 ci3 liang2 ren2， zuo4 wei4 shi4 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 维此良人，作为式穀。
interpretations.explanation: 这位良人，所作的是善道。

interpretations.segmentation: This good man acts in the way of goodness.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: wei2 bi3 bu4 shun4， zheng1 yi3 zhong1 gou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 维彼不顺，征以中垢。
interpretations.explanation: 那个不顺之人，行于中途而玷污。

interpretations.segmentation: That perverse one walks mid-course and is stained with filth.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: da4 feng1 you3 sui4， tan1 ren2 bai4 lei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 大风有隧，贪人败类。
interpretations.explanation: 大风有通路，贪人败坏同类。

interpretations.segmentation: The great wind has its tunnel; the greedy ruin their kind.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: ting1 yan2 ze2 dui4， song4 yan2 ru2 zui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 听言则对，诵言如醉。
interpretations.explanation: 听谄媚之言就应答，听忠直之言却如醉。

interpretations.segmentation: To flattery he responds; to honest speech he is as if drunk.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: fei3 yong4 qi2 liang2， fu4 bi3 wo3 bei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪用其良，复俾我悖。
interpretations.explanation: 不用良善之人，反使我违背正道。

interpretations.segmentation: He will not use the good, and makes me turn against what is right.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.content: 嗟尔朋友，予岂不知而作。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: jie1 er3 peng2 you3， yu3 qi3 bu4 zhi1 er2 zuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 嗟尔朋友，予岂不知而作。
interpretations.explanation: 唉，你们这些朋友，我难道不知而妄作此诗？

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, you friends—do you think I compose this poem in ignorance?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: ru2 bi3 fei1 chong2， shi2 yi4 yi4 huo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 如彼飞虫，时亦弋获。
interpretations.explanation: 像那飞虫，有时也会被射中捕获。

interpretations.segmentation: Like flying insects, at times they too are shot and taken.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: ji4 zhi1 yin1 nv3， fan3 yu3 lai2 he4。

interpretations.segmentation: 既之阴女，反予来赫。
interpretations.explanation: 既已暗中加害于你，反来对我怒斥。

interpretations.segmentation: Having secretly harmed you, they turn and blaze at me in anger.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: min2 zhi1 wang3 ji2， zhi2 liang2 shan4 bei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之罔极，职凉善背。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓没有止境，只因小人善于背叛。

interpretations.segmentation: The people's woes have no limit—petty men excel at turning their backs.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: wei4 min2 bu4 li4， ru2 yun2 bu4 ke4。

interpretations.segmentation: 为民不利，如云不克。
interpretations.explanation: 对百姓不利，像云聚而不能成功。

interpretations.segmentation: They are no help to the people—like clouds that gather yet cannot achieve.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: min2 zhi1 hui2 yu4， zhi2 jing4 yong4 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之回遹，职竞用力。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓邪僻，只因小人竞用力气。

interpretations.segmentation: The people go astray because petty men compete in brute force.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: min2 zhi1 wei4 li4， zhi2 dao4 wei4 kou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之未戾，职盗为寇。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓尚未安定，小人却盗为寇。

interpretations.segmentation: The people are not yet settled, yet petty men steal and play robber.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: liang2 yue1 bu4 ke3， fu4 bei4 shan4 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 凉曰不可，覆背善詈。
interpretations.explanation: 小人说不可以，背后却善于骂人。

interpretations.segmentation: The petty man says it cannot be done, yet behind backs he curses well.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou.pinyin: sui1 yue1 fei3 yu3， ji4 zuo4 er3 ge1！

interpretations.segmentation: 虽曰匪予，既作尔歌！
interpretations.explanation: 虽说不是针对你，我已经作了这首诗！

interpretations.segmentation: Though you say it is not against you—I have already made this song for you!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: song1 gao1 wei2 yue4， jun4 ji2 yu2 tian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 崧高维岳，骏极于天。
interpretations.explanation: 崧岳是高大的山，其高峻直达天际。

interpretations.segmentation: Song is the lofty peak; its summit reaches to Heaven.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: wei2 yue4 jiang4 shen2， sheng1 fu3 ji2 shen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维岳降神，生甫及申。
interpretations.explanation: 山岳降下神灵，生出了甫侯与申伯。

interpretations.segmentation: The mountain sends down its spirit and bears Fu and Shen.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: wei2 shen1 ji2 fu3， wei2 zhou1 zhi1 han4。

interpretations.segmentation: 维申及甫，维周之翰。
interpretations.explanation: 申伯与甫侯，是周室的栋梁之臣。

interpretations.segmentation: Shen and Fu are the pillars and beams of Zhou.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: si4 guo2 yu2 fan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 四国于蕃。
interpretations.explanation: 四方之国来屏卫。

interpretations.segmentation: The states of the four quarters come to shield the realm.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: si4 fang1 yu2 xuan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 四方于宣。
interpretations.explanation: 四方之地来宣布王化。

interpretations.segmentation: The four quarters receive the proclamation of royal rule.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: wei3 wei3 shen1 bo2， wang2 zuan3 zhi1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 亹亹申伯，王缵之事。
interpretations.explanation: 勤勉不懈的申伯，周王继续委以重任。

interpretations.segmentation: Diligent and untiring is Shen Bo; the king entrusts him with ongoing tasks.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: yu2 yi4 yu2 xie4， nan2 guo2 shi4 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 于邑于谢，南国是式。
interpretations.explanation: 在邑在谢，成为南国的楷模。

interpretations.segmentation: In city and in Xie he becomes the model for the southern states.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: wang2 ming4 zhao4 bo2， ding4 shen1 bo2 zhi1 zhai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 王命召伯，定申伯之宅。
interpretations.explanation: 周王命令召伯，确定申伯的居城。

interpretations.segmentation: The king commands Duke of Shao to fix the dwelling place of Shen Bo.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: deng1 shi4 nan2 bang1， shi4 zhi2 qi2 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 登是南邦，世执其功。
interpretations.explanation: 登临这南方之国，世世代代守其功业。

interpretations.segmentation: He takes up this southern land; generation after generation holds its merit.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: wang2 ming4 shen1 bo2， shi4 shi4 nan2 bang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 王命申伯，式是南邦。
interpretations.explanation: 周王命令申伯，治理这南方之国。

interpretations.segmentation: The king commands Shen Bo to govern this southern realm.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: yin1 shi4 xie4 ren2， yi3 zuo4 er3 yong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 因是谢人，以作尔庸。
interpretations.explanation: 任用谢地之人，作为你的劳役。

interpretations.segmentation: Use the people of Xie as your labor and service.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: wang2 ming4 zhao4 bo2， che4 shen1 bo2 tu3 tian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 王命召伯，彻申伯土田。
interpretations.explanation: 周王命令召伯，整理申伯的土田。

interpretations.segmentation: The king commands Duke of Shao to survey Shen Bo's fields and lands.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: wang2 ming4 fu4 yu4， qian1 qi2 si1 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 王命傅御，迁其私人。
interpretations.explanation: 周王命令太傅，迁移他的家臣。

interpretations.segmentation: The king commands the grand tutor to move his personal retainers.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: shen1 bo2 zhi1 gong1， zhao4 bo2 shi4 ying2。

interpretations.segmentation: 申伯之功，召伯是营。
interpretations.explanation: 申伯的功业，由召伯来营建。

interpretations.segmentation: Shen Bo's achievement is planned and built by Duke of Shao.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: you3 chu4 qi2 cheng2， qin3 miao4 ji4 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有俶其城，寝庙既成。
interpretations.explanation: 开始筑城，寝庙也已落成。

interpretations.segmentation: The city begins to rise; palace and temple are completed.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: ji4 cheng2 miao3 miao3， wang2 xi1 shen1 bo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既成藐藐，王锡申伯。
interpretations.explanation: 既成而高大，周王赏赐申伯。

interpretations.segmentation: When it stands grand and tall, the king rewards Shen Bo.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: si4 mu3 jue1 jue1， gou1 ying1 zhuo2 zhuo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 四牡蹻蹻，钩膺濯濯。
interpretations.explanation: 四马强健，马胸钩饰鲜明。

interpretations.segmentation: Four steeds are sturdy; hooked breast ornaments gleam bright.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: wang2 qian3 shen1 bo2， lu4 che1 cheng2 ma3。

interpretations.segmentation: 王遣申伯，路车乘马。
interpretations.explanation: 周王遣送申伯，赐路车乘马。

interpretations.segmentation: The king sends Shen Bo forth with road chariot and team.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: wo3 tu2 er3 ju1， mo4 ru2 nan2 tu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我图尔居，莫如南土。
interpretations.explanation: 我为你择居，没有比南方更合适的。

interpretations.segmentation: I choose your dwelling—none is better than the southern land.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: xi1 er3 jie4 gui1， yi3 zuo4 er3 bao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 锡尔介圭，以作尔宝。
interpretations.explanation: 赐你大圭，作为你的宝器。

interpretations.segmentation: I grant you the great jade tablet as your treasure.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: wang3 jin4 wang2 jiu4， nan2 tu3 shi4 bao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 往近王舅，南土是保。
interpretations.explanation: 前去亲近王舅，保卫南方国土。

interpretations.segmentation: Go near as the king's uncle and guard the southern soil.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: shen1 bo2 xin4 mai4， wang2 jian4 yu2 mei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 申伯信迈，王饯于郿。
interpretations.explanation: 申伯信实勇迈，周王在郿地为他饯行。

interpretations.segmentation: Shen Bo is trustworthy and bold; the king feasts him farewell at Mei.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: shen1 bo2 hai2 nan2， xie4 yu2 cheng2 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 申伯还南，谢于诚归。
interpretations.explanation: 申伯返回南方，在谢地诚心安居。

interpretations.segmentation: Shen Bo returns south and dwells in Xie with sincere heart.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: wang2 ming4 zhao4 bo2， che4 shen1 bo2 tu3 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 王命召伯，彻申伯土疆。
interpretations.explanation: 周王命令召伯，整理申伯的疆界。

interpretations.segmentation: The king commands Duke of Shao to demarcate Shen Bo's borders.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: yi3 zhi4 qi2 zhang1， shi4 chuan2 qi2 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 以峙其粻，式遄其行。
interpretations.explanation: 储积其粮，使他的行程更速。

interpretations.segmentation: Store up his grain so his journey may be swift.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: shen1 bo2 fan1 fan1， ji4 ru4 yu2 xie4。

interpretations.segmentation: 申伯番番，既入于谢。
interpretations.explanation: 申伯威仪雄壮，已经进入谢城。

interpretations.segmentation: Shen Bo is stately and strong; he has entered Xie.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: tu2 yu4 chan3 chan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 徒御啴啴。
interpretations.explanation: 徒众御者众多和乐。

interpretations.segmentation: Footmen and charioteers are many and at ease.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: zhou1 bang1 xian2 xi3， rong2 you3 liang2 han4。

interpretations.segmentation: 周邦咸喜，戎有良翰。
interpretations.explanation: 周邦都欢喜，国家有了良臣。

interpretations.segmentation: All Zhou rejoices—the realm has a fine support.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.content: 不显申伯，王之元舅，文武是宪。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: bu4 xian3 shen1 bo2， wang2 zhi1 yuan2 jiu4， wen2 wu3 shi4 xian4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不显申伯，王之元舅，文武是宪。
interpretations.explanation: 显赫的申伯，是周王的大舅，文武之道可为典范。

interpretations.segmentation: Illustrious Shen Bo—the king's chief uncle, a model of Wen and Wu's way.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: shen1 bo2 zhi1 de2， rou2 hui4 qie3 zhi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 申伯之德，柔惠且直。
interpretations.explanation: 申伯的德行，柔顺仁惠而且正直。

interpretations.segmentation: Shen Bo's virtue is gentle, kind, and upright.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: rou2 ci3 wan4 bang1， wen2 yu2 si4 guo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 揉此万邦，闻于四国。
interpretations.explanation: 安抚万邦，名声传于四方。

interpretations.segmentation: He soothes the myriad states; his fame reaches the four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: ji2 fu3 zuo4 song4， qi2 shi1 kong3 shuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 吉甫作诵，其诗孔硕。
interpretations.explanation: 尹吉甫作此颂诗，其诗宏大。

interpretations.segmentation: Ji Fu composed this hymn; the poem is grand indeed.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao.pinyin: qi2 feng1 si4 hao3， yi3 zeng4 shen1 bo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 其风四好，以赠申伯。
interpretations.explanation: 其风仪美好，用来赠送申伯。

interpretations.segmentation: Its tone is fine and good—offered as gift to Shen Bo.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: yi4 yi4 wei1 yi2， wei2 de2 zhi1 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 抑抑威仪，维德之隅。
interpretations.explanation: 举止庄重、威仪美好，是品德的外在表现。

interpretations.segmentation: Dignified bearing and fine deportment are the outward signs of virtue.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.content: 人亦有言：靡哲不愚，庶人之愚，亦职维疾。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: ren2 yi4 you3 yan2： mi2 zhe2 bu4 yu2， shu4 ren2 zhi1 yu2， yi4 zhi2 wei2 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 人亦有言：靡哲不愚，庶人之愚，亦职维疾。
interpretations.explanation: 人们也有这样的话：没有智者不装愚，平民的愚笨，也是由于急迫所致。

interpretations.segmentation: People say: no wise man fails to play the fool; the commoner's folly comes from pressing need.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: zhe2 ren2 zhi1 yu2， yi4 wei2 si1 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 哲人之愚，亦维斯戾。
interpretations.explanation: 智者的装愚，也是出于不得已。

interpretations.segmentation: The wise man's pretended folly likewise springs from necessity.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: wu2 jing4 wei2 ren2， si4 fang1 qi2 xun4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无竞维人，四方其训之。
interpretations.explanation: 不要与人争竞，要让四方都来效法你。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not strive with others; let all quarters take you as their model.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: you3 jue2 de2 xing2， si4 guo2 shun4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有觉德行，四国顺之。
interpretations.explanation: 有显著的德行，四方之国都会顺从。

interpretations.segmentation: Where conduct is clearly virtuous, the four quarters will follow.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: xu1 mo2 ding4 ming4， yuan3 you2 chen2 gao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 訏谟定命，远犹辰告。
interpretations.explanation: 宏大的谋略安定天命，向远方如星辰般昭示。

interpretations.segmentation: Grand counsel fixes Heaven's mandate and announces it afar like the stars.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: jing4 shen4 wei1 yi2， wei2 min2 zhi1 ze2。

interpretations.segmentation: 敬慎威仪，维民之则。
interpretations.explanation: 敬慎而威仪，是百姓应遵循的准则。

interpretations.segmentation: Reverent care and dignified bearing are the people's standard.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: qi2 zai4 yu2 jin1， xing1 mi2 luan4 yu2 zheng4。

interpretations.segmentation: 其在于今，兴迷乱于政。
interpretations.explanation: 问题就在今天，在政事中兴起迷乱。

interpretations.segmentation: The trouble lies in the present—confusion has risen in governance.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: dian1 fu4 jue2 de2， huang1 zhan4 yu2 jiu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 颠覆厥德，荒湛于酒。
interpretations.explanation: 颠倒了德行，沉溺于酒色。

interpretations.segmentation: Virtue is overturned and drowned in wine.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: nv3 sui1 zhan4 le4 cong2， fu2 nian4 jue2 shao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 女虽湛乐从，弗念厥绍。
interpretations.explanation: 你虽沉溺享乐而跟从，却不念继承先业。

interpretations.segmentation: Though you follow pleasure and revelry, you do not think of your inheritance.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: wang3 fu1 qiu2 xian1 wang2， ke4 gong4 ming2 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 罔敷求先王，克共明刑。
interpretations.explanation: 不广求先王之道，不能共同明察刑法。

interpretations.segmentation: You do not widely seek the former kings' way, nor jointly clarify punishments.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.content: 四皇天弗尚，如彼泉流，无沦胥以亡。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: si4 huang2 tian1 fu2 shang4， ru2 bi3 quan2 liu2， wu2 lun2 xu1 yi3 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 四皇天弗尚，如彼泉流，无沦胥以亡。
interpretations.explanation: 上天不再眷顾，像那泉水流淌，不要一起沉沦灭亡。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven no longer favors you; like a spring's flow, do not all sink together to ruin.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.content: 夙兴夜寐，洒扫庭内，维民之章。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: su4 xing1 ye4 mei4， sa3 sao3 ting2 nei4， wei2 min2 zhi1 zhang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夙兴夜寐，洒扫庭内，维民之章。
interpretations.explanation: 早起晚睡，洒扫庭院，是百姓的表率。

interpretations.segmentation: Rise early and sleep late, sweep the courtyard—this is the people's model.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.content: 修尔车马，弓矢戎兵，用戒戎作，用逷蛮方。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: xiu1 er3 che1 ma3， gong1 shi3 rong2 bing1， yong4 jie4 rong2 zuo4， yong4 ti4 man2 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 修尔车马，弓矢戎兵，用戒戎作，用逷蛮方。
interpretations.explanation: 修整车马、弓矢和兵器，以戒备戎事，以远御蛮方。

interpretations.segmentation: Ready chariots, horses, bows, and arms—to guard against war and keep distant tribes at bay.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.content: 质尔人民，谨尔侯度，用戒不虞。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: zhi4 er3 ren2 min2， jin3 er3 hou2 du4， yong4 jie4 bu4 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 质尔人民，谨尔侯度，用戒不虞。
interpretations.explanation: 质询你的人民，谨守侯国法度，以戒备意外。

interpretations.segmentation: Question your people, keep your marquisate's laws, and guard against the unforeseen.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.content: 慎尔出话，敬尔威仪，无不柔嘉。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: shen4 er3 chu1 hua4， jing4 er3 wei1 yi2， wu2 bu4 rou2 jia1。

interpretations.segmentation: 慎尔出话，敬尔威仪，无不柔嘉。
interpretations.explanation: 谨慎你的出言，敬重你的威仪，无不柔和美好。

interpretations.segmentation: Be careful in what you say, reverent in deportment—let all be gentle and good.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: bai2 gui1 zhi1 dian4， shang4 ke3 mo2 ye3；

interpretations.segmentation: 白圭之玷，尚可磨也；
interpretations.explanation: 白圭上的污点，还可以磨掉；

interpretations.segmentation: A flaw on a white jade tablet can still be polished away;

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: si1 yan2 zhi1 dian4， bu4 ke3 wei4 ye3！

interpretations.segmentation: 斯言之玷，不可为也！
interpretations.explanation: 这句话的污点，就无法挽回了！

interpretations.segmentation: A flaw in such words cannot be undone!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.content: 无易由言，无曰苟矣，莫扪朕舌，言不可逝矣。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: wu2 yi4 you2 yan2， wu2 yue1 gou3 yi3， mo4 men2 zhen4 she2， yan2 bu4 ke3 shi4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 无易由言，无曰苟矣，莫扪朕舌，言不可逝矣。
interpretations.explanation: 不要轻易随口说话，不要说“姑且如此”，不要摸我的舌头，话一出口就收不回了。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not lightly speak your mind, do not say 'for now'; do not touch my tongue—words once spoken cannot be recalled.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: wu2 yan2 bu4 chou2， wu2 de2 bu4 bao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 无言不仇，无德不报。
interpretations.explanation: 没有话不得到回应，没有德不得到回报。

interpretations.segmentation: No word goes unanswered; no virtue goes unrewarded.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: hui4 yu2 peng2 you3， shu4 min2 xiao3 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 惠于朋友，庶民小子。
interpretations.explanation: 施惠于朋友，以及庶民小子。

interpretations.segmentation: Show kindness to friends and to common folk young and old.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: zi sun1 sheng2 sheng2， wan4 min2 mi2 bu4 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 子孙绳绳，万民靡不承。
interpretations.explanation: 子孙绵延不绝，万民无不承顺。

interpretations.segmentation: Descendants continue in unbroken line; all the people follow.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.content: 视尔友君子，辑柔尔颜，不遐有愆。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: shi4 er3 you3 jun1 zi， ji2 rou2 er3 yan2， bu4 xia2 you3 qian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 视尔友君子，辑柔尔颜，不遐有愆。
interpretations.explanation: 看你们这些君子朋友，和颜悦色，就不会有大过。

interpretations.segmentation: Look to you, friends and gentlemen—keep gentle faces and you will not greatly err.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.content: 相在尔室，尚不愧于屋漏。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: xiang1 zai4 er3 shi4， shang4 bu4 kui4 yu2 wu1 lou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 相在尔室，尚不愧于屋漏。
interpretations.explanation: 在别人家里相处，也要在屋漏处无愧于心。

interpretations.segmentation: When together in another's house, still be unashamed even in the hidden corner.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: wu2 yue1 bu4 xian3， mo4 yu3 yun2 gou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 无曰不显，莫予云觏。
interpretations.explanation: 不要说看不见，没人看见我。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not say 'it is not visible'—no one sees me.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.content: 神之格思，不可度思，矧可射思！
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: shen2 zhi1 ge2 si1， bu4 ke3 du4 si1， shen3 ke3 she4 si1！

interpretations.segmentation: 神之格思，不可度思，矧可射思！
interpretations.explanation: 神明的到来，不可揣测，何况可以怠慢！

interpretations.segmentation: When the spirits draw near, it cannot be measured—how much less can you be careless!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: pi4 er3 wei4 de2， bi3 zang1 bi3 jia1。

interpretations.segmentation: 辟尔为德，俾臧俾嘉。
interpretations.explanation: 修你的德行，使善使美。

interpretations.segmentation: Cultivate your virtue—be good and be fine.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: shu1 shen4 er3 zhi3， bu4 qian1 yu2 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 淑慎尔止，不愆于仪。
interpretations.explanation: 善慎你的举止，在仪容上不出差错。

interpretations.segmentation: Be good and careful in your conduct; do not fail in deportment.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: bu4 jian4 bu4 zei2， xian1 bu4 wei4 ze2。

interpretations.segmentation: 不僭不贼，鲜不为则。
interpretations.explanation: 不越分、不伤害，很少人不以之为准则。

interpretations.segmentation: Neither overstep nor harm—few will not take you as their model.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: tou2 wo3 yi3 tao2， bao4 zhi1 yi3 li3。

interpretations.segmentation: 投我以桃，报之以李。
interpretations.explanation: 别人送我桃子，我回赠李子。

interpretations.segmentation: They throw me a peach; I repay with a plum.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: bi3 tong2 er2 jiao3， shi2 hong2 xiao3 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼童而角，实虹小子。
interpretations.explanation: 那幼兽却长角，实在是惑乱小子。

interpretations.segmentation: That young beast yet grows horns—truly it misleads the youth.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: ren3 ran3 rou2 mu4， yan2 min2 zhi1 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 荏染柔木，言缗之丝。
interpretations.explanation: 柔木经染，要用丝绳缗系。

interpretations.segmentation: Soft wood once dyed must be bound with silken cord.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: wen1 wen1 gong1 ren2， wei2 de2 zhi1 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 温温恭人，维德之基。
interpretations.explanation: 温和恭谨的人，是德行的根基。

interpretations.segmentation: The gentle and reverent person is the foundation of virtue.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.content: 其维哲人，告之话言，顺德之行。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: qi2 wei2 zhe2 ren2， gao4 zhi1 hua4 yan2， shun4 de2 zhi1 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 其维哲人，告之话言，顺德之行。
interpretations.explanation: 若是哲人，会告知善言，实行顺德之行。

interpretations.segmentation: If he is wise, tell him good words—he will walk in obedient virtue.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: qi2 wei2 yu2 ren2， fu4 wei4 wo3 jian4。

interpretations.segmentation: 其维愚人，覆谓我僭。
interpretations.explanation: 若是愚人，反而说我越分。

interpretations.segmentation: If he is a fool, he turns and calls me presumptuous.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: min2 ge4 you3 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民各有心。
interpretations.explanation: 民众各有各的心思。

interpretations.segmentation: The people each have their own hearts.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: yu2 hu1 xiao3 zi， wei4 zhi1 zang1 fou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 于乎小子，未知臧否。
interpretations.explanation: 唉，小子，你还不知善恶。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, young man, you still do not know good from ill.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: fei3 shou3 xie2 zhi1， yan2 shi4 zhi1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪手携之，言示之事。
interpretations.explanation: 不是用手拉着你，是用言语指示事情。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not by hand I lead you—I show you matters in words.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: fei3 mian4 ming4 zhi1， yan2 ti2 qi2 er3。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪面命之，言提其耳。
interpretations.explanation: 不是当面命令你，是用话提点你的耳朵。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not face to face I command you—I lift your ear with words.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: jie4 yue1 wei4 zhi1， yi4 ji4 bao4 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 借曰未知，亦既抱子。
interpretations.explanation: 如果说还不懂，你也已经抱了孩子。

interpretations.segmentation: If you say you still do not know, you already hold a child in your arms.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.content: 民之靡盈，谁夙知而莫成？
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: min2 zhi1 mi2 ying2， shui2 su4 zhi1 er2 mo4 cheng2？

interpretations.segmentation: 民之靡盈，谁夙知而莫成？
interpretations.explanation: 人难道不能满盈吗？谁早知而竟不成？

interpretations.segmentation: Can people not be full? Who knew early yet failed to achieve?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: hao4 tian1 kong3 zhao1， wo3 sheng1 mi2 le4。

interpretations.segmentation: 昊天孔昭，我生靡乐。
interpretations.explanation: 昊天多么明察，我这一生却没有安乐。

interpretations.segmentation: Great Heaven is so clear; yet my life knows no joy.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: shi4 er3 meng4 meng4， wo3 xin1 can3 can3。

interpretations.segmentation: 视尔梦梦，我心惨惨。
interpretations.explanation: 看你糊里糊涂，我心凄惨。

interpretations.segmentation: Seeing you muddled, my heart is wretched.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: hui4 er3 zhun1 zhun1， ting1 wo3 miao3 miao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 诲尔谆谆，听我藐藐。
interpretations.explanation: 教导你谆谆恳切，你听我却藐藐然。

interpretations.segmentation: I teach you earnestly; you listen to me with indifference.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: fei3 yong4 wei4 jiao4， fu4 yong4 wei4 nve4。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪用为教，覆用为虐。
interpretations.explanation: 不用来作教益，反而用来作暴虐。

interpretations.segmentation: You do not use it for instruction—you use it for cruelty.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: jie4 yue1 wei4 zhi1， yi4 yu4 ji4 mao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 借曰未知，亦聿既耄。
interpretations.explanation: 如果说还不懂，你也已经老迈了。

interpretations.segmentation: If you say you still do not know, you are already old.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: yu2 hu1， xiao3 zi， gao4 er3 jiu4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 于乎，小子，告尔旧止。
interpretations.explanation: 唉，小子，告诉你旧日的止境。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, young man, I tell you the old limits.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: ting1 yong4 wo3 mou2， shu4 wu2 da4 hui3。

interpretations.segmentation: 听用我谋，庶无大悔。
interpretations.explanation: 听用我的谋划，或许没有大悔。

interpretations.segmentation: Listen and use my counsel—perhaps there will be no great regret.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: tian1 fang1 jian1 nan2， yue1 sang4 jue2 guo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天方艰难，曰丧厥国。
interpretations.explanation: 上天正降艰难，说要丧失你的国家。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven sends hardship; it is said your state will be lost.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: qu3 pi4 bu4 yuan3， hao4 tian1 bu4 te4。

interpretations.segmentation: 取譬不远，昊天不忒。
interpretations.explanation: 取譬并不遥远，昊天没有差错。

interpretations.segmentation: The analogy is not far off; Great Heaven makes no mistake.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi.pinyin: hui2 yu4 qi2 de2， bi3 min2 da4 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 回遹其德，俾民大棘。
interpretations.explanation: 违背其德，使百姓大遭祸患。

interpretations.segmentation: Turning from virtue brings great distress upon the people.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: zhuo1 bi3 yun2 han4， zhao1 hui2 yu2 tian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 倬彼云汉，昭回于天。
interpretations.explanation: 那银河多么广大，光明回转在天上。

interpretations.segmentation: How vast that Milky Way, turning bright in the sky.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: wang2 yue1： yu2 hu1！

interpretations.segmentation: 王曰：于乎！
interpretations.explanation: 周王说：唉！

interpretations.segmentation: The king says: Alas!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: he2 gu1 jin1 zhi1 ren2？

interpretations.segmentation: 何辜今之人？
interpretations.explanation: 今天的人有什么罪过？

interpretations.segmentation: What crime have the people of today committed?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: tian1 jiang4 sang4 luan4， ji1 jin3 jian4 zhen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天降丧乱，饥馑荐臻。
interpretations.explanation: 上天降下丧乱，饥荒接连到来。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven sends ruin; famine follows famine.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: mi2 shen2 bu4 ju3， mi2 ai4 si1 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 靡神不举，靡爱斯牲。
