interpretations.explanation: 没有神不祭祀，没有牲礼不吝惜。

interpretations.segmentation: No spirit goes unhonored; no offering is spared.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: gui1 bi4 ji4 zu2， ning2 mo4 wo3 ting1？

interpretations.segmentation: 圭壁既卒，宁莫我听？
interpretations.explanation: 圭璧都已用尽，难道没有听到我的祈祷？

interpretations.segmentation: Jade tablets and disks are all used up—does none hear my prayer?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: han4 ji4 da4 shen4， yun4 long2 chong2 chong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 旱既大甚，蕴隆虫虫。
interpretations.explanation: 旱情已经十分严重，热气蒸腾如虫虫作响。

interpretations.segmentation: The drought is already severe; the heat swells and seethes.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: bu4 tian3 yin1 si4， zi4 jiao1 cu2 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不殄禋祀，自郊徂宫。
interpretations.explanation: 不停止禋祀，从郊祭到宗庙。

interpretations.segmentation: They do not cease the solemn rites—from the border sacrifice to the ancestral temple.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: shang4 xia4 dian4 yi4， mi2 shen2 bu4 zong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 上下奠瘗，靡神不宗。
interpretations.explanation: 上下都献祭埋牲，没有神不尊崇。

interpretations.segmentation: Offerings above and below, burial sacrifices—no spirit goes unhonored.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: hou4 ji4 bu4 ke4， shang4 di4 bu4 lin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 后稷不克，上帝不临。
interpretations.explanation: 后稷之神不能佑助，上帝也不降临。

interpretations.segmentation: Lord Millet cannot succor; High God does not draw near.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: hao4 yi4 xia4 tu3， ning2 ding1 wo3 geng3

interpretations.segmentation: 耗斁下土，宁丁我梗
interpretations.explanation: 耗散败坏下土，难道只使我一人遭病？

interpretations.segmentation: The lower realm is wasted and ruined—does it afflict only me with sickness?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: han4 ji4 da4 shen4， ze2 bu4 ke3 tui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 旱既大甚，则不可推。
interpretations.explanation: 旱情已经十分严重，无法推却。

interpretations.segmentation: The drought is already severe—it cannot be pushed away.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: jing1 jing1 ye4 ye4， ru2 ting2 ru2 lei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 兢兢业业，如霆如雷。
interpretations.explanation: 兢兢业业，像雷霆一般令人震惧。

interpretations.segmentation: Diligent and fearful, like thunder and lightning.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: zhou1 yu2 li2 min2， mi2 you3 jie2 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 周余黎民，靡有孑遗。
interpretations.explanation: 周朝剩余的黎民，没有孑遗一人。

interpretations.segmentation: Of Zhou's remaining people, not one is left alone.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: hao4 tian1 shang4 di4， ze2 bu4 wo3 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 昊天上帝，则不我遗。
interpretations.explanation: 昊天上帝，也不留我一人。

interpretations.segmentation: Great Heaven, High God—you do not even leave me alive.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: hu2 bu4 xiang1 wei4？

interpretations.segmentation: 胡不相畏？
interpretations.explanation: 为何不相畏惧？

interpretations.segmentation: Why do we not fear one another?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: xian1 zu3 yu2 cui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 先祖于摧。
interpretations.explanation: 先祖于是遭到摧折。

interpretations.segmentation: The forefathers are thus overthrown.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: han4 ji4 da4 shen4， ze2 bu4 ke3 ju3。

interpretations.segmentation: 旱既大甚，则不可沮。
interpretations.explanation: 旱情已经十分严重，无法阻止。

interpretations.segmentation: The drought is already severe—it cannot be stopped.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: he4 he4 yan2 yan2， yun2 wo3 wu2 suo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 赫赫炎炎，云我无所。
interpretations.explanation: 赫赫炎炎，说我没有容身之处。

interpretations.segmentation: Blazing and scorching—they say I have nowhere to go.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: da4 ming4 jin4 zhi3， mi2 zhan1 mi2 gu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 大命近止，靡瞻靡顾。
interpretations.explanation: 大命将近终结，无法瞻望无法顾念。

interpretations.segmentation: Great mandate nears its end—no looking ahead, no looking back.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: qun2 gong1 xian1 zheng4， ze2 bu4 wo3 zhu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 群公先正，则不我助。
interpretations.explanation: 群公和先正，却不助我。

interpretations.segmentation: The dukes and former worthies do not help me.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: fu4 mu3 xian1 zu3， hu2 ning2 ren3 yu3？

interpretations.segmentation: 父母先祖，胡宁忍予？
interpretations.explanation: 父母先祖，怎忍心这样待我？

interpretations.segmentation: Parents and forefathers—how can you bear to treat me so?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: han4 ji4 da4 shen4， di2 di2 shan1 chuan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 旱既大甚，涤涤山川。
interpretations.explanation: 旱情已经十分严重，山川都干枯了。

interpretations.segmentation: The drought is already severe—mountains and streams are parched dry.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: han4 ba2 wei4 nve4， ru2 tan2 ru2 fen2。

interpretations.segmentation: 旱魃为虐，如惔如焚。
interpretations.explanation: 旱魃为虐，像火烧像焚烧。

interpretations.segmentation: The drought demon wreaks havoc, like smoldering and like burning.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: wo3 xin1 dan4 shu3， you1 xin1 ru2 xun1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我心惮暑，忧心如熏。
interpretations.explanation: 我心畏惧暑热，忧心如熏。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart dreads the heat; my grief is like smothering smoke.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: qun2 gong1 xian1 zheng4， ze2 bu4 wo3 wen2。

interpretations.segmentation: 群公先正，则不我闻。
interpretations.explanation: 群公和先正，却不闻我的呼告。

interpretations.segmentation: The dukes and former worthies do not hear my cry.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: hao4 tian1 shang4 di4， ning2 bi3 wo3 dun4？

interpretations.segmentation: 昊天上帝，宁俾我遁？
interpretations.explanation: 昊天上帝，难道使我逃避吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Great Heaven, High God—would You have me flee?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: han4 ji4 da4 shen4， min3 mian3 wei4 qu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 旱既大甚，黾勉畏去。
interpretations.explanation: 旱情已经十分严重，勉力畏惧而离去。

interpretations.segmentation: The drought is already severe—I strive in fear to depart.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: hu2 ning2 dian1 wo3 yi3 han4？

interpretations.segmentation: 胡宁瘨我以旱？
interpretations.explanation: 为何用旱灾使我病倒？

interpretations.segmentation: Why afflict me sick with drought?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: can3 bu4 zhi1 qi2 gu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 憯不知其故。
interpretations.explanation: 惨痛而不知其缘故。

interpretations.segmentation: Bitter pain, and I do not know the cause.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: qi2 nian2 kong3 su4， fang1 she4 bu4 mo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 祈年孔夙，方社不莫。
interpretations.explanation: 祈年祭很早就举行，方社之祭也不晚。

interpretations.segmentation: The prayer-for-harvest rite was held early; the earth-god rites were not late.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: hao4 tian1 shang4 di4， ze2 bu4 wo3 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 昊天上帝，则不我虞。
interpretations.explanation: 昊天上帝，却不顾念我们。

interpretations.segmentation: Great Heaven, High God—You do not consider us.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: jing4 gong1 ming2 shen2， yi2 wu2 hui3 nu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 敬恭明神，宜无悔怒。
interpretations.explanation: 敬恭明神，本应没有悔恨和怒意。

interpretations.segmentation: Reverent to the bright spirits—there should be no regret or anger.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: han4 ji4 da4 shen4， san4 wu2 you3 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 旱既大甚，散无友纪。
interpretations.explanation: 旱情已经十分严重，离散没有友伴纲纪。

interpretations.segmentation: The drought is already severe—scattered, without fellowship or order.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: ju1 zai1 shu4 zheng4， jiu4 zai1 zhong3 zai3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鞫哉庶正，疚哉冢宰。
interpretations.explanation: 众正人穷究啊，冢宰也内疚啊。

interpretations.segmentation: The many upright ones investigate; the chief minister is troubled.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: qu4 ma3 shi1 shi4， shan4 fu1 zuo3 you4。

interpretations.segmentation: 趣马师氏，膳夫左右。
interpretations.explanation: 趣马、师氏、膳夫和左右近臣。

interpretations.segmentation: The horse master, the tutor, the steward, and attendants at hand.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: mi2 ren2 bu4 zhou1。

interpretations.segmentation: 靡人不周。
interpretations.explanation: 没有人不周到。

interpretations.segmentation: No one fails to be thorough.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.content: 无不能止，瞻卬昊天，云如何里！
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: wu2 bu4 neng2 zhi3， zhan1 ang2 hao4 tian1， yun2 ru2 he2 li3！

interpretations.segmentation: 无不能止，瞻卬昊天，云如何里！
interpretations.explanation: 没有不能止息，仰望昊天，说这是什么道理！

interpretations.segmentation: Nothing can stop it; I look up to Great Heaven—what is the reason!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: zhan1 ang2 hao4 tian1， you3 hui4 qi2 xing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻卬昊天，有嘒其星。
interpretations.explanation: 仰望昊天，有星光明亮。

interpretations.segmentation: I look up to Great Heaven; the stars shine bright.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: da4 fu1 jun1 zi， zhao1 jia3 wu2 ying2。

interpretations.segmentation: 大夫君子，昭假无赢。
interpretations.explanation: 大夫君子，昭告神明没有缺漏。

interpretations.segmentation: Great officers and gentlemen— their prayers to the spirits leave nothing wanting.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: da4 ming4 jin4 zhi3， wu2 qi4 er3 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 大命近止，无弃尔成。
interpretations.explanation: 大命将近终结，不要放弃你的功业。

interpretations.segmentation: Great mandate nears its end—do not abandon your achievements.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: he2 qiu2 wei4 wo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 何求为我。
interpretations.explanation: 还要求我什么呢。

interpretations.segmentation: What more do you ask of me?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: yi3 li4 shu4 zheng4。

interpretations.segmentation: 以戾庶正。
interpretations.explanation: 以安定众正。

interpretations.segmentation: To settle the many upright officers.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan.pinyin: zhan1 ang2 hao4 tian1， he2 hui4 qi2 ning2？

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻卬昊天，曷惠其宁？
interpretations.explanation: 仰望昊天，何时赐我们安宁？

interpretations.segmentation: I look up to Great Heaven—when will You grant us peace?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: zhan1 ang2 hao4 tian1， ze2 bu4 wo3 hui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻卬昊天，则不我惠。
interpretations.explanation: 仰望昊天，却不施惠于我。

interpretations.segmentation: I look up to Great Heaven, yet You show me no kindness.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: kong3 tian2 bu4 ning2， jiang4 ci3 da4 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 孔填不宁，降此大厉。
interpretations.explanation: 天下很不安宁，降下这场大祸。

interpretations.segmentation: The realm is deeply unsettled; this great calamity has descended.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: bang1 mi2 you3 ding4， shi4 min2 qi2 zhai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 邦靡有定，士民其瘵。
interpretations.explanation: 国家没有安定，士民都病弱。

interpretations.segmentation: The state has no stability; gentry and commoners are afflicted.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: mao2 zei2 mao2 ji2， mi2 you3 yi2 jie4。

interpretations.segmentation: 蟊贼蟊疾，靡有夷届。
interpretations.explanation: 蟊贼为害，没有平息的尽头。

interpretations.segmentation: Grain pests and blights—there is no end to their ravage.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: zui4 gu3 bu4 shou1， mi2 you3 yi2 chou1。

interpretations.segmentation: 罪罟不收，靡有夷瘳。
interpretations.explanation: 罪网不收，没有痊愈之时。

interpretations.segmentation: The net of guilt is not drawn in; there is no time of healing.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: ren2 you3 tu3 tian2， nv3 fan3 you3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 人有土田，女反有之。
interpretations.explanation: 别人有土田，你却反而占有。

interpretations.segmentation: Others have fields and lands—you seize them instead.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: ren2 you3 min2 ren2， nv3 fu4 duo2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 人有民人，女覆夺之。
interpretations.explanation: 别人有人民，你却反而夺去。

interpretations.segmentation: Others have subjects—you snatch them away.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: ci3 yi2 wu2 zui4， nv3 fan3 shou1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 此宜无罪，女反收之。
interpretations.explanation: 此人本应无罪，你却反而收捕他。

interpretations.segmentation: This man should be guiltless—you arrest him instead.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: bi3 yi2 you3 zui4， nv3 fu4 shuo1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼宜有罪，女覆说之。
interpretations.explanation: 那人本应有罪，你却反而释放他。

interpretations.segmentation: That man should be guilty—you release him instead.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: zhe2 fu1 cheng2 cheng2， zhe2 fu4 qing1 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 哲夫成城，哲妇倾城。
interpretations.explanation: 明智的男子筑城，明智的女子倾覆城邦。

interpretations.segmentation: A wise man builds the city; a wise woman overturns the state.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: yi4 jue2 zhe2 fu4， wei4 xiao1 wei4 chi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 懿厥哲妇，为枭为鸱。
interpretations.explanation: 那美善而多智的妇人，实为枭鸱之类。

interpretations.segmentation: That fine and clever woman is an owl and kite in truth.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: fu4 you3 zhang3 she2， wei2 li4 zhi1 jie1。

interpretations.segmentation: 妇有长舌，维厉之阶。
interpretations.explanation: 妇人长舌多语，是大祸的阶梯。

interpretations.segmentation: A woman's long tongue is the stairway to great disaster.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: luan4 fei3 jiang4 zi4 tian1， sheng1 zi4 fu4 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 乱匪降自天，生自妇人。
interpretations.explanation: 祸乱不是从天而降，是生自妇人。

interpretations.segmentation: Chaos does not fall from Heaven—it is born of women.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: fei3 jiao4 fei3 hui4， shi2 wei2 fu4 si4。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪教匪诲，时维妇寺。
interpretations.explanation: 不是教不是诲，只是妇寺在左右。

interpretations.segmentation: Not teaching, not guiding—only women and eunuchs at the side.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: ju1 ren2 zhi4 te4。

interpretations.segmentation: 鞫人忮忒。
interpretations.explanation: 审问的人狠毒邪僻。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who judge are cruel and perverse.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: zen4 shi3 jing4 bei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 谮始竞背。
interpretations.explanation: 谗言一起，竞相背叛。

interpretations.segmentation: When slander begins, all vie to turn against one another.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: qi3 yue1 bu4 ji2？

interpretations.segmentation: 岂曰不极？
interpretations.explanation: 难道说没有极点吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Can one say there is no limit?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: yi1 hu2 wei4 te4？

interpretations.segmentation: 伊胡为慝？
interpretations.explanation: 为何做这种恶事？

interpretations.segmentation: Why commit such wickedness?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: ru2 jia3 san1 bei4， jun1 zi shi4 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 如贾三倍，君子是识。
interpretations.explanation: 像商人三倍之利，君子能识别。

interpretations.segmentation: Like a merchant's triple profit—the gentleman sees through it.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: fu4 wu2 gong1 shi4， xiu1 qi2 can2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 妇无公事，休其蚕织。
interpretations.explanation: 妇人不管公事，应休其蚕织之职。

interpretations.segmentation: Women have no public business—they should leave off silk and weaving.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: tian1 he2 yi3 la2？

interpretations.segmentation: 天何以剌？
interpretations.explanation: 上天为何责罚？

interpretations.segmentation: Why does Heaven punish so?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: he2 shen2 bu4 fu4？

interpretations.segmentation: 何神不富？
interpretations.explanation: 哪个神不富佑？

interpretations.segmentation: Which spirit does not enrich and bless?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: she3 er3 jie4 di2， wei2 yu3 xu1 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 舍尔介狄，维予胥忌。
interpretations.explanation: 舍弃你那大敌，只忌恨我一人。

interpretations.segmentation: You abandon your great foe and hate only me.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: bu4 diao4 bu4 xiang2， wei1 yi2 bu4 lei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不吊不祥，威仪不类。
interpretations.explanation: 不吊唁不祥，威仪不像样子。

interpretations.segmentation: No comfort for misfortune; deportment is no longer proper.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 yun2 wang2， bang1 guo2 tian3 cui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之云亡，邦国殄瘁。
interpretations.explanation: 人们说国家将亡，邦国濒于殄瘁。

interpretations.segmentation: People say the state will perish; the realm is near exhaustion.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 jiang4 wang3， wei2 qi2 you1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 天之降罔，维其优矣。
interpretations.explanation: 上天降下罗网，其势已很优厚（广布）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven casts its net—the spread is already wide.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 yun2 wang2， xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之云亡，心之忧矣。
interpretations.explanation: 人们说国家将亡，我心中忧愁。

interpretations.segmentation: People say the state will perish; my heart is full of care.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 jiang4 wang3， wei2 qi2 ji3 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 天之降罔，维其几矣。
interpretations.explanation: 上天降下罗网，其势已很迫近。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven casts its net—the danger is already near.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 yun2 wang2， xin1 zhi1 bei1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之云亡，心之悲矣。
interpretations.explanation: 人们说国家将亡，我心中悲伤。

interpretations.segmentation: People say the state will perish; my heart is full of grief.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: bi4 fei4 kan3 quan2， wei2 qi2 shen1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 觱沸槛泉，维其深矣。
interpretations.explanation: 槛泉沸腾，因为其深。

interpretations.segmentation: The spring in the enclosure boils because it is deep.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， ning2 zi4 jin1 yi3？

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，宁自今矣？
interpretations.explanation: 心中的忧愁，难道从今天才开始吗？

interpretations.segmentation: The heart's sorrow—did it only begin today?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: bu4 zi4 wo3 xian1， bu4 zi4 wo3 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不自我先，不自我后。
interpretations.explanation: 不是在我之前，不是在我之后。

interpretations.segmentation: It was not before me, nor after me alone.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: miao3 miao3 hao4 tian1， wu2 bu4 ke4 gong3。

interpretations.segmentation: 藐藐昊天，无不克巩。
interpretations.explanation: 高远昊天，没有什么不能巩固。

interpretations.segmentation: Remote Great Heaven—nothing cannot be secured.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang.pinyin: wu2 tian3 huang2 zu3， shi4 jiu4 er3 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 无忝皇祖，式救尔后。
interpretations.explanation: 不要辱没皇祖，用以拯救你的后代。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not disgrace your royal ancestors—save your descendants thereby.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: min2 tian1 ji2 wei1， tian1 du3 jiang4 sang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 旻天疾威，天笃降丧。
interpretations.explanation: 旻天威怒，上天厚降丧乱。

interpretations.segmentation: Min Heaven is fierce; High Heaven heavily sends ruin.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: dian1 wo3 ji1 jin3， min2 zu2 liu2 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 瘨我饥馑，民卒流亡。
interpretations.explanation: 使我遭饥荒，民众终至流亡。

interpretations.segmentation: It afflicts me with famine; the people at last flee and wander.
我居圉卒荒。
interpretations.explanation: 我居守的疆域终于荒芜。

interpretations.segmentation: The domain I guard is finally waste and wild.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: tian1 jiang4 zui4 gu3， mao2 zei2 nei4 hong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天降罪罟，蟊贼内讧。
interpretations.explanation: 天降罪网，蟊贼在内讧。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven lowers the net of guilt; pests riot within.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.content: 昏椓靡共，溃溃回遹，实靖夷我邦。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: hun1 zhuo2 mi2 gong4， kui4 kui4 hui2 yu4， shi2 jing4 yi2 wo3 bang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 昏椓靡共，溃溃回遹，实靖夷我邦。
interpretations.explanation: 昏乱之臣不能共事，溃散回遹，实在要安定而倾覆我邦。

interpretations.segmentation: Dark ministers cannot cooperate; they scatter and turn back— truly they would pacify yet overthrow our state.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: gao1 gao1 zi3 zi3， ceng2 bu4 zhi1 qi2 dian4。

interpretations.segmentation: 皋皋訿訿，曾不知其玷。
interpretations.explanation: 傲慢又多言，竟不知自己的污点。

interpretations.segmentation: Arrogant and babbling—they never know their own stains.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.content: 兢兢业业，孔填不宁，我位孔贬。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: jing1 jing1 ye4 ye4， kong3 tian2 bu4 ning2， wo3 wei4 kong3 bian3。

interpretations.segmentation: 兢兢业业，孔填不宁，我位孔贬。
interpretations.explanation: 兢兢业业，天下很不安宁，我的职位大被贬损。

interpretations.segmentation: Diligent and careful—the realm is deeply unsettled; my office is greatly diminished.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.content: 如彼岁旱，草不溃茂，如彼栖苴。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: ru2 bi3 sui4 han4， cao3 bu4 kui4 mao4， ru2 bi3 qi1 ju1。

interpretations.segmentation: 如彼岁旱，草不溃茂，如彼栖苴。
interpretations.explanation: 像那年大旱，草不能茂盛生长，像那枯草栖止。

interpretations.segmentation: Like the year of great drought when grass cannot flourish—like stubble where nothing thrives.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: wo3 xiang1 ci3 bang1， wu2 bu4 kui4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我相此邦，无不溃止。
interpretations.explanation: 我看这个邦国，没有不溃败而止的。

interpretations.segmentation: I look on this state—nothing fails to collapse and stop.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.content: 维昔之富不如时，维今之疚不如兹。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: wei2 xi1 zhi1 fu4 bu4 ru2 shi2， wei2 jin1 zhi1 jiu4 bu4 ru2 zi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维昔之富不如时，维今之疚不如兹。
interpretations.explanation: 往昔的富庶不如当时，如今的病痛不如此刻。

interpretations.segmentation: Past wealth was not like then; present affliction is not like now.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: bi3 shu1 si1 bai4， hu2 bu4 zi4 ti4？

interpretations.segmentation: 彼疏斯粺，胡不自替？
interpretations.explanation: 他们粗疏却享精粺，为何不自行引退？

interpretations.segmentation: They are careless yet eat fine grain—why do they not withdraw themselves?
职兄斯引。
interpretations.explanation: 只是兄长在引掖他们。

interpretations.segmentation: Only elder brothers draw them on.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: chi2 zhi1 jie2 yi3， bu4 yun2 zi4 pin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 池之竭矣，不云自频。
interpretations.explanation: 池塘干涸了，不是自频繁使用而竭？

interpretations.segmentation: The pool is dry—is it not from constant draining?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: quan2 zhi1 jie2 yi3， bu4 yun2 zi4 zhong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 泉之竭矣，不云自中。
interpretations.explanation: 泉水干涸了，不是自中心而竭？

interpretations.segmentation: The spring is dry—is it not from the center itself?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.content: 溥斯害矣，职兄斯弘，不灾我躬。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: pu3 si1 hai4 yi3， zhi2 xiong1 si1 hong2， bu4 zai1 wo3 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 溥斯害矣，职兄斯弘，不灾我躬。
interpretations.explanation: 灾害如此广大，只是兄长在扩大，灾祸不独及我一身。

interpretations.segmentation: Harm is so wide—elder brothers enlarge it; disaster does not fall on me alone.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.content: 昔先王受命，有如召公，日辟国百里，今也日蹙国百里。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: xi1 xian1 wang2 shou4 ming4， you3 ru2 zhao4 gong1， ri4 pi4 guo2 bai3 li3， jin1 ye3 ri4 cu4 guo2 bai3 li3。

interpretations.segmentation: 昔先王受命，有如召公，日辟国百里，今也日蹙国百里。
interpretations.explanation: 从前先王受命，有像召公那样的人，日日开拓国土百里；如今却日日缩小国土百里。

interpretations.segmentation: Former kings received the mandate; men like Duke Shao opened a hundred li daily—now a hundred li shrink each day.
于乎哀哉！
interpretations.explanation: 唉，可悲啊！

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, how lamentable!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin.pinyin: wei2 jin1 zhi1 ren2， bu4 shang4 you3 jiu4！

interpretations.segmentation: 维今之人，不尚有旧！
interpretations.explanation: 如今的人，还不崇尚旧德！

interpretations.segmentation: People today—do they not still honor the old virtue!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: tian1 sheng1 zheng1 min2， you3 wu4 you3 ze2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天生烝民，有物有则。
interpretations.explanation: 上天生众民，有物有则。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven born the multitude—there are things and there are norms.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: min2 zhi1 bing3 yi2， hao3 shi4 yi4 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之秉彝，好是懿德。
interpretations.explanation: 民众所秉常性，是喜好美德。

interpretations.segmentation: What the people constantly hold is love of fine virtue.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: tian1 jian1 you3 zhou1， zhao1 jia3 yu2 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天监有周，昭假于下。
interpretations.explanation: 上天监察有周，昭明降临于下。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven watches over Zhou; its brightness descends below.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: bao3 zi1 tian1 zi， sheng1 zhong4 shan1 fu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 保兹天子，生仲山甫。
interpretations.explanation: 保此天子，生仲山甫。

interpretations.segmentation: To guard this Son of Heaven, Zhong Shanfu was born.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: zhong4 shan1 fu3 zhi1 de2， rou2 jia1 wei2 ze2。

interpretations.segmentation: 仲山甫之德，柔嘉维则。
interpretations.explanation: 仲山甫的德行，柔和美好为准则。

interpretations.segmentation: Zhong Shanfu's virtue—gentle goodness is his standard.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: ling4 yi2 ling4 se4。

interpretations.segmentation: 令仪令色。
interpretations.explanation: 美好的仪态和神色。

interpretations.segmentation: Fine bearing and pleasing countenance.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: xiao3 xin1 yi4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 小心翼翼。
interpretations.explanation: 小心翼翼。

interpretations.segmentation: Careful and cautious.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: gu3 xun4 shi4 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 古训是式。
interpretations.explanation: 以古训为法式。

interpretations.segmentation: Ancient instruction is his model.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: wei1 yi2 shi4 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 威仪是力。
interpretations.explanation: 以威仪为努力方向。

interpretations.segmentation: He strives in dignified deportment.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: tian1 zi shi4 ruo4， ming2 ming4 shi3 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天子是若，明命使赋。
interpretations.explanation: 效法天子，明命使之赋政。

interpretations.segmentation: He follows the Son of Heaven; clear mandate assigns him governance.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.content: 王命仲山甫，式是百辟，缵戎祖考，王躬是保。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: wang2 ming4 zhong4 shan1 fu3， shi4 shi4 bai3 pi4， zuan3 rong2 zu3 kao3， wang2 gong1 shi4 bao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 王命仲山甫，式是百辟，缵戎祖考，王躬是保。
interpretations.explanation: 王命仲山甫，为百辟之表率，继承戎祖考，保卫王躬。

interpretations.segmentation: The king charges Zhong Shanfu to be model for the hundred ministers, continue his martial forefathers, and guard the king's person.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: chu1 na4 wang2 ming4， wang2 zhi1 hou2 she2。

interpretations.segmentation: 出纳王命，王之喉舌。
interpretations.explanation: 传达王命，是王的喉舌。

interpretations.segmentation: He conveys the king's commands—he is the king's voice.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: fu4 zheng4 yu2 wai4， si4 fang1 yuan2 fa1。

interpretations.segmentation: 赋政于外，四方爰发。
interpretations.explanation: 在外施政，四方因而发令。

interpretations.segmentation: He administers abroad; the four quarters thereby receive orders.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: su4 su4 wang2 ming4， zhong4 shan1 fu3 jiang1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 肃肃王命，仲山甫将之。
interpretations.explanation: 严肃的王命，仲山甫奉持而行。

interpretations.segmentation: Solemn royal commands—Zhong Shanfu carries them out.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: bang1 guo2 ruo4 fou3， zhong4 shan1 fu3 ming2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 邦国若否，仲山甫明之。
interpretations.explanation: 邦国好坏，仲山甫能辨明。

interpretations.segmentation: Whether states thrive or fail—Zhong Shanfu discerns it.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: ji4 ming2 qie3 zhe2， yi3 bao3 qi2 shen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 既明且哲，以保其身。
interpretations.explanation: 既明察又智慧，以保全自身。

interpretations.segmentation: Clear-sighted and wise, he preserves himself.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: su4 ye4 fei3 jie3， yi3 shi4 yi1 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 夙夜匪解，以事一人。
interpretations.explanation: 早晚不懈，以事奉君王一人。

interpretations.segmentation: Morning and night without slackness, he serves the one king.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.content: 人亦有言，柔则茹之，刚则吐之。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: ren2 yi4 you3 yan2， rou2 ze2 ru2 zhi1， gang1 ze2 tu3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 人亦有言，柔则茹之，刚则吐之。
interpretations.explanation: 人们也说：软的就吞下去，硬的就吐出来。

interpretations.segmentation: People also say: swallow what is soft, spit out what is hard.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.content: 维仲山甫，柔亦不茹，刚亦不吐。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: wei2 zhong4 shan1 fu3， rou2 yi4 bu4 ru2， gang1 yi4 bu4 tu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 维仲山甫，柔亦不茹，刚亦不吐。
interpretations.explanation: 只有仲山甫，柔的不吞，硬的不吐。

interpretations.segmentation: Only Zhong Shanfu—soft he does not swallow, hard he does not spit.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: bu4 wu3 jin1 gua3， bu4 wei4 qiang2 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不侮矜寡，不畏强御。
interpretations.explanation: 不欺侮鳏寡，不畏强暴。

interpretations.segmentation: He does not bully widows and orphans, nor fear the strong and violent.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.content: 人亦有言，德輶如毛，民鲜克举之。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: ren2 yi4 you3 yan2， de2 you2 ru2 mao2， min2 xian1 ke4 ju3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 人亦有言，德輶如毛，民鲜克举之。
interpretations.explanation: 人们也说：德行轻如毛，民众很少能举起来。

interpretations.segmentation: People also say: virtue is light as a feather—few can lift it.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.content: 我仪图之，维仲山甫举之。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: wo3 yi2 tu2 zhi1， wei2 zhong4 shan1 fu3 ju3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我仪图之，维仲山甫举之。
interpretations.explanation: 我思量这件事，只有仲山甫能举之。

interpretations.segmentation: I consider it—only Zhong Shanfu can raise it.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: ai4 mo4 zhu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 爱莫助之。
interpretations.explanation: 爱莫能助啊。

interpretations.segmentation: Beloved, yet none can help him.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.content: 衮职有阙，维仲山甫补之。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: gun3 zhi2 you3 que1， wei2 zhong4 shan1 fu3 bu3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 衮职有阙，维仲山甫补之。
interpretations.explanation: 天子衮衣有缺，只有仲山甫能补。

interpretations.segmentation: Where the king's robe lacks, only Zhong Shanfu can mend.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: zhong4 shan1 fu3 chu1 zu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 仲山甫出祖。
interpretations.explanation: 仲山甫出祖饯行。

interpretations.segmentation: Zhong Shanfu sets out; they sacrifice and see him off.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: si4 mu3 ye4 ye4。

interpretations.segmentation: 四牡业业。
interpretations.explanation: 四匹雄马高大雄壮。

interpretations.segmentation: Four stallions, tall and strong.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: zheng1 fu1 jie2 jie2， mei3 huai2 mi2 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 征夫捷捷，每怀靡及。
interpretations.explanation: 征夫敏捷，每怀来不及之感。

interpretations.segmentation: The travelers are swift; each feels he cannot do enough.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: si4 mu3 peng2 peng2， ba1 luan2 qiang1 qiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 四牡彭彭，八鸾锵锵。
interpretations.explanation: 四马彭彭，八鸾锵锵。

interpretations.segmentation: Four horses gallop; eight bells ring clear.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: wang2 ming4 zhong4 shan1 fu3， cheng2 bi3 dong1 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 王命仲山甫，城彼东方。
interpretations.explanation: 王命仲山甫，筑城于东方。

interpretations.segmentation: The king charges Zhong Shanfu to build the city in the east.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: si4 mu3 kui2 kui2， ba1 luan2 jie1 jie1。

interpretations.segmentation: 四牡骙骙，八鸾喈喈。
interpretations.explanation: 四马骙骙，八鸾喈喈。

interpretations.segmentation: Four horses prance; eight bells chime softly.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: zhong4 shan1 fu3 cu2 qi2， shi4 chuan2 qi2 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 仲山甫徂齐，式遄其归。
interpretations.explanation: 仲山甫往齐，应速速归来。

interpretations.segmentation: Zhong Shanfu goes to Qi—may he quickly return.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: ji2 fu3 zuo4 song4， mu4 ru2 qing1 feng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 吉甫作诵，穆如清风。
interpretations.explanation: 吉甫作此颂诗，和美如清风。

interpretations.segmentation: Jifu composed this ode—graceful as a clear breeze.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin.pinyin: zhong4 shan1 fu3 yong3 huai2， yi3 wei4 qi2 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 仲山甫永怀，以慰其心。
interpretations.explanation: 仲山甫永怀德业，以慰其心。

interpretations.segmentation: Zhong Shanfu ever cherishes virtue—to comfort his heart.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: shang4 di4 ban3 ban3， xia4 min2 zu2 dan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 上帝板板，下民卒瘅。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝邪僻，下民终于病苦。

interpretations.segmentation: High God is perverse; the people at last fall ill.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: chu1 hua4 bu4 ran2， wei4 you2 bu4 yuan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 出话不然，为犹不远。
interpretations.explanation: 说出的话不对，作为犹不算远。

interpretations.segmentation: Words spoken are not true; conduct is not yet far gone.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: mi2 sheng4 guan3 guan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 靡圣管管。
interpretations.explanation: 没有圣明却纷乱。

interpretations.segmentation: No sage, yet all is confusion.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: bu4 shi2 yu2 dan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 不实于亶。
interpretations.explanation: 不实在于诚信。

interpretations.segmentation: Not rooted in sincerity.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: you2 zhi1 wei4 yuan3， shi4 yong4 da4 jian4。

interpretations.segmentation: 犹之未远，是用大谏。
interpretations.explanation: 祸犹未远，因此大力进谏。

interpretations.segmentation: Disaster is not yet far—therefore I strongly remonstrate.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 fang1 nan2， wu2 ran2 xian4 xian4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天之方难，无然宪宪。
interpretations.explanation: 上天正降难，不要那么高兴自得。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven sends hardship—do not be so gleeful and pleased.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 fang1 jue2， wu2 ran2 xie4 xie4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天之方蹶，无然泄泄。
interpretations.explanation: 上天正颠覆，不要那么轻慢泄泄。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven is overturning—do not be so lax and dismissive.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: ci2 zhi1 ji2 yi3， min2 zhi1 qia4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 辞之辑矣，民之洽矣。
interpretations.explanation: 言辞和顺了，民众就和洽了。

interpretations.segmentation: When words are harmonious, the people are united.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: ci2 zhi1 yi4 yi3， min2 zhi1 mo4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 辞之怿矣，民之莫矣。
interpretations.explanation: 言辞悦乐了，民众就归附了。

interpretations.segmentation: When words delight, the people attach to you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: wo3 sui1 yi4 shi4， ji2 er3 tong2 liao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我虽异事，及尔同僚。
interpretations.explanation: 我虽事不同，却与你同僚。

interpretations.segmentation: Though my duties differ, I am your colleague.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: wo3 ji2 er3 mou2， ting1 wo3 xiao1 xiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我即尔谋，听我嚣嚣。
interpretations.explanation: 我到你那里谋划，听我说话却嚣嚣不服。

interpretations.segmentation: I come to counsel with you—you listen yet clamor and refuse.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: wo3 yan2 wei2 fu2， wu4 yi3 wei4 xiao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我言维服，勿以为笑。
interpretations.explanation: 我的话有理，不要当作笑话。

interpretations.segmentation: My words have reason—do not take them for jest.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: xian1 min2 you3 yan2， xun2 yu2 chu2 rao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 先民有言，询于刍荛。
interpretations.explanation: 先民有言：向樵夫询问。

interpretations.segmentation: The ancients said: inquire even of the firewood gatherer.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 fang1 nve4， wu2 ran2 xue4 xue4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天之方虐，无然谑谑。
interpretations.explanation: 上天正降虐，不要那么戏谑。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven sends affliction—do not be so mocking.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: lao3 fu1 guan4 guan4， xiao3 zi jue1 jue1。

interpretations.segmentation: 老夫灌灌，小子蹻蹻。
interpretations.explanation: 老夫昏乱，小子骄蹻。

interpretations.segmentation: The old man is muddled; the youth is arrogant.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: fei3 wo3 yan2 mao4， er3 yong4 you1 xue4。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪我言耄，尔用忧谑。
interpretations.explanation: 不是我说老，是你用来忧而戏之。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not that I speak as an old man—you use worry for sport.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: duo1 jiang1 he4 he4， bu4 ke3 jiu4 yao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 多将熇熇，不可救药。
interpretations.explanation: 多行暴虐，不可救药。

interpretations.segmentation: Much cruelty—beyond remedy.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 fang1 qi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天之方懠。
interpretations.explanation: 上天正愤怒。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven is angry.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: wu2 wei4 kua1 pi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 无为夸毗。
interpretations.explanation: 不要放纵偏邪。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not indulge crooked partiality.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: wei1 yi2 zu2 mi2， shan4 ren2 zai4 shi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 威仪卒迷，善人载尸。
interpretations.explanation: 威仪终于迷乱，善人载尸而行。

interpretations.segmentation: Deportment ends in confusion; good men bear corpses.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.content: 民之方殿屎，则莫我敢葵？
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: min2 zhi1 fang1 dian4 shi3， ze2 mo4 wo3 gan3 kui2？

interpretations.segmentation: 民之方殿屎，则莫我敢葵？
interpretations.explanation: 民众正遭祸，谁还敢向我示好？

interpretations.segmentation: The people suffer disaster—who dares show me favor?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: sang4 luan4 mie4 zi1， ceng2 mo4 hui4 wo3 shi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 丧乱蔑资，曾莫惠我师？
interpretations.explanation: 丧乱无资，竟不施惠于我师？

interpretations.segmentation: In ruin there is no means—will you not show kindness to my mentor?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.content: 天之牖民，如埙如篪，如璋如圭，如取如携。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 you3 min2， ru2 xun1 ru2 chi2， ru2 zhang1 ru2 gui1， ru2 qu3 ru2 xie2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天之牖民，如埙如篪，如璋如圭，如取如携。
interpretations.explanation: 上天诱导民众，如埙如篪，如璋如圭，如取如携。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven guides the people—as xun and chi, as scepter and tablet, as taking and as leading.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: xie2 wu2 yue1 yi4， you3 min2 kong3 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 携无曰益，牖民孔易。
interpretations.explanation: 携民不要说有益，诱导民众很容易。

interpretations.segmentation: In leading the people do not say it profits you—guiding the people is very easy.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: min2 zhi1 duo1 pi4， wu2 zi4 li4 pi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之多辟，无自立辟。
interpretations.explanation: 民众多邪僻，不要自己立邪僻。

interpretations.segmentation: The people are much perverse—do not yourself establish perversity.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.content: 价人维藩，大师维垣，大邦维屏，大宗维翰，
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: jia4 ren2 wei2 fan1， da4 shi1 wei2 yuan2， da4 bang1 wei2 ping2， da4 zong1 wei2 han4，

interpretations.segmentation: 价人维藩，大师维垣，大邦维屏，大宗维翰，
interpretations.explanation: 价人如藩屏，大师如垣墙，大邦如屏障，大宗如翰辅，

interpretations.segmentation: Good men are hedges; the grand master is a wall; great states are screens; the royal clan are pillars,

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: huai2 de2 wei2 ning2， zong1 zi wei2 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 怀德维宁，宗子维城。
interpretations.explanation: 怀德则安宁，宗子如城墙。

interpretations.segmentation: Cherish virtue and there is peace; clan sons are like city walls.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: wu2 bi3 cheng2 huai4， wu2 du2 si1 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 无俾城坏，无独斯畏。
interpretations.explanation: 不要使城墙毁坏，不要独自畏惧。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not let the wall crumble; do not fear alone.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban.pinyin: jing4 tian1 zhi1 nu4， wu2 gan3 xi4 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: He sought to unite the people and brighten the realm; bows and arrows were strung.

interpretations.segmentation: Solemn and majestic in bearing, fit to be lord and fit to be king.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale.pinyin: zhi1 gang1 zhi1 ji4， yan4 ji2 peng2 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 之纲之纪，燕及朋友。
interpretations.explanation: 以纲纪天下，又使燕乐及于朋友。

interpretations.segmentation: As the world's standard, he brings ease and joy even to friends.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale.pinyin: bai3 pi4 qing1 shi4， mei4 yu2 tian1 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 百辟卿士，媚于天子。
interpretations.explanation: 百辟与卿士，皆向天子献媚尽忠。

interpretations.segmentation: The feudal lords and ministers all show devotion to the Son of Heaven.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale.pinyin: bu4 jie3 yu2 wei4， min2 zhi1 you1 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不解于位，民之攸塈。
interpretations.explanation: 不懈于职守，是百姓所仰赖的安乐。

interpretations.segmentation: Unwearying in office, he is the people's source of peace.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo.content: 泂酌彼行潦，挹彼注兹，可以餴饎。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo.pinyin: jiong3 zhuo2 bi3 xing2 lao3， yi4 bi3 zhu4 zi1， ke3 yi3 fen1 chi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 泂酌彼行潦，挹彼注兹，可以餴饎。
interpretations.explanation: 从远地的水洼中舀水，倾注到此，可以用来淘洗米、做饭。

interpretations.segmentation: Draw from distant roadside pools, pour here—fit to rinse grain and cook food.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo.pinyin: qi3 di4 jun1 zi， min2 zhi1 fu4 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂弟君子，民之父母。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，正是百姓的父母。

interpretations.segmentation: The gracious lord is truly the parent of the people.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo.content: 泂酌彼行潦，挹彼注兹，可以濯罍。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo.pinyin: jiong3 zhuo2 bi3 xing2 lao3， yi4 bi3 zhu4 zi1， ke3 yi3 zhuo2 lei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 泂酌彼行潦，挹彼注兹，可以濯罍。
interpretations.explanation: 从远地的水洼中舀水，倾注到此，可以用来洗涤酒器。

interpretations.segmentation: Draw from distant pools, pour here—fit to wash the wine vessels.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo.pinyin: qi3 di4 jun1 zi， min2 zhi1 you1 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂弟君子，民之攸归。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，是百姓所归向的人。

interpretations.segmentation: The gracious lord is where the people turn for refuge.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo.content: 泂酌彼行潦，挹彼注兹，可以濯溉。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo.pinyin: jiong3 zhuo2 bi3 xing2 lao3， yi4 bi3 zhu4 zi1， ke3 yi3 zhuo2 gai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 泂酌彼行潦，挹彼注兹，可以濯溉。
interpretations.explanation: 从远地的水洼中舀水，倾注到此，可以用来洗涤各种器具。

interpretations.segmentation: Draw from distant pools, pour here—fit to cleanse all utensils.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo.pinyin: qi3 di4 jun1 zi， min2 zhi1 you1 xi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂弟君子，民之攸墍。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，是百姓所依赖安居者。

interpretations.segmentation: The gracious lord is the one on whom the people rely for rest.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: ji4 zui4 yi3 jiu3， ji4 bao3 yi3 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既醉以酒，既饱以德。
interpretations.explanation: 既以美酒使君醉，又以美德使君饱足。

interpretations.segmentation: They have drunk their fill of wine and been nourished by virtue.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: jun1 zi wan4 nian2， jie4 er3 jing3 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子万年，介尔景福。
interpretations.explanation: 愿君子万年长寿，大大赐你景福。

interpretations.segmentation: May the lord live ten thousand years—great blessing be granted you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: ji4 zui4 yi3 jiu3， er3 yao2 ji4 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 既醉以酒，尔肴既将。
interpretations.explanation: 既以美酒使君醉，你的肴馔也已齐备。

interpretations.segmentation: They have drunk their fill; your dishes are all ready.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: jun1 zi wan4 nian2， jie4 er3 zhao1 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子万年，介尔昭明。
interpretations.explanation: 愿君子万年长寿，大大赐你昭明之福。

interpretations.segmentation: May the lord live ten thousand years—bright blessing be granted you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.content: 昭明有融，高朗令终，令终有俶。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: zhao1 ming2 you3 rong2， gao1 lang3 ling4 zhong1， ling4 zhong1 you3 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 昭明有融，高朗令终，令终有俶。
interpretations.explanation: 昭明之德融会贯通，高明而善终，善始而又有后继。

interpretations.segmentation: Bright virtue merges and flows; noble ending with a fine beginning to follow.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: gong1 shi1 jia1 gao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 公尸嘉告。
interpretations.explanation: 尸官于是致美善的祝告。

interpretations.segmentation: The impersonator of the dead now speaks the good blessing.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: qi2 gao4 wei2 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 其告维何？
interpretations.explanation: 祝告的内容是什么呢？

interpretations.segmentation: What does the blessing say?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: bian1 dou4 jing4 jia1。

interpretations.segmentation: 笾豆静嘉。
interpretations.explanation: 笾豆中的祭品洁净而美好。

interpretations.segmentation: The offerings in baskets and stands are pure and fine.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: peng2 you3 you1 she4， she4 yi3 wei1 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 朋友攸摄，摄以威仪。
interpretations.explanation: 朋友相佐助，以威仪相辅助。

interpretations.segmentation: Friends assist one another and uphold each other in proper ritual bearing.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: wei1 yi2 kong3 shi2， jun1 zi you3 xiao4 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 威仪孔时，君子有孝子。
interpretations.explanation: 威仪非常合宜，君子有孝子之德。

interpretations.segmentation: The ceremony is perfectly ordered; the lord has filial sons.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: xiao4 zi bu4 kui4， yong3 xi1 er3 lei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 孝子不匮，永锡尔类。
interpretations.explanation: 孝子之德不会匮乏，永远赐福于你的同类。

interpretations.segmentation: Filial virtue never fails; blessing forever extends to your kind.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: qi2 lei4 wei2 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 其类维何？
interpretations.explanation: 所说的同类是什么呢？

interpretations.segmentation: What kind is meant?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: shi4 jia1 zhi1 hu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 室家之壶。
interpretations.explanation: 就是室家中的福庆。

interpretations.segmentation: The blessing within household and family.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: jun1 zi wan4 nian2， yong3 xi1 zuo4 yin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子万年，永锡祚胤。
interpretations.explanation: 愿君子万年长寿，永远赐你福祚子孙。

interpretations.segmentation: May the lord live ten thousand years—may fortune and heirs be yours forever.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: qi2 yin4 wei2 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 其胤维何？
interpretations.explanation: 所说的子孙是什么呢？

interpretations.segmentation: What heirs are meant?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: tian1 bei4 er3 lu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天被尔禄。
interpretations.explanation: 上天覆盖所赐的福禄。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven's covering gift of blessing and rank.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: jun1 zi wan4 nian2， jing3 ming4 you3 pu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子万年，景命有仆。
interpretations.explanation: 愿君子万年长寿，大命之下有仆从相承。

interpretations.segmentation: May the lord live ten thousand years—under great mandate, servants follow in succession.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: qi2 pu1 wei2 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 其仆维何？
interpretations.explanation: 所说的仆从是什么呢？

interpretations.segmentation: What servants are meant?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: li2 er3 nv3 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 厘尔女士。
interpretations.explanation: 赐你贤善的女子。

interpretations.segmentation: Grant you worthy ladies.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui.pinyin: li2 er3 nv3 shi4， cong2 yi3 sun1 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 厘尔女士，从以孙子。
interpretations.explanation: 赐你贤善的女子，从而生养孙子。

interpretations.segmentation: Grant worthy ladies, that they may bear grandsons for you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 有卷者阿，飘风自南。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: you3 juan3 zhe3 a1， piao1 feng1 zi4 nan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有卷者阿，飘风自南。
interpretations.explanation: 有曲长的山阿，旋风从南方吹来。

interpretations.segmentation: A winding hill slope; a gusty wind blows from the south.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 岂弟君子，来游来歌，以矢其音。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: qi3 di4 jun1 zi， lai2 you2 lai2 ge1， yi3 shi3 qi2 yin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂弟君子，来游来歌，以矢其音。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，来游息、来歌唱，以发抒心声。

interpretations.segmentation: The gracious lord comes to roam and sing, giving voice to his heart.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 伴奂尔游矣，优游尔休矣。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: ban4 huan4 er3 you2 yi3， you1 you2 er3 xiu1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 伴奂尔游矣，优游尔休矣。
interpretations.explanation: 伴你遨游而光大，伴你优游而休息。

interpretations.segmentation: He brightens your roaming and grants you leisure and rest.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 岂弟君子，俾尔弥尔性，似先公酋矣。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: qi3 di4 jun1 zi， bi3 er3 mi2 er3 xing4， shi4 xian1 gong1 qiu2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂弟君子，俾尔弥尔性，似先公酋矣。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，使你完全顺遂本性，像先代贤君一样。

interpretations.segmentation: The gracious lord lets you fulfill your nature, like the ancient chiefs of old.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 尔土宇昄章，亦孔之厚矣。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: er3 tu3 yu3 ban3 zhang1， yi4 kong3 zhi1 hou4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔土宇昄章，亦孔之厚矣。
interpretations.explanation: 你的国土广大而有章法，也非常深厚。

interpretations.segmentation: Your domain is broad and well ordered, and very deep in foundation.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 岂弟君子，俾尔弥尔性，百神尔主矣。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: qi3 di4 jun1 zi， bi3 er3 mi2 er3 xing4， bai3 shen2 er3 zhu3 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂弟君子，俾尔弥尔性，百神尔主矣。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，使你完全顺遂本性，百神都为你做主。

interpretations.segmentation: The gracious lord lets you fulfill your nature; the hundred spirits stand with you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 尔受命长矣，茀禄尔康矣。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: er3 shou4 ming4 zhang3 yi3， fu2 lu4 er3 kang1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔受命长矣，茀禄尔康矣。
interpretations.explanation: 你受命长久，福禄康宁。

interpretations.segmentation: Long is your mandate; blessing and peace are yours.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 岂弟君子，俾尔弥尔性，纯嘏尔常矣。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: qi3 di4 jun1 zi， bi3 er3 mi2 er3 xing4， chun2 gu3 er3 chang2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂弟君子，俾尔弥尔性，纯嘏尔常矣。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，使你完全顺遂本性，纯厚之福常在你身。

interpretations.segmentation: The gracious lord lets you fulfill your nature; pure blessing stays with you always.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 有冯有翼，有孝有德，以引以翼。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: you3 feng2 you3 yi4， you3 xiao4 you3 de2， yi3 yin3 yi3 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 有冯有翼，有孝有德，以引以翼。
interpretations.explanation: 有凭依、有辅助，有孝心、有德行，引道你、翼护你。

interpretations.segmentation: With support and aid, with filial piety and virtue, they guide and shelter you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 岂弟君子，四方为则。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: qi3 di4 jun1 zi， si4 fang1 wei4 ze2。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂弟君子，四方为则。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，是四方的表率。

interpretations.segmentation: The gracious lord is the model for all four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 颙颙卬卬，如圭如璋，令闻令望。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: yong2 yong2 ang2 ang2， ru2 gui1 ru2 zhang1， ling4 wen2 ling4 wang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 颙颙卬卬，如圭如璋，令闻令望。
interpretations.explanation: 仪态端正、气宇轩昂，如圭如璋，美名远播。

interpretations.segmentation: Upright and lofty in bearing, like jade scepters— famed and hoped for afar.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 岂弟君子，四方为纲。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: qi3 di4 jun1 zi， si4 fang1 wei4 gang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂弟君子，四方为纲。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，是四方的纲纪。

interpretations.segmentation: The gracious lord is the standard for all four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 凤凰于飞，翙翙其羽，亦集爰止。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: feng4 huang2 yu2 fei1， hui4 hui4 qi2 yu3， yi4 ji2 yuan2 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 凤凰于飞，翙翙其羽，亦集爰止。
interpretations.explanation: 凤凰飞翔，羽翼翙翙，也停落在此。

interpretations.segmentation: The phoenix flies, wings fluttering, and alights here as well.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 蔼蔼王多吉士，维君子使，媚于天子。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: ai3 ai3 wang2 duo1 ji2 shi4， wei2 jun1 zi shi3， mei4 yu2 tian1 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 蔼蔼王多吉士，维君子使，媚于天子。
interpretations.explanation: 众多贤士辅佐周王，由君子差遣，向天子尽忠。

interpretations.segmentation: Many worthy men serve the king; the lord sends them to please the Son of Heaven.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 凤凰于飞，翙翙其羽，亦傅于天。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: feng4 huang2 yu2 fei1， hui4 hui4 qi2 yu3， yi4 fu4 yu2 tian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 凤凰于飞，翙翙其羽，亦傅于天。
interpretations.explanation: 凤凰飞翔，羽翼翙翙，也附于上天。

interpretations.segmentation: The phoenix flies, wings fluttering, rising toward Heaven.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 蔼蔼王多吉人，维君子命，媚于庶人。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: ai3 ai3 wang2 duo1 ji2 ren2， wei2 jun1 zi ming4， mei4 yu2 shu4 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 蔼蔼王多吉人，维君子命，媚于庶人。
interpretations.explanation: 众多贤人辅佐周王，由君子任命，使庶人悦服。

interpretations.segmentation: Many good men serve the king; the lord appoints them to win the common people's trust.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 凤凰鸣矣，于彼高冈。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: feng4 huang2 ming2 yi3， yu2 bi3 gao1 gang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 凤凰鸣矣，于彼高冈。
interpretations.explanation: 凤凰鸣叫，在那高冈之上。

interpretations.segmentation: The phoenix calls upon the high hill.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 梧桐生矣，于彼朝阳。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: wu2 tong2 sheng1 yi3， yu2 bi3 chao2 yang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 梧桐生矣，于彼朝阳。
interpretations.explanation: 梧桐生长，在那朝阳之侧。

interpretations.segmentation: The parasol tree grows on the sunny slope.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 菶菶萋萋，雍雍喈喈。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: beng3 beng3 qi1 qi1， yong1 yong1 jie1 jie1。

interpretations.segmentation: 菶菶萋萋，雍雍喈喈。
interpretations.explanation: 叶盛枝繁，和鸣喈喈。

interpretations.segmentation: Leaves lush and branches thick; harmonious cries ring clear.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 君子之车，既庶且多。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: jun1 zi zhi1 che1， ji4 shu4 qie3 duo1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子之车，既庶且多。
interpretations.explanation: 君子的车驾，既众又多。

interpretations.segmentation: The lord's chariots are many and ample.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 君子之马，既闲且驰。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: jun1 zi zhi1 ma3， ji4 xian2 qie3 chi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子之马，既闲且驰。
interpretations.explanation: 君子的马匹，既熟练又善驰。

interpretations.segmentation: The lord's horses are trained and swift.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.content: 矢诗不多，维以遂歌。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana.pinyin: shi3 shi1 bu4 duo1， wei2 yi3 sui4 ge1。

interpretations.segmentation: 矢诗不多，维以遂歌。
interpretations.explanation: 所献之诗不多，只是用来完成歌咏。

interpretations.segmentation: The poems offered are not many—just enough to complete the song.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: min2 yi4 lao2 zhi3， qi4 ke3 xiao3 kang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民亦劳止，汔可小康。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓也已劳顿，差不多可以稍得小康。

interpretations.segmentation: The people are weary; they may now reach a little ease.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: hui4 ci3 zhong1 guo2， yi3 sui2 si4 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 惠此中国，以绥四方。
interpretations.explanation: 施恩于此中原各国，以安抚四方。

interpretations.segmentation: Show kindness to the central states and pacify the four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: wu2 zong4 gui3 sui2， yi3 jin3 wu2 liang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 无纵诡随，以谨无良。
interpretations.explanation: 不要放纵狡诈之徒，以防范无良之人。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not indulge the deceitful; guard against the unworthy.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: shi4 e4 kou4 nve4， can3 bu4 wei4 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 式遏寇虐，憯不畏明。
interpretations.explanation: 要遏止寇虐，使恶人不敢藐视明法。

interpretations.segmentation: Restrain robbery and cruelty so evildoers dare not scorn the law.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: rou2 yuan3 neng2 er3， yi3 ding4 wo3 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 柔远能迩，以定我王。
interpretations.explanation: 安抚远方、亲善近邻，以安定我周之王。

interpretations.segmentation: Soothe the far and cherish the near, to secure our king's throne.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: min2 yi4 lao2 zhi3， qi4 ke3 xiao3 xiu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民亦劳止，汔可小休。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓也已劳顿，差不多可以稍得休息。

interpretations.segmentation: The people are weary; they may now rest a little.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: hui4 ci3 zhong1 guo2， yi3 wei4 min2 qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 惠此中国，以为民逑。
interpretations.explanation: 施恩于此中原各国，以聚民为归依。

interpretations.segmentation: Show kindness to the central states and gather the people to you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: wu2 zong4 gui3 sui2， yi3 jin3 hun1 nao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 无纵诡随，以谨惛怓。
interpretations.explanation: 不要放纵狡诈之徒，以防范惑乱人心者。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not indulge the deceitful; guard against those who stir confusion.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: shi4 e4 kou4 nve4， wu2 bi3 min2 you1。

interpretations.segmentation: 式遏寇虐，无俾民忧。
interpretations.explanation: 要遏止寇虐，勿使百姓忧愁。

interpretations.segmentation: Restrain robbery and cruelty; do not let the people grieve.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: wu2 qi4 er3 lao2， yi3 wei4 wang2 xiu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无弃尔劳，以为王休。
interpretations.explanation: 不要抛弃你的劳绩，以成王事之休美。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not cast away your achievements; let the king's work reach its good end.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: min2 yi4 lao2 zhi3， qi4 ke3 xiao3 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民亦劳止，汔可小息。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓也已劳顿，差不多可以稍得喘息。

interpretations.segmentation: The people are weary; they may now breathe a little.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: hui4 ci3 jing1 shi1， yi3 sui2 si4 guo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 惠此京师，以绥四国。
interpretations.explanation: 施恩于此京师，以安抚四国。

interpretations.segmentation: Show kindness to the capital and pacify the four states.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: wu2 zong4 gui3 sui2， yi3 jin3 wang3 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 无纵诡随，以谨罔极。
interpretations.explanation: 不要放纵狡诈之徒，以防范无穷之网。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not indulge the deceitful; guard against boundless snares.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: shi4 e4 kou4 nve4， wu2 bi3 zuo4 te4。

interpretations.segmentation: 式遏寇虐，无俾作慝。
interpretations.explanation: 要遏止寇虐，勿使造作恶事。

interpretations.segmentation: Restrain robbery and cruelty; do not let evil deeds be done.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: jing4 shen4 wei1 yi2， yi3 jin4 you3 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 敬慎威仪，以近有德。
interpretations.explanation: 敬慎威仪，以亲近有德之人。

interpretations.segmentation: Be reverent in bearing and draw near to the virtuous.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: min2 yi4 lao2 zhi3， qi4 ke3 xiao3 kai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 民亦劳止，汔可小愒。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓也已劳顿，差不多可以稍得歇息。

interpretations.segmentation: The people are weary; they may now pause a little.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: hui4 ci3 zhong1 guo2， bi3 min2 you1 xie4。

interpretations.segmentation: 惠此中国，俾民忧泄。
interpretations.explanation: 施恩于此中原各国，使百姓忧苦得以宣泄。

interpretations.segmentation: Show kindness to the central states and let the people's woes drain away.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: wu2 zong4 gui3 sui2， yi3 jin3 chou3 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 无纵诡随，以谨丑厉。
interpretations.explanation: 不要放纵狡诈之徒，以防范丑恶祸害。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not indulge the deceitful; guard against foul calamities.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: shi4 e4 kou4 nve4， wu2 bi3 zheng4 bai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 式遏寇虐，无俾正败。
interpretations.explanation: 要遏止寇虐，勿使正道败坏。

interpretations.segmentation: Restrain robbery and cruelty; do not let the right way be ruined.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: rong2 sui1 xiao3 zi， er2 shi4 hong2 da4。

interpretations.segmentation: 戎虽小子，而式弘大。
interpretations.explanation: 戎虽年轻，却有大志宏谋。

interpretations.segmentation: Though Rong is young, his plans are great and far-reaching.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: min2 yi4 lao2 zhi3， qi4 ke3 xiao3 an1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民亦劳止，汔可小安。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓也已劳顿，差不多可以稍得安宁。

interpretations.segmentation: The people are weary; they may now find a little peace.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: hui4 ci3 zhong1 guo2， guo2 wu2 you3 can2。

interpretations.segmentation: 惠此中国，国无有残。
interpretations.explanation: 施恩于此中原各国，使国中无残破之患。

interpretations.segmentation: Show kindness to the central states so the realm knows no ruin.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: wu2 zong4 gui3 sui2， yi3 jin3 qian3 quan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 无纵诡随，以谨缱绻。
interpretations.explanation: 不要放纵狡诈之徒，以防范结党营私。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not indulge the deceitful; guard against cliques and favoritism.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: shi4 e4 kou4 nve4， wu2 bi3 zheng4 fan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 式遏寇虐，无俾正反。
interpretations.explanation: 要遏止寇虐，勿使正反颠倒。

interpretations.segmentation: Restrain robbery and cruelty; do not let right and wrong be reversed.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao.pinyin: wang2 yu4 yu4 nv3， shi4 yong4 da4 jian4。

interpretations.segmentation: 王欲玉女，是用大谏。
interpretations.explanation: 王欲以玉护民、惜民如宝，故作此大谏。

interpretations.segmentation: The king wishes to cherish the people like jade; therefore this great remonstrance is offered.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: jue2 chu1 sheng1 min2， shi2 wei2 jiang1 yuan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 厥初生民，时维姜嫄。
interpretations.explanation: 最初生养我民，那时是姜嫄。

interpretations.segmentation: When our people first arose, it was Jiang Yuan.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: sheng1 min2 ru2 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 生民如何？
interpretations.explanation: 人民是怎么来的呢？

interpretations.segmentation: How did the people come to be?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: ke4 yin1 ke4 si4， yi3 fu2 wu2 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 克禋克祀，以弗无子。
interpretations.explanation: 能禋祭、能祀神，以祈消除无子之憾。

interpretations.segmentation: She could offer pure sacrifice and pray to remove the grief of childlessness.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.content: 履帝武敏歆，攸介攸止，载震载夙。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: lv3 di4 wu3 min3 xin1， you1 jie4 you1 zhi3， zai4 zhen4 zai4 su4。

interpretations.segmentation: 履帝武敏歆，攸介攸止，载震载夙。
interpretations.explanation: 踩了帝迹而敏动，于是怀孕止息，既震且夙。

interpretations.segmentation: She trod the Lord's footprint, conceived, and felt both awe and haste.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: zai4 sheng1 zai4 yu4， shi2 wei2 hou4 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 载生载育，时维后稷。
interpretations.explanation: 既生又养，这时就是后稷。

interpretations.segmentation: She bore and nurtured him—this was Hou Ji.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: dan4 mi2 jue2 yue4， xian1 sheng1 ru2 da2。

interpretations.segmentation: 诞弥厥月，先生如达。
interpretations.explanation: 满十月而产，生时如破壳般顺利。

interpretations.segmentation: When her month was full, birth came as easily as shell cracking open.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: bu4 chai1 bu4 fu4， wu2 zai1 wu2 hai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不拆不副，无菑无害。
interpretations.explanation: 无裂无副，无灾无害。

interpretations.segmentation: No tear, no breach—no harm, no hurt.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: yi3 he4 jue2 ling2。

interpretations.segmentation: 以赫厥灵。
interpretations.explanation: 以显明其灵异。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus his miraculous birth was shown.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.content: 上帝不宁，不康禋祀，居然生子。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: shang4 di4 bu4 ning2， bu4 kang1 yin1 si4， ju1 ran2 sheng1 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 上帝不宁，不康禋祀，居然生子。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝不安，不享其禋祀，竟公然生下孩子。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven was displeased; her sacrifice was not accepted—yet she bore a child openly.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.content: 诞寘之隘巷，牛羊腓字之。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: dan4 zhi4 zhi1 ai4 xiang4， niu2 yang2 fei2 zi4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 诞寘之隘巷，牛羊腓字之。
interpretations.explanation: 把他放在窄巷，牛羊却庇护乳养。

interpretations.segmentation: She placed him in a narrow lane; cattle and sheep sheltered and suckled him.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: dan4 zhi4 zhi1 ping2 lin2， hui4 fa2 ping2 lin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 诞寘之平林，会伐平林。
interpretations.explanation: 把他放在平林，恰逢砍伐平林。

interpretations.segmentation: She placed him in the open woods just as the woods were being felled.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: dan4 zhi4 zhi1 han2 bing1， niao3 fu4 yi4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 诞寘之寒冰，鸟覆翼之。
interpretations.explanation: 把他放在寒冰，飞鸟以翼覆盖。

interpretations.segmentation: She placed him on icy cold; birds covered him with their wings.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: niao3 nai3 qu4 yi3， hou4 ji4 gu1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鸟乃去矣，后稷呱矣。
interpretations.explanation: 鸟飞去后，后稷开始啼哭。

interpretations.segmentation: When the birds left, Hou Ji began to wail.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: shi2 tan2 shi2 xu1， jue2 sheng1 zai4 lu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 实覃实訏，厥声载路。
interpretations.explanation: 哭声又长又响，传遍了道路。

interpretations.segmentation: Long and loud his cry, echoing along the roads.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: dan4 shi2 pu2 fu2， ke4 qi2 ke4 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 诞实匍匐，克岐克嶷。
interpretations.explanation: 果然能爬行，能站立，能辨方向。

interpretations.segmentation: Truly he crawled, stood, and knew his way.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: yi3 jiu4 kou3 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 以就口食。
interpretations.explanation: 于是能自己找口食。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus he could seek food for himself.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: yi4 zhi1 ren3 shu1， ren3 shu1 pei4 pei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 蓺之荏菽，荏菽旆旆。
interpretations.explanation: 种植大豆，大豆苗势茂盛。

interpretations.segmentation: He planted soybeans; the shoots grew lush and tall.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.content: 禾役穟穟，麻麦幪幪，瓜瓞唪唪。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: he2 yi4 sui4 sui4， ma2 mai4 meng2 meng2， gua1 die2 feng3 feng3。

interpretations.segmentation: 禾役穟穟，麻麦幪幪，瓜瓞唪唪。
interpretations.explanation: 禾穗密密，麻麦蓬蓬，瓜瓞纷纷结实。

interpretations.segmentation: Grain ears clustered thick; hemp and wheat flourished; melons bore fruit in plenty.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: dan4 hou4 ji4 zhi1 se4， you3 xiang1 zhi1 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 诞后稷之穑，有相之道。
interpretations.explanation: 后稷的农事，有相种之道。

interpretations.segmentation: In Hou Ji's farming there was art to aid the crop.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: fu2 jue2 feng1 cao3， zhong3 zhi1 huang2 mao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 茀厥丰草，种之黄茂。
interpretations.explanation: 除去丰茂的杂草，种出黄而茂的禾。

interpretations.segmentation: He cleared rank weeds and sowed grain golden and lush.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: shi2 fang1 shi2 bao1， shi2 zhong3 shi2 xiu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 实方实苞，实种实褎。
interpretations.explanation: 既方实又含苞，既种粒又秀穗。

interpretations.segmentation: Square in grain, wrapped in husk; seeded and sprouting in ear.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: shi2 fa1 shi2 xiu4， shi2 jian1 shi2 hao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 实发实秀，实坚实好。
interpretations.explanation: 既抽穗又吐秀，既坚实质又好。

interpretations.segmentation: Ears emerged and flowered; grain firm, plump, and fine.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: shi2 ying3 shi2 li4， ji2 you3 tai2 jia1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 实颖实栗，即有邰家室。
interpretations.explanation: 穗尖而实栗，于是有邰氏之家室。

interpretations.segmentation: Tips sharp, grain full—thus the house of Tai was founded.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.content: 诞降嘉种，维秬维秠，维穈维芑。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: dan4 jiang4 jia1 zhong3， wei2 ju4 wei2 pi1， wei2 mei2 wei2 qi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 诞降嘉种，维秬维秠，维穈维芑。
interpretations.explanation: 降下嘉种，有黑黍、黑稷，有糜子、谷子。

interpretations.segmentation: Fine seed was sent down: black millet, black glutinous millet, broomcorn, and plain millet.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: heng2 zhi1 ju4 pi1， shi4 huo4 shi4 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 恒之秬秠，是获是亩。
interpretations.explanation: 常种黑黍黑稷，收获后入田亩。

interpretations.segmentation: They ever sowed the black millets, reaped them, and brought them to the fields.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: heng2 zhi1 mei2 qi3， shi4 ren4 shi4 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 恒之穈芑，是任是负。
interpretations.explanation: 常种糜子和谷子，担挑背负而归。

interpretations.segmentation: They ever sowed broomcorn and millet, bearing loads home on shoulder and back.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: yi3 gui1 zhao4 si4。

interpretations.segmentation: 以归肇祀。
interpretations.explanation: 以归而开始祭祀。

interpretations.segmentation: They returned to begin the sacrifice.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: dan4 wo3 si4 ru2 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 诞我祀如何？
interpretations.explanation: 我们的祭祀是怎样的呢？

interpretations.segmentation: How do we perform our sacrifice?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: huo4 chong1 huo4 yu2， huo4 bo3 huo4 rou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 或舂或揄，或簸或蹂。
interpretations.explanation: 或舂或舀，或簸或蹂。

interpretations.segmentation: Some pound, some scoop; some winnow, some tread.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: shi4 zhi1 sou3 sou3， zheng1 zhi1 fu2 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 释之叟叟，烝之浮浮。
interpretations.explanation: 淘米声叟叟，蒸饭气浮浮。

interpretations.segmentation: Rinsing murmurs softly; steam rises lightly from the cooking.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: zai4 mou2 zai4 wei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 载谋载惟。
interpretations.explanation: 一边谋划一边思量。

interpretations.segmentation: They plan and ponder as they work.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.content: 取萧祭脂，取羝以軷，载燔载烈，以兴嗣岁。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: qu3 xiao1 ji4 zhi1， qu3 di1 yi3 ba2， zai4 fan2 zai4 lie4， yi3 xing1 si4 sui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 取萧祭脂，取羝以軷，载燔载烈，以兴嗣岁。
interpretations.explanation: 取萧草和祭脂，取公羊以祓除，既燔祭又烈祭，以兴来岁。

interpretations.segmentation: They take mugwort and sacrificial fat, a ram for the rite of expiation, burn and blaze offerings to bless the coming year.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: ang2 sheng4 yu2 dou4， yu2 dou4 yu2 deng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 卬盛于豆，于豆于登。
interpretations.explanation: 盛入豆中，又盛入登。

interpretations.segmentation: It is heaped in bowls and placed on stands.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: qi2 xiang1 shi3 sheng1， shang4 di4 ju1 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 其香始升，上帝居歆。
interpretations.explanation: 香气始升，上帝居而歆享。

interpretations.segmentation: Fragrance rises; the Lord on high receives and delights.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: hu2 chou4 dan3 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 胡臭亶时。
interpretations.explanation: 为何香气如此适时？

interpretations.segmentation: Why is the aroma so timely and true?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: hou4 ji4 zhao4 si4。

interpretations.segmentation: 后稷肇祀。
interpretations.explanation: 后稷开始祭祀。

interpretations.segmentation: Hou Ji began the sacrifice.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin.pinyin: shu4 wu2 zui4 hui3， yi3 qi4 yu2 jin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 庶无罪悔，以迄于今。
interpretations.explanation: 希望无罪无悔，一直延续到今天。

interpretations.segmentation: May we be without guilt or regret—from then until now.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.pinyin: dun1 bi3 xing2 wei3， niu2 yang2 wu4 jian4 lv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 敦彼行苇，牛羊勿践履。
interpretations.explanation: 那丛生的苇草，不要让牛羊践踏。

interpretations.segmentation: Those clustered rushes—let cattle and sheep not trample them.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.pinyin: fang1 bao1 fang1 ti3， wei2 ye4 ni2 ni2。

interpretations.segmentation: 方苞方体，维叶泥泥。
interpretations.explanation: 初苞初成体，叶子润泽泥泥。

interpretations.segmentation: First wrapped, first formed; leaves soft and moist.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.pinyin: qi1 qi1 xiong1 di4， mo4 yuan3 ju4 er3。

interpretations.segmentation: 戚戚兄弟，莫远具尔。
interpretations.explanation: 兄弟相亲，莫使疏远，都要聚在你这里。

interpretations.segmentation: Brothers draw near; let none stay far—all gather around you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.pinyin: huo4 si4 zhi1 yan2， huo4 shou4 zhi1 ji3。

interpretations.segmentation: 或四之筵，或授之几。
interpretations.explanation: 或设四人之筵，或授之以几。

interpretations.segmentation: Some spread feasts for four; some hand them small tables.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.pinyin: si4 yan2 she4 xi2， shou4 ji3 you3 ji1 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 四筵设席，授几有缉御。
interpretations.explanation: 四筵设席，授几时有侍者进御。

interpretations.segmentation: Four couches are set; attendants bring tables as needed.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.pinyin: huo4 xian4 huo4 cu4， xi3 jue2 dian4 jia3。

interpretations.segmentation: 或献或酢，洗爵奠斝。
interpretations.explanation: 或献酒或酬答，洗爵奠斝。

interpretations.segmentation: Some offer wine, some return the toast; cups are rinsed and jars set down.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.pinyin: tan3 hai3 yi3 jian4， huo4 fan2 huo4 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 醓醢以荐，或燔或炙。
interpretations.explanation: 以肉酱和醢菜进献，或燔烤或炙烤。

interpretations.segmentation: Salted and pickled meats are served, roasted or broiled.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.pinyin: jia1 yao2 pi2 jue2， huo4 ge1 huo4 e4。

interpretations.segmentation: 嘉肴脾臄，或歌或咢。
interpretations.explanation: 美味有脾臄，或歌或吟。

interpretations.segmentation: Fine dishes include spleen and cheek; some sing, some chant.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.content: 敦弓既坚，四鍭既均，舍矢既均，序宾以贤。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.pinyin: dun1 gong1 ji4 jian1， si4 hou2 ji4 jun1， she3 shi3 ji4 jun1， xu4 bin1 yi3 xian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 敦弓既坚，四鍭既均，舍矢既均，序宾以贤。
interpretations.explanation: 厚弓既坚，四矢既均，放矢既均，以序宾取贤。

interpretations.segmentation: The stout bow is tight; four arrows are matched; shots are even—guests are ranked by merit.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.pinyin: dun1 gong1 ji4 ju4， ji4 xie2 si4 hou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 敦弓既句，既挟四鍭。
interpretations.explanation: 厚弓既调，又挟四矢。

interpretations.segmentation: The stout bow is bent; four arrows are nocked.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.pinyin: si4 hou2 ru2 shu4， xu4 bin1 yi3 bu4 wu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 四鍭如树，序宾以不侮。
interpretations.explanation: 四矢如树立，以序宾而不相轻侮。

interpretations.segmentation: Four arrows stand like trees; guests are ordered without insult.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.content: 曾孙维主，酒醴维醽，酌以大斗，以祈黄耇。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.pinyin: ceng2 sun1 wei2 zhu3， jiu3 li3 wei2 ling2， zhuo2 yi3 da4 dou4， yi3 qi2 huang2 gou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 曾孙维主，酒醴维醽，酌以大斗，以祈黄耇。
interpretations.explanation: 曾孙为主，酒醴既醇，用大斗酌酒，以祈黄耇长寿。

interpretations.segmentation: The host presides; wine is rich; great cups are filled to pray for gray-haired long life.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.pinyin: huang2 gou3 tai2 bei4， yi3 yin3 yi3 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 黄耇台背，以引以翼。
interpretations.explanation: 黄发台背的老人，引道你、翼护你。

interpretations.segmentation: The aged with bent backs guide and support you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei.pinyin: shou4 kao3 wei2 qi2， yi3 jie4 jing3 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 寿考维祺，以介景福。
interpretations.explanation: 长寿是吉祥，以介大景之福。

interpretations.segmentation: Long life is blessing—great fortune be granted.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: ming2 ming2 zai4 xia4， he4 he4 zai4 shang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 明明在下，赫赫在上。
interpretations.explanation: 在下者昭明，在上者赫赫。

interpretations.segmentation: Bright below, resplendent above.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: tian1 nan2 chen2 si1， bu4 yi4 wei2 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天难忱斯，不易维王。
interpretations.explanation: 天命难测，为王不易。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven's will is hard to read; to be king is not easy.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: tian1 wei4 yin1 shi4， shi3 bu4 xie2 si4 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天位殷适，使不挟四方。
interpretations.explanation: 殷商之位合适，却使不能挟制四方。

interpretations.segmentation: Yin's place seemed fit, yet it could not hold the four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.content: 挚仲氏任，自彼殷商，来嫁于周，曰嫔于京。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: zhi4 zhong4 shi4 ren4， zi4 bi3 yin1 shang1， lai2 jia4 yu2 zhou1， yue1 pin2 yu2 jing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 挚仲氏任，自彼殷商，来嫁于周，曰嫔于京。
interpretations.explanation: 挚国仲氏任姓女子，从彼殷商来嫁于周，在镐京为妃。

interpretations.segmentation: Ren, of the Zhong clan of Zhi, came from Yin to marry in Zhou and became consort at Hao.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: nai3 ji2 wang2 ji4， wei2 de2 zhi1 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃及王季，维德之行。
interpretations.explanation: 于是匹配王季，唯以德行为配。

interpretations.segmentation: She was joined to King Ji, matched only by virtue.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: da4 ren4 you3 shen1， sheng1 ci3 wen2 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 大任有身，生此文王。
interpretations.explanation: 太任有身，生下这文王。

interpretations.segmentation: Great Ren conceived and bore this King Wen.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: wei2 ci3 wen2 wang2， xiao3 xin1 yi4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 维此文王，小心翼翼。
interpretations.explanation: 这位文王，小心翼翼。

interpretations.segmentation: This King Wen was careful and reverent.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: zhao1 shi4 shang4 di4， yu4 huai2 duo1 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 昭事上帝，聿怀多福。
interpretations.explanation: 昭明事奉上帝，于是怀有多福。

interpretations.segmentation: Serving God clearly, he gathered many blessings.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: jue2 de2 bu4 hui2， yi3 shou4 fang1 guo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 厥德不回，以受方国。
interpretations.explanation: 其德不邪，因而受四方之国。

interpretations.segmentation: His virtue did not waver; thus he received the states of the four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: tian1 jian1 zai4 xia4， you3 ming4 ji4 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天监在下，有命既集。
interpretations.explanation: 天监在下，天命既已集于文王。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven watches below; the mandate has gathered on Wen.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: wen2 wang2 chu1 zai4， tian1 zuo4 zhi1 he2。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王初载，天作之合。
interpretations.explanation: 文王初成年，天作之合。

interpretations.segmentation: When Wen first came of age, Heaven made the match.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: zai4 qia4 zhi1 yang2， zai4 wei4 zhi1 si4。

interpretations.segmentation: 在洽之阳，在渭之涘。
interpretations.explanation: 在洽水之阳，在渭水之滨。

interpretations.segmentation: On the north bank of the Xia, on the Wei riverside.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: wen2 wang2 jia1 zhi3， da4 bang1 you3 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王嘉止，大邦有子。
interpretations.explanation: 文王嘉美此女，大国有女子。

interpretations.segmentation: Wen honored this bride; a great state had a daughter.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: da4 bang1 you3 zi， qian4 tian1 zhi1 mei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 大邦有子，伣天之妹。
interpretations.explanation: 大国有女子，比之天之妹。

interpretations.segmentation: The great state had a daughter—like Heaven's own sister.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: wen2 ding4 jue2 xiang2， qin1 ying2 yu2 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 文定厥祥，亲迎于渭。
interpretations.explanation: 卜筮定吉，亲迎于渭。

interpretations.segmentation: Divination fixed the auspice; he met her in person at the Wei.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: zao4 zhou1 wei4 liang2， bu4 xian3 qi2 guang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 造舟为梁，不显其光。
interpretations.explanation: 连舟为梁，其光不显而自明。

interpretations.segmentation: Boats were chained as a bridge—glory not flaunted, yet clear.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: you3 ming4 zi4 tian1， ming4 ci3 wen2 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有命自天，命此文王。
interpretations.explanation: 有命自天，命此文王。

interpretations.segmentation: A mandate came from Heaven, appointing this King Wen.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: yu2 zhou1 yu2 jing1， zuan3 nv3 wei2 shen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 于周于京，缵女维莘。
interpretations.explanation: 于周于京，续娶莘国之女。

interpretations.segmentation: In Zhou, at the capital, he took the woman of Xin in succession.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: zhang3 zi wei2 xing2， du3 sheng1 wu3 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 长子维行，笃生武王。
