interpretations.explanation: 长子行事，笃生武王。

interpretations.segmentation: The eldest son carried on; steadfastly was King Wu born.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: bao3 you4 ming4 er3， xie4 fa2 da4 shang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 保右命尔，燮伐大商。
interpretations.explanation: 保佑命你，协伐大商。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven protects and commands you to join in attacking great Shang.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: yin1 shang1 zhi1 lv3， qi2 hui4 ru2 lin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 殷商之旅，其会如林。
interpretations.explanation: 殷商之旅，其会如林。

interpretations.segmentation: Shang's armies gathered thick as a forest.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: shi3 yu2 mu4 ye3， wei2 yu3 hou2 xing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 矢于牧野，维予侯兴。
interpretations.explanation: 陈于牧野，唯我诸侯兴起。

interpretations.segmentation: They arrayed at Muye; only our lords rose up.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: shang4 di4 lin2 nv3， wu2 er4 er3 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 上帝临女，无二尔心。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝临视你，无二心。

interpretations.segmentation: God looks upon you—be not of two minds.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.content: 牧野洋洋，檀车煌煌，驷騵彭彭。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: mu4 ye3 yang2 yang2， tan2 che1 huang2 huang2， si4 yuan2 peng2 peng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 牧野洋洋，檀车煌煌，驷騵彭彭。
interpretations.explanation: 牧野广大，檀车煌煌，四马彭彭。

interpretations.segmentation: Muye is vast; sandalwood chariots blaze; four-horse teams thunder.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: wei2 shi1 shang4 fu4， shi2 wei2 ying1 yang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 维师尚父，时维鹰扬。
interpretations.explanation: 太师尚父，此时如鹰扬。

interpretations.segmentation: Grand Master Shang Fu—now like an eagle soaring.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.content: 凉彼武王，四伐大商，会朝清明。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming.pinyin: liang2 bi3 wu3 wang2， si4 fa2 da4 shang1， hui4 chao2 qing1 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 凉彼武王，四伐大商，会朝清明。
interpretations.explanation: 协助那武王，四伐大商，会于清明之朝。

interpretations.segmentation: Aid King Wu; four times strike great Shang—meet in the clear dawn.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu.pinyin: zhan1 bi3 han4 lu4， zhen1 hu4 ji4 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻彼旱麓，榛楛济济。
interpretations.explanation: 瞻望那旱山山麓，榛树楛树济济成行。

interpretations.segmentation: Look at the foot of Mount Han—hazel and thorn trees stand in rows.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu.pinyin: qi3 di4 jun1 zi， gan4 lu4 qi3 di4。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂弟君子，干禄岂弟。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，求福禄在和乐宽厚。

interpretations.segmentation: The gracious lord seeks blessing through graciousness.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu.pinyin: se4 bi3 yu4 zan4， huang2 liu2 zai4 zhong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 瑟彼玉瓒，黄流在中。
interpretations.explanation: 那玉瓒鲜明，黄流在中。

interpretations.segmentation: The jade libation cup gleams; golden liquor fills it.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu.pinyin: qi3 di4 jun1 zi， fu2 lu4 you1 jiang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂弟君子，福禄攸降。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，福禄所降。

interpretations.segmentation: The gracious lord—upon him blessing descends.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu.pinyin: yuan1 fei1 li4 tian1， yu2 yue4 yu2 yuan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鸢飞戾天，鱼跃于渊。
interpretations.explanation: 鸢飞至天，鱼跃于渊。

interpretations.segmentation: The kite flies to the sky; the fish leaps in the deep.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu.pinyin: qi3 di4 jun1 zi， xia2 bu4 zuo4 ren2？

interpretations.segmentation: 岂弟君子，遐不作人？
interpretations.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，何不造就有德之人？

interpretations.segmentation: Gracious lord, why not nurture men of virtue?

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu.pinyin: qing1 jiu3 ji4 zai4， xing1 mu3 ji4 bei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 清酒既载，骍牡既备。
interpretations.explanation: 清酒既载，赤色公牛既备。

interpretations.segmentation: Clear wine is ready; red oxen are prepared.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu.pinyin: yi3 xiang3 yi3 si4， yi3 jie4 jing3 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 以享以祀，以介景福。
interpretations.explanation: 以享以祀，以介大景之福。

interpretations.segmentation: To feast and sacrifice, and grant great shining blessing.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu.pinyin: se4 bi3 zha4 yu4， min2 suo3 liao2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 瑟彼柞棫，民所燎矣。
interpretations.explanation: 那柞树棫树，是民所燎祭之木。

interpretations.segmentation: Oak and thorn—wood the people use for sacrificial fire.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu.pinyin: qi3 di4 jun1 zi， shen2 suo3 lao2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂弟君子，神所劳矣。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，是神所劳慰者。

interpretations.segmentation: The gracious lord is one whom the spirits comfort and bless.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu.pinyin: mo4 mo4 ge2 lei3， shi1 yu2 tiao2 mei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 莫莫葛藟，施于条枚。
interpretations.explanation: 葛藤蔓蔓，延于枝条。

interpretations.segmentation: Creeping kudzu spreads along the branches.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu.pinyin: qi3 di4 jun1 zi， qiu2 fu2 bu4 hui2。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂弟君子，求福不回。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，求福而不邪曲。

interpretations.segmentation: The gracious lord seeks blessing without crooked ways.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: huang2 yi3 shang4 di4， lin2 xia4 you3 he4。

interpretations.segmentation: 皇矣上帝，临下有赫。
interpretations.explanation: 伟大的上帝，降临下界，威明赫赫。

interpretations.segmentation: Great is God on high; descending to the world below, His majesty shines bright.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: jian1 guan1 si4 fang1， qiu2 min2 zhi1 mo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 监观四方，求民之莫。
interpretations.explanation: 他监察四方，寻求百姓的安宁。

interpretations.segmentation: He watches over the four quarters and seeks the people's peace and rest.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: wei2 ci3 er4 guo2， qi2 zheng4 bu4 huo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 维此二国，其政不获。
interpretations.explanation: 这两个国家（夏、商），政令不得施行。

interpretations.segmentation: In these two states, government could not achieve its aims.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: wei2 bi3 si4 guo2， yuan2 jiu1 yuan2 du4。

interpretations.segmentation: 维彼四国，爰究爰度。
interpretations.explanation: 对那些四方之国，上帝于是考察、度量。

interpretations.segmentation: Upon those states in the four directions, He then examined and measured them.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: shang4 di4 qi2 zhi1， zeng1 qi2 shi4 kuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 上帝耆之，憎其式廓。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝喜爱周人，憎恶先王扩大疆土的做法（指商）。

interpretations.segmentation: God favored Zhou and hated how the former dynasty had overreached.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: nai3 juan4 xi1 gu4， ci3 wei2 yu3 zhai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃眷西顾，此维与宅。
interpretations.explanation: 于是眷顾西方，把这里作为周人安居之地。

interpretations.segmentation: Then He turned His gaze to the west and chose this land for Zhou to dwell in.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: zuo4 zhi1 ping2 zhi1， qi2 zai1 qi2 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 作之屏之，其菑其翳。
interpretations.explanation: 砍掉、拔除杂树，无论是灾木还是蔽日的繁枝。

interpretations.segmentation: He cleared away brush—both stunted growth and choking shade.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: xiu1 zhi1 ping2 zhi1， qi2 guan4 qi2 lie4。

interpretations.segmentation: 修之平之，其灌其栵。
interpretations.explanation: 修整、铲平地面，除去丛生的灌木和小树。

interpretations.segmentation: He trimmed and leveled the ground, removing thickets and saplings.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: qi3 zhi1 pi4 zhi1， qi2 cheng1 qi2 ju1。

interpretations.segmentation: 启之辟之，其柽其椐。
interpretations.explanation: 开辟土地，砍去柽柳、椐树等。

interpretations.segmentation: He opened the land, cutting willows, zelkova, and the like.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: rang3 zhi1 ti1 zhi1， qi2 yan3 qi2 zhe4。

interpretations.segmentation: 攘之剔之，其檿其柘。
interpretations.explanation: 剔除杂木，无论是桑树还是柘树。

interpretations.segmentation: He uprooted unwanted trees, whether mulberry or thorn.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: di4 qian1 ming2 de2， chuan4 yi2 zai4 lu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 帝迁明德，串夷载路。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝迁来明德之族，串夷之地也开辟成路。

interpretations.segmentation: God moved the clan of bright virtue here; even the wild borderlands became highways.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: tian1 li4 jue2 pei4， shou4 ming4 ji4 gu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天立厥配，受命既固。
interpretations.explanation: 上天立他的配偶（指太姜），所受天命既已牢固。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven established his consort; the mandate they received was firm.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.content: 帝省其山，柞棫斯拔，松柏斯兑。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: di4 sheng3 qi2 shan1， zha4 yu4 si1 ba2， song1 bai3 si1 dui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 帝省其山，柞棫斯拔，松柏斯兑。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝察看那座山，柞、棫拔起，松柏也畅茂。

interpretations.segmentation: God looked upon the mountain: oak and thorn were uprooted, pine and cypress flourished.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.content: 帝作邦作对，自大伯王季。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: di4 zuo4 bang1 zuo4 dui4， zi4 da4 bo2 wang2 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 帝作邦作对，自大伯王季。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝为周邦立配、立对（配偶与辅佐），自太伯、王季始。

interpretations.segmentation: God made Zhou a state with its match and help, beginning with Taibo and Wang Ji.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: wei2 ci3 wang2 ji4，

interpretations.segmentation: 维此王季，
interpretations.explanation: 这位王季，

interpretations.segmentation: This Wang Ji—

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: yin1 xin1 ze2 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 因心则友。
interpretations.explanation: 顺其本心就能友爱兄弟。

interpretations.segmentation: following his heart, was friendly to others.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.content: 则友其兄，则笃其庆，载锡之光。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: ze2 you3 qi2 xiong1， ze2 du3 qi2 qing4， zai4 xi1 zhi1 guang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 则友其兄，则笃其庆，载锡之光。
interpretations.explanation: 友爱其兄，厚集福庆，又赐以荣光。

interpretations.segmentation: He befriended his elder brother, heaped up blessings, and was granted glory.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: shou4 lu4 wu2 sang4， yan3 you3 si4 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 受禄无丧，奄有四方。
interpretations.explanation: 承受福禄而不丧失，奄有四方。

interpretations.segmentation: He received blessings without losing them and came to hold the four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: wei2 ci3 wang2 ji4， di4 du4 qi2 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维此王季，帝度其心。
interpretations.explanation: 这位王季，上帝度量他的内心。

interpretations.segmentation: This Wang Ji—God measured his heart.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: mo4 qi2 de2 yin1， qi2 de2 ke4 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 貊其德音，其德克明。
interpretations.explanation: 远播其德音，其德能照彻四方。

interpretations.segmentation: His good fame reached afar; his virtue could illumine all.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: ke4 ming2 ke4 lei4， ke4 zhang3 ke4 jun1。

interpretations.segmentation: 克明克类，克长克君。
interpretations.explanation: 能明察、能分类，能长育、能君临。

interpretations.segmentation: He could discern and classify, nurture and rule as lord.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: wang2 ci3 da4 bang1， ke4 shun4 ke4 bi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 王此大邦，克顺克比。
interpretations.explanation: 治理这个大国，能顺服、能亲附。

interpretations.segmentation: Governing this great state, he could comply and draw others near.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: bi3 yu2 wen2 wang2， qi2 de2 mi2 hui3。

interpretations.segmentation: 比于文王，其德靡悔。
interpretations.explanation: 与文王相比，其德无可悔恨。

interpretations.segmentation: Compared with King Wen, his virtue left nothing to regret.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: ji4 shou4 di4 zhi3， shi1 yu2 sun1 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 既受帝祉，施于孙子。
interpretations.explanation: 既受上帝之福，施及子孙。

interpretations.segmentation: Having received God's blessing, he extended it to his descendants.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.content: 帝谓文王：无然畔援，无然歆羡，诞先登于岸。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: di4 wei4 wen2 wang2： wu2 ran2 pan4 yuan2， wu2 ran2 xin1 xian4， dan4 xian1 deng1 yu2 an4。

interpretations.segmentation: 帝谓文王：无然畔援，无然歆羡，诞先登于岸。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝对文王说：不要攀附、不要歆羡，要率先登岸（喻率先行道）。

interpretations.segmentation: God said to King Wen: Do not cling to others or envy them; be the first to reach the shore.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: mi4 ren2 bu4 gong1， gan3 ju4 da4 bang1，

interpretations.segmentation: 密人不恭，敢距大邦，
interpretations.explanation: 密国人无礼，竟敢抗拒大国，

interpretations.segmentation: The people of Mi were disrespectful and dared resist the great state—

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: qin1 ruan3 cu2 gong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 侵阮徂共。
interpretations.explanation: 侵犯阮国、进犯共国。

interpretations.segmentation: invading Ruan and pressing on to Gong.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.content: 王赫斯怒，爰整其旅，以按徂旅。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: wang2 he4 si1 nu4， yuan2 zheng3 qi2 lv3， yi3 an4 cu2 lv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 王赫斯怒，爰整其旅，以按徂旅。
interpretations.explanation: 文王赫然发怒，于是整顿军队，以安定往来的旅人。

interpretations.segmentation: King Wen flared in anger, arrayed his hosts, and secured the roads for travelers.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.content: 以笃于周祜，以对于天下。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: yi3 du3 yu2 zhou1 hu4， yi3 dui4 yu2 tian1 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 以笃于周祜，以对于天下。
interpretations.explanation: 以厚周之福佑，以应对天下。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus enriching Zhou's blessings and answering the needs of all under heaven.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: yi1 qi2 zai4 jing1， qin1 zi4 ruan3 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 依其在京，侵自阮疆。
interpretations.explanation: 依其在镐京之势，从阮国边境进击。

interpretations.segmentation: Relying on his power at the capital, he advanced from the borders of Ruan.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: zhi4 wo3 gao1 gang1， wu2 shi3 wo3 ling2。

interpretations.segmentation: 陟我高冈，无矢我陵。
interpretations.explanation: 登上我高冈，不要用箭射我陵阜。

interpretations.segmentation: Ascend my high hill—do not shoot arrows at my mound.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: wo3 ling2 wo3 a1， wu2 yin3 wo3 quan2，

interpretations.segmentation: 我陵我阿，无饮我泉，
interpretations.explanation: 我陵我阿，不要饮用我泉，

interpretations.segmentation: My mound, my slope—do not drink from my spring,

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: wo3 quan2 wo3 chi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我泉我池。
interpretations.explanation: 我泉我池。

interpretations.segmentation: my spring, my pool.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.content: 度其鲜原，居岐之阳，在渭之将。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: du4 qi2 xian1 yuan2， ju1 qi2 zhi1 yang2， zai4 wei4 zhi1 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 度其鲜原，居岐之阳，在渭之将。
interpretations.explanation: 丈量那鲜原，居岐山之阳，在渭水之畔。

interpretations.segmentation: He measured the fresh plain, dwelling on the sunny side of Mount Qi, by the banks of the Wei.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: wan4 bang1 zhi1 fang1， xia4 min2 zhi1 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 万邦之方，下民之王。
interpretations.explanation: 万邦的法则，下民之王。

interpretations.segmentation: He became the model for all states and king to the common people.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.content: 帝谓文王：予怀明德，不大声以色，不长夏以革。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: di4 wei4 wen2 wang2： yu3 huai2 ming2 de2， bu4 da4 sheng1 yi3 se4， bu4 zhang3 xia4 yi3 ge2。

interpretations.segmentation: 帝谓文王：予怀明德，不大声以色，不长夏以革。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝对文王说：我怀明德，不大声以色，不借夏政而变革。

interpretations.segmentation: God said to Wen: I cherish bright virtue— not loud words or harsh looks, not changing things by harsh summer ways.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: bu4 shi2 bu4 zhi1， shun4 di4 zhi1 ze2。

interpretations.segmentation: 不识不知，顺帝之则。
interpretations.explanation: 不识不知，顺从天帝之则。

interpretations.segmentation: Without forced knowing, he followed Heaven's rule.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.content: 帝谓文王：訽尔仇方，同尔弟兄。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: di4 wei4 wen2 wang2： gou4 er3 chou2 fang1， tong2 er3 di4 xiong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 帝谓文王：訽尔仇方，同尔弟兄。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝对文王说：告诫你的仇方，团结你的弟兄。

interpretations.segmentation: God said to Wen: Warn your hostile neighbors and unite your brothers.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.content: 以尔钩援，与尔临冲，以伐崇墉。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: yi3 er3 gou1 yuan2， yu3 er3 lin2 chong1， yi3 fa2 chong2 yong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 以尔钩援，与尔临冲，以伐崇墉。
interpretations.explanation: 用你钩援、用你临冲，去攻打崇国城墙。

interpretations.segmentation: With your hook-ladders and your siege-engines, attack the wall of Chong.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: lin2 chong1 xian2 xian2， chong2 yong1 yan2 yan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 临冲闲闲，崇墉言言。
interpretations.explanation: 临冲战车轻稳，崇城墙高言言。

interpretations.segmentation: The siege engines rolled smoothly; Chong's wall stood towering.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: zhi2 xun4 lian2 lian2， you1 guo2 an1 an1。

interpretations.segmentation: 执讯连连，攸馘安安。
interpretations.explanation: 捉获俘虏接连不断，所割之耳安妥。

interpretations.segmentation: Captives were taken in steady streams; severed ears were laid in order.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: shi4 lei4 shi4 ma4， shi4 zhi4 shi4 fu4，

interpretations.segmentation: 是类是禡，是致是附，
interpretations.explanation: 举行类祭、禡祭，致献、归附，

interpretations.segmentation: He offered the proper rites and sacrifices, winning submission—

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: si4 fang1 yi3 wu2 wu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 四方以无侮。
interpretations.explanation: 四方因此不再侮慢。

interpretations.segmentation: so the four quarters no longer showed contempt.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: lin2 chong1 fu2 fu2， chong2 yong1 ge1 ge1。

interpretations.segmentation: 临冲茀茀，崇墉仡仡。
interpretations.explanation: 临冲隆隆，崇墙岿然。

interpretations.segmentation: The engines thundered; the wall of Chong stood firm.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: shi4 fa2 shi4 si4， shi4 jue2 shi4 hu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 是伐是四，是绝是忽。
interpretations.explanation: 于是讨伐、四面进攻，于是灭绝、迅速攻克。

interpretations.segmentation: Then they assaulted from all sides, cut off and swiftly overthrew it.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi.pinyin: si4 fang1 yi3 wu2 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 四方以无拂。
interpretations.explanation: 四方因此不再违拂。

interpretations.segmentation: So the four quarters no longer turned away in defiance.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai.pinyin: jing1 shi3 ling2 tai2， jing1 zhi1 ying2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 经始灵台，经之营之。
interpretations.explanation: 开始建造灵台，规划又经营。

interpretations.segmentation: They began the Spirit Tower, planning and building it.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai.pinyin: shu4 min2 gong1 zhi1， bu4 ri4 cheng2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 庶民攻之，不日成之。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓合力修筑，不日即成。

interpretations.segmentation: The people worked on it together, and it was finished in no time.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai.pinyin: jing1 shi3 wu4 ji2， shu4 min2 zi lai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 经始勿亟，庶民子来。
interpretations.explanation: 开工时不催促，百姓像儿子一样前来帮忙。

interpretations.segmentation: Though no haste was urged at the start, the people came like sons to help.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai.pinyin: wang2 zai4 ling2 you4， you1 lu4 you1 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 王在灵囿，麀鹿攸伏。
interpretations.explanation: 王在灵囿，母鹿安然伏卧。

interpretations.segmentation: The king was in the Spirit Park; does lay peacefully at rest.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai.pinyin: you1 lu4 zhuo2 zhuo2， bai2 niao3 he4 he4。

interpretations.segmentation: 麀鹿濯濯，白鸟翯翯。
interpretations.explanation: 母鹿肥壮，白鸟羽毛鲜明。

interpretations.segmentation: The does were plump; white birds gleamed in their feathers.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai.pinyin: wang2 zai4 ling2 zhao3， yu2 ren4 yu2 yue4。

interpretations.segmentation: 王在灵沼，于牣鱼跃。
interpretations.explanation: 王在灵沼，满池鱼跃。

interpretations.segmentation: The king was at the Spirit Pool; fish leaped in fullness.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai.pinyin: ju4 ye4 wei2 cong1， ben1 gu3 wei2 yong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 虡业维枞，贲鼓维镛。
interpretations.explanation: 虡上横木为枞，大鼓与镛钟齐备。

interpretations.segmentation: Music stands with crossbars, great drums and chime bells were set.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai.pinyin: yu2 lun4 gu3 zhong1， yu2 le4 pi4 yong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 于论鼓钟，于乐辟雍。
interpretations.explanation: 于论地击鼓钟，于乐地奏辟雍之乐。

interpretations.segmentation: In Lun they struck drums and bells; in the pleasure ground they played for the Bright Enclosure.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai.pinyin: yu2 lun4 gu3 zhong1， yu2 le4 pi4 yong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 于论鼓钟，于乐辟雍。
interpretations.explanation: 于论地击鼓钟，于乐地奏辟雍之乐。

interpretations.segmentation: In Lun they struck drums and bells; in the pleasure ground they played for the Bright Enclosure.
鼍鼓逢逢。
interpretations.explanation: 鼍鼓声逢逢。

interpretations.segmentation: The alligator-skin drums boomed.
矇瞍奏公。
interpretations.explanation: 盲人乐师奏《公》乐。

interpretations.segmentation: The blind musicians performed the Gong music.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: mian2 mian2 gua1 die2。

interpretations.segmentation: 绵绵瓜瓞。
interpretations.explanation: 瓜瓞绵绵，喻子孙繁衍不绝。

interpretations.segmentation: Melons spread on trailing vines—like descendants multiplying without end.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: min2 zhi1 chu1 sheng1， zi4 tu3 ju3 qi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之初生，自土沮漆。
interpretations.explanation: 民众初生活动，从土山沮漆一带起。

interpretations.segmentation: When the people first arose, they lived from Tu and Juqi.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.content: 古公亶父，陶复陶冗，未有家室。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: gu3 gong1 dan3 fu4， tao2 fu4 tao2 rong3， wei4 you3 jia1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 古公亶父，陶复陶冗，未有家室。
interpretations.explanation: 古公亶父挖穴而居，尚未有正式家室。

interpretations.segmentation: Gugong Danfu dug caves to dwell in; he had not yet built a proper house.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: gu3 gong1 dan3 fu4， lai2 chao2 zou3 ma3。

interpretations.segmentation: 古公亶父，来朝走马。
interpretations.explanation: 古公亶父，清晨就骑马出发。

interpretations.segmentation: Gugong Danfu set out at dawn, riding his horse.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: lv4 xi1 shui3 hu3， zhi4 yu2 qi2 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 率西水浒，至于岐下。
interpretations.explanation: 沿西方水滨，来到岐山脚下。

interpretations.segmentation: He followed the western waterside until he reached the foot of Mount Qi.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: yuan2 ji2 jiang1 nv3， yu4 lai2 xu1 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 爰及姜女，聿来胥宇。
interpretations.explanation: 连同姜女，一起来察看可居之地。

interpretations.segmentation: With Lady Jiang he came to look over where they might settle.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: zhou1 yuan2 hu1 hu1， jin3 tu2 ru2 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 周原膴膴，堇荼如饴。
interpretations.explanation: 周原肥沃，堇菜苦荼甜如饴。

interpretations.segmentation: The Zhou plain was rich; even bitter herbs tasted sweet as malt.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.content: 爰始爰谋，爰契我龟，曰止曰时，筑室于兹。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: yuan2 shi3 yuan2 mou2， yuan2 qi4 wo3 gui1， yue1 zhi3 yue1 shi2， zhu4 shi4 yu2 zi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 爰始爰谋，爰契我龟，曰止曰时，筑室于兹。
interpretations.explanation: 于是开始谋划，灼龟问卜，说“止”“时”，在此筑室。

interpretations.segmentation: Then they planned and divined with tortoise: “Stop here, now is the time”—and built houses on this spot.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.content: 乃慰乃止，乃左乃右，乃疆乃理，乃宣乃亩。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: nai3 wei4 nai3 zhi3， nai3 zuo3 nai3 you4， nai3 jiang1 nai3 li3， nai3 xuan1 nai3 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃慰乃止，乃左乃右，乃疆乃理，乃宣乃亩。
interpretations.explanation: 于是安抚定居，划分左右，定疆理田，宣导亩制。

interpretations.segmentation: They settled the people in peace, assigned left and right, marked fields and boundaries, and laid out the acre system.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: zi4 xi1 cu2 dong1， zhou1 yuan2 zhi2 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 自西徂东，周爰执事。
interpretations.explanation: 从西到东，遍处都有人办事。

interpretations.segmentation: From west to east, Zhou had people at work everywhere.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.content: 乃召司空，乃召司徒，俾立室家。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: nai3 zhao4 si1 kong1， nai3 zhao4 si1 tu2， bi3 li4 shi4 jia1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃召司空，乃召司徒，俾立室家。
interpretations.explanation: 召来司空、司徒，使大家建立家室。

interpretations.segmentation: They summoned the Minister of Works and the Minister of Land to help every household build homes.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.content: 其绳则直，缩版以载，作庙翼翼。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: qi2 sheng2 ze2 zhi2， suo1 ban3 yi3 zai4， zuo4 miao4 yi4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 其绳则直，缩版以载，作庙翼翼。
interpretations.explanation: 绳墨拉直，缩版载土，宗庙翼翼而起。

interpretations.segmentation: The line was true; boards held the earth; the ancestral temple rose grandly.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.content: 捄之陾陾，度之薨薨，筑之登登，削屡冯冯。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: jiu4 zhi1 reng2 reng2， du4 zhi1 hong1 hong1， zhu4 zhi1 deng1 deng1， xue1 lv3 feng2 feng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 捄之陾陾，度之薨薨，筑之登登，削屡冯冯。
interpretations.explanation: 填土陾陾，量度薨薨，筑墙登登，削板冯冯。

interpretations.segmentation: Earth was tamped with rumble; measurements hummed; walls rose layer on layer; boards were trimmed with clang.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: bai3 du3 jie1 xing1， gao1 gu3 fu2 sheng4。

interpretations.segmentation: 百堵皆兴，鼛鼓弗胜。
interpretations.explanation: 百堵同时兴起，鼛鼓声也盖不住。

interpretations.segmentation: A hundred walls rose together; even the work drums could scarcely be heard.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: nai3 li4 gao1 men2， gao1 men2 you3 kang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃立皋门，皋门有伉。
interpretations.explanation: 于是立皋门，皋门高大。

interpretations.segmentation: Then they raised the outer gate; the outer gate stood high.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: nai3 li4 ying1 men2， ying1 men2 jiang1 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃立应门，应门将将。
interpretations.explanation: 于是立应门，应门庄严。

interpretations.segmentation: Then they raised the inner gate; the inner gate stood stately.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: nai3 li4 zhong3 tu3， rong2 chou3 you1 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃立冢土，戎丑攸行。
interpretations.explanation: 于是立社坛，戎狄也来行礼。

interpretations.segmentation: Then they raised the earth altar; even the Rong tribes came to perform rites.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.content: 四不殄厥愠，亦不陨厥问。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: si4 bu4 tian3 jue2 yun4， yi4 bu4 yun3 jue2 wen4。

interpretations.segmentation: 四不殄厥愠，亦不陨厥问。
interpretations.explanation: 虽遭侵扰而不减其志，也不坠其声闻。

interpretations.segmentation: Though harassed, their resolve did not fail; their fame did not fall.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: zha4 yu4 ba2 yi3， xing2 dao4 dui4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 柞棫拔矣，行道兑矣。
interpretations.explanation: 柞、棫拔起，行道通畅。

interpretations.segmentation: Oaks and thorns were cleared; the roads became open.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: hun4 yi2 tui4 yi3， wei2 qi2 hui4 yi3！

interpretations.segmentation: 混夷駾矣，维其喙矣！
interpretations.explanation: 混夷退却，只闻其喘息！

interpretations.segmentation: The Hunyi retreated, panting in their flight!

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.content: 虞芮质厥成，文王蹶厥生。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: yu2 rui4 zhi4 jue2 cheng2， wen2 wang2 jue2 jue2 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 虞芮质厥成，文王蹶厥生。
interpretations.explanation: 虞、芮来质成其讼，文王蹶起其生业。

interpretations.segmentation: Yu and Rui came to Wen for judgment; Wen revived their livelihoods.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.content: 予曰有疏附，予曰有先后。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: yu3 yue1 you3 shu1 fu4， yu3 yue1 you3 xian1 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 予曰有疏附，予曰有先后。
interpretations.explanation: 我说有亲附者，我说有先后之序。

interpretations.segmentation: I say there were close adherents; I say there were leaders in order.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.content: 予曰有奔奏，予曰有御侮！
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian.pinyin: yu3 yue1 you3 ben1 zou4， yu3 yue1 you3 yu4 wu3！

interpretations.segmentation: 予曰有奔奏，予曰有御侮！
interpretations.explanation: 我说有奔走奏事者，我说有抵御外侮者！

interpretations.segmentation: I say there were runners to report; I say there were defenders against insult!

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi.content: 思齐大任，文王之母，思媚周姜，京室之妇。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi.pinyin: si1 qi2 da4 ren4， wen2 wang2 zhi1 mu3， si1 mei4 zhou1 jiang1， jing1 shi4 zhi1 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 思齐大任，文王之母，思媚周姜，京室之妇。
interpretations.explanation: 思念太任（文王之母）贤齐，又念周姜（太姜）为京室之妇。

interpretations.segmentation: We think of worthy Tai Ren, Wen's mother, and gracious Zhou Jiang, lady of the capital house.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi.pinyin: da4 si4 si4 hui1 yin1， ze2 bai3 si1 nan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 大姒嗣徽音，则百斯男。
interpretations.explanation: 太姒继承美善之德音，故生百子。

interpretations.segmentation: Tai Si inherited their fine virtue, and bore a hundred sons.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi.content: 惠于宗公，神罔时怨，神罔时恫。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi.pinyin: hui4 yu2 zong1 gong1， shen2 wang3 shi2 yuan4， shen2 wang3 shi2 dong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 惠于宗公，神罔时怨，神罔时恫。
interpretations.explanation: 施惠于宗庙先公，神灵从不怨怒，从不惊扰。

interpretations.segmentation: She was kind to the ancestral lords; the spirits never resented or troubled her.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi.content: 刑于寡妻，至于兄弟，以御于家邦。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi.pinyin: xing2 yu2 gua3 qi1， zhi4 yu2 xiong1 di4， yi3 yu4 yu2 jia1 bang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 刑于寡妻，至于兄弟，以御于家邦。
interpretations.explanation: 以寡妻为榜样，推及兄弟，以治家邦。

interpretations.segmentation: She set an example for the chief wife, extending to brothers, to govern family and state.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi.pinyin: yong1 yong1 zai4 gong1， su4 su4 zai4 miao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 雍雍在宫，肃肃在庙。
interpretations.explanation: 在宫中雍雍和穆，在庙中肃肃恭敬。

interpretations.segmentation: Harmonious in the palace, reverent in the temple.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi.pinyin: bu4 xian3 yi4 lin2， wu2 she4 yi4 bao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 不显亦临，无射亦保。
interpretations.explanation: 虽不显达亦临察，无厌亦保守。

interpretations.segmentation: Though not prominent, she still oversaw; without weariness she still kept watch.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi.pinyin: si4 rong2 ji2 bu4 tian3， lie4 jia3 bu4 xia2。

interpretations.segmentation: 四戎疾不殄，烈假不瑕。
interpretations.explanation: 虽遭戎患而不绝，烈德无瑕疵。

interpretations.segmentation: Though the Rong pressed hard, she was not cut off; her blazing virtue had no flaw.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi.pinyin: bu4 wen2 yi4 shi4， bu4 jian4 yi4 ru4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不闻亦式，不谏亦入。
interpretations.explanation: 未闻之事也效法，未谏之言也采纳。

interpretations.segmentation: What she had not heard, she still modeled; what was not urged, she still took in.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi.pinyin: si4 cheng2 ren2 you3 de2， xiao3 zi you3 zao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 四成人有德，小子有造。
interpretations.explanation: 成人有德，小子有成就。

interpretations.segmentation: The grown had virtue; the young achieved their worth.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi.pinyin: gu3 zhi1 ren2 wu2 yi4， yu4 mao2 si1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 古之人无斁，誉髦斯士。
interpretations.explanation: 古人不厌其劳，誉美俊士。

interpretations.segmentation: The ancients never tired of praise; they honored outstanding men.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: wen2 wang2 zai4 shang4， yu2 zhao1 yu2 tian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王在上，于昭于天。
interpretations.explanation: 文王在天，光明昭于上天。

interpretations.segmentation: King Wen is on high, his brightness clear in heaven.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: zhou1 sui1 jiu4 bang1， qi2 ming4 wei2 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 周虽旧邦，其命维新。
interpretations.explanation: 周虽是旧邦，其命却更新。

interpretations.segmentation: Zhou is an ancient state, yet its mandate is made new.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: you3 zhou1 bu4 xian3， di4 ming4 bu4 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有周不显，帝命不时。
interpretations.explanation: 有周之业不显达吗？帝命并非固定不变。

interpretations.segmentation: Is Zhou's achievement not glorious? Heaven's command is not unchanging.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: wen2 wang2 zhi4 jiang4， zai4 di4 zuo3 you4。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王陟降，在帝左右。
interpretations.explanation: 文王升降在天，在上帝左右。

interpretations.segmentation: King Wen ascends and descends in heaven, at God's right hand.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: wei3 wei3 wen2 wang2， ling4 wen2 bu4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 亹亹文王，令闻不已。
interpretations.explanation: 勤勉的文王，美名传扬不止。

interpretations.segmentation: Diligent King Wen—his good fame never ceases.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: chen2 xi1 zai1 zhou1， hou2 wen2 wang2 sun1 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 陈锡哉周，侯文王孙子。
interpretations.explanation: 反复赐福于周，使文王的子孙为侯。

interpretations.segmentation: Blessings were heaped on Zhou again and again, making Wen's descendants lords.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.content: 文王孙子，本支百世，凡周之士，不显亦世。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: wen2 wang2 sun1 zi， ben3 zhi1 bai3 shi4， fan2 zhou1 zhi1 shi4， bu4 xian3 yi4 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王孙子，本支百世，凡周之士，不显亦世。
interpretations.explanation: 文王的子孙，本支百世；凡周之士，不显亦世世代代。

interpretations.segmentation: Wen's descendants, root and branch for a hundred generations; all Zhou's officers, glorious generation after generation.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: shi4 zhi1 bu4 xian3， jue2 you2 yi4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 世之不显，厥犹翼翼。
interpretations.explanation: 世世代代显赫，其谋虑翼翼谨慎。

interpretations.segmentation: Age after age prominent, their plans were careful and thorough.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: si1 huang2 duo1 shi4， sheng1 ci3 wang2 guo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 思皇多士，生此王国。
interpretations.explanation: 思慕众多贤士，生于此王国。

interpretations.segmentation: Longing for many worthy men born in this royal state.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: wang2 guo2 ke4 sheng1， wei2 zhou1 zhi1 zhen1；

interpretations.segmentation: 王国克生，维周之桢；
interpretations.explanation: 王国能生出贤士，是周的栋梁；

interpretations.segmentation: The kingdom could produce them—Zhou's mainstay;

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: ji4 ji4 duo1 shi4， wen2 wang2 yi3 ning2。

interpretations.segmentation: 济济多士，文王以宁。
interpretations.explanation: 济济众多士人，文王因此安宁。

interpretations.segmentation: Hosts of officers—and King Wen was secure.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: mu4 mu4 wen2 wang2， yu2 ji1 xi1 jing4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 穆穆文王，于缉熙敬止。
interpretations.explanation: 穆穆文王，于缉熙敬止。

interpretations.segmentation: Solemn King Wen, in bright virtue and reverent conduct.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: jia3 zai1 tian1 ming4。

interpretations.segmentation: 假哉天命。
interpretations.explanation: 大哉天命。

interpretations.segmentation: Great is Heaven's command.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: you3 shang1 sun1 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 有商孙子。
interpretations.explanation: 有商的孙子。

interpretations.segmentation: There are Shang's descendants.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: shang1 zhi1 sun1 zi， qi2 li4 bu4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 商之孙子，其丽不亿。
interpretations.explanation: 商的孙子，其数量不止亿万。

interpretations.segmentation: Shang's descendants—their number is not less than hundreds of millions.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: shang4 di4 ji4 ming4， hou2 yu2 zhou1 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 上帝既命，侯于周服。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝既已下令，使之为周之诸侯。

interpretations.segmentation: God has commanded that they become Zhou's vassals.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: hou2 fu2 yu2 zhou1， tian1 ming4 mi2 chang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 侯服于周，天命靡常。
interpretations.explanation: 为周之诸侯，天命无常。

interpretations.segmentation: Serving Zhou as lords—Heaven's mandate is not constant.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: yin1 shi4 fu1 min3。

interpretations.segmentation: 殷士肤敏。
interpretations.explanation: 殷士容貌敏美。

interpretations.segmentation: Yin officers, fair and quick in mien.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: luo3 jiang1 yu2 jing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 裸将于京。
interpretations.explanation: 将在京助祭裸献。

interpretations.segmentation: They will assist at the libation rites in the capital.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: jue2 zuo4 luo3 jiang1， chang2 fu2 fu3 xu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 厥作裸将，常服黼冔。
interpretations.explanation: 他们担任裸将，常服黼冔。

interpretations.segmentation: Performing the libation service, in regular robes and embroidered caps.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: wang2 zhi1 jin4 chen2。

interpretations.segmentation: 王之荩臣。
interpretations.explanation: 是王的尽忠之臣。

interpretations.segmentation: They are the king's devoted ministers.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: wu2 nian4 er3 zu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 无念尔祖。
interpretations.explanation: 不要只想你的祖先。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not merely think of your ancestors.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: wu2 nian4 er3 zu3， yu4 xiu1 jue2 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 无念尔祖，聿修厥德。
interpretations.explanation: 不要只想你的祖先，要修其德行。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not merely think of your ancestors—cultivate their virtue.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: yong3 yan2 pei4 ming4， zi4 qiu2 duo1 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 永言配命，自求多福。
interpretations.explanation: 永远配合天命，自求多福。

interpretations.segmentation: Always align with Heaven's command and seek blessings for yourself.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: yin1 zhi1 wei4 sang4 shi1， ke4 pei4 shang4 di4。

interpretations.segmentation: 殷之未丧师，克配上帝。
interpretations.explanation: 殷商未失众师之前，尚能配上帝。

interpretations.segmentation: Before Yin lost its armies, it could still match God.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: yi2 jian4 yu2 yin1， jun4 ming4 bu4 yi4！

interpretations.segmentation: 宜鉴于殷，骏命不易！
interpretations.explanation: 宜以殷为鉴，大命不易！

interpretations.segmentation: Take Yin as a mirror—the great mandate is not easily kept!

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: ming4 zhi1 bu4 yi4， wu2 e4 er3 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 命之不易，无遏尔躬。
interpretations.explanation: 保命不易，不要阻遏自身之德。

interpretations.segmentation: Keeping the mandate is hard; do not block your own virtue.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: xuan1 zhao1 yi4 wen4， you3 yu2 yin1 zi4 tian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 宣昭义问，有虞殷自天。
interpretations.explanation: 宣明道义、善问，有虞之德自天而来。

interpretations.segmentation: Make clear righteousness and good inquiry; the virtue of Yu came from heaven.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: shang4 tian1 zhi1 zai4， wu2 sheng1 wu2 chou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 上天之载，无声无臭。
interpretations.explanation: 上天之事，无声无臭。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven's working has neither sound nor smell.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang.pinyin: yi2 xing2 wen2 wang2， wan4 bang1 zuo4 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 仪刑文王，万邦作孚。
interpretations.explanation: 效法文王，万邦作信。

interpretations.segmentation: Model yourself on King Wen, and all states will trust.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: wen2 wang2 you3 sheng1， yu4 jun4 you3 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王有声，遹骏有声。
interpretations.explanation: 文王有声，远播骏声。

interpretations.segmentation: King Wen had fame—his great name rang far.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: yu4 qiu2 jue2 ning2， yu4 guan1 jue2 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 遹求厥宁，遹观厥成。
interpretations.explanation: 远求其安，远观其成。

interpretations.segmentation: He sought peace from afar and watched his achievements from afar.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: wen2 wang2 zheng1 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 文王烝哉！
interpretations.explanation: 文王美哉！

interpretations.segmentation: King Wen, how glorious!

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: wen2 wang2 shou4 ming4， you3 ci3 wu3 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 文王受命，有此武功。
interpretations.explanation: 文王受天命，有此武功。

interpretations.segmentation: Wen received Heaven's mandate and won this martial success.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: ji4 fa2 yu2 chong2， zuo4 yi4 yu2 feng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 既伐于崇，作邑于丰。
interpretations.explanation: 既伐崇国，作邑于丰。

interpretations.segmentation: Having attacked Chong, he built his city at Feng.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: wen2 wang2 zheng1 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 文王烝哉！
interpretations.explanation: 文王美哉！

interpretations.segmentation: King Wen, how glorious!

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: zhu4 cheng2 yi1 yu4， zuo4 feng1 yi1 pi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 筑城伊淢，作丰伊匹。
interpretations.explanation: 筑城于淢地，作丰与镐相配。

interpretations.segmentation: He walled the Yi grounds and made Feng match its pair.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: fei3 ji2 qi2 yu4， yu4 zhui1 lai2 xiao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪棘其欲，遹追来孝。
interpretations.explanation: 非急其私欲，远追来孝。

interpretations.segmentation: Not rushing selfish aims, he pursued filial duty from afar.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: wang2 hou4 zheng1 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 王后烝哉！
interpretations.explanation: 王后美哉！

interpretations.segmentation: The queen, how glorious!

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: wang2 gong1 yi1 zhuo2， wei2 feng1 zhi1 yuan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 王公伊濯，维丰之垣。
interpretations.explanation: 王公光明，是丰之垣。

interpretations.segmentation: The king and duke were bright—the wall of Feng.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: si4 fang1 you1 tong2， wang2 hou4 wei2 han4。

interpretations.segmentation: 四方攸同，王后维翰。
interpretations.explanation: 四方来同，王后是翰（屏障）。

interpretations.segmentation: The four quarters came together; the queen was their bulwark.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: wang2 hou4 zheng1 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 王后烝哉！
interpretations.explanation: 王后美哉！

interpretations.segmentation: The queen, how glorious!

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: feng1 shui3 dong1 zhu4， wei2 yu3 zhi1 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 丰水东注，维禹之绩。
interpretations.explanation: 丰水东注，是大禹的功绩。

interpretations.segmentation: The Feng waters flow east—the achievement of Great Yu.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: si4 fang1 you1 tong2， huang2 wang2 wei2 pi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 四方攸同，皇王维辟。
interpretations.explanation: 四方来同，皇王是君。

interpretations.segmentation: The four quarters unite; the sovereign is their ruler.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: huang2 wang2 zheng1 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 皇王烝哉！
interpretations.explanation: 皇王美哉！

interpretations.segmentation: The sovereign, how glorious!

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.content: 镐京辟雍，自西自东，自南自北，无思不服。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: gao3 jing1 pi4 yong1， zi4 xi1 zi4 dong1， zi4 nan2 zi4 bei3， wu2 si1 bu4 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 镐京辟雍，自西自东，自南自北，无思不服。
interpretations.explanation: 镐京辟雍，自西自东，自南自北，无不臣服。

interpretations.segmentation: At Haojing's Bright Enclosure, from west and east, south and north—none failed to submit.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: huang2 wang2 zheng1 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 皇王烝哉！
interpretations.explanation: 皇王美哉！

interpretations.segmentation: The sovereign, how glorious!

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: kao3 bo wei2 wang2， zhai2 shi4 gao3 jing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 考卜维王，宅是镐京。
interpretations.explanation: 考卜维王，宅是镐京。

interpretations.segmentation: The king divined by tortoise and chose Haojing as his seat.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: wei2 gui1 zheng4 zhi1， wu3 wang2 cheng2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维龟正之，武王成之。
interpretations.explanation: 龟卜正定，武王成之。

interpretations.segmentation: The oracle confirmed it; King Wu completed it.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: wu3 wang2 zheng1 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 武王烝哉！
interpretations.explanation: 武王美哉！

interpretations.segmentation: King Wu, how glorious!

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: feng1 shui3 you3 qi3， wu3 wang2 qi3 bu4 shi4？

interpretations.segmentation: 丰水有芑，武王岂不仕？
interpretations.explanation: 丰水有杞，武王岂不就仕？

interpretations.segmentation: By the Feng grow qi trees—did King Wu not take office?

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: yi2 jue2 sun1 mou2， yi3 yan4 yi4 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 诒厥孙谋，以燕翼子。
interpretations.explanation: 遗其孙谋，以燕翼子。

interpretations.segmentation: He left plans for his descendants to comfort and protect his sons.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.pinyin: wu3 wang2 zheng1 zai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 武王烝哉！
interpretations.explanation: 武王美哉！

interpretations.segmentation: King Wu, how glorious!

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu.pinyin: xia4 wu3 wei2 zhou1， shi4 you3 zhe2 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 下武维周，世有哲王。
interpretations.explanation: 有周在下，世有哲王。

interpretations.segmentation: Zhou below has had wise kings generation after generation.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu.pinyin: san1 hou4 zai4 tian1， wang2 pei4 yu2 jing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 三后在天，王配于京。
interpretations.explanation: 三后在天，王配于京。

interpretations.segmentation: The three former kings are in heaven; the king matches them at the capital.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu.pinyin: wang2 pei4 yu2 jing1， shi4 de2 zuo4 qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 王配于京，世德作求。
interpretations.explanation: 王配于京，世德作求。

interpretations.segmentation: The king at the capital—ancestral virtue is what he seeks.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu.pinyin: yong3 yan2 pei4 ming4， cheng2 wang2 zhi1 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 永言配命，成王之孚。
interpretations.explanation: 永言配命，成王之孚。

interpretations.segmentation: Always align with Heaven's command—King Cheng's trustworthiness.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu.pinyin: cheng2 wang2 zhi1 fu2， xia4 tu3 zhi1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 成王之孚，下土之式。
interpretations.explanation: 成王之孚，下土之式。

interpretations.segmentation: Cheng's trust is the model for all below heaven.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu.pinyin: yong3 yan2 xiao4 si1， xiao4 si1 wei2 ze2。

interpretations.segmentation: 永言孝思，孝思维则。
interpretations.explanation: 永言孝思，孝思维则。

interpretations.segmentation: Ever speak of filial thought—filial thought is the rule.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu.pinyin: mei4 zi1 yi1 ren2， ying1 hou2 shun4 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 媚兹一人，应侯顺德。
interpretations.explanation: 爱此一人，应侯顺德。

interpretations.segmentation: Cherish this one man—respond as lord with compliant virtue.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu.pinyin: yong3 yan2 xiao4 si1， zhao1 zai1 si4 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 永言孝思，昭哉嗣服。
interpretations.explanation: 永言孝思，昭哉嗣服。

interpretations.segmentation: Ever filial in thought—clear is the heir's service.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu.pinyin: zhao1 zi1 lai2 xu3， sheng2 qi2 zu3 wu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 昭兹来许，绳其祖武。
interpretations.explanation: 昭明来许，绳其祖武。

interpretations.segmentation: Brightly the coming praise—follow the footsteps of his ancestors.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu.pinyin: yu2 wan4 si1 nian2， shou4 tian1 zhi1 hu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 于万斯年，受天之祜。
interpretations.explanation: 于万斯年，受天之祜。

interpretations.segmentation: For ten thousand years, receive Heaven's blessing.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu.pinyin: shou4 tian1 zhi1 hu4， si4 fang1 lai2 he4。

interpretations.segmentation: 受天之祜，四方来贺。
interpretations.explanation: 受天之祜，四方来贺。

interpretations.segmentation: Receiving Heaven's blessing, the four quarters come to congratulate.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu.pinyin: yu2 wan4 si1 nian2， bu4 xia2 you3 zuo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 于万斯年，不遐有佐。
interpretations.explanation: 于万斯年，不远有佐。

interpretations.segmentation: For ten thousand years, helpers will not be far.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu.pinyin: peng2 peng2 yu4 pu3， xin1 zhi1 you3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 芃芃棫朴，薪之槱之。
interpretations.explanation: 棫朴茂盛，砍来捆作薪柴。

interpretations.segmentation: Luxuriant oak shoots—cut and bundled for fuel.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu.pinyin: ji4 ji4 pi4 wang2， zuo3 you4 qu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 济济辟王，左右趣之。
interpretations.explanation: 济济君王，左右奔走趋事。

interpretations.segmentation: The splendid king—attendants hurry left and right to serve.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu.pinyin: ji4 ji4 pi4 wang2， zuo3 you4 feng4 zhang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 济济辟王，左右奉璋。
interpretations.explanation: 济济君王，左右捧璋。

interpretations.segmentation: The splendid king—attendants hold jade tablets on either side.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu.pinyin: feng4 zhang1 e2 e2， mao2 shi4 you1 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 奉璋峨峨，髦士攸宜。
interpretations.explanation: 捧璋峨峨，俊士所宜。

interpretations.segmentation: The tablets held high—fit for outstanding men.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu.pinyin: pi4 bi3 jing1 zhou1， zheng1 tu2 ji2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 淠彼泾舟，烝徒楫之。
interpretations.explanation: 泾水之舟泛泛，众徒划桨。

interpretations.segmentation: Boats on the Jing drift wide; the crowd rows with oars.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu.pinyin: zhou1 wang2 yu2 mai4， liu4 shi1 ji2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 周王于迈，六师及之。
interpretations.explanation: 周王出行，六师赶到。

interpretations.segmentation: The Zhou king marched; the six armies joined him.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu.pinyin: zhuo1 bi3 yun2 han4， wei4 zhang1 yu2 tian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 倬彼云汉，为章于天。
interpretations.explanation: 那银河昭昭，为章于天。

interpretations.segmentation: That Milky Way shines bright—a pattern in the sky.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu.pinyin: zhou1 wang2 shou4 kao3， xia2 bu4 zuo4 ren2？

interpretations.segmentation: 周王寿考，遐不作人？
interpretations.explanation: 周王长寿，岂远不育人？

interpretations.segmentation: The Zhou king long-lived—how could he fail to nurture men?

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu.pinyin: zhui1 zuo2 qi2 zhang1， jin1 yu4 qi2 xiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 追琢其章，金玉其相。
interpretations.explanation: 追琢其章，金玉其相。

interpretations.segmentation: Carve and polish their pattern; gold and jade their aspect.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu.pinyin: mian3 mian3 wo3 wang2， gang1 ji4 si4 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 勉勉我王，纲纪四方。
interpretations.explanation: 勉勉我王，纲纪四方。

interpretations.segmentation: Diligent is our king—he holds the four quarters in order.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: bin1 zhi1 chu1 yan2， zuo3 you4 zhi4 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 宾之初筵，左右秩秩。
interpretations.explanation: 宴会刚开，左右次序井然。

interpretations.segmentation: When the feast begins, left and right are in proper order.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: bian1 dou4 you3 chu3， xiao2 he2 wei2 lv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 笾豆有楚，殽核维旅。
interpretations.explanation: 笾豆排列整肃，肴核成行。

interpretations.segmentation: Baskets and stands are set in rows; meats and fruits line up.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: jiu3 ji4 he2 zhi3， yin3 jiu3 kong3 xie2。

interpretations.segmentation: 酒既和旨，饮酒孔偕。
interpretations.explanation: 酒已调和甘美，饮酒要和乐。

interpretations.segmentation: The wine is blended and sweet; drinking should be harmonious.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: zhong1 gu3 ji4 she4， ju3 chou2 yi4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 钟鼓既设，举酬逸逸。
interpretations.explanation: 钟鼓已设，举杯敬酒从容不迫。

interpretations.segmentation: Bells and drums are ready; cups are raised in easy toasts.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: da4 hou2 ji4 kang4， gong1 shi3 si1 zhang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 大侯既抗，弓矢斯张。
interpretations.explanation: 大射侯已竖起，弓矢已张开。

interpretations.segmentation: The great target is raised; bows and arrows are strung.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: she4 fu1 ji4 tong2， xian4 er3 fa1 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 射夫既同，献尔发功。
interpretations.explanation: 射手已齐，献你们射箭的功夫。

interpretations.segmentation: Archers stand together—show the skill of your shooting.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: fa1 bi3 you3 de， yi3 qi2 er3 jue2。

interpretations.segmentation: 发彼有的，以祈尔爵。
interpretations.explanation: 射那靶子，以求赐爵。

interpretations.segmentation: Shoot at the mark, to win the grant of a cup.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: yue4 wu3 sheng1 gu3， le4 ji4 he2 zou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 籥舞笙鼓，乐既和奏。
interpretations.explanation: 籥舞、笙鼓，乐声和奏。

interpretations.segmentation: Flute-dance, pipes and drums—the music blends in play.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: zheng1 kan4 lie4 zu3， yi3 qia4 bai3 li3。

interpretations.segmentation: 烝衎烈祖，以洽百礼。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐祖先，以协百礼。

interpretations.segmentation: Delight the glorious ancestors and harmonize the hundred rites.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: bai3 li3 ji4 zhi4， you3 ren2 you3 lin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 百礼既至，有壬有林。
interpretations.explanation: 百礼既到，宾主众多。

interpretations.segmentation: All rites are present; hosts and guests are many.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: xi1 er3 chun2 gu3， zi sun1 qi2 zhan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 锡尔纯嘏，子孙其湛。
interpretations.explanation: 赐你大福，子孙和乐。

interpretations.segmentation: May you receive pure blessing; may your descendants be at ease.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: qi2 zhan4 yue1 le4， ge4 zou4 er3 neng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 其湛曰乐，各奏尔能。
interpretations.explanation: 和乐曰乐，各奏其能。

interpretations.segmentation: In ease they call it joy—each performs his skill.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: bin1 zai4 shou3 chou2， shi4 ren2 ru4 you4。

interpretations.segmentation: 宾载手仇，室人入又。
interpretations.explanation: 宾客递相劝酒，主人再入献酒。

interpretations.segmentation: Guests hand cups to rivals; the host enters again to serve.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: zhuo2 bi3 kang1 jue2， yi3 zou4 er3 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 酌彼康爵，以奏尔时。
interpretations.explanation: 酌那丰爵，以奏合于时宜。

interpretations.segmentation: Pour the generous cup and offer what fits the moment.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: bin1 zhi1 chu1 yan2， wen1 wen1 qi2 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 宾之初筵，温温其恭。
interpretations.explanation: 宴会初时，温温恭敬。

interpretations.segmentation: At the feast's start, guests are gentle and respectful.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: qi2 wei4 zui4 zhi3， wei1 yi2 fan3 fan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 其未醉止，威仪反反。
interpretations.explanation: 未醉之前，威仪谨慎反反。

interpretations.segmentation: Before they are drunk, their bearing is careful and correct.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: yue1 ji4 zui4 zhi3， wei1 yi2 fan1 fan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 曰既醉止，威仪幡幡。
interpretations.explanation: 既已醉了，威仪就轻飘幡幡。

interpretations.segmentation: Once drunk, their dignity grows loose and wavering.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: she3 qi2 zuo4 qian1， lv3 wu3 xian1 xian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 舍其坐迁，屡舞仙仙。
interpretations.explanation: 离开座位乱走，屡屡轻佻起舞。

interpretations.segmentation: They leave their seats and dance again and again, light and improper.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: qi2 wei4 zui4 zhi3， wei1 yi2 yi4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 其未醉止，威仪抑抑。
interpretations.explanation: 未醉之前，威仪庄敬抑抑。

interpretations.segmentation: Before drunk, their bearing is restrained and solemn.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: yue1 ji4 zui4 zhi3， wei1 yi2 yi4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 曰既醉止，威仪抑抑。
interpretations.explanation: 说既醉了，威仪仍称抑抑（反讽其失）。

interpretations.segmentation: They say they are drunk yet still call their bearing solemn—ironic.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: shi4 yue1 ji4 zui4， bu4 zhi1 qi2 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 是曰既醉，不知其秩。
interpretations.explanation: 这就叫做醉了，不知行礼次序。

interpretations.segmentation: This is being drunk—not knowing ritual order.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: bin1 ji4 zui4 zhi3， zai4 hao4 zai4 nao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 宾既醉止，载号载呶。
interpretations.explanation: 宾客既醉，又呼又叫。

interpretations.segmentation: Guests drunk, shouting and clamoring.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: luan4 wo3 bian1 dou4， lv3 wu3 qi1 qi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乱我笾豆，屡舞僛僛。
interpretations.explanation: 弄乱我笾豆，屡屡歪斜起舞。

interpretations.segmentation: They upset my baskets and stands, dancing crookedly again and again.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: shi4 yue1 ji4 zui4， bu4 zhi1 qi2 you2。

interpretations.segmentation: 是曰既醉，不知其邮。
interpretations.explanation: 这就叫做醉了，不知过错。

interpretations.segmentation: This is being drunk—not knowing one's faults.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: ce4 bian4 zhi1 e2， lv3 wu3 suo1 suo1。

interpretations.segmentation: 侧弁之俄，屡舞傞傞。
interpretations.explanation: 冠帽歪戴，屡屡错乱起舞。

interpretations.segmentation: Caps askew, they dance in stumbling confusion.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: ji4 zui4 er2 chu1， bing4 shou4 qi2 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既醉而出，并受其福。
interpretations.explanation: 醉后出门，一同受福。

interpretations.segmentation: Drunk yet leaving—you still share the blessing.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: zui4 er2 bu4 chu1， shi4 wei4 fa2 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 醉而不出，是谓伐德。
interpretations.explanation: 醉了还不走，叫做败坏德行。

interpretations.segmentation: Drunk and not leaving—this is called harming virtue.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: yin3 jiu3 kong3 jia1， wei2 qi2 ling4 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 饮酒孔嘉，维其令仪。
interpretations.explanation: 饮酒甚美，关键在好的礼仪。

interpretations.segmentation: Drinking is fine—what matters is good ceremony.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: fan2 ci3 yin3 jiu3， huo4 zui4 huo4 fou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 凡此饮酒，或醉或否。
interpretations.explanation: 凡此饮酒，有人醉有人不醉。

interpretations.segmentation: Among all who drink here, some are drunk and some are not.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: ji4 li4 zhi1 jian1， huo4 zuo3 zhi1 shi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 既立之监，或佐之史。
interpretations.explanation: 既设监酒之人，又设史官记录。

interpretations.segmentation: A overseer is appointed, and a scribe may assist.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: bi3 zui4 bu4 zang1， bu4 zui4 fan3 chi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼醉不臧，不醉反耻。
interpretations.explanation: 彼人醉了不好，不醉反而羞耻（讽俗）。

interpretations.segmentation: For some, being drunk is bad; not being drunk is shame—mocking custom.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: shi4 wu4 cong2 wei4， wu2 bi3 da4 dai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 式勿从谓，无俾大怠。
interpretations.explanation: 不要跟着劝酒，不要使人大怠。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not follow urging to drink; do not let people grow greatly slack.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: fei3 yan2 wu4 yan2， fei3 you2 wu4 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪言勿言，匪由勿语。
interpretations.explanation: 不该说的不要说，不该由头的话不要讲。

interpretations.segmentation: What should not be said—do not say; what should not be broached—do not speak.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: you2 zui4 zhi1 yan2， bi3 chu1 tong2 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 由醉之言，俾出童羖。
interpretations.explanation: 醉后说的话，像公羊乱叫一样荒唐。

interpretations.segmentation: Words from drunken lips are like a ram bleating nonsense.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan.pinyin: san1 jue2 bu4 shi2， shen3 gan3 duo1 you4。

interpretations.segmentation: 三爵不识，矧敢多又。
interpretations.explanation: 三杯就不知礼，何况再多喝。

interpretations.segmentation: After three cups they know nothing—how dare they drink more?

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.pinyin: shang shang zhe3 hua2， qi2 ye4 xu1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 裳裳者华，其叶湑兮。
interpretations.explanation: 鲜花鲜亮，其叶盛茂。

interpretations.segmentation: Bright the blossoms; their leaves are lush.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.pinyin: wo3 gou4 zhi1 zi， wo3 xin1 xie3 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我觏之子，我心写兮。
interpretations.explanation: 我见那君子，我心喜悦舒展。

interpretations.segmentation: I meet that noble man—my heart opens in joy.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.content: 我心写兮，是以有誉处兮。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.pinyin: wo3 xin1 xie3 xi1， shi4 yi3 you3 yu4 chu4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我心写兮，是以有誉处兮。
interpretations.explanation: 心喜悦舒展，所以有好声誉、好居处。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart is glad—therefore I have honor and a good place.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.pinyin: shang shang zhe3 hua2， yun2 qi2 huang2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 裳裳者华，芸其黄矣。
interpretations.explanation: 鲜花鲜亮，芸草已变黄。

interpretations.segmentation: Bright the blossoms; the rue has turned yellow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.pinyin: wo3 gou4 zhi1 zi， wei2 qi2 you3 zhang1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我觏之子，维其有章矣。
interpretations.explanation: 我见那君子，文彩有章。

interpretations.segmentation: I meet that noble man—he has clear distinction.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.content: 维其有章矣，是以有庆矣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.pinyin: wei2 qi2 you3 zhang1 yi3， shi4 yi3 you3 qing4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 维其有章矣，是以有庆矣。
interpretations.explanation: 有文彩有章，所以有福庆。

interpretations.segmentation: Because he has distinction, there is celebration.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.pinyin: shang shang zhe3 hua2， huo4 huang2 huo4 bai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 裳裳者华，或黄或白。
interpretations.explanation: 鲜花鲜亮，或黄或白。

interpretations.segmentation: Bright the blossoms—some yellow, some white.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.pinyin: wo3 gou4 zhi1 zi， cheng2 qi2 si4 luo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我觏之子，乘其四骆。
interpretations.explanation: 我见那君子，乘四匹骆马。

interpretations.segmentation: I meet that noble man—he drives four black horses.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.pinyin: cheng2 qi2 si4 luo4， liu4 pei4 wo4 ruo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 乘其四骆，六辔沃若。
interpretations.explanation: 乘四骆，六辔润泽。

interpretations.segmentation: With four horses, the six reins are glossy.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.pinyin: zuo3 zhi1 zuo3 zhi1， jun1 zi yi2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 左之左之，君子宜之。
interpretations.explanation: 左用左，君子宜之。

interpretations.segmentation: Use the left where left fits—the noble man is suited to it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.pinyin: you4 zhi1 you4 zhi1， jun1 zi you3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 右之右之，君子有之。
interpretations.explanation: 右用右，君子有之。

interpretations.segmentation: Use the right where right fits—the noble man has it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.pinyin: wei2 qi2 you3 zhi1， shi4 yi3 shi4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维其有之，是以似之。
interpretations.explanation: 正因有之，所以相似（可继前人）。

interpretations.segmentation: Because he has these gifts, he resembles the great of old.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia.content: 间关车之舝兮，思娈季女逝兮。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia.pinyin: jian1 guan1 che1 zhi1 xia2 xi1， si1 luan2 ji4 nv3 shi4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 间关车之舝兮，思娈季女逝兮。
interpretations.explanation: 车舝转动声关关，想那贤淑女子同去。

interpretations.segmentation: The axle-fittings click— I think of the fair maiden going with me.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia.pinyin: fei3 ji1 fei3 ke3， de2 yin1 lai2 kuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪饥匪渴，德音来括。
interpretations.explanation: 非为饥渴，是好德音来招我。

interpretations.segmentation: Not from hunger or thirst—good virtue's call draws me.
虽无好友？
interpretations.explanation: 虽无许多朋友？

interpretations.segmentation: Though we lack many friends?
式燕且喜。
interpretations.explanation: 且宴饮且欢喜。

interpretations.segmentation: Let us feast and rejoice.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia.pinyin: yi1 bi3 ping2 lin2， you3 ji2 wei2 jiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 依彼平林，有集维鷮。
interpretations.explanation: 依那平林，有集是鹰。

interpretations.segmentation: By the level woods a hawk settles.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia.pinyin: chen2 bi3 shuo4 nv3， ling4 de2 lai2 jiao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 辰彼硕女，令德来教。
interpretations.explanation: 遇那硕女，令德来教。

interpretations.segmentation: I meet the tall maiden—fine virtue comes to instruct.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia.pinyin: shi4 yan4 qie3 yu4， hao3 er3 wu2 she4。

interpretations.segmentation: 式燕且誉，好尔无射。
interpretations.explanation: 且宴且誉，爱你不止。

interpretations.segmentation: Feast and praise you—I love you without end.
虽无旨酒？
interpretations.explanation: 虽无旨酒？

interpretations.segmentation: Though we have no fine wine?
式饮庶几。
interpretations.explanation: 且饮几杯也好。

interpretations.segmentation: Let us drink what we may.
虽无嘉肴？
interpretations.explanation: 虽无嘉肴？

interpretations.segmentation: Though we have no rich dishes?
式食庶几。
interpretations.explanation: 且吃几品也好。

interpretations.segmentation: Let us eat what we may.
虽无德与女？
interpretations.explanation: 虽无德与你相比？

interpretations.segmentation: Though I have no virtue to match yours?
式歌且舞？
interpretations.explanation: 且歌且舞如何？

interpretations.segmentation: Shall we sing and dance?

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia.pinyin: zhi4 bi3 gao1 gang1， xi1 qi2 zha4 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 陟彼高冈，析其柞薪。
interpretations.explanation: 登那高冈，劈柞柴薪。

interpretations.segmentation: Climb the high hill; split oak for firewood.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia.pinyin: xi1 qi2 zha4 xin1， qi2 ye4 xu1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 析其柞薪，其叶湑兮。
interpretations.explanation: 劈柞柴薪，其叶盛茂。

interpretations.segmentation: Splitting oak fuel—its leaves are lush.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia.pinyin: xian1 wo3 gou4 er3， wo3 xin1 xie3 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鲜我觏尔，我心写兮。
interpretations.explanation: 幸我见你，我心喜悦舒展。

interpretations.segmentation: Happy I meet you—my heart opens in joy.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia.pinyin: gao1 shan1 yang3 zhi3， jing3 xing2 xing2 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 高山仰止，景行行止。
interpretations.explanation: 高山可仰，大道可行（德可效法）。

interpretations.segmentation: The high mountain is to be looked up to; the great path is to be walked.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia.pinyin: si4 mu3 fei1 fei1， liu4 pei4 ru2 qin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 四牡騑騑，六辔如琴。
interpretations.explanation: 四马騑騑，六辔如琴。

interpretations.segmentation: Four steeds pace evenly; six reins sound like a lute.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia.pinyin: gou4 er3 xin1 hun1， yi3 wei4 wo3 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 觏尔新婚，以慰我心。
interpretations.explanation: 见尔新婚，以慰我心。

interpretations.segmentation: Seeing you newly wed—it eases my heart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.content: 大田多稼，既种既戒，既备乃事。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.pinyin: da4 tian2 duo1 jia4， ji4 zhong3 ji4 jie4， ji4 bei4 nai3 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 大田多稼，既种既戒，既备乃事。
interpretations.explanation: 大田种稼多，既种既戒，备齐乃事。

interpretations.segmentation: Great fields bear many crops—sown, warned, prepared, then the work begins.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.pinyin: yi3 wo3 tan2 si4， chu4 zai4 nan2 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 以我覃耜，俶载南亩。
interpretations.explanation: 用我的深耜，开始于南亩。

interpretations.segmentation: With my deep plowshare I start work on the southern acres.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.content: 播厥百谷，既庭且硕，曾孙是若。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.pinyin: bo1 jue2 bai3 gu3， ji4 ting2 qie3 shuo4， ceng2 sun1 shi4 ruo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 播厥百谷，既庭且硕，曾孙是若。
interpretations.explanation: 播百谷，既齐整又硕大，曾孙所悦。

interpretations.segmentation: Sow the hundred grains—neat and plump, as the lord desires.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.content: 既方既皂，既坚既好，不稂不莠。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.pinyin: ji4 fang1 ji4 zao4， ji4 jian1 ji4 hao3， bu4 lang2 bu4 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 既方既皂，既坚既好，不稂不莠。
interpretations.explanation: 既灌浆又成长，既坚又好，无稂无莠。

interpretations.segmentation: Ears fill and ripen, firm and good—no wild oats or darnel.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.pinyin: qu4 qi2 ming2 te4， ji2 qi2 mao2 zei2，

interpretations.segmentation: 去其螟螣，及其蟊贼，
interpretations.explanation: 除去螟螣，及蟊贼，

interpretations.segmentation: Remove caterpillars and borers, and all crop pests—
无害我田稚。
interpretations.explanation: 勿害我田禾。

interpretations.segmentation: do not harm our young fields.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.pinyin: tian2 zu3 you3 shen2， bing3 bi4 yan2 huo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 田祖有神，秉畀炎火。
interpretations.explanation: 田祖有神，持火除害。

interpretations.segmentation: The field god has power—carry fire to destroy the pests.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.pinyin: you3 yan3 qi1 qi1， xing1 yu3 qi2 qi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有渰萋萋，兴雨祈祈。
interpretations.explanation: 云气弥漫，细雨淅淅。

interpretations.segmentation: Clouds gather thick; rain falls softly.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.pinyin: yu3 wo3 gong1 tian2， sui4 ji2 wo3 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 雨我公田，遂及我私。
interpretations.explanation: 雨我公田，遂及我私。

interpretations.segmentation: Rain on our lord's fields, then reaches our private plots.
彼有不获稚，
interpretations.explanation: 彼处有不收的幼禾，

interpretations.segmentation: There some young grain is left ungathered—

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.content: 此有不敛穧，彼有遗秉，此有滞穗，伊寡妇之利。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.pinyin: ci3 you3 bu4 lian3 ji4， bi3 you3 yi2 bing3， ci3 you3 zhi4 sui4， yi1 gua3 fu4 zhi1 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 此有不敛穧，彼有遗秉，此有滞穗，伊寡妇之利。
interpretations.explanation: 此处有不收的禾束，彼有遗秉，此有滞穗，是寡妇之利。

interpretations.segmentation: here unbound sheaves remain; there dropped bundles, here stuck ears—the widow's gain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.pinyin: ceng2 sun1 lai2 zhi3， yi3 qi2 fu4 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 曾孙来止，以其妇子。
interpretations.explanation: 曾孙来，带妇与子。

interpretations.segmentation: The lord comes with wife and child.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.pinyin: ye4 bi3 nan2 mu3， tian2 jun4 zhi4 xi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 馌彼南亩，田畯至喜。
interpretations.explanation: 送饭到南亩，田官至喜。

interpretations.segmentation: Food is brought to the southern fields; the field master is glad.
来方禋祀，
interpretations.explanation: 来方行禋祀，

interpretations.segmentation: The coming states perform the border sacrifice—

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.pinyin: yi3 qi2 xing1 hei1， yu3 qi2 shu3 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 以其骍黑，与其黍稷。
interpretations.explanation: 用赤色黑尾牲，与黍稷。

interpretations.segmentation: with red and black beasts, and millet and panic grass.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian.pinyin: yi3 xiang3 yi3 si4， yi3 jie4 jing3 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 以享以祀，以介景福。
interpretations.explanation: 以享以祀，以介景福。

interpretations.segmentation: Offer and sacrifice, to gain great blessing.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: zhuo1 bi3 fu3 tian2， sui4 qu3 shi2 qian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 倬彼甫田，岁取十千。
interpretations.explanation: 那大片田畴多么广阔，一年能收上万石粮食。

interpretations.segmentation: How vast and broad those fields—each year they yield ten thousand measures of grain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: wo3 qu3 qi2 chen2， shi2 wo3 nong2 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我取其陈，食我农人。
interpretations.explanation: 取出陈粮来食用，养活我们的农民。

interpretations.segmentation: We take out stored grain to feed our farm folk.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: zi4 gu3 you3 nian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 自古有年。
interpretations.explanation: 自古以来就有好年成。

interpretations.segmentation: Since ancient times there have been years of plenty.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: jin1 shi4 nan2 mu3， huo4 yun2 huo4 zi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 今适南亩，或耘或耔。
interpretations.explanation: 今天到南边田里去，有的除草有的培土。

interpretations.segmentation: Today we go to the southern fields—some hoe weeds, some hill up the soil.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.content: 黍稷薿薿，攸介攸止，烝我髦士。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: shu3 ji4 ni3 ni3， you1 jie4 you1 zhi3， zheng1 wo3 mao2 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 黍稷薿薿，攸介攸止，烝我髦士。
interpretations.explanation: 黍稷长得茂盛，分田界、立田埂，召集俊秀之士。

interpretations.segmentation: Millet and millet-sorghum grow lush; we mark bounds and ridges and gather our fine young men.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.content: 以我齐明，与我牺羊，以社以方。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: yi3 wo3 qi2 ming2， yu3 wo3 xi1 yang2， yi3 she4 yi3 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 以我齐明，与我牺羊，以社以方。
interpretations.explanation: 用洁净的谷米和纯色祭羊，祭祀社神和四方神。

interpretations.segmentation: With purified grain and spotless sacrificial rams we worship the soil god and the gods of the four quarters.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: wo3 tian2 ji4 zang1， nong2 fu1 zhi1 qing4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我田既臧，农夫之庆。
interpretations.explanation: 我的田已经丰收，这是农夫的喜庆。

interpretations.segmentation: My fields are now abundant—this is the farmers' celebration.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: qin2 se4 ji1 gu3， yi3 yu4 tian2 zu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 琴瑟击鼓，以御田祖。
interpretations.explanation: 弹琴击鼓，以乐招待田祖。

interpretations.segmentation: Zithers and drums sound to entertain the field ancestor.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.content: 以祈甘雨，以介我稷黍，以穀我士女。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: yi3 qi2 gan1 yu3， yi3 jie4 wo3 ji4 shu3， yi3 gu3 wo3 shi4 nv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 以祈甘雨，以介我稷黍，以穀我士女。
interpretations.explanation: 祈求甘雨，使稷黍丰登，养活百姓。

interpretations.segmentation: We pray for sweet rain, that millet may thrive and feed our men and women.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: ceng2 sun1 lai2 zhi3， yi3 qi2 fu4 zi。

interpretations.segmentation: 曾孙来止，以其妇子。
interpretations.explanation: 曾孙来到田间，带着妻子儿女。

interpretations.segmentation: The great-grandson arrives, with his wife and children.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: ye4 bi3 nan2 mu3， tian2 jun4 zhi4 xi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 馌彼南亩，田畯至喜。
interpretations.explanation: 到南边田头送饭，田官非常欢喜。

interpretations.segmentation: Meals are brought to the southern plots; the field overseer is full of joy.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: rang3 qi2 zuo3 you4，

interpretations.segmentation: 攘其左右，
interpretations.explanation: 曾孙拨开左右的人，

interpretations.segmentation: The great-grandson pushes aside those on left and right,

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: chang2 qi2 zhi3 fou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 尝其旨否。
interpretations.explanation: 亲自尝饭菜味道好坏。

interpretations.segmentation: and himself tastes whether the food is good.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: he2 yi4 zhang3 mu3， zhong1 shan4 qie3 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 禾易长亩，终善且有。
interpretations.explanation: 禾苗长满田亩，最终既好又丰足。

interpretations.segmentation: The grain fills every acre; in the end it is fine and plentiful.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: ceng2 sun1 bu4 nu4， nong2 fu1 ke4 min3。

interpretations.segmentation: 曾孙不怒，农夫克敏。
interpretations.explanation: 曾孙不责罚，农夫便尽心竭力。

interpretations.segmentation: When the great-grandson shows no anger, the farmers work with all their skill.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: ceng2 sun1 zhi1 jia4， ru2 ci2 ru2 liang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 曾孙之稼，如茨如梁。
interpretations.explanation: 曾孙的庄稼，堆如茅茨、高如屋梁。

interpretations.segmentation: The great-grandson's crops pile like thatched roofs, rise like rafters.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: ceng2 sun1 zhi1 yu3， ru2 chi2 ru2 jing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 曾孙之庾，如坻如京。
interpretations.explanation: 曾孙的粮仓，低如水中高地、高如小山。

interpretations.segmentation: His granaries spread like islets, tower like hills.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: nai3 qiu2 qian1 si1 cang1，

interpretations.segmentation: 乃求千斯仓，
interpretations.explanation: 于是求造千百座仓，

interpretations.segmentation: Then he seeks to build granaries by the thousand,

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: nai3 qiu2 wan4 si1 xiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃求万斯箱。
interpretations.explanation: 又求造上万个粮箱。

interpretations.segmentation: and seeks ten thousand bins besides.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian.pinyin: shu3 ji4 dao4 liang2， nong2 fu1 zhi1 qing4。

interpretations.segmentation: 黍稷稻粱，农夫之庆。
interpretations.explanation: 黍稷稻粱齐备，是农夫的喜庆。

interpretations.segmentation: May the noble man live ten thousand years; fortune and rank bring him peace.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi.pinyin: zhan1 bi3 luo4 yi3， wei2 shui3 yang1 yang1。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan.pinyin: huo4 bu4 zhi1 jiao4 hao4， huo4 can3 can3 qu2 lao2；

interpretations.segmentation: 或不知叫号，或惨惨劬劳；
interpretations.explanation: 有人不知呼号之苦，有人惨惨劬劳；

interpretations.segmentation: Some know nothing of cries of distress, some toil in bitter misery;

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan.content: 或栖迟偃仰，或王事鞅掌。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan.pinyin: huo4 qi1 chi2 yan3 yang3， huo4 wang2 shi4 yang1 zhang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 或栖迟偃仰，或王事鞅掌。
interpretations.explanation: 有人安闲躺卧，有人为王事忙得不可开交。

interpretations.segmentation: Some live at leisure, others are overwhelmed with the king's business.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan.content: 或湛乐饮酒，或惨惨畏咎；
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan.pinyin: huo4 zhan4 le4 yin3 jiu3， huo4 can3 can3 wei4 jiu4；

interpretations.segmentation: 或湛乐饮酒，或惨惨畏咎；
interpretations.explanation: 有人沉湎饮酒作乐，有人惨惨畏惧灾祸；

interpretations.segmentation: Some drink deep in pleasure, some live in dread of blame and punishment;

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan.content: 或出入风议，或靡事不为。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan.pinyin: huo4 chu1 ru4 feng1 yi4， huo4 mi2 shi4 bu4 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 或出入风议，或靡事不为。
interpretations.explanation: 有人出入发表议论，有人无事不为王效劳。

interpretations.segmentation: Some go in and out airing opinions, some have no task they do not perform for the king.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.content: 楚楚者茨，言抽其棘，自昔何为？
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: chu3 chu3 zhe3 ci2， yan2 chou1 qi2 ji2， zi4 xi1 he2 wei4？

interpretations.segmentation: 楚楚者茨，言抽其棘，自昔何为？
interpretations.explanation: 丛丛茨草，要拔除其中的荆棘；自古如此是为了什么呢？

interpretations.segmentation: Thick thistles—we pull up their thorns; since olden days, what has this been for?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: wo3 yi4 shu3 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我蓺黍稷。
interpretations.explanation: 是为了种植黍和稷。

interpretations.segmentation: To plant millet and millet-sorghum.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: wo3 shu3 yu3 yu3， wo3 ji4 yi4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我黍与与，我稷翼翼。
interpretations.explanation: 我的黍苗茂盛，我的稷苗整齐。

interpretations.segmentation: My millet stands lush; my sorghum rows are neat.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: wo3 cang1 ji4 ying2， wo3 yu3 wei2 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我仓既盈，我庾维亿。
interpretations.explanation: 我的仓已满，我的庾积亿计。

interpretations.segmentation: My granaries are full; my storehouses hold measure upon measure.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.content: 以为酒食，以享以祀，以妥以侑，以介景福。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: yi3 wei4 jiu3 shi2， yi3 xiang3 yi3 si4， yi3 tuo3 yi3 you4， yi3 jie4 jing3 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 以为酒食，以享以祀，以妥以侑，以介景福。
interpretations.explanation: 做成酒食，用来献祭、祭祀，使神安、助祭，以祈求大福。

interpretations.segmentation: We make wine and food for offering and sacrifice, to settle the spirits and assist the rite, seeking great blessing.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.content: 济济跄跄，絜尔牛羊，以往烝尝。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: ji4 ji4 qiang1 qiang1， jie2 er3 niu2 yang2， yi3 wang3 zheng1 chang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 济济跄跄，絜尔牛羊，以往烝尝。
interpretations.explanation: 礼仪盛美，洁净牛羊，拿去进献秋冬之祭。

interpretations.segmentation: With stately rites we cleanse ox and sheep and bring them to the autumn and winter sacrifices.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: huo4 bo1 huo4 heng1， huo4 si4 huo4 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 或剥或亨，或四或将。
interpretations.explanation: 有的剥皮有的烹煮，有的切成四块有的端上。

interpretations.segmentation: Some skin and boil, some quarter the meat and some carry it forth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: zhu4 ji4 yu2 beng1，

interpretations.segmentation: 祝祭于祊，
interpretations.explanation: 在门内祭处祝告，

interpretations.segmentation: The invoker prays at the inner gate,

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: si4 shi4 kong3 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 祀事孔明。
interpretations.explanation: 祭祀之事非常明白成功。

interpretations.segmentation: and the sacrificial service is bright and complete.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: xian1 zu3 shi4 huang2， shen2 bao3 shi4 xiang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 先祖是皇，神保是飨。
interpretations.explanation: 先祖来享用，神尸也受祭飨。

interpretations.segmentation: The forefathers are honored; the spirit-host receives the feast.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.content: 孝孙有庆，报以介福，万寿无疆！
