sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: xiao4 sun1 you3 qing4， bao4 yi3 jie4 fu2， wan4 shou4 wu2 jiang1！

interpretations.segmentation: 孝孙有庆，报以介福，万寿无疆！
interpretations.explanation: 孝孙有喜庆，回报以大福，万寿无疆！

interpretations.segmentation: The dutiful grandson has joy; great blessing returns—may life be endless!

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.content: 执爨踖踖，为俎孔硕，或燔或炙。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: zhi2 cuan4 ji2 ji2， wei4 zu3 kong3 shuo4， huo4 fan2 huo4 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 执爨踖踖，为俎孔硕，或燔或炙。
interpretations.explanation: 掌炊的人勤勉，俎上祭品很丰盛，有的烧烤有的炙烤。

interpretations.segmentation: The cook is diligent; the stands hold ample offerings—some roasted, some broiled.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: jun1 fu4 mo4 mo4， wei4 dou4 kong3 shu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 君妇莫莫，为豆孔庶。
interpretations.explanation: 主妇恭敬，豆中食物很多。

interpretations.segmentation: The hostess is reverent; the dishes are heaped with food.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: wei4 bin1 wei4 ke4，

interpretations.segmentation: 为宾为客，
interpretations.explanation: 招待宾客，

interpretations.segmentation: Guests are welcomed as visitors,

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: xian4 chou2 jiao1 cuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 献酬交错。
interpretations.explanation: 献酒酬答交错进行。

interpretations.segmentation: and cups are offered and returned in turn.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: li3 yi2 zu2 du4， xiao4 yu3 zu2 huo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 礼仪卒度，笑语卒获。
interpretations.explanation: 礼仪合乎法度，谈笑也合宜。

interpretations.segmentation: Rites keep proper measure; laughter and talk are fitting too.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.content: 神保是格，报以介福，万寿攸酢！
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: shen2 bao3 shi4 ge2， bao4 yi3 jie4 fu2， wan4 shou4 you1 cu4！

interpretations.segmentation: 神保是格，报以介福，万寿攸酢！
interpretations.explanation: 神尸来降临，回报以大福，万寿来酬答！

interpretations.segmentation: The spirit-host arrives; great blessing returns—long life answers the toast!

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: wo3 kong3 nan3 yi3， shi4 li3 mo4 qian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我孔戁矣，式礼莫愆。
interpretations.explanation: 我十分恭敬，按礼法没有差错。

interpretations.segmentation: I am deeply reverent; in ritual there is no fault.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: gong1 zhu4 zhi4 gao4， cu2 lai4 xiao4 sun1。

interpretations.segmentation: 工祝致告，徂赉孝孙。
interpretations.explanation: 工祝致告辞，回去赏赐孝孙。

interpretations.segmentation: The ritual officer announces; blessings go back to the dutiful grandson.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: bi4 fen1 xiao4 si4， shen2 shi4 yin3 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 苾芬孝祀，神嗜饮食。
interpretations.explanation: 祭品芬芳，神喜欢饮食。

interpretations.segmentation: Offerings are fragrant; the spirits delight in food and drink.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: bo er3 bai3 fu2， ru2 ji3 ru2 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 卜尔百福，如几如式。
interpretations.explanation: 占卜赐予百福，多如期望、合于法度。

interpretations.segmentation: Divination grants a hundred blessings—as hoped, as ordained.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: ji4 qi2 ji4 ji4， ji4 kuang1 ji4 chi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 既齐既稷，既匡既敕。
interpretations.explanation: 既整齐又严肃，既端正又谨慎。

interpretations.segmentation: All is orderly and solemn, correct and disciplined.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: yong3 xi1 er3 ji2， shi2 wan4 shi2 yi4！

interpretations.segmentation: 永锡尔极，时万时亿！
interpretations.explanation: 永远赐你至极之福，万福亿福！

interpretations.segmentation: May you forever receive utmost blessing—myriad upon myriad!

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.content: 礼仪既备，钟鼓既戒，孝孙徂位，工祝致告，神具醉止，皇尸载起。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: li3 yi2 ji4 bei4， zhong1 gu3 ji4 jie4， xiao4 sun1 cu2 wei4， gong1 zhu4 zhi4 gao4， shen2 ju4 zui4 zhi3， huang2 shi1 zai4 qi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 礼仪既备，钟鼓既戒，孝孙徂位，工祝致告，神具醉止，皇尸载起。
interpretations.explanation: 礼仪已备，钟鼓已戒，孝孙就位，工祝致告，神都已醉，尸神起身。

interpretations.segmentation: Rites are ready, bells and drums sound; the grandson takes his place; the officer announces; the spirits are drunk; the corpse-stand rises.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: gu3 zhong1 song4 shi1， shen2 bao3 yu4 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鼓钟送尸，神保聿归。
interpretations.explanation: 敲钟送尸神，神保归去。

interpretations.segmentation: Bells send off the corpse; the spirit guardian returns home.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: zhu1 zai3 jun1 fu4， fei4 che4 bu4 chi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 诸宰君妇，废彻不迟。
interpretations.explanation: 诸宰和主妇，撤祭不慢。

interpretations.segmentation: Stewards and hostess clear the feast without delay.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: zhu1 fu4 xiong1 di4， bei4 yan2 yan4 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 诸父兄弟，备言燕私。
interpretations.explanation: 叔伯兄弟，都来说家常宴饮。

interpretations.segmentation: Uncles and brothers all speak at the private feast.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: le4 ju4 ru4 zou4， yi3 sui2 hou4 lu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐具入奏，以绥后禄。
interpretations.explanation: 乐器齐奏，以安后福。

interpretations.segmentation: Music enters and plays, to settle blessings yet to come.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: er3 yao2 ji4 jiang1， mo4 yuan4 ju4 qing4。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔肴既将，莫怨具庆。
interpretations.explanation: 你的菜肴已齐备，不要怨，都来同庆。

interpretations.segmentation: Your dishes are ready—let none complain; let all rejoice together.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: ji4 zui4 ji4 bao3， xiao3 da4 ji1 shou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 既醉既饱，小大稽首。
interpretations.explanation: 既醉既饱，大小皆叩头。

interpretations.segmentation: Drunk and full, young and old all bow their heads.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: shen2 shi4 yin3 shi2， shi3 jun1 shou4 kao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 神嗜饮食，使君寿考。
interpretations.explanation: 神喜欢饮食，使君长寿。

interpretations.segmentation: The spirits enjoy the feast and grant the lord long life.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: kong3 hui4 kong3 shi2， wei2 qi2 jin3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 孔惠孔时，维其尽之。
interpretations.explanation: 非常和顺非常及时，要尽心做到。

interpretations.segmentation: Great kindness, perfect timing—do your utmost to fulfill it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci.pinyin: zi zi sun1 sun1， wu4 ti4 yin3 zhi1！

interpretations.segmentation: 子子孙孙，勿替引之！
interpretations.explanation: 子子孙孙，不要废弃引继此礼！

interpretations.segmentation: Sons and grandsons—never let this rite fall away!

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: you3 meng2 gui3 sun1， you3 jiu4 ji2 bi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有饛簋飧，有捄棘匕。
interpretations.explanation: 有满簋的饭食，有长柄的棘匕。

interpretations.segmentation: Bowls brim with cooked rice; long-handled thorn spoons are ready.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: zhou1 dao4 ru2 di3， qi2 zhi2 ru2 shi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 周道如砥，其直如矢。
interpretations.explanation: 周道平坦如磨刀石，其直如箭。

interpretations.segmentation: The Zhou road is smooth as a whetstone, straight as an arrow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: jun1 zi suo3 lv3， xiao3 ren2 suo3 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子所履，小人所视。
interpretations.explanation: 君子所走的，小人所看的。

interpretations.segmentation: What the noble man treads, the common folk observe.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: juan4 yan2 gu4 zhi1， shan1 yan1 chu1 ti4。

interpretations.segmentation: 眷言顾之，潸焉出涕。
interpretations.explanation: 回头顾念它，不禁潸然泪下。

interpretations.segmentation: I turn to look back on it—and tears stream down.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: xiao3 dong1 da4 dong1， zhu4 you4 qi2 kong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 小东大东，杼柚其空。
interpretations.explanation: 小东大东，织机的轴和柚都空了。

interpretations.segmentation: East near and far—the loom's beam and spool stand empty.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: jiu1 jiu1 ge2 ju4， ke3 yi3 lv3 shuang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 纠纠葛屦，可以履霜。
interpretations.explanation: 葛藤编的破鞋，竟要穿着踏霜。

interpretations.segmentation: Shoes woven of kudzu—yet they must tread the frost.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: tiao1 tiao1 gong1 zi， xing2 bi3 zhou1 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 佻佻公子，行彼周行。
interpretations.explanation: 轻佻的公子，走在那周道上。

interpretations.segmentation: The frivolous young lord walks that Zhou highway.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: ji4 wang3 ji4 lai2， shi3 wo3 xin1 jiu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 既往既来，使我心疚。
interpretations.explanation: 他去了又来，使我的心疚痛。

interpretations.segmentation: He goes and comes again—it wrings my heart with guilt and pain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: you3 lie4 gui3 quan2， wu2 jin4 huo4 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有冽氿泉，无浸获薪。
interpretations.explanation: 有清冽的泉水，不要浸湿所砍的柴。

interpretations.segmentation: There is cool spring water—do not soak the firewood cut from the marsh.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: qi4 qi4 wu4 tan4， ai1 wo3 dan4 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 契契寤叹，哀我惮人。
interpretations.explanation: 清醒时叹息，哀怜我这劳苦的人。

interpretations.segmentation: Awake I sigh in grief for us who toil in misery.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: xin1 shi4 huo4 xin1， shang4 ke3 zai4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 薪是获薪，尚可载也。
interpretations.explanation: 柴是刚砍的柴，还可以装载。

interpretations.segmentation: The fuel is fresh-cut—it could still be loaded and carried.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: ai1 wo3 dan4 ren2， yi4 ke3 xi1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 哀我惮人，亦可息也。
interpretations.explanation: 哀怜我这劳苦的人，也可以休息了。

interpretations.segmentation: Pity us who toil—we too could have rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: dong1 ren2 zhi1 zi， zhi2 lao2 bu4 lai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 东人之子，职劳不来。
interpretations.explanation: 东方人的子弟，服劳役却得不到慰劳。

interpretations.segmentation: Sons of the eastern lands toil in service yet receive no kindness.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: xi1 ren2 zhi1 zi， can4 can4 yi1 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 西人之子，粲粲衣服。
interpretations.explanation: 西方人的子弟，衣服鲜明华丽。

interpretations.segmentation: Sons of the western lands wear bright and splendid clothes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: zhou1 ren2 zhi1 zi， xiong2 pi2 shi4 qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 舟人之子，熊罴是裘。
interpretations.explanation: 舟人之子，穿熊罴皮裘。

interpretations.segmentation: Boatmen's sons wear coats of bear and tiger hide.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: si1 ren2 zhi1 zi， bai3 liao2 shi4 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 私人之子，百僚是试。
interpretations.explanation: 贵族子弟，试任各种官职。

interpretations.segmentation: Private men's sons are tried out in every office.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: huo4 yi3 qi2 jiu3， bu4 yi3 qi2 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 或以其酒，不以其浆。
interpretations.explanation: 有人用其酒，不用其浆。

interpretations.segmentation: Some are given wine, not plain broth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: xuan4 xuan4 pei4 sui4， bu4 yi3 qi2 zhang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鞙鞙佩璲，不以其长。
interpretations.explanation: 佩玉锵锵，不凭其才德之长。

interpretations.segmentation: Jade pendants chime—yet merit, not ornament, should rule.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: wei2 tian1 you3 han4， jian1 yi4 you3 guang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维天有汉，监亦有光。
interpretations.explanation: 天上有银河，照临也有光芒。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven has its River—watching, it too sends forth light.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: qi2 bi3 zhi1 nv3， zhong1 ri4 qi1 xiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 跂彼织女，终日七襄。
interpretations.explanation: 看那织女，终日七次移位。

interpretations.segmentation: See the Weaver Maid—seven times she shifts her place all day.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: sui1 ze2 qi1 xiang1， bu4 cheng2 bao4 zhang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 虽则七襄，不成报章。
interpretations.explanation: 虽然七次移位，却织不成有花纹的布。

interpretations.segmentation: Though she moves seven times, she weaves no patterned cloth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: huan4 bi3 qian1 niu2， bu4 yi3 fu2 xiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 睆彼牵牛，不以服箱。
interpretations.explanation: 看那牵牛星，不能用来拉车箱。

interpretations.segmentation: See the Ox Driver—he cannot haul the cart's load-box.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: dong1 you3 qi3 ming2， xi1 you3 zhang3 geng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 东有启明，西有长庚。
interpretations.explanation: 东方有启明，西方有长庚。

interpretations.segmentation: Eastward is Morning Bright; westward is Long Evening Star.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: you3 jiu4 tian1 bi4， zai4 shi1 zhi1 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有捄天毕，载施之行。
interpretations.explanation: 有长柄的天毕星，却只是施在行路上。

interpretations.segmentation: The Net constellation has its handle—yet it only spans the road.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: wei2 nan2 you3 ji1， bu4 ke3 yi3 bo3 yang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 维南有箕，不可以簸扬。
interpretations.explanation: 南方有箕星，不能用来簸扬谷。

interpretations.segmentation: South is the Winnow Basket—it cannot winnow grain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.content: 维北有斗，不可以挹酒浆。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: wei2 bei3 you3 dou4， bu4 ke3 yi3 yi4 jiu3 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维北有斗，不可以挹酒浆。
interpretations.explanation: 北方有斗星，不能用来舀酒浆。

interpretations.segmentation: North is the Dipper—it cannot ladle wine and broth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: wei2 nan2 you3 ji1， zai4 xi1 qi2 she2。

interpretations.segmentation: 维南有箕，载翕其舌。
interpretations.explanation: 南方有箕星，只是合拢其舌。

interpretations.segmentation: South is the Winnow Basket—it only gathers its tongue.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong.pinyin: wei2 bei3 you3 dou4， xi1 bing3 zhi1 jie1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维北有斗，西柄之揭。
interpretations.explanation: 北方有斗星，把柄向西高举。

interpretations.segmentation: North is the Dipper—its handle lifted toward the west.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng.pinyin: xi2 xi2 gu3 feng1， wei2 feng1 ji2 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 习习谷风，维风及雨。
interpretations.explanation: 习习谷风，又刮来风又带来雨。

interpretations.segmentation: The valley wind blows—wind comes and rain follows.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng.pinyin: jiang1 kong3 jiang1 ju4， wei2 yu3 yu3 nv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 将恐将惧，维予与女。
interpretations.explanation: 将要恐惧时，只有我和你在一起。

interpretations.segmentation: When fear was near, only you and I stood together.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng.pinyin: jiang1 an1 jiang1 le4， nv3 zhuan3 qi4 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 将安将乐，女转弃予。
interpretations.explanation: 将要安乐时，你却转身抛弃我。

interpretations.segmentation: When ease was near, you turned and cast me off.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng.pinyin: xi2 xi2 gu3 feng1， wei2 feng1 ji2 tui2。

interpretations.segmentation: 习习谷风，维风及颓。
interpretations.explanation: 习习谷风，又刮来风又带来旋风。

interpretations.segmentation: The valley wind blows—wind comes and the whirl follows.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng.pinyin: jiang1 kong3 jiang1 ju4， zhi4 yu3 yu2 huai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 将恐将惧，置予于怀。
interpretations.explanation: 将要恐惧时，你把我抱在怀里。

interpretations.segmentation: When fear was near, you held me in your arms.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng.pinyin: jiang1 an1 jiang1 le4， qi4 yu3 ru2 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 将安将乐，弃予如遗。
interpretations.explanation: 将要安乐时，你把我像丢弃物一样抛弃。

interpretations.segmentation: When ease was near, you dropped me as something cast away.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng.pinyin: xi2 xi2 gu3 feng1， wei2 shan1 cui1 wei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 习习谷风，维山崔嵬。
interpretations.explanation: 习习谷风，吹过山高峻。

interpretations.segmentation: The valley wind blows over towering peaks.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng.pinyin: wu2 cao3 bu4 si3， wu2 mu4 bu4 wei1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无草不死，无木不萎。
interpretations.explanation: 没有草不枯死，没有树不凋萎。

interpretations.segmentation: No grass but dies; no tree but withers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng.pinyin: wang4 wo3 da4 de2， si1 wo3 xiao3 yuan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 忘我大德，思我小怨。
interpretations.explanation: 你忘了我大的恩德，却记我小的怨隙。

interpretations.segmentation: You forgot my great kindness yet brood on my small grievances.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong.content: 鼓钟将将，淮水汤汤，忧心且伤。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong.pinyin: gu3 zhong1 jiang1 jiang1， huai2 shui3 tang1 tang1， you1 xin1 qie3 shang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鼓钟将将，淮水汤汤，忧心且伤。
interpretations.explanation: 鼓钟锵锵，淮水汤汤，忧心而且伤。

interpretations.segmentation: Bells and drums ring loud; the Huai rolls on—my heart is wounded with grief.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong.pinyin: shu1 ren2 jun1 zi， huai2 yun3 bu4 wang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 淑人君子，怀允不忘。
interpretations.explanation: 那贤德君子，我怀念诚信不忘。

interpretations.segmentation: That good and noble man—I cherish his faith and cannot forget.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong.content: 鼓钟喈喈，淮水湝湝，忧心且悲。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong.pinyin: gu3 zhong1 jie1 jie1， huai2 shui3 jie1 jie1， you1 xin1 qie3 bei1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鼓钟喈喈，淮水湝湝，忧心且悲。
interpretations.explanation: 鼓钟喈喈，淮水湝湝，忧心而且悲。

interpretations.segmentation: Bells chime clearly; the Huai flows gently—my heart is heavy with sorrow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong.pinyin: shu1 ren2 jun1 zi， qi2 de2 bu4 hui2。

interpretations.segmentation: 淑人君子，其德不回。
interpretations.explanation: 那贤德君子，其德不邪曲。

interpretations.segmentation: That good and noble man—his virtue does not bend awry.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong.content: 鼓钟伐鼛，淮有三洲，忧心且妯。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong.pinyin: gu3 zhong1 fa2 gao1， huai2 you3 san1 zhou1， you1 xin1 qie3 zhou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鼓钟伐鼛，淮有三洲，忧心且妯。
interpretations.explanation: 鼓钟伐鼛，淮中有三洲，忧心而且动。

interpretations.segmentation: Bells strike the great drum; three islets lie in the Huai—my heart is stirred with pain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong.pinyin: shu1 ren2 jun1 zi， qi2 de2 bu4 you2。

interpretations.segmentation: 淑人君子，其德不犹。
interpretations.explanation: 那贤德君子，其德无人能及。

interpretations.segmentation: That good and noble man—none can match his virtue.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong.content: 鼓钟钦钦，鼓瑟鼓琴，笙磬同音。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong.pinyin: gu3 zhong1 qin1 qin1， gu3 se4 gu3 qin2， sheng1 qing4 tong2 yin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鼓钟钦钦，鼓瑟鼓琴，笙磬同音。
interpretations.explanation: 鼓钟钦钦，鼓瑟鼓琴，笙磬同音。

interpretations.segmentation: Bells ring softly; zithers and drums sound; pipes and chimes harmonize.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong.pinyin: yi3 ya3 yi3 nan2， yi3 yue4 bu4 jian4。

interpretations.segmentation: 以雅以南，以龠不僭。
interpretations.explanation: 奏雅乐与南乐，用龠管也不越礼。

interpretations.segmentation: They play Ya and Nan music—the flute keeps within proper bounds.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.pinyin: liao3 liao3 zhe3 e2， fei3 e2 yi1 hao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 蓼蓼者莪，匪莪伊蒿。
interpretations.explanation: 长得茂盛的莪，不是莪而是蒿。

interpretations.segmentation: Lushly growing—what seems dwarf mugwort is wild artemisia instead.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.pinyin: ai1 ai1 fu4 mu3， sheng1 wo3 qu2 lao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 哀哀父母，生我劬劳。
interpretations.explanation: 可悲啊父母，生我多么辛劳。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, my parents—bearing me cost you bitter toil.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.pinyin: liao3 liao3 zhe3 e2， fei3 e2 yi1 wei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 蓼蓼者莪，匪莪伊蔚。
interpretations.explanation: 长得茂盛的莪，不是莪而是蔚。

interpretations.segmentation: Lushly growing—what seems mugwort is wormwood instead.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.pinyin: ai1 ai1 fu4 mu3， sheng1 wo3 lao2 cui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 哀哀父母，生我劳瘁。
interpretations.explanation: 可悲啊父母，生我劳累成病。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, my parents—bearing me wore you to exhaustion.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.pinyin: ping2 zhi1 qing4 yi3， wei2 lei2 zhi1 chi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 瓶之罄矣，维罍之耻。
interpretations.explanation: 瓶已空了，是酒坛的羞耻。

interpretations.segmentation: When the flask is empty, it shames the jar that should fill it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.content: 鲜民之生，不如死之久矣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.pinyin: xian1 min2 zhi1 sheng1， bu4 ru2 si3 zhi1 jiu3 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鲜民之生，不如死之久矣。
interpretations.explanation: 孤儿活着，不如早死已久。

interpretations.segmentation: An orphan's life is worse than having long been dead.
无父何怙？
interpretations.explanation: 没有父亲依靠谁？

interpretations.segmentation: Without a father, on whom can I rely?
无母何恃？
interpretations.explanation: 没有母亲依仗谁？

interpretations.segmentation: Without a mother, on whom can I depend?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.pinyin: chu1 ze2 xian2 xu4， ru4 ze2 mi2 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 出则衔恤，入则靡至。
interpretations.explanation: 出门带着忧伤，回家没有亲人。

interpretations.segmentation: Out of doors I bear grief; at home no one awaits me.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.pinyin: fu4 xi1 sheng1 wo3， mu3 xi1 ju1 wo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 父兮生我，母兮鞠我。
interpretations.explanation: 父亲啊生养我，母亲啊哺育我。

interpretations.segmentation: Father, you gave me life; mother, you nursed me.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.content: 抚我畜我，长我育我，顾我复我，出入腹我。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.pinyin: fu3 wo3 chu4 wo3， zhang3 wo3 yu4 wo3， gu4 wo3 fu4 wo3， chu1 ru4 fu4 wo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 抚我畜我，长我育我，顾我复我，出入腹我。
interpretations.explanation: 抚我畜我，长我育我，顾我复我，出入腹我。

interpretations.segmentation: You tended and raised me, watched and brought me back, sheltered me in going out and coming in.
欲报之德。
interpretations.explanation: 想报答你们的恩德。

interpretations.segmentation: I would repay your kindness—
昊天罔极！
interpretations.explanation: 但昊天无极！

interpretations.segmentation: yet vast Heaven knows no limit!

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.pinyin: nan2 shan1 lie4 lie4， piao1 feng1 fa1 fa1。

interpretations.segmentation: 南山烈烈，飘风发发。
interpretations.explanation: 南山烈烈，暴风呼呼。

interpretations.segmentation: The southern hills stand stark; the gale blows fierce.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.pinyin: min2 mo4 bu4 gu3， wo3 du2 he2 hai4！

interpretations.segmentation: 民莫不穀，我独何害！
interpretations.explanation: 人民没有不得到好处的，唯独我有什么祸害！

interpretations.segmentation: No folk but receive good—why alone do I suffer harm?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.pinyin: nan2 shan1 lv4 lv4， piao1 feng1 fu2 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 南山律律，飘风弗弗。
interpretations.explanation: 南山高峻，暴风拂拂。

interpretations.segmentation: The southern hills rise steep; the storm wind sweeps on.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe.pinyin: min2 mo4 bu4 gu3， wo3 du2 bu4 zu2！

interpretations.segmentation: 民莫不穀，我独不卒！
interpretations.explanation: 人民没有不得到好处的，唯独我不能终老！

interpretations.segmentation: No folk but receive good—why alone may I not live out my years?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: si4 yue4 wei2 xia4， liu4 yue4 cu2 shu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 四月维夏，六月徂署。
interpretations.explanation: 四月正是夏天，六月就到了酷暑。

interpretations.segmentation: The fourth month is summer; by the sixth, the heat of summer arrives.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: xian1 zu3 fei3 ren2， hu2 ning2 ren3 yu3？

interpretations.segmentation: 先祖匪人，胡宁忍予？
interpretations.explanation: 先祖不是常人，怎忍心这样待我？

interpretations.segmentation: My forebears were not common men—how could they bear to treat me thus?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: qiu1 ri4 qi1 qi1， bai3 hui4 ju4 fei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 秋日凄凄，百卉具腓。
interpretations.explanation: 秋天凄清，百卉都枯萎。

interpretations.segmentation: Autumn is bleak; every plant withers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: luan4 li2 mo4 yi3， yuan2 qi2 shi4 gui1？

interpretations.segmentation: 乱离瘼矣，爰其适归？
interpretations.explanation: 乱离多病痛，我将归向何处？

interpretations.segmentation: In turmoil and sickness—where can I turn for home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: dong1 ri4 lie4 lie4， piao1 feng1 fa1 fa1。

interpretations.segmentation: 冬日烈烈，飘风发发。
interpretations.explanation: 冬天寒烈，暴风呼呼。

interpretations.segmentation: Winter is harsh; the gale blows fierce.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: min2 mo4 bu4 gu3， wo3 du2 he2 hai4？

interpretations.segmentation: 民莫不穀，我独何害？
interpretations.explanation: 人民没有不得到好处的，唯独我有什么祸害？

interpretations.segmentation: No folk but receive good—why alone do I suffer harm?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: shan1 you3 jia1 hui4， hou2 li4 hou2 mei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 山有嘉卉，侯栗侯梅。
interpretations.explanation: 山上有美草，有栗有梅。

interpretations.segmentation: On the hills grow fine plants—chestnut and plum.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: fei4 wei4 can2 zei2， mo4 zhi1 qi2 you2！

interpretations.segmentation: 废为残贼，莫知其尤！
interpretations.explanation: 被废弃成为残贼，不知其罪过！

interpretations.segmentation: Cast off, made an outcast—who knows my fault?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: xiang1 bi3 quan2 shui3， zai4 qing1 zai4 zhuo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 相彼泉水，载清载浊。
interpretations.explanation: 看那泉水，有时清有时浊。

interpretations.segmentation: Look at the spring—now clear, now muddy.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: wo3 ri4 gou4 huo4， he2 yun2 neng2 gu3？

interpretations.segmentation: 我日构祸，曷云能穀？
interpretations.explanation: 我天天招祸，怎么说能得好？

interpretations.segmentation: Each day I gather misfortune—how can I say I receive good?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: tao1 tao1 jiang1 han4， nan2 guo2 zhi1 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 滔滔江汉，南国之纪。
interpretations.explanation: 滔滔江汉，是南方的纲纪。

interpretations.segmentation: The Han and Jiang roll on—the backbone of the southern lands.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: jin3 cui4 yi3 shi4， ning2 mo4 wo3 you3？

interpretations.segmentation: 尽瘁以仕，宁莫我有？
interpretations.explanation: 尽心国事，难道没有我一份？

interpretations.segmentation: I wear myself out in service—does the realm not owe me anything?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: fei3 chun2 fei3 yuan1， han4 fei1 li4 tian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪鹑匪鸢，翰飞戾天。
interpretations.explanation: 不是鹑也不是鸢，却能高飞到天。

interpretations.segmentation: Neither quail nor kite—yet some fly up to the sky.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: fei3 zhan1 fei3 wei3， qian2 tao2 yu2 yuan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪鳣匪鲔，潜逃于渊。
interpretations.explanation: 不是鳣也不是鲔，却能潜藏在深渊。

interpretations.segmentation: Neither sturgeon nor shad—yet some hide in the deep.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: shan1 you3 jue2 wei1， xi2 you3 qi3 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 山有蕨薇，隰有杞桋。
interpretations.explanation: 山上有蕨薇，低湿处有杞桋。

interpretations.segmentation: Ferns grow on the hills; elm and wolfberry in the wet lowlands.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue.pinyin: jun1 zi zuo4 ge1， wei2 yi3 gao4 ai1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子作歌，维以告哀。
interpretations.explanation: 君子作歌，只是用来诉说悲哀。

interpretations.segmentation: The noble man makes this song only to declare his grief.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache.pinyin: wu2 jiang1 da4 che1， qi2 zi4 chen2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无将大车，祇自尘兮。
interpretations.explanation: 不要推那大车，只会沾满尘土。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not push the heavy cart—you will only be covered with dust.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache.pinyin: wu2 si1 bai3 you1， qi2 zi4 qi2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无思百忧，祇自疧兮。
interpretations.explanation: 不要想那些忧愁，只会自己致病。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not brood on countless cares—you will only make yourself ill.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache.pinyin: wu2 jiang1 da4 che1， wei2 chen2 ming2 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 无将大车，维尘冥冥。
interpretations.explanation: 不要推那大车，尘土昏冥蒙罩。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not push the heavy cart—the dust hangs dark and dim.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache.pinyin: wu2 si1 bai3 you1， bu4 chu1 yu2 jiong3。

interpretations.segmentation: 无思百忧，不出于颎。
interpretations.explanation: 不要想那些忧愁，不会从心中明白。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not brood on cares—they will not bring clarity to your mind.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache.pinyin: wu2 jiang1 da4 che1， wei2 chen2 yong1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无将大车，维尘雍兮。
interpretations.explanation: 不要推那大车，尘土壅塞弥漫。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not push the heavy cart—the dust chokes and swells.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache.pinyin: wu2 si1 bai3 you1， qi2 zi4 zhong4 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无思百忧，祇自重兮。
interpretations.explanation: 不要想那些忧愁，只会自寻沉重。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not brood on cares—you will only burden yourself the more.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: ming2 ming2 shang4 tian1， zhao4 lin2 xia4 tu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 明明上天，照临下土。
interpretations.explanation: 光明照人的上天，照临下方大地。

interpretations.segmentation: Bright Heaven shines clearly, looking down upon the earth below.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: wo3 zheng1 cu2 xi1， zhi4 yu2 jiao1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我征徂西，至于艽野。
interpretations.explanation: 我出征往西，到了远野之地。

interpretations.segmentation: I march west on campaign, reaching the wild distant fields.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: er4 yue4 chu1 ji2， zai4 li2 han2 shu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 二月初吉，载离寒暑。
interpretations.explanation: 二月初吉出发，经历了寒暑更替。

interpretations.segmentation: I set out at the month's first good day and passed through cold and heat.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， qi2 du2 da4 ku3。

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，其毒大苦。
interpretations.explanation: 心中的忧愁，像大苦之毒。

interpretations.segmentation: The grief in my heart is bitter as the strongest poison.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: nian4 bi3 gong4 ren2， ti4 ling2 ru2 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 念彼共人，涕零如雨。
interpretations.explanation: 想到那贤德之人，眼泪零落如雨。

interpretations.segmentation: When I think of that good man, tears fall like rain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: qi3 bu4 huai2 gui1？

interpretations.segmentation: 岂不怀归？
interpretations.explanation: 难道不想回家吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Do I not long to return home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: wei4 ci3 zui4 gu3！

interpretations.segmentation: 畏此罪罟！
interpretations.explanation: 只怕这罪网的束缚！

interpretations.segmentation: I fear the net of guilt and punishment!

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: xi1 wo3 wang3 yi3， ri4 yue4 fang1 chu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 昔我往矣，日月方除。
interpretations.explanation: 当初我离开的时候，日月刚除旧。

interpretations.segmentation: When first I left, sun and moon had just turned the year.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: he2 yun2 qi2 hai2？

interpretations.segmentation: 曷云其还？
interpretations.explanation: 什么时候能回去？

interpretations.segmentation: When can I go back?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: sui4 yu4 yun2 mo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 岁聿云莫。
interpretations.explanation: 年岁已到了暮秋。

interpretations.segmentation: The year has already reached its end.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: nian4 wo3 du2 xi1， wo3 shi4 kong3 shu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 念我独兮，我事孔庶。
interpretations.explanation: 想到我孤独一人，我的事很多很繁。

interpretations.segmentation: I think how alone I am—my tasks are many and pressing.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， dan4 wo3 bu4 xia2。

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，惮我不暇。
interpretations.explanation: 心中的忧愁，使我劳碌没有闲暇。

interpretations.segmentation: Grief in my heart leaves me no leisure to rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: nian4 bi3 gong4 ren2， juan4 juan4 huai2 gu4！

interpretations.segmentation: 念彼共人，眷眷怀顾！
interpretations.explanation: 想到那贤德之人，眷眷地怀念顾念！

interpretations.segmentation: I think of that good man and turn to him with longing!

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: qi3 bu4 huai2 gui1？

interpretations.segmentation: 岂不怀归？
interpretations.explanation: 难道不想回家吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Do I not long to return home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: wei4 ci3 qian3 nu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 畏此谴怒。
interpretations.explanation: 只怕遭到谴责发怒。

interpretations.segmentation: I fear reproof and angry blame.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: xi1 wo3 wang3 yi3， ri4 yue4 fang1 ao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 昔我往矣，日月方奥。
interpretations.explanation: 当初我离开的时候，日月正藏入地下。

interpretations.segmentation: When first I left, sun and moon were in their hidden course.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: he2 yun2 qi2 hai2？

interpretations.segmentation: 曷云其还？
interpretations.explanation: 什么时候能回去？

interpretations.segmentation: When can I go back?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: zheng4 shi4 yu4 cu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 政事愈蹙。
interpretations.explanation: 政事越来越急迫。

interpretations.segmentation: Official business grows ever more urgent.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: sui4 yu4 yun2 mo4， cai3 xiao1 huo4 shu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 岁聿云莫，采萧获菽。
interpretations.explanation: 年岁到了暮秋，采萧收豆。

interpretations.segmentation: Year's end comes—we gather wormwood and harvest beans.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， zi4 yi2 yi1 qi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，自诒伊戚。
interpretations.explanation: 心中的忧愁，是自找悲伤。

interpretations.segmentation: The grief in my heart is sorrow I bring on myself.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: nian4 bi3 gong4 ren2， xing1 yan2 chu1 su4。

interpretations.segmentation: 念彼共人，兴言出宿。
interpretations.explanation: 想到那贤德之人，起来说话而夜宿不归。

interpretations.segmentation: I think of that good man, rise to speak, and lodge abroad.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: qi3 bu4 huai2 gui1？

interpretations.segmentation: 岂不怀归？
interpretations.explanation: 难道不想回家吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Do I not long to return home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: wei4 ci3 fan3 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 畏此反覆。
interpretations.explanation: 只怕反复无常的祸患。

interpretations.segmentation: I fear the shifting turns of fortune and blame.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: jie1 er3 jun1 zi， wu2 heng2 an1 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 嗟尔君子，无恒安处。
interpretations.explanation: 唉你们君子，不要总想安逸。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, you gentlemen—do not always seek ease.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: jing4 gong4 er3 wei4， zheng4 zhi2 shi4 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 靖共尔位，正直是与。
interpretations.explanation: 敬慎你的职位，以正直为伴侣。

interpretations.segmentation: Be reverent in your post; take uprightness as your companion.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: shen2 zhi1 ting1 zhi1， shi4 gu3 yi3 nv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 神之听之，式穀以女。
interpretations.explanation: 神会听察，以福赐给你。

interpretations.segmentation: The spirits will listen and grant you blessing.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: jie1 er3 jun1 zi， wu2 heng2 an1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 嗟尔君子，无恒安息。
interpretations.explanation: 唉你们君子，不要总想安息。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, you gentlemen—do not always seek rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: jing4 gong4 er3 wei4， hao3 shi4 zheng4 zhi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 靖共尔位，好是正直。
interpretations.explanation: 敬慎你的职位，喜好正直。

interpretations.segmentation: Be reverent in your post and love what is straight.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming.pinyin: shen2 zhi1 ting1 zhi1， jie4 er3 jing3 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 神之听之，介尔景福。
interpretations.explanation: 神会听察，赐你大福。

interpretations.segmentation: The spirits will listen and grant you great blessing.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: xin4 bi3 nan2 shan1， wei2 yu3 dian1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 信彼南山，维禹甸之。
interpretations.explanation: 确实啊，那南山，是大禹所划定的疆域。

interpretations.segmentation: Truly that southern hill was the domain marked out by Yu.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: yun2 yun2 yuan2 xi2， ceng2 sun1 tian2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 畇畇原隰，曾孙田之。
interpretations.explanation: 平原和低地平坦整齐，周王在这里垦田。

interpretations.segmentation: The plains and lowlands lie smooth and even; the king's descendant tills them.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: wo3 jiang1 wo3 li3， nan2 dong1 qi2 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我疆我理，南东其亩。
interpretations.explanation: 划分疆界、整理田亩，向南向东开辟耕地。

interpretations.segmentation: We mark our borders and lay out the fields, opening plots toward south and east.
上天同云。
interpretations.explanation: 天空布满同色的云。

interpretations.segmentation: The sky is covered with one uniform cloud.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: yu3 xue3 fen1 fen1， yi4 zhi1 yi3 mai4 mu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 雨雪雰雰，益之以霡霂。
interpretations.explanation: 雪花纷纷飘落，又加上绵绵细雨。

interpretations.segmentation: Snow falls in flurries, and fine drizzle is added to it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: ji4 you1 ji4 wo4， ji4 zhan1 ji4 zu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既优既渥，既沾既足。
interpretations.explanation: 雨水既充足又丰沛，既浸润又满足。

interpretations.segmentation: The rain is ample and rich, soaking the earth until it is fully satisfied.
生我百谷。
interpretations.explanation: 于是滋养了各种谷物。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus the hundred grains are brought to life.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: jiang1 yi4 yi4 yi4， shu3 ji4 yu4 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 疆埸翼翼，黍稷彧彧。
interpretations.explanation: 田界整齐，黍稷长得茂盛繁密。

interpretations.segmentation: The field borders stand trim; millet and panicled millet grow lush and thick.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: ceng2 sun1 zhi1 se4， yi3 wei4 jiu3 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 曾孙之穑，以为酒食。
interpretations.explanation: 周王收获的庄稼，用来酿酒做饭。

interpretations.segmentation: The harvest gathered by the king's descendant becomes wine and food.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: bi4 wo3 shi1 bin1， shou4 kao3 wan4 nian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 畀我尸宾，寿考万年。
interpretations.explanation: 献给代表先人的尸和宾客，祝愿长寿万年。

interpretations.segmentation: It is offered to the impersonator of the dead and to guests, wishing long life for ten thousand years.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: zhong1 tian2 you3 lu2， jiang1 yi4 you3 gua1。

interpretations.segmentation: 中田有庐，疆埸有瓜。
interpretations.explanation: 田中有庐舍，田界上种着瓜。

interpretations.segmentation: In the middle of the fields are huts; along the borders grow melons.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: shi4 bo1 shi4 ju1， xian4 zhi1 huang2 zu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 是剥是菹，献之皇祖。
interpretations.explanation: 剥好切好，腌成菜蔬，献给先王先祖。

interpretations.segmentation: They are peeled and sliced into pickles and presented to the royal ancestors.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: ceng2 sun1 shou4 kao3， shou4 tian1 zhi1 hu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 曾孙寿考，受天之祜。
interpretations.explanation: 周王长寿，承受上天赐予的福佑。

interpretations.segmentation: The king's descendant lives long and receives Heaven's blessing.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.content: 祭以清酒，从以骍牡，享于祖考。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: ji4 yi3 qing1 jiu3， cong2 yi3 xing1 mu3， xiang3 yu2 zu3 kao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 祭以清酒，从以骍牡，享于祖考。
interpretations.explanation: 用清酒祭祀，又配上赤色公牛，献给祖先。

interpretations.segmentation: The rite uses clear wine, followed by a red bull, offered to the forefathers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.content: 执其鸾刀，以启其毛，取其血膋。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: zhi2 qi2 luan2 dao1， yi3 qi3 qi2 mao2， qu3 qi2 xue4 liao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 执其鸾刀，以启其毛，取其血膋。
interpretations.explanation: 手持鸾刀，剖开牲毛，取出血和脂膏。

interpretations.segmentation: Holding the bell-handled knife, they part the hair and take the blood and suet.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: shi4 zheng1 shi4 xiang3， bi4 bi4 fen1 fen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 是烝是享，苾苾芬芬。
interpretations.explanation: 这样蒸献、这样享祭，香气芬芳四溢。

interpretations.segmentation: Thus steamed and thus presented, the offering is richly fragrant.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan.pinyin: si4 shi4 kong3 ming2， xian1 zu3 shi4 huang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 祀事孔明，先祖是皇。
interpretations.explanation: 祭祀的事非常明达，先祖因而来享用。

interpretations.segmentation: The sacrificial service is perfectly done, and the ancestors are duly honored.
报以介福。
interpretations.explanation: 先祖回报以大福。

interpretations.segmentation: In return comes great blessing.
万寿无疆。
interpretations.explanation: 万寿无疆。

interpretations.segmentation: May life be endless without limit.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju.pinyin: jiao3 jiao3 bai2 ju1， shi2 wo3 chang3 miao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 皎皎白驹，食我场苗。
interpretations.explanation: 那洁白的小马，吃我场圃里的豆苗。

interpretations.segmentation: That gleaming white colt feeds on the shoots in my threshing yard.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju.pinyin: zhi2 zhi1 wei2 zhi1， yi3 yong3 jin1 chao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 絷之维之，以永今朝。
interpretations.explanation: 拴住它、留住它，以延长今日的相聚。

interpretations.segmentation: Tie it and hold it fast, to prolong this morning together.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju.pinyin: suo3 wei4 yi1 ren2， yu2 yan1 xiao1 yao2？

interpretations.segmentation: 所谓伊人，于焉逍遥？
interpretations.explanation: 所说的那位贤人，在这里逍遥吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Is that noble man at ease and wandering here?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju.pinyin: jiao3 jiao3 bai2 ju1， shi2 wo3 chang3 huo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 皎皎白驹，食我场藿。
interpretations.explanation: 那洁白的小马，吃我场圃里的豆叶。

interpretations.segmentation: That gleaming white colt feeds on the leaves in my yard.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju.pinyin: zhi2 zhi1 wei2 zhi1， yi3 yong3 jin1 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 絷之维之，以永今夕。
interpretations.explanation: 拴住它、留住它，以延长今夜的相聚。

interpretations.segmentation: Tie it and hold it fast, to prolong this evening together.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju.pinyin: suo3 wei4 yi1 ren2， yu2 yan1 jia1 ke4？

interpretations.segmentation: 所谓伊人，于焉嘉客？
interpretations.explanation: 所说的那位贤人，在这里作佳客吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Is that noble man here as an honored guest?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju.pinyin: jiao3 jiao3 bai2 ju1， ben1 ran2 lai2 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 皎皎白驹，贲然来思。
interpretations.explanation: 那洁白的小马，光彩照人地来了。

interpretations.segmentation: That gleaming white colt comes with shining grace.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju.pinyin: er3 gong1 er3 hou2， yi4 yu4 wu2 qi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 尔公尔侯，逸豫无期？
interpretations.explanation: 你身为公侯，安逸享乐没有止境吗？

interpretations.segmentation: You who are duke or marquis—will your ease and pleasure know no end?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju.pinyin: shen4 er3 you1 you2， mian3 er3 dun4 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 慎尔优游，勉尔遁思。
interpretations.explanation: 谨慎你的优游，勉励你及早归隐。

interpretations.segmentation: Be careful in your leisure; urge yourself toward withdrawal and retreat.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju.pinyin: jiao3 jiao3 bai2 ju1， zai4 bi3 kong1 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 皎皎白驹，在彼空谷。
interpretations.explanation: 那洁白的小马，在那空谷之中。

interpretations.segmentation: That gleaming white colt is in that empty valley.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju.pinyin: sheng1 chu2 yi1 shu4， qi2 ren2 ru2 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 生刍一束，其人如玉。
interpretations.explanation: 生刍一束，那人品德如美玉。

interpretations.segmentation: A bundle of fresh grass—for him whose person is like jade.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju.pinyin: wu2 jin1 yu4 er3 yin1， er2 you3 xia2 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 毋金玉尔音，而有遐心。
interpretations.explanation: 不要吝惜金玉般的信息，却存疏远之心。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not be sparing with messages precious as gold and jade, yet harbor a heart that keeps afar.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming.pinyin: he4 ming2 yu2 jiu3 gao1， sheng1 wen2 yu2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鹤鸣于九皋，声闻于野。
interpretations.explanation: 鹤在深水沼泽鸣叫，声音传到旷野。

interpretations.segmentation: The crane cries in the deep marsh; its voice is heard in the wilds.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming.pinyin: yu2 qian2 zai4 yuan1， huo4 zai4 yu2 zhu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鱼潜在渊，或在于渚。
interpretations.explanation: 鱼潜藏在深渊，有的却在小洲上。

interpretations.segmentation: Fish hide in the deep pool, or some lie on the sandbar.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming.content: 乐彼之园，爰有树檀，其下维萚。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming.pinyin: le4 bi3 zhi1 yuan2， yuan2 you3 shu4 tan2， qi2 xia4 wei2 tuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐彼之园，爰有树檀，其下维萚。
interpretations.explanation: 喜欢那个园圃，那里有檀树，树下是柞树。

interpretations.segmentation: Delight in that garden: there stands sandalwood, and beneath it are oak shoots.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming.pinyin: ta1 shan1 zhi1 shi2， ke3 yi3 wei4 cuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 他山之石，可以为错。
interpretations.explanation: 他山的石头，可以作磨玉的工具。

interpretations.segmentation: Stones from another hill can serve as whetstones.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming.pinyin: he4 ming2 yu2 jiu3 gao1， sheng1 wen2 yu2 tian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鹤鸣于九皋，声闻于天。
interpretations.explanation: 鹤在深水沼泽鸣叫，声音传到天上。

interpretations.segmentation: The crane cries in the deep marsh; its voice reaches the sky.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming.pinyin: yu2 zai4 yu2 zhu3， huo4 qian2 zai4 yuan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鱼在于渚，或潜在渊。
interpretations.explanation: 鱼在小洲上，有的却潜藏在深渊。

interpretations.segmentation: Fish are on the sandbar, or some hide in the deep pool.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming.content: 乐彼之园，爰有树檀，其下维谷。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming.pinyin: le4 bi3 zhi1 yuan2， yuan2 you3 shu4 tan2， qi2 xia4 wei2 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐彼之园，爰有树檀，其下维谷。
interpretations.explanation: 喜欢那个园圃，那里有檀树，树下是谷子。

interpretations.segmentation: Delight in that garden: there stands sandalwood, and beneath it is millet.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming.pinyin: ta1 shan1 zhi1 shi2， ke3 yi3 gong1 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 他山之石，可以攻玉。
interpretations.explanation: 他山的石头，可以雕琢美玉。

interpretations.segmentation: Stones from another hill can be used to carve and polish jade.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan.pinyin: hong2 yan4 yu2 fei1， su4 su4 qi2 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鸿雁于飞，肃肃其羽。
interpretations.explanation: 鸿雁在飞，羽声肃肃。

interpretations.segmentation: Wild geese are flying; their wings rustle solemnly.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan.pinyin: zhi1 zi yu2 zheng1， qu2 lao2 yu2 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 之子于征，劬劳于野。
interpretations.explanation: 那人远行在外，在旷野辛劳奔波。

interpretations.segmentation: That man is away on a journey, toiling in the open wilds.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan.pinyin: yuan2 ji2 jin1 ren2， ai1 ci3 guan1 gua3。

interpretations.segmentation: 爰及矜人，哀此鳏寡。
interpretations.explanation: 乃至可怜的人，哀怜这些鳏夫寡妇。

interpretations.segmentation: Reaching even the needy, pity these widowers and widows.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan.pinyin: hong2 yan4 yu2 fei1， ji2 yu2 zhong1 ze2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鸿雁于飞，集于中泽。
interpretations.explanation: 鸿雁在飞，落在中泽。

interpretations.segmentation: Wild geese are flying; they settle in the middle marsh.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan.pinyin: zhi1 zi yu2 yuan2， bai3 du3 jie1 zuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 之子于垣，百堵皆作。
interpretations.explanation: 那人筑墙，百堵一齐动工。

interpretations.segmentation: That man builds walls; a hundred lengths of wall are raised.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan.pinyin: sui1 ze2 qu2 lao2， qi2 jiu1 an1 zhai2？

interpretations.segmentation: 虽则劬劳，其究安宅？
interpretations.explanation: 虽然辛劳，他们究竟能安居吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Though they toil, where in the end will they find a home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan.pinyin: hong2 yan4 yu2 fei1， ai1 ming2 ao2 ao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鸿雁于飞，哀鸣嗷嗷。
interpretations.explanation: 鸿雁在飞，哀鸣嗷嗷。

interpretations.segmentation: Wild geese are flying, crying out in mournful calls.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan.pinyin: wei2 ci3 zhe2 ren2， wei4 wo3 qu2 lao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 维此哲人，谓我劬劳。
interpretations.explanation: 只有这哲人，说我是在辛劳。

interpretations.segmentation: Only the wise man says I am toiling.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan.pinyin: wei2 bi3 yu2 ren2， wei4 wo3 xuan1 jiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维彼愚人，谓我宣骄。
interpretations.explanation: 那些愚人，却说我是在炫耀。

interpretations.segmentation: Those fools say I am showing off and acting proud.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao.content: 黄鸟黄鸟，无集于穀，无啄我粟。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao.pinyin: huang2 niao3 huang2 niao3， wu2 ji2 yu2 gu3， wu2 zhuo2 wo3 su4。

interpretations.segmentation: 黄鸟黄鸟，无集于穀，无啄我粟。
interpretations.explanation: 黄鸟黄鸟，不要落在楮树上，不要啄我的粟。

interpretations.segmentation: Yellow bird, yellow bird—do not perch on the paper mulberry; do not peck my millet.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao.pinyin: ci3 bang1 zhi1 ren2， bu4 wo3 ken3 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 此邦之人，不我肯穀。
interpretations.explanation: 这个封国的人，不肯善待我。

interpretations.segmentation: The people of this state refuse to treat me kindly.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao.pinyin: yan2 xuan2 yan2 gui1， fu4 wo3 bang1 zu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 言旋言归，复我邦族。
interpretations.explanation: 快回去吧，回到我的宗族。

interpretations.segmentation: Turn back and go home; return to my clan and kin.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao.content: 黄鸟黄鸟，无集于桑，无啄我粱。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao.pinyin: huang2 niao3 huang2 niao3， wu2 ji2 yu2 sang1， wu2 zhuo2 wo3 liang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 黄鸟黄鸟，无集于桑，无啄我粱。
interpretations.explanation: 黄鸟黄鸟，不要落在桑树上，不要啄我的粱。

interpretations.segmentation: Yellow bird, yellow bird—do not perch on the mulberry; do not peck my fine grain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao.pinyin: ci3 bang1 zhi1 ren2， bu4 ke3 yu3 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 此邦之人，不可与明。
interpretations.explanation: 这个封国的人，无法与之讲理。

interpretations.segmentation: The people of this state cannot be reasoned with.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao.pinyin: yan2 xuan2 yan2 gui1， fu4 wo3 zhu1 xiong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 言旋言归，复我诸兄。
interpretations.explanation: 快回去吧，回到我的兄弟们那里。

interpretations.segmentation: Turn back and go home; return to my elder brothers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao.content: 黄鸟黄鸟，无集于栩，无啄我黍。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao.pinyin: huang2 niao3 huang2 niao3， wu2 ji2 yu2 xu3， wu2 zhuo2 wo3 shu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 黄鸟黄鸟，无集于栩，无啄我黍。
interpretations.explanation: 黄鸟黄鸟，不要落在柞树上，不要啄我的黍。

interpretations.segmentation: Yellow bird, yellow bird—do not perch on the oak; do not peck my panicled millet.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao.pinyin: ci3 bang1 zhi1 ren2， bu4 ke3 yu3 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 此邦之人，不可与处。
interpretations.explanation: 这个封国的人，无法与之共处。

interpretations.segmentation: The people of this state cannot be lived with.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao.pinyin: yan2 xuan2 yan2 gui1， fu4 wo3 zhu1 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 言旋言归，复我诸父。
interpretations.explanation: 快回去吧，回到我的叔伯们那里。

interpretations.segmentation: Turn back and go home; return to my uncles and father's brothers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui.pinyin: mian3 bi3 liu2 shui3， chao2 zong1 yu2 hai3。

interpretations.segmentation: 沔彼流水，朝宗于海。
interpretations.explanation: 沔水滔滔，朝宗于海。

interpretations.segmentation: The Mián waters flow on, gathering toward the sea.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui.pinyin: yu4 bi3 fei1 sun3， zai4 fei1 zai4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鴥彼飞隼，载飞载止。
interpretations.explanation: 隼鸟飞得很快，时而飞起时而停落。

interpretations.segmentation: The swift falcon flies—now soaring, now alighting.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui.pinyin: jie1 wo3 xiong1 di4， bang1 ren2 zhu1 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 嗟我兄弟，邦人诸友。
interpretations.explanation: 唉，我的兄弟，封国中的各位朋友。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas, my brothers, friends throughout the state.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui.pinyin: mo4 ken3 nian4 luan4， shui2 wu2 fu4 mu3？

interpretations.segmentation: 莫肯念乱，谁无父母？
interpretations.explanation: 谁肯念及祸乱？谁没有父母？

interpretations.segmentation: Who will heed the turmoil? Who is without parents?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui.pinyin: mian3 bi3 liu2 shui3， qi2 liu2 tang1 tang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 沔彼流水，其流汤汤。
interpretations.explanation: 沔水滔滔，奔流汤汤。

interpretations.segmentation: The Mián waters flow on, rushing in broad waves.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui.pinyin: yu4 bi3 fei1 sun3， zai4 fei1 zai4 yang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鴥彼飞隼，载飞载扬。
interpretations.explanation: 隼鸟飞得很快，时而飞起时而高飞。

interpretations.segmentation: The swift falcon flies—now rising, now soaring high.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui.pinyin: nian4 bi3 bu4 ji4， zai4 qi3 zai4 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 念彼不迹，载起载行。
interpretations.explanation: 想到那些不走正路的人，我起身又行。

interpretations.segmentation: Thinking of those who stray from the right path, I rise and go again.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， bu4 ke3 mi3 wang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，不可弭忘。
interpretations.explanation: 心中忧愁，无法止息忘却。

interpretations.segmentation: Sorrow fills my heart and cannot be stilled or forgotten.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui.pinyin: yu4 bi3 fei1 sun3， lv4 bi3 zhong1 ling2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鴥彼飞隼，率彼中陵。
interpretations.explanation: 隼鸟飞得很快，沿着山陵飞翔。

interpretations.segmentation: The swift falcon flies, sweeping along the hill ridges.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui.pinyin: min2 zhi1 e2 yan2， ning2 mo4 zhi1 cheng2？

interpretations.segmentation: 民之讹言，宁莫之惩？
interpretations.explanation: 民间的谣言，难道没有人惩戒吗？

interpretations.segmentation: The people's false rumors—is no one to punish them?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui.pinyin: wo3 you3 jing4 yi3， chan2 yan2 qi2 xing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我友敬矣，谗言其兴。
interpretations.explanation: 我的朋友已经恭敬了，谗言却还要兴起。

interpretations.segmentation: My friend has been respectful, yet slander is rising.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu.pinyin: qi2 fu4， yu3 wang2 zhi1 zhao3 ya2。

interpretations.segmentation: 祈父，予王之爪牙。
interpretations.explanation: 祈父啊，你是大王的爪牙。

interpretations.segmentation: Minister of war, you are the king's fangs and claws.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu.pinyin: hu2 zhuan3 yu3 yu2 xu4， mi2 suo3 zhi3 ju1？

interpretations.segmentation: 胡转予于恤，靡所止居？
interpretations.explanation: 为什么把我调去服劳役，没有安顿之处？

interpretations.segmentation: Why transfer me to hardship service with nowhere to settle?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu.pinyin: qi2 fu4， yu3 wang2 zhi1 zhao3 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 祈父，予王之爪士。
interpretations.explanation: 祈父啊，你是大王的虎士。

interpretations.segmentation: Minister of war, you are the king's brave warriors.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu.pinyin: hu2 zhuan3 yu3 yu2 xu4， mi2 suo3 di3 zhi3？

interpretations.segmentation: 胡转予于恤，靡所厎止？
interpretations.explanation: 为什么把我调去服劳役，没有止息之日？

interpretations.segmentation: Why transfer me to hardship service with no day of rest?
祈父，亶不聪。
interpretations.explanation: 祈父啊，实在不聪敏。

interpretations.segmentation: Minister of war, you are truly not discerning.
胡转予于恤？
interpretations.explanation: 为什么把我调去服劳役？

interpretations.segmentation: Why transfer me to hardship service?
有母之尸饔。
interpretations.explanation: 我有母亲在家需要供养。

interpretations.segmentation: I have a mother at home who must be fed.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: zhi4 zhi4 si1 gan4， you1 you1 nan2 shan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 秩秩斯干，幽幽南山。
interpretations.explanation: 涧水清澈，南山幽远。

interpretations.segmentation: The stream ranks clear; the southern hill lies deep and still.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: ru2 zhu2 bao1 yi3， ru2 song1 mao4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 如竹苞矣，如松茂矣。
interpretations.explanation: 像竹子丛生，像松树繁茂。

interpretations.segmentation: Like bamboo clustered thick, like pine trees lush and green.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.content: 兄及弟矣，式相好矣，无相犹矣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: xiong1 ji2 di4 yi3， shi4 xiang1 hao3 yi3， wu2 xiang1 you2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 兄及弟矣，式相好矣，无相犹矣。
interpretations.explanation: 兄弟相聚，互相友好，不要猜忌。

interpretations.segmentation: Brothers together, loving one another—let there be no suspicion.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.content: 似续妣祖，筑室百堵，西南其户。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: shi4 xu4 bi3 zu3， zhu4 shi4 bai3 du3， xi1 nan2 qi2 hu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 似续妣祖，筑室百堵，西南其户。
interpretations.explanation: 继承先妣先祖，筑室百堵，门户开向西南。

interpretations.segmentation: Continuing the line of ancestresses and forefathers, they build a hundred rooms with doors facing southwest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: yuan2 ju1 yuan2 chu4， yuan2 xiao4 yuan2 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 爰居爰处，爰笑爰语。
interpretations.explanation: 在这里居住，在这里欢笑交谈。

interpretations.segmentation: Here they dwell and rest, here they laugh and talk.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: yue1 zhi1 ge2 ge2， zhuo2 zhi1 tuo2 tuo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 约之阁阁，椓之橐橐。
interpretations.explanation: 夯土声阁阁，打桩声橐橐。

interpretations.segmentation: The tamping sounds thud-thud; the pounding of stakes goes tap-tap.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.content: 风雨攸除，鸟鼠攸去，君子攸芋。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: feng1 yu3 you1 chu2， niao3 shu3 you1 qu4， jun1 zi you1 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 风雨攸除，鸟鼠攸去，君子攸芋。
interpretations.explanation: 风雨被挡在外，鸟鼠被驱除，君子在此安居。

interpretations.segmentation: Wind and rain are kept out, birds and mice driven away—the noble man finds shelter here.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.content: 如跂斯翼，如矢斯棘，如鸟斯革，如翚斯飞，君子攸跻。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: ru2 qi2 si1 yi4， ru2 shi3 si1 ji2， ru2 niao3 si1 ge2， ru2 hui1 si1 fei1， jun1 zi you1 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 如跂斯翼，如矢斯棘，如鸟斯革，如翚斯飞，君子攸跻。
interpretations.explanation: 像人踮脚般齐整，像箭矢般端正，像鸟羽般光泽，像野鸡飞般华美，君子登堂。

interpretations.segmentation: Upright as one on tiptoe, square as an arrow's end, sleek as a bird's plumes, soaring as a pheasant in flight—the noble man ascends.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: zhi2 zhi2 qi2 ting2， you3 jue2 qi2 ying2。

interpretations.segmentation: 殖殖其庭，有觉其楹。
interpretations.explanation: 庭院平坦，楹柱高耸。

interpretations.segmentation: The courtyard lies level; the pillars stand tall and straight.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: kuai4 kuai4 qi2 zheng4， hui4 hui4 qi2 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 哙哙其正，哕哕其冥。
interpretations.explanation: 正房明亮，内室幽暗。

interpretations.segmentation: The main hall is bright; the inner rooms are dim.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: jun1 zi you1 ning2。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子攸宁。
interpretations.explanation: 君子在此安宁。

interpretations.segmentation: The noble man finds peace here.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: xia4 guan3 shang4 dian4， nai3 an1 si1 qin3。

interpretations.segmentation: 下莞上簟，乃安斯寝。
interpretations.explanation: 下铺莞草席，上盖竹席，于是安睡。

interpretations.segmentation: Rush mat below, bamboo mat above—thus they rest in sleep.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: nai3 qin3 nai3 xing1， nai3 zhan4 wo3 meng4。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃寝乃兴，乃占我梦。
interpretations.explanation: 睡下又起身，占问我的梦。

interpretations.segmentation: They sleep and rise again, and divining, ask about my dream.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: ji2 meng4 wei2 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 吉梦维何？
interpretations.explanation: 吉祥的梦是什么？

interpretations.segmentation: What was the auspicious dream?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: wei2 xiong2 wei2 pi2， wei2 hui1 wei2 she2。

interpretations.segmentation: 维熊维罴，维虺维蛇。
interpretations.explanation: 梦见熊和罴，梦见虺和蛇。

interpretations.segmentation: Bears and brown bears, serpents and snakes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.content: 大人占之：维熊维罴，男子之祥；
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: da4 ren2 zhan4 zhi1： wei2 xiong2 wei2 pi2， nan2 zi zhi1 xiang2；

interpretations.segmentation: 大人占之：维熊维罴，男子之祥；
interpretations.explanation: 长辈占梦说：熊和罴，是生男子的征兆；

interpretations.segmentation: The elders interpret: bears and brown bears mean a boy is coming;

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: wei2 hui1 wei2 she2， nv3 zi zhi1 xiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 维虺维蛇，女子之祥。
interpretations.explanation: 虺和蛇，是生女子的征兆。

interpretations.segmentation: Serpents and snakes mean a girl is coming.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: nai3 sheng1 nan2 zi， zai4 qin3 zhi1 chuang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃生男子，载寝之床。
interpretations.explanation: 于是生了男子，让他睡在床上。

interpretations.segmentation: A boy is born; he is laid on a bed.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: zai4 yi1 zhi1 shang， zai4 nong4 zhi1 zhang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 载衣之裳，载弄之璋。
interpretations.explanation: 给他穿衣裳，给他玩玉璋。

interpretations.segmentation: He is dressed in robes and given a jade scepter to play with.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.content: 其泣喤喤，朱芾斯皇，室家君王。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: qi2 qi4 huang2 huang2， zhu1 fei4 si1 huang2， shi4 jia1 jun1 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 其泣喤喤，朱芾斯皇，室家君王。
interpretations.explanation: 他哭声响亮，将来穿朱芾作诸侯，家室为王。

interpretations.segmentation: His crying rings loud; he will wear scarlet knee-guards as lord; his house will serve the king.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: nai3 sheng1 nv3 zi， zai4 qin3 zhi1 di4。

interpretations.segmentation: 乃生女子，载寝之地。
interpretations.explanation: 于是生了女子，让她睡在地上。

interpretations.segmentation: A girl is born; she is laid on the ground.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: zai4 yi1 zhi1 ti4， zai4 nong4 zhi1 wa3。

interpretations.segmentation: 载衣之裼，载弄之瓦。
interpretations.explanation: 给她穿短衣，给她玩瓦片。

interpretations.segmentation: She is dressed in a short garment and given a tile to play with.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.content: 无非无仪，唯酒食是议，无父母诒罹。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan.pinyin: wu2 fei1 wu2 yi2， wei2 jiu3 shi2 shi4 yi4， wu2 fu4 mu3 yi2 li2。

interpretations.segmentation: 无非无仪，唯酒食是议，无父母诒罹。
interpretations.explanation: 无非无仪，只议酒食，不给父母惹祸。

interpretations.segmentation: No wrong, no special role—only food and drink are her concern, bringing no trouble to her parents.
夜如何其？
interpretations.explanation: 夜到什么程度了？

interpretations.segmentation: How far has the night advanced?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao.pinyin: ye4 wei4 yang1， ting2 liao2 zhi1 guang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夜未央，庭燎之光。
interpretations.explanation: 夜还未尽，庭中火炬明亮。

interpretations.segmentation: The night is not yet ended; the court torches blaze.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao.pinyin: jun1 zi zhi4 zhi3， luan2 sheng1 jiang1 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子至止，鸾声将将。
interpretations.explanation: 君子来了，鸾铃叮当响。

interpretations.segmentation: The noble lord arrives; the bell on his carriage rings clearly.
夜如何其？
interpretations.explanation: 夜到什么程度了？

interpretations.segmentation: How far has the night advanced?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao.pinyin: ye4 wei4 ai4， ting2 liao2 zhe2 zhe2。

interpretations.segmentation: 夜未艾，庭燎晣晣。
interpretations.explanation: 夜还未止，庭中火炬亮堂堂。

interpretations.segmentation: The night is not yet over; the court torches shine bright.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao.pinyin: jun1 zi zhi4 zhi3， luan2 sheng1 hui4 hui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子至止，鸾声哕哕。
interpretations.explanation: 君子来了，鸾铃哕哕响。

interpretations.segmentation: The noble lord arrives; the carriage bells ring in succession.
夜如何其？
interpretations.explanation: 夜到什么程度了？

interpretations.segmentation: How far has the night advanced?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao.pinyin: ye4 xiang1 chen2， ting2 liao2 you3 hui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夜乡晨，庭燎有辉。
interpretations.explanation: 夜已近晨，庭中火炬仍有光辉。

interpretations.segmentation: The night nears dawn; the court torches still glow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao.pinyin: jun1 zi zhi4 zhi3， yan2 guan1 qi2 qi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子至止，言观其旂。
interpretations.explanation: 君子来了，请看他的旗帜。

interpretations.segmentation: The noble lord arrives—look upon his banners.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye.pinyin: wo3 xing2 qi2 ye3， bi4 fei4 qi2 chu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我行其野，蔽芾其樗。
interpretations.explanation: 我行走在郊野，臭椿树幼嫩茂盛。

interpretations.segmentation: I walk the wilds; the ailanthus saplings grow lush and young.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye.pinyin: hun1 yin1 zhi1 gu4， yan2 jiu4 er3 ju1。

interpretations.segmentation: 婚姻之故，言就尔居。
interpretations.explanation: 因为婚姻的缘故，才到你这里来住。

interpretations.segmentation: Because of marriage I came to dwell with you.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye.pinyin: er3 bu4 wo3 chu4， fu4 wo3 bang1 jia1。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔不我畜，复我邦家。
interpretations.explanation: 你不肯养我，让我回到我的家国。

interpretations.segmentation: You will not keep me; let me return to my state and home.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye.pinyin: wo3 xing2 qi2 ye3， yan2 cai3 qi2 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我行其野，言采其蓫。
interpretations.explanation: 我行走在郊野，采那蓫菜。

interpretations.segmentation: I walk the wilds, gathering the hogfennel.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye.pinyin: hun1 yin1 zhi1 gu4， yan2 jiu4 er3 su4。

interpretations.segmentation: 婚姻之故，言就尔宿。
interpretations.explanation: 因为婚姻的缘故，才到你这里来宿。

interpretations.segmentation: Because of marriage I came to lodge with you.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye.pinyin: er3 bu4 wo3 chu4， yan2 gui1 si1 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔不我畜，言归斯复。
interpretations.explanation: 你不肯养我，我言归就回。

interpretations.segmentation: You will not keep me; I say I will go back.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye.pinyin: wo3 xing2 qi2 ye3， yan2 cai3 qi2 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我行其野，言采其葍。
interpretations.explanation: 我行走在郊野，采那葍草。

interpretations.segmentation: I walk the wilds, gathering the convolvulus.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye.pinyin: bu4 si1 jiu4 yin1， qiu2 er3 xin1 te4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不思旧姻，求尔新特。
interpretations.explanation: 不想旧日的姻亲，只求你新的配偶。

interpretations.segmentation: You forget the old tie of kin; you seek only your new mate.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye.pinyin: cheng2 bu4 yi3 fu4， yi4 zhi1 yi3 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 成不以富，亦祗以异。
interpretations.explanation: 成亲并非因为富足，只是因为你变了心。

interpretations.segmentation: Union was not for wealth—it is only that you have changed.
谁谓尔无羊？
interpretations.explanation: 谁说你们没有羊？

interpretations.segmentation: Who says you have no sheep?
三百维群。
interpretations.explanation: 三百头一群。

interpretations.segmentation: Three hundred make one flock.
谁谓尔无牛？
interpretations.explanation: 谁说你们没有牛？

interpretations.segmentation: Who says you have no cattle?
九十其犉。
interpretations.explanation: 九十头是赤色的。

interpretations.segmentation: Ninety are reddish-brown bulls.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.pinyin: er3 yang2 lai2 si1， qi2 jiao3 ji2 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔羊来思，其角濈濈。
interpretations.explanation: 你们的羊来了，角儿密密挤在一起。

interpretations.segmentation: Your sheep come; their horns press close together.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.pinyin: er3 niu2 lai2 si1， qi2 er3 shi1 shi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔牛来思，其耳湿湿。
interpretations.explanation: 你们的牛来了，耳朵湿湿垂下。

interpretations.segmentation: Your cattle come; their ears hang damp and low.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.content: 或降于阿，或饮于池，或寝或讹。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.pinyin: huo4 jiang4 yu2 a1， huo4 yin3 yu2 chi2， huo4 qin3 huo4 e2。

interpretations.segmentation: 或降于阿，或饮于池，或寝或讹。
interpretations.explanation: 有的走下山坡，有的在池边饮水，有的睡有的动。

interpretations.segmentation: Some descend the slope, some drink at the pool, some sleep, some stir.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.content: 尔牧来思，何蓑何笠，或负其餱。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.pinyin: er3 mu4 lai2 si1， he2 suo1 he2 li4， huo4 fu4 qi2 hou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔牧来思，何蓑何笠，或负其餱。
interpretations.explanation: 你们的牧人来了，披着蓑衣戴着斗笠，有的背着干粮。

interpretations.segmentation: Your herdsmen come, in rain capes and bamboo hats, some bearing dry rations.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.pinyin: san1 shi2 wei2 wu4， er3 sheng1 ze2 ju4。

interpretations.segmentation: 三十维物，尔牲则具。
interpretations.explanation: 三十种祭物，你们的牺牲齐备了。

interpretations.segmentation: Thirty kinds of offerings—your sacrificial beasts are complete.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.content: 尔牧来思，以薪以蒸，以雌以雄。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.pinyin: er3 mu4 lai2 si1， yi3 xin1 yi3 zheng1， yi3 ci2 yi3 xiong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔牧来思，以薪以蒸，以雌以雄。
interpretations.explanation: 你们的牧人来了，带着柴薪和蒸物，有雌有雄。

interpretations.segmentation: Your herdsmen come with firewood and steamed food, both female and male beasts.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.content: 尔羊来思，矜矜兢兢，不骞不崩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.pinyin: er3 yang2 lai2 si1， jin1 jin1 jing1 jing1， bu4 qian1 bu4 beng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔羊来思，矜矜兢兢，不骞不崩。
interpretations.explanation: 你们的羊来了，矜矜兢兢，不丢失不溃散。

interpretations.segmentation: Your sheep come, careful and wary, not straying nor breaking rank.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.pinyin: hui1 zhi1 yi3 gong1， bi4 lai2 ji4 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 麾之以肱，毕来既升。
interpretations.explanation: 挥动手臂一招呼，全都聚拢登上圈栏。

interpretations.segmentation: With a wave of the arm they are all gathered and led up.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.content: 牧人乃梦，众维鱼矣，旐维旟矣，大人占之；
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.pinyin: mu4 ren2 nai3 meng4， zhong4 wei2 yu2 yi3， zhao4 wei2 yu2 yi3， da4 ren2 zhan4 zhi1；

interpretations.segmentation: 牧人乃梦，众维鱼矣，旐维旟矣，大人占之；
interpretations.explanation: 牧人做梦，梦见众鱼，梦见旗旐；长辈占梦：

interpretations.segmentation: The herdsman dreams: a multitude of fish, banners and pennants—the elders interpret:

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.pinyin: zhong4 wei2 yu2 yi3， shi2 wei2 feng1 nian2；

interpretations.segmentation: 众维鱼矣，实维丰年；
interpretations.explanation: 众鱼，预示丰收年；

interpretations.segmentation: Many fish mean a year of plenty;

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang.pinyin: zhao4 wei2 yu2 yi3， shi4 jia1 qin2 qin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 旐维旟矣，室家溱溱。
interpretations.explanation: 旗旐，预示室家众多。

interpretations.segmentation: Banners and pennants mean the household will flourish.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: bi3 he2 ren2 si1？

interpretations.segmentation: 彼何人斯？
interpretations.explanation: 那是什么人？

interpretations.segmentation: Who is that person?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: qi2 xin1 kong3 jian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 其心孔艰。
interpretations.explanation: 他的心多么险恶。

interpretations.segmentation: His heart is deeply hard and cruel.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: hu2 shi4 wo3 liang2， bu4 ru4 wo3 men2？

interpretations.segmentation: 胡逝我梁，不入我门？
interpretations.explanation: 为什么经过我的鱼梁，却不进我的门？

interpretations.segmentation: Why pass my fish weir yet not enter my door?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: yi1 shui2 yun2 cong2？

interpretations.segmentation: 伊谁云从？
interpretations.explanation: 他跟从的是谁？

interpretations.segmentation: Who is it that he follows?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: wei2 bao4 zhi1 yun2。

interpretations.segmentation: 维暴之云。
interpretations.explanation: 是跟从暴虐的人。

interpretations.segmentation: He follows the violent one.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: er4 ren2 cong2 xing2， shui2 wei4 ci3 huo4？

interpretations.segmentation: 二人从行，谁为此祸？
interpretations.explanation: 两人同行，是谁造成了这场灾祸？

interpretations.segmentation: Two walk together—who brought this disaster?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: hu2 shi4 wo3 liang2， bu4 ru4 yan4 wo3？

interpretations.segmentation: 胡逝我梁，不入唁我？
interpretations.explanation: 为什么经过我的鱼梁，不来慰问？

interpretations.segmentation: Why pass my fish weir and not come to console me?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: shi3 zhe3 bu4 ru2 jin1， yun2 bu4 wo3 ke3

interpretations.segmentation: 始者不如今，云不我可
interpretations.explanation: 当初不像现在这样，如今说我不对。

interpretations.segmentation: It was not like this at first; now he says I am in the wrong.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: bi3 he2 ren2 si1？

interpretations.segmentation: 彼何人斯？
interpretations.explanation: 那是什么人？

interpretations.segmentation: Who is that person?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: hu2 shi4 wo3 chen2？

interpretations.segmentation: 胡逝我陈？
interpretations.explanation: 为什么经过我的庭院？

interpretations.segmentation: Why pass through my courtyard?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: wo3 wen2 qi2 sheng1， bu4 jian4 qi2 shen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我闻其声，不见其身。
interpretations.explanation: 我听见他的声音，却看不见他的身影。

interpretations.segmentation: I hear his voice but do not see his form.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: bu4 kui4 yu2 ren2？

interpretations.segmentation: 不愧于人？
interpretations.explanation: 对人难道不感到惭愧？

interpretations.segmentation: Is he not ashamed before others?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: bu4 wei4 yu2 tian1？

interpretations.segmentation: 不畏于天？
interpretations.explanation: 对天难道不感到畏惧？

interpretations.segmentation: Is he not in awe of Heaven?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: bi3 he2 ren2 si1？

interpretations.segmentation: 彼何人斯？
interpretations.explanation: 那是什么人？

interpretations.segmentation: Who is that person?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: qi2 wei4 piao1 feng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 其为飘风。
interpretations.explanation: 他像旋风一样。

interpretations.segmentation: He is like a whirlwind.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: hu2 bu4 zi4 bei3？

interpretations.segmentation: 胡不自北？
interpretations.explanation: 为什么不从北边来？

interpretations.segmentation: Why does he not come from the north?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: hu2 bu4 zi4 nan2？

interpretations.segmentation: 胡不自南？
interpretations.explanation: 为什么不从南边来？

interpretations.segmentation: Why does he not come from the south?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: hu2 shi4 wo3 liang2？

interpretations.segmentation: 胡逝我梁？
interpretations.explanation: 为什么经过我的鱼梁？

interpretations.segmentation: Why pass my fish weir?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: chi1 jiao3 wo3 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 絺搅我心。
interpretations.explanation: 搅得我心乱如麻。

interpretations.segmentation: He churns my heart into turmoil.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: er3 zhi1 an1 xing2， yi4 bu4 huang2 she3。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔之安行，亦不遑舍。
interpretations.explanation: 你慢慢走，也不稍作停留。

interpretations.segmentation: When you go at ease, you still will not pause.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: er3 zhi1 ji2 xing2， huang2 zhi1 er3 che1。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔之亟行，遑脂尔车。
interpretations.explanation: 你快快走，也顾不上给车加油。

interpretations.segmentation: When you hurry, you have no time even to grease your cart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: yi1 zhe3 zhi1 lai2， yun2 he2 qi2 xu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 一者之来，云何其盱。
interpretations.explanation: 你这一来，为何那样瞪眼看我。

interpretations.segmentation: When you come, why do you stare at me so?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: er3 hai2 er2 ru4， wo3 xin1 yi4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔还而入，我心易也。
interpretations.explanation: 你回来进门，我的心就宽了。

interpretations.segmentation: If you return and enter, my heart is eased.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: hai2 er2 bu4 ru4， fou3 nan2 zhi1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 还而不入，否难知也。
interpretations.explanation: 回来却不进门，情分就难以知道了。

interpretations.segmentation: Return yet not enter—then how can affection be known?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: yi1 zhe3 zhi1 lai2， bi3 wo3 chi1 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 一者之来，俾我絺也。
interpretations.explanation: 你这一来，使我心乱如麻。

interpretations.segmentation: When you come, you throw my heart into turmoil.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: bo2 shi4 chui1 xun1， zhong4 shi4 chui1 chi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 伯氏吹埙，仲氏吹篪。
interpretations.explanation: 伯氏吹埙，仲氏吹篪。

interpretations.segmentation: The elder brother plays the xun; the younger plays the chi.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.content: 及尔如贯，谅不我郑出此三物，以诅尔斯。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: ji2 er3 ru2 guan4， liang4 bu4 wo3 zheng4 chu1 ci3 san1 wu4， yi3 zu3 er3 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 及尔如贯，谅不我郑出此三物，以诅尔斯。
interpretations.explanation: 与你如贯珠般亲密，料你不会把我抛弃；拿出这三物，对你诅咒。

interpretations.segmentation: Close as beads on a string—I trust you would not cast me off; yet I bring these three things to curse you.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: wei4 gui3 wei4 yu4， ze2 bu4 ke3 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 为鬼为蜮，则不可得。
interpretations.explanation: 若是鬼怪，就抓不到；

interpretations.segmentation: If you were ghost or goblin, one could not seize you;

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: you3 tian3 mian4 mu4， shi4 ren2 wang3 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有靦面目，视人罔极。
interpretations.explanation: 却有脸皮，看人毫无底线。

interpretations.segmentation: But you have a face and stare at people beyond all shame.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi.pinyin: zuo4 ci3 hao3 ge1， yi3 ji2 fan3 ce4。

interpretations.segmentation: 作此好歌，以极反侧。
interpretations.explanation: 作此好歌，以尽反复无常之心。

interpretations.segmentation: I make this fine song to exhaust my tossing, restless heart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: jie2 bi3 nan2 shan1， wei2 shi2 yan2 yan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 节彼南山，维石岩岩。
interpretations.explanation: 那南山高峻，岩石层层。

interpretations.segmentation: Lofty is that southern hill; its rocks stand steep and sheer.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: he4 he4 shi1 yin3， min2 ju4 er3 zhan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 赫赫师尹，民具尔瞻。
interpretations.explanation: 师尹威名赫赫，万民都在仰望他。

interpretations.segmentation: Grand Master Yin shines in majesty; all the people look up to him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: you1 xin1 ru2 tan2， bu4 gan3 xi4 tan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 忧心如惔，不敢戏谈。
interpretations.explanation: 忧心如火焚烧，不敢随便谈笑。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart burns with care; I dare not speak in jest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: guo2 ji4 zu2 zhan3， he2 yong4 bu4 jian1！

interpretations.segmentation: 国既卒斩，何用不监！
interpretations.explanation: 国家已经残破，为何还不省察！

interpretations.segmentation: The state is already cut down—why will you not look and see!

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: jie2 bi3 nan2 shan1， you3 shi2 qi2 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 节彼南山，有实其猗。
interpretations.explanation: 那南山高峻，山上有茂美的草木。

interpretations.segmentation: Lofty is that southern hill; on it grow lush plants.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: he4 he4 shi1 yin3， bu4 ping2 wei4 he2。

interpretations.segmentation: 赫赫师尹，不平谓何。
interpretations.explanation: 师尹威名赫赫，不平之事怎么说？

interpretations.segmentation: Grand Master Yin shines in majesty—how can injustice be explained?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: tian1 fang1 jian4 chai4， sang4 luan4 hong2 duo1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天方荐瘥，丧乱弘多。
interpretations.explanation: 上天正降疫病，丧乱越来越多。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven is sending pestilence; death and disorder multiply.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: min2 yan2 wu2 jia1， can3 mo4 cheng2 jie1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民言无嘉，惨莫惩嗟。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓的话没有好话，惨状无人惩戒叹息。

interpretations.segmentation: The people's words hold no praise; none lament or check the misery.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: yin3 shi4 da4 shi1， wei2 zhou1 zhi1 di1；

interpretations.segmentation: 尹氏大师，维周之氐；
interpretations.explanation: 尹氏是太师，是周的根基；

interpretations.segmentation: Yin is Grand Master, the foundation of Zhou;

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: bing3 guo2 zhi1 jun1， si4 fang1 shi4 wei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 秉国之钧，四方是维。
interpretations.explanation: 执掌国政，维系四方。

interpretations.segmentation: He holds the state's balance and holds the four quarters firm.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: tian1 zi shi4 pi2， bi3 min2 bu4 mi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 天子是毗，俾民不迷。
interpretations.explanation: 辅佐天子，使百姓不迷失。

interpretations.segmentation: He supports the Son of Heaven and keeps the people from going astray.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: bu4 diao4 hao4 tian1， bu4 yi2 kong1 wo3 shi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 不吊昊天，不宜空我师。
interpretations.explanation: 不怜恤昊天，不宜使国家空虚。

interpretations.segmentation: Pityless toward great Heaven—he should not leave the state hollow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: fu2 gong1 fu2 qin1， shu4 min2 fu2 xin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 弗躬弗亲，庶民弗信。
interpretations.explanation: 不亲自过问，百姓就不会信从。

interpretations.segmentation: If he does not attend in person, the people will not trust.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: fu2 wen4 fu2 shi4， wu4 wang3 jun1 zi。
