interpretations.segmentation: 弗问弗仕，勿罔君子。
interpretations.explanation: 不问政事、不任贤才，不要欺罔君子。

interpretations.segmentation: Not inquiring, not employing talent—do not mislead the noble men.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: shi4 yi2 shi4 yi3， wu2 xiao3 ren2 dai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 式夷式已，无小人殆。
interpretations.explanation: 平息祸乱、制止恶行，不要让小人得逞。

interpretations.segmentation: Calm disorder and stop evil; do not let petty men prevail.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: suo3 suo3 yin1 ya4， ze2 wu2 hu1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 琐琐姻亚，则无膴仕。
interpretations.explanation: 琐碎的姻亲，就没有好官职。

interpretations.segmentation: Petty connections by marriage—then no worthy office remains.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: hao4 tian1 bu4 yong1， jiang4 ci3 ju1 xiong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 昊天不佣，降此鞠訩。
interpretations.explanation: 昊天不助，降下如此大祸。

interpretations.segmentation: Great Heaven does not help; such great distress descends.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: hao4 tian1 bu4 hui4， jiang4 ci3 da4 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 昊天不惠，降此大戾。
interpretations.explanation: 昊天不惠，降下如此大灾。

interpretations.segmentation: Great Heaven is unkind; such great calamity descends.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: jun1 zi ru2 jie4， bi3 min2 xin1 que4。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子如届，俾民心阕。
interpretations.explanation: 君子如能到来，可使民心安定。

interpretations.segmentation: If noble men would come, the people's hearts would find rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: jun1 zi ru2 yi2， e4 nu4 shi4 wei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子如夷，恶怒是违。
interpretations.explanation: 君子如能平易，就可远离暴怒。

interpretations.segmentation: If noble men were even-tempered, raging anger could be avoided.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: bu4 diao4 hao4 tian1， luan4 mi2 you3 ding4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不吊昊天，乱靡有定。
interpretations.explanation: 不怜恤昊天，祸乱没有止境。

interpretations.segmentation: Pityless toward Heaven—chaos knows no end.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: shi4 yue4 si1 sheng1， bi3 min2 bu4 ning2。

interpretations.segmentation: 式月斯生，俾民不宁。
interpretations.explanation: 日月交替而生，使百姓不得安宁。

interpretations.segmentation: Month follows month and life goes on, yet the people know no peace.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: you1 xin1 ru2 cheng2， shui2 bing3 guo2 cheng2？

interpretations.segmentation: 忧心如酲，谁秉国成？
interpretations.explanation: 忧心如醉，谁执掌国政？

interpretations.segmentation: My heart aches as if drunk—who holds the reins of state?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: bu4 zi4 wei4 zheng4， zu2 lao2 bai3 xing4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不自为政，卒劳百姓。
interpretations.explanation: 不亲自理政，终使百姓劳苦。

interpretations.segmentation: Not governing himself, he finally wears the people out.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: jia4 bi3 si4 mu3， si4 mu3 xiang4 ling3。

interpretations.segmentation: 驾彼四牡，四牡项领。
interpretations.explanation: 驾起四匹公马，四马颈项肥壮。

interpretations.segmentation: He yokes the four stallions; their necks are stout and strong.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: wo3 zhan1 si4 fang1， cu4 cu4 mi2 suo3 cheng3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我瞻四方，蹙蹙靡所骋。
interpretations.explanation: 我望四方，局促无处施展。

interpretations.segmentation: I look to the four quarters—cramped, with nowhere to advance.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: fang1 mao4 er3 e4， xiang1 er3 mao2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 方茂尔恶，相尔矛矣。
interpretations.explanation: 你恶行正盛时，对我亮出矛。

interpretations.segmentation: When your wickedness flourishes, you level spears at me.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: ji4 yi2 ji4 yi4， ru2 xiang1 chou2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 既夷既怿，如相酬矣。
interpretations.explanation: 一旦和缓喜悦，又像对饮酬答。

interpretations.segmentation: Once eased and pleased, you act as at a drinking toast.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: hao4 tian1 bu4 ping2， wo3 wang2 bu4 ning2。

interpretations.segmentation: 昊天不平，我王不宁。
interpretations.explanation: 昊天不公，我王不得安宁。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven is not fair; our king finds no peace.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: bu4 cheng2 qi2 xin1， fu4 yuan4 qi2 zheng4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不惩其心，覆怨其正。
interpretations.explanation: 不惩戒其心，反而怨恨正直。

interpretations.segmentation: He will not correct his heart, yet resents those who are upright.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: jia1 fu4 zuo4 song4， yi3 jiu1 wang2 xiong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 家父作诵，以究王訩。
interpretations.explanation: 家父作此诗，以探究王的祸患。

interpretations.segmentation: Jia Fu composed this poem to probe the king's distress.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.pinyin: shi4 e2 er3 xin1， yi3 chu4 wan4 bang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 式讹尔心，以畜万邦。
interpretations.explanation: 改正你的心思，以养育万邦。

interpretations.segmentation: Amend your heart and mind, to nourish the myriad states.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: you1 you1 hao4 tian1， yue1 fu4 mu3 qie3。

interpretations.segmentation: 悠悠昊天，曰父母且。
interpretations.explanation: 悠悠昊天，如同父母啊。

interpretations.segmentation: Far-reaching great Heaven—like a parent to us.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: wu2 zui4 wu2 gu1， luan4 ru2 ci3 hu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无罪无辜，乱如此幠。
interpretations.explanation: 无罪无辜，祸乱竟如此大。

interpretations.segmentation: Without guilt, without fault—yet disorder is so vast.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: hao4 tian1 yi3 wei1， yu3 shen4 wu2 zui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 昊天已威，予慎无罪。
interpretations.explanation: 昊天已显威严，我确是无罪。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven has shown its might; truly I am not guilty.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: hao4 tian1 da4 hu1， yu3 shen4 wu2 gu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 昊天大幠，予慎无辜。
interpretations.explanation: 昊天降大祸，我确是无辜。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven sends great disaster; truly I am blameless.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: luan4 zhi1 chu1 sheng1， jian4 shi3 ji4 han2。

interpretations.segmentation: 乱之初生，僭始既涵。
interpretations.explanation: 祸乱初生，越级进言已被包容。

interpretations.segmentation: When disorder first arose, overstepping speech was already tolerated.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: luan4 zhi1 you4 sheng1， jun1 zi xin4 chan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 乱之又生，君子信谗。
interpretations.explanation: 祸乱又生，君子听信了谗言。

interpretations.segmentation: Disorder arose again—the noble man believed slander.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: jun1 zi ru2 nu4， luan4 shu4 chuan2 ju3。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子如怒，乱庶遄沮。
interpretations.explanation: 君子如能发怒，祸乱就会迅速止息。

interpretations.segmentation: If the noble man would show anger, disorder would quickly cease.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: jun1 zi ru2 zhi3， luan4 shu4 chuan2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子如祉，乱庶遄已。
interpretations.explanation: 君子如能施福，祸乱就会迅速停止。

interpretations.segmentation: If the noble man would grant blessing, disorder would quickly end.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: jun1 zi lv3 meng2， luan4 shi4 yong4 zhang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子屡盟，乱是用长。
interpretations.explanation: 君子屡次盟誓，祸乱因此滋长。

interpretations.segmentation: The noble man swears oaths again and again—therefore disorder grows long.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: jun1 zi xin4 dao4， luan4 shi4 yong4 bao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子信盗，乱是用暴。
interpretations.explanation: 君子信任盗贼，祸乱因此暴起。

interpretations.segmentation: The noble man trusts thieves—therefore disorder breaks out.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: dao4 yan2 kong3 gan1， luan4 shi4 yong4 tan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 盗言孔甘，乱是用餤。
interpretations.explanation: 盗贼的话很甜，祸乱因此蔓延。

interpretations.segmentation: The thief's words are sweet—therefore disorder spreads.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: fei3 qi2 zhi3 gong4， wei2 wang2 zhi1 qiong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪其止共，维王之邛。
interpretations.explanation: 不能止于恭敬，这是王的祸患。

interpretations.segmentation: Unable to stop at reverence—this is the king's affliction.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: yi4 yi4 qin3 miao4， jun1 zi zuo4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 奕奕寝庙，君子作之。
interpretations.explanation: 奕奕寝庙，是君子所建。

interpretations.segmentation: Splendid are the ancestral temples—the noble men built them.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: zhi4 zhi4 da4 you2， sheng4 ren2 mo4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 秩秩大猷，圣人莫之。
interpretations.explanation: 秩秩大谋，圣人所定。

interpretations.segmentation: Orderly are the great plans—the sages devised them.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: ta1 ren2 you3 xin1， yu3 cun3 du4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 他人有心，予忖度之。
interpretations.explanation: 别人有心思，我能揣度它。

interpretations.segmentation: Others have thoughts in mind; I can measure them.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: yue4 yue4 chan2 tu4， yu4 quan3 huo4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 跃跃毚兔，遇犬获之。
interpretations.explanation: 活跃的狡兔，遇到猎犬就被捉。

interpretations.segmentation: The leaping, cunning hare—meet a hound and it is caught.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: ren3 ran3 rou2 mu4， jun1 zi shu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 荏染柔木，君子树之。
interpretations.explanation: 柔弱的树木，君子才栽种。

interpretations.segmentation: Soft, pliant trees—the noble man plants them.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: wang3 lai2 xing2 yan2， xin1 yan1 shu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 往来行言，心焉数之。
interpretations.explanation: 来来往往的流言，心中要数一数。

interpretations.segmentation: Words going back and forth—count them in the heart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: she2 she2 shuo4 yan2， chu1 zi4 kou3 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 蛇蛇硕言，出自口矣。
interpretations.explanation: 夸夸其谈，从口中说出。

interpretations.segmentation: Smooth, boastful talk pours from the mouth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: qiao3 yan2 ru2 huang2， yan2 zhi1 hou4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 巧言如簧，颜之厚矣。
interpretations.explanation: 巧言如簧，脸皮厚矣。

interpretations.segmentation: Clever words like reed pipes—the face grows thick with shamelessness.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: bi3 he2 ren2 si1？

interpretations.segmentation: 彼何人斯？
interpretations.explanation: 那是什么人？

interpretations.segmentation: Who is that person?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: ju1 he2 zhi1 mi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 居河之麋。
interpretations.explanation: 住在黄河的边沿。

interpretations.segmentation: He dwells on the banks of the Yellow River.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: wu2 quan2 wu2 yong3， zhi2 wei4 luan4 jie1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无拳无勇，职为乱阶。
interpretations.explanation: 没有拳力没有勇力，却成为祸乱的阶梯。

interpretations.segmentation: No fist, no courage—yet he serves as the stair to disorder.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: ji4 wei1 qie3 zhong3， er3 yong3 yi1 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 既微且尰，尔勇伊何？
interpretations.explanation: 既瘸又肿，你的勇力在哪里？

interpretations.segmentation: Lame and swollen—where is your bravery?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan.pinyin: wei4 you2 jiang1 duo1， er3 ju1 tu2 ji3 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 为犹将多，尔居徒几何？
interpretations.explanation: 作为帮凶还很多，你的党徒有几何？

interpretations.segmentation: As accomplices you have many—how large is your band of followers?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: shi2 yue4 zhi1 jiao1， shuo4 yue4 xin1 mao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 十月之交，朔月辛卯。
interpretations.explanation: 十月之交，初一辛卯日。

interpretations.segmentation: In the intercalary tenth month, on the first day, xinmao.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: ri4 you3 shi2 zhi1， yi4 kong3 zhi1 chou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 日有食之，亦孔之丑。
interpretations.explanation: 发生日食，也实在是大凶。

interpretations.segmentation: There was an eclipse of the sun—truly a great ill omen.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: bi3 yue4 er2 wei1， ci3 ri4 er2 wei1；

interpretations.segmentation: 彼月而微，此日而微；
interpretations.explanation: 那月曾微暗，这日又微暗；

interpretations.segmentation: That moon was dimmed; this sun too is dimmed;

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: jin1 ci3 xia4 min2， yi4 kong3 zhi1 ai1。

interpretations.segmentation: 今此下民，亦孔之哀。
interpretations.explanation: 如今这下的百姓，也实在可悲。

interpretations.segmentation: Now the people below are deeply pitiable.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: ri4 yue4 gao4 xiong1， bu4 yong4 qi2 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 日月告凶，不用其行。
interpretations.explanation: 日月预告凶险，不按常道运行。

interpretations.segmentation: Sun and moon announce disaster; they do not keep their proper course.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: si4 guo2 wu2 zheng4， bu4 yong4 qi2 liang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 四国无政，不用其良。
interpretations.explanation: 四方无善政，不用贤良。

interpretations.segmentation: The four quarters lack good government; the worthy are not used.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: bi3 yue4 er2 shi2， ze2 wei2 qi2 chang2；

interpretations.segmentation: 彼月而食，则维其常；
interpretations.explanation: 月食则是常事；

interpretations.segmentation: An eclipse of the moon is within the usual order;

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: ci3 ri4 er2 shi2， yu2 he2 bu4 zang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 此日而食，于何不臧。
interpretations.explanation: 日食发生，于何不吉？

interpretations.segmentation: An eclipse of the sun—how can it not be ill?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: ye4 ye4 zhen4 dian4， bu4 ning2 bu4 ling4。

interpretations.segmentation: 烨烨震电，不宁不令。
interpretations.explanation: 电光闪闪，不安不宁。

interpretations.segmentation: Lightning flashes—there is no peace, no order.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: bai3 chuan1 fei4 teng2， shan1 zhong3 zu2 beng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 百川沸腾，山冢崒崩。
interpretations.explanation: 百川沸腾，山巅崩塌。

interpretations.segmentation: All rivers seethe; mountain peaks crumble.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: gao1 an4 wei4 gu3， shen1 gu3 wei4 ling2。

interpretations.segmentation: 高岸为谷，深谷为陵。
interpretations.explanation: 高岸变成深谷，深谷变成山陵。

interpretations.segmentation: High banks become valleys; deep valleys become hills.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: ai1 jin1 zhi1 ren2， hu2 can3 mo4 cheng2？

interpretations.segmentation: 哀今之人，胡惨莫惩？
interpretations.explanation: 哀叹现在的人，为何惨而不戒？

interpretations.segmentation: Alas for people today—why such misery with no warning heeded?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.content: 皇父卿士，番维司徒，家伯维宰，仲允膳夫，棸子内史，蹶维趣马，楀维师氏。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: huang2 fu4 qing1 shi4， fan1 wei2 si1 tu2， jia1 bo2 wei2 zai3， zhong4 yun3 shan4 fu1， zou1 zi nei4 shi3， jue2 wei2 qu4 ma3， yu3 wei2 shi1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 皇父卿士，番维司徒，家伯维宰，仲允膳夫，棸子内史，蹶维趣马，楀维师氏。
interpretations.explanation: 皇父卿士、樊司徒、家伯宰、仲允膳夫、棸子内史、蹶趣马、楀师氏。

interpretations.segmentation: Huang Fu minister, Fan steward, Jia Bo chief, Zhong Yun cook, Zou steward, Jue master of horses, Yu commander of guards.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: ke1 qi1 shan1 fang1 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 醘妻煽方处。
interpretations.explanation: 褒姒煽动，正得其所。

interpretations.segmentation: Bao Si stirs trouble and holds sway.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: yi4 ci3 huang2 fu4， qi3 yue1 bu4 shi2？

interpretations.segmentation: 抑此皇父，岂曰不时？
interpretations.explanation: 责备这皇父，难道说不是时宜？

interpretations.segmentation: Blame this Huang Fu—is it not untimely?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: hu2 wei4 wo3 zuo4， bu4 ji2 wo3 mou2？

interpretations.segmentation: 胡为我作，不即我谋？
interpretations.explanation: 为何为我造此，不即与我商量？

interpretations.segmentation: Why do this to me without consulting me at once?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: che4 wo3 qiang2 wu1， tian2 zu2 wu1 lai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 彻我墙屋，田卒污莱。
interpretations.explanation: 拆我墙屋，田终至荒芜。

interpretations.segmentation: Tear down my walls and house; my fields end in waste and weeds.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: yue1 yu3 bu4 qiang1， li3 ze2 ran2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 曰予不戕，礼则然矣。
interpretations.explanation: 说不是残害，礼法本来如此。

interpretations.segmentation: He says it is not harm—the rites simply require it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: huang2 fu4 kong3 sheng4， zuo4 dou1 yu2 xiang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 皇父孔圣，作都于向。
interpretations.explanation: 皇父很圣明，在向地建都。

interpretations.segmentation: Huang Fu is very wise; he builds his capital at Xiang.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: ze2 san1 you3 shi4， dan3 hou2 duo1 cang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 择三有事，亶侯多藏。
interpretations.explanation: 选三个有职事的人，确实多藏财物。

interpretations.segmentation: He chooses three officials—truly they hoard much wealth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: bu4 yin4 yi2 yi1 lao3， bi3 shou3 wo3 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 不慭遗一老，俾守我王。
interpretations.explanation: 不肯留下一个老臣，让他守护我王。

interpretations.segmentation: He will not leave one old minister to guard our king.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: ze2 you3 che1 ma3， yi3 ju1 cu2 xiang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 择有车马，以居徂向。
interpretations.explanation: 选有车马的人，迁居到向地。

interpretations.segmentation: He picks those with chariots and horses to move to Xiang.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: min3 mian3 cong2 shi4， bu4 gan3 gao4 lao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 黾勉从事，不敢告劳。
interpretations.explanation: 勉力从事，不敢诉说自己辛劳。

interpretations.segmentation: I strive in service and dare not speak of my toil.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: wu2 zui4 wu2 gu1， chan2 kou3 xiao1 xiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 无罪无辜，谗口嚣嚣。
interpretations.explanation: 无罪无辜，谗口却喧哗。

interpretations.segmentation: Without guilt, without fault—yet slanderous mouths clamor.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: xia4 min2 zhi1 nie4， fei3 jiang4 zi4 tian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 下民之孽，匪降自天。
interpretations.explanation: 下民的灾祸，不是从天而降。

interpretations.segmentation: The common people's disaster does not fall from Heaven.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: zun3 da2 bei4 zeng1， zhi2 jing4 you2 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 噂沓背憎，职竞由人。
interpretations.explanation: 聚谈背地憎恶，争竞都出于人。

interpretations.segmentation: Gossip and secret hatred—striving comes from men.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: you1 you1 wo3 li3， yi4 kong3 zhi1 mei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 悠悠我里，亦孔之痗。
interpretations.explanation: 悠悠我里，也实在痛苦。

interpretations.segmentation: Far stretches my hamlet—I too am deeply pained.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: si4 fang1 you3 xian4， wo3 du2 ju1 you1。

interpretations.segmentation: 四方有羡，我独居忧。
interpretations.explanation: 四方有盈余，我独自忧愁。

interpretations.segmentation: The four quarters have plenty; I alone am full of care.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: min2 mo4 bu4 yi4， wo3 du2 bu4 gan3 xiu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民莫不逸，我独不敢休。
interpretations.explanation: 民莫不安逸，我独不敢休息。

interpretations.segmentation: No people but seek ease; I alone dare not rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.content: 天命不彻，我不敢效我友自逸。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.pinyin: tian1 ming4 bu4 che4， wo3 bu4 gan3 xiao4 wo3 you3 zi4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天命不彻，我不敢效我友自逸。
interpretations.explanation: 天命不可改，我不敢效法友人自逸。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven's mandate cannot be undone; I dare not imitate my friends in seeking ease.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: qi1 xi1 fei3 xi1， cheng2 shi4 bei4 jin3。

interpretations.segmentation: 萋兮斐兮，成是贝锦。
interpretations.explanation: 花纹纷繁错杂，竟织成漂亮的贝纹锦。比喻谗言者把无说成有，巧加粉饰。

interpretations.segmentation: The patterns are intricate and fine, woven into shell-pattern brocade—like slanderers dressing lies as truth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: bi3 zen4 ren2 zhe3， yi4 yi3 da4 shen4！

interpretations.segmentation: 彼谮人者，亦已大甚！
interpretations.explanation: 那些进谗言的人，实在太过分了！

interpretations.segmentation: Those who slander others have gone much too far!

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: duo1 xi1 chi3 xi1， cheng2 shi4 nan2 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 哆兮侈兮，成是南箕。
interpretations.explanation: 嘴张得又大又阔，竟像南箕星那样开口。比喻谗人张口便诬陷。

interpretations.segmentation: Their mouths gape wide, like the southern Dipper—always open to accuse.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: bi3 zen4 ren2 zhe3， shui2 shi4 yu3 mou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼谮人者，谁适与谋。
interpretations.explanation: 那些进谗言的人，究竟和谁一起谋划？

interpretations.segmentation: Those slanderers—who is plotting with them?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: ji1 ji1 pian1 pian1， mou2 yu4 zen4 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 缉缉翩翩，谋欲谮人。
interpretations.explanation: 他们窃窃私语、轻佻往来，一心想陷害别人。

interpretations.segmentation: They whisper and flit about, scheming to slander others.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: shen4 er3 yan2 ye3， wei4 er3 bu4 xin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 慎尔言也，谓尔不信。
interpretations.explanation: 你说话再谨慎，他们仍会说你不可信。

interpretations.segmentation: Be ever so careful in what you say—they will still call you untrustworthy.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: jie2 jie2 fan1 fan1， mou2 yu4 zen4 yan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 捷捷幡幡，谋欲谮言。
interpretations.explanation: 他们花言巧语、反复无常，专谋诬陷之言。

interpretations.segmentation: Quick-tongued and fickle, they plot deceitful accusations.
岂不尔受？
interpretations.explanation: 难道你不曾领受过谗言的害处？

interpretations.segmentation: Have you not yourself suffered from such slander?
既其女迁。
interpretations.explanation: 谗言既已加在你身，使你遭祸迁谪。

interpretations.segmentation: Once slander reaches you, you are ruined and cast aside.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: jiao1 ren2 hao3 hao3， lao2 ren2 cao3 cao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 骄人好好，劳人草草。
interpretations.explanation: 骄人得意安乐，劳人却困苦憔悴。

interpretations.segmentation: The arrogant live at ease; those who toil are worn and wretched.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.content: 苍天苍天，视彼骄人，矜此劳人。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: cang1 tian1 cang1 tian1， shi4 bi3 jiao1 ren2， jin1 ci3 lao2 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 苍天苍天，视彼骄人，矜此劳人。
interpretations.explanation: 苍天啊苍天，请看那些骄人，怜悯这些劳人吧！

interpretations.segmentation: O Heaven, look upon the proud and pity those who labor!

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: bi3 zen4 ren2 zhe3， shui2 shi4 yu3 mou2？

interpretations.segmentation: 彼谮人者，谁适与谋？
interpretations.explanation: 那些进谗言的人，究竟和谁一起谋划？

interpretations.segmentation: Those slanderers—who joins them in their plots?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: qu3 bi3 zen4 ren2， tou2 bi4 chai2 hu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 取彼谮人，投畀豺虎。
interpretations.explanation: 捉住那个进谗的人，扔给豺狼虎豹。

interpretations.segmentation: Seize the slanderer and throw him to wolves and tigers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: chai2 hu3 bu4 shi2， tou2 bi4 you3 bei3。

interpretations.segmentation: 豺虎不食，投畀有北。
interpretations.explanation: 豺虎都不吃他，再把他扔到北方荒远之地。

interpretations.segmentation: If the beasts will not eat him, cast him to the bleak north.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: you3 bei3 bu4 shou4， tou2 bi4 you3 hao4！

interpretations.segmentation: 有北不受，投畀有昊！
interpretations.explanation: 北方也不收留，那就交给苍天去处置！

interpretations.segmentation: If the north rejects him, hand him over to great Heaven!

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: yang2 yuan2 zhi1 dao4， yi1 yu2 mu3 qiu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 杨园之道，猗于亩丘。
interpretations.explanation: 通往杨园的路，旁依着亩丘。

interpretations.segmentation: The road to Yang Garden runs beside the mound of Mu.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: si4 ren2 meng4 zi， zuo4 wei4 ci3 shi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 寺人孟子，作为此诗。
interpretations.explanation: 宦官孟子，作了这首诗。

interpretations.segmentation: Mengzi the palace steward composed this poem.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo.pinyin: fan2 bai3 jun1 zi， jing4 er2 ting1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 凡百君子，敬而听之。
interpretations.explanation: 各位君子，请恭敬地听一听吧。

interpretations.segmentation: All you gentlemen, listen to it with respect.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: bian4 bi3 xue2 si1， gui1 fei1 ti2 ti2。

interpretations.segmentation: 弁彼鸴斯，归飞提提。
interpretations.explanation: 群栖的鹪鹩，结伴飞回，缓缓而行。

interpretations.segmentation: The flocking wrens fly homeward together, gently and slowly.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: min2 mo4 bu4 gu3， wo3 du2 yu2 li2。

interpretations.segmentation: 民莫不穀，我独于罹。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓无不安乐，唯独我遭受祸患。

interpretations.segmentation: All the people are at ease; I alone suffer misfortune.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: he2 gu1 yu2 tian1？

interpretations.segmentation: 何辜于天？
interpretations.explanation: 我对天有什么罪过？

interpretations.segmentation: What crime have I committed against Heaven?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: wo3 zui4 yi1 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 我罪伊何？
interpretations.explanation: 我的罪又是什么呢？

interpretations.segmentation: What is my fault?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， yun2 ru2 zhi1 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，云如之何？
interpretations.explanation: 心中忧愁，不知该怎么办才好。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart is full of grief—what can I do?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: cu4 cu4 zhou1 dao4， ju1 wei4 mao4 cao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 踧踧周道，鞫为茂草。
interpretations.explanation: 平坦的周道，竟被长草遮没。

interpretations.segmentation: The smooth Zhou highway has been choked with rank grass.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: wo3 xin1 you1 shang1， ni4 yan1 ru2 dao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我心忧伤，惄焉如捣。
interpretations.explanation: 我心忧伤，像被反复捶打一样痛苦。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart aches as if it were pounded in a mortar.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: jia3 mei4 yong3 tan4， wei2 you1 yong4 lao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 假寐永叹，维忧用老。
interpretations.explanation: 和衣而卧长叹，只因忧愁而早老。

interpretations.segmentation: I lie awake sighing; sorrow alone has aged me.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， chen4 ru2 ji2 shou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，疢如疾首。
interpretations.explanation: 心头的忧思，像头痛欲裂一般。

interpretations.segmentation: The grief in my heart burns like a splitting headache.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: wei2 sang1 yu3 zi3， bi4 gong1 jing4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 维桑与梓，必恭敬止。
interpretations.explanation: 看到桑树和梓树，必当恭敬对待；比喻父母所居之地不可轻慢。

interpretations.segmentation: Seeing mulberry and catalpa, one must treat them with reverence—as one should one's parents' home.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: mi2 zhan1 fei3 fu4， mi2 yi1 fei3 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 靡瞻匪父，靡依匪母。
interpretations.explanation: 没有父亲就无所瞻仰，没有母亲就无所依傍。

interpretations.segmentation: Without a father I have none to look up to; without a mother none to lean on.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: bu4 shu3 yu2 mao2？

interpretations.segmentation: 不属于毛？
interpretations.explanation: 我不是父母的骨肉吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Am I not flesh and bone of my parents?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: bu4 li2 yu2 li3？

interpretations.segmentation: 不罹于里？
interpretations.explanation: 我不该遭受乡里这样的灾祸吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Should I not have fallen into such trouble at home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 sheng1 wo3， wo3 chen2 an1 zai4？

interpretations.segmentation: 天之生我，我辰安在？
interpretations.explanation: 老天生了我，我的好命在哪里？

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven gave me life—where is my good fortune?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.content: 菀彼柳斯，鸣蜩嘒嘒，有漼者渊，萑苇淠淠。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: wan3 bi3 liu3 si1， ming2 tiao2 hui4 hui4， you3 cui3 zhe3 yuan1， huan2 wei3 pi4 pi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 菀彼柳斯，鸣蜩嘒嘒，有漼者渊，萑苇淠淠。
interpretations.explanation: 茂盛的柳树上蝉鸣嘒嘒，深潭水波涌涌，芦苇密密。

interpretations.segmentation: On lush willows cicadas chirp; deep pools surge; reeds stand thick.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.content: 譬彼舟流，不知所届，心之忧矣，不遑假寐。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: pi4 bi3 zhou1 liu2， bu4 zhi1 suo3 jie4， xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， bu4 huang2 jia3 mei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 譬彼舟流，不知所届，心之忧矣，不遑假寐。
interpretations.explanation: 好比小舟漂流，不知漂到何处；心忧难眠，无暇安睡。

interpretations.segmentation: Like a boat adrift with no shore in sight, I am too troubled to rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: lu4 si1 zhi1 ben1， wei2 zu2 ji4 ji4。

interpretations.segmentation: 鹿斯之奔，维足伎伎。
interpretations.explanation: 鹿群奔跑，四蹄轻快。

interpretations.segmentation: The deer run swiftly, their hooves light and quick.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: zhi4 zhi1 chao2 gou4， shang4 qiu2 qi2 ci2。

interpretations.segmentation: 雉之朝雊，尚求其雌。
interpretations.explanation: 雄雉清晨鸣叫，还在寻找雌伴。

interpretations.segmentation: The cock pheasant crows at dawn, still seeking its mate.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: pi4 bi3 huai4 mu4， ji2 yong4 wu2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 譬彼坏木，疾用无枝。
interpretations.explanation: 好比枯坏的树木，很快便无枝可依。

interpretations.segmentation: Like a dying tree that soon has no branches left.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， ning2 mo4 zhi1 zhi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，宁莫之知？
interpretations.explanation: 心中忧愁，难道就没有人知道吗？

interpretations.segmentation: My heart grieves—does no one understand?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: xiang1 bi3 tou2 tu4， shang4 huo4 xian1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 相彼投兔，尚或先之。
interpretations.explanation: 看那逃入网中的野兔，尚且有人先放它一马。

interpretations.segmentation: Even a rabbit caught in a snare may find someone to free it first.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: xing2 you3 si3 ren2， shang4 huo4 jin4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 行有死人，尚或墐之。
interpretations.explanation: 路上若有死者，尚且有人掩埋。

interpretations.segmentation: If a dead man lies on the road, someone may still cover him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: jun1 zi bing3 xin1， wei2 qi2 ren3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子秉心，维其忍之。
interpretations.explanation: 君子本有仁心，却竟如此忍心。

interpretations.segmentation: A gentleman at heart—how could he be so cruel?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， ti4 ji4 yun3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，涕既陨之。
interpretations.explanation: 心中忧愁，眼泪已经落下。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart is heavy; tears have already fallen.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: jun1 zi xin4 chan2， ru2 huo4 chou2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子信谗，如或酬之。
interpretations.explanation: 君子听信谗言，就像有人向他敬酒一样欣然接受。

interpretations.segmentation: The lord believes slander as readily as he accepts a cup of wine.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: jun1 zi bu4 hui4， bu4 shu1 jiu1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子不惠，不舒究之。
interpretations.explanation: 君子不施恩惠，也不从容查究实情。

interpretations.segmentation: He shows no kindness and will not calmly investigate the truth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: fa2 mu4 ji3 yi3， xi1 xin1 tuo1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 伐木掎矣，析薪扡矣。
interpretations.explanation: 砍伐树木已就绪，劈柴也准备好了。

interpretations.segmentation: The tree is felled and ready; the firewood is split and prepared.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: she3 bi3 you3 zui4， yu3 zhi1 tuo2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 舍彼有罪，予之佗矣。
interpretations.explanation: 放过有罪的人，把灾祸加在我头上。

interpretations.segmentation: They spare the guilty and heap the blame on me.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: mo4 gao1 fei3 shan1， mo4 jun4 fei3 quan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 莫高匪山，莫浚匪泉。
interpretations.explanation: 没有不高的山，没有不深的泉；比喻秘密终难久藏。

interpretations.segmentation: No mountain is not high; no spring is not deep—secrets cannot stay hidden forever.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.content: 君子无易由言，耳属于垣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: jun1 zi wu2 yi4 you2 yan2， er3 shu3 yu2 yuan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子无易由言，耳属于垣。
interpretations.explanation: 君子不可轻率说话，隔墙有耳。

interpretations.segmentation: A gentleman must not speak rashly—ears are at the wall.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: wu2 shi4 wo3 liang2， wu2 fa1 wo3 gou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 无逝我梁，无发我笱。
interpretations.explanation: 不要动我的鱼梁，不要打开我的鱼笼。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not touch my fish dam; do not open my fish trap.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian.pinyin: wo3 gong1 bu4 yue4， huang2 xu4 wo3 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我躬不阅，遑恤我后。
interpretations.explanation: 我自己尚且难保，哪还顾得上身后的人。

interpretations.segmentation: I cannot even save myself—how can I care for those who come after?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: min2 tian1 ji2 wei1， fu1 yu2 xia4 tu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 旻天疾威，敷于下土。
interpretations.explanation: 苍天降下严厉之威，遍施于天下。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven's wrath is severe and spreads over all the land.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: mou2 you2 hui2 yu4， he2 ri4 si1 ju3？

interpretations.segmentation: 谋犹回遹，何日斯沮？
interpretations.explanation: 谋划邪僻不正，何时才能止息？

interpretations.segmentation: Counsel is crooked and perverse—when will it cease?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: mou2 zang1 bu4 cong2， bu4 zang1 fu4 yong4。

interpretations.segmentation: 谋臧不从，不臧覆用。
interpretations.explanation: 好主意不采纳，坏主意反而照办。

interpretations.segmentation: Good plans are rejected; bad ones are followed instead.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: wo3 shi4 mou2 you2， yi4 kong3 zhi1 qiong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我视谋犹，亦孔之邛。
interpretations.explanation: 我看那些谋划，也实在太坏。

interpretations.segmentation: I look at their counsel—it is utterly wretched.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: xi1 xi1 zi3 zi3， yi4 kong3 zhi1 ai1。

interpretations.segmentation: 潝潝訿訿，亦孔之哀。
interpretations.explanation: 众人附和争吵，也实在可悲。

interpretations.segmentation: They buzz and wrangle together—a pitiful sight.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: mou2 zhi1 qi2 zang1， ze2 ju4 shi4 wei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 谋之其臧，则具是违。
interpretations.explanation: 谋划若是好的，就一齐违背它。

interpretations.segmentation: When the plan is good, they all oppose it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: mou2 zhi1 bu4 zang1， ze2 ju4 shi4 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 谋之不臧，则具是依。
interpretations.explanation: 谋划若是不好的，就一齐依从它。

interpretations.segmentation: When the plan is bad, they all cling to it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: wo3 shi4 mou2 you2， yi1 yu2 hu2 di3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我视谋犹，伊于胡厎。
interpretations.explanation: 我看那些谋划，究竟要落到什么地步？

interpretations.segmentation: I watch their counsel—where will it end?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: wo3 gui1 ji4 yan4， bu4 wo3 gao4 you2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我龟既厌，不我告犹。
interpretations.explanation: 龟卜已多次占问，不再给我们指示。

interpretations.segmentation: The tortoise has been questioned again and again—it no longer gives us guidance.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: mou2 fu1 kong3 duo1， shi4 yong4 bu4 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 谋夫孔多，是用不集。
interpretations.explanation: 谋臣虽多，因此反而不能成事。

interpretations.segmentation: Though advisers are many, nothing gets done.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: fa1 yan2 ying2 ting2， shui2 gan3 zhi2 qi2 jiu4？

interpretations.segmentation: 发言盈庭，谁敢执其咎？
interpretations.explanation: 朝堂上发言的人满座，谁敢承担过失？

interpretations.segmentation: The court is full of talkers—who dares take responsibility?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.content: 如匪行迈谋，是用不得于道。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: ru2 fei3 xing2 mai4 mou2， shi4 yong4 bu4 de2 yu2 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 如匪行迈谋，是用不得于道。
interpretations.explanation: 好比行路不自己拿主意，因此走不到正道上。

interpretations.segmentation: Like travelers who let others choose the road—they never reach their goal.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.content: 哀哉为犹，匪先民是程，匪大犹是经。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: ai1 zai1 wei4 you2， fei3 xian1 min2 shi4 cheng2， fei3 da4 you2 shi4 jing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 哀哉为犹，匪先民是程，匪大犹是经。
interpretations.explanation: 可悲啊这些谋划，不以古人为榜样，不以大道为准则。

interpretations.segmentation: Alas for such counsel—it follows neither the ancients nor the great Way.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.content: 维迩言是听，维迩言是争。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: wei2 er3 yan2 shi4 ting1， wei2 er3 yan2 shi4 zheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 维迩言是听，维迩言是争。
interpretations.explanation: 只听从浅近之言，只在浅近之言上争执。

interpretations.segmentation: They heed only shallow words and quarrel over shallow words.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.content: 如彼筑室于道谋，是用不溃于成。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: ru2 bi3 zhu4 shi4 yu2 dao4 mou2， shi4 yong4 bu4 kui4 yu2 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 如彼筑室于道谋，是用不溃于成。
interpretations.explanation: 好比在道路上问人盖房，因此房子永远建不成。

interpretations.segmentation: Like building a house by asking passersby on the road—it will never be finished.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: guo2 sui1 mi2 zhi3， huo4 sheng4 huo4 fou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 国虽靡止，或圣或否。
interpretations.explanation: 国家虽不算大，也有圣人也有非圣人。

interpretations.segmentation: Though the state is not vast, some are sage and some are not.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.content: 民虽靡膴，或哲或谋，或肃或艾。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: min2 sui1 mi2 hu1， huo4 zhe2 huo4 mou2， huo4 su4 huo4 ai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 民虽靡膴，或哲或谋，或肃或艾。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓虽不算多，也有哲人、谋士、肃敬者与长者。

interpretations.segmentation: Though the people are not countless, some are wise, some plan, some are reverent, some are elders.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: ru2 bi3 quan2 liu2， wu2 lun2 xu1 yi3 bai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 如彼泉流，无沦胥以败。
interpretations.explanation: 好比泉水流淌，不要一起沉沦而败亡。

interpretations.segmentation: Like a spring flowing on—do not all sink together in ruin.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: bu4 gan3 bao4 hu3， bu4 gan3 feng2 he2。

interpretations.segmentation: 不敢暴虎，不敢冯河。
interpretations.explanation: 不敢空手打虎，不敢徒步渡河。

interpretations.segmentation: I dare not wrestle a tiger bare-handed or wade a river alone.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 qi2 yi1， mo4 zhi1 qi2 ta1。

interpretations.segmentation: 人知其一，莫知其他。
interpretations.explanation: 人们只知其一，不知其它。

interpretations.segmentation: People know one thing but not the rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.content: 战战兢兢，如临深渊，如履薄冰。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin.pinyin: zhan4 zhan4 jing1 jing1， ru2 lin2 shen1 yuan1， ru2 lv3 bao2 bing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 战战兢兢，如临深渊，如履薄冰。
interpretations.explanation: 战战兢兢，像站在深渊边，像踩在薄冰上。

interpretations.segmentation: Trembling with fear, as if over a deep abyss, as if on thin ice.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: wan3 bi3 ming2 jiu1， han4 fei1 li4 tian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 宛彼鸣鸠，翰飞戾天。
interpretations.explanation: 那小小的斑鸠，展翅高飞直到天际。

interpretations.segmentation: The small turtle-dove spreads its wings and soars to the sky.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: wo3 xin1 you1 shang1， nian4 xi1 xian1 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我心忧伤，念昔先人。
interpretations.explanation: 我心忧伤，思念已故的先人。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart grieves as I remember my departed forebears.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: ming2 fa1 bu4 mei4， you3 huai2 er4 ren2。

interpretations.segmentation: 明发不寐，有怀二人。
interpretations.explanation: 天刚亮就睡不着，心中怀念父母二人。

interpretations.segmentation: At dawn I cannot sleep; my thoughts are with my father and mother.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 qi2 sheng4， yin3 jiu3 wen1 ke4。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之齐圣，饮酒温克。
interpretations.explanation: 人若聪明圣达，饮酒也能温克自持。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who are wise and clear-minded can drink yet remain temperate.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: bi3 hun1 bu4 zhi1， yi1 zui4 ri4 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼昏不知，一醉日富。
interpretations.explanation: 那些昏昧的人不知节制，一醉就自以为富有。

interpretations.segmentation: The foolish know no restraint; drunk, they think themselves rich.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: ge4 jing4 er3 yi2， tian1 ming4 bu4 you4。

interpretations.segmentation: 各敬尔仪，天命不又。
interpretations.explanation: 各自敬守你们的威仪，天命不会一再降临。

interpretations.segmentation: Each keep your proper conduct—Heaven's favor does not come twice.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: zhong1 yuan2 you3 shu1， shu4 min2 cai3 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 中原有菽，庶民采之。
interpretations.explanation: 原野上长着大豆，百姓去采摘它。

interpretations.segmentation: In the plain grows the bean; the common people gather it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: ming2 ling2 you3 zi， guo3 luo3 fu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 螟蛉有子，蜾蠃负之。
interpretations.explanation: 螟蛉有子，蜾蠃把它背走，当作自己的幼虫来养。

interpretations.segmentation: The hornworm has offspring; the wasp carries them off to raise as its own.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: jiao4 hui4 er3 zi， shi4 gu3 shi4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 教诲尔子，式穀似之。
interpretations.explanation: 教导你的儿子，愿他善良有似先人。

interpretations.segmentation: Teach your sons—may they be good like their forebears.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: ti2 bi3 ji2 ling4， zai4 fei1 zai4 ming2。

interpretations.segmentation: 题彼脊令，载飞载鸣。
interpretations.explanation: 看那脊令鸟，一边飞一边鸣叫。

interpretations.segmentation: Look at the wagtail—flying and calling as it goes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: wo3 ri4 si1 mai4， er2 yue4 si1 zheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我日斯迈，而月斯征。
interpretations.explanation: 我日日远行，而岁月也在流逝。

interpretations.segmentation: Each day I journey on, and the months slip away.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: su4 xing1 ye4 mei4， wu2 tian3 er3 suo3 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 夙兴夜寐，毋忝尔所生。
interpretations.explanation: 早起晚睡，不要辱没生养你的父母。

interpretations.segmentation: Rise early and sleep late—do not disgrace those who bore you.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: jiao1 jiao1 sang1 hu4， lv4 chang3 zhuo2 su4。

interpretations.segmentation: 交交桑扈，率场啄粟。
interpretations.explanation: 交交的桑扈鸟，在谷场上啄食粟米。

interpretations.segmentation: The chattering orioles peck millet on the threshing ground.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: ai1 wo3 tian2 gua3， yi2 an4 yi2 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 哀我填寡，宜岸宜狱。
interpretations.explanation: 可怜我这鳏寡之人，只宜入狱受审。

interpretations.segmentation: Pity me, widowed and alone—fit only for prison and trial.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: wo4 su4 chu1 bo， zi4 he2 neng2 gu3？

interpretations.segmentation: 握粟出卜，自何能穀？
interpretations.explanation: 握着粟米去占卜，从何处能得安乐？

interpretations.segmentation: Clutching millet to divinate—whence can I find peace?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: wen1 wen1 gong1 ren2， ru2 ji2 yu2 mu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 温温恭人，如集于木。
interpretations.explanation: 温和恭谨的人，像站在高木上一样不稳。

interpretations.segmentation: The gentle and respectful man is like one perched on a tall tree.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: zhui4 zhui4 xiao3 xin1， ru2 lin2 yu2 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 惴惴小心，如临于谷。
interpretations.explanation: 小心翼翼，像站在深谷边缘。

interpretations.segmentation: Cautious and fearful, as if standing at the edge of a ravine.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan.pinyin: zhan4 zhan4 jing1 jing1， ru2 lv3 bao2 bing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 战战兢兢，如履薄冰。
interpretations.explanation: 战战兢兢，像踩在薄冰上。

interpretations.segmentation: Trembling, as if walking on thin ice.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: hao4 hao4 hao4 tian1， bu4 jun4 qi2 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 浩浩昊天，不骏其德。
interpretations.explanation: 浩大的苍天，不再保持它的恩德。

interpretations.segmentation: Vast Heaven no longer keeps its virtue.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: jiang4 sang4 ji1 jin3， zhan3 fa2 si4 guo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 降丧饥馑，斩伐四国。
interpretations.explanation: 降下丧乱饥荒，摧残四方各国。

interpretations.segmentation: It sends death, disorder, and famine, cutting down the four quarters.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: min2 tian1 ji2 wei1， fu2 lv4 fu2 tu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 旻天疾威，弗虑弗图。
interpretations.explanation: 苍天威怒已甚，却不加思虑谋划。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven's wrath is fierce, yet none consider or plan aright.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: she3 bi3 you3 zui4， ji4 fu2 qi2 gu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 舍彼有罪，既伏其辜。
interpretations.explanation: 放过有罪的人，他们已伏其罪。

interpretations.segmentation: The guilty are spared though their crimes are known.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: ruo4 ci3 wu2 zui4， lun2 xu1 yi3 pu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 若此无罪，沦胥以铺。
interpretations.explanation: 像这样无罪的人，却一齐沦亡受害。

interpretations.segmentation: Yet the innocent like me are ruined together.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: zhou1 zong1 ji4 mie4， mi2 suo3 zhi3 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 周宗既灭，靡所止戾。
interpretations.explanation: 周王室既已衰微，无处可以安身。

interpretations.segmentation: The Zhou house has declined; there is nowhere to settle.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: zheng4 da4 fu1 li2 ju1， mo4 zhi1 wo3 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 正大夫离居，莫知我勚。
interpretations.explanation: 正大夫流离在外，无人知我勤苦。

interpretations.segmentation: Chief ministers live in exile; none knows my toil.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: san1 shi4 da4 fu1， mo4 ken3 su4 ye4。

interpretations.segmentation: 三事大夫，莫肯夙夜。
interpretations.explanation: 三公大夫们，都不肯早起夜以继日。

interpretations.segmentation: The high ministers will not rise early or work late.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: bang1 jun1 zhu1 hou2， mo4 ken3 chao2 xi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 邦君诸侯，莫肯朝夕。
interpretations.explanation: 各国诸侯，都不肯朝夕尽忠。

interpretations.segmentation: The feudal lords will not serve morning and evening.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: shu4 yue1 shi4 zang1， fu4 chu1 wei4 e4。

interpretations.segmentation: 庶曰式臧，覆出为恶。
interpretations.explanation: 本说要做善事，反而做出恶行。

interpretations.segmentation: They say they will do good, yet act wickedly instead.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: ru2 he2 hao4 tian1， pi4 yan2 bu4 xin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 如何昊天，辟言不信。
interpretations.explanation: 苍天哪，正直的话却不被相信。

interpretations.segmentation: O Heaven—honest words are not believed.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: ru2 bi3 xing2 mai4， ze2 mi2 suo3 zhen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 如彼行迈，则靡所臻。
interpretations.explanation: 好比在路上行走，却到不了目的地。

interpretations.segmentation: Like walking on a road yet never arriving anywhere.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: fan2 bai3 jun1 zi， ge4 jing4 er3 shen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 凡百君子，各敬尔身。
interpretations.explanation: 各位君子，各自敬慎修身吧。

interpretations.segmentation: All you gentlemen, each guard your own conduct.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: hu2 bu4 xiang1 wei4， bu4 wei4 yu2 tian1？

interpretations.segmentation: 胡不相畏，不畏于天？
interpretations.explanation: 为何不彼此敬畏，难道不怕上天？

interpretations.segmentation: Why do you not fear one another—do you not fear Heaven?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: rong2 cheng2 bu4 tui4， ji1 cheng2 bu4 sui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 戎成不退，饥成不遂。
interpretations.explanation: 战事既成却不能退，饥荒既成却不能救。

interpretations.segmentation: War ends in no retreat; famine ends in no relief.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: ceng2 wo3 xie4 yu4， can3 can3 ri4 cui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 曾我暬御，惨惨日瘁。
interpretations.explanation: 曾是我亲近侍奉的人，如今日益憔悴。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who once served me closely now waste away daily.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: fan2 bai3 jun1 zi， mo4 ken3 yong4 xun4。

interpretations.segmentation: 凡百君子，莫肯用讯。
interpretations.explanation: 各位君子，都不肯来询问实情。

interpretations.segmentation: All you gentlemen refuse to inquire into the truth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: ting1 yan2 ze2 da2， zen4 yan2 ze2 tui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 听言则答，谮言则退。
interpretations.explanation: 听顺耳的话就应答，听谗言就退避。

interpretations.segmentation: Flattery wins an answer; slander sends one away.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.content: 哀哉不能言，匪舌是出，维躬是瘁。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: ai1 zai1 bu4 neng2 yan2， fei3 she2 shi4 chu1， wei2 gong1 shi4 cui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 哀哉不能言，匪舌是出，维躬是瘁。
interpretations.explanation: 可悲啊不能言善的人，不是舌头说不出，而是自身受摧残。

interpretations.segmentation: Pity those who cannot speak well—not the tongue fails, but the body is broken.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.content: 哿矣能言，巧言如流，俾躬处休！
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: ge3 yi3 neng2 yan2， qiao3 yan2 ru2 liu2， bi3 gong1 chu4 xiu1！

interpretations.segmentation: 哿矣能言，巧言如流，俾躬处休！
interpretations.explanation: 善于进言的人真快乐，巧言如流水，使自己居安享福！

interpretations.segmentation: How fine for the glib—smooth words flow and they live at ease!

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: wei2 yue1 yu3 shi4， kong3 ji2 qie3 dai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 维曰予仕，孔棘且殆。
interpretations.explanation: 虽说要出来做官，实在急迫又危险。

interpretations.segmentation: They say take office—but it is urgent and perilous.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: yun2 bu4 he2 shi3， de2 zui4 yu2 tian1 zi；

interpretations.segmentation: 云不何使，得罪于天子；
interpretations.explanation: 说不可出仕，会得罪天子；

interpretations.segmentation: Say you must not serve—you offend the Son of Heaven;

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: yi4 yun2 ke3 shi3， yuan4 ji2 peng2 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 亦云可使，怨及朋友。
interpretations.explanation: 说可以出仕，又会招朋友怨恨。

interpretations.segmentation: Say you may serve—you earn your friends' resentment.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: wei4 er3 qian1 yu2 wang2 dou1。

interpretations.segmentation: 谓尔迁于王都。
interpretations.explanation: 有人劝你迁回王都。

interpretations.segmentation: Someone urges you to move back to the royal capital.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: yue1 yu3 wei4 you3 shi4 jia1。

interpretations.segmentation: 曰予未有室家。
interpretations.explanation: 你却说还没有家室。

interpretations.segmentation: You reply that you still have no home.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: shu3 si1 qi4 xue4， wu2 yan2 bu4 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鼠思泣血，无言不疾。
interpretations.explanation: 鼠思泣血，没有一句话不痛心。

interpretations.segmentation: Grief like a mouse weeping blood—every word cuts to the heart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.pinyin: xi1 er3 chu1 ju1， shui2 cong2 zuo4 er3 shi4？

interpretations.segmentation: 昔尔出居，谁从作尔室？
interpretations.explanation: 当初你离开旧居，是谁给你盖的这所房子？

interpretations.segmentation: When you left your old home, who built this house for you?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: zheng4 yue4 fan2 shuang1， wo3 xin1 you1 shang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 正月繁霜，我心忧伤。
interpretations.explanation: 正月里霜雪繁密，我心忧伤。

interpretations.segmentation: In the first month frost is heavy; my heart is grieved.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: min2 zhi1 e2 yan2， yi4 kong3 zhi1 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之讹言，亦孔之将。
interpretations.explanation: 民间的谣言，也实在太盛了。

interpretations.segmentation: The people's false rumors grow ever louder.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: nian4 wo3 du2 xi1， you1 xin1 jing1 jing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 念我独兮，忧心京京。
interpretations.explanation: 想到我独处不幸，忧愁满溢心头。

interpretations.segmentation: Thinking how alone I am in misfortune, my sorrow overflows.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: ai1 wo3 xiao3 xin1， shu3 you1 yi3 yang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 哀我小心，癙忧以痒。
interpretations.explanation: 可怜我小心谨守，忧思成疾如痒。

interpretations.segmentation: Pity my careful heart—worry has become a disease like itching pain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: fu4 mu3 sheng1 wo3， hu2 bi3 wo3 yu4？

interpretations.segmentation: 父母生我，胡俾我瘉？
interpretations.explanation: 父母生了我，为何让我这样受害？

interpretations.segmentation: My parents bore me—why did they leave me to suffer so?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: bu4 zi4 wo3 xian1， bu4 zi4 wo3 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不自我先，不自我后。
interpretations.explanation: 不是在我之前，也不是在我之后（偏偏轮到我）。

interpretations.segmentation: Not before my time, not after—yet it fell on me alone.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: hao3 yan2 zi4 kou3， you3 yan2 zi4 kou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 好言自口，莠言自口。
interpretations.explanation: 好话坏话都从自己口中说出。

interpretations.segmentation: Fine words and foul words alike come from one's own mouth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: you1 xin1 yu4 yu4， shi4 yi3 you3 wu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 忧心愈愈，是以有侮。
interpretations.explanation: 忧愁愈积愈深，因此遭人欺侮。

interpretations.segmentation: Grief grows ever deeper—therefore I am insulted.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: you1 xin1 qiong2 qiong2， nian4 wo3 wu2 lu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 忧心惸惸，念我无禄。
interpretations.explanation: 忧愁孤独，想到自己没有福分。

interpretations.segmentation: Lonely in sorrow, I think how luckless I am.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: min2 zhi1 wu2 gu1， bing4 qi2 chen2 pu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之无辜，并其臣仆。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓本无罪，却连臣仆也一并受害。

interpretations.segmentation: The people are guiltless, yet servants suffer with them.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: ai1 wo3 ren2 si1， yu2 he2 cong2 lu4？

interpretations.segmentation: 哀我人斯，于何从禄？
interpretations.explanation: 可怜我们这些人，从哪里还能得福？

interpretations.segmentation: Pity us—where can we still find blessing?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: zhan1 wu1 yuan2 zhi3？

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻乌爰止？
interpretations.explanation: 看那乌鸦停在哪里？

interpretations.segmentation: Look—where do the crows perch?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: yu2 shui2 zhi1 wu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 于谁之屋？
interpretations.explanation: 是在谁家的屋顶？

interpretations.segmentation: On whose rooftop do they rest?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: zhan1 bi3 zhong1 lin2， hou2 xin1 hou2 zheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻彼中林，侯薪侯蒸。
interpretations.explanation: 看那树林中间，有的当柴有的当薪。

interpretations.segmentation: In the midst of the woods, some trees are fuel, some firewood.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: min2 jin1 fang1 dai4， shi4 tian1 meng4 meng4。

interpretations.segmentation: 民今方殆，视天梦梦。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓正处危殆，看上天却昏昧不明。

interpretations.segmentation: The people are in peril, yet Heaven seems dim and unaware.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: ji4 ke4 you3 ding4， mi2 ren2 fu2 sheng4。

interpretations.segmentation: 既克有定，靡人弗胜。
interpretations.explanation: 既然已经有了定数，就没有人不胜任（却无人担当）。

interpretations.segmentation: Since fate is fixed, none should fail—yet none takes charge.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: you3 huang2 shang4 di4， yi1 shui2 yun2 zeng1？

interpretations.segmentation: 有皇上帝，伊谁云憎？
interpretations.explanation: 伟大的上帝，究竟憎恶谁呢？

interpretations.segmentation: Great God—whom do You truly hate?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: wei4 shan1 gai4 bei1， wei4 gang1 wei4 ling2。

interpretations.segmentation: 谓山盖卑，为冈为陵。
interpretations.explanation: 说山本来低矮，却变成了冈陵。

interpretations.segmentation: They say mountains are low, yet hills and peaks appear.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: min2 zhi1 e2 yan2， ning2 mo4 zhi1 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之讹言，宁莫之惩。
interpretations.explanation: 民间的谣言，难道没有人加以惩戒？

interpretations.segmentation: The people's rumors—will no one punish them?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: zhao4 bi3 gu4 lao3， xun4 zhi1 zhan4 meng4。

interpretations.segmentation: 召彼故老，讯之占梦。
interpretations.explanation: 召来那些老臣，询问占梦的结果。

interpretations.segmentation: Summon the old counselors and ask what the dreams foretell.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.content: 具曰予圣，谁知乌之雌雄！
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: ju4 yue1 yu3 sheng4， shui2 zhi1 wu1 zhi1 ci2 xiong2！

interpretations.segmentation: 具曰予圣，谁知乌之雌雄！
interpretations.explanation: 都说自己是圣人，谁能分辨乌鸦雌雄！

interpretations.segmentation: Each claims to be a sage—who can tell male crow from female!

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: wei4 tian1 gai4 gao1， bu4 gan3 bu4 ju2。

interpretations.segmentation: 谓天盖高，不敢不局。
interpretations.explanation: 说天本来很高，不敢不弯腰屈身。

interpretations.segmentation: They say Heaven is high—I dare not but bow low.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: wei4 di4 gai4 hou4， bu4 gan3 bu4 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 谓地盖厚，不敢不蹐。
interpretations.explanation: 说地本来很厚，不敢不碎步小心。

interpretations.segmentation: They say Earth is thick—I dare not but tread mincingly.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: wei2 hao4 si1 yan2， you3 lun2 you3 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 维号斯言，有伦有脊。
interpretations.explanation: 我呼号这些言论，有理有骨（却无人听）。

interpretations.segmentation: I cry out these words—they have reason and backbone.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: ai1 jin1 zhi1 ren2， hu2 wei4 hui1 yi4？

interpretations.segmentation: 哀今之人，胡为虺蜴？
interpretations.explanation: 可悲啊当今的人，为何心如毒蛇？

interpretations.segmentation: Alas for people today—why hearts like venomous snakes?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: zhan1 bi3 ban3 tian2， you3 wan3 qi2 te4。

interpretations.segmentation: 瞻彼阪田，有菀其特。
interpretations.explanation: 看那坡田之上，有棵特别茂盛的苗。

interpretations.segmentation: On the hillside field stands one plant lush and tall.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: tian1 zhi1 wu4 wo3， ru2 bu4 wo3 ke4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天之杌我，如不我克。
interpretations.explanation: 上天折磨我，好像不能制服我似的。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven torments me as if it could not subdue me.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: bi3 qiu2 wo3 ze2， ru2 bu4 wo3 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼求我则，如不我得。
interpretations.explanation: 他们找我时，好像得不到我似的。

interpretations.segmentation: When they seek me, it is as if they cannot have me.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: zhi2 wo3 chou2 chou2， yi4 bu4 wo3 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 执我仇仇，亦不我力。
interpretations.explanation: 抓住我时敌意满满，却不肯给我助力。

interpretations.segmentation: They seize me with hatred yet give me no help.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， ru2 huo4 jie2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，如或结之。
interpretations.explanation: 心中忧愁，像被绳结紧紧捆住。

interpretations.segmentation: My heart grieves as if bound in tight knots.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: jin1 zi1 zhi1 zheng4， hu2 ran2 li4 yi3？

interpretations.segmentation: 今兹之正，胡然厉矣？
interpretations.explanation: 当今的执政者，为何这样暴虐？

interpretations.segmentation: Why are today's rulers so cruel and fierce?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: liao2 zhi1 fang1 yang2， ning2 huo4 mie4 zhi1？

interpretations.segmentation: 燎之方扬，宁或灭之？
interpretations.explanation: 火焰正熊熊燃烧，难道会有人把它熄灭？

interpretations.segmentation: The blaze is rising high—who would put it out?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: he4 he4 zong1 zhou1， bao1 si4 mie4 zhi1！

interpretations.segmentation: 赫赫宗周，褒姒灭之！
interpretations.explanation: 显赫的宗周，竟被褒姒所灭！

interpretations.segmentation: Splendid Zhou was destroyed by Bao Si!

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: zhong1 qi2 yong3 huai2， you4 jiong3 yin1 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 终其永怀，又窘阴雨。
interpretations.explanation: 终其长久怀想，又困于阴雨。

interpretations.segmentation: Long I brood, again trapped in endless rain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: qi2 che1 ji4 zai4， nai3 qi4 er3 fu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 其车既载，乃弃尔辅。
interpretations.explanation: 车子已经装载，却丢弃了车辅。

interpretations.segmentation: The cart is loaded, yet its side boards are cast away.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: zai4 shu1 er3 zai4， jiang1 bo2 zhu4 yu3！

interpretations.segmentation: 载输尔载，将伯助予！
interpretations.explanation: 再装上你的货物，请长者来帮我！

interpretations.segmentation: Load your goods again—elders, come help me!

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: wu2 qi4 er3 fu3， yuan2 yu2 er3 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 无弃尔辅，员于尔辐。
interpretations.explanation: 不要丢弃车辅，要增固你的辐条。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not discard the boards— reinforce your wheel spokes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: lv3 gu4 er3 pu1， bu4 shu1 er3 zai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 屡顾尔仆，不输尔载。
interpretations.explanation: 屡次回头看车夫，不要让货物倾落。

interpretations.segmentation: Look back often at the driver—do not lose the load.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 jue2 xian3， ceng2 shi4 bu4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 终逾绝险，曾是不意。
interpretations.explanation: 终究越过险绝之地，本不曾料到。

interpretations.segmentation: At last we cross the perilous pass—none expected it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: yu2 zai4 yu2 zhao3， yi4 fei3 ke4 le4。

interpretations.segmentation: 鱼在于沼，亦匪克乐。
interpretations.explanation: 鱼在池沼之中，也不能真正安乐。

interpretations.segmentation: Fish in the pond cannot truly be at ease.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: qian2 sui1 fu2 yi3， yi4 kong3 zhi1 zhao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 潜虽伏矣，亦孔之炤。
interpretations.explanation: 即使潜藏水底，也照得很分明。

interpretations.segmentation: Though hidden deep, they are seen all too clearly.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: you1 xin1 can3 can3， nian4 guo2 zhi1 wei4 nve4！

interpretations.segmentation: 忧心惨惨，念国之为虐！
interpretations.explanation: 忧心惨惨，想到国家遭受暴虐！

interpretations.segmentation: My grief is bitter, thinking how the state is abused!

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: bi3 you3 zhi3 jiu3， you4 you3 jia1 yao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼有旨酒，又有嘉肴。
interpretations.explanation: 他们有美酒，又有嘉肴。

interpretations.segmentation: They have fine wine and savory dishes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: qia4 bi3 qi2 lin2， hun1 yin1 kong3 yun2。

interpretations.segmentation: 洽比其邻，婚姻孔云。
interpretations.explanation: 与邻居亲密往来，婚姻亲族也众多。

interpretations.segmentation: They feast with neighbors; kin by marriage abound.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: nian4 wo3 du2 xi1， you1 xin1 yin1 yin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 念我独兮，忧心殷殷。
interpretations.explanation: 想到我独处不幸，忧心深切。

interpretations.segmentation: Thinking how alone I am, my sorrow is deep.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.content: 佌佌彼有屋，蔌蔌方有谷。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: ci3 ci3 bi3 you3 wu1， su4 su4 fang1 you3 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 佌佌彼有屋，蔌蔌方有谷。
interpretations.explanation: 渺小的人却有高屋，积粟正满盈。

interpretations.segmentation: Petty men have grand houses; their grain bins overflow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: min2 jin1 zhi1 wu2 lu4， tian1 yao1 shi4 zhuo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 民今之无禄，天夭是椓。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓如今无福，上天却降夭折之祸。

interpretations.segmentation: The people now lack blessing; Heaven strikes them with early death.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue.pinyin: ge3 yi3 fu4 ren2， ai1 ci3 qiong2 du2。

interpretations.segmentation: 哿矣富人，哀此惸独。
interpretations.explanation: 富人真快乐，可怜这孤独无依的人。

interpretations.segmentation: How fine for the rich—pity the lonely and bereft.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: cai3 wei1 cai3 wei1， wei1 yi4 zuo4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 采薇采薇，薇亦作止。
interpretations.explanation: 采薇菜啊采薇菜，薇菜已经发芽。

interpretations.segmentation: We gather wild greens—the shoots have sprouted.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: yue1 gui1 yue1 gui1， sui4 yi4 mo4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 曰归曰归，岁亦莫止。
interpretations.explanation: 说回家啊说回家，一年又将到头。

interpretations.segmentation: Home, we say—home; the year is nearly done.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: mi2 shi4 mi2 jia1， xian3 yun3 zhi1 gu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 靡室靡家，玁狁之故。
interpretations.explanation: 没有家没有室，因为玁狁入侵。

interpretations.segmentation: No home, no family—because of the Xianyun invasion.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: bu4 huang2 qi3 ju1， xian3 yun3 zhi1 gu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不遑启居，玁狁之故。
interpretations.explanation: 无暇安居休息，因为玁狁入侵。

interpretations.segmentation: No time to rest at ease—because of the Xianyun.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: cai3 wei1 cai3 wei1， wei1 yi4 rou2 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 采薇采薇，薇亦柔止。
interpretations.explanation: 采薇菜啊采薇菜，薇菜已经柔嫩。

interpretations.segmentation: We gather wild greens—the leaves are tender now.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: yue1 gui1 yue1 gui1， xin1 yi4 you1 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 曰归曰归，心亦忧止。
interpretations.explanation: 说回家啊说回家，心中也充满忧愁。

interpretations.segmentation: Home, we say—home; our hearts are full of grief.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: you1 xin1 lie4 lie4， zai4 ji1 zai4 ke3。

interpretations.segmentation: 忧心烈烈，载饥载渴。
interpretations.explanation: 忧愁烈烈，又饥又渴。

interpretations.segmentation: Sorrow burns fierce; we hunger and thirst.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: wo3 shu4 wei4 ding4， mi2 shi3 gui1 pin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我戍未定，靡使归聘。
interpretations.explanation: 我们戍边未定，无法派人回家问讯。

interpretations.segmentation: Our garrison is unsettled; no messenger can go home.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: cai3 wei1 cai3 wei1， wei1 yi4 gang1 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 采薇采薇，薇亦刚止。
interpretations.explanation: 采薇菜啊采薇菜，薇菜已经老硬。

interpretations.segmentation: We gather wild greens—the stalks are hard and old.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: yue1 gui1 yue1 gui1， sui4 yi4 yang2 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 曰归曰归，岁亦阳止。
interpretations.explanation: 说回家啊说回家，已到十月阳月。

interpretations.segmentation: Home, we say—home; the tenth month has come.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: wang2 shi4 mi2 gu3， bu4 huang2 qi3 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 王事靡盬，不遑启处。
interpretations.explanation: 王事没有止息，无暇坐起安居。

interpretations.segmentation: The king's business never ends; no time to sit and rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: you1 xin1 kong3 jiu4， wo3 xing2 bu4 lai2！

interpretations.segmentation: 忧心孔疚，我行不来！
interpretations.explanation: 忧愁非常沉重，我出征仍不能回来！

interpretations.segmentation: Grief is keen—I march yet cannot return!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: bi3 er3 wei2 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 彼尔维何？
interpretations.explanation: 那是什么？

interpretations.segmentation: What is that over there?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: wei2 chang2 zhi1 hua2。

interpretations.segmentation: 维常之华。
interpretations.explanation: 是常棣树的花。

interpretations.segmentation: It is the blossom of the cherry-apple tree.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: bi3 lu4 si1 he2？

interpretations.segmentation: 彼路斯何？
interpretations.explanation: 那是什么？

interpretations.segmentation: What is that?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: jun1 zi zhi1 che1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子之车。
interpretations.explanation: 是将帅的战车。

interpretations.segmentation: It is the commander's war chariot.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: rong2 che1 ji4 jia4， si4 mu3 ye4 ye4。

interpretations.segmentation: 戎车既驾，四牡业业。
interpretations.explanation: 戎车已经驾好，四匹雄马强壮。

interpretations.segmentation: The war cart is yoked; four stallions stand strong.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: qi3 gan3 ding4 ju1？

interpretations.segmentation: 岂敢定居？
interpretations.explanation: 哪敢定居下来？

interpretations.segmentation: How dare we settle in one place?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: yi1 yue4 san1 jie2。

interpretations.segmentation: 一月三捷。
interpretations.explanation: 一个月里要打三次胜仗。

interpretations.segmentation: In one month we win three battles.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: jia4 bi3 si4 mu3， si4 mu3 kui2 kui2。

interpretations.segmentation: 驾彼四牡，四牡骙骙。
interpretations.explanation: 驾起那四匹马，四匹马雄健有力。

interpretations.segmentation: We drive those four horses—powerful and proud.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: jun1 zi suo3 yi1， xiao3 ren2 suo3 fei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子所依，小人所腓。
interpretations.explanation: 将帅所依靠，士卒所跟随。

interpretations.segmentation: The commander relies on them; the soldiers follow close.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: si4 mu3 yi4 yi4， xiang4 mi3 yu2 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 四牡翼翼，象弭鱼服。
interpretations.explanation: 四马整齐，象牙弓配鱼皮箭袋。

interpretations.segmentation: The four steeds are steady; ivory bow and fish-skin quiver.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: qi3 bu4 ri4 jie4？

interpretations.segmentation: 岂不日戒？
interpretations.explanation: 难道不日日警戒？

interpretations.segmentation: Do we not stay alert every day?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: xian3 yun3 kong3 ji2！

interpretations.segmentation: 玁狁孔棘！
interpretations.explanation: 玁狁的侵逼非常急迫！

interpretations.segmentation: The Xianyun threat is urgent indeed!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: xi1 wo3 wang3 yi3， yang2 liu3 yi1 yi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 昔我往矣，杨柳依依。
interpretations.explanation: 当初我离开的时候，杨柳依依。

interpretations.segmentation: When I left, willows trailed soft and green.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: jin1 wo3 lai2 si1， yu3 xue3 fei1 fei1。

interpretations.segmentation: 今我来思，雨雪霏霏。
interpretations.explanation: 如今我归来思量，雨雪纷纷飘落。

interpretations.segmentation: Now I return in thought—snow and rain fall thick.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: xing2 dao4 chi2 chi2， zai4 ke3 zai4 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 行道迟迟，载渴载饥。
interpretations.explanation: 行路迟缓，又渴又饥。

interpretations.segmentation: The road is slow; I thirst and hunger.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei.pinyin: wo3 xin1 shang1 bei1， mo4 zhi1 wo3 ai1！

interpretations.segmentation: 我心伤悲，莫知我哀！
interpretations.explanation: 我心伤悲，无人知我哀！

interpretations.segmentation: My heart grieves—none knows my sorrow!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: wo3 chu1 wo3 che1， yu2 bi3 mu4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我出我车，于彼牧矣。
interpretations.explanation: 我驾出我的战车，到那牧地。

interpretations.segmentation: I drive my chariot out to the pasture lands.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: zi4 tian1 zi suo3， wei4 wo3 lai2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 自天子所，谓我来矣。
interpretations.explanation: 从天子那里来，说让我出征。

interpretations.segmentation: From the Son of Heaven comes word that I must go.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: zhao4 bi3 pu1 fu1， wei4 zhi1 zai4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 召彼仆夫，谓之载矣。
interpretations.explanation: 召来那些车夫，叫他们装车。

interpretations.segmentation: I summon the drivers and tell them to load the cart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: wang2 shi4 duo1 nan2， wei2 qi2 ji2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 王事多难，维其棘矣。
interpretations.explanation: 王事多艰难，实在急迫。

interpretations.segmentation: The king's affairs are hard—truly urgent.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: wo3 chu1 wo3 che1， yu2 bi3 jiao1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我出我车，于彼郊矣。
interpretations.explanation: 我驾出我的战车，到那郊野。

interpretations.segmentation: I drive my chariot out to the outskirts.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: she4 ci3 zhao4 yi3， jian4 bi3 mao2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 设此旐矣，建彼旄矣。
interpretations.explanation: 竖起旐旗，树起旄旗。

interpretations.segmentation: We raise the pennant flags and set up the yak-tail banners.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: bi3 yu2 zhao4 si1， hu2 bu4 pei4 pei4？

interpretations.segmentation: 彼旟旐斯，胡不旆旆？
interpretations.explanation: 那些鸟隼旟和旐旗，为何不快快飘动？

interpretations.segmentation: Why do the hawk banners and pennants not flutter briskly?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: you1 xin1 qiao1 qiao1， pu1 fu1 kuang4 cui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 忧心悄悄，仆夫况瘁。
interpretations.explanation: 忧心悄悄，车夫也愈发憔悴。

interpretations.segmentation: My worry is secret; the drivers grow more worn.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: wang2 ming4 nan2 zhong4， wang3 cheng2 yu2 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 王命南仲，往城于方。
interpretations.explanation: 王命南仲，前往方地筑城。

interpretations.segmentation: The king commands Nan Zhong to go build walls at Fang.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: chu1 che1 peng2 peng2， qi2 zhao4 yang1 yang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 出车彭彭，旂旐央央。
interpretations.explanation: 出车声彭彭，旗帜鲜明飘扬。

interpretations.segmentation: Chariots roll thunderously; banners blaze bright.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: tian1 zi ming4 wo3， cheng2 bi3 shuo4 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天子命我，城彼朔方。
interpretations.explanation: 天子命令我，在那朔方筑城。

interpretations.segmentation: The Son of Heaven orders me to fortify the northern frontier.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: he4 he4 nan2 zhong4， xian3 yun3 yu2 xiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 赫赫南仲，玁狁于襄。
interpretations.explanation: 赫赫的南仲，在襄地打败玁狁。

interpretations.segmentation: Illustrious Nan Zhong defeats the Xianyun at Xiang.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: xi1 wo3 wang3 yi3， shu3 ji4 fang1 hua2。

interpretations.segmentation: 昔我往矣，黍稷方华。
interpretations.explanation: 当初我离开的时候，黍稷正开花。

interpretations.segmentation: When I left, millet and panic grass were in bloom.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: jin1 wo3 lai2 si1， yu3 xue3 zai4 tu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 今我来思，雨雪载途。
interpretations.explanation: 如今我归来思量，雨雪满路。

interpretations.segmentation: Now I return in thought—snow and rain fill the road.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: wang2 shi4 duo1 nan2， bu4 huang2 qi3 ju1。

interpretations.segmentation: 王事多难，不遑启居。
interpretations.explanation: 王事多艰难，无暇安居。

interpretations.segmentation: The king's business is hard; no time to rest at home.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: qi3 bu4 huai2 gui1？

interpretations.segmentation: 岂不怀归？
interpretations.explanation: 难道不想回家？

interpretations.segmentation: Do we not long for home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: wei4 ci3 jian3 shu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 畏此简书。
interpretations.explanation: 只怕这份军事文书。

interpretations.segmentation: We fear this military dispatch.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: yao1 yao1 cao3 chong2， ti4 ti4 fu4 zhong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 喓喓草虫，趯趯阜螽。
interpretations.explanation: 喓喓草虫鸣，趯趯阜螽跳。

interpretations.segmentation: Grasshoppers chirp; bush crickets leap.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: wei4 jian4 jun1 zi， you1 xin1 chong1 chong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 未见君子，忧心忡忡。
interpretations.explanation: 未见君子归来，忧心忡忡。

interpretations.segmentation: Not yet seeing my lord return—I worry deeply.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: ji4 jian4 jun1 zi， wo3 xin1 ze2 jiang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 既见君子，我心则降。
interpretations.explanation: 既已见到君子，我的心才安定。

interpretations.segmentation: Once I see my lord, my heart is eased.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: he4 he4 nan2 zhong4， bao2 fa2 xi1 rong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 赫赫南仲，薄伐西戎。
interpretations.explanation: 赫赫的南仲，薄伐西戎。

interpretations.segmentation: Illustrious Nan Zhong campaigns against the Western Rong.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: chun1 ri4 chi2 chi2， hui4 mu4 qi1 qi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 春日迟迟，卉木萋萋。
interpretations.explanation: 春日迟迟，草木茂盛。

interpretations.segmentation: Spring days are long; plants and trees flourish.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: cang1 geng1 jie1 jie1， cai3 fan2 qi2 qi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 仓庚喈喈，采蘩祁祁。
interpretations.explanation: 仓庚喈喈鸣，采蘩人众盛。

interpretations.segmentation: Orioles sing clearly; gatherers of ferns are many.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: zhi2 xun4 huo4 chou3， bao2 yan2 hai2 gui1。

interpretations.segmentation: 执讯获丑，薄言还归。
interpretations.explanation: 捉住俘虏问讯，于是凯旋归来。

interpretations.segmentation: We seize prisoners for questioning and march home in triumph.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche.pinyin: he4 he4 nan2 zhong4， xian3 yun3 yu2 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 赫赫南仲，玁狁于夷。
interpretations.explanation: 赫赫的南仲，在夷地平定玁狁。

interpretations.segmentation: Illustrious Nan Zhong pacifies the Xianyun at Yi.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.pinyin: you3 di4 zhi1 du4， you3 huan4 qi2 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有杕之杜，有睆其实。
interpretations.explanation: 有棵独立的杜树，圆实的果实。

interpretations.segmentation: A lone crabapple stands, its fruit round and full.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.pinyin: wang2 shi4 mi2 gu3， ji4 si4 wo3 ri4。

interpretations.segmentation: 王事靡盬，继嗣我日。
interpretations.explanation: 王事没有止息，继续消耗我的时日。

interpretations.segmentation: The king's work never ends, consuming my days.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.content: 日月阳止，女心伤止，征夫遑止。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.pinyin: ri4 yue4 yang2 zhi3， nv3 xin1 shang1 zhi3， zheng1 fu1 huang2 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 日月阳止，女心伤止，征夫遑止。
interpretations.explanation: 日月已到十月，女子心伤，征夫何时能停？

interpretations.segmentation: The sun and moon reach the tenth month; the wife grieves—when will the soldier rest?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.pinyin: you3 di4 zhi1 du4， qi2 ye4 qi1 qi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有杕之杜，其叶萋萋。
interpretations.explanation: 有棵独立的杜树，叶子茂盛。

interpretations.segmentation: The lone crabapple's leaves grow lush and green.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.pinyin: wang2 shi4 mi2 gu3， wo3 xin1 shang1 bei1。

interpretations.segmentation: 王事靡盬，我心伤悲。
interpretations.explanation: 王事没有止息，使我心伤悲。

interpretations.segmentation: The king's work never ends—my heart breaks with sorrow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.content: 卉木萋止，女心悲止，征夫归止！
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.pinyin: hui4 mu4 qi1 zhi3， nv3 xin1 bei1 zhi3， zheng1 fu1 gui1 zhi3！

interpretations.segmentation: 卉木萋止，女心悲止，征夫归止！
interpretations.explanation: 草木茂盛，女子心悲，征夫该回来了！

interpretations.segmentation: Plants flourish; the wife mourns—the soldier should return!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.pinyin: zhi4 bi3 bei3 shan1， yan2 cai3 qi2 qi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 陟彼北山，言采其杞。
interpretations.explanation: 登上那北山，去采枸杞。

interpretations.segmentation: I climb the northern hill to gather wolfberries.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.pinyin: wang2 shi4 mi2 gu3， you1 wo3 fu4 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 王事靡盬，忧我父母。
interpretations.explanation: 王事没有止息，使我父母担忧。

interpretations.segmentation: The king's work never ends—I grieve for my parents.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.content: 檀车幝幝，四牡痯痯，征夫不远！
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.pinyin: tan2 che1 chan3 chan3， si4 mu3 guan3 guan3， zheng1 fu1 bu4 yuan3！

interpretations.segmentation: 檀车幝幝，四牡痯痯，征夫不远！
interpretations.explanation: 檀木车破敝，四马病弱，征夫已不远！

interpretations.segmentation: The sandalwood cart is worn; four horses are weak—the soldier is near!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.pinyin: fei3 zai4 fei3 lai2， you1 xin1 kong3 jiu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪载匪来，忧心孔疚。
interpretations.explanation: 不是载来也不是归来，忧心非常沉重。

interpretations.segmentation: He neither arrives in a cart nor comes home—grief is keen.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.pinyin: si1 shi4 bu4 zhi4， er2 duo1 wei4 xu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 斯逝不至，而多为恤。
interpretations.explanation: 这一去不至，反而多生忧虑。

interpretations.segmentation: This departure brings no return—only more worry.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.content: 卜筮偕止，会言近止，征夫迩止！
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu.pinyin: bo shi4 xie2 zhi3， hui4 yan2 jin4 zhi3， zheng1 fu1 er3 zhi3！

interpretations.segmentation: 卜筮偕止，会言近止，征夫迩止！
interpretations.explanation: 卜筮都说他停下了，会合的话说他近了，征夫真的近了！

interpretations.segmentation: Divination says he has halted; omens say he is near—the soldier is truly near!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: fa2 mu4 ding1 ding1， niao3 ming2 ying1 ying1。
