interpretations.segmentation: 伐木丁丁，鸟鸣嘤嘤。
interpretations.explanation: 伐木声丁丁，鸟鸣声嘤嘤。

interpretations.segmentation: Axes ring ding-ding; birds call ying-ying.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: chu1 zi4 you1 gu3， qian1 yu2 qiao2 mu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 出自幽谷，迁于乔木。
interpretations.explanation: 鸟儿走出深谷，迁到高树。

interpretations.segmentation: Birds leave the deep valley and move to tall trees.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: ying1 qi2 ming2 yi3， qiu2 qi2 you3 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 嘤其鸣矣，求其友声。
interpretations.explanation: 嘤嘤地鸣叫，寻求同伴的应声。

interpretations.segmentation: They chirp, seeking a friend's answering call.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: xiang1 bi3 niao3 yi3， you2 qiu2 you3 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 相彼鸟矣，犹求友声。
interpretations.explanation: 看那鸟儿，尚且寻求友声。

interpretations.segmentation: Look at the birds—they still seek a companion's voice.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: shen3 yi1 ren2 yi3， bu4 qiu2 you3 sheng1？

interpretations.segmentation: 矧伊人矣，不求友生？
interpretations.explanation: 何况是人呢，怎能不找朋友？

interpretations.segmentation: How much more should people seek friends?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: shen2 zhi1 ting1 zhi1， zhong1 he2 qie3 ping2。

interpretations.segmentation: 神之听之，终和且平。
interpretations.explanation: 神明听到这些，终使和睦平安。

interpretations.segmentation: When the spirits hear, harmony and peace follow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: fa2 mu4 xu3 xu3， shai1 jiu3 you3 xu4！

interpretations.segmentation: 伐木许许，酾酒有藇！
interpretations.explanation: 伐木声许许，滤出的酒味香美。

interpretations.segmentation: Axes thud xu-xu; strained wine smells sweet.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: ji4 you3 fei2 zhu4， yi3 su4 zhu1 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 既有肥羜，以速诸父。
interpretations.explanation: 既有肥羊，用来招待各位叔父。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a fat lamb to feast the elder uncles.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: ning2 shi4 bu4 lai2， wei1 wo3 fu2 gu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 宁适不来，微我弗顾。
interpretations.explanation: 纵然他们不来，不是我失礼。

interpretations.segmentation: Even if they do not come, it is not my neglect.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: yu2 can4 sa3 sao3， chen2 kui4 ba1 gui3。

interpretations.segmentation: 于粲洒扫，陈馈八簋。
interpretations.explanation: 洒扫得鲜明整洁，摆上八簋祭食。

interpretations.segmentation: The hall is swept bright; eight dishes of food are set out.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: ji4 you3 fei2 mu3， yi3 su4 zhu1 jiu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 既有肥牡，以速诸舅。
interpretations.explanation: 既有肥公牛，用来招待各位舅父。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a fat bull to feast the maternal uncles.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: ning2 shi4 bu4 lai2， wei1 wo3 you3 jiu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 宁适不来，微我有咎。
interpretations.explanation: 纵然他们不来，也不是我的过错。

interpretations.segmentation: Even if they do not come, the fault is not mine.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: fa2 mu4 yu2 ban3， shai1 jiu3 you3 yan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 伐木于阪，酾酒有衍。
interpretations.explanation: 在坡地上伐木，滤出的酒满溢。

interpretations.segmentation: We cut wood on the slope; strained wine overflows.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: bian1 dou4 you3 jian4， xiong1 di4 wu2 yuan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 笾豆有践，兄弟无远。
interpretations.explanation: 笾豆摆列整齐，兄弟不要疏远。

interpretations.segmentation: Bowls and stands are arranged—brothers, do not stay far apart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: min2 zhi1 shi1 de2， qian2 hou2 yi3 qian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之失德，乾餱以愆。
interpretations.explanation: 人们失德，往往因干粮小事而起。

interpretations.segmentation: When people lose virtue, it often starts with a dry-ration slight.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: you3 jiu3 xu1 wo3， wu2 jiu3 gu1 wo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有酒湑我，无酒酤我。
interpretations.explanation: 有酒就滤给我，没酒就去买来。

interpretations.segmentation: If there is wine, strain it for me; if not, go buy some.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: kan3 kan3 gu3 wo3， dun1 dun1 wu3 wo3。

interpretations.segmentation: 坎坎鼓我，蹲蹲舞我。
interpretations.explanation: 击鼓为我助兴，蹲蹲地跳舞。

interpretations.segmentation: Beat the drum for me; dance with steady steps.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu.pinyin: dai4 wo3 xia2 yi3， yin3 ci3 xu1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 迨我暇矣，饮此湑矣。
interpretations.explanation: 等到我有空闲，就畅饮这美酒。

interpretations.segmentation: When I have leisure, I will drink this fine wine.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.pinyin: huang2 huang2 zhe3 hua2， yu2 bi3 yuan2 xi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 皇皇者华，于彼原隰。
interpretations.explanation: 鲜艳明亮的黄花，开在那平原和低湿的原野上。

interpretations.segmentation: Bright yellow flowers bloom on the plains and low marshes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.pinyin: shen1 shen1 zheng1 fu1， mei3 huai2 mi2 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 駪駪征夫，每怀靡及。
interpretations.explanation: 奔走的征夫行列整齐，却常怀忧虑，怕任务来不及完成。

interpretations.segmentation: The marching envoys hurry on, yet each fears he may not fulfill his mission in time.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.pinyin: wo3 ma3 wei2 ju1， liu4 pei4 ru2 ru2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我马维驹，六辔如濡。
interpretations.explanation: 我骑的是小马，六条缰绳润泽光滑。

interpretations.segmentation: My horses are colts; the six reins are moist and smooth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.pinyin: zai4 chi2 zai4 qu1， zhou1 yuan2 zi1 zou1。

interpretations.segmentation: 载驰载驱，周爰咨诹。
interpretations.explanation: 既奔驰又驱策，遍访各地征询意见。

interpretations.segmentation: We gallop and drive on, going everywhere to gather counsel.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.pinyin: wo3 ma3 wei2 qi2， liu4 pei4 ru2 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我马维骐，六辔如丝。
interpretations.explanation: 我骑的是青纹马，六条缰绳细如丝。

interpretations.segmentation: My horses are piebald; the six reins are fine as silk.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.pinyin: zai4 chi2 zai4 qu1， zhou1 yuan2 zi1 mou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 载驰载驱，周爰咨谋。
interpretations.explanation: 既奔驰又驱策，遍访各地谋划国事。

interpretations.segmentation: We gallop and drive on, going everywhere to deliberate on affairs of state.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.pinyin: wo3 ma3 wei2 luo4， liu4 pei4 wo4 ruo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我马维骆，六辔沃若。
interpretations.explanation: 我骑的是白鬃黑身的骆马，六条缰绳柔润有光泽。

interpretations.segmentation: My horses are white-maned bays; the six reins are soft and lustrous.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.pinyin: zai4 chi2 zai4 qu1， zhou1 yuan2 zi1 du4。

interpretations.segmentation: 载驰载驱，周爰咨度。
interpretations.explanation: 既奔驰又驱策，遍访各地审度民情。

interpretations.segmentation: We gallop and drive on, going everywhere to assess the people's condition.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.pinyin: wo3 ma3 wei2 yin1， liu4 pei4 ji4 jun1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我马维骃，六辔既均。
interpretations.explanation: 我骑的是浅青杂色马，六条缰绳已调得均匀。

interpretations.segmentation: My horses are gray; the six reins are evenly adjusted.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.pinyin: zai4 chi2 zai4 qu1， zhou1 yuan2 zi1 xun2。

interpretations.segmentation: 载驰载驱，周爰咨询。
interpretations.explanation: 既奔驰又驱策，遍访各地访问贤能。

interpretations.segmentation: We gallop and drive on, going everywhere to inquire of the wise and capable.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.pinyin: you1 you1 lu4 ming2， shi2 ye3 zhi1 ping2。

interpretations.segmentation: 呦呦鹿鸣，食野之苹。
interpretations.explanation: 鹿群呦呦鸣叫，在野地吃着苹草。

interpretations.segmentation: The deer call yo-yo, grazing on wild apple in the field.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.pinyin: wo3 you3 jia1 bin1， gu3 se4 chui1 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我有嘉宾，鼓瑟吹笙。
interpretations.explanation: 我有嘉宾到来，鼓瑟吹笙相迎。

interpretations.segmentation: I have honored guests; we play zithers and blow the sheng in welcome.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.pinyin: chui1 sheng1 gu3 huang2， cheng2 kuang1 shi4 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 吹笙鼓簧，承筐是将。
interpretations.explanation: 吹笙鼓簧乐声起，捧着礼筐献上礼物。

interpretations.segmentation: With sheng and reed pipes sounding, we bear gift baskets in service.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 hao3 wo3， shi4 wo3 zhou1 xing2。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之好我，示我周行。
interpretations.explanation: 人们对我友好，指给我正大之道。

interpretations.segmentation: People treat me well and show me the path of integrity.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.pinyin: you1 you1 lu4 ming2， shi2 ye3 zhi1 hao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 呦呦鹿鸣，食野之蒿。
interpretations.explanation: 鹿群呦呦鸣叫，在野地吃着蒿草。

interpretations.segmentation: The deer call yo-yo, grazing on artemisia in the field.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.pinyin: wo3 you3 jia1 bin1， de2 yin1 kong3 zhao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我有嘉宾，德音孔昭。
interpretations.explanation: 我有嘉宾到来，美德声誉非常显明。

interpretations.segmentation: I have honored guests whose virtuous fame shines bright.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.content: 视民不恌，君子是则是效。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.pinyin: shi4 min2 bu4 tiao1， jun1 zi shi4 ze2 shi4 xiao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 视民不恌，君子是则是效。
interpretations.explanation: 看待百姓不轻慢，君子就效法他的榜样。

interpretations.segmentation: He does not slight the people; gentlemen take him as their model.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.content: 我有旨酒，嘉宾式燕以敖。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.pinyin: wo3 you3 zhi3 jiu3， jia1 bin1 shi4 yan4 yi3 ao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我有旨酒，嘉宾式燕以敖。
interpretations.explanation: 我有美酒，请嘉宾宴饮而尽欢。

interpretations.segmentation: I have fine wine; let the guests feast and rejoice.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.pinyin: you1 you1 lu4 ming2， shi2 ye3 zhi1 qin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 呦呦鹿鸣，食野之芩。
interpretations.explanation: 鹿群呦呦鸣叫，在野地吃着芩草。

interpretations.segmentation: The deer call yo-yo, grazing on bitter herbs in the field.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.pinyin: wo3 you3 jia1 bin1， gu3 se4 gu3 qin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我有嘉宾，鼓瑟鼓琴。
interpretations.explanation: 我有嘉宾到来，鼓瑟又弹琴。

interpretations.segmentation: I have honored guests; we play zithers and lutes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.pinyin: gu3 se4 gu3 qin2， he2 le4 qie3 zhan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 鼓瑟鼓琴，和乐且湛。
interpretations.explanation: 鼓瑟又弹琴，和乐而且尽兴。

interpretations.segmentation: Zithers and lutes sound together—in harmony and deep delight.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.content: 我有旨酒，以燕乐嘉宾之心。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming.pinyin: wo3 you3 zhi3 jiu3， yi3 yan4 le4 jia1 bin1 zhi1 xin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我有旨酒，以燕乐嘉宾之心。
interpretations.explanation: 我有美酒，用以宴饮，使嘉宾内心愉悦。

interpretations.segmentation: I have fine wine to feast the guests and gladden their hearts.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu.pinyin: si4 mu3 fei1 fei1， zhou1 dao4 wo1 chi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 四牡騑騑，周道倭迟。
interpretations.explanation: 四匹公马壮健，周道平坦却行路迟缓。

interpretations.segmentation: Four stallions are strong; the Zhou road is broad yet our march is slow.
岂不怀归？
interpretations.explanation: 难道不想回家吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Do we not long to return home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu.pinyin: wang2 shi4 mi2 gu3， wo3 xin1 shang1 bei1。

interpretations.segmentation: 王事靡盬，我心伤悲。
interpretations.explanation: 王室差事无尽无休，我的心中充满悲伤。

interpretations.segmentation: The king's business never ends; my heart is full of grief.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu.pinyin: si4 mu3 fei1 fei1， chan3 chan3 luo4 ma3。

interpretations.segmentation: 四牡騑騑，啴啴骆马。
interpretations.explanation: 四匹公马壮健，黑鬃白身的骆马喘息不止。

interpretations.segmentation: Four stallions are strong; the piebald horses pant without rest.
岂不怀归？
interpretations.explanation: 难道不想回家吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Do we not long to return home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu.pinyin: wang2 shi4 mi2 gu3， bu4 huang2 qi3 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 王事靡盬，不遑启处。
interpretations.explanation: 王室差事无尽无休，无暇安坐休息。

interpretations.segmentation: The king's business never ends; we have no leisure to sit at ease.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu.content: 翩翩者鵻，载飞载下，集于苞栩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu.pinyin: pian1 pian1 zhe3 zhui1， zai4 fei1 zai4 xia4， ji2 yu2 bao1 xu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 翩翩者鵻，载飞载下，集于苞栩。
interpretations.explanation: 翩翩飞翔的鹁鸠，时飞时落，停在那丛生的柞树上。

interpretations.segmentation: The darting turtle-dove now flies, now alights, gathering on clustered oaks.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu.pinyin: wang2 shi4 mi2 gu3， bu4 huang2 jiang1 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 王事靡盬，不遑将父。
interpretations.explanation: 王室差事无尽无休，无暇奉养父亲。

interpretations.segmentation: The king's business never ends; we cannot care for our fathers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu.content: 翩翩者鵻，载飞载止，集于苞杞。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu.pinyin: pian1 pian1 zhe3 zhui1， zai4 fei1 zai4 zhi3， ji2 yu2 bao1 qi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 翩翩者鵻，载飞载止，集于苞杞。
interpretations.explanation: 翩翩飞翔的鹁鸠，时飞时停，停在那丛生的枸杞上。

interpretations.segmentation: The darting turtle-dove now flies, now rests, gathering on clustered jujubes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu.pinyin: wang2 shi4 mi2 gu3， bu4 huang2 jiang1 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 王事靡盬，不遑将母。
interpretations.explanation: 王室差事无尽无休，无暇奉养母亲。

interpretations.segmentation: The king's business never ends; we cannot care for our mothers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu.pinyin: jia4 bi3 si4 luo4， zai4 zhou4 qin1 qin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 驾彼四骆，载骤骎骎。
interpretations.explanation: 驾起四匹骆马，奔驰飞快。

interpretations.segmentation: We yoke four piebald horses and gallop swiftly.
岂不怀归？
interpretations.explanation: 难道不想回家吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Do we not long to return home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu.pinyin: shi4 yong4 zuo4 ge1， jiang1 mu3 lai2 shen3。

interpretations.segmentation: 是用作歌，将母来谂。
interpretations.explanation: 因此写下这首歌，把思念母亲的心情告诉人。

interpretations.segmentation: So I compose this song to tell how I miss my mother.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: tang2 di4 zhi1 hua2， e4 bu4 wei3 wei3。

interpretations.segmentation: 棠棣之华，鄂不韡韡。
interpretations.explanation: 棠棣树的花，花萼也鲜明灿烂。

interpretations.segmentation: The flowers of the cherry-apple—each calyx too shines bright.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: fan2 jin1 zhi1 ren2， mo4 ru2 xiong1 di4。

interpretations.segmentation: 凡今之人，莫如兄弟。
interpretations.explanation: 凡今之人，没有比得上兄弟的。

interpretations.segmentation: Among people today, none compare to brothers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: si3 sang4 zhi1 wei1， xiong1 di4 kong3 huai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 死丧之威，兄弟孔怀。
interpretations.explanation: 面对死丧的威吓，兄弟最相牵挂。

interpretations.segmentation: In the face of death and mourning, brothers care for one another most.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: yuan2 xi2 pou2 yi3， xiong1 di4 qiu2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 原隰裒矣，兄弟求矣。
interpretations.explanation: 平原低地聚了很多人，兄弟就来相寻。

interpretations.segmentation: When people gather on plain and marsh, brothers come seeking one another.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: ji2 ling4 zai4 yuan2， xiong1 di4 ji2 nan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 脊令在原，兄弟急难。
interpretations.explanation: 鹡鸰在原野上，兄弟在急难中相助。

interpretations.segmentation: The wagtail on the plain—brothers help each other in urgent need.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: mei3 you3 liang2 peng2， kuang4 ye3 yong3 tan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 每有良朋，况也永叹。
interpretations.explanation: 即使有良朋，也只是徒然长叹。

interpretations.segmentation: Even with good friends, one can only sigh in vain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: xiong1 di4 xi4 yu2 qiang2， wai4 yu4 qi2 wu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 兄弟阋于墙，外御其务。
interpretations.explanation: 兄弟在家墙内争吵，对外却共同抵御外患。

interpretations.segmentation: Brothers may quarrel within the wall, yet together they ward off outside troubles.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: mei3 you3 liang2 peng2， zheng1 ye3 wu2 rong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 每有良朋，烝也无戎。
interpretations.explanation: 即使有良朋，也只是徒然助不了什么。

interpretations.segmentation: Even with good friends, they cannot truly help in the end.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: sang4 luan4 ji4 ping2， ji4 an1 qie3 ning2。

interpretations.segmentation: 丧乱既平，既安且宁。
interpretations.explanation: 丧乱已经平息，既安定又安宁。

interpretations.segmentation: The turmoil of loss and chaos has subsided; there is peace and calm.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: sui1 you3 xiong1 di4， bu4 ru2 you3 sheng1？

interpretations.segmentation: 虽有兄弟，不如友生？
interpretations.explanation: 虽有兄弟，却不如朋友亲吗？

interpretations.segmentation: Though one has brothers, are they not as dear as friends?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: bin1 er3 bian1 dou4， yin3 jiu3 zhi1 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 傧尔笾豆，饮酒之饫。
interpretations.explanation: 摆好笾豆，饮酒饱足。

interpretations.segmentation: Set out the bowls and stands; drink wine to satisfaction.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: xiong1 di4 ji4 ju4， he2 le4 qie3 ru2。

interpretations.segmentation: 兄弟既具，和乐且孺。
interpretations.explanation: 兄弟都已到齐，和乐而且亲密。

interpretations.segmentation: Brothers are all present—joyful and tender together.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: qi1 zi hao3 he2， ru2 gu3 se4 qin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 妻子好合，如鼓瑟琴。
interpretations.explanation: 妻子和睦，如同鼓瑟弹琴般和谐。

interpretations.segmentation: Wife and husband live in harmony, like zither and lute in tune.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: xiong1 di4 ji4 xi1， he2 le4 qie3 zhan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 兄弟既翕，和乐且湛。
interpretations.explanation: 兄弟既已聚合，和乐而且尽兴。

interpretations.segmentation: Brothers have come together—in harmony and deep delight.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: yi2 er3 shi4 jia1， le4 er3 qi1 tang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 宜尔室家，乐尔妻帑。
interpretations.explanation: 宜于你的室家，使你的妻子儿女快乐。

interpretations.segmentation: May your household prosper; may your wife and children rejoice.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi.pinyin: shi4 jiu1 shi4 tu2， dan3 qi2 ran2 hu1？

interpretations.segmentation: 是究是图，亶其然乎？
interpretations.explanation: 仔细推究、图谋，的确是这样吗？

interpretations.segmentation: When we examine and consider—is it not truly so?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: tian1 bao3 ding4 er3， yi4 kong3 zhi1 gu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 天保定尔，亦孔之固。
interpretations.explanation: 上天保佑你，使你的根基非常牢固。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven protects you; your foundation is exceedingly firm.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: bi3 er3 dan1 hou4， he2 fu2 bu4 chu2？

interpretations.segmentation: 俾尔单厚，何福不除？
interpretations.explanation: 使你厚受福禄，什么福分不能除去？

interpretations.segmentation: May you receive abundant blessings—what fortune could be taken away?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: bi3 er3 duo1 yi4， yi3 mo4 bu4 shu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 俾尔多益，以莫不庶。
interpretations.explanation: 使你增益很多，天下无不众多。

interpretations.segmentation: May you gain ever more, until all under heaven is plentiful.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: tian1 bao3 ding4 er3， bi3 er3 jian3 gu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 天保定尔，俾尔戬穀。
interpretations.explanation: 上天保佑你，使你吉祥又富足。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven protects you; may you be auspicious and rich.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: qing4 wu2 bu4 yi2， shou4 tian1 bai3 lu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 罄无不宜，受天百禄。
interpretations.explanation: 凡事无不适宜，承受上天百种福禄。

interpretations.segmentation: Nothing is unfitting; receive heaven's hundred blessings.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: jiang4 er3 xia2 fu2， wei2 ri4 bu4 zu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 降尔遐福，维日不足。
interpretations.explanation: 降给你长远之福，日日享用仍觉不足。

interpretations.segmentation: May distant blessings descend—each day's share is never enough.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: tian1 bao3 ding4 er3， yi3 mo4 bu4 xing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 天保定尔，以莫不兴。
interpretations.explanation: 上天保佑你，使万物无不兴盛。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven protects you; may nothing fail to flourish.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.content: 如山如阜，如冈如陵，如川之方至，以莫不增。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: ru2 shan1 ru2 fu4， ru2 gang1 ru2 ling2， ru2 chuan1 zhi1 fang1 zhi4， yi3 mo4 bu4 zeng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 如山如阜，如冈如陵，如川之方至，以莫不增。
interpretations.explanation: 像山像大丘，像冈像高陵，像河水滔滔方至，无不日益增多。

interpretations.segmentation: Like mountains and great mounds, like hills and high ridges, like rivers swelling onward—may all ever increase.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: ji2 juan1 wei4 chi4， shi4 yong4 xiao4 xiang3。

interpretations.segmentation: 吉蠲为饎，是用孝享。
interpretations.explanation: 洁净祭祀备酒食，用以孝享祖先。

interpretations.segmentation: With pure rites and offerings of food and wine, we filially honor the ancestors.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: yue4 ci2 zheng1 chang2， yu2 gong1 xian1 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 禴祠烝尝，于公先王。
interpretations.explanation: 春祭、夏祭、秋祭、冬祭，献给先公先王。

interpretations.segmentation: Spring, summer, autumn, and winter sacrifices are offered to the former dukes and kings.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: jun1 yue1： bo er3， wan4 shou4 wu2 jiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君曰：卜尔，万寿无疆。
interpretations.explanation: 君上说：我占卜赐你，万寿无疆。

interpretations.segmentation: The lord says: I divined for you—may you live ten thousand years without limit.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: shen2 zhi1 diao4 yi3， yi2 er3 duo1 fu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 神之吊矣，诒尔多福。
interpretations.explanation: 神灵来降福，赐给你很多福禄。

interpretations.segmentation: The spirits descend with blessing and grant you abundant fortune.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: min2 zhi1 zhi4 yi3， ri4 yong4 yin3 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之质矣，日用饮食。
interpretations.explanation: 百姓的本质，就是日用饮食。

interpretations.segmentation: The nature of the people is daily food and drink.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: qun2 li2 bai3 xing4， bian4 wei4 er3 de2。

interpretations.segmentation: 群黎百姓，遍为尔德。
interpretations.explanation: 众民百姓，都感念你的恩德。

interpretations.segmentation: All the common people everywhere respond to your virtue.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: ru2 yue4 zhi1 heng2， ru2 ri4 zhi1 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 如月之恒，如日之升。
interpretations.explanation: 像月亮一样常满，像太阳一样上升。

interpretations.segmentation: Like the moon ever full, like the sun ever rising.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: ru2 nan2 shan1 zhi1 shou4， bu4 qian1 bu4 beng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 如南山之寿，不骞不崩。
interpretations.explanation: 像南山之寿，不亏不崩。

interpretations.segmentation: Like the longevity of the southern hills—never shrinking, never crumbling.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.content: 如松柏之茂，无不尔或承。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao.pinyin: ru2 song1 bai3 zhi1 mao4， wu2 bu4 er3 huo4 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 如松柏之茂，无不尔或承。
interpretations.explanation: 像松柏之茂，无不有人继承。

interpretations.segmentation: Like pine and cypress in full leaf—may all inherit your bounty.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli.pinyin: yu2 li4 yu2 liu3， chang2 sha1。

interpretations.segmentation: 鱼丽于罶，鲿鲨。
interpretations.explanation: 鱼在鱼篓里陈列，有鲿鱼、鲨鱼。

interpretations.segmentation: Fish are arrayed in the creel—catfish and shark.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli.pinyin: jun1 zi you3 jiu3， zhi3 qie3 duo1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子有酒，旨且多。
interpretations.explanation: 君子有酒，味道好而且多。

interpretations.segmentation: The gentleman has wine—fine in flavor and abundant.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli.pinyin: yu2 li4 yu2 liu3， fang2 li3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鱼丽于罶，鲂鳢。
interpretations.explanation: 鱼在鱼篓里陈列，有鲂鱼、鳢鱼。

interpretations.segmentation: Fish are arrayed in the creel—bream and black carp.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli.pinyin: jun1 zi you3 jiu3， duo1 qie3 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子有酒，多且旨。
interpretations.explanation: 君子有酒，数量多而且味道好。

interpretations.segmentation: The gentleman has wine—plentiful and fine.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli.pinyin: yu2 li4 yu2 liu3， yan3 li3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鱼丽于罶，鰋鲤。
interpretations.explanation: 鱼在鱼篓里陈列，有鰋鱼、鲤鱼。

interpretations.segmentation: Fish are arrayed in the creel—catfish and carp.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli.pinyin: jun1 zi you3 jiu3， zhi3 qie3 you3。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子有酒，旨且有。
interpretations.explanation: 君子有酒，味道好而且充足。

interpretations.segmentation: The gentleman has wine—fine and sufficient.
物其多矣，
interpretations.explanation: 物产多么丰富啊，

interpretations.segmentation: How abundant the offerings are!
维其嘉矣！
interpretations.explanation: 多么美好啊！

interpretations.segmentation: How excellent they are!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli.pinyin: wu4 qi2 zhi3 yi3， wei2 qi2 xie2 yi3！

interpretations.segmentation: 物其旨矣，维其偕矣！
interpretations.explanation: 物产多么甘美，多么齐备啊！

interpretations.segmentation: How savory and how complete they are!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli.pinyin: wu4 qi2 you3 yi3， wei2 qi2 shi2 yi3！

interpretations.segmentation: 物其有矣，维其时矣！
interpretations.explanation: 物产多么齐全，多么合于时宜啊！

interpretations.segmentation: How fully present—and how timely they are!

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.content: 薄言采芑，于彼新田，呈此菑亩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: bao2 yan2 cai3 qi3， yu2 bi3 xin1 tian2， cheng2 ci3 zai1 mu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 薄言采芑，于彼新田，呈此菑亩。
interpretations.explanation: 我们去采苦菜，在那新垦的田，到这块初耕的亩。

interpretations.segmentation: We go to gather thistles—in the newly opened field, on this first-plowed plot.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: fang1 shu1 li4 zhi3， qi2 che1 san1 qian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 方叔涖止，其车三千。
interpretations.explanation: 方叔来到，他的战车有三千辆。

interpretations.segmentation: Fang Shu arrives; his chariots number three thousand.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: shi1 gan4 zhi1 shi4， fang1 shu1 lv4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 师干之试，方叔率止。
interpretations.explanation: 检阅军队，方叔率领前行。

interpretations.segmentation: The army is reviewed; Fang Shu leads the march.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: cheng2 qi2 si4 qi2， si4 qi2 yi4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 乘其四骐，四骐翼翼。
interpretations.explanation: 驾着四匹青骐马，四马整齐有力。

interpretations.segmentation: He drives four blue-gray horses—four steeds strong and arrayed.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.content: 路车有奭，簟茀鱼服，钩膺鞗革。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: lu4 che1 you3 shi4， dian4 fu2 yu2 fu2， gou1 ying1 tiao2 ge2。

interpretations.segmentation: 路车有奭，簟茀鱼服，钩膺鞗革。
interpretations.explanation: 路车鲜明，竹席鱼皮饰，马胸钩和革带齐备。

interpretations.segmentation: The road chariot is splendid—with bamboo mat, fish-skin trim, breastplate hooks, and leather straps.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.content: 薄言采芑，于彼新田，于此中乡。

interpretations.segmentation: 薄言采芑，于彼新田，于此中乡。
interpretations.explanation: 我们去采苦菜，在那新垦的田，到这一乡中间。

interpretations.segmentation: We go to gather thistles—in the new field, here in the middle of the district.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: fang1 shu1 li4 zhi3， qi2 che1 san1 qian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 方叔涖止，其车三千。
interpretations.explanation: 方叔来到，他的战车有三千辆。

interpretations.segmentation: Fang Shu arrives; his chariots number three thousand.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: qi2 zhao4 yang1 yang1， fang1 shu1 lv4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 旂旐央央，方叔率止。
interpretations.explanation: 旗帜鲜明，方叔率领前行。

interpretations.segmentation: Banners blaze bright; Fang Shu leads the march.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: yue1 di3 cuo4 heng2， ba1 luan2 qiang1 qiang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 约軧错衡，八鸾玱玱。
interpretations.explanation: 车毂有纹、衡木交错，八铃叮当响。

interpretations.segmentation: Wheel hubs patterned, crossbars interlaced—the eight bells ring clear.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.content: 服其命服，朱芾斯皇，有玱葱珩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: fu2 qi2 ming4 fu2， zhu1 fei4 si1 huang2， you3 qiang1 cong1 hang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 服其命服，朱芾斯皇，有玱葱珩。
interpretations.explanation: 穿着命服，朱色蔽膝鲜明，佩葱色珩玉。

interpretations.segmentation: He wears his appointed robes—scarlet knee-guards bright, with green jade pendants.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.content: 鴥彼飞隼，其飞戾天，亦集爰止。

interpretations.segmentation: 鴥彼飞隼，其飞戾天，亦集爰止。
interpretations.explanation: 迅疾飞翔的隼鸟，高飞及天，也停在这里。

interpretations.segmentation: The swift falcon flies to the sky—and also alights here.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: fang1 shu1 li4 zhi3， qi2 che1 san1 qian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 方叔涖止，其车三千。
interpretations.explanation: 方叔来到，他的战车有三千辆。

interpretations.segmentation: Fang Shu arrives; his chariots number three thousand.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: shi1 gan4 zhi1 shi4， fang1 shu1 lv4 zhi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 师干之试，方叔率止。
interpretations.explanation: 检阅军队，方叔率领前行。

interpretations.segmentation: The army is reviewed; Fang Shu leads the march.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: zheng1 ren2 fa2 gu3， chen2 shi1 ju1 lv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 钲人伐鼓，陈师鞠旅。
interpretations.explanation: 征人击鼓，陈列军队训话。

interpretations.segmentation: The bell-men beat drums; the army is drawn up and addressed.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.content: 显允方叔，伐鼓渊渊，振旅阗阗。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: xian3 yun3 fang1 shu1， fa2 gu3 yuan1 yuan1， zhen4 lv3 tian2 tian2。

interpretations.segmentation: 显允方叔，伐鼓渊渊，振旅阗阗。
interpretations.explanation: 显赫诚信的方叔，鼓声渊渊，整旅归来阗阗。

interpretations.segmentation: Renowned and true Fang Shu—deep drumbeats, returning ranks in thunderous array.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: chun3 er3 man2 jing1， da4 bang1 wei4 chou2。

interpretations.segmentation: 蠢尔蛮荆，大邦为仇。
interpretations.explanation: 愚蠢的蛮荆，与大邦为仇。

interpretations.segmentation: The foolish southern tribes make enemies of the great state.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: fang1 shu1 yuan2 lao3， ke4 zhuang4 qi2 you2。

interpretations.segmentation: 方叔元老，克壮其犹。
interpretations.explanation: 方叔是元老，能壮其谋。

interpretations.segmentation: Fang Shu is a senior minister; his plans are bold and strong.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: fang1 shu1 lv4 zhi3， zhi2 xun4 huo4 chou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 方叔率止，执讯获丑。
interpretations.explanation: 方叔率领军队，执讯获丑。

interpretations.segmentation: Fang Shu leads the host—capturing prisoners and the guilty.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: rong2 che1 chan3 chan3，

interpretations.segmentation: 戎车啴啴，
interpretations.explanation: 戎车众多，

interpretations.segmentation: War chariots roll on in numbers,

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: chan3 chan3 tun1 tun1， ru2 ting2 ru2 lei2。

interpretations.segmentation: 啴啴焞焞，如霆如雷。
interpretations.explanation: 声势焞焞，如霆如雷。

interpretations.segmentation: Their rumble like thunder and lightning.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.content: 显允方叔，征伐玁狁，蛮荆来威。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi.pinyin: xian3 yun3 fang1 shu1， zheng1 fa2 xian3 yun3， man2 jing1 lai2 wei1。

interpretations.segmentation: 显允方叔，征伐玁狁，蛮荆来威。
interpretations.explanation: 显赫诚信的方叔，征伐玁狁，蛮荆来服。

interpretations.segmentation: Renowned Fang Shu campaigns against the Xianyun; the southern tribes submit in awe.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong.pinyin: wo3 che1 ji4 gong1， wo3 ma3 ji4 tong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我车既攻，我马既同。
interpretations.explanation: 我的车已修好了，我的马已配齐了。

interpretations.segmentation: My chariots are repaired; my horses are matched.

interpretations.segmentation: 四牡庞庞，驾言徂东。
interpretations.explanation: 四匹公马壮健，驾车要往东方去。

interpretations.segmentation: Four stallions are strong; we yoke up and head east.

interpretations.segmentation: 田车既好，田牡孔阜。
interpretations.explanation: 猎车已经很好，猎马非常高大。

interpretations.segmentation: The hunting chariots are ready; the hunting horses are tall and strong.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong.pinyin: dong1 you3 fu3 cao3， jia4 yan2 xing2 shou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 东有甫草，驾言行狩。
interpretations.explanation: 东方有甫草，驾车前往行猎。

interpretations.segmentation: East lies Fu Meadow; we drive there to hunt.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong.pinyin: zhi1 zi yu2 miao2， xuan3 tu2 xiao1 xiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 之子于苗，选徒嚣嚣。
interpretations.explanation: 这位君子去田猎，选出的徒众声喧喧。

interpretations.segmentation: The lord goes hunting; the chosen followers shout with excitement.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong.pinyin: jian4 zhao4 she4 mao2， bo2 shou4 yu2 ao2。

interpretations.segmentation: 建旐设旄，搏兽于敖。
interpretations.explanation: 竖起旐旗和旄旗，在敖地搏兽。

interpretations.segmentation: Banners of silk and yak-tail are raised; we hunt beasts at Ao.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong.pinyin: jia4 bi3 si4 mu3， si4 mu3 yi4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 驾彼四牡，四牡奕奕。
interpretations.explanation: 驾起四匹公马，四马奕奕有神。

interpretations.segmentation: We yoke four stallions—four steeds spirited and fine.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong.pinyin: chi4 fei4 jin1 xi4， hui4 tong2 you3 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 赤芾金舄，会同有绎。
interpretations.explanation: 穿赤芾金舄，诸侯会同络绎不绝。

interpretations.segmentation: In scarlet knee-guards and golden shoes, lords assemble in continuous stream.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong.pinyin: jue2 shi2 ji4 ci4， gong1 shi3 ji4 diao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 决拾既佽，弓矢既调。
interpretations.explanation: 臂鞲已齐备，弓矢已调好。

interpretations.segmentation: Arm-guards are ready; bows and arrows are tuned.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong.pinyin: she4 fu1 ji4 tong2， zhu4 wo3 ju3 chai2。

interpretations.segmentation: 射夫既同，助我举柴。
interpretations.explanation: 射手已齐同，助我举柴计数猎物。

interpretations.segmentation: Archers stand aligned, helping me tally the game with brushwood markers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong.pinyin: si4 huang2 ji4 jia4， liang3 can1 bu4 yi1。

interpretations.explanation: 四匹黄马已驾，两匹骖马不偏斜。

interpretations.segmentation: Four bay horses are yoked; the two outriders do not swerve.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong.pinyin: bu4 shi1 qi2 chi2， she3 shi3 ru2 po4。

interpretations.segmentation: They keep their pace; arrows fly as if splitting targets.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong.pinyin: xiao1 xiao1 ma3 ming2， you1 you1 pei4 jing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 萧萧马鸣，悠悠旆旌。
interpretations.explanation: 马鸣萧萧，旌旗悠悠。

interpretations.segmentation: Horses whinny softly; pennants flutter far.

interpretations.segmentation: 徒御不惊，大庖不盈。
interpretations.explanation: 御者不惊，大厨不盈（猎物不多取）。

interpretations.segmentation: Drivers stay calm; the great kitchen is not overfilled.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong.pinyin: zhi1 zi yu2 zheng1， you3 wen2 wu2 sheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 之子于征，有闻无声。
interpretations.explanation: 这位君子出征归来，有声誉而无喧哗。

interpretations.segmentation: The lord returns from the expedition— famed yet without clamor.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong.pinyin: yun3 yi3 jun1 zi， zhan3 ye3 da4 cheng2。

interpretations.segmentation: At the railing the spring bubbles up; they go to gather celery.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: jun1 zi lai2 chao2， yan2 guan1 qi2 qi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子来朝，言观其旂。
interpretations.explanation: 诸侯来朝，正好观看他们的旗帜。

interpretations.segmentation: The lords come to court; we watch their banners.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: qi2 qi2 pi4 pi4， luan2 sheng1 hui4 hui4。

interpretations.segmentation: 其旂淠淠，鸾声嘒嘒。
interpretations.explanation: 旗帜飘动鲜明，鸾铃响声清脆。

interpretations.segmentation: Their banners flutter brightly; the bell pendants ring clearly.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: zai4 can1 zai4 si4， jun1 zi suo3 jie4。

interpretations.segmentation: 载骖载驷，君子所届。
interpretations.explanation: 或驾三马或驾四马，正是诸侯所乘而至。

interpretations.segmentation: Drawn by teams of three or four horses, the lords arrive in state.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: chi4 fei4 zai4 gu3， xie2 fu2 zai4 xia4。

interpretations.segmentation: 赤芾在股，邪幅在下。
interpretations.explanation: 红色蔽膝绑在大腿上，邪幅绑在腿下。

interpretations.segmentation: Red knee-pieces on the thighs, crosswise leggings below.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: bi3 jiao1 fei3 shu1， tian1 zi suo3 yu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼交匪纾，天子所予。
interpretations.explanation: 他们交往勤勉不怠，这是天子所赐予的尊荣。

interpretations.segmentation: They are diligent in duty and not slack—honors granted by the Son of Heaven.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: le4 zhi3 jun1 zi， tian1 zi ming4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐只君子，天子命之。
interpretations.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，承受天子的任命。

interpretations.segmentation: Happy is the lord, entrusted with the king's commission.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: le4 zhi3 jun1 zi， fu2 lu4 shen1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐只君子，福禄申之。
interpretations.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，福禄一再加于他身。

interpretations.segmentation: Happy is the lord; blessings and rank are repeatedly extended to him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: wei2 zha4 zhi1 zhi1， qi2 ye4 peng2 peng2。

interpretations.segmentation: 维柞之枝，其叶蓬蓬。
interpretations.explanation: 柞树枝条上，叶子长得茂盛。

interpretations.segmentation: On the oak branches the leaves grow thick and lush.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: le4 zhi3 jun1 zi， dian4 tian1 zi zhi1 bang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐只君子，殿天子之邦。
interpretations.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，镇抚天子的邦国。

interpretations.segmentation: Happy is the lord, who steadies the king's domain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: le4 zhi3 jun1 zi， wan4 fu2 you1 tong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐只君子，万福攸同。
interpretations.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，万福都集于他一身。

interpretations.segmentation: Happy is the lord; every blessing gathers upon him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: ping2 ping2 zuo3 you4， yi4 shi4 lv4 cong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 平平左右，亦是率从。
interpretations.explanation: 左右辅佐平和有序，也都遵循他的表率。

interpretations.segmentation: His aides left and right are orderly, all following his example.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: fan4 fan4 yang2 zhou1， fu2 li2 wei2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 汎汎杨舟，绋纚维之。
interpretations.explanation: 杨木小舟在水上漂荡，用绳索把它系住。

interpretations.segmentation: A poplar-wood boat floats on the water, moored fast with hemp ropes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: le4 zhi3 jun1 zi， tian1 zi kui2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐只君子，天子葵之。
interpretations.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，为天子所眷顾。

interpretations.segmentation: Happy is the lord, looked upon with favor by the king.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: le4 zhi3 jun1 zi， fu2 lu4 pi2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 乐只君子，福禄膍之。
interpretations.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，福禄厚厚地加给他。

interpretations.segmentation: Happy is the lord; blessings are heaped abundantly upon him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu.pinyin: you1 zai1 you2 zai1， yi4 shi4 li4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 优哉游哉，亦是戾矣。
interpretations.explanation: 优游自在，也就达到安定了。

interpretations.segmentation: At ease and unhurried, all reaches peace and rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: bi3 dou1 ren2 shi4， hu2 qiu2 huang2 huang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼都人士，狐裘黄黄。
interpretations.explanation: 那些京城人士，穿着黄狐皮裘。

interpretations.segmentation: Those people of the capital wear yellow fox-fur robes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: qi2 rong2 bu4 gai3， chu1 yan2 you3 zhang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 其容不改，出言有章。
interpretations.explanation: 仪容仍如旧日，说话有条有理。

interpretations.segmentation: Their bearing is unchanged; their words are well ordered.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: xing2 gui1 yu2 zhou1， wan4 min2 suo3 wang4。

interpretations.segmentation: 行归于周，万民所望。
interpretations.explanation: 他们行将回到周地，是万民所仰望的。

interpretations.segmentation: They are returning to Zhou, the hope of all the people.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: bi3 dou1 ren2 shi4， tai2 li4 zi1 cuo1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼都人士，台笠缁撮。
interpretations.explanation: 那些京城人士，戴着台笠、缁撮等帽。

interpretations.segmentation: Those capital folk wear broad bamboo hats and tight black caps.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: bi3 jun1 zi nv3， chou2 zhi2 ru2 fa1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼君子女，绸直如发。
interpretations.explanation: 那些君子的女儿，头发细直如丝。

interpretations.segmentation: Those ladies of noble families have hair fine and straight as silk.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: wo3 bu4 jian4 xi1， wo3 xin1 bu4 shuo1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我不见兮，我心不说。
interpretations.explanation: 我再也见不到他们了，心里好不愉快。

interpretations.segmentation: I see them no more, and my heart is ill at ease.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: bi3 dou1 ren2 shi4， chong1 er3 xiu4 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼都人士，充耳琇实。
interpretations.explanation: 那些京城人士，耳上挂着美玉充耳。

interpretations.segmentation: Those people of the capital wear jade ear-plugs of fine quality.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: bi3 jun1 zi nv3， wei4 zhi1 yin3 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼君子女，谓之尹吉。
interpretations.explanation: 那些君子的女儿，人们称她们为尹吉。

interpretations.segmentation: Those noble ladies are called Yin Ji—models of virtue.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: wo3 bu4 jian4 xi1， wo3 xin1 yuan4 jie2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我不见兮，我心苑结。
interpretations.explanation: 我再也见不到他们了，心中郁结难解。

interpretations.segmentation: I see them no more, and sorrow knots my heart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: bi3 dou1 ren2 shi4， chui2 dai4 er2 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼都人士，垂带而厉。
interpretations.explanation: 那些京城人士，腰带垂下显得庄重。

interpretations.segmentation: Those capital folk let their sashes hang low in dignified fashion.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: bi3 jun1 zi nv3， juan3 fa1 ru2 chai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼君子女，卷发如虿。
interpretations.explanation: 那些君子的女儿，卷发如蝎尾上翘。

interpretations.segmentation: Those noble ladies have curls like a scorpion's arched tail.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: wo3 bu4 jian4 xi1， yan2 cong2 zhi1 mai4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我不见兮，言从之迈。
interpretations.explanation: 我再也见不到他们了，只好跟着他们远去。

interpretations.segmentation: I see them no more and can only follow as they depart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: fei3 yi1 chui2 zhi1， dai4 ze2 you3 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪伊垂之，带则有余。
interpretations.explanation: 不是故意让带子垂下，而是腰带本来就有余。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not that the sash is let down on purpose—it is simply long.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: fei3 yi1 juan3 zhi1， fa1 ze2 you3 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪伊卷之，发则有旟。
interpretations.explanation: 不是故意把头发卷起来，而是发本就有卷曲。

interpretations.segmentation: It is not that the hair is curled by art—it is naturally wavy.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi.pinyin: wo3 bu4 jian4 xi1， yun2 he2 xu1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我不见兮，云何盱矣。
interpretations.explanation: 我再也见不到他们了，只能独自张望而叹。

interpretations.segmentation: I see them no more and can only gaze into the distance and sigh.
何草不黄？
interpretations.explanation: 哪一种草不枯黄？

interpretations.segmentation: What plant is not turning yellow?
何日不行？
interpretations.explanation: 哪一天不在行军？

interpretations.segmentation: What day are we not on the march?
何人不将？
interpretations.explanation: 哪一个人不随军出征？

interpretations.segmentation: Who is not called to go on campaign?
经营四方。
interpretations.explanation: 都在四方奔走劳役。

interpretations.segmentation: All are toiling and traveling throughout the four directions.
何草不玄？
interpretations.explanation: 哪一种草不变深黑？

interpretations.segmentation: What plant is not turning dark?
何人不矜？
interpretations.explanation: 哪一个人不遭忧患？

interpretations.segmentation: Who is not burdened with care?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang.pinyin: ai1 wo3 zheng1 fu1， du2 wei4 fei3 min2。

interpretations.segmentation: 哀我征夫，独为匪民。
interpretations.explanation: 可怜我们这些征夫，唯独像不是常人。

interpretations.segmentation: Pity us soldiers—we alone seem treated as less than human.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang.pinyin: fei3 si4 fei3 hu3， lv4 bi3 kuang4 ye3。

interpretations.segmentation: 匪兕匪虎，率彼旷野。
interpretations.explanation: 我们不是野牛也不是虎，却要在旷野上奔跑。

interpretations.segmentation: We are neither rhinos nor tigers, yet we are driven through the wild wastes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang.pinyin: ai1 wo3 zheng1 fu1， chao2 xi1 bu4 xia2。

interpretations.segmentation: 哀我征夫，朝夕不暇。
interpretations.explanation: 可怜我们这些征夫，从早到晚没有闲暇。

interpretations.segmentation: Pity us soldiers—we have no rest from morning till night.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang.pinyin: you3 peng2 zhe3 hu2， lv4 bi3 you1 cao3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有芃者狐，率彼幽草。
interpretations.explanation: 有蓬乱的狐狸，奔跑在深草中。

interpretations.segmentation: A shaggy fox runs through the deep grass.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang.pinyin: you3 zhan4 zhi1 che1， xing2 bi3 zhou1 dao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 有栈之车，行彼周道。
interpretations.explanation: 有栅栏高车的兵车，却行在大道上。

interpretations.segmentation: There are wagons with high sideboards, yet they travel the royal highway.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye.pinyin: fan1 fan1 hu4 ye4， cai3 zhi1 heng1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 幡幡瓠叶，采之亨之。
interpretations.explanation: 瓠叶轻轻摆动，采下来煮着吃。

interpretations.segmentation: Gourd leaves flutter; gather them and boil them to eat.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye.pinyin: jun1 zi you3 jiu3， zhuo2 yan2 chang2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子有酒，酌言尝之。
interpretations.explanation: 君子备有美酒，斟来请你先尝。

interpretations.segmentation: The host has fine wine; pour a cup and taste it first.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye.pinyin: you3 tu4 si1 shou3， pao4 zhi1 fan2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有兔斯首，炮之燔之。
interpretations.explanation: 有野兔一个头，烧烤又炙烤。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a hare's head, roasted and then broiled.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye.pinyin: jun1 zi you3 jiu3， zhuo2 yan2 xian4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子有酒，酌言献之。
interpretations.explanation: 君子备有美酒，斟来献给你。

interpretations.segmentation: The host has fine wine; pour and offer it to the guest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye.pinyin: you3 tu4 si1 shou3， fan2 zhi1 zhi4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有兔斯首，燔之炙之。
interpretations.explanation: 有野兔一个头，炙烤又烧烤。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a hare's head, broiled and roasted again.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye.pinyin: jun1 zi you3 jiu3， zhuo2 yan2 cu4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子有酒，酌言酢之。
interpretations.explanation: 君子备有美酒，斟来请你回敬。

interpretations.segmentation: The host has fine wine; pour for the guest to return the toast.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye.pinyin: you3 tu4 si1 shou3， fan2 zhi1 pao4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有兔斯首，燔之炮之。
interpretations.explanation: 有野兔一个头，烧烤又炮炙。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a hare's head, roasted by fire once more.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye.pinyin: jun1 zi you3 jiu3， zhuo2 yan2 chou2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子有酒，酌言酬之。
interpretations.explanation: 君子备有美酒，斟来相互酬答。

interpretations.segmentation: The host has fine wine; pour and exchange toasts in reply.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.pinyin: jian4 jian4 zhi1 shi2， wei2 qi2 gao1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 渐渐之石，维其高矣。
interpretations.explanation: 山石高峻陡峭，那是多么高啊。

interpretations.segmentation: The crags rise steep and high—how towering they are!

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.pinyin: shan1 chuan1 you1 yuan3， wei2 qi2 lao2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 山川悠远，维其劳矣。
interpretations.explanation: 山川路途遥远，征役多么劳苦。

interpretations.segmentation: Mountains and rivers stretch far; how weary the campaign is.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.pinyin: wu3 ren2 dong1 zheng1， bu4 huang2 chao2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 武人东征，不遑朝矣。
interpretations.explanation: 武士东征，连早晨的休整都顾不上。

interpretations.segmentation: The warriors march east and cannot even pause for morning rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.pinyin: jian4 jian4 zhi1 shi2， wei2 qi2 zu2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 渐渐之石，维其卒矣。
interpretations.explanation: 山石高峻陡峭，那是多么险啊。

interpretations.segmentation: The crags rise steep and perilous—how dangerous they are!

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.pinyin: shan1 chuan1 you1 yuan3， he2 qi2 mei2 yi3？

interpretations.segmentation: 山川悠远，曷其没矣？
interpretations.explanation: 山川路途遥远，何时才能走到尽头？

interpretations.segmentation: Mountains and rivers stretch far—when will we reach the end?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.pinyin: wu3 ren2 dong1 zheng1， bu4 huang2 chu1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 武人东征，不遑出矣。
interpretations.explanation: 武士东征，连出门的工夫都没有。

interpretations.segmentation: The warriors march east and have no leisure even to step outside.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.pinyin: you3 shi3 bai2 di2， zheng1 she4 bo1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 有豕白蹢，烝涉波矣。
interpretations.explanation: 有猪白蹄，成群涉水过河。

interpretations.segmentation: Pigs with white hooves wade the waves in herds.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.pinyin: yue4 li2 yu2 bi4， bi3 pang1 tuo2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 月离于毕，俾滂沱矣。
interpretations.explanation: 月亮靠近毕宿，于是大雨倾盆。

interpretations.segmentation: The moon nears the Net constellation, and torrents pour down.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.pinyin: wu3 ren2 dong1 zheng1， bu4 huang2 ta1 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 武人东征，不皇他矣。
interpretations.explanation: 武士东征，顾不上别的什么了。

interpretations.segmentation: The warriors march east and can think of nothing else.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: xing1 xing1 jiao3 gong1， pian1 qi2 fan3 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 骍骍角弓，翩其反矣。
interpretations.explanation: 调好的角弓，弓弦却松弛反曲。

interpretations.segmentation: The horn bow is strung, yet the string slackens and turns back.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: xiong1 di4 hun1 yin1， wu2 xu1 yuan3 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 兄弟婚姻，无胥远矣。
interpretations.explanation: 兄弟姻亲，不要彼此疏远。

interpretations.segmentation: Brothers and in-laws should not grow distant from one another.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: er3 zhi1 yuan3 yi3， min2 xu1 ran2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔之远矣，民胥然矣。
interpretations.explanation: 你疏远亲族，百姓也会跟着疏远。

interpretations.segmentation: When you keep kin at a distance, the people follow your example.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: er3 zhi1 jiao4 yi3， min2 xu1 xiao4 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 尔之教矣，民胥效矣。
interpretations.explanation: 你的教化如此，百姓也会照样仿效。

interpretations.segmentation: Whatever you teach, the people will imitate in turn.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: ci3 ling4 xiong1 di4， chuo4 chuo4 you3 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 此令兄弟，绰绰有裕。
interpretations.explanation: 这些贤良的兄弟，宽和而有余裕。

interpretations.segmentation: Good brothers are generous and ample in forbearance.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: bu4 ling4 xiong1 di4， jiao1 xiang1 wei4 yu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 不令兄弟，交相为愈。
interpretations.explanation: 不贤的兄弟，互相加害愈甚。

interpretations.segmentation: Wicked brothers only harm each other the more.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: min2 zhi1 wu2 liang2， xiang1 yuan4 yi1 fang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 民之无良，相怨一方。
interpretations.explanation: 人心不良，在同一处互相埋怨。

interpretations.segmentation: When hearts turn bad, they blame one another on the same side.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: shou4 jue2 bu4 rang4， zhi4 yu2 yi3 si1 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 受爵不让，至于已斯亡。
interpretations.explanation: 受爵却不谦让，最终会自取灭亡。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who accept rank without yielding bring ruin upon themselves.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: lao3 ma3 fan3 wei4 ju1， bu4 gu4 qi2 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 老马反为驹，不顾其后。
interpretations.explanation: 老马被当作驹马使唤，不顾身后祸患。

interpretations.segmentation: An old horse is treated like a colt, with no thought for what follows.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: ru2 shi2 yi2 yu4， ru2 zhuo2 kong3 qu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 如食宜饇，如酌孔取。
interpretations.explanation: 像吃饭该吃饱，像饮酒该适度。

interpretations.segmentation: As food should satisfy hunger, so drinking should stay within measure.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: wu2 jiao4 nao2 sheng1 mu4， ru2 tu2 tu2 fu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 毋教猱升木，如涂涂附。
interpretations.explanation: 不要教猴子爬树，（恶人）会像泥涂一样附上来。

interpretations.segmentation: Do not teach the ape to climb trees—evil will stick to you like mud on mud.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: jun1 zi you3 hui1 you2， xiao3 ren2 yu3 shu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 君子有徽猷，小人与属。
interpretations.explanation: 君子有善道，小人也来追随。

interpretations.segmentation: When the gentleman has a good path, petty men attach themselves to him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: yu3 xue3 biao1 biao1， jian4 xian4 yue1 xiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 雨雪瀌瀌，见晛曰消。
interpretations.explanation: 雨雪纷纷飘落，一见日头就说要化。

interpretations.segmentation: Snow falls thick; at the first sun they say it will melt.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: mo4 ken3 xia4 yi2， shi4 ju1 lou2 jiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 莫肯下遗，式居娄骄。
interpretations.explanation: 不肯向下施惠，反而居处骄慢。

interpretations.segmentation: They will not condescend to show kindness, but dwell in arrogance instead.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: yu3 xue3 fu2 fu2， jian4 xian4 yue1 liu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 雨雪浮浮，见晛曰流。
interpretations.explanation: 雨雪飘飘落下，一见日头就说要流走。

interpretations.segmentation: Snow drifts down; at the first sun they say it will run off.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong.pinyin: ru2 man2 ru2 mao2， wo3 shi4 yong4 you1。

interpretations.segmentation: 如蛮如髦，我是用忧。
interpretations.explanation: 像南蛮、像髠人，因此我深感忧虑。

interpretations.segmentation: Like southern barbarians, like shorn tribesmen—this is what fills me with care.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman.pinyin: mian2 man2 huang2 niao3， zhi3 yu2 qiu1 a1。

interpretations.segmentation: 绵蛮黄鸟，止于丘阿。
interpretations.explanation: 小小的黄鸟，停在山丘的弯曲处。

interpretations.segmentation: A small yellow bird rests on the bend of a hill.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman.pinyin: dao4 zhi1 yun2 yuan3， wo3 lao2 ru2 he2。

interpretations.segmentation: 道之云远，我劳如何。
interpretations.explanation: 道路那样遥远，我的劳苦怎么说得清。

interpretations.segmentation: The road is so far—how can I tell all my weariness?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman.pinyin: yin3 zhi1 shi2 zhi1， jiao4 zhi1 hui4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 饮之食之，教之诲之。
interpretations.explanation: 给他水喝给他饭吃，又教导又训诲。

interpretations.segmentation: Give him drink and food, and teach and instruct him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman.pinyin: ming4 bi3 hou4 che1， wei4 zhi1 zai4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 命彼后车，谓之载之。
interpretations.explanation: 命令后面的随从车，叫他们载他同行。

interpretations.segmentation: Tell the escort wagon behind to take him aboard.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman.pinyin: mian2 man2 huang2 niao3， zhi3 yu2 qiu1 yu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 绵蛮黄鸟，止于丘隅。
interpretations.explanation: 小小的黄鸟，停在山丘的角落。

interpretations.segmentation: A small yellow bird rests in the corner of a hill.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman.pinyin: qi3 gan3 dan4 xing2， wei4 bu4 neng2 qu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂敢惮行，畏不能趋。
interpretations.explanation: 哪敢怕走路，只怕赶不上队伍。

interpretations.segmentation: I dare not fear the journey—I fear I cannot keep up.
饮之食之。
interpretations.explanation: 给他水喝，给他饭吃。

interpretations.segmentation: Give him drink; give him food.
教之诲之。
interpretations.explanation: 又教导，又训诲。

interpretations.segmentation: Teach him; instruct him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman.pinyin: ming4 bi3 hou4 che1， wei4 zhi1 zai4 zhi1。

interpretations.explanation: 命令后面的随从车，叫他们载他同行。

interpretations.segmentation: 绵蛮黄鸟，止于丘侧。
interpretations.explanation: 小小的黄鸟，停在山丘旁边。

interpretations.segmentation: A small yellow bird rests beside the hill.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman.pinyin: qi3 gan3 dan4 xing2， wei4 bu4 neng2 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 岂敢惮行，畏不能极。
interpretations.explanation: 哪敢怕走路，只怕走不到终点。

interpretations.segmentation: I dare not fear the journey—I fear I cannot reach the end.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman.pinyin: yin3 zhi1 shi2 zhi1， jiao4 zhi1 hui4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 饮之食之，教之诲之。
interpretations.explanation: 给他水喝给他饭吃，又教导又训诲。

interpretations.segmentation: Give him drink and food, and teach and instruct him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman.pinyin: ming4 bi3 hou4 che1， wei4 zhi1 zai4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 命彼后车，谓之载之。
interpretations.explanation: 命令后面的随从车，叫他们载他同行。

interpretations.segmentation: Tell the escort wagon behind to take him aboard.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua.pinyin: shao2 zhi1 hua2， yun2 qi2 huang2 yi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 苕之华，芸其黄矣。
interpretations.explanation: 凌霄花开，已经变黄了。

interpretations.segmentation: The trumpet-creeper blooms have turned yellow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua.pinyin: xin1 zhi1 you1 yi3， wei2 qi2 shang1 yi3！

interpretations.segmentation: 心之忧矣，维其伤矣！
interpretations.explanation: 心中的忧愁，实在令人伤怀！

interpretations.segmentation: Sorrow in the heart—how deeply it wounds!

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua.pinyin: shao2 zhi1 hua2， qi2 ye4 qing1 qing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 苕之华，其叶青青。
interpretations.explanation: 凌霄花开，它的叶子还青青。

interpretations.segmentation: The trumpet-creeper's leaves are still fresh and green.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua.pinyin: zhi1 wo3 ru2 ci3， bu4 ru2 wu2 sheng1！

interpretations.segmentation: 知我如此，不如无生！
interpretations.explanation: 明知我落到这般境地，还不如不曾出生！

interpretations.segmentation: Knowing my plight as this, I wish I had never been born!

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua.pinyin: zang1 yang2 fen2 shou3， san1 xing1 zai4 liu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 牂羊坟首，三星在罶。
interpretations.explanation: 公羊头变大，三星已移到鱼笱旁。

interpretations.segmentation: A ram's head swells large while the Three Stars stand by the fish trap.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua.pinyin: ren2 ke3 yi3 shi2， xian1 ke3 yi3 bao3！

interpretations.segmentation: 人可以食，鲜可以饱！
interpretations.explanation: 人本来可以靠食物充饥，如今却难得吃饱！

interpretations.segmentation: People could live on food, yet now they can scarcely fill their bellies!

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao.pinyin: peng2 peng2 shu3 miao2， yin1 yu3 gao1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 芃芃黍苗，阴雨膏之。
interpretations.explanation: 黍苗长得茂盛，阴雨滋润它。

interpretations.segmentation: Millet shoots grow lush, nourished by rainy skies.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao.pinyin: you1 you1 nan2 xing2， zhao4 bo2 lao2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 悠悠南行，召伯劳之。
interpretations.explanation: 悠悠南行，召伯在那里慰劳众人。

interpretations.segmentation: Far south we travel; Lord Zhao labors there to comfort the people.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao.pinyin: wo3 ren4 wo3 nian3， wo3 che1 wo3 niu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 我任我辇，我车我牛。
interpretations.explanation: 我担我抬，我车我牛。

interpretations.segmentation: I bear loads and carry burdens; I have carts and oxen.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao.pinyin: wo3 xing2 ji4 ji2， gai4 yun2 gui1 zai1。

interpretations.segmentation: 我行既集，盖云归哉。
interpretations.explanation: 我的行程已经完成，该是回家的时候了。

interpretations.segmentation: My journey is done—it is time to turn homeward.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao.pinyin: wo3 tu2 wo3 yu4， wo3 shi1 wo3 lv3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我徒我御，我师我旅。
interpretations.explanation: 我徒我御，我师我旅。

interpretations.segmentation: My runners and drivers, my officers and troops.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao.pinyin: wo3 xing2 ji4 ji2， gai4 yun2 gui1 chu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 我行既集，盖云归处。
interpretations.explanation: 我的行程已经完成，该是归处的时候了。

interpretations.segmentation: My journey is done—it is time to settle and return.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao.pinyin: su4 su4 xie4 gong1， zhao4 bo2 ying2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 肃肃谢功，召伯营之。
interpretations.explanation: 谢地工程整齐完成，召伯营建它。

interpretations.segmentation: The work at Xie is finished in good order—Lord Zhao planned it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao.pinyin: lie4 lie4 zheng1 shi1， zhao4 bo2 cheng2 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 烈烈征师，召伯成之。
interpretations.explanation: 征师威武严整，召伯成全它。

interpretations.segmentation: The campaign host is bold and arrayed—Lord Zhao brought it to completion.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao.pinyin: yuan2 xi2 ji4 ping2， quan2 liu2 ji4 qing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 原隰既平，泉流既清。
interpretations.explanation: 原野和低地已经平整，泉流已经清澈。

interpretations.segmentation: Plains and lowlands are level; streams run clear.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao.pinyin: zhao4 bo2 you3 cheng2， wang2 xin1 ze2 ning2。

interpretations.segmentation: 召伯有成，王心则宁。
interpretations.explanation: 召伯功业有成，君王的心也就安宁了。

interpretations.segmentation: Lord Zhao's task succeeds, and the king's heart is at peace.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu.pinyin: you3 wan3 zhe3 liu3， bu4 shang4 xi1 yan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有菀者柳，不尚息焉。
interpretations.explanation: 有茂盛的柳树，却不许在它下面休息。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a lush willow, yet one may not rest beneath it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu.pinyin: shang4 di4 shen4 dao3， wu2 zi4 ni4 yan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 上帝甚蹈，无自暱焉。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝反复无常，不要自己亲近（他）。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven's ways are fickle—do not draw too close on your own.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu.pinyin: bi3 yu3 jing4 zhi1， hou4 yu3 ji2 yan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 俾予靖之，后予极焉。
interpretations.explanation: 当初让我安定国事，后来却使我遭祸。

interpretations.segmentation: First I was set to pacify the realm, then I was brought to ruin.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu.pinyin: you3 wan3 zhe3 liu3， bu4 shang4 kai4 yan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有菀者柳，不尚愒焉。
interpretations.explanation: 有茂盛的柳树，却不许在它下面歇息。

interpretations.segmentation: There is a lush willow, yet one may not linger beneath it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu.pinyin: shang4 di4 shen4 dao3， wu2 zi4 zhai4 yan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 上帝甚蹈，无自瘵焉。
interpretations.explanation: 上帝反复无常，不要自己招致病害。

interpretations.segmentation: Heaven's ways are fickle—do not invite affliction yourself.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu.pinyin: bi3 yu3 jing4 zhi1， hou4 yu3 mai4 yan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 俾予靖之，后予迈焉。
interpretations.explanation: 当初让我安定国事，后来却使我被放逐。

interpretations.segmentation: First I was set to pacify the realm, then I was cast far away.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu.pinyin: you3 niao3 gao1 fei1， yi4 fu4 yu2 tian1。

interpretations.segmentation: 有鸟高飞，亦傅于天。
interpretations.explanation: 有鸟高飞，也还要依附于天。

interpretations.segmentation: A bird soars high, yet still depends upon the sky.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu.pinyin: bi3 ren2 zhi1 xin1， yu2 he2 qi2 zhen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼人之心，于何其臻。
interpretations.explanation: 那个人的心思，究竟要走到哪一步？

interpretations.segmentation: That man's heart—how far will it go?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu.pinyin: he2 yu3 jing4 zhi1， ju1 yi3 xiong1 jin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 曷予靖之，居以凶矜。
interpretations.explanation: 为何让我安定国事，却居处凶险之地？

interpretations.segmentation: Why set me to pacify the state, only to leave me in peril?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang.pinyin: xi2 sang1 you3 a1， qi2 ye4 you3 nan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 隰桑有阿，其叶有难。
interpretations.explanation: 低湿之地有桑树，它的叶子多么柔美。

interpretations.segmentation: In the moist lowland stand mulberries; how lovely their leaves.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang.pinyin: ji4 jian4 jun1 zi， qi2 le4 ru2 he2。

interpretations.segmentation: 既见君子，其乐如何。
interpretations.explanation: 已经见到君子，快乐怎么说得尽。

interpretations.segmentation: I have met my lord—how boundless my joy!

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang.pinyin: xi2 sang1 you3 a1， qi2 ye4 you3 wo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 隰桑有阿，其叶有沃。
interpretations.explanation: 低湿之地有桑树，它的叶子多么润泽。

interpretations.segmentation: In the moist lowland stand mulberries; how lush and moist their leaves.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang.pinyin: ji4 jian4 jun1 zi， yun2 he2 bu4 le4。

interpretations.segmentation: 既见君子，云何不乐。
interpretations.explanation: 已经见到君子，怎能不快乐。

interpretations.segmentation: I have met my lord—how could I not rejoice?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang.pinyin: xi2 sang1 you3 a1， qi2 ye4 you3 you1。

interpretations.segmentation: 隰桑有阿，其叶有幽。
interpretations.explanation: 低湿之地有桑树，它的叶子多么深青。

interpretations.segmentation: In the moist lowland stand mulberries; how deep green their leaves.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang.pinyin: ji4 jian4 jun1 zi， de2 yin1 kong3 jiao1。

interpretations.segmentation: 既见君子，德音孔胶。
interpretations.explanation: 已经见到君子，他的德音多么和悦。

interpretations.segmentation: I have met my lord; his virtuous words are warm and binding.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang.pinyin: xin1 hu1 ai4 yi3， xia2 bu4 wei4 yi3？

interpretations.segmentation: 心乎爱矣，遐不谓矣？
interpretations.explanation: 心里多么爱他，为何不说出口？

interpretations.segmentation: My heart loves him so—why do I not speak it out?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang.pinyin: zhong1 xin1 cang2 zhi1， he2 ri4 wang4 zhi1！

interpretations.segmentation: 中心藏之，何日忘之！
interpretations.explanation: 藏在心中，哪一天能够忘记！

interpretations.segmentation: I hide it in my heart—what day could I ever forget!

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao.pinyin: yu2 zai4 zai4 zao3， you3 ban1 qi2 shou3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鱼在在藻，有颁其首。
interpretations.explanation: 鱼在水藻中游，头摆得很大。

interpretations.segmentation: Fish swim among the weeds, their heads held high and broad.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao.pinyin: wang2 zai4 zai4 gao3， qi3 le4 yin3 jiu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 王在在镐，岂乐饮酒。
interpretations.explanation: 王在镐京，安乐地饮酒。

interpretations.segmentation: The king is at Hao, drinking in ease and joy.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao.pinyin: yu2 zai4 zai4 zao3， you3 shen1 qi2 wei3。

interpretations.segmentation: 鱼在在藻，有莘其尾。
interpretations.explanation: 鱼在水藻中游，尾巴摆得很大。

interpretations.segmentation: Fish swim among the weeds, their tails spread wide.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao.pinyin: wang2 zai4 zai4 gao3， yin3 jiu3 le4 qi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 王在在镐，饮酒乐岂。
interpretations.explanation: 王在镐京，饮酒多么快乐。

interpretations.segmentation: The king is at Hao—how merry he is with his wine.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao.pinyin: yu2 zai4 zai4 zao3， yi1 yu2 qi2 pu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 鱼在在藻，依于其蒲。
interpretations.explanation: 鱼在水藻中游，依傍着蒲草。

interpretations.segmentation: Fish swim among the weeds, resting close to the rushes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao.pinyin: wang2 zai4 zai4 gao3， you3 na4 qi2 ju1。

interpretations.segmentation: 王在在镐，有那其居。
interpretations.explanation: 王在镐京，所居多么安适。

interpretations.segmentation: The king is at Hao; how pleasant and secure his dwelling.

szj-01.content: 人之初，性本善，性相近，习相远。
szj-01.pinyin: ren2 zhi1 chu1， xing4 ben3 shan4， xing4 xiang1 jin4， xi2 xiang1 yuan3。

interpretations.segmentation: 人之初，性本善，性相近，习相远。
interpretations.explanation: 人刚出生时，本性原是善良的；天性彼此相近，只因后天习染不同，才渐渐相差很远。

interpretations.segmentation: At birth, human nature is good; natures are alike, but habits drive people far apart.

szj-01.content: 苟不教，性乃迁，教之道，贵以专。
szj-01.pinyin: gou3 bu4 jiao4， xing4 nai3 qian1， jiao4 zhi1 dao4， gui4 yi3 zhuan1。

interpretations.segmentation: 苟不教，性乃迁，教之道，贵以专。
interpretations.explanation: 如果不好好教育，善良的本性就会改变；教育的方法，最要紧的是专心一贯。

interpretations.segmentation: Without teaching, that nature drifts; the way of teaching prizes focus and constancy.

szj-01.content: 昔孟母，择邻处，子不学，断机杼。
szj-01.pinyin: xi1 meng4 mu3， ze2 lin2 chu4， zi bu4 xue2， duan4 ji1 zhu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 昔孟母，择邻处，子不学，断机杼。
interpretations.explanation: 从前孟子的母亲为了孩子多次迁居选好邻居；孟子贪玩不学时，她割断织布机上的布来警醒他。

interpretations.segmentation: Mencius’s mother chose good neighbors; when he neglected study, she cut the loom to wake him.

szj-01.content: 窦燕山，有义方，教五子，名俱扬。
szj-01.pinyin: dou4 yan4 shan1， you3 yi4 fang1， jiao4 wu3 zi， ming2 ju4 yang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 窦燕山，有义方，教五子，名俱扬。
interpretations.explanation: 窦燕山懂得教子的正当方法，教育五个儿子，个个都扬名于世。

interpretations.segmentation: Dou Yanshan had a rightful way of teaching; he raised five sons, and all won renown.

szj-01.content: 养不教，父之过，教不严，师之惰。
szj-01.pinyin: yang3 bu4 jiao4， fu4 zhi1 guo4， jiao4 bu4 yan2， shi1 zhi1 duo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 养不教，父之过，教不严，师之惰。
interpretations.explanation: 只抚养而不教育，是父亲的过失；教育而不严格，是老师的怠惰。

interpretations.segmentation: To rear without teaching is a father’s fault; to teach without strictness is a teacher’s sloth.

szj-01.content: 子不学，非所宜，幼不学，老何为？
szj-01.pinyin: zi bu4 xue2， fei1 suo3 yi2， you4 bu4 xue2， lao3 he2 wei4？

interpretations.segmentation: 子不学，非所宜，幼不学，老何为？
interpretations.explanation: 孩子不肯学习，本就不对；小时候不学，长大了又能做什么？

interpretations.segmentation: For a child not to learn is wrong; if youth skips study, what can age achieve?

szj-01.content: 玉不琢，不成器，人不学，不知义。
szj-01.pinyin: yu4 bu4 zuo2， bu4 cheng2 qi4， ren2 bu4 xue2， bu4 zhi1 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 玉不琢，不成器，人不学，不知义。
interpretations.explanation: 玉不雕琢，就成不了器皿；人不学习，就不懂得道理与道义。

interpretations.segmentation: Jade uncarved cannot become a vessel; people untaught cannot know what is right.

szj-01.content: 为人子，方少时，亲师友，习礼仪。
szj-01.pinyin: wei4 ren2 zi， fang1 shao3 shi2， qin1 shi1 you3， xi2 li3 yi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 为人子，方少时，亲师友，习礼仪。
interpretations.explanation: 做子女的，正当年少时，要亲近老师朋友，学习礼仪规矩。

interpretations.segmentation: As a child, while still young, draw close to teachers and friends, and practice ritual and courtesy.

szj-01.content: 香九龄，能温席，孝于亲，所当执。
szj-01.pinyin: xiang1 jiu3 ling2， neng2 wen1 xi2， xiao4 yu2 qin1， suo3 dang1 zhi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 香九龄，能温席，孝于亲，所当执。
interpretations.explanation: 黄香九岁就能在寒冬为父亲暖被，孝敬父母，是人人应当践行的。

interpretations.segmentation: At nine, Huang Xiang warmed his father’s bed; filial care of parents is what one ought to keep.

szj-01.content: 融四岁，能让梨，悌于长，宜先知。
szj-01.pinyin: rong2 si4 sui4， neng2 rang4 li2， ti4 yu2 zhang3， yi2 xian1 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 融四岁，能让梨，悌于长，宜先知。
interpretations.explanation: 孔融四岁就懂得把大梨让给兄长，敬爱兄长的道理，应当尽早明白。

interpretations.segmentation: At four, Kong Rong yielded the larger pear; respect for elders should be learned first.

szj-01.content: 首孝弟，次见闻，知某数，识某文。
szj-01.pinyin: shou3 xiao4 di4， ci4 jian4 wen2， zhi1 mou3 shu4， shi2 mou3 wen2。

interpretations.segmentation: 首孝弟，次见闻，知某数，识某文。
interpretations.explanation: 首先要懂得孝悌，其次增长见闻；还要认识数字，识得文字。

interpretations.segmentation: First come filial piety and fraternal duty, then knowledge; know numbers and learn the written word.

szj-01.content: 一而十，十而百，百而千，千而万。
szj-01.pinyin: yi1 er2 shi2， shi2 er2 bai3， bai3 er2 qian1， qian1 er2 wan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 一而十，十而百，百而千，千而万。
interpretations.explanation: 从一到十，十到百，百到千，千到万，数目层层递进。

interpretations.segmentation: From one to ten, ten to a hundred, hundred to a thousand, thousand to ten thousand.

szj-01.content: 三才者，天地人，三光者，日月星。
szj-01.pinyin: san1 cai2 zhe3， tian1 di4 ren2， san1 guang1 zhe3， ri4 yue4 xing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 三才者，天地人，三光者，日月星。
interpretations.explanation: 所谓三才，就是天、地、人；所谓三光，就是日、月、星。

interpretations.segmentation: The Three Powers are Heaven, Earth, and Man; the Three Lights are sun, moon, and stars.

szj-01.content: 三纲者，君臣义，父子亲，夫妇顺。
szj-01.pinyin: san1 gang1 zhe3， jun1 chen2 yi4， fu4 zi qin1， fu1 fu4 shun4。

interpretations.segmentation: 三纲者，君臣义，父子亲，夫妇顺。
interpretations.explanation: 所谓三纲：君臣有义，父子相亲，夫妇和顺。

interpretations.segmentation: The Three Bonds: duty between ruler and subject, affection of father and child, harmony of husband and wife.

szj-01.content: 曰春夏，曰秋冬，此四时，运不穷。
szj-01.pinyin: yue1 chun1 xia4， yue1 qiu1 dong1， ci3 si4 shi2， yun4 bu4 qiong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 曰春夏，曰秋冬，此四时，运不穷。
interpretations.explanation: 春夏秋冬，这四季循环运转，没有穷尽。

interpretations.segmentation: Spring, summer, autumn, winter—the four seasons turn without end.

szj-01.content: 曰南北，曰西东，此四方，应乎中。
szj-01.pinyin: yue1 nan2 bei3， yue1 xi1 dong1， ci3 si4 fang1， ying1 hu1 zhong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 曰南北，曰西东，此四方，应乎中。
interpretations.explanation: 南北东西，这四方相对于中央而确定。

interpretations.segmentation: South, north, west, east—the four directions answer to the center.

szj-01.content: 曰水火，木金土，此五行，本乎数。
szj-01.pinyin: yue1 shui3 huo3， mu4 jin1 tu3， ci3 wu3 xing2， ben3 hu1 shu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 曰水火，木金土，此五行，本乎数。
interpretations.explanation: 水火木金土，这五行，本于天地自然之数。

interpretations.segmentation: Water, fire, wood, metal, earth—the Five Phases rest on number and order.

szj-01.content: 曰仁义，礼智信，此五常，不容紊。
szj-01.pinyin: yue1 ren2 yi4， li3 zhi4 xin4， ci3 wu3 chang2， bu4 rong2 wen3。

interpretations.segmentation: 曰仁义，礼智信，此五常，不容紊。
interpretations.explanation: 仁义礼智信，这五常，秩序不容混乱。

interpretations.segmentation: Benevolence, rightness, ritual, wisdom, trust—the Five Constants must not be disordered.

szj-01.content: 稻粱菽，麦黍稷，此六谷，人所食。
szj-01.pinyin: dao4 liang2 shu1， mai4 shu3 ji4， ci3 liu4 gu3， ren2 suo3 shi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 稻粱菽，麦黍稷，此六谷，人所食。
interpretations.explanation: 稻、粱、菽、麦、黍、稷，这六谷，是人们食用的粮食。

interpretations.segmentation: Rice, millet, beans, wheat, glutinous millet, and broomcorn—these six grains are what people eat.

szj-01.content: 马牛羊，鸡犬豕，此六畜，人所饲。
szj-01.pinyin: ma3 niu2 yang2， ji1 quan3 shi3， ci3 liu4 chu4， ren2 suo3 si4。

interpretations.segmentation: 马牛羊，鸡犬豕，此六畜，人所饲。
interpretations.explanation: 马、牛、羊、鸡、狗、猪，这六畜，是人们饲养的牲畜。

interpretations.segmentation: Horse, ox, sheep, chicken, dog, and pig—these six livestock are what people raise.

szj-01.content: 曰喜怒，曰哀惧，爱恶欲，七情具。
szj-01.pinyin: yue1 xi3 nu4， yue1 ai1 ju4， ai4 e4 yu4， qi1 qing2 ju4。

interpretations.segmentation: 曰喜怒，曰哀惧，爱恶欲，七情具。
interpretations.explanation: 喜、怒、哀、惧、爱、恶、欲，这七情人都具备。

interpretations.segmentation: Joy, anger, sorrow, fear, love, hate, and desire—the seven feelings are all in us.

szj-01.content: 匏土革，木石金，丝与竹，乃八音。
szj-01.pinyin: pao2 tu3 ge2， mu4 shi2 jin1， si1 yu3 zhu2， nai3 ba1 yin1。

interpretations.segmentation: 匏土革，木石金，丝与竹，乃八音。
interpretations.explanation: 匏、土、革、木、石、金、丝、竹，合称八音，是古代乐器的类别。

interpretations.segmentation: Gourd, clay, hide, wood, stone, metal, silk, and bamboo—these make the Eight Tones.

szj-01.content: 高曾祖，父而身，身而子，子而孙。
szj-01.pinyin: gao1 ceng2 zu3， fu4 er2 shen1， shen1 er2 zi， zi er2 sun1。

interpretations.segmentation: 高曾祖，父而身，身而子，子而孙。
interpretations.explanation: 从高祖、曾祖、祖父到父亲再到自己，自己再生儿子，儿子再生孙子。

interpretations.segmentation: From great-great-grandfather and great-grandfather to father and self, then son, then grandson.

szj-01.content: 自子孙，至玄曾，乃九族，人之伦。
szj-01.pinyin: zi4 zi sun1， zhi4 xuan2 ceng2， nai3 jiu3 zu2， ren2 zhi1 lun2。

interpretations.segmentation: 自子孙，至玄曾，乃九族，人之伦。
interpretations.explanation: 从子孙再传到玄孙、曾孙，共为九族，这是人伦的辈分。

interpretations.segmentation: From sons and grandsons on to great-great-grandsons—the nine degrees of kinship, the human order.

szj-01.content: 父子恩，夫妇从，兄则友，弟则恭。
szj-01.pinyin: fu4 zi en1， fu1 fu4 cong2， xiong1 ze2 you3， di4 ze2 gong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 父子恩，夫妇从，兄则友，弟则恭。
interpretations.explanation: 父子讲恩情，夫妇相随和顺，兄长友爱，弟弟恭敬。

interpretations.segmentation: Father and son share kindness; husband and wife concord; the elder brother is friendly, the younger respectful.

szj-01.content: 长幼序，友与朋，君则敬，臣则忠。
szj-01.pinyin: zhang3 you4 xu4， you3 yu3 peng2， jun1 ze2 jing4， chen2 ze2 zhong1。

interpretations.segmentation: 长幼序，友与朋，君则敬，臣则忠。
interpretations.explanation: 长幼有次序，朋友讲信义；君主要受人敬重，臣下应当忠诚。

interpretations.segmentation: Age keeps its order among kin and friends; the ruler is honored, the minister loyal.

szj-01.content: 此十义，人所同。
szj-01.pinyin: ci3 shi2 yi4， ren2 suo3 tong2。

interpretations.segmentation: 此十义，人所同。
interpretations.explanation: 以上十种伦理道义，是人人共同应当遵守的。

interpretations.segmentation: These ten duties are what people share in common.

szj-02.content: 凡训蒙，须讲究，详训诂，明句读。
szj-02.pinyin: fan2 xun4 meng2， xu1 jiang3 jiu1， xiang2 xun4 gu3， ming2 ju4 du2。

interpretations.segmentation: 凡训蒙，须讲究，详训诂，明句读。
interpretations.explanation: 凡是教导蒙童，必须讲究方法：详细讲解字词，分明句子的停顿。

interpretations.segmentation: In teaching the young, be careful: explain the glosses in detail and mark the pauses of the sentence.

szj-02.content: 为学者，必有初，小学终，至四书。
szj-02.pinyin: wei4 xue2 zhe3， bi4 you3 chu1， xiao3 xue2 zhong1， zhi4 si4 shu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 为学者，必有初，小学终，至四书。
interpretations.explanation: 求学一定要有起点：先学完小学（文字训诂），再进而读四书。

interpretations.segmentation: Learners must begin at the start: finish the elementary learning, then go on to the Four Books.

szj-02.content: 论语者，二十篇，群弟子，记善言。
szj-02.pinyin: lun4 yu3 zhe3， er4 shi2 pian1， qun2 di4 zi， ji4 shan4 yan2。

interpretations.segmentation: 论语者，二十篇，群弟子，记善言。
interpretations.explanation: 《论语》共二十篇，是孔子门下弟子记录老师嘉言的书。

interpretations.segmentation: The Analects has twenty chapters; the disciples recorded the Master’s good words.

szj-02.content: 孟子者，七篇止，讲道德，说仁义。
szj-02.pinyin: meng4 zi zhe3， qi1 pian1 zhi3， jiang3 dao4 de2， shuo1 ren2 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 孟子者，七篇止，讲道德，说仁义。
interpretations.explanation: 《孟子》只有七篇，讲的是道德修养，阐发仁义之道。

interpretations.segmentation: Mencius stops at seven books; it teaches moral virtue and speaks of benevolence and right.

szj-02.content: 作中庸，子思笔，中不偏，庸不易。
szj-02.pinyin: zuo4 zhong1 yong1， zi si1 bi3， zhong1 bu4 pian1， yong1 bu4 yi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 作中庸，子思笔，中不偏，庸不易。
interpretations.explanation: 《中庸》是子思所写：中是不偏不倚，庸是平常不易之理。

interpretations.segmentation: The Doctrine of the Mean was written by Zisi: the Mean is not leaning; the Constant does not change.

szj-02.content: 作大学，乃曾子，自修齐，至平治。
szj-02.pinyin: zuo4 da4 xue2， nai3 ceng2 zi， zi4 xiu1 qi2， zhi4 ping2 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 作大学，乃曾子，自修齐，至平治。
interpretations.explanation: 《大学》是曾子所作，从修身齐家讲到治国平天下。

interpretations.segmentation: The Great Learning is by Zengzi: from self-cultivation and ordering the family to governing and pacifying all under Heaven.

szj-02.content: 孝经通，四书熟，如六经，始可读。
szj-02.pinyin: xiao4 jing1 tong1， si4 shu1 shu2， ru2 liu4 jing1， shi3 ke3 du2。

interpretations.segmentation: 孝经通，四书熟，如六经，始可读。
interpretations.explanation: 《孝经》通晓、四书熟读之后，才可以开始阅读六经。

interpretations.segmentation: When the Classic of Filial Piety is clear and the Four Books familiar, one may begin the Six Classics.

szj-02.content: 诗书易，礼春秋，号六经，当讲求。
szj-02.pinyin: shi1 shu1 yi4， li3 chun1 qiu1， hao4 liu4 jing1， dang1 jiang3 qiu2。

interpretations.segmentation: 诗书易，礼春秋，号六经，当讲求。
interpretations.explanation: 《诗》《书》《易》《礼》《春秋》等合称六经，应当用心研读。

interpretations.segmentation: Poetry, Documents, Changes, Rites, and Spring and Autumn—called the Six Classics—deserve careful study.

szj-02.content: 有连山，有归藏，有周易，三易祥。
szj-02.pinyin: you3 lian2 shan1， you3 gui1 cang2， you3 zhou1 yi4， san1 yi4 xiang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 有连山，有归藏，有周易，三易祥。
interpretations.explanation: 有《连山》、有《归藏》、有《周易》，三部易书内容详备。

interpretations.segmentation: There are the Lianshan, the Guicang, and the Zhouyi—the three Changes, complete and clear.

szj-02.content: 有典谟，有训诰，有誓命，书之奥。
szj-02.pinyin: you3 dian3 mo2， you3 xun4 gao4， you3 shi4 ming4， shu1 zhi1 ao4。

interpretations.segmentation: 有典谟，有训诰，有誓命，书之奥。
interpretations.explanation: 典、谟、训、诰、誓、命，是《尚书》中深奥的文体类别。

interpretations.segmentation: Canons, counsels, instructions, announcements, oaths, and charges—the deep forms of the Documents.

szj-02.content: 我周公，作周礼，著六官，存治体。
szj-02.pinyin: wo3 zhou1 gong1， zuo4 zhou1 li3， zhu4 liu4 guan1， cun2 zhi4 ti3。

interpretations.segmentation: 我周公，作周礼，著六官，存治体。
interpretations.explanation: 周公作《周礼》，设立六官制度，保存了治国的体制。

interpretations.segmentation: The Duke of Zhou made the Rites of Zhou, set out the Six Offices, and preserved the form of government.

szj-02.content: 大小戴，注礼记，述圣言，礼乐备。
szj-02.pinyin: da4 xiao3 dai4， zhu4 li3 ji4， shu4 sheng4 yan2， li3 le4 bei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 大小戴，注礼记，述圣言，礼乐备。
interpretations.explanation: 大戴、小戴为《礼记》作注，记述圣人言论，礼乐于是完备。

interpretations.segmentation: The Elder and Younger Dai annotated the Record of Rites, transmitting the sages’ words; ritual and music are complete.

szj-02.content: 曰国风，曰雅颂，号四诗，当讽咏。
szj-02.pinyin: yue1 guo2 feng1， yue1 ya3 song4， hao4 si4 shi1， dang1 feng3 yong3。

interpretations.segmentation: 曰国风，曰雅颂，号四诗，当讽咏。
interpretations.explanation: 国风、雅、颂合称四诗，应当讽诵吟咏。

interpretations.segmentation: The Airs, the Odes, and the Hymns—called the Four Songs—ought to be chanted and sung.

szj-02.content: 诗既亡，春秋作，寓褒贬，别善恶。
szj-02.pinyin: shi1 ji4 wang2， chun1 qiu1 zuo4， yu4 bao1 bian3， bie2 shan4 e4。

interpretations.segmentation: 诗既亡，春秋作，寓褒贬，别善恶。
interpretations.explanation: 采诗的风气衰亡后，孔子作《春秋》，寄托褒贬，分辨善恶。
