interpretations.segmentation: When the Songs declined, the Spring and Autumn was made: it embeds praise and blame, and sorts good from evil.

szj-02.content: 三传者，有公羊，有左氏，有谷梁。
szj-02.pinyin: san1 chuan2 zhe3， you3 gong1 yang2， you3 zuo3 shi4， you3 gu3 liang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 三传者，有公羊，有左氏，有谷梁。
interpretations.explanation: 解说《春秋》的三传，有《公羊传》《左传》《谷梁传》。

interpretations.segmentation: The three commentaries are the Gongyang, the Zuo, and the Guliang.

szj-02.content: 经既明，方读子，撮其要，记其事。
szj-02.pinyin: jing1 ji4 ming2， fang1 du2 zi， cuo1 qi2 yao4， ji4 qi2 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 经既明，方读子，撮其要，记其事。
interpretations.explanation: 经典明白之后，才读诸子；抓住要点，记住其中的事迹道理。

interpretations.segmentation: When the classics are clear, then read the philosophers: grasp the essentials and remember their affairs.

szj-02.content: 五子者，有荀扬，文中子，及老庄。
szj-02.pinyin: wu3 zi zhe3， you3 xun2 yang2， wen2 zhong1 zi， ji2 lao3 zhuang1。

interpretations.segmentation: 五子者，有荀扬，文中子，及老庄。
interpretations.explanation: 五子指荀子、扬子、文中子，以及老子、庄子。

interpretations.segmentation: The five masters include Xun and Yang, Master Wenzhong, and also Laozi and Zhuangzi.

szj-03.content: 经子通，读诸史，考世系，知终始。
szj-03.pinyin: jing1 zi tong1， du2 zhu1 shi3， kao3 shi4 xi4， zhi1 zhong1 shi3。

interpretations.segmentation: 经子通，读诸史，考世系，知终始。
interpretations.explanation: 经书和子书通晓后，再读各种史书：考察世系传承，明白朝代的终始。

interpretations.segmentation: When classics and philosophers are clear, read the histories: examine lineages and know how dynasties begin and end.

szj-03.content: 自羲农，至黄帝，号三皇，居上世。
szj-03.pinyin: zi4 xi1 nong2， zhi4 huang2 di4， hao4 san1 huang2， ju1 shang4 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 自羲农，至黄帝，号三皇，居上世。
interpretations.explanation: 从伏羲、神农到黄帝，合称三皇，处于上古之世。

interpretations.segmentation: From Fu Xi and Shen Nong to the Yellow Emperor—called the Three Sovereigns—they belong to high antiquity.

szj-03.content: 唐有虞，号二帝，相揖逊，称盛世。
szj-03.pinyin: tang2 you3 yu2， hao4 er4 di4， xiang1 yi1 xun4， cheng1 sheng4 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 唐有虞，号二帝，相揖逊，称盛世。
interpretations.explanation: 唐尧、虞舜称为二帝，禅让相传，被称作太平盛世。

interpretations.segmentation: Tang Yao and Yu Shun are called the Two Emperors; they yielded the throne in turn—an age called flourishing.

szj-03.content: 夏有禹，商有汤，周文武，称三王。
szj-03.pinyin: xia4 you3 yu3， shang1 you3 tang1， zhou1 wen2 wu3， cheng1 san1 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 夏有禹，商有汤，周文武，称三王。
interpretations.explanation: 夏禹、商汤、周文王与武王，合称三王。

interpretations.segmentation: Yu of Xia, Tang of Shang, and Kings Wen and Wu of Zhou are called the Three Kings.

szj-03.content: 夏传子，家天下，四百载，迁夏社。
szj-03.pinyin: xia4 chuan2 zi， jia1 tian1 xia4， si4 bai3 zai4， qian1 xia4 she4。

interpretations.segmentation: 夏传子，家天下，四百载，迁夏社。
interpretations.explanation: 夏朝传位给儿子，变为家天下；约四百年后，夏朝社稷迁易灭亡。

interpretations.segmentation: Xia passed the throne to sons—a family realm; after some four hundred years, Xia’s altars fell.

szj-03.content: 汤伐夏，国号商，六百载，至纣亡。
szj-03.pinyin: tang1 fa2 xia4， guo2 hao4 shang1， liu4 bai3 zai4， zhi4 zhou4 wang2。

interpretations.segmentation: 汤伐夏，国号商，六百载，至纣亡。
interpretations.explanation: 商汤讨伐夏桀，国号为商；约六百年传到纣王而亡。

interpretations.segmentation: Tang struck down Xia and named the realm Shang; after some six hundred years it ended with Zhou.

szj-03.content: 周武王，始诛纣，八百载，最长久。
szj-03.pinyin: zhou1 wu3 wang2， shi3 zhu1 zhou4， ba1 bai3 zai4， zui4 zhang3 jiu3。

interpretations.segmentation: 周武王，始诛纣，八百载，最长久。
interpretations.explanation: 周武王诛灭纣王，周朝延续约八百年，最为长久。

interpretations.segmentation: King Wu of Zhou first slew Zhou of Shang; for some eight hundred years Zhou lasted longest.

szj-03.content: 周撤东，王纲坠，逞干戈，尚游说。
szj-03.pinyin: zhou1 che4 dong1， wang2 gang1 zhui4， cheng3 gan4 ge1， shang4 you2 shuo1。

interpretations.segmentation: 周撤东，王纲坠，逞干戈，尚游说。
interpretations.explanation: 周室东迁后，王权纲纪坠落，诸侯动用武力，游说之士盛行。

interpretations.segmentation: When Zhou moved east, the royal order fell; arms were flaunted, and traveling persuaders thrived.

szj-03.content: 始春秋，终战国，五霸强，七雄出。
szj-03.pinyin: shi3 chun1 qiu1， zhong1 zhan4 guo2， wu3 ba4 qiang2， qi1 xiong2 chu1。

interpretations.segmentation: 始春秋，终战国，五霸强，七雄出。
interpretations.explanation: 从春秋到战国：先有五霸称强，后有七雄并起。

interpretations.segmentation: From Spring and Autumn to the Warring States: the Five Hegemons rose strong, then the Seven Powers emerged.

szj-03.content: 嬴秦氏，始兼并，传二世，楚汉争。
szj-03.pinyin: ying2 qin2 shi4， shi3 jian1 bing4， chuan2 er4 shi4， chu3 han4 zheng1。

interpretations.segmentation: 嬴秦氏，始兼并，传二世，楚汉争。
interpretations.explanation: 秦国嬴氏开始兼并天下，只传二世，便陷入楚汉相争。

interpretations.segmentation: The Ying house of Qin first united the realm; after two reigns came the struggle of Chu and Han.

szj-03.content: 高祖兴，汉业建，至孝平，王莽篡。
szj-03.pinyin: gao1 zu3 xing1， han4 ye4 jian4， zhi4 xiao4 ping2， wang2 mang3 cuan4。

interpretations.segmentation: 高祖兴，汉业建，至孝平，王莽篡。
interpretations.explanation: 汉高祖兴起，建立汉朝基业；传到汉平帝时，被王莽篡夺。

interpretations.segmentation: Gaozu rose and founded the Han; by Emperor Ping, Wang Mang usurped the throne.

szj-03.content: 光武兴，为东汉，四百年，终于献。
szj-03.pinyin: guang1 wu3 xing1， wei4 dong1 han4， si4 bai3 nian2， zhong1 yu2 xian4。

interpretations.segmentation: 光武兴，为东汉，四百年，终于献。
interpretations.explanation: 光武帝兴起，建立东汉；前后约四百年，到汉献帝时终结。

interpretations.segmentation: Guangwu rose and made the Eastern Han; some four hundred years later it ended with Emperor Xian.

szj-03.content: 魏蜀吴，争汉鼎，号三国，迄两晋。
szj-03.pinyin: wei4 shu3 wu2， zheng1 han4 ding3， hao4 san1 guo2， qi4 liang3 jin4。

interpretations.segmentation: 魏蜀吴，争汉鼎，号三国，迄两晋。
interpretations.explanation: 魏、蜀、吴争夺汉朝天下，称为三国，其后进入两晋。

interpretations.segmentation: Wei, Shu, and Wu fought for Han’s cauldron—called the Three Kingdoms—until the two Jin.

szj-03.content: 宋齐继，梁陈承，为南朝，都金陵。
szj-03.pinyin: song4 qi2 ji4， liang2 chen2 cheng2， wei4 nan2 chao2， dou1 jin1 ling2。

interpretations.segmentation: 宋齐继，梁陈承，为南朝，都金陵。
interpretations.explanation: 宋、齐相继，梁、陈承接，合称南朝，都城在金陵。

interpretations.segmentation: Song and Qi followed, Liang and Chen continued—the Southern Dynasties, capital at Jinling.

szj-03.content: 北元魏，分东西，宇文周，与高齐。
szj-03.pinyin: bei3 yuan2 wei4， fen1 dong1 xi1， yu3 wen2 zhou1， yu3 gao1 qi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 北元魏，分东西，宇文周，与高齐。
interpretations.explanation: 北方有元魏，后来分成东魏、西魏；又有宇文氏的北周与高氏的北齐。

interpretations.segmentation: In the north, the Yuan Wei split east and west; then came the Yuwen Zhou and the Gao Qi.

szj-03.content: 迨至隋，一土宇，不再传，失统绪。
szj-03.pinyin: dai4 zhi4 sui2， yi1 tu3 yu3， bu4 zai4 chuan2， shi1 tong3 xu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 迨至隋，一土宇，不再传，失统绪。
interpretations.explanation: 到了隋朝统一天下，却未能再传多久，便失去了统治的统绪。

interpretations.segmentation: When Sui came, it unified the land; it did not pass on long, and lost the thread of rule.

szj-03.content: 唐高祖，起义师，除隋乱，创国基。
szj-03.pinyin: tang2 gao1 zu3， qi3 yi4 shi1， chu2 sui2 luan4， chuang4 guo2 ji1。

interpretations.segmentation: 唐高祖，起义师，除隋乱，创国基。
interpretations.explanation: 唐高祖起兵起义，扫除隋末乱局，开创唐朝国基。

interpretations.segmentation: Gaozu of Tang raised righteous troops, cleared Sui’s chaos, and laid the dynasty’s foundation.

szj-03.content: 二十传，三百载，梁灭之，国乃改。
szj-03.pinyin: er4 shi2 chuan2， san1 bai3 zai4， liang2 mie4 zhi1， guo2 nai3 gai3。

interpretations.segmentation: 二十传，三百载，梁灭之，国乃改。
interpretations.explanation: 唐朝传二十代、约三百年，后梁灭唐，国号于是改变。

interpretations.segmentation: Through twenty reigns and some three hundred years, Liang destroyed it and the state was renamed.

szj-03.content: 梁唐晋，及汉周，称五代，皆有由。
szj-03.pinyin: liang2 tang2 jin4， ji2 han4 zhou1， cheng1 wu3 dai4， jie1 you3 you2。

interpretations.segmentation: 梁唐晋，及汉周，称五代，皆有由。
interpretations.explanation: 后梁、后唐、后晋、后汉、后周，合称五代，各有兴替的缘由。

interpretations.segmentation: Liang, Tang, Jin, Han, and Zhou—called the Five Dynasties—each had its cause.

szj-03.content: 炎宋兴，受周禅，十八传，南北混。
szj-03.pinyin: yan2 song4 xing1， shou4 zhou1 chan2， shi2 ba1 chuan2， nan2 bei3 hun4。

interpretations.segmentation: 炎宋兴，受周禅，十八传，南北混。
interpretations.explanation: 赵宋兴起，接受后周禅让；传十八帝，经历北宋与南宋。

interpretations.segmentation: The fiery Song rose, receiving Zhou’s abdication; through eighteen reigns north and south were joined in one story.

szj-03.content: 辽与金，皆称帝，元灭金，绝宋世。
szj-03.pinyin: liao2 yu3 jin1， jie1 cheng1 di4， yuan2 mie4 jin1， jue2 song4 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 辽与金，皆称帝，元灭金，绝宋世。
interpretations.explanation: 辽与金都称帝；元朝灭金，又断绝了宋朝的国祚。

interpretations.segmentation: Liao and Jin both claimed the imperial title; Yuan destroyed Jin and cut off the Song.

szj-03.content: 莅中国，兼戎狄，九十年，国祚废。
szj-03.pinyin: li4 zhong1 guo2， jian1 rong2 di2， jiu3 shi2 nian2， guo2 zuo4 fei4。

interpretations.segmentation: 莅中国，兼戎狄，九十年，国祚废。
interpretations.explanation: 元朝入主中原，兼统边疆各族，约九十年后国运废止。

interpretations.segmentation: It entered the Central States and ruled the border peoples too; after some ninety years the mandate failed.

szj-03.content: 太祖兴，国大明，号洪武，都金陵。
szj-03.pinyin: tai4 zu3 xing1， guo2 da4 ming2， hao4 hong2 wu3， dou1 jin1 ling2。

interpretations.segmentation: 太祖兴，国大明，号洪武，都金陵。
interpretations.explanation: 明太祖兴起，建立大明，年号洪武，定都金陵。

interpretations.segmentation: Taizu rose and founded Great Ming; his reign title was Hongwu, the capital Jinling.

szj-03.content: 迨成祖，迁燕京，十七世，至崇祯。
szj-03.pinyin: dai4 cheng2 zu3， qian1 yan4 jing1， shi2 qi1 shi4， zhi4 chong2 zhen1。

interpretations.segmentation: 迨成祖，迁燕京，十七世，至崇祯。
interpretations.explanation: 到明成祖迁都燕京；明朝传十七世，直到崇祯。

interpretations.segmentation: When Chengzu came, the capital moved to Yanjing; through seventeen reigns it reached Chongzhen.

szj-03.content: 权阉肆，寇如林，至李闯，神器焚。
szj-03.pinyin: quan2 yan1 si4， kou4 ru2 lin2， zhi4 li3 chuang3， shen2 qi4 fen2。

interpretations.segmentation: 权阉肆，寇如林，至李闯，神器焚。
interpretations.explanation: 权阉横行，盗寇如林；到李自成起事，明朝帝位倾覆。

interpretations.segmentation: Eunuch power ran wild and bandits thronged; with Li Zicheng the sacred vessel was burned.

szj-03.content: 清太祖，膺景命，靖四方，克大定。
szj-03.pinyin: qing1 tai4 zu3， ying1 jing3 ming4， jing4 si4 fang1， ke4 da4 ding4。

interpretations.segmentation: 清太祖，膺景命，靖四方，克大定。
interpretations.explanation: 清太祖承受天命，平定四方，使天下大体安定。

interpretations.segmentation: Taizu of Qing received the bright mandate, pacified the four quarters, and brought great order.

szj-03.content: 廿一史，全在兹，载治乱，知兴衰。
szj-03.pinyin: nian4 yi1 shi3， quan2 zai4 zi1， zai4 zhi4 luan4， zhi1 xing1 shuai1。

interpretations.segmentation: 廿一史，全在兹，载治乱，知兴衰。
interpretations.explanation: 二十一史都在这里概括：记载治乱，使人知道兴衰的道理。

interpretations.segmentation: The twenty-one histories are all here in sum: they record order and chaos, so we know rise and fall.

szj-03.content: 读史者，考实录，通古今，若亲目。
szj-03.pinyin: du2 shi3 zhe3， kao3 shi2 lu4， tong1 gu3 jin1， ruo4 qin1 mu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 读史者，考实录，通古今，若亲目。
interpretations.explanation: 读史的人要考察实录，贯通古今，如同亲眼看见一般。

interpretations.segmentation: Readers of history should examine the veritable records, master past and present as if seeing with their own eyes.

szj-04.content: 口而诵，心而惟，朝于斯，夕于斯。
szj-04.pinyin: kou3 er2 song4， xin1 er2 wei2， chao2 yu2 si1， xi1 yu2 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 口而诵，心而惟，朝于斯，夕于斯。
interpretations.explanation: 口里诵读，心里思考；早晨在此用功，晚上也在此用功。

interpretations.segmentation: Recite with the mouth, reflect with the mind; morning and evening, keep to this.

szj-04.content: 昔仲尼，师项橐，古圣贤，尚勤学。
szj-04.pinyin: xi1 zhong4 ni2， shi1 xiang4 tuo2， gu3 sheng4 xian2， shang4 qin2 xue2。

interpretations.segmentation: 昔仲尼，师项橐，古圣贤，尚勤学。
interpretations.explanation: 从前孔子也曾向项橐请教；古代圣贤尚且勤奋好学。

interpretations.segmentation: Once Confucius took Xiang Tuo as teacher; even the ancient sages still studied hard.

szj-04.content: 赵中令，读鲁论，彼既仕，学且勤。
szj-04.pinyin: zhao4 zhong1 ling4， du2 lu3 lun4， bi3 ji4 shi4， xue2 qie3 qin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 赵中令，读鲁论，彼既仕，学且勤。
interpretations.explanation: 赵普做中书令后仍读《论语》；已经做官，学习依然勤奋。

interpretations.segmentation: Zhao the Grand Councilor still read the Lu Analects; already in office, he kept studying diligently.

szj-04.content: 披蒲编，削竹简，彼无书，且知勉。
szj-04.pinyin: pi1 pu2 bian1， xue1 zhu2 jian3， bi3 wu2 shu1， qie3 zhi1 mian3。

interpretations.segmentation: 披蒲编，削竹简，彼无书，且知勉。
interpretations.explanation: 有人用蒲草编书、削竹为简；他们没有现成书籍，尚且知道勉励自己。

interpretations.segmentation: Some wove reed books and pared bamboo slips; without ready books, they still knew to strive.

szj-04.content: 头悬梁，锥刺股，彼不教，自勤苦。
szj-04.pinyin: tou2 xuan2 liang2， zhui1 ci4 gu3， bi3 bu4 jiao4， zi4 qin2 ku3。

interpretations.segmentation: 头悬梁，锥刺股，彼不教，自勤苦。
interpretations.explanation: 有人头发悬梁、锥子刺股来驱赶睡意；并非别人逼迫，而是自己勤苦。

interpretations.segmentation: Some hung by the hair from a beam or pricked the thigh with an awl; unprodded by others, they drove themselves hard.

szj-04.content: 如囊萤，如映雪，家虽贫，学不辍。
szj-04.pinyin: ru2 nang2 ying2， ru2 ying4 xue3， jia1 sui1 pin2， xue2 bu4 chuo4。

interpretations.segmentation: 如囊萤，如映雪，家虽贫，学不辍。
interpretations.explanation: 像车胤囊萤、孙康映雪那样借光读书；家虽贫穷，学业并不中断。

interpretations.segmentation: Like gathering fireflies in a bag or reading by snow-light: though poor, they did not stop learning.

szj-04.content: 如负薪，如挂角，身虽劳，犹苦卓。
szj-04.pinyin: ru2 fu4 xin1， ru2 gua4 jiao3， shen1 sui1 lao2， you2 ku3 zhuo2。

interpretations.segmentation: 如负薪，如挂角，身虽劳，犹苦卓。
interpretations.explanation: 像负薪读书、挂角诵经那样；身体虽然劳苦，志向依然卓绝。

interpretations.segmentation: Like carrying firewood or hanging books on the horns: though the body toiled, the will stayed firm.

szj-04.content: 苏老泉，二十七，始发奋，读书籍。
szj-04.pinyin: su1 lao3 quan2， er4 shi2 qi1， shi3 fa1 fen4， du2 shu1 ji2。

interpretations.segmentation: 苏老泉，二十七，始发奋，读书籍。
interpretations.explanation: 苏老泉二十七岁才发愤读书。

interpretations.segmentation: Su Laoquan at twenty-seven first set his mind and began to read.

szj-04.content: 彼既老，犹悔迟，尔小生，宜早思。
szj-04.pinyin: bi3 ji4 lao3， you2 hui3 chi2， er3 xiao3 sheng1， yi2 zao3 si1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼既老，犹悔迟，尔小生，宜早思。
interpretations.explanation: 他年纪已经不小还后悔起步太迟；你们后生，应当及早用心。

interpretations.segmentation: Though already older, he still regretted delay; you young students should think early.

szj-04.content: 若梁灏，八十二，对大廷，魁多士。
szj-04.pinyin: ruo4 liang2 hao4， ba1 shi2 er4， dui4 da4 ting2， kui2 duo1 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 若梁灏，八十二，对大廷，魁多士。
interpretations.explanation: 像梁灏八十二岁还能在朝廷对策，考取第一。

interpretations.segmentation: Like Liang Hao at eighty-two: he answered at the great court and headed the scholars.

szj-04.content: 彼既成，众称异，尔小生，宜立志。
szj-04.pinyin: bi3 ji4 cheng2， zhong4 cheng1 yi4， er3 xiao3 sheng1， yi2 li4 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼既成，众称异，尔小生，宜立志。
interpretations.explanation: 他成功后众人惊叹称奇；你们后生，应当立定志向。

interpretations.segmentation: When he succeeded, all called it wondrous; you young students should set your will.

szj-04.content: 莹八岁，能咏诗，泌七岁，能赋棋。
szj-04.pinyin: ying2 ba1 sui4， neng2 yong3 shi1， mi4 qi1 sui4， neng2 fu4 qi2。

interpretations.segmentation: 莹八岁，能咏诗，泌七岁，能赋棋。
interpretations.explanation: 祖莹八岁就能咏诗，李泌七岁就能作棋赋。

interpretations.segmentation: Ying at eight could chant verse; Bi at seven could compose on chess.

szj-04.content: 彼颖悟，人称奇，尔幼学，当效之。
szj-04.pinyin: bi3 ying3 wu4， ren2 cheng1 qi2， er3 you4 xue2， dang1 xiao4 zhi1。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼颖悟，人称奇，尔幼学，当效之。
interpretations.explanation: 他们聪颖过人，被人称作奇才；你们幼年求学，应当效法。

interpretations.segmentation: Their quick wit was called marvelous; you who study young should take them as models.

szj-04.content: 蔡文姬，能辨琴，谢道韫，能咏吟。
szj-04.pinyin: cai4 wen2 ji1， neng2 bian4 qin2， xie4 dao4 yun4， neng2 yong3 yin2。

interpretations.segmentation: 蔡文姬，能辨琴，谢道韫，能咏吟。
interpretations.explanation: 蔡文姬善于辨识琴音，谢道韫善于咏诗吟诵。

interpretations.segmentation: Cai Wenji could judge the qin; Xie Daoyun could chant and sing.

szj-04.content: 彼女子，且聪敏，尔男子，当自警。
szj-04.pinyin: bi3 nv3 zi， qie3 cong1 min3， er3 nan2 zi， dang1 zi4 jing3。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼女子，且聪敏，尔男子，当自警。
interpretations.explanation: 她们身为女子尚且聪明敏慧；你们男子，更当自我警醒。

interpretations.segmentation: Those girls were already clever and keen; you boys should wake yourselves.

szj-04.content: 唐刘晏，方七岁，举神童，作正字。
szj-04.pinyin: tang2 liu2 yan4， fang1 qi1 sui4， ju3 shen2 tong2， zuo4 zheng4 zi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 唐刘晏，方七岁，举神童，作正字。
interpretations.explanation: 唐朝刘晏才七岁，就被举为神童，担任正字官职。

interpretations.segmentation: Liu Yan of Tang, only seven, was named a prodigy and made Corrector of Characters.

szj-04.content: 彼虽幼，身已仕，尔幼学，勉而致。
szj-04.pinyin: bi3 sui1 you4， shen1 yi3 shi4， er3 you4 xue2， mian3 er2 zhi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 彼虽幼，身已仕，尔幼学，勉而致。
interpretations.explanation: 他年纪虽小已经做官；你们幼年求学，也当勉力达到。

interpretations.segmentation: Though young, he already held office; you who study young should strive to reach it.

szj-04.content: 有为者，亦若是。
szj-04.pinyin: you3 wei4 zhe3， yi4 ruo4 shi4。

interpretations.segmentation: 有为者，亦若是。
interpretations.explanation: 有作为的人，也能像他们一样。

interpretations.segmentation: Those who act with purpose can be like this too.

szj-04.content: 犬守夜，鸡司晨，苟不学，曷为人？
szj-04.pinyin: quan3 shou3 ye4， ji1 si1 chen2， gou3 bu4 xue2， he2 wei4 ren2？

interpretations.segmentation: 犬守夜，鸡司晨，苟不学，曷为人？
interpretations.explanation: 狗会守夜，鸡会报晓；人如果不肯学习，还怎么算人？

interpretations.segmentation: Dogs keep the night, roosters announce the dawn; if one will not learn, how be called human?

szj-04.content: 蚕吐丝，蜂酿蜜，人不学，不如物。
szj-04.pinyin: can2 tu3 si1， feng1 niang4 mi4， ren2 bu4 xue2， bu4 ru2 wu4。

interpretations.segmentation: 蚕吐丝，蜂酿蜜，人不学，不如物。
interpretations.explanation: 蚕能吐丝，蜂能酿蜜；人若不学习，连这些小物都不如。

interpretations.segmentation: Silkworms spin silk, bees make honey; if people will not learn, they fall short of these creatures.

szj-04.content: 幼而学，壮而行，上致君，下泽民。
szj-04.pinyin: you4 er2 xue2， zhuang4 er2 xing2， shang4 zhi4 jun1， xia4 ze2 min2。

interpretations.segmentation: 幼而学，壮而行，上致君，下泽民。
interpretations.explanation: 幼年努力学习，壮年付诸实行：对上辅佐君主，对下造福百姓。

interpretations.segmentation: Learn in youth, act in prime: above, serve the ruler; below, benefit the people.

szj-04.content: 扬名声，显父母，光于前，裕于后。
szj-04.pinyin: yang2 ming2 sheng1， xian3 fu4 mu3， guang1 yu2 qian2， yu4 yu2 hou4。

interpretations.segmentation: 扬名声，显父母，光于前，裕于后。
interpretations.explanation: 使自己声名远扬，让父母荣耀；光耀前人，又惠及后代。

interpretations.segmentation: Raise your name, honor your parents; shed light on those before, and enrich those who follow.

szj-04.content: 人遗子，金满籯，我教子，惟一经。
szj-04.pinyin: ren2 yi2 zi， jin1 man3 ying2， wo3 jiao4 zi， wei2 yi1 jing1。

interpretations.segmentation: 人遗子，金满籯，我教子，惟一经。
interpretations.explanation: 别人留给子孙满箱黄金；我教育孩子，只传一部经书。

interpretations.segmentation: Others leave their sons a chest of gold; I teach my child one classic alone.

szj-04.content: 勤有功，戏无益，戒之哉，宜勉力。
szj-04.pinyin: qin2 you3 gong1， xi4 wu2 yi4， jie4 zhi1 zai1， yi2 mian3 li4。

interpretations.segmentation: 勤有功，戏无益，戒之哉，宜勉力。
interpretations.explanation: 勤奋就有功效，嬉戏没有益处；要警戒啊，应当努力自勉。

interpretations.segmentation: Diligence brings merit; play brings none—take warning, and strive with all your strength.

ddj-01-01.explanation: 可以用言辞表述的「道」，就不是那永恒不变的道。强调道超言绝象，不可被概念完全固定。
ddj-01-01.note: 通行读法：以「可道／非常道」相对。

terms.explanation: 本源、规律、道路；此处指终极之「道」。
可以说、可以用言语称说。

terms.note: 「非」否定；「常」永恒。帛书本作「非恒道」。

ddj-01-01.explanation: 另作一读：先标举「道」，再言「可道」者皆非恒道。
ddj-01-01.note: 较少见的断法，用来对照理解「道」与「可道」的层次。

terms.explanation: 凡可称说者，皆不是永恒之道。
terms.note: 将「可道非常道」作一整段判断。

ddj-01-01.segmentation: The Way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way;
यः मार्गः वक्तुं शक्यते स नित्यमार्गः न भवति;

ddj-01-02.explanation: 可以用名号固定下来的「名」，就不是那永恒的名。与上句「道／名」对举。
ddj-01-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

terms.explanation: 名称、名相，用以指称事物。

ddj-01-02.note: 异读：与上句「道，可道…」同构。

ddj-01-02.segmentation: The name that can be named is not the constant name.
यं नाम वक्तुं शक्यते तन्नित्यनाम न भवति।

ddj-01-03.explanation: 就「无」这一面说，可以称之为天地的开始。
ddj-01-03.note: 王弼读法：在「无／有」处断读。

terms.explanation: 无形无名的面向；与「有」相对。

ddj-01-03.explanation: 「无名」即天地之始。把「无名」视为一词。
ddj-01-03.note: 今教材常见读法：以「无名／有名」为对。

ddj-01-03.segmentation: The nameless is the beginning of Heaven and Earth;

ddj-01-04.explanation: 就「有」这一面说，可以称之为万物的母亲。

ddj-01-04.segmentation: The named is the mother of the myriad things.

ddj-01-05.explanation: 所以常从「无」的欲望状态去观照道的精微。
所以要常保持无欲，才能观照道的奥妙。

ddj-01-05.segmentation: Therefore, constantly without desire, one observes its subtlety;
तस्माद् नित्यम् अकरणेन तस्य गुह्यत्वं द्रष्टुं शक्यते;

ddj-01-06.explanation: 常从「有」的一面去观照道的边际、显象。

terms.explanation: 用以观照道之端倪、边际。

ddj-01-06.explanation: 常就「有欲」的状态，观照道的端倪。

ddj-01-06.segmentation: Constantly with desire, one observes its manifestations.
नित्यम् इच्छया तस्य प्रकाशं द्रष्टुं शक्यते।

ddj-01-07.segmentation: 此两者同出而异名，同谓之玄。
ddj-01-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-01-07.segmentation: These two emerge together but differ in name; together they are called the Mystery.
इदमुभयं एकस्माद् उत्थितम् अन्यनाम, उभयं गुह्यम् इति उच्यते।

ddj-01-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-01-08.segmentation: Mystery upon mystery—the gateway of all wonders.

ddj-02-01.segmentation: 天下皆知美之为美，斯恶已；
ddj-02-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-02-01.segmentation: When all under Heaven know beauty as beauty, then ugliness is already there;
जगति सर्वे सौन्दर्यं सौन्दर्यम् इति जानन्ति, तदा कुरूपता अस्त्येव;

ddj-02-02.segmentation: 皆知善之为善，斯不善已。
ddj-02-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-02-02.segmentation: When all know good as good, then what is not good is already there.
सर्वे शुभं शुभम् इति जानन्ति, तदा अशुभम् अस्त्येव।

ddj-02-03.segmentation: 故有无相生，难易相成，长短相形，高下相倾，音声相和，前后相随。
ddj-02-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-02-03.segmentation: Thus being and non-being give birth to each other; difficult and easy complete each other; long and short shape each other; high and low lean on each other; tone and voice harmonize with each other; front and back follow each other.
तस्मात् सदसत् परस्परं जनयति, कठिनं सुलभं च परस्परं पूरयति, दीर्घं ह्रस्वं च आकारयति, उन्नतं नीचं च आश्रित्यते, ध्वनिरन्तरं सङ्गच्छति, पूर्वम् अपरं च अनुगच्छति।

ddj-02-04.segmentation: 是以圣人处无为之事，行不言之教。
ddj-02-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-02-04.segmentation: Therefore the sage abides in affairs of non-action and practices the teaching without words.
तस्मात् मुनिः निष्क्रियतायां स्थित्वा अनुदितोपदेशं चरति।

ddj-02-05.segmentation: 万物作焉而不辞，生而不有，为而不恃，功成而弗居。
ddj-02-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-02-05.segmentation: The myriad things arise and he does not turn them away; he gives life but does not possess; he acts but does not rely; when the work is done he does not dwell on it.
सर्वाणि भूतानि उत्पद्यन्ते न च निवारयति, जीवयति न च स्वीकरोति, करोति न च आश्रयति, कर्म समाप्तं न च तिष्ठति।

ddj-02-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-02-06.segmentation: Precisely because he does not dwell on it, it does not leave him.
यस्माद् न तिष्ठति तस्मात् न त्यजति।

ddj-03-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-03-01.segmentation: Do not exalt the worthy, and the people will not contend;
आर्यान् न स्तूयेत, लोकः न स्पर्धते;

ddj-03-02.segmentation: 不贵难得之货，使民不为盗；
ddj-03-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-03-02.segmentation: Do not prize rare goods, and the people will not become thieves;
दुर्लभवस्तून् न मह्येत, लोकः न चौर्यं करोति;

ddj-03-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-03-03.segmentation: Do not display what can be desired, and the people's hearts will not be disturbed.
इच्छनीयं न दर्शयेत, लोकचित्तं न व्याकुलीभवति।

ddj-03-04.segmentation: 是以圣人之治，虚其心，实其腹；
ddj-03-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-03-04.segmentation: Therefore the sage's way of governing empties their minds and fills their bellies;
तस्मात् मुनेः शासनं चित्तं शून्यं करोति, उदरं पूर्णं;

ddj-03-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-03-05.segmentation: Weakens their ambitions and strengthens their bones.

ddj-03-06.segmentation: 常使民无知无欲，使夫智者不敢为也。
ddj-03-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-03-06.segmentation: He constantly keeps the people without knowledge and without desire, so that the clever dare not act.
नित्यं लोकं अज्ञानमकामं करोति, प्राज्ञाः न प्रवर्तन्ते।

ddj-03-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-03-07.segmentation: Act by non-action, and nothing will be left ungoverned.

ddj-04-01.segmentation: 道冲而用之或不盈，渊兮似万物之宗。
ddj-04-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-04-01.segmentation: The Way is empty, yet use it and it is never filled; how deep it is, as if the ancestor of the myriad things.
मार्गः शून्यः, उपयोगेन न पूर्णः, गम्भीरः सर्वभूतप्रपितृवत्।

ddj-04-02.segmentation: 挫其锐，解其纷，和其光，同其尘。
ddj-04-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-04-02.segmentation: Blunt the sharpness, untie the tangles, soften the glare, and merge with the dust.
तीक्ष्णतां नमयति, बन्धं विसृजति, प्रभां मृदुयति, धूलिसहितः समवायी भवति।

ddj-04-03.segmentation: 湛兮似或存，吾不知谁之子，象帝之先。
ddj-04-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-04-03.segmentation: How deep and clear it seems to endure; I do not know whose child it is—it appears to precede the Lord.
गम्भीरः स्थायीव मन्यते, न जानामि कस्य सन्तानः, स्वर्गात् पूर्वम् प्रतिभाति।

ddj-05-01.segmentation: 天地不仁，以万物为刍狗；
ddj-05-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-05-01.segmentation: Heaven and Earth are not humane; they treat the myriad things as straw dogs;
द्यौः पृथिवी च न दयालु, सर्वभूतानि तृणमृगवत्;

ddj-05-02.segmentation: 圣人不仁，以百姓为刍狗。
ddj-05-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-05-02.segmentation: The sage is not humane; he treats the hundred clans as straw dogs.

ddj-05-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-05-03.segmentation: Is the space between Heaven and Earth not like a bellows?

ddj-05-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-05-04.segmentation: Empty yet inexhaustible; the more it moves, the more it yields.
शून्या च न शीर्यते, चलनेन अधिकं निर्यति।

ddj-05-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-05-05.segmentation: Much talking leads to exhaustion; better to hold to the center.
बहु भाषणं क्षयाय, मध्यस्थानं रक्षितुं श्रेयः।

ddj-06-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-06-01.segmentation: The spirit of the valley never dies; this is called the mysterious female.

ddj-06-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-06-02.segmentation: The gateway of the mysterious female is called the root of Heaven and Earth.

ddj-06-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-06-03.segmentation: Continuous and as if enduring, use it and it is never worn out.

ddj-07-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-07-01.segmentation: Heaven is lasting and Earth endures.

ddj-07-02.segmentation: 天地所以能长且久者，以其不自生，故能长生。
ddj-07-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-07-02.segmentation: The reason Heaven and Earth can last and endure is that they do not live for themselves; thus they can live long.
द्यावापृथिव्योः दीर्घायुषः कारणं स्वार्थं न जीवनम्, तस्मात् दीर्घजीविनौ।

ddj-07-03.segmentation: 是以圣人后其身而身先，外其身而身存。
ddj-07-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-07-03.segmentation: Therefore the sage puts his person behind and yet it comes first; sets his person aside and yet it is preserved.
तस्मात् मुनिः आत्मानं पश्चात् कृत्वा अग्रे भवति, बहिः कृत्वा तिष्ठति।

ddj-07-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-07-04.segmentation: Is it not because he is without self-interest?

ddj-07-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-07-05.segmentation: Thus he is able to accomplish his own ends.

ddj-08-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-08-01.segmentation: The highest good is like water.

ddj-08-02.segmentation: 水善利万物而不争，处众人之所恶，故几于道。
ddj-08-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-08-02.segmentation: Water benefits the myriad things and does not contend; it dwells in places the multitude dislike—thus it is close to the Way.
जलं सर्वभूतानि हित्वा न स्पर्धते, जनानाम् अप्रिये स्थाने, मार्गनिकटम्।

ddj-08-03.segmentation: 居善地，心善渊，与善仁，言善信，政善治，事善能，动善时。
ddj-08-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-08-03.segmentation: In dwelling, good is the low place; in mind, good is depth; in giving, good is kindness; in speech, good is trustworthiness; in government, good is order; in affairs, good is ability; in action, good is timing.
निवासे नीचं शुभम्, चित्ते गम्भीरता, दाने दया, वचसि सत्यम्, राज्ये व्यवस्था, कार्ये कौशलम्, चेष्टायां समयः।

ddj-08-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-08-04.segmentation: Precisely because it does not contend, it is without blame.
यस्माद् न स्पर्धते तस्माद् न दोषः।

ddj-09-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-09-01.segmentation: To hold and fill it to the brim is not as good as stopping;

ddj-09-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-09-02.segmentation: To hammer and sharpen it cannot keep it long.
घट्टयित्वा तीक्ष्णं कर्तुं दीर्घकालं न स्थातुं शक्यते।

ddj-09-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-09-03.segmentation: A hall filled with gold and jade cannot be guarded;

ddj-09-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-09-04.segmentation: Wealth and rank with arrogance bring their own calamity.

ddj-09-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-09-05.segmentation: When the work is done, withdraw—this is the Way of Heaven.
कर्म समाप्तम्, शरीरं निवर्त, द्योः मार्गः।

ddj-10-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-10-01.segmentation: In carrying the soul and embracing the One, can you keep from parting?
आत्मानं धारयन् एकं गृहाण, विभक्तिं वर्जयितुं शक्यते?

ddj-10-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-10-02.segmentation: In concentrating the breath and making it soft, can you become as an infant?
प्राणं केन्द्रित्वा मृदुं कुर्वन् बालवत् भवितुं शक्यते?

ddj-10-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-10-03.segmentation: In cleansing and purifying the mysterious mirror, can you be without blemish?

ddj-10-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-10-04.segmentation: In loving the people and governing the state, can you practice non-action?
जनान् प्रेम्णा राज्यं शासन् अकरणेन कर्तुं शक्यते?

ddj-10-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-10-05.segmentation: In the opening and closing of Heaven's gate, can you take the female part?
द्योद्वारस्य उद्घाटने संवरणे, प्रकृतिवत् भवितुं शक्यते?

ddj-10-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-10-06.segmentation: In understanding that reaches in all directions, can you be without knowledge?

ddj-11-01.segmentation: 三十辐共一毂，当其无，有车之用。
ddj-11-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-11-01.segmentation: Thirty spokes share one hub; it is in the empty space that the use of the cart lies.
त्रिंशत् अराः एकनाभौ, शून्ये रथस्य उपयोगः।

ddj-11-02.segmentation: 埏埴以为器，当其无，有器之用。
ddj-11-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-11-02.segmentation: Knead clay to make a vessel; it is in the empty space that the use of the vessel lies.
मृत्तिकां लम्बयित्वा पात्रं, शून्ये पात्रस्य उपयोगः।

ddj-11-03.segmentation: 凿户牖以为室，当其无，有室之用。
ddj-11-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-11-03.segmentation: Cut doors and windows to make a room; it is in the empty space that the use of the room lies.
द्वारजालानि कृत्वा गेहे, शून्ये गेहस्य उपयोगः।

ddj-11-04.segmentation: 故有之以为利，无之以为用。
ddj-11-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-11-04.segmentation: Therefore what is has benefit; what is not has use.

ddj-12-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-12-01.segmentation: The five colors make people's eyes blind;

ddj-12-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-12-02.segmentation: The five tones make people's ears deaf;

ddj-12-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-12-03.segmentation: The five flavors make people's mouths dull;

ddj-12-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-12-04.segmentation: Racing and hunting make people's hearts go mad;

ddj-12-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-12-05.segmentation: Goods hard to obtain make people's conduct go astray.

ddj-12-06.segmentation: 是以圣人为腹不为目，故去彼取此。
ddj-12-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-12-06.segmentation: Therefore the sage provides for the belly, not for the eyes; thus he discards that and takes this.
तस्मात् मुनिः उदराय कार्यं करोति नेत्राय न, तत् त्यजति इदं गृह्णाति।

ddj-13-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-13-01.segmentation: Favor and disgrace are alike startling; value great trouble as you value your body.
प्रसादअपमानौ सममेव भयङ्करौ, महापदं शरीरवत् मह्यताम्;

ddj-13-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-13-02.segmentation: What is meant by "favor and disgrace are alike startling"?

ddj-13-03.segmentation: 宠为下，得之若惊，失之若惊，是谓宠辱若惊。
ddj-13-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-13-03.segmentation: Favor is lowly: gaining it startles, losing it startles—this is what is meant by favor and disgrace being alike startling.
प्रसादः नीचः, प्राप्तौ भयं, हानौ भयं, एष प्रसादअपमानयोः समभयः।

ddj-13-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-13-04.segmentation: What is meant by "value great trouble as you value your body"?

ddj-13-05.segmentation: 吾所以有大患者，为吾有身，及吾无身，吾有何患？
ddj-13-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-13-05.segmentation: The reason I have great trouble is that I have a body; if I had no body, what trouble would I have?
मम महापदस्य कारणं शरीरम्, शरीररहितः किं पीडां प्राप्नुयाम्?

ddj-13-06.segmentation: 故贵以身为天下，若可寄天下；
ddj-13-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-13-06.segmentation: Therefore, one who values the world as he values his body may be entrusted with the world;
तस्मात् यः शरीरवत् जगन्तं मह्यते, तस्मै जगद् समर्प्यते;

ddj-13-07.segmentation: 爱以身为天下，若可托天下。
ddj-13-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-13-07.segmentation: One who loves the world as he loves his body may be given charge of the world.
यः शरीरवत् जगन्तं प्रेमति, तस्य जगद् न्यस्तम्।

ddj-14-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-14-01.segmentation: Look at it and you do not see it—it is called the Invisible;

ddj-14-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-14-02.segmentation: Listen to it and you do not hear it—it is called the Inaudible;

ddj-14-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-14-03.segmentation: Grasp at it and you do not get it—it is called the Intangible.

ddj-14-04.segmentation: 此三者不可致诘，故混而为一。
ddj-14-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-14-04.segmentation: These three cannot be further inquired into; therefore they merge and become one.
इमे त्रयः न पृष्टुं शक्याः, तस्मात् मिलित्वा एकं भवन्ति।

ddj-14-05.segmentation: 其上不皦，其下不昧，绳绳兮不可名，复归于无物。
ddj-14-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-14-05.segmentation: 其上不皦，其下不昧。绳绳兮不可名，复归于无物。
ddj-14-05.note: 异读：在「不昧」后作更大停顿。

ddj-14-05.segmentation: Above it is not bright; below it is not dark; continuous and unnameable, it returns again to no-thing.
ऊर्ध्वं न तेजस्वि, अधः न तमः, सततम् अनाम, पुनः अवस्तुषु प्रत्येति।

ddj-14-06.segmentation: 是谓无状之状，无物之象，是谓惚恍。
ddj-14-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-14-06.segmentation: This is called the form of the formless, the image of no-thing—this is called the Vague and Elusive.

ddj-14-07.segmentation: 迎之不见其首，随之不见其后。
ddj-14-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-14-07.segmentation: Meet it and you see no front; follow it and you see no rear.
सम्मुखं गच्छन् अग्रं न दृश्यते, पृष्ठतः गच्छन् पश्चात् न दृश्यते।

ddj-14-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-14-08.segmentation: Hold to the Way of old to master the things of today.

ddj-14-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-14-09.segmentation: To be able to know the ancient beginning—this is called the thread of the Way.
प्राचीनस्य आरम्भं ज्ञातुं शक्नुवन्, मार्गस्य सूत्रमित्युच्यते।

ddj-15-01.segmentation: 古之善为道者，微妙玄通，深不可识。
ddj-15-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-15-01.segmentation: Those of old who were good at practicing the Way were subtle, mysterious, penetrating, and too deep to be known.
पुरातनाः मार्गे दक्षाः सूक्ष्मगुह्यसमग्राः, गम्भीरा अज्ञेयाः।

ddj-15-02.segmentation: 夫唯不可识，故强为之容：豫兮若冬涉川；
ddj-15-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-15-02.segmentation: Precisely because they cannot be known, one can only force a description: Cautious, as if crossing a winter stream;
यस्माद् अज्ञेयाः, बलात् वर्णनम्, सावधानः शीतनदीतरणवत्;

ddj-15-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-15-03.segmentation: Hesitant, as if fearing the neighbors on all sides;

ddj-15-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-15-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-15-05.segmentation: Yielding, like ice about to melt;

ddj-15-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-15-06.segmentation: Simple and genuine, like uncarved wood;

ddj-15-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-15-07.segmentation: Open and broad, like a valley;

ddj-15-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-15-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-15-09.segmentation: Who can take the muddy and, by stillness, gradually make it clear?
कः कलुषं शान्त्या क्रमेण शुद्धं करोति?

ddj-15-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-15-10.segmentation: Who can take the settled and, by long movement, gradually bring it to life?

ddj-15-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-15-11.segmentation: Those who preserve this Way do not desire to be full.
एतं मार्गं रक्षन्तः न पूर्णं इच्छन्ति।

ddj-15-12.segmentation: 夫唯不盈，故能蔽不新成。
ddj-15-12.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-15-12.segmentation: Precisely because they are not full, they can be worn and yet newly made.
यस्माद् न पूर्णाः, जीर्णाः च नूतनाः च भवन्ति।

ddj-16-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-16-01.segmentation: Attain utmost emptiness; hold firmly to stillness.
परमं शून्यं प्राप्नु, शान्तिं दृढं रक्ष।

ddj-16-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-16-02.segmentation: The myriad things arise together; I watch their return.
सर्वाणि भूतानि उत्तिष्ठन्ति, अहं प्रत्यागमनं पश्यामि।

ddj-16-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-16-03.segmentation: Things flourish in abundance, yet each returns to its root.

ddj-16-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-16-04.segmentation: Returning to the root is called stillness; stillness is called returning to destiny.

ddj-16-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-16-05.segmentation: Returning to destiny is called the Constant; knowing the Constant is called insight.

ddj-16-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-16-06.segmentation: Not knowing the Constant, one acts recklessly and meets with misfortune.
नित्यं न ज्ञात्वा मिथ्या कुर्वन् दुःखं प्राप्नुयात्।

ddj-16-07.segmentation: 知常容，容乃公，公乃王，王乃天，天乃道，道乃久，没身不殆。
ddj-16-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-16-07.segmentation: Knowing the Constant, one is tolerant; tolerance leads to impartiality; impartiality leads to kingliness; kingliness leads to Heaven; Heaven leads to the Way; the Way leads to permanence—to the end of life one is without danger.
नित्यं ज्ञात्वा सहिष्णु, सहिष्णुता समत्वं, समत्वात् राजत्वं, राजत्वात् स्वर्गः, स्वर्गात् मार्गः, मार्गात् चिरस्थितिः, जीवनान्तं न भयम्।

ddj-17-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-17-01.segmentation: Of the highest, those below merely know that he exists;
उत्तमाधिपतौ, अधः जनाः केवलं अस्तीतिं जानन्ति;

ddj-17-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-17-02.segmentation: Of the next, they draw near and praise him;

ddj-17-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-17-03.segmentation: Of the next, they fear him;

ddj-17-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-17-04.segmentation: Of the next, they insult him.

ddj-17-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-17-05.segmentation: When trust is insufficient, there is distrust.

ddj-17-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-17-06.segmentation: How leisurely he is, sparing of his words.

ddj-17-07.segmentation: 功成事遂，百姓皆谓我自然。
ddj-17-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-17-07.segmentation: When the work is done and affairs succeed, the hundred clans all say, "We did this ourselves."
कर्म समाप्तं, कार्यं सिद्धम्, जनाः स्वकृतमित्येव भाषन्ते।

ddj-18-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-18-01.segmentation: When the Great Way is abandoned, there are benevolence and righteousness;

ddj-18-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-18-02.segmentation: When wisdom and cleverness appear, there is great hypocrisy;

ddj-18-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-18-03.segmentation: When the six relations are not in harmony, there are filial piety and parental kindness;

ddj-18-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-18-04.segmentation: When the state is in disorder, there are loyal ministers.

ddj-19-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-19-01.segmentation: Abolish sagehood and discard wisdom, and the people will benefit a hundredfold;
मुनित्वं त्यज प्रज्ञां च, लोकः शतगुणं लभते;

ddj-19-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-19-02.segmentation: Abolish benevolence and discard righteousness, and the people will return to filial piety and kindness;
दयां धर्मार्धतां च त्यज, लोकः पितृपुत्रस्नेहम पुनराव्रजति;

ddj-19-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-19-03.segmentation: Abolish cleverness and discard profit, and there will be no thieves.
चातुर्यं त्यज लाभं च, चोराः न सन्ति।

ddj-19-04.segmentation: 此三者以为文不足，故令有所属：见素抱朴，少私寡欲。
ddj-19-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-19-04.segmentation: These three, taken as outward culture, are not enough; therefore let people have something to hold to: look to the plain and embrace the uncarved; lessen self-interest and reduce desire.
एतत् त्रयं बाह्योपासनया अल्पम्, अतो लोकस्य आश्रयो भवेत्; शुक्लम् अवलम्य अनकृतं गृह्णाति, स्वार्थं न्यूनम्, इच्छां च न्यूनाम्।

ddj-20-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-01.segmentation: Abolish learning, and there will be no sorrow.

ddj-20-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-03.segmentation: How far is good from evil?

ddj-20-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-04.segmentation: What people fear cannot but be feared.

ddj-20-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-05.segmentation: How desolate—it has not yet reached its end!

ddj-20-06.segmentation: 众人熙熙，如享太牢，如春登台。
ddj-20-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-06.segmentation: The multitude are merry, as if enjoying a great feast, as if climbing a terrace in spring.
बहवः प्रहर्षन्ति, महायज्तभोजनवत्, वसन्तसोपाने आरोहणवत् इव।

ddj-20-07.segmentation: 我独泊兮其未兆，如婴儿之未孩。
ddj-20-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-07.segmentation: I alone am still, without sign—like an infant that has not yet smiled.
अहमेकः शान्तः, अङ्कितं न, बालस्य हासरहितवत्।

ddj-20-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-08.segmentation: Weary and forlorn, as if I had nowhere to return.

ddj-20-09.segmentation: 众人皆有余，而我独若遗。
ddj-20-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-09.segmentation: The multitude all have more than enough, while I alone seem to have lost.

ddj-20-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-10.segmentation: I have the mind of a fool indeed!

ddj-20-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-12.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-12.segmentation: Ordinary people are bright and clear; I alone am dull and confused;

ddj-20-13.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-13.segmentation: Ordinary people are sharp and discerning; I alone am closed and muffled.

ddj-20-14.segmentation: 澹兮其若海，飂兮若无止。
ddj-20-14.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-14.segmentation: Calm as the sea, drifting as if without end.

ddj-20-15.segmentation: 众人皆有以，而我独顽似鄙。
ddj-20-15.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-15.segmentation: The multitude all have purpose, while I alone am stubborn and rustic.

ddj-20-16.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-20-16.segmentation: I alone differ from others, and value drawing nourishment from the Mother.
अहमेकः अन्येभ्यो भिन्नः, मातुः पोषणं मह्यते।

ddj-21-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-21-01.segmentation: The bearing of great virtue follows only the Way.

ddj-21-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-21-02.segmentation: As a thing, the Way is only elusive and vague.
मार्गः वस्तु भूत्वा, केवलं सन्दिग्धः एव सन्दिग्धः।

ddj-21-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-21-03.segmentation: Vague and elusive—within it there is image;
सन्दिग्धः, सन्दिग्धः — तस्य अन्तः आकृतिः अस्ति;

ddj-21-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-21-04.segmentation: Elusive and vague—within it there is substance.
सन्दिग्धः, सन्दिग्धः — तस्य अन्तः वस्तु अस्ति।

ddj-21-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-21-05.segmentation: Deep and dark—within it there is essence;
गम्भीरः, तमः — तस्य अन्तः सारः अस्ति;

ddj-21-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-21-06.segmentation: Its essence is most true; within it there is trust.
तस्य सारः अत्यन्तं सत्यः; तस्य अन्तः विश्वासः अस्ति।

ddj-21-07.segmentation: 自今及古，其名不去，以阅众甫。
ddj-21-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-21-07.segmentation: From the present back to antiquity, its name has not departed; by it one surveys the beginnings of the multitude.
अद्यात् प्राचीनकालं यावत्, तस्य नाम न विच्युतम्; तेन बहूनां आदीन् अवलोकयति।

ddj-21-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-21-08.segmentation: How do I know the form of the beginnings of the multitude?

ddj-21-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-22-01.segmentation: 曲则全，枉则直，洼则盈，敝则新，少则得，多则惑。
ddj-22-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-22-01.segmentation: Bent, then whole; crooked, then straight; hollow, then full; worn, then new; little, then gain; much, then confusion.
वक्रः, तर्हि पूर्णः; विकृतः, तर्हि ऋजुः; निम्नः, तर्हि पूर्णः; जीर्णः, तर्हि नवः; अल्पं, तर्हि लभ्यते; बहु, तर्हि मोहः।

ddj-22-02.segmentation: 是以圣人抱一为天下式。
ddj-22-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-22-02.segmentation: Therefore the sage embraces the One and becomes the model for all under Heaven.
तस्मात् मुनिः एकं आश्रित्य सर्वस्य मार्गः भवति।

ddj-22-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-22-03.segmentation: He does not display himself, and so is illustrious;

ddj-22-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-22-04.segmentation: He does not assert himself, and so is distinguished;

ddj-22-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-22-05.segmentation: He does not boast, and so has merit;

ddj-22-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-22-06.segmentation: He does not vaunt himself, and so endures.

ddj-22-07.segmentation: 夫唯不争，故天下莫能与之争。
ddj-22-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-22-07.segmentation: Precisely because he does not contend, no one under Heaven can contend with him.
यतः न स्पर्धते, तस्मात् अन्तरिक्षे न कोऽपि तेन स्पर्धते।

ddj-22-08.segmentation: 古之所谓曲则全者，岂虚言哉？
ddj-22-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-22-08.segmentation: The ancient saying "bent, then whole"—how could it be empty words?
प्राचीनाः "वक्रः, तर्हि पूर्णः" इति — कथं रिक्तं वचः?

ddj-22-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-23-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-23-02.segmentation: 故飘风不终朝，骤雨不终日。
ddj-23-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-23-02.segmentation: Therefore a whirlwind does not last a morning; a sudden rain does not last a day.
तस्मात् वायुः प्रातः न तिष्ठति, वर्षा दिवसं न तिष्ठति।

ddj-23-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-23-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-23-05.segmentation: 天地尚不能久，而况于人乎？
ddj-23-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-23-05.segmentation: Even Heaven and Earth cannot make them last—how much less can man?
द्यावापृथिव्योः अपि दीर्घकालं न, किं पुनः मनुष्यस्य?

ddj-23-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-23-06.segmentation: Therefore one who engages in the Way becomes one with the Way;
तस्मात् मार्गे यः कार्यं करोति, मार्गेण सह एकः भवति;

ddj-23-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-23-07.segmentation: One who engages in virtue becomes one with virtue;

ddj-23-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-23-08.segmentation: One who engages in loss becomes one with loss.

ddj-23-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-23-09.segmentation: One who is one with the Way—the Way also gladly receives him;
मार्गेण यः एकः, मार्गः अपि तं प्रीत्या गृह्णाति;

ddj-23-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-23-10.segmentation: One who is one with virtue—virtue also gladly receives him;
गुणेन यः एकः, गुणः अपि तं प्रीत्या गृह्णाति;

ddj-23-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-23-11.segmentation: One who is one with loss—loss also gladly receives him.
हानिना यः एकः, हानिः अपि तं प्रीत्या गृह्णाति।

ddj-23-12.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-23-12.segmentation: When trust is insufficient, there is distrust.

ddj-24-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-24-01.segmentation: He who stands on tiptoe cannot stand firm;

ddj-24-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-24-02.segmentation: He who strides cannot walk far;

ddj-24-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-24-03.segmentation: He who displays himself is not illustrious;

ddj-24-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-24-04.segmentation: He who asserts himself is not distinguished;

ddj-24-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-24-05.segmentation: He who boasts has no merit;

ddj-24-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-24-06.segmentation: He who vaunts himself does not endure.

ddj-24-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-24-07.segmentation: In the Way, such things are called leftover food and superfluous growths.
मार्गे एतत् "अवशिष्टान्नं, अतिरिक्तं शरीरम्" इति उच्यते।

ddj-24-08.segmentation: 物或恶之，故有道者不处。
ddj-24-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-24-08.segmentation: Things may detest them; therefore one who has the Way does not abide in them.
वस्तूनि एतत् द्वेष्टि; तस्मात् मार्गवान् न वसति।

ddj-25-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-25-01.segmentation: There was something formed in chaos, born before Heaven and Earth.

ddj-25-02.segmentation: 寂兮寥兮，独立而不改，周行而不殆，可以为天地母。
ddj-25-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-25-02.segmentation: Silent and void, it stands alone and does not change; it cycles and does not weary—it may be the mother of Heaven and Earth.
निःशब्दं, शून्यं, एकाकी स्थित्वा न परिवर्तते; परिभ्रमन् न श्रान्तः — द्यावापृथिव्योः माता भवितुम् अर्हति।

ddj-25-03.segmentation: 吾不知其名，强字之曰道，强为之名曰大。
ddj-25-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-25-03.segmentation: I do not know its name; I style it "the Way," and force a name upon it, calling it "Great."
तस्य नाम न जानामि; बलात् "मार्गः" इति नामकरणम्, बलात् "महत्" इति नाम।

ddj-25-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-25-04.segmentation: Great means passing on; passing on means going far; going far means returning.
महत् — गमनम्; गमनम् — दूरम्; दूरम् — प्रत्यागमनम्।

ddj-25-05.segmentation: 故道大，天大，地大，人亦大。
ddj-25-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-25-05.segmentation: Therefore the Way is great, Heaven is great, Earth is great, and man also is great.
तस्मात् मार्गः महान्, द्यौः महती, पृथिवी महती, मनुष्यः अपि महान्।

ddj-25-06.segmentation: 域中有四大，而人居其一焉。
ddj-25-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-25-06.segmentation: In the realm there are four greats, and man is one of them.

ddj-25-07.segmentation: 人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然。
ddj-25-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-25-07.segmentation: Man models himself on Earth; Earth models itself on Heaven; Heaven models itself on the Way; the Way models itself on what is naturally so.
मनुष्यः पृथिवीम् अनुकरोति, पृथिवी द्यौम्, द्यौः मार्गम्, मार्गः स्वभावम्।

ddj-26-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-26-01.segmentation: Heaviness is the root of lightness; stillness is the master of restlessness.
गुरुत्वं लघुत्वस्य मूलम्, शान्तिः उद्वेगस्य स्वामी।

ddj-26-02.segmentation: 是以圣人终日行不离辎重。
ddj-26-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-26-02.segmentation: Therefore the sage travels all day without leaving his baggage wagons.
तस्मात् मुनिः दिवसं चलन् भारवाहनं न त्यजति।

ddj-26-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-26-03.segmentation: Though there be glorious sights, he dwells at ease, detached.
शोभा दृष्ट्वा अपि, सुखेन निर्लिप्तः वसति।

ddj-26-04.segmentation: 奈何万乘之主，而以身轻天下？
ddj-26-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-26-04.segmentation: How then can the lord of ten thousand chariots take his own person lightly in ruling the world?
सहस्ररथाधिपतिः स्वम् अङ्गं लघु कृत्वा जगतं कथम्?

ddj-26-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-26-05.segmentation: Lightness loses the root; restlessness loses the master.
लघुत्वात् मूलं ह्रियते, उद्वेगात् स्वामी ह्रियते।

ddj-27-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-27-01.segmentation: A good traveler leaves no track;

ddj-27-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-27-02.segmentation: A good speaker leaves no flaw for blame;

ddj-27-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-27-03.segmentation: A good reckoner needs no counting rods;

ddj-27-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-27-04.segmentation: A good closer needs no bolts, yet none can open;
कुशलनिरोधः बन्धनं विना, न अपि उद्घाट्यते;

ddj-27-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-27-05.segmentation: A good binder needs no ropes, yet none can untie.
कुशलबन्धनं रज्जु विना, न अपि विमुच्यते।

ddj-27-06.segmentation: 是以圣人常善救人，故无弃人；
ddj-27-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-27-06.segmentation: Therefore the sage is always good at saving people, and so abandons no one;
तस्मात् मुनिः सदा जनान् रक्षति, तस्मात् न त्यजति;

ddj-27-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-27-07.segmentation: Always good at saving things, and so abandons nothing.
सदा वस्तूनि रक्षति, तस्मात् न त्यजति।

ddj-27-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-27-08.segmentation: This is called clothing oneself in light.

ddj-27-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-27-09.segmentation: Therefore the good man is the teacher of the not-good;

ddj-27-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-27-10.segmentation: The not-good man is the material of the good.

ddj-27-11.segmentation: 不贵其师，不爱其资，虽智大迷，是谓要妙。
ddj-27-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-27-11.segmentation: Not to value the teacher, not to love the material—though wise, one is greatly confused: this is called the essential mystery.
गुरुं न पूजयन्, साधनं न प्रेमन् — बुद्धिमान् अपि महामोहः; एतत् "मर्मगुह्यम्" इति उच्यते।

ddj-28-01.segmentation: 知其雄，守其雌，为天下溪。
ddj-28-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-28-01.segmentation: Know the male, yet keep to the female, and be the stream of the world.
पुंभावं ज्ञात्वा स्त्रीभावं रक्षन्, जगतः स्रोतः भव।

ddj-28-02.segmentation: 为天下溪，常德不离，复归于婴儿。
ddj-28-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-28-02.segmentation: Being the stream of the world, constant virtue does not depart, and one returns again to the infant.
जगतः स्रोतः भूत्वा, नित्यगुणः न विच्युतः, शिशुं प्रत्यागच्छति।

ddj-28-03.segmentation: 知其白，守其黑，为天下式。
ddj-28-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-28-03.segmentation: Know the white, yet keep to the black, and be the model of the world.
शुक्लं ज्ञात्वा कृष्णं रक्षन्, जगतः मार्गः भव।

ddj-28-04.segmentation: 为天下式，常德不忒，复归于无极。
ddj-28-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-28-04.segmentation: Being the model of the world, constant virtue does not err, and one returns again to the limitless.
जगतः मार्गः भूत्वा, नित्यगुणः न भ्रमति, अनन्तं प्रत्यागच्छति।

ddj-28-05.segmentation: 知其荣，守其辱，为天下谷。
ddj-28-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-28-05.segmentation: Know honor, yet keep to disgrace, and be the valley of the world.
यशः ज्ञात्वा अपयशः रक्षन्, जगतः कन्दरः भव।

ddj-28-06.segmentation: 为天下谷，常德乃足，复归于朴。
ddj-28-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-28-06.segmentation: Being the valley of the world, constant virtue is then sufficient, and one returns again to the uncarved block.
जगतः कन्दरः भूत्वा, नित्यगुणः पूर्णः, अखण्डं प्रत्यागच्छति।

ddj-28-07.segmentation: 朴散则为器，圣人用之则为官长。
ddj-28-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-28-07.segmentation: When the uncarved block is scattered, it becomes vessels; the sage uses it and becomes the chief of officers.
अखण्डं विभज्यमानं पात्राणि भवन्ति; मुनिः तत् उपयुज्य अधिकारिणां प्रधानः भवति।

ddj-28-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-28-08.segmentation: Therefore the great cutting does not sever.

ddj-29-01.segmentation: 将欲取天下而为之，吾见其不得已。
ddj-29-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-29-01.segmentation: If one would take the world and act upon it, I see that he will not succeed.
जगत् ग्रहीतुं कर्तुं च इच्छन्, न सफलः इति पश्यामि।

ddj-29-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-29-02.segmentation: The world is a sacred vessel; it cannot be acted upon.
जगत् पवित्रं पात्रम्; कर्तुं न शक्यते।

ddj-29-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-29-03.segmentation: He who acts upon it ruins it; he who grasps it loses it.

ddj-29-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-29-04.segmentation: Therefore among things, some go forward, some follow;
तस्मात् वस्तूनि — केचित् अग्रे गच्छन्ति, केचित् अनुवर्तन्ति;

ddj-29-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-29-05.segmentation: Some blow warm, some blow cold;
केचित् उष्णं वमन्ति, केचित् शीतं वायन्ति;

ddj-29-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-29-06.segmentation: Some are strong, some are weak;

ddj-29-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-29-07.segmentation: Some are loaded, some are broken.

ddj-29-08.segmentation: 是以圣人去甚，去奢，去泰。
ddj-29-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-29-08.segmentation: Therefore the sage discards extremes, discards extravagance, discards excess.
तस्मात् मुनिः अतिशयं, विलासं, अतिरेकं त्यजति।

ddj-30-01.segmentation: 以道佐人主者，不以兵强天下。
ddj-30-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-30-01.segmentation: One who assists a ruler with the Way does not use arms to force the world.
मार्गेण स्वामिनं साहाय्यं कुन्वन्, शस्त्रेण जगत् न प्रभावयति।

ddj-30-02.segmentation: 其事好还：师之所处，荆棘生焉；
ddj-30-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-30-02.segmentation: Such affairs tend to rebound: where armies encamp, thorns and brambles grow;
अस्य कार्यस्य प्रत्यावृत्तिः: यत्र सेना, तत्र कण्टकाणि;

ddj-30-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-30-03.segmentation: After a great war, there are sure to be years of famine.

ddj-30-04.segmentation: 善有果而已，不敢以取强。
ddj-30-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-30-04.segmentation: A good commander achieves his end and stops; he dares not take by force.
कुशलः फलमेव प्राप्य, बलेन न गृहन्न्ति।

ddj-30-05.segmentation: 果而勿矜，果而勿伐，果而勿骄，果而不得已，果而勿强。
ddj-30-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-30-05.segmentation: Achieve the end and do not boast; achieve and do not brag; achieve and do not be proud; achieve only as a last resort; achieve and do not force.
फलं प्राप्य न गर्वयति, न स्तौति, न दर्पयति; अवश्यं फलम्, बलेन न।

ddj-30-06.segmentation: 物壮则老，是谓不道，不道早已。
ddj-30-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-30-06.segmentation: When things are strong they grow old—this is called contrary to the Way; what is contrary to the Way comes to an early end.
वस्तूनि बलवन्ति जीर्णानि — "अमार्गः" इति उच्यते; अमार्गः शीघ्रं नाशः।

ddj-31-01.segmentation: 夫兵者，不祥之器，物或恶之，故有道者不处。
ddj-31-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-31-01.segmentation: Arms are instruments of ill omen; things may detest them; therefore one who has the Way does not abide by them.
शस्त्राणि अशुभोपकरणानि; वस्तूनि द्वेषन्ति; मार्गवान् न वसन्ति।

ddj-31-02.segmentation: 君子居则贵左，用兵则贵右。
ddj-31-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-31-02.segmentation: The gentleman values the left in ordinary dwelling; when using arms he values the right.
आर्यः वासे वामं पूजयति, शस्त्रे दक्षिणाम्।

ddj-31-03.segmentation: 兵者不祥之器，非君子之器，不得已而用之，恬淡为上。
ddj-31-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-31-03.segmentation: Arms are instruments of ill omen, not the instruments of a gentleman; he uses them only when he must, and calm detachment is best.
शस्त्राणि अशुभानि, नार्यस्य उपकरणानि; अवश्यं यदा, शान्त्या उत्तमम्।

ddj-31-04.segmentation: 胜而不美，而美之者，是乐杀人。
ddj-31-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-31-04.segmentation: To win and yet find no beauty in it—to find beauty in it is to delight in killing men.
जयं न शोभयते; जयं शोभयते — वधरतिम्।

ddj-31-05.segmentation: 夫乐杀人者，则不可得志于天下矣。
ddj-31-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-31-05.segmentation: One who delights in killing men cannot fulfill his will under Heaven.

ddj-31-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-31-06.segmentation: Auspicious affairs honor the left; inauspicious affairs honor the right.

ddj-31-07.segmentation: 偏将军居左，上将军居右，言以丧礼处之。
ddj-31-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-31-07.segmentation: The lieutenant general stands on the left, the senior general on the right—this means they are treated with funeral rites.
उपसेनापतिः वामे, महासेनापतिः दक्षिणे — अन्त्यक्रियया इति।

ddj-31-08.segmentation: 杀人之众，以悲哀泣之，战胜以丧礼处之。
ddj-31-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-31-08.segmentation: When many are slain, weep for them with grief; when victorious, treat it with funeral rites.
बहून् हत्वा शोकेन रोदति, जिते अन्त्यक्रियया इति।

ddj-32-01.segmentation: 道常无名，朴虽小，天下莫能臣。
ddj-32-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-32-01.segmentation: 道常无名。朴虽小，天下莫能臣。
ddj-32-01.note: 异读：「道常无名」独立成读。

ddj-32-01.segmentation: The Way is constantly nameless; though the uncarved block is small, none under Heaven can make it a subject.
मार्गः सदा अनाम; अखण्डं लघु, अन्तरिक्षे न दासं करोति।

ddj-32-02.segmentation: 侯王若能守之，万物将自宾。
ddj-32-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-32-02.segmentation: If lords and kings can keep to it, the myriad things will of themselves submit as guests.
राजानः रक्षेयुः, सर्वाणि स्वयम् अतिथि भवन्ति।

ddj-32-03.segmentation: 天地相合，以降甘露，民莫之令而自均。
ddj-32-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-32-03.segmentation: Heaven and Earth join and send down sweet dew; the people, without being commanded, share it evenly of themselves.
द्यावापृथिवी संयुज्यते, मधु वर्षन्ति; जनाः आज्ञां विना समाः भवन्ति।

ddj-32-04.segmentation: 始制有名，名亦既有，夫亦将知止。
ddj-32-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-32-04.segmentation: When institutions begin, names appear; once there are names, one should also know when to stop.
विधानं नाम; नाम्नि सति, स्थानं ज्ञात्वा।

ddj-32-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-32-05.segmentation: Knowing when to stop, one can be without danger.

ddj-32-06.segmentation: 譬道之在天下，犹川谷之于江海。
ddj-32-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-32-06.segmentation: The Way's presence in the world is like streams and valleys flowing to the rivers and the sea.

ddj-33-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-33-01.segmentation: To know others is wisdom; to know oneself is insight.
परान् ज्ञात्वा प्रज्ञा; आत्मानं ज्ञात्वा प्रकाशः।

ddj-33-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-33-02.segmentation: To conquer others is strength; to conquer oneself is true power.
परान् जेतुं बलम्; आत्मानं जेतुं शक्तिः।

ddj-33-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-33-03.segmentation: To know contentment is wealth; to press on with vigor is to have will.
तृप्तिं ज्ञात्वा धनम्; उत्साहेन गच्छन् इच्छा।

ddj-33-04.segmentation: 不失其所者久，死而不亡者寿。
ddj-33-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-33-04.segmentation: Not to lose one's place is to endure; to die and yet not perish is to live long.
स्थानं न त्यजन् दीर्घम्; मृत्युं लब्ध्वा न नशन् आयुः।

ddj-34-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-34-01.segmentation: The Great Way floods everywhere; it may go left or right.

ddj-34-02.segmentation: 万物恃之以生而不辞，功成不名有。
ddj-34-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-34-02.segmentation: The myriad things rely on it to live, and it does not refuse them; when the work is done, it claims no name of possession.
सर्वाणि तेन जीवन्ति, न प्रत्याहति; कृत्ये न स्वं नाम।

ddj-34-03.segmentation: 衣养万物而不为主，常无欲，可名于小；
ddj-34-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-34-03.segmentation: 衣养万物而不为主。常无欲，可名于小；
It clothes and nourishes the myriad things yet does not act as their master; always without desire, it may be named small;
पोषयति न स्वामी; सदा निरीहा, लघु इति नाम;

ddj-34-04.segmentation: 万物归焉而不为主，可名为大。
ddj-34-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-34-04.segmentation: The myriad things return to it yet it does not act as their master—it may be named great.
सर्वाणि प्रत्यागच्छन्ति न स्वामी; महत् इति नाम।

ddj-34-05.segmentation: 以其终不自为大，故能成其大。
ddj-34-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-34-05.segmentation: Because to the end it does not make itself great, it is able to achieve its greatness.
अन्ततः न महत्, तस्मात् महत् साधयति।

ddj-35-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-35-01.segmentation: Hold the great image, and the world will come.

ddj-35-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-35-02.segmentation: Coming, they suffer no harm, but find peace, evenness, and ease.
आगताः न हीयन्ते, शान्त्या समतया सुखेन।

ddj-35-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-35-03.segmentation: Music and fine food make the passing guest pause.

ddj-35-04.segmentation: 道之出口，淡乎其无味，视之不足见，听之不足闻，用之不足既。
ddj-35-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-35-04.segmentation: When the Way comes forth from the mouth, how bland—it has no flavor; look, and it is not enough to see; listen, and it is not enough to hear; use it, and it is not enough to exhaust.
मार्गः वक्तुं — निर्रसः; दृष्ट्वा न पर्याप्तम्, श्रुत्वा न पर्याप्तम्, उपयुज्य न क्षीयते।

ddj-36-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-36-01.segmentation: What is to be contracted must first be expanded;

ddj-36-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-36-02.segmentation: What is to be weakened must first be strengthened;

ddj-36-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-36-03.segmentation: What is to be abolished must first be raised;

ddj-36-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-36-04.segmentation: What is to be taken must first be given.

ddj-36-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-36-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-36-06.segmentation: The soft and weak overcome the hard and strong.

ddj-36-07.segmentation: 鱼不可脱于渊，国之利器不可以示人。
ddj-36-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-36-07.segmentation: Fish cannot leave the depths; the sharp instruments of the state must not be shown to others.
मत्स्यः गर्तात् न निर्याति; राज्यस्य तीक्ष्णानि न दृश्यन्ते।

ddj-37-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。
异读：强调「无为／无不为」对举停顿。

ddj-37-01.segmentation: The Way constantly does nothing, yet nothing is left undone.
मार्गः सदा अकरणम्, न किंचिद् अकृतम्।

ddj-37-02.segmentation: 侯王若能守之，万物将自化。
ddj-37-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-37-02.segmentation: If lords and kings can keep to it, the myriad things will transform of themselves.

ddj-37-03.segmentation: 化而欲作，吾将镇之以无名之朴。
ddj-37-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-37-03.segmentation: If, transforming, desire should arise, I will quiet it with the nameless uncarved block.

ddj-37-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-37-04.segmentation: With the nameless uncarved block, there will also be no desire.

ddj-37-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-37-05.segmentation: Without desire and thus still, the world will settle of itself.

ddj-38-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-38-01.segmentation: Highest virtue is not virtue, and therefore it has virtue;

ddj-38-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-38-02.segmentation: Lower virtue never loses virtue, and therefore it has no virtue.
अधमगुणः गुणं न त्यजति, तस्मात् न गुणः।

ddj-38-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-38-03.segmentation: Highest virtue does nothing and has no motive for doing;

ddj-38-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-38-04.segmentation: Lower virtue acts and has a motive for acting.

ddj-38-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-38-05.segmentation: Highest benevolence acts but has no motive for acting;

ddj-38-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-38-06.segmentation: Highest righteousness acts and has a motive for acting.

ddj-38-07.segmentation: 上礼为之而莫之应，则攘臂而扔之。
ddj-38-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-38-07.segmentation: Highest propriety acts, and when none respond, it rolls up its sleeves and forces them.
उत्तमव्यवहारः करोति, न प्रत्युत्तरति, बाहुमुद्यम्य क्षिपति।

ddj-38-08.segmentation: 故失道而后德，失德而后仁，失仁而后义，失义而后礼。
ddj-38-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-38-08.segmentation: Therefore when the Way is lost, then comes virtue; when virtue is lost, then comes benevolence; when benevolence is lost, then comes righteousness; when righteousness is lost, then comes propriety.
मार्गः नष्टे गुणः; गुणः नष्टे करुणा; करुणा नष्टे धर्मः; धर्मः नष्टे व्यवहारः।

ddj-38-09.segmentation: 夫礼者，忠信之薄，而乱之首。
ddj-38-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-38-09.segmentation: Propriety is the thinning of loyalty and trust, and the beginning of disorder.

ddj-38-10.segmentation: 前识者，道之华，而愚之始。
ddj-38-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-38-10.segmentation: Foresight is the flower of the Way, and the beginning of folly.

ddj-38-11.segmentation: 是以大丈夫处其厚，不居其薄；
ddj-38-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-38-11.segmentation: Therefore the great man abides in the thick, and does not dwell in the thin;

ddj-38-12.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-38-12.segmentation: Abides in the substance, and does not dwell in the flower.

ddj-38-13.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-38-13.segmentation: Thus he discards that and takes this.

ddj-39-01.segmentation: 昔之得一者：天得一以清；
ddj-39-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-01.segmentation: Of those who of old attained the One: Heaven attained the One and became clear;
प्राचीना एकं लभ्द्वा: द्यौः एकं लभ्द्वा शुद्धा;

ddj-39-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-02.segmentation: Earth attained the One and became settled;

ddj-39-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-03.segmentation: Spirits attained the One and became efficacious;

ddj-39-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-04.segmentation: Valleys attained the One and became full;

ddj-39-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-05.segmentation: The myriad things attained the One and came to life;

ddj-39-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-06.segmentation: Lords and kings attained the One and became the standard for the world.

ddj-39-07.segmentation: 其致之：天无以清将恐裂；
ddj-39-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-07.segmentation: What brings this about: if Heaven had nothing by which to be clear, it would, I fear, split;
एतद् यदि न स्यात्: द्यौः शुद्धा न स्यात्, भयम् भिद्येत्;

ddj-39-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-08.segmentation: If Earth had nothing by which to be settled, it would, I fear, collapse;
पृथिवी स्थिरा न स्यात्, भयम् भग्नेत्;

ddj-39-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-09.segmentation: If spirits had nothing by which to be efficacious, they would, I fear, cease;
देवाः प्रभावा न स्युः, भयम् शाम्येत्;

ddj-39-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-10.segmentation: If valleys had nothing by which to be full, they would, I fear, dry up;
कन्दराः पूर्णा न स्युः, भयम् शुष्येत्;

ddj-39-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-11.segmentation: If the myriad things had nothing by which to live, they would, I fear, perish;
सर्वाणि जीवन्ति न स्युः, भयम् नशेत्;

ddj-39-12.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-12.segmentation: If lords and kings had nothing by which to be noble and high, they would, I fear, fall.
राजानः उच्चा न स्युः, भयम् पतन्ति।

ddj-39-13.segmentation: 故贵以贱为本，高以下为基。
ddj-39-13.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-13.segmentation: Therefore the noble takes the lowly as its root; the high takes the low as its foundation.
तस्मात् उच्चाः नीचां मूलम्, उच्चं अधः आधारम्।

ddj-39-14.segmentation: 是以侯王自谓孤、寡、不谷。
ddj-39-14.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-14.segmentation: Thus lords and kings call themselves "orphan," "lonely," and "unworthy."

ddj-39-15.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-15.segmentation: Is this not taking the lowly as the root?

ddj-39-16.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-17.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-17.segmentation: Therefore the highest renown is to have no renown.

ddj-39-18.segmentation: 不欲琭琭如玉，珞珞如石。
ddj-39-18.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-39-18.segmentation: Do not desire to shine like jade, or to be hard like stone.
मणिव दीप्तिम्, अश्मिव कठोरताम् इच्छां मा कुरु।

ddj-40-01.segmentation: 反者道之动，弱者道之用。
ddj-40-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-40-01.segmentation: Return is the movement of the Way; weakness is the use of the Way.

ddj-40-02.segmentation: 天下万物生于有，有生于无。
ddj-40-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-40-02.segmentation: The myriad things under Heaven are born of being; being is born of non-being.

ddj-41-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-01.segmentation: When the highest type of man hears the Way, he diligently puts it into practice;
उत्तमः श्रुत्वा मार्गं तं प्रयत्नेन आचरति;

ddj-41-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-02.segmentation: When the middling type hears the Way, he seems to keep it and seems to lose it;
मध्यमः श्रुत्वा मार्गं धारयति इव, नश्यति इव;

ddj-41-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-03.segmentation: When the lowest type hears the Way, he laughs aloud at it.

ddj-41-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-04.segmentation: If it were not laughed at, it would not be fit to be the Way.
न हसितः स्यात्, मार्गः न स्यात्।

ddj-41-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-05.segmentation: Therefore the established sayings have it: The bright Way seems dark;

ddj-41-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-06.segmentation: The advancing Way seems to retreat;

ddj-41-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-08.segmentation: Highest virtue seems like a valley;

ddj-41-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-12.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-13.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-13.segmentation: The great square has no corners;

ddj-41-14.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-14.segmentation: The great vessel is late in being completed;

ddj-41-15.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-15.segmentation: The great note has a rarefied sound;

ddj-41-16.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-16.segmentation: The great image has no form.

ddj-41-17.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-17.segmentation: The Way is hidden and nameless.

ddj-41-18.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-41-18.segmentation: Only the Way is good at lending and bringing things to completion.
केवलं मार्गः उद्धारयति च सम्पादयति च।

ddj-42-01.segmentation: 道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物。
ddj-42-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-42-01.segmentation: The Way gives birth to One; One gives birth to Two; Two gives birth to Three; Three gives birth to the myriad things.
मार्गः एकं जनयति, एकं द्वौ, द्वौ त्रीणि, त्रीणि सर्वाणि भूतानि।

ddj-42-02.segmentation: 万物负阴而抱阳，冲气以为和。
ddj-42-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-42-02.segmentation: The myriad things carry yin on their backs and embrace yang; the blending of the vital breaths makes harmony.
सर्वाणि भूतानि अन्धं धारयन्ति, उष्णं आलिङ्गन्ति; प्राणसंयोगः साम्यं करोति।

ddj-42-03.segmentation: 人之所恶，唯孤、寡、不谷，而王公以为称。
ddj-42-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-42-03.segmentation: What people detest—"orphan," "lonely," and "unworthy"—kings and dukes take as titles.
यत् जनाः द्वेष्टुं, अनाथः एकाकी अयोग्यः—राजानः तत् नामधेयं गृह्णन्ति।

ddj-42-04.segmentation: 故物或损之而益，或益之而损。
ddj-42-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-42-04.segmentation: Therefore some things are diminished and thereby gain; some are increased and thereby diminish.
तस्मात् केचित् ह्रसयन्ति, लभन्ते; केचित् वर्धयन्ति, ह्रसन्ति।

ddj-42-05.segmentation: 人之所教，我亦教之：强梁者不得其死，吾将以为教父。
ddj-42-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-42-05.segmentation: What others teach, I also teach: the violent and overbearing do not meet a natural death—I take this as the father of my teaching.
यत् अन्ये उपदिशन्ति, अहं अपि—बलवान् अत्याचारी स्वाभाविकं मरणं न लभते; एतत् उपदेशस्य पिता।

ddj-43-01.segmentation: 天下之至柔，驰骋天下之至坚。
ddj-43-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-43-01.segmentation: The softest thing under Heaven races through the hardest under Heaven.
अधः स्वभावतः मृदुतमं, स्वभावतः कठिनतमं अतिक्रमति।

ddj-43-02.segmentation: 无有入无间，吾是以知无为之有益。
ddj-43-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-43-02.segmentation: That which has no being enters where there is no space; thereby I know the benefit of non-action.
असत् अन्तरं प्रविशति; ततः अकरणस्य फलं जानामि।

ddj-43-03.segmentation: 不言之教，无为之益，天下希及之。
ddj-43-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-43-03.segmentation: The teaching without words, the benefit of non-action—few under Heaven attain to these.
अवाक् उपदेशः, अकरणस्य फलं—क्वचित् लोकेऽपि प्राप्नोति।

ddj-44-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-44-01.segmentation: Fame or the body—which is dearer?

ddj-44-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-44-02.segmentation: The body or goods—which is worth more?

ddj-44-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-44-03.segmentation: Gain or loss—which is the greater affliction?

ddj-44-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-44-04.segmentation: Excessive love must bring great expense;

ddj-44-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-44-05.segmentation: Much hoarding must bring heavy loss.

ddj-44-06.segmentation: 故知足不辱，知止不殆，可以长久。
ddj-44-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-44-06.segmentation: Therefore know contentment and you will not be disgraced; know when to stop and you will not be in danger—you can last long.
तस्मात् तृप्तिं जानाति, अपमानं न; स्थानं जानाति, भयं न—दीर्घकालं स्थातुं शक्नोति।

ddj-45-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-45-01.segmentation: Great completion seems incomplete, yet its use is never worn out.
महत् पूर्णं अपूर्णम् इव, तस्य उपयोगः न शीर्यते।

ddj-45-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-45-02.segmentation: Great fullness seems empty, yet its use is never exhausted.
महत् पूर्णं रिक्तम् इव, तस्य उपयोगः न क्षीयते।

ddj-45-03.segmentation: 大直若屈，大巧若拙，大辩若讷。
ddj-45-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-45-03.segmentation: Great straightness seems bent; great skill seems clumsy; great eloquence seems stammering.
महान् ऋजुः वक्रः इव, महत् कौशलं अकुशलम् इव, महान् वाक् मूकः इव।

ddj-45-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-45-04.segmentation: Restlessness overcomes cold; stillness overcomes heat.
चञ्चलता शीतं जयति, स्थैर्यं उष्णं जयति।

ddj-45-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-45-05.segmentation: Clarity and stillness set the world in order.
शान्तिः स्थैर्यं च लोकस्य धर्मं स्थापयति।

ddj-46-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-46-01.segmentation: When the world has the Way, spare horses are used for manure;
लोके मार्गः सन्, अश्वाः क्षेत्रं सिञ्चन्ति;

ddj-46-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-46-02.segmentation: When the world lacks the Way, war horses are bred on the borders.
लोके मार्गः न सन्, युद्धाश्वाः सीमायां जायन्ते।

ddj-46-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-46-03.segmentation: No disaster is greater than not knowing contentment;

ddj-46-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-46-04.segmentation: No fault is greater than the desire to get.

ddj-46-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-46-05.segmentation: Therefore the contentment of knowing contentment is lasting contentment.

ddj-47-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-47-01.segmentation: Without going out the door, know the world;
गृहाद् बहिर् न गच्छन्, लोकं जानाति;

ddj-47-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-47-02.segmentation: Without looking through the window, see the Way of Heaven.
जालकं न पश्यन्, दिव्यं मार्गं पश्यति।

ddj-47-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-47-03.segmentation: The farther one goes out, the less one knows.
यावत् दूरं गच्छति, तावत् अल्पं जानाति।

ddj-47-04.segmentation: 是以圣人不行而知，不见而明，不为而成。
ddj-47-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-47-04.segmentation: Therefore the sage knows without traveling, understands without seeing, and accomplishes without acting.
तस्मात् मुनिः न गच्छन् जानाति, न पश्यन् अवगच्छति, न कुर्वन् सम्पादयति।

ddj-48-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-48-01.segmentation: In pursuit of learning, one increases day by day; in pursuit of the Way, one decreases day by day.
अध्ययने दिने दिने वर्धते, मार्गे दिने दिने ह्रस्यति।

ddj-48-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-48-02.segmentation: Decrease and again decrease, until one reaches non-action.

ddj-48-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-48-03.segmentation: Through non-action, nothing is left undone.

ddj-48-04.segmentation: 取天下常以无事，及其有事，不足以取天下。
ddj-48-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-48-04.segmentation: To take the world, one must always be without meddling; when there is meddling, one is not fit to take the world.
लोकं ग्रहीतुं सदा निर्व्यापारः; व्यापारे सति, लोकं ग्रहीतुं न अर्हति।

ddj-49-01.segmentation: 圣人无常心，以百姓心为心。
ddj-49-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-49-01.segmentation: The sage has no fixed mind; he takes the mind of the hundred clans as his mind.
मुनेः न स्थिरं चित्तम्; जनानां चित्तं स्वचित्तम्।

ddj-49-02.segmentation: 善者吾善之，不善者吾亦善之，德善。
ddj-49-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-49-02.segmentation: Those who are good I treat as good; those who are not good I also treat as good—this is the virtue of goodness.
शुभान् शुभं, अशुभान् अपि शुभं—गुणः शुभत्वम्।

ddj-49-03.segmentation: 信者吾信之，不信者吾亦信之，德信。
ddj-49-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-49-03.segmentation: Those who are trustworthy I trust; those who are not trustworthy I also trust—this is the virtue of trust.

ddj-49-04.segmentation: 圣人在天下，歙歙焉为天下浑其心。
ddj-49-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-49-04.segmentation: The sage in the world gathers it in and makes the world's mind one and muddled.
मुनिः लोके संगृह्य लोकचित्तं एकं मिश्रं करोति।

ddj-49-05.segmentation: 百姓皆注其耳目，圣人皆孩之。
ddj-49-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-49-05.segmentation: The hundred clans all fix their ears and eyes upon him; the sage treats them all as children.
जनाः श्रोत्रचक्षूणि नियोजयन्ति; मुनिः सर्वान् बालान् इव पालयति।

ddj-50-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-50-01.segmentation: We come forth into life and enter into death.

ddj-50-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-50-02.segmentation: Companions of life are three in ten;

ddj-50-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-50-03.segmentation: Companions of death are three in ten;

ddj-50-04.segmentation: 人之生动之死地，亦十有三。
ddj-50-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-50-04.segmentation: People whose living moves them onto the ground of death are also three in ten.
जीवन्तः मरणभूमौ गच्छन्ति, अपि दशसु त्रयः।

ddj-50-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-50-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-50-06.segmentation: Because they live life too richly.

ddj-50-07.segmentation: 盖闻善摄生者，陆行不遇兕虎，入军不被甲兵。
ddj-50-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-50-07.segmentation: I have heard that one skilled at preserving life walks on land without meeting rhinoceros or tiger, and enters the army without being touched by armor or weapons.
श्रुतम्—जीवनरक्षणे कुशलः भौमे गच्छन् गण्डकं व्याघ्रं न लभते, सेनायां न शस्त्रैः स्पृश्यते।

ddj-50-08.segmentation: 兕无所投其角，虎无所措其爪，兵无所容其刃。
ddj-50-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-50-08.segmentation: The rhinoceros finds no place to thrust its horn, the tiger no place to set its claws, weapons no place to lodge their blades.
गण्डकः शृङ्गं न प्रक्षिपति, व्याघ्रः नखान् न स्थापयति, शस्त्राणि न प्रविशन्ति।

ddj-50-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-50-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-50-10.segmentation: Because he has no ground of death.

ddj-51-01.segmentation: 道生之，德畜之，物形之，势成之。
ddj-51-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-51-01.segmentation: The Way gives them birth; virtue rears them; things give them form; circumstances bring them to completion.
मार्गः जनयति, गुणः पालयति, वस्तु रूपं, परिस्थितिः सम्पादयति।

ddj-51-02.segmentation: 是以万物莫不尊道而贵德。
ddj-51-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-51-02.segmentation: Therefore among the myriad things none fails to honor the Way and prize virtue.
तस्मात् सर्वाणि भूतानि मार्गं पूजयन्ति, गुणं प्रशंसन्ति।

ddj-51-03.segmentation: 道之尊，德之贵，夫莫之命而常自然。
ddj-51-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-51-03.segmentation: The honor of the Way and the prizing of virtue—none commands it, yet it is always naturally so.
मार्गस्य पूजा, गुणस्य महत्त्वम्—न कोत्पि आज्ञापयति, सदा स्वाभाविकम्।

ddj-51-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-51-04.segmentation: Therefore the Way gives them birth, and virtue rears them;

ddj-51-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-51-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-51-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-51-08.segmentation: 生而不有，为而不恃，长而不宰，是谓玄德。
ddj-51-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-51-08.segmentation: It gives birth but does not possess; acts but does not rely; raises but does not rule—this is called mysterious virtue.
जनयति न धारयति, करोति न आश्रयति, वर्धयति न अधिशिष्यति—एष गुप्तः गुणः।

ddj-52-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-52-01.segmentation: The world has a beginning; take it as the mother of the world.
लोकस्य आदिः अस्ति; तं लोकस्य मातरम् गृह्णीहि।

ddj-52-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-52-02.segmentation: Having found the mother, one knows her children;

ddj-52-03.segmentation: 既知其子，复守其母，没身不殆。
ddj-52-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-52-03.segmentation: Having known the children, return and keep to the mother, and to the end of life one is without danger.
पुत्रान् ज्ञात्वा, मातरम् पुनः रक्षति, जीवनं न भयम्।

ddj-52-04.segmentation: 塞其兑，闭其门，终身不勤。
ddj-52-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-52-04.segmentation: Block the openings, shut the doors, and all one's life one will not toil.
द्वाराणि पिधाय, द्वाराणि पिधाय, जीवनं न श्रमति।

ddj-52-05.segmentation: 开其兑，济其事，终身不救。
ddj-52-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。
