ddj-52-05.segmentation: Open the openings, multiply affairs, and all one's life one will not be saved.
द्वाराणि विवरयति, कर्माणि बहूनि करोति, जीवनं न त्रायते।

ddj-52-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-52-06.segmentation: To see the small is called insight; to keep to the soft is called strength.
अल्पम् पश्यन् प्रज्ञा उच्यते, मृदुम् रक्षन् बलम् उच्यते।

ddj-52-07.segmentation: 用其光，复归其明，无遗身殃，是为袭常。
ddj-52-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-52-07.segmentation: Use the light, return again to insight, leave the body no calamity—this is called practicing the Constant.
ज्योतिः उपयुज्य, प्रज्ञाम् पुनः गच्छति, शरीरम् न दुःखम्—एष नित्यं सेवते।

ddj-53-01.segmentation: 使我介然有知，行于大道，唯施是畏。
ddj-53-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-53-01.segmentation: If I had even a shred of knowledge, walking on the great Way, I would fear only going astray.
अल्पम् अपि ज्ञानम् स्यात्, महति मार्गे गच्छन्, विकृतिम् एव बिभेमि।

ddj-53-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-53-02.segmentation: The great Way is very level, yet people love bypaths.
महान् मार्गः अति समः, जनाः तु क्षुद्रं पन्थानम् इच्छन्ति।

ddj-53-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-53-03.segmentation: The court is very well kept, the fields are very weedy, the granaries very empty;
सभा अति शुद्धा, क्षेत्रम् अति उषरम्, कोशः अति रिक्तम्;

ddj-53-04.segmentation: 服文采，带利剑，厌饮食，财货有余，是谓盗夸。
ddj-53-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-53-04.segmentation: Wearing patterned clothes, carrying sharp swords, sated with food and drink, with goods in surplus—this is called the swagger of robbers.
वर्णवन्तं वाससी, तीक्ष्णं खड्गम्, अन्नपाने तृप्ताः, वसु अतिशिष्टम्—एष चोरस्य दर्पः।

ddj-53-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-54-01.segmentation: 善建者不拔，善抱者不脱，子孙以祭祀不辍。
ddj-54-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-54-01.segmentation: What is well planted is not uprooted; what is well embraced is not pulled away—sons and grandsons will offer sacrifice without cease.
सुष्टु रोपितम् न उन्मूल्यते, सुष्टु आलिङ्गितम् न मुञ्चते—पुत्रपौत्राः यज्यम् न मुञ्चन्ति।

ddj-54-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-54-02.segmentation: Cultivate it in the person, and its virtue is genuine;

ddj-54-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-54-03.segmentation: Cultivate it in the family, and its virtue has surplus;

ddj-54-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-54-04.segmentation: Cultivate it in the village, and its virtue endures;

ddj-54-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-54-05.segmentation: Cultivate it in the state, and its virtue is abundant;

ddj-54-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-54-06.segmentation: Cultivate it in the world, and its virtue is universal.

ddj-54-07.segmentation: 故以身观身，以家观家，以乡观乡，以国观国，以天下观天下。
ddj-54-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-54-07.segmentation: Therefore observe persons by the person, families by the family, villages by the village, states by the state, the world by the world.
तस्मात् आत्मना आत्मानम्, कुलेन कुलम्, ग्रामेण ग्रामम्, राष्ट्रेण राष्ट्रम्, लोकेन लोकम् पश्यति।

ddj-54-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-54-08.segmentation: How do I know that the world is so?

ddj-54-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-55-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-55-01.segmentation: One who holds virtue in abundance may be compared to a newborn child.
गुणस्य भारं धारयन् नवजातस्य बालस्य उपमा।

ddj-55-02.segmentation: 毒虫不螫，猛兽不据，攫鸟不搏。
ddj-55-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-55-02.segmentation: Poisonous insects do not sting it, fierce beasts do not seize it, birds of prey do not strike it.
विषवन्तः न दंशन्ति, व्याघ्रा न गृह्णन्ति, पक्षिणो न हन्ति।

ddj-55-03.segmentation: 骨弱筋柔而握固，未知牝牡之合而朘作，精之至也。
ddj-55-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-55-03.segmentation: Its bones are weak and its sinews soft, yet its grip is firm; it does not yet know the union of male and female, yet its organ stirs—this is the perfection of essence.
अस्थनि दुर्बलम्, स्नायु मृदु, ग्रहणं तु दृढम्; स्त्रीपुंसः संयोगम् अजानन् अपि उद्भवति—ओजसां परमम्।

ddj-55-04.segmentation: 终日号而不嗄，和之至也。
ddj-55-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-55-04.segmentation: It cries all day and does not grow hoarse—this is the perfection of harmony.
अहर्निषम् रोदिति, न स्वरः भ्रश्यते—साम्यस्य परमम्।

ddj-55-05.segmentation: 知和曰常，知常曰明，益生曰祥，心使气曰强。
ddj-55-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-55-05.segmentation: To know harmony is called the Constant; to know the Constant is called insight; to force life is called ominous; for the mind to drive the vital breath is called forcing.
साम्यम् ज्ञात्वा नित्यम् उच्यते, नित्यम् ज्ञात्वा प्रज्ञा; जीवनं वर्धयति अशुभम्, चित्तम् प्राणम् बलम् करोति।

ddj-55-06.segmentation: 物壮则老，谓之不道，不道早已。
ddj-55-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-55-06.segmentation: When things are strong they grow old—this is called contrary to the Way; what is contrary to the Way comes to an early end.
वस्तूनि बलवन्ति जरां गच्छन्ति—मार्गे विरुद्धम्; मार्गे विरुद्धम् शीघ्रम् अन्तम्।

ddj-56-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-56-01.segmentation: Those who know do not speak; those who speak do not know.
जानन्तः न वदन्ति, वदन्तः न जानन्ति।

ddj-56-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-56-02.segmentation: Block the openings, shut the doors;

ddj-56-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-56-03.segmentation: Blunt the sharpness, untie the tangles;

ddj-56-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-56-04.segmentation: Soften the glare, merge with the dust;
प्रभाम् साम्यम् करोति, रजसा सह युज्यते;

ddj-56-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-56-05.segmentation: This is called the mysterious identity.

ddj-56-06.segmentation: 故不可得而亲，不可得而疏；
ddj-56-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-56-06.segmentation: Therefore one cannot get close to it, nor get distant from it;
तस्मात् न उपगन्तुम् शक्यते, न दूरीकर्तुम्;

ddj-56-07.segmentation: 不可得而利，不可得而害；
ddj-56-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-56-07.segmentation: Cannot get benefit from it, nor get harm from it;

ddj-56-08.segmentation: 不可得而贵，不可得而贱。
ddj-56-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-56-08.segmentation: Cannot get honor from it, nor get lowliness from it.

ddj-56-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-56-09.segmentation: Therefore it is prized by all under Heaven.

ddj-57-01.segmentation: 以正治国，以奇用兵，以无事取天下。
ddj-57-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-57-01.segmentation: Govern the state with uprightness, use arms with surprise, take the world by being without affairs.
राष्ट्रम् धर्मेण शासति, सेनाम् आश्चर्येण, लोकम् निर्व्यापारेण गृह्णाति।

ddj-57-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-57-02.segmentation: How do I know that this is so?

ddj-57-03.segmentation: 以此：天下多忌讳，而民弥贫；
ddj-57-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-57-03.segmentation: By this: the more taboos under Heaven, the poorer the people;
एतेन—लोके निषेदा बहवः, जनाः अति दीनाः;

ddj-57-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-57-04.segmentation: The more sharp instruments among the people, the more the state grows disordered;
जनाः तीक्ष्णानि शस्त्राणि बहूनि, राष्ट्रम् अति मूढम्;

ddj-57-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-57-05.segmentation: The more skills people have, the more strange things arise;

ddj-57-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-57-06.segmentation: The more laws and ordinances are proclaimed, the more thieves and robbers there are.

ddj-57-07.segmentation: 故圣人云：我无为而民自化；
ddj-57-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-57-07.segmentation: Therefore the sage says: I do nothing, and the people transform of themselves;
तस्मात् मुनिर् आह—अहम् अकुर्वन् जनाः स्वयम् परिवर्तन्ते;

ddj-57-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-57-08.segmentation: I love stillness, and the people correct themselves;
अहम् शान्तिम् इच्छामि, जनाः स्वयम् सम्यक्;

ddj-57-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-57-09.segmentation: I am without affairs, and the people enrich themselves;

ddj-57-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-57-10.segmentation: I am without desire, and the people become simple of themselves.

ddj-58-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-58-01.segmentation: When government is muffled and dull, the people are pure and simple;

ddj-58-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-58-02.segmentation: When government is sharp and prying, the people are wanting and deficient.

ddj-58-03.segmentation: 祸兮福之所倚，福兮祸之所伏。
ddj-58-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-58-03.segmentation: Disaster is that on which good fortune leans; good fortune is that in which disaster lurks.
दुःखम् यत्र सुखम् आश्रयति, सुखम् यत्र दुःखम् गूढम्।

ddj-58-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-58-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-58-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-58-06.segmentation: The correct reverts to the strange; the good reverts to the ominous.
सम्यक् पुनः आश्चर्यम्, शुभम् पुनः अशुभम्।

ddj-58-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-58-07.segmentation: People's confusion has long been so.

ddj-58-08.segmentation: 是以圣人方而不割，廉而不刿，直而不肆，光而不耀。
ddj-58-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-58-08.segmentation: Therefore the sage is square but does not cut; sharp but does not wound; straight but not unrestrained; bright but not dazzling.
तस्मात् मुनिर् चतुरस्रः न छिन्दति, तीक्ष्णः न व्रणयति, ऋजुः न अत्याचरति, ज्योतिर्मान् न दीप्यति।

ddj-59-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-59-01.segmentation: In governing people and serving Heaven, nothing is better than frugality.
जनान् परिपालयन् दिवम् सेवन्, न किंचित् परिश्रुतात् श्रेष्ठम्।

ddj-59-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-59-02.segmentation: Only frugality is called early submission;

ddj-59-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-59-03.segmentation: Early submission is called heavily accumulating virtue;
पूर्वं सेवा बहु गुणम् संचिनोति उच्यते;

ddj-59-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-59-04.segmentation: Heavily accumulating virtue, there is nothing one cannot overcome;
बहु गुणम् संचिन्वन् न किंचित् न जयति;

ddj-59-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-59-05.segmentation: When there is nothing one cannot overcome, none knows one's limit;
न किंचित् न जयन्न्, न कश्चित् अन्तम् जानाति;

ddj-59-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-59-06.segmentation: When none knows one's limit, one can possess the state;

ddj-59-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-59-07.segmentation: Possessing the mother of the state, one can last long.

ddj-59-08.segmentation: 是谓深根固柢，长生久视之道。
ddj-59-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-59-08.segmentation: This is called deep roots and a firm base—the Way of long life and lasting vision.

ddj-60-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-60-01.segmentation: Governing a large state is like cooking a small fish.
महत् राष्ट्रम् शालयः पक्वमत्स्यम् इव शास्ति।

ddj-60-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-60-02.segmentation: When one approaches the world with the Way, its ghosts have no spirit;
मार्गेण लोकम् अभ्युपगच्छन्, प्रेताः न प्रभवन्ति;

ddj-60-03.segmentation: 非其鬼不神，其神不伤人；
ddj-60-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-60-03.segmentation: It is not that the ghosts have no spirit, but that their spirit does not harm people;
प्रेताः न प्रभवन्ति न, तेषाम् प्रभावः जनान् न हन्ति;

ddj-60-04.segmentation: 非其神不伤人，圣人亦不伤人。
ddj-60-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-60-04.segmentation: It is not only that their spirit does not harm people—the sage also does not harm people.
प्रभावः न हन्ति एव, मुनिर् अपि न हन्ति।

ddj-60-05.segmentation: 夫两不相伤，故德交归焉。
ddj-60-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-60-05.segmentation: When these two do not harm each other, virtue converges and returns to them.
उभौ न हन्ति, तस्मात् गुणः उभयोः समागच्छति।

ddj-61-01.segmentation: 大邦者下流，天下之牝，天下之交也。
ddj-61-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-61-01.segmentation: A great state is like the lower reaches of a river—the female of the world, the meeting place of the world.
महत् राज्यम् अधोगामि, जगतः स्त्री, जगतः संगमः।

ddj-61-02.segmentation: 牝常以静胜牡，以静为下。
ddj-61-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-61-02.segmentation: The female constantly overcomes the male by stillness, and by stillness takes the lower place.
स्त्री नित्यं शान्त्या पुमानं जयति, शान्त्या अधः स्थानं गृह्णाति।

ddj-61-03.segmentation: 故大邦以下小邦，则取小邦；
ddj-61-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-61-03.segmentation: Therefore when a great state places itself below a small state, it takes the small state;
तस्माद् महत् राज्यं क्षुद्रात् अधस्तात् स्थितं क्षुद्रं गृह्णाति;

ddj-61-04.segmentation: 小邦以下大邦，则取大邦。
ddj-61-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-61-04.segmentation: When a small state places itself below a great state, it is taken by the great state.
क्षुद्रं महतः अधस्तात् स्थितं महता गृह्यते।

ddj-61-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-61-05.segmentation: Thus some take by placing themselves below; some are taken by placing themselves below.
तस्मात् केचित् अधः स्थित्वा गृह्णन्ति, केचित् अधः स्थिताः गृह्यन्ते।

ddj-61-06.segmentation: 大邦不过欲兼畜人，小邦不过欲入事人。
ddj-61-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-61-06.segmentation: A great state wants no more than to unite and nurture others; a small state wants no more than to enter and serve others.
महत् राज्यं न केवलं जनान् संगृहीतुम् इच्छति, क्षुद्रं प्रविश्य सेवां इच्छति।

ddj-61-07.segmentation: 夫两者各得所欲，大者宜为下。
ddj-61-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-61-07.segmentation: When both get what they desire, the great one should take the lower place.
उभयोः स्वम् इच्छितं लभ्यते, महान् अधः स्थातुम् युज्यते।

ddj-62-01.segmentation: 道者万物之奥，善人之宝，不善人之所保。
ddj-62-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-62-01.segmentation: The Way is the sanctuary of the myriad things, the treasure of the good man, and that by which the not-good are kept.
मार्गः भूतानां गुहा, शुभानां रत्नम्, अशुभानां रक्षा।

ddj-62-02.segmentation: 美言可以市尊，美行可以加人。
ddj-62-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-62-02.segmentation: Fine words can purchase honor; fine conduct can raise a person above others.
शोभनं वचनं मानम् अर्जयति, शोभना कृतिः उपरि उठापयति।

ddj-62-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-62-03.segmentation: Even if people are not good, how can they be abandoned?

ddj-62-04.segmentation: 故立天子，置三公，虽有拱璧以先驷马，不如坐进此道。
ddj-62-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-62-04.segmentation: Therefore when the Son of Heaven is established and the Three Dukes appointed, though one present a jade disk ahead of a team of four horses, it is not as good as sitting and offering this Way.
तस्माद् देवपुत्रं स्थापयित्वा, त्रयः मन्त्रिणः नियुज्यन्ते, यद्यपि श्याममणिः चतुरश्वैः पूर्वं दीयते, तत् न तावत् यत् आसीनः एतत् मार्गं समर्पयति।

ddj-62-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-62-05.segmentation: Why did the ancients prize this Way?

ddj-62-06.segmentation: 不曰：求以得，有罪以免邪？
ddj-62-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-62-06.segmentation: Was it not said: by seeking, one obtains; having guilt, one is spared?
नोच्यते: अन्वेषणेन लभ्यते, पापं च मुच्यते?

ddj-62-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-62-07.segmentation: Therefore it is prized by all under Heaven.

ddj-63-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-63-01.segmentation: Act by non-action; handle affairs by being without affairs; taste the tasteless.
अकरणेन कुर्यात्, निष्क्रियतया कार्याणि, अरसम् अनुभवेत्।

ddj-63-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-63-02.segmentation: Regard the great as small, the many as few; repay injury with virtue.
महत् क्षुद्रम्, बहु अल्पम्; वैरम् गुणेन प्रतिकुर्यात्।

ddj-63-03.segmentation: 图难于其易，为大于其细。
ddj-63-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-63-03.segmentation: Plan the difficult while it is easy; do the great while it is fine.
कठिनं सुकरे योजयेत्, महत् सूक्ष्मे करोतु।

ddj-63-04.segmentation: 天下难事必作于易，天下大事必作于细。
ddj-63-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-63-04.segmentation: The difficult affairs of the world must arise from the easy; the great affairs of the world must arise from the fine.
जगतः कठिनानि कार्याणि सुकरात् उद्भवन्ति, महान्ति कार्याणि सूक्ष्मात्।

ddj-63-05.segmentation: 是以圣人终不为大，故能成其大。
ddj-63-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-63-05.segmentation: Therefore the sage to the end does not attempt the great, and so is able to achieve greatness.
तस्माद् मुनिः अन्तं महत् न करोति, ततः स्वम् महत्त्वं साधयति।

ddj-63-06.segmentation: 夫轻诺必寡信，多易必多难。
ddj-63-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-63-06.segmentation: Light promises must bring little trust; taking many things as easy must bring many difficulties.
लघु प्रतिज्ञा अल्पविश्वासं जनयति, बहु सुकरं बहु कठिनम्।

ddj-63-07.segmentation: 是以圣人犹难之，故终无难矣。
ddj-63-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-63-07.segmentation: Therefore the sage still treats them as difficult, and so in the end has no difficulty.
तस्माद् मुनिः तानि अपि कठिनानि मन्यते, ततः अन्ते कठिनता नास्ति।

ddj-64-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-64-01.segmentation: What is at peace is easy to hold; what has not yet shown signs is easy to plan for.
यत् शान्तं तत् धारयितुं सुलभम्, यत् अ-लक्षितं तत् योजयितुं सुलभम्।

ddj-64-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-64-02.segmentation: What is brittle is easy to break; what is minute is easy to scatter.
यत् भग्नं तत् विघटयितुं सुलभम्, यत् सूक्ष्मं तत् विसर्पयितुं सुलभम्।

ddj-64-03.segmentation: 为之于未有，治之于未乱。
ddj-64-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-64-03.segmentation: Act on it before it exists; order it before disorder arises.

ddj-64-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-64-04.segmentation: A tree that fills the arms' embrace grows from a tiny shoot;

ddj-64-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-64-05.segmentation: A terrace of nine stories rises from a heap of earth;

ddj-64-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-64-06.segmentation: A journey of a thousand li begins under one's feet.

ddj-64-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-64-07.segmentation: He who acts upon it ruins it; he who grasps it loses it.
यः करोति स भ्रंशयति, यः गृह्णाति स हरति।

ddj-64-08.segmentation: 是以圣人无为故无败，无执故无失。
ddj-64-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-64-08.segmentation: Therefore the sage does not act, and so does not ruin; does not grasp, and so does not lose.
तस्माद् मुनिः अकरणात् न भ्रंशति, अ-ग्रहणात् न हरति।

ddj-64-09.segmentation: 民之从事，常于几成而败之。
ddj-64-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-64-09.segmentation: People in their undertakings often fail when nearly complete.

ddj-64-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-64-10.segmentation: Be as careful at the end as at the beginning, and there will be no failed affairs.
अन्तं आदौ इव सावधानं, ततः विफलं कार्यं न भवति।

ddj-64-11.segmentation: 是以圣人欲不欲，不贵难得之货；
ddj-64-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-64-11.segmentation: Therefore the sage desires not to desire, and does not prize goods hard to obtain;
तस्माद् मुनिः अ-कामं कामयते, दुर्लभ-वस्तूनि न पूजयति;

ddj-64-12.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-64-12.segmentation: Learns not to learn, and returns to what the multitude pass by.
अ-शिक्षां शिक्षते, जन-समूहस्य अतिक्रमं पुनः गच्छति।

ddj-64-13.segmentation: 以辅万物之自然而不敢为。
ddj-64-13.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-64-13.segmentation: He assists the natural course of the myriad things and dares not act.
भूतानां स्व-स्वभावं अनुगृह्णाति, कर्तुं न धृष्टं भवति।

ddj-65-01.segmentation: 古之善为道者，非以明民，将以愚之。
ddj-65-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-65-01.segmentation: Those of old who were good at practicing the Way did not use it to enlighten the people, but to keep them simple.
पुरातनाः मार्गे कुशलाः, जनान् प्रकाशयितुं न, तान् सरलान् कर्तुम्।

ddj-65-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-65-02.segmentation: The people are hard to govern because they have too much cleverness.

ddj-65-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-65-03.segmentation: Therefore to govern a state by cleverness is to be a thief of the state;
तस्माद् बुद्ध्या राज्यं शासितुं राज्यस्य चोरः;

ddj-65-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-65-04.segmentation: Not to govern a state by cleverness is to be a blessing to the state.

ddj-65-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-65-05.segmentation: To know these two is also a standard.

ddj-65-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-65-06.segmentation: Always to know the standard is called mysterious virtue.

ddj-65-07.segmentation: 玄德深矣，远矣，与物反矣，然后乃至大顺。
ddj-65-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-65-07.segmentation: Mysterious virtue is deep, is far; it returns with things, and only then reaches great accordance.
गुह्य-गुणः गम्भीरः, दूरः, भूतैः सह प्रतिनिवर्तते, ततः महत् अनुकूलं प्राप्नोति।

ddj-66-01.segmentation: 江海所以能为百谷王者，以其善下之，故能为百谷王。
ddj-66-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-66-01.segmentation: The reason the rivers and the sea can be kings of the hundred valleys is that they are good at taking the lower place—thus they can be kings of the hundred valleys.
नद्यः समुद्रः शत-दरीणां राजा, अधः स्थानं कुशलत्वात्, तस्माद् शत-दरीणां राजा।

ddj-66-02.segmentation: 是以圣人欲上民，必以言下之；
ddj-66-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-66-02.segmentation: Therefore if the sage would be above the people, he must in speech put himself below them;
तस्माद् मुनिः जनान् उपरि इच्छन्, वचनैः अधः स्थातव्यम्;

ddj-66-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-66-03.segmentation: If he would be ahead of the people, he must in person put himself behind them.
जनान् अग्रे इच्छन्, शरीरेण पश्चात् स्थातव्यम्।

ddj-66-04.segmentation: 是以圣人处上而民不重，处前而民不害。
ddj-66-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-66-04.segmentation: Therefore the sage dwells above and the people do not feel burdened; dwells ahead and the people do not feel harmed.
तस्माद् मुनिः उपरि स्थितः जनाः न बाधन्ते, अग्रे स्थितः न हिंसन्ते।

ddj-66-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-66-05.segmentation: Therefore all under Heaven gladly push him forward and do not tire of him.
तस्माद् जगत् सुखेन प्रेरयति, न क्लान्ति।

ddj-66-06.segmentation: 以其不争，故天下莫能与之争。
ddj-66-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-66-06.segmentation: Because he does not contend, no one under Heaven can contend with him.
अ-स्पर्धया, जगति कोऽपि स्पर्धितुं न शक्नोति।

ddj-67-01.segmentation: 天下皆谓我道大，似不肖。
ddj-67-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-67-01.segmentation: All under Heaven say my Way is great, and seems unlike anything else.
जगत् सर्वे मम मार्गं महान्तम्, असदृशम् इति वदन्ति।

ddj-67-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-67-02.segmentation: Precisely because it is great, it seems unlike anything else.

ddj-67-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-67-03.segmentation: If it were like anything else, it would long ago have been small!
यदि सदृशः स्यात्, पुरा एव क्षुद्रः अभविष्यत्!

ddj-67-04.segmentation: 我有三宝，持而保之：一曰慈，二曰俭，三曰不敢为天下先。
ddj-67-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-67-04.segmentation: I have three treasures that I hold and keep: the first is compassion; the second is frugality; the third is not daring to be first under Heaven.
मम त्रीणि रत्नानि, धृत्वा रक्षामि: प्रथमं दया, द्वितीयं परिमितिः, तृतीयं जगति अग्रे न धृष्टः।

ddj-67-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-67-05.segmentation: With compassion one can be brave;

ddj-67-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-67-06.segmentation: With frugality one can be generous;

ddj-67-07.segmentation: 不敢为天下先，故能成器长。
ddj-67-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-67-07.segmentation: Not daring to be first under Heaven, one can become the chief of vessels.
जगति अग्रे न धृष्टः, तस्माद् पात्राणां नायकः।

ddj-67-08.segmentation: 今舍慈且勇，舍俭且广，舍后且先，死矣！
ddj-67-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-67-08.segmentation: Now to discard compassion and yet be brave, to discard frugality and yet be generous, to discard being behind and yet be first—is to die!
अद्य दयां त्यक्त्वा वीरः, परिमितिं त्यक्त्वा व्यापकः, पश्चात् त्यक्त्वा अग्रे — मृत्युः!

ddj-67-09.segmentation: 夫慈，以战则胜，以守则固。
ddj-67-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-67-09.segmentation: With compassion, one who fights wins; one who defends holds firm.

ddj-67-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-67-10.segmentation: Heaven will save him, and guard him with compassion.
द्यौः तं रक्षति, दया तं पालयति।

ddj-68-01.segmentation: 善为士者不武，善战者不怒，善胜敌者不与，善用人者为之下。
ddj-68-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-68-01.segmentation: A good officer is not warlike; a good fighter is not angry; a good conqueror of enemies does not engage them; one good at using people places himself below them.
कुशलः शूरः न योद्धा, कुशलः योद्धा न क्रुद्धः, कुशलः शत्रु-जेता न युध्यते, कुशलः जन-उपयोक्ता अधः स्थाति।

ddj-68-02.segmentation: 是谓不争之德，是谓用人之力，是谓配天古之极。
ddj-68-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-68-02.segmentation: This is called the virtue of not contending; this is called the power of using people; this is called matching Heaven—the ultimate of old.
इदं अ-स्पर्धा-गुणः, जन-शक्ति-उपयोगः, द्योः अनुकूलता — पुरातन-परमम्।

ddj-69-01.segmentation: 用兵有言：吾不敢为主而为客，不敢进寸而退尺。
ddj-69-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-69-01.segmentation: Military strategists have a saying: I dare not be the host but prefer to be the guest; I dare not advance an inch but prefer to withdraw a foot.
सैन्य-शास्त्रेषु उक्तम्: स्वामित्वं न धृष्टः, अतिथित्वं गृह्णामि; अङ्गुलिं न अग्रे, पादं पश्चात्।

ddj-69-02.segmentation: 是谓行无行，攘无臂，扔无敌，执无兵。
ddj-69-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-69-02.segmentation: This is called marching without ranks, rolling up the sleeves without an arm, facing without an enemy, grasping without a weapon.
इदं उच्यते: पङ्क्ति-विना गमनम्, बाहु-विना विक्षेपणम्, शत्रु-विना मुखम्, शस्त्र-विना ग्रहणम्।

ddj-69-03.segmentation: 祸莫大于轻敌，轻敌几丧吾宝。
ddj-69-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-69-03.segmentation: No disaster is greater than underestimating the enemy; to underestimate the enemy is nearly to lose my treasure.
शत्रु-अवमानात् न कोऽपि दुःखं महत्तरम्; शत्रु-अवमानः मम रत्नं प्रायः हरति।

ddj-69-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-69-04.segmentation: Therefore when opposing armies are evenly matched, the one that grieves wins.

ddj-70-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-70-01.segmentation: My words are very easy to understand, very easy to practice.
मम वचांसि अत्यन्तं सुज्ञेयानि, सुकराणि च।

ddj-70-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-70-02.segmentation: Yet none under Heaven can understand them, none can practice them.
जगति कोऽपि ज्ञातुं न शक्नोति, कर्तुं न शक्नोति।

ddj-70-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-70-03.segmentation: Words have an ancestor; affairs have a sovereign.

ddj-70-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-70-04.segmentation: Precisely because people are without knowledge, they do not understand me.
यतो अ-ज्ञानम्, तस्माद् मां न जानन्ति।

ddj-70-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-70-05.segmentation: Those who understand me are rare; thus I am prized.

ddj-70-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-70-06.segmentation: Therefore the sage wears coarse cloth and holds jade in his bosom.
तस्माद् मुनिः जीर्ण-वस्त्रं धारयति, हृदये मणिम्।

ddj-71-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-71-01.segmentation: To know that one does not know is best;

ddj-71-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-71-02.segmentation: Not to know and yet think one knows is a disease.

ddj-71-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-71-03.segmentation: The sage is not diseased, because he treats disease as disease.
मुनिः न रोगी, यतः रोगं रोग इति मन्यते।

ddj-71-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-71-04.segmentation: Precisely because he treats disease as disease, he is therefore not diseased.
यतो रोगं रोग इति मन्यते, तस्माद् न रोगी।

ddj-72-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-72-01.segmentation: When the people do not fear power, then a greater power arrives.
जनाः शक्तिं न बिभ्यति, ततः महती शक्तिः आगच्छति।

ddj-72-02.segmentation: 无狎其所居，无厌其所生。
ddj-72-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-72-02.segmentation: Do not constrict their dwellings; do not oppress their livelihood.
तेषां वास-स्थानं न संकुचय, जीविकां न पीडय।

ddj-72-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-72-03.segmentation: Precisely because one does not oppress, they are not oppressed.
यतो न पीडयति, तस्माद् न पीड्यन्ते।

ddj-72-04.segmentation: 是以圣人自知不自见，自爱不自贵。
ddj-72-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-72-04.segmentation: Therefore the sage knows himself but does not display himself; loves himself but does not exalt himself.
तस्माद् मुनिः स्वं जानाति, न दर्शयति, स्वं प्रेमति, न उन्नतयति।

ddj-72-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-72-05.segmentation: Thus he discards that and takes this.

ddj-73-01.segmentation: 勇于敢则杀，勇于不敢则活。
ddj-73-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-73-01.segmentation: Courage in daring leads to death; courage in not daring leads to life.

ddj-73-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-73-02.segmentation: Of these two, one benefits and one harms.

ddj-73-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-73-03.segmentation: What Heaven detests—who knows its reason?
यत् द्यौः द्वेष्टि, तस्य कारणं कः जानति?

ddj-73-04.segmentation: 天之道，不争而善胜，不言而善应，不召而自来，繟然而善谋。
ddj-73-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-73-04.segmentation: The Way of Heaven does not contend and yet is good at winning; does not speak and yet is good at responding; is not summoned and yet comes of itself; is relaxed and yet good at planning.
द्योः मार्गः, न स्पर्धते, जयति; न वदति, प्रत्युत्तरति; न आहूयते, स्वयम् आगच्छति; शिथिलः, कुशल-योजकः।

ddj-73-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-73-05.segmentation: Heaven's net is vast; though its mesh is coarse, nothing slips through.
द्योः जालं विशालम्, विरलं, न किञ्चित् त्यजति।

ddj-74-01.segmentation: 民不畏死，奈何以死惧之？
ddj-74-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-74-01.segmentation: If the people do not fear death, how can one frighten them with death?
जनाः मरणात् न बिभ्यति, मरणेन कथं भयं दास्यसि?

ddj-74-02.segmentation: 若使民常畏死，而为奇者，吾得执而杀之，孰敢？
ddj-74-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-74-02.segmentation: If one could make the people constantly fear death, and there were those who acted strangely, I could seize and kill them—who would dare?
यदि जनाः नित्यं मरणात् बिभ्युः, विचित्र-कर्तारः, हत्वा कः धृष्टः?

ddj-74-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-74-03.segmentation: There is always One who is in charge of killing.

ddj-74-04.segmentation: 夫代司杀者杀，是谓代大匠斫。
ddj-74-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-74-04.segmentation: To take the place of the One in charge of killing is called hewing wood in place of the master carpenter.

ddj-74-05.segmentation: 夫代大匠斫者，希有不伤其手矣。
ddj-74-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-74-05.segmentation: Of those who hew wood in place of the master carpenter, few do not injure their own hands.
महत्-स्थापत्य-स्थाने छिन्वन्तः, दुर्लभाः हस्तं न क्षुण्णन्ति।

ddj-75-01.segmentation: 民之饥，以其上食税之多，是以饥。
ddj-75-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-75-01.segmentation: The people starve because those above eat too much in taxes—thus they starve.
जनानां क्षुधा, उपरि-जनानां बहु-कर-भक्षणात्, तस्माद् क्षुधा।

ddj-75-02.segmentation: 民之难治，以其上之有为，是以难治。
ddj-75-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-75-02.segmentation: The people are hard to govern because those above are given to action—thus they are hard to govern.
जनानां दुःशास्यता, उपरि-जनानां करणात्, तस्माद् दुःशास्यता।

ddj-75-03.segmentation: 民之轻死，以其上求生之厚，是以轻死。
ddj-75-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-75-03.segmentation: The people take death lightly because those above seek life too richly—thus they take death lightly.
जनानां मरण-लघुता, उपरि-जनानां जीवन-गौरवात्, तस्माद् मरण-लघुता।

ddj-75-04.segmentation: 夫唯无以生为者，是贤于贵生。
ddj-75-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-75-04.segmentation: Only one who does not make living his concern is wiser than one who values life.
यः जीवनं न करोति, स जीवन-पूजकात् श्रेष्ठः।

ddj-76-01.segmentation: 人之生也柔弱，其死也坚强。
ddj-76-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-76-01.segmentation: When people are alive they are soft and weak; when dead they are hard and stiff.

ddj-76-02.segmentation: 万物草木之生也柔脆，其死也枯槁。
ddj-76-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-76-02.segmentation: The myriad things, the grasses and trees, when alive are soft and fragile; when dead they are dry and withered.
भूतानि, तृण-वृक्षाः, जीवन्तः मृदु-भग्नाः, मृताः शुष्काः।

ddj-76-03.segmentation: 故坚强者死之徒，柔弱者生之徒。
ddj-76-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-76-03.segmentation: Therefore the hard and strong are companions of death; the soft and weak are companions of life.
तस्माद् दृढाः मृत्योः सहचराः, मृदवः जीवनस्य।

ddj-76-04.segmentation: 是以兵强则灭，木强则折。
ddj-76-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-76-04.segmentation: Thus when arms are strong they are destroyed; when a tree is strong it is broken.

ddj-76-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-76-05.segmentation: The strong and great take the lower place; the soft and weak take the higher place.

ddj-77-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-77-01.segmentation: The Way of Heaven—is it not like stretching a bow?

ddj-77-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-77-02.segmentation: What is high is brought down; what is low is raised;

ddj-77-03.segmentation: 有余者损之，不足者补之。
ddj-77-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-77-03.segmentation: What has surplus is diminished; what is insufficient is supplemented.

ddj-77-04.segmentation: 天之道，损有余而补不足。
ddj-77-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-77-04.segmentation: The Way of Heaven diminishes what has surplus and supplements what is insufficient.
द्योः मार्गः, अतिरिक्तं ह्रासयति, अ-पर्याप्तं पूरयति।

ddj-77-05.segmentation: 人之道则不然，损不足以奉有余。
ddj-77-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-77-05.segmentation: The way of man is not so: it diminishes what is insufficient to offer to what has surplus.
मनुष्य-मार्गः न तथा, अ-पर्याप्तं ह्रास्य अतिरिक्ताय समर्पयति।

ddj-77-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-77-06.segmentation: Who can take his surplus and offer it to the world?

ddj-77-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-77-07.segmentation: Only one who has the Way.

ddj-77-08.segmentation: 是以圣人为而不恃，功成而不处，其不欲见贤。
ddj-77-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-77-08.segmentation: Therefore the sage acts but does not rely; when the work is done he does not dwell on it; he does not wish to display his worth.
तस्माद् मुनिः करोति, न आश्रयति, सिद्धौ न तिष्ठति, गुण-दर्शनं न इच्छति।

ddj-78-01.segmentation: 天下莫柔弱于水，而攻坚强者莫之能胜，以其无以易之。
ddj-78-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-78-01.segmentation: Nothing under Heaven is softer and weaker than water, yet for attacking the hard and strong nothing can surpass it, because nothing can take its place.
जगति जलात् मृदुतरं नास्ति, दृढ-प्रहारे जलात् श्रेष्ठं नास्ति, तस्य अ-प्रतिस्थाप्यत्वात्।

ddj-78-02.segmentation: 弱之胜强，柔之胜刚，天下莫不知，莫能行。
ddj-78-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-78-02.segmentation: That the weak overcomes the strong, the soft overcomes the hard—none under Heaven does not know it, yet none can put it into practice.
दुर्बलः बलवन्तं, मृदुः दृढं जयति — जगति सर्वे जानन्ति, कर्तुं न शक्नुवन्ति।

ddj-78-03.segmentation: 是以圣人云：受国之垢，是谓社稷主；
ddj-78-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-78-03.segmentation: Therefore the sage says: He who takes upon himself the dirt of the state is called the lord of the altars of soil and grain;
तस्माद् मुनिः वदति: राज्य-मलं गृह्णाति, स राज्य-स्वामी;

ddj-78-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-78-04.segmentation: He who takes upon himself the misfortunes of the state is called the king of the world.

ddj-78-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-79-01.segmentation: 和大怨，必有余怨，安可以为善？
ddj-79-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-79-01.segmentation: When a great resentment is reconciled, there is sure to be leftover resentment—how can this be considered good?

ddj-79-02.segmentation: 是以圣人执左契，而不责于人。
ddj-79-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-79-02.segmentation: Therefore the sage holds the left-hand tally and does not press people for payment.
तस्माद् मुनिः वाम-पत्रं धारयति, जनान् न दण्डयति।

ddj-79-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-79-03.segmentation: One with virtue takes charge of the tally; one without virtue takes charge of the tax.
गुण-युक्तः पत्रं शास्ति, अ-गुणः करं शास्ति।

ddj-79-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-79-04.segmentation: The Way of Heaven shows no favoritism; it is always with the good person.
द्योः मार्गः न पक्षपाति, सदा शुभ-जनैः सह।

ddj-80-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-80-01.segmentation: Let the state be small and the people few.

ddj-80-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-80-02.segmentation: Let there be tools for tens and hundreds, yet none be used;

ddj-80-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-80-03.segmentation: Let the people take death seriously and not migrate far.
जनाः मरणं गौरवन्ति, दूरं न गच्छन्ति।

ddj-80-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-80-04.segmentation: Though there be boats and carriages, none will ride them;

ddj-80-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-80-05.segmentation: Though there be armor and weapons, none will display them.

ddj-80-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-80-06.segmentation: Let the people return to knotting cords and using them.

ddj-80-07.segmentation: 甘其食，美其服，安其居，乐其俗。
ddj-80-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-80-07.segmentation: Let them find their food sweet, their clothes beautiful, their dwellings peaceful, their customs delightful.
अन्नं मधुरम्, वस्त्रं शोभनम्, वासः शान्तः, रीतिः रमणीया।

ddj-80-08.segmentation: 邻国相望，鸡犬之声相闻，民至老死不相往来。
ddj-80-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-80-08.segmentation: Neighboring states may overlook one another, and the sounds of chickens and dogs be heard from each, yet the people grow old and die without coming and going among them.
समीप-राज्यानि दृश्यन्ते, कुक्कुट-श्वान-ध्वनयः श्रूयन्ते, जनाः जरया म्रियन्ते, न गच्छन्ति।

ddj-81-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-81-01.segmentation: True words are not beautiful; beautiful words are not true.
सत्य-वचनं न शोभनम्, शोभनं वचनं न सत्यम्।

ddj-81-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-81-02.segmentation: The good do not argue; those who argue are not good.
शुभाः न वादन्ति, वादिनः न शुभाः।

ddj-81-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-81-03.segmentation: Those who know are not broadly learned; the broadly learned do not know.
ज्ञातारः न बहु-विद्याः, बहु-विद्याः न ज्ञातारः।

ddj-81-04.segmentation: 圣人不积，既以为人己愈有，既以与人己愈多。
ddj-81-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-81-04.segmentation: The sage does not accumulate: having done for others, he has himself all the more; having given to others, he himself has all the more.
मुनिः न सञ्चयति, परेषां कृत्वा स्वं अधिकं, परेषां दत्वा स्वं अधिकम्।

ddj-81-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-81-05.segmentation: The Way of Heaven benefits and does not harm;
द्योः मार्गः, हितं करोति, न हिंसति;

ddj-81-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-81-06.segmentation: The Way of the sage acts but does not contend.

ddj-bs-01-01.explanation: 可以说出来的「道」，就不是那永恒不变的道。帛书用「恒」字，传世本多作「常」（避汉文帝刘恒讳）。
ddj-bs-01-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

terms.explanation: 本源、规律；此处指终极之「道」。
可以说、可以用言语称说。

ddj-bs-01-01.segmentation: The Way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way.

ddj-bs-01-02.explanation: 可以命名、固定下来的「名」，就不是那永恒的名。与上句「道／名」对举。
ddj-bs-01-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-01-02.segmentation: The name that can be named is not the constant name.

ddj-bs-01-03.explanation: 「无名」即万物（天地）之始。帛书此句作「万物之始」，传世本常见「天地之始」。
ddj-bs-01-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-01-03.segmentation: The nameless is the beginning of the myriad things.

ddj-bs-01-04.explanation: 「有名」即万物之母——有规定性的一面，是万物生成之所依。
ddj-bs-01-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-01-04.segmentation: The named is the mother of the myriad things.

ddj-bs-01-05.segmentation: 故恒无欲也，以观其妙，恒有欲也，以观其所徼。
ddj-bs-01-05.explanation: 常从「无欲」观其精微，从「有欲」观其边界／显现。帛书「恒无欲／恒有欲」连写于一句。
ddj-bs-01-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

terms.explanation: 恒常地有所指向、有欲求。

ddj-bs-01-05.segmentation: Therefore, constantly without desire, observe its subtlety; constantly with desire, observe its manifestations.

ddj-bs-01-06.segmentation: 两者同出，异名同谓，玄之又玄，众妙之门。
ddj-bs-01-06.explanation: 无欲／有欲，妙／徼，同出而异名，同谓之玄；玄之又玄，是众妙所出之门。
ddj-bs-01-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

terms.explanation: 妙与徼、无与有同出一源。

terms.note: 帛书作「同谓」；传世本或作「同谓之玄」。

ddj-bs-01-06.segmentation: These two emerge together—different names for the same calling; mystery upon mystery, the gateway of all subtleties.

ddj-bs-02-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-02-01.segmentation: When all under Heaven know beauty as beauty, then ugliness is already there;

ddj-bs-02-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-02-02.segmentation: When all know good as good, then what is not good is already there.

ddj-bs-02-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-02-03.segmentation: Being and non-being give birth to each other;

ddj-bs-02-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-02-04.segmentation: Difficult and easy complete each other;

ddj-bs-02-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-02-05.segmentation: Long and short shape each other;

ddj-bs-02-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-02-06.segmentation: High and low fill each other;

ddj-bs-02-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-02-07.segmentation: Tone and voice harmonize with each other;

ddj-bs-02-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-02-08.segmentation: Before and after follow each other—this is constant.

ddj-bs-02-09.segmentation: 是以圣人居无为之事，行不言之教。
ddj-bs-02-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-02-09.segmentation: Therefore the sage abides in affairs of non-action and practices the teaching without words.

ddj-bs-02-10.segmentation: 万物作而弗始也，为而弗恃也，成功而弗居也。
ddj-bs-02-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-02-10.segmentation: The myriad things arise and he does not turn them away; he gives life but does not possess; he acts but does not rely; when the work is done he does not dwell on it.

ddj-bs-02-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-02-11.segmentation: Precisely because he does not dwell on it, it does not leave him.

ddj-bs-03-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-03-01.segmentation: Do not exalt the worthy, and the people will not contend;

ddj-bs-03-02.segmentation: 不贵难得之货，使民不为盗。
ddj-bs-03-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-03-02.segmentation: Do not prize rare goods, and the people will not become thieves;

ddj-bs-03-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-03-03.segmentation: Do not display what can be desired, and the people's hearts will not be disturbed.

ddj-bs-03-04.segmentation: 是以圣人之治也，虚其心，实其腹，弱其志，强其骨。
ddj-bs-03-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-03-04.segmentation: Therefore the sage's way of governing empties their minds and fills their bellies;

ddj-bs-03-05.segmentation: 恒使民无知无欲也，使夫智不敢。
ddj-bs-03-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-03-05.segmentation: He constantly keeps the people without knowledge and without desire, so that the clever dare not act.

ddj-bs-03-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-03-06.segmentation: Act by non-action, and nothing will be left ungoverned.

ddj-bs-04-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-04-01.segmentation: The Way is empty, yet use it and it is never filled; how deep it is, as if the ancestor of the myriad things.

ddj-bs-04-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-04-02.segmentation: The Way is empty, yet use it and it is never filled; how deep it is, as if the ancestor of the myriad things.

ddj-bs-04-03.segmentation: 挫其锐，解其纷，和其光，同其尘。
ddj-bs-04-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-04-03.segmentation: Blunt the sharpness, untie the tangles, soften the glare, and merge with the dust.

ddj-bs-04-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-04-04.segmentation: Deep—it seems as if it were there.

ddj-bs-04-05.segmentation: 吾不知其谁之子也，象帝之先。
ddj-bs-04-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-04-05.segmentation: How deep and clear it seems to endure; I do not know whose child it is—it appears to precede the Lord.

ddj-bs-05-01.segmentation: 天地不仁，以万物为刍狗。
ddj-bs-05-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-05-01.segmentation: Heaven and Earth are not humane; they treat the myriad things as straw dogs;

ddj-bs-05-02.segmentation: 圣人不仁，以百姓为刍狗。
ddj-bs-05-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-05-02.segmentation: The sage is not humane; he treats the hundred clans as straw dogs.

ddj-bs-05-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-05-03.segmentation: Is the space between Heaven and Earth not like a bellows?

ddj-bs-05-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-05-04.segmentation: Empty yet inexhaustible; the more it moves, the more it yields.

ddj-bs-05-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-05-05.segmentation: Much talking leads to exhaustion; better to hold to the center.

ddj-bs-06-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-06-01.segmentation: The spirit of the valley never dies; this is called the mysterious female.

ddj-bs-06-02.segmentation: 玄牝之门，是谓天地之根。
ddj-bs-06-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-06-02.segmentation: The gateway of the mysterious female is called the root of Heaven and Earth.

ddj-bs-06-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-06-03.segmentation: Continuous and as if enduring, use it and it is never worn out.

ddj-bs-07-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-07-01.segmentation: Heaven is lasting and Earth endures.

ddj-bs-07-02.segmentation: 天地所以能长且久者，以其不自生，故能长生。
ddj-bs-07-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-07-02.segmentation: The reason Heaven and Earth can last and endure is that they do not live for themselves; thus they can live long.

ddj-bs-07-03.segmentation: 是以圣人后其身而身先，外其身而身存。
ddj-bs-07-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-07-03.segmentation: Therefore the sage puts his person behind and yet it comes first; sets his person aside and yet it is preserved.

ddj-bs-07-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-07-04.segmentation: Is it not because he is without self-interest?

ddj-bs-07-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-07-05.segmentation: Thus he is able to accomplish his own ends.

ddj-bs-08-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-08-01.segmentation: Highest good is like water. Water benefits the myriad things and stays quiet, dwelling where others dislike, and so comes close to the Way. In dwelling, good is the place; in heart, good is depth; in giving, good is Heaven; in speech, good is trust; in government, good is order; in affairs, good is ability; in action, good is timing. Only by not contending is there no blame.

ddj-bs-08-02.segmentation: 水善利万物而有静，居众人之所恶，故几于道矣。
ddj-bs-08-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-08-02.segmentation: Water benefits the myriad things and does not contend; it dwells in places the multitude dislike—thus it is close to the Way.

ddj-bs-08-03.segmentation: 居善地，心善渊，予善天，言善信，政善治，事善能，动善时。
ddj-bs-08-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-08-03.segmentation: In dwelling, good is the low place; in mind, good is depth; in giving, good is kindness; in speech, good is trustworthiness; in government, good is order; in affairs, good is ability; in action, good is timing.

ddj-bs-08-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-08-04.segmentation: Precisely because it does not contend, it is without blame.

ddj-bs-09-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-09-01.segmentation: To hold and fill it to the brim is not as good as stopping;

ddj-bs-09-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-09-02.segmentation: To hammer and sharpen it cannot keep it long.

ddj-bs-09-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-09-03.segmentation: A hall filled with gold and jade cannot be guarded;

ddj-bs-09-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-09-04.segmentation: Wealth and rank with arrogance bring their own calamity.

ddj-bs-09-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-09-05.segmentation: When the work is done, withdraw—this is the Way of Heaven.

ddj-bs-10-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-10-01.segmentation: In carrying the soul and embracing the One, can you keep from parting?

ddj-bs-10-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-10-02.segmentation: In concentrating the breath and making it soft, can you become as an infant?

ddj-bs-10-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-10-03.segmentation: In cleansing and purifying the mysterious mirror, can you be without blemish?

ddj-bs-10-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-10-04.segmentation: In loving the people and governing the state, can you practice non-action?

ddj-bs-10-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-10-05.segmentation: In the opening and closing of Heaven's gate, can you take the female part?

ddj-bs-10-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-10-06.segmentation: In understanding that reaches in all directions, can you be without knowledge?

ddj-bs-10-07.segmentation: 生之畜之，生而不有，为而不恃，长而不宰，是谓玄德。
ddj-bs-10-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-10-07.segmentation: Give them life and nurture them—give life without possessing, act without relying, lead without dominating: this is called mysterious virtue.

ddj-bs-11-01.segmentation: 三十辐共一毂，当其无，有车之用。
ddj-bs-11-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-11-01.segmentation: Thirty spokes share one hub; it is in the empty space that the use of the cart lies.

ddj-bs-11-02.segmentation: 埏埴以为器，当其无，有器之用。
ddj-bs-11-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-11-02.segmentation: Knead clay to make a vessel; it is in the empty space that the use of the vessel lies.

ddj-bs-11-03.segmentation: 凿户牖以为室，当其无，有室之用。
ddj-bs-11-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-11-03.segmentation: Cut doors and windows to make a room; it is in the empty space that the use of the room lies.

ddj-bs-11-04.segmentation: 故有之以为利，无之以为用。
ddj-bs-11-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-11-04.segmentation: Therefore what is has benefit; what is not has use.

ddj-bs-12-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-12-01.segmentation: The five colors make people's eyes blind;

ddj-bs-12-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-12-02.segmentation: The five tones make people's ears deaf;

ddj-bs-12-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-12-03.segmentation: The five flavors make people's mouths dull;

ddj-bs-12-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-12-04.segmentation: Racing and hunting make people's hearts go mad;

ddj-bs-12-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-12-05.segmentation: Goods hard to obtain make people's conduct go astray.

ddj-bs-12-06.segmentation: 是以圣人为腹不为目，故去彼取此。
ddj-bs-12-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-12-06.segmentation: Therefore the sage provides for the belly, not for the eyes; thus he discards that and takes this.

ddj-bs-13-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-13-01.segmentation: Favor and disgrace are alike startling; value great trouble as you value your body.

ddj-bs-13-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-13-02.segmentation: What is meant by "favor and disgrace are alike startling"?

ddj-bs-13-03.segmentation: 宠为下，得之若惊，失之若惊，是谓宠辱若惊。
ddj-bs-13-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-13-03.segmentation: Favor is lowly: gaining it startles, losing it startles—this is what is meant by favor and disgrace being alike startling.

ddj-bs-13-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-13-04.segmentation: What is meant by "value great trouble as you value your body"?

ddj-bs-13-05.segmentation: 吾所以有大患者，为吾有身，及吾无身，吾有何患？
ddj-bs-13-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-13-05.segmentation: The reason I have great trouble is that I have a body; if I had no body, what trouble would I have?

ddj-bs-13-06.segmentation: 故贵以身为天下，若可寄天下；
ddj-bs-13-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-13-06.segmentation: Therefore, one who values the world as he values his body may be entrusted with the world;

ddj-bs-13-07.segmentation: 爱以身为天下，若可托天下。
ddj-bs-13-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-13-07.segmentation: One who loves the world as he loves his body may be given charge of the world.

ddj-bs-14-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-14-01.segmentation: Look at it and you do not see it—it is called the Invisible;

ddj-bs-14-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-14-02.segmentation: Listen to it and you do not hear it—it is called the Inaudible;

ddj-bs-14-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-14-03.segmentation: Grasp at it and you do not get it—it is called the Intangible.

ddj-bs-14-04.segmentation: 此三者不可致诘，故混而为一。
ddj-bs-14-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-14-04.segmentation: These three cannot be further inquired into; therefore they merge and become one.

ddj-bs-14-05.segmentation: 其上不徼，其下不昧，绳绳兮不可名，复归于无物。
ddj-bs-14-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-14-05.segmentation: Above it is not bright; below it is not dark; continuous and unnameable, it returns again to no-thing.

ddj-bs-14-06.segmentation: 是谓无状之状，无物之象，是谓惚恍。
ddj-bs-14-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-14-06.segmentation: This is called the form of the formless, the image of no-thing—this is called the Vague and Elusive.

ddj-bs-14-07.segmentation: 迎之不见其首，随之不见其后。
ddj-bs-14-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-14-07.segmentation: Meet it and you see no front; follow it and you see no rear.

ddj-bs-14-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-14-08.segmentation: Hold to the Way of old to master the things of today.

ddj-bs-14-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-14-09.segmentation: To be able to know the ancient beginning—this is called the thread of the Way.

ddj-bs-15-01.segmentation: 古之善为道者，微妙玄通，深不可识。
ddj-bs-15-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-15-01.segmentation: Those of old who were good at practicing the Way were subtle, mysterious, penetrating, and too deep to be known.

ddj-bs-15-02.segmentation: 夫不唯不可识，故强为之容；
ddj-bs-15-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-15-02.segmentation: Precisely because they cannot be known, one can only force a description: Cautious, as if crossing a winter stream;

ddj-bs-15-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-15-03.segmentation: Precisely because they cannot be known, one can only force a description: Cautious, as if crossing a winter stream;

ddj-bs-15-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-15-04.segmentation: Hesitant, as if fearing the neighbors on all sides;

ddj-bs-15-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-15-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-15-06.segmentation: Yielding, like ice about to melt;

ddj-bs-15-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-15-07.segmentation: Simple and genuine, like uncarved wood;

ddj-bs-15-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-15-08.segmentation: Open and broad, like a valley;

ddj-bs-15-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-15-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-15-10.segmentation: Who can take the muddy and, by stillness, gradually make it clear?

ddj-bs-15-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-15-11.segmentation: Who can take the settled and, by long movement, gradually bring it to life?

ddj-bs-15-12.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-15-12.segmentation: Those who preserve this Way do not desire to be full.

ddj-bs-15-13.segmentation: 夫唯不盈，故能蔽而新成。
ddj-bs-15-13.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-15-13.segmentation: Precisely because they are not full, they can be worn and yet newly made.

ddj-bs-16-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-16-01.segmentation: Attain utmost emptiness; hold firmly to stillness.

ddj-bs-16-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-16-02.segmentation: The myriad things arise together; I watch their return.

ddj-bs-16-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-16-03.segmentation: Things flourish in abundance, yet each returns to its root.

ddj-bs-16-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-16-04.segmentation: Returning to the root is called stillness; stillness is called returning to destiny.

ddj-bs-16-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-16-05.segmentation: Returning to destiny is called the Constant; knowing the Constant is called insight.

ddj-bs-16-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-16-06.segmentation: Not knowing the Constant, one acts recklessly and meets with misfortune.

ddj-bs-16-07.segmentation: 知常容，容乃公，公乃全，全乃天，天乃道，道乃久，没身不殆。
ddj-bs-16-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-16-07.segmentation: Knowing the Constant, one is tolerant; tolerance leads to impartiality; impartiality leads to kingliness; kingliness leads to Heaven; Heaven leads to the Way; the Way leads to permanence—to the end of life one is without danger.

ddj-bs-17-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-17-01.segmentation: Of the highest, those below merely know that he exists;

ddj-bs-17-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-17-02.segmentation: Of the next, they draw near and praise him;

ddj-bs-17-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-17-03.segmentation: Of the next, they fear him;

ddj-bs-17-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-17-04.segmentation: Of the next, they insult him.

ddj-bs-17-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-17-05.segmentation: When trust is insufficient, there is distrust.

ddj-bs-17-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-17-06.segmentation: How leisurely he is, sparing of his words.

ddj-bs-17-07.segmentation: 功成事遂，百姓皆谓我自然。
ddj-bs-17-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-17-07.segmentation: When the work is done and affairs succeed, the hundred clans all say, "We did this ourselves."

ddj-bs-18-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-18-01.segmentation: When the Great Way is abandoned, there are benevolence and righteousness;

ddj-bs-18-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-18-02.segmentation: When wisdom and cleverness appear, there is great hypocrisy;

ddj-bs-18-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-18-03.segmentation: When the six relations are not in harmony, there are filial piety and parental kindness;

ddj-bs-18-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-18-04.segmentation: When the state is in disorder, there are loyal ministers.

ddj-bs-19-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-19-01.segmentation: Abolish sagehood and discard wisdom, and the people will benefit a hundredfold;

ddj-bs-19-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-19-02.segmentation: Abolish benevolence and discard righteousness, and the people will return to filial piety and kindness;

ddj-bs-19-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-19-03.segmentation: Abolish cleverness and discard profit, and there will be no thieves.

ddj-bs-19-04.segmentation: 此三者以为文不足，故令有所属；
ddj-bs-19-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-19-04.segmentation: These three, taken as outward culture, are not enough; therefore let people have something to hold to: look to the plain and embrace the uncarved; lessen self-interest and reduce desire.

ddj-bs-19-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-19-05.segmentation: These three, taken as outward culture, are not enough; therefore let people have something to hold to: look to the plain and embrace the uncarved; lessen self-interest and reduce desire.

ddj-bs-19-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-02.segmentation: How far is good from evil?

ddj-bs-20-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-03.segmentation: What people fear cannot but be feared.

ddj-bs-20-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-04.segmentation: How desolate—it has not yet reached its end!

ddj-bs-20-05.segmentation: 众人熙熙，如享太牢，如春登台。
ddj-bs-20-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-05.segmentation: The multitude are merry, as if enjoying a great feast, as if climbing a terrace in spring.

ddj-bs-20-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-06.segmentation: I alone am still, without sign—like an infant that has not yet smiled.

ddj-bs-20-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-07.segmentation: I alone am still, without sign—like an infant that has not yet smiled.

ddj-bs-20-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-08.segmentation: Weary and forlorn, as if I had nowhere to return.

ddj-bs-20-09.segmentation: 众人皆有余，而我独若遗。
ddj-bs-20-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-09.segmentation: The multitude all have more than enough, while I alone seem to have lost.

ddj-bs-20-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-10.segmentation: I have the mind of a fool indeed!

ddj-bs-20-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-11.segmentation: Ordinary people are bright and clear; I alone am dull and confused;

ddj-bs-20-12.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-12.segmentation: Ordinary people are sharp and discerning; I alone am closed and muffled.

ddj-bs-20-13.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-13.segmentation: Calm as the sea, drifting as if without end.

ddj-bs-20-14.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-14.segmentation: Calm as the sea, drifting as if without end.

ddj-bs-20-15.segmentation: 众人皆有以，而我独顽且鄙。
ddj-bs-20-15.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-15.segmentation: The multitude all have purpose, while I alone am stubborn and rustic.

ddj-bs-20-16.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-20-16.segmentation: I alone differ from others, and value drawing nourishment from the Mother.

ddj-bs-21-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-21-01.segmentation: The bearing of great virtue follows only the Way.

ddj-bs-21-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-21-02.segmentation: As a thing, the Way is only elusive and vague.

ddj-bs-21-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-21-03.segmentation: Vague and elusive—within it there is image;

ddj-bs-21-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-21-04.segmentation: Elusive and vague—within it there is substance.

ddj-bs-21-05.segmentation: 窈兮冥兮，其中有精，其精甚真，其中有信，自今及古，其名不去，以阅众甫。
ddj-bs-21-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-21-05.segmentation: From the present back to antiquity, its name has not departed; by it one surveys the beginnings of the multitude.

ddj-bs-21-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-21-06.segmentation: How do I know the form of the beginnings of the multitude?

ddj-bs-21-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-22-01.segmentation: 曲则全，枉则直，洼则盈，敝则新，少则得，多则惑。
ddj-bs-22-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-22-01.segmentation: Bent, then whole; crooked, then straight; hollow, then full; worn, then new; little, then gain; much, then confusion.

ddj-bs-22-02.segmentation: 是以圣人抱一为天下式。
ddj-bs-22-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-22-02.segmentation: Therefore the sage embraces the One and becomes the model for all under Heaven.

ddj-bs-22-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-22-03.segmentation: He does not display himself, and so is illustrious;

ddj-bs-22-04.segmentation: 不自是，故彰，不自伐，故有功；
ddj-bs-22-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-22-04.segmentation: He does not boast, and so has merit;

ddj-bs-22-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-22-05.segmentation: He does not vaunt himself, and so endures.

ddj-bs-22-06.segmentation: 夫唯不争，故天下莫能与之争。
ddj-bs-22-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-22-06.segmentation: Precisely because he does not contend, no one under Heaven can contend with him.

ddj-bs-22-07.segmentation: 古之所谓曲则全者，岂虚言哉？
ddj-bs-22-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-22-07.segmentation: The ancient saying "bent, then whole"—how could it be empty words?

ddj-bs-22-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-23-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-23-02.segmentation: 故飘风不终朝，骤雨不终日，孰为此者？
ddj-bs-23-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-23-02.segmentation: Therefore a whirlwind does not last a morning; a sudden rain does not last a day.

ddj-bs-23-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-23-04.segmentation: 天地尚不能久，而况于人乎？
ddj-bs-23-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-23-04.segmentation: Even Heaven and Earth cannot make them last—how much less can man?

ddj-bs-23-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-23-05.segmentation: Therefore one who engages in the Way becomes one with the Way;

ddj-bs-23-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-23-06.segmentation: One who engages in virtue becomes one with virtue;

ddj-bs-23-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-23-07.segmentation: One who engages in loss becomes one with loss.

ddj-bs-23-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-23-08.segmentation: One who is one with the Way—the Way also gladly receives him;

ddj-bs-23-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-23-09.segmentation: One who is one with virtue—virtue also gladly receives him;

ddj-bs-23-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-23-10.segmentation: One who is one with loss—loss also gladly receives him.

ddj-bs-23-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-23-11.segmentation: When trust is insufficient, there is distrust.

ddj-bs-24-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-24-01.segmentation: He who stands on tiptoe cannot stand firm;

ddj-bs-24-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-24-02.segmentation: He who displays himself is not illustrious;

ddj-bs-24-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-24-03.segmentation: He who asserts himself is not distinguished;

ddj-bs-24-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-24-04.segmentation: He who boasts has no merit;

ddj-bs-24-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-24-05.segmentation: He who vaunts himself does not endure.

ddj-bs-24-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-24-06.segmentation: In the Way, such things are called leftover food and superfluous growths.

ddj-bs-24-07.segmentation: 物或恶之，故有道者不处。
ddj-bs-24-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-24-07.segmentation: Things may detest them; therefore one who has the Way does not abide in them.

ddj-bs-25-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-25-01.segmentation: There was something formed in chaos, born before Heaven and Earth.

ddj-bs-25-02.segmentation: 寂兮寥兮，独立而不改，周行而不殆，可以为天地母。
ddj-bs-25-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-25-02.segmentation: Silent and void, it stands alone and does not change; it cycles and does not weary—it may be the mother of Heaven and Earth.

ddj-bs-25-03.segmentation: 吾不知其名，强字之曰：道，强为之名曰：大。
ddj-bs-25-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-25-03.segmentation: I do not know its name; I style it "the Way," and force a name upon it, calling it "Great."

ddj-bs-25-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-25-04.segmentation: Great means passing on; passing on means going far; going far means returning.

ddj-bs-25-05.segmentation: 故道大，天大，地大，人亦大。
ddj-bs-25-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-25-05.segmentation: Therefore the Way is great, Heaven is great, Earth is great, and man also is great.

ddj-bs-25-06.segmentation: 域中有四大，而人居其一焉。
ddj-bs-25-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-25-06.segmentation: In the realm there are four greats, and man is one of them.

ddj-bs-25-07.segmentation: 人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然。
ddj-bs-25-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-25-07.segmentation: Man models himself on Earth; Earth models itself on Heaven; Heaven models itself on the Way; the Way models itself on what is naturally so.

ddj-bs-26-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-26-01.segmentation: Heaviness is the root of lightness; stillness is the master of restlessness.

ddj-bs-26-02.segmentation: 是以君子终日行不离辎重，虽有荣观，燕处超然。
ddj-bs-26-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-26-02.segmentation: Therefore the sage travels all day without leaving his baggage wagons.

ddj-bs-26-03.segmentation: 奈何万乘之主，而以身轻天下？
ddj-bs-26-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-26-03.segmentation: How then can the lord of ten thousand chariots take his own person lightly in ruling the world?

ddj-bs-26-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-26-04.segmentation: Lightness loses the root; restlessness loses the master.

ddj-bs-27-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-27-01.segmentation: A good traveler leaves no track;

ddj-bs-27-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-27-02.segmentation: A good speaker leaves no flaw for blame;

ddj-bs-27-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-27-03.segmentation: A good reckoner needs no counting rods;

ddj-bs-27-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-27-04.segmentation: A good closer needs no bolts, yet none can open;

ddj-bs-27-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-27-05.segmentation: A good binder needs no ropes, yet none can untie.

ddj-bs-27-06.segmentation: 是以圣人常善救人，故无弃人；
ddj-bs-27-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-27-06.segmentation: Therefore the sage is always good at saving people, and so abandons no one;

ddj-bs-27-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-27-07.segmentation: Always good at saving things, and so abandons nothing.

ddj-bs-27-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-27-08.segmentation: This is called clothing oneself in light.

ddj-bs-27-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-27-09.segmentation: Therefore the good man is the teacher of the not-good;

ddj-bs-27-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-27-10.segmentation: The not-good man is the material of the good.

ddj-bs-27-11.segmentation: 不贵其师，不爱其资，虽智大迷，是谓要妙。
ddj-bs-27-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-27-11.segmentation: Not to value the teacher, not to love the material—though wise, one is greatly confused: this is called the essential mystery.

ddj-bs-28-01.segmentation: 知其雄，守其雌，为天下溪。
ddj-bs-28-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-28-01.segmentation: Know the male, yet keep to the female, and be the stream of the world.

ddj-bs-28-02.segmentation: 为天下溪，常德不离，复归于婴儿。
ddj-bs-28-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-28-02.segmentation: Being the stream of the world, constant virtue does not depart, and one returns again to the infant.

ddj-bs-28-03.segmentation: 知其白，守其黑，为天下式，为天下式，常德不忒，复归于无极。
ddj-bs-28-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-28-03.segmentation: Being the model of the world, constant virtue does not err, and one returns again to the limitless.

ddj-bs-28-04.segmentation: 知其荣，守其辱，为天下谷。
ddj-bs-28-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-28-04.segmentation: Know honor, yet keep to disgrace, and be the valley of the world.

ddj-bs-28-05.segmentation: 为天下谷，常德乃足，复归于朴。
ddj-bs-28-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-28-05.segmentation: Being the valley of the world, constant virtue is then sufficient, and one returns again to the uncarved block.

ddj-bs-28-06.segmentation: 朴散则为器，圣人用之，则为官长，故大制不割。
ddj-bs-28-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-28-06.segmentation: When the uncarved block is scattered, it becomes vessels; the sage uses it and becomes the chief of officers.

ddj-bs-29-01.segmentation: 将欲取天下而为之，吾见其不得已。
ddj-bs-29-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-29-01.segmentation: If one would take the world and act upon it, I see that he will not succeed.

ddj-bs-29-02.segmentation: 天下神器，不可为也，不可执也。
ddj-bs-29-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-29-02.segmentation: The world is a sacred vessel; it cannot be acted upon.

ddj-bs-29-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-29-03.segmentation: He who acts upon it ruins it; he who grasps it loses it.

ddj-bs-29-04.segmentation: 是以圣人无为，故无败，故无失。
ddj-bs-29-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-29-04.segmentation: Therefore the sage does nothing, and so does not fail, and so does not lose.

ddj-bs-29-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-29-05.segmentation: Therefore among things, some go forward, some follow;

ddj-bs-29-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-29-06.segmentation: Some blow warm, some blow cold;

ddj-bs-29-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-29-07.segmentation: Some are strong, some are weak;

ddj-bs-29-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-29-08.segmentation: Some are loaded, some are broken.

ddj-bs-29-09.segmentation: 是以圣人去甚、去奢、去泰。
ddj-bs-29-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-29-09.segmentation: Therefore the sage discards extremes, discards extravagance, discards excess.

ddj-bs-30-01.segmentation: 以道佐人主者，不以兵强天下，其事好还。
ddj-bs-30-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-30-01.segmentation: One who assists a ruler with the Way does not use arms to force the world.

ddj-bs-30-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-30-02.segmentation: Such affairs tend to rebound: where armies encamp, thorns and brambles grow;

ddj-bs-30-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-30-03.segmentation: After a great war, there are sure to be years of famine.

ddj-bs-30-04.segmentation: 善有果而已，不敢以取强。
ddj-bs-30-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-30-04.segmentation: A good commander achieves his end and stops; he dares not take by force.

ddj-bs-30-05.segmentation: 果而勿矜，果而勿伐，果而勿骄，果而不得已，果而勿强。
ddj-bs-30-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-30-05.segmentation: Achieve the end and do not boast; achieve and do not brag; achieve and do not be proud; achieve only as a last resort; achieve and do not force.

ddj-bs-30-06.segmentation: 物壮则老，是谓不道，不道早已。
ddj-bs-30-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-30-06.segmentation: When things are strong they grow old—this is called contrary to the Way; what is contrary to the Way comes to an early end.

ddj-bs-31-01.segmentation: 夫兵者，不祥之器，物或恶之，故有道者不处。
ddj-bs-31-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-31-01.segmentation: Arms are instruments of ill omen; things may detest them; therefore one who has the Way does not abide by them.

ddj-bs-31-02.segmentation: 君子居则贵左，用兵则贵右。
ddj-bs-31-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-31-02.segmentation: The gentleman values the left in ordinary dwelling; when using arms he values the right.

ddj-bs-31-03.segmentation: 兵者不祥之器，非君子之器，不得已而用之，恬淡为上，胜而不美，而美之者，是乐杀人。
ddj-bs-31-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-31-03.segmentation: Arms are instruments of ill omen, not the instruments of a gentleman; he uses them only when he must, and calm detachment is best.

ddj-bs-31-04.segmentation: 夫乐杀人者，则不可得志于天下矣。
ddj-bs-31-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-31-04.segmentation: One who delights in killing men cannot fulfill his will under Heaven.

ddj-bs-31-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-31-05.segmentation: Auspicious affairs honor the left; inauspicious affairs honor the right.

ddj-bs-31-06.segmentation: 偏将军居左，上将军居右。
ddj-bs-31-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-31-06.segmentation: The lieutenant general stands on the left, the senior general on the right—this means they are treated with funeral rites.

ddj-bs-31-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-31-07.segmentation: The lieutenant general stands on the left, the senior general on the right—this means they are treated with funeral rites.

ddj-bs-31-08.segmentation: 杀人之众，以悲哀莅之，战胜以丧礼处之。
ddj-bs-31-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-31-08.segmentation: When many are slain, weep for them with grief; when victorious, treat it with funeral rites.

ddj-bs-32-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-32-01.segmentation: The Way is constantly nameless; though the uncarved block is small, none under Heaven can make it a subject.

ddj-bs-32-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-32-02.segmentation: The Way is constantly nameless; though the uncarved block is small, none under Heaven can make it a subject.

ddj-bs-32-03.segmentation: 候王若能守之，万物将自宾。
ddj-bs-32-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-32-03.segmentation: If lords and kings can keep to it, the myriad things will of themselves submit as guests.

ddj-bs-32-04.segmentation: 天地相合，以降甘露，民莫之令而自均。
ddj-bs-32-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-32-04.segmentation: Heaven and Earth join and send down sweet dew; the people, without being commanded, share it evenly of themselves.

ddj-bs-32-05.segmentation: 始制有名，名亦既有，夫亦将知止，知止可以不殆。
ddj-bs-32-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-32-05.segmentation: When institutions begin, names appear; once there are names, one should also know when to stop.

ddj-bs-32-06.segmentation: 譬道之在天下，犹川谷之于江海。
ddj-bs-32-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-32-06.segmentation: The Way's presence in the world is like streams and valleys flowing to the rivers and the sea.

ddj-bs-33-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-33-01.segmentation: To know others is wisdom; to know oneself is insight.

ddj-bs-33-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-33-02.segmentation: To conquer others is strength; to conquer oneself is true power.

ddj-bs-33-03.segmentation: 知足者富，强行者有志，不失其所者久，死而不亡者寿。
ddj-bs-33-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-33-03.segmentation: Not to lose one's place is to endure; to die and yet not perish is to live long.

ddj-bs-34-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-34-01.segmentation: The Great Way floods everywhere; it may go left or right.

ddj-bs-34-02.segmentation: 万物恃之以生而不辞，功成而不有。
ddj-bs-34-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-34-02.segmentation: The myriad things rely on it to live, and it does not refuse them; when the work is done, it claims no name of possession.

ddj-bs-34-03.segmentation: 衣养万物而不为主，常无欲，可名于小；
ddj-bs-34-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-34-03.segmentation: It clothes and nourishes the myriad things yet does not act as their master; always without desire, it may be named small;

ddj-bs-34-04.segmentation: 万物归焉而不为主，可名为大。
ddj-bs-34-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-34-04.segmentation: The myriad things return to it yet it does not act as their master—it may be named great.

ddj-bs-34-05.segmentation: 以其终不自为大，故能成其大。
ddj-bs-34-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-34-05.segmentation: Because to the end it does not make itself great, it is able to achieve its greatness.

ddj-bs-35-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-35-01.segmentation: Hold the great image, and the world will come.

ddj-bs-35-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-35-02.segmentation: Coming, they suffer no harm, but find peace, evenness, and ease.

ddj-bs-35-03.segmentation: 乐与饵，过客止，道之出口，淡乎其无味，视之不足见，听之不足闻，用之不足既。
ddj-bs-35-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-35-03.segmentation: When the Way comes forth from the mouth, how bland—it has no flavor; look, and it is not enough to see; listen, and it is not enough to hear; use it, and it is not enough to exhaust.

ddj-bs-36-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-36-01.segmentation: What is to be contracted must first be expanded;

ddj-bs-36-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-36-02.segmentation: What is to be weakened must first be strengthened;

ddj-bs-36-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-36-03.segmentation: What is to be abolished must first be raised;

ddj-bs-36-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-36-04.segmentation: What is to be taken must first be given.

ddj-bs-36-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-36-05.segmentation: The soft and weak overcome the hard and strong.

ddj-bs-36-06.segmentation: 鱼不可脱于渊，国之利器不可以示人。
ddj-bs-36-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-36-06.segmentation: Fish cannot leave the depths; the sharp instruments of the state must not be shown to others.

ddj-bs-37-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-37-01.segmentation: The Way constantly does nothing, yet nothing is left undone.

ddj-bs-37-02.segmentation: 候王若能守之，万物将自化。
ddj-bs-37-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-37-02.segmentation: If lords and kings can keep to it, the myriad things will transform of themselves.

ddj-bs-37-03.segmentation: 化而欲作，吾将镇之以无名之朴，镇之以无名之朴，夫将不欲。
ddj-bs-37-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-37-03.segmentation: If, transforming, desire should arise, I will quiet it with the nameless uncarved block.

ddj-bs-37-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-37-04.segmentation: Without desire and thus still, the world will settle of itself.

ddj-bs-38-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-38-01.segmentation: Highest virtue is not virtue, and therefore it has virtue;

ddj-bs-38-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-38-02.segmentation: Lower virtue never loses virtue, and therefore it has no virtue.

ddj-bs-38-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-38-03.segmentation: Highest virtue does nothing and has no motive for doing;

ddj-bs-38-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-38-04.segmentation: Lower virtue acts and has a motive for acting.

ddj-bs-38-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-38-05.segmentation: Highest benevolence acts but has no motive for acting;

ddj-bs-38-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-38-06.segmentation: Highest righteousness acts and has a motive for acting.

ddj-bs-38-07.segmentation: 上礼为之而莫之应，则攘臂而扔之。
ddj-bs-38-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-38-07.segmentation: Highest propriety acts, and when none respond, it rolls up its sleeves and forces them.

ddj-bs-38-08.segmentation: 故失道而后德，失德而后仁，失仁而后义，失义而后礼。
ddj-bs-38-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-38-08.segmentation: Therefore when the Way is lost, then comes virtue; when virtue is lost, then comes benevolence; when benevolence is lost, then comes righteousness; when righteousness is lost, then comes propriety.

ddj-bs-38-09.segmentation: 夫礼者，忠信之薄，而乱之首。
ddj-bs-38-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-38-09.segmentation: Propriety is the thinning of loyalty and trust, and the beginning of disorder.

ddj-bs-38-10.segmentation: 前识者，道之华，而愚之始。
ddj-bs-38-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-38-10.segmentation: Foresight is the flower of the Way, and the beginning of folly.

ddj-bs-38-11.segmentation: 是以大丈夫处其厚，不居其薄；
ddj-bs-38-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-38-11.segmentation: Therefore the great man abides in the thick, and does not dwell in the thin;

ddj-bs-38-12.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-38-12.segmentation: Abides in the substance, and does not dwell in the flower.

ddj-bs-38-13.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-38-13.segmentation: Thus he discards that and takes this.

ddj-bs-39-01.segmentation: 昔之得一者，天得一以清；
ddj-bs-39-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-01.segmentation: Of those who of old attained the One: Heaven attained the One and became clear;

ddj-bs-39-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-02.segmentation: Earth attained the One and became settled;

ddj-bs-39-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-03.segmentation: Spirits attained the One and became efficacious;

ddj-bs-39-04.segmentation: 谷得一以盈，万物得一以生；
ddj-bs-39-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-04.segmentation: The myriad things attained the One and came to life;

ddj-bs-39-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-05.segmentation: Lords and kings attained the One and became the standard for the world.

ddj-bs-39-06.segmentation: 其致之也，谓天无以清，将恐裂；
ddj-bs-39-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-06.segmentation: What brings this about: if Heaven had nothing by which to be clear, it would, I fear, split;

ddj-bs-39-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-07.segmentation: If Earth had nothing by which to be settled, it would, I fear, collapse;

ddj-bs-39-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-08.segmentation: If spirits had nothing by which to be efficacious, they would, I fear, cease;

ddj-bs-39-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-09.segmentation: If valleys had nothing by which to be full, they would, I fear, dry up;

ddj-bs-39-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-10.segmentation: If the myriad things had nothing by which to live, they would, I fear, perish;

ddj-bs-39-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-11.segmentation: If lords and kings had nothing by which to be noble and high, they would, I fear, fall.

ddj-bs-39-12.segmentation: 故贵以贱为本，高以下为基。
ddj-bs-39-12.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-12.segmentation: Therefore the noble takes the lowly as its root; the high takes the low as its foundation.

ddj-bs-39-13.segmentation: 是以侯王自称孤、寡、不谷。
ddj-bs-39-13.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-13.segmentation: Thus lords and kings call themselves "orphan," "lonely," and "unworthy."

ddj-bs-39-14.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-14.segmentation: Is this not taking the lowly as the root?

ddj-bs-39-15.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-16.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-16.segmentation: Hence the highest praise is without praise.

ddj-bs-39-17.segmentation: 是故不欲琭琭如玉，珞珞如石。
ddj-bs-39-17.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-39-17.segmentation: Do not desire to shine like jade, or to be hard like stone.

ddj-bs-40-01.segmentation: 反者道之动，弱者道之用。
ddj-bs-40-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-40-01.segmentation: Return is the movement of the Way; weakness is the use of the Way.

ddj-bs-40-02.segmentation: 天下万物生于有，有生于无。
ddj-bs-40-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-40-02.segmentation: The myriad things under Heaven are born of being; being is born of non-being.

ddj-bs-41-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-01.segmentation: When the highest type of man hears the Way, he diligently puts it into practice;

ddj-bs-41-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-02.segmentation: When the middling type hears the Way, he seems to keep it and seems to lose it;

ddj-bs-41-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-03.segmentation: When the lowest type hears the Way, he laughs aloud at it.

ddj-bs-41-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-04.segmentation: If it were not laughed at, it would not be fit to be the Way.

ddj-bs-41-05.segmentation: 故建言有之：明道若昧，进道若退，夷道若纇。
ddj-bs-41-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-05.segmentation: Therefore the established sayings have it: The bright Way seems dark;

ddj-bs-41-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-06.segmentation: Highest virtue seems like a valley;

ddj-bs-41-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-11.segmentation: The great square has no corners;

ddj-bs-41-12.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-12.segmentation: The great vessel is late in being completed;
