ddj-bs-41-13.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-13.segmentation: The great note has a rarefied sound;

ddj-bs-41-14.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-14.segmentation: The great image has no form.

ddj-bs-41-15.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-15.segmentation: The Way is hidden and nameless.

ddj-bs-41-16.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-41-16.segmentation: Only the Way is good at lending and bringing things to completion.

ddj-bs-42-01.segmentation: 道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物。
ddj-bs-42-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-42-01.segmentation: The Way gives birth to One; One gives birth to Two; Two gives birth to Three; Three gives birth to the myriad things.

ddj-bs-42-02.segmentation: 万物负阴而抱阳，冲气以为和。
ddj-bs-42-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-42-02.segmentation: The myriad things carry yin on their backs and embrace yang; the blending of the vital breaths makes harmony.

ddj-bs-42-03.segmentation: 人之所恶，唯孤、寡、不谷，而王公以为称。
ddj-bs-42-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-42-03.segmentation: What people detest—"orphan," "lonely," and "unworthy"—kings and dukes take as titles.

ddj-bs-42-04.segmentation: 故物或损之而益，或益之而损。
ddj-bs-42-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-42-04.segmentation: Therefore some things are diminished and thereby gain; some are increased and thereby diminish.

ddj-bs-42-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-42-05.segmentation: What others teach, I also teach: the violent and overbearing do not meet a natural death—I take this as the father of my teaching.

ddj-bs-42-06.segmentation: 强梁者不得其死，吾将以为教父。
ddj-bs-42-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-42-06.segmentation: What others teach, I also teach: the violent and overbearing do not meet a natural death—I take this as the father of my teaching.

ddj-bs-43-01.segmentation: 天下之至柔，驰骋天下之至坚。
ddj-bs-43-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-43-01.segmentation: The softest thing under Heaven races through the hardest under Heaven.

ddj-bs-43-02.segmentation: 无有入无间，吾是以知无为之有益。
ddj-bs-43-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-43-02.segmentation: That which has no being enters where there is no space; thereby I know the benefit of non-action.

ddj-bs-43-03.segmentation: 不言之教，无为之益，天下希及之。
ddj-bs-43-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-43-03.segmentation: The teaching without words, the benefit of non-action—few under Heaven attain to these.

ddj-bs-44-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-44-01.segmentation: Fame or the body—which is dearer?

ddj-bs-44-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-44-02.segmentation: The body or goods—which is worth more?

ddj-bs-44-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-44-03.segmentation: Gain or loss—which is the greater affliction?

ddj-bs-44-04.segmentation: 甚爱必大费，多藏必厚亡。
ddj-bs-44-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-44-04.segmentation: Excessive love must bring great expense;

ddj-bs-44-05.segmentation: 故知足不辱，知止不殆，可以长久。
ddj-bs-44-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-44-05.segmentation: Therefore know contentment and you will not be disgraced; know when to stop and you will not be in danger—you can last long.

ddj-bs-45-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-45-01.segmentation: Great completion seems incomplete, yet its use is never worn out.

ddj-bs-45-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-45-02.segmentation: Great fullness seems empty, yet its use is never exhausted.

ddj-bs-45-03.segmentation: 大直若屈，大巧若拙，大辩若讷。
ddj-bs-45-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-45-03.segmentation: Great straightness seems bent; great skill seems clumsy; great eloquence seems stammering.

ddj-bs-45-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-45-04.segmentation: Restlessness overcomes cold; stillness overcomes heat.

ddj-bs-45-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-45-05.segmentation: Clarity and stillness set the world in order.

ddj-bs-46-01.segmentation: 天下有道，却走马以粪，天下无道，戎马生于郊。
ddj-bs-46-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-46-01.segmentation: When the world has the Way, spare horses are used for manure;

ddj-bs-46-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-46-02.segmentation: No disaster is greater than not knowing contentment;

ddj-bs-46-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-46-03.segmentation: No fault is greater than the desire to get.

ddj-bs-46-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-46-04.segmentation: Therefore the contentment of knowing contentment is lasting contentment.

ddj-bs-47-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-47-01.segmentation: Without going out the door, know the world;

ddj-bs-47-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-47-02.segmentation: Without looking through the window, see the Way of Heaven.

ddj-bs-47-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-47-03.segmentation: The farther one goes out, the less one knows.

ddj-bs-47-04.segmentation: 是以圣人不行而知，不见而明，不为而成。
ddj-bs-47-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-47-04.segmentation: Therefore the sage knows without traveling, understands without seeing, and accomplishes without acting.

ddj-bs-48-01.segmentation: 为学日益，为道日损，损之又损，以至于无为。
ddj-bs-48-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-48-01.segmentation: Decrease and again decrease, until one reaches non-action.

ddj-bs-48-02.segmentation: 无为而无不为，取天下常以无事；
ddj-bs-48-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-48-02.segmentation: Through non-action, nothing is left undone.

ddj-bs-48-03.segmentation: 及其有事，不足以取天下。
ddj-bs-48-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-48-03.segmentation: To take the world, one must always be without meddling; when there is meddling, one is not fit to take the world.

ddj-bs-49-01.segmentation: 圣人常无心，以百姓之心为心。
ddj-bs-49-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-49-01.segmentation: The sage has no fixed mind; he takes the mind of the hundred clans as his mind.

ddj-bs-49-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-49-02.segmentation: Those who are good I treat as good; those who are not good I also treat as good—this is the virtue of goodness.

ddj-bs-49-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-49-03.segmentation: Those who are good I treat as good; those who are not good I also treat as good—this is the virtue of goodness.

ddj-bs-49-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-49-04.segmentation: Those who are trustworthy I trust; those who are not trustworthy I also trust—this is the virtue of trust.

ddj-bs-49-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-49-05.segmentation: Those who are trustworthy I trust; those who are not trustworthy I also trust—this is the virtue of trust.

ddj-bs-49-06.segmentation: 圣人在天下，歙歙焉为天下浑其心，百姓皆注其耳目，圣人皆孩之。
ddj-bs-49-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-49-06.segmentation: The sage in the world gathers it in and makes the world's mind one and muddled.

ddj-bs-50-01.segmentation: 出生入死，生之徒，十有三；
ddj-bs-50-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-50-01.segmentation: Companions of life are three in ten;

ddj-bs-50-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-50-02.segmentation: Companions of death are three in ten;

ddj-bs-50-03.segmentation: 人之生，动之于死地，亦十有三。
ddj-bs-50-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-50-03.segmentation: People whose living moves them onto the ground of death are also three in ten.

ddj-bs-50-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-50-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-50-05.segmentation: Because they live life too richly.

ddj-bs-50-06.segmentation: 盖闻善摄生者，陆行不遇兕虎，入军不被甲兵。
ddj-bs-50-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-50-06.segmentation: I have heard that one skilled at preserving life walks on land without meeting rhinoceros or tiger, and enters the army without being touched by armor or weapons.

ddj-bs-50-07.segmentation: 兕无所投其角，虎无所措其爪，兵无所容其刃。
ddj-bs-50-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-50-07.segmentation: The rhinoceros finds no place to thrust its horn, the tiger no place to set its claws, weapons no place to lodge their blades.

ddj-bs-50-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-50-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-50-09.segmentation: Because he has no ground of death.

ddj-bs-51-01.segmentation: 道生之，德畜之，物形之，势成之。
ddj-bs-51-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-51-01.segmentation: The Way gives them birth; virtue rears them; things give them form; circumstances bring them to completion.

ddj-bs-51-02.segmentation: 是以万物莫不尊道而贵德。
ddj-bs-51-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-51-02.segmentation: Therefore among the myriad things none fails to honor the Way and prize virtue.

ddj-bs-51-03.segmentation: 道之尊，德之贵，夫莫之命而常自然。
ddj-bs-51-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-51-03.segmentation: The honor of the Way and the prizing of virtue—none commands it, yet it is always naturally so.

ddj-bs-51-04.segmentation: 故道生之，德畜之，长之育之，亭之毒之；
ddj-bs-51-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-51-04.segmentation: Therefore the Way gives them birth, and virtue rears them;

ddj-bs-51-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-51-06.segmentation: 生而不有，为而不恃，长而不宰，是谓玄德。
ddj-bs-51-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-51-06.segmentation: It gives birth but does not possess; acts but does not rely; raises but does not rule—this is called mysterious virtue.

ddj-bs-52-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-52-01.segmentation: The world has a beginning; take it as the mother of the world.

ddj-bs-52-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-52-02.segmentation: Having found the mother, one knows her children;

ddj-bs-52-03.segmentation: 既知其子，复守其母，没身不殆。
ddj-bs-52-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-52-03.segmentation: Having known the children, return and keep to the mother, and to the end of life one is without danger.

ddj-bs-52-04.segmentation: 塞其兑，闭其门，终身不勤。
ddj-bs-52-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-52-04.segmentation: Block the openings, shut the doors, and all one's life one will not toil.

ddj-bs-52-05.segmentation: 开其兑，济其事，终身不救。
ddj-bs-52-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-52-05.segmentation: Open the openings, multiply affairs, and all one's life one will not be saved.

ddj-bs-52-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-52-06.segmentation: To see the small is called insight; to keep to the soft is called strength.

ddj-bs-52-07.segmentation: 用其光，复归其明，无遗身殃；
ddj-bs-52-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-52-07.segmentation: Use the light, return again to insight, leave the body no calamity—this is called practicing the Constant.

ddj-bs-52-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-52-08.segmentation: This is called wearing the constant.

ddj-bs-53-01.segmentation: 使我介然有知，行于大道，唯施是畏。
ddj-bs-53-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-53-01.segmentation: If I had even a shred of knowledge, walking on the great Way, I would fear only going astray.

ddj-bs-53-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-53-02.segmentation: The great Way is very level, yet people love bypaths.

ddj-bs-53-03.segmentation: 朝甚除，田甚芜，仓甚虚，服文采，带利剑，厌饮食，财货有余，是谓盗竽。
ddj-bs-53-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-53-03.segmentation: Wearing patterned clothes, carrying sharp swords, sated with food and drink, with goods in surplus—this is called the swagger of robbers.

ddj-bs-53-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-54-01.segmentation: 善建者不拔，善抱者不脱，子孙以祭祀不辍。
ddj-bs-54-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-54-01.segmentation: What is well planted is not uprooted; what is well embraced is not pulled away—sons and grandsons will offer sacrifice without cease.

ddj-bs-54-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-54-02.segmentation: Cultivate it in the person, and its virtue is genuine;

ddj-bs-54-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-54-03.segmentation: Cultivate it in the family, and its virtue has surplus;

ddj-bs-54-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-54-04.segmentation: Cultivate it in the village, and its virtue endures;

ddj-bs-54-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-54-05.segmentation: Cultivate it in the state, and its virtue is abundant;

ddj-bs-54-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-54-06.segmentation: Cultivate it in the world, and its virtue is universal.

ddj-bs-54-07.segmentation: 故以身观身，以家观家，以乡观乡，以邦观邦，以天下观天下。
ddj-bs-54-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-54-07.segmentation: Therefore observe persons by the person, families by the family, villages by the village, states by the state, the world by the world.

ddj-bs-54-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-54-08.segmentation: How do I know that the world is so?

ddj-bs-54-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-55-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-55-01.segmentation: One who holds virtue in abundance may be compared to a newborn child.

ddj-bs-55-02.segmentation: 毒虫不螫，猛兽不据,攫鸟不搏。
ddj-bs-55-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-55-02.segmentation: Poisonous insects do not sting it, fierce beasts do not seize it, birds of prey do not strike it.

ddj-bs-55-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-55-03.segmentation: Its bones are weak and its sinews soft, yet its grip is firm; it does not yet know the union of male and female, yet its organ stirs—this is the perfection of essence.

ddj-bs-55-04.segmentation: 未知牝牡之合而朘作，精之至也。
ddj-bs-55-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-55-04.segmentation: Its bones are weak and its sinews soft, yet its grip is firm; it does not yet know the union of male and female, yet its organ stirs—this is the perfection of essence.

ddj-bs-55-05.segmentation: 终日号而不嗄，和之至也。
ddj-bs-55-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-55-05.segmentation: It cries all day and does not grow hoarse—this is the perfection of harmony.

ddj-bs-55-06.segmentation: 知和曰常，知常曰明，益生曰祥，心使气曰强。
ddj-bs-55-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-55-06.segmentation: To know harmony is called the Constant; to know the Constant is called insight; to force life is called ominous; for the mind to drive the vital breath is called forcing.

ddj-bs-55-07.segmentation: 物壮则老，谓之不道，不道早已。
ddj-bs-55-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-55-07.segmentation: When things are strong they grow old—this is called contrary to the Way; what is contrary to the Way comes to an early end.

ddj-bs-56-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-56-01.segmentation: Those who know do not speak; those who speak do not know.

ddj-bs-56-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-56-02.segmentation: Block the openings, shut the doors;

ddj-bs-56-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-56-03.segmentation: Blunt the sharpness, untie the tangles;

ddj-bs-56-04.segmentation: 和其光，同其尘，是谓玄同。
ddj-bs-56-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-56-04.segmentation: Soften the glare, merge with the dust;

ddj-bs-56-05.segmentation: 故不可得而亲，不可得而疏；
ddj-bs-56-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-56-05.segmentation: Therefore one cannot get close to it, nor get distant from it;

ddj-bs-56-06.segmentation: 不可得而利，不可得而害；
ddj-bs-56-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-56-06.segmentation: Cannot get benefit from it, nor get harm from it;

ddj-bs-56-07.segmentation: 不可得而贵，不可得而贱；
ddj-bs-56-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-56-07.segmentation: Cannot get honor from it, nor get lowliness from it.

ddj-bs-56-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-56-08.segmentation: Therefore it is prized by all under Heaven.

ddj-bs-57-01.segmentation: 以正治国，以奇用兵，以无事取天下。
ddj-bs-57-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-57-01.segmentation: Govern the state with uprightness, use arms with surprise, take the world by being without affairs.

ddj-bs-57-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-57-02.segmentation: How do I know that this is so?

ddj-bs-57-03.segmentation: 以此：天下多忌讳，而民弥贫；
ddj-bs-57-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-57-03.segmentation: By this: the more taboos under Heaven, the poorer the people;

ddj-bs-57-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-57-04.segmentation: The more sharp instruments among the people, the more the state grows disordered;

ddj-bs-57-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-57-05.segmentation: The more skills people have, the more strange things arise;

ddj-bs-57-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-57-06.segmentation: The more laws and ordinances are proclaimed, the more thieves and robbers there are.

ddj-bs-57-07.segmentation: 故圣人云：我无为，而民自化；
ddj-bs-57-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-57-07.segmentation: Therefore the sage says: I do nothing, and the people transform of themselves;

ddj-bs-57-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-57-08.segmentation: I love stillness, and the people correct themselves;

ddj-bs-57-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-57-09.segmentation: I am without affairs, and the people enrich themselves;

ddj-bs-57-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-57-10.segmentation: I am without desire, and the people become simple of themselves.

ddj-bs-58-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-58-01.segmentation: When government is muffled and dull, the people are pure and simple;

ddj-bs-58-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-58-02.segmentation: When government is sharp and prying, the people are wanting and deficient.

ddj-bs-58-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-58-03.segmentation: Disaster is that on which good fortune leans; good fortune is that in which disaster lurks.

ddj-bs-58-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-58-04.segmentation: Disaster is that on which good fortune leans; good fortune is that in which disaster lurks.

ddj-bs-58-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-58-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-58-06.segmentation: The correct reverts to the strange; the good reverts to the ominous.

ddj-bs-58-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-58-07.segmentation: People's confusion has long been so.

ddj-bs-58-08.segmentation: 是以圣人方而不割，廉而不刿，直而不肆，光而不耀。
ddj-bs-58-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-58-08.segmentation: Therefore the sage is square but does not cut; sharp but does not wound; straight but not unrestrained; bright but not dazzling.

ddj-bs-59-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-59-01.segmentation: In governing people and serving Heaven, nothing is better than frugality.

ddj-bs-59-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-59-02.segmentation: Only frugality is called early submission;

ddj-bs-59-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-59-03.segmentation: Early submission is called heavily accumulating virtue;

ddj-bs-59-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-59-04.segmentation: Heavily accumulating virtue, there is nothing one cannot overcome;

ddj-bs-59-05.segmentation: 无不克则莫知其极，莫知其极，可以有国；
ddj-bs-59-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-59-05.segmentation: When there is nothing one cannot overcome, none knows one's limit;

ddj-bs-59-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-59-06.segmentation: Possessing the mother of the state, one can last long.

ddj-bs-59-07.segmentation: 是谓根深固柢，长生久视之道。
ddj-bs-59-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-59-07.segmentation: This is called deep roots and a firm base—the Way of long life and lasting vision.

ddj-bs-60-01.segmentation: 治大国，若烹小鲜，以道莅天下，其鬼不神。
ddj-bs-60-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-60-01.segmentation: When one approaches the world with the Way, its ghosts have no spirit;

ddj-bs-60-02.segmentation: 非其鬼不神，其神不伤人。
ddj-bs-60-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-60-02.segmentation: It is not that the ghosts have no spirit, but that their spirit does not harm people;

ddj-bs-60-03.segmentation: 非其神不伤人，圣人亦不伤人。
ddj-bs-60-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-60-03.segmentation: It is not only that their spirit does not harm people—the sage also does not harm people.

ddj-bs-60-04.segmentation: 夫两不相伤，故德交归焉。
ddj-bs-60-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-60-04.segmentation: When these two do not harm each other, virtue converges and returns to them.

ddj-bs-61-01.segmentation: 大邦者下流，天下之牝，天下之交也。
ddj-bs-61-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-61-01.segmentation: A great state is like the lower reaches of a river—the female of the world, the meeting place of the world.

ddj-bs-61-02.segmentation: 牝常以静胜牡，以静为下。
ddj-bs-61-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-61-02.segmentation: The female constantly overcomes the male by stillness, and by stillness takes the lower place.

ddj-bs-61-03.segmentation: 故大邦以下小邦，则取小邦；
ddj-bs-61-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-61-03.segmentation: Therefore when a great state places itself below a small state, it takes the small state;

ddj-bs-61-04.segmentation: 小邦以下大邦，则取大邦。
ddj-bs-61-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-61-04.segmentation: When a small state places itself below a great state, it is taken by the great state.

ddj-bs-61-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-61-05.segmentation: Thus some take by placing themselves below; some are taken by placing themselves below.

ddj-bs-61-06.segmentation: 大邦不过欲兼畜人，小邦不过欲入事人。
ddj-bs-61-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-61-06.segmentation: A great state wants no more than to unite and nurture others; a small state wants no more than to enter and serve others.

ddj-bs-61-07.segmentation: 夫两者各得所欲，大者宜为下。
ddj-bs-61-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-61-07.segmentation: When both get what they desire, the great one should take the lower place.

ddj-bs-62-01.segmentation: 道者，万物之奥，善人之宝，不善人之所保。
ddj-bs-62-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-62-01.segmentation: The Way is the sanctuary of the myriad things, the treasure of the good man, and that by which the not-good are kept.

ddj-bs-62-02.segmentation: 美言可以市尊，美行可以加人。
ddj-bs-62-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-62-02.segmentation: Fine words can purchase honor; fine conduct can raise a person above others.

ddj-bs-62-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-62-03.segmentation: Even if people are not good, how can they be abandoned?

ddj-bs-62-04.segmentation: 故立天子，置三公，虽有拱璧以先驷马，不如坐进此道。
ddj-bs-62-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-62-04.segmentation: Therefore when the Son of Heaven is established and the Three Dukes appointed, though one present a jade disk ahead of a team of four horses, it is not as good as sitting and offering this Way.

ddj-bs-62-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-62-05.segmentation: Why did the ancients prize this Way?

ddj-bs-62-06.segmentation: 不曰：求以得，有罪以免邪？
ddj-bs-62-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-62-06.segmentation: Was it not said: by seeking, one obtains; having guilt, one is spared?

ddj-bs-62-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-62-07.segmentation: Therefore it is prized by all under Heaven.

ddj-bs-63-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-63-01.segmentation: Act by non-action; handle affairs by being without affairs; taste the tasteless.

ddj-bs-63-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-63-02.segmentation: Regard the great as small, the many as few; repay injury with virtue.

ddj-bs-63-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-63-03.segmentation: Regard the great as small, the many as few; repay injury with virtue.

ddj-bs-63-04.segmentation: 图难于其易，为大于其细；
ddj-bs-63-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-63-04.segmentation: Plan the difficult while it is easy; do the great while it is fine.

ddj-bs-63-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-63-05.segmentation: The difficult affairs of the world must arise from the easy; the great affairs of the world must arise from the fine.

ddj-bs-63-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-63-06.segmentation: The difficult affairs of the world must arise from the easy; the great affairs of the world must arise from the fine.

ddj-bs-63-07.segmentation: 是以圣人终不为大，故能成其大。
ddj-bs-63-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-63-07.segmentation: Therefore the sage to the end does not attempt the great, and so is able to achieve greatness.

ddj-bs-63-08.segmentation: 夫轻诺必寡信，多易必多难。
ddj-bs-63-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-63-08.segmentation: Light promises must bring little trust; taking many things as easy must bring many difficulties.

ddj-bs-63-09.segmentation: 是以圣人犹难之，故终无难矣。
ddj-bs-63-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-63-09.segmentation: Therefore the sage still treats them as difficult, and so in the end has no difficulty.

ddj-bs-64-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-64-01.segmentation: What is at peace is easy to hold; what has not yet shown signs is easy to plan for.

ddj-bs-64-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-64-02.segmentation: What is brittle is easy to break; what is minute is easy to scatter.

ddj-bs-64-03.segmentation: 为之于未有，治之于未乱。
ddj-bs-64-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-64-03.segmentation: Act on it before it exists; order it before disorder arises.

ddj-bs-64-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-64-04.segmentation: A tree that fills the arms' embrace grows from a tiny shoot;

ddj-bs-64-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-64-05.segmentation: A terrace of nine stories rises from a heap of earth;

ddj-bs-64-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-64-06.segmentation: A journey of a thousand li begins under one's feet.

ddj-bs-64-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-64-07.segmentation: He who acts upon it ruins it; he who grasps it loses it.

ddj-bs-64-08.segmentation: 是以圣人无为故无败，无执故无失。
ddj-bs-64-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-64-08.segmentation: Therefore the sage does not act, and so does not ruin; does not grasp, and so does not lose.

ddj-bs-64-09.segmentation: 民之从事，常于几成而败之。
ddj-bs-64-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-64-09.segmentation: People in their undertakings often fail when nearly complete.

ddj-bs-64-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-64-10.segmentation: Be as careful at the end as at the beginning, and there will be no failed affairs.

ddj-bs-64-11.segmentation: 是以圣人欲不欲，不贵难得之货，学不学，复众人之所过，以辅万物之自然而不敢为。
ddj-bs-64-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-64-11.segmentation: Therefore the sage desires not to desire, and does not prize goods hard to obtain;

ddj-bs-65-01.segmentation: 古之善为道者，非以明民，将以愚之。
ddj-bs-65-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-65-01.segmentation: Those of old who were good at practicing the Way did not use it to enlighten the people, but to keep them simple.

ddj-bs-65-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-65-02.segmentation: The people are hard to govern because they have too much cleverness.

ddj-bs-65-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-65-03.segmentation: Therefore to govern a state by cleverness is to be a thief of the state;

ddj-bs-65-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-65-04.segmentation: Not to govern a state by cleverness is to be a blessing to the state.

ddj-bs-65-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-65-05.segmentation: To know these two is also a standard.

ddj-bs-65-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-65-06.segmentation: Always to know the standard is called mysterious virtue.

ddj-bs-65-07.segmentation: 玄德深矣，远矣，与物反矣，然后乃至大顺。
ddj-bs-65-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-65-07.segmentation: Mysterious virtue is deep, is far; it returns with things, and only then reaches great accordance.

ddj-bs-66-01.segmentation: 江海之所以能为百谷王者，以其善下之，故能为百谷王。
ddj-bs-66-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-66-01.segmentation: The reason the rivers and the sea can be kings of the hundred valleys is that they are good at taking the lower place—thus they can be kings of the hundred valleys.

ddj-bs-66-02.segmentation: 是以圣人欲上民，必以言下之；
ddj-bs-66-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-66-02.segmentation: Therefore if the sage would be above the people, he must in speech put himself below them;

ddj-bs-66-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-66-03.segmentation: If he would be ahead of the people, he must in person put himself behind them.

ddj-bs-66-04.segmentation: 是以圣人处上而民不重，处前而民不害。
ddj-bs-66-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-66-04.segmentation: Therefore the sage dwells above and the people do not feel burdened; dwells ahead and the people do not feel harmed.

ddj-bs-66-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-66-05.segmentation: Therefore all under Heaven gladly push him forward and do not tire of him.

ddj-bs-66-06.segmentation: 以其不争，故天下莫能与之争。
ddj-bs-66-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-66-06.segmentation: Because he does not contend, no one under Heaven can contend with him.

ddj-bs-67-01.segmentation: 天下皆谓我道大，似不肖。
ddj-bs-67-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-67-01.segmentation: All under Heaven say my Way is great, and seems unlike anything else.

ddj-bs-67-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-67-02.segmentation: Precisely because it is great, it seems unlike anything else.

ddj-bs-67-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-67-03.segmentation: If it were like anything else, it would long ago have been small!

ddj-bs-67-04.segmentation: 我有三宝，持而保之：一曰慈，二曰俭，三曰不敢为天下先。
ddj-bs-67-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-67-04.segmentation: I have three treasures that I hold and keep: the first is compassion; the second is frugality; the third is not daring to be first under Heaven.

ddj-bs-67-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-67-05.segmentation: With compassion one can be brave;

ddj-bs-67-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-67-06.segmentation: With frugality one can be generous;

ddj-bs-67-07.segmentation: 不敢为天下先，故能成器长。
ddj-bs-67-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-67-07.segmentation: Not daring to be first under Heaven, one can become the chief of vessels.

ddj-bs-67-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-67-08.segmentation: Now to discard compassion and yet be brave, to discard frugality and yet be generous, to discard being behind and yet be first—is to die!

ddj-bs-67-09.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-67-09.segmentation: With frugality one can be generous;

ddj-bs-67-10.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-67-10.segmentation: To cast aside the rear and put oneself first—

ddj-bs-67-11.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-67-12.segmentation: 夫慈，以战则胜，以守则固。
ddj-bs-67-12.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-67-12.segmentation: With compassion, one who fights wins; one who defends holds firm.

ddj-bs-67-13.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-67-13.segmentation: Heaven will save him, and guard him with compassion.

ddj-bs-68-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-68-01.segmentation: One good at being an officer is not martial;

ddj-bs-68-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-68-02.segmentation: one good at battle is not angry;

ddj-bs-68-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-68-03.segmentation: one good at defeating enemies does not engage them;

ddj-bs-68-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-68-04.segmentation: A good officer is not warlike; a good fighter is not angry; a good conqueror of enemies does not engage them; one good at using people places himself below them.

ddj-bs-68-05.segmentation: 是谓不争之德，是谓用人之力，是谓配天古之极。
ddj-bs-68-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-68-05.segmentation: This is called the virtue of not contending; this is called the power of using people; this is called matching Heaven—the ultimate of old.

ddj-bs-69-01.segmentation: 用兵有言：吾不敢为主，而为客；
ddj-bs-69-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-69-01.segmentation: Military strategists have a saying: I dare not be the host but prefer to be the guest; I dare not advance an inch but prefer to withdraw a foot.

ddj-bs-69-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-69-02.segmentation: Military strategists have a saying: I dare not be the host but prefer to be the guest; I dare not advance an inch but prefer to withdraw a foot.

ddj-bs-69-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-69-03.segmentation: This is called marching without ranks, rolling up the sleeves without an arm, facing without an enemy, grasping without a weapon.

ddj-bs-69-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-69-04.segmentation: to bare an arm where there is none;

ddj-bs-69-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-69-05.segmentation: to throw where there is no enemy;

ddj-bs-69-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-69-06.segmentation: to grasp a weapon where there is none.

ddj-bs-69-07.segmentation: 祸莫大于轻敌，轻敌几丧吾宝。
ddj-bs-69-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-69-07.segmentation: No disaster is greater than underestimating the enemy; to underestimate the enemy is nearly to lose my treasure.

ddj-bs-69-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-69-08.segmentation: Therefore when opposing armies are evenly matched, the one that grieves wins.

ddj-bs-70-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-70-01.segmentation: My words are very easy to understand, very easy to practice.

ddj-bs-70-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-70-02.segmentation: Yet none under Heaven can understand them, none can practice them.

ddj-bs-70-03.segmentation: 言有宗，事有君，夫唯无知，是以不我知。
ddj-bs-70-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-70-03.segmentation: Precisely because people are without knowledge, they do not understand me.

ddj-bs-70-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-70-04.segmentation: Those who understand me are rare; thus I am prized.

ddj-bs-70-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-70-05.segmentation: Therefore the sage wears coarse cloth and holds jade in his bosom.

ddj-bs-71-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-71-01.segmentation: To know that one does not know is best;

ddj-bs-71-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-71-02.segmentation: Not to know and yet think one knows is a disease.

ddj-bs-71-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-71-03.segmentation: The sage is not diseased, because he treats disease as disease.

ddj-bs-71-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-71-04.segmentation: Precisely because he treats disease as disease, he is therefore not diseased.

ddj-bs-72-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-72-01.segmentation: When the people do not fear power, then a greater power arrives.

ddj-bs-72-02.segmentation: 无狎其所居，无厌其所生。
ddj-bs-72-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-72-02.segmentation: Do not constrict their dwellings; do not oppress their livelihood.

ddj-bs-72-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-72-03.segmentation: Precisely because one does not oppress, they are not oppressed.

ddj-bs-72-04.segmentation: 是以圣人自知不自见，自爱不自贵。
ddj-bs-72-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-72-04.segmentation: Therefore the sage knows himself but does not display himself; loves himself but does not exalt himself.

ddj-bs-72-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-72-05.segmentation: Thus he discards that and takes this.

ddj-bs-73-01.segmentation: 勇于敢则杀，勇于不敢则活。
ddj-bs-73-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-73-01.segmentation: Courage in daring leads to death; courage in not daring leads to life.

ddj-bs-73-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-73-02.segmentation: Of these two, one benefits and one harms.

ddj-bs-73-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-73-03.segmentation: What Heaven detests—who knows its reason?

ddj-bs-73-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-73-04.segmentation: Therefore even the sage finds this hard.

ddj-bs-73-05.segmentation: 天之道，不争而善胜，不应而善应，不召而自来，繟然而善谋。
ddj-bs-73-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-73-05.segmentation: The Way of Heaven does not contend and yet is good at winning; does not speak and yet is good at responding; is not summoned and yet comes of itself; is relaxed and yet good at planning.

ddj-bs-73-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-73-06.segmentation: Heaven's net is vast; though its mesh is coarse, nothing slips through.

ddj-bs-74-01.segmentation: 民不畏死，奈何以死惧之。
ddj-bs-74-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-74-01.segmentation: If the people do not fear death, how can one frighten them with death?

ddj-bs-74-02.segmentation: 若使民常畏死，而为奇者，吾得执而杀之，孰敢？
ddj-bs-74-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-74-02.segmentation: If one could make the people constantly fear death, and there were those who acted strangely, I could seize and kill them—who would dare?

ddj-bs-74-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-74-03.segmentation: There is always One who is in charge of killing.

ddj-bs-74-04.segmentation: 夫代司杀者杀，是谓代大匠斫，希有不伤其手者矣。
ddj-bs-74-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-74-04.segmentation: To take the place of the One in charge of killing is called hewing wood in place of the master carpenter.

ddj-bs-75-01.segmentation: 民之饥，以其上食税之多，是以饥。
ddj-bs-75-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-75-01.segmentation: The people starve because those above eat too much in taxes—thus they starve.

ddj-bs-75-02.segmentation: 民之难治，以其上之有为，是以难治。
ddj-bs-75-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-75-02.segmentation: The people are hard to govern because those above are given to action—thus they are hard to govern.

ddj-bs-75-03.segmentation: 民之轻死，以其上求生之厚，是以轻死。
ddj-bs-75-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-75-03.segmentation: The people take death lightly because those above seek life too richly—thus they take death lightly.

ddj-bs-75-04.segmentation: 夫唯无以生为者，是贤于贵生。
ddj-bs-75-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-75-04.segmentation: Only one who does not make living his concern is wiser than one who values life.

ddj-bs-76-01.segmentation: 人之生也柔弱，其死也坚强。
ddj-bs-76-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-76-01.segmentation: When people are alive they are soft and weak; when dead they are hard and stiff.

ddj-bs-76-02.segmentation: 草木之生也柔脆，其死也枯槁。
ddj-bs-76-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-76-02.segmentation: The myriad things, the grasses and trees, when alive are soft and fragile; when dead they are dry and withered.

ddj-bs-76-03.segmentation: 故坚强者死之徒，柔弱者生之徒。
ddj-bs-76-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-76-03.segmentation: Therefore the hard and strong are companions of death; the soft and weak are companions of life.

ddj-bs-76-04.segmentation: 是以兵强则灭，木强则折。
ddj-bs-76-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-76-04.segmentation: Thus when arms are strong they are destroyed; when a tree is strong it is broken.

ddj-bs-76-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-76-05.segmentation: The strong and great take the lower place; the soft and weak take the higher place.

ddj-bs-77-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-77-01.segmentation: The Way of Heaven—is it not like stretching a bow?

ddj-bs-77-02.segmentation: 高者抑下，下者举之，有余者损之，不足者补之。
ddj-bs-77-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-77-02.segmentation: What has surplus is diminished; what is insufficient is supplemented.

ddj-bs-77-03.segmentation: 天之道，损有余而补不足。
ddj-bs-77-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-77-03.segmentation: The Way of Heaven diminishes what has surplus and supplements what is insufficient.

ddj-bs-77-04.segmentation: 人之道，则不然，损不足以奉有余。
ddj-bs-77-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-77-04.segmentation: The way of man is not so: it diminishes what is insufficient to offer to what has surplus.

ddj-bs-77-05.segmentation: 孰能有余以奉天下，唯有道者。
ddj-bs-77-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-77-05.segmentation: Who can take his surplus and offer it to the world?

ddj-bs-77-06.segmentation: 是以圣人为而不恃，功成而不处，其不欲见贤。
ddj-bs-77-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-77-06.segmentation: Therefore the sage acts but does not rely; when the work is done he does not dwell on it; he does not wish to display his worth.

ddj-bs-78-01.segmentation: 天下莫柔弱于水，而攻坚强者莫之能胜，以其无以易之。
ddj-bs-78-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-78-01.segmentation: Nothing under Heaven is softer and weaker than water, yet for attacking the hard and strong nothing can surpass it, because nothing can take its place.

ddj-bs-78-02.segmentation: 弱之胜强，柔之胜刚，天下莫不知，莫能行。
ddj-bs-78-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-78-02.segmentation: That the weak overcomes the strong, the soft overcomes the hard—none under Heaven does not know it, yet none can put it into practice.

ddj-bs-78-03.segmentation: 是以圣人云：受国之垢，是谓社稷主；
ddj-bs-78-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-78-03.segmentation: Therefore the sage says: He who takes upon himself the dirt of the state is called the lord of the altars of soil and grain;

ddj-bs-78-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-78-04.segmentation: He who takes upon himself the misfortunes of the state is called the king of the world.

ddj-bs-78-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-79-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-79-01.segmentation: When a great resentment is reconciled, there is sure to be leftover resentment—how can this be considered good?

ddj-bs-79-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-79-02.segmentation: When a great resentment is reconciled, there is sure to be leftover resentment—how can this be considered good?

ddj-bs-79-03.segmentation: 是以圣人执左契，而不责于人。
ddj-bs-79-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-79-03.segmentation: Therefore the sage holds the left-hand tally and does not press people for payment.

ddj-bs-79-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-79-04.segmentation: One with virtue takes charge of the tally; one without virtue takes charge of the tax.

ddj-bs-79-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-79-05.segmentation: The Way of Heaven shows no favoritism; it is always with the good person.

ddj-bs-80-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-80-01.segmentation: Let the state be small and the people few.

ddj-bs-80-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-80-02.segmentation: Let there be tools for tens and hundreds, yet none be used;

ddj-bs-80-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-80-03.segmentation: Let the people take death seriously and not migrate far.

ddj-bs-80-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-80-04.segmentation: Though there be boats and carriages, none will ride them;

ddj-bs-80-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-80-05.segmentation: Though there be armor and weapons, none will display them.

ddj-bs-80-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-80-06.segmentation: Let the people return to knotting cords and using them.

ddj-bs-80-07.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-80-07.segmentation: This is the utmost of ordered rule.

ddj-bs-80-08.segmentation: 甘美食，美其服，安其居，乐其俗，邻国相望，鸡犬之声相闻，民至老死不相往来。
ddj-bs-80-08.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-80-08.segmentation: Neighboring states may overlook one another, and the sounds of chickens and dogs be heard from each, yet the people grow old and die without coming and going among them.

ddj-bs-81-01.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-81-01.segmentation: True words are not beautiful; beautiful words are not true.

ddj-bs-81-02.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-81-02.segmentation: The good do not argue; those who argue are not good.

ddj-bs-81-03.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-81-03.segmentation: Those who know are not broadly learned; the broadly learned do not know.

ddj-bs-81-04.segmentation: 圣人不积，既以为人己愈有，既以与人己愈多。
ddj-bs-81-04.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-81-04.segmentation: The sage does not accumulate: having done for others, he has himself all the more; having given to others, he himself has all the more.

ddj-bs-81-05.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-81-05.segmentation: The Way of Heaven benefits and does not harm;

ddj-bs-81-06.note: 通行断句（据本书正文标点）。

ddj-bs-81-06.segmentation: The Way of the sage acts but does not contend.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l001.explanation: 那柏木做的小船在水上漂荡，也随着河水一起漂流。

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l001.segmentation: That cypress boat floats on the water, drifting along with the current.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l002.explanation: 心中有事耿耿难眠，好像藏着说不出口的忧愁。

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l002.segmentation: I lie awake with a troubled mind, as if carrying a hidden grief.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l003.explanation: 并非我没有酒，本想借饮酒出游来排遣愁绪。

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l003.segmentation: It is not that I lack wine; I would roam and forget my cares with drink.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l004.explanation: 我的心不是镜子，不能把什么委屈都照见、都吞下去。

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l004.segmentation: My heart is no mirror; it cannot reflect and swallow every wrong.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l005.explanation: 虽然也有兄弟，却不能依靠他们。

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l005.segmentation: Though I have brothers, I cannot rely on them.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l006.explanation: 前去向他们诉说，却碰上了他们的发怒。

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l006.segmentation: When I went to pour out my heart, I met only their anger.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l007.explanation: 我的心不是石头，不能任人转来转去。

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l007.segmentation: My heart is not stone; it cannot be turned at will.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l008.explanation: 我的心不是席子，不能任人卷起来抛弃。

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l008.segmentation: My heart is not a mat; it cannot be rolled up and cast aside.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l009.explanation: 我举止端庄、威仪美好，不是可以随意挑选、随意抛弃的人。

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l009.segmentation: My bearing is dignified and fine; I am not someone to be picked and discarded.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l010.explanation: 忧愁悄悄压在心上，却被那些小人怨恨。

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l010.segmentation: Secret sorrow weighs on me, while petty men resent me.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l011.explanation: 遭受的祸患已经很多，受到的侮辱也不少。

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l011.segmentation: Misfortunes I meet are many; insults I suffer are not few.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l012.explanation: 静下来细细想这件事，醒来拍胸顿足，痛彻心扉。

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l012.segmentation: When I ponder it in silence, I wake and beat my breast in anguish.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l013.explanation: 太阳啊月亮啊，为什么交替变得昏暗不明？

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l013.segmentation: O sun and moon, why do you alternately grow dim?

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l014.explanation: 心中的忧愁啊，就像脏衣服洗不干净一样。

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l014.segmentation: The sorrow in my heart is like a garment that will not come clean.

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l015.explanation: 静下来细细想这件事，却无力像鸟一样奋飞逃离。

sj-feng-beifeng-baizhou-l015.segmentation: When I ponder it in silence, I cannot spread my wings and fly away.

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l001.explanation: 北风刮来带着寒意，雨雪纷纷扬扬。

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l001.segmentation: The north wind blows cold; snow and sleet fall thick.

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l002.explanation: 你既爱我、待我好，就与我携手同行。

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l002.segmentation: Since you love me and are kind to me, take my hand and go with me.

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l003.segmentation: Is it not too slow and lingering?

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l005.explanation: 北风刮来呜呜作响，雨雪纷纷飘落。

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l005.segmentation: The north wind moans; snow and sleet drift down.

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l006.explanation: 你既爱我、待我好，就与我携手同归。

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l006.segmentation: Since you love me and are kind to me, take my hand and return with me.

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l007.segmentation: Is it not too slow and lingering?

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l009.explanation: 没有不红的不是狐狸，没有不黑的不是乌鸦；比喻世事混浊。

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l009.segmentation: Nothing red is not a fox, nothing black is not a crow—the world is murky and alike in evil.

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l010.explanation: 你既爱我、待我好，就与我同乘一车。

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l010.segmentation: Since you love me and are kind to me, ride in the same carriage with me.

sj-feng-beifeng-beifeng-l011.segmentation: Is it not too slow and lingering?

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l001.explanation: 从北门出来，心中忧愁深重。

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l001.segmentation: I go out by the north gate, my heart heavy with care.

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l002.explanation: 终究又穷又苦，没人知道我的艰难。

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l002.segmentation: Poor and wretched at last, and none know how hard it is for me.

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l004.explanation: 这都是上天安排的，还能说什么呢！

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l004.segmentation: Heaven has willed it so—what can I say?

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l005.segmentation: 王事适我，政事一埤益我。
sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l005.explanation: 王室的事推给我，公务又一层层加到我身上。

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l005.segmentation: The king's business falls on me, and official duties are piled ever higher on me.

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l006.segmentation: 我入自外，室人交遍谪我。
sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l006.explanation: 我从外头回家，家里人反而一齐责备我。

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l006.segmentation: When I come in from outside, those at home all reproach me together.

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l008.explanation: 这都是上天安排的，还能说什么呢！

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l008.segmentation: Heaven has willed it so—what can I say?

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l009.segmentation: 王事敦我，政事一埤遗我。
sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l009.explanation: 王室的事催逼我，公务又一件件丢给我。

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l009.segmentation: The king's business presses me, and official tasks are dumped on me one after another.

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l010.segmentation: 我入自外，室人交遍摧我。
sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l010.explanation: 我从外头回家，家里人反而一齐摧折我。

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l010.segmentation: When I come in from outside, those at home all wear me down together.

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l012.explanation: 这都是上天安排的，还能说什么呢！

sj-feng-beifeng-beimen-l012.segmentation: Heaven has willed it so—what can I say?

sj-feng-beifeng-erzichengzhou-l001.explanation: 两个少年乘着小船，船影在水上漂荡。

sj-feng-beifeng-erzichengzhou-l001.segmentation: Two youths ride a boat; its shadow drifts on the water.

sj-feng-beifeng-erzichengzhou-l002.explanation: 多么想念他们啊，心中忧思绵绵！

sj-feng-beifeng-erzichengzhou-l002.segmentation: How I long for them—my heart is full of anxious love!

sj-feng-beifeng-erzichengzhou-l003.explanation: 两个少年乘着小船，船儿向远方驶去。

sj-feng-beifeng-erzichengzhou-l003.segmentation: Two youths ride a boat; it sails away into the distance.

sj-feng-beifeng-erzichengzhou-l004.explanation: 多么想念他们啊，他们该不会有什么灾祸吧？

sj-feng-beifeng-erzichengzhou-l004.segmentation: How I long for them—surely no harm will befall them?

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l001.explanation: 山谷里风习习吹来，带来阴云和雨意。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l001.segmentation: The valley wind blows steadily, bringing cloud and rain.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l002.explanation: 应当同心协力，不该彼此发怒。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l002.segmentation: We should strive together in one heart, not turn to anger.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l003.explanation: 采萝卜采菲菜，难道能因根部不好就不要吗？

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l003.segmentation: When we gather turnips and melons, do we reject them for the lower part?

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l004.explanation: 美好的誓言不要违背，愿与你同生共死。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l004.segmentation: Do not break your good words; I would share life and death with you.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l005.explanation: 走在路上步履迟缓，心中却充满离恨。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l005.segmentation: I walk the road with slow steps, but rebellion fills my heart.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l006.explanation: 路并不远，你却只把我送到近郊。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l006.segmentation: The way is not far, yet you send me off only to the outskirts.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l007.explanation: 谁说荼菜是苦的？对我来说却像荠菜一样甜。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l007.segmentation: Who says bitter sow-thistle is bitter? To me it is sweet as shepherd's purse.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l008.explanation: 你和新妇欢宴作乐，亲如兄弟。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l008.segmentation: You feast with your new bride, close as brothers.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l009.explanation: 泾水因渭水而显得浊，但泾水清处仍澄澈见底。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l009.segmentation: The Jing seems turbid beside the Wei, yet where it is clear its bed shines bright.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l010.explanation: 你和新妇欢宴作乐，却不肯把我放在眼里。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l010.segmentation: You feast with your new bride and will not deign to notice me.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l011.explanation: 不要离开我的鱼梁，不要打开我的鱼笼。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l011.segmentation: Do not leave my fish dam; do not open my bamboo trap.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l012.explanation: 我自己都过不下去，哪还顾得上以后的事。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l012.segmentation: I cannot even save myself—how could I care for what comes after?

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l013.explanation: 水深了就撑船过去，想办法渡过去。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l013.segmentation: Where the water is deep, I raft and boat across.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l014.explanation: 水浅了就涉水游过去，自己想办法过去。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l014.segmentation: Where it is shallow, I wade and swim across.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l015.explanation: 无论有无，都勉力去寻求、操持家务。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l015.segmentation: Whether we have or lack, I strive hard to seek and provide.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l016.explanation: 别人家有丧事，我爬着也要去帮忙。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l016.segmentation: When neighbors suffer bereavement, I crawl on hands and knees to help.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l017.explanation: 你不但不能好好待我，反而把我当作仇敌。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l017.segmentation: You cannot cherish me; instead you treat me as an enemy.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l018.explanation: 你既嫌弃我的德行，我的好意也如同货物卖不出去。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l018.segmentation: You reject my virtue; my goodwill is like goods that will not sell.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l019.explanation: 从前怕养不活孩子、受委屈，也曾陪你度过艰难。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l019.segmentation: Once, fearing want and hardship in raising children, I stayed with you through ruin.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l020.explanation: 如今孩子已经长大，你却把我比作毒物。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l020.segmentation: Now the children are raised, yet you compare me to poison.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l021.explanation: 我存了美味的菜干，本用来抵御寒冬。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l021.segmentation: I stored tasty preserved greens to see us through the winter.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l022.explanation: 你和新妇欢宴作乐，却拿我去抵挡贫穷。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l022.segmentation: You feast with your new bride and use me to fend off poverty.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l023.explanation: 你水流满面的样子，还对我嬉笑戏弄。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l023.segmentation: With tears streaming you still mock and toy with me.

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l024.explanation: 不念往日的情分，如今才把我扫地出门。

sj-feng-beifeng-gufeng-l024.segmentation: Forgetting the past, you now cast me out and sweep the house clean of me.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l001.explanation: 多么勇武啊，正要跳起万舞。

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l001.segmentation: How bold and grand—he is about to lead the great dance.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l002.explanation: 太阳正当中天，他在前面高位上。

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l002.segmentation: The sun stands at noon; he is in the place of honor ahead.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l003.explanation: 身材高大的人仪态美好，在公堂上跳万舞。

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l003.segmentation: The tall man moves with grace, performing the great dance in the court.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l004.explanation: 有力气像猛虎，执缰绳像编织一样稳。

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l004.segmentation: Strong as a tiger, he holds the reins firm as woven silk.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l005.explanation: 左手拿着龠管，右手举着雉尾。

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l005.segmentation: In his left hand the flute; in his right, pheasant plumes.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l006.explanation: 面色红润如涂赭，国君发言赐他酒爵。

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l006.segmentation: His face glows red as ochre; the lord speaks and grants him a cup.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l007.explanation: 山上有榛树，低湿处有苓草。

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l007.segmentation: On the hill are hazels; in the wet low ground, licorice grows.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l009.segmentation: The fair one from the west.

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l010.explanation: 那美人啊，就是西方来的那个人啊。

sj-feng-beifeng-jianxi-l010.segmentation: That fair one—he is the man from the west.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l001.explanation: 战鼓咚咚响，士兵踊跃要出征。

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l001.segmentation: War drums thunder; soldiers leap eager for battle.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l002.explanation: 本国筑城漕邑，唯独我向南行。

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l002.segmentation: At home they fortify Cao; I alone march south.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l003.explanation: 跟随孙子仲，去平定陈国与宋国。

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l003.segmentation: Following Sun Zizhong, I help pacify Chen and Song.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l004.explanation: 他不带我回去，心中忧愁不安。

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l004.segmentation: He will not take me home—my heart is restless with care.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l006.segmentation: Where did I lose my horse?

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l009.explanation: 生死离合，我曾与你立下誓言。

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l009.segmentation: Through life and death, parting and meeting—we once made our vow.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l010.explanation: 握着你的手，与你白头偕老。

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l010.segmentation: I hold your hand and grow old with you.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l011.explanation: 唉，分离啊，你不能与我团聚了。

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l011.segmentation: Alas for separation—you cannot live on with me.

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l012.explanation: 唉，确实啊，你不能守信用了。

sj-feng-beifeng-jigu-l012.segmentation: Alas, it is true—you cannot keep faith with me.

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv-l001.explanation: 娴静姑娘真美丽，在城角等我。

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv-l001.segmentation: The quiet maiden is fair; she waits for me at the corner of the wall.

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv-l002.explanation: 她有意躲着不见，我挠头徘徊不知所措。

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv-l002.segmentation: She hides and will not show herself; I scratch my head and linger, at a loss.

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv-l003.explanation: 娴静姑娘真姣好，送给我一支彤管。

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv-l003.segmentation: The quiet maiden is lovely; she gives me a red flute.

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv-l004.explanation: 彤管色彩鲜明，我为你的美而喜悦。

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv-l004.segmentation: The red flute shines bright; I delight in your beauty.

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv-l005.explanation: 从郊野采来的嫩荑，确实又美又特别。

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv-l005.segmentation: The tender grass she brought from the meadow is truly fine and rare.

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv-l006.explanation: 不是荑草本身美，是美人所赠才珍贵。

sj-feng-beifeng-jingnv-l006.segmentation: It is not the grass itself that is beautiful—it is precious because the fair one gave it.

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng-l001.explanation: 和暖的南风吹来，吹在棘树嫩心上。

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng-l001.segmentation: The warm south wind blows upon the tender heart of the thorn tree.

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng-l002.explanation: 棘心茁壮生长，母亲养育多么辛劳。

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng-l002.segmentation: The thorn heart grows lush—how toilsome was my mother's care.

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng-l003.explanation: 和暖的南风吹来，吹在已成薪柴的棘树。

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng-l003.segmentation: The warm south wind blows upon the thorn now gathered as fuel.

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng-l004.explanation: 母亲圣明善良，我却不是好儿子。

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng-l004.segmentation: My mother is wise and good, yet I am no worthy child.

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng-l007.explanation: 有七个儿子，母亲仍然劳苦。

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng-l007.segmentation: Though she has seven sons, our mother still toils in hardship.

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng-l008.explanation: 黄鸟婉转鸣叫，声音多么好听。

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng-l008.segmentation: The oriole sings softly, its voice so sweet.

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng-l009.explanation: 有七个儿子，却不能安慰母亲的心。

sj-feng-beifeng-kaifeng-l009.segmentation: Seven sons we have, yet none can comfort our mother's heart.

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l001.explanation: 绿啊衣啊，绿衣里配黄里子。

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l001.segmentation: Green, the robe—green outside with yellow lining.

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l002.explanation: 心中的忧伤啊，什么时候才能停止！

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l002.segmentation: Sorrow in my heart—when will it ever end?

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l003.explanation: 绿啊衣啊，绿衣下配黄下裳。

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l003.segmentation: Green, the robe—green upper garment with yellow skirt.

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l004.explanation: 心中的忧伤啊，什么时候才能消散！

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l004.segmentation: Sorrow in my heart—when will it pass away?

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l005.explanation: 绿啊丝啊，是你亲手所织啊。

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l005.segmentation: Green thread—it was you who wove it.

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l006.explanation: 我思念古人，愿不再有过失啊！

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l006.segmentation: I think of the ancients, that I may commit no fault!

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l007.explanation: 粗葛细葛啊，风吹上去感到凄凉。

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l007.segmentation: Coarse and fine hemp cloth—wind through them feels chill.

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l008.explanation: 我思念古人，他们实在深得我心！

sj-feng-beifeng-lvyi-l008.segmentation: I think of the ancients—they truly reached my heart!

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l001.segmentation: 旄丘之葛兮，何诞之节兮。
sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l001.explanation: 旄丘上的葛藤啊，为什么枝节这样长？

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l001.segmentation: The vine on Mao Hill—why are its joints so long?

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l002.explanation: 叔伯们啊，为什么拖了这么多日子？

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l002.segmentation: O uncles and elders, why so many days' delay?

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l003.segmentation: Why do you sit at ease?

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l004.segmentation: Surely you have company with you!

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l007.explanation: 穿着狐裘却蒙着戎装，不是车不往东去。

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l007.segmentation: Fox fur wrapped in martial garb—not that the chariot will not go east.

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l008.explanation: 叔伯们啊，没有谁与我同行。

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l008.segmentation: O uncles and elders, none share the road with me.

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l009.explanation: 细小又尾随啊，像流离失所的孩子。

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l009.segmentation: Small and trailing—like a child cast adrift.

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l010.explanation: 叔伯们啊，袖手旁观像塞满了耳朵。

sj-feng-beifeng-maoqiu-l010.segmentation: O uncles and elders, you stand aloof as if your ears were stuffed.

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l001.explanation: 葫芦带着苦叶，渡口有深水要渡。

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l001.segmentation: The gourd has bitter leaves; at the ford lies a deep crossing.

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l002.explanation: 水深就连衣涉水，水浅就撩起衣摆。

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l002.segmentation: If deep, wade with skirts tied up; if shallow, raise the hem.

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l003.explanation: 济水满溢，雄雉声声鸣叫。

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l003.segmentation: The Ji overflows; the cock pheasant calls.

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l004.segmentation: 济盈不濡轨，雉鸣求其牡。
sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l004.explanation: 水虽满却不湿车轴，雉鸣是在求其配偶。

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l004.segmentation: Though full, it wets not the axle—the pheasant calls seeking its mate.

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l005.explanation: 雁声雍雍，旭日刚刚升起。

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l005.segmentation: Wild geese call harmoniously; the morning sun just rises.

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l006.explanation: 士人若要求妻，应趁冰未融化之时。

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l006.segmentation: If a gentleman would take a wife, let him do it before the ice melts.

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l007.explanation: 船家招手唤人，别人渡河我是否渡？

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l007.segmentation: The boatman beckons—others cross; shall I cross?

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l008.explanation: 别人不渡我也不渡，我要等我的朋友。

sj-feng-beifeng-paoyoukuye-l008.segmentation: If others do not cross, I will not; I must wait for my friend.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l001.explanation: 清澈的泉水汩汩流出，也流入淇水。

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l001.segmentation: Clear spring water bubbles forth and flows into the Qi.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l002.explanation: 心中怀念卫国，没有一天不想念。

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l002.segmentation: My heart yearns for Wei—not a day passes without longing.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l003.explanation: 那些卫国的姬姓女子，姑且与她们商量。

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l003.segmentation: Those Ji clanswomen of Wei—I will talk my plans over with them.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l004.explanation: 出宿在泲地，在祢地饮酒饯行。

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l004.segmentation: I lodge at Ji on the way out; they give me a parting cup at Ni.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l005.segmentation: 女子有行，远父母兄弟，问我诸姑，遂及伯姊。
sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l005.explanation: 女子出嫁远行，远离父母兄弟；我问候各位姑姑，也问到伯姊。

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l005.segmentation: A woman travels far from parents and kin; I greet my aunts and elder sister too.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l006.explanation: 出宿在干地，在言地饮酒饯行。

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l006.segmentation: I lodge at Gan on the way out; they give me a parting cup at Yan.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l007.explanation: 涂好脂膏、装好车辖，转车就要上路。

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l007.segmentation: I grease the axle and fit the linchpin; the returning cart sets out.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l008.explanation: 很快就能到卫国，该不会有灾祸吧？

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l008.segmentation: Soon I reach Wei—surely no harm will come?

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l009.explanation: 我思念肥泉，为此长久叹息。

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l009.segmentation: I think of Fei Spring and sigh long for it.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l010.explanation: 思念须地与漕地，我的心悠悠不已。

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l010.segmentation: I think of Xu and Cao—my heart is endlessly sad.

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l011.explanation: 驾上车出游，以排遣心中的忧愁。

sj-feng-beifeng-quanshui-l011.segmentation: I drive out to wander and ease the sorrow in my heart.

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l001.explanation: 太阳啊月亮啊，照临下方大地。

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l001.segmentation: O sun and moon, you shine upon the earth below.

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l002.explanation: 像这样的人啊，为何不像古人那样相处？

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l002.segmentation: A man like this—why does he not dwell with me as men of old?

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l004.segmentation: Will he not turn and look to me?

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l005.explanation: 太阳啊月亮啊，照临下方土地。

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l005.segmentation: O sun and moon, you cover the land below.

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l006.explanation: 像这样的人啊，为何不再与我相好。

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l006.segmentation: A man like this—why will he no longer love me?

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l008.segmentation: Will he not answer me in turn?

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l009.explanation: 太阳啊月亮啊，从东方升起。

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l009.segmentation: O sun and moon, you rise from the east.

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l010.explanation: 像这样的人啊，好话里却没有善良。

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l010.segmentation: A man like this—fair words, yet no goodness in them.

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l012.segmentation: So that I too may forget him.

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l013.explanation: 太阳啊月亮啊，从东方出来。

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l013.segmentation: O sun and moon, you come forth from the east.

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l014.explanation: 父亲啊母亲啊，养我不终。

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l014.segmentation: Father and mother, you reared me but not to the end.

sj-feng-beifeng-riyue-l016.segmentation: You answer me, yet do not speak the truth.

sj-feng-beifeng-shiwei-l001.explanation: 天黑了，天黑了，为什么还不回家？

sj-feng-beifeng-shiwei-l001.segmentation: Dark, dark—why do we not return home?

sj-feng-beifeng-shiwei-l002.explanation: 若不是为君主的事，为什么在露水中劳作！

sj-feng-beifeng-shiwei-l002.segmentation: If not for our lord's sake, why toil in the open dew?

sj-feng-beifeng-shiwei-l003.explanation: 天黑了，天黑了，为什么还不回家？

sj-feng-beifeng-shiwei-l003.segmentation: Dark, dark—why do we not return home?

sj-feng-beifeng-shiwei-l004.explanation: 若不是为君主自身，为什么在泥里劳作！

sj-feng-beifeng-shiwei-l004.segmentation: If not for our lord himself, why work in the mud?

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai-l001.explanation: 新台高大鲜明，河水满溢流淌。

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai-l001.segmentation: The new tower gleams bright; the river brims and flows.

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai-l002.explanation: 本想求得温柔和顺的佳人，得到的却是蓬头垢面的丑妇。

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai-l002.segmentation: Seeking a gentle, graceful bride, he gets a unkempt, coarse woman instead.

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai-l003.explanation: 新台高大开阔，河水奔流不息。

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai-l003.segmentation: The new tower stands broad; the river rushes on.

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai-l004.explanation: 本想求得温柔和顺的佳人，得到的丑妇却未绝灭（仍占其位）。

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai-l004.segmentation: Seeking a gentle bride, he gets one so ugly she should have perished—yet she remains.

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai-l005.explanation: 鱼网已经张开，鸿雁却被网住。

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai-l005.segmentation: The fish net is set, yet the wild swan is caught in it.

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai-l006.explanation: 本想求得温柔和顺的佳人，得到的却是驼背的丑人。

sj-feng-beifeng-xintai-l006.segmentation: Seeking a gentle bride, he ends with this hunchback.

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l001.explanation: 雄雉在空中飞，缓缓扇动翅膀。

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l001.segmentation: The cock pheasant flies, slowly spreading its wings.

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l002.explanation: 我心中有思念，这是自己招来的阻隔。

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l002.segmentation: Longing fills my heart—I brought this barrier on myself.

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l003.explanation: 雄雉在空中飞，上下鸣叫。

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l003.segmentation: The cock pheasant flies, calling above and below.

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l004.explanation: 那君子啊，实在使我的心劳神。

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l004.segmentation: That gentleman truly wears my heart with care.

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l005.explanation: 望着那日月，我的思念悠长。

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l005.segmentation: I gaze at sun and moon—my longing stretches far.

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l006.explanation: 道路如此遥远，什么时候才能再来？

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l006.segmentation: The way is so distant—when can he come again?

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l007.explanation: 你们这些君子，不懂得德行。

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l007.segmentation: You gentlemen do not understand virtue.

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l008.explanation: 不嫉妒、不贪求，有什么不好呢。

sj-feng-beifeng-xiongzhi-l008.segmentation: Without envy or greed—what could be wrong?

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l001.explanation: 燕子飞来飞去，翅膀错落不齐。

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l001.segmentation: Swallows fly to and fro, their wings uneven in flight.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l002.explanation: 这位姑娘要出嫁，远送到郊野。

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l002.segmentation: This maiden goes to her new home; we send her far to the wilds.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l003.explanation: 望着已看不见她，眼泪像雨一样落下。

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l003.segmentation: We watch until she is gone; tears fall like rain.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l004.explanation: 燕子飞来飞去，一上一下。

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l004.segmentation: Swallows fly to and fro, now up, now down.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l005.explanation: 这位姑娘要出嫁，远远送她离去。

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l005.segmentation: This maiden goes to her new home; we escort her far away.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l006.explanation: 望着已看不见她，伫立在那里哭泣。

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l006.segmentation: We watch until she is gone; we stand and weep.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l007.explanation: 燕子飞来飞去，上下鸣叫。

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l007.segmentation: Swallows fly to and fro, calling above and below.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l008.explanation: 这位姑娘要出嫁，远送到南方。

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l008.segmentation: This maiden goes to her new home; we send her far to the south.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l009.explanation: 望着已看不见她，实在使我的心劳神。

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l009.segmentation: We watch until she is gone—it truly wears my heart.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l010.explanation: 仲氏诚实可信，心胸深广。

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l010.segmentation: Zhong is steadfast; her heart is deep as a pool.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l011.explanation: 既温和又柔顺，谨慎守身。

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l011.segmentation: Warm and gentle, she is pure and careful in conduct.

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l012.explanation: 不忘先君之思，以此勉励我。

sj-feng-beifeng-yanyan-l012.segmentation: She remembers our late lord's wish and thus encourages me.

sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng-l001.segmentation: 终风且暴，顾我则笑，谑浪笑敖，中心是悼。
sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng-l001.explanation: 风整天狂暴，看见我反而笑，戏谑调笑，心中却满是悲伤。

sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng-l001.segmentation: All day the wind rages; seeing me he laughs—mocking and jeering—while my heart grieves.

sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng-l002.segmentation: 终风且霾，惠然肯来，莫往莫来，悠悠我思。
sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng-l002.explanation: 风整天灰蒙蒙，若肯温柔前来多好；不来也不去，我的思念悠长。

sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng-l002.segmentation: All day haze and wind; would he kindly come? Neither going nor coming—my thoughts stretch on.

sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng-l003.segmentation: 终风且曀，不日有曀，寤言不寐，愿言则嚏。
sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng-l003.explanation: 风整天阴云密布，不日更阴；醒来睡不着，想念他就打喷嚏。

sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng-l003.segmentation: All day cloudy wind; soon darker still. I wake and cannot sleep—missing him, I sneeze.

sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng-l004.segmentation: 曀曀其阴，虺虺其雷，寤言不寐，愿言则怀。
sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng-l004.explanation: 阴云密布，雷声隐隐；醒来睡不着，想念他就心有所怀。

sj-feng-beifeng-zhongfeng-l004.segmentation: Dark clouds gather; thunder mutters. I wake and cannot sleep—missing him, my heart holds him close.

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l001.segmentation: 鸱鸮鸱鸮，既取我子，无毁我室。
sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l001.explanation: 猫头鹰啊猫头鹰，你已经叼走我的孩子，不要再毁我的巢。

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l001.segmentation: O owl, owl—you took my young; do not destroy my nest.

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l002.explanation: 恩爱勤劳啊，养子的可怜啊。

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l002.segmentation: With love and toil—the pity of raising young!

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l003.segmentation: 迨天之未阴雨，彻彼桑土，绸缪牖户。
sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l003.explanation: 趁还没下雨，剥取桑根皮，把窗户门扇牢牢扎好。

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l003.segmentation: Before rain falls, strip mulberry bark and bind window and door tight.

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l004.explanation: 如今你们这些下民，还敢欺侮我吗？

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l004.segmentation: Now you folk below—dare you still insult me?

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l005.explanation: 我手劳累，我所采的荼菜。

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l005.segmentation: My hands are worn with work—the bitter herbs I pluck.

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l006.segmentation: 予所蓄租，予口卒瘏，曰予未有室家。
sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l006.explanation: 我所积蓄的柴草，我口劳瘁，说我还未成家有室。

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l006.segmentation: The fuel I stored; my mouth is sore—they say I have no home yet.

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l007.segmentation: 予羽谯谯，予尾翛翛，予室翘翘。
sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l007.explanation: 我的羽毛枯焦，我的尾巴残破，我的巢室高翘。

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l007.segmentation: My feathers are tattered, my tail frayed, my nest stands high.

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l008.segmentation: 风雨所漂摇，予维音哓哓！
sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l008.explanation: 在风雨中飘摇，我只能声声号叫！

sj-feng-binfeng-chixiao-l008.segmentation: Tossed in wind and rain—I can only cry out loud!

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l001.explanation: 我出征东山，久久不能回家。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l001.segmentation: I marched to the eastern hills and long did not return.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l002.explanation: 我从东方回来，细雨蒙蒙。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l002.segmentation: I come from the east; fine rain drizzles down.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l003.explanation: 我向东边说归期，心却向西悲。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l003.segmentation: I say eastward I will return, but my heart grieves westward.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l004.explanation: 缝制那套衣裳，不再当兵衔枚。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l004.segmentation: I sew those garments—no more marching with gag in mouth.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l005.explanation: 蠕动的野蚕，成群在桑野。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l005.segmentation: Crawling caterpillars teem in the mulberry fields.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l006.segmentation: Alone I sleep—even beneath the cart.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l007.explanation: 我出征东山，久久不能回家。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l007.segmentation: I marched to the eastern hills and long did not return.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l008.explanation: 我从东方回来，细雨蒙蒙。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l008.segmentation: I come from the east; fine rain drizzles down.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l009.explanation: 栝楼果实，也挂到屋檐下。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l009.segmentation: Gourd fruit hangs even under the eaves.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l010.explanation: 喜蛛在室内，蜘蛛在门边。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l010.segmentation: Longlegs in the room; spiders at the door.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l011.explanation: 田鹿场里，萤火虫夜间闪亮。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l011.segmentation: On the field paths, fireflies gleam at night.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l012.explanation: 并不可怕啊，实在值得怀念。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l012.segmentation: Not to be feared—they are truly worth remembering.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l013.explanation: 我出征东山，久久不能回家。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l013.segmentation: I marched to the eastern hills and long did not return.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l014.explanation: 我从东方回来，细雨蒙蒙。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l014.segmentation: I come from the east; fine rain drizzles down.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l015.explanation: 鹳鸟在土丘上鸣叫，妇人在室内叹息。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l015.segmentation: The stork calls on the mound; the wife sighs indoors.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l016.explanation: 洒扫洞室，我的征人就要到了。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l016.segmentation: She sweeps the hollow room—my soldier will soon arrive.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l017.segmentation: Bitter gourds hang thick on the stacked firewood.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l018.explanation: 自从见不到你，至今已经三年。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l018.segmentation: Since I last saw you, three years have passed.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l019.explanation: 我出征东山，久久不能回家。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l019.segmentation: I marched to the eastern hills and long did not return.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l020.explanation: 我从东方回来，细雨蒙蒙。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l020.segmentation: I come from the east; fine rain drizzles down.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l021.explanation: 仓庚鸟在飞，羽毛闪闪发亮。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l021.segmentation: Orioles fly; their feathers shine bright.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l022.explanation: 姑娘要出嫁，马儿斑驳多彩。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l022.segmentation: A maiden weds; the horses are dappled and fine.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l023.explanation: 母亲为她结好婚带，礼仪齐全。

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l023.segmentation: Her mother ties her wedding sash; rites are complete in every way.

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l024.explanation: 新嫁很好，旧妻又该怎么办呢？

sj-feng-binfeng-dongshan-l024.segmentation: The new bride is splendid—what of the old wife?

sj-feng-binfeng-fake-l001.segmentation: How do we hew an axe handle?

sj-feng-binfeng-fake-l002.segmentation: Without an axe it cannot be done.

sj-feng-binfeng-fake-l003.segmentation: How do we take a wife?

sj-feng-binfeng-fake-l004.segmentation: Without a go-between it cannot be done.

sj-feng-binfeng-fake-l005.explanation: 砍斧柄啊砍斧柄，它的法则就在近处。

sj-feng-binfeng-fake-l005.segmentation: Hew the handle, hew the handle—the pattern is close at hand.

sj-feng-binfeng-fake-l006.explanation: 我见到那位姑娘，礼器摆列整齐。

sj-feng-binfeng-fake-l006.segmentation: I meet that maiden; platters and cups are set in order.

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu-l001.explanation: 九罭之网捕到的，是鳟鱼和鲂鱼。

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu-l001.segmentation: In the nine-meshed net are trout and bream.

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu-l002.explanation: 我见到那位君子，穿着衮衣绣裳。

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu-l002.segmentation: I meet that lord in robe and embroidered skirt.

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu-l003.segmentation: 鸿飞遵渚，公归无所，于女信处。
sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu-l003.explanation: 鸿雁沿沙洲飞，公要归去无所栖，在此信处可安居。

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu-l003.segmentation: Wild swans fly along the islet; the lord returns with nowhere to stay—here he may dwell in trust.

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu-l004.segmentation: 鸿飞遵六，公归不复，于女信宿。
sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu-l004.explanation: 鸿雁沿渚岸飞，公要归去不再回，在此信宿可留连。

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu-l004.segmentation: Wild swans fly along the bank; the lord returns no more—here he may lodge in trust.

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu-l005.segmentation: 是以有衮衣兮，无以我公归兮，无使我心悲兮。
sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu-l005.explanation: 因此有这衮衣啊，不要让我公归去啊，不要使我的心悲啊。

sj-feng-binfeng-jiuyu-l005.segmentation: Thus we have this grand robe—do not let our lord go home; do not break my heart with grief.

sj-feng-binfeng-langba-l001.explanation: 狼前进时踩着胡须，又绊住尾巴。

sj-feng-binfeng-langba-l001.segmentation: The wolf steps on its beard, then trips on its tail.

sj-feng-binfeng-langba-l002.explanation: 公孙皮肤丰腴，赤舄几几然。

sj-feng-binfeng-langba-l002.segmentation: Our lord's skin is full and smooth; his red shoes stand firm.

sj-feng-binfeng-langba-l003.explanation: 狼绊住尾巴，又踩着胡须。

sj-feng-binfeng-langba-l003.segmentation: The wolf trips on its tail, then steps on its beard.

sj-feng-binfeng-langba-l004.explanation: 公孙皮肤丰腴，德行难道有瑕疵？

sj-feng-binfeng-langba-l004.segmentation: Our lord's skin is full and smooth—is there any flaw in his virtue?

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l001.explanation: 既打坏我的斧，又损缺我的凿。

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l001.segmentation: They broke my axe and chipped my adze.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l002.explanation: 周公东征，安定四方之国。

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l002.segmentation: The Duke of Zhou marched east and settled the four realms.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l003.explanation: 可怜我们这些人，也实在很刚强。

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l003.segmentation: Pity us common folk—we too are very tough.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l004.explanation: 既打坏我的斧，又损缺我的凿（锜）。

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l004.segmentation: They broke my axe and chipped my chisel.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l005.explanation: 周公东征，四方之国来归顺。

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l005.segmentation: The Duke of Zhou marched east; the four realms submitted.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l006.explanation: 可怜我们这些人，也实在很好。

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l006.segmentation: Pity us common folk—we too are very fine.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l007.explanation: 既打坏我的斧，又损缺我的矛头。

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l007.segmentation: They broke my axe and chipped my spear-blade.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l008.explanation: 周公东征，四方之国来归顺。

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l008.segmentation: The Duke of Zhou marched east; the four realms submitted.

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l009.explanation: 可怜我们这些人，也实在美善。

sj-feng-binfeng-pofu-l009.segmentation: Pity us common folk—we too are very good.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l001.explanation: 七月里大火星向西落，九月就该把寒衣发给人们了。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l001.segmentation: In the seventh month the Fire Star sets westward; in the ninth month winter clothes are handed out.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l002.segmentation: 一之日觱发，二之日栗烈。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l002.explanation: 周历正月北风刺骨，二月寒气更加凛冽。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l002.segmentation: In the first month of Zhou the north wind bites; in the second month the cold is keener still.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l003.explanation: 没有衣服也没有粗布短衣，怎么熬过这一年？

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l003.segmentation: With no coat and no coarse garment, how can we get through the year?

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l004.segmentation: 三之日于耜，四之日举趾。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l004.explanation: 三月里修理农具，四月里就动身下地。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l004.segmentation: In the third month we mend the plough; in the fourth we set out to the fields.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l005.explanation: 带着我的妻子儿女，到南边田里去送饭。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l005.segmentation: With my wife and children I carry food to the southern fields.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l006.segmentation: The field overseer comes and is greatly pleased.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l007.explanation: 七月里大火星向西落，九月就该把寒衣发给人们了。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l007.segmentation: In the seventh month the Fire Star sets westward; in the ninth month winter clothes are handed out.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l008.explanation: 春天里阳光和煦，黄鹂鸟在鸣叫。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l008.segmentation: In spring the sun shines warm, and the oriole sings.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l009.segmentation: 女执懿筐，遵彼微行，爰求柔桑。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l009.explanation: 姑娘提着深筐，沿着小路去采嫩桑叶。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l009.segmentation: The girl takes a deep basket and, along the narrow path, goes to gather tender mulberry leaves.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l010.explanation: 春日漫长，姑娘们采白蒿，成群结队。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l010.segmentation: The spring day is long; girls gather felwort in great numbers.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l011.segmentation: 女心伤悲，殆及公子同归。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l011.explanation: 姑娘心里悲伤，恐怕要随公子嫁去。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l011.segmentation: The girl's heart is sad, fearing she must go home with the lord's son.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l012.explanation: 七月里大火星向西落，八月里芦苇已长得茂密。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l012.segmentation: In the seventh month the Fire Star sets; in the eighth month reeds and rushes grow thick.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l013.explanation: 养蚕的月份要修剪桑枝，取来斧头与方刃斧。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l013.segmentation: In silkworm month we trim the mulberry; we take axe and adze.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l014.explanation: 砍去高处的枝条，嫩桑树多么茂盛。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l014.segmentation: We cut the far-reaching branches; how lush the young mulberry trees!

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l015.explanation: 七月里伯劳鸟叫，八月里开始绩麻。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l015.segmentation: In the seventh month the shrike calls; in the eighth we begin spinning hemp.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l016.segmentation: 载玄载黄，我朱孔阳，为公子裳。
