sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l016.explanation: 染出黑线黄线，我们的朱红格外鲜明，为公子做下裳。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l016.segmentation: We dye black and yellow threads; our crimson is bright indeed, to make the lord's lower robe.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l017.explanation: 四月里远志开花，五月里蝉在鸣叫。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l017.segmentation: In the fourth month the plantain blooms; in the fifth the cicada sings.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l018.explanation: 八月里收获庄稼，十月里落叶纷纷。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l018.segmentation: In the eighth month we harvest; in the tenth the leaves fall.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l019.segmentation: 一之日于貉，取彼狐狸，为公子裘。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l019.explanation: 正月里去打貉，猎取狐狸，为公子做皮裘。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l019.segmentation: In the first month we hunt raccoon-dogs and foxes for the lord's fur coat.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l020.explanation: 二月里众人会同狩猎，继续练武事。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l020.segmentation: In the second month all hunt together, carrying on martial practice.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l021.explanation: 自己留下小猪，把大猪献给公家。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l021.segmentation: We keep the piglets for ourselves and present the boars to the lord.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l022.segmentation: 五月斯螽动股，六月莎鸡振羽。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l022.explanation: 五月里螽斯弹动后股，六月里纺织娘振翅。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l022.segmentation: In the fifth month the katydid stirs its legs; in the sixth the grasshopper beats its wings.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l023.segmentation: 七月在野，八月在宇，九月在户，十月蟋蟀，入我床下。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l023.explanation: 七月蟋蟀在野外，八月在檐下，九月在门内，十月钻进床下。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l023.segmentation: In the seventh month crickets are in the wild; in the eighth under the eaves; in the ninth at the door; in the tenth under the bed.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l024.explanation: 熏鼠洞堵向开，用泥把门缝抹严。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l024.segmentation: We fumigate mouse holes, block the north window, and seal the door.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l025.segmentation: 嗟我妇子，曰为改岁，入此室处。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l025.explanation: 唉，我的妻子儿女，说到了改年，就搬进这屋里住。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l025.segmentation: Ah, my wife and children—when the year turns, we enter this room to dwell.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l026.segmentation: 六月食郁及薁，七月亨葵及菽。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l026.explanation: 六月里吃李子和葡萄，七月里煮葵菜和豆类。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l026.segmentation: In the sixth month we eat plums and grapes; in the seventh we boil mallow and beans.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l027.explanation: 八月里打枣，十月里收稻。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l027.segmentation: In the eighth month we pick dates; in the tenth we gather rice.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l028.explanation: 酿这春酒，用来祝老人长寿。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l028.segmentation: We brew this spring wine to wish the elders long life.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l029.segmentation: 七月食瓜，八月断壶，九月叔苴，采荼薪樗。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l029.explanation: 七月里吃瓜，八月里断壶，九月里收麻子，采苦菜、砍臭椿当柴。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l029.segmentation: In the seventh we eat melons; in the eighth gather gourds; in the ninth pick hemp seed, gather sowthistle, and cut ailanthus for fuel.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l031.segmentation: 九月筑场圃，十月纳禾稼。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l031.explanation: 九月里筑场圃，十月里把禾稼收进场。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l031.segmentation: In the ninth month we build threshing floors; in the tenth we bring in the grain.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l032.explanation: 黍稷重穋，还有禾、麻、豆、麦。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l032.segmentation: Millet, late millet, and also hemp, beans, and wheat.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l033.segmentation: 嗟我农夫，我稼既同，上入执宫功。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l033.explanation: 唉，我们农夫，庄稼都收齐了，还要上去服宫中的劳役。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l033.segmentation: Alas, we farmers—when the crops are all in, we must go up to labor at the palace.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l034.segmentation: 昼尔于茅，宵尔索綯，亟其乘屋，其始播百谷。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l034.explanation: 白天割茅草，夜里搓绳，赶紧盖屋，好再播种百谷。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l034.segmentation: By day we cut thatch, by night we twist rope, hurry to roof the house, and sow the grains again.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l035.segmentation: 二之日凿冰冲冲，三之日纳于凌阴。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l035.explanation: 二月里凿冰咚咚响，三月里把冰送进冰窖。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l035.segmentation: In the second month we chop ice with a clang; in the third we store it in the ice house.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l036.explanation: 四月里早起来，献羔羊、祭韭菜。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l036.segmentation: In the fourth month, rising early, we offer a lamb and leeks in sacrifice.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l037.explanation: 九月里秋霜肃杀，十月里清扫场圃。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l037.segmentation: In the ninth month frost falls sharp; in the tenth we clean the threshing ground.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l038.segmentation: 朋酒斯飨，曰杀羔羊，跻彼公堂。
sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l038.explanation: 聚酒宴饮，杀羔羊，登上公堂。

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l038.segmentation: We gather for a feast with wine, kill a lamb, and climb the lord's hall.

sj-feng-binfeng-qiyue-l039.segmentation: Raise the rhinoceros horn cup: may you live ten thousand years without end!

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou-l001.explanation: 蜉蝣的翅膀，使衣裳显得鲜明整齐。

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou-l001.segmentation: The mayfly's wings make its garments bright and neat.

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou-l002.explanation: 内心忧愁啊，该到何处安身？

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou-l002.segmentation: My heart is full of sorrow—where shall I find a resting place?

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou-l003.explanation: 蜉蝣的翅膀，色彩鲜明，衣服华美。

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou-l003.segmentation: The mayfly's wings are bright; its clothes are fine.

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou-l004.explanation: 内心忧愁啊，该到哪里休息？

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou-l004.segmentation: My heart is full of sorrow—where shall I find repose?

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou-l005.explanation: 蜉蝣刚刚钻出，麻衣洁白如雪。

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou-l005.segmentation: The mayfly just emerges, its hemp robe white as snow.

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou-l006.explanation: 内心忧愁啊，该向谁倾诉？

sj-feng-caofeng-fuyou-l006.segmentation: My heart is full of sorrow—to whom shall I unburden myself?

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l001.explanation: 那候望的人啊，为何拿着戈和祋？

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l001.segmentation: That lookout—why does he carry spear and trident?

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l002.explanation: 那些贵族子弟，有三百人身穿赤色蔽膝。

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l002.segmentation: Those lordlings—three hundred in crimson knee-guards.

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l003.explanation: 鹈鹕站在鱼梁上，却不沾湿翅膀。

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l003.segmentation: The pelican stands on the fish dam yet does not wet its wings.

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l004.explanation: 那些贵族子弟，与其身份不相称。

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l004.segmentation: Those lordlings—their rank does not match their dress.

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l005.explanation: 鹈鹕站在鱼梁上，却不沾湿嘴。

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l005.segmentation: The pelican stands on the fish dam yet does not wet its beak.

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l006.explanation: 那些贵族子弟，不配享受他们的恩宠。

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l006.segmentation: Those lordlings—they do not deserve the favor they receive.

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l007.explanation: 草木茂盛，南山朝云升起。

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l007.segmentation: Lush and thick the growth; on the southern hill morning clouds rise.

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l008.explanation: 温柔美丽啊，年轻姑娘正挨饿。

sj-feng-caofeng-houren-l008.segmentation: Gentle and fair—the young girl goes hungry.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l001.explanation: 斑鸠在桑树上，它的孩子有七个。

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l001.segmentation: The turtledove is in the mulberry; its brood numbers seven.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l002.explanation: 贤德的君子，他的仪态始终如一。

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l002.segmentation: The good and noble man keeps one uniform bearing.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l003.explanation: 仪态始终如一，内心专一坚定。

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l003.segmentation: His bearing is one; his heart is firm as a knot.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l004.explanation: 斑鸠在桑树上，它的孩子在梅树间。

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l004.segmentation: The turtledove is in the mulberry; its young are among the plum trees.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l005.explanation: 贤德的君子，他的腰带是丝织的。

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l005.segmentation: The good and noble man wears a silk girdle.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l006.explanation: 丝织的腰带，皮弁上饰有青黑纹。

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l006.segmentation: A silk girdle; on his cap, dark patterned trim.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l007.explanation: 斑鸠在桑树上，它的孩子在荆棘间。

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l007.segmentation: The turtledove is in the mulberry; its young are among the thorns.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l008.explanation: 贤德的君子，他的仪态没有差错。

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l008.segmentation: The good and noble man—his conduct never errs.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l009.explanation: 仪态没有差错，正是四国的榜样。

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l009.segmentation: Without error in bearing, he is the model for the four states.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l010.explanation: 斑鸠在桑树上，它的孩子在榛树下。

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l010.segmentation: The turtledove is in the mulberry; its young are under the hazel.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l011.segmentation: 淑人君子，正是国人，正是国人。
sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l011.explanation: 贤德的君子，正是国人的表率，正是国人的表率。

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l011.segmentation: The good and noble man is the people's standard—yes, the people's standard.

sj-feng-caofeng-shijiu-l012.segmentation: Why not wish him ten thousand years of life?

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan-l001.explanation: 清冷的泉水，浸泡着丛生的狼尾草。

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan-l001.segmentation: Cold is the spring below; it soaks the tufted barnyard grass.

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan-l002.explanation: 醒来长叹，怀念那周朝京都。

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan-l002.segmentation: Awake I sigh deeply, thinking of the capital of Zhou.

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan-l003.explanation: 清冷的泉水，浸泡着丛生的艾蒿。

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan-l003.segmentation: Cold is the spring below; it soaks the tufted wormwood.

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan-l004.segmentation: Awake I sigh deeply, thinking of the Zhou capital.

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan-l005.explanation: 清冷的泉水，浸泡着丛生的蓍草。

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan-l005.segmentation: Cold is the spring below; it soaks the tufted yarrow.

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan-l006.segmentation: Awake I sigh deeply, thinking of the royal capital.

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan-l007.explanation: 黍苗长得茂盛，阴雨滋润它。

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan-l007.segmentation: Luxuriant grow the millet shoots, nourished by rainy dew.

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan-l008.explanation: 四方有王，郇伯来慰劳他们。

sj-feng-caofeng-xiaquan-l008.segmentation: The four regions have a king; Lord Xun labors to comfort them.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi-l001.explanation: 东门外有池塘，可以在里面沤麻。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi-l001.segmentation: By the east gate is a pool where hemp may be steeped.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi-l002.explanation: 那美丽贤淑的姑娘，可以和她对歌。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi-l002.segmentation: That fair and good maiden—we may sing with her.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi-l003.explanation: 东门外有池塘，可以在里面沤苎。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi-l003.segmentation: By the east gate is a pool where ramie may be steeped.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi-l004.explanation: 那美丽贤淑的姑娘，可以和她交谈。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi-l004.segmentation: That fair and good maiden—we may talk with her.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi-l005.explanation: 东门外有池塘，可以在里面沤菅草。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi-l005.segmentation: By the east gate is a pool where sedge may be steeped.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi-l006.explanation: 那美丽贤淑的姑娘，可以和她畅言。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhichi-l006.segmentation: That fair and good maiden—we may speak freely with her.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen-l001.explanation: 东门的白榆，宛丘的柞树。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen-l001.segmentation: The elm at the east gate, the oak on Wan Hill.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen-l002.explanation: 子仲家的姑娘，在树下翩翩起舞。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen-l002.segmentation: The girl of Zizhong's house dances gracefully beneath them.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen-l003.explanation: 选个吉日，到南边的原野去。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen-l003.segmentation: On a chosen good day we go to the southern plain.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen-l004.explanation: 不绩麻了，在集市上跳舞。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen-l004.segmentation: She does not spin hemp; at the market she dances.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen-l005.explanation: 吉日已逝，越地人带着礼物来。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen-l005.segmentation: The good day has passed; men from Yue come with gifts.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen-l006.explanation: 看你像锦葵一样美，赠我一把花椒。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhifen-l006.segmentation: I see you lovely as mallow; you give me a handful of pepper.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhiyang-l001.explanation: 东门的白杨，叶子多么茂盛。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhiyang-l001.segmentation: The poplar at the east gate—how lush its leaves!

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhiyang-l002.explanation: 黄昏为约会之时，明星明亮闪耀。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhiyang-l002.segmentation: Twilight was our tryst; the stars blaze bright.

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhiyang-l003.explanation: 东门的白杨，叶子多么繁密。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhiyang-l003.segmentation: The poplar at the east gate—how thick its foliage!

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhiyang-l004.explanation: 黄昏为约会之时，明星清朗可见。

sj-feng-chenfeng-dongmenzhiyang-l004.segmentation: Twilight was our tryst; the stars shine clear.

sj-feng-chenfeng-fangyouquechao-l001.explanation: 堤上有鹊巢，土丘上有美苕。

sj-feng-chenfeng-fangyouquechao-l001.segmentation: On the dyke—a magpie's nest; on the mound—fine reed grass.

sj-feng-chenfeng-fangyouquechao-l003.segmentation: My heart is torn with grief.

sj-feng-chenfeng-fangyouquechao-l004.explanation: 院中铺有砖，土丘上有美鹳。

sj-feng-chenfeng-fangyouquechao-l004.segmentation: In the courtyard are tiles; on the mound—a fine heron.

sj-feng-chenfeng-fangyouquechao-l006.segmentation: My heart is full of fear.

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen-l001.explanation: 横木为门之下，可以栖身安居。

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen-l001.segmentation: Beneath a simple crossbeam gate one may dwell at ease.

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen-l002.explanation: 泌水洋洋流淌，可以解饥为乐。

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen-l002.segmentation: The Bi waters flow wide—enough to ease hunger with joy.

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen-l003.explanation: 难道吃鱼，一定要黄河的鲂鱼？

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen-l003.segmentation: Must one eat only bream from the Yellow River?

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen-l004.explanation: 难道娶妻，一定要齐国的姜女？

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen-l004.segmentation: Must one wed only a Jiang girl from Qi?

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen-l005.explanation: 难道吃鱼，一定要黄河的鲤鱼？

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen-l005.segmentation: Must one eat only carp from the Yellow River?

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen-l006.explanation: 难道娶妻，一定要宋国的姑娘？

sj-feng-chenfeng-hengmen-l006.segmentation: Must one wed only a girl from Song?

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen-l001.explanation: 墓门有荆棘，用斧子来砍伐。

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen-l001.segmentation: At the grave gate are thorns—cut them with the axe.

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen-l002.explanation: 这个人不好，国中人都知道。

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen-l002.segmentation: This man is wicked; all in the state know it.

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen-l003.explanation: 知道却不制止，是谁从前纵容的？

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen-l003.segmentation: Knowing yet not stopping—who indulged him long ago?

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen-l004.explanation: 墓门有梅树，有猫头鹰聚集栖息。

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen-l004.segmentation: At the grave gate is a plum tree; owls gather there.

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen-l005.explanation: 这个人不好，用歌来告诫他。

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen-l005.segmentation: This man is wicked—I warn him in song.

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen-l006.explanation: 告诫他却不听，颠倒过来还怨我。

sj-feng-chenfeng-mumen-l006.segmentation: He heeds no warning; turned upside down, he blames me.

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu-l001.segmentation: You wander there on the top of Wan Hill.

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu-l002.explanation: 确实有情意，却没有希望。

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu-l002.segmentation: Truly you have feeling, yet there is no hope.

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu-l003.explanation: 击鼓声坎坎，在宛丘之下。

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu-l003.segmentation: Drums beat steadily below Wan Hill.

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu-l004.explanation: 不论冬夏，都举着鹭羽舞蹈。

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu-l004.segmentation: Winter or summer, they dance holding egret plumes.

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu-l005.explanation: 击缶声坎坎，在宛丘的大道上。

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu-l005.segmentation: Pot-drums beat on the road of Wan Hill.

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu-l006.explanation: 不论冬夏，都举着鹭翿舞蹈。

sj-feng-chenfeng-wanqiu-l006.segmentation: Winter or summer, they dance holding egret fans.

sj-feng-chenfeng-yuechu-l001.segmentation: The moon comes out, bright and clear.

sj-feng-chenfeng-yuechu-l002.segmentation: The fair one's beauty is splendid.

sj-feng-chenfeng-yuechu-l003.segmentation: Her figure is graceful and slender.

sj-feng-chenfeng-yuechu-l004.segmentation: My heart labors; I am quietly sad.

sj-feng-chenfeng-yuechu-l005.segmentation: The moon comes out, pure and white.

sj-feng-chenfeng-yuechu-l006.segmentation: The fair one's beauty is lovely.

sj-feng-chenfeng-yuechu-l007.segmentation: Her bearing is relaxed and fine.

sj-feng-chenfeng-yuechu-l008.segmentation: My heart labors; I am restless with care.

sj-feng-chenfeng-yuechu-l009.segmentation: The moon comes out and shines on all.

sj-feng-chenfeng-yuechu-l010.segmentation: The fair one's beauty is radiant.

sj-feng-chenfeng-yuechu-l011.segmentation: Her figure is light and gracefully long.

sj-feng-chenfeng-yuechu-l012.segmentation: My heart labors; my grief is bitter.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l001.explanation: 那池塘的堤岸，有蒲草和荷花。

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l001.segmentation: On the bank of that marsh are cattail and lotus.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l002.explanation: 有一个美人，我思念她该怎么办？

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l002.segmentation: There is a fair one—how can I bear longing for her?

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l003.explanation: 醒也睡也无所作为，眼泪滂沱而下。

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l003.segmentation: Waking or sleeping I can do nothing; tears pour in streams.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l004.explanation: 那池塘的堤岸，有蒲草和兰草。

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l004.segmentation: On the bank of that marsh are cattail and orchid grass.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l005.explanation: 有一个美人，身材高大而卷发。

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l005.segmentation: There is a fair one, tall and with curling hair.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l006.explanation: 醒也睡也无所作为，心中郁闷忧愁。

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l006.segmentation: Waking or sleeping I can do nothing; my heart is troubled and sad.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l007.explanation: 那池塘的堤岸，有蒲和荷花。

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l007.segmentation: On the bank of that marsh are cattail and lotus bloom.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l008.explanation: 有一个美人，身材高大而庄重。

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l008.segmentation: There is a fair one, tall and dignified.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l009.explanation: 醒也睡也无所作为，辗转伏在枕上。

sj-feng-chenfeng-zebei-l009.segmentation: Waking or sleeping I can do nothing; I toss and lie on my pillow.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zhulin-l001.segmentation: Why go to the Zhi grove?

sj-feng-chenfeng-zhulin-l003.explanation: 不是要到株林，是为了追随夏南！

sj-feng-chenfeng-zhulin-l003.segmentation: Not to reach Zhi grove—to follow Xia Nan!

sj-feng-chenfeng-zhulin-l004.explanation: 驾我的四马，在株野停息。

sj-feng-chenfeng-zhulin-l004.segmentation: Drive my team of four; rest at Zhi wilds.

sj-feng-chenfeng-zhulin-l005.explanation: 骑我的马驹，在株地吃早饭！

sj-feng-chenfeng-zhulin-l005.segmentation: Ride my colts; take morning meal at Zhi!

sj-feng-guifeng-feifeng-l001.explanation: 不是风在刮，不是车在急驰。

sj-feng-guifeng-feifeng-l001.segmentation: It is not the wind rising; it is not the cart rushing.

sj-feng-guifeng-feifeng-l002.segmentation: I look back at the Zhou road; my heart is sore.

sj-feng-guifeng-feifeng-l003.explanation: 不是风在飘，不是车在轻驰。

sj-feng-guifeng-feifeng-l003.segmentation: It is not the wind drifting; it is not the cart gliding.

sj-feng-guifeng-feifeng-l004.segmentation: I look back at the Zhou road; my heart mourns.

sj-feng-guifeng-feifeng-l006.segmentation: One must wash the pot and cauldron.

sj-feng-guifeng-feifeng-l008.segmentation: I cherish the good word from afar.

sj-feng-guifeng-gaoqiu-l001.explanation: 穿着羔裘逍遥，穿着狐裘上朝。

sj-feng-guifeng-gaoqiu-l001.segmentation: In lamb fur he roams at ease; in fox fur he attends court.

sj-feng-guifeng-gaoqiu-l002.segmentation: Do I not think of you?

sj-feng-guifeng-gaoqiu-l003.segmentation: My heart labors; I am deeply grieved.

sj-feng-guifeng-gaoqiu-l004.explanation: 穿着羔裘翱翔，狐裘放在堂上。

sj-feng-guifeng-gaoqiu-l004.segmentation: In lamb fur he ranges free; fox fur hangs in the hall.

sj-feng-guifeng-gaoqiu-l005.segmentation: Do I not think of you?

sj-feng-guifeng-gaoqiu-l007.explanation: 羔裘像油脂一样润泽，太阳出来闪闪发光。

sj-feng-guifeng-gaoqiu-l007.segmentation: Lamb fur glossy as grease; when the sun rises it gleams.

sj-feng-guifeng-gaoqiu-l008.segmentation: Do I not think of you?

sj-feng-guifeng-gaoqiu-l009.segmentation: In my heart is nothing but mourning.

sj-feng-guifeng-suguan-l001.segmentation: 庶见素冠兮，棘人栾栾兮。
sj-feng-guifeng-suguan-l001.explanation: 希望能见到戴素冠的人，棘丛中人瘦骨嶙峋。

sj-feng-guifeng-suguan-l001.segmentation: Would I might see him in the white mourning cap—among thorns, wasted and thin.

sj-feng-guifeng-suguan-l002.segmentation: My heart labors with anxious care.

sj-feng-guifeng-suguan-l003.segmentation: 庶见素衣兮，我心伤悲兮。
sj-feng-guifeng-suguan-l003.explanation: 希望能见到穿素衣的人，我的心中悲伤。

sj-feng-guifeng-suguan-l003.segmentation: Would I might see him in white robes—grief fills my heart.

sj-feng-guifeng-suguan-l004.segmentation: Let me go home with you for a while.

sj-feng-guifeng-suguan-l005.segmentation: 庶见素韠兮，我心蕴结兮。
sj-feng-guifeng-suguan-l005.explanation: 希望能见到穿素蔽膝的人，我的心中郁结。

sj-feng-guifeng-suguan-l005.segmentation: Would I might see him in white knee-guards—knots bind my heart.

sj-feng-guifeng-suguan-l006.segmentation: Let me be as one with you.

sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu-l001.segmentation: 隰有苌楚，猗傩其枝，夭之沃沃，乐子之无知。
sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu-l001.explanation: 低湿处有猕猴桃，枝条柔嫩，果实饱满，羡慕你没有知觉。

sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu-l001.segmentation: In the marsh are kiwi vines—tender branches, plump fruit; happy you who have no cares.

sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu-l002.segmentation: 隰有苌楚，猗傩其华，夭之沃沃。
sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu-l002.explanation: 低湿处有猕猴桃，枝条柔嫩，花朵繁茂，果实饱满。

sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu-l002.segmentation: In the marsh are kiwi vines—tender branches, lush flowers, plump fruit.

sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu-l003.segmentation: Happy you who have no family burden.

sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu-l004.segmentation: 隰有苌楚，猗傩其实，夭之沃沃。
sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu-l004.explanation: 低湿处有猕猴桃，枝条柔嫩，果实累累，果实饱满。

sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu-l004.segmentation: In the marsh are kiwi vines—tender branches, heavy fruit, plump and full.

sj-feng-guifeng-xiyouchangchu-l005.segmentation: Happy you who have no wife and home to worry over.

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou-l001.explanation: 破鱼篓在鱼梁上，鱼是鲂和鳏。

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou-l001.segmentation: A broken fish basket on the dam—bream and bighead carp.

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou-l002.explanation: 齐国的女子回来了，随从像云一样多。

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou-l002.segmentation: The Qi lady returns; her followers cloud the road.

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou-l003.explanation: 破鱼篓在鱼梁上，鱼是鲂和鱮。

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou-l003.segmentation: A broken fish basket on the dam—bream and silver carp.

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou-l004.explanation: 齐国的女子回来了，随从像雨一样密。

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou-l004.segmentation: The Qi lady returns; her followers fall like rain.

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou-l005.explanation: 破鱼篓在鱼梁上，鱼缓缓游去。

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou-l005.segmentation: A broken fish basket on the dam—the fish slip through at ease.

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou-l006.explanation: 齐国的女子回来了，随从像水一样涌。

sj-feng-qifeng-bigou-l006.segmentation: The Qi lady returns; her followers flow like water.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming-l001.explanation: 东方还未亮，穿衣穿颠倒了。

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming-l001.segmentation: The east is not yet light; I put my clothes on upside down.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming-l002.explanation: 颠颠倒倒地穿，是公家来召唤。

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming-l002.segmentation: Dressing all awry— the lord has summoned me.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming-l003.explanation: 东方还未晒干，下裳上衣穿颠倒了。

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming-l003.segmentation: The east is not yet dry; skirt and coat are reversed.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming-l004.explanation: 倒倒颠颠地穿，是公家来下令。

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming-l004.segmentation: All reversed again—the lord has ordered me out.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming-l005.explanation: 折柳编篱笆，狂夫瞪眼怒视。

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming-l005.segmentation: Break willow to fence the garden—the wild man stares fiercely.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming-l006.explanation: 不能分清早晚，不是早就是晚。

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangweiming-l006.segmentation: He cannot tell night from dawn—if not too early, then too late.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri-l001.segmentation: 东方之日兮，彼姝者子，在我室兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri-l001.explanation: 东方太阳升起，那美丽的姑娘在我室内。

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri-l001.segmentation: The sun rises in the east; that fair girl is in my room.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri-l002.explanation: 在我室内，踩着我的足迹。

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri-l002.segmentation: In my room she treads upon my footprints.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri-l003.segmentation: 东方之月兮，彼姝者子，在我闼兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri-l003.explanation: 东方月亮升起，那美丽的姑娘在我门内。

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri-l003.segmentation: The moon rises in the east; that fair girl is at my door.

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri-l004.explanation: 在我门内，踩着我走过的足迹。

sj-feng-qifeng-dongfangzhiri-l004.segmentation: At my door she treads where I have walked.

sj-feng-qifeng-futian-l001.explanation: 不要种大田，莠草长得骄骄。

sj-feng-qifeng-futian-l001.segmentation: Do not plant the great field—cockle grows rank and tall.

sj-feng-qifeng-futian-l002.explanation: 不要思念远方的人，劳心忧伤。

sj-feng-qifeng-futian-l002.segmentation: Do not long for one far away; the heart grieves in vain.

sj-feng-qifeng-futian-l003.explanation: 不要种大田，莠草长得桀桀。

sj-feng-qifeng-futian-l003.segmentation: Do not plant the great field—cockle shoots up wild.

sj-feng-qifeng-futian-l004.explanation: 不要思念远方的人，劳心悲苦。

sj-feng-qifeng-futian-l004.segmentation: Do not long for one far away; the heart is sore with care.

sj-feng-qifeng-futian-l007.explanation: 不久再见面，突然戴上冠了！

sj-feng-qifeng-futian-l007.segmentation: Soon we meet again—suddenly he wears a man's cap!

sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l001.segmentation: 子之还兮，遭我乎狃之间兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l001.explanation: 你打猎回来，在狃地的小路上遇见我。

sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l001.segmentation: Returning from the hunt, you met me on the path at Niu.

sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l002.segmentation: 并驱从两肩兮，揖我谓我儇兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l002.explanation: 并马驱从两匹公马，作揖说我敏捷。

sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l002.segmentation: Riding side by side with two stallions, you bow and call me quick.

sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l003.segmentation: 子之茂兮，遭我乎狃之道兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l003.explanation: 你仪表美好，在狃地的大路上遇见我。

sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l003.segmentation: Handsome you are—you met me on the road at Niu.

sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l004.segmentation: 并驱从两牡兮，揖我谓我好兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l004.explanation: 并马驱从两匹公马，作揖说我好。

sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l004.segmentation: Riding side by side with two stallions, you bow and call me fine.

sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l005.segmentation: 子之昌兮，遭我乎狃之阳兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l005.explanation: 你仪表昌盛，在狃地的山南遇见我。

sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l005.segmentation: Splendid you are—you met me on the sunny slope at Niu.

sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l006.segmentation: 并驱从两狼兮，揖我谓我臧兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l006.explanation: 并马驱从两匹公马，作揖说我善。

sj-feng-qifeng-hai-l006.segmentation: Riding side by side with two stallions, you bow and call me good.

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming-l001.explanation: 鸡已经叫了，朝堂上已坐满人。

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming-l001.segmentation: The cock has crowed; the court is full.

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming-l002.explanation: 不是鸡在叫，是苍蝇的声音。

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming-l002.segmentation: It is not the cock—it is the buzz of flies.

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming-l003.explanation: 东方已明亮，朝堂上已兴旺。

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming-l003.segmentation: The east is bright; the court is thriving.

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming-l004.explanation: 不是东方亮，是月亮出来的光。

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming-l004.segmentation: It is not the dawn—it is the moon's light.

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming-l005.explanation: 虫飞嗡嗡，甘愿与你同梦。

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming-l005.segmentation: Insects hum in flight; gladly I share your dream.

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming-l006.explanation: 会集且要回去了，不要让人憎恶我们。

sj-feng-qifeng-jiming-l006.segmentation: The meeting ends and we must go—let no one hate us for it.

sj-feng-qifeng-luling-l001.explanation: 猎犬铃铃响，那人美好又仁德。

sj-feng-qifeng-luling-l001.segmentation: The hound's bell rings clear; the man is fair and kind.

sj-feng-qifeng-luling-l002.explanation: 猎犬项圈成双，那人美好卷发。

sj-feng-qifeng-luling-l002.segmentation: Double rings on the hound; the man is fair with curling hair.

sj-feng-qifeng-luling-l003.explanation: 猎犬项圈相连，那人美好又有才。

sj-feng-qifeng-luling-l003.segmentation: Linked rings on the hound; the man is fair and able.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l001.explanation: 南山高大，雄狐缓缓行走。

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l001.segmentation: The southern hill rises steep; the male fox moves slowly.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l002.explanation: 通往鲁国的路宽平，齐国的女子从那里出嫁。

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l002.segmentation: The road to Lu is broad; the Qi bride goes home by it.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l003.explanation: 已经说嫁人了，为何又怀念？

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l003.segmentation: She was said to be wed—why does she still yearn?

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l004.segmentation: Hemp shoes in pairs of five; cap tassels come double.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l005.explanation: 通往鲁国的路宽平，齐国的女子嫁过去了。

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l005.segmentation: The road to Lu is broad; the Qi bride has gone.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l006.explanation: 已经说嫁过去了，为何又跟从？

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l006.segmentation: She was said to be gone—why does she follow again?

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l008.segmentation: Lay furrows crosswise from the field strip.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l009.segmentation: How does one take a wife?

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l011.explanation: 已经说告知了，为何又放纵？

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l011.segmentation: They were told—why indulge her still?

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l013.segmentation: Without an axe it cannot be done.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l014.segmentation: How does one take a wife?

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l015.segmentation: Without a go-between it cannot be done.

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l016.explanation: 已经说得到了，为何又过头？

sj-feng-qifeng-nanshan-l016.segmentation: It was done—why push it to the extreme?

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie-l001.segmentation: Ah, how splendid he is—tall and long of limb!

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie-l002.segmentation: His brow is broad; his eyes shine bright.

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie-l003.segmentation: His step is nimble; his archery is true.

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie-l004.explanation: 唉，他真有名望，美目清亮。

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie-l004.segmentation: Ah, how famed he is—his eyes are clear.

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie-l005.segmentation: 仪既成兮，终日射侯，不出正兮，展我甥兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-yijie-l005.explanation: 仪态已成，整天射侯，箭不出靶心，展现我外甥的才能。

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie-l005.segmentation: His bearing is set; all day he shoots at the mark, never missing the center—my sister's son shows his skill.

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie-l006.explanation: 唉，他真美好，眉目清扬婉丽。

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie-l006.segmentation: Ah, how lovely he is—clear brows and graceful looks.

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie-l007.segmentation: 舞则选兮，射则贯兮，四矢反兮，以御乱兮。
sj-feng-qifeng-yijie-l007.explanation: 舞姿出众，射箭穿透靶子，四箭全中，用以抵御祸乱。

sj-feng-qifeng-yijie-l007.segmentation: He chooses the dance; his arrows pierce the target—four shafts reversed—to ward off disorder.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l001.explanation: 车马轻快地奔驰，竹席车蔽朱色皮革。

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l001.segmentation: The carriage drives lightly; bamboo mat screen, red leather.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l002.explanation: 通往鲁国的路宽平，齐国的女子黄昏出发。

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l002.segmentation: The road to Lu is broad; the Qi lady sets out at dusk.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l003.explanation: 四匹黑马整齐，垂着缰绳缓缓行。

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l003.segmentation: Four black horses in order; reins hang loose and easy.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l004.explanation: 通往鲁国的路宽平，齐国的女子和乐平易。

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l004.segmentation: The road to Lu is broad; the Qi lady is gentle and kind.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l005.explanation: 汶水汤汤流淌，行人众多。

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l005.segmentation: The Wen waters surge; travelers are many.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l006.explanation: 通往鲁国的路宽平，齐国的女子自在翱翔。

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l006.segmentation: The road to Lu is broad; the Qi lady roams at ease.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l007.explanation: 汶水滔滔流淌，行人往来纷纷。

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l007.segmentation: The Wen waters roll on; travelers throng the way.

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l008.explanation: 通往鲁国的路宽平，齐国的女子游遨其中。

sj-feng-qifeng-zaiqu-l008.segmentation: The road to Lu is broad; the Qi lady wanders and plays.

sj-feng-qifeng-zhe-l001.segmentation: 俟我于着乎而，充耳以素乎而，尚之以琼华乎而。
sj-feng-qifeng-zhe-l001.explanation: 在着地等我，充耳用白丝线，再饰以琼华。

sj-feng-qifeng-zhe-l001.segmentation: Wait for me at Zhu—earplugs of white silk, topped with fine jade.

sj-feng-qifeng-zhe-l002.segmentation: 俟我于庭乎而，充耳以青乎而，尚之以琼莹乎而。
sj-feng-qifeng-zhe-l002.explanation: 在庭院等我，充耳用青丝线，再饰以琼莹。

sj-feng-qifeng-zhe-l002.segmentation: Wait for me in the courtyard—earplugs of green silk, topped with gleaming jade.

sj-feng-qifeng-zhe-l003.segmentation: 俟我于堂乎而，充耳以黄乎而，尚之以琼英乎而。
sj-feng-qifeng-zhe-l003.explanation: 在堂上等我，充耳用黄丝线，再饰以琼英。

sj-feng-qifeng-zhe-l003.segmentation: Wait for me in the hall—earplugs of yellow silk, topped with precious jade.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l001.explanation: 有车声邻邻，有马额白颠。

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l001.segmentation: Carriages rumble near; horses have white foreheads.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l002.explanation: 还没见到君子，先听到寺人的命令。

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l002.segmentation: Before I see the lord, I hear the eunuch's order.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l003.explanation: 坡上有漆树，低湿处有栗树。

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l003.segmentation: On the slope are lacquer trees; in the marsh, chestnuts.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l004.explanation: 已经见到君子，并坐一起鼓瑟。

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l004.segmentation: Now I have seen the lord; we sit together playing zither.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l005.explanation: 今天不乐，时光逝去人将老。

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l005.segmentation: If we do not rejoice today, time will pass and we grow old.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l006.explanation: 坡上有桑树，低湿处有杨树。

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l006.segmentation: On the slope are mulberries; in the marsh, poplars.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l007.explanation: 已经见到君子，并坐一起吹簧。

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l007.segmentation: Now I have seen the lord; we sit together playing reed pipe.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l008.explanation: 今天不乐，时光逝去人将亡。

sj-feng-qinfeng-chelin-l008.segmentation: If we do not rejoice today, time will pass and we are gone.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l001.explanation: 晨风鸟疾飞，北林树茂密。

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l001.segmentation: The morning breeze bird flies swiftly; the northern woods are dense and dark.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l002.explanation: 见不到丈夫，心中忧愁不已。

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l002.segmentation: I have not seen my lord; my heart is full of anxious care.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l003.explanation: 为何这样啊，他把我忘得这样多！

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l003.segmentation: How is it so? He has forgotten me so much!

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l004.explanation: 山上有丛生的栎树，低湿处有斑纹的马。

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l004.segmentation: On the hills are clustered oaks; in the low wet ground are dappled horses.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l005.explanation: 见不到丈夫，心中没有欢乐。

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l005.segmentation: I have not seen my lord; my heart knows no joy.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l006.explanation: 为何这样啊，他把我忘得这样多！

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l006.segmentation: How is it so? He has forgotten me so much!

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l007.explanation: 山上有丛生的棣树，低湿处有树檖。

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l007.segmentation: On the hills are clustered pear trees; in the wet ground grow mulberry-leaf trees.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l008.explanation: 见不到丈夫，忧愁像醉了一样。

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l008.segmentation: I have not seen my lord; my sorrow is like drunkenness.

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l009.explanation: 为何这样啊，他把我忘得这样多！

sj-feng-qinfeng-chenfeng-l009.segmentation: How is it so? He has forgotten me so much!

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l001.explanation: 黄鸟叫声交交，停落在荆棘上。

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l001.segmentation: The yellow birds cry crisply; they perch on the thorn bushes.

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l002.segmentation: Who followed Duke Mu to the grave?

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l004.explanation: 这位奄息，能抵百夫之勇。

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l004.segmentation: This Yansi was a match for a hundred men.

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l005.explanation: 来到墓穴前，心中恐惧战栗。

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l005.segmentation: Approaching his tomb, we tremble with dread.

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l006.explanation: 苍天啊，你害死了我们的好人！

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l006.segmentation: O blue Heaven, you have destroyed our good man!

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l007.explanation: 若可赎回，愿以百身代替他！

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l007.segmentation: If he could be ransomed, we would give a hundred lives for his!

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l008.explanation: 黄鸟叫声交交，停落在桑树上。

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l008.segmentation: The yellow birds cry crisply; they perch on the mulberry trees.

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l009.segmentation: Who followed Duke Mu to the grave?

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l011.explanation: 这位仲行，能抵百夫之防。

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l011.segmentation: This Zhonghang was the defense of a hundred men.

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l012.explanation: 来到墓穴前，心中恐惧战栗。

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l012.segmentation: Approaching his tomb, we tremble with dread.

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l013.segmentation: O blue Heaven, you have destroyed our good man!

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l014.explanation: 若可赎回，愿以百身代替他！

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l014.segmentation: If he could be ransomed, we would give a hundred lives for his!

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l015.explanation: 黄鸟叫声交交，停落在荆楚上。

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l015.segmentation: The yellow birds cry crisply; they perch on the thorn trees.

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l016.segmentation: Who followed Duke Mu to the grave?

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l018.explanation: 这位针虎，能抵百夫之御。

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l018.segmentation: This Zhenhu could withstand a hundred men in battle.

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l019.explanation: 来到墓穴前，心中恐惧战栗。

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l019.segmentation: Approaching his tomb, we tremble with dread.

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l020.explanation: 苍天啊，你害死了我们的好人！

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l020.segmentation: O blue Heaven, you have destroyed our good man!

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l021.explanation: 若可赎回，愿以百身代替他！

sj-feng-qinfeng-huangniao-l021.segmentation: If he could be ransomed, we would give a hundred lives for his!

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l001.explanation: 芦苇青苍，白露凝结成霜。

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l001.segmentation: The reeds are lush and green; white dew has turned to frost.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l002.explanation: 所说的那个人，在水的那一边。

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l002.segmentation: The one I speak of is on the other side of the water.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l003.explanation: 逆流而上追寻他，道路险阻又漫长。

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l003.segmentation: Going upstream to follow him, the way is blocked and long.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l004.explanation: 顺流而下追寻他，仿佛就在水中央。

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l004.segmentation: Going downstream to follow him, he seems to be in the middle of the water.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l005.explanation: 芦苇茂盛，白露尚未晒干。

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l005.segmentation: The reeds are thick; the white dew has not yet dried.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l006.explanation: 所说的那个人，在水边岸上。

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l006.segmentation: The one I speak of is on the water's bank.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l007.explanation: 逆流而上追寻他，道路险阻又陡峻。

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l007.segmentation: Going upstream to follow him, the way is blocked and steep.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l008.explanation: 顺流而下追寻他，仿佛在水中小洲上。

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l008.segmentation: Going downstream to follow him, he seems on an islet in the water.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l009.explanation: 芦苇采采，白露尚未止歇。

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l009.segmentation: The reeds are plentiful; the white dew has not yet ceased.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l010.explanation: 所说的那个人，在水边涯上。

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l010.segmentation: The one I speak of is at the water's edge.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l011.explanation: 逆流而上追寻他，道路险阻又迂回。

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l011.segmentation: Going upstream to follow him, the way is blocked and winding.

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l012.explanation: 顺流而下追寻他，仿佛在水中小块陆地。

sj-feng-qinfeng-jianjia-l012.segmentation: Going downstream to follow him, he seems on a small shoal in the water.

sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu-l001.segmentation: 于我乎，夏屋渠渠，今也每食无余。
sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu-l001.explanation: 当初对我啊，大屋高大宽敞，如今每顿饭都吃不饱。

sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu-l001.segmentation: Once for me there were grand spacious halls; now at every meal I have nothing left.

sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu-l002.explanation: 唉，不能继承当初的起始之福啊！

sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu-l002.segmentation: Alas, we cannot inherit the blessings we began with!

sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu-l003.segmentation: 于我乎，每食四簋，今也每食不饱。
sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu-l003.explanation: 当初对我啊，每顿四簋盛食，如今每顿饭都吃不饱。

sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu-l003.segmentation: Once for me each meal filled four bowls; now at every meal I am not full.

sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu-l004.explanation: 唉，不能继承当初的起始之福啊！

sj-feng-qinfeng-quanyu-l004.segmentation: Alas, we cannot inherit the blessings we began with!

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie-l001.explanation: 四匹黑鬃马高大，六根缰绳握在手中。

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie-l001.segmentation: Four black-maned horses are stout and tall; six reins are held in hand.

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie-l002.explanation: 国君所宠爱的人，跟随国君去打猎。

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie-l002.segmentation: The duke's favored men follow the duke on the hunt.

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie-l003.explanation: 按时进献应季的公兽，公兽非常肥大。

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie-l003.segmentation: They present the season's royal quarry; the beasts are very large.

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie-l004.explanation: 国君说向左，放下箭就能射中猎物。

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie-l004.segmentation: The duke says 'to the left'; they release the arrows and make the kill.

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie-l005.explanation: 在北园游乐，四匹马已经熟练。

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie-l005.segmentation: They roam the northern park; the four horses are now well trained.

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie-l006.explanation: 轻便车配鸾铃，载着猎犬歇骄。

sj-feng-qinfeng-sitie-l006.segmentation: Light carts with tinkling bells carry the hounds Xi and Jiao.

sj-feng-qinfeng-weiyang-l001.explanation: 我送别舅氏，来到渭水之阳。

sj-feng-qinfeng-weiyang-l001.segmentation: I escort my mother's brother; we reach the south bank of the Wei River.

sj-feng-qinfeng-weiyang-l002.segmentation: With what shall I gift him?

sj-feng-qinfeng-weiyang-l003.segmentation: A carriage for the road and a team of yellow horses.

sj-feng-qinfeng-weiyang-l004.explanation: 我送别舅氏，思念之情悠长。

sj-feng-qinfeng-weiyang-l004.segmentation: I escort my mother's brother; my longing stretches far.

sj-feng-qinfeng-weiyang-l005.segmentation: With what shall I gift him?

sj-feng-qinfeng-weiyang-l006.segmentation: Pendants of fine jade and gems.

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi-l001.segmentation: Who says we have no coats?

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi-l002.segmentation: We share the same robe with you.

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi-l003.explanation: 君王要兴兵，我们修好戈矛。

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi-l003.segmentation: The king is raising troops; we ready our spears and halberds.

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi-l004.segmentation: We share the same enemy with you!

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi-l005.segmentation: Who says we have no coats?

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi-l006.segmentation: We share the same inner garment with you.

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi-l007.explanation: 君王要兴兵，我们修好矛戟。

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi-l007.segmentation: The king is raising troops; we ready our spears and ji.

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi-l009.segmentation: Who says we have no coats?

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi-l010.segmentation: We share the same skirt with you.

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi-l011.explanation: 君王要兴兵，我们修好铠甲兵器。

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi-l011.segmentation: The king is raising troops; we ready our armor and weapons.

sj-feng-qinfeng-wuyi-l012.segmentation: We march to war with you!

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l001.explanation: 轻小的兵车辖毂收束，车辕五处用皮革缠束。

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l001.segmentation: The light war chariot has tight fittings; five places on the yoke are bound with leather.

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l002.explanation: 游环胁驱，阴靷以白铜续连。

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l002.segmentation: Loose rings flank the team; the inner traces are joined with white bronze.

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l003.explanation: 有花纹的垫褥铺在车毂，驾着我那骐馵马。

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l003.segmentation: Patterned mats line the axle; they drive my piebald qi horses.

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l004.explanation: 想到君子，他温润如美玉。

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l004.segmentation: When I think of my lord, he is gentle and warm as jade.

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l005.explanation: 他在板屋之中，搅乱我的心曲。

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l005.segmentation: He is in his plank house; it unsettles the tune of my heart.

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l006.explanation: 四匹公马高大，六根缰绳握在手中。

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l006.segmentation: The four stallions are stout; six reins are held in hand.

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l007.explanation: 骐骝在中间，騧骊在两旁作骖马。

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l007.segmentation: Bay and black horses are in the middle; chestnut and black are the outer pair.

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l008.explanation: 绘龙的盾牌合拢，用白铜饰在环和軜上。

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l008.segmentation: Dragon shields meet; white bronze adorns the rings and yoke ends.

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l009.explanation: 想到君子，他在外邑仍温和。

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l009.segmentation: When I think of my lord, he is still gentle though in another town.

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l010.segmentation: When is the day of his return?

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l011.segmentation: Why must I miss him so!

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l012.explanation: 四匹浅赤色马很合群，有刃的矛以白铜饰錞。

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l012.segmentation: Four light-red horses run well together; bladed spears have white bronze ferrules.

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l013.explanation: 蒙有花纹的伐，虎皮弓袋雕饰胸前。

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l013.segmentation: Patterned shields, tiger-skin quivers with carved breastplates.

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l014.explanation: 交叉的弓袋装两张弓，竹制闭以绲绳縢缠。

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l014.segmentation: Crossed quivers hold two bows; bamboo closures bound with cord.

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l015.explanation: 想到君子，或睡或起都在想他。

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l015.segmentation: When I think of my lord, asleep or awake I think of him.

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l016.explanation: 和顺的好丈夫，德行有声有序。

sj-feng-qinfeng-xiaorong-l016.segmentation: My gentle good husband—his virtue and words are orderly and clear.

sj-feng-qinfeng-zhongnan-l001.segmentation: What is there on Mount Zhongnan?

sj-feng-qinfeng-zhongnan-l002.explanation: 有枝条舒展的楠木和梅树。

sj-feng-qinfeng-zhongnan-l002.segmentation: There are straight nan trees and plum trees.

sj-feng-qinfeng-zhongnan-l003.explanation: 君子来到这里，穿着锦衣狐裘。

sj-feng-qinfeng-zhongnan-l003.segmentation: The lord has arrived, in brocade and fox fur.

sj-feng-qinfeng-zhongnan-l004.explanation: 脸色红润如涂丹，真是君主啊！

sj-feng-qinfeng-zhongnan-l004.segmentation: His face is ruddy as if painted with cinnabar—truly a ruler!

sj-feng-qinfeng-zhongnan-l005.segmentation: What is there on Mount Zhongnan?

sj-feng-qinfeng-zhongnan-l006.explanation: 有高大纪树和堂屋般的大树。

sj-feng-qinfeng-zhongnan-l006.segmentation: There are tall ji trees and trees like halls.

sj-feng-qinfeng-zhongnan-l007.explanation: 君子来到这里，穿着黻衣绣裳。

sj-feng-qinfeng-zhongnan-l007.segmentation: The lord has arrived, in patterned robes and embroidered skirts.

sj-feng-qinfeng-zhongnan-l008.explanation: 佩玉锵锵作响，愿长寿不忘！

sj-feng-qinfeng-zhongnan-l008.segmentation: His jade pendants ring clearly—may he live long and be remembered!

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l001.explanation: 鸨鸟羽声肃肃，集在丛生的柞树上。

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l001.segmentation: The bustard's wings rustle; they gather on clustered oak trees.

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l002.explanation: 王事没有休止，不能种稷和黍。

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l002.segmentation: The king's service never ends; we cannot plant millet and broomcorn.

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l004.explanation: 悠悠苍天啊，何时才有归宿？

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l004.segmentation: O distant Heaven, when will we have a place to rest?

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l005.explanation: 鸨鸟翼声肃肃，集在丛生的棘树上。

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l005.segmentation: The bustard's wings rustle; they gather on clustered thorn trees.

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l006.explanation: 王事没有休止，不能种黍和稷。

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l006.segmentation: The king's service never ends; we cannot plant broomcorn and millet.

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l008.explanation: 悠悠苍天啊，何时才是尽头？

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l008.segmentation: O distant Heaven, when will this ever end?

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l009.segmentation: 肃肃鸨行，集于苞桑，王事靡盬，不能蓺稻梁。
sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l009.explanation: 鸨鸟行列肃肃，集在丛生的桑上；王事没有休止，不能种稻和高粱。

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l009.segmentation: The bustards in ranks rustle; they gather on clustered mulberries; the king's service never ends—we cannot plant rice and grain.

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l010.segmentation: Have our parents ever had a proper meal?

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l011.explanation: 悠悠苍天啊，何时才有常道？

sj-feng-tangfeng-baoyu-l011.segmentation: O distant Heaven, when will there be constancy again?

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l001.explanation: 采苓啊采苓，在首阳山顶。

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l001.segmentation: Gathering sweet flag, gathering sweet flag—on the summit of Mount Shouyang.

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l002.explanation: 别人编造的谣言，也不要相信。

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l002.segmentation: Do not believe the rumors others spread.

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l003.explanation: 舍弃吧舍弃吧，也不要这样去做。

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l003.segmentation: Put them aside, put them aside—do not act on them at all.

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l004.explanation: 别人编造的谣言，从哪儿得来？

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l004.segmentation: Where do the rumors others spread come from?

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l005.explanation: 采苦啊采苦，在首阳山下。

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l005.segmentation: Gathering bitter herbs on the slopes of Mount Shouyang.

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l006.explanation: 别人编造的谣言，也不要参与。

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l006.segmentation: Do not take part in the rumors others spread.

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l007.explanation: 舍弃吧舍弃吧，也不要这样去做。

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l007.segmentation: Put them aside, put them aside—do not act on them at all.

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l008.explanation: 别人编造的谣言，从哪儿得来？

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l008.segmentation: Where do the rumors others spread come from?

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l009.explanation: 采葑啊采葑，在首阳之东。

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l009.segmentation: Gathering turnips east of Mount Shouyang.

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l010.explanation: 别人编造的谣言，也不要跟从。

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l010.segmentation: Do not follow the rumors others spread.

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l011.explanation: 舍弃吧舍弃吧，也不要这样去做。

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l011.segmentation: Put them aside, put them aside—do not act on them at all.

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l012.explanation: 别人编造的谣言，从哪儿得来？

sj-feng-tangfeng-cailing-l012.segmentation: Where do the rumors others spread come from?

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l001.explanation: 紧紧捆扎柴薪，三星高悬在天上。

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l001.segmentation: They bind the firewood tight; the three stars are high in the sky.

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l002.explanation: 今晚是什么夜晚，见到这位好丈夫？

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l002.segmentation: What night is tonight, that I meet this good man?

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l003.explanation: 你啊你啊，遇到这样好丈夫怎么办？

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l003.segmentation: O you, O you—what shall we do with such a good man?

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l004.explanation: 紧紧捆扎牧草，三星斜在角隅。

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l004.segmentation: They bind the fodder tight; the three stars slant in the corner of the sky.

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l005.explanation: 今晚是什么夜晚，见到这次不期而遇？

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l005.segmentation: What night is tonight, that I meet this chance encounter?

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l006.explanation: 你啊你啊，遇到这样邂逅怎么办？

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l006.segmentation: O you, O you—what shall we do with such a meeting?

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l007.explanation: 紧紧捆扎荆条，三星照在门户。

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l007.segmentation: They bind the thorn branches tight; the three stars shine at the door.

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l008.explanation: 今晚是什么夜晚，见到这位鲜明的人？

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l008.segmentation: What night is tonight, that I see this radiant one?

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l009.explanation: 你啊你啊，遇到这样鲜明的人怎么办？

sj-feng-tangfeng-choumou-l009.segmentation: O you, O you—what shall we do with one so bright?

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l001.explanation: 有棵单独的杜树，叶子润泽茂盛。

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l001.segmentation: A solitary du tree stands; its leaves are lush and glossy.

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l002.segmentation: I walk alone, lonely and unsupported.

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l004.segmentation: None are like my brother of the same father.

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l005.explanation: 唉，路上的人，为何不亲近他？

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l005.segmentation: Alas, you travelers—why do you not draw close to him?

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l006.explanation: 人没有兄弟，为何不帮助他？

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l006.segmentation: If a man has no brothers, why will you not aid him?

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l007.explanation: 有棵单独的杜树，叶子青青密密。

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l007.segmentation: A solitary du tree stands; its leaves are thick and green.

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l008.segmentation: I walk alone, turning back with no one beside me.

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l010.segmentation: None are like my kinsman of the same clan.

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l011.explanation: 唉，路上的人，为何不亲近他？

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l011.segmentation: Alas, you travelers—why do you not draw close to him?

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l012.explanation: 人没有兄弟，为何不帮助他？

sj-feng-tangfeng-didu-l012.segmentation: If a man has no brothers, why will you not aid him?

sj-feng-tangfeng-gaoqiu-l001.explanation: 羔裘袖饰豹纹，我的丈夫安闲自得。

sj-feng-tangfeng-gaoqiu-l001.segmentation: Lamb fur with leopard cuffs—my lord lives at ease.

sj-feng-tangfeng-gaoqiu-l003.segmentation: It is only because of you.

sj-feng-tangfeng-gaoqiu-l004.explanation: 羔裘袖饰豹纹，我的丈夫心事重重。

sj-feng-tangfeng-gaoqiu-l004.segmentation: Lamb fur with leopard cuffs—my lord is full of care.

sj-feng-tangfeng-gaoqiu-l006.segmentation: It is only because I love you.

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l001.explanation: 葛藤覆盖荆树，蔹草蔓延于野。

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l001.segmentation: Kudzu covers the thorn tree; creepers spread across the wild.

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l002.segmentation: My beloved is gone from here—with whom

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l004.explanation: 葛藤覆盖棘树，蔹草蔓延于域。

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l004.segmentation: Kudzu covers the jujube tree; creepers spread over the burial ground.

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l005.segmentation: My beloved is gone from here—with whom

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l007.explanation: 角枕鲜明啊，锦被灿烂啊。

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l007.segmentation: The horn pillow is bright; the brocade coverlet shines.

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l008.segmentation: My beloved is gone from here—with whom

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l009.segmentation: shall I pass the long night?

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l010.explanation: 夏天的白昼，冬天的夜晚。

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l011.explanation: 百年之后，回到他的居处。

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l011.segmentation: after a hundred years I will go to his dwelling.

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l012.explanation: 冬天的夜晚，夏天的白昼。

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l013.explanation: 百年之后，回到他的墓室。

sj-feng-tangfeng-gesheng-l013.segmentation: after a hundred years I will go to his chamber in the grave.

sj-feng-tangfeng-jiaoliao-l001.segmentation: The fruit of the pepper plant multiplies to fill a pint.

sj-feng-tangfeng-jiaoliao-l002.explanation: 那个人的儿子，硕大无比。

sj-feng-tangfeng-jiaoliao-l002.segmentation: That man's son is huge beyond compare.

sj-feng-tangfeng-jiaoliao-l003.segmentation: O pepper plant—your branches stretch far.

sj-feng-tangfeng-jiaoliao-l004.segmentation: The fruit of the pepper plant multiplies to fill two hands.

sj-feng-tangfeng-jiaoliao-l005.explanation: 那个人的儿子，硕大又敦厚。

sj-feng-tangfeng-jiaoliao-l005.segmentation: That man's son is large and steadfast.

sj-feng-tangfeng-jiaoliao-l006.segmentation: O pepper plant—your branches stretch far.

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l001.explanation: 山上有枢树，低湿处有榆树。

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l001.segmentation: On the hill are shu trees; in the wet ground are elms.

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l002.explanation: 你有衣裳，却不拖曳不穿着。

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l002.segmentation: You have clothes, yet you neither drag nor wear them.

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l003.explanation: 你有车马，却不奔驰不驱赶。

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l003.segmentation: You have chariots and horses, yet you neither race nor drive them.

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l004.explanation: 忽然有一天死了，别人来享受。

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l004.segmentation: Suddenly you die—and others take their pleasure.

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l005.explanation: 山上有栲树，低湿处有杻树。

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l005.segmentation: On the hill are kao trees; in the wet ground are niu trees.

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l006.explanation: 你有庭院，却不洒水不打扫。

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l006.segmentation: You have courts and halls, yet you neither sprinkle nor sweep them.

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l007.explanation: 你有钟鼓，却不敲击不演奏。

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l007.segmentation: You have bells and drums, yet you neither strike nor play them.

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l008.explanation: 忽然有一天死了，别人来保有。

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l008.segmentation: Suddenly you die—and others keep what was yours.

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l009.explanation: 山上有漆树，低湿处有栗树。

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l009.segmentation: On the hill are lacquer trees; in the wet ground are chestnuts.

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l010.explanation: 你有酒食，为何不日日鼓瑟？

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l010.segmentation: You have wine and food—why not play the zither every day?

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l011.explanation: 且以此喜乐，且以此度日。

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l011.segmentation: Take joy in this, and pass the days in happiness.

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l012.explanation: 忽然有一天死了，别人进你的室。

sj-feng-tangfeng-shanyoushu-l012.segmentation: Suddenly you die—and others enter your room.

sj-feng-tangfeng-wuyi-l001.explanation: 难道说没有七件换洗衣物？

sj-feng-tangfeng-wuyi-l001.segmentation: Who says I have not seven changes of clothes?

sj-feng-tangfeng-wuyi-l002.explanation: 不如你送我的衣，既安适又吉祥！

sj-feng-tangfeng-wuyi-l002.segmentation: They are not like the robe you gave—safe and blessed!

sj-feng-tangfeng-wuyi-l003.explanation: 难道说没有六件换洗衣物？

sj-feng-tangfeng-wuyi-l003.segmentation: Who says I have not six changes of clothes?

sj-feng-tangfeng-wuyi-l004.explanation: 不如你送我的衣，既安适又温暖！

sj-feng-tangfeng-wuyi-l004.segmentation: They are not like the robe you gave—safe and warm!

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l001.explanation: 蟋蟀在堂，年岁将要结束。

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l001.segmentation: Crickets are in the hall; the year is nearly done.

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l002.explanation: 如今我不取乐，日月将要逝去。

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l002.segmentation: If I do not enjoy myself now, days and months will pass away.

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l003.explanation: 不要过度安乐，应常念本职。

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l003.segmentation: Do not indulge in great ease; think always of your duties at home.

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l004.explanation: 爱好享乐而不荒废，贤士才警惕。

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l004.segmentation: Enjoy pleasure without excess, and good men stay watchful.

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l005.explanation: 蟋蟀在堂，年岁将要过去。

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l005.segmentation: Crickets are in the hall; the year is slipping by.

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l006.explanation: 如今我不取乐，日月将要飞逝。

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l006.segmentation: If I do not enjoy myself now, days and months will hurry on.

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l007.explanation: 不要过度安乐，应常念身外之责。

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l007.segmentation: Do not indulge in great ease; think of responsibilities beyond yourself.

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l008.explanation: 爱好享乐而不荒废，贤士才勤勉。

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l008.segmentation: Enjoy pleasure without excess, and good men stay diligent.

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l009.explanation: 蟋蟀在堂，役车将要停息。

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l009.segmentation: Crickets are in the hall; the service carts will soon rest.

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l010.explanation: 如今我不取乐，日月将要漫长流逝。

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l010.segmentation: If I do not enjoy myself now, days and months will drift on.

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l011.explanation: 不要以过度安乐为满足。

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l011.segmentation: Do not take excessive ease as your goal.

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l012.segmentation: Think always of cares and troubles ahead.

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l013.explanation: 爱好享乐而不荒废，贤士才和乐。

sj-feng-tangfeng-xishuai-l013.segmentation: Enjoy pleasure without excess, and good men are at peace.

sj-feng-tangfeng-yangzhishui-l001.segmentation: The rushing water—bright white stones show clear.

sj-feng-tangfeng-yangzhishui-l002.explanation: 素衣朱领，随你前往沃地。

sj-feng-tangfeng-yangzhishui-l002.segmentation: In white robe and red collar, I follow you to Wo.

sj-feng-tangfeng-yangzhishui-l003.explanation: 已经见到君子，为何不欢乐？

sj-feng-tangfeng-yangzhishui-l003.segmentation: Having seen the lord, how can we not rejoice?

sj-feng-tangfeng-yangzhishui-l004.segmentation: The rushing water—white stones gleam bright.

sj-feng-tangfeng-yangzhishui-l005.explanation: 素衣朱绣，随你前往鹄地。

sj-feng-tangfeng-yangzhishui-l005.segmentation: In white robe and red embroidery, I follow you to Hu.

sj-feng-tangfeng-yangzhishui-l006.explanation: 已经见到君子，为何还忧愁？

sj-feng-tangfeng-yangzhishui-l006.segmentation: Having seen the lord, why should we still grieve?

sj-feng-tangfeng-yangzhishui-l008.explanation: 我听说有命令，不敢告诉他人。

sj-feng-tangfeng-yangzhishui-l008.segmentation: I have heard there is an order; I dare not tell others.

sj-feng-tangfeng-youdizhidu-l001.explanation: 有棵单独的杜树，生在路左。

sj-feng-tangfeng-youdizhidu-l001.segmentation: A solitary du tree grows on the left of the road.

sj-feng-tangfeng-youdizhidu-l002.explanation: 那君子啊，是否肯来我这里？

sj-feng-tangfeng-youdizhidu-l002.segmentation: That gentleman—will he be willing to come to me?

sj-feng-tangfeng-youdizhidu-l003.explanation: 心中喜爱他，拿什么招待饮食？

sj-feng-tangfeng-youdizhidu-l003.segmentation: I love him in my heart—how shall I feed and host him?

sj-feng-tangfeng-youdizhidu-l004.explanation: 有棵单独的杜树，生在路周。

sj-feng-tangfeng-youdizhidu-l004.segmentation: A solitary du tree grows at the road's bend.

sj-feng-tangfeng-youdizhidu-l005.explanation: 那君子啊，是否肯来游赏？

sj-feng-tangfeng-youdizhidu-l005.segmentation: That gentleman—will he be willing to come and visit?

sj-feng-tangfeng-youdizhidu-l006.explanation: 心中喜爱他，拿什么招待饮食？

sj-feng-tangfeng-youdizhidu-l006.segmentation: I love him in my heart—how shall I feed and host him?

sj-feng-wangfeng-caige-l001.segmentation: 彼采葛兮，一日不见，如三月兮！
sj-feng-wangfeng-caige-l001.explanation: 他采葛啊，一天不见，像隔三月！

sj-feng-wangfeng-caige-l001.segmentation: He gathers kudzu—one day apart feels like three months!

sj-feng-wangfeng-caige-l002.segmentation: 彼采萧兮，一日不见，如三秋兮！
sj-feng-wangfeng-caige-l002.explanation: 他采萧啊，一天不见，像隔三秋！

sj-feng-wangfeng-caige-l002.segmentation: He gathers wormwood—one day apart feels like three autumns!

sj-feng-wangfeng-caige-l004.segmentation: One day apart feels like three years!

sj-feng-wangfeng-dache-l001.explanation: 大车行进槛槛，毳衣如菼色。

sj-feng-wangfeng-dache-l001.segmentation: The great cart rumbles on; his fur coat is the color of reeds.

sj-feng-wangfeng-dache-l002.segmentation: Do I not think of you?

sj-feng-wangfeng-dache-l004.segmentation: 大车啍啍，毳衣如璊，岂不尔思？
sj-feng-wangfeng-dache-l004.explanation: 大车行进啍啍，毳衣如赤璋色，难道不想你吗？

sj-feng-wangfeng-dache-l004.segmentation: The great cart rolls slowly; his fur coat is like red jade—do I not think of you?

sj-feng-wangfeng-dache-l005.segmentation: I fear you will not elope with me.

sj-feng-wangfeng-dache-l006.explanation: 活着各住一室，死后同穴而葬。

sj-feng-wangfeng-dache-l006.segmentation: Alive we have separate rooms; dead we share one grave.

sj-feng-wangfeng-dache-l007.segmentation: If you do not believe me, let the bright sun be witness.

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l001.segmentation: Long trailing kudzu grows on the river's bank.

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l002.explanation: 终久远离兄弟，称他人为父。

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l002.segmentation: Having long been far from brothers, I call another man father.

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l003.explanation: 称他人为父，也不顾念我！

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l003.segmentation: I call another father, yet he does not care for me!

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l004.segmentation: Long trailing kudzu grows on the river's islet.

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l005.explanation: 终久远离兄弟，称他人为母。

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l005.segmentation: Having long been far from brothers, I call another woman mother.

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l006.explanation: 称他人为母，也不体恤我！

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l006.segmentation: I call another mother, yet she does not cherish me!

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l007.segmentation: Long trailing kudzu grows on the river's edge.

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l008.explanation: 终久远离兄弟，称他人为兄。

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l008.segmentation: Having long been far from brothers, I call another man elder brother.

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l009.explanation: 称他人为兄，也不闻问我！

sj-feng-wangfeng-gelei-l009.segmentation: I call another brother, yet he does not ask after me!

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyangyang-l001.segmentation: 君子阳阳，左执簧，右招我由房，其乐只且！
sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyangyang-l001.explanation: 君子和乐，左手持簧，右手招我同入房室，其乐无穷！

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyangyang-l001.segmentation: The lord is cheerful—left hand on the reed pipe, right hand beckons me to the inner room; what joy!

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyangyang-l002.segmentation: 君子陶陶，左执翿，右招我由敖，其乐只且！
sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyangyang-l002.explanation: 君子陶然，左手持羽，右手招我同游敖地，其乐无穷！

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyangyang-l002.segmentation: The lord is at ease—left hand on the feather fan, right hand beckons me to roam in Ao; what joy!

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyuyi-l001.explanation: 丈夫在外服役，不知归期。

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyuyi-l001.segmentation: My lord is on service; we do not know when he will return.

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyuyi-l003.segmentation: The chickens roost in their perches.

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyuyi-l004.explanation: 太阳西下了，羊牛也下来了。

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyuyi-l004.segmentation: The sun is setting; sheep and cattle come down from the hills.

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyuyi-l005.explanation: 丈夫在外服役，怎能不想念！

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyuyi-l005.segmentation: My lord is on service—how can I not miss him!

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyuyi-l006.explanation: 丈夫在外服役，不知日也不知月。

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyuyi-l006.segmentation: My lord is on service—we know neither day nor month of return.

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyuyi-l008.segmentation: The chickens roost on their racks.

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyuyi-l009.explanation: 太阳西下了，羊牛也下来了。

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyuyi-l009.segmentation: The sun is setting; sheep and cattle come down.

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyuyi-l010.explanation: 丈夫在外服役，希望不要饥渴！

sj-feng-wangfeng-junziyuyi-l010.segmentation: My lord is on service—may he not suffer hunger or thirst!

sj-feng-wangfeng-qiuzhongyouma-l001.segmentation: In the hillock is hemp—that is Liu Zijie.

sj-feng-wangfeng-qiuzhongyouma-l002.explanation: 那位留子嗟，希望他能来施与。

sj-feng-wangfeng-qiuzhongyouma-l002.segmentation: That Liu Zijie—may he come and give generously.

sj-feng-wangfeng-qiuzhongyouma-l003.segmentation: In the hillock is wheat—that is Liu Ziguo.

sj-feng-wangfeng-qiuzhongyouma-l004.explanation: 那位留子国，希望他能来共食。

sj-feng-wangfeng-qiuzhongyouma-l004.segmentation: That Liu Ziguo—may he come and share a meal.

sj-feng-wangfeng-qiuzhongyouma-l005.explanation: 丘中有李，那是留氏之子。

sj-feng-wangfeng-qiuzhongyouma-l005.segmentation: In the hillock are plums—that is the son of the Liu clan.

sj-feng-wangfeng-qiuzhongyouma-l006.explanation: 那位留氏之子，赠我佩九。

sj-feng-wangfeng-qiuzhongyouma-l006.segmentation: That son of Liu gives me the pendant Jiu.

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l001.explanation: 那边黍子长得密又密，那边稷苗才刚抽穗。

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l001.segmentation: Over there the broomcorn millet stands thick and tall; over there the panicled millet is still in the tender shoot.

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l002.explanation: 我一步步走得很慢，心里动荡不安。

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l002.segmentation: I walk with slow, lingering steps, and my heart sways with unrest.

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l003.explanation: 了解我的人，会说我是心中忧愁；

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l003.segmentation: Those who understand me say my heart is heavy with grief;

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l004.explanation: 不了解我的人，会说我还在求什么。

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l004.segmentation: those who do not understand me ask what I am still seeking.

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l005.explanation: 高远无边的苍天，这（毁宗庙的）究竟是谁？

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l005.segmentation: O vast and distant Heaven—who is it that has brought this upon us?

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l006.explanation: 那边黍子长得密又密，那边稷子已经抽穗。

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l006.segmentation: Over there the broomcorn millet stands thick; over there the panicled millet has formed its ears.

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l007.explanation: 我一步步走得很慢，心里像醉了一样昏沉。

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l007.segmentation: I walk with slow steps, and my heart feels as if I were drunk.

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l008.explanation: 了解我的人，会说我是心中忧愁；

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l008.segmentation: Those who understand me say my heart is heavy with grief;

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l009.explanation: 不了解我的人，会说我还在求什么。

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l009.segmentation: those who do not understand me ask what I am still seeking.

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l010.explanation: 高远无边的苍天，这究竟是谁（造成的）？

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l010.segmentation: O vast and distant Heaven—who is it that has done this?

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l011.explanation: 那边黍子长得密又密，那边稷子已经结籽成熟。

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l011.segmentation: Over there the broomcorn millet stands thick; over there the panicled millet bears ripe grain.

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l012.explanation: 我一步步走得很慢，心里像被堵住一样难受。

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l012.segmentation: I walk with slow steps, and my heart feels choked as if I cannot swallow.

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l013.explanation: 了解我的人，会说我是心中忧愁；

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l013.segmentation: Those who understand me say my heart is heavy with grief;

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l014.explanation: 不了解我的人，会说我还在求什么。

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l014.segmentation: those who do not understand me ask what I am still seeking.

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l015.explanation: 高远无边的苍天，这究竟是谁（造成的）？

sj-feng-wangfeng-shuli-l015.segmentation: O vast and distant Heaven—who is it that has done this?

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l001.explanation: 有只兔子行动舒缓，野鸡却撞入网罗。

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l001.segmentation: A rabbit moves at ease, yet a pheasant is caught in the net.

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l002.explanation: 我出生之初，天下还少祸乱；

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l002.segmentation: In the days when I was born, the world was still free of much turmoil;

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l003.explanation: 我出生之后，却遇上种种灾难。

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l003.segmentation: but after I was born, I met one calamity after another.

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l004.explanation: 但愿长睡不醒，不要再说话。

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l004.segmentation: Would that I could sleep on and never wake to speak again.

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l005.explanation: 有只兔子行动舒缓，野鸡却撞进罗网。

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l005.segmentation: A rabbit moves at ease, yet a pheasant is caught in the snare.

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l006.explanation: 我出生之初，天下还少变故；

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l006.segmentation: In the days when I was born, the world had few upheavals;

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l007.explanation: 我出生之后，却遇上种种忧患。

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l007.segmentation: but after I was born, I met sorrow upon sorrow.

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l008.explanation: 但愿长睡不醒，不要再知觉。

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l008.segmentation: Would that I could sleep on and never wake to feel again.

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l009.explanation: 有只兔子行动舒缓，野鸡却撞进密网。

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l009.segmentation: A rabbit moves at ease, yet a pheasant is caught in the tight net.

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l010.explanation: 我出生之初，天下还少劳役；

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l010.segmentation: In the days when I was born, the world had little forced labor;

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l011.explanation: 我出生之后，却遇上种种凶祸。

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l011.segmentation: but after I was born, I met one misfortune after another.

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l012.explanation: 但愿长睡不醒，不要再听见。

sj-feng-wangfeng-tuyuan-l012.segmentation: Would that I could sleep on and never wake to hear again.

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l001.explanation: 河水缓缓流，却冲不动捆好的柴薪。

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l001.segmentation: The river flows gently, yet it cannot carry off the bundled firewood.

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l002.explanation: 那个小伙子，不能和我一同戍守申地。

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l002.segmentation: That young man of theirs cannot garrison Shen with me.

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l003.segmentation: 怀哉怀哉，曷月予还归哉？
sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l003.explanation: 思念啊思念，何月我才能回家？

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l003.segmentation: Longing, longing—what month will I return home?

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l004.explanation: 河水缓缓流，却冲不动捆好的荆条。

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l004.segmentation: The river flows gently, yet it cannot carry off the bundled thorn branches.

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l005.explanation: 那个小伙子，不能和我一同戍守甫地。

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l005.segmentation: That young man of theirs cannot garrison Fu with me.

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l006.segmentation: 怀哉怀哉，曷月予还归哉？
sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l006.explanation: 思念啊思念，何月我才能回家？

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l006.segmentation: Longing, longing—what month will I return home?

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l007.explanation: 河水缓缓流，却冲不动捆好的蒲草。

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l007.segmentation: The river flows gently, yet it cannot carry off the bundled rushes.

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l008.explanation: 那个小伙子，不能和我一同戍守许地。

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l008.segmentation: That young man of theirs cannot garrison Xu with me.

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l009.segmentation: 怀哉怀哉，曷月予还归哉？
sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l009.explanation: 思念啊思念，何月我才能回家？

sj-feng-wangfeng-yangzhishui-l009.segmentation: Longing, longing—what month will I return home?

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l001.explanation: 山谷里有益母草，已被晒干枯了。

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l001.segmentation: In the middle of the valley grows motherwort, now parched and withered dry.

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l002.explanation: 有个女子被抛弃，独自长声叹息。

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l002.segmentation: A woman cast off in divorce sighs again and again.

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l003.segmentation: 慨其叹矣，遇人之艰难矣。
sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l003.explanation: 她长声叹息，是因为遇人太艰难啊。

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l003.segmentation: She sighs so—because meeting the right person is so hard.

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l004.explanation: 山谷里有益母草，已经干到只剩茎秆。

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l004.segmentation: In the valley grows motherwort, dried down to its stalks.

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l005.explanation: 有个女子被抛弃，放声长啸。

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l005.segmentation: A woman cast off in divorce gives a long, wailing cry.

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l006.segmentation: 条其歗矣，遇人之不淑矣。
sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l006.explanation: 她放声长啸，是因为所遇之人不好啊。

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l006.segmentation: She wails so—because the man she met was not good.

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l007.explanation: 山谷里有益母草，被晒得湿漉漉又枯了。

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l007.segmentation: In the valley grows motherwort, wilted and damp from the heat.

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l008.explanation: 有个女子被抛弃，抽泣不止。

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l008.segmentation: A woman cast off in divorce weeps in broken sobs.

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l009.explanation: 她抽泣不止，后悔也来不及了。

sj-feng-wangfeng-zhongguyoutui-l009.segmentation: She weeps so—yet it is too late for regret.

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l001.explanation: 丈夫啊多么英武，是国家的豪杰。

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l001.segmentation: My lord is bold and gallant—the hero of the state.

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l002.explanation: 他手持兵器，做王的先锋。

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l002.segmentation: He holds a halberd and marches as the king's vanguard.

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l003.explanation: 自从他向东出征，我的头发乱如蓬草。

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l003.segmentation: Since he went east on campaign, my hair has flown wild like tumbleweed.

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l004.explanation: 难道没有脂膏可以润发？

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l004.segmentation: Is it that I lack ointment to dress my hair?

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l005.segmentation: For whom should I make myself fair!

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l006.explanation: 希望下雨啊下雨，（盼他归）却见灿烂日出。

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l006.segmentation: I pray for rain, yet the bright sun climbs high.

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l007.explanation: 一心思念丈夫，情愿为此头疾也不悔。

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l007.segmentation: My heart longs only for my lord; I gladly bear this ache in my head.

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l008.segmentation: Where can I find the forget-sorrow plant?

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l009.segmentation: They say to plant it behind the roof ridge.

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l010.segmentation: My heart longs only for my lord;

sj-feng-weifeng-boxi-l011.segmentation: it makes my heart sick with grief.

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l001.segmentation: 坎坎伐檀兮，置之河之干兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l001.explanation: 坎坎声里伐檀树，把木头放在河岸上。

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l001.segmentation: With axe-strokes ringing, we hew sandalwood and lay it on the river bank.

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l002.segmentation: The river water is clear and ripples gently.

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l003.segmentation: 不稼不穑，胡取禾三百廛兮？
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l003.explanation: 不种不收，凭什么占我三百户人家的禾稼？

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l003.segmentation: You neither sow nor reap—why do you take grain from three hundred households?

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l004.segmentation: 不狩不猎，胡瞻尔庭有县貆兮？
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l004.explanation: 不打不猎，凭什么看见你庭院里挂着野猪肉？

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l004.segmentation: You neither hunt nor chase—why hang wild boar in your courtyard?

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l005.explanation: 那些君子啊，不能白吃饭！

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l005.segmentation: Those 'gentlemen' must not live on idle meals!

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l006.segmentation: 坎坎伐辐兮，置之河之侧兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l006.explanation: 坎坎声里伐车辐，把木头放在河旁边。

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l006.segmentation: With axe-strokes ringing, we hew wheel spokes and lay them by the river.

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l007.segmentation: The river water is clear and runs straight.

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l008.segmentation: 不稼不穑，胡取禾三百亿兮？
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l008.explanation: 不种不收，凭什么占我亿万粒禾稼？

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l008.segmentation: You neither sow nor reap—why do you take grain by the hundred million?

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l009.segmentation: 不狩不猎，胡瞻尔庭有县特兮？
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l009.explanation: 不打不猎，凭什么看见你庭院里挂着三岁大兽？

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l009.segmentation: You neither hunt nor chase—why hang a three-year-old beast in your courtyard?

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l010.explanation: 那些君子啊，不能白吃肉！

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l010.segmentation: Those 'gentlemen' must not live on idle meat!

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l011.segmentation: 坎坎伐轮兮，置之河之漘兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l011.explanation: 坎坎声里伐车轮，把木头放在河湾处。

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l011.segmentation: With axe-strokes ringing, we hew wheel rims and lay them at the river bend.

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l012.segmentation: The river water is clear and swirls in eddies.

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l013.segmentation: 不稼不穑，胡取禾三百囷兮？
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l013.explanation: 不种不收，凭什么占我三百囷仓的禾稼？

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l013.segmentation: You neither sow nor reap—why fill three hundred granaries with our grain?

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l014.segmentation: 不狩不猎，胡瞻尔庭有县鹑兮？
sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l014.explanation: 不打不猎，凭什么看见你庭院里挂着鹌鹑？

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l014.segmentation: You neither hunt nor chase—why hang quail in your courtyard?

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l015.explanation: 那些君子啊，不能白吃晚餐！

sj-feng-weifeng-fatan-l015.segmentation: Those 'gentlemen' must not live on idle suppers!

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l001.explanation: 在那汾水低湿处，人们采泽泻。

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l001.segmentation: On the marshy banks of the Fen, they gather the water plantain.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l002.explanation: 那个公子，美好得无法度量。

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l002.segmentation: That young lord is so fair that beauty cannot measure him.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l003.explanation: 美好无法度量，和公路大夫大不相同。

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l003.segmentation: Beyond measure in beauty—utterly unlike the Grand Road officer.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l004.explanation: 在那汾水一方，人们采桑叶。

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l004.segmentation: On one stretch of the Fen, they gather mulberry leaves.
