sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l005.segmentation: That young lord is lovely as blossoming flowers.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l006.explanation: 美如鲜花，和公行大夫大不相同。

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l006.segmentation: Lovely as flowers—utterly unlike the Grand Procession officer.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l007.explanation: 在那汾水弯曲处，人们采藚草。

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l007.segmentation: Where the Fen bends, they gather the artemisia.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l008.segmentation: That young lord is fair as polished jade.

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l009.explanation: 美如美玉，和公族大夫大不相同。

sj-feng-weifeng-fenjuru-l009.segmentation: Fair as jade—utterly unlike the lord of the clan.

sj-feng-weifeng-geju-l001.explanation: 麻葛编成的鞋，能踩霜过冬吗？

sj-feng-weifeng-geju-l001.segmentation: Can shoes woven of hemp and vine truly tread upon the frost?

sj-feng-weifeng-geju-l002.explanation: 那女子细瘦的手，能缝好衣裳吗？

sj-feng-weifeng-geju-l002.segmentation: Can that girl's thin, weary hands truly sew a proper robe?

sj-feng-weifeng-geju-l003.explanation: 她缝好领子袖口，让“好人”穿上。

sj-feng-weifeng-geju-l003.segmentation: She finishes collar and cuff for the 'fine lady' to wear.

sj-feng-weifeng-geju-l004.segmentation: 好人提提，宛然左辟，佩其象揥。
sj-feng-weifeng-geju-l004.explanation: 那“好人”仪态闲雅，侧身让路，佩戴象牙簪。

sj-feng-weifeng-geju-l004.segmentation: The 'fine lady' moves with ease, steps aside to the left, and wears an ivory hairpin.

sj-feng-weifeng-geju-l005.explanation: 正因为她心地偏狭，才写下这首诗讽刺。

sj-feng-weifeng-geju-l005.segmentation: Because her heart is narrow and cruel, this poem is written as a rebuke.

sj-feng-weifeng-heguang-l001.segmentation: Who says the Yellow River is wide?

sj-feng-weifeng-heguang-l002.segmentation: A single reed could ferry you across.

sj-feng-weifeng-heguang-l003.segmentation: Who says the state of Song is far?

sj-feng-weifeng-heguang-l004.segmentation: Stand on tiptoe and you can see it.

sj-feng-weifeng-heguang-l005.segmentation: Who says the Yellow River is wide?

sj-feng-weifeng-heguang-l006.segmentation: It cannot even hold a little boat.

sj-feng-weifeng-heguang-l007.segmentation: Who says the state of Song is far?

sj-feng-weifeng-heguang-l008.segmentation: One morning is enough to reach it.

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan-l001.explanation: 他盘桓在山涧，隐士心胸宽畅。

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan-l001.segmentation: He dwells and wanders in the mountain stream— the lofty man's heart is spacious.

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan-l002.explanation: 独自睡醒来言说，永志不忘这份快乐。

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan-l002.segmentation: Alone he sleeps and wakes to speak; forever he will not forget this joy.

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan-l003.explanation: 他盘桓在山坡，隐士形貌魁伟。

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan-l003.segmentation: He dwells on the hillside— the lofty man's form is grand.

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan-l004.explanation: 独自睡醒来歌唱，永志不违背此志。

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan-l004.segmentation: Alone he sleeps and wakes to sing; forever he will not stray from this path.

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan-l005.explanation: 他盘桓在土丘，隐士风度温厚。

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan-l005.segmentation: He dwells on the earthen mound— the lofty man's bearing is warm and steady.

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan-l006.explanation: 独自睡醒来栖止，永志不把此志告人。

sj-feng-weifeng-kaopan-l006.segmentation: Alone he sleeps and wakes to rest; forever he will not proclaim this resolve to others.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l001.explanation: 那男子装得老实，抱着布来换丝。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l001.segmentation: That man looked simple and honest, carrying cloth to trade for silk.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l002.explanation: 并不是真来换丝，是来谈婚嫁之事。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l002.segmentation: He did not come to trade silk—he came to talk of marriage.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l003.explanation: 我送你渡过淇水，到达顿丘。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l003.segmentation: I saw you across the Qi and on to Dunqiu.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l004.explanation: 不是我拖延婚期，是你没有好媒人。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l004.segmentation: It was not I who delayed our wedding—you had no good go-between.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l005.explanation: 请你别生气，把秋天定为婚期吧。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l005.segmentation: Do not be angry; let autumn be our wedding day.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l006.explanation: 我登上那破墙，眺望复关。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l006.segmentation: I climbed the broken wall to gaze toward Fuguan.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l007.explanation: 看不见你从复关来，眼泪涟涟。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l007.segmentation: When I did not see you coming from Fuguan, tears streamed down.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l008.explanation: 一旦看见你从复关来，又笑又说。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l008.segmentation: When I saw you coming from Fuguan, I laughed and talked with joy.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l009.explanation: 你占卦又占筮，结果没有凶兆。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l009.segmentation: You divined by tortoise and milfoil, and the omens held no blame.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l010.explanation: 你用车来接我，把我的嫁妆运走。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l010.segmentation: You came with your cart to fetch me and carry away my dowry.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l011.explanation: 桑树还未落叶，叶子润泽茂盛。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l011.segmentation: The mulberry had not yet shed its leaves; they were lush and moist.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l013.explanation: 不要贪吃桑葚，（吃多了会醉人）。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l013.segmentation: Do not gorge on mulberries—they will intoxicate you.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l015.explanation: 不要与男子沉溺于情爱。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l015.segmentation: Do not lose yourself in love with a man.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l016.explanation: 男子沉溺于情，还可以解脱。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l016.segmentation: When a man is lost in love, he may still be talked out of it.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l017.explanation: 女子沉溺于情，就无法解脱了。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l017.segmentation: When a woman is lost in love, there is no talking her free.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l018.explanation: 桑树已经落叶，叶子变黄飘落。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l018.segmentation: The mulberry has shed its leaves; they turn yellow and fall.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l019.explanation: 自从我嫁到你家，三年过着贫苦日子。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l019.segmentation: Since I came to you, three years we have lived in want.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l020.explanation: 淇水滚滚，漫湿了我的车帷。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l020.segmentation: The Qi runs broad and deep and soaked my carriage curtain.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l021.explanation: 我没有差错，你却变心两意。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l021.segmentation: I have not been at fault, yet you go two ways at once.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l022.explanation: 男子无底线，反复改变德行。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l022.segmentation: The man knows no limit and shifts his virtue again and again.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l023.explanation: 三年做你的妻子，家务劳动没有稍息。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l023.segmentation: Three years as your wife—I never rested from household toil.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l024.explanation: 早起晚睡，没有一天有过早晨的闲暇。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l024.segmentation: Up early and late to bed—not one morning had I to myself.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l025.explanation: 你目的达到了，竟至于对我施暴。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l025.segmentation: Once you had your way, you even turned cruel to me.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l026.explanation: 兄弟不了解我，对我嗤笑。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l026.segmentation: My brothers did not understand and laughed at me.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l027.explanation: 静思此事，只能独自悲伤。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l027.segmentation: Thinking on it in silence, I can only mourn alone.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l028.explanation: 当初说要白头偕老，到老只余怨恨。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l028.segmentation: You said we would grow old together—now old age would only mean resentment.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l029.explanation: 淇水有岸，湿地有边，情变却无界。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l029.segmentation: The Qi has its bank and the marsh its shore—yet betrayal knows no bound.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l030.segmentation: 总角之宴，言笑晏晏，信誓旦旦，不思其反。
sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l030.explanation: 少年时欢宴言笑，誓言旦旦，却不想日后反悔。

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l030.segmentation: In youth we feasted and laughed, swore oaths bright and clear, never thinking you would turn back.

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l031.explanation: 既然你全然不想旧情，也就到此为止吧！

sj-feng-weifeng-mang-l031.segmentation: Since you will not think of the past at all, let it end here!

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l001.segmentation: 投我以木瓜，报之以琼琚。
sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l001.explanation: 你赠我木瓜，我还你美玉佩。

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l001.segmentation: You toss me a papaya; I return a fine jade pendant.

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l002.explanation: 不是为了回报，是为永结友好！

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l002.segmentation: Not as repayment—to bind our friendship forever!

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l003.segmentation: 投我以木桃，报之以琼瑶。
sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l003.explanation: 你赠我木桃，我还你美玉瑶。

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l003.segmentation: You toss me a peach-wood gift; I return fine jade and carnelian.

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l004.explanation: 不是为了回报，是为永结友好！

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l004.segmentation: Not as repayment—to bind our friendship forever!

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l005.segmentation: 投我以木李，报之以琼九。
sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l005.explanation: 你赠我木李，我还你美玉玖。

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l005.segmentation: You toss me a plum-wood gift; I return dark fine jade.

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l006.explanation: 不是为了回报，是为永结友好！

sj-feng-weifeng-mugua-l006.segmentation: Not as repayment—to bind our friendship forever!

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l001.explanation: 远望淇水弯曲处，绿竹长得茂盛。

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l001.segmentation: Gazing at the bends of the Qi, the green bamboo grows lush.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l002.segmentation: 有匪君子，如切如磋，如琢如磨，瑟兮僴兮，赫兮咺兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l002.explanation: 有位俊美君子，如切磋骨角、如雕琢玉石；庄重而威严，光明又显赫。

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l002.segmentation: There is a splendid gentleman—polished as bone on stone, refined as gem on jade; dignified and stern, bright and commanding.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l003.explanation: 有位俊美君子，永远不能忘怀啊。

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l003.segmentation: There is a splendid gentleman—one can never forget him.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l004.explanation: 远望淇水弯曲处，绿竹青青。

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l004.segmentation: Gazing at the bends of the Qi, the green bamboo is deep green.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l005.segmentation: 有匪君子，充耳秀莹，会弁如星。
sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l005.explanation: 有位俊美君子，充耳玉光莹润，帽上美玉如星。

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l005.segmentation: There is a splendid gentleman—ear-plugs gleam, cap gems shine like stars.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l007.segmentation: 赫兮咺兮，有匪君子，终不可谖兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l007.explanation: 光明又显赫；有位俊美君子，永远不能忘怀啊。

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l007.segmentation: Bright and commanding—there is a splendid gentleman one can never forget.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l008.explanation: 远望淇水弯曲处，绿竹密如积。

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l008.segmentation: Gazing at the bends of the Qi, the green bamboo stands thick as a stack.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l009.segmentation: 有匪君子，如金如锡，如圭如璧。
sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l009.explanation: 有位俊美君子，如金如锡，如圭如璧。

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l009.segmentation: There is a splendid gentleman—like gold and tin, like scepter-stone and disk-jade.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l010.explanation: 宽宏又从容，倚在车轼上。

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l010.segmentation: Spacious and at ease, he leans on the chariot rail.

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l011.explanation: 善于说笑取乐，却不伤人。

sj-feng-weifeng-qiao-l011.segmentation: He jokes and teases well, yet never hurts.

sj-feng-weifeng-shimuzhijian-l001.segmentation: 十亩之间兮，桑者闲闲兮，行与子还兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-shimuzhijian-l001.explanation: 十亩桑园之间，采桑的人从容悠闲，我和你一起回家。

sj-feng-weifeng-shimuzhijian-l001.segmentation: Among ten acres of mulberry, the pickers move at ease—I walk home with you.

sj-feng-weifeng-shimuzhijian-l002.segmentation: 十亩之外兮，桑者泄泄兮，行与子逝兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-shimuzhijian-l002.explanation: 十亩桑园之外，采桑的人散放而行，我和你一同离去。

sj-feng-weifeng-shimuzhijian-l002.segmentation: Beyond the ten acres, the pickers stroll freely—I go away with you.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l001.explanation: 新娘身材颀长，穿着锦缎罩衣。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l001.segmentation: The bride is tall and stately, wearing brocade over her robe.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l002.explanation: 她是齐侯的女儿，卫侯的妻子。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l002.segmentation: She is the daughter of the Lord of Qi, wife of the Lord of Wei.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l003.segmentation: 东宫之妹，邢侯之姨，谭公维私。
sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l003.explanation: 东宫之妹，邢侯之姨，谭公之妻。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l003.segmentation: Sister of the heir, aunt of the Lord of Xing, wife of the Lord of Tan.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l004.segmentation: 手如柔荑，肤如凝脂，领如蝤蛴，齿如瓠犀，螓首蛾眉，巧笑倩兮，美目盼兮。
sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l004.explanation: 手像柔荑，肤像凝脂，颈像蝤蛴，齿像瓠犀，额广眉秀；巧笑倩兮，美目盼兮。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l004.segmentation: Hands like tender shoots, skin like congealed cream, neck like larvae-white, teeth like melon seeds, broad brow and fine brows—her clever smile charms, her lovely eyes glance.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l005.explanation: 新娘体态闲雅，在郊外农人面前致意。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l005.segmentation: The stately bride greets the farmers in the outskirts.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l006.explanation: 四匹雄马骄健，朱饰马络鲜明。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l006.segmentation: Four stallions are proud; red trappings gleam.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l007.explanation: 以雉羽为饰的车驾上朝。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l007.segmentation: She rides in state to court in a carriage hung with pheasant feathers.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l008.explanation: 大夫们早退，莫使国君劳倦。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l008.segmentation: Let the ministers withdraw early—do not weary our lord.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l009.explanation: 黄河水势浩荡，向北奔流活活。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l009.segmentation: The Yellow River rolls vast, flowing north with a rushing sound.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l010.explanation: 撒网入水濊濊，鳣鲔游动发发。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l010.segmentation: Cast nets splash wide; sturgeon and trout dart and flash.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l011.segmentation: 葭菼揭揭，庶姜孽孽，庶士有朅。
sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l011.explanation: 芦苇荻花揭揭，陪嫁众女盛美，士人前来迎亲。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoren-l011.segmentation: Reeds and rushes rise tall; the attendant ladies are glorious; gentlemen come to meet the bride.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l001.explanation: 大鼠啊大鼠，不要吃我的黍！

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l001.segmentation: Big rat, big rat—do not eat my millet!

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l002.explanation: 多年供养你，你却不肯顾念我。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l002.segmentation: Years we have fed you, yet you never care for us.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l003.explanation: 我要离开你，到那安乐的土地去。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l003.segmentation: I will leave you and go to that happy land.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l004.explanation: 安乐的土地啊，那里才有我的归宿。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l004.segmentation: Happy land, happy land—there I shall find my place.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l005.explanation: 大鼠啊大鼠，不要吃我的麦！

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l005.segmentation: Big rat, big rat—do not eat my wheat!

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l006.explanation: 多年供养你，你却不肯感激我。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l006.segmentation: Years we have fed you, yet you never repay us.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l007.explanation: 我要离开你，到那安乐的国家去。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l007.segmentation: I will leave you and go to that happy state.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l008.explanation: 安乐的国家啊，那里才有我的所值。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l008.segmentation: Happy state, happy state—there I shall find my worth.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l009.explanation: 大鼠啊大鼠，不要吃我的苗！

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l009.segmentation: Big rat, big rat—do not eat my young crops!

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l010.explanation: 多年供养你，你却不肯慰劳我。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l010.segmentation: Years we have fed you, yet you never comfort our toil.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l011.explanation: 我要离开你，到那安乐的郊野去。

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l011.segmentation: I will leave you and go to that happy borderland.

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l012.explanation: 安乐的郊野啊，谁还会长声号哭？

sj-feng-weifeng-shuoshu-l012.segmentation: Happy borderland—who would wail forever there?

sj-feng-weifeng-wanlan-l001.explanation: 芄兰嫩枝，童子佩着解结之觿。

sj-feng-weifeng-wanlan-l001.segmentation: Tender branches of the balloon vine—a boy wears the knot-untying girdle-pick.

sj-feng-weifeng-wanlan-l002.explanation: 虽然佩着觿，却不能真懂我。

sj-feng-weifeng-wanlan-l002.segmentation: Though he wears the pick, he cannot truly know me.

sj-feng-weifeng-wanlan-l003.explanation: 装模作样，宽缓而行，垂带摇摆。

sj-feng-weifeng-wanlan-l003.segmentation: He puts on airs and saunters slow, his sash-ends fluttering.

sj-feng-weifeng-wanlan-l004.explanation: 芄兰之叶，童子佩着射箭之韘。

sj-feng-weifeng-wanlan-l004.segmentation: Leaves of the balloon vine—a boy wears the archer's thumb-ring.

sj-feng-weifeng-wanlan-l005.explanation: 虽然佩着韘，却不能与我亲近。

sj-feng-weifeng-wanlan-l005.segmentation: Though he wears the ring, he cannot truly draw near to me.

sj-feng-weifeng-wanlan-l006.explanation: 装模作样，宽缓而行，垂带摇摆。

sj-feng-weifeng-wanlan-l006.segmentation: He puts on airs and saunters slow, his sash-ends fluttering.

sj-feng-weifeng-youhu-l001.explanation: 有狐狸缓行，在淇水石梁上。

sj-feng-weifeng-youhu-l001.segmentation: A fox moves slowly on the stone ford of the Qi.

sj-feng-weifeng-youhu-l002.explanation: 心中忧愁啊，那人没有下裳。

sj-feng-weifeng-youhu-l002.segmentation: My heart grieves—that man has no lower robe.

sj-feng-weifeng-youhu-l003.explanation: 有狐狸缓行，在淇水浅滩上。

sj-feng-weifeng-youhu-l003.segmentation: A fox moves slowly on the shallow shoals of the Qi.

sj-feng-weifeng-youhu-l004.explanation: 心中忧愁啊，那人没有腰带。

sj-feng-weifeng-youhu-l004.segmentation: My heart grieves—that man has no sash.

sj-feng-weifeng-youhu-l005.explanation: 有狐狸缓行，在淇水岸边。

sj-feng-weifeng-youhu-l005.segmentation: A fox moves slowly on the bank of the Qi.

sj-feng-weifeng-youhu-l006.explanation: 心中忧愁啊，那人没有衣服。

sj-feng-weifeng-youhu-l006.segmentation: My heart grieves—that man has no proper clothes.

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l001.explanation: 园里有桃树，它的果实可以作肴食。

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l001.segmentation: In the garden are peach trees— their fruit can serve as food.

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l002.explanation: 心中忧愁啊，我且歌且谣。

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l002.segmentation: My heart is heavy—I sing and chant my grief.

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l003.explanation: 不了解我的人，说我士人骄狂。

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l003.segmentation: Those who do not know me say this scholar is proud.

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l004.explanation: 那些人说得对吗？你为何这样讲？

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l004.segmentation: Are those people right? Why do you speak so?

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l005.explanation: 心中忧愁啊，有谁能知道？

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l005.segmentation: My heart is heavy—who can understand?

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l006.explanation: 有谁能知道？还是别想它了！

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l006.segmentation: Who can understand? Better not to dwell on it!

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l007.explanation: 园里有酸枣，它的果实可以充饥。

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l007.segmentation: In the garden are jujubes— their fruit can fill the belly.

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l008.explanation: 心中忧愁啊，姑且周游列国。

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l008.segmentation: My heart is heavy—I wander the states to ease it.

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l009.segmentation: 不知我者，谓我士也罔极。
sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l009.explanation: 不了解我的人，说我士人无度。

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l009.segmentation: Those who do not know me say this scholar knows no bounds.

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l010.explanation: 那些人说得对吗？你为何这样讲？

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l010.segmentation: Are those people right? Why do you speak so?

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l011.explanation: 心中忧愁啊，有谁能知道？

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l011.segmentation: My heart is heavy—who can understand?

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l012.explanation: 有谁能知道？还是别想它了！

sj-feng-weifeng-yuanyoutao-l012.segmentation: Who can understand? Better not to dwell on it!

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l001.explanation: 登上那有树之山，遥望父亲啊。

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l001.segmentation: I climb the hill with trees and gaze toward my father.

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l003.explanation: 我的儿子服役，早晚不止。

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l003.segmentation: My son is on corvée—early and late without rest.

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l004.explanation: 路上要当心啊，还要回来！

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l004.segmentation: Be careful on the road—come back!

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l006.explanation: 登上那无树之山，遥望母亲啊。

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l006.segmentation: I climb the barren hill and gaze toward my mother.

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l008.explanation: 我的小儿子服役，早晚不得安眠。

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l008.segmentation: My youngest son is on corvée—early and late he cannot sleep.

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l009.explanation: 路上要当心啊，还要回来！

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l009.segmentation: Be careful on the road—come back!

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l011.explanation: 登上那山冈，遥望兄长啊。

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l011.segmentation: I climb the ridge and gaze toward my elder brother.

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l013.explanation: 我的弟弟服役，早晚都要同行。

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l013.segmentation: My younger brother is on corvée—early and late he must keep pace.

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l014.explanation: 路上要当心啊，还要回来！

sj-feng-weifeng-zhihu-l014.segmentation: Be careful on the road—come back!

sj-feng-weifeng-zhugan-l001.explanation: 细长的竹竿，在淇水垂钓。

sj-feng-weifeng-zhugan-l001.segmentation: Slender, tall bamboo poles—I fish upon the Qi.

sj-feng-weifeng-zhugan-l002.segmentation: Do I not think of you?

sj-feng-weifeng-zhugan-l003.segmentation: The way is far—I cannot reach you.

sj-feng-weifeng-zhugan-l004.segmentation: The spring source lies to the left, the Qi to the right.

sj-feng-weifeng-zhugan-l005.explanation: 女子出嫁，远离兄弟父母。

sj-feng-weifeng-zhugan-l005.segmentation: When a girl weds, she leaves brothers and parents far behind.

sj-feng-weifeng-zhugan-l006.segmentation: The Qi lies to the right, the spring source to the left.

sj-feng-weifeng-zhugan-l007.segmentation: Her bright smile gleams; her jade ornaments chime.

sj-feng-weifeng-zhugan-l008.explanation: 淇水悠悠，桧木作桨松木作舟。

sj-feng-weifeng-zhugan-l008.segmentation: The Qi flows on— oars of cypress, boats of pine.

sj-feng-weifeng-zhugan-l009.explanation: 驾舟出游，以排遣心中忧愁。

sj-feng-weifeng-zhugan-l009.segmentation: I drive the boat and roam to pour out my sorrow.

sj-feng-yongfeng-baizhou-l001.explanation: 柏木小舟漂荡，在那河水中央。

sj-feng-yongfeng-baizhou-l001.segmentation: That little boat of cypress floats in midstream.

sj-feng-yongfeng-baizhou-l002.explanation: 他垂着两髻，确实是我所爱的配偶。

sj-feng-yongfeng-baizhou-l002.segmentation: With his hair in twin tufts— truly he is my chosen mate.

sj-feng-yongfeng-baizhou-l003.segmentation: Until death I will not turn from this vow.

sj-feng-yongfeng-baizhou-l004.explanation: 母亲啊上天啊，不理解人啊！

sj-feng-yongfeng-baizhou-l004.segmentation: O mother, O Heaven—you do not understand my heart!

sj-feng-yongfeng-baizhou-l005.explanation: 柏木小舟漂荡，在那河水旁边。

sj-feng-yongfeng-baizhou-l005.segmentation: That little boat of cypress floats by the river's edge.

sj-feng-yongfeng-baizhou-l006.explanation: 他垂着两髻，确实是我独许之人。

sj-feng-yongfeng-baizhou-l006.segmentation: With his hair in twin tufts— truly he is the one I alone chose.

sj-feng-yongfeng-baizhou-l007.segmentation: Until death I will harbor no second thought.

sj-feng-yongfeng-baizhou-l008.explanation: 母亲啊上天啊，不理解人啊！

sj-feng-yongfeng-baizhou-l008.segmentation: O mother, O Heaven—you do not understand my heart!

sj-feng-yongfeng-chunzhibenben-l001.segmentation: Quails rush and dart; magpies beat their wings.

sj-feng-yongfeng-chunzhibenben-l002.explanation: 那人没有德行，我竟把他当兄长！

sj-feng-yongfeng-chunzhibenben-l002.segmentation: That man lacks virtue—yet I took him for a brother!

sj-feng-yongfeng-chunzhibenben-l003.segmentation: Magpies beat their wings; quails rush and dart.

sj-feng-yongfeng-chunzhibenben-l004.explanation: 那人没有德行，我竟把他当国君！

sj-feng-yongfeng-chunzhibenben-l004.segmentation: That man lacks virtue—yet I took him for my lord!

sj-feng-yongfeng-didong-l001.explanation: 彩虹出现在东方，无人敢指它（讳言淫奔）。

sj-feng-yongfeng-didong-l001.segmentation: The rainbow appears in the east—no one dares point at it.

sj-feng-yongfeng-didong-l002.explanation: 女子出嫁，远离父母兄弟。

sj-feng-yongfeng-didong-l002.segmentation: When a girl goes away in marriage, she leaves parents and brothers far behind.

sj-feng-yongfeng-didong-l003.explanation: 朝虹在西，一个早晨就会下雨。

sj-feng-yongfeng-didong-l003.segmentation: A morning bow in the west—rain will come within a morning.

sj-feng-yongfeng-didong-l004.explanation: 女子出嫁，远离兄弟父母。

sj-feng-yongfeng-didong-l004.segmentation: When a girl goes away in marriage, she leaves brothers and parents far behind.

sj-feng-yongfeng-didong-l005.explanation: 像这样的人，一心只想私奔成婚。

sj-feng-yongfeng-didong-l005.segmentation: A person like this thinks only of eloping into marriage.

sj-feng-yongfeng-didong-l006.explanation: 太没有信用，不懂天命礼法啊！

sj-feng-yongfeng-didong-l006.segmentation: So faithless—ignorant of fate and right conduct!

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l001.explanation: 室宿居中时，在楚地营建宫室。

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l001.segmentation: When the Room constellation stands at the meridian, we build the palace in Chu.

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l002.explanation: 以日影测度，在楚地建造室屋。

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l002.segmentation: We measure by the sun's shadow and raise the house in Chu.

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l003.segmentation: 树之榛栗，椅桐梓漆，爰伐琴桑。
sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l003.explanation: 种植榛栗椅桐梓漆，又伐琴桑。

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l003.segmentation: We plant hazels, chestnuts, catalpa, paulownia, lac trees, and cut mulberry for lutes.

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l004.segmentation: We climb the mound and look out toward Chu.

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l005.explanation: 望见楚地与堂地，景山与京丘。

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l005.segmentation: We see Chu and Tang, Jing Hill and the capital mound.

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l006.segmentation: 降观于桑，卜云其吉，终然允臧。
sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l006.explanation: 下来察看桑田，占卜说吉利，终果然美好。

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l006.segmentation: We descend to view the mulberry fields; divination says auspicious—and so it proves good.

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l007.segmentation: 灵雨既零，命彼倌人，星言夙驾，说于桑田。
sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l007.explanation: 好雨已下，命那管园人，星夜早驾，到桑田慰劳。

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l007.segmentation: The blessed rain has fallen; we bid the keeper drive out at starlight and greet the mulberry fields.

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l008.segmentation: 匪直也人，秉心塞渊，騋牝三千。
sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l008.explanation: 不只是因为人好，更因秉性深沉，马匹三千。

sj-feng-yongfeng-dingzhifangzhong-l008.segmentation: Not men alone are upright—their hearts are deep and true, and three thousand mares stand in the stalls.

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l001.explanation: 孤零零的牛尾旗高举，出现在浚城郊外。

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l001.segmentation: Alone flies the ox-tail banner, out on the outskirts of Jun.

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l002.explanation: 用白丝绳编饰旗杆，以四匹良马驾车。

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l002.segmentation: White silk cords trim the staff; four fine horses draw the chariot.

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l003.explanation: 那位贤德之士，该用什么赠给他呢？

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l003.segmentation: That worthy man—what shall we bestow upon him?

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l004.explanation: 孤零零的鸟隼旗飘扬，在浚城都邑。

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l004.segmentation: Alone flies the falcon banner, at the capital of Jun.

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l005.explanation: 用白丝绳编织旗饰，以五匹良马驾车。

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l005.segmentation: White silk is woven into the pennant; five fine horses draw the chariot.

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l006.explanation: 那位贤德之士，该用什么给予他呢？

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l006.segmentation: That worthy man—what shall we grant him?

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l007.explanation: 孤零零的羽旌招展，在浚城城下。

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l007.segmentation: Alone flies the feathered standard, below the walls of Jun.

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l008.explanation: 用白丝绳扎束旗杆，以六匹良马驾车。

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l008.segmentation: White silk binds the staff; six fine horses draw the chariot.

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l009.explanation: 那位贤德之士，该用什么告知他呢？

sj-feng-yongfeng-ganmao-l009.segmentation: That worthy man—what shall we declare to him?

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l001.explanation: 君子与她白头偕老，她头戴副笄，缀有六珈。

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l001.segmentation: The lord grows old with her; she wears the ceremonial hairpin with six jade pendants.

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l002.segmentation: 委委佗佗，如山如河，象服是宜。
sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l002.explanation: 她举止雍容，如山如河，穿绘有象牙的礼服十分相宜。

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l002.segmentation: Graceful and stately as mountains and rivers, she suits her robe embroidered with ivory figures.

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l003.explanation: 你的品行却不善，这该怎么办呢？

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l003.segmentation: Your conduct is not good—what can be done about it?

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l004.explanation: 多么鲜明啊，她穿的翟衣。

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l004.segmentation: How bright and clear—her robe of pheasant feathers!

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l005.explanation: 黑发如云，不必用假发修饰。

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l005.segmentation: Her black hair is like clouds; she need not wear a wig.

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l006.segmentation: 玉之瑱也，象之揥也，扬且之晳也。
sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l006.explanation: 耳上玉瑱，头上象簪，额角洁白明亮。

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l006.segmentation: Jade ear-plugs, an ivory hairpin, and a fair, bright brow.

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l007.segmentation: How can she seem like a being of heaven!

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l008.segmentation: How can she seem like a divine sovereign!

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l009.explanation: 多么洁白啊，她穿的展衣。

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l009.segmentation: How pure and white—her ceremonial robe!

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l010.explanation: 外罩绉纱单衣，里面是绁袢。

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l010.segmentation: Over fine crepe she wears an outer robe; beneath is her inner garment.

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l011.explanation: 你眉目清朗，额角和颜悦色。

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l011.segmentation: Your brows and eyes are clear; your brow is fair and serene.

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l012.explanation: 像这样真美的人，是国家的佳丽！

sj-feng-yongfeng-junzixielao-l012.segmentation: A woman truly fair as this is the beauty of the state!

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l001.explanation: 墙上长着蒺藜，没法扫掉。

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l001.segmentation: Thistles grow on the wall—they cannot be swept away.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l002.explanation: 宫廷内部的丑话，没法说出口。

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l002.segmentation: The shameful talk within the court cannot be spoken aloud.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l003.explanation: 若要说出来，那话太丑恶了。

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l003.segmentation: If one could tell it, the words would be too ugly.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l004.explanation: 墙上长着蒺藜，没法除掉。

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l004.segmentation: Thistles grow on the wall—they cannot be cleared away.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l005.explanation: 宫廷内部的丑话，没法细说。

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l005.segmentation: The shameful talk within the court cannot be told in detail.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l006.segmentation: If one could recount it, the tale would be too long.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l007.explanation: 墙上长着蒺藜，没法捆束。

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l007.segmentation: Thistles grow on the wall—they cannot be bound up.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l008.explanation: 宫廷内部的丑话，没法传读。

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l008.segmentation: The shameful talk within the court cannot be read aloud.

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l009.explanation: 若要说出来，那太辱没人了。

sj-feng-yongfeng-qiangyouci-l009.segmentation: If one could speak it, it would be too humiliating.

sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong-l001.segmentation: Where shall we gather the tang plant?

sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong-l005.segmentation: 期我乎桑中，要我乎上宫，送我乎淇之上矣。
sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong-l005.explanation: 在桑中与我相约，在上宫等我，在淇水之上送我。

sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong-l005.segmentation: She fixed a tryst with me at Sangzhong, waited for me at Shanggong, and saw me off on the Qi riverbank.

sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong-l010.segmentation: 期我乎桑中，要我乎上宫，送我乎淇之上矣。
sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong-l010.explanation: 在桑中与我相约，在上宫等我，在淇水之上送我。

sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong-l010.segmentation: She fixed a tryst with me at Sangzhong, waited for me at Shanggong, and saw me off on the Qi riverbank.

sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong-l011.segmentation: Where shall we gather turnip greens?

sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong-l015.segmentation: 期我乎桑中，要我乎上宫，送我乎淇之上矣。
sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong-l015.explanation: 在桑中与我相约，在上宫等我，在淇水之上送我。

sj-feng-yongfeng-sangzhong-l015.segmentation: She fixed a tryst with me at Sangzhong, waited for me at Shanggong, and saw me off on the Qi riverbank.

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu-l001.explanation: 看那老鼠还有皮，人却没有威仪！

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu-l001.segmentation: Look—the rat has its hide, yet this man has no dignity!

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu-l002.explanation: 人若无威仪，不死还等什么？

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu-l002.segmentation: If a man lacks dignity, why does he not die?

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu-l003.explanation: 看那老鼠还有牙齿，人却没有节制！

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu-l003.segmentation: Look—the rat has teeth, yet this man has no restraint!

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu-l004.explanation: 人若无节制，不死还等何时？

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu-l004.segmentation: If a man lacks restraint, what is he waiting for but death?

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu-l005.segmentation: 相鼠有体，人而无礼，人而无礼！
sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu-l005.explanation: 看那老鼠还有身体，人却没有礼节，人却没有礼节！

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu-l005.segmentation: Look—the rat has a body, yet this man has no propriety—no propriety at all!

sj-feng-yongfeng-xiangshu-l006.segmentation: Why does he not hurry up and die?

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l001.explanation: 车马疾驰，我要回去慰问卫侯。

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l001.segmentation: I drive on, I hurry on, to return and comfort the lord of Wei.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l002.segmentation: The horses travel far; I say I have reached Cao.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l003.explanation: 大夫们跋山涉水赶来，我的心却满怀忧愁。

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l003.segmentation: The ministers come struggling over hills and streams, yet my heart is full of grief.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l004.explanation: 既然不赞许我，我也不能马上回去。

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l004.segmentation: Since you do not approve of me, I cannot turn back at once.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l005.explanation: 看你们并不善，我的思念并不远。

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l005.segmentation: You are not kind, yet my longing is not far from home.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l006.explanation: 既然不赞许我，难道不能渡河返回？

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l006.segmentation: Since you do not approve of me, can I not cross the river and return?

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l007.explanation: 看你们并不善，我的心思藏不住。

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l007.segmentation: You are not kind, yet I cannot hide my thoughts.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l008.explanation: 登上那阿丘，说要采那里的益母草。

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l008.segmentation: I climb that hillock, saying I will gather its medicinal plants.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l009.explanation: 女子多怀忧思，也各有其道理。

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l009.segmentation: Women are prone to sorrow, yet each has her own way.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l010.explanation: 许国人责备我，说我幼稚又狂妄。

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l010.segmentation: The people of Xu blame me, calling me childish and reckless.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l011.explanation: 我行走在原野上，麦子长得茂盛。

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l011.segmentation: I walk the open country; the wheat grows lush and tall.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l012.explanation: 向大国求助，谁能依靠、谁能到头？

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l012.segmentation: I appeal to a great state—on whom can I rely, and who will see it through?

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l013.explanation: 各位大夫君子，不要责怪我。

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l013.segmentation: You ministers and gentlemen, do not blame me.

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l014.explanation: 你们百般谋划，不如我所行的道路。

sj-feng-yongfeng-zaichi-l014.segmentation: All your schemes are not equal to the course I have taken.

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei-l001.explanation: 梅子纷纷落地，还剩七成。

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei-l001.segmentation: Plums fall and scatter; seven tenths of the fruit remain.

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei-l002.explanation: 各位士子来求我吧，趁这吉利时候。

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei-l002.segmentation: Come woo me, you gentlemen—while the time is auspicious.

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei-l003.explanation: 梅子纷纷落地，只剩三成。

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei-l003.segmentation: Plums fall and scatter; only three tenths remain.

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei-l004.explanation: 各位士子来求我吧，就在今天。

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei-l004.segmentation: Come woo me, you gentlemen—while it is still today.

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei-l005.explanation: 梅子纷纷落地，用倾筐拾取。

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei-l005.segmentation: Plums fall and scatter; scoop them up with a tilted basket.

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei-l006.explanation: 各位士子来求我吧，趁有人开口说媒。

sj-feng-zhaonan-biaoyoumei-l006.segmentation: Come woo me, you gentlemen—while someone speaks for a match.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caifan-l001.segmentation: Where shall we gather the white artemisia?

sj-feng-zhaonan-caifan-l002.segmentation: In the ponds and on the islets.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caifan-l003.segmentation: What shall we use it for?

sj-feng-zhaonan-caifan-l004.segmentation: For the rites of lords and marquises.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caifan-l005.segmentation: Where shall we gather the white artemisia?

sj-feng-zhaonan-caifan-l007.segmentation: What shall we use it for?

sj-feng-zhaonan-caifan-l008.segmentation: For the ancestral halls of lords and marquises.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caifan-l009.explanation: 采蒿人披着蓬蓬的围裙，日夜为公家劳作。

sj-feng-zhaonan-caifan-l009.segmentation: Gatherers wear full aprons, toiling for their lord from dawn to dusk.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caifan-l010.explanation: 采蒿人披着轻盈的围裙，说罢就回家。

sj-feng-zhaonan-caifan-l010.segmentation: Gatherers wear light aprons; when done, they say they will return home.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caiping-l001.segmentation: Where shall we gather the duckweed?

sj-feng-zhaonan-caiping-l002.segmentation: On the banks of the southern stream.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caiping-l004.segmentation: In the standing water along the road.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caiping-l005.segmentation: What shall we use to hold them?

sj-feng-zhaonan-caiping-l007.segmentation: What shall we use to cook them?

sj-feng-zhaonan-caiping-l009.segmentation: Where shall we set out the offerings?

sj-feng-zhaonan-caiping-l010.segmentation: Beneath the window of the ancestral hall.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caiping-l011.segmentation: Who will preside at the rite?

sj-feng-zhaonan-caiping-l012.segmentation: A fasting maiden of the clan.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l001.explanation: 草虫喓喓叫，阜螽跳跳跃跃。

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l001.segmentation: Grass crickets chirp; bush crickets leap and hop.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l002.explanation: 还没见到君子，心中忧愁不安。

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l002.segmentation: I have not yet seen my lord; my heart is heavy with care.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l003.segmentation: 亦既见止，亦既觏止，我心则降。
sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l003.explanation: 既已见到他，既已遇见他，我的心就平静了。

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l003.segmentation: Now I have seen him, now I have met him—my heart is eased.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l004.explanation: 登上那南山，说要采蕨菜。

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l004.segmentation: I climb the southern hill, saying I will gather fern shoots.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l005.explanation: 还没见到君子，忧心更加急切。

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l005.segmentation: I have not yet seen my lord; my worry grows keener.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l006.segmentation: 亦既见止，亦既觏止，我心则说。
sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l006.explanation: 既已见到他，既已遇见他，我的心就喜悦了。

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l006.segmentation: Now I have seen him, now I have met him—my heart is glad.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l007.explanation: 登上那南山，说要采薇菜。

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l007.segmentation: I climb the southern hill, saying I will gather wild thorn.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l008.explanation: 还没见到君子，我心中悲伤。

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l008.segmentation: I have not yet seen my lord; my heart grieves.

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l009.segmentation: 亦既见止，亦既觏止，我心则夷。
sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l009.explanation: 既已见到他，既已遇见他，我的心就安定了。

sj-feng-zhaonan-caochong-l009.segmentation: Now I have seen him, now I have met him—my heart is at peace.

sj-feng-zhaonan-gantang-l001.segmentation: 蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿伐，召伯所茇。
sj-feng-zhaonan-gantang-l001.explanation: 甘棠树虽小却茂盛，不要剪伐，召伯曾在此歇宿。

sj-feng-zhaonan-gantang-l001.segmentation: Young yet lush is the pear tree—do not cut or hew it; Lord Zhao once lodged here.

sj-feng-zhaonan-gantang-l002.segmentation: 蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿败，召伯所憩。
sj-feng-zhaonan-gantang-l002.explanation: 甘棠树虽小却茂盛，不要剪败，召伯曾在此休息。

sj-feng-zhaonan-gantang-l002.segmentation: Young yet lush is the pear tree—do not trim or ruin it; Lord Zhao once rested here.

sj-feng-zhaonan-gantang-l003.segmentation: 蔽芾甘棠，勿翦勿拜，召伯所说。
sj-feng-zhaonan-gantang-l003.explanation: 甘棠树虽小却茂盛，不要剪拜，召伯曾在此暂居。

sj-feng-zhaonan-gantang-l003.segmentation: Young yet lush is the pear tree—do not cut or bend it; Lord Zhao once sojourned here.

sj-feng-zhaonan-gaoyang-l001.explanation: 羔羊的皮袄，用素丝五绹缝缀。

sj-feng-zhaonan-gaoyang-l001.segmentation: The lamb-skin coat is trimmed with five twists of white silk.

sj-feng-zhaonan-gaoyang-l002.explanation: 从公门退朝用饭，步履从容舒缓。

sj-feng-zhaonan-gaoyang-l002.segmentation: Leaving the court to take his meal, he walks with easy grace.

sj-feng-zhaonan-gaoyang-l003.explanation: 羔羊的革衣，用素丝五緎缝缀。

sj-feng-zhaonan-gaoyang-l003.segmentation: The lamb-leather coat is trimmed with five bands of white silk.

sj-feng-zhaonan-gaoyang-l004.explanation: 步履从容舒缓，从公门退朝用饭。

sj-feng-zhaonan-gaoyang-l004.segmentation: With easy grace he walks, leaving the court to take his meal.

sj-feng-zhaonan-gaoyang-l005.explanation: 羔羊的缝衣，用素丝五总缝缀。

sj-feng-zhaonan-gaoyang-l005.segmentation: The stitched lamb-skin coat is bound with five ties of white silk.

sj-feng-zhaonan-gaoyang-l006.explanation: 步履从容舒缓，退朝从公门用饭。

sj-feng-zhaonan-gaoyang-l006.segmentation: With easy grace he walks, leaving the court to dine.

sj-feng-zhaonan-hebinongyi-l001.explanation: 那多么浓艳啊，是唐棣的花？

sj-feng-zhaonan-hebinongyi-l001.segmentation: How lush and bright—are those pear blossoms?

sj-feng-zhaonan-hebinongyi-l002.segmentation: Why is the procession not more solemn and harmonious?

sj-feng-zhaonan-hebinongyi-l003.segmentation: It is the chariot of the king's daughter.

sj-feng-zhaonan-hebinongyi-l004.explanation: 那多么浓艳啊，像桃李般鲜艳？

sj-feng-zhaonan-hebinongyi-l004.segmentation: How lush and bright—like peach and plum in bloom?

sj-feng-zhaonan-hebinongyi-l005.explanation: 是平王的孙女，齐侯的儿子。

sj-feng-zhaonan-hebinongyi-l005.segmentation: The grandson of King Ping and the son of the lord of Qi.

sj-feng-zhaonan-hebinongyi-l006.segmentation: What is the fishing line made of?

sj-feng-zhaonan-hebinongyi-l008.explanation: 齐侯的儿子，平王的孙女。

sj-feng-zhaonan-hebinongyi-l008.segmentation: The son of the lord of Qi and the granddaughter of King Ping.

sj-feng-zhaonan-jiangyousi-l001.explanation: 江水有支流，姑娘要出嫁，不要我了。

sj-feng-zhaonan-jiangyousi-l001.segmentation: The river has a branch; the girl is going to wed—she will not have me.

sj-feng-zhaonan-jiangyousi-l002.explanation: 不要我了，以后定会后悔。

sj-feng-zhaonan-jiangyousi-l002.segmentation: She will not have me; later she will regret it.

sj-feng-zhaonan-jiangyousi-l003.explanation: 江水有小洲，姑娘要出嫁，不跟我了。

sj-feng-zhaonan-jiangyousi-l003.segmentation: The river has a shoal; the girl is going to wed—she will not go with me.

sj-feng-zhaonan-jiangyousi-l004.explanation: 不跟我了，以后只能独处。

sj-feng-zhaonan-jiangyousi-l004.segmentation: She will not go with me; later she will dwell alone.

sj-feng-zhaonan-jiangyousi-l005.explanation: 江水有沱水，姑娘要出嫁，不来访我了。

sj-feng-zhaonan-jiangyousi-l005.segmentation: The river has the Tuo stream; the girl is going to wed—she will not visit me.

sj-feng-zhaonan-jiangyousi-l006.explanation: 不来访我了，只能长啸而歌。

sj-feng-zhaonan-jiangyousi-l006.segmentation: She will not visit me; I can only sigh and sing.

sj-feng-zhaonan-quechao-l001.explanation: 喜鹊筑了巢，斑鸠来居住。

sj-feng-zhaonan-quechao-l001.segmentation: The magpie has a nest; the turtledove dwells in it.

sj-feng-zhaonan-quechao-l002.explanation: 姑娘要出嫁，百辆马车来迎她。

sj-feng-zhaonan-quechao-l002.segmentation: The bride goes to wed; a hundred chariots come to escort her.

sj-feng-zhaonan-quechao-l003.explanation: 喜鹊筑了巢，斑鸠来占居。

sj-feng-zhaonan-quechao-l003.segmentation: The magpie has a nest; the turtledove takes possession.

sj-feng-zhaonan-quechao-l004.explanation: 姑娘要出嫁，百辆马车来送她。

sj-feng-zhaonan-quechao-l004.segmentation: The bride goes to wed; a hundred chariots come to convey her.

sj-feng-zhaonan-quechao-l005.explanation: 喜鹊筑了巢，斑鸠来住满。

sj-feng-zhaonan-quechao-l005.segmentation: The magpie has a nest; the turtledove fills it.

sj-feng-zhaonan-quechao-l006.explanation: 姑娘要出嫁，百辆马车成全婚礼。

sj-feng-zhaonan-quechao-l006.segmentation: The bride goes to wed; a hundred chariots complete the wedding.

sj-feng-zhaonan-xiaoxing-l001.explanation: 小小星光明亮，三五颗在东边。

sj-feng-zhaonan-xiaoxing-l001.segmentation: Bright are the little stars—three or five in the east.

sj-feng-zhaonan-xiaoxing-l002.explanation: 夜里早起赶路，日夜为公家办事。

sj-feng-zhaonan-xiaoxing-l002.segmentation: Setting out early at night, from dawn to dusk serving the lord.

sj-feng-zhaonan-xiaoxing-l003.segmentation: Truly our fates are not the same!

sj-feng-zhaonan-xiaoxing-l004.explanation: 小小星光明亮，那是参星和昴星。

sj-feng-zhaonan-xiaoxing-l004.segmentation: Bright are the little stars—the constellations Shen and Mao.

sj-feng-zhaonan-xiaoxing-l005.explanation: 夜里早起赶路，抱着被子和褥子。

sj-feng-zhaonan-xiaoxing-l005.segmentation: Setting out early at night, carrying quilt and coverlet.

sj-feng-zhaonan-xiaoxing-l006.segmentation: Truly I am not like others!

sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l001.segmentation: 厌浥行露，岂不夙夜，谓行多露。
sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l001.explanation: 路上露水湿漉漉，难道不想早起，怕路上露水多。

sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l001.segmentation: The road dew is sodden; I would rise early, yet fear the dew on the way.

sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l002.segmentation: Who says the sparrow has no horn?

sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l003.segmentation: How does it pierce my house?

sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l004.segmentation: Who says you have no home?

sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l005.segmentation: Why do you hurry me into court?

sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l006.explanation: 即使催我去打官司，也办不成家室！

sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l006.segmentation: Even if you hurry me to court, a household cannot be made!

sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l007.segmentation: Who says the rat has no teeth?

sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l008.segmentation: How does it gnaw through my wall?

sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l009.segmentation: Who says you have no home?

sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l010.segmentation: Why do you hurry me into a lawsuit?

sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l011.explanation: 即使催我去诉讼，我也不会顺从你！

sj-feng-zhaonan-xinglu-l011.segmentation: Even if you hurry me to court, I will not yield to you!

sj-feng-zhaonan-yeyousijun-l001.explanation: 野地有死獐，用白茅包裹它。

sj-feng-zhaonan-yeyousijun-l001.segmentation: In the field lies a dead buck; white rushes wrap it.

sj-feng-zhaonan-yeyousijun-l002.explanation: 有女子怀春，好男子来引诱她。

sj-feng-zhaonan-yeyousijun-l002.segmentation: A maiden feels spring love; a fine man woos her.

sj-feng-zhaonan-yeyousijun-l003.explanation: 林中有小木，野地有死鹿。

sj-feng-zhaonan-yeyousijun-l003.segmentation: In the grove are saplings; in the field lies a dead deer.

sj-feng-zhaonan-yeyousijun-l004.explanation: 白茅成捆扎好，有女子美如玉。

sj-feng-zhaonan-yeyousijun-l004.segmentation: White rushes bind it in a bundle; a maiden fair as jade.

sj-feng-zhaonan-yeyousijun-l005.segmentation: 舒而脱脱兮，无感我帨兮，无使尨也吠。
sj-feng-zhaonan-yeyousijun-l005.explanation: 慢慢脱衣啊，别碰我的佩巾，别让狗叫起来。

sj-feng-zhaonan-yeyousijun-l005.segmentation: Slowly, gently remove your clothes; do not touch my scarf; do not let the dog bark.

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei-l001.segmentation: Thunder rolls, on the sunny side of the southern hill.

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei-l002.explanation: 为何离开这里，不敢有片刻闲暇？

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei-l002.segmentation: Why leave this place—daring not a moment's rest?

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei-l003.explanation: 忠厚君子啊，归来吧归来吧！

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei-l004.segmentation: Thunder rolls, on the flank of the southern hill.

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei-l005.explanation: 为何离开这里，不敢休息片刻？

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei-l005.segmentation: Why leave this place—daring not to pause and rest?

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei-l006.explanation: 忠厚君子啊，归来吧归来吧！

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei-l007.segmentation: Thunder rolls, below the southern hill.

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei-l008.explanation: 为何离开这里，不敢安居停留？

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei-l008.segmentation: Why leave this place—daring not to stay and dwell?

sj-feng-zhaonan-yinqilei-l009.explanation: 忠厚君子啊，归来吧归来吧！

sj-feng-zhaonan-zouyu-l001.segmentation: 彼茁者葭，壹发五豝，于嗟乎驺虞！
sj-feng-zhaonan-zouyu-l001.explanation: 那茁壮的芦苇，一箭射中五头小猪，啊驺虞！

sj-feng-zhaonan-zouyu-l001.segmentation: Lush reeds grow tall; one shot brings down five piglets—ah, Zou Yu!

sj-feng-zhaonan-zouyu-l002.segmentation: 彼茁者蓬，壹发五豵，于嗟乎驺虞！
sj-feng-zhaonan-zouyu-l002.explanation: 那茁壮的蓬草，一箭射中五头小豕，啊驺虞！

sj-feng-zhaonan-zouyu-l002.segmentation: Lush wormwood grows tall; one shot brings down five shoats—ah, Zou Yu!

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen-l001.segmentation: Out of the east gate—girls thick as clouds.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen-l002.segmentation: Though they are thick as clouds,

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen-l003.segmentation: They are not the one I hold in my heart.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen-l004.explanation: 穿素衣戴綦巾的她，足以使我快乐。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen-l004.segmentation: She in white robe and green scarf is enough to make me glad.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen-l005.explanation: 走出城门外，女子多如茶白。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen-l005.segmentation: Out through the city gate—girls white as tea blossoms.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen-l006.explanation: 虽然多如茶白，却不是我所思的。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen-l006.segmentation: Though white as tea blossoms, she is not the one I long for.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen-l007.explanation: 穿素衣戴茹藘（红巾）的她，可以与她相娱。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-chuqidongmen-l007.segmentation: She in white robe and red scarf— with her I may find joy.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l001.segmentation: Uncle goes hunting, driving a team of four.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l002.segmentation: He holds the reins like woven cords; the outer pair prance like dancers.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l003.segmentation: Uncle is in the marsh; fires blaze all around.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l004.segmentation: Bare-chested he wrestles a tiger and presents it at the lord's place.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l005.explanation: 请叔别习以为常，当心伤着你。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l005.segmentation: Uncle, do not grow reckless—take care lest you be hurt.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l006.segmentation: Uncle goes hunting, driving bay horses.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l007.explanation: 两服马齐上，两骖如雁行。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l007.segmentation: The inner pair pull evenly; the outer pair fly like geese in line.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l008.segmentation: Uncle is in the marsh; flames leap high together.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l009.explanation: 叔善于射箭，又善于驾车。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l009.segmentation: Uncle shoots well and drives well too.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l010.explanation: 时而勒马，时而纵放，技艺精熟。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l010.segmentation: Now he reins in, now he lets go—skilled in every move.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l011.segmentation: Uncle goes hunting, driving piebald horses.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l012.segmentation: The inner pair match heads; the outer pair move like hands in unison.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l013.segmentation: Uncle is in the marsh; the fires burn fierce together.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l014.segmentation: 叔马慢忌，叔发罕忌，抑释掤忌，抑鬯弓忌。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l014.explanation: 叔马舒缓，叔发稀少，放下盾牌，放松弓弦。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dashuyutian-l014.segmentation: Uncle's horses slow; his shots are few; he sets aside shield and loosens bow.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dongmenzhishan-l001.explanation: 东门外的广场，茹藘长在山坡。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dongmenzhishan-l001.segmentation: On the open ground east of the gate, madder grows on the slope.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dongmenzhishan-l002.segmentation: His house is near, yet the man is far away.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dongmenzhishan-l003.explanation: 东门的栗树，有整齐的人家。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dongmenzhishan-l003.segmentation: East-gate chestnut trees—orderly homes stand there.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dongmenzhishan-l004.segmentation: Do I not long for you?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-dongmenzhishan-l005.segmentation: You do not come to me!

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng-l001.segmentation: 子之丰兮，俟我乎巷兮，悔予不送兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng-l001.explanation: 你丰仪美好，在巷口等我，后悔没送你。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng-l001.segmentation: Handsome as you are, you waited for me in the lane—I regret I did not escort you.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng-l002.segmentation: 子之昌兮，俟我乎堂兮，悔予不将兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng-l002.explanation: 你仪表堂堂，在堂上等我，后悔没跟你走。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng-l002.segmentation: Bright as you are, you waited in the hall—I regret I did not go with you.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng-l003.explanation: 里穿锦衣外罩麻衣，下裳也如此。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng-l003.segmentation: Silk within, hemp robe without—the skirt the same.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng-l004.explanation: 叔啊伯啊，驾车接我同行。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng-l004.segmentation: Uncle, elder brother—drive your chariot and take me along.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng-l005.explanation: 下裳外罩麻衣，里穿锦衣。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng-l006.explanation: 叔啊伯啊，驾车接我同归。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-feng-l006.segmentation: Uncle, elder brother—drive your chariot and take me home.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu-l001.segmentation: 风雨凄凄，鸡鸣喈喈，既见君子。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu-l001.explanation: 风雨凄凄，鸡鸣喈喈，已经见到君子。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu-l001.segmentation: Wind and rain are chill; cocks crow clearly—I have seen my lord.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu-l002.segmentation: Why should my heart not be at ease?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu-l003.segmentation: Wind and rain rush; cocks crow steadily.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu-l004.explanation: 已经见到君子，为何不快慰呢？

sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu-l004.segmentation: I have seen my lord—why should I not be comforted?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu-l005.segmentation: Wind and rain darken the day; cocks crow without cease.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu-l006.explanation: 已经见到君子，为何不欢喜呢？

sj-feng-zhengfeng-fengyu-l006.segmentation: I have seen my lord—why should I not rejoice?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu-l001.explanation: 羔裘润泽，确实正直而美好。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu-l001.segmentation: The lamb-skin coat is glossy—truly upright and noble.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu-l002.explanation: 那位君子，舍命也不改其志。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu-l002.segmentation: That man would give his life and never change his pledge.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu-l003.explanation: 羔裘豹饰，非常勇武有力。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu-l003.segmentation: Lamb-skin with leopard trim—most bold and strong.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu-l004.explanation: 那位君子，是国家的正直之士。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu-l004.segmentation: That man is the upright judge of the state.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu-l005.explanation: 羔裘鲜明，三英光彩照人。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu-l005.segmentation: The lamb-skin coat is bright; three ornaments gleam.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu-l006.explanation: 那位君子，是国家的俊彦。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-gaoqiu-l006.segmentation: That man is the outstanding talent of the state.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l001.segmentation: 将仲子兮，无逾我里，无折我树杞。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l001.explanation: 仲子啊，别越过我的里墙，别折断我的杞树。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l001.segmentation: Zhongzi, do not climb over my lane wall; do not break my jujube tree.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l002.segmentation: It is not that I cherish the tree—

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l004.segmentation: 仲可怀也，父母之言亦可畏也。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l004.explanation: 仲子值得思念，父母的话也令人畏惧。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l004.segmentation: Zhongzi is dear to me, yet my parents' words are to be feared.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l005.segmentation: 将仲子兮，无逾我墙，无折我树桑。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l005.explanation: 仲子啊，别越过我的墙，别折断我的桑树。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l005.segmentation: Zhongzi, do not climb over my wall; do not break my mulberry tree.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l006.segmentation: It is not that I cherish the tree—

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l008.segmentation: 仲可怀也，诸兄之言亦可畏也。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l008.explanation: 仲子值得思念，兄长的话也令人畏惧。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l008.segmentation: Zhongzi is dear to me, yet my brothers' words are to be feared.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l009.segmentation: 将仲子兮，无逾我园，无折我树檀。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l009.explanation: 仲子啊，别越过我的园，别折断我的檀树。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l009.segmentation: Zhongzi, do not enter my garden; do not break my sandalwood tree.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l010.segmentation: It is not that I cherish the tree—

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l012.segmentation: 仲可怀也，人之多言亦可畏也。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l012.explanation: 仲子值得思念，闲言碎语也令人畏惧。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiangzhongzi-l012.segmentation: Zhongzi is dear to me, yet loose talk is to be feared.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong-l001.explanation: 那个狡童啊，不跟我说话。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong-l001.segmentation: That fickle youth will not speak with me.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong-l002.segmentation: 维子之故，使我不能餐兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong-l002.explanation: 都因为你的缘故，使我吃不下饭。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong-l002.segmentation: Because of you alone, I cannot eat my meal.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong-l003.explanation: 那个狡童啊，不跟我一起吃饭。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong-l003.segmentation: That fickle youth will not dine with me.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong-l004.segmentation: 维子之故，使我不能息兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong-l004.explanation: 都因为你的缘故，使我不能安睡。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-jiaotong-l004.segmentation: Because of you alone, I cannot rest in sleep.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l001.explanation: 女子说鸡叫了，男子说天还没亮。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l001.segmentation: The wife says the cock has crowed; the husband says it is still dark.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l002.explanation: 你起来看看夜色，启明星已经明亮。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l002.segmentation: Rise and look at the night—the morning star burns bright.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l003.explanation: 将要飞射将要翱翔，去射野鸭和大雁。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l003.segmentation: Soon to fly and roam—to shoot duck and wild geese.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l004.explanation: 射到了就给你，与你同享。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l004.segmentation: What I shoot I give you; we share it together.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l005.explanation: 该当饮酒，与你白头偕老。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l005.segmentation: We should drink wine and grow old together.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l006.explanation: 琴瑟在旁，无不安静美好。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l006.segmentation: Zither and lute at hand—all is calm and good.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l007.segmentation: 知子之来之，杂佩以赠之。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l007.explanation: 知道你来看望我，杂佩赠给你。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l007.segmentation: Knowing you come to me, I give you my mixed pendants.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l008.segmentation: 知子之顺之，杂佩以问之。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l008.explanation: 知道你顺从我，杂佩向你问安。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l008.segmentation: Knowing you follow my wish, I greet you with mixed pendants.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l009.segmentation: 知子之好之，杂佩以报之。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l009.explanation: 知道你爱我，杂佩回报你。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-nvyuejiming-l009.segmentation: Knowing you love me, I repay you with mixed pendants.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qianshang-l001.explanation: 你若爱我，就提起衣裳渡过溱水。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qianshang-l001.segmentation: If you love me, lift your skirt and wade the Zhen.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qianshang-l002.explanation: 你若不想我，难道没有别人？

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qianshang-l002.segmentation: If you do not think of me, are there not other men?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qianshang-l004.explanation: 你若爱我，就提起衣裳渡过洧水。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qianshang-l004.segmentation: If you love me, lift your skirt and wade the Wei.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qianshang-l005.explanation: 你若不想我，难道没有其他士子？

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qianshang-l005.segmentation: If you do not think of me, are there not other gentlemen?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren-l001.explanation: 郑国的军队在彭地，四马披甲整齐。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren-l001.segmentation: Zheng's troops are at Peng; four armored horses stand in rank.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren-l002.explanation: 两支矛饰重英，在黄河上翱翔。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren-l002.segmentation: Two spears with heavy tassels—they soar above the river.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren-l003.explanation: 郑国的军队在消地，四马披甲威武。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren-l003.segmentation: Zheng's troops are at Xiao; four armored horses look fierce.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren-l004.explanation: 两支矛饰重乔，在黄河上逍遥。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren-l004.segmentation: Two spears with tall plumes—they roam freely on the river.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren-l005.explanation: 郑国的军队在轴地，四马披甲和乐。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren-l005.segmentation: Zheng's troops are at Zhou; four armored horses seem at ease.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren-l006.explanation: 左旋右抽，在中军显示好身手。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qingren-l006.segmentation: Wheel left, draw right—showing their skill in the center army.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l001.explanation: 溱水与洧水，春水正哗哗奔流。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l001.segmentation: The Zhen and Wei rivers are swelling and rushing in the spring flood.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l002.explanation: 青年男女，正手持香草（蕳）出游。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l002.segmentation: Young men and women are out together, each holding sprigs of fragrant herb.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l003.segmentation: The girl says, “Shall we go and look?”

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l005.segmentation: “Then shall we go again and see?” she asks.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l006.explanation: 洧水岸边，地方又宽又热闹，真快乐。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l006.segmentation: Beyond the Wei, the ground is wide and open—truly spacious and joyful.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l007.segmentation: 维士与女，伊其相谑，赠之以勺药。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l007.explanation: 那些男女彼此说笑调情，还互赠芍药花。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l007.segmentation: The couples banter and flirt, exchanging peonies as tokens.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l008.segmentation: The Zhen and Wei now run clear and bright.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l009.explanation: 男女游人，越来越多，挤得满满当当。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l009.segmentation: Men and women throng the banks, packed in great numbers.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l010.segmentation: Again the girl says, “Shall we go and look?”

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l011.segmentation: Again the lad says, “We’ve already been.”

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l012.segmentation: “Then shall we go again?” she presses.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l013.explanation: 洧水岸边，又宽又乐，和前面一样。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l013.segmentation: Beyond the Wei it is still wide and merry as before.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l014.segmentation: 维士与女，伊其将谑，赠之以勺药。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l014.explanation: 男女将要互相戏谑，仍以芍药相赠。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-qinwei-l014.segmentation: The couples are about to jest and tease, again giving peonies in gift.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shanyoufusu-l001.explanation: 山上有扶苏树，低湿处开着荷花。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shanyoufusu-l001.segmentation: On the hill grows fusu; in the marsh bloom lotus flowers.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shanyoufusu-l002.explanation: 没见到子都那样的美男子，却碰上了狂且。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shanyoufusu-l002.segmentation: I did not meet the handsome Zidu, but met this reckless fellow instead.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shanyoufusu-l003.segmentation: 山有乔松，隰有游龙，不见子充，乃见狡童。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-shanyoufusu-l003.explanation: 山上有高大松树，低处有游龙草；不见子充，却见狡童。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shanyoufusu-l003.segmentation: Tall pines on the hill, dragon-tail grass below; no Zichong—only a sly youth appears.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian-l001.explanation: 叔出去打猎，巷里像没人似的。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian-l001.segmentation: When Uncle goes hunting, the lanes seem deserted.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian-l002.segmentation: Is there really no one left?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian-l004.segmentation: He is truly handsome and kind-hearted.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian-l005.explanation: 叔出去冬猎，巷里没人饮酒作乐。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian-l005.segmentation: When Uncle goes on the winter hunt, no one drinks in the lanes.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian-l006.segmentation: Is there no feasting with wine?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian-l008.segmentation: He is truly fine and good.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian-l009.explanation: 叔到郊野去，巷里没人备马出行。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian-l009.segmentation: When Uncle rides to the wilds, no one saddles horses in the lanes.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian-l011.segmentation: Still, none measure up to Uncle.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-shuyutian-l012.segmentation: He is truly handsome and brave.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-tuoxi-l001.explanation: 落叶纷纷啊，风把它吹向你。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-tuoxi-l001.segmentation: Leaves fall, fall—the wind blows them toward you.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-tuoxi-l002.explanation: 叔啊伯啊，你起头唱，我来和着你。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-tuoxi-l002.segmentation: Brothers dear, you lead the song and I will harmonize with you.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-tuoxi-l003.explanation: 落叶纷纷啊，风把它飘向你。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-tuoxi-l003.segmentation: Leaves drift, drift—the wind wafts them toward you.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-tuoxi-l004.explanation: 叔啊伯啊，你起头唱，我来邀你同歌。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-tuoxi-l004.segmentation: Brothers dear, you start the tune and I will draw you in to sing.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui-l001.explanation: 缓缓的流水，冲不散捆好的荆条。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui-l001.segmentation: The slow current cannot break apart a bundle of thornwood.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui-l002.explanation: 终究没有兄弟，只有我和你相依。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui-l002.segmentation: I have no brothers at last—only you and me.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui-l003.explanation: 别信别人的话，他们其实在骗你。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui-l003.segmentation: Do not trust others’ words; they are truly deceiving you.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui-l004.explanation: 缓缓的流水，冲不散捆好的柴薪。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui-l004.segmentation: The slow current cannot break apart a bundle of firewood.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui-l005.explanation: 终究没有兄弟，只剩我们两人。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui-l005.segmentation: I have no brothers—just the two of us.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui-l006.explanation: 别信别人的话，他们实在不可信。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yangzhishui-l006.segmentation: Do not trust others’ words; they are truly not to be believed.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao-l001.explanation: 郊野长着蔓草，晶莹的露水成团。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao-l001.segmentation: Creeping grass in the wilds; dew gathers in shining beads.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao-l002.explanation: 有一位美人，眉目清秀又温柔。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao-l002.segmentation: There is a fair person, with clear brows and gentle grace.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao-l003.explanation: 偶然相遇，正合我的心愿。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao-l003.segmentation: We meet by chance—just as my heart wished.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao-l004.explanation: 郊野蔓草青青，露水浓得发亮。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao-l004.segmentation: Creeping grass in the wilds; dew lies heavy and bright.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao-l005.explanation: 有一位美人，温柔得像清扬的眉目。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao-l005.segmentation: There is a fair one, gentle as clear, lifted brows.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao-l006.explanation: 偶然相遇，愿与你同好共处。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-yeyoumancao-l006.segmentation: We meet by chance; with you I would share what is good.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche-l001.explanation: 有位姑娘同车而行，容颜像木槿花一样鲜。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche-l001.segmentation: A girl rides in the same carriage; her face is fresh as hibiscus bloom.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche-l002.explanation: 步履轻扬如鸟飞，佩玉琼琚叮当作响。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche-l002.segmentation: She moves as if about to soar; jade pendants chime on her belt.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche-l003.explanation: 那美丽的孟姜，确实又美又娴雅。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche-l003.segmentation: That lovely Meng Jiang is truly beautiful and refined.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche-l004.explanation: 有位姑娘同路而行，容颜像木槿花一样盛。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche-l004.segmentation: A girl walks the same road; her face glows like hibiscus in full flower.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche-l005.explanation: 步履轻扬，佩玉锵锵有声。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche-l005.segmentation: She moves lightly; her jade ornaments ring clearly.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche-l006.explanation: 那美丽的孟姜，好德行令人难忘。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-younvtongche-l006.segmentation: That lovely Meng Jiang—her virtue is not forgotten.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin-l001.explanation: 青青的是你的衣领，悠悠的是我的心。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin-l001.segmentation: Your collar is blue-green; my heart is long with longing.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin-l002.explanation: 即使我不去找你，你难道就不给我音讯吗？

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin-l002.segmentation: Even if I do not go to you, will you not send word?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin-l003.explanation: 青青的是你的佩玉，悠悠的是我的思念。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin-l003.segmentation: Your girdle-gems are blue-green; my thoughts stretch on and on.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin-l004.explanation: 即使我不去找你，你难道就不来吗？

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin-l004.segmentation: Even if I do not go, will you not come?

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin-l005.explanation: 我独自往来张望，站在高高的城楼上。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin-l005.segmentation: I pace back and forth, waiting on the high city tower.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin-l006.explanation: 一天不见，就像过了三个月那样久。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zijin-l006.segmentation: One day apart feels like three months long.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l001.segmentation: 缁衣之宜兮，敝予又改为兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l001.explanation: 黑色官服很合宜，穿旧了我又给你改做新的。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l001.segmentation: The black robe suits you well; worn out, I make you another.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l003.explanation: 回来把做好的新衣交给你。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l003.segmentation: Returning, I hand you the fine new garment I made.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l004.segmentation: 缁衣之好兮，敝予又改造兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l004.explanation: 黑色官服真好看，旧了我又给你改做。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l004.segmentation: The black robe is lovely; when it frays, I refashion it for you.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l005.segmentation: 适子之馆兮，还予授子之粲兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l005.explanation: 到你馆舍去，回来把新衣交给你。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l005.segmentation: To your lodging I go, and come back to give you the new robe.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l006.segmentation: 缁衣之席兮，敝予又改作兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l006.explanation: 黑色官服坐着正合适，旧了我又重新制作。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l006.segmentation: The black robe fits you at ease; worn, I sew a fresh one.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l007.segmentation: 适子之馆兮，还予授子之粲兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l007.explanation: 到你馆舍去，回来把新衣交给你。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-ziyi-l007.segmentation: To your lodging I go, and return to present the new garment.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu-l001.segmentation: 遵大路兮，掺执子之袪兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu-l001.explanation: 沿着大路走啊，我拉着你的衣襟。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu-l001.segmentation: Along the broad road I go, clutching the hem of your robe.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu-l002.explanation: 别嫌恶我啊，不要因旧情而疏远！

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu-l002.segmentation: Do not loathe me—do not turn away because of old ties!

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu-l003.segmentation: 遵大路兮，掺执子之手兮。
sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu-l003.explanation: 沿着大路走啊，我握着你的手。

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu-l003.segmentation: Along the broad road I go, holding your hand.

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu-l004.explanation: 别讨厌我啊，不要因相好而背弃！

sj-feng-zhengfeng-zundalu-l004.segmentation: Do not detest me—do not forsake our affection!

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi-l001.explanation: 采啊采芣苡，我们去采它。

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi-l001.segmentation: Gather, gather plantain—we set out to pick it.

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi-l002.segmentation: Gather, gather plantain—we have some in hand.

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi-l003.segmentation: Gather, gather plantain—we pluck it up.

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi-l004.explanation: 采啊采芣苡，顺着茎捋下来。

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi-l004.segmentation: Gather, gather plantain—we strip it along the stalk.

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi-l005.explanation: 采啊采芣苡，用衣襟兜住。

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi-l005.segmentation: Gather, gather plantain—we tuck it in our aprons.

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi-l006.explanation: 采啊采芣苡，提起衣襟装满怀。

sj-feng-zhounan-fuyi-l006.segmentation: Gather, gather plantain—we lift our skirts to fill them full.

sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l001.segmentation: 葛之覃兮，施于中谷，维叶萋萋。
sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l001.explanation: 葛藤蔓延长，延到山谷中，叶子茂盛青青。

sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l001.segmentation: The kudzu spreads far into the mid-valley; its leaves grow lush and green.

sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l002.segmentation: 黄鸟于飞，集于灌木，其鸣喈喈。
sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l002.explanation: 黄鸟飞来飞去，落在灌木上，叫声和悦喈喈。

sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l002.segmentation: Yellow birds fly and alight on bushes, singing clear and sweet.

sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l003.segmentation: 葛之覃兮，施于中谷，维叶莫莫。
sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l003.explanation: 葛藤又蔓延，延到山谷中，叶子密密层层。

sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l003.segmentation: Again the kudzu spreads through the valley; its leaves hang thick and deep.

sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l004.segmentation: 是刈是濩，为絺为绤，服之无斁。
sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l004.explanation: 割下煮软，织成细葛布和粗葛布，穿了不厌。

sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l004.segmentation: Cut and boil it, weave fine and coarse cloth—we never tire of wearing it.

sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l005.explanation: 告诉师氏，告诉已可回娘家。

sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l005.segmentation: I tell the mistress; I tell her I may go home.

sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l006.explanation: 快洗我的私衣，快浣我的礼服。

sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l006.segmentation: Quick, wash my private clothes; rinse my formal robes.

sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l007.explanation: 哪些该洗哪些不洗，我要回去看望父母。

sj-feng-zhounan-getan-l007.segmentation: Which to wash, which not—I go home to comfort my parents.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l001.explanation: 雎鸠鸟关关和鸣，在河中的沙洲上。

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l001.segmentation: Fish hawks call guan-guan on the islet in the river.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l002.explanation: 文静美好的姑娘，是君子理想的配偶。

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l002.segmentation: The gentle, graceful maiden is a good match for the gentleman.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l003.explanation: 长短不齐的荇菜，左右捞取它。

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l003.segmentation: Uneven water shield—left and right we gather it.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l004.explanation: 文静美好的姑娘，醒着睡着都在追求她。

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l004.segmentation: The gentle maiden—waking and sleeping I seek her.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l005.explanation: 追求不到，醒着睡着都在思念。

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l005.segmentation: Seeking in vain, I think of her waking and in sleep.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l006.explanation: 思念绵长啊，辗转反侧睡不着。

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l006.segmentation: Long, long longing—I toss and turn and cannot rest.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l007.explanation: 长短不齐的荇菜，左右采摘它。

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l007.segmentation: Uneven water shield—left and right we pick it.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l008.explanation: 文静美好的姑娘，用琴瑟亲近她。

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l008.segmentation: The gentle maiden—I befriend her with zither and lute.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l009.explanation: 长短不齐的荇菜，左右择取它。

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l009.segmentation: Uneven water shield—left and right we select it.

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l010.explanation: 文静美好的姑娘，敲钟击鼓使她欢乐。

sj-feng-zhounan-guanju-l010.segmentation: The gentle maiden—I delight her with bells and drums.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l001.explanation: 南方有高大乔木，不能在其下休息。

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l001.segmentation: Southward stands a tall tree—you cannot rest beneath it.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l002.explanation: 汉水上有游女，不能去求娶她。

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l002.segmentation: On the Han floats a roaming maiden—you cannot woo her.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l003.explanation: 汉水多么宽广，不能游渡过去。

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l003.segmentation: How wide the Han—one cannot swim across.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l004.explanation: 长江多么漫长，不能筏渡过去。

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l004.segmentation: How long the Yangtze—one cannot ferry across.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l005.explanation: 柴薪堆得高翘，说的是去割荆条。

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l005.segmentation: Firewood piled high—I speak of cutting thornwood.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l006.explanation: 那姑娘要出嫁，说的是喂饱她的马。

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l006.segmentation: That girl will wed—I speak of feeding her horses.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l007.explanation: 汉水多么宽广，不能游渡过去。

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l007.segmentation: How wide the Han—one cannot swim across.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l008.explanation: 长江多么漫长，不能筏渡过去。

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l008.segmentation: How long the Yangtze—one cannot ferry across.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l009.explanation: 柴薪堆得高翘，说的是去割蒌蒿。

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l009.segmentation: Firewood piled high—I speak of cutting artemisia.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l010.segmentation: That girl is going to marry.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l011.segmentation: I speak of feeding her colt.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l012.explanation: 汉水多么宽广，不能游渡过去。

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l012.segmentation: How wide the Han—one cannot swim across.

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l013.explanation: 长江多么漫长，不能筏渡过去。

sj-feng-zhounan-hanguang-l013.segmentation: How long the Yangtze—one cannot ferry across.

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu-l001.explanation: 南方有弯曲的树枝，葛藤层层缠绕它。

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu-l001.segmentation: Southward a bending tree—kudzu vines climb and bind it.

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu-l002.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，愿福禄安稳降临。

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu-l002.segmentation: Happy is the lord—may fortune and blessing settle on him.

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu-l003.explanation: 南方有弯曲的树枝，葛藤密密覆盖它。

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu-l003.segmentation: Southward a bending tree—kudzu covers it thickly.

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu-l004.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，愿福禄扶助他。

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu-l004.segmentation: Happy is the lord—may fortune assist him.

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu-l005.explanation: 南方有弯曲的树枝，葛藤环绕缠抱它。

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu-l005.segmentation: Southward a bending tree—kudzu coils and embraces it.

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu-l006.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，愿福禄成就他。

sj-feng-zhounan-jiumu-l006.segmentation: Happy is the lord—may fortune be fulfilled for him.

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l001.explanation: 采啊采卷耳，却采不满浅筐。

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l001.segmentation: Gather, gather mouse-ear—but the shallow basket is not filled.

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l002.explanation: 唉，我思念那人，把筐放在大道旁。

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l002.segmentation: Alas, I think of my love and set the basket by the highway.

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l003.explanation: 登上高峻的山，我的马已疲惫。

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l003.segmentation: I climb steep heights; my horses are worn and faltering.

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l004.segmentation: 我姑酌彼金罍，维以不永怀。
sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l004.explanation: 我且斟那金杯，借此排遣长久思念。

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l004.segmentation: I pour the golden goblet—to ease this endless longing.

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l005.explanation: 登上高高的冈，我的马已色衰力竭。

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l005.segmentation: I climb the high ridge; my horses are spent and sallow.

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l006.segmentation: 我姑酌彼兕觥，维以不永伤。
sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l006.explanation: 我且斟那兕角杯，借此减轻心中忧伤。

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l006.segmentation: I pour the rhinoceros horn cup—to lighten enduring grief.

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l007.segmentation: 陟彼砠矣，我马瘏矣，我仆痡矣，云何吁矣。
sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l007.explanation: 登上多石的山，马病仆倒，我为何如此叹息！

sj-feng-zhounan-juaner-l007.segmentation: I climb rocky slopes—horses sick, servants collapsed; why such sighs!

sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi-l001.segmentation: 麟之趾，振振公子，于嗟麟兮。
sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi-l001.explanation: 麒麟的蹄足，公子的后代德行美好，唉，麒麟啊！

sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi-l001.segmentation: The unicorn’s hooves—the lord’s sons are dignified; alas, the unicorn!

sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi-l002.segmentation: 麟之定，振振公姓，于嗟麟兮。
sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi-l002.explanation: 麒麟的额顶，公姓的子孙德行美好，唉，麒麟啊！

sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi-l002.segmentation: The unicorn’s brow—the lord’s clan is dignified; alas, the unicorn!

sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi-l003.segmentation: 麟之角，振振公族，于嗟麟兮。
sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi-l003.explanation: 麒麟的角，公族的子弟德行美好，唉，麒麟啊！

sj-feng-zhounan-linzhizhi-l003.segmentation: The unicorn’s horn—the lord’s kindred are dignified; alas, the unicorn!

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen-l001.explanation: 沿着汝水堤岸走，砍伐那树枝条。

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen-l001.segmentation: Along the Ru’s bank I go, cutting branches and twigs.

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen-l002.explanation: 还没见到君子，心中饥渴像调羹未熟。

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen-l002.segmentation: Not yet seeing my lord, I hunger like broth not yet ready.

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen-l003.explanation: 沿着汝水堤岸走，砍伐那树新条。

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen-l003.segmentation: Along the Ru’s bank I go, cutting fresh young shoots.

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen-l004.explanation: 已经见到君子，他没有把我远远抛弃。

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen-l004.segmentation: Having seen my lord, he has not cast me far away.

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen-l005.explanation: 鲂鱼尾巴发红，王室像遭火焚。

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen-l005.segmentation: Bream tails turn red—the royal house seems burned.

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen-l006.explanation: 虽然像遭焚毁，父母还在身边很近。

sj-feng-zhounan-rufen-l006.segmentation: Though it seems ruined, my parents are still very near.

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao-l001.explanation: 桃花开得茂盛，颜色灼灼鲜明。

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao-l001.segmentation: Peach trees flourish; their blossoms blaze bright.
