sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao-l002.explanation: 这位姑娘要出嫁，宜于安室宜家。

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao-l002.segmentation: This girl goes to wed—fit to settle house and home.

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao-l003.explanation: 桃花开得茂盛，果实累累饱满。

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao-l003.segmentation: Peach trees flourish; fruit hangs heavy and full.

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao-l004.explanation: 这位姑娘要出嫁，宜于治理家室。

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao-l004.segmentation: This girl goes to wed—fit to keep the household in order.

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao-l005.explanation: 桃花开得茂盛，叶子密密层层。

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao-l005.segmentation: Peach trees flourish; leaves grow thick and green.

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao-l006.explanation: 这位姑娘要出嫁，宜于和睦家人。

sj-feng-zhounan-taoyao-l006.segmentation: This girl goes to wed—fit to harmonize with her family.

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju-l001.explanation: 密密布置兔网，桩子敲得丁丁响。

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju-l001.segmentation: Rabbit snares set tight—the stakes ring ding-ding as they are driven.

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju-l002.explanation: 威武的武士，是公侯的屏障。

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju-l002.segmentation: Bold, sturdy warriors—they are ramparts for lords and marquises.

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju-l003.explanation: 密密布置兔网，设在四通八达的路口。

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju-l003.segmentation: Rabbit snares set tight—placed at crossroads in the open.

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju-l004.explanation: 威武的武士，是公侯的好帮手。

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju-l004.segmentation: Bold warriors—they are good companions to lords and marquises.

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju-l005.explanation: 密密布置兔网，设在树林深处。

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju-l005.segmentation: Rabbit snares set tight—spread through the heart of the woods.

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju-l006.explanation: 威武的武士，是公侯的心腹。

sj-feng-zhounan-tuju-l006.segmentation: Bold warriors—they are trusted hearts of lords and marquises.

sj-feng-zhounan-zhongsi-l001.segmentation: Katydids spread their wings—your offspring teem.

sj-feng-zhounan-zhongsi-l002.explanation: 愿你的子孙，兴旺发达啊。

sj-feng-zhounan-zhongsi-l002.segmentation: May your descendants flourish and thrive.

sj-feng-zhounan-zhongsi-l003.segmentation: Katydids hum in flight—your offspring swarm.

sj-feng-zhounan-zhongsi-l007.explanation: 愿你的子孙，和睦众多啊。

sj-feng-zhounan-zhongsi-l007.segmentation: May your descendants be harmonious and numerous.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l001.explanation: 閟宫广大，建筑坚实而众多。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l001.segmentation: The Bi palace is spacious; its halls stand solid and many.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l002.explanation: 伟大的姜嫄，德行纯正无邪。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l002.segmentation: Glorious Jiang Yuan—her virtue never swerves.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l003.segmentation: God favored her—no harm, no woe.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l004.explanation: 满月按时而生，于是生下后稷。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l004.segmentation: At full term, not late, she bore Lord Millet.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l005.segmentation: Heaven sent down blessings in abundance.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l006.explanation: 黍稷重穋，早种晚收的豆麦齐备。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l006.segmentation: Millet, double-crop grain, early and late beans and wheat.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l007.explanation: 拥有天下，使百姓从事稼穑。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l007.segmentation: He held the realm below and taught the people to farm.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l008.segmentation: There were millet and panic grass, rice and black millet.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l009.explanation: 拥有天下土地，继承大禹的事业。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l009.segmentation: He held the land below and continued Yu’s work.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l010.explanation: 后稷的子孙，就是大王（古公亶父）。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l010.segmentation: Lord Millet’s descendant was the Great Lord.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l011.explanation: 住在岐山南面，开始剪除商纣。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l011.segmentation: He dwelt on the sunny slope of Qi and began to cut down Shang.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l012.segmentation: 至于文武，缵大王之绪，致天之届，于牧之野。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l012.explanation: 到了文王武王，继承大王基业，致天命于牧野。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l012.segmentation: Through Wen and Wu, continuing the Great Lord’s line, Heaven’s mandate reached Muye.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l013.explanation: 没有二心没有疑虑，上帝照临你们。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l013.segmentation: No duplicity, no doubt—God looks down upon you.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l014.explanation: 整治商之旅，皆能成就其功。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l014.segmentation: The hosts of Shang were subdued—all their deeds fulfilled.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l015.segmentation: 王曰叔父，建尔元子，俾侯于鲁。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l015.explanation: 王说：叔父，立你的长子，封他为鲁侯。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l015.segmentation: The king said, “Uncle, establish your eldest son and make him marquis of Lu.”

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l016.explanation: 大大开辟你的封土，做周王室的辅佐。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l016.segmentation: Greatly open your domain to be a pillar of the Zhou house.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l017.explanation: 于是命鲁公，封侯于东方。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l017.segmentation: Then he charged the Lord of Lu to rule the east.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l018.explanation: 赐给他山川土地和附庸。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l018.segmentation: He granted mountains, rivers, fields, and vassal lands.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l019.explanation: 周公的孙子，庄公的儿子。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l019.segmentation: The Duke of Zhou’s grandson, Duke Zhuang’s son.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l020.segmentation: With dragon banner he carries on the rites.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l021.segmentation: Six reins hang even; horse bells ring clear.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l022.explanation: 春秋祭祀不懈，享祭没有差错。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l022.segmentation: Spring and autumn rites never slack; offerings are without fault.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l025.explanation: 用赤色牺牲献祭，既享又合宜。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l025.segmentation: With red victims we sacrifice—fitting to offer and to feast.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l026.segmentation: 降福既多，周公皇祖，亦其福女。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l026.explanation: 降福已经很多，周公皇祖也赐福于你。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l026.segmentation: Blessings descend in plenty; the Duke of Zhou’s royal ancestor blesses you too.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l027.segmentation: 秋而载尝，夏而楅衡，白牡骍刚。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l027.explanation: 秋天尝祭，夏天设衡，用白牡赤犧。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l027.segmentation: Autumn tasting rites, summer yokes in place—white bull and red victim.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l028.explanation: 牺尊排列，毛炮肉羹齐备。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l028.segmentation: Sacrificial bronzes stand in rows; roasted flesh and sliced soup are ready.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l029.segmentation: Baskets, dishes, and great trays; myriad dancers move in grandeur.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l030.segmentation: The reverent grandson has cause to rejoice.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l031.segmentation: 俾尔炽而昌，俾尔寿而臧。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l031.explanation: 使你炽盛而昌盛，使你长寿而吉祥。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l031.segmentation: May you blaze and flourish; may you live long and be good.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l032.explanation: 保祐东方，鲁邦因此受福。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l032.segmentation: Guard the east—Lu receives the blessing.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l033.segmentation: No loss, no collapse; no shock, no upheaval.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l034.segmentation: Three long lives as companions—firm as hills and mounds.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l035.segmentation: A thousand chariots of the lord—red tassels, green lashings.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l037.segmentation: Thirty thousand footmen—shell helmets, red kneecaps.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l038.segmentation: 烝徒增增，戎狄是膺，荆舒是惩，则莫我敢承！
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l038.explanation: 众徒增增，抵御戎狄，惩罚荆舒，无人敢承当（其锋）！

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l038.segmentation: Hosts swell and swell—they beat the Rong and Di, chastise Jing and Shu; none dare meet them!

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l039.segmentation: 俾尔昌而炽，俾尔寿而富。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l039.explanation: 使你昌而炽，使你寿而富。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l039.segmentation: May you thrive and blaze; may you live long and grow rich.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l040.explanation: 黄发台背，长寿相与试验（享验）。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l040.segmentation: Gray hair and bent backs—long life granted and proved.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l041.segmentation: 俾尔昌而大，俾尔耆而艾。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l041.explanation: 使你昌而大，使你老而治。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l041.segmentation: May you flourish and grow great; may you age in wisdom and rule.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l042.segmentation: Myriad years, a thousand ages—long life without harm.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l043.explanation: 泰山岩岩，是鲁邦所瞻仰。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l043.segmentation: Mount Tai stands stern—the pillar Lu looks to.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l044.explanation: 拥有龟蒙，于是开拓大东。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l044.segmentation: Holding Gui and Meng, they opened the great east.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l045.segmentation: To the sea’s edge the Huai tribes came in unity.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l046.explanation: 无不顺从，这是鲁侯的功劳。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l046.segmentation: None failed to follow—this is the Lu lord’s merit.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l047.explanation: 保有凫绎，于是开拓徐地。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l047.segmentation: Keeping Fu and Yi, they extended over Xu’s lands.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l048.segmentation: To the sea came Huai tribes and southern barbarians.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l049.segmentation: Down to the southern tribes—all obeyed.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l050.explanation: 不敢不诺，鲁侯是这样（的君主）。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l050.segmentation: None dared refuse assent—such is the Lord of Lu.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l051.explanation: 上天赐鲁公大福，眉寿保鲁。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l051.segmentation: Heaven grants the Lord of Lu pure blessing—long life guarding Lu.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l052.explanation: 居常与许，恢复周公的封宇。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l052.segmentation: Dwelling at Chang and Xu, restoring the Duke of Zhou’s domain.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l053.segmentation: The Lu lord feasts in peace—fine wife, long-lived mother.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l054.explanation: 大夫庶士适宜，邦国因此有秩序。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l054.segmentation: Great officers and common knights in place—the state stands firm.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l055.explanation: 既多受福，黄发儿齿（高寿）。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l055.segmentation: Blessings received in plenty—gray hair like a child’s teeth (great age).

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l056.explanation: 徂徕的松树，新甫的柏树。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l056.segmentation: Pines of Culai, cypress of Xinfu.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l057.segmentation: Felled and measured—marked by cubits and feet.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l058.segmentation: 松桷有舄，路寝孔硕，新庙奕奕。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l058.explanation: 松椽有舄，路寝宏大，新庙奕奕。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l058.segmentation: Pine rafters with shoe-blocks; the main hall vast; the new temple gleams.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l059.segmentation: 奚斯所作，孔曼且硕，万民是若。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l059.explanation: 奚斯所作，非常广大，万民效法。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-bigong-l059.segmentation: Built by Xi Si—grand and vast; all people take it as model.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l001.explanation: 壮马肥健，在郊外的野地。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l001.segmentation: Sturdy stallions graze on the open plain beyond the city.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l002.segmentation: 薄言駉者，有驈有皇，有骊有黄，以车彭彭。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l002.explanation: 那些骏马，有青白有黄骊，拉车彭彭有声。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l002.segmentation: Those fine horses—piebald, bay, black, and yellow—draw chariots rumbling on.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l003.segmentation: Thought without limit—the horses are all good.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l004.explanation: 壮马肥健，在郊外的野地。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l004.segmentation: Sturdy stallions on the open plain beyond the city.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l005.segmentation: 薄言駉者，有骓有駓，有骍有骐，以车伾伾。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l005.explanation: 那些骏马，有骓有駓有骍有骐，拉车伾伾有力。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l005.segmentation: Those fine horses—dappled, chestnut, red, and dark—pull chariots strong and steady.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l006.segmentation: Thought without end—the horses all have talent.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l007.explanation: 壮马肥健，在郊外的野地。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l007.segmentation: Sturdy stallions on the open plain beyond the city.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l008.segmentation: 溥言駉者，有驒有骆，有骝有雒，以车绎绎。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l008.explanation: 那些骏马，有驒有骆有骝有雒，拉车绎绎不绝。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l008.segmentation: Those fine horses—gray, white, bay, and piebald—draw chariots in endless train.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l009.segmentation: Thought without weariness—the horses all excel.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l010.explanation: 壮马肥健，在郊外的野地。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l010.segmentation: Sturdy stallions on the open plain beyond the city.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l011.segmentation: 薄言駉者，有骃有騢，有驔有鱼，以车祛祛。
sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l011.explanation: 那些骏马，有骃有騢有驔有鱼，拉车祛祛徐行。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l011.segmentation: Those fine horses—light bay, gray, dappled, and marked—draw chariots moving at ease.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-jiong-l012.segmentation: Thought without crookedness—the horses all go forward.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l001.explanation: 快乐地在泮水边，采那里的芹菜。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l001.segmentation: Joy at Pan water—we lightly gather celery there.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l002.explanation: 鲁侯来到，要看他的旗帜。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l002.segmentation: The Lord of Lu arrives; we gaze upon his banner.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l003.explanation: 旗帜飘动，鸾铃哕哕作响。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l003.segmentation: His banner flutters; bell-charms on the team ring clear.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l004.explanation: 无论幼小或长大，都跟随公侯前行。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l004.segmentation: None too small, none too great—all follow the lord on the march.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l005.explanation: 快乐地在泮水边，采那里的藻。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l005.segmentation: Joy at Pan water—we gather water plants there.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l006.explanation: 鲁侯来到，他的马蹻蹻健壮。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l006.segmentation: The Lord of Lu arrives; his horses step strong and tall.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l007.explanation: 马儿蹻蹻，声音昭昭明畅。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l007.segmentation: The horses stride high; their bells sound bright and far.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l008.explanation: 和颜悦色带笑，不是发怒而是施教。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l008.segmentation: With color and laughter—not anger but instruction.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l009.explanation: 快乐地在泮水边，采那里的茆（茅）。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l009.segmentation: Joy at Pan water—we pick rushes on the bank.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l010.segmentation: The Lord of Lu arrives to drink at Pan water.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l011.explanation: 既饮美酒，永赐难老之福。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l011.segmentation: Having tasted fine wine, may he receive endless age.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l012.segmentation: Along the long road he goes, bending rebellious foes.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l013.segmentation: Solemn is the Lord of Lu—he makes his virtue clear.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l014.explanation: 敬慎威仪，是民众的法则。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l014.segmentation: Reverent in bearing and rites—he is the people’s model.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l015.segmentation: Cultured and martial—he announces it to blazing ancestors.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l016.segmentation: None fail in filial duty—he seeks blessing for himself.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l017.segmentation: Bright is the Lord of Lu—he can illumine his virtue.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l018.explanation: 既建泮宫，淮夷于是臣服。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l018.segmentation: The Pan palace built—the Huai tribes submit.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l019.explanation: 勇武如虎的臣，在泮宫献所斩敌首。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l019.segmentation: Tiger-bold warriors present severed heads at Pan.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l020.explanation: 审问如皋陶，在泮宫献俘虏。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l020.segmentation: Judging like Gao Yao, they present captives at Pan.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l021.segmentation: Many officers in array—they broaden the heart of virtue.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l022.segmentation: Bold on campaign—they pacify the southeast.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l023.explanation: 众多而皇皇，不喧哗不张扬。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l023.segmentation: Hosts vast and stately—neither noisy nor boastful.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l024.explanation: 不必诉于喧哗，在泮宫献战功。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l024.segmentation: No need to clamor in dispute—they report merit at Pan.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l027.segmentation: War chariots are broad and grand.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l029.explanation: 既克淮夷，非常和顺不叛逆。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l029.segmentation: Having conquered the Huai, they are most gentle and not rebellious.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l030.explanation: 巩固你的谋划，淮夷终被俘获。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l030.segmentation: Make firm your plans—the Huai are taken at last.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l031.segmentation: Flying owls wheel and settle in Pan grove.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l032.segmentation: They eat our mulberries and cherish our good words.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l033.segmentation: From afar the Huai come, offering tribute gems.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-panshui-l034.segmentation: Great tortoises, ivory tusks—rich gifts of southern gold.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l001.explanation: 骏马强壮又肥硕，拉着黄色的车乘。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l001.segmentation: Strong and stout are the steeds, drawing the yellow chariot.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l002.explanation: 从早到晚在公门办事，在朝廷上光明公正。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l002.segmentation: From early morn till night they serve the lord, upright and clear in the hall.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l003.explanation: 白鹭振翅翩翩，向下飞落。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l003.segmentation: White egrets flutter their wings, settling down below.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l004.explanation: 鼓声咽咽响起，醉后说着话、跳起舞。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l004.segmentation: Drums beat softly; tipsy, they speak and dance.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l006.explanation: 骏马强壮又肥硕，拉着公马的车乘。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l006.segmentation: Strong and stout are the steeds, drawing the stallion team.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l007.explanation: 从早到晚在公门办事，在朝廷上饮酒宴乐。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l007.segmentation: From early morn till night they serve the lord, drinking at court.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l008.explanation: 白鹭振翅翩翩，向空中飞去。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l008.segmentation: White egrets flutter their wings, soaring in flight.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l009.explanation: 鼓声咽咽响起，醉后说着要回去。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l009.segmentation: Drums beat softly; drunk, they speak of going home.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l011.explanation: 骏马强壮又肥硕，拉着青骢马的车乘。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l011.segmentation: Strong and stout are the steeds, drawing the piebald team.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l012.explanation: 从早到晚在公门办事，在朝廷上设宴欢聚。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l012.segmentation: From early morn till night they serve the lord, feasting at court.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l013.explanation: 从今以后，愿年年都有好收成。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l013.segmentation: From this day on, may each year bring abundance.

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l014.explanation: 君子有五谷，留给子孙享用。

sj-song-lusong-jiongzhishen-youbi-l014.segmentation: The noble lord has grain to leave for sons and grandsons.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l001.explanation: 商族深谋远虑，祥瑞长久绵延。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l001.segmentation: Deep in wisdom is Shang; its good omens long endure.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l002.explanation: 洪水茫茫无际，禹遍治天下四方。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l002.segmentation: Vast was the flood; Yu spread order over the land.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l003.explanation: 划分大国疆界，幅员因而扩大。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l003.segmentation: He marked the great states' bounds; the realm grew wide.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l004.explanation: 有娀氏正强盛，上帝立其子，商族由此而生。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l004.segmentation: When You-song rose, God set her son—thus Shang was born.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l005.segmentation: 玄王桓拨，受小国是达，受大国是达。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l005.explanation: 玄王勇武开拓，使小国大国都通达归附。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l005.segmentation: Lord Xuan boldly opened the way; small and great states all reached him.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l006.explanation: 遵循法度不越轨，于是视民而政令畅达。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l006.segmentation: He kept the path without straying; his rule went forth to the people.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l008.segmentation: Even beyond the seas, all were brought in line.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l009.explanation: 天命不可违背，传至汤时齐同受命。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l009.segmentation: Heaven's command was not defied, till Tang received it in full.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l010.explanation: 汤王降世不迟，圣敬之心日日上升。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l010.segmentation: Tang came not late; sacred reverence rose day by day.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l011.segmentation: 昭假迟迟，上帝是祗，帝命式于九围。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l011.explanation: 光明久照，敬奉上帝，受命治理九州。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l011.segmentation: Long he shone in prayer, revering God; Heaven charged him with the nine regions.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l012.segmentation: 受小球大球，为下国缀旒，何天之休。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l012.explanation: 接受大小玉球，为下国作缀旒，这是上天所赐的美福。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l012.segmentation: He received large and small jade spheres, pendant gems for vassal kings—Heaven's grace.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l013.explanation: 不争强好胜，也不软弱退缩；不刚愎，不优柔。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l013.segmentation: He did not strive nor slack; neither hard nor soft alone.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l014.segmentation: His governance was gentle and ample.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l015.segmentation: All hundred blessings gathered to him.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l016.segmentation: 受小共大共，为下国骏厖。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l016.explanation: 接受大小贡物，为下国作厚辅。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l016.segmentation: He took small and great tribute, a mighty support for vassal states.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l017.explanation: 上天多么隆宠，陈奏其勇武。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l017.segmentation: How Heaven favored him—he showed forth his valor.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l018.segmentation: 不震不动，不戁不竦，百禄是总。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l018.explanation: 不震不动，不恐不悚，百种福禄总集其身。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l018.segmentation: Unshaken, unafraid, all hundred blessings were his.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l019.explanation: 武王挥旗出征，虔诚手执斧钺。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l019.segmentation: King Wu raised his banner; devoutly he grasped axe and halberd.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l020.explanation: 如火烈烈，没有谁敢与我为敌。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l020.segmentation: Blazing like fire—none dared stand against us.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l021.explanation: 根株有三蘖，却不得遂长、不得通达。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l021.segmentation: The root had three shoots, yet none could thrive or reach far.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l022.segmentation: 九有有截，韦顾既伐，昆吾夏桀。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l022.explanation: 九州都顺服，韦、顾已伐灭，昆吾与夏桀同亡。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l022.segmentation: The nine realms were subdued; Wei and Gu fell, Kun-wu and Jie of Xia perished.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l023.explanation: 昔在中叶之时，有震威且有功业。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l023.segmentation: In mid-dynasty days there was awe and great achievement.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l024.explanation: 确实是天子，降任卿士辅佐。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l024.segmentation: Truly a Son of Heaven—he sent down ministers to aid.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l025.explanation: 实有阿衡，实在左右商王。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-changfa-l025.segmentation: There was A-heng indeed, truly at the king of Shang's side.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l001.segmentation: Ah, great Ancestor of fiery merit!

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l003.explanation: 再次赐予无穷福泽，及于此时此地。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l003.segmentation: Again bestowing boundless grace, reaching us here and now.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l004.explanation: 既已备好清酒，赐我祭祀成功。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l004.segmentation: Clear wine is ready; grant us a successful rite.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l005.explanation: 也有调和的羹汤，既已戒备又已齐备。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l005.segmentation: There is harmonized broth; all is prepared and settled.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l006.explanation: 肃敬无声，此时没有争讼。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l007.explanation: 赐我长寿，黄发老人福泽无疆。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l007.segmentation: Grant us long life; the aged enjoy endless blessing.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l008.explanation: 车軧皮革交错，八鸾铃响当当。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l008.segmentation: Leather traces cross; eight bells ring clear.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l009.explanation: 以此致祭享献，我受命广大将行。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l009.segmentation: With these we pray and feast; I bear a broad mandate.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l010.explanation: 自天降康，丰年谷粮满仓。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l010.segmentation: From Heaven comes peace; harvest years overflow.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l011.segmentation: Come to worship, come to feast—blessings without end.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l012.explanation: 顾念我秋冬之祭，汤孙将主其事。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-liezu-l012.segmentation: Look on our seasonal offerings; Tang's descendant will lead them.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l003.explanation: 击鼓声简简，使我烈祖欣悦。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l003.segmentation: Drums beat steadily, delighting our fiery ancestor.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l004.explanation: 汤孙奏乐致祭，安我祭祀成功。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l004.segmentation: Tang's descendant plays in prayer; settle our rite in success.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l005.explanation: 鞉鼓声渊渊，管乐嘒嘒清亮。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l005.segmentation: Hand-drums rumble deep; pipes shrill and bright.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l006.explanation: 既和谐又平和，依循磬声齐奏。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l006.segmentation: Harmonious and calm, following the chime-stones' lead.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l008.segmentation: Solemn and dignified is his fame.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l009.segmentation: Drums never cease; the myriad dance is grand.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l010.explanation: 我有嘉客，也都非常喜悦。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l010.segmentation: We have honored guests, and none are displeased.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l011.explanation: 自古在昔，先民有所创制。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l011.segmentation: From ancient times our forebears made these rites.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l012.segmentation: 温恭朝夕，执事有恪，顾予烝尝，汤孙之将。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l012.explanation: 温恭朝夕，执事有恪，顾念我烝尝之祭，汤孙将主其事。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-na-l012.segmentation: Gentle and reverent day and night, dutiful in service—mind our offerings; Tang's descendant will lead.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao-l00.segmentation: 天命玄鸟，降而生商，宅殷土芒芒。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao-l00.explanation: 天命玄鸟，降而生商，定居殷土广大。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao-l00.segmentation: Heaven sent the dark bird; it descended and Shang was born, dwelling on vast Yin soil.
古帝命武汤，正域彼四方。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao-l00.explanation: 古帝命武汤，正其域于四方。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao-l00.segmentation: The ancient Lord charged valiant Tang to set the realm in order on every side.
He assigned their heirs— they held the nine realms.
商之先后，受命不殆，在武丁孙子。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao-l00.explanation: 商之先后，受命不殆，在武丁孙子身上。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao-l00.segmentation: Shang's forebears and successors, charged without fail, live on in Wu-ding's line.
Wu-ding's descendant—the martial king wins every battle.
Ten dragon banners; he receives the great grain tribute.
邦畿千里，维民所止，肇域彼四海。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao-l00.explanation: 邦畿千里，维民所止，始开域于四海。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao-l00.segmentation: The capital domain spans a thousand li where people dwell; thus the four seas were opened.
From the four seas they come; hosts arrive in throngs.
Jing Mountain lies by the great River.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao-l01.explanation: 殷受天命皆合宜，百种福禄归之。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-xuanniao-l01.segmentation: Yin received Heaven's charge fitly— all hundred blessings are theirs.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l001.segmentation: Mighty is Yin-Wu, striking hard against Jing and Chu.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l002.explanation: 深入其险阻，聚荆楚之众。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l002.segmentation: Deep into their rugged land; he gathered the hosts of Jing.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l003.segmentation: Where he went, all submitted— the legacy of Tang's line.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l004.segmentation: You of Jing and Chu, your state lies in the south.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l005.segmentation: 昔有成汤，自彼氐羌，莫敢不来享，莫敢不来王。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l005.explanation: 昔有成汤，自氐羌以来，莫敢不来享，莫敢不来朝。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l005.segmentation: Once Cheng Tang ruled—from Di and Qiang on, none dared not come to feast or pay homage.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l006.segmentation: They said Shang was the constant lord.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l007.segmentation: 天命多辟，设都于禹之绩。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l007.explanation: 天命多诸侯，设都于禹治水之功绩之地。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l007.segmentation: Heaven charged many lords to set capitals where Yu's work endured.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l008.segmentation: 岁事来辟，勿予祸适，稼穑匪解。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l008.explanation: 岁事来朝，勿予祸患，稼穑不懈。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l008.segmentation: Each year they come to court— bring no disaster; keep farming without slack.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l009.explanation: 天命降监察，下民有严敬。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l009.segmentation: Heaven sends down oversight; the people below are reverent.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l010.explanation: 不越分不滥刑，不敢懈怠偷安。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l010.segmentation: Neither overstepping nor excess in punishment— never idle or negligent.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l011.segmentation: Charge the states below; allot them blessing.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l012.explanation: 商都翼翼整齐，为四方之极。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l012.segmentation: Shang's capital stands in order—the pole for all directions.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l013.explanation: 赫赫其声名，濯濯其威灵。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l014.explanation: 寿考且安宁，以保我后世子孙。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l014.segmentation: Long life and peace—to guard our later generations.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l015.explanation: 登上景山，松树柏树丸丸齐整。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l015.segmentation: We climb Jing Mountain; pines and cypresses stand round and tall.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l016.segmentation: Felling and moving them— square-hewing with devotion.

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l017.segmentation: 松桷有梴，旅楹有闲，寝成孔安。
sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l017.explanation: 松作椽条长，旅楹有闲，寝庙成而甚安。

sj-song-shangsong-nazhishen-yinwu-l017.segmentation: Pine rafters long, pillars in rows with space— the temple hall stands secure.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.explanation: 啊，各位臣工，敬慎地在公门办事。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.segmentation: O ministers all, be reverent in public service.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.explanation: 王赞美你们的成就，来咨询、来采纳意见。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.segmentation: The king praises your work— come counsel and advise.
嗟嗟保介，维莫之春，亦又何求？
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.explanation: 啊，各位田官，正是暮春时节，还求什么？

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.segmentation: O field officers, it is late spring— what more do you seek?
How fare the newly broken fields?
Fine is the wheat and barley— it will receive bright bounty.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.explanation: 光明昭告上帝，终得康年。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.segmentation: Brightly tell God above— at last a year of plenty.
命我众人：庤乃钱镈，奄观铚艾。
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.explanation: 命我众人：修治钱镈，尽观铚艾之获。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-chengon.segmentation: He charges us all: ready the sickles and reaping hooks, and watch the harvest.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-fengnia.segmentation: 丰年多黍多稌，亦有高廪，万亿及秭。
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-fengnia.explanation: 丰年多黍多稌，也有高仓，积至万亿秭。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-fengnia.segmentation: In a rich year, millet and glutinous grain abound; granaries rise high— stores to trillions.
Brew wine and sweet liquor to offer forebears.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-fengnia.explanation: 以洽百礼，降福非常普遍。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-fengnia.segmentation: Thus all rites are fulfilled; blessings descend abundantly.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-qian-l0.explanation: 美好啊漆沮之水，潜藏许多鱼。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-qian-l0.segmentation: How fine are Qi and Ju— many fish hide in their depths.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-qian-l0.explanation: 有鳣有鲔，还有鲦、鲿、鰋、鲤。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-qian-l0.segmentation: Sturgeon and great carp, plus minnow, catfish, loach, and carp.
For feast and sacrifice—to gain great blessing.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-wu-l002.segmentation: None can rival his blazing merit.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-wu-l003.explanation: 确实文德之王文王，能开其后嗣。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-wu-l003.segmentation: Truly cultured King Wen opened the way for those after.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-wu-l004.segmentation: 嗣武受之，胜殷遏刘，耆定尔功。
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-wu-l004.explanation: 嗣武王承受之，胜殷遏杀，耆定其功。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-wu-l004.segmentation: Successor Wu received it— conquered Yin, checked slaughter, settled his achievement in old age.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yixi-l0.segmentation: O King Cheng, you have clearly prayed to Heaven.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yixi-l0.explanation: 率领此时农夫，播种种类百谷。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yixi-l0.segmentation: Lead the farmers now to sow every kind of grain.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yixi-l0.explanation: 迅速发私田，终行三十里。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yixi-l0.segmentation: Quickly open private plots— thirty li they go.
They also work the lord's field— ten thousand pairs plow together.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yong-l0.segmentation: Guests come in harmony; on arrival all is solemn.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yong-l0.explanation: 助祭的是诸侯，天子穆穆庄重。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yong-l0.segmentation: The feudal lords assist; the Son of Heaven is grave and dignified.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yong-l0.explanation: 进献大公牛，助我四时之祭。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yong-l0.segmentation: They offer great bulls to aid my four-season rites.
How glorious is my late father!
Give peace to me, his filial son.
Clear and wise are the men— heirs of Wen and Wu.
Reaching to great Heaven— may their line flourish.
绥我眉寿，介以繁祉，既右烈考，亦右文母。
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yong-l0.explanation: 安我长寿，介以多福，既右烈考，亦右文母。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yong-l0.segmentation: Grant long life, bestow rich blessing— honor fierce father and cultured mother.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yougu-l.segmentation: Blind musicians, blind musicians—in Zhou's courtyard.
Set the bell frames and stands, lofty teeth and feather plumes.
Responding drums and suspended drums, hand-drums, chimes, grain-scraper, and tiger-chime.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yougu-l.explanation: 于是奏乐，箫管一齐响起。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yougu-l.segmentation: Then they play— flutes and pipes all rise together.
喤喤厥声，肃雍和鸣，先祖是听。
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yougu-l.explanation: 喤喤其声，肃雍和鸣，先祖来听。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-yougu-l.segmentation: Sound resounds; solemn harmony rings— ancestors listen.
Our guests have come—to forever behold this completed rite.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-youke-l.segmentation: Guests arrive— their horses are white.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-youke-l.explanation: 随从茂盛且多，雕琢其行列。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-youke-l.segmentation: Attendants lush and many— their ranks refined.
Some guests stay long; some lodge many nights.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-youke-l.explanation: 于是授之绊索，以拴其马。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-youke-l.segmentation: We give them tether ropes to tie their horses.
We go to see them off; attendants ease them on either side.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-youke-l.explanation: 既有大威，降福非常平易。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-youke-l.segmentation: Great is their majesty— blessings descend in ample ease.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zaijian.explanation: 初次见诸侯王，说求其章服。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zaijian.segmentation: First meeting the feudal king— seeking his regalia.
Dragon banners gleam; harmony bells ring clear.
Leather traces bear azure; beauty shines with fiery light.
Lead to bright father— with filial piety we sacrifice.
以介眉寿，永言保之，思皇多祜。
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zaijian.explanation: 以介眉寿，永言保之，思皇多祜。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zaijian.segmentation: Grant long life, ever keep it— think of Heaven's many blessings.
烈文辟公，绥以多福，俾缉熙于纯嘏。
sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zaijian.explanation: 烈文诸侯，绥以多福，俾缉熙于纯嘏。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zaijian.segmentation: Illustrious lords— peace with much fortune, that they may gather pure blessing.

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zhenlu-.explanation: 白鹭振翅而飞，于彼西雍。

sj-song-zhousong-chengongzhishen-zhenlu-.segmentation: White egrets flutter in flight— there at Western Yong.
Our guests have come—with the same dignified bearing.
None hate them there; none tire of them here.
May they rise early and sleep late—to keep honor to the end.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-ban-.segmentation: Great is Zhou in this age!
陟其高山，嶞山乔岳，允犹翕河。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-ban-.explanation: 登其高山，嶞山乔岳，确实犹似黄河。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-ban-.segmentation: We climb high mountains— steep peaks and lofty ranges, truly like the great River.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-ban-.explanation: 遍天之下，聚此时之对答。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-ban-.segmentation: Under all Heaven— gather this time's responses.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-fang.segmentation: I consult at my accession— following bright father of old.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-fang.explanation: 呜呼悠远啊，我尚未有定见。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-fang.segmentation: Alas, how far it stretches—I have not yet found my way.
I would approach it— the legacy still seems scattered.
I, a young king, am not yet equal to the house's many troubles.
Continue the court above and below— ascend and descend in the house.
Blessed was bright father— he kept himself clear and safe.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-huan.segmentation: Pacify ten thousand states— again and again, rich harvest years.
Heaven's charge unbroken— bold, bold King Wu.
保有厥士，于以四方，克定厥家。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-huan.explanation: 保有其士众，于以四方，克定厥家。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-huan.segmentation: He kept his warriors— to the four quarters, and settled his house.
Bright before Heaven— the sovereign mediates between.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.segmentation: 敬之敬之，天维显思，命不易哉。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.explanation: 敬之又敬，天维显思，命不易哉。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.segmentation: Be reverent, ever reverent— Heaven sees clearly; the charge is not easy.
无曰高高在上，陟降厥士，日监在兹。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.explanation: 勿说高高在上，陟降厥士，日监在兹。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.segmentation: Do not say 'I sit on high'— Heaven rises and descends among the people, watching daily here.
I, the young king, am not yet wise enough in reverence.
日就月将，学有缉熙于光明。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.explanation: 日就月将，学有缉熙于光明。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-jing.segmentation: Day by day, month by month— learning gathers toward the light.
Help me bear the burden— show me bright virtue to follow.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lai-.segmentation: King Wen toiled to the end—I should receive his legacy.
Spread thought through the times—I go only to seek stability.
This is Zhou's charge— ever to be pondered.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.segmentation: 畟畟良耜，俶载南亩。
Sharp is the good plough— first turned in the southern field.
播厥百谷，实函斯活。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.explanation: 播种种类百谷，实涵斯活。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.segmentation: Sow every grain— seeds swell and live.
或来瞻女，载筐及莒，其饟伊黍。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.explanation: 或来瞻女，载筐及筥，其饷伊黍。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.segmentation: Some come to watch you— baskets and tubs bring millet for refreshment.
其笠伊纠，其镈斯赵，以薅荼蓼。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.explanation: 其笠伊纠，其镈斯赵，以薅荼蓼。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.segmentation: Bamboo hats tight, hoes flash— to weed out thorn and smartweed.
荼蓼朽止，黍稷茂止。
Weeds rot away; millet and panic grass thrive.
获之挃挃，积之栗栗。
Harvest cut clean; stacks piled tight.
其崇如墉，其比如栉。
As high as a wall, as close as comb teeth.
以开百室，百室盈止，妇子宁止。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.explanation: 以开百室，百室盈止，妇子宁止。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-lian.segmentation: Open a hundred rooms—all full; wives and children rest in peace.
杀时犉牡，有捄其角。
Slaughter this season's bull— its horns curved for ritual.
以似以续，续古之人。
Thus we continue the rites— following the ancients.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-miny.segmentation: 闵予小子，遭家不造，嬛嬛在疚。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-miny.explanation: 悯我小子，遭家不造，孤独在忧病。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-miny.segmentation: Pity me, young king— the house meets ill fortune; alone in grief and care.
Alas, bright father— forever able in filial piety.
Think on this grand ancestor— ascending and descending in the hall.
I, the young king— early and late I am reverent.
Alas, royal king— continue the order; never forget.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-siyi.segmentation: Silken robes dark red; caps worn with grace.
自堂徂基，自羊徂牛，鼐鼎及鼒，兕觥其觩。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-siyi.explanation: 自堂徂基，自羊徂牛，鼐鼎及鼒，兕觥其觩。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-siyi.segmentation: From hall to altar, sheep to ox— great and small cauldrons, rhinoceros horns curved.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-siyi.explanation: 不喧哗不傲慢，长寿之福。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-siyi.segmentation: Neither noisy nor proud—the blessing of long life.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-xiao.segmentation: I will take warning and guard against later harm.
Do not make me a bristling bee— you seek bitter stings yourselves.
At first trust that peach worm—it flaps wings and becomes a bird.
未堪家多难，予又集于蓼。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-xiao.explanation: 未堪家多难，予又集于蓼。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-xiao.segmentation: Not yet equal to the house's troubles—I am plunged again into hardship.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.segmentation: 载芟载柞，其耕泽泽。
Weed and fell trees—the plowing moist and fine.
千耦其耘，徂隰徂畛。
A thousand pairs plow— to low fields and to borders.
侯主侯伯，侯亚侯旅，侯彊侯以。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.explanation: 有主有伯，有亚有旅，有强有以。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.segmentation: Masters and chiefs, deputies and companies, the strong and helpers.
有嗿其馌，思媚其妇，有依其士。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.explanation: 有送其饭，思媚其妇，有依其士。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.segmentation: Food is brought; wives are gracious; men have their support.
有略其耜，俶载南亩，播厥百谷。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.explanation: 有略其耜，始载南亩，播种种类百谷。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.segmentation: Sharp ploughshares— first in the south field, sow every grain.
实函斯活，驿驿其达。
Seeds swell and live; swiftly they sprout.
有厌其杰，厌厌其苗，绵绵其麃。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.explanation: 有厌其杰，厌厌其苗，绵绵其麃。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.segmentation: Fine are the tallest; lush the shoots; thick the rows.
载获济济，有实其积，万亿及秭。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.explanation: 收获济济，有实其积，万亿及秭。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.segmentation: Harvest abundant; stores solid— trillions piled.
为酒为醴，烝畀祖妣，不洽百礼。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.explanation: 为酒为醴，进献祖先，以洽百礼。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.segmentation: Brew wine and liquor— offer ancestors, fulfill every rite.
有飶其香。
Fragrance rises rich.
邦家之光。
Glory to state and clan.
有椒其馨，胡考之宁。
Spicy fragrance— long life and peace.
匪且有且，匪今斯今，振古如兹。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.explanation: 匪且有且，匪今斯今，振古如兹。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zais.segmentation: Not only now but always—not only today but forever—as from ancient times.

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zhuo.segmentation: Glorious the royal host— nurturing strength till the hour is dark.
Now pure brightness comes— thus great aid is given.
I, the sovereign, receive it— valiant is the king's achievement.
载用有嗣，实维尔公允师。
sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zhuo.explanation: 载用有嗣，实维尔公允师。

sj-song-zhousong-minyuxiaozizhishen-zhuo.segmentation: Thus heirs continue— truly you, lord, are the fair model.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-haotian.explanation: 昊天有成命，文武二后受之。

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-haotian.segmentation: Great Heaven fixed the mandate— the two kings Wen and Wu received it.
成王不敢康，夙夜基命宥密。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-haotian.explanation: 成王不敢康，夙夜基命宥密。

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-haotian.segmentation: King Cheng dares not be at ease— day and night he grounds the charge in reverent care.
With all his heart— the four quarters are settled.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-liewen-.segmentation: Illustrious feudal lords— Heaven grants this blessing.
Favor us without end— sons and grandsons keep it.
无封靡于尔邦，维王其崇之。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-liewen-.explanation: 无封靡于尔邦，维王其崇之。

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-liewen-.segmentation: Let no one overreach in your states— the king will honor you.
Remember this martial merit— continue the sovereign's line.
Strive not against the people— the four quarters will learn from you.
Make not bright your virtue alone— all lords will take it as model.
Alas— do not forget the former kings!

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-qingmia.segmentation: Solemn is the clear temple— reverent harmony, illustrious assistants.
Hosts of officers— bearing culture's virtue.
Facing Heaven above— they swiftly serve in the shrine.
Neither failing to show nor to receive— endless praise for these men.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai-.segmentation: 时迈其邦，昊天其子之，实右序有周。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai-.explanation: 时巡其邦，昊天其子之，实右序有周。

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai-.segmentation: He tours the states in season— Heaven treats him as its child, truly aiding ordered Zhou.
When he stirs them, none fail to tremble and submit.
怀柔百神，及河乔岳，允王维后。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai-.explanation: 怀柔百神，及河乔岳，允王维后。

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai-.segmentation: Gentle to all spirits— to the River and lofty peaks— truly the king is Heaven's heir.
Bright is Zhou— thus order ranks in office.
Put away spears and shields; case bows and arrows.
我求懿德，四于时夏，允王保之。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai-.explanation: 我求懿德，四于时夏，允王保之。

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-shimai-.segmentation: We seek fine virtue— spread through this great realm; the king truly keeps it.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-siwen-l.segmentation: Think on cultured Hou Ji— he could match Heaven.
He established our people— none beyond your utmost care.
贻我来牟，帝命率育，无此疆尔界。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-siwen-l.explanation: 贻我来牟，帝命率育，无此疆尔界。

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-siwen-l.segmentation: He left us wheat and barley— God's charge to nurture all, without this border or that.
Set the constant way in this great realm.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-tianzuo.segmentation: Heaven made the high mountains— Great King tamed them.
He built there— King Wen made it secure.
He passed on— at Qi, roads lay smooth and level.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-weiqing.segmentation: Pure gathering toward light— King Wen's rite.
肇禋，迄用有成，维周之祯。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-weiqing.explanation: 肇禋，迄用有成，维周之祯。

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-weiqing.segmentation: He began the sacrifice— at last success came; Zhou's good omen.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-weitian.segmentation: Such is Heaven's charge— solemn, never ceasing.
于乎不显，文王之德之纯。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-weitian.explanation: 呜呼不显，文王之德之纯。

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-weitian.segmentation: Alas how glorious— King Wen's virtue wholly pure.
Grant overflow to us—we shall receive it.
Greatly favor our King Wen— his great-grandson holds it firm.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-wojiang.segmentation: 我将我享，维羊维牛，维天其右之。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-wojiang.explanation: 我将我享，维羊维牛，维天其右之。

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-wojiang.segmentation: I bring, I sacrifice— sheep and oxen— may Heaven assist.
仪式刑文王之典，日靖四方。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-wojiang.explanation: 仪式刑文王之典，日靖四方。

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-wojiang.segmentation: In form and rule, King Wen's rite— daily pacify the four quarters.
Ah, blessed Wen— already honored at the feast.
我其夙夜，畏天之威，于时保之。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-wojiang.explanation: 我其夙夜，畏天之威，于时保之。

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-wojiang.segmentation: Early and late I fear Heaven's majesty— thus I keep the charge.

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-zhijing.segmentation: Strive on, King Wu— none rival your blazing merit.
Glorious Cheng and Kang— they revered God on high.
自彼成康，奄有四方，斤斤其明。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-zhijing.explanation: 自彼成康，奄有四方，斤斤其明。

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-zhijing.segmentation: From Cheng and Kang on— they held the four quarters, keen and bright.
钟鼓喤喤，磬莞将将，降福穰穰。
sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-zhijing.explanation: 钟鼓喤喤，磬莞将将，降福穰穰。

sj-song-zhousong-qingmiaozhishen-zhijing.segmentation: Bells and drums resound; chimes ring clear— blessings pour down rich.
Blessings come simple and ample; dignity returns again and again.
Drunk and full— fortune and blessing come back to us.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l001.explanation: 周宣王英武威严，声名显赫。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l001.segmentation: The king is majestic and resplendent in fame and authority.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l002.segmentation: 王命卿士，南仲大祖，大师皇父。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l002.explanation: 宣王任命卿士南仲、太祖、皇父等重臣。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l002.segmentation: The king appoints his ministers Nan Zhong, Da Zu, and Grand Master Huang Fu.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l003.explanation: 整顿六军，修治兵器，准备出征。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l003.segmentation: He musters the six armies and readies the weapons of war.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l004.explanation: 既敬慎又戒备，施恩德于南方诸国。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l004.segmentation: With reverence and vigilance, he brings kindness to the southern states.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l005.segmentation: 王谓尹氏，命程伯休父，左右陈行。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l005.explanation: 宣王对尹氏下令，命程伯休父左右排列军队行列。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l005.segmentation: The king tells Yin Shi to command Cheng Bo Xiufu to array the ranks on left and right.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l006.segmentation: 戒我师旅，率彼淮浦，省此徐土。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l006.explanation: 告诫军队，沿淮水岸前进，巡视徐国土地。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l006.segmentation: He warns the troops to march along the Huai shore and inspect the land of Xu.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l007.explanation: 不停留、不安居，三公之职各就各位。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l007.segmentation: They tarry not nor linger; the three high offices are all in readiness.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l008.explanation: 威武严肃，天子威仪凛然。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l008.segmentation: Grand and awe-inspiring is the stern majesty of the Son of Heaven.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l009.explanation: 宣王从容安行，不是迟缓也不是游逸。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l009.segmentation: The king moves at ease yet with purpose—not slack nor idle.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l010.explanation: 徐方骚动不安，大为震惊。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l010.segmentation: The region of Xu is stirred and thrown into great alarm.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l011.explanation: 王师声势如雷如霆，徐方再次震惊。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l011.segmentation: Like thunder and lightning the royal host resounds, and Xu is shaken again.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l012.explanation: 宣王奋发武勇，如雷霆震怒。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l012.segmentation: The king rouses his martial prowess, fierce as thunder in wrath.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l013.explanation: 派出虎臣猛将，勇猛如咆哮的猛虎。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l013.segmentation: He sends forth his tiger-like warriors, bold as roaring tigers.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l014.explanation: 在淮水边大举进击，仍俘获敌酋。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l014.segmentation: They press hard upon the Huai banks and still seize the enemy chiefs.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l015.explanation: 截断淮水沿岸，正是王师驻扎之处。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l015.segmentation: They cut off the Huai shore—there the king's army makes its stand.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l016.explanation: 王师行进和缓，却快如飞羽。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l016.segmentation: The royal columns move at ease, yet swift as flight or soaring pinions.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l017.explanation: 浩大如江汉，稳固如山岳。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l017.segmentation: Vast as the Yangtze and Han, firm as mountains wrapped in strength.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l018.explanation: 奔流如江河，绵延而齐整。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l018.segmentation: Flowing like rivers in flood, continuous and orderly in array.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l019.explanation: 深不可测、不可抵挡，大举征伐徐国。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l019.segmentation: Deep beyond measure and irresistible, they sweep forth to chastise the state of Xu.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l020.explanation: 宣王谋划确实可行，徐方已经前来归附。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l020.segmentation: The king's plans are truly fulfilled, and Xu has already come to submit.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l021.explanation: 徐方已与周室同心，这是天子的功业。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l021.segmentation: Xu is now of one mind with Zhou; this is the Son of Heaven's achievement.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l022.explanation: 四方既已平定，徐方来朝见天子。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l022.segmentation: When the four quarters are pacified, Xu comes to the royal court.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l023.explanation: 徐方不敢违逆，宣王下令班师还朝。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-changwu-l023.segmentation: Xu dares not turn away; the king commands the army to return home.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l001.explanation: 上帝广大无边，是下民的君主。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l001.segmentation: Vast is God on high, the ruler and refuge of the people below.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l002.explanation: 上帝疾恶暴虐，其降下的命令多给不法之君。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l002.segmentation: God abhors cruel might; his decrees often fall on lawless rulers.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l003.explanation: 上天生养众民，给人的命数却未必恒久可信。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l003.segmentation: Heaven breeds the multitude, yet the fate it assigns is not always steadfast.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l004.explanation: 凡事多能善始，却少有能善终的。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l004.segmentation: Nothing lacks a good beginning, but few can bring things to a good end.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l005.explanation: 文王叹息说：唉，你们殷商啊。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l005.segmentation: King Wen sighs and says: Alas, you people of Yin-Shang!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l006.explanation: 难道曾不是强暴的抵御者吗？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l006.segmentation: Were you not once fierce defenders of your realm?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l007.explanation: 难道曾不是聚敛搜刮吗？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l007.segmentation: Were you not once gatherers who scraped the people dry?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l008.segmentation: Were you not once seated in high office?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l009.explanation: 难道曾不在服事之列吗？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l009.segmentation: Were you not once among those who served the throne?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l010.explanation: 上天降下滔天恶德，你却凭此自恃强力。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l010.segmentation: Heaven sent down overflowing wickedness, and you rose up by that very force.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l011.explanation: 文王叹息说：唉，你们殷商啊。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l011.segmentation: King Wen sighs and says: Alas, you people of Yin-Shang!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l012.explanation: 你本当秉持道义，强暴之徒却多生怨怼。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l012.segmentation: You should have held to righteousness, yet the violent breed much resentment.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l013.explanation: 用流言蜚语来应对政事。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l013.segmentation: You answer affairs with slander and idle rumor.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l014.explanation: 寇盗攘夺之风竟入于朝廷之内。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l014.segmentation: Robbery and plunder even enter the inner court.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l015.explanation: 诸侯作威作福、祝祷求福，却无边无际、没有尽头。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l015.segmentation: Lords play lord and pray for blessing, yet there is no limit and no end.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l016.explanation: 文王叹息说：唉，你们殷商啊。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l016.segmentation: King Wen sighs and says: Alas, you people of Yin-Shang!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l017.explanation: 你在中原大肆烹杀暴虐。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l017.segmentation: You boil and burn with cruelty throughout the central lands.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l018.explanation: 把招来的怨恨当作自己的德政。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l018.segmentation: You take gathered hatred and call it your virtue.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l019.explanation: 不明你的德行，朝中没有辅佐与侧近。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l019.segmentation: Your virtue is not clear; in court there are no aides at back or side.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l020.explanation: 你的德行昏昧，因此没有陪臣、没有卿士。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l020.segmentation: Your virtue is dim, so you have no attendants and no ministers of rank.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l021.explanation: 文王叹息说：唉，你们殷商啊。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l021.segmentation: King Wen sighs and says: Alas, you people of Yin-Shang!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l022.segmentation: 天不湎尔以酒，不义从式。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l022.explanation: 上天并非让你沉溺于酒，你却从不义之道放纵。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l022.segmentation: Heaven did not drown you in wine, yet you follow the way of injustice.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l023.explanation: 已经越过了应有的限度。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l023.segmentation: You have already overstepped every proper bound.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l024.segmentation: There is no distinction of bright day or dark night in your deeds.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l025.segmentation: You shout and cry out without restraint.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l026.explanation: 竟把白天当作黑夜来荒淫作乐。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l026.segmentation: You make the day into night for riot and pleasure.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l027.explanation: 文王叹息说：唉，你们殷商啊。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l027.segmentation: King Wen sighs and says: Alas, you people of Yin-Shang!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l028.explanation: 像蝉鸣螗叫般聒噪，像沸水羹汤般翻滚。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l028.segmentation: Noisy as cicadas and katydids, seething like boiling broth.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l029.explanation: 大小官职近于丧亡，人们还沿着旧路不改。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l029.segmentation: Great and small offices near ruin, yet men still walk the old crooked way.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l030.explanation: 在国内兴妖作乱，祸延及远方鬼方。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l030.segmentation: You stir chaos within the realm, and the harm reaches even to distant Gui Fang.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l031.explanation: 文王叹息说：唉，你们殷商啊。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l031.segmentation: King Wen sighs and says: Alas, you people of Yin-Shang!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l032.explanation: 不是上帝不适时，而是殷商不遵旧法。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l032.segmentation: It is not that God is untimely, but that Yin will not use the old ways.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l033.explanation: 虽然没有老成之人，尚有先王留下的典章法度。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l033.segmentation: Though there are no elders of long experience, the statutes and models still remain.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l034.explanation: 你们竟不肯听从，天命因此倾覆。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l034.segmentation: Yet you would not listen, and the great mandate toppled.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l035.explanation: 文王叹息说：唉，你们殷商啊。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l035.segmentation: King Wen sighs and says: Alas, you people of Yin-Shang!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l036.explanation: 古人也有话说：颠仆时刚被揭起，

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l036.segmentation: Men also have a saying: when a tree is uprooted and raised,

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l037.explanation: 枝叶尚未受损，根实却已先被拔断。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l037.segmentation: the branches and leaves are not yet harmed, but the root and fruit are torn out first.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l038.explanation: 殷商的鉴戒并不遥远，就在夏朝末年的情形。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-dang-l038.segmentation: Yin's mirror is not far off—it lies in the age after the Xia.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l001.segmentation: 奕奕梁山，维禹甸之，有倬其道。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l001.explanation: 高大雄壮的梁山，是大禹所划分的疆域，道路宽阔通达。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l001.segmentation: Lofty and grand is Mount Liang, marked out by Yu; its roads are broad and clear.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l002.segmentation: 韩侯受命，王亲命之：缵戎祖考，无废朕命。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l002.explanation: 韩侯受天子之命，周王亲自嘱咐：继承你祖上的事业，不要废弃我的命令。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l002.segmentation: The Marquis of Han receives the mandate; the king personally charges him: continue your forefathers' work and do not fail my command.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l003.segmentation: 夙夜匪解，虔共尔位，朕命不易。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l003.explanation: 早晚不懈怠，恭敬守其位，王命不可更改。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l003.segmentation: From dawn to dusk without slackening, serve your post with reverence—the royal charge must not change.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l004.explanation: 光明磊落地治理四方，以辅佐周王。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l004.segmentation: He governs the regions with bright integrity to assist the king.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l005.explanation: 四匹雄马威武，车马装饰华美而张扬。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l005.segmentation: The four stallions are stately; the chariot is finely adorned and splendid.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l006.segmentation: 韩侯入觐，以其介圭，入觐于王。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l006.explanation: 韩侯入朝觐见，手持大圭，向周王行觐见之礼。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l006.segmentation: The Marquis of Han enters audience, bearing his great jade tablet to pay homage to the king.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l007.segmentation: 王锡韩侯，淑旂绥章，簟茀错衡。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l007.explanation: 周王赏赐韩侯：绘有图案的旗帜、绥带章饰，以及竹席车蔽和错金的衡木。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l007.segmentation: The king bestows on Han: fine banners and insignia, bamboo awning and inlaid chariot yoke.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l008.segmentation: 玄衮赤舄，钩膺镂锡，鞹鞃浅幭，鞗革金厄。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l008.explanation: 玄色礼服、赤色鞋履，马胸饰与镂刻锡饰，皮革护具与浅幭，鞗革金环等全套仪仗。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l008.segmentation: Black robe and red shoes, hooked breast-plates and chased tin, leather fittings and shallow covers, thongs and golden rings—all full regalia.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l009.explanation: 韩侯出京上路，首夜宿于屠地。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l009.segmentation: The Marquis of Han sets out on the road and lodges the first night at Tu.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l010.explanation: 显父设宴为他饯行，备清酒百壶。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l010.segmentation: Xian Fu holds a farewell feast for him with a hundred jars of clear wine.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l016.segmentation: A team of horses and a road chariot.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l017.segmentation: Bowls and dishes are set out in good order.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l018.segmentation: The lords feast together in mutual joy.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l019.segmentation: 韩侯取妻，汾王之甥，蹶父之子。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l019.explanation: 韩侯迎娶妻子，她是汾王的外甥女、蹶父的女儿。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l019.segmentation: The Marquis of Han takes a wife—the niece of the king of Fen and daughter of Jue Fu.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l020.explanation: 韩侯前往迎亲，来到蹶父的乡里。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l020.segmentation: The Marquis goes to meet the bride at the hamlet of Jue.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l021.segmentation: 百两彭彭，八鸾锵锵，不显其光。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l021.explanation: 百辆婚车声势彭彭，八鸾铃声锵锵，光彩显赫。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l021.segmentation: A hundred wedding chariots roll mightily; eight bells ring clear—splendor shines forth.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l022.explanation: 众娣女随从而行，仪态美好如云。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l022.segmentation: The attendant maidens follow, graceful and numerous as clouds.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l023.explanation: 韩侯回头顾看，门庭光彩满溢。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l023.segmentation: The Marquis looks back—the courtyard glows with brilliance.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l024.explanation: 蹶父非常勇武，没有到不了的地方。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l024.segmentation: Jue Fu is very bold; there is no land he has not reached.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l025.explanation: 为韩姞选择居处，没有比韩国更安乐的。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l025.segmentation: Choosing a home for Lady Han Ji, none is happier than the land of Han.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l026.segmentation: 孔乐韩土，川泽訏訏，鲂鱮甫甫，麀鹿噳噳。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l026.explanation: 韩国土地十分安乐，川泽广阔，鲂鱮成群，母鹿呦呦。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l026.segmentation: Great joy is the soil of Han—broad marshes and streams, shoals of bream, does calling softly.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l027.explanation: 有熊有罴，有猫有虎，物产丰饶。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l027.segmentation: There are bears and brown bears, lynxes and tigers—rich in game and goods.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l028.explanation: 庆氏既有好居处，韩姞也备受称誉。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l028.segmentation: The Qing clan has a fine dwelling; Lady Han Ji wins praise and honor.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l029.explanation: 韩城广大，由燕国军队协助修筑完成。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l029.segmentation: Wide is the city of Han, completed with aid from Yan's troops.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l030.explanation: 因先祖受天命，适时镇抚百蛮。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l030.segmentation: Because their ancestors received the mandate, they rule the many barbarian peoples in season.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l031.explanation: 周王赐韩侯统辖之追、貊等部。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l031.segmentation: The king grants the Marquis of Han authority over the Zhui and Mo peoples.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l032.explanation: 奄有北方国土，因而封为伯。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l032.segmentation: He holds the northern realm and is made a regional lord.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l033.explanation: 修筑城墙沟壑，整理田亩与税籍。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l033.segmentation: He builds walls and moats, and sets fields and tax registers in order.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l034.explanation: 进献貔皮，以及赤豹、黄罴等珍兽之皮。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-hanyi-l034.segmentation: He presents pelts of the pi beast, red leopards, and yellow bears.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l001.explanation: 江汉水势浩荡，武士众多威武。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l001.segmentation: The Jiang and Han roll on; warriors abound in martial splendor.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l002.explanation: 并非安逸游逸，而是淮夷前来请求治理。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l002.segmentation: Not for ease or idle roaming—the Huai tribes come seeking rule and order.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l003.explanation: 已经出动战车，已经竖起军旗。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l003.segmentation: Our chariots are out; our banners are raised.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l004.explanation: 并非安逸舒缓，而是淮夷前来归附。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l004.segmentation: Not for rest and slackness—the Huai tribes come to submit.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l005.explanation: 江汉汤汤奔流，武士光明勇武。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l005.segmentation: The Jiang and Han surge onward; the warriors shine with courage.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l006.explanation: 经营四方事务，向周王报告功业已成。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l006.segmentation: They manage the four quarters and report completion to the king.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l007.explanation: 四方既已平定，王国大致安定。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l007.segmentation: When the four sides are pacified, the royal domain is largely settled.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l008.explanation: 当时没有争乱，周王心中因而安宁。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l008.segmentation: In that time there was no strife, and the king's heart was at peace.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l009.segmentation: 江汉之浒，王命召虎：式辟四方，彻我疆土。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l009.explanation: 在江汉之滨，周王命令召虎：开辟四方，治理我疆土。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l009.segmentation: On the Jiang-Han shore the king commands Hu of Zhao: open the four quarters and govern our borders.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l010.explanation: 不是忧患也不是急难，王国来归附至极。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l010.segmentation: Neither affliction nor distress—the realm comes to its utmost order.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l011.explanation: 划分疆界、整理田亩，直到南海。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l011.segmentation: Demarcating fields and boundaries, even to the Southern Sea.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l012.explanation: 周王命令召虎：按时巡行、宣布王命。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l012.segmentation: The king commands Hu of Zhao: come round in season and proclaim the royal will.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l013.explanation: 文武受天命，召公是国家的栋梁。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l013.segmentation: Wen and Wu received the mandate; Duke of Zhao is the state's mainstay.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l014.explanation: 不要说我年幼，要效法召公那样。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l014.segmentation: Do not say I am young—be like Duke of Zhao.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l015.explanation: 开始敏于公事，因此赐你福禄。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l015.segmentation: Be diligent in public duty from the start, and so receive blessing from me.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l016.explanation: 赐你圭瓒，以及一卣黑黍鬯酒。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l016.segmentation: I grant you the jade libation vessel and one jar of black-millet fragrant wine.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l017.explanation: 祭告文德祖先，并赐山土田。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l017.segmentation: Report to the civil ancestors and bestow hills, land, and fields.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l018.segmentation: 于周受命，自召祖命，虎拜稽首：天子万年！
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l018.explanation: 在周室受封，承召祖之命，召虎叩头拜谢：愿天子万年！

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l018.segmentation: Receiving charge in Zhou, from Zhao's ancestral command—Hu kowtows: May the Son of Heaven live ten thousand years!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l019.explanation: 召虎叩头拜谢，称颂宣扬王的美善。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l019.segmentation: Hu kowtows and responds, praising and spreading the king's grace.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l020.explanation: 作召公之颂：愿天子万寿无疆！

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l020.segmentation: He composes a hymn to Duke of Zhao: May the Son of Heaven enjoy long life!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l021.segmentation: 明明天子，令闻不已，矢其文德，洽此四国。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l021.explanation: 光明睿智的天子，美名不绝，发扬文德，和洽四方之国。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-jianghan-l021.segmentation: Bright and wise is the Son of Heaven; his fair fame unceasing—he displays civil virtue and harmonizes the four realms.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l001.segmentation: 菀彼桑柔，其下侯旬，捋采其刘，瘼此下民。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l001.explanation: 茂盛柔嫩的桑树，其下遍生旬类植物；采捋已凋的桑叶，百姓因此受病。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l001.segmentation: Lush and tender mulberries; beneath them rank weeds grow—stripping the faded leaves, the common people are afflicted.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l002.explanation: 忧思不绝，仓皇悲戚填满心间。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l002.segmentation: My grief does not cease; panic and sorrow fill my breast.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l003.explanation: 那广大的苍天，难道不怜悯我吗？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l003.segmentation: O vast bright Heaven, will you not pity me?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l004.explanation: 四马雄健，旗帜随风翩飞。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l004.segmentation: The four steeds are strong; banners and pennants flutter in the wind.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l005.explanation: 祸乱生起不能平定，没有哪一个国家不危亡。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l005.segmentation: When disorder rises it is not pacified; no state escapes ruin.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l006.explanation: 百姓没有安宁，一齐遭受灾祸如同焚烬。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l006.segmentation: The people have no peace; together they meet disaster as if burned to ash.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l007.explanation: 唉，真可悲啊，国运如此频危。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l007.segmentation: Alas, how sad—the nation's course is so often perilous.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l008.explanation: 国运将尽资财，上天不再扶助我们。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l008.segmentation: The nation's step consumes its resources; Heaven no longer upholds us.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l009.explanation: 没有可止之处、可定之方，将要往哪里去？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l009.segmentation: There is nowhere to stop or settle—where shall we go?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l010.explanation: 君子实在在此，秉持心志而不争竞。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l010.segmentation: The noble man is truly here, holding his heart without strife.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l011.explanation: 是谁生出祸乱的阶梯，至今成为阻碍？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l011.segmentation: Who raised the steps of calamity that still block us today?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l012.explanation: 忧心深切，惦念我们的国土。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l012.segmentation: Deep is my worry; I think of our land and realm.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l013.explanation: 我生不逢时，正遇上天降怒。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l013.segmentation: I was born at an ill hour, meeting Heaven's raging wrath.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l014.explanation: 从西到东，没有可安定的地方。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l014.segmentation: From west to east there is no place to rest secure.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l015.explanation: 多遇我病痛之事，边境也极为危急。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l015.segmentation: I meet much sickness; our borders are sorely threatened.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l016.explanation: 谋划谨慎，乱局才得削减。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l016.segmentation: With careful counsel and prudence, disorder may be reduced.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l017.explanation: 告知你们忧虑体恤之道，教你们按序授爵。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l017.segmentation: I tell you how to care and show concern; I teach you to grant ranks in order.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l018.explanation: 谁能手执灼热之物，而不先用水洗濯？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l018.segmentation: Who can hold what is hot and not first wash his hands in water?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l019.explanation: 这样怎能行善，只会相与陷溺。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l019.segmentation: How then can they do good? They will drag one another into drowning.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l020.explanation: 像逆风而行，也实在很艰难。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l020.segmentation: Like walking against the wind—it is painfully hard.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l021.explanation: 百姓本有肃敬之心，却被小人说不逮。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l021.segmentation: The people have reverent hearts, yet petty men say they fall short.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l022.explanation: 他们好的是不事稼穑，役使百姓而代食其禄。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l022.segmentation: They love not farming but force the people to toil while they eat others' food.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l023.explanation: 稼穑才是宝贝，代食才是好吗？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l023.segmentation: Is not farming the treasure—how can living on others be good?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l024.explanation: 上天降下丧乱，欲灭我们所立的王。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l024.segmentation: Heaven sends ruin and chaos, destroying the king we set up.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l025.explanation: 又降下蟊贼，使稼穑尽受损害。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l025.segmentation: It sends blight and pests until the crops are all harmed.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l026.explanation: 可悲地痛惜中原，人民如赘疣般困穷荒芜。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l026.segmentation: Pity the central land—the people are like excrescences, destitute and waste.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l027.explanation: 没有一点力量，只能仰望苍天。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l027.segmentation: With no strength at all, we can only look up to Heaven.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l028.explanation: 只有这位惠爱的君主，是百姓所仰望的。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l028.segmentation: Only this gracious lord is whom the people look to.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l029.explanation: 他秉持心意、宣示善谋，考察慎选辅相。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l029.segmentation: He holds his heart, declares good counsel, and carefully chooses his ministers.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l030.explanation: 那些不顺之人，却独自自以为善。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l030.segmentation: Those who are perverse think themselves alone in the right.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l031.explanation: 自有私心，使百姓终至狂乱。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l031.segmentation: With private schemes they drive the people to madness.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l032.explanation: 望见林中的鹿群，众多而往来。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l032.segmentation: Looking at the deer in the wood—they throng and move about.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l033.explanation: 朋友已经进谗，不能彼此以善相待。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l033.segmentation: Friends have already slandered; they cannot treat one another with goodness.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l034.explanation: 古人也说：进退都处于困境。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l034.segmentation: Men also say: in advance or retreat one is trapped in a ravine.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l035.explanation: 这位圣人，远望能及百里。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l035.segmentation: This sage sees a hundred li ahead.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l036.explanation: 那个愚人，颠倒狂妄却自欢喜。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l036.segmentation: That fool turns things upside down in folly yet rejoices.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l037.explanation: 不是不能说话，为何如此畏忌？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l037.segmentation: It is not that he cannot speak—why then such fear and restraint?
