sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l038.explanation: 这位良人，不求进用也不求显达。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l038.segmentation: This good man neither seeks promotion nor presses forward.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l039.explanation: 那个忍心之人，却反复顾念坏人。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l039.segmentation: That hard-hearted one looks back again and again to the wicked.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l040.explanation: 百姓贪于乱政，宁愿忍受荼毒。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l040.segmentation: The people, greedy for disorder, would rather endure poison and pain.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l041.explanation: 大风有通路，有空阔的大谷。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l041.segmentation: The great wind has its tunnel; there is a hollow, wide valley.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l042.explanation: 这位良人，所作的是善道。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l042.segmentation: This good man acts in the way of goodness.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l043.explanation: 那个不顺之人，行于中途而玷污。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l043.segmentation: That perverse one walks mid-course and is stained with filth.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l044.explanation: 大风有通路，贪人败坏同类。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l044.segmentation: The great wind has its tunnel; the greedy ruin their kind.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l045.explanation: 听谄媚之言就应答，听忠直之言却如醉。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l045.segmentation: To flattery he responds; to honest speech he is as if drunk.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l046.explanation: 不用良善之人，反使我违背正道。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l046.segmentation: He will not use the good, and makes me turn against what is right.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l047.segmentation: 嗟尔朋友，予岂不知而作。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l047.explanation: 唉，你们这些朋友，我难道不知而妄作此诗？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l047.segmentation: Alas, you friends—do you think I compose this poem in ignorance?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l048.explanation: 像那飞虫，有时也会被射中捕获。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l048.segmentation: Like flying insects, at times they too are shot and taken.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l049.explanation: 既已暗中加害于你，反来对我怒斥。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l049.segmentation: Having secretly harmed you, they turn and blaze at me in anger.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l050.explanation: 百姓没有止境，只因小人善于背叛。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l050.segmentation: The people's woes have no limit—petty men excel at turning their backs.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l051.explanation: 对百姓不利，像云聚而不能成功。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l051.segmentation: They are no help to the people—like clouds that gather yet cannot achieve.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l052.explanation: 百姓邪僻，只因小人竞用力气。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l052.segmentation: The people go astray because petty men compete in brute force.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l053.explanation: 百姓尚未安定，小人却盗为寇。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l053.segmentation: The people are not yet settled, yet petty men steal and play robber.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l054.explanation: 小人说不可以，背后却善于骂人。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l054.segmentation: The petty man says it cannot be done, yet behind backs he curses well.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l055.explanation: 虽说不是针对你，我已经作了这首诗！

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-sangrou-l055.segmentation: Though you say it is not against you—I have already made this song for you!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l001.explanation: 崧岳是高大的山，其高峻直达天际。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l001.segmentation: Song is the lofty peak; its summit reaches to Heaven.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l002.explanation: 山岳降下神灵，生出了甫侯与申伯。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l002.segmentation: The mountain sends down its spirit and bears Fu and Shen.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l003.explanation: 申伯与甫侯，是周室的栋梁之臣。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l003.segmentation: Shen and Fu are the pillars and beams of Zhou.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l004.segmentation: The states of the four quarters come to shield the realm.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l005.segmentation: The four quarters receive the proclamation of royal rule.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l006.explanation: 勤勉不懈的申伯，周王继续委以重任。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l006.segmentation: Diligent and untiring is Shen Bo; the king entrusts him with ongoing tasks.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l007.explanation: 在邑在谢，成为南国的楷模。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l007.segmentation: In city and in Xie he becomes the model for the southern states.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l008.explanation: 周王命令召伯，确定申伯的居城。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l008.segmentation: The king commands Duke of Shao to fix the dwelling place of Shen Bo.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l009.explanation: 登临这南方之国，世世代代守其功业。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l009.segmentation: He takes up this southern land; generation after generation holds its merit.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l010.explanation: 周王命令申伯，治理这南方之国。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l010.segmentation: The king commands Shen Bo to govern this southern realm.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l011.explanation: 任用谢地之人，作为你的劳役。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l011.segmentation: Use the people of Xie as your labor and service.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l012.explanation: 周王命令召伯，整理申伯的土田。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l012.segmentation: The king commands Duke of Shao to survey Shen Bo's fields and lands.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l013.explanation: 周王命令太傅，迁移他的家臣。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l013.segmentation: The king commands the grand tutor to move his personal retainers.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l014.explanation: 申伯的功业，由召伯来营建。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l014.segmentation: Shen Bo's achievement is planned and built by Duke of Shao.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l015.explanation: 开始筑城，寝庙也已落成。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l015.segmentation: The city begins to rise; palace and temple are completed.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l016.explanation: 既成而高大，周王赏赐申伯。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l016.segmentation: When it stands grand and tall, the king rewards Shen Bo.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l017.explanation: 四马强健，马胸钩饰鲜明。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l017.segmentation: Four steeds are sturdy; hooked breast ornaments gleam bright.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l018.explanation: 周王遣送申伯，赐路车乘马。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l018.segmentation: The king sends Shen Bo forth with road chariot and team.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l019.explanation: 我为你择居，没有比南方更合适的。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l019.segmentation: I choose your dwelling—none is better than the southern land.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l020.explanation: 赐你大圭，作为你的宝器。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l020.segmentation: I grant you the great jade tablet as your treasure.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l021.explanation: 前去亲近王舅，保卫南方国土。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l021.segmentation: Go near as the king's uncle and guard the southern soil.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l022.explanation: 申伯信实勇迈，周王在郿地为他饯行。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l022.segmentation: Shen Bo is trustworthy and bold; the king feasts him farewell at Mei.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l023.explanation: 申伯返回南方，在谢地诚心安居。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l023.segmentation: Shen Bo returns south and dwells in Xie with sincere heart.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l024.explanation: 周王命令召伯，整理申伯的疆界。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l024.segmentation: The king commands Duke of Shao to demarcate Shen Bo's borders.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l025.explanation: 储积其粮，使他的行程更速。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l025.segmentation: Store up his grain so his journey may be swift.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l026.explanation: 申伯威仪雄壮，已经进入谢城。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l026.segmentation: Shen Bo is stately and strong; he has entered Xie.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l027.segmentation: Footmen and charioteers are many and at ease.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l028.explanation: 周邦都欢喜，国家有了良臣。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l028.segmentation: All Zhou rejoices—the realm has a fine support.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l029.segmentation: 不显申伯，王之元舅，文武是宪。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l029.explanation: 显赫的申伯，是周王的大舅，文武之道可为典范。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l029.segmentation: Illustrious Shen Bo—the king's chief uncle, a model of Wen and Wu's way.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l030.explanation: 申伯的德行，柔顺仁惠而且正直。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l030.segmentation: Shen Bo's virtue is gentle, kind, and upright.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l031.explanation: 安抚万邦，名声传于四方。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l031.segmentation: He soothes the myriad states; his fame reaches the four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l032.explanation: 尹吉甫作此颂诗，其诗宏大。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l032.segmentation: Ji Fu composed this hymn; the poem is grand indeed.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l033.explanation: 其风仪美好，用来赠送申伯。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-songgao-l033.segmentation: Its tone is fine and good—offered as gift to Shen Bo.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l001.explanation: 举止庄重、威仪美好，是品德的外在表现。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l001.segmentation: Dignified bearing and fine deportment are the outward signs of virtue.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l002.segmentation: 人亦有言：靡哲不愚，庶人之愚，亦职维疾。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l002.explanation: 人们也有这样的话：没有智者不装愚，平民的愚笨，也是由于急迫所致。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l002.segmentation: People say: no wise man fails to play the fool; the commoner's folly comes from pressing need.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l003.explanation: 智者的装愚，也是出于不得已。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l003.segmentation: The wise man's pretended folly likewise springs from necessity.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l004.explanation: 不要与人争竞，要让四方都来效法你。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l004.segmentation: Do not strive with others; let all quarters take you as their model.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l005.explanation: 有显著的德行，四方之国都会顺从。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l005.segmentation: Where conduct is clearly virtuous, the four quarters will follow.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l006.explanation: 宏大的谋略安定天命，向远方如星辰般昭示。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l006.segmentation: Grand counsel fixes Heaven's mandate and announces it afar like the stars.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l007.explanation: 敬慎而威仪，是百姓应遵循的准则。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l007.segmentation: Reverent care and dignified bearing are the people's standard.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l008.explanation: 问题就在今天，在政事中兴起迷乱。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l008.segmentation: The trouble lies in the present—confusion has risen in governance.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l009.explanation: 颠倒了德行，沉溺于酒色。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l009.segmentation: Virtue is overturned and drowned in wine.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l010.explanation: 你虽沉溺享乐而跟从，却不念继承先业。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l010.segmentation: Though you follow pleasure and revelry, you do not think of your inheritance.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l011.explanation: 不广求先王之道，不能共同明察刑法。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l011.segmentation: You do not widely seek the former kings' way, nor jointly clarify punishments.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l012.segmentation: 四皇天弗尚，如彼泉流，无沦胥以亡。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l012.explanation: 上天不再眷顾，像那泉水流淌，不要一起沉沦灭亡。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l012.segmentation: Heaven no longer favors you; like a spring's flow, do not all sink together to ruin.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l013.segmentation: 夙兴夜寐，洒扫庭内，维民之章。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l013.explanation: 早起晚睡，洒扫庭院，是百姓的表率。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l013.segmentation: Rise early and sleep late, sweep the courtyard—this is the people's model.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l014.segmentation: 修尔车马，弓矢戎兵，用戒戎作，用逷蛮方。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l014.explanation: 修整车马、弓矢和兵器，以戒备戎事，以远御蛮方。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l014.segmentation: Ready chariots, horses, bows, and arms—to guard against war and keep distant tribes at bay.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l015.segmentation: 质尔人民，谨尔侯度，用戒不虞。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l015.explanation: 质询你的人民，谨守侯国法度，以戒备意外。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l015.segmentation: Question your people, keep your marquisate's laws, and guard against the unforeseen.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l016.segmentation: 慎尔出话，敬尔威仪，无不柔嘉。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l016.explanation: 谨慎你的出言，敬重你的威仪，无不柔和美好。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l016.segmentation: Be careful in what you say, reverent in deportment—let all be gentle and good.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l017.explanation: 白圭上的污点，还可以磨掉；

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l017.segmentation: A flaw on a white jade tablet can still be polished away;

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l018.explanation: 这句话的污点，就无法挽回了！

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l018.segmentation: A flaw in such words cannot be undone!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l019.segmentation: 无易由言，无曰苟矣，莫扪朕舌，言不可逝矣。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l019.explanation: 不要轻易随口说话，不要说“姑且如此”，不要摸我的舌头，话一出口就收不回了。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l019.segmentation: Do not lightly speak your mind, do not say 'for now'; do not touch my tongue—words once spoken cannot be recalled.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l020.explanation: 没有话不得到回应，没有德不得到回报。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l020.segmentation: No word goes unanswered; no virtue goes unrewarded.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l021.explanation: 施惠于朋友，以及庶民小子。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l021.segmentation: Show kindness to friends and to common folk young and old.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l022.explanation: 子孙绵延不绝，万民无不承顺。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l022.segmentation: Descendants continue in unbroken line; all the people follow.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l023.segmentation: 视尔友君子，辑柔尔颜，不遐有愆。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l023.explanation: 看你们这些君子朋友，和颜悦色，就不会有大过。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l023.segmentation: Look to you, friends and gentlemen—keep gentle faces and you will not greatly err.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l024.segmentation: 相在尔室，尚不愧于屋漏。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l024.explanation: 在别人家里相处，也要在屋漏处无愧于心。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l024.segmentation: When together in another's house, still be unashamed even in the hidden corner.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l025.explanation: 不要说看不见，没人看见我。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l025.segmentation: Do not say 'it is not visible'—no one sees me.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l026.segmentation: 神之格思，不可度思，矧可射思！
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l026.explanation: 神明的到来，不可揣测，何况可以怠慢！

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l026.segmentation: When the spirits draw near, it cannot be measured—how much less can you be careless!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l027.segmentation: Cultivate your virtue—be good and be fine.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l028.explanation: 善慎你的举止，在仪容上不出差错。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l028.segmentation: Be good and careful in your conduct; do not fail in deportment.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l029.explanation: 不越分、不伤害，很少人不以之为准则。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l029.segmentation: Neither overstep nor harm—few will not take you as their model.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l030.explanation: 别人送我桃子，我回赠李子。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l030.segmentation: They throw me a peach; I repay with a plum.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l031.explanation: 那幼兽却长角，实在是惑乱小子。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l031.segmentation: That young beast yet grows horns—truly it misleads the youth.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l032.explanation: 柔木经染，要用丝绳缗系。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l032.segmentation: Soft wood once dyed must be bound with silken cord.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l033.explanation: 温和恭谨的人，是德行的根基。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l033.segmentation: The gentle and reverent person is the foundation of virtue.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l034.segmentation: 其维哲人，告之话言，顺德之行。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l034.explanation: 若是哲人，会告知善言，实行顺德之行。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l034.segmentation: If he is wise, tell him good words—he will walk in obedient virtue.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l035.explanation: 若是愚人，反而说我越分。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l035.segmentation: If he is a fool, he turns and calls me presumptuous.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l036.segmentation: The people each have their own hearts.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l037.segmentation: Alas, young man, you still do not know good from ill.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l038.explanation: 不是用手拉着你，是用言语指示事情。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l038.segmentation: It is not by hand I lead you—I show you matters in words.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l039.explanation: 不是当面命令你，是用话提点你的耳朵。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l039.segmentation: It is not face to face I command you—I lift your ear with words.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l040.explanation: 如果说还不懂，你也已经抱了孩子。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l040.segmentation: If you say you still do not know, you already hold a child in your arms.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l041.segmentation: 民之靡盈，谁夙知而莫成？
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l041.explanation: 人难道不能满盈吗？谁早知而竟不成？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l041.segmentation: Can people not be full? Who knew early yet failed to achieve?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l042.explanation: 昊天多么明察，我这一生却没有安乐。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l042.segmentation: Great Heaven is so clear; yet my life knows no joy.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l043.explanation: 看你糊里糊涂，我心凄惨。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l043.segmentation: Seeing you muddled, my heart is wretched.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l044.explanation: 教导你谆谆恳切，你听我却藐藐然。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l044.segmentation: I teach you earnestly; you listen to me with indifference.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l045.explanation: 不用来作教益，反而用来作暴虐。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l045.segmentation: You do not use it for instruction—you use it for cruelty.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l046.explanation: 如果说还不懂，你也已经老迈了。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l046.segmentation: If you say you still do not know, you are already old.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l047.explanation: 唉，小子，告诉你旧日的止境。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l047.segmentation: Alas, young man, I tell you the old limits.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l048.explanation: 听用我的谋划，或许没有大悔。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l048.segmentation: Listen and use my counsel—perhaps there will be no great regret.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l049.explanation: 上天正降艰难，说要丧失你的国家。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l049.segmentation: Heaven sends hardship; it is said your state will be lost.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l050.explanation: 取譬并不遥远，昊天没有差错。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l050.segmentation: The analogy is not far off; Great Heaven makes no mistake.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l051.explanation: 违背其德，使百姓大遭祸患。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yi-l051.segmentation: Turning from virtue brings great distress upon the people.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l001.explanation: 那银河多么广大，光明回转在天上。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l001.segmentation: How vast that Milky Way, turning bright in the sky.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l003.segmentation: What crime have the people of today committed?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l004.explanation: 上天降下丧乱，饥荒接连到来。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l004.segmentation: Heaven sends ruin; famine follows famine.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l005.explanation: 没有神不祭祀，没有牲礼不吝惜。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l005.segmentation: No spirit goes unhonored; no offering is spared.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l006.explanation: 圭璧都已用尽，难道没有听到我的祈祷？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l006.segmentation: Jade tablets and disks are all used up—does none hear my prayer?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l007.explanation: 旱情已经十分严重，热气蒸腾如虫虫作响。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l007.segmentation: The drought is already severe; the heat swells and seethes.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l008.explanation: 不停止禋祀，从郊祭到宗庙。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l008.segmentation: They do not cease the solemn rites—from the border sacrifice to the ancestral temple.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l009.explanation: 上下都献祭埋牲，没有神不尊崇。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l009.segmentation: Offerings above and below, burial sacrifices—no spirit goes unhonored.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l010.explanation: 后稷之神不能佑助，上帝也不降临。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l010.segmentation: Lord Millet cannot succor; High God does not draw near.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l011.explanation: 耗散败坏下土，难道只使我一人遭病？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l011.segmentation: The lower realm is wasted and ruined—does it afflict only me with sickness?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l012.explanation: 旱情已经十分严重，无法推却。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l012.segmentation: The drought is already severe—it cannot be pushed away.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l013.explanation: 兢兢业业，像雷霆一般令人震惧。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l013.segmentation: Diligent and fearful, like thunder and lightning.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l014.explanation: 周朝剩余的黎民，没有孑遗一人。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l014.segmentation: Of Zhou's remaining people, not one is left alone.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l015.explanation: 昊天上帝，也不留我一人。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l015.segmentation: Great Heaven, High God—you do not even leave me alive.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l016.segmentation: Why do we not fear one another?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l018.explanation: 旱情已经十分严重，无法阻止。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l018.segmentation: The drought is already severe—it cannot be stopped.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l019.explanation: 赫赫炎炎，说我没有容身之处。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l019.segmentation: Blazing and scorching—they say I have nowhere to go.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l020.explanation: 大命将近终结，无法瞻望无法顾念。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l020.segmentation: Great mandate nears its end—no looking ahead, no looking back.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l021.segmentation: The dukes and former worthies do not help me.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l022.explanation: 父母先祖，怎忍心这样待我？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l022.segmentation: Parents and forefathers—how can you bear to treat me so?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l023.explanation: 旱情已经十分严重，山川都干枯了。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l023.segmentation: The drought is already severe—mountains and streams are parched dry.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l024.explanation: 旱魃为虐，像火烧像焚烧。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l024.segmentation: The drought demon wreaks havoc, like smoldering and like burning.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l025.explanation: 我心畏惧暑热，忧心如熏。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l025.segmentation: My heart dreads the heat; my grief is like smothering smoke.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l026.explanation: 群公和先正，却不闻我的呼告。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l026.segmentation: The dukes and former worthies do not hear my cry.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l027.explanation: 昊天上帝，难道使我逃避吗？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l027.segmentation: Great Heaven, High God—would You have me flee?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l028.explanation: 旱情已经十分严重，勉力畏惧而离去。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l028.segmentation: The drought is already severe—I strive in fear to depart.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l029.segmentation: Why afflict me sick with drought?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l030.segmentation: Bitter pain, and I do not know the cause.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l031.explanation: 祈年祭很早就举行，方社之祭也不晚。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l031.segmentation: The prayer-for-harvest rite was held early; the earth-god rites were not late.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l032.explanation: 昊天上帝，却不顾念我们。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l032.segmentation: Great Heaven, High God—You do not consider us.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l033.explanation: 敬恭明神，本应没有悔恨和怒意。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l033.segmentation: Reverent to the bright spirits—there should be no regret or anger.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l034.explanation: 旱情已经十分严重，离散没有友伴纲纪。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l034.segmentation: The drought is already severe—scattered, without fellowship or order.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l035.explanation: 众正人穷究啊，冢宰也内疚啊。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l035.segmentation: The many upright ones investigate; the chief minister is troubled.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l036.explanation: 趣马、师氏、膳夫和左右近臣。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l036.segmentation: The horse master, the tutor, the steward, and attendants at hand.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l037.segmentation: No one fails to be thorough.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l038.segmentation: 无不能止，瞻卬昊天，云如何里！
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l038.explanation: 没有不能止息，仰望昊天，说这是什么道理！

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l038.segmentation: Nothing can stop it; I look up to Great Heaven—what is the reason!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l039.segmentation: I look up to Great Heaven; the stars shine bright.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l040.explanation: 大夫君子，昭告神明没有缺漏。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l040.segmentation: Great officers and gentlemen— their prayers to the spirits leave nothing wanting.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l041.explanation: 大命将近终结，不要放弃你的功业。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l041.segmentation: Great mandate nears its end—do not abandon your achievements.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l042.segmentation: What more do you ask of me?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l043.segmentation: To settle the many upright officers.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l044.explanation: 仰望昊天，何时赐我们安宁？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-yunhan-l044.segmentation: I look up to Great Heaven—when will You grant us peace?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l001.explanation: 仰望昊天，却不施惠于我。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l001.segmentation: I look up to Great Heaven, yet You show me no kindness.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l002.explanation: 天下很不安宁，降下这场大祸。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l002.segmentation: The realm is deeply unsettled; this great calamity has descended.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l003.explanation: 国家没有安定，士民都病弱。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l003.segmentation: The state has no stability; gentry and commoners are afflicted.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l004.explanation: 蟊贼为害，没有平息的尽头。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l004.segmentation: Grain pests and blights—there is no end to their ravage.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l005.explanation: 罪网不收，没有痊愈之时。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l005.segmentation: The net of guilt is not drawn in; there is no time of healing.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l006.explanation: 别人有土田，你却反而占有。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l006.segmentation: Others have fields and lands—you seize them instead.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l007.explanation: 别人有人民，你却反而夺去。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l007.segmentation: Others have subjects—you snatch them away.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l008.explanation: 此人本应无罪，你却反而收捕他。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l008.segmentation: This man should be guiltless—you arrest him instead.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l009.explanation: 那人本应有罪，你却反而释放他。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l009.segmentation: That man should be guilty—you release him instead.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l010.explanation: 明智的男子筑城，明智的女子倾覆城邦。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l010.segmentation: A wise man builds the city; a wise woman overturns the state.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l011.explanation: 那美善而多智的妇人，实为枭鸱之类。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l011.segmentation: That fine and clever woman is an owl and kite in truth.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l012.explanation: 妇人长舌多语，是大祸的阶梯。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l012.segmentation: A woman's long tongue is the stairway to great disaster.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l013.explanation: 祸乱不是从天而降，是生自妇人。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l013.segmentation: Chaos does not fall from Heaven—it is born of women.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l014.explanation: 不是教不是诲，只是妇寺在左右。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l014.segmentation: Not teaching, not guiding—only women and eunuchs at the side.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l015.segmentation: Those who judge are cruel and perverse.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l016.segmentation: When slander begins, all vie to turn against one another.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l017.segmentation: Can one say there is no limit?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l019.explanation: 像商人三倍之利，君子能识别。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l019.segmentation: Like a merchant's triple profit—the gentleman sees through it.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l020.explanation: 妇人不管公事，应休其蚕织之职。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l020.segmentation: Women have no public business—they should leave off silk and weaving.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l022.segmentation: Which spirit does not enrich and bless?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l023.explanation: 舍弃你那大敌，只忌恨我一人。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l023.segmentation: You abandon your great foe and hate only me.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l024.explanation: 不吊唁不祥，威仪不像样子。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l024.segmentation: No comfort for misfortune; deportment is no longer proper.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l025.explanation: 人们说国家将亡，邦国濒于殄瘁。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l025.segmentation: People say the state will perish; the realm is near exhaustion.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l026.explanation: 上天降下罗网，其势已很优厚（广布）。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l026.segmentation: Heaven casts its net—the spread is already wide.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l027.explanation: 人们说国家将亡，我心中忧愁。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l027.segmentation: People say the state will perish; my heart is full of care.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l028.explanation: 上天降下罗网，其势已很迫近。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l028.segmentation: Heaven casts its net—the danger is already near.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l029.explanation: 人们说国家将亡，我心中悲伤。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l029.segmentation: People say the state will perish; my heart is full of grief.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l030.segmentation: The spring in the enclosure boils because it is deep.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l031.explanation: 心中的忧愁，难道从今天才开始吗？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l031.segmentation: The heart's sorrow—did it only begin today?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l032.explanation: 不是在我之前，不是在我之后。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l032.segmentation: It was not before me, nor after me alone.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l033.explanation: 高远昊天，没有什么不能巩固。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l033.segmentation: Remote Great Heaven—nothing cannot be secured.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l034.explanation: 不要辱没皇祖，用以拯救你的后代。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhanang-l034.segmentation: Do not disgrace your royal ancestors—save your descendants thereby.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l001.explanation: 旻天威怒，上天厚降丧乱。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l001.segmentation: Min Heaven is fierce; High Heaven heavily sends ruin.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l002.explanation: 使我遭饥荒，民众终至流亡。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l002.segmentation: It afflicts me with famine; the people at last flee and wander.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l003.explanation: 我居守的疆域终于荒芜。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l003.segmentation: The domain I guard is finally waste and wild.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l004.segmentation: Heaven lowers the net of guilt; pests riot within.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l005.segmentation: 昏椓靡共，溃溃回遹，实靖夷我邦。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l005.explanation: 昏乱之臣不能共事，溃散回遹，实在要安定而倾覆我邦。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l005.segmentation: Dark ministers cannot cooperate; they scatter and turn back— truly they would pacify yet overthrow our state.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l006.explanation: 傲慢又多言，竟不知自己的污点。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l006.segmentation: Arrogant and babbling—they never know their own stains.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l007.segmentation: 兢兢业业，孔填不宁，我位孔贬。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l007.explanation: 兢兢业业，天下很不安宁，我的职位大被贬损。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l007.segmentation: Diligent and careful—the realm is deeply unsettled; my office is greatly diminished.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l008.segmentation: 如彼岁旱，草不溃茂，如彼栖苴。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l008.explanation: 像那年大旱，草不能茂盛生长，像那枯草栖止。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l008.segmentation: Like the year of great drought when grass cannot flourish—like stubble where nothing thrives.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l009.explanation: 我看这个邦国，没有不溃败而止的。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l009.segmentation: I look on this state—nothing fails to collapse and stop.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l010.segmentation: 维昔之富不如时，维今之疚不如兹。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l010.explanation: 往昔的富庶不如当时，如今的病痛不如此刻。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l010.segmentation: Past wealth was not like then; present affliction is not like now.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l011.explanation: 他们粗疏却享精粺，为何不自行引退？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l011.segmentation: They are careless yet eat fine grain—why do they not withdraw themselves?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l012.segmentation: Only elder brothers draw them on.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l013.explanation: 池塘干涸了，不是自频繁使用而竭？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l013.segmentation: The pool is dry—is it not from constant draining?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l014.explanation: 泉水干涸了，不是自中心而竭？

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l014.segmentation: The spring is dry—is it not from the center itself?

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l015.segmentation: 溥斯害矣，职兄斯弘，不灾我躬。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l015.explanation: 灾害如此广大，只是兄长在扩大，灾祸不独及我一身。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l015.segmentation: Harm is so wide—elder brothers enlarge it; disaster does not fall on me alone.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l016.segmentation: 昔先王受命，有如召公，日辟国百里，今也日蹙国百里。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l016.explanation: 从前先王受命，有像召公那样的人，日日开拓国土百里；如今却日日缩小国土百里。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l016.segmentation: Former kings received the mandate; men like Duke Shao opened a hundred li daily—now a hundred li shrink each day.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l018.explanation: 如今的人，还不崇尚旧德！

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhaomin-l018.segmentation: People today—do they not still honor the old virtue!

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l001.segmentation: Heaven born the multitude—there are things and there are norms.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l002.explanation: 民众所秉常性，是喜好美德。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l002.segmentation: What the people constantly hold is love of fine virtue.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l003.explanation: 上天监察有周，昭明降临于下。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l003.segmentation: Heaven watches over Zhou; its brightness descends below.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l004.segmentation: To guard this Son of Heaven, Zhong Shanfu was born.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l005.explanation: 仲山甫的德行，柔和美好为准则。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l005.segmentation: Zhong Shanfu's virtue—gentle goodness is his standard.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l010.explanation: 效法天子，明命使之赋政。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l010.segmentation: He follows the Son of Heaven; clear mandate assigns him governance.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l011.segmentation: 王命仲山甫，式是百辟，缵戎祖考，王躬是保。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l011.explanation: 王命仲山甫，为百辟之表率，继承戎祖考，保卫王躬。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l011.segmentation: The king charges Zhong Shanfu to be model for the hundred ministers, continue his martial forefathers, and guard the king's person.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l012.segmentation: He conveys the king's commands—he is the king's voice.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l013.explanation: 在外施政，四方因而发令。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l013.segmentation: He administers abroad; the four quarters thereby receive orders.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l014.explanation: 严肃的王命，仲山甫奉持而行。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l014.segmentation: Solemn royal commands—Zhong Shanfu carries them out.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l015.explanation: 邦国好坏，仲山甫能辨明。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l015.segmentation: Whether states thrive or fail—Zhong Shanfu discerns it.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l016.explanation: 既明察又智慧，以保全自身。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l016.segmentation: Clear-sighted and wise, he preserves himself.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l017.explanation: 早晚不懈，以事奉君王一人。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l017.segmentation: Morning and night without slackness, he serves the one king.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l018.segmentation: 人亦有言，柔则茹之，刚则吐之。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l018.explanation: 人们也说：软的就吞下去，硬的就吐出来。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l018.segmentation: People also say: swallow what is soft, spit out what is hard.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l019.segmentation: 维仲山甫，柔亦不茹，刚亦不吐。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l019.explanation: 只有仲山甫，柔的不吞，硬的不吐。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l019.segmentation: Only Zhong Shanfu—soft he does not swallow, hard he does not spit.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l020.segmentation: He does not bully widows and orphans, nor fear the strong and violent.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l021.segmentation: 人亦有言，德輶如毛，民鲜克举之。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l021.explanation: 人们也说：德行轻如毛，民众很少能举起来。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l021.segmentation: People also say: virtue is light as a feather—few can lift it.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l022.segmentation: 我仪图之，维仲山甫举之。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l022.explanation: 我思量这件事，只有仲山甫能举之。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l022.segmentation: I consider it—only Zhong Shanfu can raise it.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l023.segmentation: Beloved, yet none can help him.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l024.segmentation: 衮职有阙，维仲山甫补之。
sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l024.explanation: 天子衮衣有缺，只有仲山甫能补。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l024.segmentation: Where the king's robe lacks, only Zhong Shanfu can mend.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l025.segmentation: Zhong Shanfu sets out; they sacrifice and see him off.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l027.explanation: 征夫敏捷，每怀来不及之感。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l027.segmentation: The travelers are swift; each feels he cannot do enough.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l028.segmentation: Four horses gallop; eight bells ring clear.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l029.explanation: 王命仲山甫，筑城于东方。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l029.segmentation: The king charges Zhong Shanfu to build the city in the east.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l030.segmentation: Four horses prance; eight bells chime softly.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l031.explanation: 仲山甫往齐，应速速归来。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l031.segmentation: Zhong Shanfu goes to Qi—may he quickly return.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l032.explanation: 吉甫作此颂诗，和美如清风。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l032.segmentation: Jifu composed this ode—graceful as a clear breeze.

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l033.explanation: 仲山甫永怀德业，以慰其心。

sj-ya-daya-dangzhishen-zhengmin-l033.segmentation: Zhong Shanfu ever cherishes virtue—to comfort his heart.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l001.explanation: 上帝邪僻，下民终于病苦。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l001.segmentation: High God is perverse; the people at last fall ill.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l002.explanation: 说出的话不对，作为犹不算远。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l002.segmentation: Words spoken are not true; conduct is not yet far gone.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l003.segmentation: No sage, yet all is confusion.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l005.explanation: 祸犹未远，因此大力进谏。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l005.segmentation: Disaster is not yet far—therefore I strongly remonstrate.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l006.explanation: 上天正降难，不要那么高兴自得。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l006.segmentation: Heaven sends hardship—do not be so gleeful and pleased.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l007.explanation: 上天正颠覆，不要那么轻慢泄泄。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l007.segmentation: Heaven is overturning—do not be so lax and dismissive.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l008.explanation: 言辞和顺了，民众就和洽了。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l008.segmentation: When words are harmonious, the people are united.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l009.explanation: 言辞悦乐了，民众就归附了。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l009.segmentation: When words delight, the people attach to you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l010.explanation: 我虽事不同，却与你同僚。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l010.segmentation: Though my duties differ, I am your colleague.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l011.explanation: 我到你那里谋划，听我说话却嚣嚣不服。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l011.segmentation: I come to counsel with you—you listen yet clamor and refuse.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l012.explanation: 我的话有理，不要当作笑话。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l012.segmentation: My words have reason—do not take them for jest.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l013.segmentation: The ancients said: inquire even of the firewood gatherer.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l014.explanation: 上天正降虐，不要那么戏谑。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l014.segmentation: Heaven sends affliction—do not be so mocking.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l015.segmentation: The old man is muddled; the youth is arrogant.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l016.explanation: 不是我说老，是你用来忧而戏之。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l016.segmentation: It is not that I speak as an old man—you use worry for sport.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l020.explanation: 威仪终于迷乱，善人载尸而行。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l020.segmentation: Deportment ends in confusion; good men bear corpses.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l021.segmentation: 民之方殿屎，则莫我敢葵？
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l021.explanation: 民众正遭祸，谁还敢向我示好？

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l021.segmentation: The people suffer disaster—who dares show me favor?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l022.explanation: 丧乱无资，竟不施惠于我师？

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l022.segmentation: In ruin there is no means—will you not show kindness to my mentor?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l023.segmentation: 天之牖民，如埙如篪，如璋如圭，如取如携。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l023.explanation: 上天诱导民众，如埙如篪，如璋如圭，如取如携。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l023.segmentation: Heaven guides the people—as xun and chi, as scepter and tablet, as taking and as leading.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l024.explanation: 携民不要说有益，诱导民众很容易。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l024.segmentation: In leading the people do not say it profits you—guiding the people is very easy.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l025.explanation: 民众多邪僻，不要自己立邪僻。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l025.segmentation: The people are much perverse—do not yourself establish perversity.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l026.segmentation: 价人维藩，大师维垣，大邦维屏，大宗维翰，
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l026.explanation: 价人如藩屏，大师如垣墙，大邦如屏障，大宗如翰辅，

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l026.segmentation: Good men are hedges; the grand master is a wall; great states are screens; the royal clan are pillars,

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l027.explanation: 怀德则安宁，宗子如城墙。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l027.segmentation: Cherish virtue and there is peace; clan sons are like city walls.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l028.explanation: 不要使城墙毁坏，不要独自畏惧。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l028.segmentation: Do not let the wall crumble; do not fear alone.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l029.segmentation: Revere Heaven's anger—dare not play and take ease.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l030.segmentation: Revere Heaven's changes—dare not gallop recklessly.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l031.segmentation: Great Heaven is bright—it reaches you when you go forth as king.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-ban-l032.segmentation: Great Heaven is dawn—it reaches you when you wander abroad.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l001.segmentation: 凫鹥在泾，公尸在燕来宁。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l001.explanation: 野鸭大雁在泾水，公尸燕饮来安宁。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l001.segmentation: Wild ducks and geese on the Jing—the lord's corpse feasts and comes to peace.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l002.explanation: 你的酒已清，你的肴已香。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l002.segmentation: Your wine is clear; your dishes fragrant.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l003.segmentation: The lord's corpse feasts—blessing and rank come to fulfillment.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l004.segmentation: 凫鹥在沙，公尸来燕来宜。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l004.explanation: 野鸭大雁在沙洲，公尸来燕饮很适宜。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l004.segmentation: Wild ducks and geese on the sandbar—the lord's corpse comes to feast, fit and right.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l005.explanation: 你的酒已多，你的肴已美。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l005.segmentation: Your wine is plentiful; your dishes fine.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l006.segmentation: The lord's corpse feasts—blessing and rank come to aid.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l007.segmentation: 凫鹥在渚，公尸来燕来处。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l007.explanation: 野鸭大雁在小洲，公尸来燕饮来安居。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l007.segmentation: Wild ducks and geese on the islet—the lord's corpse comes to feast and dwell at ease.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l008.explanation: 你的酒已浓，你的肴是干肉。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l008.segmentation: Your wine is rich; your meat is dried.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l009.segmentation: The lord's corpse feasts—blessing and rank descend.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l010.segmentation: 凫鹥在潀，公尸来燕来宗，既燕于宗，福禄攸降。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l010.explanation: 野鸭大雁在潨水，公尸来燕饮来宗祭，既燕于宗庙，福禄就降下。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l010.segmentation: Wild ducks and geese at the confluence—the lord's corpse comes to feast and honor the ancestors; having feasted at the temple, blessing and rank descend.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l011.segmentation: The lord's corpse feasts—blessing and rank come in abundance.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l012.segmentation: 凫鹥在亹，公尸来止熏熏。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l012.explanation: 野鸭大雁在弯曲处，公尸来止而和乐熏熏。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l012.segmentation: Wild ducks and geese in the winding reach—the lord's corpse comes to rest, harmonious and warm.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l013.segmentation: Fine wine rejoices; roasted meat is fragrant.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-fuyi-l014.segmentation: The lord's corpse feasts—no hardship afterward.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l001.explanation: 忠厚笃实的公刘，不安于旧居、不图安逸。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l001.segmentation: Steadfast Lord Liu would not settle idly or seek ease alone.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l002.explanation: 于是划分田界、划定疆土，积聚粮食、修建粮仓。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l002.segmentation: He marked fields and borders, piled up grain, and built storehouses.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l003.explanation: 又包备好干粮，装在口袋和行囊里。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l003.segmentation: He packed dry provisions into bags and sacks for the journey.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l004.explanation: 想使百姓和睦而光大邦国，张弓搭箭。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l004.segmentation: He sought to unite the people and brighten the realm; bows and arrows were strung.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l005.explanation: 盾牌、戈矛、斧钺齐备，于是才出发迁徙。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l005.segmentation: With shields, spears, axes, and halberds ready, they set out on the move.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l006.explanation: 忠厚笃实的公刘，来到那高广的原野。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l006.segmentation: Steadfast Lord Liu came to the broad high plain.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l007.segmentation: 既庶既繁，既顺乃宣，而无永叹。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l007.explanation: 人口既多又繁，既顺服又宣导，不再长久叹息。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l007.segmentation: The people grew numerous and orderly; they were guided and no longer sighed in grief.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l008.segmentation: When he climbed, he stood upon the hilltops,

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l009.segmentation: and when he came down, he walked the low plains.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l010.explanation: 用什么来显示他的尊贵？

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l010.segmentation: What showed his rank and dignity?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l011.explanation: 是美玉和瑶石，还有佩刀装在鞞琫之中。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l011.segmentation: Jade and fine stones, and a knife in its scabbard and mount.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l012.explanation: 忠厚笃实的公刘，前往那百泉汇聚之处。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l012.segmentation: Steadfast Lord Liu went to where the hundred springs gathered.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l013.explanation: 远望那广阔的原野，又登上南面的山冈。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l013.segmentation: He gazed at the wide plain and climbed the southern ridge.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l014.explanation: 于是在京地相遇，就在京师的郊野。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l014.segmentation: There he met them at Jing, in the outskirts of the capital site.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l015.segmentation: 于时处处，于时庐旅，于时言言，于时语语。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l015.explanation: 这时有人定居，有人搭棚寄旅，有人谈笑，有人语论。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l015.segmentation: Some settled, some lodged in shelters, some chatted lightly, some talked at length.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l016.explanation: 忠厚笃实的公刘，在京地安顿下来。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l016.segmentation: Steadfast Lord Liu took his rest at Jing.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l017.explanation: 仪态庄重、行列整齐，摆好筵席、安放几案。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l017.segmentation: With dignified bearing and ordered ranks, he spread feasts and set out tables.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l018.explanation: 登席就座，又依次会见各宗族。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l018.segmentation: They took their seats, then he visited each clan in turn.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l019.explanation: 在牢中捉猪，用匏瓢酌酒。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l019.segmentation: Pigs were taken from the pen; wine was poured from gourd cups.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l020.explanation: 请大家吃喝，以君长之礼尊奉宗族。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l020.segmentation: All ate and drank as he honored the clans as their lord.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l021.explanation: 忠厚笃实的公刘，所居之地既广又长。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l021.segmentation: Steadfast Lord Liu's domain was wide and long.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l022.segmentation: 既景乃冈，相其阴阳，观其流泉。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l022.explanation: 观察日影定冈陵，察看阴阳向背，又看泉水的流势。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l022.segmentation: He read the sun's shadow on hills, noted yin and yang slopes, and watched flowing springs.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l023.segmentation: The army was divided into three detachments,

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l025.explanation: 开垦田地以产粮，又量度向西的夕阳之地。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l025.segmentation: Fields were opened for grain; the western lands toward the setting sun were surveyed.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l026.explanation: 在豳地定居，确实开辟得广大。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l026.segmentation: They settled at Bin and truly opened a vast territory.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l027.explanation: 忠厚笃实的公刘，在豳地建馆舍。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l027.segmentation: Steadfast Lord Liu built lodges at Bin.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l028.segmentation: 涉渭为乱，取厉取锻，止基乃理。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l028.explanation: 渡渭水取石料，取磨刀石，奠定基址而治理土地。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l028.segmentation: They crossed the Wei for stone, fetched whetstones, laid foundations, and ordered the land.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l029.segmentation: The people were many and growing,

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l030.segmentation: dwelling along both banks of the Huang stream.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l031.segmentation: They also went upstream along the Guo stream.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l032.explanation: 旅人停住而聚居稠密，就靠近芮、鞫一带。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-gongliu-l032.segmentation: Travelers settled thickly together, drawing near the Rui and Ju region.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l001.segmentation: 假乐君子，显显令德，宜民宜人。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l001.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，德行显明，使百姓各得其所、各安其位。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l001.segmentation: The gracious lord's bright virtue suits the people and fits each to his place.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l002.segmentation: 受禄于天，保右命之，自天申之。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l002.explanation: 从天接受福禄，上天保佑并命定他，福禄皆由天申赐。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l002.segmentation: He receives blessing from Heaven; Heaven protects, appoints, and bestows it upon him.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l003.explanation: 千种福禄、百种吉祥，子孙将繁衍至千亿。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l003.segmentation: A thousand blessings, a hundred fortunes—descendants beyond count.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l004.explanation: 仪态穆穆、威仪皇皇，宜于为君、宜于为王。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l004.segmentation: Solemn and majestic in bearing, fit to be lord and fit to be king.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l005.explanation: 不有过失、不遗忘先王，一切遵循旧有的典章。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l005.segmentation: Without fault or forgetfulness, he follows the ancient statutes.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l006.explanation: 威仪抑抑而谨严，德音秩秩而有序。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l006.segmentation: His bearing is restrained and dignified; his virtuous fame is orderly.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l007.explanation: 既无怨恨也无憎恶，皆能率导群贤同侶。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l007.segmentation: Without resentment or hatred, he leads his worthy companions.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l008.explanation: 所受之福无穷无尽，是四方之纲纪。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l008.segmentation: Boundless blessing is his; he is the model for all four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l009.explanation: 以纲纪天下，又使燕乐及于朋友。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l009.segmentation: As the world's standard, he brings ease and joy even to friends.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l010.explanation: 百辟与卿士，皆向天子献媚尽忠。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l010.segmentation: The feudal lords and ministers all show devotion to the Son of Heaven.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l011.explanation: 不懈于职守，是百姓所仰赖的安乐。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiale-l011.segmentation: Unwearying in office, he is the people's source of peace.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo-l00.segmentation: 泂酌彼行潦，挹彼注兹，可以餴饎。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo-l00.explanation: 从远地的水洼中舀水，倾注到此，可以用来淘洗米、做饭。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo-l00.segmentation: Draw from distant roadside pools, pour here—fit to rinse grain and cook food.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo-l00.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，正是百姓的父母。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo-l00.segmentation: The gracious lord is truly the parent of the people.
泂酌彼行潦，挹彼注兹，可以濯罍。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo-l00.explanation: 从远地的水洼中舀水，倾注到此，可以用来洗涤酒器。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo-l00.segmentation: Draw from distant pools, pour here—fit to wash the wine vessels.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo-l00.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，是百姓所归向的人。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo-l00.segmentation: The gracious lord is where the people turn for refuge.
泂酌彼行潦，挹彼注兹，可以濯溉。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo-l00.explanation: 从远地的水洼中舀水，倾注到此，可以用来洗涤各种器具。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo-l00.segmentation: Draw from distant pools, pour here—fit to cleanse all utensils.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo-l00.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，是百姓所依赖安居者。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jiongzhuo-l00.segmentation: The gracious lord is the one on whom the people rely for rest.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l001.explanation: 既以美酒使君醉，又以美德使君饱足。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l001.segmentation: They have drunk their fill of wine and been nourished by virtue.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l002.explanation: 愿君子万年长寿，大大赐你景福。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l002.segmentation: May the lord live ten thousand years—great blessing be granted you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l003.explanation: 既以美酒使君醉，你的肴馔也已齐备。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l003.segmentation: They have drunk their fill; your dishes are all ready.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l004.explanation: 愿君子万年长寿，大大赐你昭明之福。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l004.segmentation: May the lord live ten thousand years—bright blessing be granted you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l005.segmentation: 昭明有融，高朗令终，令终有俶。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l005.explanation: 昭明之德融会贯通，高明而善终，善始而又有后继。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l005.segmentation: Bright virtue merges and flows; noble ending with a fine beginning to follow.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l006.explanation: 尸官于是致美善的祝告。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l006.segmentation: The impersonator of the dead now speaks the good blessing.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l008.explanation: 笾豆中的祭品洁净而美好。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l008.segmentation: The offerings in baskets and stands are pure and fine.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l009.explanation: 朋友相佐助，以威仪相辅助。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l009.segmentation: Friends assist one another and uphold each other in proper ritual bearing.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l010.explanation: 威仪非常合宜，君子有孝子之德。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l010.segmentation: The ceremony is perfectly ordered; the lord has filial sons.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l011.explanation: 孝子之德不会匮乏，永远赐福于你的同类。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l011.segmentation: Filial virtue never fails; blessing forever extends to your kind.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l013.segmentation: The blessing within household and family.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l014.explanation: 愿君子万年长寿，永远赐你福祚子孙。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l014.segmentation: May the lord live ten thousand years—may fortune and heirs be yours forever.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l016.segmentation: Heaven's covering gift of blessing and rank.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l017.explanation: 愿君子万年长寿，大命之下有仆从相承。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l017.segmentation: May the lord live ten thousand years—under great mandate, servants follow in succession.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l020.explanation: 赐你贤善的女子，从而生养孙子。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-jizui-l020.segmentation: Grant worthy ladies, that they may bear grandsons for you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l001.explanation: 有曲长的山阿，旋风从南方吹来。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l001.segmentation: A winding hill slope; a gusty wind blows from the south.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l002.segmentation: 岂弟君子，来游来歌，以矢其音。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l002.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，来游息、来歌唱，以发抒心声。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l002.segmentation: The gracious lord comes to roam and sing, giving voice to his heart.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l003.segmentation: 伴奂尔游矣，优游尔休矣。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l003.explanation: 伴你遨游而光大，伴你优游而休息。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l003.segmentation: He brightens your roaming and grants you leisure and rest.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l004.segmentation: 岂弟君子，俾尔弥尔性，似先公酋矣。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l004.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，使你完全顺遂本性，像先代贤君一样。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l004.segmentation: The gracious lord lets you fulfill your nature, like the ancient chiefs of old.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l005.segmentation: 尔土宇昄章，亦孔之厚矣。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l005.explanation: 你的国土广大而有章法，也非常深厚。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l005.segmentation: Your domain is broad and well ordered, and very deep in foundation.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l006.segmentation: 岂弟君子，俾尔弥尔性，百神尔主矣。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l006.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，使你完全顺遂本性，百神都为你做主。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l006.segmentation: The gracious lord lets you fulfill your nature; the hundred spirits stand with you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l007.segmentation: 尔受命长矣，茀禄尔康矣。
Long is your mandate; blessing and peace are yours.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l008.segmentation: 岂弟君子，俾尔弥尔性，纯嘏尔常矣。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l008.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，使你完全顺遂本性，纯厚之福常在你身。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l008.segmentation: The gracious lord lets you fulfill your nature; pure blessing stays with you always.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l009.segmentation: 有冯有翼，有孝有德，以引以翼。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l009.explanation: 有凭依、有辅助，有孝心、有德行，引道你、翼护你。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l009.segmentation: With support and aid, with filial piety and virtue, they guide and shelter you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l010.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，是四方的表率。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l010.segmentation: The gracious lord is the model for all four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l011.segmentation: 颙颙卬卬，如圭如璋，令闻令望。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l011.explanation: 仪态端正、气宇轩昂，如圭如璋，美名远播。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l011.segmentation: Upright and lofty in bearing, like jade scepters— famed and hoped for afar.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l012.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，是四方的纲纪。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l012.segmentation: The gracious lord is the standard for all four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l013.segmentation: 凤凰于飞，翙翙其羽，亦集爰止。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l013.explanation: 凤凰飞翔，羽翼翙翙，也停落在此。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l013.segmentation: The phoenix flies, wings fluttering, and alights here as well.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l014.segmentation: 蔼蔼王多吉士，维君子使，媚于天子。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l014.explanation: 众多贤士辅佐周王，由君子差遣，向天子尽忠。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l014.segmentation: Many worthy men serve the king; the lord sends them to please the Son of Heaven.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l015.segmentation: 凤凰于飞，翙翙其羽，亦傅于天。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l015.explanation: 凤凰飞翔，羽翼翙翙，也附于上天。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l015.segmentation: The phoenix flies, wings fluttering, rising toward Heaven.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l016.segmentation: 蔼蔼王多吉人，维君子命，媚于庶人。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l016.explanation: 众多贤人辅佐周王，由君子任命，使庶人悦服。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l016.segmentation: Many good men serve the king; the lord appoints them to win the common people's trust.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l017.explanation: 凤凰鸣叫，在那高冈之上。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l017.segmentation: The phoenix calls upon the high hill.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l018.explanation: 梧桐生长，在那朝阳之侧。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l018.segmentation: The parasol tree grows on the sunny slope.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l019.segmentation: Leaves lush and branches thick; harmonious cries ring clear.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l020.segmentation: The lord's chariots are many and ample.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l021.explanation: 君子的马匹，既熟练又善驰。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l021.segmentation: The lord's horses are trained and swift.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l022.explanation: 所献之诗不多，只是用来完成歌咏。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-juana-l022.segmentation: The poems offered are not many—just enough to complete the song.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l001.explanation: 百姓也已劳顿，差不多可以稍得小康。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l001.segmentation: The people are weary; they may now reach a little ease.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l002.explanation: 施恩于此中原各国，以安抚四方。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l002.segmentation: Show kindness to the central states and pacify the four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l003.explanation: 不要放纵狡诈之徒，以防范无良之人。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l003.segmentation: Do not indulge the deceitful; guard against the unworthy.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l004.explanation: 要遏止寇虐，使恶人不敢藐视明法。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l004.segmentation: Restrain robbery and cruelty so evildoers dare not scorn the law.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l005.explanation: 安抚远方、亲善近邻，以安定我周之王。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l005.segmentation: Soothe the far and cherish the near, to secure our king's throne.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l006.explanation: 百姓也已劳顿，差不多可以稍得休息。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l006.segmentation: The people are weary; they may now rest a little.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l007.explanation: 施恩于此中原各国，以聚民为归依。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l007.segmentation: Show kindness to the central states and gather the people to you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l008.explanation: 不要放纵狡诈之徒，以防范惑乱人心者。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l008.segmentation: Do not indulge the deceitful; guard against those who stir confusion.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l009.explanation: 要遏止寇虐，勿使百姓忧愁。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l009.segmentation: Restrain robbery and cruelty; do not let the people grieve.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l010.explanation: 不要抛弃你的劳绩，以成王事之休美。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l010.segmentation: Do not cast away your achievements; let the king's work reach its good end.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l011.explanation: 百姓也已劳顿，差不多可以稍得喘息。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l011.segmentation: The people are weary; they may now breathe a little.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l012.explanation: 施恩于此京师，以安抚四国。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l012.segmentation: Show kindness to the capital and pacify the four states.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l013.explanation: 不要放纵狡诈之徒，以防范无穷之网。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l013.segmentation: Do not indulge the deceitful; guard against boundless snares.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l014.explanation: 要遏止寇虐，勿使造作恶事。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l014.segmentation: Restrain robbery and cruelty; do not let evil deeds be done.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l015.explanation: 敬慎威仪，以亲近有德之人。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l015.segmentation: Be reverent in bearing and draw near to the virtuous.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l016.explanation: 百姓也已劳顿，差不多可以稍得歇息。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l016.segmentation: The people are weary; they may now pause a little.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l017.explanation: 施恩于此中原各国，使百姓忧苦得以宣泄。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l017.segmentation: Show kindness to the central states and let the people's woes drain away.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l018.explanation: 不要放纵狡诈之徒，以防范丑恶祸害。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l018.segmentation: Do not indulge the deceitful; guard against foul calamities.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l019.explanation: 要遏止寇虐，勿使正道败坏。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l019.segmentation: Restrain robbery and cruelty; do not let the right way be ruined.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l020.explanation: 戎虽年轻，却有大志宏谋。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l020.segmentation: Though Rong is young, his plans are great and far-reaching.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l021.explanation: 百姓也已劳顿，差不多可以稍得安宁。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l021.segmentation: The people are weary; they may now find a little peace.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l022.explanation: 施恩于此中原各国，使国中无残破之患。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l022.segmentation: Show kindness to the central states so the realm knows no ruin.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l023.explanation: 不要放纵狡诈之徒，以防范结党营私。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l023.segmentation: Do not indulge the deceitful; guard against cliques and favoritism.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l024.explanation: 要遏止寇虐，勿使正反颠倒。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l024.segmentation: Restrain robbery and cruelty; do not let right and wrong be reversed.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l025.explanation: 王欲以玉护民、惜民如宝，故作此大谏。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-minlao-l025.segmentation: The king wishes to cherish the people like jade; therefore this great remonstrance is offered.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l001.explanation: 最初生养我民，那时是姜嫄。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l001.segmentation: When our people first arose, it was Jiang Yuan.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l002.segmentation: How did the people come to be?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l003.explanation: 能禋祭、能祀神，以祈消除无子之憾。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l003.segmentation: She could offer pure sacrifice and pray to remove the grief of childlessness.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l004.segmentation: 履帝武敏歆，攸介攸止，载震载夙。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l004.explanation: 踩了帝迹而敏动，于是怀孕止息，既震且夙。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l004.segmentation: She trod the Lord's footprint, conceived, and felt both awe and haste.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l005.explanation: 既生又养，这时就是后稷。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l005.segmentation: She bore and nurtured him—this was Hou Ji.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l006.explanation: 满十月而产，生时如破壳般顺利。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l006.segmentation: When her month was full, birth came as easily as shell cracking open.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l007.segmentation: No tear, no breach—no harm, no hurt.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l008.segmentation: Thus his miraculous birth was shown.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l009.segmentation: 上帝不宁，不康禋祀，居然生子。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l009.explanation: 上帝不安，不享其禋祀，竟公然生下孩子。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l009.segmentation: Heaven was displeased; her sacrifice was not accepted—yet she bore a child openly.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l010.segmentation: 诞寘之隘巷，牛羊腓字之。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l010.explanation: 把他放在窄巷，牛羊却庇护乳养。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l010.segmentation: She placed him in a narrow lane; cattle and sheep sheltered and suckled him.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l011.explanation: 把他放在平林，恰逢砍伐平林。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l011.segmentation: She placed him in the open woods just as the woods were being felled.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l012.explanation: 把他放在寒冰，飞鸟以翼覆盖。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l012.segmentation: She placed him on icy cold; birds covered him with their wings.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l013.explanation: 鸟飞去后，后稷开始啼哭。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l013.segmentation: When the birds left, Hou Ji began to wail.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l014.explanation: 哭声又长又响，传遍了道路。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l014.segmentation: Long and loud his cry, echoing along the roads.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l015.explanation: 果然能爬行，能站立，能辨方向。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l015.segmentation: Truly he crawled, stood, and knew his way.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l016.segmentation: Thus he could seek food for himself.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l017.explanation: 种植大豆，大豆苗势茂盛。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l017.segmentation: He planted soybeans; the shoots grew lush and tall.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l018.segmentation: 禾役穟穟，麻麦幪幪，瓜瓞唪唪。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l018.explanation: 禾穗密密，麻麦蓬蓬，瓜瓞纷纷结实。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l018.segmentation: Grain ears clustered thick; hemp and wheat flourished; melons bore fruit in plenty.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l019.explanation: 后稷的农事，有相种之道。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l019.segmentation: In Hou Ji's farming there was art to aid the crop.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l020.explanation: 除去丰茂的杂草，种出黄而茂的禾。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l020.segmentation: He cleared rank weeds and sowed grain golden and lush.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l021.explanation: 既方实又含苞，既种粒又秀穗。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l021.segmentation: Square in grain, wrapped in husk; seeded and sprouting in ear.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l022.explanation: 既抽穗又吐秀，既坚实质又好。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l022.segmentation: Ears emerged and flowered; grain firm, plump, and fine.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l023.explanation: 穗尖而实栗，于是有邰氏之家室。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l023.segmentation: Tips sharp, grain full—thus the house of Tai was founded.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l024.segmentation: 诞降嘉种，维秬维秠，维穈维芑。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l024.explanation: 降下嘉种，有黑黍、黑稷，有糜子、谷子。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l024.segmentation: Fine seed was sent down: black millet, black glutinous millet, broomcorn, and plain millet.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l025.explanation: 常种黑黍黑稷，收获后入田亩。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l025.segmentation: They ever sowed the black millets, reaped them, and brought them to the fields.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l026.explanation: 常种糜子和谷子，担挑背负而归。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l026.segmentation: They ever sowed broomcorn and millet, bearing loads home on shoulder and back.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l027.segmentation: They returned to begin the sacrifice.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l028.explanation: 我们的祭祀是怎样的呢？

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l028.segmentation: How do we perform our sacrifice?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l029.segmentation: Some pound, some scoop; some winnow, some tread.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l030.explanation: 淘米声叟叟，蒸饭气浮浮。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l030.segmentation: Rinsing murmurs softly; steam rises lightly from the cooking.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l031.segmentation: They plan and ponder as they work.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l032.segmentation: 取萧祭脂，取羝以軷，载燔载烈，以兴嗣岁。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l032.explanation: 取萧草和祭脂，取公羊以祓除，既燔祭又烈祭，以兴来岁。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l032.segmentation: They take mugwort and sacrificial fat, a ram for the rite of expiation, burn and blaze offerings to bless the coming year.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l033.segmentation: It is heaped in bowls and placed on stands.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l034.explanation: 香气始升，上帝居而歆享。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l034.segmentation: Fragrance rises; the Lord on high receives and delights.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l035.segmentation: Why is the aroma so timely and true?

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l037.explanation: 希望无罪无悔，一直延续到今天。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-shengmin-l037.segmentation: May we be without guilt or regret—from then until now.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l001.explanation: 那丛生的苇草，不要让牛羊践踏。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l001.segmentation: Those clustered rushes—let cattle and sheep not trample them.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l002.explanation: 初苞初成体，叶子润泽泥泥。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l002.segmentation: First wrapped, first formed; leaves soft and moist.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l003.explanation: 兄弟相亲，莫使疏远，都要聚在你这里。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l003.segmentation: Brothers draw near; let none stay far—all gather around you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l004.explanation: 或设四人之筵，或授之以几。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l004.segmentation: Some spread feasts for four; some hand them small tables.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l005.explanation: 四筵设席，授几时有侍者进御。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l005.segmentation: Four couches are set; attendants bring tables as needed.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l006.explanation: 或献酒或酬答，洗爵奠斝。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l006.segmentation: Some offer wine, some return the toast; cups are rinsed and jars set down.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l007.explanation: 以肉酱和醢菜进献，或燔烤或炙烤。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l007.segmentation: Salted and pickled meats are served, roasted or broiled.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l008.segmentation: Fine dishes include spleen and cheek; some sing, some chant.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l009.segmentation: 敦弓既坚，四鍭既均，舍矢既均，序宾以贤。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l009.explanation: 厚弓既坚，四矢既均，放矢既均，以序宾取贤。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l009.segmentation: The stout bow is tight; four arrows are matched; shots are even—guests are ranked by merit.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l010.segmentation: The stout bow is bent; four arrows are nocked.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l011.explanation: 四矢如树立，以序宾而不相轻侮。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l011.segmentation: Four arrows stand like trees; guests are ordered without insult.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l012.segmentation: 曾孙维主，酒醴维醽，酌以大斗，以祈黄耇。
sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l012.explanation: 曾孙为主，酒醴既醇，用大斗酌酒，以祈黄耇长寿。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l012.segmentation: The host presides; wine is rich; great cups are filled to pray for gray-haired long life.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l013.explanation: 黄发台背的老人，引道你、翼护你。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l013.segmentation: The aged with bent backs guide and support you.

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l014.explanation: 长寿是吉祥，以介大景之福。

sj-ya-daya-shengminzhishen-xingwei-l014.segmentation: Long life is blessing—great fortune be granted.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l001.explanation: 在下者昭明，在上者赫赫。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l002.segmentation: Heaven's will is hard to read; to be king is not easy.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l003.explanation: 殷商之位合适，却使不能挟制四方。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l003.segmentation: Yin's place seemed fit, yet it could not hold the four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l004.segmentation: 挚仲氏任，自彼殷商，来嫁于周，曰嫔于京。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l004.explanation: 挚国仲氏任姓女子，从彼殷商来嫁于周，在镐京为妃。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l004.segmentation: Ren, of the Zhong clan of Zhi, came from Yin to marry in Zhou and became consort at Hao.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l005.explanation: 于是匹配王季，唯以德行为配。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l005.segmentation: She was joined to King Ji, matched only by virtue.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l006.segmentation: Great Ren conceived and bore this King Wen.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l007.segmentation: This King Wen was careful and reverent.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l008.explanation: 昭明事奉上帝，于是怀有多福。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l008.segmentation: Serving God clearly, he gathered many blessings.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l009.explanation: 其德不邪，因而受四方之国。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l009.segmentation: His virtue did not waver; thus he received the states of the four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l010.explanation: 天监在下，天命既已集于文王。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l010.segmentation: Heaven watches below; the mandate has gathered on Wen.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l011.segmentation: When Wen first came of age, Heaven made the match.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l012.explanation: 在洽水之阳，在渭水之滨。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l012.segmentation: On the north bank of the Xia, on the Wei riverside.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l013.explanation: 文王嘉美此女，大国有女子。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l013.segmentation: Wen honored this bride; a great state had a daughter.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l014.explanation: 大国有女子，比之天之妹。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l014.segmentation: The great state had a daughter—like Heaven's own sister.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l015.segmentation: Divination fixed the auspice; he met her in person at the Wei.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l016.explanation: 连舟为梁，其光不显而自明。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l016.segmentation: Boats were chained as a bridge—glory not flaunted, yet clear.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l017.segmentation: A mandate came from Heaven, appointing this King Wen.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l018.explanation: 于周于京，续娶莘国之女。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l018.segmentation: In Zhou, at the capital, he took the woman of Xin in succession.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l019.segmentation: The eldest son carried on; steadfastly was King Wu born.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l020.segmentation: Heaven protects and commands you to join in attacking great Shang.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l021.segmentation: Shang's armies gathered thick as a forest.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l022.explanation: 陈于牧野，唯我诸侯兴起。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l022.segmentation: They arrayed at Muye; only our lords rose up.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l023.segmentation: God looks upon you—be not of two minds.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l024.segmentation: 牧野洋洋，檀车煌煌，驷騵彭彭。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l024.explanation: 牧野广大，檀车煌煌，四马彭彭。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l024.segmentation: Muye is vast; sandalwood chariots blaze; four-horse teams thunder.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l025.segmentation: Grand Master Shang Fu—now like an eagle soaring.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l026.segmentation: 凉彼武王，四伐大商，会朝清明。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l026.explanation: 协助那武王，四伐大商，会于清明之朝。
