sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-daming-l026.segmentation: Aid King Wu; four times strike great Shang—meet in the clear dawn.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l001.explanation: 瞻望那旱山山麓，榛树楛树济济成行。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l001.segmentation: Look at the foot of Mount Han—hazel and thorn trees stand in rows.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l002.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，求福禄在和乐宽厚。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l002.segmentation: The gracious lord seeks blessing through graciousness.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l003.segmentation: The jade libation cup gleams; golden liquor fills it.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l004.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，福禄所降。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l004.segmentation: The gracious lord—upon him blessing descends.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l005.segmentation: The kite flies to the sky; the fish leaps in the deep.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l006.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，何不造就有德之人？

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l006.segmentation: Gracious lord, why not nurture men of virtue?

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l007.explanation: 清酒既载，赤色公牛既备。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l007.segmentation: Clear wine is ready; red oxen are prepared.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l008.explanation: 以享以祀，以介大景之福。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l008.segmentation: To feast and sacrifice, and grant great shining blessing.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l009.explanation: 那柞树棫树，是民所燎祭之木。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l009.segmentation: Oak and thorn—wood the people use for sacrificial fire.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l010.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，是神所劳慰者。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l010.segmentation: The gracious lord is one whom the spirits comfort and bless.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l011.segmentation: Creeping kudzu spreads along the branches.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l012.explanation: 和乐宽厚的君子，求福而不邪曲。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-hanlu-l012.segmentation: The gracious lord seeks blessing without crooked ways.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l001.explanation: 伟大的上帝，降临下界，威明赫赫。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l001.segmentation: Great is God on high; descending to the world below, His majesty shines bright.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l002.explanation: 他监察四方，寻求百姓的安宁。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l002.segmentation: He watches over the four quarters and seeks the people's peace and rest.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l003.explanation: 这两个国家（夏、商），政令不得施行。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l003.segmentation: In these two states, government could not achieve its aims.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l004.explanation: 对那些四方之国，上帝于是考察、度量。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l004.segmentation: Upon those states in the four directions, He then examined and measured them.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l005.explanation: 上帝喜爱周人，憎恶先王扩大疆土的做法（指商）。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l005.segmentation: God favored Zhou and hated how the former dynasty had overreached.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l006.explanation: 于是眷顾西方，把这里作为周人安居之地。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l006.segmentation: Then He turned His gaze to the west and chose this land for Zhou to dwell in.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l007.explanation: 砍掉、拔除杂树，无论是灾木还是蔽日的繁枝。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l007.segmentation: He cleared away brush—both stunted growth and choking shade.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l008.explanation: 修整、铲平地面，除去丛生的灌木和小树。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l008.segmentation: He trimmed and leveled the ground, removing thickets and saplings.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l009.explanation: 开辟土地，砍去柽柳、椐树等。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l009.segmentation: He opened the land, cutting willows, zelkova, and the like.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l010.explanation: 剔除杂木，无论是桑树还是柘树。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l010.segmentation: He uprooted unwanted trees, whether mulberry or thorn.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l011.explanation: 上帝迁来明德之族，串夷之地也开辟成路。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l011.segmentation: God moved the clan of bright virtue here; even the wild borderlands became highways.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l012.explanation: 上天立他的配偶（指太姜），所受天命既已牢固。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l012.segmentation: Heaven established his consort; the mandate they received was firm.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l013.segmentation: 帝省其山，柞棫斯拔，松柏斯兑。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l013.explanation: 上帝察看那座山，柞、棫拔起，松柏也畅茂。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l013.segmentation: God looked upon the mountain: oak and thorn were uprooted, pine and cypress flourished.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l014.segmentation: 帝作邦作对，自大伯王季。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l014.explanation: 上帝为周邦立配、立对（配偶与辅佐），自太伯、王季始。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l014.segmentation: God made Zhou a state with its match and help, beginning with Taibo and Wang Ji.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l016.explanation: 顺其本心就能友爱兄弟。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l016.segmentation: following his heart, was friendly to others.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l017.segmentation: 则友其兄，则笃其庆，载锡之光。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l017.explanation: 友爱其兄，厚集福庆，又赐以荣光。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l017.segmentation: He befriended his elder brother, heaped up blessings, and was granted glory.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l018.explanation: 承受福禄而不丧失，奄有四方。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l018.segmentation: He received blessings without losing them and came to hold the four quarters.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l019.explanation: 这位王季，上帝度量他的内心。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l019.segmentation: This Wang Ji—God measured his heart.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l020.explanation: 远播其德音，其德能照彻四方。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l020.segmentation: His good fame reached afar; his virtue could illumine all.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l021.explanation: 能明察、能分类，能长育、能君临。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l021.segmentation: He could discern and classify, nurture and rule as lord.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l022.explanation: 治理这个大国，能顺服、能亲附。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l022.segmentation: Governing this great state, he could comply and draw others near.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l023.explanation: 与文王相比，其德无可悔恨。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l023.segmentation: Compared with King Wen, his virtue left nothing to regret.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l024.explanation: 既受上帝之福，施及子孙。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l024.segmentation: Having received God's blessing, he extended it to his descendants.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l025.segmentation: 帝谓文王：无然畔援，无然歆羡，诞先登于岸。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l025.explanation: 上帝对文王说：不要攀附、不要歆羡，要率先登岸（喻率先行道）。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l025.segmentation: God said to King Wen: Do not cling to others or envy them; be the first to reach the shore.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l026.explanation: 密国人无礼，竟敢抗拒大国，

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l026.segmentation: The people of Mi were disrespectful and dared resist the great state—

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l027.segmentation: invading Ruan and pressing on to Gong.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l028.segmentation: 王赫斯怒，爰整其旅，以按徂旅。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l028.explanation: 文王赫然发怒，于是整顿军队，以安定往来的旅人。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l028.segmentation: King Wen flared in anger, arrayed his hosts, and secured the roads for travelers.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l029.segmentation: 以笃于周祜，以对于天下。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l029.explanation: 以厚周之福佑，以应对天下。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l029.segmentation: Thus enriching Zhou's blessings and answering the needs of all under heaven.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l030.explanation: 依其在镐京之势，从阮国边境进击。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l030.segmentation: Relying on his power at the capital, he advanced from the borders of Ruan.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l031.explanation: 登上我高冈，不要用箭射我陵阜。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l031.segmentation: Ascend my high hill—do not shoot arrows at my mound.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l032.explanation: 我陵我阿，不要饮用我泉，

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l032.segmentation: My mound, my slope—do not drink from my spring,

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l034.segmentation: 度其鲜原，居岐之阳，在渭之将。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l034.explanation: 丈量那鲜原，居岐山之阳，在渭水之畔。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l034.segmentation: He measured the fresh plain, dwelling on the sunny side of Mount Qi, by the banks of the Wei.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l035.segmentation: He became the model for all states and king to the common people.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l036.segmentation: 帝谓文王：予怀明德，不大声以色，不长夏以革。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l036.explanation: 上帝对文王说：我怀明德，不大声以色，不借夏政而变革。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l036.segmentation: God said to Wen: I cherish bright virtue— not loud words or harsh looks, not changing things by harsh summer ways.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l037.explanation: 不识不知，顺从天帝之则。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l037.segmentation: Without forced knowing, he followed Heaven's rule.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l038.segmentation: 帝谓文王：訽尔仇方，同尔弟兄。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l038.explanation: 上帝对文王说：告诫你的仇方，团结你的弟兄。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l038.segmentation: God said to Wen: Warn your hostile neighbors and unite your brothers.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l039.segmentation: 以尔钩援，与尔临冲，以伐崇墉。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l039.explanation: 用你钩援、用你临冲，去攻打崇国城墙。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l039.segmentation: With your hook-ladders and your siege-engines, attack the wall of Chong.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l040.explanation: 临冲战车轻稳，崇城墙高言言。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l040.segmentation: The siege engines rolled smoothly; Chong's wall stood towering.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l041.explanation: 捉获俘虏接连不断，所割之耳安妥。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l041.segmentation: Captives were taken in steady streams; severed ears were laid in order.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l042.explanation: 举行类祭、禡祭，致献、归附，

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l042.segmentation: He offered the proper rites and sacrifices, winning submission—

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l043.segmentation: so the four quarters no longer showed contempt.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l044.segmentation: The engines thundered; the wall of Chong stood firm.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l045.explanation: 于是讨伐、四面进攻，于是灭绝、迅速攻克。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l045.segmentation: Then they assaulted from all sides, cut off and swiftly overthrew it.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-huangyi-l046.segmentation: So the four quarters no longer turned away in defiance.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l001.explanation: 开始建造灵台，规划又经营。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l001.segmentation: They began the Spirit Tower, planning and building it.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l002.explanation: 百姓合力修筑，不日即成。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l002.segmentation: The people worked on it together, and it was finished in no time.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l003.explanation: 开工时不催促，百姓像儿子一样前来帮忙。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l003.segmentation: Though no haste was urged at the start, the people came like sons to help.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l004.explanation: 王在灵囿，母鹿安然伏卧。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l004.segmentation: The king was in the Spirit Park; does lay peacefully at rest.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l005.explanation: 母鹿肥壮，白鸟羽毛鲜明。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l005.segmentation: The does were plump; white birds gleamed in their feathers.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l006.segmentation: The king was at the Spirit Pool; fish leaped in fullness.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l007.explanation: 虡上横木为枞，大鼓与镛钟齐备。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l007.segmentation: Music stands with crossbars, great drums and chime bells were set.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l008.explanation: 于论地击鼓钟，于乐地奏辟雍之乐。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l008.segmentation: In Lun they struck drums and bells; in the pleasure ground they played for the Bright Enclosure.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l009.explanation: 于论地击鼓钟，于乐地奏辟雍之乐。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l009.segmentation: In Lun they struck drums and bells; in the pleasure ground they played for the Bright Enclosure.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-lingtai-l011.segmentation: The blind musicians performed the Gong music.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l001.explanation: 瓜瓞绵绵，喻子孙繁衍不绝。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l001.segmentation: Melons spread on trailing vines—like descendants multiplying without end.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l002.explanation: 民众初生活动，从土山沮漆一带起。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l002.segmentation: When the people first arose, they lived from Tu and Juqi.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l003.segmentation: 古公亶父，陶复陶冗，未有家室。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l003.explanation: 古公亶父挖穴而居，尚未有正式家室。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l003.segmentation: Gugong Danfu dug caves to dwell in; he had not yet built a proper house.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l004.explanation: 古公亶父，清晨就骑马出发。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l004.segmentation: Gugong Danfu set out at dawn, riding his horse.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l005.explanation: 沿西方水滨，来到岐山脚下。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l005.segmentation: He followed the western waterside until he reached the foot of Mount Qi.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l006.explanation: 连同姜女，一起来察看可居之地。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l006.segmentation: With Lady Jiang he came to look over where they might settle.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l007.explanation: 周原肥沃，堇菜苦荼甜如饴。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l007.segmentation: The Zhou plain was rich; even bitter herbs tasted sweet as malt.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l008.segmentation: 爰始爰谋，爰契我龟，曰止曰时，筑室于兹。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l008.explanation: 于是开始谋划，灼龟问卜，说“止”“时”，在此筑室。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l008.segmentation: Then they planned and divined with tortoise: “Stop here, now is the time”—and built houses on this spot.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l009.segmentation: 乃慰乃止，乃左乃右，乃疆乃理，乃宣乃亩。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l009.explanation: 于是安抚定居，划分左右，定疆理田，宣导亩制。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l009.segmentation: They settled the people in peace, assigned left and right, marked fields and boundaries, and laid out the acre system.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l010.explanation: 从西到东，遍处都有人办事。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l010.segmentation: From west to east, Zhou had people at work everywhere.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l011.segmentation: 乃召司空，乃召司徒，俾立室家。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l011.explanation: 召来司空、司徒，使大家建立家室。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l011.segmentation: They summoned the Minister of Works and the Minister of Land to help every household build homes.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l012.segmentation: 其绳则直，缩版以载，作庙翼翼。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l012.explanation: 绳墨拉直，缩版载土，宗庙翼翼而起。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l012.segmentation: The line was true; boards held the earth; the ancestral temple rose grandly.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l013.segmentation: 捄之陾陾，度之薨薨，筑之登登，削屡冯冯。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l013.explanation: 填土陾陾，量度薨薨，筑墙登登，削板冯冯。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l013.segmentation: Earth was tamped with rumble; measurements hummed; walls rose layer on layer; boards were trimmed with clang.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l014.explanation: 百堵同时兴起，鼛鼓声也盖不住。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l014.segmentation: A hundred walls rose together; even the work drums could scarcely be heard.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l015.segmentation: Then they raised the outer gate; the outer gate stood high.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l016.segmentation: Then they raised the inner gate; the inner gate stood stately.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l017.explanation: 于是立社坛，戎狄也来行礼。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l017.segmentation: Then they raised the earth altar; even the Rong tribes came to perform rites.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l018.segmentation: 四不殄厥愠，亦不陨厥问。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l018.explanation: 虽遭侵扰而不减其志，也不坠其声闻。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l018.segmentation: Though harassed, their resolve did not fail; their fame did not fall.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l019.segmentation: Oaks and thorns were cleared; the roads became open.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l020.segmentation: The Hunyi retreated, panting in their flight!

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l021.segmentation: 虞芮质厥成，文王蹶厥生。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l021.explanation: 虞、芮来质成其讼，文王蹶起其生业。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l021.segmentation: Yu and Rui came to Wen for judgment; Wen revived their livelihoods.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l022.segmentation: 予曰有疏附，予曰有先后。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l022.explanation: 我说有亲附者，我说有先后之序。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l022.segmentation: I say there were close adherents; I say there were leaders in order.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l023.segmentation: 予曰有奔奏，予曰有御侮！
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l023.explanation: 我说有奔走奏事者，我说有抵御外侮者！

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-mian-l023.segmentation: I say there were runners to report; I say there were defenders against insult!

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l001.segmentation: 思齐大任，文王之母，思媚周姜，京室之妇。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l001.explanation: 思念太任（文王之母）贤齐，又念周姜（太姜）为京室之妇。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l001.segmentation: We think of worthy Tai Ren, Wen's mother, and gracious Zhou Jiang, lady of the capital house.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l002.explanation: 太姒继承美善之德音，故生百子。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l002.segmentation: Tai Si inherited their fine virtue, and bore a hundred sons.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l003.segmentation: 惠于宗公，神罔时怨，神罔时恫。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l003.explanation: 施惠于宗庙先公，神灵从不怨怒，从不惊扰。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l003.segmentation: She was kind to the ancestral lords; the spirits never resented or troubled her.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l004.segmentation: 刑于寡妻，至于兄弟，以御于家邦。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l004.explanation: 以寡妻为榜样，推及兄弟，以治家邦。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l004.segmentation: She set an example for the chief wife, extending to brothers, to govern family and state.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l005.explanation: 在宫中雍雍和穆，在庙中肃肃恭敬。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l005.segmentation: Harmonious in the palace, reverent in the temple.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l006.explanation: 虽不显达亦临察，无厌亦保守。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l006.segmentation: Though not prominent, she still oversaw; without weariness she still kept watch.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l007.explanation: 虽遭戎患而不绝，烈德无瑕疵。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l007.segmentation: Though the Rong pressed hard, she was not cut off; her blazing virtue had no flaw.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l008.explanation: 未闻之事也效法，未谏之言也采纳。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l008.segmentation: What she had not heard, she still modeled; what was not urged, she still took in.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l009.segmentation: The grown had virtue; the young achieved their worth.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l010.explanation: 古人不厌其劳，誉美俊士。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-siqi-l010.segmentation: The ancients never tired of praise; they honored outstanding men.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l001.explanation: 文王在天，光明昭于上天。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l001.segmentation: King Wen is on high, his brightness clear in heaven.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l002.explanation: 周虽是旧邦，其命却更新。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l002.segmentation: Zhou is an ancient state, yet its mandate is made new.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l003.explanation: 有周之业不显达吗？帝命并非固定不变。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l003.segmentation: Is Zhou's achievement not glorious? Heaven's command is not unchanging.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l004.explanation: 文王升降在天，在上帝左右。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l004.segmentation: King Wen ascends and descends in heaven, at God's right hand.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l005.explanation: 勤勉的文王，美名传扬不止。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l005.segmentation: Diligent King Wen—his good fame never ceases.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l006.explanation: 反复赐福于周，使文王的子孙为侯。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l006.segmentation: Blessings were heaped on Zhou again and again, making Wen's descendants lords.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l007.segmentation: 文王孙子，本支百世，凡周之士，不显亦世。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l007.explanation: 文王的子孙，本支百世；凡周之士，不显亦世世代代。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l007.segmentation: Wen's descendants, root and branch for a hundred generations; all Zhou's officers, glorious generation after generation.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l008.explanation: 世世代代显赫，其谋虑翼翼谨慎。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l008.segmentation: Age after age prominent, their plans were careful and thorough.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l009.explanation: 思慕众多贤士，生于此王国。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l009.segmentation: Longing for many worthy men born in this royal state.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l010.explanation: 王国能生出贤士，是周的栋梁；

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l010.segmentation: The kingdom could produce them—Zhou's mainstay;

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l011.explanation: 济济众多士人，文王因此安宁。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l011.segmentation: Hosts of officers—and King Wen was secure.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l012.segmentation: Solemn King Wen, in bright virtue and reverent conduct.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l015.explanation: 商的孙子，其数量不止亿万。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l015.segmentation: Shang's descendants—their number is not less than hundreds of millions.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l016.explanation: 上帝既已下令，使之为周之诸侯。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l016.segmentation: God has commanded that they become Zhou's vassals.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l017.segmentation: Serving Zhou as lords—Heaven's mandate is not constant.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l018.segmentation: Yin officers, fair and quick in mien.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l019.segmentation: They will assist at the libation rites in the capital.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l020.explanation: 他们担任裸将，常服黼冔。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l020.segmentation: Performing the libation service, in regular robes and embroidered caps.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l021.segmentation: They are the king's devoted ministers.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l022.segmentation: Do not merely think of your ancestors.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l023.explanation: 不要只想你的祖先，要修其德行。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l023.segmentation: Do not merely think of your ancestors—cultivate their virtue.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l024.explanation: 永远配合天命，自求多福。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l024.segmentation: Always align with Heaven's command and seek blessings for yourself.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l025.explanation: 殷商未失众师之前，尚能配上帝。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l025.segmentation: Before Yin lost its armies, it could still match God.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l026.segmentation: Take Yin as a mirror—the great mandate is not easily kept!

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l027.explanation: 保命不易，不要阻遏自身之德。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l027.segmentation: Keeping the mandate is hard; do not block your own virtue.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l028.explanation: 宣明道义、善问，有虞之德自天而来。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l028.segmentation: Make clear righteousness and good inquiry; the virtue of Yu came from heaven.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l029.segmentation: Heaven's working has neither sound nor smell.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwang-l030.segmentation: Model yourself on King Wen, and all states will trust.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.segmentation: King Wen had fame—his great name rang far.
He sought peace from afar and watched his achievements from afar.
Wen received Heaven's mandate and won this martial success.
Having attacked Chong, he built his city at Feng.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.explanation: 筑城于淢地，作丰与镐相配。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.segmentation: He walled the Yi grounds and made Feng match its pair.
Not rushing selfish aims, he pursued filial duty from afar.
The king and duke were bright—the wall of Feng.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.explanation: 四方来同，王后是翰（屏障）。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.segmentation: The four quarters came together; the queen was their bulwark.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.explanation: 丰水东注，是大禹的功绩。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.segmentation: The Feng waters flow east—the achievement of Great Yu.
The four quarters unite; the sovereign is their ruler.
镐京辟雍，自西自东，自南自北，无思不服。
sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.explanation: 镐京辟雍，自西自东，自南自北，无不臣服。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.segmentation: At Haojing's Bright Enclosure, from west and east, south and north—none failed to submit.
The king divined by tortoise and chose Haojing as his seat.
The oracle confirmed it; King Wu completed it.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.explanation: 丰水有杞，武王岂不就仕？

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-wenwangyoushen.segmentation: By the Feng grow qi trees—did King Wu not take office?
He left plans for his descendants to comfort and protect his sons.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu-l001.segmentation: Zhou below has had wise kings generation after generation.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu-l002.segmentation: The three former kings are in heaven; the king matches them at the capital.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu-l003.segmentation: The king at the capital—ancestral virtue is what he seeks.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu-l004.segmentation: Always align with Heaven's command—King Cheng's trustworthiness.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu-l005.segmentation: Cheng's trust is the model for all below heaven.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu-l006.segmentation: Ever speak of filial thought—filial thought is the rule.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu-l007.segmentation: Cherish this one man—respond as lord with compliant virtue.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu-l008.segmentation: Ever filial in thought—clear is the heir's service.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu-l009.segmentation: Brightly the coming praise—follow the footsteps of his ancestors.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu-l010.segmentation: For ten thousand years, receive Heaven's blessing.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu-l011.segmentation: Receiving Heaven's blessing, the four quarters come to congratulate.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-xiawu-l012.segmentation: For ten thousand years, helpers will not be far.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu-l001.explanation: 棫朴茂盛，砍来捆作薪柴。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu-l001.segmentation: Luxuriant oak shoots—cut and bundled for fuel.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu-l002.explanation: 济济君王，左右奔走趋事。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu-l002.segmentation: The splendid king—attendants hurry left and right to serve.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu-l003.segmentation: The splendid king—attendants hold jade tablets on either side.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu-l004.segmentation: The tablets held high—fit for outstanding men.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu-l005.explanation: 泾水之舟泛泛，众徒划桨。

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu-l005.segmentation: Boats on the Jing drift wide; the crowd rows with oars.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu-l006.segmentation: The Zhou king marched; the six armies joined him.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu-l007.segmentation: That Milky Way shines bright—a pattern in the sky.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu-l008.segmentation: The Zhou king long-lived—how could he fail to nurture men?

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu-l009.segmentation: Carve and polish their pattern; gold and jade their aspect.

sj-ya-daya-wenwangzhishen-yupu-l010.segmentation: Diligent is our king—he holds the four quarters in order.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 宴会刚开，左右次序井然。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: When the feast begins, left and right are in proper order.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 笾豆排列整肃，肴核成行。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Baskets and stands are set in rows; meats and fruits line up.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 酒已调和甘美，饮酒要和乐。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: The wine is blended and sweet; drinking should be harmonious.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 钟鼓已设，举杯敬酒从容不迫。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Bells and drums are ready; cups are raised in easy toasts.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 大射侯已竖起，弓矢已张开。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: The great target is raised; bows and arrows are strung.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 射手已齐，献你们射箭的功夫。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Archers stand together—show the skill of your shooting.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 射那靶子，以求赐爵。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Shoot at the mark, to win the grant of a cup.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 籥舞、笙鼓，乐声和奏。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Flute-dance, pipes and drums—the music blends in play.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 和乐祖先，以协百礼。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Delight the glorious ancestors and harmonize the hundred rites.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 百礼既到，宾主众多。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: All rites are present; hosts and guests are many.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 赐你大福，子孙和乐。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: May you receive pure blessing; may your descendants be at ease.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 和乐曰乐，各奏其能。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: In ease they call it joy—each performs his skill.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 宾客递相劝酒，主人再入献酒。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Guests hand cups to rivals; the host enters again to serve.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 酌那丰爵，以奏合于时宜。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Pour the generous cup and offer what fits the moment.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 宴会初时，温温恭敬。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: At the feast's start, guests are gentle and respectful.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 未醉之前，威仪谨慎反反。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Before they are drunk, their bearing is careful and correct.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 既已醉了，威仪就轻飘幡幡。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Once drunk, their dignity grows loose and wavering.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 离开座位乱走，屡屡轻佻起舞。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: They leave their seats and dance again and again, light and improper.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 未醉之前，威仪庄敬抑抑。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Before drunk, their bearing is restrained and solemn.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 说既醉了，威仪仍称抑抑（反讽其失）。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: They say they are drunk yet still call their bearing solemn—ironic.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 这就叫做醉了，不知行礼次序。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: This is being drunk—not knowing ritual order.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 宾客既醉，又呼又叫。
弄乱我笾豆，屡屡歪斜起舞。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: They upset my baskets and stands, dancing crookedly again and again.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 这就叫做醉了，不知过错。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: This is being drunk—not knowing one's faults.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 冠帽歪戴，屡屡错乱起舞。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Caps askew, they dance in stumbling confusion.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 醉后出门，一同受福。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Drunk yet leaving—you still share the blessing.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 醉了还不走，叫做败坏德行。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Drunk and not leaving—this is called harming virtue.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 饮酒甚美，关键在好的礼仪。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Drinking is fine—what matters is good ceremony.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 凡此饮酒，有人醉有人不醉。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Among all who drink here, some are drunk and some are not.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 既设监酒之人，又设史官记录。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: A overseer is appointed, and a scribe may assist.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 彼人醉了不好，不醉反而羞耻（讽俗）。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: For some, being drunk is bad; not being drunk is shame—mocking custom.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 不要跟着劝酒，不要使人大怠。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Do not follow urging to drink; do not let people grow greatly slack.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 不该说的不要说，不该由头的话不要讲。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: What should not be said—do not say; what should not be broached—do not speak.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 醉后说的话，像公羊乱叫一样荒唐。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: Words from drunken lips are like a ram bleating nonsense.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.explanation: 三杯就不知礼，何况再多喝。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-binzhichuyan-.segmentation: After three cups they know nothing—how dare they drink more?

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.segmentation: 裳裳者华，其叶湑兮。
Bright the blossoms; their leaves are lush.
我觏之子，我心写兮。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.explanation: 我见那君子，我心喜悦舒展。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.segmentation: I meet that noble man—my heart opens in joy.
我心写兮，是以有誉处兮。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.explanation: 心喜悦舒展，所以有好声誉、好居处。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.segmentation: My heart is glad—therefore I have honor and a good place.
裳裳者华，芸其黄矣。
Bright the blossoms; the rue has turned yellow.
我觏之子，维其有章矣。
I meet that noble man—he has clear distinction.
维其有章矣，是以有庆矣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.explanation: 有文彩有章，所以有福庆。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.segmentation: Because he has distinction, there is celebration.
裳裳者华，或黄或白。
Bright the blossoms—some yellow, some white.
我觏之子，乘其四骆。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.explanation: 我见那君子，乘四匹骆马。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.segmentation: I meet that noble man—he drives four black horses.
乘其四骆，六辔沃若。
With four horses, the six reins are glossy.
左之左之，君子宜之。
Use the left where left fits—the noble man is suited to it.
右之右之，君子有之。
Use the right where right fits—the noble man has it.
维其有之，是以似之。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.explanation: 正因有之，所以相似（可继前人）。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-changchangzhe.segmentation: Because he has these gifts, he resembles the great of old.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l001.segmentation: 间关车之舝兮，思娈季女逝兮。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l001.explanation: 车舝转动声关关，想那贤淑女子同去。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l001.segmentation: The axle-fittings click— I think of the fair maiden going with me.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l002.explanation: 非为饥渴，是好德音来招我。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l002.segmentation: Not from hunger or thirst—good virtue's call draws me.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l005.segmentation: By the level woods a hawk settles.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l006.segmentation: I meet the tall maiden—fine virtue comes to instruct.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l007.segmentation: Feast and praise you—I love you without end.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l008.segmentation: Though we have no fine wine?

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l009.segmentation: Let us drink what we may.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l010.segmentation: Though we have no rich dishes?

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l011.segmentation: Let us eat what we may.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l012.segmentation: Though I have no virtue to match yours?

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l014.segmentation: Climb the high hill; split oak for firewood.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l015.segmentation: Splitting oak fuel—its leaves are lush.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l016.explanation: 幸我见你，我心喜悦舒展。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l016.segmentation: Happy I meet you—my heart opens in joy.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l017.explanation: 高山可仰，大道可行（德可效法）。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l017.segmentation: The high mountain is to be looked up to; the great path is to be walked.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l018.segmentation: Four steeds pace evenly; six reins sound like a lute.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-chexia-l019.segmentation: Seeing you newly wed—it eases my heart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l001.segmentation: 大田多稼，既种既戒，既备乃事。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l001.explanation: 大田种稼多，既种既戒，备齐乃事。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l001.segmentation: Great fields bear many crops—sown, warned, prepared, then the work begins.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l002.explanation: 用我的深耜，开始于南亩。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l002.segmentation: With my deep plowshare I start work on the southern acres.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l003.segmentation: 播厥百谷，既庭且硕，曾孙是若。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l003.explanation: 播百谷，既齐整又硕大，曾孙所悦。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l003.segmentation: Sow the hundred grains—neat and plump, as the lord desires.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l004.segmentation: 既方既皂，既坚既好，不稂不莠。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l004.explanation: 既灌浆又成长，既坚又好，无稂无莠。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l004.segmentation: Ears fill and ripen, firm and good—no wild oats or darnel.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l005.segmentation: Remove caterpillars and borers, and all crop pests—

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l006.segmentation: do not harm our young fields.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l007.segmentation: The field god has power—carry fire to destroy the pests.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l008.segmentation: Clouds gather thick; rain falls softly.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l009.segmentation: Rain on our lord's fields, then reaches our private plots.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l010.segmentation: There some young grain is left ungathered—

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l011.segmentation: 此有不敛穧，彼有遗秉，此有滞穗，伊寡妇之利。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l011.explanation: 此处有不收的禾束，彼有遗秉，此有滞穗，是寡妇之利。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l011.segmentation: here unbound sheaves remain; there dropped bundles, here stuck ears—the widow's gain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l012.segmentation: The lord comes with wife and child.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l013.segmentation: Food is brought to the southern fields; the field master is glad.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l014.segmentation: The coming states perform the border sacrifice—

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l015.segmentation: with red and black beasts, and millet and panic grass.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-datian-l016.segmentation: Offer and sacrifice, to gain great blessing.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l001.explanation: 那大片田畴多么广阔，一年能收上万石粮食。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l001.segmentation: How vast and broad those fields—each year they yield ten thousand measures of grain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l002.explanation: 取出陈粮来食用，养活我们的农民。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l002.segmentation: We take out stored grain to feed our farm folk.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l003.segmentation: Since ancient times there have been years of plenty.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l004.explanation: 今天到南边田里去，有的除草有的培土。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l004.segmentation: Today we go to the southern fields—some hoe weeds, some hill up the soil.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l005.segmentation: 黍稷薿薿，攸介攸止，烝我髦士。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l005.explanation: 黍稷长得茂盛，分田界、立田埂，召集俊秀之士。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l005.segmentation: Millet and millet-sorghum grow lush; we mark bounds and ridges and gather our fine young men.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l006.segmentation: 以我齐明，与我牺羊，以社以方。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l006.explanation: 用洁净的谷米和纯色祭羊，祭祀社神和四方神。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l006.segmentation: With purified grain and spotless sacrificial rams we worship the soil god and the gods of the four quarters.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l007.explanation: 我的田已经丰收，这是农夫的喜庆。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l007.segmentation: My fields are now abundant—this is the farmers' celebration.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l008.explanation: 弹琴击鼓，以乐招待田祖。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l008.segmentation: Zithers and drums sound to entertain the field ancestor.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l009.segmentation: 以祈甘雨，以介我稷黍，以穀我士女。
sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l009.explanation: 祈求甘雨，使稷黍丰登，养活百姓。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l009.segmentation: We pray for sweet rain, that millet may thrive and feed our men and women.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l010.explanation: 曾孙来到田间，带着妻子儿女。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l010.segmentation: The great-grandson arrives, with his wife and children.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l011.explanation: 到南边田头送饭，田官非常欢喜。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l011.segmentation: Meals are brought to the southern plots; the field overseer is full of joy.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l012.segmentation: The great-grandson pushes aside those on left and right,

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l013.segmentation: and himself tastes whether the food is good.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l014.explanation: 禾苗长满田亩，最终既好又丰足。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l014.segmentation: The grain fills every acre; in the end it is fine and plentiful.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l015.explanation: 曾孙不责罚，农夫便尽心竭力。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l015.segmentation: When the great-grandson shows no anger, the farmers work with all their skill.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l016.explanation: 曾孙的庄稼，堆如茅茨、高如屋梁。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l016.segmentation: The great-grandson's crops pile like thatched roofs, rise like rafters.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l017.explanation: 曾孙的粮仓，低如水中高地、高如小山。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l017.segmentation: His granaries spread like islets, tower like hills.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l018.segmentation: Then he seeks to build granaries by the thousand,

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l019.segmentation: and seeks ten thousand bins besides.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l020.explanation: 黍稷稻粱齐备，是农夫的喜庆。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l020.segmentation: Millet, sorghum, rice, and fine grain—all this is the farmers' joy.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-futian-l021.segmentation: Great blessing is returned; may life be endless without bound.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l001.explanation: 戴着有棱角的皮弁，这究竟是为了谁？

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l001.segmentation: Those with peaked caps—whom are they really for?

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l002.explanation: 你的酒已很甘美，你的菜肴已很丰盛。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l002.segmentation: Your wine is already fine; your dishes are already splendid.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l005.explanation: 茑萝缠绕在松柏上，比喻兄弟依附君子。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l005.segmentation: Dodder and female creeper cling to pine and cypress—brothers rely on the noble man.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l006.explanation: 没见到君子时，忧心忡忡；

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l006.segmentation: Before seeing the noble man, my heart is heavy with care;

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l007.explanation: 既见到君子，差不多可以欢喜宽慰了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l007.segmentation: Once I see him, I can nearly rejoice and be at ease.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l008.explanation: 戴着有棱角的皮弁，这究竟是为了何时？

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l008.segmentation: Those peaked caps—for what occasion are they?

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l009.explanation: 你的酒已很甘美，你的菜肴已很适时。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l009.segmentation: Your wine is fine; your dishes are timely and fit.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l012.segmentation: Dodder and female creeper spread upon the pine.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l013.explanation: 没见到君子时，忧心怦怦；

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l013.segmentation: Before seeing the noble man, my heart beats with anxiety;

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l014.explanation: 既见到君子，差不多可以有所善成了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l014.segmentation: Once I see him, good fortune seems near at hand.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l015.explanation: 戴着有棱角的皮弁，实在戴在头上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l015.segmentation: Those peaked caps—they truly rest upon our heads.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l016.explanation: 你的酒已很甘美，你的菜肴已很丰足。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l016.segmentation: Your wine is fine; your fare is rich and ample.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l018.segmentation: They are brothers, nephews, and maternal uncles.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l019.explanation: 像那将要下雪，先落下的是雪霰。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l019.segmentation: Like snow about to fall, first comes the icy sleet—a sign of death drawing near.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l020.explanation: 死亡不知何日，相见的日子不多了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l020.segmentation: Death may come any day; we have little time left to meet.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l021.explanation: 今夜痛饮欢乐，君子在此设宴。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-kuibian-l021.segmentation: Let us drink and rejoice tonight—the noble man holds this feast.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-qingying-l001.explanation: 嗡嗡飞舞的青蝇，停落在篱笆上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-qingying-l001.segmentation: Buzzing blue flies settle on the fence.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-qingying-l002.explanation: 和乐平易的君子，不要听信谗言。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-qingying-l002.segmentation: Easy and gracious lord, do not trust slanderous words.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-qingying-l003.explanation: 嗡嗡飞舞的青蝇，停落在酸枣树上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-qingying-l003.segmentation: Buzzing blue flies settle on the jujube thorns.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-qingying-l004.explanation: 谗人没有止境，搅乱四方之国。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-qingying-l004.segmentation: Slanderers know no limit; they throw the four quarters into disorder.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-qingying-l005.explanation: 嗡嗡飞舞的青蝇，停落在榛树上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-qingying-l005.segmentation: Buzzing blue flies settle on the hazel trees.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-qingying-l006.explanation: 谗人没有止境，构陷我们两人。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-qingying-l006.segmentation: Slanderers know no limit; they plot against us two.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l001.explanation: 交交的桑扈鸟，羽毛有文采。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l001.segmentation: The mulberry finch calls crisply; its feathers gleam with color.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l002.explanation: 君子安乐，承受上天赐福。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l002.segmentation: The noble man rejoices and receives Heaven's blessing.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l003.explanation: 交交的桑扈鸟，颈项有文采。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l003.segmentation: The mulberry finch calls; its neck is bright with plumage.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l004.explanation: 君子安乐，是万邦的屏障。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l004.segmentation: The noble man rejoices—he is the shield of all the states.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l005.explanation: 是国家的屏障和栋梁，百辟以他为法则。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l005.segmentation: He is rampart and pillar of the realm; all lords take him as their model.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l006.explanation: 不骄不躁、不遇大难，承受的福分就很多。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l006.segmentation: Not overbearing, not in straits—his blessings are beyond measure.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l007.explanation: 牛角弯曲的兕觥，美酒温和香柔。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l007.segmentation: The rhinoceros horn cup curves; the fine wine is mild and soft.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l008.explanation: 他交往而不傲慢，万福都来求附。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-sanghu-l008.segmentation: He keeps company without pride; ten thousand blessings seek him out.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l001.explanation: 鸳鸯成双飞翔，用网罗捕取它们。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l001.segmentation: Mandarin ducks fly in pairs—they are caught with nets.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l002.explanation: 君子万年长寿，福禄都合宜。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l002.segmentation: May the noble man live ten thousand years; may fortune and rank suit him well.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l003.explanation: 鸳鸯在梁上，收敛着左翼。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l003.segmentation: Mandarin ducks on the beam fold their left wings.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l004.segmentation: May the noble man live ten thousand years,

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l006.explanation: 乘马在厩中，有人喂草又喂粟。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l006.segmentation: Steeds stand in the stable; they are fed with fodder and grain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l007.explanation: 君子万年长寿，福禄来安抚他。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l007.segmentation: May the noble man live ten thousand years; fortune and rank comfort him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l008.explanation: 乘马在厩中，先喂粟再喂草。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l008.segmentation: Steeds in the stable—grain first, then fodder.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l009.explanation: 君子万年长寿，福禄来安绥他。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-yuanyang-l009.segmentation: May the noble man live ten thousand years; fortune and rank bring him peace.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.explanation: 远望那洛水，河水泱泱流淌。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.segmentation: Gazing on the Luo River—the waters surge and flow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.explanation: 君子来到这里，福禄多如茅茨。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.segmentation: The noble man has come; his blessings pile like thatched roofs.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.explanation: 红色蔽膝鲜明，以此统率六军。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.segmentation: Scarlet knee-covers gleam—with them he leads the six armies.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.explanation: 远望那洛水，河水泱泱流淌。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.segmentation: Gazing on the Luo—the waters surge and flow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.explanation: 君子来到这里，剑鞘上镶有玉饰。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.segmentation: The noble man has come; gems adorn the scabbard of his sword.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.explanation: 君子万年长寿，保全家室。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.segmentation: May the noble man live ten thousand years and keep his household safe.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.explanation: 远望那洛水，河水泱泱流淌。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.segmentation: Gazing on the Luo—the waters surge and flow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.explanation: 君子来到这里，福禄已经齐备。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.segmentation: The noble man has come; fortune and rank are complete.

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.explanation: 君子万年长寿，保全国家。

sj-ya-xiaoya-futianzhishen-zhanbiluoyi-l.segmentation: May the noble man live ten thousand years and guard the realm.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l001.segmentation: I climb the northern hill to gather wolfberry.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l002.explanation: 体态壮健的士子，早晚都在服役办事。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l002.segmentation: Sturdy officers serve from morning till night in royal tasks.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l003.explanation: 王事没有止息，我为父母而忧愁。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l003.segmentation: The king's business never ends; I grieve for my father and mother.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l004.explanation: 普天之下，没有不是王的土地；

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l004.segmentation: Under wide Heaven, none of the land is not the king's;

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l005.explanation: 四海之内，没有不是王的臣民。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l005.segmentation: Along all the shores, none are not the king's subjects.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l006.explanation: 大夫分配不均，唯独我劳役最多。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l006.segmentation: The great officers share unfairly—only I am burdened with the most toil.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l007.explanation: 四匹马强壮有力，王事纷繁急迫。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l007.segmentation: Four steeds are strong; the king's affairs press hard on every side.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l008.explanation: 王说我还未老，正当年少力壮。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l008.segmentation: The king says I am not yet old, that youth and vigor are still mine.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l009.explanation: 体力正刚健，要经营四方。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l009.segmentation: My strength is at its peak—I must manage the four quarters.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l010.segmentation: 或燕燕居息，或尽瘁事国；
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l010.explanation: 有人安闲地休息，有人尽心国事；

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l010.segmentation: Some rest at ease at home, some wear themselves out for the state;

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l011.segmentation: 或息偃在床，或不已于行。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l011.explanation: 有人躺在床上，有人在路上不停奔走。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l011.segmentation: Some lie down on their beds, some never cease traveling on the road.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l012.segmentation: 或不知叫号，或惨惨劬劳；
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l012.explanation: 有人不知呼号之苦，有人惨惨劬劳；

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l012.segmentation: Some know nothing of cries of distress, some toil in bitter misery;

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l013.segmentation: 或栖迟偃仰，或王事鞅掌。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l013.explanation: 有人安闲躺卧，有人为王事忙得不可开交。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l013.segmentation: Some live at leisure, others are overwhelmed with the king's business.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l014.segmentation: 或湛乐饮酒，或惨惨畏咎；
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l014.explanation: 有人沉湎饮酒作乐，有人惨惨畏惧灾祸；

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l014.segmentation: Some drink deep in pleasure, some live in dread of blame and punishment;

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l015.segmentation: 或出入风议，或靡事不为。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l015.explanation: 有人出入发表议论，有人无事不为王效劳。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-beishan-l015.segmentation: Some go in and out airing opinions, some have no task they do not perform for the king.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l001.segmentation: 楚楚者茨，言抽其棘，自昔何为？
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l001.explanation: 丛丛茨草，要拔除其中的荆棘；自古如此是为了什么呢？

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l001.segmentation: Thick thistles—we pull up their thorns; since olden days, what has this been for?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l003.explanation: 我的黍苗茂盛，我的稷苗整齐。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l003.segmentation: My millet stands lush; my sorghum rows are neat.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l004.explanation: 我的仓已满，我的庾积亿计。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l004.segmentation: My granaries are full; my storehouses hold measure upon measure.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l005.segmentation: 以为酒食，以享以祀，以妥以侑，以介景福。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l005.explanation: 做成酒食，用来献祭、祭祀，使神安、助祭，以祈求大福。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l005.segmentation: We make wine and food for offering and sacrifice, to settle the spirits and assist the rite, seeking great blessing.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l006.segmentation: 济济跄跄，絜尔牛羊，以往烝尝。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l006.explanation: 礼仪盛美，洁净牛羊，拿去进献秋冬之祭。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l006.segmentation: With stately rites we cleanse ox and sheep and bring them to the autumn and winter sacrifices.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l007.explanation: 有的剥皮有的烹煮，有的切成四块有的端上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l007.segmentation: Some skin and boil, some quarter the meat and some carry it forth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l008.segmentation: The invoker prays at the inner gate,

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l009.explanation: 祭祀之事非常明白成功。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l009.segmentation: and the sacrificial service is bright and complete.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l010.explanation: 先祖来享用，神尸也受祭飨。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l010.segmentation: The forefathers are honored; the spirit-host receives the feast.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l011.segmentation: 孝孙有庆，报以介福，万寿无疆！
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l011.explanation: 孝孙有喜庆，回报以大福，万寿无疆！

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l011.segmentation: The dutiful grandson has joy; great blessing returns—may life be endless!

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l012.segmentation: 执爨踖踖，为俎孔硕，或燔或炙。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l012.explanation: 掌炊的人勤勉，俎上祭品很丰盛，有的烧烤有的炙烤。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l012.segmentation: The cook is diligent; the stands hold ample offerings—some roasted, some broiled.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l013.explanation: 主妇恭敬，豆中食物很多。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l013.segmentation: The hostess is reverent; the dishes are heaped with food.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l015.segmentation: and cups are offered and returned in turn.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l016.explanation: 礼仪合乎法度，谈笑也合宜。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l016.segmentation: Rites keep proper measure; laughter and talk are fitting too.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l017.segmentation: 神保是格，报以介福，万寿攸酢！
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l017.explanation: 神尸来降临，回报以大福，万寿来酬答！

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l017.segmentation: The spirit-host arrives; great blessing returns—long life answers the toast!

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l018.explanation: 我十分恭敬，按礼法没有差错。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l018.segmentation: I am deeply reverent; in ritual there is no fault.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l019.explanation: 工祝致告辞，回去赏赐孝孙。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l019.segmentation: The ritual officer announces; blessings go back to the dutiful grandson.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l020.segmentation: Offerings are fragrant; the spirits delight in food and drink.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l021.explanation: 占卜赐予百福，多如期望、合于法度。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l021.segmentation: Divination grants a hundred blessings—as hoped, as ordained.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l022.explanation: 既整齐又严肃，既端正又谨慎。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l022.segmentation: All is orderly and solemn, correct and disciplined.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l023.explanation: 永远赐你至极之福，万福亿福！

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l023.segmentation: May you forever receive utmost blessing—myriad upon myriad!

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l024.segmentation: 礼仪既备，钟鼓既戒，孝孙徂位，工祝致告，神具醉止，皇尸载起。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l024.explanation: 礼仪已备，钟鼓已戒，孝孙就位，工祝致告，神都已醉，尸神起身。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l024.segmentation: Rites are ready, bells and drums sound; the grandson takes his place; the officer announces; the spirits are drunk; the corpse-stand rises.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l025.segmentation: Bells send off the corpse; the spirit guardian returns home.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l026.segmentation: Stewards and hostess clear the feast without delay.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l027.explanation: 叔伯兄弟，都来说家常宴饮。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l027.segmentation: Uncles and brothers all speak at the private feast.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l028.segmentation: Music enters and plays, to settle blessings yet to come.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l029.explanation: 你的菜肴已齐备，不要怨，都来同庆。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l029.segmentation: Your dishes are ready—let none complain; let all rejoice together.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l030.segmentation: Drunk and full, young and old all bow their heads.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l031.segmentation: The spirits enjoy the feast and grant the lord long life.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l032.explanation: 非常和顺非常及时，要尽心做到。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l032.segmentation: Great kindness, perfect timing—do your utmost to fulfill it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l033.explanation: 子子孙孙，不要废弃引继此礼！

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-chuci-l033.segmentation: Sons and grandsons—never let this rite fall away!

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l001.explanation: 有满簋的饭食，有长柄的棘匕。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l001.segmentation: Bowls brim with cooked rice; long-handled thorn spoons are ready.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l002.explanation: 周道平坦如磨刀石，其直如箭。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l002.segmentation: The Zhou road is smooth as a whetstone, straight as an arrow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l003.explanation: 君子所走的，小人所看的。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l003.segmentation: What the noble man treads, the common folk observe.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l004.explanation: 回头顾念它，不禁潸然泪下。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l004.segmentation: I turn to look back on it—and tears stream down.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l005.explanation: 小东大东，织机的轴和柚都空了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l005.segmentation: East near and far—the loom's beam and spool stand empty.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l006.explanation: 葛藤编的破鞋，竟要穿着踏霜。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l006.segmentation: Shoes woven of kudzu—yet they must tread the frost.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l007.explanation: 轻佻的公子，走在那周道上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l007.segmentation: The frivolous young lord walks that Zhou highway.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l008.explanation: 他去了又来，使我的心疚痛。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l008.segmentation: He goes and comes again—it wrings my heart with guilt and pain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l009.explanation: 有清冽的泉水，不要浸湿所砍的柴。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l009.segmentation: There is cool spring water—do not soak the firewood cut from the marsh.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l010.explanation: 清醒时叹息，哀怜我这劳苦的人。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l010.segmentation: Awake I sigh in grief for us who toil in misery.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l011.explanation: 柴是刚砍的柴，还可以装载。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l011.segmentation: The fuel is fresh-cut—it could still be loaded and carried.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l012.explanation: 哀怜我这劳苦的人，也可以休息了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l012.segmentation: Pity us who toil—we too could have rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l013.explanation: 东方人的子弟，服劳役却得不到慰劳。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l013.segmentation: Sons of the eastern lands toil in service yet receive no kindness.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l014.explanation: 西方人的子弟，衣服鲜明华丽。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l014.segmentation: Sons of the western lands wear bright and splendid clothes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l015.segmentation: Boatmen's sons wear coats of bear and tiger hide.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l016.explanation: 贵族子弟，试任各种官职。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l016.segmentation: Private men's sons are tried out in every office.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l017.segmentation: Some are given wine, not plain broth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l018.explanation: 佩玉锵锵，不凭其才德之长。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l018.segmentation: Jade pendants chime—yet merit, not ornament, should rule.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l019.explanation: 天上有银河，照临也有光芒。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l019.segmentation: Heaven has its River—watching, it too sends forth light.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l020.explanation: 看那织女，终日七次移位。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l020.segmentation: See the Weaver Maid—seven times she shifts her place all day.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l021.explanation: 虽然七次移位，却织不成有花纹的布。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l021.segmentation: Though she moves seven times, she weaves no patterned cloth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l022.explanation: 看那牵牛星，不能用来拉车箱。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l022.segmentation: See the Ox Driver—he cannot haul the cart's load-box.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l023.explanation: 东方有启明，西方有长庚。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l023.segmentation: Eastward is Morning Bright; westward is Long Evening Star.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l024.explanation: 有长柄的天毕星，却只是施在行路上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l024.segmentation: The Net constellation has its handle—yet it only spans the road.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l025.explanation: 南方有箕星，不能用来簸扬谷。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l025.segmentation: South is the Winnow Basket—it cannot winnow grain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l026.segmentation: 维北有斗，不可以挹酒浆。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l026.explanation: 北方有斗星，不能用来舀酒浆。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l026.segmentation: North is the Dipper—it cannot ladle wine and broth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l027.explanation: 南方有箕星，只是合拢其舌。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l027.segmentation: South is the Winnow Basket—it only gathers its tongue.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l028.explanation: 北方有斗星，把柄向西高举。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-dadong-l028.segmentation: North is the Dipper—its handle lifted toward the west.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l001.explanation: 习习谷风，又刮来风又带来雨。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l001.segmentation: The valley wind blows—wind comes and rain follows.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l002.explanation: 将要恐惧时，只有我和你在一起。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l002.segmentation: When fear was near, only you and I stood together.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l003.explanation: 将要安乐时，你却转身抛弃我。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l003.segmentation: When ease was near, you turned and cast me off.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l004.explanation: 习习谷风，又刮来风又带来旋风。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l004.segmentation: The valley wind blows—wind comes and the whirl follows.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l005.explanation: 将要恐惧时，你把我抱在怀里。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l005.segmentation: When fear was near, you held me in your arms.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l006.explanation: 将要安乐时，你把我像丢弃物一样抛弃。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l006.segmentation: When ease was near, you dropped me as something cast away.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l007.segmentation: The valley wind blows over towering peaks.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l008.explanation: 没有草不枯死，没有树不凋萎。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l008.segmentation: No grass but dies; no tree but withers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l009.explanation: 你忘了我大的恩德，却记我小的怨隙。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-gufeng-l009.segmentation: You forgot my great kindness yet brood on my small grievances.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l001.segmentation: 鼓钟将将，淮水汤汤，忧心且伤。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l001.explanation: 鼓钟锵锵，淮水汤汤，忧心而且伤。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l001.segmentation: Bells and drums ring loud; the Huai rolls on—my heart is wounded with grief.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l002.explanation: 那贤德君子，我怀念诚信不忘。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l002.segmentation: That good and noble man—I cherish his faith and cannot forget.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l003.segmentation: 鼓钟喈喈，淮水湝湝，忧心且悲。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l003.explanation: 鼓钟喈喈，淮水湝湝，忧心而且悲。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l003.segmentation: Bells chime clearly; the Huai flows gently—my heart is heavy with sorrow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l004.explanation: 那贤德君子，其德不邪曲。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l004.segmentation: That good and noble man—his virtue does not bend awry.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l005.segmentation: 鼓钟伐鼛，淮有三洲，忧心且妯。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l005.explanation: 鼓钟伐鼛，淮中有三洲，忧心而且动。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l005.segmentation: Bells strike the great drum; three islets lie in the Huai—my heart is stirred with pain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l006.explanation: 那贤德君子，其德无人能及。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l006.segmentation: That good and noble man—none can match his virtue.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l007.segmentation: 鼓钟钦钦，鼓瑟鼓琴，笙磬同音。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l007.explanation: 鼓钟钦钦，鼓瑟鼓琴，笙磬同音。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l007.segmentation: Bells ring softly; zithers and drums sound; pipes and chimes harmonize.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l008.explanation: 奏雅乐与南乐，用龠管也不越礼。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-guzhong-l008.segmentation: They play Ya and Nan music—the flute keeps within proper bounds.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l001.explanation: 长得茂盛的莪，不是莪而是蒿。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l001.segmentation: Lushly growing—what seems dwarf mugwort is wild artemisia instead.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l002.explanation: 可悲啊父母，生我多么辛劳。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l002.segmentation: Alas, my parents—bearing me cost you bitter toil.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l003.explanation: 长得茂盛的莪，不是莪而是蔚。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l003.segmentation: Lushly growing—what seems mugwort is wormwood instead.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l004.explanation: 可悲啊父母，生我劳累成病。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l004.segmentation: Alas, my parents—bearing me wore you to exhaustion.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l005.explanation: 瓶已空了，是酒坛的羞耻。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l005.segmentation: When the flask is empty, it shames the jar that should fill it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l006.segmentation: 鲜民之生，不如死之久矣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l006.explanation: 孤儿活着，不如早死已久。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l006.segmentation: An orphan's life is worse than having long been dead.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l007.segmentation: Without a father, on whom can I rely?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l008.segmentation: Without a mother, on whom can I depend?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l009.explanation: 出门带着忧伤，回家没有亲人。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l009.segmentation: Out of doors I bear grief; at home no one awaits me.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l010.explanation: 父亲啊生养我，母亲啊哺育我。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l010.segmentation: Father, you gave me life; mother, you nursed me.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l011.segmentation: 抚我畜我，长我育我，顾我复我，出入腹我。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l011.explanation: 抚我畜我，长我育我，顾我复我，出入腹我。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l011.segmentation: You tended and raised me, watched and brought me back, sheltered me in going out and coming in.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l013.segmentation: yet vast Heaven knows no limit!

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l014.segmentation: The southern hills stand stark; the gale blows fierce.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l015.explanation: 人民没有不得到好处的，唯独我有什么祸害！

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l015.segmentation: No folk but receive good—why alone do I suffer harm?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l016.segmentation: The southern hills rise steep; the storm wind sweeps on.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l017.explanation: 人民没有不得到好处的，唯独我不能终老！

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-liaoe-l017.segmentation: No folk but receive good—why alone may I not live out my years?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l001.explanation: 四月正是夏天，六月就到了酷暑。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l001.segmentation: The fourth month is summer; by the sixth, the heat of summer arrives.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l002.explanation: 先祖不是常人，怎忍心这样待我？

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l002.segmentation: My forebears were not common men—how could they bear to treat me thus?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l003.segmentation: Autumn is bleak; every plant withers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l004.explanation: 乱离多病痛，我将归向何处？

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l004.segmentation: In turmoil and sickness—where can I turn for home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l005.segmentation: Winter is harsh; the gale blows fierce.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l006.explanation: 人民没有不得到好处的，唯独我有什么祸害？

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l006.segmentation: No folk but receive good—why alone do I suffer harm?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l007.segmentation: On the hills grow fine plants—chestnut and plum.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l008.explanation: 被废弃成为残贼，不知其罪过！

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l008.segmentation: Cast off, made an outcast—who knows my fault?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l009.explanation: 看那泉水，有时清有时浊。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l009.segmentation: Look at the spring—now clear, now muddy.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l010.explanation: 我天天招祸，怎么说能得好？

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l010.segmentation: Each day I gather misfortune—how can I say I receive good?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l011.explanation: 滔滔江汉，是南方的纲纪。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l011.segmentation: The Han and Jiang roll on—the backbone of the southern lands.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l012.explanation: 尽心国事，难道没有我一份？

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l012.segmentation: I wear myself out in service—does the realm not owe me anything?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l013.explanation: 不是鹑也不是鸢，却能高飞到天。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l013.segmentation: Neither quail nor kite—yet some fly up to the sky.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l014.explanation: 不是鳣也不是鲔，却能潜藏在深渊。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l014.segmentation: Neither sturgeon nor shad—yet some hide in the deep.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l015.explanation: 山上有蕨薇，低湿处有杞桋。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l015.segmentation: Ferns grow on the hills; elm and wolfberry in the wet lowlands.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l016.explanation: 君子作歌，只是用来诉说悲哀。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-siyue-l016.segmentation: The noble man makes this song only to declare his grief.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache-.explanation: 不要推那大车，只会沾满尘土。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache-.segmentation: Do not push the heavy cart—you will only be covered with dust.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache-.explanation: 不要想那些忧愁，只会自己致病。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache-.segmentation: Do not brood on countless cares—you will only make yourself ill.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache-.explanation: 不要推那大车，尘土昏冥蒙罩。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache-.segmentation: Do not push the heavy cart—the dust hangs dark and dim.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache-.explanation: 不要想那些忧愁，不会从心中明白。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache-.segmentation: Do not brood on cares—they will not bring clarity to your mind.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache-.explanation: 不要推那大车，尘土壅塞弥漫。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache-.segmentation: Do not push the heavy cart—the dust chokes and swells.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache-.explanation: 不要想那些忧愁，只会自寻沉重。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-wujiangdache-.segmentation: Do not brood on cares—you will only burden yourself the more.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l001.explanation: 光明照人的上天，照临下方大地。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l001.segmentation: Bright Heaven shines clearly, looking down upon the earth below.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l002.explanation: 我出征往西，到了远野之地。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l002.segmentation: I march west on campaign, reaching the wild distant fields.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l003.explanation: 二月初吉出发，经历了寒暑更替。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l003.segmentation: I set out at the month's first good day and passed through cold and heat.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l004.explanation: 心中的忧愁，像大苦之毒。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l004.segmentation: The grief in my heart is bitter as the strongest poison.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l005.explanation: 想到那贤德之人，眼泪零落如雨。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l005.segmentation: When I think of that good man, tears fall like rain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l006.segmentation: Do I not long to return home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l007.segmentation: I fear the net of guilt and punishment!

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l008.explanation: 当初我离开的时候，日月刚除旧。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l008.segmentation: When first I left, sun and moon had just turned the year.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l010.segmentation: The year has already reached its end.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l011.explanation: 想到我孤独一人，我的事很多很繁。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l011.segmentation: I think how alone I am—my tasks are many and pressing.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l012.explanation: 心中的忧愁，使我劳碌没有闲暇。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l012.segmentation: Grief in my heart leaves me no leisure to rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l013.explanation: 想到那贤德之人，眷眷地怀念顾念！

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l013.segmentation: I think of that good man and turn to him with longing!

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l014.segmentation: Do I not long to return home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l015.segmentation: I fear reproof and angry blame.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l016.explanation: 当初我离开的时候，日月正藏入地下。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l016.segmentation: When first I left, sun and moon were in their hidden course.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l018.segmentation: Official business grows ever more urgent.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l019.explanation: 年岁到了暮秋，采萧收豆。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l019.segmentation: Year's end comes—we gather wormwood and harvest beans.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l020.explanation: 心中的忧愁，是自找悲伤。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l020.segmentation: The grief in my heart is sorrow I bring on myself.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l021.explanation: 想到那贤德之人，起来说话而夜宿不归。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l021.segmentation: I think of that good man, rise to speak, and lodge abroad.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l022.segmentation: Do I not long to return home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l023.segmentation: I fear the shifting turns of fortune and blame.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l024.explanation: 唉你们君子，不要总想安逸。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l024.segmentation: Alas, you gentlemen—do not always seek ease.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l025.explanation: 敬慎你的职位，以正直为伴侣。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l025.segmentation: Be reverent in your post; take uprightness as your companion.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l026.segmentation: The spirits will listen and grant you blessing.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l027.explanation: 唉你们君子，不要总想安息。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l027.segmentation: Alas, you gentlemen—do not always seek rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l028.explanation: 敬慎你的职位，喜好正直。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l028.segmentation: Be reverent in your post and love what is straight.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xiaoming-l029.segmentation: The spirits will listen and grant you great blessing.

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: 信彼南山，维禹甸之。
