sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 确实啊，那南山，是大禹所划定的疆域。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: Truly that southern hill was the domain marked out by Yu.
畇畇原隰，曾孙田之。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 平原和低地平坦整齐，周王在这里垦田。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: The plains and lowlands lie smooth and even; the king's descendant tills them.
我疆我理，南东其亩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 划分疆界、整理田亩，向南向东开辟耕地。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: We mark our borders and lay out the fields, opening plots toward south and east.
上天同云。
The sky is covered with one uniform cloud.
雨雪雰雰，益之以霡霂。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 雪花纷纷飘落，又加上绵绵细雨。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: Snow falls in flurries, and fine drizzle is added to it.
既优既渥，既沾既足。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 雨水既充足又丰沛，既浸润又满足。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: The rain is ample and rich, soaking the earth until it is fully satisfied.
生我百谷。
Thus the hundred grains are brought to life.
疆埸翼翼，黍稷彧彧。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 田界整齐，黍稷长得茂盛繁密。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: The field borders stand trim; millet and panicled millet grow lush and thick.
曾孙之穑，以为酒食。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 周王收获的庄稼，用来酿酒做饭。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: The harvest gathered by the king's descendant becomes wine and food.
畀我尸宾，寿考万年。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 献给代表先人的尸和宾客，祝愿长寿万年。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: It is offered to the impersonator of the dead and to guests, wishing long life for ten thousand years.
中田有庐，疆埸有瓜。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 田中有庐舍，田界上种着瓜。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: In the middle of the fields are huts; along the borders grow melons.
是剥是菹，献之皇祖。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 剥好切好，腌成菜蔬，献给先王先祖。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: They are peeled and sliced into pickles and presented to the royal ancestors.
曾孙寿考，受天之祜。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 周王长寿，承受上天赐予的福佑。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: The king's descendant lives long and receives Heaven's blessing.
祭以清酒，从以骍牡，享于祖考。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 用清酒祭祀，又配上赤色公牛，献给祖先。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: The rite uses clear wine, followed by a red bull, offered to the forefathers.
执其鸾刀，以启其毛，取其血膋。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 手持鸾刀，剖开牲毛，取出血和脂膏。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: Holding the bell-handled knife, they part the hair and take the blood and suet.
是烝是享，苾苾芬芬。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 这样蒸献、这样享祭，香气芬芳四溢。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: Thus steamed and thus presented, the offering is richly fragrant.
祀事孔明，先祖是皇。
sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.explanation: 祭祀的事非常明达，先祖因而来享用。

sj-ya-xiaoya-gufengzhishen-xinnanshan-l0.segmentation: The sacrificial service is perfectly done, and the ancestors are duly honored.
报以介福。
In return comes great blessing.
万寿无疆。
May life be endless without limit.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l001.explanation: 那洁白的小马，吃我场圃里的豆苗。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l001.segmentation: That gleaming white colt feeds on the shoots in my threshing yard.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l002.explanation: 拴住它、留住它，以延长今日的相聚。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l002.segmentation: Tie it and hold it fast, to prolong this morning together.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l003.explanation: 所说的那位贤人，在这里逍遥吗？

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l003.segmentation: Is that noble man at ease and wandering here?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l004.explanation: 那洁白的小马，吃我场圃里的豆叶。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l004.segmentation: That gleaming white colt feeds on the leaves in my yard.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l005.explanation: 拴住它、留住它，以延长今夜的相聚。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l005.segmentation: Tie it and hold it fast, to prolong this evening together.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l006.explanation: 所说的那位贤人，在这里作佳客吗？

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l006.segmentation: Is that noble man here as an honored guest?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l007.explanation: 那洁白的小马，光彩照人地来了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l007.segmentation: That gleaming white colt comes with shining grace.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l008.explanation: 你身为公侯，安逸享乐没有止境吗？

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l008.segmentation: You who are duke or marquis—will your ease and pleasure know no end?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l009.explanation: 谨慎你的优游，勉励你及早归隐。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l009.segmentation: Be careful in your leisure; urge yourself toward withdrawal and retreat.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l010.explanation: 那洁白的小马，在那空谷之中。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l010.segmentation: That gleaming white colt is in that empty valley.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l011.explanation: 生刍一束，那人品德如美玉。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l011.segmentation: A bundle of fresh grass—for him whose person is like jade.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l012.explanation: 不要吝惜金玉般的信息，却存疏远之心。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-baiju-l012.segmentation: Do not be sparing with messages precious as gold and jade, yet harbor a heart that keeps afar.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l001.explanation: 鹤在深水沼泽鸣叫，声音传到旷野。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l001.segmentation: The crane cries in the deep marsh; its voice is heard in the wilds.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l002.explanation: 鱼潜藏在深渊，有的却在小洲上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l002.segmentation: Fish hide in the deep pool, or some lie on the sandbar.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l003.segmentation: 乐彼之园，爰有树檀，其下维萚。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l003.explanation: 喜欢那个园圃，那里有檀树，树下是柞树。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l003.segmentation: Delight in that garden: there stands sandalwood, and beneath it are oak shoots.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l004.explanation: 他山的石头，可以作磨玉的工具。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l004.segmentation: Stones from another hill can serve as whetstones.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l005.explanation: 鹤在深水沼泽鸣叫，声音传到天上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l005.segmentation: The crane cries in the deep marsh; its voice reaches the sky.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l006.explanation: 鱼在小洲上，有的却潜藏在深渊。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l006.segmentation: Fish are on the sandbar, or some hide in the deep pool.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l007.segmentation: 乐彼之园，爰有树檀，其下维谷。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l007.explanation: 喜欢那个园圃，那里有檀树，树下是谷子。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l007.segmentation: Delight in that garden: there stands sandalwood, and beneath it is millet.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l008.explanation: 他山的石头，可以雕琢美玉。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-heming-l008.segmentation: Stones from another hill can be used to carve and polish jade.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l001.segmentation: Wild geese are flying; their wings rustle solemnly.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l002.explanation: 那人远行在外，在旷野辛劳奔波。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l002.segmentation: That man is away on a journey, toiling in the open wilds.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l003.explanation: 乃至可怜的人，哀怜这些鳏夫寡妇。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l003.segmentation: Reaching even the needy, pity these widowers and widows.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l004.segmentation: Wild geese are flying; they settle in the middle marsh.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l005.explanation: 那人筑墙，百堵一齐动工。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l005.segmentation: That man builds walls; a hundred lengths of wall are raised.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l006.explanation: 虽然辛劳，他们究竟能安居吗？

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l006.segmentation: Though they toil, where in the end will they find a home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l007.segmentation: Wild geese are flying, crying out in mournful calls.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l008.explanation: 只有这哲人，说我是在辛劳。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l008.segmentation: Only the wise man says I am toiling.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l009.explanation: 那些愚人，却说我是在炫耀。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-hongyan-l009.segmentation: Those fools say I am showing off and acting proud.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.segmentation: 黄鸟黄鸟，无集于穀，无啄我粟。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.explanation: 黄鸟黄鸟，不要落在楮树上，不要啄我的粟。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.segmentation: Yellow bird, yellow bird—do not perch on the paper mulberry; do not peck my millet.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.explanation: 这个封国的人，不肯善待我。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.segmentation: The people of this state refuse to treat me kindly.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.explanation: 快回去吧，回到我的宗族。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.segmentation: Turn back and go home; return to my clan and kin.
黄鸟黄鸟，无集于桑，无啄我粱。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.explanation: 黄鸟黄鸟，不要落在桑树上，不要啄我的粱。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.segmentation: Yellow bird, yellow bird—do not perch on the mulberry; do not peck my fine grain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.explanation: 这个封国的人，无法与之讲理。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.segmentation: The people of this state cannot be reasoned with.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.explanation: 快回去吧，回到我的兄弟们那里。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.segmentation: Turn back and go home; return to my elder brothers.
黄鸟黄鸟，无集于栩，无啄我黍。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.explanation: 黄鸟黄鸟，不要落在柞树上，不要啄我的黍。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.segmentation: Yellow bird, yellow bird—do not perch on the oak; do not peck my panicled millet.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.explanation: 这个封国的人，无法与之共处。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.segmentation: The people of this state cannot be lived with.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.explanation: 快回去吧，回到我的叔伯们那里。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-huangniao-l0.segmentation: Turn back and go home; return to my uncles and father's brothers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.segmentation: The Mián waters flow on, gathering toward the sea.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.explanation: 隼鸟飞得很快，时而飞起时而停落。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.segmentation: The swift falcon flies—now soaring, now alighting.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.explanation: 唉，我的兄弟，封国中的各位朋友。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.segmentation: Alas, my brothers, friends throughout the state.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.explanation: 谁肯念及祸乱？谁没有父母？

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.segmentation: Who will heed the turmoil? Who is without parents?
The Mián waters flow on, rushing in broad waves.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.explanation: 隼鸟飞得很快，时而飞起时而高飞。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.segmentation: The swift falcon flies—now rising, now soaring high.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.explanation: 想到那些不走正路的人，我起身又行。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.segmentation: Thinking of those who stray from the right path, I rise and go again.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.explanation: 心中忧愁，无法止息忘却。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.segmentation: Sorrow fills my heart and cannot be stilled or forgotten.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.explanation: 隼鸟飞得很快，沿着山陵飞翔。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l00.segmentation: The swift falcon flies, sweeping along the hill ridges.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l01.explanation: 民间的谣言，难道没有人惩戒吗？

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l01.segmentation: The people's false rumors—is no one to punish them?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l01.explanation: 我的朋友已经恭敬了，谗言却还要兴起。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-mianshui-l01.segmentation: My friend has been respectful, yet slander is rising.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu-l001.explanation: 祈父啊，你是大王的爪牙。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu-l001.segmentation: Minister of war, you are the king's fangs and claws.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu-l002.explanation: 为什么把我调去服劳役，没有安顿之处？

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu-l002.segmentation: Why transfer me to hardship service with nowhere to settle?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu-l003.explanation: 祈父啊，你是大王的虎士。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu-l003.segmentation: Minister of war, you are the king's brave warriors.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu-l004.explanation: 为什么把我调去服劳役，没有止息之日？

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu-l004.segmentation: Why transfer me to hardship service with no day of rest?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu-l005.segmentation: Minister of war, you are truly not discerning.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu-l006.explanation: 为什么把我调去服劳役？

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu-l006.segmentation: Why transfer me to hardship service?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu-l007.explanation: 我有母亲在家需要供养。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-qifu-l007.segmentation: I have a mother at home who must be fed.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l001.segmentation: The stream ranks clear; the southern hill lies deep and still.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l002.explanation: 像竹子丛生，像松树繁茂。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l002.segmentation: Like bamboo clustered thick, like pine trees lush and green.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l003.segmentation: 兄及弟矣，式相好矣，无相犹矣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l003.explanation: 兄弟相聚，互相友好，不要猜忌。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l003.segmentation: Brothers together, loving one another—let there be no suspicion.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l004.segmentation: 似续妣祖，筑室百堵，西南其户。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l004.explanation: 继承先妣先祖，筑室百堵，门户开向西南。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l004.segmentation: Continuing the line of ancestresses and forefathers, they build a hundred rooms with doors facing southwest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l005.explanation: 在这里居住，在这里欢笑交谈。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l005.segmentation: Here they dwell and rest, here they laugh and talk.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l006.explanation: 夯土声阁阁，打桩声橐橐。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l006.segmentation: The tamping sounds thud-thud; the pounding of stakes goes tap-tap.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l007.segmentation: 风雨攸除，鸟鼠攸去，君子攸芋。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l007.explanation: 风雨被挡在外，鸟鼠被驱除，君子在此安居。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l007.segmentation: Wind and rain are kept out, birds and mice driven away—the noble man finds shelter here.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l008.segmentation: 如跂斯翼，如矢斯棘，如鸟斯革，如翚斯飞，君子攸跻。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l008.explanation: 像人踮脚般齐整，像箭矢般端正，像鸟羽般光泽，像野鸡飞般华美，君子登堂。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l008.segmentation: Upright as one on tiptoe, square as an arrow's end, sleek as a bird's plumes, soaring as a pheasant in flight—the noble man ascends.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l009.segmentation: The courtyard lies level; the pillars stand tall and straight.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l010.segmentation: The main hall is bright; the inner rooms are dim.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l011.segmentation: The noble man finds peace here.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l012.explanation: 下铺莞草席，上盖竹席，于是安睡。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l012.segmentation: Rush mat below, bamboo mat above—thus they rest in sleep.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l013.explanation: 睡下又起身，占问我的梦。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l013.segmentation: They sleep and rise again, and divining, ask about my dream.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l015.explanation: 梦见熊和罴，梦见虺和蛇。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l015.segmentation: Bears and brown bears, serpents and snakes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l016.segmentation: 大人占之：维熊维罴，男子之祥；
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l016.explanation: 长辈占梦说：熊和罴，是生男子的征兆；

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l016.segmentation: The elders interpret: bears and brown bears mean a boy is coming;

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l017.explanation: 虺和蛇，是生女子的征兆。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l017.segmentation: Serpents and snakes mean a girl is coming.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l018.explanation: 于是生了男子，让他睡在床上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l018.segmentation: A boy is born; he is laid on a bed.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l019.explanation: 给他穿衣裳，给他玩玉璋。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l019.segmentation: He is dressed in robes and given a jade scepter to play with.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l020.segmentation: 其泣喤喤，朱芾斯皇，室家君王。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l020.explanation: 他哭声响亮，将来穿朱芾作诸侯，家室为王。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l020.segmentation: His crying rings loud; he will wear scarlet knee-guards as lord; his house will serve the king.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l021.explanation: 于是生了女子，让她睡在地上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l021.segmentation: A girl is born; she is laid on the ground.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l022.explanation: 给她穿短衣，给她玩瓦片。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l022.segmentation: She is dressed in a short garment and given a tile to play with.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l023.segmentation: 无非无仪，唯酒食是议，无父母诒罹。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l023.explanation: 无非无仪，只议酒食，不给父母惹祸。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-sigan-l023.segmentation: No wrong, no special role—only food and drink are her concern, bringing no trouble to her parents.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao-l00.segmentation: How far has the night advanced?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao-l00.explanation: 夜还未尽，庭中火炬明亮。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao-l00.segmentation: The night is not yet ended; the court torches blaze.
The noble lord arrives; the bell on his carriage rings clearly.
How far has the night advanced?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao-l00.explanation: 夜还未止，庭中火炬亮堂堂。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao-l00.segmentation: The night is not yet over; the court torches shine bright.
The noble lord arrives; the carriage bells ring in succession.
How far has the night advanced?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao-l00.explanation: 夜已近晨，庭中火炬仍有光辉。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao-l00.segmentation: The night nears dawn; the court torches still glow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao-l00.explanation: 君子来了，请看他的旗帜。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-tingliao-l00.segmentation: The noble lord arrives—look upon his banners.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.explanation: 我行走在郊野，臭椿树幼嫩茂盛。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.segmentation: I walk the wilds; the ailanthus saplings grow lush and young.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.explanation: 因为婚姻的缘故，才到你这里来住。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.segmentation: Because of marriage I came to dwell with you.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.explanation: 你不肯养我，让我回到我的家国。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.segmentation: You will not keep me; let me return to my state and home.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.explanation: 我行走在郊野，采那蓫菜。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.segmentation: I walk the wilds, gathering the hogfennel.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.explanation: 因为婚姻的缘故，才到你这里来宿。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.segmentation: Because of marriage I came to lodge with you.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.explanation: 你不肯养我，我言归就回。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.segmentation: You will not keep me; I say I will go back.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.explanation: 我行走在郊野，采那葍草。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.segmentation: I walk the wilds, gathering the convolvulus.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.explanation: 不想旧日的姻亲，只求你新的配偶。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.segmentation: You forget the old tie of kin; you seek only your new mate.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.explanation: 成亲并非因为富足，只是因为你变了心。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-woxingqiye-l.segmentation: Union was not for wealth—it is only that you have changed.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l001.segmentation: Who says you have no sheep?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l003.segmentation: Who says you have no cattle?

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l005.explanation: 你们的羊来了，角儿密密挤在一起。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l005.segmentation: Your sheep come; their horns press close together.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l006.explanation: 你们的牛来了，耳朵湿湿垂下。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l006.segmentation: Your cattle come; their ears hang damp and low.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l007.segmentation: 或降于阿，或饮于池，或寝或讹。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l007.explanation: 有的走下山坡，有的在池边饮水，有的睡有的动。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l007.segmentation: Some descend the slope, some drink at the pool, some sleep, some stir.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l008.segmentation: 尔牧来思，何蓑何笠，或负其餱。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l008.explanation: 你们的牧人来了，披着蓑衣戴着斗笠，有的背着干粮。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l008.segmentation: Your herdsmen come, in rain capes and bamboo hats, some bearing dry rations.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l009.explanation: 三十种祭物，你们的牺牲齐备了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l009.segmentation: Thirty kinds of offerings—your sacrificial beasts are complete.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l010.segmentation: 尔牧来思，以薪以蒸，以雌以雄。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l010.explanation: 你们的牧人来了，带着柴薪和蒸物，有雌有雄。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l010.segmentation: Your herdsmen come with firewood and steamed food, both female and male beasts.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l011.segmentation: 尔羊来思，矜矜兢兢，不骞不崩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l011.explanation: 你们的羊来了，矜矜兢兢，不丢失不溃散。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l011.segmentation: Your sheep come, careful and wary, not straying nor breaking rank.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l012.explanation: 挥动手臂一招呼，全都聚拢登上圈栏。

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l012.segmentation: With a wave of the arm they are all gathered and led up.

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l013.segmentation: 牧人乃梦，众维鱼矣，旐维旟矣，大人占之；
sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l013.explanation: 牧人做梦，梦见众鱼，梦见旗旐；长辈占梦：

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l013.segmentation: The herdsman dreams: a multitude of fish, banners and pennants—the elders interpret:

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l014.segmentation: Many fish mean a year of plenty;

sj-ya-xiaoya-hongyanzhishen-wuyang-l015.segmentation: Banners and pennants mean the household will flourish.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: His heart is deeply hard and cruel.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.explanation: 为什么经过我的鱼梁，却不进我的门？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: Why pass my fish weir yet not enter my door?
Who is it that he follows?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.explanation: 两人同行，是谁造成了这场灾祸？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: Two walk together—who brought this disaster?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.explanation: 为什么经过我的鱼梁，不来慰问？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: Why pass my fish weir and not come to console me?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.explanation: 当初不像现在这样，如今说我不对。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: It was not like this at first; now he says I am in the wrong.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.explanation: 我听见他的声音，却看不见他的身影。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: I hear his voice but do not see his form.
Is he not ashamed before others?
Is he not in awe of Heaven?
Why does he not come from the north?
Why does he not come from the south?
He churns my heart into turmoil.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.explanation: 你慢慢走，也不稍作停留。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: When you go at ease, you still will not pause.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.explanation: 你快快走，也顾不上给车加油。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: When you hurry, you have no time even to grease your cart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.explanation: 你这一来，为何那样瞪眼看我。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: When you come, why do you stare at me so?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.explanation: 你回来进门，我的心就宽了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: If you return and enter, my heart is eased.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.explanation: 回来却不进门，情分就难以知道了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: Return yet not enter—then how can affection be known?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.explanation: 你这一来，使我心乱如麻。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: When you come, you throw my heart into turmoil.
The elder brother plays the xun; the younger plays the chi.
及尔如贯，谅不我郑出此三物，以诅尔斯。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.explanation: 与你如贯珠般亲密，料你不会把我抛弃；拿出这三物，对你诅咒。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: Close as beads on a string—I trust you would not cast me off; yet I bring these three things to curse you.
If you were ghost or goblin, one could not seize you;

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.explanation: 却有脸皮，看人毫无底线。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: But you have a face and stare at people beyond all shame.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.explanation: 作此好歌，以尽反复无常之心。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-herensi-l.segmentation: I make this fine song to exhaust my tossing, restless heart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: 节彼南山，维石岩岩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 那南山高峻，岩石层层。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Lofty is that southern hill; its rocks stand steep and sheer.
赫赫师尹，民具尔瞻。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 师尹威名赫赫，万民都在仰望他。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Grand Master Yin shines in majesty; all the people look up to him.
忧心如惔，不敢戏谈。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 忧心如火焚烧，不敢随便谈笑。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: My heart burns with care; I dare not speak in jest.
国既卒斩，何用不监！
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 国家已经残破，为何还不省察！

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: The state is already cut down—why will you not look and see!
节彼南山，有实其猗。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 那南山高峻，山上有茂美的草木。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Lofty is that southern hill; on it grow lush plants.
赫赫师尹，不平谓何。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 师尹威名赫赫，不平之事怎么说？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Grand Master Yin shines in majesty—how can injustice be explained?
天方荐瘥，丧乱弘多。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 上天正降疫病，丧乱越来越多。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Heaven is sending pestilence; death and disorder multiply.
民言无嘉，惨莫惩嗟。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 百姓的话没有好话，惨状无人惩戒叹息。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: The people's words hold no praise; none lament or check the misery.
尹氏大师，维周之氐；
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 尹氏是太师，是周的根基；

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Yin is Grand Master, the foundation of Zhou;
秉国之钧，四方是维。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 执掌国政，维系四方。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: He holds the state's balance and holds the four quarters firm.
天子是毗，俾民不迷。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 辅佐天子，使百姓不迷失。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: He supports the Son of Heaven and keeps the people from going astray.
不吊昊天，不宜空我师。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 不怜恤昊天，不宜使国家空虚。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Pityless toward great Heaven—he should not leave the state hollow.
弗躬弗亲，庶民弗信。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 不亲自过问，百姓就不会信从。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: If he does not attend in person, the people will not trust.
弗问弗仕，勿罔君子。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 不问政事、不任贤才，不要欺罔君子。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Not inquiring, not employing talent—do not mislead the noble men.
式夷式已，无小人殆。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 平息祸乱、制止恶行，不要让小人得逞。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Calm disorder and stop evil; do not let petty men prevail.
琐琐姻亚，则无膴仕。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 琐碎的姻亲，就没有好官职。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Petty connections by marriage—then no worthy office remains.
昊天不佣，降此鞠訩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 昊天不助，降下如此大祸。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Great Heaven does not help; such great distress descends.
昊天不惠，降此大戾。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 昊天不惠，降下如此大灾。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Great Heaven is unkind; such great calamity descends.
君子如届，俾民心阕。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 君子如能到来，可使民心安定。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: If noble men would come, the people's hearts would find rest.
君子如夷，恶怒是违。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 君子如能平易，就可远离暴怒。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: If noble men were even-tempered, raging anger could be avoided.
不吊昊天，乱靡有定。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 不怜恤昊天，祸乱没有止境。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Pityless toward Heaven—chaos knows no end.
式月斯生，俾民不宁。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 日月交替而生，使百姓不得安宁。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Month follows month and life goes on, yet the people know no peace.
忧心如酲，谁秉国成？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 忧心如醉，谁执掌国政？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: My heart aches as if drunk—who holds the reins of state?
不自为政，卒劳百姓。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 不亲自理政，终使百姓劳苦。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Not governing himself, he finally wears the people out.
驾彼四牡，四牡项领。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 驾起四匹公马，四马颈项肥壮。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: He yokes the four stallions; their necks are stout and strong.
我瞻四方，蹙蹙靡所骋。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 我望四方，局促无处施展。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: I look to the four quarters—cramped, with nowhere to advance.
方茂尔恶，相尔矛矣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 你恶行正盛时，对我亮出矛。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: When your wickedness flourishes, you level spears at me.
既夷既怿，如相酬矣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 一旦和缓喜悦，又像对饮酬答。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Once eased and pleased, you act as at a drinking toast.
昊天不平，我王不宁。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 昊天不公，我王不得安宁。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Heaven is not fair; our king finds no peace.
不惩其心，覆怨其正。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 不惩戒其心，反而怨恨正直。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: He will not correct his heart, yet resents those who are upright.
家父作诵，以究王訩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 家父作此诗，以探究王的祸患。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Jia Fu composed this poem to probe the king's distress.
式讹尔心，以畜万邦。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.explanation: 改正你的心思，以养育万邦。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-jienansha.segmentation: Amend your heart and mind, to nourish the myriad states.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 悠悠昊天，如同父母啊。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: Far-reaching great Heaven—like a parent to us.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 无罪无辜，祸乱竟如此大。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: Without guilt, without fault—yet disorder is so vast.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 昊天已显威严，我确是无罪。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: Heaven has shown its might; truly I am not guilty.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 昊天降大祸，我确是无辜。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: Heaven sends great disaster; truly I am blameless.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 祸乱初生，越级进言已被包容。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: When disorder first arose, overstepping speech was already tolerated.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 祸乱又生，君子听信了谗言。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: Disorder arose again—the noble man believed slander.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 君子如能发怒，祸乱就会迅速止息。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: If the noble man would show anger, disorder would quickly cease.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 君子如能施福，祸乱就会迅速停止。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: If the noble man would grant blessing, disorder would quickly end.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 君子屡次盟誓，祸乱因此滋长。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: The noble man swears oaths again and again—therefore disorder grows long.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 君子信任盗贼，祸乱因此暴起。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: The noble man trusts thieves—therefore disorder breaks out.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 盗贼的话很甜，祸乱因此蔓延。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: The thief's words are sweet—therefore disorder spreads.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 不能止于恭敬，这是王的祸患。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: Unable to stop at reverence—this is the king's affliction.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 奕奕寝庙，是君子所建。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: Splendid are the ancestral temples—the noble men built them.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 秩秩大谋，圣人所定。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: Orderly are the great plans—the sages devised them.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 别人有心思，我能揣度它。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: Others have thoughts in mind; I can measure them.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 活跃的狡兔，遇到猎犬就被捉。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: The leaping, cunning hare—meet a hound and it is caught.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 柔弱的树木，君子才栽种。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: Soft, pliant trees—the noble man plants them.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 来来往往的流言，心中要数一数。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: Words going back and forth—count them in the heart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 夸夸其谈，从口中说出。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: Smooth, boastful talk pours from the mouth.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 巧言如簧，脸皮厚矣。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: Clever words like reed pipes—the face grows thick with shamelessness.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 那是什么人？
住在黄河的边沿。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: He dwells on the banks of the Yellow River.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 没有拳力没有勇力，却成为祸乱的阶梯。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: No fist, no courage—yet he serves as the stair to disorder.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 既瘸又肿，你的勇力在哪里？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: Lame and swollen—where is your bravery?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.explanation: 作为帮凶还很多，你的党徒有几何？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-qiaoyan-l.segmentation: As accomplices you have many—how large is your band of followers?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: 十月之交，朔月辛卯。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 十月之交，初一辛卯日。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: In the intercalary tenth month, on the first day, xinmao.
日有食之，亦孔之丑。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 发生日食，也实在是大凶。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: There was an eclipse of the sun—truly a great ill omen.
彼月而微，此日而微；
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 那月曾微暗，这日又微暗；

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: That moon was dimmed; this sun too is dimmed;
今此下民，亦孔之哀。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 如今这下的百姓，也实在可悲。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: Now the people below are deeply pitiable.
日月告凶，不用其行。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 日月预告凶险，不按常道运行。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: Sun and moon announce disaster; they do not keep their proper course.
四国无政，不用其良。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 四方无善政，不用贤良。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: The four quarters lack good government; the worthy are not used.
彼月而食，则维其常；
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 月食则是常事；

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: An eclipse of the moon is within the usual order;
此日而食，于何不臧。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 日食发生，于何不吉？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: An eclipse of the sun—how can it not be ill?
烨烨震电，不宁不令。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 电光闪闪，不安不宁。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: Lightning flashes—there is no peace, no order.
百川沸腾，山冢崒崩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 百川沸腾，山巅崩塌。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: All rivers seethe; mountain peaks crumble.
高岸为谷，深谷为陵。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 高岸变成深谷，深谷变成山陵。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: High banks become valleys; deep valleys become hills.
哀今之人，胡惨莫惩？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 哀叹现在的人，为何惨而不戒？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: Alas for people today—why such misery with no warning heeded?
皇父卿士，番维司徒，家伯维宰，仲允膳夫，棸子内史，蹶维趣马，楀维师氏。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 皇父卿士、樊司徒、家伯宰、仲允膳夫、棸子内史、蹶趣马、楀师氏。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: Huang Fu minister, Fan steward, Jia Bo chief, Zhong Yun cook, Zou steward, Jue master of horses, Yu commander of guards.
醘妻煽方处。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 褒姒煽动，正得其所。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: Bao Si stirs trouble and holds sway.
抑此皇父，岂曰不时？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 责备这皇父，难道说不是时宜？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: Blame this Huang Fu—is it not untimely?
胡为我作，不即我谋？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 为何为我造此，不即与我商量？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: Why do this to me without consulting me at once?
彻我墙屋，田卒污莱。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 拆我墙屋，田终至荒芜。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: Tear down my walls and house; my fields end in waste and weeds.
曰予不戕，礼则然矣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 说不是残害，礼法本来如此。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: He says it is not harm—the rites simply require it.
皇父孔圣，作都于向。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 皇父很圣明，在向地建都。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: Huang Fu is very wise; he builds his capital at Xiang.
择三有事，亶侯多藏。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 选三个有职事的人，确实多藏财物。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: He chooses three officials—truly they hoard much wealth.
不慭遗一老，俾守我王。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 不肯留下一个老臣，让他守护我王。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: He will not leave one old minister to guard our king.
择有车马，以居徂向。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 选有车马的人，迁居到向地。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: He picks those with chariots and horses to move to Xiang.
黾勉从事，不敢告劳。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 勉力从事，不敢诉说自己辛劳。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: I strive in service and dare not speak of my toil.
无罪无辜，谗口嚣嚣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 无罪无辜，谗口却喧哗。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: Without guilt, without fault—yet slanderous mouths clamor.
下民之孽，匪降自天。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 下民的灾祸，不是从天而降。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: The common people's disaster does not fall from Heaven.
噂沓背憎，职竞由人。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 聚谈背地憎恶，争竞都出于人。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: Gossip and secret hatred—striving comes from men.
悠悠我里，亦孔之痗。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 悠悠我里，也实在痛苦。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: Far stretches my hamlet—I too am deeply pained.
四方有羡，我独居忧。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 四方有盈余，我独自忧愁。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: The four quarters have plenty; I alone am full of care.
民莫不逸，我独不敢休。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 民莫不安逸，我独不敢休息。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: No people but seek ease; I alone dare not rest.
天命不彻，我不敢效我友自逸。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.explanation: 天命不可改，我不敢效法友人自逸。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-shiyuezhi.segmentation: Heaven's mandate cannot be undone; I dare not imitate my friends in seeking ease.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: 萋兮斐兮，成是贝锦。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 花纹纷繁错杂，竟织成漂亮的贝纹锦。比喻谗言者把无说成有，巧加粉饰。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: The patterns are intricate and fine, woven into shell-pattern brocade—like slanderers dressing lies as truth.
彼谮人者，亦已大甚！
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 那些进谗言的人，实在太过分了！

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: Those who slander others have gone much too far!
哆兮侈兮，成是南箕。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 嘴张得又大又阔，竟像南箕星那样开口。比喻谗人张口便诬陷。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: Their mouths gape wide, like the southern Dipper—always open to accuse.
彼谮人者，谁适与谋。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 那些进谗言的人，究竟和谁一起谋划？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: Those slanderers—who is plotting with them?
缉缉翩翩，谋欲谮人。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 他们窃窃私语、轻佻往来，一心想陷害别人。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: They whisper and flit about, scheming to slander others.
慎尔言也，谓尔不信。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 你说话再谨慎，他们仍会说你不可信。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: Be ever so careful in what you say—they will still call you untrustworthy.
捷捷幡幡，谋欲谮言。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 他们花言巧语、反复无常，专谋诬陷之言。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: Quick-tongued and fickle, they plot deceitful accusations.
岂不尔受？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 难道你不曾领受过谗言的害处？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: Have you not yourself suffered from such slander?
既其女迁。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 谗言既已加在你身，使你遭祸迁谪。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: Once slander reaches you, you are ruined and cast aside.
骄人好好，劳人草草。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 骄人得意安乐，劳人却困苦憔悴。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: The arrogant live at ease; those who toil are worn and wretched.
苍天苍天，视彼骄人，矜此劳人。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 苍天啊苍天，请看那些骄人，怜悯这些劳人吧！

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: O Heaven, look upon the proud and pity those who labor!
彼谮人者，谁适与谋？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 那些进谗言的人，究竟和谁一起谋划？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: Those slanderers—who joins them in their plots?
取彼谮人，投畀豺虎。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 捉住那个进谗的人，扔给豺狼虎豹。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: Seize the slanderer and throw him to wolves and tigers.
豺虎不食，投畀有北。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 豺虎都不吃他，再把他扔到北方荒远之地。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: If the beasts will not eat him, cast him to the bleak north.
有北不受，投畀有昊！
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 北方也不收留，那就交给苍天去处置！

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: If the north rejects him, hand him over to great Heaven!
杨园之道，猗于亩丘。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 通往杨园的路，旁依着亩丘。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: The road to Yang Garden runs beside the mound of Mu.
寺人孟子，作为此诗。
Mengzi the palace steward composed this poem.
凡百君子，敬而听之。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.explanation: 各位君子，请恭敬地听一听吧。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiangbo-l.segmentation: All you gentlemen, listen to it with respect.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: 弁彼鸴斯，归飞提提。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 群栖的鹪鹩，结伴飞回，缓缓而行。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: The flocking wrens fly homeward together, gently and slowly.
民莫不穀，我独于罹。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 百姓无不安乐，唯独我遭受祸患。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: All the people are at ease; I alone suffer misfortune.
何辜于天？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 我对天有什么罪过？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: What crime have I committed against Heaven?
我罪伊何？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 我的罪又是什么呢？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: What is my fault?
心之忧矣，云如之何？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 心中忧愁，不知该怎么办才好。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: My heart is full of grief—what can I do?
踧踧周道，鞫为茂草。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 平坦的周道，竟被长草遮没。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: The smooth Zhou highway has been choked with rank grass.
我心忧伤，惄焉如捣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 我心忧伤，像被反复捶打一样痛苦。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: My heart aches as if it were pounded in a mortar.
假寐永叹，维忧用老。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 和衣而卧长叹，只因忧愁而早老。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: I lie awake sighing; sorrow alone has aged me.
心之忧矣，疢如疾首。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 心头的忧思，像头痛欲裂一般。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: The grief in my heart burns like a splitting headache.
维桑与梓，必恭敬止。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 看到桑树和梓树，必当恭敬对待；比喻父母所居之地不可轻慢。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: Seeing mulberry and catalpa, one must treat them with reverence—as one should one's parents' home.
靡瞻匪父，靡依匪母。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 没有父亲就无所瞻仰，没有母亲就无所依傍。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: Without a father I have none to look up to; without a mother none to lean on.
不属于毛？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 我不是父母的骨肉吗？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: Am I not flesh and bone of my parents?
不罹于里？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 我不该遭受乡里这样的灾祸吗？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: Should I not have fallen into such trouble at home?
天之生我，我辰安在？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 老天生了我，我的好命在哪里？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: Heaven gave me life—where is my good fortune?
菀彼柳斯，鸣蜩嘒嘒，有漼者渊，萑苇淠淠。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 茂盛的柳树上蝉鸣嘒嘒，深潭水波涌涌，芦苇密密。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: On lush willows cicadas chirp; deep pools surge; reeds stand thick.
譬彼舟流，不知所届，心之忧矣，不遑假寐。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 好比小舟漂流，不知漂到何处；心忧难眠，无暇安睡。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: Like a boat adrift with no shore in sight, I am too troubled to rest.
鹿斯之奔，维足伎伎。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 鹿群奔跑，四蹄轻快。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: The deer run swiftly, their hooves light and quick.
雉之朝雊，尚求其雌。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 雄雉清晨鸣叫，还在寻找雌伴。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: The cock pheasant crows at dawn, still seeking its mate.
譬彼坏木，疾用无枝。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 好比枯坏的树木，很快便无枝可依。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: Like a dying tree that soon has no branches left.
心之忧矣，宁莫之知？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 心中忧愁，难道就没有人知道吗？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: My heart grieves—does no one understand?
相彼投兔，尚或先之。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 看那逃入网中的野兔，尚且有人先放它一马。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: Even a rabbit caught in a snare may find someone to free it first.
行有死人，尚或墐之。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 路上若有死者，尚且有人掩埋。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: If a dead man lies on the road, someone may still cover him.
君子秉心，维其忍之。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 君子本有仁心，却竟如此忍心。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: A gentleman at heart—how could he be so cruel?
心之忧矣，涕既陨之。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 心中忧愁，眼泪已经落下。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: My heart is heavy; tears have already fallen.
君子信谗，如或酬之。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 君子听信谗言，就像有人向他敬酒一样欣然接受。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: The lord believes slander as readily as he accepts a cup of wine.
君子不惠，不舒究之。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 君子不施恩惠，也不从容查究实情。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: He shows no kindness and will not calmly investigate the truth.
伐木掎矣，析薪扡矣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 砍伐树木已就绪，劈柴也准备好了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: The tree is felled and ready; the firewood is split and prepared.
舍彼有罪，予之佗矣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 放过有罪的人，把灾祸加在我头上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: They spare the guilty and heap the blame on me.
莫高匪山，莫浚匪泉。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 没有不高的山，没有不深的泉；比喻秘密终难久藏。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: No mountain is not high; no spring is not deep—secrets cannot stay hidden forever.
君子无易由言，耳属于垣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 君子不可轻率说话，隔墙有耳。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: A gentleman must not speak rashly—ears are at the wall.
无逝我梁，无发我笱。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 不要动我的鱼梁，不要打开我的鱼笼。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: Do not touch my fish dam; do not open my fish trap.
我躬不阅，遑恤我后。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.explanation: 我自己尚且难保，哪还顾得上身后的人。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaobian-.segmentation: I cannot even save myself—how can I care for those who come after?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: 旻天疾威，敷于下土。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 苍天降下严厉之威，遍施于天下。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: Heaven's wrath is severe and spreads over all the land.
谋犹回遹，何日斯沮？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 谋划邪僻不正，何时才能止息？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: Counsel is crooked and perverse—when will it cease?
谋臧不从，不臧覆用。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 好主意不采纳，坏主意反而照办。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: Good plans are rejected; bad ones are followed instead.
我视谋犹，亦孔之邛。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 我看那些谋划，也实在太坏。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: I look at their counsel—it is utterly wretched.
潝潝訿訿，亦孔之哀。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 众人附和争吵，也实在可悲。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: They buzz and wrangle together—a pitiful sight.
谋之其臧，则具是违。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 谋划若是好的，就一齐违背它。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: When the plan is good, they all oppose it.
谋之不臧，则具是依。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 谋划若是不好的，就一齐依从它。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: When the plan is bad, they all cling to it.
我视谋犹，伊于胡厎。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 我看那些谋划，究竟要落到什么地步？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: I watch their counsel—where will it end?
我龟既厌，不我告犹。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 龟卜已多次占问，不再给我们指示。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: The tortoise has been questioned again and again—it no longer gives us guidance.
谋夫孔多，是用不集。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 谋臣虽多，因此反而不能成事。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: Though advisers are many, nothing gets done.
发言盈庭，谁敢执其咎？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 朝堂上发言的人满座，谁敢承担过失？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: The court is full of talkers—who dares take responsibility?
如匪行迈谋，是用不得于道。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 好比行路不自己拿主意，因此走不到正道上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: Like travelers who let others choose the road—they never reach their goal.
哀哉为犹，匪先民是程，匪大犹是经。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 可悲啊这些谋划，不以古人为榜样，不以大道为准则。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: Alas for such counsel—it follows neither the ancients nor the great Way.
维迩言是听，维迩言是争。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 只听从浅近之言，只在浅近之言上争执。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: They heed only shallow words and quarrel over shallow words.
如彼筑室于道谋，是用不溃于成。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 好比在道路上问人盖房，因此房子永远建不成。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: Like building a house by asking passersby on the road—it will never be finished.
国虽靡止，或圣或否。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 国家虽不算大，也有圣人也有非圣人。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: Though the state is not vast, some are sage and some are not.
民虽靡膴，或哲或谋，或肃或艾。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 百姓虽不算多，也有哲人、谋士、肃敬者与长者。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: Though the people are not countless, some are wise, some plan, some are reverent, some are elders.
如彼泉流，无沦胥以败。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 好比泉水流淌，不要一起沉沦而败亡。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: Like a spring flowing on—do not all sink together in ruin.
不敢暴虎，不敢冯河。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 不敢空手打虎，不敢徒步渡河。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: I dare not wrestle a tiger bare-handed or wade a river alone.
人知其一，莫知其他。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 人们只知其一，不知其它。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: People know one thing but not the rest.
战战兢兢，如临深渊，如履薄冰。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.explanation: 战战兢兢，像站在深渊边，像踩在薄冰上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaomin-l.segmentation: Trembling with fear, as if over a deep abyss, as if on thin ice.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: 宛彼鸣鸠，翰飞戾天。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 那小小的斑鸠，展翅高飞直到天际。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: The small turtle-dove spreads its wings and soars to the sky.
我心忧伤，念昔先人。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 我心忧伤，思念已故的先人。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: My heart grieves as I remember my departed forebears.
明发不寐，有怀二人。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 天刚亮就睡不着，心中怀念父母二人。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: At dawn I cannot sleep; my thoughts are with my father and mother.
人之齐圣，饮酒温克。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 人若聪明圣达，饮酒也能温克自持。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: Those who are wise and clear-minded can drink yet remain temperate.
彼昏不知，一醉日富。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 那些昏昧的人不知节制，一醉就自以为富有。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: The foolish know no restraint; drunk, they think themselves rich.
各敬尔仪，天命不又。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 各自敬守你们的威仪，天命不会一再降临。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: Each keep your proper conduct—Heaven's favor does not come twice.
中原有菽，庶民采之。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 原野上长着大豆，百姓去采摘它。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: In the plain grows the bean; the common people gather it.
螟蛉有子，蜾蠃负之。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 螟蛉有子，蜾蠃把它背走，当作自己的幼虫来养。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: The hornworm has offspring; the wasp carries them off to raise as its own.
教诲尔子，式穀似之。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 教导你的儿子，愿他善良有似先人。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: Teach your sons—may they be good like their forebears.
题彼脊令，载飞载鸣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 看那脊令鸟，一边飞一边鸣叫。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: Look at the wagtail—flying and calling as it goes.
我日斯迈，而月斯征。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 我日日远行，而岁月也在流逝。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: Each day I journey on, and the months slip away.
夙兴夜寐，毋忝尔所生。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 早起晚睡，不要辱没生养你的父母。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: Rise early and sleep late—do not disgrace those who bore you.
交交桑扈，率场啄粟。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 交交的桑扈鸟，在谷场上啄食粟米。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: The chattering orioles peck millet on the threshing ground.
哀我填寡，宜岸宜狱。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 可怜我这鳏寡之人，只宜入狱受审。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: Pity me, widowed and alone—fit only for prison and trial.
握粟出卜，自何能穀？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 握着粟米去占卜，从何处能得安乐？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: Clutching millet to divinate—whence can I find peace?
温温恭人，如集于木。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 温和恭谨的人，像站在高木上一样不稳。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: The gentle and respectful man is like one perched on a tall tree.
惴惴小心，如临于谷。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 小心翼翼，像站在深谷边缘。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: Cautious and fearful, as if standing at the edge of a ravine.
战战兢兢，如履薄冰。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.explanation: 战战兢兢，像踩在薄冰上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-xiaowan-l.segmentation: Trembling, as if walking on thin ice.

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: 浩浩昊天，不骏其德。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 浩大的苍天，不再保持它的恩德。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: Vast Heaven no longer keeps its virtue.
降丧饥馑，斩伐四国。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 降下丧乱饥荒，摧残四方各国。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: It sends death, disorder, and famine, cutting down the four quarters.
旻天疾威，弗虑弗图。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 苍天威怒已甚，却不加思虑谋划。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: Heaven's wrath is fierce, yet none consider or plan aright.
舍彼有罪，既伏其辜。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 放过有罪的人，他们已伏其罪。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: The guilty are spared though their crimes are known.
若此无罪，沦胥以铺。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 像这样无罪的人，却一齐沦亡受害。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: Yet the innocent like me are ruined together.
周宗既灭，靡所止戾。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 周王室既已衰微，无处可以安身。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: The Zhou house has declined; there is nowhere to settle.
正大夫离居，莫知我勚。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 正大夫流离在外，无人知我勤苦。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: Chief ministers live in exile; none knows my toil.
三事大夫，莫肯夙夜。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 三公大夫们，都不肯早起夜以继日。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: The high ministers will not rise early or work late.
邦君诸侯，莫肯朝夕。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 各国诸侯，都不肯朝夕尽忠。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: The feudal lords will not serve morning and evening.
庶曰式臧，覆出为恶。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 本说要做善事，反而做出恶行。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: They say they will do good, yet act wickedly instead.
如何昊天，辟言不信。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 苍天哪，正直的话却不被相信。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: O Heaven—honest words are not believed.
如彼行迈，则靡所臻。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 好比在路上行走，却到不了目的地。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: Like walking on a road yet never arriving anywhere.
凡百君子，各敬尔身。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 各位君子，各自敬慎修身吧。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: All you gentlemen, each guard your own conduct.
胡不相畏，不畏于天？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 为何不彼此敬畏，难道不怕上天？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: Why do you not fear one another—do you not fear Heaven?
戎成不退，饥成不遂。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 战事既成却不能退，饥荒既成却不能救。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: War ends in no retreat; famine ends in no relief.
曾我暬御，惨惨日瘁。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 曾是我亲近侍奉的人，如今日益憔悴。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: Those who once served me closely now waste away daily.
凡百君子，莫肯用讯。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 各位君子，都不肯来询问实情。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: All you gentlemen refuse to inquire into the truth.
听言则答，谮言则退。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 听顺耳的话就应答，听谗言就退避。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: Flattery wins an answer; slander sends one away.
哀哉不能言，匪舌是出，维躬是瘁。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 可悲啊不能言善的人，不是舌头说不出，而是自身受摧残。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: Pity those who cannot speak well—not the tongue fails, but the body is broken.
哿矣能言，巧言如流，俾躬处休！
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 善于进言的人真快乐，巧言如流水，使自己居安享福！

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: How fine for the glib—smooth words flow and they live at ease!
维曰予仕，孔棘且殆。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 虽说要出来做官，实在急迫又危险。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: They say take office—but it is urgent and perilous.
云不何使，得罪于天子；
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 说不可出仕，会得罪天子；

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: Say you must not serve—you offend the Son of Heaven;
亦云可使，怨及朋友。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 说可以出仕，又会招朋友怨恨。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: Say you may serve—you earn your friends' resentment.
谓尔迁于王都。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 有人劝你迁回王都。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: Someone urges you to move back to the royal capital.
曰予未有室家。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 你却说还没有家室。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: You reply that you still have no home.
鼠思泣血，无言不疾。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 鼠思泣血，没有一句话不痛心。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: Grief like a mouse weeping blood—every word cuts to the heart.
昔尔出居，谁从作尔室？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.explanation: 当初你离开旧居，是谁给你盖的这所房子？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-yuwuzheng.segmentation: When you left your old home, who built this house for you?

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: 正月繁霜，我心忧伤。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 正月里霜雪繁密，我心忧伤。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: In the first month frost is heavy; my heart is grieved.
民之讹言，亦孔之将。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 民间的谣言，也实在太盛了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: The people's false rumors grow ever louder.
念我独兮，忧心京京。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 想到我独处不幸，忧愁满溢心头。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Thinking how alone I am in misfortune, my sorrow overflows.
哀我小心，癙忧以痒。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 可怜我小心谨守，忧思成疾如痒。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Pity my careful heart—worry has become a disease like itching pain.
父母生我，胡俾我瘉？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 父母生了我，为何让我这样受害？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: My parents bore me—why did they leave me to suffer so?
不自我先，不自我后。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 不是在我之前，也不是在我之后（偏偏轮到我）。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Not before my time, not after—yet it fell on me alone.
好言自口，莠言自口。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 好话坏话都从自己口中说出。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Fine words and foul words alike come from one's own mouth.
忧心愈愈，是以有侮。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 忧愁愈积愈深，因此遭人欺侮。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Grief grows ever deeper—therefore I am insulted.
忧心惸惸，念我无禄。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 忧愁孤独，想到自己没有福分。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Lonely in sorrow, I think how luckless I am.
民之无辜，并其臣仆。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 百姓本无罪，却连臣仆也一并受害。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: The people are guiltless, yet servants suffer with them.
哀我人斯，于何从禄？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 可怜我们这些人，从哪里还能得福？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Pity us—where can we still find blessing?
瞻乌爰止？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 看那乌鸦停在哪里？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Look—where do the crows perch?
于谁之屋？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 是在谁家的屋顶？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: On whose rooftop do they rest?
瞻彼中林，侯薪侯蒸。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 看那树林中间，有的当柴有的当薪。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: In the midst of the woods, some trees are fuel, some firewood.
民今方殆，视天梦梦。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 百姓正处危殆，看上天却昏昧不明。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: The people are in peril, yet Heaven seems dim and unaware.
既克有定，靡人弗胜。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 既然已经有了定数，就没有人不胜任（却无人担当）。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Since fate is fixed, none should fail—yet none takes charge.
有皇上帝，伊谁云憎？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 伟大的上帝，究竟憎恶谁呢？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Great God—whom do You truly hate?
谓山盖卑，为冈为陵。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 说山本来低矮，却变成了冈陵。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: They say mountains are low, yet hills and peaks appear.
民之讹言，宁莫之惩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 民间的谣言，难道没有人加以惩戒？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: The people's rumors—will no one punish them?
召彼故老，讯之占梦。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 召来那些老臣，询问占梦的结果。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Summon the old counselors and ask what the dreams foretell.
具曰予圣，谁知乌之雌雄！
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 都说自己是圣人，谁能分辨乌鸦雌雄！

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Each claims to be a sage—who can tell male crow from female!
谓天盖高，不敢不局。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 说天本来很高，不敢不弯腰屈身。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: They say Heaven is high—I dare not but bow low.
谓地盖厚，不敢不蹐。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 说地本来很厚，不敢不碎步小心。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: They say Earth is thick—I dare not but tread mincingly.
维号斯言，有伦有脊。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 我呼号这些言论，有理有骨（却无人听）。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: I cry out these words—they have reason and backbone.
哀今之人，胡为虺蜴？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 可悲啊当今的人，为何心如毒蛇？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Alas for people today—why hearts like venomous snakes?
瞻彼阪田，有菀其特。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 看那坡田之上，有棵特别茂盛的苗。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: On the hillside field stands one plant lush and tall.
天之杌我，如不我克。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 上天折磨我，好像不能制服我似的。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Heaven torments me as if it could not subdue me.
彼求我则，如不我得。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 他们找我时，好像得不到我似的。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: When they seek me, it is as if they cannot have me.
执我仇仇，亦不我力。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 抓住我时敌意满满，却不肯给我助力。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: They seize me with hatred yet give me no help.
心之忧矣，如或结之。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 心中忧愁，像被绳结紧紧捆住。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: My heart grieves as if bound in tight knots.
今兹之正，胡然厉矣？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 当今的执政者，为何这样暴虐？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Why are today's rulers so cruel and fierce?
燎之方扬，宁或灭之？
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 火焰正熊熊燃烧，难道会有人把它熄灭？

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: The blaze is rising high—who would put it out?
赫赫宗周，褒姒灭之！
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 显赫的宗周，竟被褒姒所灭！

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Splendid Zhou was destroyed by Bao Si!
终其永怀，又窘阴雨。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 终其长久怀想，又困于阴雨。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Long I brood, again trapped in endless rain.
其车既载，乃弃尔辅。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 车子已经装载，却丢弃了车辅。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: The cart is loaded, yet its side boards are cast away.
载输尔载，将伯助予！
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 再装上你的货物，请长者来帮我！

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Load your goods again—elders, come help me!
无弃尔辅，员于尔辐。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 不要丢弃车辅，要增固你的辐条。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Do not discard the boards— reinforce your wheel spokes.
屡顾尔仆，不输尔载。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 屡次回头看车夫，不要让货物倾落。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Look back often at the driver—do not lose the load.
终逾绝险，曾是不意。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 终究越过险绝之地，本不曾料到。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: At last we cross the perilous pass—none expected it.
鱼在于沼，亦匪克乐。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 鱼在池沼之中，也不能真正安乐。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Fish in the pond cannot truly be at ease.
潜虽伏矣，亦孔之炤。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 即使潜藏水底，也照得很分明。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Though hidden deep, they are seen all too clearly.
忧心惨惨，念国之为虐！
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 忧心惨惨，想到国家遭受暴虐！

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: My grief is bitter, thinking how the state is abused!
彼有旨酒，又有嘉肴。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 他们有美酒，又有嘉肴。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: They have fine wine and savory dishes.
洽比其邻，婚姻孔云。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 与邻居亲密往来，婚姻亲族也众多。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: They feast with neighbors; kin by marriage abound.
念我独兮，忧心殷殷。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 想到我独处不幸，忧心深切。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Thinking how alone I am, my sorrow is deep.
佌佌彼有屋，蔌蔌方有谷。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 渺小的人却有高屋，积粟正满盈。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: Petty men have grand houses; their grain bins overflow.
民今之无禄，天夭是椓。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 百姓如今无福，上天却降夭折之祸。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: The people now lack blessing; Heaven strikes them with early death.
哿矣富人，哀此惸独。
sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.explanation: 富人真快乐，可怜这孤独无依的人。

sj-ya-xiaoya-jienanshanzhishen-zhengyue-.segmentation: How fine for the rich—pity the lonely and bereft.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l001.explanation: 采薇菜啊采薇菜，薇菜已经发芽。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l001.segmentation: We gather wild greens—the shoots have sprouted.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l002.explanation: 说回家啊说回家，一年又将到头。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l002.segmentation: Home, we say—home; the year is nearly done.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l003.explanation: 没有家没有室，因为玁狁入侵。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l003.segmentation: No home, no family—because of the Xianyun invasion.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l004.explanation: 无暇安居休息，因为玁狁入侵。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l004.segmentation: No time to rest at ease—because of the Xianyun.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l005.explanation: 采薇菜啊采薇菜，薇菜已经柔嫩。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l005.segmentation: We gather wild greens—the leaves are tender now.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l006.explanation: 说回家啊说回家，心中也充满忧愁。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l006.segmentation: Home, we say—home; our hearts are full of grief.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l007.segmentation: Sorrow burns fierce; we hunger and thirst.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l008.explanation: 我们戍边未定，无法派人回家问讯。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l008.segmentation: Our garrison is unsettled; no messenger can go home.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l009.explanation: 采薇菜啊采薇菜，薇菜已经老硬。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l009.segmentation: We gather wild greens—the stalks are hard and old.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l010.explanation: 说回家啊说回家，已到十月阳月。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l010.segmentation: Home, we say—home; the tenth month has come.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l011.explanation: 王事没有止息，无暇坐起安居。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l011.segmentation: The king's business never ends; no time to sit and rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l012.explanation: 忧愁非常沉重，我出征仍不能回来！

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l012.segmentation: Grief is keen—I march yet cannot return!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l014.segmentation: It is the blossom of the cherry-apple tree.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l016.segmentation: It is the commander's war chariot.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l017.explanation: 戎车已经驾好，四匹雄马强壮。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l017.segmentation: The war cart is yoked; four stallions stand strong.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l018.segmentation: How dare we settle in one place?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l019.explanation: 一个月里要打三次胜仗。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l019.segmentation: In one month we win three battles.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l020.explanation: 驾起那四匹马，四匹马雄健有力。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l020.segmentation: We drive those four horses—powerful and proud.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l021.explanation: 将帅所依靠，士卒所跟随。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l021.segmentation: The commander relies on them; the soldiers follow close.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l022.explanation: 四马整齐，象牙弓配鱼皮箭袋。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l022.segmentation: The four steeds are steady; ivory bow and fish-skin quiver.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l023.segmentation: Do we not stay alert every day?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l024.segmentation: The Xianyun threat is urgent indeed!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l025.explanation: 当初我离开的时候，杨柳依依。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l025.segmentation: When I left, willows trailed soft and green.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l026.explanation: 如今我归来思量，雨雪纷纷飘落。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l026.segmentation: Now I return in thought—snow and rain fall thick.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l027.segmentation: The road is slow; I thirst and hunger.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-caiwei-l028.segmentation: My heart grieves—none knows my sorrow!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l001.explanation: 我驾出我的战车，到那牧地。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l001.segmentation: I drive my chariot out to the pasture lands.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l002.explanation: 从天子那里来，说让我出征。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l002.segmentation: From the Son of Heaven comes word that I must go.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l003.explanation: 召来那些车夫，叫他们装车。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l003.segmentation: I summon the drivers and tell them to load the cart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l004.segmentation: The king's affairs are hard—truly urgent.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l005.explanation: 我驾出我的战车，到那郊野。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l005.segmentation: I drive my chariot out to the outskirts.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l006.segmentation: We raise the pennant flags and set up the yak-tail banners.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l007.explanation: 那些鸟隼旟和旐旗，为何不快快飘动？

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l007.segmentation: Why do the hawk banners and pennants not flutter briskly?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l008.explanation: 忧心悄悄，车夫也愈发憔悴。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l008.segmentation: My worry is secret; the drivers grow more worn.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l009.explanation: 王命南仲，前往方地筑城。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l009.segmentation: The king commands Nan Zhong to go build walls at Fang.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l010.explanation: 出车声彭彭，旗帜鲜明飘扬。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l010.segmentation: Chariots roll thunderously; banners blaze bright.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l011.explanation: 天子命令我，在那朔方筑城。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l011.segmentation: The Son of Heaven orders me to fortify the northern frontier.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l012.explanation: 赫赫的南仲，在襄地打败玁狁。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l012.segmentation: Illustrious Nan Zhong defeats the Xianyun at Xiang.
