sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l013.explanation: 当初我离开的时候，黍稷正开花。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l013.segmentation: When I left, millet and panic grass were in bloom.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l014.explanation: 如今我归来思量，雨雪满路。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l014.segmentation: Now I return in thought—snow and rain fill the road.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l015.segmentation: The king's business is hard; no time to rest at home.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l016.segmentation: Do we not long for home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l018.explanation: 喓喓草虫鸣，趯趯阜螽跳。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l019.explanation: 未见君子归来，忧心忡忡。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l019.segmentation: Not yet seeing my lord return—I worry deeply.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l020.explanation: 既已见到君子，我的心才安定。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l020.segmentation: Once I see my lord, my heart is eased.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l021.segmentation: Illustrious Nan Zhong campaigns against the Western Rong.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l022.segmentation: Spring days are long; plants and trees flourish.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l023.explanation: 仓庚喈喈鸣，采蘩人众盛。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l023.segmentation: Orioles sing clearly; gatherers of ferns are many.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l024.explanation: 捉住俘虏问讯，于是凯旋归来。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l024.segmentation: We seize prisoners for questioning and march home in triumph.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l025.explanation: 赫赫的南仲，在夷地平定玁狁。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-chuche-l025.segmentation: Illustrious Nan Zhong pacifies the Xianyun at Yi.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l001.explanation: 有棵独立的杜树，圆实的果实。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l001.segmentation: A lone crabapple stands, its fruit round and full.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l002.explanation: 王事没有止息，继续消耗我的时日。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l002.segmentation: The king's work never ends, consuming my days.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l003.segmentation: 日月阳止，女心伤止，征夫遑止。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l003.explanation: 日月已到十月，女子心伤，征夫何时能停？

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l003.segmentation: The sun and moon reach the tenth month; the wife grieves—when will the soldier rest?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l004.explanation: 有棵独立的杜树，叶子茂盛。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l004.segmentation: The lone crabapple's leaves grow lush and green.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l005.explanation: 王事没有止息，使我心伤悲。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l005.segmentation: The king's work never ends—my heart breaks with sorrow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l006.segmentation: 卉木萋止，女心悲止，征夫归止！
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l006.explanation: 草木茂盛，女子心悲，征夫该回来了！

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l006.segmentation: Plants flourish; the wife mourns—the soldier should return!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l007.segmentation: I climb the northern hill to gather wolfberries.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l008.explanation: 王事没有止息，使我父母担忧。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l008.segmentation: The king's work never ends—I grieve for my parents.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l009.segmentation: 檀车幝幝，四牡痯痯，征夫不远！
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l009.explanation: 檀木车破敝，四马病弱，征夫已不远！

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l009.segmentation: The sandalwood cart is worn; four horses are weak—the soldier is near!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l010.explanation: 不是载来也不是归来，忧心非常沉重。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l010.segmentation: He neither arrives in a cart nor comes home—grief is keen.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l011.explanation: 这一去不至，反而多生忧虑。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l011.segmentation: This departure brings no return—only more worry.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l012.segmentation: 卜筮偕止，会言近止，征夫迩止！
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l012.explanation: 卜筮都说他停下了，会合的话说他近了，征夫真的近了！

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-didu-l012.segmentation: Divination says he has halted; omens say he is near—the soldier is truly near!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l001.explanation: 伐木声丁丁，鸟鸣声嘤嘤。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l001.segmentation: Axes ring ding-ding; birds call ying-ying.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l002.explanation: 鸟儿走出深谷，迁到高树。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l002.segmentation: Birds leave the deep valley and move to tall trees.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l003.explanation: 嘤嘤地鸣叫，寻求同伴的应声。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l003.segmentation: They chirp, seeking a friend's answering call.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l004.explanation: 看那鸟儿，尚且寻求友声。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l004.segmentation: Look at the birds—they still seek a companion's voice.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l005.explanation: 何况是人呢，怎能不找朋友？

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l005.segmentation: How much more should people seek friends?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l006.explanation: 神明听到这些，终使和睦平安。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l006.segmentation: When the spirits hear, harmony and peace follow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l007.explanation: 伐木声许许，滤出的酒味香美。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l007.segmentation: Axes thud xu-xu; strained wine smells sweet.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l008.explanation: 既有肥羊，用来招待各位叔父。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l008.segmentation: There is a fat lamb to feast the elder uncles.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l009.explanation: 纵然他们不来，不是我失礼。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l009.segmentation: Even if they do not come, it is not my neglect.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l010.explanation: 洒扫得鲜明整洁，摆上八簋祭食。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l010.segmentation: The hall is swept bright; eight dishes of food are set out.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l011.explanation: 既有肥公牛，用来招待各位舅父。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l011.segmentation: There is a fat bull to feast the maternal uncles.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l012.explanation: 纵然他们不来，也不是我的过错。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l012.segmentation: Even if they do not come, the fault is not mine.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l013.explanation: 在坡地上伐木，滤出的酒满溢。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l013.segmentation: We cut wood on the slope; strained wine overflows.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l014.explanation: 笾豆摆列整齐，兄弟不要疏远。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l014.segmentation: Bowls and stands are arranged—brothers, do not stay far apart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l015.explanation: 人们失德，往往因干粮小事而起。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l015.segmentation: When people lose virtue, it often starts with a dry-ration slight.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l016.explanation: 有酒就滤给我，没酒就去买来。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l016.segmentation: If there is wine, strain it for me; if not, go buy some.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l017.explanation: 击鼓为我助兴，蹲蹲地跳舞。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l017.segmentation: Beat the drum for me; dance with steady steps.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l018.explanation: 等到我有空闲，就畅饮这美酒。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-famu-l018.segmentation: When I have leisure, I will drink this fine wine.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.segmentation: 皇皇者华，于彼原隰。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.explanation: 鲜艳明亮的黄花，开在那平原和低湿的原野上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.segmentation: Bright yellow flowers bloom on the plains and low marshes.
駪駪征夫，每怀靡及。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.explanation: 奔走的征夫行列整齐，却常怀忧虑，怕任务来不及完成。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.segmentation: The marching envoys hurry on, yet each fears he may not fulfill his mission in time.
我马维驹，六辔如濡。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.explanation: 我骑的是小马，六条缰绳润泽光滑。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.segmentation: My horses are colts; the six reins are moist and smooth.
载驰载驱，周爰咨诹。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.explanation: 既奔驰又驱策，遍访各地征询意见。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.segmentation: We gallop and drive on, going everywhere to gather counsel.
我马维骐，六辔如丝。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.explanation: 我骑的是青纹马，六条缰绳细如丝。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.segmentation: My horses are piebald; the six reins are fine as silk.
载驰载驱，周爰咨谋。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.explanation: 既奔驰又驱策，遍访各地谋划国事。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.segmentation: We gallop and drive on, going everywhere to deliberate on affairs of state.
我马维骆，六辔沃若。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.explanation: 我骑的是白鬃黑身的骆马，六条缰绳柔润有光泽。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.segmentation: My horses are white-maned bays; the six reins are soft and lustrous.
载驰载驱，周爰咨度。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.explanation: 既奔驰又驱策，遍访各地审度民情。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.segmentation: We gallop and drive on, going everywhere to assess the people's condition.
我马维骃，六辔既均。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.explanation: 我骑的是浅青杂色马，六条缰绳已调得均匀。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.segmentation: My horses are gray; the six reins are evenly adjusted.
载驰载驱，周爰咨询。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.explanation: 既奔驰又驱策，遍访各地访问贤能。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-huanghuangzhe.segmentation: We gallop and drive on, going everywhere to inquire of the wise and capable.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l001.explanation: 鹿群呦呦鸣叫，在野地吃着苹草。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l001.segmentation: The deer call yo-yo, grazing on wild apple in the field.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l002.explanation: 我有嘉宾到来，鼓瑟吹笙相迎。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l002.segmentation: I have honored guests; we play zithers and blow the sheng in welcome.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l003.explanation: 吹笙鼓簧乐声起，捧着礼筐献上礼物。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l003.segmentation: With sheng and reed pipes sounding, we bear gift baskets in service.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l004.explanation: 人们对我友好，指给我正大之道。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l004.segmentation: People treat me well and show me the path of integrity.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l005.explanation: 鹿群呦呦鸣叫，在野地吃着蒿草。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l005.segmentation: The deer call yo-yo, grazing on artemisia in the field.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l006.explanation: 我有嘉宾到来，美德声誉非常显明。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l006.segmentation: I have honored guests whose virtuous fame shines bright.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l007.segmentation: 视民不恌，君子是则是效。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l007.explanation: 看待百姓不轻慢，君子就效法他的榜样。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l007.segmentation: He does not slight the people; gentlemen take him as their model.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l008.segmentation: 我有旨酒，嘉宾式燕以敖。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l008.explanation: 我有美酒，请嘉宾宴饮而尽欢。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l008.segmentation: I have fine wine; let the guests feast and rejoice.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l009.explanation: 鹿群呦呦鸣叫，在野地吃着芩草。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l009.segmentation: The deer call yo-yo, grazing on bitter herbs in the field.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l010.explanation: 我有嘉宾到来，鼓瑟又弹琴。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l010.segmentation: I have honored guests; we play zithers and lutes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l011.explanation: 鼓瑟又弹琴，和乐而且尽兴。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l011.segmentation: Zithers and lutes sound together—in harmony and deep delight.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l012.segmentation: 我有旨酒，以燕乐嘉宾之心。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l012.explanation: 我有美酒，用以宴饮，使嘉宾内心愉悦。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-luming-l012.segmentation: I have fine wine to feast the guests and gladden their hearts.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l001.explanation: 四匹公马壮健，周道平坦却行路迟缓。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l001.segmentation: Four stallions are strong; the Zhou road is broad yet our march is slow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l002.segmentation: Do we not long to return home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l003.explanation: 王室差事无尽无休，我的心中充满悲伤。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l003.segmentation: The king's business never ends; my heart is full of grief.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l004.explanation: 四匹公马壮健，黑鬃白身的骆马喘息不止。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l004.segmentation: Four stallions are strong; the piebald horses pant without rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l005.segmentation: Do we not long to return home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l006.explanation: 王室差事无尽无休，无暇安坐休息。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l006.segmentation: The king's business never ends; we have no leisure to sit at ease.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l007.segmentation: 翩翩者鵻，载飞载下，集于苞栩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l007.explanation: 翩翩飞翔的鹁鸠，时飞时落，停在那丛生的柞树上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l007.segmentation: The darting turtle-dove now flies, now alights, gathering on clustered oaks.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l008.explanation: 王室差事无尽无休，无暇奉养父亲。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l008.segmentation: The king's business never ends; we cannot care for our fathers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l009.segmentation: 翩翩者鵻，载飞载止，集于苞杞。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l009.explanation: 翩翩飞翔的鹁鸠，时飞时停，停在那丛生的枸杞上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l009.segmentation: The darting turtle-dove now flies, now rests, gathering on clustered jujubes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l010.explanation: 王室差事无尽无休，无暇奉养母亲。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l010.segmentation: The king's business never ends; we cannot care for our mothers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l011.explanation: 驾起四匹骆马，奔驰飞快。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l011.segmentation: We yoke four piebald horses and gallop swiftly.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l012.segmentation: Do we not long to return home?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l013.explanation: 因此写下这首歌，把思念母亲的心情告诉人。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-simu-l013.segmentation: So I compose this song to tell how I miss my mother.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l001.explanation: 棠棣树的花，花萼也鲜明灿烂。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l001.segmentation: The flowers of the cherry-apple—each calyx too shines bright.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l002.explanation: 凡今之人，没有比得上兄弟的。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l002.segmentation: Among people today, none compare to brothers.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l003.explanation: 面对死丧的威吓，兄弟最相牵挂。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l003.segmentation: In the face of death and mourning, brothers care for one another most.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l004.explanation: 平原低地聚了很多人，兄弟就来相寻。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l004.segmentation: When people gather on plain and marsh, brothers come seeking one another.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l005.explanation: 鹡鸰在原野上，兄弟在急难中相助。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l005.segmentation: The wagtail on the plain—brothers help each other in urgent need.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l006.explanation: 即使有良朋，也只是徒然长叹。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l006.segmentation: Even with good friends, one can only sigh in vain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l007.explanation: 兄弟在家墙内争吵，对外却共同抵御外患。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l007.segmentation: Brothers may quarrel within the wall, yet together they ward off outside troubles.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l008.explanation: 即使有良朋，也只是徒然助不了什么。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l008.segmentation: Even with good friends, they cannot truly help in the end.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l009.explanation: 丧乱已经平息，既安定又安宁。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l009.segmentation: The turmoil of loss and chaos has subsided; there is peace and calm.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l010.explanation: 虽有兄弟，却不如朋友亲吗？

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l010.segmentation: Though one has brothers, are they not as dear as friends?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l011.segmentation: Set out the bowls and stands; drink wine to satisfaction.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l012.explanation: 兄弟都已到齐，和乐而且亲密。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l012.segmentation: Brothers are all present—joyful and tender together.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l013.explanation: 妻子和睦，如同鼓瑟弹琴般和谐。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l013.segmentation: Wife and husband live in harmony, like zither and lute in tune.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l014.explanation: 兄弟既已聚合，和乐而且尽兴。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l014.segmentation: Brothers have come together—in harmony and deep delight.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l015.explanation: 宜于你的室家，使你的妻子儿女快乐。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l015.segmentation: May your household prosper; may your wife and children rejoice.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l016.explanation: 仔细推究、图谋，的确是这样吗？

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tangdi-l016.segmentation: When we examine and consider—is it not truly so?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l001.explanation: 上天保佑你，使你的根基非常牢固。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l001.segmentation: Heaven protects you; your foundation is exceedingly firm.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l002.explanation: 使你厚受福禄，什么福分不能除去？

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l002.segmentation: May you receive abundant blessings—what fortune could be taken away?

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l003.explanation: 使你增益很多，天下无不众多。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l003.segmentation: May you gain ever more, until all under heaven is plentiful.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l004.explanation: 上天保佑你，使你吉祥又富足。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l004.segmentation: Heaven protects you; may you be auspicious and rich.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l005.explanation: 凡事无不适宜，承受上天百种福禄。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l005.segmentation: Nothing is unfitting; receive heaven's hundred blessings.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l006.explanation: 降给你长远之福，日日享用仍觉不足。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l006.segmentation: May distant blessings descend—each day's share is never enough.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l007.explanation: 上天保佑你，使万物无不兴盛。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l007.segmentation: Heaven protects you; may nothing fail to flourish.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l008.segmentation: 如山如阜，如冈如陵，如川之方至，以莫不增。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l008.explanation: 像山像大丘，像冈像高陵，像河水滔滔方至，无不日益增多。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l008.segmentation: Like mountains and great mounds, like hills and high ridges, like rivers swelling onward—may all ever increase.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l009.explanation: 洁净祭祀备酒食，用以孝享祖先。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l009.segmentation: With pure rites and offerings of food and wine, we filially honor the ancestors.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l010.explanation: 春祭、夏祭、秋祭、冬祭，献给先公先王。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l010.segmentation: Spring, summer, autumn, and winter sacrifices are offered to the former dukes and kings.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l011.explanation: 君上说：我占卜赐你，万寿无疆。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l011.segmentation: The lord says: I divined for you—may you live ten thousand years without limit.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l012.explanation: 神灵来降福，赐给你很多福禄。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l012.segmentation: The spirits descend with blessing and grant you abundant fortune.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l013.explanation: 百姓的本质，就是日用饮食。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l013.segmentation: The nature of the people is daily food and drink.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l014.explanation: 众民百姓，都感念你的恩德。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l014.segmentation: All the common people everywhere respond to your virtue.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l015.explanation: 像月亮一样常满，像太阳一样上升。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l015.segmentation: Like the moon ever full, like the sun ever rising.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l016.segmentation: Like the longevity of the southern hills—never shrinking, never crumbling.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l017.segmentation: 如松柏之茂，无不尔或承。
sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l017.explanation: 像松柏之茂，无不有人继承。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-tianbao-l017.segmentation: Like pine and cypress in full leaf—may all inherit your bounty.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l001.explanation: 鱼在鱼篓里陈列，有鲿鱼、鲨鱼。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l001.segmentation: Fish are arrayed in the creel—catfish and shark.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l002.explanation: 君子有酒，味道好而且多。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l002.segmentation: The gentleman has wine—fine in flavor and abundant.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l003.explanation: 鱼在鱼篓里陈列，有鲂鱼、鳢鱼。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l003.segmentation: Fish are arrayed in the creel—bream and black carp.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l004.explanation: 君子有酒，数量多而且味道好。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l004.segmentation: The gentleman has wine—plentiful and fine.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l005.explanation: 鱼在鱼篓里陈列，有鰋鱼、鲤鱼。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l005.segmentation: Fish are arrayed in the creel—catfish and carp.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l006.explanation: 君子有酒，味道好而且充足。

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l006.segmentation: The gentleman has wine—fine and sufficient.

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l009.explanation: 物产多么甘美，多么齐备啊！

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l009.segmentation: How savory and how complete they are!

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l010.explanation: 物产多么齐全，多么合于时宜啊！

sj-ya-xiaoya-lumingzhishen-yuli-l010.segmentation: How fully present—and how timely they are!

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: 薄言采芑，于彼新田，呈此菑亩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 我们去采苦菜，在那新垦的田，到这块初耕的亩。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: We go to gather thistles—in the newly opened field, on this first-plowed plot.
方叔涖止，其车三千。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 方叔来到，他的战车有三千辆。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: Fang Shu arrives; his chariots number three thousand.
师干之试，方叔率止。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 检阅军队，方叔率领前行。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: The army is reviewed; Fang Shu leads the march.
乘其四骐，四骐翼翼。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 驾着四匹青骐马，四马整齐有力。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: He drives four blue-gray horses—four steeds strong and arrayed.
路车有奭，簟茀鱼服，钩膺鞗革。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 路车鲜明，竹席鱼皮饰，马胸钩和革带齐备。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: The road chariot is splendid—with bamboo mat, fish-skin trim, breastplate hooks, and leather straps.
薄言采芑，于彼新田，于此中乡。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 我们去采苦菜，在那新垦的田，到这一乡中间。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: We go to gather thistles—in the new field, here in the middle of the district.
方叔涖止，其车三千。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 方叔来到，他的战车有三千辆。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: Fang Shu arrives; his chariots number three thousand.
旂旐央央，方叔率止。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 旗帜鲜明，方叔率领前行。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: Banners blaze bright; Fang Shu leads the march.
约軧错衡，八鸾玱玱。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 车毂有纹、衡木交错，八铃叮当响。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: Wheel hubs patterned, crossbars interlaced—the eight bells ring clear.
服其命服，朱芾斯皇，有玱葱珩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 穿着命服，朱色蔽膝鲜明，佩葱色珩玉。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: He wears his appointed robes—scarlet knee-guards bright, with green jade pendants.
鴥彼飞隼，其飞戾天，亦集爰止。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 迅疾飞翔的隼鸟，高飞及天，也停在这里。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: The swift falcon flies to the sky—and also alights here.
方叔涖止，其车三千。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 方叔来到，他的战车有三千辆。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: Fang Shu arrives; his chariots number three thousand.
师干之试，方叔率止。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 检阅军队，方叔率领前行。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: The army is reviewed; Fang Shu leads the march.
钲人伐鼓，陈师鞠旅。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 征人击鼓，陈列军队训话。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: The bell-men beat drums; the army is drawn up and addressed.
显允方叔，伐鼓渊渊，振旅阗阗。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 显赫诚信的方叔，鼓声渊渊，整旅归来阗阗。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: Renowned and true Fang Shu—deep drumbeats, returning ranks in thunderous array.
蠢尔蛮荆，大邦为仇。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 愚蠢的蛮荆，与大邦为仇。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: The foolish southern tribes make enemies of the great state.
方叔元老，克壮其犹。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 方叔是元老，能壮其谋。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: Fang Shu is a senior minister; his plans are bold and strong.
方叔率止，执讯获丑。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 方叔率领军队，执讯获丑。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: Fang Shu leads the host—capturing prisoners and the guilty.
戎车啴啴，
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 戎车众多，

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: War chariots roll on in numbers,
啴啴焞焞，如霆如雷。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 声势焞焞，如霆如雷。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: Their rumble like thunder and lightning.
显允方叔，征伐玁狁，蛮荆来威。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.explanation: 显赫诚信的方叔，征伐玁狁，蛮荆来服。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-caiqi-l0.segmentation: Renowned Fang Shu campaigns against the Xianyun; the southern tribes submit in awe.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: 我车既攻，我马既同。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.explanation: 我的车已修好了，我的马已配齐了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: My chariots are repaired; my horses are matched.
四牡庞庞，驾言徂东。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.explanation: 四匹公马壮健，驾车要往东方去。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: Four stallions are strong; we yoke up and head east.
田车既好，田牡孔阜。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.explanation: 猎车已经很好，猎马非常高大。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: The hunting chariots are ready; the hunting horses are tall and strong.
东有甫草，驾言行狩。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.explanation: 东方有甫草，驾车前往行猎。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: East lies Fu Meadow; we drive there to hunt.
之子于苗，选徒嚣嚣。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.explanation: 这位君子去田猎，选出的徒众声喧喧。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: The lord goes hunting; the chosen followers shout with excitement.
建旐设旄，搏兽于敖。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.explanation: 竖起旐旗和旄旗，在敖地搏兽。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: Banners of silk and yak-tail are raised; we hunt beasts at Ao.
驾彼四牡，四牡奕奕。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.explanation: 驾起四匹公马，四马奕奕有神。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: We yoke four stallions—four steeds spirited and fine.
赤芾金舄，会同有绎。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.explanation: 穿赤芾金舄，诸侯会同络绎不绝。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: In scarlet knee-guards and golden shoes, lords assemble in continuous stream.
决拾既佽，弓矢既调。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.explanation: 臂鞲已齐备，弓矢已调好。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: Arm-guards are ready; bows and arrows are tuned.
射夫既同，助我举柴。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.explanation: 射手已齐同，助我举柴计数猎物。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: Archers stand aligned, helping me tally the game with brushwood markers.
四黄既驾，两骖不猗。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.explanation: 四匹黄马已驾，两匹骖马不偏斜。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: Four bay horses are yoked; the two outriders do not swerve.
不失其驰，舍矢如破。
They keep their pace; arrows fly as if splitting targets.
萧萧马鸣，悠悠旆旌。
Horses whinny softly; pennants flutter far.
徒御不惊，大庖不盈。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.explanation: 御者不惊，大厨不盈（猎物不多取）。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: Drivers stay calm; the great kitchen is not overfilled.
之子于征，有闻无声。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.explanation: 这位君子出征归来，有声誉而无喧哗。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: The lord returns from the expedition— famed yet without clamor.
允矣君子，展也大成。
sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.explanation: 确实是君子，大有成就啊。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-chegong-.segmentation: Truly a gentleman—great is his accomplishment.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-jingjing.explanation: 莪草长得茂盛，在那山阿中间。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-jingjing.segmentation: Luxuriant is the artemisia, in the middle of the hill slope.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-jingjing.explanation: 既已见到君子，快乐而且有礼仪。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-jingjing.segmentation: Having met the gentleman, I am joyful and well-mannered.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-jingjing.explanation: 莪草长得茂盛，在那水洲中间。

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-jingjing.segmentation: Luxuriant is the artemisia, in the middle of the islet.

sj-ya-xiaoya-nanyoujiayuzhishen-jingjing.explanation: 既已见到君子，我的心中就欢喜。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l005.segmentation: The Biao pool flows north, soaking the rice fields.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l006.segmentation: Singing sadly, I grieve—thinking of that noble one.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l007.explanation: 砍那桑柴，却拿去烧瓦灶。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l007.segmentation: I cut mulberry fuel yet burn it in a tile kiln.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l008.explanation: 想起那硕人，实在劳我心。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l008.segmentation: Thinking of that noble one truly wears on my heart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l009.explanation: 在宫中敲钟，声音传到外面。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l009.segmentation: Drums and bells sound in the palace; the noise reaches outside.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l010.segmentation: I think of you in distress, yet you look at me coldly.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l011.explanation: 有鹈鹕在鱼梁上，有鹤在林中。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l011.segmentation: A pelican on the fish dam; a crane in the woods.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l012.explanation: 想起那硕人，实在劳我心。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l012.segmentation: Thinking of that noble one truly wears on my heart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l013.explanation: 鸳鸯在鱼梁上，收敛左翼。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l013.segmentation: Mandarin ducks on the fish dam fold their left wings.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l014.explanation: 那人没有良德，三心二意。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l014.segmentation: That person lacks virtue—his loyalty shifts this way and that.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l015.explanation: 有扁扁的石头，踩在上面很卑下。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l015.segmentation: There is a flat stone—stepping on it feels low and mean.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-baihua-l016.segmentation: That person goes far away, leaving me sick at heart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-cailv-l001.explanation: 整天采荩草，采不满一手。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-cailv-l001.segmentation: All morning I gather pigweed—not enough to fill one handful.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-cailv-l002.explanation: 我的头发卷曲，早日回家洗头。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-cailv-l002.segmentation: My hair is tangled; soon I will go home to wash it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-cailv-l003.explanation: 整天采蓝草，采不满一衣。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-cailv-l003.segmentation: All morning I gather indigo—not enough to fill one apron.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-cailv-l004.explanation: 约定五日归来，六日仍不见。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-cailv-l004.segmentation: Five days were promised; on the sixth he still has not come.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-cailv-l005.explanation: 那人去打猎，说是收起弓。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-cailv-l005.segmentation: He went hunting, they say—putting away his bow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-cailv-l006.explanation: 那人去钓鱼，说是整理钓绳。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-cailv-l006.segmentation: He went fishing, they say—mending his fishing line.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-cailv-l009.explanation: 鲂鱼和鱮鱼，姑且让人看看。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-cailv-l009.segmentation: Bream and tench—let people come and look.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l001.explanation: 一边采豆一边把豆装进圆筐和方筐。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l001.segmentation: They pick beans and fill both round and square baskets.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l002.explanation: 诸侯来朝见天子，天子会赏赐什么？

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l002.segmentation: When lords come to court, what gifts will the king bestow?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l003.explanation: 说好像没有什么可赐的吗？

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l003.segmentation: As if there were nothing to give?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l004.explanation: 其实有路车和四匹马拉的仪仗车。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l004.segmentation: There are state carriages and teams of four horses.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l005.segmentation: And what else will be granted?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l006.explanation: 还有玄色衮衣和绣有斧形纹的蔽膝。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l006.segmentation: Black dragon robes and embroidered aprons with axe patterns.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l007.explanation: 栏边泉水沸涌，人们去采芹菜。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l007.segmentation: At the railing the spring bubbles up; they go to gather celery.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l008.explanation: 诸侯来朝，正好观看他们的旗帜。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l008.segmentation: The lords come to court; we watch their banners.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l009.explanation: 旗帜飘动鲜明，鸾铃响声清脆。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l009.segmentation: Their banners flutter brightly; the bell pendants ring clearly.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l010.explanation: 或驾三马或驾四马，正是诸侯所乘而至。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l010.segmentation: Drawn by teams of three or four horses, the lords arrive in state.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l011.explanation: 红色蔽膝绑在大腿上，邪幅绑在腿下。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l011.segmentation: Red knee-pieces on the thighs, crosswise leggings below.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l012.explanation: 他们交往勤勉不怠，这是天子所赐予的尊荣。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l012.segmentation: They are diligent in duty and not slack—honors granted by the Son of Heaven.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l013.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，承受天子的任命。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l013.segmentation: Happy is the lord, entrusted with the king's commission.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l014.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，福禄一再加于他身。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l014.segmentation: Happy is the lord; blessings and rank are repeatedly extended to him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l015.explanation: 柞树枝条上，叶子长得茂盛。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l015.segmentation: On the oak branches the leaves grow thick and lush.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l016.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，镇抚天子的邦国。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l016.segmentation: Happy is the lord, who steadies the king's domain.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l017.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，万福都集于他一身。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l017.segmentation: Happy is the lord; every blessing gathers upon him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l018.explanation: 左右辅佐平和有序，也都遵循他的表率。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l018.segmentation: His aides left and right are orderly, all following his example.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l019.explanation: 杨木小舟在水上漂荡，用绳索把它系住。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l019.segmentation: A poplar-wood boat floats on the water, moored fast with hemp ropes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l020.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，为天子所眷顾。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l020.segmentation: Happy is the lord, looked upon with favor by the king.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l021.explanation: 快乐的君子啊，福禄厚厚地加给他。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l021.segmentation: Happy is the lord; blessings are heaped abundantly upon him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l022.explanation: 优游自在，也就达到安定了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-caishu-l022.segmentation: At ease and unhurried, all reaches peace and rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l001.explanation: 那些京城人士，穿着黄狐皮裘。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l001.segmentation: Those people of the capital wear yellow fox-fur robes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l002.explanation: 仪容仍如旧日，说话有条有理。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l002.segmentation: Their bearing is unchanged; their words are well ordered.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l003.explanation: 他们行将回到周地，是万民所仰望的。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l003.segmentation: They are returning to Zhou, the hope of all the people.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l004.explanation: 那些京城人士，戴着台笠、缁撮等帽。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l004.segmentation: Those capital folk wear broad bamboo hats and tight black caps.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l005.explanation: 那些君子的女儿，头发细直如丝。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l005.segmentation: Those ladies of noble families have hair fine and straight as silk.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l006.explanation: 我再也见不到他们了，心里好不愉快。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l006.segmentation: I see them no more, and my heart is ill at ease.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l007.explanation: 那些京城人士，耳上挂着美玉充耳。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l007.segmentation: Those people of the capital wear jade ear-plugs of fine quality.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l008.explanation: 那些君子的女儿，人们称她们为尹吉。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l008.segmentation: Those noble ladies are called Yin Ji—models of virtue.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l009.explanation: 我再也见不到他们了，心中郁结难解。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l009.segmentation: I see them no more, and sorrow knots my heart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l010.explanation: 那些京城人士，腰带垂下显得庄重。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l010.segmentation: Those capital folk let their sashes hang low in dignified fashion.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l011.explanation: 那些君子的女儿，卷发如蝎尾上翘。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l011.segmentation: Those noble ladies have curls like a scorpion's arched tail.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l012.explanation: 我再也见不到他们了，只好跟着他们远去。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l012.segmentation: I see them no more and can only follow as they depart.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l013.explanation: 不是故意让带子垂下，而是腰带本来就有余。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l013.segmentation: It is not that the sash is let down on purpose—it is simply long.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l014.explanation: 不是故意把头发卷起来，而是发本就有卷曲。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l014.segmentation: It is not that the hair is curled by art—it is naturally wavy.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l015.explanation: 我再也见不到他们了，只能独自张望而叹。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-dourenshi-l015.segmentation: I see them no more and can only gaze into the distance and sigh.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang-l.segmentation: 何草不黄？
What plant is not turning yellow?
何日不行？
What day are we not on the march?
何人不将？
Who is not called to go on campaign?
经营四方。
All are toiling and traveling throughout the four directions.
何草不玄？
What plant is not turning dark?
何人不矜？
Who is not burdened with care?
哀我征夫，独为匪民。
sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang-l.explanation: 可怜我们这些征夫，唯独像不是常人。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang-l.segmentation: Pity us soldiers—we alone seem treated as less than human.
匪兕匪虎，率彼旷野。
sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang-l.explanation: 我们不是野牛也不是虎，却要在旷野上奔跑。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang-l.segmentation: We are neither rhinos nor tigers, yet we are driven through the wild wastes.
哀我征夫，朝夕不暇。
sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang-l.explanation: 可怜我们这些征夫，从早到晚没有闲暇。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang-l.segmentation: Pity us soldiers—we have no rest from morning till night.
有芃者狐，率彼幽草。
sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang-l.explanation: 有蓬乱的狐狸，奔跑在深草中。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang-l.segmentation: A shaggy fox runs through the deep grass.
有栈之车，行彼周道。
sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang-l.explanation: 有栅栏高车的兵车，却行在大道上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-hecaobuhuang-l.segmentation: There are wagons with high sideboards, yet they travel the royal highway.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l001.explanation: 瓠叶轻轻摆动，采下来煮着吃。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l001.segmentation: Gourd leaves flutter; gather them and boil them to eat.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l002.explanation: 君子备有美酒，斟来请你先尝。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l002.segmentation: The host has fine wine; pour a cup and taste it first.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l003.explanation: 有野兔一个头，烧烤又炙烤。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l003.segmentation: There is a hare's head, roasted and then broiled.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l004.explanation: 君子备有美酒，斟来献给你。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l004.segmentation: The host has fine wine; pour and offer it to the guest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l005.explanation: 有野兔一个头，炙烤又烧烤。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l005.segmentation: There is a hare's head, broiled and roasted again.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l006.explanation: 君子备有美酒，斟来请你回敬。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l006.segmentation: The host has fine wine; pour for the guest to return the toast.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l007.explanation: 有野兔一个头，烧烤又炮炙。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l007.segmentation: There is a hare's head, roasted by fire once more.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l008.explanation: 君子备有美酒，斟来相互酬答。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-huye-l008.segmentation: The host has fine wine; pour and exchange toasts in reply.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.explanation: 山石高峻陡峭，那是多么高啊。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.segmentation: The crags rise steep and high—how towering they are!

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.explanation: 山川路途遥远，征役多么劳苦。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.segmentation: Mountains and rivers stretch far; how weary the campaign is.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.explanation: 武士东征，连早晨的休整都顾不上。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.segmentation: The warriors march east and cannot even pause for morning rest.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.explanation: 山石高峻陡峭，那是多么险啊。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.segmentation: The crags rise steep and perilous—how dangerous they are!

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.explanation: 山川路途遥远，何时才能走到尽头？

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.segmentation: Mountains and rivers stretch far—when will we reach the end?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.explanation: 武士东征，连出门的工夫都没有。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.segmentation: The warriors march east and have no leisure even to step outside.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.explanation: 有猪白蹄，成群涉水过河。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.segmentation: Pigs with white hooves wade the waves in herds.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.explanation: 月亮靠近毕宿，于是大雨倾盆。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.segmentation: The moon nears the Net constellation, and torrents pour down.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.explanation: 武士东征，顾不上别的什么了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jianjianzhishi.segmentation: The warriors march east and can think of nothing else.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l001.explanation: 调好的角弓，弓弦却松弛反曲。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l001.segmentation: The horn bow is strung, yet the string slackens and turns back.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l002.explanation: 兄弟姻亲，不要彼此疏远。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l002.segmentation: Brothers and in-laws should not grow distant from one another.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l003.explanation: 你疏远亲族，百姓也会跟着疏远。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l003.segmentation: When you keep kin at a distance, the people follow your example.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l004.explanation: 你的教化如此，百姓也会照样仿效。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l004.segmentation: Whatever you teach, the people will imitate in turn.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l005.explanation: 这些贤良的兄弟，宽和而有余裕。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l005.segmentation: Good brothers are generous and ample in forbearance.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l006.explanation: 不贤的兄弟，互相加害愈甚。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l006.segmentation: Wicked brothers only harm each other the more.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l007.explanation: 人心不良，在同一处互相埋怨。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l007.segmentation: When hearts turn bad, they blame one another on the same side.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l008.explanation: 受爵却不谦让，最终会自取灭亡。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l008.segmentation: Those who accept rank without yielding bring ruin upon themselves.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l009.explanation: 老马被当作驹马使唤，不顾身后祸患。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l009.segmentation: An old horse is treated like a colt, with no thought for what follows.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l010.explanation: 像吃饭该吃饱，像饮酒该适度。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l010.segmentation: As food should satisfy hunger, so drinking should stay within measure.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l011.explanation: 不要教猴子爬树，（恶人）会像泥涂一样附上来。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l011.segmentation: Do not teach the ape to climb trees—evil will stick to you like mud on mud.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l012.explanation: 君子有善道，小人也来追随。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l012.segmentation: When the gentleman has a good path, petty men attach themselves to him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l013.explanation: 雨雪纷纷飘落，一见日头就说要化。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l013.segmentation: Snow falls thick; at the first sun they say it will melt.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l014.explanation: 不肯向下施惠，反而居处骄慢。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l014.segmentation: They will not condescend to show kindness, but dwell in arrogance instead.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l015.explanation: 雨雪飘飘落下，一见日头就说要流走。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l015.segmentation: Snow drifts down; at the first sun they say it will run off.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l016.explanation: 像南蛮、像髠人，因此我深感忧虑。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-jiaogong-l016.segmentation: Like southern barbarians, like shorn tribesmen—this is what fills me with care.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l001.explanation: 小小的黄鸟，停在山丘的弯曲处。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l001.segmentation: A small yellow bird rests on the bend of a hill.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l002.explanation: 道路那样遥远，我的劳苦怎么说得清。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l002.segmentation: The road is so far—how can I tell all my weariness?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l003.explanation: 给他水喝给他饭吃，又教导又训诲。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l003.segmentation: Give him drink and food, and teach and instruct him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l004.explanation: 命令后面的随从车，叫他们载他同行。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l004.segmentation: Tell the escort wagon behind to take him aboard.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l005.explanation: 小小的黄鸟，停在山丘的角落。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l005.segmentation: A small yellow bird rests in the corner of a hill.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l006.explanation: 哪敢怕走路，只怕赶不上队伍。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l006.segmentation: I dare not fear the journey—I fear I cannot keep up.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l007.segmentation: Give him drink; give him food.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l009.explanation: 命令后面的随从车，叫他们载他同行。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l009.segmentation: Tell the escort wagon behind to take him aboard.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l010.explanation: 小小的黄鸟，停在山丘旁边。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l010.segmentation: A small yellow bird rests beside the hill.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l011.explanation: 哪敢怕走路，只怕走不到终点。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l011.segmentation: I dare not fear the journey—I fear I cannot reach the end.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l012.explanation: 给他水喝给他饭吃，又教导又训诲。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l012.segmentation: Give him drink and food, and teach and instruct him.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l013.explanation: 命令后面的随从车，叫他们载他同行。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-mianman-l013.segmentation: Tell the escort wagon behind to take him aboard.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua-l00.segmentation: The trumpet-creeper blooms have turned yellow.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua-l00.explanation: 心中的忧愁，实在令人伤怀！

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua-l00.segmentation: Sorrow in the heart—how deeply it wounds!

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua-l00.explanation: 凌霄花开，它的叶子还青青。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua-l00.segmentation: The trumpet-creeper's leaves are still fresh and green.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua-l00.explanation: 明知我落到这般境地，还不如不曾出生！

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua-l00.segmentation: Knowing my plight as this, I wish I had never been born!

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua-l00.explanation: 公羊头变大，三星已移到鱼笱旁。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua-l00.segmentation: A ram's head swells large while the Three Stars stand by the fish trap.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua-l00.explanation: 人本来可以靠食物充饥，如今却难得吃饱！

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shaozhihua-l00.segmentation: People could live on food, yet now they can scarcely fill their bellies!

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l001.explanation: 黍苗长得茂盛，阴雨滋润它。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l001.segmentation: Millet shoots grow lush, nourished by rainy skies.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l002.explanation: 悠悠南行，召伯在那里慰劳众人。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l002.segmentation: Far south we travel; Lord Zhao labors there to comfort the people.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l003.segmentation: I bear loads and carry burdens; I have carts and oxen.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l004.explanation: 我的行程已经完成，该是回家的时候了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l004.segmentation: My journey is done—it is time to turn homeward.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l005.segmentation: My runners and drivers, my officers and troops.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l006.explanation: 我的行程已经完成，该是归处的时候了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l006.segmentation: My journey is done—it is time to settle and return.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l007.explanation: 谢地工程整齐完成，召伯营建它。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l007.segmentation: The work at Xie is finished in good order—Lord Zhao planned it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l008.explanation: 征师威武严整，召伯成全它。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l008.segmentation: The campaign host is bold and arrayed—Lord Zhao brought it to completion.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l009.explanation: 原野和低地已经平整，泉流已经清澈。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l009.segmentation: Plains and lowlands are level; streams run clear.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l010.explanation: 召伯功业有成，君王的心也就安宁了。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-shumiao-l010.segmentation: Lord Zhao's task succeeds, and the king's heart is at peace.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l001.explanation: 有茂盛的柳树，却不许在它下面休息。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l001.segmentation: There is a lush willow, yet one may not rest beneath it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l002.explanation: 上帝反复无常，不要自己亲近（他）。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l002.segmentation: Heaven's ways are fickle—do not draw too close on your own.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l003.explanation: 当初让我安定国事，后来却使我遭祸。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l003.segmentation: First I was set to pacify the realm, then I was brought to ruin.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l004.explanation: 有茂盛的柳树，却不许在它下面歇息。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l004.segmentation: There is a lush willow, yet one may not linger beneath it.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l005.explanation: 上帝反复无常，不要自己招致病害。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l005.segmentation: Heaven's ways are fickle—do not invite affliction yourself.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l006.explanation: 当初让我安定国事，后来却使我被放逐。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l006.segmentation: First I was set to pacify the realm, then I was cast far away.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l007.explanation: 有鸟高飞，也还要依附于天。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l007.segmentation: A bird soars high, yet still depends upon the sky.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l008.explanation: 那个人的心思，究竟要走到哪一步？

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l008.segmentation: That man's heart—how far will it go?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l009.explanation: 为何让我安定国事，却居处凶险之地？

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-wanliu-l009.segmentation: Why set me to pacify the state, only to leave me in peril?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l001.explanation: 低湿之地有桑树，它的叶子多么柔美。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l001.segmentation: In the moist lowland stand mulberries; how lovely their leaves.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l002.explanation: 已经见到君子，快乐怎么说得尽。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l002.segmentation: I have met my lord—how boundless my joy!

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l003.explanation: 低湿之地有桑树，它的叶子多么润泽。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l003.segmentation: In the moist lowland stand mulberries; how lush and moist their leaves.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l004.explanation: 已经见到君子，怎能不快乐。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l004.segmentation: I have met my lord—how could I not rejoice?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l005.explanation: 低湿之地有桑树，它的叶子多么深青。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l005.segmentation: In the moist lowland stand mulberries; how deep green their leaves.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l006.explanation: 已经见到君子，他的德音多么和悦。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l006.segmentation: I have met my lord; his virtuous words are warm and binding.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l007.explanation: 心里多么爱他，为何不说出口？

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l007.segmentation: My heart loves him so—why do I not speak it out?

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l008.explanation: 藏在心中，哪一天能够忘记！

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-xisang-l008.segmentation: I hide it in my heart—what day could I ever forget!

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao-l001.explanation: 鱼在水藻中游，头摆得很大。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao-l001.segmentation: Fish swim among the weeds, their heads held high and broad.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao-l002.segmentation: The king is at Hao, drinking in ease and joy.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao-l003.explanation: 鱼在水藻中游，尾巴摆得很大。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao-l003.segmentation: Fish swim among the weeds, their tails spread wide.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao-l004.explanation: 王在镐京，饮酒多么快乐。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao-l004.segmentation: The king is at Hao—how merry he is with his wine.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao-l005.explanation: 鱼在水藻中游，依傍着蒲草。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao-l005.segmentation: Fish swim among the weeds, resting close to the rushes.

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao-l006.explanation: 王在镐京，所居多么安适。

sj-ya-xiaoya-yuzaozhishen-yuzao-l006.segmentation: The king is at Hao; how pleasant and secure his dwelling.

szj-01-l001.segmentation: 人之初，性本善，性相近，习相远。
szj-01-l001.explanation: 人刚出生时，本性原是善良的；天性彼此相近，只因后天习染不同，才渐渐相差很远。

szj-01-l001.segmentation: At birth, human nature is good; natures are alike, but habits drive people far apart.

szj-01-l002.segmentation: 苟不教，性乃迁，教之道，贵以专。
szj-01-l002.explanation: 如果不好好教育，善良的本性就会改变；教育的方法，最要紧的是专心一贯。

szj-01-l002.segmentation: Without teaching, that nature drifts; the way of teaching prizes focus and constancy.

szj-01-l003.segmentation: 昔孟母，择邻处，子不学，断机杼。
szj-01-l003.explanation: 从前孟子的母亲为了孩子多次迁居选好邻居；孟子贪玩不学时，她割断织布机上的布来警醒他。

szj-01-l003.segmentation: Mencius’s mother chose good neighbors; when he neglected study, she cut the loom to wake him.

szj-01-l004.segmentation: 窦燕山，有义方，教五子，名俱扬。
szj-01-l004.explanation: 窦燕山懂得教子的正当方法，教育五个儿子，个个都扬名于世。

szj-01-l004.segmentation: Dou Yanshan had a rightful way of teaching; he raised five sons, and all won renown.

szj-01-l005.segmentation: 养不教，父之过，教不严，师之惰。
szj-01-l005.explanation: 只抚养而不教育，是父亲的过失；教育而不严格，是老师的怠惰。

szj-01-l005.segmentation: To rear without teaching is a father’s fault; to teach without strictness is a teacher’s sloth.

szj-01-l006.segmentation: 子不学，非所宜，幼不学，老何为？
szj-01-l006.explanation: 孩子不肯学习，本就不对；小时候不学，长大了又能做什么？

szj-01-l006.segmentation: For a child not to learn is wrong; if youth skips study, what can age achieve?

szj-01-l007.segmentation: 玉不琢，不成器，人不学，不知义。
szj-01-l007.explanation: 玉不雕琢，就成不了器皿；人不学习，就不懂得道理与道义。

szj-01-l007.segmentation: Jade uncarved cannot become a vessel; people untaught cannot know what is right.

szj-01-l008.segmentation: 为人子，方少时，亲师友，习礼仪。
szj-01-l008.explanation: 做子女的，正当年少时，要亲近老师朋友，学习礼仪规矩。

szj-01-l008.segmentation: As a child, while still young, draw close to teachers and friends, and practice ritual and courtesy.

szj-01-l009.segmentation: 香九龄，能温席，孝于亲，所当执。
szj-01-l009.explanation: 黄香九岁就能在寒冬为父亲暖被，孝敬父母，是人人应当践行的。

szj-01-l009.segmentation: At nine, Huang Xiang warmed his father’s bed; filial care of parents is what one ought to keep.

szj-01-l010.segmentation: 融四岁，能让梨，悌于长，宜先知。
szj-01-l010.explanation: 孔融四岁就懂得把大梨让给兄长，敬爱兄长的道理，应当尽早明白。

szj-01-l010.segmentation: At four, Kong Rong yielded the larger pear; respect for elders should be learned first.

szj-01-l011.segmentation: 首孝弟，次见闻，知某数，识某文。
szj-01-l011.explanation: 首先要懂得孝悌，其次增长见闻；还要认识数字，识得文字。

szj-01-l011.segmentation: First come filial piety and fraternal duty, then knowledge; know numbers and learn the written word.

szj-01-l012.segmentation: 一而十，十而百，百而千，千而万。
szj-01-l012.explanation: 从一到十，十到百，百到千，千到万，数目层层递进。

szj-01-l012.segmentation: From one to ten, ten to a hundred, hundred to a thousand, thousand to ten thousand.

szj-01-l013.segmentation: 三才者，天地人，三光者，日月星。
szj-01-l013.explanation: 所谓三才，就是天、地、人；所谓三光，就是日、月、星。

szj-01-l013.segmentation: The Three Powers are Heaven, Earth, and Man; the Three Lights are sun, moon, and stars.

szj-01-l014.segmentation: 三纲者，君臣义，父子亲，夫妇顺。
szj-01-l014.explanation: 所谓三纲：君臣有义，父子相亲，夫妇和顺。

szj-01-l014.segmentation: The Three Bonds: duty between ruler and subject, affection of father and child, harmony of husband and wife.

szj-01-l015.segmentation: 曰春夏，曰秋冬，此四时，运不穷。
szj-01-l015.explanation: 春夏秋冬，这四季循环运转，没有穷尽。

szj-01-l015.segmentation: Spring, summer, autumn, winter—the four seasons turn without end.

szj-01-l016.segmentation: 曰南北，曰西东，此四方，应乎中。
szj-01-l016.explanation: 南北东西，这四方相对于中央而确定。

szj-01-l016.segmentation: South, north, west, east—the four directions answer to the center.

szj-01-l017.segmentation: 曰水火，木金土，此五行，本乎数。
szj-01-l017.explanation: 水火木金土，这五行，本于天地自然之数。

szj-01-l017.segmentation: Water, fire, wood, metal, earth—the Five Phases rest on number and order.

szj-01-l018.segmentation: 曰仁义，礼智信，此五常，不容紊。
szj-01-l018.explanation: 仁义礼智信，这五常，秩序不容混乱。

szj-01-l018.segmentation: Benevolence, rightness, ritual, wisdom, trust—the Five Constants must not be disordered.

szj-01-l019.segmentation: 稻粱菽，麦黍稷，此六谷，人所食。
szj-01-l019.explanation: 稻、粱、菽、麦、黍、稷，这六谷，是人们食用的粮食。

szj-01-l019.segmentation: Rice, millet, beans, wheat, glutinous millet, and broomcorn—these six grains are what people eat.

szj-01-l020.segmentation: 马牛羊，鸡犬豕，此六畜，人所饲。
szj-01-l020.explanation: 马、牛、羊、鸡、狗、猪，这六畜，是人们饲养的牲畜。

szj-01-l020.segmentation: Horse, ox, sheep, chicken, dog, and pig—these six livestock are what people raise.

szj-01-l021.segmentation: 曰喜怒，曰哀惧，爱恶欲，七情具。
szj-01-l021.explanation: 喜、怒、哀、惧、爱、恶、欲，这七情人都具备。

szj-01-l021.segmentation: Joy, anger, sorrow, fear, love, hate, and desire—the seven feelings are all in us.

szj-01-l022.segmentation: 匏土革，木石金，丝与竹，乃八音。
szj-01-l022.explanation: 匏、土、革、木、石、金、丝、竹，合称八音，是古代乐器的类别。

szj-01-l022.segmentation: Gourd, clay, hide, wood, stone, metal, silk, and bamboo—these make the Eight Tones.

szj-01-l023.segmentation: 高曾祖，父而身，身而子，子而孙。
szj-01-l023.explanation: 从高祖、曾祖、祖父到父亲再到自己，自己再生儿子，儿子再生孙子。

szj-01-l023.segmentation: From great-great-grandfather and great-grandfather to father and self, then son, then grandson.

szj-01-l024.segmentation: 自子孙，至玄曾，乃九族，人之伦。
szj-01-l024.explanation: 从子孙再传到玄孙、曾孙，共为九族，这是人伦的辈分。

szj-01-l024.segmentation: From sons and grandsons on to great-great-grandsons—the nine degrees of kinship, the human order.

szj-01-l025.segmentation: 父子恩，夫妇从，兄则友，弟则恭。
szj-01-l025.explanation: 父子讲恩情，夫妇相随和顺，兄长友爱，弟弟恭敬。

szj-01-l025.segmentation: Father and son share kindness; husband and wife concord; the elder brother is friendly, the younger respectful.

szj-01-l026.segmentation: 长幼序，友与朋，君则敬，臣则忠。
szj-01-l026.explanation: 长幼有次序，朋友讲信义；君主要受人敬重，臣下应当忠诚。

szj-01-l026.segmentation: Age keeps its order among kin and friends; the ruler is honored, the minister loyal.

szj-01-l027.explanation: 以上十种伦理道义，是人人共同应当遵守的。

szj-01-l027.segmentation: These ten duties are what people share in common.

szj-02-l001.segmentation: 凡训蒙，须讲究，详训诂，明句读。
szj-02-l001.explanation: 凡是教导蒙童，必须讲究方法：详细讲解字词，分明句子的停顿。

szj-02-l001.segmentation: In teaching the young, be careful: explain the glosses in detail and mark the pauses of the sentence.

szj-02-l002.segmentation: 为学者，必有初，小学终，至四书。
szj-02-l002.explanation: 求学一定要有起点：先学完小学（文字训诂），再进而读四书。

szj-02-l002.segmentation: Learners must begin at the start: finish the elementary learning, then go on to the Four Books.

szj-02-l003.segmentation: 论语者，二十篇，群弟子，记善言。
szj-02-l003.explanation: 《论语》共二十篇，是孔子门下弟子记录老师嘉言的书。

szj-02-l003.segmentation: The Analects has twenty chapters; the disciples recorded the Master’s good words.

szj-02-l004.segmentation: 孟子者，七篇止，讲道德，说仁义。
szj-02-l004.explanation: 《孟子》只有七篇，讲的是道德修养，阐发仁义之道。

szj-02-l004.segmentation: Mencius stops at seven books; it teaches moral virtue and speaks of benevolence and right.

szj-02-l005.segmentation: 作中庸，子思笔，中不偏，庸不易。
szj-02-l005.explanation: 《中庸》是子思所写：中是不偏不倚，庸是平常不易之理。

szj-02-l005.segmentation: The Doctrine of the Mean was written by Zisi: the Mean is not leaning; the Constant does not change.

szj-02-l006.segmentation: 作大学，乃曾子，自修齐，至平治。
szj-02-l006.explanation: 《大学》是曾子所作，从修身齐家讲到治国平天下。

szj-02-l006.segmentation: The Great Learning is by Zengzi: from self-cultivation and ordering the family to governing and pacifying all under Heaven.

szj-02-l007.segmentation: 孝经通，四书熟，如六经，始可读。
szj-02-l007.explanation: 《孝经》通晓、四书熟读之后，才可以开始阅读六经。

szj-02-l007.segmentation: When the Classic of Filial Piety is clear and the Four Books familiar, one may begin the Six Classics.

szj-02-l008.segmentation: 诗书易，礼春秋，号六经，当讲求。
szj-02-l008.explanation: 《诗》《书》《易》《礼》《春秋》等合称六经，应当用心研读。

szj-02-l008.segmentation: Poetry, Documents, Changes, Rites, and Spring and Autumn—called the Six Classics—deserve careful study.

szj-02-l009.segmentation: 有连山，有归藏，有周易，三易祥。
szj-02-l009.explanation: 有《连山》、有《归藏》、有《周易》，三部易书内容详备。

szj-02-l009.segmentation: There are the Lianshan, the Guicang, and the Zhouyi—the three Changes, complete and clear.

szj-02-l010.segmentation: 有典谟，有训诰，有誓命，书之奥。
szj-02-l010.explanation: 典、谟、训、诰、誓、命，是《尚书》中深奥的文体类别。

szj-02-l010.segmentation: Canons, counsels, instructions, announcements, oaths, and charges—the deep forms of the Documents.

szj-02-l011.segmentation: 我周公，作周礼，著六官，存治体。
szj-02-l011.explanation: 周公作《周礼》，设立六官制度，保存了治国的体制。

szj-02-l011.segmentation: The Duke of Zhou made the Rites of Zhou, set out the Six Offices, and preserved the form of government.

szj-02-l012.segmentation: 大小戴，注礼记，述圣言，礼乐备。
szj-02-l012.explanation: 大戴、小戴为《礼记》作注，记述圣人言论，礼乐于是完备。

szj-02-l012.segmentation: The Elder and Younger Dai annotated the Record of Rites, transmitting the sages’ words; ritual and music are complete.

szj-02-l013.segmentation: 曰国风，曰雅颂，号四诗，当讽咏。
szj-02-l013.explanation: 国风、雅、颂合称四诗，应当讽诵吟咏。

szj-02-l013.segmentation: The Airs, the Odes, and the Hymns—called the Four Songs—ought to be chanted and sung.

szj-02-l014.segmentation: 诗既亡，春秋作，寓褒贬，别善恶。
szj-02-l014.explanation: 采诗的风气衰亡后，孔子作《春秋》，寄托褒贬，分辨善恶。

szj-02-l014.segmentation: When the Songs declined, the Spring and Autumn was made: it embeds praise and blame, and sorts good from evil.

szj-02-l015.segmentation: 三传者，有公羊，有左氏，有谷梁。
szj-02-l015.explanation: 解说《春秋》的三传，有《公羊传》《左传》《谷梁传》。

szj-02-l015.segmentation: The three commentaries are the Gongyang, the Zuo, and the Guliang.

szj-02-l016.segmentation: 经既明，方读子，撮其要，记其事。
szj-02-l016.explanation: 经典明白之后，才读诸子；抓住要点，记住其中的事迹道理。

szj-02-l016.segmentation: When the classics are clear, then read the philosophers: grasp the essentials and remember their affairs.

szj-02-l017.segmentation: 五子者，有荀扬，文中子，及老庄。
szj-02-l017.explanation: 五子指荀子、扬子、文中子，以及老子、庄子。

szj-02-l017.segmentation: The five masters include Xun and Yang, Master Wenzhong, and also Laozi and Zhuangzi.

szj-03-l001.segmentation: 经子通，读诸史，考世系，知终始。
szj-03-l001.explanation: 经书和子书通晓后，再读各种史书：考察世系传承，明白朝代的终始。

szj-03-l001.segmentation: When classics and philosophers are clear, read the histories: examine lineages and know how dynasties begin and end.

szj-03-l002.segmentation: 自羲农，至黄帝，号三皇，居上世。
szj-03-l002.explanation: 从伏羲、神农到黄帝，合称三皇，处于上古之世。

szj-03-l002.segmentation: From Fu Xi and Shen Nong to the Yellow Emperor—called the Three Sovereigns—they belong to high antiquity.

szj-03-l003.segmentation: 唐有虞，号二帝，相揖逊，称盛世。
szj-03-l003.explanation: 唐尧、虞舜称为二帝，禅让相传，被称作太平盛世。

szj-03-l003.segmentation: Tang Yao and Yu Shun are called the Two Emperors; they yielded the throne in turn—an age called flourishing.

szj-03-l004.segmentation: 夏有禹，商有汤，周文武，称三王。
szj-03-l004.explanation: 夏禹、商汤、周文王与武王，合称三王。

szj-03-l004.segmentation: Yu of Xia, Tang of Shang, and Kings Wen and Wu of Zhou are called the Three Kings.

szj-03-l005.segmentation: 夏传子，家天下，四百载，迁夏社。
szj-03-l005.explanation: 夏朝传位给儿子，变为家天下；约四百年后，夏朝社稷迁易灭亡。

szj-03-l005.segmentation: Xia passed the throne to sons—a family realm; after some four hundred years, Xia’s altars fell.

szj-03-l006.segmentation: 汤伐夏，国号商，六百载，至纣亡。
szj-03-l006.explanation: 商汤讨伐夏桀，国号为商；约六百年传到纣王而亡。

szj-03-l006.segmentation: Tang struck down Xia and named the realm Shang; after some six hundred years it ended with Zhou.

szj-03-l007.segmentation: 周武王，始诛纣，八百载，最长久。
szj-03-l007.explanation: 周武王诛灭纣王，周朝延续约八百年，最为长久。

szj-03-l007.segmentation: King Wu of Zhou first slew Zhou of Shang; for some eight hundred years Zhou lasted longest.

szj-03-l008.segmentation: 周撤东，王纲坠，逞干戈，尚游说。
szj-03-l008.explanation: 周室东迁后，王权纲纪坠落，诸侯动用武力，游说之士盛行。

szj-03-l008.segmentation: When Zhou moved east, the royal order fell; arms were flaunted, and traveling persuaders thrived.

szj-03-l009.segmentation: 始春秋，终战国，五霸强，七雄出。
szj-03-l009.explanation: 从春秋到战国：先有五霸称强，后有七雄并起。

szj-03-l009.segmentation: From Spring and Autumn to the Warring States: the Five Hegemons rose strong, then the Seven Powers emerged.

szj-03-l010.segmentation: 嬴秦氏，始兼并，传二世，楚汉争。
szj-03-l010.explanation: 秦国嬴氏开始兼并天下，只传二世，便陷入楚汉相争。

szj-03-l010.segmentation: The Ying house of Qin first united the realm; after two reigns came the struggle of Chu and Han.

szj-03-l011.segmentation: 高祖兴，汉业建，至孝平，王莽篡。
szj-03-l011.explanation: 汉高祖兴起，建立汉朝基业；传到汉平帝时，被王莽篡夺。

szj-03-l011.segmentation: Gaozu rose and founded the Han; by Emperor Ping, Wang Mang usurped the throne.

szj-03-l012.segmentation: 光武兴，为东汉，四百年，终于献。
szj-03-l012.explanation: 光武帝兴起，建立东汉；前后约四百年，到汉献帝时终结。

szj-03-l012.segmentation: Guangwu rose and made the Eastern Han; some four hundred years later it ended with Emperor Xian.

szj-03-l013.segmentation: 魏蜀吴，争汉鼎，号三国，迄两晋。
szj-03-l013.explanation: 魏、蜀、吴争夺汉朝天下，称为三国，其后进入两晋。

szj-03-l013.segmentation: Wei, Shu, and Wu fought for Han’s cauldron—called the Three Kingdoms—until the two Jin.

szj-03-l014.segmentation: 宋齐继，梁陈承，为南朝，都金陵。
szj-03-l014.explanation: 宋、齐相继，梁、陈承接，合称南朝，都城在金陵。

szj-03-l014.segmentation: Song and Qi followed, Liang and Chen continued—the Southern Dynasties, capital at Jinling.

szj-03-l015.segmentation: 北元魏，分东西，宇文周，与高齐。
szj-03-l015.explanation: 北方有元魏，后来分成东魏、西魏；又有宇文氏的北周与高氏的北齐。

szj-03-l015.segmentation: In the north, the Yuan Wei split east and west; then came the Yuwen Zhou and the Gao Qi.

szj-03-l016.segmentation: 迨至隋，一土宇，不再传，失统绪。
szj-03-l016.explanation: 到了隋朝统一天下，却未能再传多久，便失去了统治的统绪。

szj-03-l016.segmentation: When Sui came, it unified the land; it did not pass on long, and lost the thread of rule.

szj-03-l017.segmentation: 唐高祖，起义师，除隋乱，创国基。
szj-03-l017.explanation: 唐高祖起兵起义，扫除隋末乱局，开创唐朝国基。

szj-03-l017.segmentation: Gaozu of Tang raised righteous troops, cleared Sui’s chaos, and laid the dynasty’s foundation.

szj-03-l018.segmentation: 二十传，三百载，梁灭之，国乃改。
szj-03-l018.explanation: 唐朝传二十代、约三百年，后梁灭唐，国号于是改变。

szj-03-l018.segmentation: Through twenty reigns and some three hundred years, Liang destroyed it and the state was renamed.

szj-03-l019.segmentation: 梁唐晋，及汉周，称五代，皆有由。
szj-03-l019.explanation: 后梁、后唐、后晋、后汉、后周，合称五代，各有兴替的缘由。

szj-03-l019.segmentation: Liang, Tang, Jin, Han, and Zhou—called the Five Dynasties—each had its cause.

szj-03-l020.segmentation: 炎宋兴，受周禅，十八传，南北混。
szj-03-l020.explanation: 赵宋兴起，接受后周禅让；传十八帝，经历北宋与南宋。

szj-03-l020.segmentation: The fiery Song rose, receiving Zhou’s abdication; through eighteen reigns north and south were joined in one story.

szj-03-l021.segmentation: 辽与金，皆称帝，元灭金，绝宋世。
szj-03-l021.explanation: 辽与金都称帝；元朝灭金，又断绝了宋朝的国祚。

szj-03-l021.segmentation: Liao and Jin both claimed the imperial title; Yuan destroyed Jin and cut off the Song.

szj-03-l022.segmentation: 莅中国，兼戎狄，九十年，国祚废。
szj-03-l022.explanation: 元朝入主中原，兼统边疆各族，约九十年后国运废止。

szj-03-l022.segmentation: It entered the Central States and ruled the border peoples too; after some ninety years the mandate failed.

szj-03-l023.segmentation: 太祖兴，国大明，号洪武，都金陵。
szj-03-l023.explanation: 明太祖兴起，建立大明，年号洪武，定都金陵。

szj-03-l023.segmentation: Taizu rose and founded Great Ming; his reign title was Hongwu, the capital Jinling.

szj-03-l024.segmentation: 迨成祖，迁燕京，十七世，至崇祯。
szj-03-l024.explanation: 到明成祖迁都燕京；明朝传十七世，直到崇祯。

szj-03-l024.segmentation: When Chengzu came, the capital moved to Yanjing; through seventeen reigns it reached Chongzhen.

szj-03-l025.segmentation: 权阉肆，寇如林，至李闯，神器焚。
szj-03-l025.explanation: 权阉横行，盗寇如林；到李自成起事，明朝帝位倾覆。

szj-03-l025.segmentation: Eunuch power ran wild and bandits thronged; with Li Zicheng the sacred vessel was burned.

szj-03-l026.segmentation: 清太祖，膺景命，靖四方，克大定。
szj-03-l026.explanation: 清太祖承受天命，平定四方，使天下大体安定。

szj-03-l026.segmentation: Taizu of Qing received the bright mandate, pacified the four quarters, and brought great order.

szj-03-l027.segmentation: 廿一史，全在兹，载治乱，知兴衰。
szj-03-l027.explanation: 二十一史都在这里概括：记载治乱，使人知道兴衰的道理。

szj-03-l027.segmentation: The twenty-one histories are all here in sum: they record order and chaos, so we know rise and fall.

szj-03-l028.segmentation: 读史者，考实录，通古今，若亲目。
szj-03-l028.explanation: 读史的人要考察实录，贯通古今，如同亲眼看见一般。

szj-03-l028.segmentation: Readers of history should examine the veritable records, master past and present as if seeing with their own eyes.

szj-04-l001.segmentation: 口而诵，心而惟，朝于斯，夕于斯。
szj-04-l001.explanation: 口里诵读，心里思考；早晨在此用功，晚上也在此用功。

szj-04-l001.segmentation: Recite with the mouth, reflect with the mind; morning and evening, keep to this.

szj-04-l002.segmentation: 昔仲尼，师项橐，古圣贤，尚勤学。
szj-04-l002.explanation: 从前孔子也曾向项橐请教；古代圣贤尚且勤奋好学。

szj-04-l002.segmentation: Once Confucius took Xiang Tuo as teacher; even the ancient sages still studied hard.

szj-04-l003.segmentation: 赵中令，读鲁论，彼既仕，学且勤。
szj-04-l003.explanation: 赵普做中书令后仍读《论语》；已经做官，学习依然勤奋。

szj-04-l003.segmentation: Zhao the Grand Councilor still read the Lu Analects; already in office, he kept studying diligently.

szj-04-l004.segmentation: 披蒲编，削竹简，彼无书，且知勉。
szj-04-l004.explanation: 有人用蒲草编书、削竹为简；他们没有现成书籍，尚且知道勉励自己。

szj-04-l004.segmentation: Some wove reed books and pared bamboo slips; without ready books, they still knew to strive.

szj-04-l005.segmentation: 头悬梁，锥刺股，彼不教，自勤苦。
szj-04-l005.explanation: 有人头发悬梁、锥子刺股来驱赶睡意；并非别人逼迫，而是自己勤苦。

szj-04-l005.segmentation: Some hung by the hair from a beam or pricked the thigh with an awl; unprodded by others, they drove themselves hard.

szj-04-l006.segmentation: 如囊萤，如映雪，家虽贫，学不辍。
szj-04-l006.explanation: 像车胤囊萤、孙康映雪那样借光读书；家虽贫穷，学业并不中断。

szj-04-l006.segmentation: Like gathering fireflies in a bag or reading by snow-light: though poor, they did not stop learning.

szj-04-l007.segmentation: 如负薪，如挂角，身虽劳，犹苦卓。
szj-04-l007.explanation: 像负薪读书、挂角诵经那样；身体虽然劳苦，志向依然卓绝。

szj-04-l007.segmentation: Like carrying firewood or hanging books on the horns: though the body toiled, the will stayed firm.

szj-04-l008.segmentation: 苏老泉，二十七，始发奋，读书籍。
szj-04-l008.explanation: 苏老泉二十七岁才发愤读书。

szj-04-l008.segmentation: Su Laoquan at twenty-seven first set his mind and began to read.

szj-04-l009.segmentation: 彼既老，犹悔迟，尔小生，宜早思。
szj-04-l009.explanation: 他年纪已经不小还后悔起步太迟；你们后生，应当及早用心。

szj-04-l009.segmentation: Though already older, he still regretted delay; you young students should think early.

szj-04-l010.segmentation: 若梁灏，八十二，对大廷，魁多士。
szj-04-l010.explanation: 像梁灏八十二岁还能在朝廷对策，考取第一。

szj-04-l010.segmentation: Like Liang Hao at eighty-two: he answered at the great court and headed the scholars.

szj-04-l011.segmentation: 彼既成，众称异，尔小生，宜立志。
szj-04-l011.explanation: 他成功后众人惊叹称奇；你们后生，应当立定志向。

szj-04-l011.segmentation: When he succeeded, all called it wondrous; you young students should set your will.

szj-04-l012.segmentation: 莹八岁，能咏诗，泌七岁，能赋棋。
szj-04-l012.explanation: 祖莹八岁就能咏诗，李泌七岁就能作棋赋。

szj-04-l012.segmentation: Ying at eight could chant verse; Bi at seven could compose on chess.

szj-04-l013.segmentation: 彼颖悟，人称奇，尔幼学，当效之。
szj-04-l013.explanation: 他们聪颖过人，被人称作奇才；你们幼年求学，应当效法。

szj-04-l013.segmentation: Their quick wit was called marvelous; you who study young should take them as models.

szj-04-l014.segmentation: 蔡文姬，能辨琴，谢道韫，能咏吟。
szj-04-l014.explanation: 蔡文姬善于辨识琴音，谢道韫善于咏诗吟诵。

szj-04-l014.segmentation: Cai Wenji could judge the qin; Xie Daoyun could chant and sing.

szj-04-l015.segmentation: 彼女子，且聪敏，尔男子，当自警。
szj-04-l015.explanation: 她们身为女子尚且聪明敏慧；你们男子，更当自我警醒。

szj-04-l015.segmentation: Those girls were already clever and keen; you boys should wake yourselves.

szj-04-l016.segmentation: 唐刘晏，方七岁，举神童，作正字。
szj-04-l016.explanation: 唐朝刘晏才七岁，就被举为神童，担任正字官职。

szj-04-l016.segmentation: Liu Yan of Tang, only seven, was named a prodigy and made Corrector of Characters.

szj-04-l017.segmentation: 彼虽幼，身已仕，尔幼学，勉而致。
szj-04-l017.explanation: 他年纪虽小已经做官；你们幼年求学，也当勉力达到。

szj-04-l017.segmentation: Though young, he already held office; you who study young should strive to reach it.

szj-04-l018.explanation: 有作为的人，也能像他们一样。

szj-04-l018.segmentation: Those who act with purpose can be like this too.

szj-04-l019.segmentation: 犬守夜，鸡司晨，苟不学，曷为人？
szj-04-l019.explanation: 狗会守夜，鸡会报晓；人如果不肯学习，还怎么算人？

szj-04-l019.segmentation: Dogs keep the night, roosters announce the dawn; if one will not learn, how be called human?

szj-04-l020.segmentation: 蚕吐丝，蜂酿蜜，人不学，不如物。
szj-04-l020.explanation: 蚕能吐丝，蜂能酿蜜；人若不学习，连这些小物都不如。

szj-04-l020.segmentation: Silkworms spin silk, bees make honey; if people will not learn, they fall short of these creatures.

szj-04-l021.segmentation: 幼而学，壮而行，上致君，下泽民。
szj-04-l021.explanation: 幼年努力学习，壮年付诸实行：对上辅佐君主，对下造福百姓。

szj-04-l021.segmentation: Learn in youth, act in prime: above, serve the ruler; below, benefit the people.

szj-04-l022.segmentation: 扬名声，显父母，光于前，裕于后。
szj-04-l022.explanation: 使自己声名远扬，让父母荣耀；光耀前人，又惠及后代。

szj-04-l022.segmentation: Raise your name, honor your parents; shed light on those before, and enrich those who follow.

szj-04-l023.segmentation: 人遗子，金满籯，我教子，惟一经。
szj-04-l023.explanation: 别人留给子孙满箱黄金；我教育孩子，只传一部经书。

szj-04-l023.segmentation: Others leave their sons a chest of gold; I teach my child one classic alone.

szj-04-l024.segmentation: 勤有功，戏无益，戒之哉，宜勉力。
szj-04-l024.explanation: 勤奋就有功效，嬉戏没有益处；要警戒啊，应当努力自勉。

szj-04-l024.segmentation: Diligence brings merit; play brings none—take warning, and strive with all your strength.
